Array.name: NPC_Talk_Yese_Balatro_001
Array.english: <size=34>I was super focused…!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku sangat fokus…!!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Yese_Balatro_002
Array.english: And I just discarded the card I needed to play by mistake!
Array.indonesia: Dan aku baru saja membuang kartu yang seharusnya aku mainkan secara tidak sengaja!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Padeuma_Balatro_001
Array.english: Good... a two pair with face cards!
Array.indonesia: Bagus... dua pasang dengan kartu bergambar!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Padeuma_Balatro_002
Array.english: I can conclude the game in this round.
Array.indonesia: Aku bisa mengakhiri permainan di putaran ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman04_Balatro_001
Array.english: I am opening a Card Pack and you're bothering me. Can you go away?
Array.indonesia: Aku sedang membuka Paket Kartu dan kamu menggangguku. Bisakah kamu pergi?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman05_Balatro_001
Array.english: <size=35>This is it! A Joker that completes a straight even when you're missing a card!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ini dia! Joker yang melengkapi straight meski kamu kekurangan satu kartu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_VillageTalk_001
Array.english: Hmm... The villagers seem a bit different than usual.
Array.indonesia: Hmm… Penduduk desa ini tampak sedikit berbeda dari biasanya.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_VillageTalk_002
Array.english: It looks like they are enjoying some type of card game...
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya mereka sedang menikmati semacam permainan kartu…

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_VillageTalk_003
Array.english: Should I go to the <color=#F1DC2B>Game Parlor</color> and ask?
Array.indonesia: Haruskah aku pergi ke <color=#F1DC2B>Ruang Permainan</color> dan bertanya?

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionStart_001
Array.english: <size=33> Haha! Ho! Human, it's been a while! </size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33> Haha! Ho! Manusia, sudah lama tidak bertemu! </size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionStart_002
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(…It feels different here.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(…Rasanya berbeda di sini.)</color>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionStart_003
Array.english: The villagers all seem to be busy with something…\nwhat is happening?
Array.indonesia: Para penduduk desa sepertinya sedang sibuk dengan sesuatu…\napa yang sedang terjadi?

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionStart_004
Array.english: <size=33>Haha…so you have seen...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Haha…jadi kamu sudah melihatnya...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionStart_005
Array.english: <size=34> It's a game called <color=#1DFEAF>Jimbo's Game</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34> Itu adalah permainan bernama <color=#1DFEAF>Permainan Jimbo</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionStart_006
Array.english: <size=36><color=#1DFEAF> Jimbo's game </color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36><color=#1DFEAF> Permainan Jimbo </color>?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionStart_007
Array.english: <size=32>That's right! A game recorded in an ancient book I found... deep in the sea at night...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Benar sekali! Sebuah permainan yang tercatat dalam sebuah buku kuno yang kutemukan… jauh di dasar laut pada malam hari…</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionStart_008
Array.english: <size=33>It's all the rage at the Sea People Village, hehehe...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Permainan ini sedang hits di Desa Orang Laut, hehehe...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionStart_009
Array.english: Hmm... How fun could it be?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Seberapa seru sih?

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionStart_010
Array.english: Are you interested?
Array.indonesia: Kamu tertarik?

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionStart_011
Array.english: You too, human, will be captivated by it. Hehe...
Array.indonesia: Kamu juga, manusia, pasti akan terpikat olehnya. Hehe...

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionStart_012
Array.english: <size=35>I will teach you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Aku akan mengajari kamu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameTalk_Ramo_001
Array.english: By any chance... Have you heard of <color=#1DFEAF>Jimbo's Game</color>?
Array.indonesia: Kebetulan... Apakah kamu pernah mendengar tentang <color=#1DFEAF>Permainan Jimbo</color>?

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameTalk_Ramo_002
Array.english: <size=33>Of course! It's all the rage in the Sea People village!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tentu saja! Permainan itu sedang hits di Desa Suku Laut!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameTalk_Ramo_003
Array.english: Really...? Hmm. Junak told me about it...\nDo you want to try playing?
Array.indonesia: Benarkah...? Hmm. Junak sudah menceritakannya padaku...\nMau coba main?

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameTalk_Ramo_004
Array.english: <size=35>Haha! You are no match for me!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Haha! Kamu bukan lawanku!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Ramo_001
Array.english: <size=35>Woah…! It's gotten weird again!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wah…! Ini jadi aneh lagi!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Ramo_002
Array.english: <size=34>Mhahaha! That's the charm of this game!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Mhahaha! Itulah daya tarik permainan ini!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Ramo_003
Array.english: <size=35> So? Are you ready for a duel?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35> Jadi? Kamu siap duel?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameTalk_Suwam_001
Array.english: Pfft…a human? Playing <color=#1DFEAF>Jimbo's Game</color>…?
Array.indonesia: Pfft… manusia? Main <color=#1DFEAF>Jimbo's Game</color>…?

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameTalk_Suwam_002
Array.english: Junak at the Game Parlor taught me...\nI thought I should get some practice.
Array.indonesia: Junak di Game Parlor yang ngajarin aku...\nAku pikir aku harus latihan dulu.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameTalk_Suwam_003
Array.english: You seriously thought I could be your practice partner?
Array.indonesia: Kamu beneran pikir aku bisa jadi lawan latihannya?

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameTalk_Suwam_004
Array.english: Skill gap...
Array.indonesia: Perbedaan kemampuan...

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameTalk_Suwam_005
Array.english: <size=35>I will make you understand what that's about!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Aku akan membuatmu mengerti apa maksudnya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Suwam_001
Array.english: <size=34>Woah... it changed again…!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wah... berubah lagi…!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Suwam_002
Array.english: Hehehe... I feel a big victory coming today...
Array.indonesia: Hehehe... Aku merasa kemenangan besar akan datang hari ini...

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Suwam_003
Array.english: <size=35>Bring it on! Rookie!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ayo mulai! Pemula!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameTalk_Kazhin_001
Array.english: <size=34>Mm? You know this game, too?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Mm? Kamu juga tahu game ini?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameTalk_Kazhin_002
Array.english: Yes, it looks quite fun, so I am learning how to play it.
Array.indonesia: Ya, kelihatannya cukup seru, jadi aku sedang belajar cara memainkannya.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameTalk_Kazhin_003
Array.english: Haha, then I shouldn't miss this chance to play with you.
Array.indonesia: Haha, kalau begitu aku nggak boleh melewatkan kesempatan main bareng kamu ini.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Kazhin_001
Array.english: Ack! Kazhin, you look...!
Array.indonesia: Aduh! Kazhin, kamu kelihatan...!

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Kazhin_002
Array.english: It's the charm of this game.
Array.indonesia: Itulah daya tarik permainan ini.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameTalk_Mima_001
Array.english: Oh, is this game popular among humans, too?
Array.indonesia: Oh, apakah permainan ini juga populer di kalangan manusia?

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameTalk_Mima_002
Array.english: I just thought it seemed fun, so I'm learning how to play.
Array.indonesia: Aku hanya merasa ini terlihat seru, jadi aku sedang belajar cara memainkannya.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameTalk_Mima_003
Array.english: In that case! Mind if I teach you a thing or two?
Array.indonesia: Kalau begitu! Bolehkah aku mengajari kamu satu atau dua hal?

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Mima_001
Array.english: Hohoho! Don't I look like a Queen?
Array.indonesia: Hohoho! Bukankah aku terlihat seperti seorang Ratu?

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Mima_002
Array.english: You look a bit scary…
Array.indonesia: Kamu terlihat agak menakutkan…

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Mima_003
Array.english: Humans don't grasp the concept of elegance.
Array.indonesia: Manusia tidak memahami konsep keanggunan.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameTalk_Gumo_001
Array.english: <color=#1DFEAF>Jimbo's Game</color>… Yes, I know it.
Array.indonesia: <color=#1DFEAF>Permainan Jimbo</color>… Ya, aku tahu itu.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameTalk_Gumo_002
Array.english: It's a great game to pass the time while waiting for the crops to grow.
Array.indonesia: Ini permainan yang bagus untuk mengisi waktu sambil menunggu tanaman tumbuh.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameTalk_Gumo_003
Array.english: I'll play with you, if you want.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan bermain bersamamu, kalau kamu mau.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Gumo_001
Array.english: Hehehe, I transformed again.
Array.indonesia: Hehehe, aku berubah wujud lagi.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Gumo_002
Array.english: You are the 11th person to witness this form...
Array.indonesia: Kamu adalah orang ke-11 yang menyaksikan wujud ini...

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Gumo_003
Array.english: ...That's quite a lot.
Array.indonesia: ...Itu cukup banyak.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Gumo_004
Array.english: ...Silence. En garde!
Array.indonesia: ...Diam. En garde!

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameTalk_Junak_001
Array.english: I've defeated 5 people, as you asked.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah mengalahkan 5 orang, seperti yang kamu minta.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameTalk_Junak_002
Array.english: <size=34>Oho... I must have underestimated you.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oho. .. Sepertinya aku meremehkanmu.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameTalk_Junak_003
Array.english: Very well. Then I, Junak, the master of <color=#1DFEAF>Jimbo's Game</color>, will take you on.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah. Maka aku, Junak, sang ahli <color=#1DFEAF>Jimbo's Game</color>, akan melawamu.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Junak_001
Array.english: Hehe... I didn't think I would get to show you this side of me again.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... Aku tidak menyangka bisa menunjukkan sisi diriku yang seperti ini lagi padamu.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Junak_002
Array.english: <size=35> I hope your practice has paid off!! </size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35> Semoga latihanmu membuahkan hasil!! </size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Ramo_Cancel_001
Array.english: Aw, that was too easy.
Array.indonesia: Aduh, itu terlalu mudah.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Ramo_Cancel_002
Array.english: Come back after you get better!
Array.indonesia: Kembalilah setelah kamu lebih mahir!

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Suwam_Cancel_001
Array.english: You're not even going to try…
Array.indonesia: Kamu bahkan tidak akan mencoba…

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Suwam_Cancel_002
Array.english: Overwhelmed by my presence? Heh.
Array.indonesia: Terintimidasi oleh kehadiranku? Heh.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Kazhin_Cancel_001
Array.english: Drop by anytime you're ready.
Array.indonesia: Mampirlah kapan saja kamu siap.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Mima_Cancel_001
Array.english: Aw, it was so close.
Array.indonesia: Aduh, nyaris saja.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Mima_Cancel_002
Array.english: You can come back anytime you want, dear.
Array.indonesia: Kamu bisa kembali kapan saja kamu mau, sayang.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Gumo_Cancel_001
Array.english: Heh, no need to hurry.
Array.indonesia: Heh, nggak perlu terburu-buru.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Gumo_Cancel_002
Array.english: Come back when you'd like.
Array.indonesia: Kembalilah kapan pun kamu mau.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Junak_Cancel_001
Array.english: Oh, are you giving up now?
Array.indonesia: Oh, apa kamu menyerah sekarang?

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Junak_Cancel_002
Array.english: Feel free to come back any time, I shall be here waiting.
Array.indonesia: Silakan kembali kapan saja, aku akan menunggumu di sini.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveLose_Ramo_001
Array.english: Ha, it seems you need more practice.
Array.indonesia: Ha, sepertinya kamu perlu lebih banyak latihan.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveLose_Suwam_001
Array.english: Hehe, no shame in being beaten by me.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, tidak ada yang memalukan jika dikalahkan olehku.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveLose_Suwam_002
Array.english: <size=35>It is only natural.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Itu wajar saja.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveLose_Kazhin_001
Array.english: Hahaha! Luck is a part of the game. Don't be too discouraged.
Array.indonesia: Hahaha! Keberuntungan adalah bagian dari permainan. Jangan terlalu kecewa.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveLose_Mima_001
Array.english: Hohoho! I love the thrill of victory!
Array.indonesia: Hohoho! Aku suka sensasi kemenangan!

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveLose_Mima_002
Array.english: That is why I fell in love with this game.
Array.indonesia: Itulah mengapa aku jatuh cinta pada permainan ini.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveLose_Gumo_001
Array.english: Ha, you're a noob.\nCome back after gaining more experience.
Array.indonesia: Ha, kamu masih pemula.\nKembalilah setelah mendapatkan lebih banyak pengalaman.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveLose_Junak_001
Array.english: Ah, did I assign you too easy of a task?
Array.indonesia: Ah, apakah aku memberi tugas yang terlalu mudah padamu?

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveLose_Junak_002
Array.english: My bad, hehe.
Array.indonesia: Maaf ya, hehe.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Ramo_Retry_001
Array.english: Challenging me again?
Array.indonesia: Mau menantangku lagi?

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Ramo_Retry_002
Array.english: Accepting is no trouble at all!
Array.indonesia: Menerimanya tidak masalah sama sekali!

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Suwam_Retry_001
Array.english: A rematch...
Array.indonesia: Pertandingan ulang...

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Suwam_Retry_002
Array.english: Why play again when we already know who the winner will be?
Array.indonesia: Ngapain main lagi kalau kita udah tahu siapa yang bakal menang?

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Suwam_Retry_003
Array.english: <size=35>Bring it on, human!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ayo, manusia!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Kazhin_Retry_001
Array.english: You want another match?
Array.indonesia: Kamu mau main lagi?

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Kazhin_Retry_002
Array.english: I would feel bad if I beat you too easily, hehe.
Array.indonesia: Aku bakal merasa bersalah kalau mengalahkanmu terlalu mudah, hehe.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Mima_Retry_001
Array.english: Are you ready to be bested again?
Array.indonesia: Kamu siap dikalahkan lagi?

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Gumo_Retry_001
Array.english: It's you again. I see you have some tenacity.
Array.indonesia: Kamu lagi. Kupandang kamu cukup gigih.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Gumo_Retry_002
Array.english: But the result will be the same!
Array.indonesia: Tapi hasilnya akan sama saja!

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Junak_Retry_001
Array.english: Are you challenging me again?
Array.indonesia: Apa kamu menantangku lagi?

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Junak_Retry_002
Array.english: I hope you'd put some practice in. An easy opponent is quite boring, hehe.
Array.indonesia: Kuharap kamu sudah berlatih. Lawan yang mudah itu cukup membosankan, hehe.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveWin_Ramo_001
Array.english: Ha! You caught me off guard.
Array.indonesia: Ha! Kamu berhasil mengejutkanku.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveWin_Ramo_002
Array.english: Well, a promise is a promise...
Array.indonesia: Yah, janji adalah janji...

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveWin_Ramo_003
Array.english: Here is my <color=#1DFEAF>Joker</color> card! Hope you use it well.
Array.indonesia: Ini kartu <color=#1DFEAF>Joker</color>-ku! Semoga kamu memanfaatkannya dengan baik.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveWin_Suwam_001
Array.english: I knew this game was strange! There must have been a trick!
Array.indonesia: Aku tahu permainan ini aneh! Pasti ada triknya!

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveWin_Suwam_002
Array.english: But I am a man of my word...
Array.indonesia: Tapi aku orang yang menepati janji...

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveWin_Suwam_003
Array.english: A <color=#1DFEAF>Joker</color> card. Keep it.
Array.indonesia: Kartu <color=#1DFEAF>Joker</color>. Simpan saja.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveWin_Kazhin_001
Array.english: You are better than I thought! It's your win.
Array.indonesia: Kamu lebih hebat dari yang kukira! Kamu yang menang.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveWin_Kazhin_002
Array.english: Here is the <color=#1DFEAF>Joker</color> card I promised. It's yours!
Array.indonesia: Ini kartu <color=#1DFEAF>Joker</color> yang aku janjikan. Ini milikmu!

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveWin_Mima_001
Array.english: My goodness, I lost!?
Array.indonesia: Astaga, aku kalah!?

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveWin_Mima_002
Array.english: Well, what matters is that we had fun!
Array.indonesia: Yah, yang penting kita bersenang-senang!

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveWin_Mima_003
Array.english: Here is the <color=#1DFEAF>Joker</color> card. Take this with you!
Array.indonesia: Ini kartu <color=#1DFEAF>Joker</color>. Bawa ini bersamamu!

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveWin_Gumo_001
Array.english: I did not see that coming…
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak menyangka itu…

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveWin_Gumo_002
Array.english: I accept my defeat. Here, take this <color=#1DFEAF>Joker</color> card.
Array.indonesia: Aku menerima kekalahanku. Ini, ambil kartu <color=#1DFEAF>Joker</color> ini.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionEnd_001
Array.english: <size=35>What...? I, Junak, the master of Jimbo's Game, have been defeated?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Apa...? Aku, Junak, sang ahli Jimbo's Game, telah dikalahkan?!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionEnd_002
Array.english: <size=34>Unbelievable, Mr. Human...</size><color=#C3C3C3>Could it be that you used some kind of trick...?</color>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Luar biasa, Tuan Manusia...</size><color=#C3C3C3>Mungkinkah kamu menggunakan semacam trik...?</color>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionEnd_003
Array.english: What are you talking about?
Array.indonesia: Apa yang kamu bicarakan?

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionEnd_004
Array.english: It.. It's nothing. Here is the promised gift.
Array.indonesia: Itu... Itu bukan apa-apa. Ini hadiah yang dijanjikan.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionEnd_005
Array.english: <size=35>My gift is this <color=#F1DC2B>Jimbo Coin</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Hadiahku adalah <color=#F1DC2B>Koin Jimbo</color> ini.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionEnd_006
Array.english: Just possessing it makes your attacks gradually stronger.
Array.indonesia: Hanya dengan memilikinya, seranganmu akan semakin kuat secara bertahap.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionEnd_007
Array.english: But the effect will disappear if you take damage…
Array.indonesia: Tapi efeknya akan hilang jika kamu terkena serangan…

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionEnd_008
Array.english: <size=35>It feels just like Jimbo's Game, hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Rasanya persis seperti Jimbo's Game, hehe.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionEnd_009
Array.english: Well, if you say so.
Array.indonesia: Yah, kalau kamu bilang begitu.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionEnd_010
Array.english: Honestly, the game itself is quite fun.
Array.indonesia: Sejujurnya, gimnya sendiri cukup seru.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionEnd_011
Array.english: <size=33>I am sure it would sell like crazy if one made a video game out of it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku yakin game ini bakal laris manis kalau dibuat jadi video game!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionEnd_012
Array.english: Haha, who knows? Someone might have already done it somewhere.
Array.indonesia: Haha, siapa tahu? Mungkin sudah ada yang membuatnya di suatu tempat.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionEnd_013
Array.english: Ah, please accept this <color=#1DFEAF>Joker</color> card as a memento as well.
Array.indonesia: Ah, tolong terima kartu <color=#1DFEAF>Joker</color> ini sebagai kenang-kenangan juga.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionEnd_014
Array.english: This Joker card will allow you to make a Flush or a Straight from just 4 cards.
Array.indonesia: Kartu Joker ini akan memungkinkanmu membuat Flush atau Straight hanya dari 4 kartu.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionEnd_015
Array.english: That's why it's my favorite card, hehe.
Array.indonesia: Itulah mengapa ini kartu favoritku, hehe.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionEnd_016
Array.english: If you want a rematch, you know where to find me.
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu mau balas dendam, kamu tahu di mana mencariku.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionEnd_017
Array.english: ...of course, with Bei in your pocket, hehe.
Array.indonesia: ...tentu saja, dengan Bei di saku kamu, hehe.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionNormalGameEnd_001
Array.english: <size=33>Awesome! I collected 5 <color=#1DFEAF>Joker</color> cards.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Keren! Aku sudah mengumpulkan 5 kartu <color=#1DFEAF>Joker</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionNormalGameEnd_002
Array.english: <size=34>Talk to Junak at the Game Parlor.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Bicaralah dengan Junak di Ruang Permainan.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_Start_001
Array.english: Hehe.
Array.indonesia: Hehe.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_Start_002
Array.english: You... changed?!
Array.indonesia: Kamu... berubah?!

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_Start_003
Array.english: Haha, this is the charm of <color=#1DFEAF>Jimbo's Game</color>.
Array.indonesia: Haha, inilah daya tarik <color=#1DFEAF>Permainan Jimbo</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_Start_004
Array.english: I will teach you the rules then.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan mengajarkan aturannya padamu.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_Start_005
Array.english: Listen well, the rules may be a bit complex!
Array.indonesia: Dengarkan baik-baik, aturannya mungkin agak rumit!

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_CardSelectAndPlay_001
Array.english: Choose cards from the hand I just dealt.
Array.indonesia: Pilih kartu dari tumpukan yang baru saja aku bagikan.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_CardSelectAndPlay_002
Array.english: You can choose up to 5 cards.
Array.indonesia: Kamu bisa memilih hingga 5 kartu.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_ScoreCal_001
Array.english: <size=34>Very good, hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Bagus sekali, hehe.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_ScoreCal_002
Array.english: You will receive points based on the highest combination formed with the cards you just selected.
Array.indonesia: Kamu akan mendapatkan poin berdasarkan kombinasi tertinggi yang terbentuk dari kartu yang baru saja kamu pilih.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_ScoreCal_003
Array.english: The higher the number on the cards, the greater your score will be.
Array.indonesia: Semakin tinggi angka pada kartu-kartu tersebut, semakin besar pula skormu.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_ScoreCal_004
Array.english: Oh, if you don't know what kind of combinations there are...
Array.indonesia: Oh, kalau kamu belum tahu kombinasi apa saja yang ada...

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_ScoreCal_005
Array.english: You can check them by pressing the button here.
Array.indonesia: Kamu bisa memeriksanya dengan menekan tombol di sini.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_PokerHandsDetail_001
Array.english: You can see the details of a combination like this.
Array.indonesia: Kamu bisa melihat detail kombinasi seperti ini.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_PokerHandsDetail_002
Array.english: You will get the hang of it after a couple tries.
Array.indonesia: Kamu akan menguasainya setelah mencoba beberapa kali.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_PokerHandsDetail_003
Array.english: You can close the window now.
Array.indonesia: Kamu bisa menutup jendela ini sekarang.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_CardSelectAndDiscard_001
Array.english: Oh, aren't you curious about what to do when there aren't any good combinations?
Array.indonesia: Oh, apa kamu tidak penasaran apa yang harus dilakukan jika tidak ada kombinasi yang bagus?

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_CardSelectAndDiscard_002
Array.english: Use <color=#1DFEAF>Discard</color> in that case!
Array.indonesia: Gunakan <color=#1DFEAF>Discard</color> dalam hal ini!

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_CardSelectAndDiscard_003
Array.english: Boldly discard unnecessary cards and receive new ones.
Array.indonesia: Buanglah kartu yang tidak diperlukan dengan berani dan dapatkan kartu baru.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_CardSelectAndDiscard_004
Array.english: Choose what to discard then, hehe.
Array.indonesia: Pilih kartu mana yang akan dibuang, hehe.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_DiscardDetail_001
Array.english: Perfect. Be careful though. Once discarded, they cannot be used again.
Array.indonesia: Sempurna. Tapi hati-hati. Begitu dibuang, kartu-kartu itu tidak bisa digunakan lagi.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_PlayDiscardCount_001
Array.english: There is a limit on how many cards you can play or discard in a round.
Array.indonesia: Ada batasan jumlah kartu yang bisa kamu mainkan atau buang dalam satu putaran.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_PlayDiscardCount_002
Array.english: If you overlook this limit, you will be in trouble.
Array.indonesia: Jika kamu mengabaikan batasan ini, kamu akan mendapat masalah.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_BlindScore_001
Array.english: Hehe, should we begin the real game, then?
Array.indonesia: Hehe, maukah kita mulai permainan yang sesungguhnya?

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_BlindScore_002
Array.english: The score you see here is the one you must surpass, human.
Array.indonesia: Skor yang kamu lihat di sini adalah skor yang harus kamu lampaui, manusia.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_BlindScore_003
Array.english: You need to score higher than that within the allowed number of plays.
Array.indonesia: Kamu harus mencetak skor lebih tinggi dari itu dalam jumlah permainan yang diizinkan.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_BlindScore_004
Array.english: Why don't you try? It won't take long to score 300 points, hehe.
Array.indonesia: Kenapa kamu tidak mencobanya? Tidak butuh waktu lama untuk mencetak 300 poin, hehe.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_Reward_001
Array.english: I told you, it's easy.
Array.indonesia: Sudah kubilang, ini mudah.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_Reward_002
Array.english: When you win a round like this, you get <color=#1DFEAF>Jimbo Tokens</color>.
Array.indonesia: Saat kamu memenangkan putaran seperti ini, kamu akan mendapatkan <color=#1DFEAF>Jimbo Tokens</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_Reward_003
Array.english: The number of tokens you can earn depends on the number of Jimbo Tokens you have and your remaining Plays.
Array.indonesia: Jumlah token yang bisa kamu dapatkan bergantung pada jumlah Jimbo Tokens yang kamu miliki dan sisa Putaranmu.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_Reward_004
Array.english: So, it would be advantageous to reach the target score with fewer Plays.
Array.indonesia: Jadi, akan lebih menguntungkan jika kamu mencapai skor target dengan jumlah Putaran yang lebih sedikit.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_Reward_005
Array.english: Claim your <color=#1DFEAF>Jimbo Tokens</color> here.
Array.indonesia: Klaim <color=#1DFEAF>Jimbo Tokens</color>-mu di sini.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_BuyJoker_001
Array.english: What are the <color=#1DFEAF>Jimbo Token</color>s for?
Array.indonesia: Untuk apa <color=#1DFEAF>Jimbo Token</color> itu?

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_BuyJoker_002
Array.english: That is a good question! I almost forgot to tell you.
Array.indonesia: Itu pertanyaan yang bagus! Aku hampir lupa memberitahumu.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_BuyJoker_003
Array.english: You can use them to purchase new <color=#1DFEAF>Joker</color> cards.
Array.indonesia: Kamu bisa menggunakannya untuk membeli kartu <color=#1DFEAF>Joker</color> baru.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_BuyJoker_004
Array.english: Each <color=#1DFEAF>Joker</color> card has a different effect.
Array.indonesia: Setiap kartu <color=#1DFEAF>Joker</color> memiliki efek yang berbeda.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_BuyJoker_005
Array.english: Why don't you purchase one yourself?
Array.indonesia: Mengapa kamu tidak membelinya sendiri?

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_Reroll01_001
Array.english: I'm glad there's one you want!
Array.indonesia: Aku senang ada yang kamu inginkan!

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_Reroll01_002
Array.english: But if there isn't any you want, don’t worry.
Array.indonesia: Tapi jika tidak ada yang kamu inginkan, jangan khawatir.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_Reroll01_003
Array.english: For a small amount of <color=#1DFEAF>Jimbo Tokens</color>, I can always show you different Jokers...
Array.indonesia: Dengan sejumlah kecil <color=#1DFEAF>Jimbo Tokens</color>, aku selalu bisa menunjukkan berbagai Joker kepadamu...

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_Reroll01_004
Array.english: <size=34>Why don't you give it a try?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kenapa kamu tidak mencobanya?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_Reroll02_001
Array.english: By the way, each time you use Reroll, it will cost you increasingly more tokens.
Array.indonesia: Ngomong-ngomong, setiap kali kamu menggunakan Reroll, biayanya akan semakin mahal.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_NextBlind_001
Array.english: Proceed to the next round when you're ready.
Array.indonesia: Lanjutkan ke babak berikutnya saat kamu sudah siap.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_NextBlind_002
Array.english: A stage consists of 3 rounds. The final round comes with a special penalty.
Array.indonesia: Satu tahap terdiri dari 3 babak. Babak terakhir memiliki penalti khusus.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_NextBlind_003
Array.english: There will be some kind of restriction, so be prepared... Hehe.
Array.indonesia: Akan ada semacam batasan, jadi bersiaplah... Hehe.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_PlayJoker_001
Array.english: I will give you some extra cards along with the Joker you just purchased. Try them out yourself.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan memberimu beberapa kartu tambahan bersama dengan kartu Joker yang baru saja kamu beli. Cobalah sendiri.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_PlayJoker_002
Array.english: Hands-on experience is the best teacher after all, hehe!
Array.indonesia: Pengalaman langsung memang guru terbaik, hehe!

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_JokerEffect_001
Array.english: <size=33>How did you enjoy the power of the Joker card?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Bagaimana menurutmu kekuatan kartu Joker itu?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_JokerEffect_002
Array.english: There are various types of Joker cards. Some can change the game's rules, while others can grant extra points, so use them to your advantage.
Array.indonesia: Ada berbagai jenis kartu Joker. Beberapa di antaranya bisa mengubah aturan permainan, sementara yang lain bisa memberikan poin tambahan, jadi manfaatkanlah kartu-kartu tersebut untuk keuntunganmu.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_End01_001
Array.english: <size=35>Now, shall we play the game?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Nah, maukah kita mulai bermain?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_End01_002
Array.english: <size=34>But you just explained the rules!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Tapi kamu baru saja menjelaskan aturannya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_End01_003
Array.english: Right, there will be no joy in defeating a beginner who only has basic cards.
Array.indonesia: Benar, tidak ada kesenangan dalam mengalahkan pemula yang hanya memiliki kartu dasar.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_End02_001
Array.english: There are people who play <color=#1DFEAF>Jimbo's Game</color> in the village.
Array.indonesia: Ada orang-orang yang bermain <color=#1DFEAF>Jimbo's Game</color> di desa ini.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_End02_002
Array.english: If you defeat them, you will get a <color=#1DFEAF>Joker</color> card.
Array.indonesia: Jika kamu mengalahkan mereka, kamu akan mendapatkan kartu <color=#1DFEAF>Joker</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_End02_003
Array.english: Let me see... Five should be good. Collect 5 Joker cards and come back to me, hehe.
Array.indonesia: Coba kulihat... Lima seharusnya cukup. Kumpulkan 5 kartu Joker dan kembali temui aku, hehe.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_End02_004
Array.english: <size=34>And I, Junak, will play against you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Dan aku, Junak, akan bertanding melawanmu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_End02_005
Array.english: It's very unlikely, but if you manage to defeat me...
Array.indonesia: Kemungkinannya sangat kecil, tapi jika kamu berhasil mengalahkanku...

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_End02_006
Array.english: I will give you a nice gift, hehe.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan memberimu hadiah yang bagus, hehe.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_End02_007
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(Hmm… I don't think I can trust this guy, but the game looks fun.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Hmm… Aku rasa aku tidak bisa mempercayai orang ini, tapi permainannya kelihatannya seru.)</color>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_Tutorial_End02_008
Array.english: Okay, defeat 5 villagers and collect their <color=#1DFEAF>Joker</color> cards? Got it.
Array.indonesia: Oke, kalahkan 5 penduduk desa dan kumpulkan kartu <color=#1DFEAF>Joker</color> mereka? Paham.

Array.name: Tutorial_Balatro_CardSelect
Array.english: Select up to 5 cards.
Array.indonesia: Pilih maksimal 5 kartu.

Array.name: Tutorial_Balatro_CardPlay
Array.english: Play the selected cards.
Array.indonesia: Mainkan kartu yang dipilih.

Array.name: Tutorial_Balatro_PokerHands
Array.english: Check hand information.
Array.indonesia: Periksa informasi tangan.

Array.name: Tutorial_Balatro_PokerHands_Close
Array.english: Close hand information.
Array.indonesia: Tutup informasi kartu di tangan.

Array.name: Tutorial_Balatro_Discard
Array.english: Discard the selected card.
Array.indonesia: Buang kartu yang dipilih.

Array.name: Tutorial_Balatro_JustPlay
Array.english: Achieve the target score!
Array.indonesia: Raih skor target!

Array.name: Tutorial_Balatro_Reward
Array.english: Claim the reward.
Array.indonesia: Klaim hadiah.

Array.name: Tutorial_Balatro_BuyJoker
Array.english: Purchase a Joker.
Array.indonesia: Beli Joker.

Array.name: Tutorial_Balatro_Reroll
Array.english: Press the Reroll button.
Array.indonesia: Tekan tombol Reroll.

Array.name: Tutorial_Balatro_NextRound
Array.english: Start the next round.
Array.indonesia: Mulai putaran berikutnya.

Array.name: ContentsDesc_Balatro01
Array.english: Achieve the target score by combining high-score cards.\nUse your cards wisely, as there is a limit on the number of Plays and Discards allowed in each round.
Array.indonesia: Raih skor target dengan menggabungkan kartu-kartu bernilai tinggi.\nGunakan kartu-kartu Kamu dengan bijak, karena ada batasan jumlah Langkah dan Pembuangan yang diperbolehkan di setiap putaran.

Array.name: ContentsDesc_Balatro02
Array.english: Utilize <color=#1DFEAF>Joker</color>, a special card of which you can have up to 6.\nHaving multiple <color=#1DFEAF>Joker</color> cards creates synergies, allowing you to achieve even higher scores.
Array.indonesia: Manfaatkan <color=#1DFEAF>Joker</color>, kartu khusus yang dapat Kamu miliki hingga 6 buah.\nMemiliki beberapa kartu <color=#1DFEAF>Joker</color> akan menciptakan sinergi, sehingga Kamu dapat meraih skor yang lebih tinggi lagi.

Array.name: ContentsDesc_Balatro03
Array.english: <color=#1DFEAF>Joker</color> cards can be purchased from the store.\nIf you don't find a Joker card you like, refresh the stock using Reroll.
Array.indonesia: Kartu <color=#1DFEAF>Joker</color> dapat dibeli dari toko.\nJika kamu tidak menemukan kartu Joker yang kamu sukai, segarkan stoknya menggunakan Reroll.

Array.name: PartyEvent_Title_14150001
Array.english: Jellyfish Party!
Array.indonesia: Pesta Ubur-ubur!

Array.name: PartyEvent_Message_14150001
Array.english: Hello residents! We have finally launched a tourism committee to promote the newly discovered mysterious Blue Hole! \nOur first event, the <color=#00a583>Jellyfish Party</color>, will be held in 3 days. \nIf you know of any restaurants that can serve <color=#00a583>Jellyfish dishes</color> to match the theme, please spread the word!
Array.indonesia: Halo warga! Kami akhirnya meluncurkan komite pariwisata untuk mempromosikan Blue Hole misterius yang baru ditemukan! \nAcara pertama kami, <color=#00a583>Pesta Ubur-ubur</color>, akan diadakan dalam 3 hari. \nJika Kamu mengetahui restoran yang dapat menyajikan <color=#00a583>hidangan ubur-ubur</color> sesuai tema, tolong sebarkan informasinya!

Array.name: PartyEvent_Title_14150002
Array.english: Tuna Yacht Party!
Array.indonesia: Pesta Kapal Pesiar Tuna!

Array.name: PartyEvent_Message_14150002
Array.english:
Hello residents! Blue Hole Tourism Board here!
The Blue Hole is getting more and more well known, and interest is growing! In 3 days a <color=#00a583>Yacht Party</color> will be held! As a lot of wealthy people will likely come, if there is a restaurant that can handle preparing high class <color=#00a583>Tuna dishes</color> this could significantly increase sales! We ask for your support until it becomes the best attraction in the world!

Blue Hole Tourism Committee
Array.indonesia:
Halo warga! Ini Dewan Pariwisata Blue Hole!
Blue Hole semakin dikenal luas, dan minat terhadapnya pun terus meningkat! Dalam 3 hari lagi, <color=#00a583>Pesta Kapal Pesiar</color> akan diselenggarakan! Karena kemungkinan besar banyak orang kaya akan datang, jika ada restoran yang mampu menyiapkan <color=#00a583>hidangan tuna</color> kelas atas, hal ini dapat meningkatkan penjualan secara signifikan! Kami memohon dukungan Kamu hingga acara ini menjadi atraksi terbaik di dunia!

Komite Pariwisata Blue Hole

Array.name: PartyEvent_Title_14150009
Array.english: Storm Shark Party!
Array.indonesia: Pesta Hiu Badai!

Array.name: PartyEvent_Message_14150009
Array.english:
Hello, folks! This is the Blue Hole Tourism Committee! According to the national weather service, a storm will hit the Blue Hole hard for three days, and amazingly people have started to report sightings of a variety of sharks roaming the coastal areas.
The committee decided to utilize this opportunity and release a new tourism product! It’s called the <color=#00a583>Storm Shark Party</color>! 

Dear store owners, do not miss this opportunity to rack up revenue! We have <color=#00a583>special breeds of sharks</color> sighted as well!

Blue Hole Tourism Committee
Array.indonesia:
Halo, semuanya! Ini Komite Pariwisata Blue Hole! Menurut badan meteorologi nasional, badai akan melanda Blue Hole dengan keras selama tiga hari, dan yang menakjubkan, orang-orang mulai melaporkan penampakan berbagai jenis hiu yang berkeliaran di perairan pesisir.
Komite memutuskan untuk memanfaatkan kesempatan ini dan meluncurkan produk pariwisata baru! Namanya <color=#00a583>Pesta Hiu Badai</color>! 

Para pemilik toko yang terhormat, jangan lewatkan kesempatan ini untuk meningkatkan pendapatan! Kami juga telah <color=#00a583>melihat spesies hiu langka</color>!

Komite Pariwisata Blue Hole

Array.name: PartyEvent_Title_14150010
Array.english: The Cucumberholics
Array.indonesia: The Cucumberholics

Array.name: PartyEvent_Message_14150010
Array.english:
Hello, folks! We are a group of people who are just addicted to cucumber. You can simply call us the <color=#00a583>Cucumberholics</color>.

If you see anyone picking cucumber out of their food, tell them they need to learn how to appreciate the true taste of cucumber!

We will host a <color=#00a583>cucumber party</color> in three days to educate people on cucumber's great taste. They’re delicious, and they’re great for your skin. Any store owners who serve dishes containing cucumber may participate in the cooking contest! Remember, cucumber is green love.

The Cucumberholics
Array.indonesia:
Halo, semuanya! Kami adalah sekelompok orang yang benar-benar kecanduan mentimun. Kalian bisa memanggil kami <color=#00a583>Cucumberholics</color>.

Jika kalian melihat ada orang yang memisahkan mentimun dari makanannya, katakan pada mereka bahwa mereka perlu belajar menghargai rasa asli mentimun!

Kami akan mengadakan <color=#00a583>pesta mentimun</color> dalam tiga hari lagi untuk mengedukasi orang-orang tentang kelezatan rasa mentimun. Mentimun itu lezat, dan sangat baik untuk kulit Kamu. Para pemilik toko yang menyajikan hidangan yang mengandung mentimun dipersilakan untuk berpartisipasi dalam lomba memasak! Ingat, mentimun adalah cinta yang hijau.

The Cucumberholics

Array.name: PartyEvent_Title_14150011
Array.english: Marlin Party!
Array.indonesia: Pesta Marlin!

Array.name: PartyEvent_Message_14150011
Array.english:
Hello, this is the Blue Hole Tourism Committee!
I am sure you all know the story of an old man who couldn’t catch a fish for 84 days off the coast of the Gulf of Mexico. 
The fish he finally caught was a <color=#00a583>marlin</color>.
And now, marlins are beginning to be sighted in the waters near the Blue Hole!
To seize this opportunity, the committee decided to host a <color=#00a583>Marlin Party</color>  three days from today.
Local restaurant owners are encouraged to participate in the event to rack up revenue!
Rumor has it that some even sighted sailfish, not very often though!

The Blue Hole Tourism Committee
Array.indonesia:
Halo, ini Komite Pariwisata Blue Hole!
Saya yakin kalian semua tahu kisah seorang lelaki tua yang tidak bisa menangkap ikan selama 84 hari di lepas pantai Teluk Meksiko. 
Ikan yang akhirnya ia tangkap adalah <color=#00a583>marlin</color>.
Dan kini, marlin mulai terlihat di perairan dekat Blue Hole!
Untuk memanfaatkan kesempatan ini, panitia memutuskan untuk menyelenggarakan <color=#00a583>Pesta Marlin</color>  tiga hari dari sekarang.
Para pemilik restoran lokal didorong untuk berpartisipasi dalam acara ini guna meningkatkan pendapatan!
Konon, ada yang bahkan melihat ikan layang, meski tidak terlalu sering!

Komite Pariwisata Blue Hole

Array.name: PartyEvent_Title_14150012
Array.english: Curry Party!
Array.indonesia: Pesta Kari!

Array.name: PartyEvent_Message_14150012
Array.english:
Hello, everyone. This is the Spice Lab. We research the perfect combination of various spices and ingredients.

We’ve heard that the waters of the Blue Hole are like a world fair that exhibit all kinds of marine species!
What kind of palatal surprises shall we find when various fish and spices meet?
We will embark on this culinary journey in three days. Our chosen ingredient is <color=#00a583>curry</color>!
Curry is well known for its anticancer and antidementia properties. Meet the new tastes of the Blue Hole at the party!

The Spice Lab
Array.indonesia:
Halo, semuanya. Ini adalah Spice Lab. Kami meneliti kombinasi sempurna dari berbagai rempah dan bahan makanan.

Kami mendengar bahwa perairan Blue Hole bagaikan pameran dunia yang memamerkan segala jenis spesies laut!
Kejutan rasa apa yang akan kita temukan saat berbagai ikan dan rempah berpadu?
Kita akan memulai perjalanan kuliner ini dalam tiga hari. Bahan yang kami pilih adalah <color=#00a583>kari</color>!
Kari terkenal karena khasiatnya yang dapat mencegah kanker dan demensia. Temukan cita rasa baru Blue Hole di pesta ini!

The Spice Lab

Array.name: PartyEvent_Title_14150013
Array.english: Shrimp Party!
Array.indonesia: Pesta Udang!

Array.name: PartyEvent_Message_14150013
Array.english:
Greetings! It’s your Blue Hole Tourism Committee again! 
You all know Blue Hole is home to big, fat, and juicy shrimp.
The excellent taste of the shrimps must be known to the whole world.
This time, we’re hosting a <color=#00a583>Shrimp Party</color>!
If you own a restaurant with fine shrimp recipes, don’t miss out on this opportunity!

The Blue Hole Tourism Committee
Array.indonesia:
Salam! Ini Komite Pariwisata Blue Hole lagi! 
Kalian semua tahu bahwa Blue Hole adalah rumah bagi udang yang besar, gemuk, dan berair.
Rasa udang yang luar biasa ini harus dikenal oleh seluruh dunia.
Kali ini, kami akan menyelenggarakan <color=#00a583>Pesta Udang</color>!
Jika kalian memiliki restoran dengan resep udang yang lezat, jangan lewatkan kesempatan ini!

Komite Pariwisata Blue Hole

Array.name: PartyEvent_Title_14150014
Array.english: Lobster Party!
Array.indonesia: Pesta Lobster!

Array.name: PartyEvent_Message_14150014
Array.english:
Hello! This is the Blue Hole Tourism Committee, dedicated to making Blue Hole a world-class tourist destination.
We are happy to announce that the <color=#00a583>Lobster Party</color> Festival, where you can enjoy fresh lobsters caught in Blue Hole, will open in three days! We urge nearby restaurants to participate in this fantastic opportunity!

Blue Hole Tourism Committee
Array.indonesia:
Halo! Ini adalah Komite Pariwisata Blue Hole, yang berkomitmen untuk menjadikan Blue Hole sebagai destinasi wisata kelas dunia.
Dengan senang hati kami mengumumkan bahwa Festival <color=#00a583>Lobster Party</color>, di mana Kamu dapat menikmati lobster segar hasil tangkapan di Blue Hole, akan dibuka dalam tiga hari lagi! Kami mengimbau restoran-restoran di sekitar area ini untuk ikut serta dalam kesempatan luar biasa ini!

Komite Pariwisata Blue Hole

Array.name: Mail_Title_DiverCity
Array.english: #1 Best Diving Spot - Thistlegorm
Array.indonesia: #1 Tempat Menyelam Terbaik - Thistlegorm

Array.name: Mail_Message_DiverCity
Array.english: Hello, this is Diver City, a friend of all divers. Today I'd like to introduce you to Dahab, Egypt, where a British transport ship with a name meaning 'blue thistle,' was wrecked. The shipwreck, which sank to a depth of 30m, is a spectacular sight, but amazingly, you can even tour the inside of the ship! What are you waiting for? The mystery of the Red Sea awaits you! Tour inquiries : 064-1979-6698
Array.indonesia: Halo, ini Diver City, sahabat para penyelam. Hari ini saya ingin memperkenalkan Dahab, Mesir, tempat kapal angkut Inggris dengan nama yang berarti 'thistle biru' karam. Bangkai kapal yang tenggelam hingga kedalaman 30 m ini merupakan pemandangan yang spektakuler, namun yang menakjubkan, Kamu bahkan bisa menjelajahi bagian dalam kapal! Tunggu apa lagi? Misteri Laut Merah menanti Kamu! Pertanyaan mengenai tur: 064-1979-6698

Array.english: [Movie News] A giant crocodile in the sewer!?

Array.name: Mail_Message_MovieWonder02
Array.english:
Hello, this is Movie Wonder.
The weather's getting a bit chilly! How about a creepy horror movie?
What if a giant mutant crocodile appeared in the sewer!?
Experience realistic horror on the big screen!
Array.indonesia:
Halo, ini Movie Wonder.
Cuaca mulai sedikit dingin! Bagaimana kalau menonton film horor yang menyeramkan?
Bagaimana jika seekor buaya mutan raksasa muncul di saluran pembuangan!?
Rasakan horor yang realistis di layar lebar!

Array.name: Mail_Title_DiverCity02
Array.english: Best Diving Spot #2 - Bajo Alcyone
Array.indonesia: Tempat Menyelam Terbaik #2 - Bajo Alcyone

Array.name: Mail_Message_DiverCity02
Array.english: Hey there Divers. This is Diver City. Today we are introducing 'Hammerhead's Paradise,' of Costa Rica's Bajo Alcyone. Hammerheads can be found on Cocos Island, only accessible through Liveboard! You can meet groups of over 100, depending on the season. Tour Inquiries : 064-1979-6698
Array.indonesia: Halo para penyelam. Ini Diver City. Hari ini kami memperkenalkan 'Surga Hiu Martil' di Bajo Alcyone, Kosta Rika. Hiu martil dapat ditemukan di Pulau Cocos, yang hanya dapat diakses melalui kapal liveaboard! Kamu bisa menjumpai kawanan yang berjumlah lebih dari 100 ekor, tergantung musimnya. Pertanyaan soal Tur : 064-1979-6698

Array.name: Mail_Title_ChallengeTheChef
Array.english: (Ad) Intense Chef Showdown!
Array.indonesia: (Iklan) Pertarungan Koki yang Seru!

Array.name: Mail_Message_ChallengeTheChef
Array.english:
Vincent Yamaoka is back!
The chefs from last season's big chef clash are back, <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆The Chef</color>, coming soon!
Stay glued to your seats to see who Vincent will proclaim the victor!


Sponsored by B&C Corp.
Array.indonesia:
Vincent Yamaoka kembali!
Para koki dari pertarungan besar musim lalu kembali, <color=#00d98f>Tantangan◆The Chef</color>, segera tayang!
Tetaplah menonton untuk melihat siapa yang akan dinyatakan sebagai pemenang oleh Vincent!


Disponsori oleh B&C Corp.
