Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Eating_003
Array.english: It melts in the mouth!
Array.indonesia: Meleleh di mulut!

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Eating_004
Array.english: Lovely stuff!
Array.indonesia: Enak banget!

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Eating_005
Array.english: This is what I’m talking about!
Array.indonesia: Inilah yang kumaksud!

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Eating_006
Array.english: Way better than I expected!
Array.indonesia: Jauh lebih enak dari yang kuduga!

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Eating_007
Array.english: Wow, wonderful!
Array.indonesia: Wah, luar biasa!

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Angry_001
Array.english: The food’s coming out too slowly...
Array.indonesia: Makanannya keluarnya terlalu lambat...

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Angry_002
Array.english: I’m so hungry...
Array.indonesia: Aku lapar sekali...

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Angry_003
Array.english: I’ll be late to my appointment...
Array.indonesia: Aku bakal telat ke janji temu...

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Angry_004
Array.english: When’s it coming out...
Array.indonesia: Kapan sih keluarnya...

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Angry_005
Array.english: Please hurry up...
Array.indonesia: Tolong cepat dong...

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Angry_006
Array.english: Ugh... I’m about to faint from hunger...
Array.indonesia: Ugh... Aku hampir pingsan karena lapar...

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Angry_007
Array.english: I’m at my limit...
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah nggak tahan lagi...

Array.name: DLC_InstallNotice_DLCDesc_Godzilla
Array.english: Godzilla, the king of kaijus, has appeared in the Blue Hole. Help the G-Force agent and complete the mission to track down Godzilla!
Array.indonesia: Godzilla, raja kaiju, telah muncul di Blue Hole. Bantu agen G-Force dan selesaikan misi untuk melacak Godzilla!

Array.name: DLC_InstallNotice_ConditionTitle_Godzilla
Array.english: Start Conditions
Array.indonesia: Syarat Awal

Array.name: DLC_InstallNotice_Condition01_Godzilla
Array.english: - Occurs on a certain night after the end of Chapter 5.
Array.indonesia: - Terjadi pada suatu malam setelah akhir Bab 5.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_AfterEarthquake_001
Array.english: Dave, I think there was a strong earthquake last night...\nDid you feel it?
Array.indonesia: Dave, sepertinya tadi malam terjadi gempa bumi yang kuat...\nApakah kamu merasakannya?

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_AfterEarthquake_002
Array.english: Yeah, the loud noise made me jump out of bed.
Array.indonesia: Ya, suara keras itu membuatku terkejut sampai melompat dari tempat tidur.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_AfterEarthquake_003
Array.english: But I just had some snacks and went back to sleep...
Array.indonesia: Tapi aku hanya makan camilan sebentar lalu kembali tidur...

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_AfterEarthquake_004
Array.english: The earthquake last night felt different than usual.\nIt was like something huge fell...
Array.indonesia: Gempa bumi tadi malam terasa berbeda dari biasanya.\nRasanya seperti ada sesuatu yang sangat besar jatuh...

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_MissionStart01_001
Array.english: <size=35>Hmm...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Hmm...!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_MissionStart01_002
Array.english: <size=33>Huh...? Who are you?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hah...? Siapa kamu?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_MissionStart01_003
Array.english: Did you hear a huge crashing sound in this area by any chance?
Array.indonesia: Apakah kamu kebetulan mendengar suara benturan yang sangat keras di daerah ini?

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_MissionStart01_004
Array.english: Well... We did hear a loud noise last night.
Array.indonesia: Yah... Kami memang mendengar suara keras tadi malam.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_MissionStart01_005
Array.english: Then that must be it. \nLet me introduce myself first.
Array.indonesia: Kalau begitu, pasti itu. \nIzinkan saya memperkenalkan diri terlebih dahulu.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_MissionStart01_006
Array.english: I am <color=#F1DC2B>Miki</color> from the G-Force, the military branch of the UNGCC. \nIt stands for the United Nations Godzilla Countermeasures Center.
Array.indonesia: Saya <color=#F1DC2B>Miki</color> dari G-Force, cabang militer UNGCC. \nItu singkatan dari United Nations Godzilla Countermeasures Center.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_MissionStart01_007
Array.english: <size=35>...Uh, Godzilla?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>...Uh, Godzilla?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_MissionStart01_008
Array.english: Yes. It's a giant kaiju... \nbut it recently disappeared after fighting another kaiju near Fukuoka.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Itu adalah kaiju raksasa... \ntapi baru-baru ini ia menghilang setelah bertarung dengan kaiju lain di dekat Fukuoka.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_MissionStart01_009
Array.english: I think I saw that on the news...! \nI thought it was some kind of movie at first.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya aku melihatnya di berita...! \nAwalnya aku kira itu semacam film.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_MissionStart01_010
Array.english: Godzilla was wounded. \nWe tracked down its brainwaves, and they led us here.
Array.indonesia: Godzilla terluka. \nKami melacak gelombang otaknya, dan jejaknya membawa kami ke sini.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_MissionStart01_011
Array.english: <size=32>Could you tell me more about this place?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Bisakah kamu ceritakan lebih banyak tentang tempat ini?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_MissionStart01_012
Array.english: <size=33>This is the <color=#90CDFF>Giant Blue Hole</color>, a mysterious place where all kinds of fish from across the world gather! Hahaha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ini adalah <color=#90CDFF>Giant Blue Hole</color>, tempat misterius di mana berbagai jenis ikan dari seluruh dunia berkumpul! Hahaha!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_MissionStart01_013
Array.english: Hmm... mysterious, you say... \nThat explains the gigantic creatures I saw.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... misterius, katamu... \nItu menjelaskan makhluk-makhluk raksasa yang aku lihat.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_MissionStart01_014
Array.english: Then there's a chance that Godzilla came here to heal its wounds.
Array.indonesia: Kalau begitu, ada kemungkinan Godzilla datang ke sini untuk menyembuhkan lukanya.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_MissionStart01_015
Array.english: I searched a bit under the sea, but I couldn't find my way around it. \nIt's like the environment keeps changing.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah mencari-cari di bawah laut, tapi aku tidak bisa menemukan jalan keluar. \nSepertinya lingkungannya terus berubah.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_MissionStart01_016
Array.english: Well... That's just how this place is.
Array.indonesia: Yah... Tempat ini memang seperti itu.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_MissionStart01_017
Array.english: <size=34>Ah! You there, with the diving suit...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ah! Kamu di sana, yang pakai pakaian selam...!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_MissionStart01_018
Array.english: <size=34>Could you please lend me some help?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Bisakah kamu membantuku?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_MissionStart01_019
Array.english: <size=35>Huh...? Me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Hah...? Aku?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_MissionStart01_020
Array.english: Yes... \nYou seem to know a lot about the geography of this region...
Array.indonesia: Ya... \nKamu sepertinya tahu banyak tentang geografi wilayah ini...

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_MissionStart01_021
Array.english: <size=33>We must find Godzilla's hideout!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kita harus menemukan tempat persembunyian Godzilla!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_MissionStart01_022
Array.english: Hmm... I'm not sure if something that big could hide somewhere here...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Aku tidak yakin apakah makhluk sebesar itu bisa bersembunyi di suatu tempat di sini...

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_MissionStart01_023
Array.english: I can locate Godzilla by its brainwaves...\nBut since you probably can't...
Array.indonesia: Aku bisa melacak Godzilla melalui gelombang otaknya...\nTapi karena kamu mungkin tidak bisa...

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_MissionStart01_024
Array.english: <size=36>Here, I'll give you this.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Ini, aku akan memberimu ini.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_MissionStart01_025
Array.english: It's a <color=#F1DC2B>Godzilla Radar</color> made by the G-Force. \nIts signal will get stronger the closer you are to Godzilla.
Array.indonesia: Ini adalah <color=#F1DC2B>Radar Godzilla</color> yang dibuat oleh G-Force. \nSinyalnya akan semakin kuat seiring kamu semakin dekat dengan Godzilla.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_MissionStart01_026
Array.english: Dave, if what that military lady just said is true...
Array.indonesia: Dave, jika apa yang baru saja dikatakan wanita militer itu benar...

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_MissionStart01_027
Array.english: <size=33>Godzilla may soon recover and destroy everything around here!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Godzilla mungkin akan segera pulih dan menghancurkan segala sesuatu di sekitar sini!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_MissionStart01_028
Array.english: We should track it right away and tell them its location.
Array.indonesia: Kita harus segera melacaknya dan memberi tahu mereka lokasinya.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_MissionStart01_029
Array.english: You're right. \nI'll try following the radar's signal.
Array.indonesia: Kamu benar. \nAku akan mencoba mengikuti sinyal radar itu.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FindGodzilla_DZoneArrive01_001
Array.english: Hmm... It seems to be around here.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Sepertinya ada di sekitar sini.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FindGodzilla_DZoneArrive02_001
Array.english: <size=34>...! I can sense a strong signal from inside that cave.\nI bet it's over there.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>...! Aku bisa merasakan sinyal yang kuat dari dalam gua itu.\nPasti ada di sana.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FindGodzilla_DZoneArrive02_002
Array.english: Hmm... The entrance collapsed. \nIt'll be hard to enter the cave.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Pintu masuknya runtuh. \nAkan sulit untuk masuk ke dalam gua.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FindGodzilla_DZoneArrive02_003
Array.english: Could you check if there's anything we can use nearby?
Array.indonesia: Bisakah kamu memeriksa apakah ada sesuatu yang bisa kita gunakan di sekitar sini?

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FindGodzilla_DoorOpen_Start_001
Array.english: Huh...? Isn't that a <color=#F1DC2B>Mine</color> that fell from John Watson's suit...?
Array.indonesia: Hah...? Bukankah itu <color=#F1DC2B>rudal</color> yang jatuh dari baju pelindung John Watson...?

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FindGodzilla_DoorOpen_Start_002
Array.english: <size=33>Maybe I could throw that at the <color=#1DFEAF>collapsed door</color>...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Mungkin aku bisa melemparkan itu ke <color=#1DFEAF>pintu yang runtuh</color>...?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FindGodzilla_DoorOpen_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=34>Great! The door is open!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Bagus! Pintunya terbuka!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FindGodzilla_DoorOpen_Complete_002
Array.english: <size=34>Now could you enter that cave?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Sekarang bisakah kamu masuk ke gua itu?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FindGodzilla_DoorOpen_Complete_003
Array.english: <size=34>What?! You want me to go in there?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Apa?! Kamu mau aku masuk ke sana?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FindGodzilla_DoorOpen_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=32>Yeah... It's hard to explain, but I can't go in there myself...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Iya... Sulit dijelaskan, tapi aku sendiri nggak bisa masuk ke sana...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FindGodzilla_DoorOpen_Complete_005
Array.english: <size=34>So, please! Do me this favor!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Jadi, tolong! Bantu aku, ya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FindGodzilla_DoorOpen_Complete_006
Array.english: Godzilla... Isn't that thing super huge...? \nIt's too dangerous...
Array.indonesia: Godzilla... Bukankah makhluk itu sangat besar...? \nTerlalu berbahaya...

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FindGodzilla_DoorOpen_Complete_007
Array.english: I believe Godzilla is just resting at the moment.
Array.indonesia: Aku yakin Godzilla sedang beristirahat saat ini.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FindGodzilla_DoorOpen_Complete_008
Array.english: Just check the situation inside the cave. Please.
Array.indonesia: Cek saja situasi di dalam gua itu. Tolong.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FindGodzilla_DoorOpen_Complete_009
Array.english: Uhm... If you say so.
Array.indonesia: Uhm... Kalau kamu bilang begitu.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FindGodzilla_DoorOpen_barricade_001
Array.english: <size=33>You can't leave! Please track down Godzilla's location!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kamu tidak boleh pergi! Tolong lacak lokasi Godzilla!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FindGodzilla_DoorOpen_Retry_EmptyAmmo_001
Array.english: It seems like we don't have enough <color=#F1DC2B>Mines</color>...
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya kita tidak punya cukup <color=#F1DC2B>Ranjau</color>...

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FindGodzilla_DoorOpen_Retry_EmptyAmmo_002
Array.english: Maybe we should find another method...
Array.indonesia: Mungkin kita harus mencari cara lain...

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FindGodzilla_Room_barricade_001
Array.english: The signal on the radar... is coming from deep inside.
Array.indonesia: Sinyal di radar... berasal dari jauh di dalam.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FindGodzilla_Room_barricade_002
Array.english: Please go a little deeper!
Array.indonesia: Tolong masuk sedikit lebih dalam!

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FindGodzilla_EnterCave_001
Array.english: Huh? The interior of the Abandoned Cave looks a bit different...
Array.indonesia: Hah? Bagian dalam Gua Terlantar ini terlihat sedikit berbeda...

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FindGodzilla_EnterCave_002
Array.english: Did Godzilla really barge in here...?
Array.indonesia: Apakah Godzilla benar-benar menerobos masuk ke sini...?

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FindGodzilla_Inside01_001
Array.english: <size=35>Whoa! It really is here!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wah! Dia benar-benar ada di sini!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FindGodzilla_Inside01_002
Array.english: Look at its size... How did it even get in here...?
Array.indonesia: Lihat ukurannya... Bagaimana dia bisa masuk ke sini...?

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FindGodzilla_Inside02_001
Array.english: Woaah... That roar... It's unbelievable...
Array.indonesia: Woaah... Raungan itu... Luar biasa...

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FindGodzilla_Inside02_002
Array.english: <size=33>So it's here, just as I thought...! \nIt seems much weaker.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Jadi dia ada di sini, seperti yang kuduga...! \nSepertinya dia jauh lebih lemah.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FindGodzilla_Inside02_003
Array.english: But how did you know it was here?
Array.indonesia: Tapi bagaimana kamu tahu dia ada di sini?

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FindGodzilla_Inside02_004
Array.english: I... have a special power that can detect Godzilla's brainwaves.
Array.indonesia: Aku... memiliki kekuatan khusus yang bisa mendeteksi gelombang otak Godzilla.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FindGodzilla_Inside02_005
Array.english: Although it was difficult to track it down, as it's far away from where it was last seen...
Array.indonesia: Meskipun sulit melacaknya, karena lokasinya jauh dari tempat terakhir kali terlihat...

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FindGodzilla_Inside02_006
Array.english: It seems to be healing by using the special power of this Blue Hole.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya ia sedang memulihkan diri dengan memanfaatkan kekuatan khusus Blue Hole ini.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FindGodzilla_Inside02_007
Array.english: Help me set up a <color=#F1DC2B>surveillance camera</color> so that we can observe Godzilla's movements.
Array.indonesia: Bantu aku memasang <color=#F1DC2B>kamera pengawas</color> agar kita bisa mengamati pergerakan Godzilla.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FindGodzilla_Inside02_008
Array.english: It could suddenly go berserk, so the G-Force will monitor it.
Array.indonesia: Ia bisa tiba-tiba mengamuk, jadi G-Force akan memantaunya.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FindGodzilla_SetCCTV_barricade_001
Array.english: Install the surveillance camera!\nDon't leave yet!
Array.indonesia: Pasang kamera pengawasnya!\nJangan pergi dulu!

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_SleepGodzillaHit_001
Array.english: You're not... doing something to Godzilla right now, are you...?
Array.indonesia: Kamu tidak... sedang melakukan sesuatu pada Godzilla sekarang, kan...?

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_SleepGodzillaHit_002
Array.english: You'd better not wake it up... \nThere'll be consequences if you do.
Array.indonesia: Sebaiknya jangan membangunkannya... \nAkan ada konsekuensinya jika kamu melakukannya.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FindGodzilla_CameraSet_001
Array.english: Great. I can see clearly.
Array.indonesia: Bagus. Aku bisa melihat dengan jelas.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FindGodzilla_CameraSet_002
Array.english: That'll be enough for now. Go back to the boat.
Array.indonesia: Cukup dulu untuk saat ini. Kembalilah ke kapal.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FindGodzilla_ReturnBoat_001
Array.english: It seems Godzilla was heavily wounded and is currently recovering.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya Godzilla terluka parah dan saat ini sedang dalam masa pemulihan.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FindGodzilla_ReturnBoat_002
Array.english: We shouldn't interfere with it for now.
Array.indonesia: Kita sebaiknya tidak mengganggunya untuk saat ini.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FindGodzilla_ReturnBoat_003
Array.english: We'll continue to monitor it with the surveillance camera.
Array.indonesia: Kita akan terus memantaunya dengan kamera pengawas.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Godzilla_SushibarToChasing_SushiBarExit_001
Array.english: <size=32> Why are you here at this hour? \nWe're closed now.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32> Kenapa kamu di sini jam segini? \nTempat ini sudah tutup.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Godzilla_SushibarToChasing_SushiBarExit_002
Array.english: *Pant* Sorry for showing up so late. But it's an urgent matter...
Array.indonesia: *Terengah-engah* Maaf datang terlambat. Tapi ini urusan mendesak...

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Godzilla_SushibarToChasing_SushiBarExit_003
Array.english: <size=33>Let's go to the submarine first!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ayo kita ke kapal selam dulu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_SushibarToChasing_SubmarineStart_001
Array.english: What's going on, Miki?
Array.indonesia: Ada apa, Miki?

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_SushibarToChasing_SubmarineStart_002
Array.english: There are strong spikes in Godzilla's brainwaves. And...
Array.indonesia: Ada lonjakan kuat pada gelombang otak Godzilla. Dan...

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_SushibarToChasing_SubmarineStart_003
Array.english: ...And?
Array.indonesia: ...Dan?

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_SushibarToChasing_SubmarineStart_004
Array.english: <size=35>Another giant object is heading this way...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ada benda raksasa lain yang sedang menuju ke sini...!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_SushibarToChasing_SubmarineStart_005
Array.english: <size=35>Another kaiju...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Kaiju lain...?!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_SushibarToChasing_SubmarineStart_006
Array.english: I'm not sure... But it's currently heading toward Godzilla at a high speed.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak yakin... Tapi saat ini benda itu sedang menuju ke arah Godzilla dengan kecepatan tinggi.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_SushibarToChasing_SubmarineStart_007
Array.english: <size=32>I should go check on the situation.\nDave, could you come with me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku harus pergi memeriksa situasinya.\nDave, bisakah kamu ikut denganku?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_SushibarToChasing_SubmarineStart_008
Array.english: <size=34>Huh? Me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hah? Aku?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_SushibarToChasing_SubmarineStart_009
Array.english: Yes. It's difficult to navigate the Blue Hole, so I need a guide.\nAnd...
Array.indonesia: Ya. Sulit untuk menavigasi Blue Hole, jadi aku butuh pemandu.\nDan...

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_SushibarToChasing_SubmarineStart_010
Array.english: ...And?
Array.indonesia: ...Dan?

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_SushibarToChasing_SubmarineStart_011
Array.english: No... It's nothing.
Array.indonesia: Tidak... Tidak apa-apa.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_SushibarToChasing_SubmarineStart_012
Array.english: Let's ride this submarine together.\nStay behind me.
Array.indonesia: Ayo kita naik kapal selam ini bersama-sama.\nTetap di belakangku.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_BToC_001
Array.english: <size=34>Why did you stop?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kenapa kamu berhenti?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_BToC_002
Array.english: Well... There's something I need to tell you...
Array.indonesia: Nah... Ada sesuatu yang perlu aku sampaikan padamu...

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_BToC_003
Array.english: The thing is, I have thalassophobia.
Array.indonesia: Masalahnya, aku menderita thalassophobia.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_BToC_004
Array.english: Thalasso... what?
Array.indonesia: Thalasso... apa?

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_BToC_005
Array.english: Thalassophobia. It's a fear of the deep, dark ocean...
Array.indonesia: Thalassophobia. Itu adalah rasa takut terhadap laut yang dalam dan gelap...

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_BToC_006
Array.english: Although I was able to overcome a lot through training...\nTo be honest, I'm not sure if I can drive this submarine safely.
Array.indonesia: Meskipun aku sudah bisa mengatasi banyak hal melalui latihan...\nSejujurnya, aku tidak yakin bisa mengemudikan kapal selam ini dengan aman.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_BToC_007
Array.english: <size=35>Dave, would you mind piloting the submarine for me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Dave, maukah kamu mengemudikan kapal selam ini untukku?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_BToC_008
Array.english: <size=35>What...!? The submarine?! </size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Apa...!? Kapal selam?! </size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_BToC_009
Array.english: Yes. It's not that difficult. It's similar to driving a car.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Sebenarnya tidak terlalu sulit. Mirip seperti mengemudikan mobil.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_BToC_010
Array.english: ...Well, except this one has a Machine Gun attached.
Array.indonesia: ...Ya, kecuali yang ini dilengkapi dengan senapan mesin.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_BToC_011
Array.english: Umm... This is all so sudden…
Array.indonesia: Umm... Ini semua terjadi begitu mendadak…

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_BToC_012
Array.english: Don't worry. I'll be right next to you for instructions.
Array.indonesia: Jangan khawatir. Aku akan berada tepat di sampingmu untuk memberikan petunjuk.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_Start_001
Array.english: I adjusted your seat for more space. \nAre you comfortable?
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah menyesuaikan kursimu agar lebih lega. \nApakah kamu nyaman?

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_Start_002
Array.english: ...Yeah. This isn't as difficult as I thought.
Array.indonesia: ...Ya. Ini tidak sesulit yang kubayangkan.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_Start_003
Array.english: That's good to hear. \nNow let's go to where Godzilla was!
Array.indonesia: Senang mendengarnya. \nSekarang ayo kita pergi ke tempat Godzilla tadi!

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_StartBarricade_001
Array.english: <size=33>You're going the wrong way! We don't have much time!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kamu salah arah! Waktu kita tidak banyak!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_EbirahEnter_001
Array.english: <size=36>What was that...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Apa itu tadi...?!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_EbirahEnter_002
Array.english: <size=34>T-That's <color=#F1DC2B>Ebirah</color>!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I-Itu <color=#F1DC2B>Ebirah</color>!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_EbirahEnter_003
Array.english: It's a lobster-shaped kaiju...\nIt went up against Godzilla on Letchi Island a long time ago.
Array.indonesia: Itu kaiju berbentuk lobster...\nDulu, di Pulau Letchi, ia pernah bertarung melawan Godzilla.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_EbirahEnter_004
Array.english: Maybe it's after Godzilla to get its revenge, now that Godzilla has gotten weaker...!
Array.indonesia: Mungkin dia mengejar Godzilla untuk membalas dendam, sekarang setelah Godzilla semakin lemah...!

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_EbirahEnter_005
Array.english: Umm... That thing is gigantic... And those claws are really scary, too...
Array.indonesia: Umm... Makhluk itu raksasa... Dan cakarnya juga sangat menakutkan...

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_EbirahEnter_006
Array.english: If we don't stop it, that kaiju will tear Godzilla apart.
Array.indonesia: Kalau kita tidak menghentikannya, kaiju itu akan mencabik-cabik Godzilla.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_EbirahEnter_007
Array.english: But isn't Godzilla a bad kaiju that destroys cities?
Array.indonesia: Tapi bukankah Godzilla itu kaiju jahat yang menghancurkan kota-kota?

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_EbirahEnter_008
Array.english: Not always. Godzilla is a creature that sometimes protects humans.
Array.indonesia: Tidak selalu. Godzilla adalah makhluk yang terkadang melindungi manusia.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_EbirahEnter_009
Array.english: Sometimes it's against humans. Sometimes it's against another kaiju. \nThat's all.
Array.indonesia: Terkadang ia melawan manusia. Terkadang ia melawan kaiju lain. \nItu saja.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_EbirahEnter_010
Array.english: I see... In any case, we must protect Godzilla from that Ebirah kaiju, am I right?
Array.indonesia: Begitu... Bagaimanapun juga, kita harus melindungi Godzilla dari kaiju Ebirah itu, kan?

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_EbirahEnter_011
Array.english: Yes... We must get to Godzilla and wake it up before Ebirah gets there.
Array.indonesia: Ya... Kita harus segera menemui Godzilla dan membangunkannya sebelum Ebirah sampai di sana.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_EbirahEnter_012
Array.english: Good. Then let's move.
Array.indonesia: Bagus. Ayo kita berangkat.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_EbirahStare01_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ebirah... has noticed our presence.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ebirah... sudah menyadari kehadiran kita.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_EbirahStare01_002
Array.english: Let's move carefully, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Ayo bergerak dengan hati-hati, Dave.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_EbirahSwingAttack_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh dear...! That was so close...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Astaga...! Itu nyaris saja...!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_EbirahSwingAttack_002
Array.english: I think it noticed that we're heading toward Godzilla.
Array.indonesia: Kurasa dia menyadari bahwa kita sedang menuju ke arah Godzilla.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_EbirahSwingAttack_003
Array.english: <size=33>We're gonna face some fierce attacks...\nI'll leave it to you!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kita akan menghadapi serangan-serangan yang ganas...\nAku serahkan padamu!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_EbirahSwingAttack_004
Array.english: <size=34>What...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Apa...?!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_WallWhine_001
Array.english: That claw is blocking our path.
Array.indonesia: Cakar itu menghalangi jalan kita.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_WallWhine_002
Array.english: <size=33>It's time to use the Machine Gun!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Saatnya menggunakan Senapan Mesin!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_WallWhine_003
Array.english: <size=33>Get that claw out of the way with <image=Shooting.Fire, preset=Dialogue_EN/>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Singkirkan cakar itu dengan <image=Shooting.Fire, preset=Dialogue_EN/>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_RockBlock_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ebirah's pincer has blocked our path...!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Cakar Ebirah telah menghalangi jalan kita...!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_RockBlock_002
Array.english: We're gonna have to use the Machine Gun for this...
Array.indonesia: Kita harus menggunakan Senapan Mesin untuk ini...

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_RockBlock_003
Array.english: <size=34>We need to activate a <color=#F1DC2B>Torpedo</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kita perlu mengaktifkan <color=#F1DC2B>Torpedo</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_RockBlock_004
Array.english: <size=35>Uh, a <color=#F1DC2B>Torpedo</color>...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Eh, <color=#F1DC2B>Torpedo</color>...?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_RockBlock_005
Array.english: <size=34>Yes, we can clear the blocked path with it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ya, kita bisa membersihkan jalan yang terhalang dengan itu.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_RockBlock_006
Array.english: <size=35>Now!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Sekarang!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_End_001
Array.english: <size=34>Yes! The path is clear!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ya! Jalannya sudah bersih!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Chasing_End_002
Array.english: <size=34>Good. Now let's go that way!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Bagus. Sekarang ayo kita pergi ke sana!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_EbirahBoss_Appear_001
Array.english: I knew it... No way it simply escaped.
Array.indonesia: Aku tahu... Tidak mungkin dia lolos begitu saja.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_EbirahBoss_Appear_002
Array.english: We have no choice at this rate.
Array.indonesia: Kita tidak punya pilihan lain kalau begini terus.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_EbirahBoss_Appear_003
Array.english: <size=34>Let's defeat that kaiju.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ayo kita kalahkan kaiju itu.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_EbirahBoss_Appear_004
Array.english: ...I think that's easier said than done.
Array.indonesia: ...Menurutku itu lebih mudah diucapkan daripada dilakukan.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_EbirahBoss_Appear_005
Array.english: With your submarine-piloting skills, we have a chance.
Array.indonesia: Dengan keahlianmu mengemudikan kapal selam, kita punya peluang.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_EbirahBoss_Appear_006
Array.english: It's time to return the favor to Godzilla for protecting us.
Array.indonesia: Saatnya membalas budi kepada Godzilla karena telah melindungi kita.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_EbirahBoss_Appear_007
Array.english: <size=34>Try using the Torpedoes and the Machine Gun! </size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Coba gunakan Torpedo dan Senapan Mesin! </size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_EbirahBoss_MikiRepair_001
Array.english: <size=35>Oh Wait, Dave!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh, tunggu, Dave!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_EbirahBoss_MikiRepair_002
Array.english: <size=33>What's going on?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ada apa?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_EbirahBoss_MikiRepair_003
Array.english: Being a soldier in name.....\nyet to just quietly sit back and do nothing would be to neglect my duties.
Array.indonesia: Sebagai seorang prajurit secara nama.....\nnamun hanya duduk diam dan tidak berbuat apa-apa berarti mengabaikan tugasku.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_EbirahBoss_MikiRepair_004
Array.english: I...I won first place in my unit's 'Fix a Submarine Fast' contest last year.
Array.indonesia: Aku...aku memenangkan juara pertama dalam lomba 'Perbaiki Kapal Selam dengan Cepat' di unitku tahun lalu.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_EbirahBoss_MikiRepair_005
Array.english: <size=33>…Sounds like an interesting contest.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>…Kedengarannya seperti lomba yang menarik.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_EbirahBoss_MikiRepair_006
Array.english: <size=33>If the submarine is damaged, press the <image=Shooting.Repair, preset=Dialogue_KR/>button\nand I'll fix it right away.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Jika kapal selamnya rusak, tekan <image=Shooting.Repair, preset=Dialogue_KR/>tombol\ndan aku akan segera memperbaikinya.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_EbirahBoss_EndRun_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh no! It's escaping towards the surface!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh tidak! Kapal selam itu melarikan diri ke permukaan!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_EbirahBoss_EndRun_002
Array.english: <size=34>Is it heading towards land...!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Apakah kapal selam itu menuju daratan...!?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_EbirahBoss_EndRun_003
Array.english: <size=34>People on the surface are in danger. We should go up!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Orang-orang di permukaan dalam bahaya. Kita harus naik ke permukaan!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_GodzillaVSEbirah_ReturnBoat_001
Array.english: <size=33>Dave, are you alright?! There have been rumblings from the ground.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Dave, apa kamu baik-baik saja?! Ada suara gemuruh dari bawah tanah.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_GodzillaVSEbirah_ReturnBoat_002
Array.english: Well... There was this big lobster monster, and it's going to attack Godzilla...
Array.indonesia: Nah... Ada monster lobster raksasa, dan dia akan menyerang Godzilla...

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_GodzillaVSEbirah_ReturnBoat_003
Array.english: <size=33>...? What are you even talking abo...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...? Apa sih yang kamu bicarakan...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_GodzillaVSEbirah_EbirahMove_001
Array.english: <size=34>Aghhh! That's what I'm talking about!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aghhh! Itulah yang aku maksud!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_GodzillaVSEbirah_EbirahMove_002
Array.english: <size=33>That thing is massive!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Makhluk itu sangat besar!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_GodzillaVSEbirah_EbirahMove_003
Array.english: <size=33>It's... heading towards Bancho Sushi...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Dia... sedang menuju ke Bancho Sushi...!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_GodzillaVSEbirah_EbirahMove_004
Array.english: This is bad. We can't attack that thing with a submarine on the surface.
Array.indonesia: Ini buruk. Kita tidak bisa menyerang makhluk itu dengan kapal selam yang berada di permukaan.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_GodzillaVSEbirah_EbirahMove_005
Array.english: *Sigh* This one's gonna cost us a massive repair bill...
Array.indonesia: *Huff* Ini bakal bikin kita harus bayar tagihan perbaikan yang sangat besar...

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_GodzillaVSEbirah_GodzillaAppear_001
Array.english: <size=35>Woah... Is that Godzilla?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wah... Apa itu Godzilla?!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_GodzillaVSEbirah_GodzillaAppear_002
Array.english: It seems to have fully recovered... \nBut that burning body...
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya dia sudah pulih sepenuhnya... \nTapi tubuhnya yang terbakar itu...

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_GodzillaVSEbirah_GodzillaAppear_003
Array.english: It seems like the Blue Hole's power is causing Godzilla's energy to overload.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya kekuatan Blue Hole menyebabkan energi Godzilla kelebihan beban.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_GodzillaVSEbirah_GodzillaAppear_004
Array.english: It... It's heading toward Ebirah.
Array.indonesia: Dia... Dia sedang menuju ke arah Ebirah.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_GodzillaVSEbirah_GodzillaAppear_005
Array.english: Is it trying to stop Ebirah...?
Array.indonesia: Apakah dia berusaha menghentikan Ebirah...?

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_GodzillaVSEbirah_GodzillaWin_001
Array.english: <size=35>Godzilla has defeated Ebirah...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Godzilla telah mengalahkan Ebirah...!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_GodzillaVSEbirah_GodzillaWin_002
Array.english: <size=34>A battle between giant kaijus...\nI can't believe my own eyes.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Pertarungan antara kaiju raksasa...\nAku tak percaya dengan apa yang kulihat.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_GodzillaVSEbirah_GodzillaLeave_001
Array.english: Thank goodness Godzilla fought off Ebirah and left minimal damage.
Array.indonesia: Syukurlah Godzilla berhasil mengalahkan Ebirah dan kerusakan yang ditimbulkan pun minimal.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_GodzillaVSEbirah_GodzillaLeave_002
Array.english: It seems the Blue Hole's power has also fully healed Godzilla's wound.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya kekuatan Blue Hole juga telah menyembuhkan luka Godzilla sepenuhnya.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_GodzillaVSEbirah_GodzillaLeave_003
Array.english: It's all thanks to everyone's help.
Array.indonesia: Semua ini berkat bantuan kalian semua.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_GodzillaVSEbirah_GodzillaLeave_004
Array.english: The G-Force will continue to monitor Godzilla's movements.
Array.indonesia: G-Force akan terus memantau pergerakan Godzilla.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_GodzillaVSEbirah_GodzillaLeave_005
Array.english: It's not much, but here's a gift to celebrate today's battle.
Array.indonesia: Memang tidak seberapa, tapi ini hadiah untuk merayakan pertempuran hari ini.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_GodzillaVSEbirah_GodzillaLeave_006
Array.english: I think it'll be a good decoration for your boat. Haha.
Array.indonesia: Menurutku ini akan jadi hiasan yang bagus untuk kapalmumu. Haha.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_GodzillaVSEbirah_GodzillaLeave_007
Array.english: Goodbye, then.
Array.indonesia: Sampai jumpa.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_GodzillaVSEbirah_GodzillaAfterLeave_001
Array.english: There are lots of things we don't know about in this world.
Array.indonesia: Ada banyak hal yang belum kita ketahui di dunia ini.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_GodzillaVSEbirah_GodzillaAfterLeave_002
Array.english: I agree. To think such giant kaijus were hiding somewhere.
Array.indonesia: Aku setuju. Siapa sangka ada kaiju raksasa seperti itu yang bersembunyi di suatu tempat.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_GodzillaVSEbirah_GodzillaAfterLeave_003
Array.english: Well, it's a good thing everything went well in the end. Hahaha!
Array.indonesia: Yah, untungnya semuanya berjalan lancar pada akhirnya. Hahaha!

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_GodzillaVSEbirah_GodzillaAfterLeave_004
Array.english: By the way... I wonder if the restaurant took any damage from the massive shock.
Array.indonesia: Ngomong-ngomong... Aku penasaran apakah restoran itu mengalami kerusakan akibat guncangan hebat tadi.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_GodzillaVSEbirah_GodzillaAfterLeave_005
Array.english: You're right. I'll go check it out!
Array.indonesia: Kamu benar. Aku akan pergi memeriksanya!

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Recipe_Reward_Complete01_001
Array.english: Bancho, something huge happened right in front of the restaurant... \nAre you alright?
Array.indonesia: Bancho, sesuatu yang sangat besar terjadi tepat di depan restoran... \nKamu baik-baik saja?

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Recipe_Reward_Complete01_002
Array.english: The restaurant is safe. \nGood thing I made it earthquake-resistant when I had repairs done.
Array.indonesia: Restoran ini aman. \nUntungnya aku sudah membuatnya tahan gempa saat melakukan perbaikan.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Recipe_Reward_Complete01_003
Array.english: <size=33>But still... That was one amazing battle. </size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tapi tetap saja... Itu pertarungan yang luar biasa. </size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Recipe_Reward_Complete01_004
Array.english: I know you've told me about giant undersea creatures before, but seeing them with my own eyes was a whole new experience.
Array.indonesia: Aku tahu kamu pernah bercerita tentang makhluk raksasa di bawah laut sebelumnya, tapi melihatnya dengan mata kepalaku sendiri adalah pengalaman yang benar-benar baru.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Recipe_Reward_Complete01_005
Array.english: When I saw that incredible fight... \nIt gave me the inspiration for some new dishes.
Array.indonesia: Saat aku melihat pertarungan yang luar biasa itu... \nItu memberiku inspirasi untuk beberapa hidangan baru.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Recipe_Reward_Complete01_006
Array.english: Oh... are these new dishes related to Godzilla?
Array.indonesia: Oh... apakah hidangan baru ini berhubungan dengan Godzilla?

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Recipe_Reward_Complete01_007
Array.english: Yes. I should write it down in case I forget it. \nCould you step aside for a bit?
Array.indonesia: Ya. Aku harus menuliskannya agar tidak lupa. \nBisakah kamu minggir sebentar?

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Recipe_Reward_Complete02_001
Array.english: <size=34>Good. I think this will do.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Bagus. Kurasa ini sudah cukup.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Recipe_Reward_Complete02_002
Array.english: I came up with this on the fly... \nSo the recipe might include ingredients we can't collect yet.
Array.indonesia: Aku memikirkan ini secara spontan... \nJadi, resepnya mungkin mengandung bahan-bahan yang belum bisa kita kumpulkan.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Recipe_Reward_Complete02_003
Array.english: Amazing, you can see all the intense moments we had from these dishes...!
Array.indonesia: Luar biasa, kita bisa merasakan semua momen intens yang kita alami dari hidangan-hidangan ini...!

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_Recipe_Reward_Complete02_004
Array.english: I'll eat these every time I think back to this whole situation.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan makan ini setiap kali aku mengingat kembali seluruh situasi ini.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FigureCollect_Start_001
Array.english: Oh, Miki. Did you go back safely?
Array.indonesia: Oh, Miki. Apakah kamu sudah pulang dengan selamat?

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FigureCollect_Start_002
Array.english: Yes... But...
Array.indonesia: Ya... Tapi...

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FigureCollect_Start_003
Array.english: I think I accidentally dropped the <color=#F1DC2B>Kaiju Figurines</color> I had been using for research, into the ocean.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya aku secara tidak sengaja menjatuhkan <color=#F1DC2B>Patung Kaiju</color> yang aku gunakan untuk penelitian, ke laut.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FigureCollect_Start_004
Array.english: I think they were in a <color=#1DFEAF>Box</color> that looks like this...
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya patung-patung itu ada di dalam <color=#1DFEAF>Kotak</color> yang terlihat seperti ini...

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FigureCollect_Start_005
Array.english: If you happen to find them, could you retrieve them for me?
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu kebetulan menemukannya, bisakah kamu mengambilkannya untukku?

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FigureCollect_Start_006
Array.english: I see. Yeah, if I see them, I'll pick them and let you know!
Array.indonesia: Begitu ya. Oke, kalau aku melihatnya, aku akan mengambilnya dan memberitahumu!

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FigureCollect_Start_007
Array.english: Thank you. \nThen allow me to install an app for you.
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih. \nKalau begitu, izinkan aku menginstal aplikasi untukmu.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FigureCollect_Start_008
Array.english: The figurines you recover can be seen in the app.\nThen you can check the information for each kaiju.
Array.indonesia: Figur-figur yang kamu temukan bisa dilihat di aplikasi itu.\nKemudian kamu bisa memeriksa informasi masing-masing kaiju.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FigureCollect_Start_009
Array.english: I wish you the best of luck.\nI'll contact you again once you have retrieved them all.
Array.indonesia: Semoga kamu beruntung.\nAku akan menghubungimu lagi setelah kamu mengambil semuanya.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FigureCollect_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=33>Wow...! You've retrieved all the Kaiju Figurines. Thank you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wah...! Kamu sudah mengambil semua Patung Kaiju. Terima kasih!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FigureCollect_Complete_002
Array.english: Yeah, there were scattered across many more places than I thought.
Array.indonesia: Ya, ternyata tersebar di lebih banyak tempat daripada yang aku kira.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FigureCollect_Complete_003
Array.english: I didn't know there were this many kaijus in the world.
Array.indonesia: Saya tidak tahu ada begitu banyak kaiju di dunia ini.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FigureCollect_Complete_004
Array.english: Haha, these are only a few.\nThere are many more kaijus on Earth.
Array.indonesia: Haha, ini baru sebagian kecil saja.\nMasih ada banyak kaiju lainnya di Bumi.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FigureCollect_Complete_005
Array.english: The G-Force will always be vigilant to stop kaijus from destroying our home.
Array.indonesia: G-Force akan selalu waspada untuk mencegah kaiju menghancurkan rumah kita.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FigureCollect_Complete_006
Array.english: Ah, this is a large figurine that depicts the moment when Godzilla first landed in Tokyo.
Array.indonesia: Ah, ini adalah patung besar yang menggambarkan momen ketika Godzilla pertama kali mendarat di Tokyo.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FigureCollect_Complete_007
Array.english: I'll give you this as a gift. \nWhy don't you display it in the sushi restaurant?
Array.indonesia: Aku akan memberikannya kepadamu sebagai hadiah. \nMengapa kamu tidak memajangnya di restoran sushi?

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FigureCollect_Complete_008
Array.english: Woah... Is it biting a train? That's scary.
Array.indonesia: Wah... Apakah dia sedang menggigit kereta api? Itu menakutkan.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FigureCollect_Complete_009
Array.english: Godzilla has been living with us on this Earth for a long time. \nIt's good to commemorate its first appearance.
Array.indonesia: Godzilla telah hidup bersama kita di Bumi ini sejak lama. \nBagus juga untuk memperingati kemunculannya yang pertama.

Array.name: dialog_Godzilla_FigureCollect_Complete_010
Array.english: I'll continue my research with the figurines you retrieved.\nSee you.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan melanjutkan penelitianku dengan patung-patung yang kamu temukan.\nSampai jumpa.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Miki01_CollectMission_001
Array.english: Have you found any Kaiju Figurines?
Array.indonesia: Apa kamu sudah menemukan patung Kaiju?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Miki01_CollectMission_002
Array.english: ...I'm trying my best. Where can I see the figurines I found, again?
Array.indonesia: ...Aku sedang berusaha sebaik mungkin. Di mana aku bisa melihat patung-patung yang kutemukan tadi?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Miki01_CollectMission_003
Array.english: There's the Kaiju Codex app I installed for you.
Array.indonesia: Ada aplikasi Kaiju Codex yang sudah aku instal untukmu.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Miki01_CollectMission_004
Array.english: You can see the pictures of kaijus and hear their roaring sound.
Array.indonesia: Kamu bisa melihat gambar-gambar kaiju dan mendengar suara raungannya.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Miki01_CollectMission_005
Array.english: It feels like... I'm now part of the defense force of Earth. It's pretty cool.
Array.indonesia: Rasanya seperti... aku sekarang menjadi bagian dari pasukan pertahanan Bumi. Keren banget.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Miki01_CollectMission_006
Array.english: <size=34>I'll do my best to find them all!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku akan berusaha semaksimal mungkin untuk menemukan semuanya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Miki01_AfterCollectMission01_001
Array.english: What's the matter, Dave?
Array.indonesia: Ada apa, Dave?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Miki01_AfterCollectMission01_002
Array.english: Oh, I just got curious if kaijus still appear often these days.
Array.indonesia: Oh, aku cuma penasaran apakah kaiju masih sering muncul belakangan ini.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Miki01_AfterCollectMission01_003
Array.english: Phew... It's hard to get information about kaijus when they're hiding all over the world.
Array.indonesia: Wah... Sulit banget dapetin informasi tentang kaiju kalau mereka bersembunyi di seluruh penjuru dunia.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Miki01_AfterCollectMission01_004
Array.english: Not to mention there are kaijus that are born out of human greed.
Array.indonesia: Belum lagi ada kaiju yang lahir dari keserakahan manusia.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Miki01_AfterCollectMission01_005
Array.english: Nevertheless, the G-Force must act quickly in order to prevent their attacks.
Array.indonesia: Meski begitu, G-Force harus bertindak cepat untuk mencegah serangan mereka.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Miki01_AfterCollectMission01_006
Array.english: Please let me know if you find anything suspicious in the Blue Hole, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Tolong beri tahu aku jika kamu menemukan sesuatu yang mencurigakan di Blue Hole, Dave.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Miki01_AfterCollectMission02_001
Array.english: What's the matter, Dave?
Array.indonesia: Ada apa, Dave?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Miki01_AfterCollectMission02_002
Array.english: Um... Where did Godzilla go after that battle?
Array.indonesia: Um... Kemana Godzilla pergi setelah pertempuran itu?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Miki01_AfterCollectMission02_003
Array.english: I think...
Array.indonesia: Menurutku...

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Miki01_AfterCollectMission02_004
Array.english: It might be taking a break, somewhere in the deep sea where our radar can't find it.
Array.indonesia: Mungkin dia sedang beristirahat, di suatu tempat di laut dalam yang tidak bisa dideteksi radar kita.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Miki01_AfterCollectMission02_005
Array.english: Then it'll show up again if there's another threat to the Earth.
Array.indonesia: Kalau begitu, dia akan muncul lagi jika ada ancaman lain terhadap Bumi.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Miki01_AfterCollectMission02_006
Array.english: Still, it's a bit scary to think it might show up here...
Array.indonesia: Meski begitu, agak menakutkan membayangkan dia mungkin muncul di sini...

Array.name: Figure_Godzilla_Desc
Array.english: After Spacegodzilla arrived on Earth, it was drawn to Birth Island and attacked Baby Godzilla. The space kaiju trapped Baby Godzilla in a crystal, prompting Godzilla to follow his clone to the Japanese city of Fukuoka.
Array.indonesia: Setelah Spacegodzilla tiba di Bumi, ia tertarik ke Pulau Birth dan menyerang Baby Godzilla. Kaiju luar angkasa itu menjebak Baby Godzilla dalam sebuah kristal, sehingga mendorong Godzilla untuk mengikuti klonnya ke kota Fukuoka di Jepang.

Array.name: Figure_Ebirah_Desc
Array.english: A terrorist organization known as the Red Bamboo operates from a secret base on Letchi Island, where they experiment with nuclear energy. When their radioactive waste is washed into the ocean, a strange mutation occurs, spawning the giant, lobster-like Ebirah.
Array.indonesia: Sebuah organisasi teroris yang dikenal sebagai Red Bamboo beroperasi dari pangkalan rahasia di Pulau Letchi, tempat mereka melakukan eksperimen dengan energi nuklir. Ketika limbah radioaktif mereka terbawa arus ke laut, terjadi mutasi aneh yang melahirkan Ebirah, makhluk raksasa yang mirip lobster.

Array.name: Figure_Mechagodzilla_Desc
Array.english: The Black Hole Planet 3 aliens recovered the body of Mechagodzilla from the seabed of Okinawa after its defeat at the hands of Godzilla. Hoping to quickly rebuild the super mech, the aliens enlisted the help of Dr. Shinzo Mafune.
Array.indonesia: Makhluk luar angkasa dari Planet Lubang Hitam 3 menemukan jasad Mechagodzilla di dasar laut Okinawa setelah kekalahannya di tangan Godzilla. Berharap dapat segera membangun kembali robot raksasa tersebut, makhluk luar angkasa itu meminta bantuan Dr. Shinzo Mafune.

Array.name: Figure_JetJaguar_Desc
Array.english: Jet Jaguar is a human-sized robot created by Goro Ibuki. Known as the Electronic Robot, it is operated via remote control with a special radio wave transmitter.
Array.indonesia: Jet Jaguar adalah robot seukuran manusia yang diciptakan oleh Goro Ibuki. Dikenal sebagai Robot Elektronik, robot ini dioperasikan melalui kendali jarak jauh dengan pemancar gelombang radio khusus.

Array.name: Figure_KingGhidorah_Desc
Array.english: King Ghidorah was created when three 23rd Century house pets known as Dorats were taken back in time to the end of WWII, where they were exposed to the same atomic forces that originally created Godzilla and mutated together into King Ghidorah.
Array.indonesia: King Ghidorah tercipta ketika tiga hewan peliharaan abad ke-23 yang dikenal sebagai Dorats dibawa kembali ke masa lalu hingga akhir Perang Dunia II, di mana mereka terpapar kekuatan atom yang sama yang awalnya menciptakan Godzilla dan bermutasi bersama menjadi King Ghidorah.

Array.name: Figure_Gigan_Desc
Array.english: Based on a species of space dinosaur, Gigan is a cyborg kaiju created by the aliens of the M Nebula. It arrived from outer space with King Ghidorah as part of the alien's strategy to attack the Earth.
Array.indonesia: Berdasarkan spesies dinosaurus luar angkasa, Gigan adalah kaiju cyborg yang diciptakan oleh alien dari Nebula M. Ia tiba dari luar angkasa bersama King Ghidorah sebagai bagian dari strategi alien untuk menyerang Bumi.

Array.name: Figure_Minilla_Desc
Array.english: Born from an egg in the embankment of Sollgel Island. Grew up in a harsh environment where life was in danger from birth, but basically has a childlike personality.
Array.indonesia: Lahir dari telur di tanggul Pulau Sollgel. Tumbuh di lingkungan yang keras di mana nyawanya terancam sejak lahir, namun pada dasarnya memiliki kepribadian seperti anak-anak.

Array.name: Figure_BurningGodzilla_Desc
Array.english: When Godzilla's internal energy core became unstable, a chain reaction began leading the Kaiju to its apocalyptic meltdown. Godzilla glowed red as heat rose to dangerous levels, and his body let loose geysers of irradiated steam.
Array.indonesia: Ketika inti energi internal Godzilla menjadi tidak stabil, reaksi berantai pun dimulai yang mengarah pada kehancuran apokaliptik sang kaiju. Godzilla bersinar merah saat panas meningkat ke tingkat yang berbahaya, dan tubuhnya memancarkan semburan uap yang terkontaminasi radiasi.

Array.name: Figure_Mothra_Desc
Array.english: Worshipped as a living deity, Mothra is an ancient and enormous species of moth that functions as the eternal guardian of Infant Island. The Mothra larva spins itself into a cocoon after arriving at Tokyo Tower and later emerges in its imago (winged) form, enabling it to fly to Rolisica to rescue the twins.
Array.indonesia: Dipuja sebagai dewa hidup, Mothra adalah spesies ngengat purba dan raksasa yang berfungsi sebagai penjaga abadi Pulau Infant. Larva Mothra membungkus dirinya dalam kepompong setelah tiba di Menara Tokyo dan kemudian muncul dalam bentuk imago (bersayap), yang memungkinkannya terbang ke Rolisica untuk menyelamatkan si kembar.

Array.name: Figure_Hedorah_Desc
Array.english: Hedorah is an extraterrestrial creature that was attracted to the industrial pollution found on Earth. After merging with the toxic sludge on the ocean floor and other poisonous elements, it grew into a deadly threat.
Array.indonesia: Hedorah adalah makhluk luar angkasa yang tertarik pada polusi industri di Bumi. Setelah menyatu dengan lumpur beracun di dasar laut dan unsur-unsur beracun lainnya, ia tumbuh menjadi ancaman mematikan.

Array.name: Figure_Biolante_Desc
Array.english: The initial Rose form of Biollante that appeared at Lake Ashi. Produced from a mixture of DNA taken from Godzilla, a rose, and Dr. Shiragami's dead daughter Erika. Although Biollante's ivy-like tendrils allow her to grapple in battle, she is no match for Godzilla's radioactive Heat Ray.
Array.indonesia: Bentuk Rose awal Biollante yang muncul di Danau Ashi. Diciptakan dari campuran DNA yang diambil dari Godzilla, sekuntum mawar, dan putri Dr. Shiragami yang telah meninggal, Erika. Meskipun sulur-sulur Biollante yang menyerupai tanaman ivy memungkinkannya untuk bergulat dalam pertempuran, ia tidak mampu menandingi Sinar Panas radioaktif Godzilla.

Array.name: Figure_Rodan_Desc
Array.english: Rodan is a Pteranodon from Adonoa Island mutated due to radioactivity from an abandoned nuclear waste. Rodan fought with Godzilla over Baby Godzilla's egg.
Array.indonesia: Rodan adalah seekor Pteranodon dari Pulau Adonoa yang bermutasi akibat radiasi dari limbah nuklir yang ditinggalkan. Rodan bertarung dengan Godzilla memperebutkan telur Baby Godzilla.

Array.name: Figure_ShinGodzilla_Desc
Array.english: The reimagined story of Godzilla's origin, wherein marine organisms living deep within the sea underwent rapid mutation and growth under the influence of radioactive waste. The body's shape and size continued to change, adapting to accommodate its radical developmental process.
Array.indonesia: Kisah asal-usul Godzilla yang diinterpretasi ulang, di mana organisme laut yang hidup di kedalaman laut mengalami mutasi dan pertumbuhan pesat di bawah pengaruh limbah radioaktif. Bentuk dan ukuran tubuhnya terus berubah, beradaptasi untuk menyesuaikan diri dengan proses perkembangannya yang radikal.

Array.name: Figure_SpaceGodzilla_Desc
Array.english: Called the God of Destruction, Spacegodzilla was formed after Mothra carried some of Godzilla's cells into space, where they were drawn into a black hole. They were absorbed by a rapidly evolving crystalline life form and absorbed in the energy of a dying star.
Array.indonesia: Dijuluki Dewa Kehancuran, Spacegodzilla terbentuk setelah Mothra membawa beberapa sel Godzilla ke luar angkasa, di mana sel-sel tersebut tersedot ke dalam lubang hitam. Sel-sel tersebut diserap oleh bentuk kehidupan kristalin yang berkembang pesat dan terserap dalam energi bintang yang sekarat.

Array.name: Figure_Destoroyah_Desc
Array.english: When the Oxygen Destroyer was successfully deployed against Godzilla back in 1954, an unexpected side effect of the area's sudden oxygen depletion was the re-activation of microorganisms. Each stage saw larger and more destructive evolutions, until the creatures reformed into a single kaiju of terrible perfection—Destoroyah.
Array.indonesia: Ketika Oxygen Destroyer berhasil digunakan melawan Godzilla pada tahun 1954, efek samping tak terduga dari berkurangnya oksigen secara tiba-tiba di wilayah tersebut adalah reaktivasi mikroorganisme. Setiap tahap menunjukkan evolusi yang lebih besar dan lebih merusak, hingga makhluk-makhluk tersebut bersatu menjadi satu kaiju dengan kesempurnaan yang mengerikan—Destoroyah.

Array.name: Figure_Godzilla1965_Desc
Array.english: A lightning strike awoke Godzilla from his ancient slumber in a cave on Letchi Island in the South Pacific. Godzilla fought against the local sea kaiju Ebirah, a tool of the Red Bamboo, who operated in a secret base on Letchi.
Array.indonesia: Sambaran petir membangunkan Godzilla dari tidur panjangnya di sebuah gua di Pulau Letchi di Samudra Pasifik Selatan. Godzilla bertarung melawan kaiju laut setempat, Ebirah, yang merupakan alat dari Red Bamboo, yang beroperasi di sebuah pangkalan rahasia di Letchi.

Array.name: Figure_MechaKingGhidorah_Desc
Array.english: In the 23rd Century, the Futurians recovered the remains of King Ghidorah from the sea floor where it had laid since Godzilla defeated it in the 20th century. They used their advanced technology to resurrect the kaiju as a cyborg.
Array.indonesia: Pada abad ke-23, kaum Futurian menemukan sisa-sisa King Ghidorah di dasar laut, tempat ia terbaring sejak dikalahkan oleh Godzilla pada abad ke-20. Mereka menggunakan teknologi canggih mereka untuk menghidupkan kembali kaiju tersebut sebagai cyborg.

Array.name: Figure_Anguirus_Desc
Array.english: Anguirus was created when an Ankylosaurus was exposed to radiation. Its fighting style consists of rolling its body into a ball that crashes into its foes.
Array.indonesia: Anguirus tercipta ketika seekor Ankylosaurus terpapar radiasi. Gaya bertarungnya adalah dengan menggulung tubuhnya menjadi bola yang menghantam musuh-musuhnya.

Array.name: Figure_KingCaesar_Desc
Array.english: In the ancient kingdom of Ryukyu, located in what is now called Okinawa, the Guardian of the Azumi tribe's Royal family was a kaiju known as King Caesar (Shisa). Resembling a cross between a lion and a dog, King Caesar's form may have inspired the lion statues that are commonly found in the region as artifacts of Ryukyu culture.
Array.indonesia: Di kerajaan kuno Ryukyu, yang terletak di wilayah yang kini dikenal sebagai Okinawa, Penjaga Keluarga Kerajaan suku Azumi adalah seekor kaiju yang dikenal sebagai King Caesar (Shisa). Dengan penampilan yang menyerupai perpaduan antara singa dan anjing, wujud King Caesar mungkin telah menginspirasi patung-patung singa yang umum ditemukan di wilayah tersebut sebagai artefak budaya Ryukyu.

Array.name: Figure_LittleGodzilla_Desc
Array.english: A grown-up version of Baby Godzilla living with Godzilla on Baas Island. Due to radiation, the monster's form has become stronger. Its height is 30 meters.
Array.indonesia: Versi dewasa dari Baby Godzilla yang tinggal bersama Godzilla di Pulau Baas. Akibat radiasi, bentuk monster ini menjadi lebih kuat. Tingginya mencapai 30 meter.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10051001
Array.english: Godzilla seems to have come here after being wounded. Go to the location that shows up on the radar.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya Godzilla datang ke sini setelah terluka. Pergi ke lokasi yang muncul di radar.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10051901
Array.english: So Godzilla is in there? Let's find out how to open the door.
Array.indonesia: Jadi Godzilla ada di dalam sana? Ayo cari tahu cara membuka pintunya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10051002
Array.english: Maybe I can open the door by throwing the Mine that John Watson dropped?
Array.indonesia: Mungkin aku bisa membuka pintunya dengan melemparkan ranjau yang dijatuhkan John Watson?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10051003
Array.english: The door is open. Let's head inside.
Array.indonesia: Pintunya sudah terbuka. Ayo masuk ke dalam.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10051004
Array.english: Godzilla must be here. Please find it.
Array.indonesia: Godzilla pasti ada di sini. Tolong temukan dia.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10051005
Array.english: Set up a surveillance camera at the designated point.
Array.indonesia: Pasang kamera pengawas di titik yang ditentukan.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10051006
Array.english: Now that the camera has been set up, return to the boat.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang kamera sudah terpasang, kembali ke kapal.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10051007
Array.english: Something is heading toward Godzilla! Go after it with the submarine!
Array.indonesia: Ada sesuatu yang sedang menuju ke arah Godzilla! Kejar makhluk itu dengan kapal selam!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10051008
Array.english: Ebirah... It's after Godzilla, now that it's wounded. We have no choice but to defeat it.
Array.indonesia: Ebirah... Ia mengejar Godzilla yang kini terluka. Kita tidak punya pilihan selain mengalahkannya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10051009
Array.english: A battle between Godzilla and Ebirah... Bancho Sushi can only be safe if Godzilla wins this fight.
Array.indonesia: Pertempuran antara Godzilla dan Ebirah... Bancho Sushi hanya akan aman jika Godzilla memenangkan pertarungan ini.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10051010
Array.english: The Kaiju Figurines used for research fell into the ocean. Could you retrieve them?
Array.indonesia: Patung-patung Kaiju yang digunakan untuk penelitian jatuh ke laut. Bisakah kamu mengambilnya kembali?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10051000
Array.english: I should go see if Bancho Sushi took any damage.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus memeriksa apakah Bancho Sushi mengalami kerusakan.

Array.name: Mission_Condition_10033001
Array.english: Follow the radar signal
Array.indonesia: Ikuti sinyal radar

Array.name: Mission_Condition_10033901
Array.english: Find out how to open the door
Array.indonesia: Cari tahu cara membuka pintunya

Array.name: Mission_Condition_10033002
Array.english: Destroy the blocked entrance
Array.indonesia: Hancurkan pintu masuk yang terhalang

Array.name: Mission_Condition_10033003
Array.english: Go into the entrance
Array.indonesia: Masuk ke pintu masuk

Array.name: Mission_Condition_10033004
Array.english: Search the interior of the cave
Array.indonesia: Telusuri bagian dalam gua

Array.name: Mission_Condition_10033005
Array.english: Set up a surveillance camera
Array.indonesia: Pasang kamera pengawas

Array.name: Mission_Condition_10033006
Array.english: Head back to the boat
Array.indonesia: Kembali ke kapal

Array.name: Mission_Condition_10033007
Array.english: Go to Godzilla's hideout
Array.indonesia: Pergi ke sarang Godzilla

Array.name: Mission_Condition_10033008
Array.english: Defeat Ebirah
Array.indonesia: Kalahkan Ebirah

Array.name: Mission_Condition_10033009
Array.english: Win the battle against Ebirah
Array.indonesia: Menangkan pertempuran melawan Ebirah

Array.name: Mission_Condition_10033010
Array.english: Find Kaiju Figurines
Array.indonesia: Temukan patung-patung Kaiju

Array.name: Mission_Condition_10033000
Array.english: Talk to Bancho
Array.indonesia: Bicara dengan Bancho

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Godzilla_Fight
Array.english: <size=24>Use Godzilla's attacks to defeat Ebirah!\nEach attack has a different affinity. For example, <color=#F1DC2B>Defend</color> can block the <color=#F1DC2B>Strike</color> attack, but is ineffective against the <color=#F1DC2B>Dash</color> attack. </size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Gunakan serangan Godzilla untuk mengalahkan Ebirah!\nSetiap serangan memiliki afinitas yang berbeda. Misalnya, <color=#F1DC2B>Defend</color> dapat memblokir serangan <color=#F1DC2B>Strike</color>, tetapi tidak efektif melawan serangan <color=#F1DC2B>Dash</color>. </size>

Array.name: ContentsName_DLC_Godzilla_Codex
Array.english: Kaiju Codex
Array.indonesia: Ensiklopedia Kaiju

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Godzilla_Codex
Array.english: <size=24>Find the G-Force's Kaiju Figurines scattered across the Blue Hole and check their live-action photos, descriptions, and roar sound effects.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Temukan patung-patung Kaiju milik G-Force yang tersebar di Blue Hole dan periksa foto-foto live-action, deskripsi, serta efek suara raungannya.</size>

Array.name: Melee_GodzillaMissionMine_Description
Array.english: An unexploded mine from John Watson. It may explode on impact.
Array.indonesia: Ranjau yang belum meledak dari John Watson. Ranjau ini bisa meledak saat terkena benturan.

Array.name: Menu_Ebira_Chasing_Sashimi_Name
Array.english: Ebirah Chasing Sashimi
Array.indonesia: Ebirah Mengejar Sashimi

Array.name: Menu_Ebira_Chasing_Sashimi_Desc
Array.english: Sashimi depicting the moment where the submarine escaped from Ebirah. The giant Ebirah is made of California spiny lobster, and the submarine is made of barreleye.
Array.indonesia: Sashimi yang menggambarkan momen ketika kapal selam berhasil melarikan diri dari Ebirah. Ebirah raksasa terbuat dari lobster berduri California, sedangkan kapal selamnya terbuat dari ikan mata tong.

Array.name: Menu_Ebira_Godzilla_Curry_Name
Array.english: Godzilla vs. Ebirah Curry
Array.indonesia: Kari Godzilla vs. Ebirah

Array.name: Menu_Ebira_Godzilla_Curry_Desc
Array.english: Curry depicting the fierce battle between Godzilla and Ebirah. Godzilla is made of Moray eel, and Ebirah is made of fried European lobster.
Array.indonesia: Kari yang menggambarkan pertempuran sengit antara Godzilla dan Ebirah. Godzilla terbuat dari belut moray, sedangkan Ebirah terbuat dari lobster Eropa goreng.

Array.name: Menu_Underwater_Godzilla_Ramen_Name
Array.english: Deep Sea Kaiju Ramen
Array.indonesia: Ramen Kaiju Laut Dalam

Array.name: Menu_Underwater_Godzilla_Ramen_Desc
Array.english: A ramen dish depicting Godzilla lying in the deep sea. The cut seaweed resembles Godzilla, and comb jelly was used instead of ordinary wheat noodles to add more flavor.
Array.indonesia: Hidangan ramen yang menggambarkan Godzilla terbaring di laut dalam. Rumput laut yang dipotong menyerupai Godzilla, dan ubur-ubur sisir digunakan sebagai pengganti mie gandum biasa untuk menambah rasa.

Array.name: Cooksta_Content_Menu_Ebira_Chasing_Sashimi
Array.english: To let the submarine escape safely... I should eat Ebirah first, right?\n<color=#3a8ed6>#ebirah #submarine #bancho_sushi</color>
Array.indonesia: Agar kapal selam bisa melarikan diri dengan selamat... aku harus makan Ebirah dulu, kan?\n<color=#3a8ed6>#ebirah #submarine #bancho_sushi</color>

Array.name: Cooksta_Content_Menu_Ebira_Godzilla_Curry
Array.english: I think there's a kaiju movie that looked just like this... I can't remember.\n<color=#3a8ed6>#bancho_sushi #ebirah #godzilla #curry</color>
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya ada film kaiju yang persis seperti ini... Aku tidak ingat.\n<color=#3a8ed6>#bancho_sushi #ebirah #godzilla #curry</color>

Array.name: Cooksta_Content_Menu_Underwater_Godzilla_Ramen
Array.english: A dish that depicts a deep sea kaiju? Isn't that just some hoax?\n<color=#3a8ed6>#kaiju #ramen #bancho_sushi #combjelly</color>
Array.indonesia: Hidangan yang menggambarkan kaiju laut dalam? Bukankah itu hanya hoaks?\n<color=#3a8ed6>#kaiju #ramen #bancho_sushi #combjelly</color>
