Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_Firsttalk_001
Array.english: Woah,\nlooks like there’re a lot more tourists around these days.
Array.indonesia: Wah, \n sepertinya ada lebih banyak turis di sekitar sini akhir-akhir ini.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_Firsttalk_002
Array.english: Indeed. The Blue Hole appears to be gaining fame.
Array.indonesia: Benar juga. Blue Hole tampaknya semakin terkenal.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_Firsttalk_003
Array.english: I must strive even harder in cooking to live up to expectations.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus berusaha lebih keras lagi dalam memasak agar bisa memenuhi harapan mereka.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchosushi_Kasuga_Enter_001
Array.english: <size=34>Sorry to barge in, I know it's late, but…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34> Maaf mengganggu, aku tahu sudah larut, tapi…</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchosushi_Kasuga_Enter_002
Array.english: Hm...? Who might you be? We’re closed for the day.
Array.indonesia: Hm...? Siapa kamu? Kami sudah tutup hari ini.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchosushi_Kasuga_Enter_003
Array.english: Ah, guess it’s already over… Just my luck.
Array.indonesia: Ah, sepertinya sudah selesai… Nasibku memang sial.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchosushi_Kasuga_Enter_004
Array.english: Sorry about this, we’re tourists from Japan.
Array.indonesia: Maaf ya, kami turis dari Jepang.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchosushi_Kasuga_Enter_005
Array.english: The roaming connection was bad, and the map wouldn’t load properly, so we had a hard time finding this place...
Array.indonesia: Sinyal roamingnya jelek, dan peta tidak bisa dimuat dengan benar, jadi kami kesulitan menemukan tempat ini.. .

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchosushi_Kasuga_Enter_006
Array.english: <size=32>We haven’t eaten since this morning…\nI know it’s rude to ask, but is there anything we could eat?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kami belum makan sejak pagi tadi…\nSaya tahu ini kurang sopan, tapi adakah sesuatu yang bisa kami makan?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchosushi_Kasuga_Enter_007
Array.english: Well... I’ve just cleaned up... \nUnfortunately, there’s nothing at the moment.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Saya baru saja selesai membersihkan... \nSayangnya, saat ini tidak ada apa-apa.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchosushi_Kasuga_Enter_008
Array.english: Well then... never mind the food.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah... lupakan soal makanannya.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchosushi_Kasuga_Enter_009
Array.english: Oh? There's some liquor over there.\nWould you be able to make something refreshing,\nlike a <color=#1DFEAF>cocktail</color>?
Array.indonesia: Oh? Ada minuman beralkohol di sana.\nBisakah kamu membuat sesuatu yang menyegarkan,\nseperti <color=#1DFEAF>koktail</color>?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchosushi_Kasuga_Enter_010
Array.english: <color=#1DFEAF>Cocktail</color> should be fine!\nI'll make one for you right away! Here you go!
Array.indonesia: <color=#1DFEAF>Koktail</color> pasti bisa!\nAku akan segera membuatkannya untukmu! Ini dia!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_AfterCocktail01_001
Array.english: <size=36>Thank you... Wait...!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Terima kasih... Tunggu... !?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_AfterCocktail01_002
Array.english: <size=32>What’s wrong?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ada apa?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_AfterCocktail01_003
Array.english: This mixture tastes off… Perhaps there’s an issue with the way the ingredients are stored?
Array.indonesia: Campuran ini rasanya aneh… Mungkin ada masalah dengan cara penyimpanan bahan-bahannya?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_AfterCocktail01_004
Array.english: Never mind. I suppose I shouldn’t expect much more from a small town like this.
Array.indonesia: Sudahlah. Sepertinya aku tidak boleh berharap banyak dari kota kecil seperti ini.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_AfterCocktail01_005
Array.english: <size=31>... What do you mean? \nAre you saying it tastes foul?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>... Apa maksudmu? \nMaksudmu rasanya tidak enak?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_AfterCocktail01_006
Array.english: It’s not that bad…\nIt seems you haven’t really studied cocktails professionally?
Array.indonesia: Tidak seburuk itu…\nSepertinya kamu belum benar-benar mempelajari koktail secara profesional?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_AfterCocktail01_007
Array.english: Uhh... the cocktail is a skill we have only recently acquired.\nOur true specialty, of course, lies in fish dishes.
Array.indonesia: Uhh... membuat koktail adalah keterampilan yang baru saja kami kuasai.\nKeahlian utama kami, tentu saja, ada pada hidangan ikan.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_AfterCocktail01_008
Array.english: Hmph. Well, that’s a relief.
Array.indonesia: Hmph. Yah, itu melegakan.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_AfterCocktail01_009
Array.english: <size=33>Hmph...! What do you mean by that?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hmph...! Apa maksudmu dengan itu?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_AfterCocktail01_010
Array.english: Sorry! He didn’t mean anything by it.\nHe’s just a bit on edge from the long journey and being hungry.
Array.indonesia: Maaf! Dia tidak bermaksud apa-apa.\nDia hanya sedikit tegang karena perjalanan panjang dan lapar.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_AfterCocktail01_011
Array.english: Still, this place is way cooler than the photos in the guidebook.
Array.indonesia: Meski begitu, tempat ini jauh lebih keren daripada foto-foto di buku panduan.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_AfterCocktail01_012
Array.english: And a sushi spot right by the beach?\nThe location’s amazing!
Array.indonesia: Dan ada tempat sushi tepat di tepi pantai?\nLokasinya luar biasa!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_AfterCocktail01_013
Array.english: <size=32>Thanks for the meal! We’re kinda tired from our late flight, haha. We’ll get going then!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Terima kasih atas makanannya! Kami agak lelah karena penerbangan larut malam, haha. Kami akan berangkat dulu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_AfterCocktail02_001
Array.english: They left like a storm, but they were interesting people.
Array.indonesia: Mereka pergi dengan terburu-buru, tapi mereka orang-orang yang menarik.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_AfterCocktail02_002
Array.english: Um... the cocktail...\nwas perfectly fine... what could be the issue?
Array.indonesia: Um... koktailnya...\nsempurna kok. .. apa masalahnya?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_AfterCocktail02_003
Array.english: Come on, don’t overthink it!\nThey’re just tourists after all.
Array.indonesia: Ayolah, jangan dipikirin terlalu dalam!\nLagipula mereka cuma turis.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_AfterCocktail02_004
Array.english: Maybe I didn’t mix it right, who knows!
Array.indonesia: Mungkin aku nggak mencampurnya dengan benar, siapa tahu!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_AfterCocktail02_005
Array.english: The cleaning’s all done, so let’s head home!
Array.indonesia: Pembersihannya sudah selesai, jadi ayo pulang!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_AfterCocktail02_006
Array.english: …Alright, got it...
Array.indonesia: …Oke, paham...

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue01_001
Array.english: Now that I think about it, we had some tough-looking customers from Japan yesterday.
Array.indonesia: Kalau dipikir-pikir, kemarin ada beberapa pelanggan dari Jepang yang kelihatan garang.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue01_002
Array.english: <size=32>Huh? Did they cause trouble?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hah? Apa mereka bikin masalah?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue01_003
Array.english: Nope, nothing like that...\nThey just looked a little scary, I guess?
Array.indonesia: Nggak, nggak ada yang kayak gitu...\nMereka cuma kelihatan agak menakutkan, kayaknya?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue01_004
Array.english: A scar-faced person criticized our cocktail and caused \nsome tension.
Array.indonesia: Ada orang berwajah bekas luka yang mengkritik koktail kita dan bikin \nsuasana jadi tegang.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue01_005
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! Bancho Sushi isn’t exactly known for its drinks!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Bancho Sushi memang nggak terlalu terkenal dengan minumannya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue01_2_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh! Thanks again for yesterday!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh! Terima kasih lagi untuk kemarin!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue01_2_002
Array.english: Hmm?
Array.indonesia: Hmm?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue02_001
Array.english: <size=32>Man! This place is really great for beating the heat! </size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wah! Tempat ini benar-benar asyik buat menghalau panas! </size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue02_002
Array.english: Oh, you’re that scary guy from last time. \nEnjoying your vacation?
Array.indonesia: Oh, kamu si cowok menakutkan itu dari kemarin. \nLagi menikmati liburan?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue02_003
Array.english: Yeah, the waves are calm and there are all kinds of fish...\nThis place is the best!
Array.indonesia: Iya, ombaknya tenang dan ada berbagai macam ikan...\nTempat ini yang terbaik!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue02_004
Array.english: Cool! Well, stop by our restaurant for a meal next time.
Array.indonesia: Keren! Nah, mampir ke restoran kami buat makan lain kali.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue02_005
Array.english: Haha! Sure. \nOh, I’m <color=#F1DC2B>Kasuga</color>, by the way.
Array.indonesia: Haha! Oke. \nOh, ngomong-ngomong, aku <color=#F1DC2B>Kasuga</color>.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue02_006
Array.english: The guy that was with me that time... Um... \nJust call him <color=#F1DC2B>Bartender</color>.
Array.indonesia: Cowok yang bareng aku waktu itu... Um... \nPanggil saja dia <color=#F1DC2B>Bartender</color>.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue02_007
Array.english: I’m Dave, and this is Cobra.
Array.indonesia: Aku Dave, dan ini Cobra.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue02_008
Array.english: Hahaha! Funny hairstyle!\nDid you get caught in an explosion or something?
Array.indonesia: Hahaha! Gaya rambutnya lucu!\nKamu kena ledakan atau gimana?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue02_009
Array.english: Ah this...\nI was going for a punch perm, but it failed spectacularly.
Array.indonesia: Ah, ini...\nAku mau coba gaya rambut punch perm, tapi gagal total.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue02_010
Array.english: <size=33>Huh?\nThat sounded like a dolphin?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hah?\nTadi kedengarannya kayak lumba-lumba?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue03_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oi! Get outta my way, old man!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hei! Minggir, Pak Tua!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue03_002
Array.english: Are you... talkin’ to me?
Array.indonesia: Apa kamu... ngomong sama aku?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue03_003
Array.english: <size=33>Of course I’m talkin’ to you!\nYou’re gettin’ in the way of us catchin’ dolphins!\nYou wanna get shot at?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tentu saja aku ngomong sama kamu!\nKamu menghalangi kami menangkap lumba-lumba!\nMau ditembak?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue03_004
Array.english: <size=33>Catching dolphins...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Menangkap lumba-lumba...?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue03_005
Array.english: <size=35>It's those Sea Blue guys again!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Itu orang-orang Sea Blue lagi!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue03_006
Array.english: Huh? That’s the guy who snuck into our base...!
Array.indonesia: Hah? Itu orang yang menyelinap ke markas kita...!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue03_007
Array.english: You think hidin’ behind a mask would fool us?\nWe got chewed out by the boss ‘cuz of you!
Array.indonesia: Kamu pikir bersembunyi di balik topeng bisa menipu kami?\nKami dimarahi bos karena kamu!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue03_008
Array.english: <size=35>Nice runnin’ into you! Get ready to eat lead!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Senang bertemu denganmu! Bersiaplah untuk ditembak!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue04_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ugh...! Why the heck are his punches so darn strong...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ugh...! Kenapa sih pukulannya begitu kuat...!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue04_002
Array.english: <size=35>You’ll regret this, you bastards!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Kalian akan menyesal, bajingan-bajingan!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_001
Array.english: What’s with these dudes?
Array.indonesia: Ada apa dengan orang-orang ini?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_002
Array.english: They’re from <color=#90CDFF>Sea Blue</color>, an organization running an illegal dolphin-poaching operation.
Array.indonesia: Mereka berasal dari <color=#90CDFF>Sea Blue</color>, sebuah organisasi yang menjalankan operasi perburuan lumba-lumba ilegal.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_003
Array.english: I guess they aren’t ordinary pirates, huh?
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya mereka bukan bajak laut biasa, ya?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_004
Array.english: I snuck into their base the other day, but...
Array.indonesia: Aku menyusup ke markas mereka beberapa hari yang lalu, tapi...

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_005
Array.english: Turned out they were running a meat processing plant.
Array.indonesia: Ternyata mereka mengoperasikan pabrik pengolahan daging.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_006
Array.english: They even had some kind of experiment plans written \non the walls...
Array.indonesia: Mereka bahkan punya semacam rencana eksperimen yang tertulis \ndi dinding...

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_007
Array.english: That's fishy, like they’re trying to do something with dolphins.\nPeople like that, if you leave them alone, they’ll just multiply like cockroaches.
Array.indonesia: Itu mencurigakan, seolah-olah mereka mencoba melakukan sesuatu pada lumba-lumba.\nOrang-orang seperti itu, kalau dibiarkan begitu saja, mereka akan berkembang biak seperti kecoa.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_008
Array.english: <size=32>It seems we were fated to meet. Lemme help ya out!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Sepertinya kita memang ditakdirkan untuk bertemu. Biar aku bantu kamu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_009
Array.english: Um... Thanks for the offer, but the entrance to their base is hidden behind a thick steel gate under the sea.
Array.indonesia: Um... Terima kasih atas tawarannya, tapi pintu masuk ke markas mereka tersembunyi di balik gerbang baja tebal di bawah laut.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_010
Array.english: I managed to tail a drone to enter the gate before…\nBut now, security's probably much stricter than before.
Array.indonesia: Aku sempat mengikuti sebuah drone untuk masuk ke gerbang itu sebelumnya…\nTapi sekarang, pengamanannya mungkin jauh lebih ketat daripada sebelumnya.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_010_1
Array.english: <size=32>I might not seem like it, but I've survived plenty of brutal fights back in Japan. Just leave it to me!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Mungkin aku nggak kelihatan begitu, tapi aku udah selamat dari banyak pertarungan brutal di Jepang. Serahkan saja padaku!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_011
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! Just telling me to leave it to you? \nYou're a funny one!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Cuma bilang suruh serahkan padamu? \nKamu lucu banget!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_012
Array.english: Your hair reminded me of somethin’...
Array.indonesia: Rambutmu bikin aku inget sesuatu...

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_013
Array.english: I’ve got a spare <color=#1DFEAF>Large Explosive</color> with me!\nShould be enough to blow open that door!
Array.indonesia: Aku bawa <color=#1DFEAF>Bahan Peledak Besar</color> cadangan!\nSeharusnya cukup untuk meledakkan pintu itu!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_014
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(Why would you keep spare explosives on you...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Kenapa kamu bawa bahan peledak cadangan...)</color>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_015
Array.english: So... Looks like this will depend on you and your great swimming abilities, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Jadi... Sepertinya ini akan bergantung padamu dan kemampuan renangmu yang hebat, Dave.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_016
Array.english: We’ll definitely run into more pirates on the way too...
Array.indonesia: Kita pasti akan bertemu lebih banyak bajak laut di sepanjang jalan juga...

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_017
Array.english: Can you swim, Kasuga?
Array.indonesia: Kamu bisa berenang, Kasuga?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_018
Array.english: Haha! Of course! But I’m not that great at it, though.
Array.indonesia: Haha! Tentu saja! Tapi aku nggak terlalu jago sih.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_019
Array.english: Then I’ll lend you some diving gear. \nYou can escort Dave.
Array.indonesia: Kalau gitu, aku pinjamkan perlengkapan selam. \nKamu bisa mengawal Dave.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_020
Array.english: That means you’ll be carrying the bomb, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Itu berarti kamu yang akan membawa bomnya, Dave.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_020_1
Array.english: …But it looks very heavy.
Array.indonesia: …Tapi kelihatannya sangat berat.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_020_2
Array.english: Hahaha! Being underwater should make it easier than on land.
Array.indonesia: Hahaha! Di bawah air seharusnya lebih mudah daripada di darat.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_021
Array.english: Let's see...\nA late night like last time might be too dangerous for Kasuga…
Array.indonesia: Coba kita pikirkan...\nMalam larut seperti terakhir kali mungkin terlalu berbahaya bagi Kasuga…

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_022
Array.english: <size=33>Evening would be best, before it gets too dark!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Sore hari akan lebih baik, sebelum terlalu gelap!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_023
Array.english: You guys should head out before the sushi bar opens at night.
Array.indonesia: Kalian sebaiknya berangkat sebelum bar sushi buka di malam hari.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_024
Array.english: <size=34>Let’s gather back here after your afternoon dive!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ayo berkumpul kembali di sini setelah penyelaman sore kalian!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Boat01_001
Array.english: <size=34>Great! You’re all back. \nAre you guys ready?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Bagus! Kalian semua sudah kembali. \nKalian sudah siap?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Boat01_002
Array.english: Of course! I’m itching for a fight!
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja! Aku sudah tidak sabar ingin bertarung!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Boat01_003
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! I like your enthusiasm.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Aku suka antusiasme kalian.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Boat01_004
Array.english: All right. Dave, grab that <color=#1DFEAF>Large Explosive</color> over there.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah. Dave, ambil <color=#1DFEAF>Bahan Peledak Besar</color> yang ada di sana.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Boat02_001
Array.english: Ugh... This is really heavy. \nCarrying this is gonna be a pain.
Array.indonesia: Ugh... Ini benar-benar berat. \nMembawanya pasti bakal merepotkan.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Boat02_002
Array.english: Fear not! I’ll escort you.
Array.indonesia: Jangan khawatir! Aku akan menemanimu.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Boat02_003
Array.english: Hahaha! That’s the spirit. \nI’ll leave it to you guys then!
Array.indonesia: Hahaha! Itu baru semangat. \nKalau begitu, aku serahkan pada kalian!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Boat02_004
Array.english: <size=34>Let’s end this once and for all!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ayo selesaikan ini sekali dan untuk selamanya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Diving_001
Array.english: You got that radar I gave you, Kasuga?
Array.indonesia: Kamu sudah dapat radar yang kuberikan, Kasuga?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Diving_002
Array.english: Sure thing. Do I just follow what it says on here?
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja. Apa aku tinggal ikuti petunjuk di sini saja?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Diving_003
Array.english: <size=35>Looks really simple!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Kelihatannya sangat sederhana!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage01Start_001
Array.english: Huh? Diving at this hour...?
Array.indonesia: Hah? Menyelam pada jam segini...?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage01Start_002
Array.english: <size=34>Suspicious! What’re ya up to?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Mencurigakan! Apa yang sedang kamu rencanakan?!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage01Start_003
Array.english: <size=34>We’re gonna blow up your base...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kita bakal meledakkan markas kalian...</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage01Start_004
Array.english: Ah, Kasuga... If you say something like that...!
Array.indonesia: Ah, Kasuga... Kalau kamu bilang begitu...!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage01Start_005
Array.english: You’ve got some nerve saying that so bluntly!\nI’ll make sure you learn the hard way if you try to get in our way!
Array.indonesia: Kamu berani banget ngomong begitu blak-blakan!\nAku bakal pastikan kamu belajar dengan cara yang keras kalau kamu coba menghalangi kami!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage01Start_006
Array.english: <size=32>Ya not gonna get away this time!\nNot with that heavy thing in ya hand!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kamu nggak bakal bisa kabur kali ini!\nNggak dengan benda berat di tanganmu itu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage01Start_007
Array.english: <size=35>Pfft. I’ll take you on!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Pfft. Aku bakal hadapi kamu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage01End_001
Array.english: Those Sea Blue guys, looks like they were up to something at this hour.
Array.indonesia: Orang-orang Sea Blue itu, sepertinya mereka sedang merencanakan sesuatu di jam segini.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage01End_002
Array.english: I think there are more of them around.
Array.indonesia: Kurasa masih ada lagi di sekitar sini.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage01End_003
Array.english: <size=32>Don’t matter how many there are!\nI’ll beat the lights out of ‘em!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Nggak peduli berapa banyak jumlahnya!\nAku bakal hajar mereka habis-habisan!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage02Start_001
Array.english: <size=33>Whatcha think ya doin’?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kamu pikir lagi ngapain sih?!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage02Start_002
Array.english: <size=33>Ugh! It’s those pirate guys again...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ugh! Itu bajak laut lagi...</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage02Start_003
Array.english: Watch out. They might be carrying deadlier weapons.
Array.indonesia: Hati-hati. Mereka mungkin membawa senjata yang lebih mematikan.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage02End_001
Array.english: Phew... What the heck are they even doin’ here?\nWhat’s with all the security?
Array.indonesia: Fiuh... Apa sih yang mereka lakukan di sini?\nKenapa pengamanannya segini ketat?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage02End_002
Array.english: Yeah, I mean, for just dolphin-poaching, this is a little over \nthe top...
Array.indonesia: Iya, maksudku, buat sekadar perburuan lumba-lumba, ini agak \nberlebihan...

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage02End_003
Array.english: <size=34>Let’s just keep pressing forward.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ayo terus maju saja.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage03Start_001
Array.english: <size=34>That’s the door up ahead!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Itu pintunya di depan!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage03Start_002
Array.english: I knew it, there’re people guardin’ it.
Array.indonesia: Sudah kuduga, ada orang yang menjaganya.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage03Start_003
Array.english: Wait right here.
Array.indonesia: Tunggu di sini.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage03Start_004
Array.english: <size=33>I’ll handle it right away!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku akan mengatasinya sekarang juga!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage03End_001
Array.english: Phew... It’s not easy fighting underwater...
Array.indonesia: Wah... Tidak mudah bertarung di bawah air...

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage03End_002
Array.english: I think that’s the last of them.
Array.indonesia: Kurasa itu yang terakhir.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage03End_003
Array.english: <size=33>Glad to hear it. Let's head toward the door!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Senang mendengarnya. Ayo kita menuju pintu itu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BombSet_001
Array.english: Time to set up the door with this explosive.
Array.indonesia: Saatnya memasang bahan peledak ini di pintu.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BombSet_002
Array.english: Just a sec, Kasuga.
Array.indonesia: Tunggu sebentar, Kasuga.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BombSet_Faraway_001
Array.english: <size=32>All right! It’s done.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oke! Sudah selesai.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BombSet_Faraway_002
Array.english: <size=34>Take a step back, and I’ll set it off!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Mundur sedikit, aku akan meledakkannya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BaseEnter_001
Array.english: <size=35>Awesome, it’s open! Let’s go in!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Keren, pintunya terbuka! Ayo masuk!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BaseInside01_001
Array.english: Ugh... This place is just as unpleasant the second time around.
Array.indonesia: Ugh... Tempat ini tetap sama tidak menyenangkannya saat dikunjungi untuk kedua kalinya.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BaseInside01_002
Array.english: There’s gonna be a bunch of armed pirates up ahead.\nKeep your eyes peeled.
Array.indonesia: Nanti bakal ada banyak bajak laut bersenjata di depan.\nTetap waspada.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BaseInside01_003
Array.english: I’ve fought tougher guys than this. \nThis is a piece of cake...
Array.indonesia: Aku pernah melawan musuh yang lebih tangguh dari ini. \nIni gampang banget...

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BaseInside02_001
Array.english: <size=35>Cobra...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Cobra...?!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BaseInside02_002
Array.english: Hahaha! Even if you're good at fighting, pal,\nI was still worried about letting you go alone.
Array.indonesia: Hahaha! Meskipun kamu jago bertarung, sobat,\naku tetap khawatir membiarkanmu pergi sendirian.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BaseInside02_003
Array.english: Don’t overdo it, or you’re gonna hurt yourself, old man.
Array.indonesia: Jangan berlebihan, atau kamu bakal terluka, Pak Tua.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BaseInside02_004
Array.english: Pfft. Don’t you worry about me. I’m ex-special forces... Although I left early due to certain circumstances.
Array.indonesia: Pfft. Jangan khawatirkan aku. Aku mantan pasukan khusus... Meskipun aku keluar lebih awal karena keadaan tertentu.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BaseInside02_005
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(Oh... This is the first time I heard about this.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Oh... Ini pertama kalinya aku dengar soal ini.)</color>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BaseInside02_006
Array.english: <size=34>I’m itching for some action after so long!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku sudah tak sabar ingin bertarung setelah sekian lama!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BaseInside02_007
Array.english: <size=34>All right, this is a job for the ultimate trio then!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Baiklah, ini tugas untuk trio terhebat!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BaseInside02_008
Array.english: Dave... Hate to kill the mood... \nI need your help with something else…
Array.indonesia: Dave... Maaf mengganggu suasana... . \nAku butuh bantuanmu untuk hal lain…

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BaseInside02_009
Array.english: ...Huh? But I’m going with you...!
Array.indonesia: ...Hah? Tapi aku mau ikut denganmu...!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BaseInside02_010
Array.english: <size=33>Ah! Why don’t you find us an escape route back to \nthe dry land? </size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ah! Kenapa kamu tidak mencari rute pelarian untuk kembali ke \ndaratan kering? </size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BaseInside02_011
Array.english: <size=33>I need you on this top-secret mission! \nIt’s more important!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku butuh kamu dalam misi rahasia ini! \nIni lebih penting!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BaseInside02_012
Array.english: <size=34>I-I see! A secret mission!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>O-oh, begitu! Misi rahasia!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BaseInside02_013
Array.english: <size=34>All right. I’ll let you handle the rest then!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Baiklah. Aku serahkan sisanya padamu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BaseInside02_014
Array.english: <size=35>Let's go all out!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ayo kita beraksi habis-habisan!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_001
Array.english: <size=32>Heh, you've got some spirit, pal.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Heh, kamu punya semangat, kawan.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_002
Array.english: <size=32>Haha. Just try not to hurt your back, old man!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha. Jangan sampai punggungmu sakit, Pak Tua!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Lab_001
Array.english: This place... Looks like some kinda lab.
Array.indonesia: Tempat ini.. . Kelihatannya seperti semacam laboratorium.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Lab_002
Array.english: Something is off here. Let’s keep going.
Array.indonesia: Ada yang aneh di sini. Ayo kita lanjutkan.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss01_001
Array.english: <size=32>M-Mr. Torben! Intruders...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>T-Tuan Torben! Ada penyusup...!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss01_002
Array.english: Huh...? How did they get in here...?!
Array.indonesia: Hah...? Bagaimana mereka bisa masuk ke sini...?!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss01_003
Array.english: This... ain’t just a slaughterhouse, is it?
Array.indonesia: Ini... bukan sekadar rumah jagal, kan?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss01_004
Array.english: They’re catching dolphins and experimenting on them.\nWhat in the world...
Array.indonesia: Mereka menangkap lumba-lumba dan melakukan eksperimen pada mereka.\nApa-apaan ini...

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss01_005
Array.english: Argh... I don’t know what you’re doing here,\nbut you’re not leaving this place alive...!
Array.indonesia: Argh... Aku nggak tahu apa yang kamu lakukan di sini,\ntapi kamu nggak bakal keluar dari tempat ini hidup-hidup...!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss01_006
Array.english: <size=35>Take them out!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Habisi mereka!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss02_001
Array.english: <size=34>Ha...! You’re pretty good...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ha...! Kamu lumayan jago...!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss02_002
Array.english: As a sign of respect...\nI’ll take you on with my secret weapon!
Array.indonesia: Sebagai tanda penghormatan...\nAku akan menghadapimu dengan senjata rahasia ku!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss02_003
Array.english: <size=33>I’ll put you out of your misery soon enough!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku akan segera mengakhiri penderitaanmu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_001
Array.english: <size=32>Uhh... I haven’t used this in a while, did it get rusty...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Uhh... Sudah lama aku tidak menggunakan ini, apakah sudah berkarat...?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_002
Array.english: Guess I’ll have to inject some energy I harvested from the Blue Hole...
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya aku harus menyuntikkan sedikit energi yang kudapatkan dari Blue Hole...

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_003
Array.english: Though the research isn’t complete...\nthis will be a great opportunity for a test run! Hehe!
Array.indonesia: Meskipun penelitiannya belum selesai...\nini akan jadi kesempatan bagus untuk uji coba! Hehe!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_Majima01_001
Array.english: Ow... I twisted my ankle.
Array.indonesia: Aduh... Pergelangan kakiku terkilir.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_Majima01_002
Array.english: Uh... This is gonna be tough.
Array.indonesia: Uh... Ini bakal sulit.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_Majima01_003
Array.english: <size=33>Now, I will end you with this final blow!!\nBrace yourselves! Hehe!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Sekarang, aku akan menghabisimu dengan pukulan terakhir ini!!\nBersiaplah! Hehe!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_Majima02_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oi, frizzhead!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hei, si rambut keriting!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_Majima02_002
Array.english: ... Majima-san? How did you get here?
Array.indonesia: ... Majima-san? Bagaimana kamu bisa sampai di sini?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_Majima02_003
Array.english: Heard you were flyin’ overseas, so I followed you here,\nthought I’d get to meet Kiryu-chan...
Array.indonesia: Dengar-dengar kamu terbang ke luar negeri, jadi aku mengikutimu ke sini,\npikirku bisa ketemu Kiryu-chan...

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_Majima02_004
Array.english: <size=33>What’s with this mess?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ada apa dengan kekacauan ini?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_Majima02_005
Array.english: Uh... This is embarrassing.
Array.indonesia: Uh... Ini memalukan.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_Majima02_006
Array.english: <size=33>Who’s Kiryu...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Siapa Kiryu...?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_Majima02_007
Array.english: The legend... the Dragon of Dojima, Kiryu Kazuma.
Array.indonesia: Legenda... Naga Dojima, Kiryu Kazuma.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_Majima02_008
Array.english: He suddenly disappeared off somewhere.\nVanished into thin air...
Array.indonesia: Dia tiba-tiba menghilang entah ke mana.\nLenyap begitu saja...

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_Majima02_009
Array.english: Oh… So there was someone like that huh? \nAnyway, you with the eye patch, can you lend us a hand?
Array.indonesia: Oh… Jadi ada orang seperti itu ya? \nBagaimanapun, kamu yang pakai penutup mata, bisakah kamu membantu kami?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_Majima02_010
Array.english: Hee hee hee. I was just itching for a fight.\nI’ll lend you a hand!
Array.indonesia: Hee hee hee. Aku memang sudah tak sabar ingin bertarung.\nAku akan membantumu!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_Majima02_011
Array.english: <size=33>Just sit there and watch, will ya!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Duduk saja di sana dan tonton saja, ya!?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_End01_001
Array.english: <size=38>I-Impossible! My Killer Crab Mk-III...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>T-Tidak mungkin! Kepiting Pembunuh Mk-III-ku...!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_End01_002
Array.english: Argh... I won’t let you off so easily...
Array.indonesia: Argh... Aku tidak akan membiarkan kalian lolos begitu saja...

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_End01_003
Array.english: <size=32>I’m not letting just you guys get away.\nLet’s become Blue Hole’s shark bait together!! Hehehehe!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku tidak akan membiarkan kalian saja yang lolos.\nAyo kita jadi umpan hiu di Blue Hole bersama-sama!! Hehehehe!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_End02_001
Array.english: <size=33>Th-That guy’s planning to burn this whole place to the ground!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>O-Orang itu berencana membakar seluruh tempat ini sampai rata dengan tanah!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_End02_002
Array.english: <size=34>Ugh... Let’s get outta here!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ugh... Ayo kita keluar dari sini!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_End03_001
Array.english: <size=34>This way! I found our way out!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ke sini! Aku sudah menemukan jalan keluarnya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Complete_001
Array.english: Phew... Close call.
Array.indonesia: Fiuh... Hampir saja.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Complete_001_1
Array.english: That was close...\nWe wouldn't made it without Majima-san.
Array.indonesia: Itu tadi nyaris...\nKita tidak akan selamat tanpa Majima-san.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Complete_001_2
Array.english: <size=32>I owe you big time.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku berhutang budi besar padamu.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Complete_001_3
Array.english: You haven’t been getting too soft lately, have ya? \nHeh, I needed a little stretch anyway.
Array.indonesia: Kamu nggak jadi terlalu lembek belakangan ini, kan? \nHeh, lagipula aku memang butuh sedikit peregangan.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Complete_001_4
Array.english: You got me there…
Array.indonesia: Kamu benar juga…

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Complete_002
Array.english: Anyways, those Sea Blue guys won’t be showin’ their faces around here for a while!
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun, orang-orang Sea Blue itu nggak akan muncul di sekitar sini untuk sementara waktu!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Complete_003
Array.english: Hahaha! \nLet’s have a toast at the sushi bar once we close up!
Array.indonesia: Hahaha! \nAyo bersulang di bar sushi setelah kita tutup!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Complete_004
Array.english: Appreciate the sentiment but I’m gonna take off to go find Kiryu-chan.
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih atas niat baiknya, tapi aku harus pergi mencari Kiryu-chan.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Complete_005
Array.english: Well, that was fun. \nCatch ya'll somewhere down the line!
Array.indonesia: Wah, itu seru banget. \nSampai jumpa lagi nanti!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Complete_006
Array.english: Too bad, he seemed like an interesting fella.\nCatch you all later tonight then!
Array.indonesia: Sayang sekali, dia kelihatannya orang yang menarik.\nSampai jumpa nanti malam!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Complete_007
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(Huh... But what exactly were they researching...?)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Huh... Tapi apa sebenarnya yang mereka teliti...?)</color>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Complete_008
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(That research director seemed oddly familiar, too...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Direktur penelitian itu juga kelihatan anehnya familiar...)</color>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission01_001
Array.english: <size=34>Wow! This is the bomb!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wow! Ini luar biasa!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission01_002
Array.english: <size=31>I’ve never seen fish like this before, and they taste out of this world... This is amazing, Bancho-san!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Aku belum pernah melihat ikan seperti ini sebelumnya, dan rasanya luar biasa... Ini luar biasa, Bancho-san!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission01_003
Array.english: You flatter me.\nI am but merely drawing out the flavor of the ingredients.
Array.indonesia: Kamu terlalu memujiku.\nAku hanya mengeluarkan rasa dari bahan-bahannya saja.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission01_004
Array.english: Hmm... This sushi is tasty without a doubt.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Sushi ini memang enak, tak diragukan lagi.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission01_005
Array.english: <size=33>Try as you might, even you cannot find fault with my sushi.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Seberapa keras pun kamu mencoba, bahkan kamu pun tak bisa menemukan kekurangan pada sushi buatan saya.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission01_006
Array.english: This is something I can’t help but acknowledge. Then, I will fully enjoy the sushi here… As for "that dish", I suppose I’ll have it once I return to Yokohama.</size>
Array.indonesia: Ini adalah sesuatu yang tak bisa saya sangkal. Kalau begitu, saya akan menikmati sushi di sini sepenuhnya… Adapun “hidangan itu”, saya kira saya akan mencobanya setelah kembali ke Yokohama.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission01_007
Array.english: <size=35>"That dish"? What do you speak of...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>"Hidangan itu"? Apa yang kamu maksud...?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission01_008
Array.english: <size=33>Ah, <color=#F1DC2B>Cold Noodles</color>, that is. \nSince this is a sushi bar, I thought it would be difficult to have it here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ah, <color=#F1DC2B>Mi Dingin</color>, maksudku. \nKarena ini bar sushi, kupikir akan sulit untuk memesan hidangan itu di sini.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission01_009
Array.english: <size=34>Don't underestimate me!\nThere is no dish I cannot prepare!!\nI shall make that Cold... <color=#F1DC2B>Cold Noodles</color> and prove it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Jangan remehkan aku!\nTidak ada hidangan yang tidak bisa aku buat!!\nAku akan membuat Mie... <color=#F1DC2B>Mie Dingin</color> itu dan membuktikannya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission01_010
Array.english: <size=35>Come back <color=#F1DC2B>3 days</color> later.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Kembalilah <color=#F1DC2B>3 hari</color> lagi.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission02_001
Array.english: What’s gotten into you this time?
Array.indonesia: Ada apa denganmu kali ini?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission02_002
Array.english: I can tolerate the cocktail, but I cannot bear anyone disparaging my cooking skills!
Array.indonesia: Aku bisa mentolerir koktail itu, tapi aku tidak bisa mentolerir siapa pun yang meremehkan kemampuan memasakku!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission02_003
Array.english: It is not merely about making <color=#F1DC2B>Cold Noodles</color>. To silence that man, one requires a rather unexpected topping.
Array.indonesia: Ini bukan sekadar soal membuat <color=#F1DC2B>Mie Dingin</color>. Untuk membungkam pria itu, dibutuhkan topping yang cukup tak terduga.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission02_004
Array.english: First, I’ll need some <color=#1DFEAF>Buckwheat</color> to make the noodles...
Array.indonesia: Pertama, aku butuh <color=#1DFEAF>gandum hitam</color> untuk membuat mie...

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission02_005
Array.english: How about asking <color=#F1DC2B>Otto</color> at the farm?\nHe might have some buckwheat seeds.
Array.indonesia: Bagaimana kalau tanya <color=#F1DC2B>Otto</color> di pertanian?\nDia mungkin punya biji buckwheat.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission02_006
Array.english: That works. What else do you need?
Array.indonesia: Itu bisa. Apa lagi yang kamu butuhkan?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission02_007
Array.english: I’ll need <color=#1DFEAF>Stingrays</color> to craft a unique flavor.\nThree pieces should do.
Array.indonesia: Aku butuh <color=#1DFEAF>Ikan Pari</color> untuk menciptakan rasa yang unik.\nTiga potong sudah cukup.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission02_008
Array.english: Ah, and <color=#1DFEAF>Eggs</color> as a topping would do the trick.\nI’m counting on you.
Array.indonesia: Ah, dan <color=#1DFEAF>Telur</color> sebagai taburan pasti pas.\nAku mengandalkanmu.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission02_009
Array.english: That’s a lot, but I’ll give it a try….
Array.indonesia: Itu banyak, tapi aku akan mencobanya….

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission02_010
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(Guess I’ll ask Otto if he has any <color=#1DFEAF>Buckwheat seeds</color> tomorrow.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Sepertinya besok aku akan tanya Otto apakah dia punya <color=#1DFEAF>biji soba</color>.)</color>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission03_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hey, Otto!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hei, Otto!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission03_002
Array.english: Ayy, Dave. Long time no see.
Array.indonesia: Ayy, Dave. Lama nggak ketemu.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission03_003
Array.english: <size=33>Ya need somethin’?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Butuh apa?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission03_004
Array.english: <size=32>Um… I’m looking for <color=#1DFEAF>Buckwheat seeds</color> on behalf of Bancho.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Um… Aku lagi nyari <color=#1DFEAF>biji soba</color> atas nama Bancho.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission03_005
Array.english: Ha! You’re in luck! I was cravin’ some buckwheat noodles and got my hands on some <color=#1DFEAF>Buckwheat Seeds</color>.
Array.indonesia: Ha! Kamu beruntung! Aku lagi pengen makan mie soba dan kebetulan dapet <color=#1DFEAF>biji soba</color>.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission03_006
Array.english: Since I can’t process them myself... I just left ‘em there.\nIt’ll be great if you can grow ‘em! Hahaha.
Array.indonesia: Karena aku nggak bisa mengolahnya sendiri... aku tinggalin aja di sana.\nAkan bagus banget kalau kamu bisa menanamnya! Hahaha.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission03_007
Array.english: Oh! Perfect! Bancho is in need of some, too.
Array.indonesia: Oh! Sempurna! Bancho juga membutuhkannya.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission03_008
Array.english: <size=34>I’ll give it a shot then!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku akan mencobanya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionFail_001
Array.english: Darn... I couldn’t gather all the ingredients for \nthe <color=#F1DC2B>Cold Noodles</color>.
Array.indonesia: Sial... Aku tidak bisa mengumpulkan semua bahan untuk \n<color=#F1DC2B>Mi Dingin</color>.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionFail_002
Array.english: Guess you’ll have to ask Bartender to come some other time.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya kamu harus meminta Bartender datang lain kali.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete01_001
Array.english: The <color=#F1DC2B>Cold Noodles</color> ingredients are ready.
Array.indonesia: Bahan-bahan <color=#F1DC2B>Mie Dingin</color> sudah siap.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete01_002
Array.english: It’s flawless. Excellent work!
Array.indonesia: Sempurna. Kerja bagus!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete01_003
Array.english: Hehe.\nI’ll ask Bartender to drop by once we close for the day.
Array.indonesia: Hehe.\nAku akan minta Bartender mampir setelah kita tutup hari ini.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete02_001
Array.english: I got Dave’s message... Is it really ready?
Array.indonesia: Aku dapat pesan dari Dave... Benarkah sudah siap?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete02_002
Array.english: Pfft, Bancho-san, aren’t you just a sushi expert?\nThere’s no need to go overboard.
Array.indonesia: Pfft, Bancho-san, bukankah kamu cuma ahli sushi?\nNggak perlu berlebihan gitu.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete02_003
Array.english: <size=33>You talk too much. Just give it a taste.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kamu terlalu banyak bicara. Coba saja rasanya.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete03_001
Array.english: <size=37>Ha...! This certainly is delicious...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Ha...! Ini memang enak banget...!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete03_002
Array.english: <size=37>Umm... This fish...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Umm... Ikan ini...</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete03_003
Array.english: <size=33>It’s stingray.\nThey are usually eaten with cold noodles in Korea.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Itu ikan pari.\nDi Korea, ikan ini biasanya dimakan bersama mi dingin.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete03_004
Array.english: I heard stingrays have a strong smell...
Array.indonesia: Aku dengar ikan pari punya bau yang menyengat...

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete03_005
Array.english: But you can remove the smell by soaking it in soju and then mixing it with garlic and gochujang.
Array.indonesia: Tapi kamu bisa menghilangkan baunya dengan merendamnya dalam soju, lalu mencampurnya dengan bawang putih dan gochujang.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete03_006
Array.english: It leaves a chewy texture that goes great with cold noodles.
Array.indonesia: Teksturnya jadi kenyal dan sangat cocok dengan mi dingin.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete03_007
Array.english: <size=33>Haha... Seems I’ve lost. This I’ll admit.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Haha... Sepertinya aku kalah. Ini aku akui.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete03_008
Array.english: <size=35>You’re quite the chef.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Kamu memang jago masak.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete03_009
Array.english: <size=32>The flavor of the drink was somewhat disappointing, though...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Rasa minumannya agak mengecewakan, sih...</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete03_010
Array.english: <size=33>Ugh... You’re an unyielding man…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ugh... Kamu memang orang yang keras kepala…</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete03_011
Array.english: Apologies, I’m particular about cold noodles.\nThat aside, allow me to assist you as a token of gratitude.
Array.indonesia: Maaf, aku memang pilih-pilih soal mie dingin.\nTerlepas dari itu, izinkan aku membantumu sebagai tanda terima kasih.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete03_012
Array.english: <size=34>Here, a gift for you.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ini, hadiah untukmu.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete04_001
Array.english: What’s this...?
Array.indonesia: Apa ini...?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete04_002
Array.english: <size=33>A <color=#1DFEAF>Cocktail Shaker</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Sebuah <color=#1DFEAF>Cocktail Shaker</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete04_003
Array.english: You use it to make cocktails...\nIt helps you mix them a bit better.
Array.indonesia: Kamu menggunakannya untuk membuat koktail...\nIni membantumu mengaduknya dengan lebih baik.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete04_004
Array.english: And it’s fun watching it mix, haha.
Array.indonesia: Dan seru juga melihatnya berputar, haha.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete04_005
Array.english: <size=35>Oh! Looks like you two got along pretty well!\nGlad to see it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh! Sepertinya kalian berdua cukup akur!\nSenang melihatnya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete04_006
Array.english: We were just starting to bond...\nShame it’s the last day of our vacation.
Array.indonesia: Kami baru saja mulai akrab...\nSayang sekali ini hari terakhir liburan kami.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete04_007
Array.english: Ah... You’re flying back tomorrow, I see. What a pity.
Array.indonesia: Ah... Kamu akan terbang pulang besok, ya. Sayang sekali.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete04_008
Array.english: <size=35>Exactly. If you’re up for it...\nhow about we make the most of tonight?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Benar sekali. Kalau kamu mau...\ngimana kalau kita manfaatkan malam ini sebaik-baiknya?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete04_009
Array.english: <size=35>I even brought a karaoke machine just in case!\nHow ‘bout we sing a song together?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Aku bahkan bawa mesin karaoke buat jaga-jaga!\nGimana kalau kita nyanyi bareng?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete04_010
Array.english: <size=33>Huh? A karaoke machine?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hah? Mesin karaoke?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete04_011
Array.english: <size=32>There’re a ton of portable ones these days.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Sekarang ini banyak sekali yang portabel.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete04_012
Array.english: <size=33>We love karaoke too. Let’s have fun!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kita juga suka karaoke. Ayo bersenang-senang!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete04_013
Array.english: <size=33>Then, I’ll sing a song while reminiscing about my memories with <color=#F1DC2B>Kiryu-san</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kalau begitu, aku akan menyanyikan sebuah lagu sambil mengenang kenanganku bersama <color=#F1DC2B>Kiryu-san</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete04_014
Array.english: <size=33>Here, Dave! I’ll sing, and you play the tambourine to the beat of the music!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ini, Dave! Aku yang nyanyi, dan kamu mainkan rebana sesuai irama musiknya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete04_014_1
Array.english: <size=34>If you say so!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kalau kamu bilang begitu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete04_015
Array.english: <size=35>For <color=#F1DC2B>Kiryu-san</color>’s sake, let’s pump it up!\nHere comes <JUDGEMENT>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Demi <color=#F1DC2B>Kiryu-san</color>, ayo kita semarakkan suasana!\nIni dia <JUDGEMENT>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete05_001
Array.english: <size=34>Haha! A tambourine really hypes things up!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Haha! Tamburin benar-benar bikin suasana makin seru!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete05_002
Array.english: Man, I had so much fun! This trip was awesome!
Array.indonesia: Wah, aku benar-benar bersenang-senang! Perjalanan ini luar biasa!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete05_003
Array.english: <size=32>Time for us to get going.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Saatnya kita berangkat.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete05_004
Array.english: It was great meeting you, Kasuga and Bartender!
Array.indonesia: Senang bertemu denganmu, Kasuga dan Bartender!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete05_005
Array.english: Hahaha! Nice work, Kasuga.\nThis place’s gonna be a bit more peaceful, thanks to you.
Array.indonesia: Hahaha! Kerja bagus, Kasuga.\nTempat ini bakal jadi sedikit lebih tenang, berkat kamu.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete05_006
Array.english: Oh, it must be fate, meeting like this.\nI should probably get you a gift!
Array.indonesia: Oh, pasti ini takdir, bisa bertemu seperti ini.\nSepertinya aku harus memberimu hadiah!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete05_007
Array.english: Here you go! A phone charm of a character called <color=#1DFEAF>Ono Michio</color>. He’s a really popular mascot in Japan!
Array.indonesia: Ini dia! Gantungan ponsel bergambar karakter bernama <color=#1DFEAF>Ono Michio</color>. Dia maskot yang sangat populer di Jepang!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete05_008
Array.english: <size=34>Aww...! This is absolutely adorable!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aww...! Ini benar-benar menggemaskan!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete05_009
Array.english: <size=32>Haha! I’m glad you like it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha! Senang kamu menyukainya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete05_010
Array.english: <size=32>Till we meet again!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Sampai jumpa lagi!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete05_011
Array.english: <size=32>Have a safe trip home! It was great meeting you two!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Selamat perjalanan pulang! Senang sekali bisa bertemu kalian berdua!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_Reward_NewStaffAdd_001
Array.english: <size=33>Kasuga?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kasuga?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_Reward_NewStaffAdd_002
Array.english: We’re safely back on Japan soil.
Array.indonesia: Kami sudah kembali dengan selamat ke tanah Jepang.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_Reward_NewStaffAdd_003
Array.english: <size=33>That’s a relief!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Syukurlah!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_Reward_NewStaffAdd_004
Array.english: If you ever make it to Yokohama, drop by a bar called \nSurvive Bar. My treat.
Array.indonesia: Kalau suatu saat kamu ke Yokohama, mampir ke bar bernama \nSurvive Bar. Aku yang traktir.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_Reward_NewStaffAdd_005
Array.english: Oh, and I’ve been telling everyone I know about \nyour restaurant!
Array.indonesia: Oh, dan aku sudah menceritakan ke semua orang yang aku kenal tentang \nrestoranmu!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_Reward_NewStaffAdd_006
Array.english: <size=33>Who knows... \nMaybe someone would wanna work there.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Siapa tahu... \nMungkin ada yang mau bekerja di sana.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_Reward_NewStaffAdd_007
Array.english: <size=33>Oh! Then I should put up some <color=#F1DC2B>Recruitment Ads</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh! Kalau begitu, aku harus memasang beberapa <color=#F1DC2B>Iklan Lowongan Kerja</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_Reward_NewStaffAdd_008
Array.english: <size=35>Come to think of it...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Kalau dipikir-pikir...</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_Reward_NewStaffAdd_009
Array.english: Hmm? Is something wrong?
Array.indonesia: Hmm? Ada yang salah?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_Reward_NewStaffAdd_010
Array.english: <size=33>I dropped my <color=#1DFEAF>Baseball Bat</color> into the sea.\nDid you happen to see it?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku menjatuhkan <color=#1DFEAF>Tongkat Bisbol</color>-ku ke laut.\nKebetulan kamu melihatnya?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_Reward_NewStaffAdd_011
Array.english: Hmm… What’s it like? Any special features?
Array.indonesia: Hmm… Seperti apa bentuknya? Ada ciri khasnya?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_Reward_NewStaffAdd_012
Array.english: <size=33>It’s a baseball bat with some wires wrapped around it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Itu tongkat bisbol yang dililit beberapa kabel.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_Reward_NewStaffAdd_013
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>Pretty dangerous thing to be carrying around...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Benda yang cukup berbahaya untuk dibawa-bawa...</color>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_Reward_NewStaffAdd_014
Array.english: I saw a strange shadow in the water at night, so I jumped right in with the bat...
Array.indonesia: Aku melihat bayangan aneh di air saat malam, jadi aku langsung melompat ke laut sambil membawa tongkat itu...

Array.name: dialog_LAD_Reward_NewStaffAdd_015
Array.english: <size=35>Turns out, it was just seaweed! Haha!\nI probably dropped it around that time.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ternyata, itu cuma rumput laut! Haha!\nMungkin aku menjatuhkannya sekitar waktu itu.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_Reward_NewStaffAdd_016
Array.english: Uhh... Even if it's found, that thing’s kinda dangerous to send through mail...
Array.indonesia: Uhh... Meskipun ketemu, benda itu agak berbahaya kalau dikirim lewat pos...

Array.name: dialog_LAD_Reward_NewStaffAdd_017
Array.english: <size=32>If you happen to come across it, you can have it! Hahaha!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kalau kebetulan kamu menemukannya, silakan ambil! Hahaha!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_Reward_NewStaffAdd_018
Array.english: Um... Thanks, I guess?
Array.indonesia: Um... Terima kasih, kurasa?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_Reward_NewStaffAdd_019
Array.english: Haha! All right, take care! \nTell your friends I said hi!
Array.indonesia: Haha! Baiklah, jaga diri ya! \nSampaikan salamku ke teman-temanmu!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Barricade_001
Array.english: <size=32>Where are you going, Kasuga?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Mau ke mana, Kasuga?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Barricade_002
Array.english: <size=33>Oops, wrong way. Gotta pay attention to the radar.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ups, salah arah. Harus lebih perhatikan radar.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Barricade_DaveDistance_001
Array.english: It’s kinda tough keeping up with you while carrying this thing, Kasuga.
Array.indonesia: Agak susah ngikutin kamu sambil bawa barang ini, Kasuga.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Barricade_DaveDistance_002
Array.english: <size=33>Sorry, I got ahead of myself there.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Maaf, aku keburu duluan tadi.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Barricade_WaveBlock_001
Array.english: Kasuga... We can’t move forward with these guys around.
Array.indonesia: Kasuga... Kita nggak bisa lanjut kalau orang-orang ini masih di sini.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Barricade_WaveBlock_002
Array.english: <size=33>Oh right, of course!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh iya, tentu saja!</size>

Array.name: ContentsName_DLC_LAD_Escort
Array.english: Escort Dave
Array.indonesia: Temani Dave

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_LAD_Escort
Array.english: <size=24>Control Kasuga and escort Dave, who is carrying the explosive,\nto the entrance of Sea Blue’s base.\nPay attention to both Kasuga and Dave’s oxygen levels.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Kendalikan Kasuga dan temani Dave, yang membawa bahan peledak,\nke pintu masuk markas Sea Blue.\nPerhatikan tingkat oksigen Kasuga dan Dave.</size>

Array.name: ContentsName_DLC_LAD_Karaoke
Array.english: Party at Bancho Sushi
Array.indonesia: Pesta di Bancho Sushi

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_LAD_Karaoke
Array.english: <size=24>Kasuga’s song is about to start.\nPress the corresponding <color=#F1DC2B>buttons</color> in the rhythm of the beat!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Lagu Kasuga akan segera dimulai.\nTekan <color=#F1DC2B>tombol-tombol</color> yang sesuai sesuai irama musik!</size>

Array.name: ContentsName_DLC_LAD_CocktailShaker
Array.english: Cocktail Shaker
Array.indonesia: Pengocok Koktail

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_LAD_CocktailShaker
Array.english: <size=24>Put the ingredients for the drink the customer ordered into the cocktail shaker in the correct proportions and shake.\nThe order of the ingredients doesn’t matter, as long as the amount is correct!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Masukkan bahan-bahan minuman yang dipesan pelanggan ke dalam pengocok koktail dengan proporsi yang benar, lalu kocok.\nUrutan bahan tidak masalah, asalkan jumlahnya tepat!</size>

Array.name: ContentsName_DLC_LAD_NewStaff
Array.english: New Staff!
Array.indonesia: Staf Baru!

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_LAD_NewStaff
Array.english: <size=24>Visitors from Japan want to work at Bancho Sushi!\nYou can hire new staff from the Hire Staff menu.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Para pengunjung dari Jepang ingin bekerja di Bancho Sushi!\nKamu bisa merekrut staf baru dari menu "Rekrut Staf".</size>

Array.name: ContentsName_DLC_LAD_LegendBaseballBat
Array.english: Hero's Bat discovered!
Array.indonesia: Tongkat Pahlawan ditemukan!

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_LAD_LegendBaseballBat
Array.english: <size=24>The baseball bat Kasuga lost is lodged in the depths of the Blue Hole.\nIt’s said that only the chosen one can pull it out and use it...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Tongkat bisbol yang hilang milik Kasuga tersangkut di kedalaman Blue Hole.\nKonon, hanya orang terpilih yang bisa mengeluarkannya dan menggunakannya...</size>

Array.name: ContentsName_DLC_LAD_BeatemUp
Array.english: Sea Blue's Hideout
Array.indonesia: Markas Rahasia Sea Blue

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_LAD_BeatemUp
Array.english: <size=24>Use <image=Guide.Swap, preset=ContentsGuide_EN/> to alternate between Kasuga and Cobra to defeat Sea Blue and infiltrate deep into the base.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Gunakan <image=Guide.Swap, preset=ContentsGuide_EN/> untuk berganti antara Kasuga dan Cobra guna mengalahkan Sea Blue dan menyusup jauh ke dalam markas.</size>

Array.name: ContentsName_DLC_LAD_MiniGameAdd
Array.english: New Mini Game
Array.indonesia: Mini Game Baru

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_LAD_MiniGameAdd
Array.english: <size=24>New mini games,\n<color=#F1DC2B>Karaoke</color> and <color=#F1DC2B>Sea Blue's Hideout</color> have been added to the mini game app.\nTry to beat the high score!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Mini game baru,\n<color=#F1DC2B>Karaoke</color> dan <color=#F1DC2B>Sarang Rahasia Sea Blue</color> telah ditambahkan ke aplikasi mini game.\nCobalah untuk mengalahkan skor tertinggi!</size>

Array.name: Menu_Stingray_Cold_Noodles_Name
Array.english: Stingray Sashimi Cold Noodles
Array.indonesia: Mie Dingin Sashimi Ikan Pari

Array.name: Menu_Eggplant_Soba_Oyaki_Name
Array.english: Eggplant Soba Oyaki
Array.indonesia: Soba Oyaki Terong

Array.name: Menu_SpearSquid_Soba_Futomaki_Name
Array.english: Spear Squid Soba Futomaki
Array.indonesia: Soba Futomaki Cumi-cumi Panjang

Array.name: Menu_Atlantic_Mackerel_Soba_Name
Array.english: Warm Atlantic Mackerel Soba
Array.indonesia: Soba Ikan Tenggiri Atlantik Hangat

Array.name: Menu_Stingray_Cold_Noodles_Desc
Array.english: A Korean-style cold noodles dish topped with seasoned stingray meat.
Array.indonesia: Hidangan mie dingin ala Korea yang diberi taburan daging ikan pari berbumbu.

Array.name: Menu_Eggplant_Soba_Oyaki_Desc
Array.english: A type of manjū made with buckwheat flour dough and seasonal vegetable fillings.\nThe soft, chewy texture of the outer skin pairs perfectly with the texture of the eggplant inside.
Array.indonesia: Jenis manjū yang terbuat dari adonan tepung soba dan isian sayuran musiman.\nTekstur kulit luar yang lembut dan kenyal sangat cocok dipadukan dengan tekstur terong di dalamnya.

Array.name: Menu_SpearSquid_Soba_Futomaki_Desc
Array.english: A dish made of spear squid, eggs, and carrots wrapped in soba noodles, and rolled up like kimbap.\nThe soft and mild soba pairs wonderfully with the chewy texture of the squid.
Array.indonesia: Hidangan yang terbuat dari cumi-cumi tombak, telur, dan wortel yang dibungkus dengan mie soba, lalu digulung seperti kimbap.\nMie soba yang lembut dan bercita rasa ringan sangat cocok dipadukan dengan tekstur cumi-cumi yang kenyal.

Array.name: Menu_Atlantic_Mackerel_Soba_Desc
Array.english: A dish where grilled Atlantic mackerel is placed on top of warm soba noodles.\nThe fish is marinated in radish juice, eliminating any fishy odor and enhancing its savory flavor.
Array.indonesia: Hidangan di mana ikan tenggiri Atlantik panggang diletakkan di atas mie soba hangat.\nIkan tersebut direndam dalam jus lobak, sehingga menghilangkan bau amis dan memperkaya rasa gurihnya.

Array.name: Cooksta_Content_CocktailShaker
Array.english: Cocktails made with a cocktail shaker somehow feel fancier. Watching it mixed right in front of you adds to the experience!\n<color=#3a8ed6>#bancho_sushi #new_cocktail #cocktail_shaker</color>
Array.indonesia: Koktail yang dibuat dengan shaker koktail terasa lebih mewah. Melihatnya dicampur tepat di depan mata menambah keseruan pengalaman!\n<color=#3a8ed6>#bancho_sushi #new_cocktail #cocktail_shaker</color>

Array.name: Cooksta_Content_Menu_Stingray_Cold_Noodles
Array.english: Wow! Stingray sashimi on top of cold noodles?! The tangy and refreshing flavor really goes well together!\n<color=#3a8ed6>#bancho_sushi #stingray #cold_noodles</color>
Array.indonesia: Wow! Sashimi ikan pari di atas mi dingin?! Rasa asam segar dan menyegarkan ini benar-benar serasi!\n<color=#3a8ed6>#bancho_sushi #stingray #cold_noodles</color>

Array.name: Cooksta_Content_Bancho_LADEndSushi
Array.english: Strange customers from Japan visited. They were kind of noisy... but it was a fun experience nonetheless!\n<color=#3a8ed6>#bancho_sushi #fun_customers #new_friends</color>
Array.indonesia: Ada pelanggan aneh dari Jepang yang datang. Mereka agak berisik... tapi tetap saja pengalaman yang seru!\n<color=#3a8ed6>#bancho_sushi #fun_customers #new_friends</color>

Array.name: Cooksta_Content_Menu_Eggplant_Soba_Oyaki
Array.english: Chewy outside and juicy inside. The subtle aroma of buckwheat really hits the spot!!\n<color=#3a8ed6>#Eggplant_Soba_Oyaki #buckwheat #eggplant</color>
Array.indonesia: Bagian luarnya kenyal dan bagian dalamnya berair. Aroma halus dari soba benar-benar memuaskan!!\n<color=#3a8ed6>#Eggplant_Soba_Oyaki #buckwheat #eggplant</color>

Array.name: Cooksta_Content_Menu_SpearSquid_Soba_Futomaki
Array.english: Who knew you could roll buckwheat up like a kimbap? What a unique flavor!\n<color=#3a8ed6>#bancho_sushi #buckwheat #kimbap #SpearSquid_Soba_Futomaki</color>
Array.indonesia: Siapa sangka soba bisa digulung seperti kimbap? Rasanya sungguh unik!\n<color=#3a8ed6>#bancho_sushi #buckwheat #kimbap #SpearSquid_Soba_Futomaki</color>

Array.name: Cooksta_Content_Menu_Atlantic_Mackerel_Soba
Array.english: Warm soba noodles with perfectly grilled mackerel… it warms me to my very soul...\n<color=#3a8ed6>#bancho_sushi #Atlantic_Mackerel_Soba #Mackerel </color>
Array.indonesia: Mie soba hangat dengan ikan tenggiri yang dipanggang sempurna… rasanya menghangatkan jiwa saya...\n<color=#3a8ed6>#bancho_sushi #Atlantic_Mackerel_Soba #Mackerel </color>

Array.name: Cooksta_Content_Staff_Etsuko
Array.english: Etsuko said, “If you post a photo of me, you’ll definitely get more customers.” So here goes nothing. \n<color=#3a8ed6>#StaffIntro #Etsuko #bancho_sushi</color>
Array.indonesia: Etsuko berkata, “Kalau kamu posting foto aku, pasti bakal dapet lebih banyak pelanggan.” Jadi, ayo dicoba. \n<color=#3a8ed6>#StaffIntro #Etsuko #bancho_sushi</color>

Array.name: Cooksta_Content_Staff_Chitose
Array.english: This is Chitose, who sneaks in a quick workout whenever there’s a spare moment. Lifting huge orders? No problem. \n<color=#3a8ed6>#StaffIntro #Chitose #bancho_sushi</color>
Array.indonesia: Ini Chitose, yang menyempatkan diri berolahraga sebentar setiap ada waktu luang. Mengangkat pesanan dalam jumlah besar? Nggak masalah. \n<color=#3a8ed6>#StaffIntro #Chitose #bancho_sushi</color>

Array.name: Cooksta_Content_Staff_Hamako
Array.english: Hamako, calling her home in Ijincho. Looks like she gets a little homesick now and then. \n<color=#3a8ed6>#StaffIntro #Hamako #bancho_sushi</color>
Array.indonesia: Hamako, menelepon ke rumahnya di Ijincho. Sepertinya dia kadang-kadang sedikit rindu rumah. \n<color=#3a8ed6>#StaffIntro #Hamako #bancho_sushi</color>

Array.name: dialog_Staff_HireCompleted_22_Etsuko
Array.english: Woohoo! It is a crime not to pick me!
Array.indonesia: Woohoo! Itu dosa kalau nggak pilih aku!

Array.name: dialog_Staff_HireCompleted_23_Chitose
Array.english: I’m Chitose! I know I’ll do great~Let me help~
Array.indonesia: Aku Chitose! Aku tahu aku pasti bisa melakukannya dengan baik~Biarkan aku membantu~

Array.name: dialog_Staff_HireCompleted_24_Hamako
Array.english: I’m here to work while on vacation. What do you say?
Array.indonesia: Aku di sini untuk bekerja sambil berlibur. Bagaimana menurutmu?

Array.name: dialog_NPC_Staff_Talk_22_Etsuko01_001
Array.english: This place is completely different from Osaka. \nI love it!
Array.indonesia: Tempat ini benar-benar berbeda dari Osaka. \nAku suka sekali!

Array.name: dialog_NPC_Staff_Talk_22_Etsuko01_002
Array.english: <size=32>There are so many good looking men around too! \nWoohoo!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ada banyak pria tampan di sekitar sini juga! \nWoohoo!</size>

Array.name: dialog_NPC_Staff_Talk_22_Etsuko02_001
Array.english: Oh my... Upon closer inspection, you’re so round and cute too, eh...?
Array.indonesia: Astaga... Kalau dilihat lebih dekat, kamu juga montok dan imut, ya...?

Array.name: dialog_NPC_Staff_Talk_22_Etsuko02_002
Array.english: Are you ready to heat up the beach with Etsuko?
Array.indonesia: Siap memanaskan pantai bersama Etsuko?

Array.name: dialog_NPC_Staff_Talk_22_Etsuko03_001
Array.english: <size=32>Wow, why are you speaking to Etsuko out of the blue?\nAre you…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wah, kenapa tiba-tiba ngobrol sama Etsuko?\nApa kamu…</size>

Array.name: dialog_NPC_Staff_Talk_22_Etsuko03_002
Array.english: Nooo. Etsuko’s heart belongs to someone else!
Array.indonesia: Nggak. Hati Etsuko sudah dimiliki orang lain!

Array.name: dialog_NPC_Staff_Talk_23_Chitose01_001
Array.english: I’m Chitose, I’m a hard worker~
Array.indonesia: Aku Chitose, aku pekerja keras~

Array.name: dialog_NPC_Staff_Talk_23_Chitose02_001
Array.english: This place is awesome.\nIt’s so similar to where I was in Hawaii~
Array.indonesia: Tempat ini keren banget.\nMirip banget sama tempat yang pernah aku kunjungi di Hawaii~

Array.name: dialog_NPC_Staff_Talk_23_Chitose02_002
Array.english: I will do my best to help out~
Array.indonesia: Aku akan berusaha sebaik mungkin untuk membantu~

Array.name: dialog_NPC_Staff_Talk_23_Chitose03_001
Array.english: I should ask this question when customers arrive~
Array.indonesia: Aku harus menanyakan pertanyaan ini saat pelanggan datang~

Array.name: dialog_NPC_Staff_Talk_23_Chitose03_002
Array.english: <size=32>Do you prefer... chicken or beef?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kamu lebih suka... ayam atau daging sapi?</size>

Array.name: dialog_NPC_Staff_Talk_24_Hamako01_001
Array.english: Haha! This place really lives up to its reputation. \nI like it.
Array.indonesia: Haha! Tempat ini benar-benar sesuai dengan reputasinya. \nAku suka.

Array.name: dialog_NPC_Staff_Talk_24_Hamako01_002
Array.english: I’ll feel refreshed after working for a bit.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan merasa segar kembali setelah bekerja sebentar.

Array.name: dialog_NPC_Staff_Talk_24_Hamako02_001
Array.english: Things back in Ijincho has me exhausted,\nbut the sea breeze here really takes my exhaustion away!
Array.indonesia: Keadaan di Ijincho membuatku kelelahan,\ntapi angin laut di sini benar-benar menghilangkan kelelahan itu!

Array.name: dialog_NPC_Staff_Talk_24_Hamako02_002
Array.english: I’m not as tired as I look, so assign me to necessary chores.\nI’m geared up and ready to work!
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak selelah yang terlihat, jadi tolong beri aku tugas-tugas yang perlu.\nAku sudah siap dan bersemangat untuk bekerja!

Array.name: dialog_Staff_Talk_Manager_Etsuko01_001
Array.english: You promoted me to branch manager… \nWhat a great honor!
Array.indonesia: Kamu mempromosikanku menjadi manajer cabang… \nSungguh suatu kehormatan besar!

Array.name: dialog_Staff_Talk_Manager_Etsuko01_002
Array.english: I’m not old enough for retirement. \nWoohoo!
Array.indonesia: Aku belum cukup tua untuk pensiun. \nWoohoo!

Array.name: dialog_Staff_Talk_Manager_Etsuko02_001
Array.english: What if more customers start coming here instead of the main branch because of me?
Array.indonesia: Bagaimana kalau lebih banyak pelanggan mulai datang ke sini daripada ke cabang utama karena aku?

Array.name: dialog_Staff_Talk_Manager_Etsuko02_002
Array.english: Should I rename this place to “Etsuko Sushi” then?
Array.indonesia: Haruskah aku mengganti nama tempat ini menjadi “Etsuko Sushi”?

Array.name: dialog_Staff_Talk_Manager_Chitose01_001
Array.english: I’m Chitose, I’m so touched you entrusted me with such an important job~!
Array.indonesia: Aku Chitose, aku sangat tersentuh karena kamu mempercayakan pekerjaan penting ini padaku~!

Array.name: dialog_Staff_Talk_Manager_Chitose01_002
Array.english: I’ll do my best and earn lots of money~
Array.indonesia: Aku akan berusaha sebaik mungkin dan menghasilkan banyak uang~

Array.name: dialog_Staff_Talk_Manager_Chitose02_001
Array.english: I’m a manager, huh? I’m truly touched~
Array.indonesia: Aku jadi manajer, ya? Aku benar-benar terharu~

Array.name: dialog_Staff_Talk_Manager_Chitose02_002
Array.english: I’m Chitose, I’ll do my best to run this restaurant flawlessly~
Array.indonesia: Aku Chitose, aku akan berusaha sebaik mungkin untuk mengelola restoran ini dengan sempurna~

Array.name: dialog_Staff_Talk_Manager_Hamako01_001
Array.english: I’m experienced in running a business. \nJust count on me.
Array.indonesia: Aku berpengalaman dalam mengelola bisnis. \nSerahkan saja padaku.

Array.name: dialog_Staff_Talk_Manager_Hamako02_001
Array.english: The people here are real gentlemen compared to customers I dealt with in Ijincho.
Array.indonesia: Orang-orang di sini benar-benar sopan dibandingkan dengan pelanggan yang pernah aku tangani di Ijincho.

Array.name: dialog_Staff_Talk_Manager_Hamako02_002
Array.english: <size=32>Alright, let’s have a great day today!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Baiklah, mari kita jadikan hari ini hari yang luar biasa!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_Mission01Progress_001
Array.english: We need the following ingredients: <color=#F1DC2B>Tilapia</color>, <color=#F1DC2B>Calamansi</color>,\nand <color=#F1DC2B>Lemongrass</color>.
Array.indonesia: Kita membutuhkan bahan-bahan berikut: <color=#F1DC2B>Ikan nila</color>, <color=#F1DC2B>Calamansi</color>, \ndan <color=#F1DC2B>Serai</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_Mission01Progress_002
Array.english: <size=32>Try asking someone in the village who knows herbs and spices.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Cobalah tanyakan kepada seseorang di desa yang mengerti tentang tanaman obat dan rempah-rempah.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Mission01Progress_001
Array.english: You're looking for <color=#1DFEAF>Spices</color>?
Array.indonesia: Kamu sedang mencari <color=#1DFEAF>Rempah-rempah</color>?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Mission01Progress_002
Array.english: <color=#F1DC2B>Herbalist Lathi</color> on the right side of the village probably knows.
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Ahli herbal Lathi</color> di sisi kanan desa mungkin tahu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Mission01CalamansiProgress_001
Array.english: <color=#1DFEAF>Calamansi</color>, you say?
Array.indonesia: <color=#1DFEAF>Calamansi</color>, katamu?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Mission01CalamansiProgress_002
Array.english: There's a tree with green fruit below the sacred tree.\nTry shaking it.
Array.indonesia: Ada pohon dengan buah hijau di bawah pohon suci.\nCoba goyangkan pohon itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Task_410050008_001
Array.english: Carpenter... you mean <color=#F1DC2B>Peneb</color>?
Array.indonesia: Tukang kayu... maksudmu <color=#F1DC2B>Peneb</color>?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Task_410050008_002
Array.english: Check the house on the right side of the village.\nDuring the day, he's usually outside working with wood.
Array.indonesia: Periksa rumah di sisi kanan desa.\nSiang hari, dia biasanya berada di luar sedang mengolah kayu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_FirstTalk_001
Array.english: Hello. Are the fish biting?
Array.indonesia: Halo. Ikan-ikannya sedang menggigit umpan?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_FirstTalk_002
Array.english: <size=35>Eek! Oh no!\nYa scared all the fish away!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Eek! Oh tidak!\nKamu membuat semua ikan kabur!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_FirstTalk_003
