Array.english: <size=32>Oh... I'm sorry...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... Maaf...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_FirstTalk_004
Array.english: Ah...you must be that outsider I heard was coming to investigate?
Array.indonesia: Ah... kamu pasti orang luar yang kudengar akan datang untuk menyelidiki?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_FirstTalk_005
Array.english: Yes. I heard there've been strange phenomenon happening in the lake.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Kudengar ada fenomena aneh yang terjadi di danau.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_FirstTalk_006
Array.english: Ah... the water's been gettin' real murky lately...\nand these strange monster fish keep showin' up...
Array.indonesia: Ah... airnya jadi sangat keruh belakangan ini...\ndan ikan-ikan monster aneh ini terus muncul.. .

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_FirstTalk_007
Array.english: <size=34>A while back there was even an earthquake.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Beberapa waktu lalu bahkan terjadi gempa bumi.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_FirstTalk_008
Array.english: I couldn't swim before anyway...\nand now I sure wouldn't dare try.
Array.indonesia: Lagipula, aku memang tidak bisa berenang sebelumnya...\ndan sekarang aku pasti tidak berani mencobanya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_FirstTalk_009
Array.english: Oh, come to think of it, you're headin' into the water...\nAin't that kinda dangerous?
Array.indonesia: Oh, kalau dipikir-pikir, kamu mau masuk ke air...\nBukankah itu agak berbahaya?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_FirstTalk_010
Array.english: Yeah. So there's a lot going on underwater...\nbut I'm used to it now!
Array.indonesia: Iya. Jadi banyak hal yang terjadi di bawah air...\ntapi aku sudah terbiasa sekarang!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_FirstTalk_011
Array.english: Sheesh. Don't get cocky and end up gettin' hooked on a fishin' line.
Array.indonesia: Astaga. Jangan terlalu percaya diri sampai akhirnya tersangkut di tali pancing.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Mission01Progress_001
Array.english: When it comes to spices, <color=#F1DC2B>Herbalist Lathi</color> would know best. Head a bit up to the right from here and you'll find her.
Array.indonesia: Kalau soal rempah-rempah, <color=#F1DC2B>Ahli Herbal Lathi</color> pasti yang paling tahu. Pergilah sedikit ke kanan dari sini dan kamu akan menemukannya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Task_410050008_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, if you're looking for a carpenter, that'd be <color=#F1DC2B>Peneb</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, kalau kamu mencari tukang kayu, itu pasti <color=#F1DC2B>Peneb</color>.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Task_410050008_002
Array.english: <size=34>Head up to the right a bit from here and you'll find his house.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Pergilah sedikit ke kanan dari sini dan kamu akan menemukan rumahnya.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Task_410050008_001
Array.english: Hmm... I think I saw <color=#F1DC2B>Carpenter</color> tools at the house on the far right side of the village.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Sepertinya aku melihat <color=#F1DC2B>peralatan tukang kayu</color> di rumah di ujung kanan desa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Mission01Progress_001
Array.english: <color=#F1DC2B>Calamansi</color>? \nThere's a tree with round, green fruits.
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Calamansi</color>? \nAda pohon dengan buah bulat berwarna hijau.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Mission01Progress_002
Array.english: <size=33>You can easily find it near the big tree north of the village!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kamu bisa dengan mudah menemukannya di dekat pohon besar di utara desa!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Task_410050008_001
Array.english: Ah... if you're looking for a carpenter, you probably mean <color=#F1DC2B>Peneb</color>.
Array.indonesia: Ah... kalau kamu mencari tukang kayu, mungkin yang kamu maksud adalah <color=#F1DC2B>Peneb</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Task_410050008_002
Array.english: Peneb's house is at the far right end of the village!
Array.indonesia: Rumah Peneb ada di ujung paling kanan desa!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_FirstTalk_001
Array.english: Oh my, you must be the outsider who came to study the dinosaurs.
Array.indonesia: Wah, kamu pasti orang luar yang datang untuk mempelajari dinosaurus.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_FirstTalk_002
Array.english: <size=32>Nice to meet you, I'm <color=#F1DC2B>Lipah</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Senang bertemu denganmu, aku <color=#F1DC2B>Lipah</color>.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_FirstTalk_003
Array.english: Hello. I'm Dave.
Array.indonesia: Halo. Aku Dave.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_FirstTalk_004
Array.english: It might be a little quiet for someone from the city, but...
Array.indonesia: Mungkin tempat ini terasa agak sepi bagi orang kota, tapi...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_FirstTalk_005
Array.english: This village has so many beautiful insects.\nThat alone makes it feel like heaven to me.
Array.indonesia: Desa ini memiliki begitu banyak serangga yang indah.\nItu saja sudah membuatnya terasa seperti surga bagiku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_FirstTalk_006
Array.english: I can see why. I haven't seen anything like this in the city.
Array.indonesia: Saya mengerti kenapa. Saya belum pernah melihat yang seperti ini di kota.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_FirstTalk_007
Array.english: Hehe. It's nice to meet someone who understands.\nI look forward to working with you.
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Senang bertemu dengan seseorang yang mengerti.\nSaya menantikan untuk bekerja sama dengan Kamu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_FirstTalk_008
Array.english: <size=32>Hehe... likewise.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehe... saya juga.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_FirstTalk_001
Array.english: Hello. You're the farmer who grows papayas and coconuts, right?
Array.indonesia: Halo. Kamu petani yang menanam pepaya dan kelapa, kan?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_FirstTalk_002
Array.english: I'm Dave. I run the restaurant nearby.\nNice to meet you.
Array.indonesia: Aku Dave. Aku mengelola restoran di dekat sini.\nSenang bertemu denganmu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_FirstTalk_003
Array.english: <size=36>Ha! So you're the outsider who's been using my coconuts.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Ha! Jadi kamu orang luar yang selama ini menggunakan kelapa-kelapaku.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_FirstTalk_004
Array.english: <size=32>Uhm...? I guess so...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Uhm...? Sepertinya begitu...?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_FirstTalk_005
Array.english: <size=33>I see. So, you're here to lecture us about everything we don't have that the city does, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Begitu. Jadi, kamu ke sini untuk mengomeli kami tentang segala hal yang tidak kami miliki tapi ada di kota, kan?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_FirstTalk_006
Array.english: N-No, not at all. That's not why I'm here...
Array.indonesia: T-Tidak, sama sekali tidak. Bukan itu alasan aku ke sini...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_FirstTalk_007
Array.english: <size=33>I'll send the crops to the restaurant since the chief asked…\nBut don't run your mouth while you're here!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku akan mengirim hasil panen ke restoran karena kepala desa memintanya…\nTapi jangan banyak bicara selama kamu di sini!!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_FirstTalk_008
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... he's really hostile. Getting close to him won't be easy.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... dia benar-benar bermusuhan. Mendekatinya tidak akan mudah.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Mission01Progress_001
Array.english: <size=34>Ha! You can't even find <color=#1DFEAF>Calamansi</color>? You really are clueless.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ha! Kamu bahkan nggak bisa nemuin <color=#1DFEAF>Calamansi</color>? Kamu bener-bener nggak tahu apa-apa.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Mission01Progress_002
Array.english: <size=34>It's the tree right in front of you? Tsk.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Itu pohon yang ada tepat di depanmu? Ckck.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Task_410050008_001
Array.english: <size=33>The carpenter...? You mean <color=#F1DC2B>Peneb</color>, on the right side of the village.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tukang kayu...? Maksudmu <color=#F1DC2B>Peneb</color>, di sisi kanan desa.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Task_410050008_002
Array.english: <size=33>Don't go bothering him for no reason.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Jangan ganggu dia tanpa alasan.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_FirstTalk_001
Array.english: Dave, is something on your mind?
Array.indonesia: Dave, ada yang mengganggu pikiranmu?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_FirstTalk_002
Array.english: Oh, right. Uzme, thanks for earlier.
Array.indonesia: Oh, iya. Uzme, terima kasih tadi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_FirstTalk_003
Array.english: That <color=#1DFEAF>Map</color> you gave me really makes it easier to get around the village!
Array.indonesia: <color=#1DFEAF>Peta</color> yang kamu berikan itu benar-benar memudahkan aku berkeliling desa!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_FirstTalk_004
Array.english: Hehehe, I'm glad to hear that.
Array.indonesia: Hehehe, senang mendengarnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_FirstTalk_005
Array.english: Um... if you don't mind me asking...\nDoes the chef need anything else?
Array.indonesia: Um... kalau boleh tanya...\nApakah koki itu butuh sesuatu lagi?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_FirstTalk_006
Array.english: Hmm. Bancho can work with just about anything.\nI'm sure it'll turn out great.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Bancho bisa mengolah apa saja.\nAku yakin hasilnya akan luar biasa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_FirstTalk_007
Array.english: I see... Thanks for letting me know.
Array.indonesia: Begitu ya... Terima kasih sudah memberitahu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_GoToBluehole_001
Array.english: Heading back to the <color=#F1DC2B>Blue Hole</color>?\nIt'll take about a day.
Array.indonesia: Mau kembali ke <color=#F1DC2B>Blue Hole</color>?\nButuh waktu sekitar satu hari.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_GoToBluehole_option1
Array.english: Go back
Array.indonesia: Kembali

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_GoToBluehole_option2
Array.english: Don't go back
Array.indonesia: Jangan kembali

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_GoToBluehole_Go_001
Array.english: <size=32>Alright, let's get going. If we hurry, we'll be there by tomorrow morning!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Baiklah, ayo berangkat. Kalau kita buru-buru, kita akan sampai di sana besok pagi!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_GoToBluehole_Stay_001
Array.english: Got it. Just let me know when you're ready.
Array.indonesia: Oke. Beri tahu aku saja kalau kamu sudah siap.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_PreferenceLV3_001
Array.english: <size=32>Dave, havin' any trouble gettin' around the village?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Dave, ada kesulitan berkeliling desa?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_PreferenceLV3_002
Array.english: Not really, but...\nwalking in this heat is pretty tiring.
Array.indonesia: Nggak juga, tapi...\nberjalan di cuaca panas begini lumayan melelahkan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_PreferenceLV3_003
Array.english: Hehe. The village is actually pretty big, and it's quite a walk to get to the houses on the other side.
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Desa ini sebenarnya cukup besar, dan jaraknya lumayan jauh untuk sampai ke rumah-rumah di sisi seberang.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_PreferenceLV3_004
Array.english: <size=33>That's why I got a little somethin' for ya!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Itulah mengapa aku punya sesuatu untukmu!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_PreferenceLV3_005
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... what's this...?\nA <color=#F1DC2B>Kick Scooter</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... apa ini...?\nSebuah <color=#F1DC2B>Kick Scooter</color>?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_PreferenceLV3_006
Array.english: Hehe, that's right. Ain't nothin' too fancy, but...
Array.indonesia: Hehe, betul. Nggak ada yang mewah-mewah, tapi...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_PreferenceLV3_007
Array.english: <size=32>It'll make gettin' around the village a whole lot easier.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ini bakal bikin berkeliling desa jadi jauh lebih mudah.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_PreferenceLV3_008
Array.english: Wow... thanks, Rimbo! This'll make getting around way easier!
Array.indonesia: Wow... makasih, Rimbo! Ini bakal bikin berkeliling jadi jauh lebih mudah!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_ShopOpen_001
Array.english: I heard that giving <color=#FF73C3>Gifts</color> is a good way to get closer to the villagers.
Array.indonesia: Aku dengar bahwa memberikan <color=#FF73C3>Hadiah</color> adalah cara yang bagus untuk mendekati penduduk desa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_ShopOpen_002
Array.english: <size=32>Haha, everyone loves gifts, but round here we see it as an important tradition!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha, semua orang suka hadiah, tapi di sini kami menganggapnya sebagai tradisi yang penting!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_ShopOpen_003
Array.english: But I'm not sure where to find gifts people would like.
Array.indonesia: Tapi aku nggak yakin di mana bisa menemukan hadiah yang disukai orang-orang.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_ShopOpen_004
Array.english: That's true. Folks all like different things.
Array.indonesia: Itu benar. Setiap orang punya selera yang berbeda-beda.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_ShopOpen_005
Array.english: <size=32>I can sell ya some of the stuff I brought from the city.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku bisa jualin beberapa barang yang kubawa dari kota.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_ShopOpen_006
Array.english: <size=32>That way ya won't have to go lookin' all over the place.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Dengan begitu, kamu nggak perlu repot-repot nyari ke sana-sini.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_ShopOpen_007
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, that's a great idea.\nI'll come to you when I need something!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, itu ide yang bagus.\nAku bakal mampir ke tempatmu kalau butuh sesuatu!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_ShopOpen_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ain't it dangerous inside the lake?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Bukankah berbahaya di dalam danau?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_ShopOpen_002
Array.english: It is... The visibility's poor, and fish sometimes attack out of nowhere.
Array.indonesia: Memang... Jarak pandangnya buruk, dan ikan terkadang menyerang tiba-tiba.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_ShopOpen_003
Array.english: <size=33>Hmm... then how 'bout just fishin' instead?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hmm... kalau begitu, bagaimana kalau kita memancing saja?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_ShopOpen_004
Array.english: Well... Bancho likes to use all kinds of ingredients...\nSo if I catch them myself, I can bring in more variety.
Array.indonesia: Yah... Bancho suka menggunakan berbagai macam bahan...\nJadi kalau aku menangkapnya sendiri, aku bisa menghadirkan variasi yang lebih banyak.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_ShopOpen_005
Array.english: Sometimes I come back empty-handed, though...
Array.indonesia: Kadang-kadang aku pulang dengan tangan kosong, sih...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_ShopOpen_006
Array.english: <size=33>Haha! I see!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Haha! Aku mengerti!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_ShopOpen_007
Array.english: <size=33>Then when that happens, I could sell ya some of the fish I caught!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kalau begitu, kalau itu terjadi, aku bisa jual beberapa ikan yang aku tangkap ke kamu!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_ShopOpen_008
Array.english: It won't be as much variety as catchin' 'em yourself...\nbut it'll help when ya need somethin' quick.
Array.indonesia: Memang variasi ikan yang aku tangkap nggak sebanyak kalau kamu menangkapnya sendiri...\ntapi ini bakal membantu kalau kamu butuh sesuatu dengan cepat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_ShopOpen_009
Array.english: That'll definitely come in handy when I'm short on ingredients!
Array.indonesia: Itu pasti bakal berguna banget kalau aku kehabisan bahan makanan!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_ShopOpen_010
Array.english: Oh, and I've stocked better fishin' rods and bait than what I gave ya before.
Array.indonesia: Oh, dan aku sudah menyiapkan pancing serta umpan yang lebih bagus daripada yang kuberikan sebelumnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_ShopOpen_011
Array.english: <size=32>Just in case something breaks, I've got <color=#F1DC2B>Repair Tools</color> ready too!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kalau-kalau ada yang rusak, aku juga sudah menyiapkan <color=#F1DC2B>Alat Perbaikan</color>!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_ShopOpen_012
Array.english: Oh, got it.\nI'll let you know when I need them!
Array.indonesia: Oh, oke.\nAku akan memberitahumu kalau aku membutuhkannya!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopOpen_001
Array.english: Oh, did you use the lemongrass I gave you?
Array.indonesia: Oh, apakah kamu sudah menggunakan serai yang kuberikan?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopOpen_002
Array.english: <size=32>Yes. Thanks to you, Bancho was able to make a wonderful dish.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ya. Berkat kamu, Bancho bisa membuat hidangan yang lezat.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopOpen_003
Array.english: I'm glad it helped, hehe.
Array.indonesia: Senang bisa membantu, hehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopOpen_004
Array.english: If you need any other <color=#F1DC2B>Spices</color>, just let me know.
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu butuh <color=#F1DC2B>bumbu</color> lain, bilang saja padaku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopOpen_005
Array.english: I can't give them away for free, but...\nI'll make sure you get a fair price.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak bisa memberikannya secara gratis, tapi...\nAku akan pastikan kamu mendapat harga yang wajar.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopOpen_006
Array.english: Oh, understood.\nI'll stop by when I need some.
Array.indonesia: Oh, paham.\nAku akan mampir kalau aku membutuhkannya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopLV3_001
Array.english: Ah, thank you for all your help.
Array.indonesia: Ah, terima kasih atas semua bantuannya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopLV3_002
Array.english: Hehe, it's nothing. I owe the village, so I'm happy to help however I can.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, tidak apa-apa. Aku berhutang budi pada desa ini, jadi aku senang bisa membantu sebisa mungkin.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopLV3_003
Array.english: It's not much in return, but... I've stocked a few more <color=#F1DC2B>Spices</color>.
Array.indonesia: Ini memang tidak seberapa sebagai balasannya, tapi... aku sudah menyimpan beberapa <color=#F1DC2B>Rempah-rempah</color> lagi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopLV3_004
Array.english: <size=33>Let me know if you need any.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Beri tahu aku kalau kamu membutuhkannya.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Marone_01_001
Array.english: Woof!
Array.indonesia: Woof!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Marone_01_002
Array.english: Maybe it's because the villagers treat him so well,\nbut he's full of energy.
Array.indonesia: Mungkin karena penduduk desa memperlakukannya dengan sangat baik,\ntapi dia penuh energi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Marone_01_003
Array.english: If we hadn't found him in that pit back then...\nIt's scary just to think about.
Array.indonesia: Seandainya kita tidak menemukannya di lubang itu saat itu...\nMenakutkan hanya dengan memikirkannya saja.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Marone_01_004
Array.english: Woof!!
Array.indonesia: Guk!!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Marone_02_001
Array.english: Marone isn't picky about food, which is nice.
Array.indonesia: Marone tidak pilih-pilih soal makanan, dan itu bagus.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Marone_02_002
Array.english: Woof!!
Array.indonesia: Guk!!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Marone_02_003
Array.english: He does seem to have put on a bit of weight since coming to the village...
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya berat badannya memang naik sedikit sejak datang ke desa ini...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Marone_02_004
Array.english: ...Woof.
Array.indonesia: ...Woof.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_01_001
Array.english: Phew... It's been a while since I've been somewhere this humid.
Array.indonesia: Wah... Sudah lama aku tidak berada di tempat yang selembab ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_01_001
Array.english: Muna's really passionate about her research.
Array.indonesia: Muna sangat bersemangat dalam penelitiannya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_01_002
Array.english: Haha! That kid's the type to dive into whatever she's interested in all day long!
Array.indonesia: Haha! Anak itu tipe orang yang bisa menghabiskan sepanjang hari menyelami apa pun yang dia minati!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_01_003
Array.english: It's a great quality for a researcher, but...
Array.indonesia: Itu kualitas yang bagus untuk seorang peneliti, tapi...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_01_004
Array.english: <size=33>The problem is, she doesn't care about time or place.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Masalahnya, dia nggak peduli soal waktu atau tempat.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_01_005
Array.english: One time, we went to a conference together,\nand she hogged the Q&A for a full 30 minutes...
Array.indonesia: Suatu kali, kami pergi ke konferensi bareng,\ndan dia mendominasi sesi tanya jawab selama 30 menit penuh...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_01_006
Array.english: The staff had to drag her away.\nShe's unstoppable.
Array.indonesia: Panitia terpaksa menyeretnya pergi.\nDia memang tak terbendung.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_02_001
Array.english: Still, I'm glad Muna's back from her hiatus.
Array.indonesia: Meski begitu, aku senang Muna sudah kembali dari masa istirahatnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_02_002
Array.english: That girl... once she gets into something, she sees it\nthrough to the end...
Array.indonesia: Gadis itu... begitu dia tertarik pada sesuatu, dia akan\nmelakukannya sampai tuntas...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_02_003
Array.english: She got obsessed with blockchain technology and ended up putting her entire fortune into some unknown coin.
Array.indonesia: Dia terobsesi dengan teknologi blockchain dan akhirnya menginvestasikan seluruh kekayaannya ke dalam koin yang tidak dikenal.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_02_004
Array.english: <size=34>...That's pretty reckless.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>...Thatu cukup nekat.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_02_005
Array.english:
Lucky for her, she managed to recover her losses.
Otherwise, we might've lost a great talent.
Array.indonesia:
Untungnya, dia berhasil memulihkan kerugiannya.
Kalau tidak, kita mungkin akan kehilangan talenta hebat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_02_006
Array.english: She'd be better off focusing on her research...
Array.indonesia: Sebaiknya dia fokus pada penelitiannya saja.. .

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_03_001
Array.english: This region feels completely different from the Blue Hole.
Array.indonesia: Wilayah ini terasa sangat berbeda dari Blue Hole.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_03_002
Array.english: Tell me about it! The cool ocean's nice, but a jungle like this has its own charm!!
Array.indonesia: Benar sekali! Laut yang sejuk memang menyenangkan, tapi hutan seperti ini punya pesonanya sendiri!!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_03_003
Array.english: <size=32>There are a lot of interesting insects here too.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ada banyak serangga menarik di sini juga.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_03_004
Array.english: Be careful not to get bitten, you could catch some unknown disease and drop dead!
Array.indonesia: Hati-hati jangan sampai digigit, kamu bisa tertular penyakit yang tidak diketahui dan mati mendadak!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_03_005
Array.english: <size=42>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_Night01_001
Array.english: It's getting late. Aren't you turning in, Dr. Bacon?
Array.indonesia: Sudah larut. Bukankah kamu mau tidur, Dr. Bacon?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_Night01_002
Array.english: <size=32>Haha! How could I sleep in a place with so much to study!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha! Bagaimana mungkin aku bisa tidur di tempat yang masih banyak hal untuk diteliti!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_Night01_003
Array.english: Honestly, I'd love to take my time researching...
Array.indonesia: Sejujurnya, aku ingin sekali meluangkan waktu untuk meneliti...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_Night01_004
Array.english: but thinking about the villagers, I feel like I should solve this quickly.
Array.indonesia: tapi memikirkan para penduduk desa, saya merasa harus menyelesaikan ini secepatnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_Night01_005
Array.english: I've talked to them, and there are a lot of good people here. I hope we can help.
Array.indonesia: Saya sudah berbicara dengan mereka, dan ada banyak orang baik di sini. Saya harap kita bisa membantu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_01_001
Array.english: Bancho, you pick up ingredients from new places so quickly.
Array.indonesia: Bancho, kamu begitu cepat mendapatkan bahan-bahan dari tempat-tempat baru.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_01_002
Array.english: It helps that I traveled the world learning to cook when I was younger.
Array.indonesia: Beruntungnya, aku berkeliling dunia sambil belajar memasak saat masih muda.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_01_003
Array.english:
I worked in restaurants in unfamiliar places,
learning the local cuisine and serving it to customers.
Array.indonesia:
Aku bekerja di restoran-restoran di tempat-tempat asing,
mempelajari masakan lokal dan menyajikannya kepada pelanggan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_01_004
Array.english: I see. So that's where your skills come from.
Array.indonesia: Begitu. Jadi dari situlah keahlianmu berasal.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_01_005
Array.english: Learning something new is always difficult.\nI'm just grateful I had the chance.
Array.indonesia: Belajar hal baru selalu sulit.\nAku hanya bersyukur punya kesempatan itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_02_001
Array.english: I heard you can't eat freshwater fish raw.
Array.indonesia: Aku dengar ikan air tawar tidak boleh dimakan mentah.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_02_002
Array.english:
Unfortunately, that's true. The taste isn't great,
and more importantly, they can carry parasites.
Array.indonesia:
Sayangnya, itu benar. Rasanya tidak enak,
dan yang lebih penting, ikan tersebut bisa membawa parasit.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_02_003
Array.english: It's a shame I won't be able to have your sushi for a while, Bancho.
Array.indonesia: Sayang sekali aku tidak bisa menikmati sushi buatanmu untuk sementara waktu, Bancho.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_02_004
Array.english: It is what it is. I'll make the best dishes I can with what I have.
Array.indonesia: Ya, begitulah adanya. Aku akan membuat hidangan terbaik yang bisa aku buat dengan bahan yang ada.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_03_001
Array.english: Sorry for dragging you all the way out here.
Array.indonesia: Maaf sudah menyeretmu sejauh ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_03_002
Array.english: Don't worry. I see this as part of my training.
Array.indonesia: Jangan khawatir. Aku menganggap ini sebagai bagian dari latihanku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_03_003
Array.english: When else would I get to come to a place like this and work with wild ingredients?
Array.indonesia: Kapan lagi aku bisa datang ke tempat seperti ini dan bekerja dengan bahan-bahan liar?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_03_004
Array.english: Still, if you can't cook sushi, won't your skills get rusty?
Array.indonesia: Tapi, kalau kamu nggak bisa masak sushi, bukankah keahlianmu bakal tumpul?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_03_005
Array.english: To prevent that, I've been practicing my knife work whenever I can.
Array.indonesia: Untuk mencegahnya, aku terus berlatih mengolah bahan dengan pisau setiap ada kesempatan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_03_006
Array.english: <size=33>It's a shame I can't serve them as proper dishes, though.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Sayang sekali aku nggak bisa menyajikannya sebagai hidangan yang layak.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_03_007
Array.english: As expected, Bancho. You never let anything slip.
Array.indonesia: Seperti yang kuduga, Bancho. Kamu memang nggak pernah melewatkan apa pun.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_Night01_001
Array.english: <size=32>Another long day.\nYou've had it rough too.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hari yang panjang lagi.\nKamu juga pasti mengalami hari yang berat.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_Night01_002
Array.english: <size=32>It's not easy getting used to this weather.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Memang tidak mudah membiasakan diri dengan cuaca seperti ini.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_Night01_003
Array.english: <size=33>At least the evenings are cool, which is nice.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Setidaknya malam hari terasa sejuk, itu lumayan.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_Night01_004
Array.english: Unlike the beach, you can hear the wild at night here.\nIt's different.
Array.indonesia: Tidak seperti di pantai, di sini kamu bisa mendengar suara alam liar di malam hari.\nRasanya berbeda.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_Night01_005
Array.english: <size=31>The sound of creatures fighting to survive...\neven while I rest.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Suara makhluk-makhluk yang berjuang untuk bertahan hidup...\nbahkan saat aku beristirahat.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_Night01_006
Array.english: <size=32>It's humbling, thinking I get to rest in the middle of all that.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Rasanya membuatku merasa rendah hati, memikirkan bahwa aku bisa beristirahat di tengah-tengah semua itu.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_Night01_007
Array.english: <size=32>Haha, look at you getting all sentimental at night, Bancho.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha, lihat dirimu jadi sentimentil di malam hari, Bancho.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_Night01_008
Array.english: <size=33>Th-That's not it.\nI was just thinking about what to cook!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>B-Bukan begitu.\nAku hanya sedang memikirkan apa yang akan dimasak!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_01_001
Array.english: I should've brought more tools...\nDidn't think that through.
Array.indonesia: Seharusnya aku membawa lebih banyak peralatan...\nAku tidak memikirkannya dengan matang.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_01_002
Array.english: Tell me about it! But with a boat that small, there wasn't much we could do.
Array.indonesia: Benar banget! Tapi dengan perahu sekecil itu, nggak banyak yang bisa kita lakukan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_01_003
Array.english: There should be folks in the village who can help.\nTake a look around.
Array.indonesia: Pasti ada orang-orang di desa yang bisa membantu.\nCoba lihat-lihat sekeliling.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_01_004
Array.english: Some of them seem wary of outsiders...\nI'll have to do my best.
Array.indonesia: Beberapa dari mereka kelihatannya waspada terhadap orang luar...\nAku harus berusaha sebaik mungkin.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_02_001
Array.english: Phew. The jungle's definitely hot.
Array.indonesia: Wah. Hutan ini benar-benar panas.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_02_002
Array.english: Have you ever been to the jungle before?
Array.indonesia: Pernahkah kamu ke hutan sebelumnya?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_02_003
Array.english: <size=32>Hahaha! I spent quite some time there back in my military days!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hahaha! Aku pernah menghabiskan cukup banyak waktu di sana saat masih di militer!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_02_004
Array.english: We'd pick wild fruits and hunt animals to cook...\nIt was rough.
Array.indonesia: Kami memetik buah liar dan berburu hewan untuk dimasak...\nItu sangat berat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_02_005
Array.english: Sounds like it was good eating, though...
Array.indonesia: Tapi sepertinya makanannya enak, sih...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_03_001
Array.english: A dinosaur carcass drifting in here? \nThe villagers must've been shocked.
Array.indonesia: Bangkai dinosaurus hanyut ke sini? \nPenduduk desa pasti kaget.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_03_002
Array.english: Tell me about it. I was shocked when I first saw it too.
Array.indonesia: Benar banget. Aku juga kaget saat pertama kali melihatnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_03_003
Array.english: It looks like an ordinary lake... \nI wonder what's going on down below?
Array.indonesia: Kelihatannya seperti danau biasa... \nAku penasaran apa yang terjadi di bawah sana?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_03_004
Array.english: You've handled worse in the Blue Hole, haven't you?\nWhy don't you go see for yourself?
Array.indonesia: Kamu pernah menghadapi hal yang lebih parah di Blue Hole, kan?\nKenapa kamu tidak pergi melihatnya sendiri?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_04_001
Array.english: Cobra, how's your arm holding up?
Array.indonesia: Cobra, bagaimana kondisi lenganmu?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_04_002
Array.english: I'm getting used to it quicker than I expected.
Array.indonesia: Aku mulai terbiasa lebih cepat dari yang kuduga.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_04_003
Array.english: Seems it works by reading my muscle movements…\nQuite the technology.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya ini bekerja dengan membaca gerakan ototku…\nTeknologi yang luar biasa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_04_004
Array.english: In movies, robot arms can even stretch out…\nThat'd be super cool!
Array.indonesia: Di film-film, lengan robot bahkan bisa menjulur…\nItu pasti keren banget!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_04_005
Array.english: <size=32>Gahaha! Then I could grab a beer from the fridge\nwithout even leaving the couch!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Gahaha! Kalau begitu, aku bisa mengambil bir dari kulkas\ntanpa harus beranjak dari sofa!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_05_001
Array.english: Seeing Marone…\nReminds me of getting lost on a mission, way back!
Array.indonesia: Melihat Marone…\nMembuatku teringat saat tersesat dalam sebuah misi, dulu sekali!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_05_002
Array.english: Got cut off from my squad,\nspent about a week alone in the forest.
Array.indonesia: Terputus dari regu aku,\nmenghabiskan sekitar seminggu sendirian di hutan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_05_003
Array.english: Back then I caught and ate all sorts of wild animals…
Array.indonesia: Dulu aku menangkap dan memakan segala macam binatang liar…

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_05_004
Array.english: Lizard meat suited my taste the best.
Array.indonesia: Daging kadal paling cocok dengan seleraku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_05_005
Array.english: Texture like chicken…\nAnd you can even taste a hint of sweetness!
Array.indonesia: Teksturnya seperti ayam…\nDan bahkan terasa sedikit manis!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_05_006
Array.english: <size=33>Just thinking about it makes my mouth water… Gahaha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Cuma memikirkannya saja sudah bikin air liurku mengalir… Gahaha!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_06_001
Array.english: Honestly, it's more livable than I thought, but…
Array.indonesia: Jujur, hidup di sini lebih bisa ditoleransi daripada yang aku kira, tapi…

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_06_002
Array.english: Just a shame the network connection's lousy.
Array.indonesia: Sayangnya, koneksi internetnya jelek banget.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_06_003
Array.english: Is there something important going on?
Array.indonesia: Ada hal penting yang terjadi?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_06_004
Array.english: Can't check the delivery status on my Blue Hole orders.
Array.indonesia: Aku nggak bisa mengecek status pengiriman pesanan Blue Hole-ku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_06_005
Array.english: You'll head back eventually, so just sit tight.
Array.indonesia: Nanti kamu juga bakal balik, jadi tunggu saja.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_06_006
Array.english: <size=32>Hah… What are you saying? Business is all about timing.\nWaiting ain't good manners.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hah… Apa maksudmu? Bisnis itu soal waktu yang tepat.\nMenunggu itu nggak sopan.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_Night01_001
Array.english: Oh, come to think of it... aren't you uncomfortable sleeping in a hammock like that?
Array.indonesia: Oh, kalau dipikir-pikir... apakah kamu tidak merasa tidak nyaman tidur di tempat tidur gantung seperti itu?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_Night01_002
Array.english: Haha, it's more comfortable than you'd think.\nI used to sleep like this in the jungle.
Array.indonesia: Haha, ini lebih nyaman daripada yang kamu bayangkan.\nDulu aku sering tidur seperti ini di hutan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_Night01_003
Array.english: <size=32>Wanna give it a try?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Mau coba?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_Night01_004
Array.english: <size=35>Sure!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Tentu!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_Night01_005
Array.english: <size=50>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_Night01_006
Array.english: ...Actually, never mind.\nMight not be such a great idea.
Array.indonesia: ...Sebenarnya, lupakan saja.\nMungkin itu bukan ide yang bagus.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_Night01_007
Array.english: <size=32>...Whats that supposed to mean?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>...Whatsu maksudnya apa?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv01_Night01_001
Array.english: That's a really big tree.
Array.indonesia: Itu pohon yang sangat besar.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv01_Night01_002
Array.english: It's the guardian tree that has protected this village for generations.
Array.indonesia: Itu adalah pohon penjaga yang telah melindungi desa ini selama beberapa generasi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv01_Night01_003
Array.english: Coming-of-age ceremonies and other village events are usually held in front of it.
Array.indonesia: Upacara kedewasaan dan acara desa lainnya biasanya diadakan di depannya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv01_Night01_004
Array.english: I see. It really suits the atmosphere of the village.
Array.indonesia: Begitu ya. Pohon itu benar-benar cocok dengan suasana desa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv01_Night01_005
Array.english: Heh. I suppose it would look that way even to someone from a place with nothing but cold buildings.
Array.indonesia: Heh. Kurasa memang akan terlihat seperti itu bahkan bagi seseorang yang berasal dari tempat yang hanya dipenuhi bangunan-bangunan yang dingin.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv01_Night01_006
Array.english: Even in hard times, standing before this tree brings a sense of peace.
Array.indonesia: Bahkan di masa-masa sulit, berdiri di depan pohon ini memberikan rasa damai.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv01_Night01_007
Array.english: That's likely why the villagers haven't been too shaken, even with all the strange happenings lately.
Array.indonesia: Mungkin itulah sebabnya penduduk desa tidak terlalu terguncang, meski ada banyak kejadian aneh belakangan ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_RelationEvent_01_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, speaking of which... have you met my daughter?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, ngomong-ngomong... apakah kamu sudah bertemu putriku?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_RelationEvent_01_002
Array.english: <size=33>Yes, we've met.\nHer name was...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ya, kami sudah bertemu.\nNamanya...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_RelationEvent_01_option1
Array.english: Uzme
Array.indonesia: Uzme

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_RelationEvent_01_option2
Array.english: Uchiha
Array.indonesia: Uchiha

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_RelationEvent_01_Correct_001
Array.english: <size=36><color=#F1DC2B>Uzme, right?</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36><color=#F1DC2B>Uzme, kan?</color></size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_RelationEvent_01_Correct_002
Array.english: She's very kind. She even showed me around the village and gave me a map.
Array.indonesia: Dia sangat baik. Dia bahkan mengajakku berkeliling desa dan memberiku peta.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_RelationEvent_01_Correct_003
Array.english: Hehe, I thought so.\nShe has a warm heart.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, aku kira begitu.\nDia memiliki hati yang hangat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_RelationEvent_01_Correct_004
Array.english: I wish she'd enjoy her youth a bit more...\nbut she's completely absorbed in her training.
Array.indonesia: Aku berharap dia bisa lebih menikmati masa mudanya...\ntapi dia benar-benar fokus pada latihannya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_RelationEvent_01_Correct_005
Array.english: Ever since I injured my leg in a crocodile attack...\nshe's been saying she'll protect the village herself.
Array.indonesia: Sejak kakiku terluka akibat serangan buaya...\ndia terus bilang akan melindungi desa ini sendiri.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_RelationEvent_01_Correct_006
Array.english: I wish she'd meet a good partner... but she has no interest in men at all...
Array.indonesia: Aku berharap dia bisa bertemu pasangan yang baik... tapi dia sama sekali tidak tertarik pada pria...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_RelationEvent_01_Correct_007
Array.english: I see. I hope she meets someone nice.
Array.indonesia: Begitu ya. Semoga dia bertemu seseorang yang baik.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_RelationEvent_01_Correct_008
Array.english: Anyone come to mind?
Array.indonesia: Ada yang terlintas di pikiran?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_RelationEvent_01_Correct_009
Array.english: <size=33>Huh? I don't think so...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hah? Kurasa tidak...?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_RelationEvent_01_Correct_010
Array.english: Ah, never mind. I can't just set my daughter up with an outsider who doesn't know our ways.
Array.indonesia: Ah, sudahlah. Aku tidak bisa begitu saja menjodohkan putriku dengan orang luar yang tidak mengenal adat istiadat kita.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_RelationEvent_01_Correct_011
Array.english: I shouldn't have said that.\nYou must be busy, so go on ahead.
Array.indonesia: Seharusnya aku tidak mengatakan itu.\nKamu pasti sibuk, jadi silakan pergi saja.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_RelationEvent_01_Incorrect_001
Array.english: Uh... <color=#F1DC2B>Uchiha</color>, right?\nThat was it, wasn't it?
Array.indonesia: Uh... <color=#F1DC2B>Uchiha</color>, kan?\nItu namanya, kan?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_RelationEvent_01_Incorrect_002
Array.english: ...Is that some tribe from another village?
Array.indonesia: ...Apakah itu suku dari desa lain?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_RelationEvent_01_Incorrect_003
Array.english: Seems like you need to get to know the villagers a bit better.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya kamu perlu mengenal penduduk desa ini sedikit lebih baik.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv01_01_001
Array.english: Chief, have you lived in this village your whole life?
Array.indonesia: Kepala Desa, apakah Kamu sudah tinggal di desa ini sepanjang hidup Kamu?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv01_01_002
Array.english: What kind of question is that? \nOf course I was born and raised here.
Array.indonesia: Pertanyaan macam apa itu? \nTentu saja saya lahir dan besar di sini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv01_01_003
Array.english: Wow... then you must know the village's history really well.
Array.indonesia: Wah... kalau begitu, Kamu pasti sangat paham sejarah desa ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv01_01_004
Array.english: History... well, it's mostly just what I've seen myself...
Array.indonesia: Sejarah... yah, kebanyakan hanya apa yang saya lihat sendiri...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv01_01_005
Array.english: But I've heard there were many strange things in this region in ancient times.
Array.indonesia: Tapi aku pernah dengar ada banyak hal aneh di wilayah ini pada zaman dahulu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv01_01_006
Array.english: I've studied quite a few old texts about it.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah mempelajari cukup banyak teks kuno tentang hal itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv01_01_007
Array.english: I'd love to hear about that sometime.
Array.indonesia: Aku ingin sekali mendengar ceritanya suatu saat nanti.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv01_02_001
Array.english: The villagers...\nare they uncomfortable with us being here?
Array.indonesia: Penduduk desa...\napakah mereka merasa tidak nyaman dengan kehadiran kita di sini?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv01_02_002
Array.english: It would be a lie to say outsiders aren't an inconvenience.
Array.indonesia: Akan menjadi kebohongan jika mengatakan bahwa orang luar tidak merepotkan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv01_02_003
Array.english: But with the recent earthquakes... and seeing that dinosaur carcass, they'll understand we need outside help.
Array.indonesia: Namun, dengan gempa bumi yang baru-baru ini terjadi... dan setelah melihat bangkai dinosaurus itu, mereka akan mengerti bahwa kami membutuhkan bantuan dari luar.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv01_02_004
Array.english: Some may be unfriendly...\nbut they're good people at heart, so try to get along.
Array.indonesia: Beberapa di antaranya mungkin bersikap tidak ramah...\ntetapi pada dasarnya mereka adalah orang-orang baik, jadi cobalah untuk bergaul dengan mereka.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_InfoTalk01_001
Array.english: Chief, what kind of food do you like?
Array.indonesia: Kepala Desa, makanan apa yang Kamu sukai?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_InfoTalk01_002
Array.english: Hmm... maybe it's because I'm getting older...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... mungkin karena saya semakin tua...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_InfoTalk01_003
Array.english: <size=33>I've grown to like nourishing dishes... \nlike ones made with <color=#FF73C3>King Oyster Mushrooms</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Saya mulai menyukai hidangan yang bergizi... \nseperti yang dibuat dengan <color=#FF73C3>Jamur Tiram Raja</color>.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_InfoTalk01_004
Array.english: <size=32><color=#FF73C3>King Oyster Mushrooms</color> are great for anti-aging too, Chief.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32><color=#FF73C3>Jamur Tiram Raja</color> juga bagus untuk anti-penuaan, Kepala.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_InfoTalk01_005
Array.english: <size=35>Are you saying I look old?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Maksudmu aku terlihat tua?!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_InfoTalk01_006
Array.english: <size=34>Oh... that's not what I meant...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh... bukan itu maksudku...!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv01_03_001
Array.english: Since Utara Lake turned murky, the fish seem to have grown more aggressive.
Array.indonesia: Sejak Danau Utara menjadi keruh, ikan-ikan di sana sepertinya menjadi lebih agresif.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv01_03_002
Array.english: I suppose the change in their environment made them more sensitive...
Array.indonesia: Mungkin perubahan lingkungan membuat mereka lebih sensitif...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv01_03_003
Array.english: I wish it could return to how clear it once was...\nI wonder if there's a way.
Array.indonesia: Aku berharap danau itu bisa kembali sejernih dulu...\nAku penasaran apakah ada caranya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_01_001
Array.english: Isn't it too hot for you here?
Array.indonesia: Bukankah di sini terlalu panas untukmu?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_01_002
Array.english: <size=32>Yeah, it definitely is.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ya, memang begitu.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_01_003
Array.english: But when a cool breeze comes through, it feels really nice.
Array.indonesia: Tapi saat angin sejuk bertiup, rasanya sangat menyenangkan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_01_004
Array.english: Haha, well, the village sits on high ground,\nso it stays a bit cooler.
Array.indonesia: Haha, ya, desa ini terletak di dataran tinggi,\njadi suhunya tetap sedikit lebih sejuk.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_01_005
Array.english: And with that lake over there, we're fairly self-sufficient.
Array.indonesia: Dan dengan danau di sana, kami cukup mandiri.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_01_006
Array.english: It's amazing that there's a lake this high up.
Array.indonesia: Luar biasa ada danau setinggi ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_01_007
Array.english: You've probably noticed during your investigation...\nthey say the lake connects to the sea below.
Array.indonesia: Kamu mungkin sudah menyadarinya selama penyelidikanmu...\nkatanya danau ini terhubung dengan laut di bawah sana.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_01_008
Array.english: Strange, isn't it?\nThe same water, yet divided like this.
Array.indonesia: Aneh, bukan?\nAir yang sama, tapi terpisah seperti ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_01_009
Array.english: Maybe that's why so many strange things happen here.
Array.indonesia: Mungkin itulah sebabnya banyak hal aneh terjadi di sini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_01_010
Array.english: Hehe... even so, the spirits of Setah Forest have watched over us, allowing our history to endure.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... meski begitu, roh-roh Hutan Setah telah melindungi kita, sehingga sejarah kita tetap bertahan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_01_011
Array.english: But this time... it seems we'll need your help.
Array.indonesia: Tapi kali ini... sepertinya kita akan membutuhkan bantuanmu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_01_012
Array.english: Don't worry. We'll find the cause
Array.indonesia: Jangan khawatir. Kita akan menemukan penyebabnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_02_001
Array.english: Are you settling in well?
Array.indonesia: Apakah kamu sudah mulai terbiasa di sini?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_02_002
Array.english: Yes. There are plenty of ingredients, and even the villagers who were wary at first are starting to warm up to us.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Bahan-bahannya berlimpah, dan bahkan penduduk desa yang awalnya waspada pun mulai bersikap ramah kepada kita.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_02_003
Array.english: I see. Resources in this village tend to recover quickly.
Array.indonesia: Begitu ya. Sumber daya di desa ini cenderung pulih dengan cepat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_02_004
Array.english: If you need anything, feel free to make use of them.
Array.indonesia: Jika kamu membutuhkan sesuatu, silakan gunakan saja.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_02_005
Array.english: The villagers won't give you a hard time about it.
Array.indonesia: Penduduk desa tidak akan mempersulitmu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_InfoTalk02_001
Array.english: Oh... your face looks a bit redder than usual.
Array.indonesia: Oh... wajahmu terlihat sedikit lebih merah dari biasanya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_InfoTalk02_002
Array.english: Haha... I had a glass of <color=#FF73C3>Wine</color> for a change.\nI suppose it shows.
Array.indonesia: Haha... aku minum segelas <color=#FF73C3>Anggur</color> untuk sekadar ganti suasana.\nSepertinya itu terlihat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_InfoTalk02_003
Array.english: I didn't know you liked <color=#FF73C3>Wine</color>, Chief...\nThat's unexpected.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak tahu kamu suka <color=#FF73C3>Anggur</color>, Kepala Desa...\nItu tidak terduga.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_InfoTalk02_004
Array.english: Haha, is it? I started drinking a little to ease the pain after I injured my leg...
Array.indonesia: Haha, benarkah? Aku mulai minum sedikit untuk meredakan rasa sakit setelah kakiku terluka...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_InfoTalk02_005
Array.english: Now it's become a habit to have a glass or two before bed.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang sudah jadi kebiasaan minum satu atau dua gelas sebelum tidur.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_InfoTalk02_006
Array.english:
By the way... if you come across any good <color=#FF73C3>Wine</color>, 
I'd appreciate it if you brought some to me...
Array.indonesia:
Ngomong-ngomong... kalau kamu menemukan <color=#FF73C3>Anggur</color> yang enak, 
aku akan sangat berterima kasih kalau kamu membawakannya untukku...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_InfoTalk02_007
Array.english: <size=33>Just keep it between us. Uzme doesn't need to know. Haha.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ini rahasia kita berdua saja. Uzme nggak perlu tahu. Haha.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_03_001
Array.english: Hmm... I have to admit, your cooking was quite good.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Aku harus akui, masakanmu lumayan enak.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_03_002
Array.english: Hehe. Bancho's cooking really is world-class!
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Masakan Bancho memang kelas dunia!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_03_003
Array.english: This village has plenty of delicious food too.
Array.indonesia: Desa ini juga punya banyak makanan lezat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_03_004
Array.english: But with the lake polluted, he probably had to adjust his cooking a bit.
Array.indonesia: Tapi karena danau tercemar, dia mungkin harus sedikit menyesuaikan masakannya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_03_005
Array.english: Haha, the ingredients here are so good.\nPerhaps we've relied on that a little too much.
Array.indonesia: Haha, bahan-bahannya di sini sangat bagus.\nMungkin kita terlalu mengandalkan itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_03_006
Array.english: Food makes a big difference in people's lives, you know.
Array.indonesia: Makanan sangat berpengaruh dalam kehidupan orang-orang, lho.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_03_007
Array.english: We'll keep working on new recipes and make sure everyone gets to enjoy them!
Array.indonesia: Kita akan terus mengembangkan resep baru dan memastikan semua orang bisa menikmatinya!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_01_001
Array.english: Uzme's mentioned your restaurant and chef a few times,\nsaying they're excellent.
Array.indonesia: Uzme sudah beberapa kali menyebut restoran dan koki kalian,\nkatanya mereka luar biasa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_01_002
Array.english: Haha! Bancho's cooking is the best!\nHonestly, he's always thinking about ingredients!
Array.indonesia: Haha! Masakan Bancho adalah yang terbaik!\nJujur saja, dia selalu memikirkan bahan-bahannya!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_01_003
Array.english: Heh heh... quite an unusual fellow, indeed. Are you planning to leave once the investigation is done?
Array.indonesia: Heh heh... memang sosok yang cukup unik. Apakah kamu berencana pergi begitu penyelidikan selesai?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_01_004
Array.english: Yes. We need to get back and run Bancho's restaurant.\nIt's temporarily closed, you see.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Kami harus kembali dan mengelola restoran Bancho.\nRestoran itu ditutup sementara, lho.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_01_005
Array.english: If it were up to me, I'd have him stay and keep the place running...
Array.indonesia: Kalau terserah aku, aku akan memintanya tinggal dan terus mengelola tempat itu...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_01_006
Array.english: Settle down in the village and all...
Array.indonesia: Menetap di desa dan sebagainya...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_01_007
Array.english: Who knows? Maybe that young chef will become the next village chief, haha!
Array.indonesia: Siapa tahu? Mungkin koki muda itu akan menjadi kepala desa berikutnya, haha!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_01_008
Array.english: An outsider becoming village chief...?\nDoes that actually happen?
Array.indonesia: Orang luar menjadi kepala desa...?\nApakah hal seperti itu benar-benar terjadi?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_01_009
Array.english: Well... you never know. He might end up marrying someone from the village.
Array.indonesia: Yah... siapa tahu. Dia mungkin akan menikahi seseorang dari desa ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_01_010
Array.english: Hmm... I'm not sure if Bancho's interested in getting married.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Aku tidak yakin apakah Bancho tertarik untuk menikah.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_01_011
Array.english: ...Haha, I see.
Array.indonesia: ...Haha, begitu ya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_02_001
Array.english: As an outsider...
Array.indonesia: Sebagai orang luar...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_02_002
Array.english: what do you think this village still needs?
Array.indonesia: menurutmu apa yang masih dibutuhkan desa ini?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_02_option1
Array.english: 5G connection
Array.indonesia: Koneksi 5G

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_02_option2
Array.english: Paved roads for cars
Array.indonesia: Jalan beraspal untuk mobil

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_02_option1_answer_001
Array.english: Come to think of it, you mentioned the phone connection wasn't great here.
Array.indonesia: Kalau dipikir-pikir, kamu pernah bilang koneksi telepon di sini kurang bagus.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_02_option1_answer_002
Array.english: Yeah... some apps won't even run.
Array.indonesia: Iya... beberapa aplikasi bahkan nggak bisa jalan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_02_option1_answer_003
Array.english: Hmm... that wasn't intentional...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... itu tidak disengaja...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_02_option1_answer_004
Array.english: But setting up a stable connection would mean installing a base station in the village. That would be quite a large project.
Array.indonesia: Tapi untuk membuat koneksi yang stabil, berarti harus memasang stasiun pemancar di desa. Itu akan menjadi proyek yang cukup besar.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_02_option1_answer_005
Array.english: We'd likely need to put up several utility poles around the village as well...
Array.indonesia: Kita mungkin juga perlu memasang beberapa tiang utilitas di sekitar desa...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_02_option1_answer_006
Array.english: I see. That would ruin the village's scenery...
Array.indonesia: Oh, begitu. Itu akan merusak pemandangan desa...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_02_option1_answer_007
Array.english: Actually, I don't really need those things,\nso it's fine as it is!
Array.indonesia: Sebenarnya, aku tidak terlalu membutuhkan hal-hal itu,\njadi tidak apa-apa seperti ini saja!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_02_option2_answer_001
Array.english: A proper road for cars...
Array.indonesia: Jalan yang layak untuk mobil...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_02_option2_answer_002
Array.english: That would be a massive undertaking, digging up land all across the village.
Array.indonesia: Itu akan menjadi pekerjaan besar, menggali tanah di seluruh desa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_02_option2_answer_003
Array.english: Oh... I suppose it would.
Array.indonesia: Oh... kurasa memang begitu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_02_option2_answer_004
Array.english: We can't ruin this village's beautiful scenery.
Array.indonesia: Kita tidak boleh merusak pemandangan indah desa ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_02_option2_answer_005
Array.english: We can just keep using Rimbo's truck like we do now,\nso I don't think we'll need one!
Array.indonesia: Kita bisa terus menggunakan truk Rimbo seperti biasa,\njadi menurutku kita tidak perlu yang baru!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv01_Night01_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hm? What's with you dropping by this late?\nThat's kinda rude!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hm? Kenapa kamu mampir selarut ini?\nItu agak tidak sopan!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv01_01_001
Array.english: Come to think of it... how did you hurt your arm again?
Array.indonesia: Kalau dipikir-pikir... bagaimana sih lenganmu bisa terluka lagi?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv01_01_002
Array.english: Ah... well, I was chopping down a rubber tree on a hill in Setah Forest...
Array.indonesia: Ah... begini, aku sedang menebang pohon karet di bukit di Hutan Setah...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv01_01_003
Array.english: <size=33>All of a sudden, there was a huge earthquake with a loud crash!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tiba-tiba, terjadi gempa bumi besar disertai suara dentuman keras!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv01_01_004
Array.english: So I lost my footing while holding the axe...
Array.indonesia: Jadi aku kehilangan keseimbangan saat memegang kapak...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv01_01_005
Array.english: ...and messed up all my limbs... That's a career-ending injury for a carpenter, you know.
Array.indonesia: ...dan seluruh anggota tubuhku jadi kacau... Itu cedera yang bisa mengakhiri karier seorang tukang kayu, lho.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv01_01_006
Array.english: But you're doing great with just one arm.
Array.indonesia: Tapi kamu hebat banget meski cuma pakai satu tangan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv01_01_007
Array.english: W-Well... that's nothing for me, ahem.
Array.indonesia: Y-Ya... itu bukan apa-apa buatku, ahem.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv01_02_001
Array.english: Peneb, have you been in this village long?
Array.indonesia: Peneb, sudah lama kamu tinggal di desa ini?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv01_02_002
Array.english: Hehe, of course. I was born and raised here.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, tentu saja. Aku lahir dan besar di sini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv01_02_003
Array.english: I see. It's a really beautiful village.
Array.indonesia: Begitu. Desa ini benar-benar indah.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv01_02_004
Array.english: Is there anything you don't like about it?
Array.indonesia: Adakah hal yang tidak kamu sukai dari desa ini?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv01_02_005
Array.english: Hmm... this village has a ton of <color=#F1DC2B>Bugs</color>.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... desa ini penuh dengan <color=#F1DC2B>Serangga</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv01_02_006
Array.english: <size=34>And I really hate <color=#F1DC2B>Bugs</color>...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Dan aku benar-benar benci <color=#F1DC2B>Serangga</color>...!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv01_02_007
Array.english: But aren't some bugs pretty, like butterflies and fireflies?
Array.indonesia: Tapi bukankah ada serangga yang cantik, seperti kupu-kupu dan kunang-kunang?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv01_02_008
Array.english: <size=32>How can anything with that many legs be pretty...? Just thinking about it gives me the creeps!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Bagaimana mungkin makhluk dengan kaki sebanyak itu bisa cantik...? Hanya memikirkannya saja sudah membuatku merinding!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv01_02_009
Array.english: I see...! Got it.
Array.indonesia: Begitu ya... ! Paham.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv01_03_001
Array.english: Your friend's cooking... I'm still not quite ready to try it yet...
Array.indonesia: Masakan temanmu... Aku masih belum siap mencobanya...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv01_03_002
Array.english: <size=33>If I get a stomachache out here, that'd be a real problem!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kalau aku sakit perut di sini, itu bakal jadi masalah besar!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_InfoTalk01_001
Array.english: Ugh. After work, I always crave something sweet...
Array.indonesia: Ugh. Setelah kerja, aku selalu pengen sesuatu yang manis...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_InfoTalk01_002
Array.english: Like <color=#FF73C3>Candy</color> or <color=#FF73C3>Chocolate</color>.
Array.indonesia: Seperti <color=#FF73C3>Permen</color> atau <color=#FF73C3>Cokelat</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_InfoTalk01_003
Array.english: Come to think of it, there's nowhere in the village that sells them.
Array.indonesia: Kalau dipikir-pikir, nggak ada tempat di desa ini yang jual itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_InfoTalk01_004
Array.english: Well, Rimbo brings some back from the city sometimes!\nBut they're not always available.
Array.indonesia: Yah, kadang-kadang Rimbo bawa pulang dari kota!\nTapi nggak selalu ada.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_InfoTalk01_005
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(So Peneb likes <color=#FF73C3>Sweets</color>.\nI should make a note of that.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Jadi Peneb suka <color=#FF73C3>Makanan Manis</color>.\nAku harus mencatat itu.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv03_01_001
Array.english: That... friend of yours.
Array.indonesia: Teman...mu itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv03_01_002
Array.english: <size=33>He's pretty good at cooking, I'll give him that.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Dia lumayan jago masak, aku akui itu.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv03_01_003
Array.english: <size=32>Haha, right? Bancho's the best chef!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha, kan? Bancho adalah koki terbaik!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv03_01_004
Array.english: But the restaurant's decor is a bit lacking...
Array.indonesia: Tapi dekorasi restorannya agak kurang...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv03_01_005
Array.english: Well, it's your taste, I suppose. If you ever want to redecorate, just let me know.
Array.indonesia: Yah, itu selera kamu, kurasa. Kalau suatu saat mau mendekorasi ulang, bilang saja padaku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv03_02_001
Array.english: I see. So you're a carpenter, but you work with stone too?
Array.indonesia: Begitu. Jadi kamu tukang kayu, tapi juga menguasai pekerjaan batu?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv03_02_002
Array.english: Hehe, wood's my main trade, but I picked up stonework as well.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, kayu memang keahlian utamaku, tapi aku juga belajar mengolah batu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv03_02_003
Array.english: I've loved making things since I was a kid.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah suka membuat berbagai benda sejak kecil.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv03_02_004
Array.english: I used to gather my own wood for materials... but as you can see, it's not easy for me to get around much these days.
Array.indonesia: Dulu aku biasa mengumpulkan kayu sendiri untuk bahan... tapi seperti yang kamu lihat, sekarang aku sulit bergerak ke mana-mana.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv03_02_005
Array.english: <size=33>I've written down what I need, so just bring the materials and I'll make it for you.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku sudah menuliskan apa yang kubutuhkan, jadi bawakan saja bahannya dan aku akan membuatnya untukmu.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv03_03_001
Array.english: Ugh... this arm of mine's injured, and it's a real pain. I can still work, but...
Array.indonesia: Ugh... lengan ini terluka, dan rasanya sangat sakit. Aku masih bisa bekerja, tapi...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv03_03_002
Array.english: If you want your bones to heal properly, you've got to eat regularly and get enough nutrients.
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu ingin tulangmu sembuh dengan baik, kamu harus makan teratur dan mendapatkan nutrisi yang cukup.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv03_03_003
Array.english: Hehe. That's why I've been eating the bones too when I have fish!
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Itulah mengapa aku juga memakan tulangnya saat makan ikan!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv03_03_004
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm... I'm not sure that actually helps with bone healing.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm... Aku tidak yakin itu benar-benar membantu penyembuhan tulang.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_InfoTalk02_001
Array.english: Hey Peneb, which fish from the lake do you think is the most delicious?
Array.indonesia: Hei Peneb, menurutmu ikan apa dari danau ini yang paling enak?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_InfoTalk02_002
Array.english: <size=34>Ah! The villagers enjoy all kinds of fish...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ah! Penduduk desa menikmati semua jenis ikan...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_InfoTalk02_003
Array.english: <size=33>But if we're talking taste, it's gotta be <color=#FF73C3>Sea Bass</color>, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tapi kalau soal rasa, pasti <color=#FF73C3>Sea Bass</color>, kan?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_InfoTalk02_004
Array.english: <size=33>Especially the <color=#FF73C3>Nile Perch</color> from this lake. The meat's great, but the skin is incredible!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Terutama <color=#FF73C3>Nile Perch</color> dari danau ini. Dagingnya enak, tapi kulitnya luar biasa!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_InfoTalk02_005
Array.english: <size=33>That thick meat with crispy skin together is just the best!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Daging tebal dengan kulit renyah itu benar-benar yang terbaik!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_InfoTalk02_006
Array.english: Ah... just hearing you talk about it is making me hungry... hehe.
Array.indonesia: Ah... cuma dengar kamu ngomongin itu aja udah bikin aku lapar... hehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv05_01_001
Array.english: Shouldn't you rest a bit while you recover?
Array.indonesia: Bukankah sebaiknya kamu istirahat sebentar sambil memulihkan diri?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv05_01_002
Array.english: Nah... if I just sit around, my skills'll get rusty.
Array.indonesia: Ah, tidak... kalau aku cuma duduk-duduk saja, kemampuanku bakal tumpul.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv05_01_003
Array.english: <size=32>I gotta fix broken furniture and make more sculptures too!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku harus memperbaiki perabotan yang rusak dan membuat lebih banyak patung juga!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv05_01_004
Array.english: <size=34>The village can't run without me! Hehehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Desa ini nggak bisa berjalan tanpa aku! Hehehe.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv05_02_001
Array.english: To be honest, when I first saw you folks, I was a bit worried.
Array.indonesia: Sejujurnya, saat pertama kali melihat kalian, aku agak khawatir.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv05_02_002
Array.english: You didn't even bring a single axe or pickaxe with you...
Array.indonesia: Kalian bahkan tidak membawa satu pun kapak atau beliung...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv05_02_003
Array.english: Like those outsiders who pass through, don't respect our traditions, just strut around like they own the place, then leave.
Array.indonesia: Seperti orang luar yang sekadar lewat, tidak menghormati tradisi kami, hanya berjalan-jalan dengan angkuh seolah-olah mereka pemilik tempat ini, lalu pergi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv05_02_004
Array.english: But you folks are different, I'll admit.
Array.indonesia: Tapi kalian berbeda, aku akui.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv05_02_005
Array.english: The way you pitch in with the village work...\nand your cooking's pretty darn good too...
Array.indonesia: Cara kalian ikut membantu pekerjaan desa...\ndan masakan kalian juga lumayan enak...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv05_02_006
Array.english: That archaeologist drops by at night sometimes,\nand we even grab a drink together!
Array.indonesia: Arkeolog itu kadang mampir di malam hari,\ndan kami bahkan minum-minum bareng!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv05_02_007
Array.english: ...Dr. Bacon...\nGiving alcohol to an injured person...
Array.indonesia: ...Dr. Bacon...\nMemberi minuman beralkohol kepada orang yang terluka...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv01_01_001
Array.english: <size=32>So when ya dive, ya get air from that tank on yer back?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Jadi, saat kalian menyelam, kalian mengambil udara dari tabung di punggung kalian?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv01_01_002
Array.english: That's right. We call it an oxygen tank for convenience... but it's actually an air tank with 78% nitrogen and 21% oxygen.
Array.indonesia: Benar. Kami menyebutnya tabung oksigen untuk kemudahan... tapi sebenarnya itu tabung udara yang berisi 78% nitrogen dan 21% oksigen.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv01_01_003
Array.english: I thought about tryin' it once when an outsider came through... but just havin' the gear ain't enough to go in the water.
Array.indonesia: Aku pernah berpikir untuk mencobanya sekali saat ada orang luar yang datang... tapi cuma punya perlengkapannya saja nggak cukup buat masuk ke air.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv01_01_004
Array.english: There's a lot to prepare... and I was too scared of critters like piranhas, so I gave up.
Array.indonesia: Ada banyak hal yang harus dipersiapkan... dan aku terlalu takut sama makhluk-makhluk seperti piranha, jadi aku menyerah.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv01_01_005
Array.english: I see. Well, you're great at fishing anyway.\nThat's more than enough.
Array.indonesia: Oh, begitu. Yah, kamu jago memancing kok.\nItu sudah lebih dari cukup.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv01_01_006
Array.english: Hehe, looks like you know what you're talkin' about, mister.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, sepertinya kamu tahu apa yang kamu bicarakan, Pak.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv01_02_001
Array.english: Ain't catchin' no fish these days.
Array.indonesia: Belakangan ini nggak ada ikan yang ketangkep.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv01_02_002
Array.english: You sure it ain't 'cause you already caught 'em all?
Array.indonesia: Kamu yakin itu bukan karena kamu sudah menangkap semuanya?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv01_02_003
Array.english: Ah... I don't think so...!
Array.indonesia: Ah... Kurasa tidak...!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv01_02_004
Array.english: <size=32>Well, don't go stirrin' up the water too much.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Yah, jangan terlalu banyak mengaduk-aduk airnya.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv01_03_001
Array.english: There's plenty to eat in this village, but...
Array.indonesia: Makanan di desa ini memang berlimpah, tapi...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv01_03_002
Array.english: Still, fish dishes are our staple, and with the lake gettin' that polluted...
Array.indonesia: Meski begitu, hidangan ikan tetap menjadi makanan pokok kami, dan dengan danau yang semakin tercemar...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv01_03_003
Array.english: It must've been cleaner before.
Array.indonesia: Dulu pasti lebih bersih.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv01_03_004
Array.english: The water was definitely clearer than it is now.
Array.indonesia: Airnya jelas lebih jernih daripada sekarang.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv01_03_005
Array.english: <size=33>It was great for castin' a line too, made fishin' real enjoyable!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tempat itu juga asyik buat memancing, bikin kegiatan memancing jadi sangat menyenangkan!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv01_03_006
Array.english: It'll be clean again like before once the investigation's done!
Array.indonesia: Nanti bakal bersih lagi kayak dulu setelah penyelidikan selesai!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv01_03_007
Array.english: You sound mighty confident.\nWell then, I'll be watchin'.
Array.indonesia: Kamu terdengar sangat yakin.\nBaiklah, aku akan menantikannya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_InfoTalk01_001
Array.english: You dive 'cause you like fish dishes?
Array.indonesia: Kamu menyelam karena suka hidangan ikan?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_InfoTalk01_002
Array.english: Yes! Bancho's sushi is absolutely incredible.
Array.indonesia: Ya! Sushi Bancho benar-benar luar biasa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_InfoTalk01_003
Array.english: Though I can't get it here...
Array.indonesia: Meskipun aku tidak bisa mendapatkannya di sini...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_InfoTalk01_004
Array.english: Haha, then could ya make <color=#FF73C3>Piraiba Catfish</color> sushi too?
Array.indonesia: Haha, kalau begitu bisakah kamu membuat sushi <color=#FF73C3>Ikan Lele Piraiba</color> juga?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_InfoTalk01_005
Array.english: Hmm... actually, we don't use freshwater fish for sushi. Too many parasites.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... sebenarnya, kami tidak menggunakan ikan air tawar untuk sushi. Terlalu banyak parasit.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_InfoTalk01_006
Array.english: Oh... I see.
Array.indonesia: Oh... begitu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_InfoTalk01_007
Array.english: Well, no matter. <color=#FF73C3>Piraiba Catfish</color> tastes great no matter how ya cook it. Grilled, steamed, ya name it.
Array.indonesia: Yah, tak apa-apa. <color=#FF73C3>Ikan Lele Piraiba</color> rasanya enak apa pun cara memasaknya. Dipanggang, dikukus, apa saja.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_InfoTalk01_008
Array.english: Sure would be nice if we could get it at your restaurant too, haha.
Array.indonesia: Pasti asyik kalau kita bisa mendapatkannya di restoranmu juga, haha.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv03_01_001
Array.english: I heard this lake's pretty deep. What's it really like?
Array.indonesia: Aku dengar danau ini cukup dalam. Seperti apa sebenarnya?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv03_01_002
Array.english: I thought it'd be shallow since it's a lake...\nbut it's over 70 meters deep.
Array.indonesia: Aku kira danau ini dangkal karena memang danau. ..\ntapi kedalamannya lebih dari 70 meter.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv03_01_003
Array.english: Goodness... that's mighty deep. It won't be easy gettin' the line down to the bottom.
Array.indonesia: Astaga... itu sangat dalam. Pasti nggak gampang menurunkan tali pancing sampai ke dasar.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv03_01_004
Array.english: <size=32>Looks like I'll be needin' your help for a while longer! Haha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Sepertinya aku masih butuh bantuanmu untuk sementara waktu lagi! Haha!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv03_02_001
Array.english: Don't you get bored just waiting around when you fish?
Array.indonesia: Kamu nggak bosan cuma nunggu-nunggu pas lagi mancing?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv03_02_002
Array.english: Well, sure I do.
Array.indonesia: Ya, tentu saja.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv03_02_003
Array.english: But the fish 'round here are so active, ya don't have to wait long at all.
Array.indonesia: Tapi ikan-ikan di sini sangat aktif, jadi kamu nggak perlu nunggu lama-lama.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv03_02_004
Array.english: Just hum a Muse Dash tune and next thing ya know,\none's on the hook!
Array.indonesia: Cukup senandungin lagu Muse Dash, dan sebelum kamu sadar,\nsudah ada yang ketangkep!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_InfoTalk02_001
Array.english: So hit me up~♪\nSpeeding up fast♬~♪
Array.indonesia: Jadi hubungi aku~♪\nMelaju kencang♬~♪

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_InfoTalk02_002
Array.english: Huh? Basu, what song are you humming?
Array.indonesia: Hah? Basu, lagu apa yang kamu senandungkan?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_InfoTalk02_003
