Array.english: <size=34>Oh, it ain't nothin'!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh, bukan apa-apa!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_InfoTalk02_004
Array.english: Wait, is that song...\nMuse Dash's Hit Me Up?
Array.indonesia: Tunggu, apakah lagu itu.. .\nMuse Dash's Hit Me Up?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_InfoTalk02_005
Array.english: <size=35>Ooh?! You know 'em too?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ooh?! Kamu juga kenal mereka?!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_InfoTalk02_006
Array.english: Of course. They're a super popular girl group right now.
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja. Mereka adalah girlband yang sangat populer saat ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_InfoTalk02_007
Array.english: <size=34>Hahaha! You've got good taste!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hahaha! Selera kamu bagus banget!!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_InfoTalk02_008
Array.english: Haha. I never would've guessed you're a Muse Dash fan, Basu.
Array.indonesia: Haha. Aku nggak pernah nyangka kamu penggemar Muse Dash, Basu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_InfoTalk02_009
Array.english: <size=34>Do you collect their merch or anything?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kamu koleksi merchandise mereka atau apa?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_InfoTalk02_010
Array.english: <size=34>W-well... I might have a few things...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Y-ya... Mungkin aku punya beberapa barang... </size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_InfoTalk02_011
Array.english: (Maybe I should get him some Muse Dash merch as a gift sometime?)
Array.indonesia: (Mungkin aku harus membelikannya beberapa merchandise Muse Dash sebagai hadiah suatu saat nanti?)

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv05_01_001
Array.english: I've been seeing a lot of lizards around here.
Array.indonesia: Aku sering melihat banyak kadal di sekitar sini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv05_01_002
Array.english: Oh... you mean the <color=#F1DC2B>Big-Eyed Lizards</color>.
Array.indonesia: Oh... maksudmu <color=#F1DC2B>Kadal Bermata Besar</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv05_01_003
Array.english: Big-eyed lizards come in all sorts of colors and patterns.
Array.indonesia: Kadal bermata besar ada dalam berbagai macam warna dan pola.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv05_01_004
Array.english: It's got a real cute look to it... and though it's timid, ya can befriend it if ya tame it.
Array.indonesia: Penampilannya benar-benar imut... dan meskipun pemalu, kamu bisa berteman dengannya kalau kamu menjinakkannya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv05_01_005
Array.english: They're good eatin' too, makes 'em great prey for wild animals.
Array.indonesia: Mereka juga enak dimakan, jadi mangsa yang bagus buat hewan liar.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv05_01_006
Array.english: Huh? Do you like big-eyed lizards too, like Lipah?\nYou sure know a lot about them.
Array.indonesia: Hah? Apakah kamu juga suka kadal bermata besar, seperti Lipah?\nKamu benar-benar tahu banyak tentang mereka.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv05_01_007
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, no, it ain't like that... it's just...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, tidak, bukan begitu... hanya saja...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv05_01_008
Array.english: I gotta catch worms for fishin' bait...\nand I just happened to see 'em then and learned a bit!
Array.indonesia: Aku harus menangkap cacing untuk umpan memancing...\ndan kebetulan aku melihat mereka saat itu dan belajar sedikit!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv05_01_009
Array.english: I see... Sounds like you've been studying up on them.
Array.indonesia: Begitu... Sepertinya kamu sudah mempelajari mereka.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv05_01_010
Array.english: <size=33>Wh-why would I go studyin' 'em? Ya just see 'em every day and ya get to know 'em, that's all!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>M-mengapa aku harus mempelajarinya? Kamu hanya melihatnya setiap hari dan jadi mengenalnya, itu saja!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv01_Night01_001
Array.english: Oh my... what are you doing up so late?
Array.indonesia: Astaga... apa yang kamu lakukan masih terjaga sampai larut begini?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv01_Night01_002
Array.english: The breeze is nice and cool here. I've been looking around to see if I missed anything.
Array.indonesia: Angin di sini sejuk dan segar. Aku sedang melihat-lihat sekeliling untuk memastikan tidak ada yang terlewatkan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv01_Night01_003
Array.english: I see, hehe. Macaques used to come down at night and cause trouble in the village...
Array.indonesia: Oh, begitu, hehe. Dulu, kera-kera sering turun pada malam hari dan membuat onar di desa...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv01_Night01_004
Array.english: But since the boulder blocked the path, they don't show up much anymore.
Array.indonesia: Tapi sejak batu besar itu menghalangi jalan, mereka jarang muncul lagi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv01_Night01_005
Array.english: Still, you never know when they might come back,\nso always be careful at night.
Array.indonesia: Meski begitu, kamu tidak pernah tahu kapan mereka akan kembali,\njadi selalu berhati-hatilah di malam hari.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Task_410050008_001
Array.english: Oh, haven't you seen it? The house right next door is the carpenter <color=#F1DC2B>Peneb</color>'s place.
Array.indonesia: Oh, apa kamu belum melihatnya? Rumah tepat di sebelah ini adalah rumah tukang kayu <color=#F1DC2B>Peneb</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv01_01_001
Array.english: You've got quite a variety of herbs here.
Array.indonesia: Kamu punya banyak jenis tanaman obat di sini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv01_01_002
Array.english: Oh, these aren't just any herbs, they're ingredients for cooking.
Array.indonesia: Oh, ini bukan sekadar ramuan biasa, ini bahan-bahan untuk memasak.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv01_01_003
Array.english: I've also got some herbs that are good for restoring stamina.
Array.indonesia: Aku juga punya beberapa ramuan yang bagus untuk memulihkan stamina.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv01_01_004
Array.english: It's been harder to get them since the boulder blocked the path...
Array.indonesia: Semakin sulit mendapatkannya sejak batu besar itu menghalangi jalan...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv01_01_005
Array.english: Once I've got a bit more ready, I'll share some with you too, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Begitu aku sudah menyiapkan sedikit lagi, aku akan membagikannya padamu juga, Dave.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_InfoTalk01_001
Array.english: Did you make good use of the bamboo shoots I brought you?
Array.indonesia: Apakah kamu sudah memanfaatkan rebung yang kubawakan untukmu dengan baik?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_InfoTalk01_002
Array.english: Yes. Thanks to you, I was able to use some for herbs and eat the rest.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Berkat kamu, aku bisa menggunakan sebagian sebagai ramuan dan memakan sisanya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_InfoTalk01_003
Array.english: <color=#FF73C3>Bamboo Shoots</color> have a bit of an astringent taste, don't they?
Array.indonesia: <color=#FF73C3>Rebung</color> rasanya agak sepat, bukan?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_InfoTalk01_004
Array.english: I didn't find them very tasty.
Array.indonesia: Menurutku rasanya tidak terlalu enak.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_InfoTalk01_005
Array.english: Haha, they do if you eat them plain. But if you rinse them thoroughly and season them, only the sweetness remains.
Array.indonesia: Haha, memang begitu kalau dimakan begitu saja. Tapi kalau dicuci bersih dan dibumbui, yang tersisa hanyalah rasa manisnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_InfoTalk01_006
Array.english: Oh... I see.
Array.indonesia: Oh... begitu ya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_InfoTalk01_007
Array.english: A chef would probably know how to prepare them properly.\nI'd love to eat some nicely cooked <color=#FF73C3>Bamboo Shoots</color>.
Array.indonesia: Seorang koki pasti tahu cara mengolahnya dengan benar.\nAku pengen banget makan <color=#FF73C3>Tunas Bambu</color> yang dimasak dengan enak.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv03_01_001
Array.english: If you come across any herbs or spices while you're out and about, I'd be happy to buy them from you.
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu nemu rempah-rempah atau bumbu saat jalan-jalan, aku bakal senang beli dari kamu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv03_01_002
Array.english: I'll make it worth your while... hehe.
Array.indonesia: Aku bakal kasih imbalan yang sepadan... hehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_InfoTalk02_001
Array.english: Thanks to you, Dave, the lake's gotten clearer.\nThank you.
Array.indonesia: Berkat kamu, Dave, danau itu jadi lebih jernih.\nTerima kasih.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_InfoTalk02_002
Array.english: Not at all. I'm just glad I could help the village.
Array.indonesia: Sama-sama. Aku cuma senang bisa bantu desa ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_InfoTalk02_003
Array.english: When the lake got polluted, some fish disappeared.
Array.indonesia: Saat danau tercemar, beberapa ikan menghilang.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_InfoTalk02_004
Array.english: The Pirarucu was one of them.
Array.indonesia: Pirarucu adalah salah satunya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_InfoTalk02_005
Array.english: <color=#FF73C3>Pirarucu Scales</color> are very hard, so they're perfect for peeling vegetables and herbs.
Array.indonesia: <color=#FF73C3>Sisik Pirarucu</color> sangat keras, jadi sangat cocok untuk mengupas sayuran dan rempah-rempah.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_InfoTalk02_006
Array.english: But I'm relieved to hear the Pirarucu are back in the lake now, hehe.
Array.indonesia: Tapi aku lega mendengar Pirarucu sudah kembali ke danau sekarang, hehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_InfoTalk02_007
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Maybe I should give her a <color=#FF73C3>Pirarucu Scale</color> if I find one.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Mungkin aku harus memberinya <color=#FF73C3>Sisik Pirarucu</color> jika aku menemukannya.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_InfoTalk03_001
Array.english: Something I like...
Array.indonesia: Sesuatu yang kusukai...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_InfoTalk03_002
Array.english: I used to gather herbs from the forest, make drinks, \nand share them with the villagers.
Array.indonesia: Dulu aku sering mengumpulkan rempah-rempah dari hutan, membuat minuman, \ndan membagikannya kepada penduduk desa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_InfoTalk03_003
Array.english: But... after the earthquake not long ago blocked the path, I haven't been able to get to the forest....
Array.indonesia: Tapi... setelah gempa bumi belum lama ini menghalangi jalan, aku belum bisa pergi ke hutan....

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_InfoTalk03_004
Array.english: Still, there was such joy in looking after the villagers' health... It's a shame.
Array.indonesia: Meski begitu, ada kebahagiaan tersendiri dalam menjaga kesehatan warga desa... Sayang sekali.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_InfoTalk03_005
Array.english: I can only hope no one falls ill before we can gather herbs again.
Array.indonesia: Aku hanya bisa berharap tidak ada yang jatuh sakit sebelum kita bisa mengumpulkan ramuan lagi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv05_01_001
Array.english: You might not have noticed, Dave, but...
Array.indonesia: Mungkin kamu tidak menyadarinya, Dave, tapi...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv05_01_002
Array.english: After the earthquake and the pollution in the lake,\nthe village felt quite bleak.
Array.indonesia: Setelah gempa bumi dan pencemaran di danau,\ndesa ini terasa sangat suram.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv05_01_003
Array.english: And the journalists who came poking around only made people more wary of outsiders.
Array.indonesia: Dan para jurnalis yang datang mengorek-ngorek hanya membuat orang-orang semakin waspada terhadap orang luar.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv05_01_004
Array.english: But ever since you and the others arrived...
Array.indonesia: Namun, sejak kamu dan yang lainnya tiba...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv05_01_005
Array.english: You've truly helped the villagers... and shared such wonderful meals with us. Thanks to you, the village feels lively again.
Array.indonesia: Kamu benar-benar telah membantu penduduk desa... dan berbagi hidangan yang luar biasa dengan kami. Berkat kamu, desa ini terasa hidup kembali.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv05_01_006
Array.english: I only did what I thought I should. It's a bit embarrassing to hear that.
Array.indonesia: Aku hanya melakukan apa yang menurutku seharusnya kulakukan. Agak memalukan mendengarnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv05_01_007
Array.english: Huhu... As one of the villagers, I just wanted to thank you.
Array.indonesia: Huhu... Sebagai salah satu penduduk desa, aku hanya ingin mengucapkan terima kasih.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv01_Night01_001
Array.english: Hmm... where did I put those notes...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... di mana ya aku meletakkan catatan-catatan itu...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv02_01_001
Array.english: I see. Doing some research?
Array.indonesia: Oh, begitu. Sedang melakukan penelitian?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv02_01_002
Array.english: Yeah. This area's always had a unique ecosystem,\nso I've been wanting to come here.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Daerah ini selalu memiliki ekosistem yang unik,\njadi aku sudah lama ingin datang ke sini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv02_01_003
Array.english: But lately, with the sudden earthquakes and dinosaurs showing up...
Array.indonesia: Tapi belakangan ini, dengan gempa bumi yang tiba-tiba dan kemunculan dinosaurus...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv02_01_004
Array.english: There's been a surge in unusual phenomena...\nso there's even more to study now.
Array.indonesia: Fenomena-fenomena aneh semakin marak...\njadi sekarang ada lebih banyak hal yang bisa diteliti.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv02_01_005
Array.english: Dr. Bacon insists on keeping the research private, so we don't cause trouble for the residents if word gets out...
Array.indonesia: Dr. Bacon bersikeras agar penelitian ini dirahasiakan, agar kita tidak menimbulkan masalah bagi penduduk jika kabar ini tersebar...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv02_01_006
Array.english: <size=33>Hehe. If it were up to me, I'd be bragging to the whole world about this incredible research material!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hehe. Kalau terserah aku, aku pasti akan membanggakan bahan penelitian yang luar biasa ini ke seluruh dunia!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv02_02_001
Array.english: Muna, have you been working with Dr. Bacon for long?
Array.indonesia: Muna, sudah lama kamu bekerja sama dengan Dr. Bacon?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv02_02_002
Array.english: Oh, he's been looking out for me since I was an undergrad.
Array.indonesia: Oh, dia sudah membimbingku sejak aku masih mahasiswa sarjana.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv02_02_003
Array.english: Even when I got into trouble, he'd just brush it off,\nsaying I was just being curious...
Array.indonesia: Bahkan saat aku bermasalah, dia hanya mengabaikannya,\ndengan mengatakan aku hanya sedang penasaran...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv02_02_004
Array.english: <size=32>He even let me work here at the research institute!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Dia bahkan mengizinkanku bekerja di lembaga penelitian ini!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv02_02_005
Array.english: <size=33>I have to... work harder... and do more research... to repay him... hehehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku harus... bekerja lebih keras... dan melakukan lebih banyak penelitian... untuk membalas budinya... hehehe.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv02_03_001
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>Looking at the teeth and fins...\nI'm sure... it's a Basilosaurus...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>Melihat gigi dan siripnya...\nAku yakin... ini Basilosaurus...</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv02_03_002
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>But... it's way too small...\nCould it be... a baby...?</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>Tapi... ukurannya terlalu kecil...\nMungkinkah... ini bayi...?</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv02_03_003
Array.english: What are you writing so diligently?
Array.indonesia: Apa yang kamu tulis dengan begitu tekun?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv02_03_004
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, Dave! I'm... looking into the dinosaur that washed up on the beach...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, Dave! Aku... sedang meneliti dinosaurus yang terdampar di pantai...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv02_03_005
Array.english: <size=33>I think it's a species called <color=#F1DC2B>Basilosaurus</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Menurutku itu spesies yang disebut <color=#F1DC2B>Basilosaurus</color>!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv02_03_006
Array.english: <size=31>Well, technically it's not a dinosaur, more like an ancient whale... But let's just call it that for convenience.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Sebenarnya, secara teknis itu bukan dinosaurus, lebih mirip paus purba... Tapi mari kita sebut saja begitu untuk kemudahan.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv02_03_007
Array.english: <size=31>But its size does seem a bit small...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Tapi ukurannya memang tampak agak kecil...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv02_03_008
Array.english: <size=31>Well... it's not like there's any accurate ecological data on them anyway.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Yah... lagipula, tidak ada data ekologis yang akurat tentang makhluk itu.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_InfoTalk01_001
Array.english: Looking into old texts is useful, but...
Array.indonesia: Meneliti teks-teks kuno memang berguna, tapi...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_InfoTalk01_002
Array.english: when later generations write things down, inaccuracies can creep in.
Array.indonesia: ketika generasi selanjutnya menuliskannya, ketidakakuratan bisa saja menyusup.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_InfoTalk01_003
Array.english: That's why I tend to trust information from <color=#FF73C3>Stone Tablets</color>.
Array.indonesia: Itulah mengapa aku cenderung mempercayai informasi dari <color=#FF73C3>Lempengan Batu</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_InfoTalk01_004
Array.english: Is there something special about <color=#FF73C3>Stone Tablets</color>?
Array.indonesia: Apakah ada yang istimewa dari <color=#FF73C3>Lempengan Batu</color>?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_InfoTalk01_005
Array.english: Yes! For one, it's content written by people from that era...
Array.indonesia: Ya! Pertama, isinya ditulis oleh orang-orang dari zaman itu...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_InfoTalk01_006
Array.english: and through appraisal, we can get other info too!\nHehe.
Array.indonesia: dan melalui penilaian, kita juga bisa mendapatkan informasi lain!\nHehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_InfoTalk01_007
Array.english: There should be <color=#FF73C3>Stone Tablets</color> left by the ancient Sunang people at the lake too.
Array.indonesia: Seharusnya ada <color=#FF73C3>Lempengan Batu</color> yang ditinggalkan oleh suku Sunang kuno di danau itu juga.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_InfoTalk01_008
Array.english: <size=34>It's hard for me to go find them myself, though...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Tapi sulit bagiku untuk mencarinya sendiri...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_InfoTalk01_009
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm. If I find any <color=#FF73C3>Stone Tablets</color> at the lake,\nI should give them to her as a gift.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3> (Hmm. Kalau aku menemukan <color=#FF73C3>Lempengan Batu</color> di danau itu,\naku harus memberikannya kepadanya sebagai hadiah.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv04_01_001
Array.english: Muna, what were you researching before all this?
Array.indonesia: Muna, apa yang kamu teliti sebelum semua ini terjadi?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv04_01_002
Array.english: You mean... before I went missing, right?
Array.indonesia: Maksudmu... sebelum aku menghilang, kan?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv04_01_003
Array.english: <size=34>Yeah...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Iya...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv04_01_004
Array.english: Well... I've always been researching the Sea People civilization with Dr. Bacon.
Array.indonesia: Nah... Aku selalu meneliti peradaban Suku Laut bersama Dr. Bacon.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv04_01_005
Array.english: We've actually found traces of the Sea People in many places, not just here or the Blue Hole.
Array.indonesia: Kami sebenarnya telah menemukan jejak-jejak Suku Laut di banyak tempat, tidak hanya di sini atau di Blue Hole.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv04_01_006
Array.english: But what makes this region special is that it's believed to be where they originated.
Array.indonesia: Namun, yang membuat wilayah ini istimewa adalah keyakinan bahwa di sinilah asal-usul mereka.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv04_01_007
Array.english: Our institute believes the ancient Sea People here followed the ocean currents and settled in other regions.
Array.indonesia: Lembaga kami meyakini bahwa Suku Laut kuno di sini mengikuti arus laut dan menetap di wilayah lain.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv04_01_008
Array.english: It's such ancient history that it'd be hard to find traces, but...
Array.indonesia: Ini adalah sejarah yang sangat kuno sehingga sulit untuk menemukan jejaknya, tapi...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv04_01_009
Array.english: <size=34>Isn't it just so romantic~?<color=#ff61e3>♥</color> An undersea civilization deep beneath the ocean~<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Bukankah itu sangat romantis~?<color=#ff61e3>♥</color> Sebuah peradaban bawah laut yang terletak jauh di kedalaman samudra~<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv04_01_010
Array.english: Once this investigation is over, I want to go looking in other places too. Hehe.
Array.indonesia: Setelah penyelidikan ini selesai, aku ingin mencari di tempat-tempat lain juga. Hehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_InfoTalk02_001
Array.english: Muna, is there any food you especially like?
Array.indonesia: Muna, adakah makanan yang kamu sukai secara khusus?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_InfoTalk02_002
Array.english: <size=34>Oh! I like <color=#FF73C3>Electric Eel</color> dishes!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh! Aku suka hidangan <color=#FF73C3>Belut Listrik</color>!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_InfoTalk02_003
Array.english: Oh... is <color=#FF73C3>Electric Eel</color> actually tasty?
Array.indonesia: Oh... apakah <color=#FF73C3>Belut Listrik</color> itu benar-benar enak?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_InfoTalk02_004
Array.english: <size=34>Yes, of course!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ya, tentu saja!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_InfoTalk02_005
Array.english: Ah, actually, it's not like it's the absolute tastiest...
Array.indonesia: Ah, sebenarnya, rasanya nggak bisa dibilang paling enak...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_InfoTalk02_006
Array.english: <size=34>But you can only eat it here in the jungle!\nHehe!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Tapi kamu cuma bisa makan itu di sini, di hutan!\nHehe!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_InfoTalk02_007
Array.english: It's probably not really true... but I feel like I get a little tingle when I eat it, hehe.
Array.indonesia: Mungkin itu nggak benar-benar benar... tapi aku merasa ada sensasi kesemutan sedikit saat memakannya, hehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_InfoTalk02_008
Array.english: An <color=#FF73C3>Electric Eel</color> dish cooked by Bancho would be amazing.
Array.indonesia: Hidangan <color=#FF73C3>Ikan Lele Listrik</color> yang dimasak oleh Bancho pasti luar biasa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv05_01_001
Array.english: The unusual minerals found in this region...
Array.indonesia: Mineral-mineral langka yang ditemukan di wilayah ini...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv05_01_002
Array.english: Utara Crystals and Sunang Stones are things you hardly ever see anywhere else.
Array.indonesia: Kristal Utara dan Batu Sunang adalah benda-benda yang hampir tidak pernah kamu temui di tempat lain.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv05_01_003
Array.english: Why do you think those minerals only formed here?
Array.indonesia: Menurutmu, mengapa mineral-mineral itu hanya terbentuk di sini?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv05_01_004
Array.english: Hmm... I'm still looking into that, but...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Aku masih menelitinya, tapi...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv05_01_005
Array.english: I think it has to do with the Divine Trees growing in the sea beneath the lake.
Array.indonesia: Menurutku, ini ada hubungannya dengan Pohon-Pohon Suci yang tumbuh di laut di bawah danau.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv05_01_006
Array.english: The Blue Hole affected the surrounding terrain and ecosystem too, didn't it?
Array.indonesia: Blue Hole juga memengaruhi medan dan ekosistem di sekitarnya, bukan?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv05_01_007
Array.english: It seems like it's the same situation here.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya situasinya sama di sini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv05_01_008
Array.english: Maybe the energy from the Divine Trees solidified when it met the freshwater lake, and that's what created <color=#E6ABFF>Utara Crystals</color>...
Array.indonesia: Mungkin energi dari Pohon-pohon Ilahi mengeras saat bersentuhan dengan danau air tawar, dan itulah yang menciptakan <color=#E6ABFF>Kristal Utara</color>...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv05_01_009
Array.english: <size=33>That is the brilliant hypothesis of yours truly, the genius Muna!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Itulah hipotesis brilian dari diriku sendiri, si jenius Muna!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv05_01_010
Array.english: Now that you mention it, that does sound pretty convincing.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang setelah kamu sebutkan, kedengarannya memang cukup meyakinkan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_RelationEvent_01_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, Dave. What brings ya out this late?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, Dave. Ada apa sampai keluar se tarde ini?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_RelationEvent_01_002
Array.english: Ah, saw ya workin' on the vehicle. Figured you'd still be at it this late.
Array.indonesia: Ah, aku lihat kamu lagi mengutak-atik mobilnya. Kupikir kamu masih mengerjakannya sampai larut begini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_RelationEvent_01_003
Array.english: Hahaha, gotta get it done at night if I wanna drive it tomorrow, ya know.
Array.indonesia: Hahaha, harus diselesaikan malam ini kalau aku mau mengendarainya besok, kan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_RelationEvent_01_004
Array.english: Dave, do ya know how to drive?
Array.indonesia: Dave, apa kamu bisa mengemudi?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_RelationEvent_01_005
Array.english: Yeah. I don't drive much, but I've got a license.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Aku jarang mengemudi, tapi aku punya SIM.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_RelationEvent_01_006
Array.english: Hahaha, I see.\nSo, what kinda car d'ya like?
Array.indonesia: Hahaha, begitu ya.\nJadi, mobil jenis apa yang kamu suka?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_RelationEvent_01_option1
Array.english: A cool convertible car
Array.indonesia: Mobil convertible yang keren

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_RelationEvent_01_option2
Array.english: A big, sturdy SUV
Array.indonesia: SUV yang besar dan kokoh

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_RelationEvent_01_Correct_001
Array.english: <size=33>If I had to pick, I'd definitely go for a cool sports car!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kalau harus pilih, aku pasti pilih mobil sport yang keren!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_RelationEvent_01_Correct_002
Array.english: <size=34>Haha, now you're talkin'!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Haha, itu baru namanya bicara!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_RelationEvent_01_Correct_003
Array.english: That feelin' of cuttin' through the wind with the top down... you can only get that in a convertible.
Array.indonesia: Sensasi menerobos angin dengan atap terbuka... itu cuma bisa kamu rasakan di mobil convertible.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_RelationEvent_01_Correct_004
Array.english: But truth be told, it's kinda hard drivin' a convertible in a place this hot.
Array.indonesia: Tapi jujur aja, agak susah nyetir mobil convertible di tempat sepanas ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_RelationEvent_01_Correct_005
Array.english: Feels great for a moment... but your head gets so hot ya wanna close it right away.
Array.indonesia: Rasanya memang asyik sebentar... tapi kepalamu jadi kepanasan sampai pengen langsung menutup atapnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_RelationEvent_01_Correct_006
Array.english: <size=34>Come to think of it, my truck's the best choice after all!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kalau dipikir-pikir, trukku memang pilihan terbaik!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_RelationEvent_01_Incorrect_001
Array.english: Sports cars are a bit cramped... I think SUVs are more my style.
Array.indonesia: Mobil sport agak sempit... menurutku SUV lebih cocok buatku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_RelationEvent_01_Incorrect_002
Array.english: <size=33>Haha, when it comes to style and practicality, nothin' beats an SUV!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Haha, kalau soal gaya dan kepraktisan, nggak ada yang bisa ngalahin SUV!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_RelationEvent_01_Incorrect_003
Array.english: Try showin' off in a sports car, and ya can't even fit your groceries if ya buy a lot.
Array.indonesia: Coba pamer pakai mobil sport, kamu bahkan nggak bisa muat belanjaan kalau beli banyak.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_RelationEvent_01_Incorrect_004
Array.english: <size=34>Come to think of it, my truck's the best of all!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kalau dipikir-pikir, trukku memang yang terbaik!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Mission01Progress_001
Array.english: Hmm, <color=#F1DC2B>Calamansi</color>? That'd be the tree with them little round green fruits.
Array.indonesia: Hmm, <color=#F1DC2B>Calamansi</color>? Itu pohon yang buahnya kecil, bulat, dan hijau.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Mission01Progress_002
Array.english: <size=32>I think I saw one in front of the village chief's house...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kayaknya aku pernah lihat satu di depan rumah kepala desa...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv02_01_001
Array.english: That truck I gave ya a ride in...
Array.indonesia: Truk yang aku tumpangi itu...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv02_01_002
Array.english: <size=32>I've been drivin' it for over ten years now.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku sudah mengendarainya selama lebih dari sepuluh tahun.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv02_01_003
Array.english: And I bought it used... so it's actually a whole lot older than that.
Array.indonesia: Dan aku membelinya dalam kondisi bekas... jadi sebenarnya usianya jauh lebih tua dari itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv02_01_004
Array.english: Is that so...? It still seemed perfectly fine to me.
Array.indonesia: Begitu ya...? Menurutku masih terlihat bagus-bagus saja.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv02_01_005
Array.english: These days, a lot of people actually like cars with that retro vibe.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang ini, banyak orang yang justru suka mobil dengan nuansa retro.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv02_01_006
Array.english: <size=32>It might even be worth more, honestly.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Jujur saja, mungkin harganya malah lebih tinggi.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv02_01_007
Array.english: <size=33>Haha, really? Well, that's good to hear!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Haha, beneran? Wah, senang dengar itu!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv02_01_008
Array.english: Well... I'm pretty attached to it, so I've no intention of selling it, but...
Array.indonesia: Yah... aku cukup terikat dengan mobil itu, jadi aku nggak berniat menjualnya, tapi...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv02_01_009
Array.english: <size=33>Someday, I'd sure love to drive a brand-new, fancy car! Hahaha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Suatu hari nanti, aku pasti ingin sekali mengendarai mobil baru yang mewah! Hahaha!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv02_02_001
Array.english: You go back and forth to the city quite a bit, don't you? Which do you like better?
Array.indonesia: Kamu cukup sering bolak-balik ke kota, kan? Mana yang lebih kamu sukai?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv02_02_002
Array.english: Hmm... that's a tough one.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... itu pertanyaan yang sulit.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv02_02_003
Array.english: The city's got lots of interestin' stuff... but I always feel a bit of distance from the folks there.
Array.indonesia: Kota punya banyak hal menarik... tapi aku selalu merasa agak jauh dari orang-orang di sana.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv02_02_004
Array.english: But the village... it's got good folks, and there's somethin' real comforting about it.
Array.indonesia: Tapi desa... orang-orangnya baik, dan ada sesuatu yang benar-benar menenangkan di sana.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv02_02_005
Array.english: Well, if you brought stuff in from the city and shared it around the village, maybe that'd help!
Array.indonesia: Nah, kalau kamu bawa barang-barang dari kota dan membagikannya ke seluruh desa, mungkin itu bisa membantu!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv02_02_006
Array.english: Oh... Dave, you're sharper than you look!
Array.indonesia: Oh... Dave, kamu lebih cerdas dari yang terlihat!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv02_02_007
Array.english: <size=34>What's that supposed to mean...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Apa maksudnya itu...?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv02_03_001
Array.english: You're always in the village, Rimbo...\nWhen do you head into the city?
Array.indonesia: Kamu selalu di desa, Rimbo...\nKapan kamu pergi ke kota?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv02_03_002
Array.english: <size=34>Uh... well...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Uh... ya...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv02_03_003
Array.english: I usually go while you're out diving, or early in the morning.
Array.indonesia: Aku biasanya pergi saat kamu sedang menyelam, atau pagi-pagi sekali.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv02_03_004
Array.english: I see. Just got curious, that's all.
Array.indonesia: Oh, begitu. Aku cuma penasaran aja, itu saja.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv02_03_005
Array.english: Hehe, dig too deep and... there are some things I'd rather not get into.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, kalau ditanya terlalu dalam... ada beberapa hal yang lebih baik nggak aku bahas.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk01_001
Array.english: You seem to like charms, Rimbo.
Array.indonesia: Kamu sepertinya suka jimat, Rimbo.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk01_002
Array.english: Hehe, well... I do drive around a lot...\nand sometimes I gotta go through some dangerous places.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, ya... aku memang sering berkendara ke sana-sini...\ndan kadang-kadang harus melewati tempat-tempat berbahaya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk01_003
Array.english: <size=34>It's better to have a little peace of mind, ya know? Hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Lebih baik punya sedikit ketenangan pikiran, kan? Hehe.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk01_004
Array.english: Are there other things besides <color=#FF73C3>Red Feathers</color> that bring good luck?
Array.indonesia: Ada hal lain selain <color=#FF73C3>Red Feathers</color> yang membawa keberuntungan?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk01_005
Array.english: Hmm... they say havin' somethin' from a strong creature can ward off bad luck.
Array.indonesia: Hmm.. . Katanya, memiliki sesuatu dari makhluk yang kuat bisa mengusir nasib buruk.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk01_006
Array.english: <size=34>Somethin' like a <color=#FF73C3>Black Caiman Tooth</color> would sure give me some peace of mind!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Sesuatu seperti <color=#FF73C3>Gigi Buaya Hitam</color> pasti bakal bikin aku tenang!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk01_007
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(I should give him a <color=#FF73C3>Black Caiman Tooth</color> if I find one.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Aku harus kasih dia <color=#FF73C3>Gigi Buaya Hitam</color> kalau aku nemu.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv04_01_001
Array.english: The road outta the village ain't fully paved,\nso long drives ain't easy.
Array.indonesia: Jalan keluar desa belum sepenuhnya beraspal,\njadi perjalanan jauh tidaklah mudah.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv04_01_002
Array.english: Yeah, I noticed that on the way in.
Array.indonesia: Ya, aku menyadarinya saat dalam perjalanan ke sini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv04_01_003
Array.english: By evening, I'm usually pretty worn out...
Array.indonesia: Menjelang malam, aku biasanya sudah cukup lelah...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv04_01_004
Array.english: But once I have some of Bancho's cooking, all that fatigue just melts away, haha.
Array.indonesia: Tapi begitu aku mencicipi masakan Bancho, semua kelelahan itu langsung lenyap, haha.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv04_01_005
Array.english: Good food really does bring your energy back and lift your spirits.
Array.indonesia: Makanan enak memang benar-benar mengembalikan energi dan mengangkat semangat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv04_01_006
Array.english: Talkin' about it is makin' me hungry again.
Array.indonesia: Ngomongin soal itu bikin aku lapar lagi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk04_001
Array.english: What I like, huh...
Array.indonesia: Apa yang aku suka, ya...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk04_002
Array.english: <size=34>I reckon I'm pretty attached to this here truck.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Sepertinya aku cukup terikat dengan truk ini.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk04_003
Array.english:
It's a PONY pickup truck...
Made in Korea.
Array.indonesia:
Ini truk pikap PONY...
Buatan Korea.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk04_004
Array.english: She's been a real big help haulin' stuff through these rough jungle roads, hahaha!
Array.indonesia: Dia sangat membantu mengangkut barang-barang melalui jalan-jalan hutan yang berat ini, hahaha!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk04_005
Array.english:
I see.
The red color really looks great!
Array.indonesia:
Begitu ya.
Warna merahnya benar-benar keren!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk04_006
Array.english:
<size=34>Heh, right?
It's my favorite color!</size>
Array.indonesia:
<size=34>Heh, kan?
Itu warna favoritku!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk02_001
Array.english: Rimbo, is there any particular food you like?
Array.indonesia: Rimbo, adakah makanan tertentu yang kamu suka?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk02_002
Array.english: Ah, remember I told ya my lucky color's red?
Array.indonesia: Ah, ingat kan aku pernah bilang kalau warna keberuntunganku adalah merah?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk02_003
Array.english: Yeah. You said you keep a red feather in your car as a charm.
Array.indonesia: Iya. Kamu bilang kamu menyimpan bulu merah di mobilmu sebagai jimat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk02_004
Array.english: Haha! That's right!\nI like food with a bit of red in it too.
Array.indonesia: Haha! Benar juga!\nAku juga suka makanan yang ada sedikit warna merah di dalamnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk02_005
Array.english: There used to be a fish called <color=#FF73C3>Sockeye Salmon</color> in this lake...
Array.indonesia: Dulu ada ikan bernama <color=#FF73C3>Sockeye Salmon</color> di danau ini...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk02_006
Array.english: Its color was a beautiful deep red, and the meat was so tender... It was unbelievably good!
Array.indonesia: Warnanya merah tua yang indah, dan dagingnya sangat empuk... Rasanya luar biasa enak!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk02_007
Array.english:
But... since the lake got polluted like this,
I ain't seen a single one.
Array.indonesia:
Tapi... sejak danau ini tercemar seperti ini,
saya belum pernah melihat seekor pun.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk02_008
Array.english: I guess <color=#FF73C3>Sockeye Salmon</color> are sensitive to water quality... They might've left the lake.
Array.indonesia: Kurasa <color=#FF73C3>Sockeye Salmon</color> sensitif terhadap kualitas air... Mungkin mereka sudah meninggalkan danau ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk02_009
Array.english: A real shame, ain't it?\nI'd sure love to have one again.
Array.indonesia: Sayang sekali, bukan?\nAku benar-benar ingin mencicipinya lagi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk03_001
Array.english: Come to think of it... the lake's been getting cleaner lately.
Array.indonesia: Kalau dipikir-pikir... danau ini mulai semakin bersih belakangan ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk03_002
Array.english: Yeah. I was able to purify it with Martin's help.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Aku berhasil memurnikannya berkat bantuan Martin.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk03_003
Array.english: Hahaha, if the water stays this clean, the <color=#FF73C3>Sockeye Salmon</color> might come back to the lake!
Array.indonesia: Hahaha, kalau airnya tetap sebersih ini, <color=#FF73C3>Ikan Salmon Sockeye</color> mungkin bakal balik ke danau!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk03_004
Array.english: Been a while since I had some, hahaha.
Array.indonesia: Udah lama banget aku nggak makan itu, hahaha.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk03_005
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Rimbo likes <color=#FF73C3>Sockeye Salmon</color>... I should check if there are any in the lake.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Rimbo suka <color=#FF73C3>Ikan Salmon Sockeye</color>... Aku harus cek apakah ada di danau.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv05_01_001
Array.english: It's been quite a while since ya came to the village, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Sudah cukup lama sejak kamu datang ke desa ini, Dave.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv05_01_002
Array.english: Yeah, it has. Thought I might end up in the wrong place, but you came out to meet me, so that was a relief.
Array.indonesia: Ya, memang. Aku sempat khawatir bakal salah tempat, tapi kamu keluar menemuiku, jadi aku lega.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv05_01_003
Array.english: Haha, Muna told me what Dr. Bacon looked like,\nso I spotted him right away.
Array.indonesia: Haha, Muna sudah memberitahuku seperti apa rupa Dr. Bacon,\njadi aku langsung mengenalinya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv05_01_004
Array.english: What'd she say?
Array.indonesia: Apa yang dia katakan?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv05_01_005
Array.english: Said there'd be a skinny, middle-aged fella with a face all red like he'd been drinkin'...
Array.indonesia: Katanya akan ada pria kurus paruh baya dengan wajah memerah seolah-olah baru saja minum...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv05_01_006
Array.english: <size=33>...That's surprisingly accurate.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...That ternyata cukup akurat.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv05_01_007
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! Glad it turned out to be such a fun bunch!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Senang ternyata mereka sekelompok orang yang seru!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_GoToBeach_Night_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm? Ya wanna head to the beach this late at night?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm? Kamu mau ke pantai jam segini malam?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_GoToBeach_Night_002
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm... the road's pretty rough, and it ain't the best at night.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm... jalannya lumayan bergelombang, dan nggak aman kalau malam.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_GoToBeach_Night_003
Array.english: <size=32>Come back and ask me again in the daytime, alright!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kembalilah dan tanyakan lagi padaku di siang hari, oke!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv01_01_001
Array.english: The <color=#F1DC2B>Insects</color> here tend to grow larger than in other places.
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Serangga</color> di sini cenderung tumbuh lebih besar daripada di tempat lain.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv01_01_002
Array.english: So outsiders are sometimes surprised when they see them.
Array.indonesia: Jadi, orang luar terkadang terkejut saat melihatnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv01_01_003
Array.english: Aren't they cuter when they're bigger? Hehe.
Array.indonesia: Bukankah mereka lebih lucu kalau ukurannya lebih besar? Hehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv01_02_001
Array.english: Have you ever seen a <color=#F1DC2B>Diving Beetle</color> near water?
Array.indonesia: Pernahkah kamu melihat <color=#F1DC2B>Kumbang Penyelam</color> di dekat air?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv01_02_002
Array.english: They may look calm, but they're actually incredibly fast hunters. They even snatch and eat small fish.
Array.indonesia: Mereka mungkin terlihat tenang, tapi sebenarnya mereka adalah pemburu yang sangat cepat. Mereka bahkan bisa menangkap dan memakan ikan kecil.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv01_02_003
Array.english: If you're planning to catch one... I'd recommend approaching slowly and carefully.
Array.indonesia: Jika kamu berencana menangkap salah satunya... Aku sarankan untuk mendekatinya secara perlahan dan hati-hati.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv01_03_001
Array.english: Does the food in this village suit your palate?
Array.indonesia: Apakah makanan di desa ini sesuai dengan seleramu?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv01_03_002
Array.english: Hmm... actually, it doesn't really suit me,\nso I've been eating what Bancho makes.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... sebenarnya, itu tidak terlalu cocok untukku,\njadi aku makan apa yang dibuat Bancho.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv01_03_003
Array.english: Hehe, the food in our village isn't really something to boast about.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, makanan di desa kita memang tidak terlalu istimewa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv01_03_004
Array.english: Since the ingredients are so fresh, I feel like we've been a bit neglectful when it comes to cooking?
Array.indonesia: Karena bahan-bahannya sangat segar, aku merasa kita agak lalai dalam hal memasak?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv01_03_005
Array.english: On top of that... since the lake got polluted,\nthe taste of the fish has gone down too...
Array.indonesia: Selain itu... sejak danau tercemar,\nrasa ikannya pun jadi kurang enak...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv01_03_006
Array.english: I'm still a bit cautious, but... I'd love to try the food your friend makes.
Array.indonesia: Aku masih agak ragu, tapi... aku ingin sekali mencoba masakan temanmu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv01_03_007
Array.english:
Bancho's cooking is the best! If you're interested,
feel free to visit the restaurant anytime.
Array.indonesia:
Masakan Bancho adalah yang terbaik! Kalau kamu tertarik,
silakan mampir ke restorannya kapan saja.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv01_04_001
Array.english: The food at the shop was really delicious.\nI didn't leave a single bite.
Array.indonesia: Makanan di toko itu benar-benar lezat.\nAku tidak menyisakan sedikit pun.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv01_04_002
Array.english: Knowing Bancho's cooking holds up even out here \nmakes me proud.
Array.indonesia: Mengetahui bahwa masakan Bancho tetap enak bahkan di sini \nmembuatku bangga.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv01_04_003
Array.english: The local ingredients here are so fresh and full of flavor.
Array.indonesia: Bahan-bahan lokal di sini sangat segar dan kaya rasa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv01_04_004
Array.english: The chef brings out the texture of the ingredients so beautifully. It's just wonderful.
Array.indonesia: Koki di sini berhasil menonjolkan tekstur bahan-bahannya dengan sangat indah. Sungguh luar biasa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv01_04_005
Array.english: I'll keep dropping by, so I'm counting on you. Hehe.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan terus mampir, jadi aku mengandalkanmu. Hehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_InfoTalk01_001
Array.english: To be honest, I prefer <color=#FF73C3>Meat</color> over fish. Hehe...
Array.indonesia: Sejujurnya, aku lebih suka <color=#FF73C3>Daging</color> daripada ikan. Hehe...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_InfoTalk01_002
Array.english: <color=#FF73C3>Meat</color> is always the answer.
Array.indonesia: <color=#FF73C3>Daging</color> selalu jadi jawabannya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_InfoTalk01_003
Array.english: Oh, so you like it too, Dave?
Array.indonesia: Oh, jadi kamu juga suka, Dave?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_InfoTalk01_004
Array.english: I used to catch a lot of wild animals in the forest... but I haven't been able to eat much since the path was blocked.
Array.indonesia: Dulu aku sering menangkap banyak binatang liar di hutan... tapi aku jadi jarang bisa makan sejak jalan setapaknya terhalang.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_InfoTalk01_005
Array.english: <size=33>I really miss it sometimes, hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kadang-kadang aku benar-benar merindukannya, hehe.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv03_01_001
Array.english: There aren't many types of <color=#F1DC2B>Big-Eyed Lizards</color> in the village, but...
Array.indonesia: Tidak banyak jenis <color=#F1DC2B>Kadal Bermata Besar</color> di desa ini, tapi...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv03_01_002
Array.english: In new areas, you'll be able to find ones with different colors.
Array.indonesia: Di daerah baru, kamu bisa menemukan yang warnanya berbeda-beda.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv03_01_003
Array.english: It'd be a shame to see one and miss it...\nso always have lizard bait ready.
Array.indonesia: Sayang sekali kalau melihatnya tapi melewatkannya...\njadi selalu siapkan umpan kadal.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv03_02_001
Array.english: With the flower garden right next to my house, I can enjoy the scent of flowers anytime.
Array.indonesia: Dengan taman bunga tepat di sebelah rumahku, aku bisa menikmati aroma bunga kapan saja.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv03_02_002
Array.english: When you fall asleep surrounded by a lovely fragrance, you won't have any bad dreams, you know.
Array.indonesia: Saat kamu tertidur dikelilingi aroma yang harum, kamu tidak akan mengalami mimpi buruk, lho.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_InfoTalk02_001
Array.english: Come to think of it, what kind of food did you say you like, Lipah?
Array.indonesia: Kalau dipikir-pikir, makanan apa sih yang kamu bilang kamu suka, Lipah?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_InfoTalk02_002
Array.english: Oh, I like <color=#FF73C3>Meat</color> dishes.
Array.indonesia: Oh, aku suka hidangan <color=#FF73C3>daging</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_InfoTalk02_003
Array.english: I like fish too, but... maybe because I ate so much of it growing up, <color=#FF73C3>Meat</color> dishes just sound more appealing to me.
Array.indonesia: Aku juga suka ikan, tapi... mungkin karena aku sering makan ikan saat kecil, hidangan <color=#FF73C3>daging</color> terdengar lebih menggugah selera bagiku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_InfoTalk02_004
Array.english: Oh, now that we can go to Setah Forest, I'll be able to get some meat.
Array.indonesia: Oh, sekarang kita bisa pergi ke Hutan Setah, jadi aku bisa mendapatkan daging.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_InfoTalk02_005
Array.english: <size=34>Once I get some <color=#FF73C3>Meat</color>, I'll serve you a meal at the restaurant!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Begitu aku dapat <color=#FF73C3>Daging</color>, aku akan menyajikan hidangan untukmu di restoran!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_InfoTalk02_006
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Though Bancho will be the one cooking it...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Meskipun Bancho yang akan memasaknya...)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_InfoTalk02_007
Array.english: <size=34>I'm looking forward to it! I'll order it when it shows up on the menu!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku sudah tidak sabar menantikannya! Aku akan memesannya begitu muncul di menu!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv05_01_001
Array.english: Big-Eyed Lizards are greedy eaters with flashy colors, so they often get eaten by wild animals.
Array.indonesia: Kadal Bermata Besar adalah pemakan rakus dengan warna-warna mencolok, jadi mereka sering dimangsa oleh hewan liar.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv05_01_002
Array.english: They're very wary, so normally they run away the moment you get close, but...
Array.indonesia: Mereka sangat waspada, jadi biasanya mereka langsung lari begitu kamu mendekat, tapi...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv05_01_003
Array.english: When they're eating, they let their guard down completely.
Array.indonesia: Saat sedang makan, mereka benar-benar menurunkan kewaspadaan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv05_01_004
Array.english: Oh, but some of the rarer ones among them will dash off if you get close, even while they're eating.
Array.indonesia: Oh, tapi beberapa di antara mereka yang lebih langka akan langsung melarikan diri jika kamu mendekat, bahkan saat mereka sedang makan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv05_01_005
Array.english: In that case... \nit'd be best to sneak up on them ever so quietly.
Array.indonesia: Kalau begitu... \nsebaiknya kamu mendekati mereka dengan sangat diam-diam.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv01_01_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm? What is it now?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm? Ada apa lagi?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv01_01_002
Array.english: <size=32>Don't bother me. If you're bored, go chase the birds off that scarecrow over there.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Jangan ganggu aku. Kalau kamu bosan, pergi saja usir burung-burung dari orang-orangan sawah di sana.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv01_02_001
Array.english: <size=32>What are you doing snooping around the farm?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Apa yang kamu lakukan mengintip-intip di sekitar ladang?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv01_02_002
Array.english: I've already given you coconuts and papayas. What,\nyou need something else?
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah memberimu kelapa dan pepaya. Apa,\nkamu butuh yang lain?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv01_02_003
Array.english: Tch. Outsiders... never satisfied, are they.
Array.indonesia: Tch. Orang luar... memang tidak pernah puas, ya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk01_001
Array.english: Phew... when I'm working, I start craving something cold...
Array.indonesia: Wah... saat aku sedang bekerja, aku mulai ngidam sesuatu yang dingin...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk01_002
Array.english: But it's so hot here, it goes lukewarm in no time.
Array.indonesia: Tapi di sini sangat panas, jadi minuman itu langsung jadi suam-suam kuku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk01_003
Array.english: Come to think of it, I heard there's some kind of cup from the city that keeps drinks cold...
Array.indonesia: Kalau dipikir-pikir, aku dengar ada semacam gelas dari kota yang bisa menjaga minuman tetap dingin...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk01_004
Array.english: <size=33>Sounds pretty useful.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kedengarannya cukup berguna.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk01_005
Array.english: Ah... are you talking about a <color=#FF73C3>Tumbler</color>?
Array.indonesia: Ah... apa kamu sedang membicarakan <color=#FF73C3>Tumbler</color>?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk01_006
Array.english: <size=32>How would I remember all those names?! Now that you mention it, yeah, that sounds about right!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Bagaimana mungkin aku bisa mengingat semua nama itu?! Sekarang setelah kamu menyebutkannya, ya, sepertinya memang begitu!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk01_007
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Maybe I should get him a <color=#FF73C3>Tumbler</color> as a gift if I find one?)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Mungkin aku harus membelikannya <color=#FF73C3>Tumbler</color> sebagai hadiah kalau aku menemukannya?)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv03_01_001
Array.english: Hmm... not bad. I'll give you that.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... lumayan. Aku setuju dengan itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv03_01_002
Array.english: <size=32>But it's the ingredients that matter most, right?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tapi yang paling penting itu bahan-bahannya, kan?!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv03_01_003
Array.english: You oughta be grateful. The ingredients here are top-notch.
Array.indonesia: Kamu harusnya bersyukur. Bahan-bahannya di sini berkualitas tinggi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv03_01_004
Array.english: ...Not that I'm sayin' the chef isn't skilled.
Array.indonesia: ...Bukan berarti aku bilang koki di sini nggak terampil.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv03_02_001
Array.english: The folks in the village have been talkin' about your shop, y'know...
Array.indonesia: Orang-orang di desa udah pada ngomongin toko kamu, lho...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv03_02_002
Array.english: <size=34>Don't go gettin' too full of yourself!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Jangan sampai jadi sombong, ya!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv03_02_003
Array.english: Anything tastes better when you eat it with the coconuts I grow.
Array.indonesia: Apa pun rasanya lebih enak kalau dimakan bareng kelapa yang aku tanam.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv03_02_004
Array.english: <size=32>You oughta be thankin' me, that's what!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kamu seharusnya berterima kasih padaku, itu dia!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk02_001
Array.english: Jepun, are there any ingredients you particularly like?
Array.indonesia: Jepun, adakah bahan makanan yang kamu suka banget?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk02_002
Array.english: Hmm... I prefer cooking vegetable dishes myself.\nThey just taste better that way...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Aku lebih suka memasak hidangan sayuran sendiri.\nRasanya memang lebih enak kalau begitu...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk02_003
Array.english: And fish dishes? Picking out all the bones is such a hassle.
Array.indonesia: Bagaimana dengan hidangan ikan? Memisahkan semua tulangnya itu merepotkan sekali.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk02_004
Array.english: Oh, right! There are a few root vegetables that only grow in the forest...
Array.indonesia: Oh, benar! Ada beberapa umbi-umbian yang hanya tumbuh di hutan...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk02_005
Array.english: Dishes made with those are really good.
Array.indonesia: Hidangan yang dibuat dari umbi-umbian itu sangat enak.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk02_006
Array.english: Things like <color=#FF73C3>Taro</color> or <color=#FF73C3>Cassava</color> are great even just roasted.
Array.indonesia: Bahan-bahan seperti <color=#FF73C3>Taro</color> atau <color=#FF73C3>Singkong</color> sangat enak bahkan hanya dengan dipanggang saja.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk02_007
Array.english: Come to think of it, I haven't had any since the forest path got blocked.
Array.indonesia: Kalau dipikir-pikir, aku belum pernah memakannya lagi sejak jalan setapak di hutan itu terhalang.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk02_008
Array.english: <size=33>Now you had to go and bring that up and make me hungry!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kamu malah mengungkit hal itu dan membuatku lapar!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk02_009
Array.english: <size=34>Oh... sorry...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh... maaf...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk02_010
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Looks like Jepun likes dishes made with root vegetables like <color=#FF73C3>Taro</color> and <color=#FF73C3>Cassava</color>. I should write that down.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Sepertinya Jepun suka hidangan yang terbuat dari umbi-umbian seperti <color=#FF73C3>Taro</color> dan <color=#FF73C3>Cassava</color>. Aku harus mencatatnya.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk03_001
Array.english: Hmm... I wouldn't say I'm fond of it...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Aku nggak bisa bilang aku suka...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk03_002
Array.english: But I heard there's a farming tool from Korea called a <color=#FF73C3>Homi</color>.
Array.indonesia: Tapi aku dengar ada alat pertanian dari Korea yang disebut <color=#FF73C3>Homi</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk03_003
Array.english: They say it pulls weeds out clean, roots and all… real handy thing.
Array.indonesia: Katanya alat itu bisa mencabut gulma sampai bersih, termasuk akarnya… benar-benar berguna.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk03_004
Array.english: Pulling 'em out by hand or with a hoe every time gives me a real backache.
Array.indonesia: Mencabutnya dengan tangan atau cangkul setiap kali bikin punggungku sakit banget.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk03_005
Array.english:
<color=#E3E3E3>(I bet Jepun would love it if I got him a <color=#FF73C3>Homi</color>.
I should write that down.)</color>
Array.indonesia:
<color=#E3E3E3>(Pasti Jepun bakal senang banget kalau aku beliin dia <color=#FF73C3>Homi</color>.
Aku harus catat itu.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv05_01_001
Array.english: <size=32>Seeing the crops growing so well in the garden... makes me proud!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Melihat tanaman tumbuh subur di kebun... bikin aku bangga!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv05_01_002
Array.english: <size=33>You've been a big help, I'll give you that.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kamu sudah sangat membantu, aku akui itu.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv05_01_003
Array.english: Hehe... hearing you say that makes me feel pretty good.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... mendengar kamu mengatakan itu membuatku merasa senang.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv05_01_004
Array.english: Hey, don't go getting a big head now! The faster they grow, the more often you'll have to plant!
Array.indonesia: Hei, jangan sampai sombong dulu! Semakin cepat mereka tumbuh, semakin sering kamu harus menanam!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv05_01_005
Array.english: Don't go pretending you're too busy...\nCome by and take care of the crops regularly!
Array.indonesia: Jangan pura-pura sibuk...\nMampir dan rawat tanaman-tanaman itu secara rutin!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv05_01_006
Array.english: Yes, got it.\nI'll try planting new seeds every now and then.
Array.indonesia: Ya, paham.\nAku akan coba menanam benih baru sesekali.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv05_02_001
Array.english: Like I told ya, the crops in this here garden grow at a ridiculous speed.
Array.indonesia: Seperti yang sudah kubilang, tanaman di kebun ini tumbuh dengan kecepatan yang gila-gilaan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv05_02_002
Array.english: But if ya wanna see 'em grow even faster, try usin' some <color=#F1DC2B>Rapid Growth Fertilizer</color>.
Array.indonesia: Tapi kalau kamu mau melihatnya tumbuh lebih cepat lagi, coba gunakan <color=#F1DC2B>Pupuk Pertumbuhan Cepat</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv05_02_003
Array.english: And if ya wanna see big crops or unusual ones, there's fertilizer for that too.
Array.indonesia: Dan kalau kamu mau melihat tanaman yang besar atau yang tidak biasa, ada pupuk untuk itu juga.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv05_02_004
Array.english: Gimme yer leftover stuff and I'll turn it into fertilizer, so bring it by now and then to clear out yer bag!
Array.indonesia: Berikan sisa-sisa barangmu padaku dan aku akan mengubahnya menjadi pupuk, jadi bawalah sesekali untuk mengosongkan tasmu!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv01_Night01_001
Array.english: Oh my, what brings you here this late?
Array.indonesia: Astaga, apa yang membawamu ke sini selarut ini?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv01_Night01_002
Array.english: I'm just checking if there's anything left to take care of.
Array.indonesia: Aku cuma mau cek apakah ada yang perlu diselesaikan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv01_Night01_003
Array.english: You must be tired from running the shop...\nYou should get some rest.
Array.indonesia: Kamu pasti lelah mengurus toko...\nSebaiknya kamu istirahat dulu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv01_Night01_004
Array.english: Thanks for looking out for me, Uzme.
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih sudah memperhatikan aku, Uzme.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv02_01_001
Array.english: It makes me a little sad to think you'll all be heading back home someday.
Array.indonesia: Aku sedikit sedih memikirkan bahwa suatu hari nanti kalian semua akan pulang ke rumah.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv02_01_002
Array.english: <size=32>I know... but we still have our old restaurant to look after…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku tahu... tapi kami masih harus mengurus restoran lama kami…</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv02_01_003
Array.english: <size=33>Still, we'll do our best while we're here!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Meski begitu, kami akan berusaha sebaik mungkin selama masih di sini!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv02_01_004
Array.english: <size=32>That means a lot.\nBancho's cooking really is amazing...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Itu sangat berarti bagiku.\nMasakan Bancho memang luar biasa...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv02_01_005
Array.english: <size=32>Haha, right? Bancho's cooking really is the best in the world!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha, kan? Masakan Bancho memang yang terbaik di dunia!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv02_02_001
Array.english: I like collecting small <color=#F1DC2B>Seashells</color> and stringing them together.
Array.indonesia: Aku suka mengumpulkan <color=#F1DC2B>kerang</color> kecil dan merangkainya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv02_02_002
Array.english: <size=32>Someday...\nI'd like to give them to someone I care about.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Suatu hari nanti...\nAku ingin memberikannya kepada seseorang yang kusayangi.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv02_03_001
Array.english: Are you running the shop again today?
Array.indonesia: Apa kamu lagi jaga toko hari ini?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv02_03_002
Array.english: Yeah, of course.\nBancho really hates closing the shop.
Array.indonesia: Ya, tentu saja.\nBancho benar-benar benci menutup toko.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv02_03_003
Array.english: He'd never close unless it's something really important.
Array.indonesia: Dia tidak akan pernah menutupnya kecuali ada hal yang sangat penting.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv02_03_004
Array.english: When we caught that giant squid, he shut the place down and invited everyone over for a feast.
Array.indonesia: Saat kita menangkap cumi-cumi raksasa itu, dia menutup toko dan mengundang semua orang untuk pesta makan-makan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv02_03_005
Array.english: So he has a warm side too...
Array.indonesia: Jadi, dia juga punya sisi yang hangat...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv02_03_006
Array.english: I never would've guessed. I always see him with that stern look, completely focused on cooking.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak pernah menyangka. Aku selalu melihatnya dengan ekspresi tegas, sepenuhnya fokus pada memasak.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv02_03_007
Array.english: Cooking is his whole life.
Array.indonesia: Memasak adalah seluruh hidupnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv02_03_008
Array.english: I heard that when he was younger, he went to Japan on his own to learn the cuisine.
Array.indonesia: Aku dengar waktu dia masih muda, dia pergi ke Jepang sendirian buat belajar masakan di sana.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv02_03_009
Array.english:
That's brave... With that kind of dedication,
it's no wonder he's as skilled as he is now.
Array.indonesia:
Itu berani banget... Dengan dedikasi seperti itu,
tidak heran dia jadi sehandal sekarang.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_InfoTalk01_001
Array.english: Sometimes, beautiful <color=#FF73C3>Coral</color> washes up on this sandy beach.
Array.indonesia: Kadang-kadang, <color=#FF73C3>karang</color> yang indah terdampar di pantai berpasir ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_InfoTalk01_002
Array.english: <size=33>But there shouldn't be coral in a lake, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tapi seharusnya tidak ada karang di danau, kan?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_InfoTalk01_003
Array.english: That's what I thought too, but...
Array.indonesia: Aku juga berpikir begitu, tapi...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_InfoTalk01_004
Array.english: Old writings say there's an ocean beneath the lake...\nMaybe it drifted up from there?
Array.indonesia: Tulisan-tulisan kuno menyebutkan ada lautan di bawah danau itu...\nMungkin karang itu hanyut dari sana?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_InfoTalk01_005
Array.english: If there's a place with such beautiful <color=#FF73C3>Coral</color>,\nI'd love to visit it someday.
Array.indonesia: Kalau ada tempat dengan <color=#FF73C3>karang</color> seindah itu,\naku ingin sekali mengunjunginya suatu hari nanti.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_InfoTalk01_006
Array.english: Oh, but I suppose you've already seen plenty in the ocean, Dave?
Array.indonesia: Oh, tapi kurasa kamu sudah sering melihatnya di laut, Dave?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_InfoTalk01_007
Array.english:
Haha, it's even more beautiful in the ocean.
I hope you get to see it for yourself someday, Uzme.
Array.indonesia:
Haha, di laut bahkan lebih indah lagi.
Semoga suatu hari nanti kamu bisa melihatnya sendiri, Uzme.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_InfoTalk01_008
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(So Uzme likes <color=#FF73C3>Coral</color>.\nI should make a note of that.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Jadi Uzme suka <color=#FF73C3>karang</color>.\nAku harus mencatat itu.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv04_01_001
Array.english: You really train hard, Uzme.
Array.indonesia: Kamu benar-benar berlatih keras, Uzme.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv04_01_002
Array.english: Yeah... My dad's not in the best health.\nAnd he's getting older...
Array.indonesia: Ya... Ayahku sedang tidak dalam kondisi kesehatan yang baik.\nDan dia semakin tua...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv04_01_003
Array.english: So I have to be the one to protect him.
Array.indonesia: Jadi, aku yang harus melindunginya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv04_01_004
Array.english: Didn't you say a crocodile bit his leg?
Array.indonesia: Bukankah kamu pernah bilang ada buaya yang menggigit kakinya?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv04_01_005
Array.english: Yeah... I was just a kid back then...\nIf my dad hadn't stepped in, I wouldn't be here today.
Array.indonesia: Ya... Saat itu aku masih kecil...\nKalau ayahku tidak turun tangan, aku tidak akan ada di sini hari ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv04_01_006
Array.english: That's why I train, to protect him.
Array.indonesia: Itulah mengapa aku berlatih, untuk melindunginya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv04_01_007
Array.english: The chief must be very proud to have a daughter like you, Uzme.
Array.indonesia: Kepala suku pasti sangat bangga memiliki putri sepertimu, Uzme.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv04_01_008
Array.english: Oh... it's nothing special. It's just what any daughter would do...
Array.indonesia: Oh... ini bukan apa-apa. Itu cuma hal yang biasa dilakukan putri mana pun...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_InfoTalk02_001
Array.english: I get really hungry after working out, but...
Array.indonesia: Aku jadi sangat lapar setelah berolahraga, tapi...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_InfoTalk02_002
Array.english: greasy food slows down muscle recovery, so I try to avoid it.
Array.indonesia: Makanan berlemak memperlambat pemulihan otot, jadi aku berusaha menghindarinya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_InfoTalk02_003
Array.english: You're so disciplined...\nI eat a ton after diving...!
Array.indonesia: Kamu sangat disiplin...\nAku makan banyak sekali setelah menyelam...!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_InfoTalk02_004
Array.english: Hehe, that's probably the more natural reaction.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, itu mungkin reaksi yang lebih wajar.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_InfoTalk02_005
Array.english: Still, don't you need to eat enough?
Array.indonesia: Tapi, bukankah kamu perlu makan cukup?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_InfoTalk02_006
Array.english: Of course. As long as I eat high-protein meals,\nit's not a problem.
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja. Selama aku makan makanan tinggi protein,\nitu bukan masalah.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_InfoTalk02_007
Array.english: I heard that among fish, the <color=#FF73C3>Giant Snakehead</color> is almost all protein with barely any fat.
Array.indonesia: Aku dengar di antara ikan-ikan, <color=#FF73C3>Giant Snakehead</color> hampir seluruhnya terdiri dari protein dan hampir tidak mengandung lemak sama sekali.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_InfoTalk02_008
Array.english: <size=32>I can eat fish like that as much as I want, right? Hehe!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku bisa makan ikan seperti itu sebanyak yang aku mau, kan? Hehe!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_ShopRPG_001
Array.english: Dave, you gettin' by alright in the forest?\nThe wild animals've been gettin' pretty fierce.
Array.indonesia: Dave, kamu baik-baik saja di hutan?\nHewan-hewan liar belakangan ini semakin ganas.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_ShopRPG_002
Array.english: I've got a weapon, so I'm mostly fine, but...
Array.indonesia: Aku punya senjata, jadi umumnya aku baik-baik saja, tapi...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_ShopRPG_003
Array.english: sometimes when I run into really tough ones, it gets rough.
Array.indonesia: kadang-kadang saat aku bertemu yang benar-benar tangguh, situasinya jadi sulit.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_ShopRPG_004
Array.english: Hehe, yeah.\nThey've gotten even fiercer lately.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, ya.\nMereka bahkan semakin ganas belakangan ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_ShopRPG_005
Array.english: That's why I brought in some <color=#F1DC2B>Weapons</color> from the city...
Array.indonesia: Makanya aku bawa beberapa <color=#F1DC2B>Senjata</color> dari kota...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_ShopRPG_006
Array.english: They're a bit pricey, but...\nI reckon they'll come in handy.
Array.indonesia: Harganya agak mahal, tapi...\nMenurutku senjata-senjata itu bakal berguna.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_ShopRPG_007
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... nice!\nI'll let ya know when I need 'em!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... bagus!\nAku bakal kasih tahu kalau aku butuh senjata-senjata itu!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_ShopRPGLv2_001
Array.english: Looks like Muna's headin' into the forest with ya too.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya Muna juga ikut masuk ke hutan bersamamu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_ShopRPGLv2_002
Array.english: Yeah. I tried to stop her... but she brought a whip and told me not to worry.
Array.indonesia: Iya. Aku coba menghentikannya... tapi dia bawa cambuk dan bilang jangan khawatir.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_ShopRPGLv2_003
Array.english: <size=32>Haha, Muna sure is brave!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha, Muna memang berani banget!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_ShopRPGLv2_004
Array.english: I've stocked some weapons at the shop that she can use.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah nyetok beberapa senjata di toko yang bisa dia pakai.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_ShopRPGLv2_005
Array.english: <size=32>Let me know if ya need any!\nI'll just charge ya cost.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kabar-kabari aku kalau kamu butuh!\nAku cuma bakal ngasih harga pokok aja.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopLV4_001
Array.english: Bancho's cooking is really delicious.
Array.indonesia: Masakan Bancho benar-benar enak.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopLV4_002
Array.english: Some people are still cautious... but many others are really enjoying it.
Array.indonesia: Ada yang masih was-was... tapi banyak juga yang benar-benar menikmatinya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopLV4_003
Array.english: I thought it might help, so I've stocked up on a few more <color=#F1DC2B>Spices</color>.
Array.indonesia: Aku pikir ini mungkin bisa membantu, jadi aku sudah membeli beberapa <color=#F1DC2B>bumbu</color> lagi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopLV4_004
Array.english: Just let me know if you need anything.
Array.indonesia: Beri tahu aku saja kalau kamu butuh apa-apa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopLV5_001
Array.english: The lake became polluted, and the taste of the fish changed... so I haven't had much of an appetite lately.
Array.indonesia: Danau itu tercemar, dan rasa ikannya berubah... jadi akhir-akhir ini nafsu makanku berkurang.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopLV5_002
Array.english: My body had been aching here and there as well...
Array.indonesia: Tubuhku juga terasa pegal-pegal di sana-sini...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopLV5_003
Array.english: But thanks to your cooking, Bancho, my appetite has returned and I feel much healthier now.
Array.indonesia: Tapi berkat masakanmu, Bancho, nafsu makanku kembali dan aku merasa jauh lebih sehat sekarang.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopLV5_004
Array.english: I'm truly grateful you're making such good use of the village's ingredients.
Array.indonesia: Aku sungguh bersyukur kamu memanfaatkan bahan-bahan dari desa ini dengan sangat baik.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopLV5_005
Array.english: Thinking it might help, I've prepared a few more <color=#F1DC2B>Spices</color> at the shop.
Array.indonesia: Karena kupikir ini mungkin bisa membantu, aku sudah menyiapkan beberapa <color=#F1DC2B>Rempah-rempah</color> lagi di toko.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopLV5_006
Array.english: Well then, I'll be counting on you from now on.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah, mulai sekarang aku akan mengandalkanmu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopRPG_001
Array.english: I heard you went to Setah Forest.
Array.indonesia: Kudengar kamu pergi ke Hutan Setah.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopRPG_002
Array.english: With all the recent earthquakes, the wild animals have become quite aggressive...
Array.indonesia: Dengan banyaknya gempa bumi belakangan ini, hewan-hewan liar menjadi cukup agresif...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopRPG_003
Array.english: I've been growing some <color=#F1DC2B>Herbs</color> that only grow in Setah Forest...
Array.indonesia: Aku telah menanam beberapa <color=#F1DC2B>Ramuan</color> yang hanya tumbuh di Hutan Setah...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopRPG_004
Array.english: <size=32>If you need any, I can sell them to you.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Jika kamu membutuhkannya, aku bisa menjualnya kepadamu.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopRPG_005
Array.english: Herbs have all sorts of effects. Mixing them can make them even more potent.
Array.indonesia: Ramuan memiliki berbagai macam efek. Mencampurkannya bisa membuatnya semakin ampuh.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopRPG_006
