Array.english: You can prepare them yourself using the <color=#F1DC2B>Mortar</color> in my room, so please feel free to use it.
Array.indonesia: Kamu bisa mengolahnya sendiri menggunakan <color=#F1DC2B>lesung</color> di kamarku, jadi silakan gunakan sesukamu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopRPG_007
Array.english: Oh, thanks!\nNow I can stock up before heading out!
Array.indonesia: Oh, terima kasih!\nSekarang aku bisa menyetoknya sebelum berangkat!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_01_002
Array.english: You folks... said you're here to investigate something,\nright?
Array.indonesia: Kalian... bilang kalau kalian ke sini untuk menyelidiki sesuatu,\nkan?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_01_003
Array.english: Yes. A giant dinosaur carcass washed up.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Bangkai dinosaurus raksasa terdampar.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_01_004
Array.english: We think there's something strange going on at the bottom of the lake…so I'm investigating with Dr. Bacon and his assistant, Muna.
Array.indonesia: Kami menduga ada sesuatu yang aneh terjadi di dasar danau… jadi aku sedang menyelidikinya bersama Dr. Bacon dan asistennya, Muna.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_01_005
Array.english: Oh... you mean the Basilomon carcass on the sandy beach.
Array.indonesia: Oh... maksudmu bangkai Basilomon di pantai berpasir itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_01_006
Array.english: <size=33>...What?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...What?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_01_007
Array.english: Ah, I meant Basilosaurus. I mixed it up with a game I've been playing lately.
Array.indonesia: Ah, maksudku Basilosaurus. Aku salah mengira karena game yang sedang aku mainkan belakangan ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_01_008
Array.english: The Basilosaurus is part of Marinca's <color=#F1DC2B>Ancient Creatures Pack</color>.
Array.indonesia: Basilosaurus adalah bagian dari <color=#F1DC2B>Ancient Creatures Pack</color> milik Marinca.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_01_009
Array.english: I wasn't sure if you could actually get the card...
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak yakin apakah kamu benar-benar bisa mendapatkan kartunya...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_01_010
Array.english: Looks like I came to the right place, haha.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya aku datang ke tempat yang tepat, haha.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_02_001
Array.english: <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color>, using it well?
Array.indonesia: <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color>, sudah terbiasa menggunakannya?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_02_002
Array.english: Ah... I'm getting used to it.
Array.indonesia: Ah... aku mulai terbiasa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_02_003
Array.english: It's amazing how it automatically tracks my steps and swimming distance.
Array.indonesia: Luar biasa, dia secara otomatis melacak langkah dan jarak renangku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_02_004
Array.english: <size=33>Hehe! That's the power of technology!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hehe! Itulah kekuatan teknologi!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_02_005
Array.english: When you walk around, you keep getting notifications,\nso you can't help but check it.
Array.indonesia: Saat kamu berjalan-jalan, notifikasi terus berdatangan,\njadi kamu pasti tergoda untuk memeriksanya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_02_006
Array.english: With a regular Marinca, you tend to ignore it when you're not actively collecting.
Array.indonesia: Dengan Marinca biasa, kamu cenderung mengabaikannya saat tidak sedang aktif mengumpulkan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_02_007
Array.english: I want to complete the collection quickly and make the flower bloom. So help me out.
Array.indonesia: Aku ingin segera menyelesaikan koleksinya dan membuat bunga itu mekar. Jadi, tolong bantu aku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_02_008
Array.english: ...Monmon.
Array.indonesia: ...Monmon.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_03_001
Array.english: But if collecting Marinca is your profession...\nhow do you make a living?
Array.indonesia: Tapi kalau mengumpulkan Marinca adalah profesi kamu...\nbagaimana kamu mencari nafkah?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_03_002
Array.english: <size=34>Ha, what a practical question!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ha, pertanyaan yang praktis sekali!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_03_003
Array.english: The World Marinca Association provides a small activity fund to registered Professional Marinca Collectors.
Array.indonesia: Asosiasi Marinca Dunia menyediakan dana kegiatan kecil untuk Pengumpul Marinca Profesional yang terdaftar.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_03_004
Array.english: This allows us to gather information on unknown Marinca cards... and also helps promote Marinca.
Array.indonesia: Hal ini memungkinkan kami mengumpulkan informasi tentang kartu Marinca yang belum diketahui... dan juga membantu mempromosikan Marinca.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_03_005
Array.english: Currently, there are about 4,600 registered Professional Marinca Collectors worldwide...
Array.indonesia: Saat ini, ada sekitar 4.600 Kolektor Marinca Profesional terdaftar di seluruh dunia...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_03_006
Array.english: Among them, no one has completed the <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color> yet.
Array.indonesia: Di antara mereka, belum ada yang menyelesaikan <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_03_007
Array.english: Finding this region was a blessing from the heavens...\nI will definitely be the first Super Marinca Completer.
Array.indonesia: Menemukan wilayah ini adalah berkah dari langit...\nAku pasti akan menjadi Penyelesaian Super Marinca pertama.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_FirstTalk_001
Array.english: Hello. Looking for something?
Array.indonesia: Halo. Sedang mencari sesuatu?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_FirstTalk_002
Array.english: Oh my, you must be from far away. We haven't had many outsiders around here lately...
Array.indonesia: Astaga, kamu pasti datang dari jauh. Belakangan ini jarang ada orang luar di sini...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_FirstTalk_003
Array.english: <size=34>By the way, have you seen my husband, <color=#F1DC2B>Gesang</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ngomong-ngomong, apakah kamu melihat suamiku, <color=#F1DC2B>Gesang</color>?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_FirstTalk_004
Array.english: <size=32>Huh? No...\nI don't think so.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hah? Tidak...\nSepertinya tidak.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_FirstTalk_005
Array.english:
He left all his laundry undone and went off somewhere.
Just wait till I get my hands on him!
Array.indonesia:
Dia meninggalkan semua cucian yang belum dicuci dan pergi ke suatu tempat.
Tunggu saja sampai aku menangkapnya!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_FirstTalk_006
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(She looks scary...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Dia terlihat menakutkan...)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_FirstTalk_007
Array.english: Well... anyway, I'm <color=#F1DC2B>Chandra</color>.\nEnjoy your stay.
Array.indonesia: Yah... bagaimanapun, aku <color=#F1DC2B>Chandra</color>.\nSelamat menikmati masa tinggalmu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_FirstTalk_008
Array.english: If you see my husband doing anything strange,\nlet me know right away.
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu melihat suamiku melakukan hal yang aneh,\nberi tahu aku segera.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_FirstTalk_001
Array.english: Hello, I'm Dave. I came to this village for research.
Array.indonesia: Halo, aku Dave. Aku datang ke desa ini untuk melakukan penelitian.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_FirstTalk_002
Array.english: Oh you're reading. Sorry to interrupt.
Array.indonesia: Oh, kamu sedang membaca. Maaf mengganggumu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_FirstTalk_003
Array.english: Oh, it's fine. I'm <color=#F1DC2B>Kinah</color>.\nIt means "peace of mind."
Array.indonesia: Oh, nggak apa-apa. Namaku <color=#F1DC2B>Kinah</color>.\nArtinya "ketenangan pikiran."

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_FirstTalk_004
Array.english: <size=32>Do you enjoy reading, Dave?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Apakah kamu suka membaca, Dave?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_FirstTalk_005
Array.english: Of course. Reading a book with a cocktail on the beach is absolute heaven.
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja. Membaca buku sambil menikmati koktail di pantai itu sungguh surga.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_FirstTalk_006
Array.english: Haha, we're on the same page. \nWhat have you been reading lately?
Array.indonesia: Haha, kita sepaham. \nApa yang kamu baca belakangan ini?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_FirstTalk_007
Array.english: Oh, it's about a guy preparing for an exam to join the Anti-Monster Defense Force, but he suddenly turns into a monster himself!
Array.indonesia: Oh, ceritanya tentang seorang pria yang sedang mempersiapkan diri untuk ujian agar bisa bergabung dengan Pasukan Pertahanan Anti-Monster, tapi tiba-tiba dia sendiri berubah menjadi monster!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_FirstTalk_008
Array.english: But he gains incredible physical abilities... so he passes the exam anyway, while struggling with being a monster at the same time.
Array.indonesia: Tapi dia mendapatkan kemampuan fisik yang luar biasa... jadi dia tetap lulus ujian, sambil berjuang menghadapi kenyataan bahwa dia sekarang menjadi monster.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_FirstTalk_009
Array.english: <size=35>...That's a comic book, isn't it...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>...Thatu komik, kan...?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_FirstTalk_010
Array.english: <size=33>Yeah! It's really fun, I swear! You should check it out!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Iya! Seru banget, sumpah! Kamu harus coba baca!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_FirstTalk_011
Array.english: ...I see... I'll think about it.\nWell then, I'll get back to my poetry.
Array.indonesia: ...Oh, begitu... Aku akan memikirkannya.\nBaiklah, aku akan kembali menulis puisi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_FirstTalk_001
Array.english: Hello. I'm Dave. I came here to investigate.
Array.indonesia: Halo. Aku Dave. Aku datang ke sini untuk menyelidiki.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_FirstTalk_002
Array.english: I saw in the stars recently that a large, round presence was approaching... I suppose that must be you.
Array.indonesia: Baru-baru ini aku melihat di bintang-bintang bahwa ada kehadiran besar dan bulat yang mendekat... Kurasa itu pasti kamu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_FirstTalk_003
Array.english: Utara Village is a beautiful place, full of flowers and trees.
Array.indonesia: Desa Utara adalah tempat yang indah, penuh dengan bunga dan pohon.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_FirstTalk_004
Array.english: It really does seem that way. \nI was expecting something more desolate.
Array.indonesia: Memang terlihat seperti itu. \nAku mengira tempat ini akan lebih sunyi sepi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_FirstTalk_005
Array.english: It is thanks to the spirit of <color=#1DFEAF>Setah Forest</color>,\nwho has watched over us in peace all this time.
Array.indonesia: Itu berkat roh <color=#1DFEAF>Hutan Setah</color>,\nyang telah menjaga kita dalam kedamaian selama ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_FirstTalk_006
Array.english: I cannot understand why such strange things have begun to occur so suddenly...
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak mengerti mengapa hal-hal aneh seperti ini mulai terjadi begitu tiba-tiba...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_FirstTalk_007
Array.english: Perhaps my sight has dimmed, and I can no longer read the flow of the stars as I once did...
Array.indonesia: Mungkin penglihatanku sudah kabur, dan aku tidak bisa lagi membaca aliran bintang-bintang seperti dulu...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_FirstTalk_008
Array.english: <size=32>It must be the spirit's will. All we can do is wait and see.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Pasti ini kehendak roh tersebut. Yang bisa kita lakukan hanyalah menunggu dan melihat.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_FirstTalk_001
Array.english: Nice to meet you. I'm Dave, staying in this village for a while.
Array.indonesia: Senang bertemu denganmu. Aku Dave, sedang tinggal di desa ini untuk sementara waktu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_FirstTalk_002
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... I was just about to have a brilliant musical idea...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... Aku baru saja hampir mendapatkan ide musik yang brilian...!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_FirstTalk_003
Array.english: Adults really have no respect for art...
Array.indonesia: Orang dewasa memang tidak menghargai seni...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_FirstTalk_004
Array.english: Oh, uh... right. Sorry about that.
Array.indonesia: Oh, eh... benar. Maaf soal itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_FirstTalk_001
Array.english: <size=34>Whoa! Hey, mister!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wah! Hei, Pak!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_FirstTalk_002
Array.english: Ah... looks like I interrupted you...\nI'm Dave.
Array.indonesia: Ah... sepertinya aku mengganggu kamu...\nAku Dave.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_FirstTalk_003
Array.english: Oh, you're the one investigating what's been going on in the village...
Array.indonesia: Oh, kamu yang sedang menyelidiki apa yang terjadi di desa ini...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_FirstTalk_004
Array.english: <size=32>I need to focus on my performance, so keep it down, okay? Yeah!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku harus fokus pada penampilanku, jadi bisakah kamu bicara pelan-pelan? Oke!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_FirstTalk_005
Array.english: Uh... okay. Good luck.
Array.indonesia: Eh... oke. Semoga berhasil.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_ChangeTalk_001
Array.english: <size=34>Woooow! Mister! Hey!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Woooow! Pak! Hei!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_ChangeTalk_002
Array.english: Uh... hmm. You look a bit different.
Array.indonesia: Eh... hmm. Kamu terlihat agak beda.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_ChangeTalk_003
Array.english: <size=32>Haha! I'm an adult now.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha! Aku sudah dewasa sekarang.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_ChangeTalk_004
Array.english: See this cool tattoo? Hahaha.\nIt's the mark of adulthood.
Array.indonesia: Lihat tato keren ini? Hahaha.\nIni tanda kedewasaan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_ChangeTalk_005
Array.english: I thought you really didn't want to go through the coming-of-age ceremony.
Array.indonesia: Kupikir kamu benar-benar tidak mau menjalani upacara kedewasaan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_ChangeTalk_006
Array.english: Sigh. That was me when I was a kid.\nI'm an adult now. An adult.
Array.indonesia: Huh. Itu aku waktu masih kecil.\nSekarang aku sudah dewasa. Dewasa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_ChangeTalk_007
Array.english: My music's gonna be way more mature from now on.\nJust wait and see! Haha!
Array.indonesia: Musikku bakal jauh lebih dewasa mulai sekarang.\nTunggu saja! Haha!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_ChangeTalk_008
Array.english: <size=35>...Woooow!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>...Woooow!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_ChangeTalk_009
Array.english: Yeah... I'll look forward to it.
Array.indonesia: Ya... Aku akan menantikannya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_FirstTalk_001
Array.english: <size=34>Um...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Um...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_FirstTalk_002
Array.english: <size=32>Did you just check me out?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Apa kamu baru saja memandangi aku?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_FirstTalk_003
Array.english: <size=32>No?! I think there's some misunderstanding here...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tidak?! Kurasa ada kesalahpahaman di sini...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_FirstTalk_004
Array.english: That's what they all say... You sleazy, long-nosed monkeys...
Array.indonesia: Itu yang mereka semua katakan... Kalian monyet-monyet mesum berhidung panjang...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_FirstTalk_005
Array.english: <size=32>As a refined human being deserving of respect, I will not tolerate such vulgar behavior!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Sebagai manusia beradab yang layak dihormati, aku tidak akan mentolerir perilaku vulgar seperti itu!!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_FirstTalk_006
Array.english: <size=33>I'll be watching you closely, so don't get any funny ideas.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku akan mengawasimu dengan cermat, jadi jangan sampai punya niat aneh-aneh.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_FirstTalk_007
Array.english: <size=38>...What the...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>...What...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_FirstTalk_001
Array.english: Hello, my name is Dave.
Array.indonesia: Halo, nama saya Dave.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_FirstTalk_002
Array.english: Oh my, you must be from far away.\nI'm <color=#F1DC2B>Omila</color>.
Array.indonesia: Wah, kamu pasti datang dari jauh.\nSaya <color=#F1DC2B>Omila</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_FirstTalk_003
Array.english: I'm raising two children here in the village.
Array.indonesia: Saya sedang membesarkan dua anak di desa ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_FirstTalk_004
Array.english: Ah, I think I saw your kids.\nThey seemed very cheerful.
Array.indonesia: Ah, sepertinya saya pernah melihat anak-anakmu.\nMereka tampak sangat ceria.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_FirstTalk_005
Array.english: Hoho, they're quite the handful.
Array.indonesia: Hoho, mereka memang cukup merepotkan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_FirstTalk_006
Array.english: Anyway, I hope you enjoy your time here.\nI'll see you around.
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun, semoga kamu menikmati waktumu di sini.\nSampai jumpa nanti.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_FirstTalk_001
Array.english: Huh? I haven't seen you around before.
Array.indonesia: Hah? Aku belum pernah melihatmu di sini sebelumnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_FirstTalk_002
Array.english: Oh, I'm Dave. I'll be staying here for a while for some research.
Array.indonesia: Oh, aku Dave. Aku akan tinggal di sini sebentar untuk melakukan penelitian.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_FirstTalk_003
Array.english: Research...? Ah, you mean those dinosaurs.
Array.indonesia: Penelitian...? Ah, maksudmu dinosaurus-dinosaurus itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_FirstTalk_004
Array.english: Yeah, a lot of strange things have been happening lately. Even earthquakes.
Array.indonesia: Ya, banyak hal aneh yang terjadi belakangan ini. Bahkan gempa bumi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_FirstTalk_005
Array.english: <size=32>Well, it won't be easy, but please look into it for us.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Yah, ini tidak akan mudah, tapi tolong selidiki hal ini untuk kami.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_FirstTalk_006
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, I'm <color=#F1DC2B>Perak</color>.\nFather of two.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, aku <color=#F1DC2B>Perak</color>.\nAyah dari dua anak.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_FirstTalk_001
Array.english: Hello. My name is Dave. I'll be staying in this village for a while.
Array.indonesia: Halo. Namaku Dave. Aku akan tinggal di desa ini untuk sementara waktu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_FirstTalk_002
Array.english: Hello...\n<size=34>Oh, I'm sorry.</size>
Array.indonesia: Halo...\n<size=34>Oh, maaf.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_FirstTalk_003
Array.english: Oh. Are you crying?! I'm sorry, I spoke to you at a bad time.
Array.indonesia: Oh. Apakah kamu menangis?! Maaf, sepertinya aku mengganggumu di saat yang tidak tepat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_FirstTalk_004
Array.english: No, it's alright. I was looking at the lake and remembered when <color=#F1DC2B>Jaka</color> and my husband used to play there.
Array.indonesia: Tidak, tidak apa-apa. Aku sedang melihat danau itu dan teringat saat <color=#F1DC2B>Jaka</color> dan suamiku dulu sering bermain di sana.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_FirstTalk_005
Array.english: I'm <color=#F1DC2B>Cinta</color>, and I live in this village with my son.
Array.indonesia: Namaku <color=#F1DC2B>Cinta</color>, dan aku tinggal di desa ini bersama putraku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_FirstTalk_006
Array.english: We haven't had visitors in quite some time...\nIt's nice to see someone from outside again.
Array.indonesia: Sudah cukup lama kami tidak kedatangan tamu...\nSenang rasanya melihat orang dari luar lagi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_FirstTalk_007
Array.english: Though some people here might not be too happy about it.
Array.indonesia: Meskipun beberapa orang di sini mungkin tidak terlalu senang dengan hal itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_FirstTalk_008
Array.english: I'll do my best not to cause any trouble.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan berusaha sebaik mungkin agar tidak menimbulkan masalah.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_FirstTalk_009
Array.english: My Jaka dreams of going to the city someday and becoming a musician.
Array.indonesia: Jaka bermimpi suatu hari nanti bisa pergi ke kota dan menjadi musisi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_FirstTalk_010
Array.english: He's a bit shy, so he may not approach you first...\nBut if you have any advice, I'd really appreciate it.
Array.indonesia: Dia agak pemalu, jadi mungkin dia tidak akan menyapa Kamu lebih dulu...\nTapi jika Kamu punya saran, saya akan sangat menghargainya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_FirstTalk_001
Array.english: Hey there. I'm Dave, just staying in this village for a bit.
Array.indonesia: Halo. Saya Dave, hanya tinggal sebentar di desa ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_FirstTalk_002
Array.english: Oh... so you're with that glasses girl who came here recently.
Array.indonesia: Oh... jadi Kamu bersama gadis berkacamata yang baru-baru ini datang ke sini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_FirstTalk_003
Array.english: <size=32>I'm <color=#F1DC2B>Eka</color>! I'm 10!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku <color=#F1DC2B>Eka</color>! Umurku 10 tahun!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_FirstTalk_004
Array.english: Mister, do you have any <color=#1DFEAF>Games</color> on your phone?
Array.indonesia: Pak, apakah Kamu punya <color=#1DFEAF>Game</color> di ponsel Kamu?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_FirstTalk_005
Array.english: <size=32>Yeah... a few?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ya... ada beberapa?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_FirstTalk_006
Array.english: <size=35>Whoa! Can I try one??</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wah! Boleh aku coba satu??</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_FirstTalk_007
Array.english: Sure, why not.\nHere you go.
Array.indonesia: Tentu, kenapa tidak.\nIni, silakan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_FirstTalk_008
Array.english: <size=35>Whoa! I'll give it back soon!\nThanks!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wah! Aku akan segera mengembalikannya!\nTerima kasih!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_FirstTalk_012
Array.english: <size=41>Ugh! I died...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=41>Aduh! Aku mati...!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_FirstTalk_013
Array.english: Haha, what did you play? <color=#1DFEAF>Evil Factory</color>?
Array.indonesia: Haha, game apa yang kamu mainkan? <color=#1DFEAF>Evil Factory</color>?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_FirstTalk_014
Array.english: Nope, that looked boring, so I played <color=#1DFEAF>Bouncy Dumbo</color>.
Array.indonesia: Nggak, kelihatannya membosankan, jadi aku main <color=#1DFEAF>Bouncy Dumbo</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_FirstTalk_015
Array.english: <size=35>It's super fun! Let me play again next time!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Seru banget! Biar aku main lagi lain kali!!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_FirstTalk_016
Array.english: Sure, maybe next time.
Array.indonesia: Oke, mungkin lain kali.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_FirstTalk_017
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Evil Factory's fun though... Guess kids these days have different tastes.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Evil Factory juga seru sih... Kayaknya anak-anak jaman sekarang seleranya beda.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_FirstTalk_001
Array.english: Hi there! I'm Uncle Dave.\nNice to meet you.
Array.indonesia: Halo! Aku Paman Dave.\nSenang bertemu denganmu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_FirstTalk_002
Array.english: <size=33>Whoa... you're an outsider?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wah.. . kamu orang luar?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_FirstTalk_003
Array.english: They say outsiders pluck out people's eyeballs and eat them like candy... Is that true?
Array.indonesia: Katanya orang luar mencabut bola mata orang dan memakannya seperti permen... Benarkah itu?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_FirstTalk_004
Array.english: ...What kind of nonsense is that?\nWhere'd you hear that?
Array.indonesia: ...Omong kosong apa itu?\nDari mana kamu dengar itu?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_FirstTalk_005
Array.english: Bima told me... I'm glad it's not true.
Array.indonesia: Bima yang bilang... Syukurlah itu tidak benar.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_FirstTalk_006
Array.english: I'm <color=#F1DC2B>Saniah</color>.\nMy brother is <color=#F1DC2B>Eka</color>.
Array.indonesia: Namaku <color=#F1DC2B>Saniah</color>.\nKakakku adalah <color=#F1DC2B>Eka</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_FirstTalk_007
Array.english: I see. I'll be staying here for a while, so let's get along.
Array.indonesia: Begitu ya. Aku akan tinggal di sini untuk sementara waktu, jadi mari kita akur.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_FirstTalk_001
Array.english: Hey there, kid. I'm Dave.\nLet's get along.
Array.indonesia: Hai, Nak. Namaku Dave.\nMari kita akur.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_FirstTalk_002
Array.english: <size=32>Oh! Mister Outsider!\nI'm the boss of this village, <color=#F1DC2B>Bima</color>, hehe!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh! Tuan Pendatang!\nAku adalah kepala desa ini, <color=#F1DC2B>Bima</color>, hehe!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_FirstTalk_003
Array.english: <size=32>If you've got any questions, ask me, the great Bima! Hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kalau ada pertanyaan, tanya saja padaku, Bima yang hebat! Hehe.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_FirstTalk_004
Array.english: You're a confident one. Alright, got it.
Array.indonesia: Kamu memang percaya diri. Baiklah, paham.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Calamansi_Mission01Progress_Title
Array.english: How to get calamansi
Array.indonesia: Cara mendapatkan calamansi

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Mission01Progress_Title
Array.english: How to get lemongrass
Array.indonesia: Cara mendapatkan serai

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Mission01Progress_Title
Array.english: Getting herbs and spices
Array.indonesia: Mendapatkan rempah-rempah dan bumbu-bumbu

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_Mission01Progress_Title
Array.english: What materials do I need again?
Array.indonesia: Bahan apa saja yang aku butuhkan lagi?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Task_410050008_Talk_Title
Array.english: Where do carpenters live?
Array.indonesia: Di mana tukang kayu tinggal?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_FirstTalk_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hm? You're from out of town...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hm? Kamu dari luar kota...?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_FirstTalk_002
Array.english: Yes, that's right. I'm Dave.
Array.indonesia: Ya, benar. Aku Dave.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_FirstTalk_003
Array.english: Hehe. Heard you've been here a while, but we're only just meeting now.
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Kudengar kamu sudah lama di sini, tapi kita baru bertemu sekarang.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_FirstTalk_004
Array.english: I'm <color=#F1DC2B>Harta</color>. Well... you could say I'm a bit of a regular around here. Hehe.
Array.indonesia: Aku <color=#F1DC2B>Harta</color>. Yah... bisa dibilang aku cukup sering muncul di sini. Hehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_FirstTalk_005
Array.english: <size=32>I'll be seeing you around... Let's get along.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Sampai jumpa lagi... Ayo kita akrab-akrab saja.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_Kind01_001
Array.english: Didn't you have any fun games back where you're from?
Array.indonesia: Apa di tempat asalmu tidak ada permainan seru?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_Kind01_002
Array.english: Now that I think about it... Bancho and Cobra were always busy, so we never really got to have much fun.
Array.indonesia: Kalau dipikir-pikir... Bancho dan Cobra selalu sibuk, jadi kami jarang benar-benar bisa bersenang-senang.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_Kind01_003
Array.english: But in the Sea People Village, they had all sorts of fun games.
Array.indonesia: Tapi di Desa Orang Laut, mereka punya berbagai macam permainan seru.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_Kind01_004
Array.english: Like one where you use shark teeth...\nand another where you guess where the pearl is...
Array.indonesia: Seperti permainan yang pakai gigi hiu...\ndan yang lain di mana kamu menebak di mana mutiara itu...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_Kind01_005
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, and the seahorse races were actually pretty fun too!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, dan balapan kuda lautnya juga lumayan seru, lho!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_Kind01_006
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm... I'm not really following any of that...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm... Aku nggak begitu ngerti yang kamu maksud...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_InfoTalk01_001
Array.english: Harta you seem to like <color=#FF73C3>Gold Jewelry</color>.
Array.indonesia: Harta, sepertinya kamu suka <color=#FF73C3>Perhiasan Emas</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_InfoTalk01_002
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, you've got a sharp eye, don't ya? Hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, matamu tajam banget, ya? Hehe.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_InfoTalk01_003
Array.english: <size=33>You gotta wear expensive stuff if you want money to come your way!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kamu harus pakai barang-barang mahal kalau mau uang datang menghampiri!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_InfoTalk01_004
Array.english: My favorite's this necklace... I heard it was made by the ancient Sunang people.
Array.indonesia: Favoritku adalah kalung ini... Kudengar kalung ini dibuat oleh suku Sunang kuno.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_InfoTalk01_005
Array.english: Basu happened to fish it up, and I won it from him in a bet! Hehe.
Array.indonesia: Basu kebetulan menemukannya saat memancing, dan aku memenangkannya darinya dalam sebuah taruhan! Hehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_InfoTalk01_006
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Looks like Harta's a fan of <color=#FF73C3>Gold Jewelry</color>.\nI should make a note of that.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Sepertinya Harta penggemar <color=#FF73C3>Perhiasan Emas</color>.\nAku harus mencatat itu.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_NotKind01_001
Array.english: I don't get people who work hard all day...
Array.indonesia: Aku nggak ngerti orang-orang yang kerja keras seharian...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_NotKind01_002
Array.english: I mean, gambling's way faster...\nand it's more fun too.
Array.indonesia: Maksudku, judi jauh lebih cepat...\ndan juga lebih seru.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_NotKind01_003
Array.english: But you could lose money too, couldn't you?
Array.indonesia: Tapi kamu juga bisa kehilangan uang, kan?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_NotKind01_004
Array.english: <size=32>Haha, you think working guarantees money? Plenty of people go broke that way too!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha, kamu pikir bekerja menjamin uang? Banyak orang yang bangkrut karena itu juga!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_NotKind01_005
Array.english:
If you're gonna lose it anyway, might as well have fun,
right? Don't you think?
Array.indonesia:
Kalau memang bakal kehilangan uang, mendingan bersenang-senang saja,
kan? Kamu nggak setuju?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_NotKind02_001
Array.english: My son sometimes makes up stories that aren't even true...
Array.indonesia: Anakku kadang-kadang mengarang cerita yang bahkan tidak benar...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_NotKind02_002
Array.english: The villagers come to me about it...\nbut what am I supposed to do?
Array.indonesia: Warga desa datang kepadaku untuk mengadukannya...\ntapi apa yang harus kulakukan?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_NotKind02_003
Array.english: Maybe he just wants attention? He probably doesn't mean any harm.
Array.indonesia: Mungkin dia hanya ingin diperhatikan? Dia mungkin tidak bermaksud jahat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_NotKind02_004
Array.english: <size=32>Hmph! I was way more honest at his age!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmph! Aku jauh lebih jujur saat seumurannya!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_NotKind02_005
Array.english: He should learn from his dad... but he hangs out with those weird village kids, and that's why he's like this.
Array.indonesia: Dia seharusnya belajar dari ayahnya... tapi dia sering bergaul dengan anak-anak desa yang aneh itu, dan itulah sebabnya dia jadi seperti ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_NotKind03_001
Array.english: <size=32>The coconut liquor from this village is seriously top-notch.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Minuman kelapa dari desa ini benar-benar berkualitas tinggi.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_NotKind03_002
Array.english:
That <color=#F1DC2B>Jepun</color>... he's got a difficult personality,
but he sure knows how to farm.
Array.indonesia:
Si <color=#F1DC2B>Jepun</color> itu... dia punya kepribadian yang sulit,
tapi dia memang jago bertani.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_NotKind03_003
Array.english: <size=33>That's what happens when all you care about is crops and land. No wonder the ladies aren't interested, hahaha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Itulah yang terjadi kalau yang kamu pedulikan cuma tanaman dan tanah. Pantas saja para wanita nggak tertarik, hahaha!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_InfoTalk02_001
Array.english: Harta, is there a dish you like?
Array.indonesia: Harta, ada hidangan yang kamu suka?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_InfoTalk02_002
Array.english: Oh... have you ever had <color=#FF73C3>Stingray</color> dishes?
Array.indonesia: Oh... pernahkah kamu mencicipi hidangan <color=#FF73C3>ikan pari</color>?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_InfoTalk02_003
Array.english: Of course. But I remember it having a pretty strong smell.
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja. Tapi aku ingat baunya cukup menyengat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_InfoTalk02_004
Array.english: <size=33>Haha! You're talking about ocean stingrays!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Haha! Kamu sedang membicarakan ikan pari laut!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_InfoTalk02_005
Array.english: <color=#FF73C3>Freshwater Stingrays</color> barely have any smell.\nThey're light and really tasty.
Array.indonesia: <color=#FF73C3>Ikan pari air tawar</color> hampir tidak berbau sama sekali.\nDagingnya lembut dan sangat lezat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_InfoTalk02_006
Array.english: They used to be caught a lot before the lake got polluted... but I haven't seen them much lately.
Array.indonesia: Dulu banyak ditangkap sebelum danau tercemar... tapi belakangan ini aku jarang melihatnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_InfoTalk02_007
Array.english: <size=33>Man... just talking about it makes me crave some <color=#FF73C3>Stingray</color> with a glass of coconut wine!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wah... cuma ngomongin aja udah bikin aku pengen makan <color=#FF73C3>Stingray</color> ditemani segelas anggur kelapa!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_InfoTalk02_008
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Looks like Harta likes <color=#FF73C3>Stingray</color> dishes.\nI should write that down.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Sepertinya Harta suka hidangan <color=#FF73C3>ikan pari</color>.\nAku harus mencatatnya.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_FirstTalk_001
Array.english: Ugh... I just said I was going for a short walk...\nI'll get in trouble if I'm late...
Array.indonesia: Ugh... Aku baru saja bilang mau jalan-jalan sebentar...\nAku bakal kena masalah kalau terlambat...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_FirstTalk_002
Array.english: Hello. My name is Dave.
Array.indonesia: Halo. Namaku Dave.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_FirstTalk_003
Array.english: Oh, the outsider? I heard you came to investigate that dinosaur carcass over there.
Array.indonesia: Oh, orang luar? Aku dengar kamu datang untuk menyelidiki bangkai dinosaurus di sana.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_FirstTalk_004
Array.english: <size=32>I'm <color=#F1DC2B>Gesang</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku <color=#F1DC2B>Gesang</color>.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_FirstTalk_005
Array.english: Nice to meet you. Is there... in this village...
Array.indonesia: Senang bertemu denganmu. Apakah ada... di desa ini...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_FirstTalk_006
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, sorry... I really need to finish carving this animal sculpture right now... can we talk later?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, maaf... Aku benar-benar harus menyelesaikan ukiran patung hewan ini sekarang... bisakah kita bicara nanti?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_FirstTalk_007
Array.english: ...Okay, got it.
Array.indonesia: ...Oke, paham.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Kind01_001
Array.english: Isn't there some way to just kick back and live easy my whole life without working...?
Array.indonesia: Apa tidak ada cara untuk bersantai dan hidup santai sepanjang hidupku tanpa harus bekerja...?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Kind01_002
Array.english: Hmm... what about trying your hand at investing, like in stocks?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... bagaimana kalau mencoba berinvestasi, misalnya di saham?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Kind01_003
Array.english: Stocks...? \nAh, you mean buying and selling pieces of a company?
Array.indonesia: Saham...? \nAh, maksudmu membeli dan menjual bagian dari sebuah perusahaan?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Kind01_004
Array.english: Yes. There are even folks who make a living off investment returns instead of working.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Bahkan ada orang yang hidup dari hasil investasi alih-alih bekerja.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Kind01_005
Array.english: But... if you invest wrong, don't you end up losing money instead?
Array.indonesia: Tapi... kalau salah berinvestasi, bukankah justru akan rugi?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Kind01_006
Array.english: <size=32>Well... that's true. \nBuy carelessly and you could lose it all.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Yah... itu benar. \nKalau beli sembarangan, kamu bisa kehilangan semuanya.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Kind01_007
Array.english: Ugh... if I lose money on stocks, I'm already scared of what my wife would say...
Array.indonesia: Ugh... kalau aku rugi dari saham, aku sudah takut membayangkan apa yang akan dikatakan istriku...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Kind02_001
Array.english: Just thinkin' about that weird place I ended up in still gives me the creeps.
Array.indonesia: Hanya dengan memikirkan tempat aneh yang aku temui itu saja sudah membuatku merinding.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Kind02_002
Array.english: Next thing I knew, I was suddenly in that woman Mita's room!
Array.indonesia: Tanpa kusadari, tiba-tiba aku sudah berada di kamar wanita bernama Mita itu!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Kind02_003
Array.english: It seems Mita is an NPC that exists in several different versions.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya Mita adalah NPC yang ada dalam beberapa versi berbeda.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Kind02_004
Array.english: Why don't we ask the Mita who's here in the village right now?
Array.indonesia: Mengapa kita tidak bertanya kepada Mita yang ada di desa ini sekarang?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Kind02_005
Array.english: <size=32>Hii...! Just gettin' near her is terrifying!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hai...! Hanya mendekatinya saja sudah menakutkan!!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Kind02_006
Array.english: ...And if Chandra saw me, she'd grill me for sure, y'know.
Array.indonesia: ...Dan kalau Chandra melihatku, dia pasti akan menginterogasiku habis-habisan, lho.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_InfoTalk01_001
Array.english: This village is great, but there's not much to do for fun.
Array.indonesia: Desa ini memang bagus, tapi nggak banyak hal seru yang bisa dilakukan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_InfoTalk01_002
Array.english: If I gamble with Harta, my wife gives me the stink eye...
Array.indonesia: Kalau aku berjudi dengan Harta, istriku bakal melotot ke arahku...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_InfoTalk01_003
Array.english: What kind of things do you like?
Array.indonesia: Hal-hal apa yang kamu suka?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_InfoTalk01_004
Array.english: Hehe... well, you know... things like <color=#FF73C3>Manga</color> and <color=#FF73C3>Game Consoles</color>.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... yah, kamu tahu lah... hal-hal seperti <color=#FF73C3>manga</color> dan <color=#FF73C3>konsol game</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_InfoTalk01_005
Array.english: I could get them if I wanted to, but she'd nag me endlessly, saying that stuff's for kids.
Array.indonesia: Aku bisa membelinya kalau mau, tapi dia bakal terus-terusan mengomel, bilang barang-barang itu buat anak-anak.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_InfoTalk01_006
Array.english: <size=33>I mean, that's way better than actually losing money gambling, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Maksudku, itu jauh lebih baik daripada benar-benar kehilangan uang karena berjudi, kan?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_InfoTalk01_007
Array.english: I guess I'll have to get them in secret... and enjoy them on the sly.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya aku harus membelinya secara diam-diam... dan menikmatinya secara sembunyi-sembunyi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_InfoTalk01_008
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(So Gesang likes things like <color=#FF73C3>Manga</color> and <color=#FF73C3>Game Consoles</color>.\nI should make a note of that.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Jadi Gesang suka hal-hal seperti <color=#FF73C3>Manga</color> dan <color=#FF73C3>Konsol Game</color>.\nAku harus mencatat itu.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_NotKind01_001
Array.english: You look a bit tired, Gesang. You okay?
Array.indonesia: Kamu terlihat agak lelah, Gesang. Kamu baik-baik saja?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_NotKind01_002
Array.english: Huh...? Do I?
Array.indonesia: Hah...? Benarkah?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_NotKind01_003
Array.english: This is bad... I snuck out last night and did a little gambling with Harta.
Array.indonesia: Ini tidak bagus... Tadi malam aku menyelinap keluar dan berjudi sebentar bersama Harta.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_NotKind01_004
Array.english: Can't let that show...
Array.indonesia: Tidak boleh sampai ketahuan...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_NotKind01_005
Array.english: Sounds like Chandra's a heavy sleeper.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya Chandra tidurnya nyenyak sekali.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_NotKind01_006
Array.english: Hehe! That's the best thing about my wife!
Array.indonesia: Hehe! Itu hal terbaik dari istriku!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_NotKind01_007
Array.english: Once she's out, nothing wakes her.
Array.indonesia: Begitu dia tertidur, tidak ada yang bisa membangunkannya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_NotKind01_008
Array.english: Still, don't rely on that too much...\nShe might just be pretending to sleep.
Array.indonesia: Tapi, jangan terlalu mengandalkan itu...\nDia mungkin hanya berpura-pura tidur.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_NotKind01_009
Array.english: Yikes... don't say stuff like that.
Array.indonesia: Astaga... jangan bilang hal seperti itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_NotKind02_001
Array.english: I hear there are places in the city where folks gamble 24 hours a day?
Array.indonesia: Aku dengar ada tempat di kota ini di mana orang-orang berjudi 24 jam sehari?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_NotKind02_002
Array.english: Yes. They're called casinos... You buy chips with money and can play all sorts of games there.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Tempat itu disebut kasino... Kamu membeli chip dengan uang dan bisa memainkan berbagai macam permainan di sana.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_NotKind02_003
Array.english: <size=33>Ohh... that sounds like a whole lotta fun, doesn't it...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ohh... kedengarannya sangat seru, bukan...?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_NotKind02_004
Array.english: I went once... but I lost all my money in no time and walked right out.
Array.indonesia: Aku pernah ke sana sekali... tapi uangku habis dalam sekejap dan aku langsung keluar.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_NotKind02_005
Array.english: Heh heh, that's just 'cause you've got no skill, pal! It'd be a different story if I went!
Array.indonesia: Heh heh, itu cuma karena kamu nggak punya skill, sobat! Ceritanya bakal beda kalau aku yang pergi!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_NotKind02_006
Array.english: <size=32>I don't think Chandra would let you go, though...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tapi aku rasa Chandra nggak bakal ngizinin kamu pergi...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_InfoTalk02_001
Array.english: Ah... now that I think about it, I heard you can go all the way down to the sea beneath the lake?
Array.indonesia: Ah... sekarang aku ingat, aku dengar kamu bisa turun sampai ke laut di bawah danau itu?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_InfoTalk02_002
Array.english: Yes. Thanks to my new suit, I can go even deeper now.
Array.indonesia: Iya. Berkat baju selam baruku, sekarang aku bisa turun lebih dalam lagi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_InfoTalk02_003
Array.english: <size=33>Ooh...! So, are there any squid down there?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wah...! Jadi, ada cumi-cumi di sana?!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_InfoTalk02_004
Array.english: Hmm... it's mostly ancient creatures... so not exactly squid, but I think there was something similar.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... kebanyakan makhluk purba... jadi bukan cumi-cumi sebenarnya, tapi kurasa ada yang mirip.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_InfoTalk02_005
Array.english: I'm pretty sure it was called... <color=#FF73C3>Orthoceras</color>.
Array.indonesia: Aku cukup yakin namanya... <color=#FF73C3>Orthoceras</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_InfoTalk02_006
Array.english: ...What a weird name.\nAnyway, I really love grilled squid.
Array.indonesia: ...Nama yang aneh sekali.\nBagaimanapun, aku sangat suka cumi-cumi panggang.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_InfoTalk02_007
Array.english: But there are no squid in this lake...
Array.indonesia: Tapi tidak ada cumi-cumi di danau ini...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_InfoTalk02_008
Array.english: That Ortho...
Array.indonesia: Ortho itu...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_InfoTalk02_009
Array.english: <size=32><color=#FF73C3>Orthoceras</color>, you mean.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32><color=#FF73C3>Orthoceras</color>, maksudmu.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_InfoTalk02_010
Array.english: Yeah, that. If you catch one of those ancient squids,\nI'd love to grill it up nice and eat it, hehe!
Array.indonesia: Ya, itu. Kalau kamu berhasil menangkap salah satu cumi-cumi purba itu,\naku pengen banget memanggangnya dengan enak dan memakannya, hehe!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_InfoTalk02_011
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(If I catch an <color=#FF73C3>Orthoceras</color> in the deep sea, I should treat \nGesang to some.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Kalau aku menangkap <color=#FF73C3>Orthoceras</color> di laut dalam, aku harus mentraktir \nGesang.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_Kind01_001
Array.english: My husband and I? We were childhood friends,\nwe grew up together.
Array.indonesia: Aku dan suamiku? Kami adalah teman masa kecil,\nkami tumbuh besar bersama.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_Kind01_002
Array.english: <size=32>Then one day, out of nowhere, he confessed he'd liked me all along... hehehe!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Lalu suatu hari, tiba-tiba saja, dia mengaku bahwa dia sudah menyukaiku sejak dulu... hehehe!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_Kind01_003
Array.english: He's been lazy and frustrating since we were kids,\nso I never really saw him as a man...
Array.indonesia: Dia memang malas dan menyebalkan sejak kami masih kecil,\njadi aku tidak pernah benar-benar melihatnya sebagai seorang pria...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_Kind01_004
Array.english: Well, what can you do. One thing led to another,\nand we ended up getting married.
Array.indonesia: Yah, apa boleh buat. Satu hal mengarah ke hal lain,\ndan akhirnya kami menikah.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_Kind01_005
Array.english: Still, as long as you've stayed together and been happy all this time, that's what matters.
Array.indonesia: Meski begitu, selama kalian tetap bersama dan bahagia selama ini, itulah yang terpenting.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_Kind01_006
Array.english: <size=34>A Divorce would be a huge scandal in our village!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Perceraian akan menjadi skandal besar di desa kami!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_Kind01_007
Array.english: Even if he's a good-for-nothing husband, I still have to take care of him. Who else would? *Sigh.*
Array.indonesia: Meskipun dia suami yang tidak berguna, aku tetap harus merawatnya. Siapa lagi yang akan melakukannya? *Huff.*

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_InfoTalk01_001
Array.english: That's a really nice bracelet.
Array.indonesia: Gelang itu sangat cantik.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_InfoTalk01_002
Array.english: <size=33>Ohohoho!! You've got a good eye!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ohohoho!! Matamu tajam sekali!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_InfoTalk01_003
Array.english: <size=32>It's a <color=#FF73C3>Pearl</color> accessory my husband made for me himself.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ini adalah <color=#FF73C3>aksesori mutiara</color> yang dibuat sendiri oleh suamiku untukku.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_InfoTalk01_004
Array.english: <size=32>My husband's not just handsome, he's great with his hands too!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Suamiku tidak hanya tampan, tapi juga jago membuat kerajinan tangan!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_InfoTalk01_005
Array.english: The <color=#FF73C3>Pearls</color> from this lake have such a radiant glow,\nI just love them.
Array.indonesia: <color=#FF73C3>Mutiara</color> dari danau ini bersinar begitu cemerlang,\naku sangat menyukainya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_InfoTalk01_006
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Chandra really loves <color=#FF73C3>Pearls</color>.\nI should make a note of that.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Chandra benar-benar menyukai <color=#FF73C3>Mutiara</color>.\nAku harus mencatat hal itu.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind01_001
Array.english: There's this man in the village named <color=#F1DC2B>Harta</color>...
Array.indonesia: Ada seorang pria di desa ini bernama <color=#F1DC2B>Harta</color>...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind01_002
Array.english: He never works, just drinks and gambles all day.
Array.indonesia: Dia tidak pernah bekerja, hanya minum dan berjudi sepanjang hari.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind01_003
Array.english: I'm worried because my husband seems to be getting close to him...
Array.indonesia: Aku khawatir karena suamiku sepertinya mulai dekat dengannya...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind01_004
Array.english: If you see the two of them up to something,\nyou absolutely have to tell me.
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu melihat mereka berdua sedang merencanakan sesuatu,\nkamu harus memberitahuku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind01_005
Array.english: Well... he's an adult, so isn't a little bit okay?
Array.indonesia: Yah... dia sudah dewasa, jadi sedikit-sedikit kan tidak apa-apa?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind01_006
Array.english: <size=33>That's how it starts and before you know it, they've ruined their lives!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Begitulah awalnya, dan sebelum kamu sadari, hidup mereka sudah hancur!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind01_007
Array.english: ...Alright, I get it.
Array.indonesia: ...Baiklah, aku mengerti.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind02_001
Array.english: Ugh... that coconut liquor.
Array.indonesia: Ugh... minuman kelapa itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind02_002
Array.english: Huh? Isn't that the village's traditional drink?
Array.indonesia: Hah? Bukankah itu minuman tradisional desa?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind02_003
Array.english: It is, but...\ndon't you know how dangerous alcohol can be?
Array.indonesia: Memang, tapi...\nkamu nggak tahu betapa berbahayanya alkohol?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind02_004
Array.english: When you drink, your judgment gets clouded...\nand you start getting swayed by women...
Array.indonesia: Kalau minum, penilaianmu jadi kabur...\ndan kamu mulai terpengaruh oleh wanita...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind02_005
Array.english: <size=32>Just the other day, he came home after drinking and suddenly...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Baru-baru ini, dia pulang setelah minum dan tiba-tiba...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind02_006
Array.english: <size=35>Oh my!! What am I saying!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Astaga!! Apa yang aku katakan!!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind02_007
Array.english: Anyway, I think he's been secretly drinking it at night. I should get rid of the bottles... tsk.
Array.indonesia: Pokoknya, kurasa dia diam-diam meminumnya di malam hari. Aku harus membuang botol-botol itu... tsk.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind03_001
Array.english: You seem like a pretty decent person, though...
Array.indonesia: Kamu kelihatannya orang yang cukup baik, sih...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind03_002
Array.english: <size=33>You don't do things like gambling, do you?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kamu nggak melakukan hal-hal seperti berjudi, kan?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind03_003
Array.english: Oh... well... Things like Shark Tooth Challenges or Seahorse Races are fine, right?
Array.indonesia: Oh... ya... Hal-hal seperti Tantangan Gigi Hiu atau Balapan Kuda Laut sih nggak apa-apa, kan?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind03_004
Array.english: I don't know what those are, but... just don't go wasting your money on things like that!
Array.indonesia: Aku nggak tahu apa itu, tapi... jangan sampai buang-buang uangmu untuk hal-hal seperti itu!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind03_005
Array.english: But isn't it fine if you keep it recreational?
Array.indonesia: Tapi bukankah tidak apa-apa kalau hanya untuk hiburan?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind03_006
Array.english: <size=32>Recreational?!\nOnce people start, they don't know when to stop!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hiburan?!\nBegitu orang mulai, mereka tidak tahu kapan harus berhenti!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind03_007
Array.english: <size=33>And don't go putting ideas like that in my husband's head... seriously!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Dan jangan tanamkan ide-ide seperti itu ke kepala suamiku... serius!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind03_008
Array.english: Okay... I get it.
Array.indonesia: Oke... Aku mengerti.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_InfoTalk02_001
Array.english: Chandra, what kind of food do you like?
Array.indonesia: Chandra, makanan apa yang kamu suka?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_InfoTalk02_002
Array.english: Oh my... can't you tell by looking at my skin?
Array.indonesia: Astaga... apa kamu tidak bisa menebaknya dengan melihat kulitku?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_InfoTalk02_003
Array.english: <size=31>Um... crocodile meat...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Um... daging buaya...?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_InfoTalk02_004
Array.english: Hah... you outsiders...\nyou really have no sense at all...
Array.indonesia: Hah... kalian orang luar...\nkalian benar-benar nggak punya akal sehat sama sekali...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_InfoTalk02_005
Array.english: <color=#FF73C3>Water Spinach</color>, of course! <color=#FF73C3>Water Spinach</color> is great for your skin!
Array.indonesia: <color=#FF73C3>Kangkung</color>, tentu saja! <color=#FF73C3>Kangkung</color> bagus banget buat kulitmu!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_InfoTalk02_006
Array.english: The stems are hollow, so they soak up flavor really well... and they're great for your skin, it's the best vegetable, hehe!
Array.indonesia: Batangnya berlubang, jadi bisa menyerap rasa dengan sangat baik... dan bagus buat kulitmu, ini sayuran terbaik, hehe!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_InfoTalk02_007
Array.english: It only grows near the water in <color=#1DFEAF>Setah Forest</color>... so it's been hard to get lately, and I think my skin's getting worse because of it.
Array.indonesia: Sayuran ini hanya tumbuh di dekat air di <color=#1DFEAF>Hutan Setah</color>... jadi belakangan ini sulit didapat, dan kurasa kulitku jadi semakin buruk karena itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_InfoTalk02_008
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Getting some <color=#FF73C3>Water Spinach</color> for Bancho would be easy. She'd probably love it if I brought her some next time.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Mendapatkan <color=#FF73C3>Kangkung</color> untuk Bancho pasti mudah. Dia pasti akan senang kalau aku membawakannya lain kali.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Kind01_001
Array.english: You're always writing something, aren't you, Kinah?
Array.indonesia: Kamu selalu menulis sesuatu, kan, Kinah?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Kind01_002
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... you noticed.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... kamu perhatikan.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Kind01_003
Array.english: It's nothing special... I just write down little thoughts as they come to me.
Array.indonesia: Nggak ada yang istimewa... Aku cuma mencatat pikiran-pikiran kecil begitu muncul di benakku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Kind01_004
Array.english: If I write down how I feel in the moment like this...\nI can revisit those feelings later.
Array.indonesia: Kalau aku mencatat perasaanku di saat seperti ini...\nAku bisa mengenang perasaan-perasaan itu nanti.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Kind01_005
Array.english: There's so much in this village that can inspire you.
Array.indonesia: Ada begitu banyak hal di desa ini yang bisa menginspirasimu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Kind01_006
Array.english: Like bananas... or tilapia...
Array.indonesia: Seperti pisang... atau ikan nila...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Kind01_007
Array.english: Mm... yes. Even food can be... a source of inspiration...
Array.indonesia: Mm... ya. Bahkan makanan pun bisa menjadi... sumber inspirasi...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_InfoTalk01_001
Array.english: It's a bit hard to get <color=#FF73C3>Novels</color> here in the village.
Array.indonesia: Agak sulit mendapatkan <color=#FF73C3>Novel</color> di desa ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_InfoTalk01_002
Array.english: Hmm. I'd imagine so...\nYou said reading's your hobby?
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Kurasa begitu...\nKamu bilang membaca adalah hobimu?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_InfoTalk01_003
Array.english: Yes. I really love this village, but...
Array.indonesia: Ya. Aku sangat menyukai desa ini, tapi...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_InfoTalk01_004
Array.english: There's nothing better than <color=#FF73C3>Novels</color> for experiencing other worlds.
Array.indonesia: Tidak ada yang lebih baik daripada <color=#FF73C3>Novel</color> untuk menjelajahi dunia lain.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_InfoTalk01_005
Array.english: I don't really read anything besides comics...\nAren't comics more fun?
Array.indonesia: Aku sebenarnya nggak pernah baca apa-apa selain komik...\nBukankah komik lebih seru?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_InfoTalk01_006
Array.english: But text-only stimulates the imagination more.\nWith pictures, there's... less room to imagine.
Array.indonesia: Tapi teks saja lebih merangsang imajinasi.\nKalau ada gambarnya, ruang untuk berimajinasi jadi... lebih sedikit.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_InfoTalk01_007
Array.english: Come to think of it, you're always writing something.\nDo you write novels yourself?
Array.indonesia: Kalau dipikir-pikir, kamu selalu menulis sesuatu.\nApakah kamu menulis novel sendiri?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_InfoTalk01_008
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, no! I'm not skilled enough to write novels... I just jot down my feelings in a <color=#FF73C3>Notebook</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, tidak! Aku belum cukup terampil untuk menulis novel... Aku hanya mencatat perasaanku di <color=#FF73C3>Buku Catatan</color>!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_InfoTalk01_009
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(I bet Kinah would love it if I gave her some <color=#FF73C3>Novels</color> or <color=#FF73C3>Writing Supplies</color> as gifts. I should make a note of that.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Pasti Kinah akan senang kalau aku memberinya <color=#FF73C3>Novel</color> atau <color=#FF73C3>Perlengkapan Menulis</color> sebagai hadiah. Aku harus mencatat itu.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_NotKind01_001
Array.english: When inspiration strikes while I'm walking through the village, I write it down in my notebook.
Array.indonesia: Saat inspirasi datang saat aku berjalan-jalan di desa, aku menuliskannya di buku catatanku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_NotKind01_002
Array.english: A hibiscus blooming crimson, bathed in red sunlight...\nIt's like...
Array.indonesia: Bunga kembang sepatu yang mekar merah tua, diterangi sinar matahari merah...\nRasanya seperti...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_NotKind01_003
Array.english: ...a bearded ma...
Array.indonesia: ...a pria berjanggut...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_NotKind01_004
Array.english: <size=32>...Sorry, but I'm having trouble concentrating... Could you give me some space...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>...Sorry, tapi aku kesulitan berkonsentrasi... Bisakah kamu memberi aku sedikit ruang...?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_NotKind02_001
Array.english: I used to gaze at the lake and come up with poetic ideas...
Array.indonesia: Dulu aku sering memandangi danau dan mendapatkan ide-ide puitis...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_NotKind02_002
Array.english: But lately, it's gotten so murky, which is a shame.
Array.indonesia: Tapi belakangan ini, airnya jadi sangat keruh, sayang sekali.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_NotKind02_003
Array.english: There are really amazing things in the water.\nTurning them into poetry sounds fun.
Array.indonesia: Ada hal-hal yang benar-benar menakjubkan di dalam air.\nMengubahnya menjadi puisi terdengar seru.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_NotKind02_004
Array.english: If you find anything interesting, let me know.
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu menemukan sesuatu yang menarik, beri tahu aku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_NotKind03_001
Array.english: A figure fallen cold, crossing through the rift in time\nEven its sharp teeth are slowly growing dull
Array.indonesia: Sebuah sosok yang sudah dingin, melintasi celah waktu\nBahkan giginya yang tajam pun perlahan menjadi tumpul

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_NotKind03_002
Array.english: Oh, Dave. I was just trying to write a poem about the dinosaur on Lake Beach.
Array.indonesia: Oh, Dave. Aku hanya mencoba menulis puisi tentang dinosaurus di Lake Beach.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_NotKind03_003
Array.english: If I'd seen it alive, I'd have been scared, but...\nnow it just looks a bit pitiful.
Array.indonesia: Kalau aku melihatnya saat masih hidup, aku pasti akan takut, tapi...\nsekarang dia justru terlihat agak menyedihkan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_NotKind03_004
Array.english: True, it probably didn't want to come here either.
Array.indonesia: Benar, mungkin dia juga tidak ingin datang ke sini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_InfoTalk02_001
Array.english: Is there any particular fish from this region you especially like?
Array.indonesia: Adakah ikan tertentu dari daerah ini yang sangat kamu sukai?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_InfoTalk02_002
Array.english: Ah... actually, there's a fish I absolutely love...\nand it has a rather romantic name.
Array.indonesia: Ah... sebenarnya, ada ikan yang sangat aku sukai...\ndan namanya cukup romantis.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_InfoTalk02_003
Array.english: It's called <color=#FF73C3>Moonlight Gourami</color>... True to its name, \nits body shines with a silver moonlight.
Array.indonesia: Namanya <color=#FF73C3>Moonlight Gourami</color>... Sesuai namanya, \ntubuhnya bersinar seperti cahaya bulan perak.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_InfoTalk02_004
Array.english: It's a small fish, but its flavor spreads gently and subtly in your mouth, like moonlight.
Array.indonesia: Ikan ini kecil, tapi rasanya menyebar dengan lembut dan halus di mulutmu, seperti cahaya bulan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_InfoTalk02_005
Array.english: Basu caught one <color=#F1DC2B>Fishing</color> before...\nI can't forget the taste.
Array.indonesia: Basu pernah menangkap satu ekor <color=#F1DC2B>saat memancing</color>...\nAku tak bisa melupakan rasanya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_InfoTalk02_006
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(So she loves the <color=#FF73C3>Moonlight Gourami</color>, which you can catch by fishing. I should catch one and serve it to her.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Jadi dia menyukai <color=#FF73C3>Moonlight Gourami</color>, yang bisa kamu tangkap dengan memancing. Aku harus menangkap satu dan menyajikannya untuknya.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Kind01_001
Array.english: The sky feels especially clear here.
Array.indonesia: Langit terasa sangat jernih di sini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Kind01_002
Array.english: Hehe, if you watch the flow of the sky, you can glimpse the future.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, jika kau mengamati aliran langit, kau bisa melihat sekilas masa depan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Kind01_003
Array.english: What we humans can do is very small.
Array.indonesia: Apa yang bisa kita lakukan sebagai manusia sangatlah kecil.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Kind01_004
Array.english: We simply follow the greater flow... and prepare what we can.
Array.indonesia: Kita hanya mengikuti aliran yang lebih besar... dan mempersiapkan apa yang bisa kita lakukan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Kind01_005
Array.english: Just like bees sensing the bloom of flowers and preparing for spring.
Array.indonesia: Sama seperti lebah yang merasakan mekarnya bunga dan bersiap menyambut musim semi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Kind02_001
Array.english: So many strange things have been happening lately...
Array.indonesia: Begitu banyak hal aneh yang terjadi belakangan ini...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Kind02_002
Array.english: I've been watching the movement of the stars closely.
Array.indonesia: Aku telah mengamati pergerakan bintang-bintang dengan saksama.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Kind02_003
Array.english: Based on their current positions... it does read as a <color=#1DFEAF>Crisis</color>, but...
Array.indonesia: Berdasarkan posisi mereka saat ini... memang terlihat seperti <color=#1DFEAF>Krisis</color>, tapi...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Kind02_004
Array.english: a great comet, one that can be seen as <color=#1DFEAF>Hope</color>,\npassed by not long ago.
Array.indonesia: sebuah komet besar, yang dapat dipandang sebagai <color=#1DFEAF>Harapan</color>,\ntelah melintas belum lama ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Kind02_005
Array.english: Perhaps... that comet was a sign of you all, hehe.
Array.indonesia: Mungkin... komet itu adalah pertanda dari kalian semua, hehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_InfoTalk01_001
Array.english: Ms. Meilan, is there a flower you especially like?
Array.indonesia: Nona Meilan, adakah bunga yang sangat kamu sukai?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_InfoTalk01_002
Array.english: Hoho, every flower in the village is beautiful.
Array.indonesia: Hoho, setiap bunga di desa ini indah.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_InfoTalk01_003
Array.english: Watching them bloom with life each day brings me great joy.
Array.indonesia: Melihat mereka mekar dengan penuh kehidupan setiap hari membuatku sangat bahagia.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_InfoTalk01_004
Array.english: But the <color=#FF73C3>Hibiscus</color> that blooms near Surga Falls...\nI rarely get to see it, which is a shame.
Array.indonesia: Tapi <color=#FF73C3>Hibiscus</color> yang mekar di dekat Air Terjun Surga...\nAku jarang bisa melihatnya, sayang sekali.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_InfoTalk01_005
Array.english: That flower has no scent, so unless you see it yourself, you cannot truly feel its presence.
Array.indonesia: Bunga itu tidak berbau, jadi kecuali kamu melihatnya sendiri, kamu tidak bisa benar-benar merasakan kehadirannya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_InfoTalk01_006
Array.english: These old bones make the journey to <color=#1DFEAF>Surga Falls</color> quite far... So I can only admire it from afar.
Array.indonesia: Tubuh tua ini merasa perjalanan ke <color=#1DFEAF>Air Terjun Surga</color> cukup jauh... Jadi aku hanya bisa mengaguminya dari kejauhan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_InfoTalk01_007
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Ms. Meilan wishes to see the <color=#FF73C3>Hibiscus</color>.\nI should make a note of that.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Nona Meilan ingin melihat <color=#FF73C3>Hibiscus</color>.\nAku harus mencatatnya.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_NotKind01_001
Array.english: Grandma, you really love flowers, don't you?
Array.indonesia: Nenek, kamu benar-benar menyukai bunga, bukan?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_NotKind01_002
Array.english: Flowers are a gift from nature. They share their fragrance and nectar for a brief time, then return to the earth.
Array.indonesia: Bunga adalah anugerah dari alam. Mereka membagikan aroma dan nektar mereka untuk waktu yang singkat, lalu kembali ke tanah.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_NotKind01_003
Array.english: And in time, they wait to bloom once more.
Array.indonesia: Dan pada waktunya, mereka menunggu untuk mekar sekali lagi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_NotKind01_004
Array.english: Now that you mention it, that's true. I just thought they were pretty plants.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang kau menyebutkannya, itu benar. Aku hanya mengira mereka adalah tanaman yang cantik.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_NotKind01_005
Array.english: Hehe, our lives may seem long, but they are not.\nWe should always live with a giving heart.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, hidup kita mungkin tampak panjang, tapi sebenarnya tidak.\nKita harus selalu hidup dengan hati yang dermawan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_NotKind02_001
Array.english: I heard the person with you is a chef...?
Array.indonesia: Aku dengar orang yang bersamamu adalah seorang koki...?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_NotKind02_002
Array.english: Yes. Bancho is a chef who explores flavors from all kinds of ingredients across the world.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Bancho adalah seorang koki yang mengeksplorasi cita rasa dari berbagai macam bahan makanan di seluruh dunia.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_NotKind02_003
Array.english: He is probably studying the ingredients of this jungle right now too!
Array.indonesia: Dia mungkin sedang mempelajari bahan-bahan dari hutan ini juga saat ini!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_NotKind02_004
Array.english: Hehe, every gift of nature has its own unique flavor.\nExploring them is a meaningful pursuit.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, setiap karunia alam memiliki cita rasa yang unik.\nMengeksplorasi semuanya adalah upaya yang bermakna.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_NotKind02_005
Array.english: But do not forget that we are part of it as well,\nand always be grateful.
Array.indonesia: Tapi jangan lupa bahwa kita juga merupakan bagian darinya,\ndan selalu bersyukurlah.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_NotKind03_001
Array.english: Did you say you read fortunes?
Array.indonesia: Apakah kamu bilang bisa meramal nasib?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_NotKind03_002
Array.english: It is a small skill my mother taught me. If you follow the flow of nature, you can sense the direction.
Array.indonesia: Itu adalah keterampilan kecil yang diajarkan ibuku. Jika kamu mengikuti aliran alam, kamu bisa merasakan arahnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_NotKind03_003
Array.english: Of course, it is not always accurate.
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja, itu tidak selalu akurat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_NotKind03_004
Array.english: Perhaps it is because I have grown old...\nbut it seems even less so these days.
Array.indonesia: Mungkin karena aku sudah tua...\ntapi belakangan ini sepertinya semakin kurang akurat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_InfoTalk02_001
Array.english: That would be <color=#FF73C3>Mangosteen</color>, hehe.
Array.indonesia: Itu pasti <color=#FF73C3>Mangosteen</color>, hehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_InfoTalk02_002
Array.english: Oh... I love <color=#FF73C3>Mangosteen</color> too! It is a fruit, but it melts in your mouth like jelly. Truly delightful.
Array.indonesia: Oh... Aku juga suka <color=#FF73C3>Mangosteen</color>! Itu buah, tapi meleleh di mulut seperti jeli. Benar-benar nikmat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_InfoTalk02_003
Array.english: Hehehe, I see.\nSo it is well known among outsiders as well.
Array.indonesia: Hehehe, begitu ya.\nJadi, buah ini juga terkenal di kalangan orang luar.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_InfoTalk02_004
Array.english: But... sadly, <color=#FF73C3>Mangosteen</color> only grows near the waterfall at Lake Beach.
Array.indonesia: Tapi... sayangnya, <color=#FF73C3>Mangosteen</color> hanya tumbuh di dekat air terjun di Lake Beach.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_InfoTalk02_005
Array.english: It is a bit too far for me to travel...\nso I rarely get to enjoy it.
Array.indonesia: Jaraknya agak terlalu jauh buat aku...\njadi aku jarang bisa menikmatinya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_InfoTalk02_006
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(If I manage to get some <color=#FF73C3>Mangosteen</color>, I should prepare something for her.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Kalau aku berhasil mendapatkan <color=#FF73C3>mangosteen</color>, aku harus menyiapkan sesuatu untuknya.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Kind01_001
Array.english: Oh... I was just about to get a great musical idea.
Array.indonesia: Oh... aku baru saja hampir mendapatkan ide musik yang hebat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Kind01_002
Array.english: Really? What kind of song were you working on?
Array.indonesia: Benarkah? Lagu seperti apa yang sedang kamu kerjakan?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Kind01_003
Array.english: I was imagining eight black bears dancing in a trance inside a dark cave.
Array.indonesia: Aku membayangkan delapan beruang hitam menari dalam keadaan trance di dalam gua yang gelap.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Kind01_004
Array.english: <size=33>Uh... right. That's... quite something.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Uh... oke. Itu... cukup unik.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Kind01_005
Array.english: It's the kind of song people in the city could never come up with. Hehe.
Array.indonesia: Itu jenis lagu yang orang-orang di kota tidak akan pernah bisa pikirkan. Hehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Kind02_001
Array.english: No... this song's too predictable...
Array.indonesia: Tidak... lagu ini terlalu mudah ditebak...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Kind02_002
Array.english: I need something fresh, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Aku butuh sesuatu yang segar, Dave.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Kind02_003
Array.english: Hey... could you get bitten by a crocodile and tell me what it feels like?
Array.indonesia: Hei... bisakah kamu digigit buaya dan ceritakan padaku bagaimana rasanya?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Kind02_004
Array.english: <size=33>What kind of request is that...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Permintaan macam apa itu...?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Kind02_005
Array.english: If I get bitten myself, I won't be able to finish the song...
Array.indonesia: Kalau aku sendiri yang digigit, aku nggak bakal bisa menyelesaikan lagu ini...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Kind03_001
Array.english: I heard there are a lot of talented musicians in the city.
Array.indonesia: Aku dengar ada banyak musisi berbakat di kota itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Kind03_002
Array.english: Yeah. But honestly, someone at your level would do just fine there.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Tapi jujur saja, seseorang sekelas kamu pasti bisa beradaptasi dengan baik di sana.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Kind03_003
Array.english: Hmm. I'd love to play with them someday.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Aku ingin sekali bermain bersama mereka suatu hari nanti.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Kind03_004
Array.english: I'd definitely come watch.
Array.indonesia: Aku pasti akan datang menonton.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_InfoTalk01_001
Array.english: <size=32>The only thing I care about is music.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Satu-satunya hal yang aku pedulikan adalah musik.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_InfoTalk01_002
Array.english: These beautiful Panting melodies...
Array.indonesia: Melodi-melodi Panting yang indah ini...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_InfoTalk01_003
Array.english: And <color=#FF73C3>Earphones</color> that shut out the world...
Array.indonesia: Dan <color=#FF73C3>earphone</color> yang mengisolasi dari dunia luar...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_InfoTalk01_004
Array.english: Come to think of it, I heard there are ones that block out all ambient noise these days...
Array.indonesia: Kalau dipikir-pikir, aku dengar sekarang ada earphone yang bisa memblokir semua suara sekitar...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_InfoTalk01_005
Array.english: With something like that, I could really focus on my music.
Array.indonesia: Dengan barang seperti itu, aku bisa benar-benar fokus pada musikku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_InfoTalk01_006
Array.english: Sometimes the birds and monkeys totally break my concentration...
Array.indonesia: Kadang-kadang suara burung dan monyet benar-benar mengganggu konsentrasiku...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_InfoTalk01_007
