Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Is he talking about <color=#FF73C3>Noise-Canceling Earphones</color>...?\nThat might make a good gift for Jaka.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Apakah dia sedang membicarakan <color=#FF73C3>Earphone Peredam Kebisingan</color>...?\nItu mungkin bisa jadi hadiah yang bagus untuk Jaka.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_NotKind01_001
Array.english: Ah... I was just about to come up with something great... and then you talked to me and broke my flow.
Array.indonesia: Ah... Aku baru saja mau memikirkan sesuatu yang hebat... tapi kamu malah ngobrol denganku dan mengganggu alur pikiranku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_NotKind01_002
Array.english: Adults who don't understand art are always like this...\nSo thoughtless...
Array.indonesia: Orang dewasa yang nggak ngerti seni selalu kayak gini...\nSungguh nggak peka...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_NotKind02_001
Array.english: I heard people lose their artistic sense once they become adults...
Array.indonesia: Aku dengar orang-orang kehilangan selera seninya begitu mereka dewasa...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_NotKind02_002
Array.english: That's not always true. There are plenty of incredible older musicians.
Array.indonesia: Itu tidak selalu benar. Ada banyak musisi senior yang luar biasa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_NotKind02_003
Array.english: Ugh... my mom says stuff like that too.\nShe just doesn't get art.
Array.indonesia: Ugh... ibuku juga sering ngomong gitu.\nDia memang nggak paham seni.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_NotKind02_004
Array.english: She's probably just worried about you...
Array.indonesia: Dia mungkin cuma khawatir sama kamu...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_NotKind02_005
Array.english: You're saying the exact same thing. Sigh.
Array.indonesia: Kamu ngomongnya persis sama. Huh.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_NotKind03_001
Array.english: My coming-of-age ceremony's coming up...\nUgh... I really don't wanna do it.
Array.indonesia: Upacara kedewasaan aku sebentar lagi...\nUgh... Aku benar-benar nggak mau melakukannya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_NotKind03_002
Array.english: Huh? Isn't being an adult better? You can drink beer whenever you want and all.
Array.indonesia: Hah? Bukankah jadi dewasa itu lebih baik? Kamu bisa minum bir kapan saja dan sebagainya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_NotKind03_003
Array.english: In this village, they get tattoos during the coming-of-age ceremony.
Array.indonesia: Di desa ini, mereka ditato selama upacara kedewasaan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_NotKind03_004
Array.english: Ugh... just looking at it makes it seem painful...
Array.indonesia: Ugh... cuma lihat aja udah kelihatan sakit...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_NotKind03_005
Array.english: Ah... yeah, I get why you'd be worried. But it's tradition, so you can't really avoid it, right?
Array.indonesia: Ah... iya, aku ngerti kenapa kamu khawatir. Tapi ini tradisi, jadi nggak bisa dihindari, kan?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_NotKind03_006
Array.english: I can't become a real musician if I just follow traditions!
Array.indonesia: Aku nggak bisa jadi musisi sejati kalau cuma ngikutin tradisi!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_NotKind03_007
Array.english: <size=34>I refuse to become an adult!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku menolak jadi dewasa!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_NotKind03_008
Array.english: What are you even talking about...?
Array.indonesia: Apa sih yang kamu bicarakan...?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_Kind01_001
Array.english: Dave, have you ever felt true anger?
Array.indonesia: Dave, pernahkah kamu merasakan kemarahan yang sesungguhnya?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_Kind01_002
Array.english: Hmm... yeah. I think I did once, when I saw pirates capturing dolphins.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... ya. Kurasa pernah sekali, saat aku melihat bajak laut menangkap lumba-lumba.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_Kind01_003
Array.english: <size=33>Excellent! Anger is the source of inspiration!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Bagus sekali! Kemarahan adalah sumber inspirasi!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_Kind01_004
Array.english: <size=32>Channel that boiling emotion and let it out!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Salurkan emosi yang mendidih itu dan keluarkan!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_Kind01_005
Array.english: <size=37>Ugh!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Ugh!!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_Kind01_006
Array.english: ...Like this?
Array.indonesia: ...Seperti ini?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_Kind01_007
Array.english: ...Hmm... Guess expressing emotions takes talent too...
Array.indonesia: ...Hmm... Sepertinya mengekspresikan emosi juga butuh bakat...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_Kind01_008
Array.english: <size=45>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=45>...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_Kind02_001
Array.english: Dave. Now that I think about it, the drum you played at my coming-of-age ceremony...
Array.indonesia: Dave. Sekarang kalau dipikir-pikir, drum yang kamu mainkan di upacara kedewasaan aku...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_Kind02_002
Array.english: <size=33>It wasn't bad.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Itu lumayan.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_Kind02_003
Array.english: Oh... really? That's good to hear.
Array.indonesia: Oh... beneran? Senang mendengarnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_Kind02_004
Array.english: Maybe you've got a hidden talent for music?
Array.indonesia: Mungkin kamu punya bakat tersembunyi di bidang musik?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_Kind02_005
Array.english: Come to think of it, I did get some praise when I was learning piano as a kid.
Array.indonesia: Kalau dipikir-pikir, aku memang pernah mendapat pujian saat belajar piano waktu kecil.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_Kind02_006
Array.english: If you'd kept at it, you'd probably be an amazing musician by now!
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu terus melanjutkannya, mungkin sekarang kamu sudah jadi musisi yang hebat!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_Kind02_007
Array.english: <size=35>Dave the Musician!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Dave si Musisi!!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_Kind02_008
Array.english: ...Right?
Array.indonesia: ...Benar, kan?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_Kind02_009
Array.english: Oh... that actually sounds kind of cool.\nMaybe I'll pick it up again when I get back. Hehe.
Array.indonesia: Oh... kedengarannya cukup keren, sih.\nMungkin aku akan memulainya lagi nanti setelah pulang. Hehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_InfoTalk01_001
Array.english: Hmm... favorite food, huh...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... makanan favorit, ya...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_InfoTalk01_002
Array.english: I don't really like talking about my dad, but...
Array.indonesia: Aku sebenarnya nggak terlalu suka membicarakan ayahku, tapi...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_InfoTalk01_003
Array.english: When I was little, he used to catch <color=#FF73C3>Largemouth Bass</color> and cook it for me.
Array.indonesia: Dulu waktu aku masih kecil, dia sering menangkap <color=#FF73C3>Largemouth Bass</color> dan memasaknya untukku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_InfoTalk01_004
Array.english: But <color=#FF73C3>Largemouth Bass</color> can have a muddy taste...
Array.indonesia: Tapi <color=#FF73C3>Largemouth Bass</color> bisa terasa seperti lumpur...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_InfoTalk01_005
Array.english: I've tried it in other places, but it doesn't quite taste like the way he made it. Woo.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah mencobanya di tempat lain, tapi rasanya nggak persis seperti yang dia buat. Woo.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_InfoTalk01_006
Array.english: <size=32>Not that I miss him or anything!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Bukan berarti aku merindukannya atau apa!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_InfoTalk01_007
Array.english: Still... I do crave <color=#FF73C3>Largemouth Bass</color> dishes sometimes.\nWoohoo.
Array.indonesia: Meski begitu... kadang-kadang aku memang ngidam masakan <color=#FF73C3>Largemouth Bass</color>.\nWoohoo.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_InfoTalk01_008
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm. I bet Bancho could cook <color=#FF73C3>Largemouth Bass</color> without that muddy taste. I should make a note of that.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm. Aku yakin Bancho bisa memasak <color=#FF73C3>Largemouth Bass</color> tanpa rasa lumpur itu. Aku harus mencatat itu.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_InfoTalk02_001
Array.english: <size=32>The only thing I care about is music!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Satu-satunya hal yang aku pedulikan adalah musik!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_InfoTalk02_002
Array.english: These beautiful Panting melodies...\nyeah.
Array.indonesia: Melodi-melodi Panting yang indah ini...\nya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_InfoTalk02_003
Array.english: And these <color=#FF73C3>Earphones</color> that shut out the world...\nyeah.
Array.indonesia: Dan <color=#FF73C3>Earphone</color> ini yang menghalangi suara dunia luar...\nya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_InfoTalk02_004
Array.english: Come to think of it, I heard there are earphones that block out ambient noise these days...
Array.indonesia: Kalau dipikir-pikir, aku dengar sekarang ada earphone yang bisa menghalangi kebisingan sekitar...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_InfoTalk02_005
Array.english: With something like that, I could really focus on the music. Wow.
Array.indonesia: Dengan barang seperti itu, aku bisa benar-benar fokus pada musik. Wow.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_InfoTalk02_006
Array.english: Sometimes the birds and monkeys break my concentration...
Array.indonesia: Kadang-kadang suara burung dan monyet mengganggu konsentrasiku...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_InfoTalk02_007
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Is he talking about <color=#FF73C3>Noise-Canceling Earphones</color>...?\nThat might be a good gift for Jaka.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Apakah dia sedang membicarakan <color=#FF73C3>Earphone Peredam Kebisingan</color>...?\nItu mungkin bisa jadi hadiah yang bagus untuk Jaka.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_NotKind01_001
Array.english: Hmm? Did you come over because my playing was bothering you?
Array.indonesia: Hmm? Apa kamu datang ke sini karena permainan musikku mengganggumu?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_NotKind01_002
Array.english: No? That's not it.
Array.indonesia: Tidak? Bukan itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_NotKind01_003
Array.english: I see... that's a relief.
Array.indonesia: Begitu... syukurlah.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_NotKind01_004
Array.english: <size=33>When I'm in the zone, I don't really notice anything around me. Woo!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Saat aku sedang asyik bermain, aku nggak terlalu memperhatikan apa pun di sekitarku. Woo!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_NotKind02_001
Array.english: <size=32>I feel like my inspiration's flowing even more after getting this tattoo! Wow!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku merasa inspirasiku mengalir lebih deras setelah membuat tato ini! Wow!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_NotKind02_002
Array.english: Glad to hear it. Didn't it hurt?
Array.indonesia: Senang mendengarnya. Apakah tidak sakit?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_NotKind02_003
Array.english: Of course it did! But...
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja sakit! Tapi...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_NotKind02_004
Array.english: <size=33>Pain is a source of inspiration too.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Rasa sakit juga bisa jadi sumber inspirasi.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManAfter_NotKind02_005
Array.english: <size=33>I need to turn this explosive inspiration into music right away! Woohoo!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku harus segera mengubah inspirasi yang meledak-ledak ini menjadi musik! Woohoo!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_NotKind01_001
Array.english: <size=33>Outsider... You're not here for some ulterior motive... are you?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Orang luar... Kamu nggak di sini karena ada motif tersembunyi... kan?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_NotKind01_002
Array.english: <size=35>What... what are you talking about?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Apa... apa maksudmu?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_NotKind01_003
Array.english: <size=32>Like trying to find yourself a lover...\nor something like that.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Seperti mencoba mencari pasangan...\natau semacamnya.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_NotKind01_004
Array.english: <size=34>What kind of nonsense is that...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Omong kosong apa itu...?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_NotKind01_005
Array.english: <size=34>Well... good. Glad that's not the case.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Baiklah... bagus. Senang mendengar itu bukan masalahnya.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_NotKind01_006
Array.english: <size=32>People always treat others like objects of desire!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Orang-orang selalu memperlakukan orang lain seperti objek nafsu!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_NotKind01_007
Array.english: Especially city folks, always chasing pleasure...\nI can't trust them.
Array.indonesia: Terutama orang kota, selalu mengejar kesenangan...\nAku tidak bisa mempercayai mereka.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_NotKind01_008
Array.english: Umm... you're the one jumping to weird conclusions here...
Array.indonesia: Umm... kamu lah yang langsung menarik kesimpulan aneh di sini...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_NotKind02_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh my! What exactly do you think you're looking at?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Astaga! Apa sebenarnya yang kamu pikir sedang kamu lihat?!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_NotKind02_002
Array.english: <size=35>What?! You were staring so intensely, I just glanced down!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Apa?! Kamu menatap begitu intens, jadi aku cuma melirik ke bawah!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_NotKind02_003
Array.english: Hmph... I won't tolerate that kind of behavior in this village.
Array.indonesia: Hmph... Aku tidak akan mentolerir perilaku seperti itu di desa ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_NotKind02_004
Array.english: Especially not toward me. I don't make exceptions,\nso watch yourself.
Array.indonesia: Apalagi terhadapku. Aku tidak membuat pengecualian,\njadi hati-hati.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_NotKind03_001
Array.english: I'm not sure what you're trying to say, but...\nlet's be honest.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak yakin apa yang ingin kamu katakan, tapi...\njujur saja.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_NotKind03_002
Array.english: <size=33>If I weren't this attractive, would you even have come up to me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kalau aku tidak se-menarik ini, apakah kamu akan mendekatiku?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_NotKind03_003
Array.english: <size=34>What's that supposed to mean...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Apa maksudnya itu...?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_NotKind03_004
Array.english: HOW!EV!ER!\nLooks are only skin-deep.
Array.indonesia: TAPI! BAGAIMANA PUN!\nPenampilan hanyalah kulit luar.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_NotKind03_005
Array.english: We all have dignity within.\nYou need to learn to see that.
Array.indonesia: Kita semua memiliki martabat di dalam diri.\nKamu harus belajar melihat hal itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_NotKind03_006
Array.english: Yeah... I think so too...?
Array.indonesia: Ya... Aku juga berpikir begitu...?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_NotKind03_007
Array.english: <size=32>Saying one thing and doing another... This is exactly why I can't trust outsiders!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Berbicara satu hal tapi melakukan hal lain... Inilah tepatnya mengapa aku tidak bisa mempercayai orang luar!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_NotKind03_008
Array.english: <size=34>...Sigh.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>...Sigh.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_InfoTalk01_001
Array.english: <size=34>Ah... Rover...<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ah... Rover...<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_InfoTalk01_002
Array.english: Huh? What are you looking at?
Array.indonesia: Hah? Apa yang kamu lihat?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_InfoTalk01_003
Array.english: Ah... the sudden sound of soul-crushing reality...
Array.indonesia: Ah... suara kenyataan yang menghancurkan jiwa yang tiba-tiba...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_InfoTalk01_004
Array.english: This is <color=#FF73C3>Rover</color>. He is the one who will save the world from Threnodian.
Array.indonesia: Ini adalah <color=#FF73C3>Rover</color>. Dialah yang akan menyelamatkan dunia dari Threnodian.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_InfoTalk01_005
Array.english: Hmm... he doesn't look all that strong. \nCan he really save the world?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... dia tidak terlihat begitu kuat. \nApakah dia benar-benar bisa menyelamatkan dunia?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_InfoTalk01_006
Array.english: Hah! What blasphemy! \n<color=#FF73C3>Rover</color> sacrificed even his memories to save the world...
Array.indonesia: Hah! Itu penghujatan! \n<color=#FF73C3>Rover</color> bahkan mengorbankan ingatannya demi menyelamatkan dunia...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_InfoTalk01_007
Array.english: He is a beautiful, benevolent being, far beyond lowly mortals.
Array.indonesia: Dia adalah makhluk yang indah dan penuh kebaikan, jauh melampaui manusia biasa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_InfoTalk01_008
Array.english: I see. Still, I'm surprised they're even selling merch.
Array.indonesia: Begitu ya. Tapi, aku tetap kaget mereka sampai-sampai menjual merchandise.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_InfoTalk01_009
Array.english: <size=32>Collecting traces of <color=#FF73C3>Rover</color> helps you resonate more deeply with him.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Mengumpulkan jejak-jejak <color=#FF73C3>Rover</color> membantumu merasakan ikatan yang lebih dalam dengannya.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_InfoTalk01_010
Array.english:
So... if you see anything with <color=#FF73C3>Rover</color>'s image on it,
let me know.
Array.indonesia:
Jadi... kalau kamu melihat sesuatu yang bergambar <color=#FF73C3>Rover</color>,
beri tahu aku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_InfoTalk01_011
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm. Looks like Bonita collects <color=#FF73C3>Rover</color> merch.\nI should make a note of that.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm. Sepertinya Bonita mengoleksi merchandise <color=#FF73C3>Rover</color>.\nAku harus mencatat itu.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Kind01_001
Array.english: About the food at the shop...
Array.indonesia: Soal makanan di toko itu...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Kind01_002
Array.english: <size=32>It's not bad, I suppose.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Cuma lumayan, kurasa.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Kind01_003
Array.english: Oh... hearing that from you means a lot, Bonita.
Array.indonesia: Oh... mendengar itu darimu sangat berarti, Bonita.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Kind01_004
Array.english: But... I do think it's a bit too heavy on the spices and sugar...
Array.indonesia: Tapi... menurutku bumbu dan gulanya agak terlalu banyak...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Kind01_005
Array.english: That just adds calories, and it's not exactly good for your health.
Array.indonesia: Itu hanya menambah kalori, dan tidak terlalu baik untuk kesehatanmu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Kind01_006
Array.english: Bancho's the kind of guy who focuses more on flavor...
Array.indonesia: Bancho adalah tipe orang yang lebih mementingkan rasa...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Kind01_007
Array.english: What you eat shapes your body, you know.
Array.indonesia: Apa yang kamu makan membentuk tubuhmu, lho.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Kind01_008
Array.english: If you'd like to see me at the shop more often,\nyou might want to keep that in mind.
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu ingin lebih sering melihatku di toko,\nmungkin kamu perlu mengingat hal itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Kind01_009
Array.english: <size=33>...Yeah, I'll think about it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...Yeah, aku akan memikirkannya.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_InfoTalk02_001
Array.english: Hmm... that time...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... waktu itu...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_InfoTalk02_002
Array.english: That crocodile tail dish was quite good.
Array.indonesia: Hidangan ekor buaya itu cukup enak.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_InfoTalk02_003
Array.english: Hehe... Bancho's cooking is the best in the world.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... Masakan Bancho adalah yang terbaik di dunia.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_InfoTalk02_004
Array.english: <size=32>Ha! The ingredients must have been exceptional!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ha! Bahan-bahannya pasti luar biasa!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_InfoTalk02_005
Array.english: <size=32>What was that crocodile called again?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Apa nama buaya itu tadi?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_InfoTalk02_006
Array.english: It's a <color=#FF73C3>Black Caiman</color>.
Array.indonesia: Namanya <color=#FF73C3>Black Caiman</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_InfoTalk02_007
Array.english:
Right... that. If you have other dishes like that,
I may grace them with a taste.
Array.indonesia:
Benar... itu. Kalau ada hidangan lain seperti itu,
aku mungkin akan mencicipinya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_InfoTalk02_008
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Looks like she really enjoyed the tail dish last time. I should serve her some <color=#FF73C3>Black Caiman</color> meat if I get more.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Sepertinya dia benar-benar menikmati hidangan ekor itu terakhir kali. Aku harus menyajikan daging <color=#FF73C3>Buaya Hitam</color> untuknya kalau aku dapat lagi.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_NotKind01_001
Array.english: My husband really adores the children.
Array.indonesia: Suamiku sangat menyayangi anak-anak.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_NotKind01_002
Array.english: I told him he could set up his workshop near the house...
Array.indonesia: Aku bilang padanya dia boleh mendirikan bengkelnya di dekat rumah...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_NotKind01_003
Array.english: But he was worried it'd be too noisy while the kids were napping, so he built it a bit further away.
Array.indonesia: Tapi dia khawatir bakal terlalu berisik saat anak-anak tidur siang, jadi dia membangunnya agak jauh dari rumah.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_NotKind01_004
Array.english: If you have something to make from ore, you should visit the <color=#1DFEAF>Furnace</color>.
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu punya bahan yang bisa diolah dari bijih, sebaiknya kamu mampir ke <color=#1DFEAF>Tungku</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_NotKind01_005
Array.english: It's a bit embarrassing to brag about my husband,\nbut he's quite skilled, hehe
Array.indonesia: Agak malu sih membanggakan suamiku,\ntapi dia cukup terampil, hehe

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_NotKind02_001
Array.english: Oh, I heard the person who came with you is opening a restaurant here.
Array.indonesia: Oh, aku dengar orang yang datang bersamamu akan membuka restoran di sini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_NotKind02_002
Array.english: My kids do like fish dishes, but...
Array.indonesia: Anak-anakku memang suka hidangan ikan, tapi...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_NotKind02_003
Array.english: <size=33>For now, I'd still like to be the one cooking for them.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Untuk saat ini, aku masih ingin menjadi orang yang memasak untuk mereka.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_InfoTalk01_001
Array.english: Does the Chef only cook fish dishes?
Array.indonesia: Apakah Chef hanya memasak hidangan ikan?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_InfoTalk01_002
Array.english: Not at all. He's great with fruit and vegetable dishes too.
Array.indonesia: Sama sekali tidak. Dia juga jago memasak hidangan buah dan sayuran.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_InfoTalk01_003
Array.english: Oh... I see. Actually, I really love dishes made with <color=#FF73C3>Bananas</color>...
Array.indonesia: Oh... begitu. Sebenarnya, aku sangat suka hidangan yang terbuat dari <color=#FF73C3>pisang</color>...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_InfoTalk01_004
Array.english: But the kids love them so much, I always end up giving them away as snacks.
Array.indonesia: Tapi anak-anak sangat menyukainya, jadi aku selalu akhirnya memberikannya sebagai camilan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_InfoTalk01_005
Array.english: <size=33>I hope it makes it onto the menu, hehe!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Semoga masuk ke menu, hehe!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_InfoTalk01_006
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(So Omila likes dishes made with <color=#FF73C3>Bananas</color>.\nI should write that down.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Jadi Omila suka hidangan yang dibuat dengan <color=#FF73C3>pisang</color>.\nAku harus mencatatnya.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_Kind01_001
Array.english: If the kids wander off somewhere strange, please let me know.
Array.indonesia: Kalau anak-anak pergi ke tempat yang aneh, tolong beri tahu aku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_Kind01_002
Array.english: Especially my second, Saniah... she keeps showing interest in the forest...
Array.indonesia: Terutama anak keduaku, Saniah... dia terus-terusan tertarik dengan hutan...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_Kind02_001
Array.english: The food the chef makes is really delicious.
Array.indonesia: Makanan yang dibuat koki itu benar-benar lezat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_Kind02_002
Array.english: Right? Bancho's the best chef!
Array.indonesia: Benar, kan? Bancho adalah koki terbaik!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_Kind02_003
Array.english: It's the same grilled fish, but it tastes completely different from when I make it.
Array.indonesia: Ini ikan panggang yang sama, tapi rasanya benar-benar berbeda dari yang aku buat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_Kind02_004
Array.english: I should ask him his secret when I get the chance
Array.indonesia: Aku harus tanya rahasianya saat ada kesempatan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_InfoTalk02_001
Array.english: Raising children is mostly a joy, but...
Array.indonesia: Membesarkan anak-anak sebagian besar menyenangkan, tapi...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_InfoTalk02_002
Array.english: sometimes they make me angry too.
Array.indonesia: kadang-kadang mereka juga membuatku marah.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_InfoTalk02_003
Array.english: <size=34>Especially when they break my <color=#FF73C3>Dishes</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Terutama saat mereka memecahkan <color=#FF73C3>piring-piringku</color>.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_InfoTalk02_004
Array.english: Just the other day, Eka was fooling around and broke one of my favorite <color=#FF73C3>Dishes</color>... I really scolded him.
Array.indonesia: Baru-baru ini, Eka sedang iseng-iseng dan memecahkan salah satu <color=#FF73C3>piring</color> favoritku... Aku benar-benar memarahinya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_InfoTalk02_005
Array.english: I've always loved collecting pretty <color=#FF73C3>Dishes</color>,\nso I guess I got a bit sensitive about it.
Array.indonesia: Aku selalu suka mengoleksi <color=#FF73C3>piring</color> yang cantik,\n jadi mungkin aku jadi sedikit sensitif soal itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_InfoTalk02_006
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Maybe I should get her a nice <color=#FF73C3>Dish</color> as a gift?)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Mungkin aku harus membelikannya <color=#FF73C3>piring</color> yang bagus sebagai hadiah?)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_Kind01_001
Array.english: Seeing the kids run around always brings me joy.
Array.indonesia: Melihat anak-anak berlari-lari selalu membuatku bahagia.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_Kind01_002
Array.english: Saniah and Eka...\nThey're both such sweet, pure kids.
Array.indonesia: Saniah dan Eka...\nKeduanya adalah anak-anak yang manis dan polos.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_Kind01_003
Array.english: And Bima too, of course.
Array.indonesia: Dan Bima juga, tentu saja.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_Kind01_004
Array.english: Harta...\nI just wish he'd take better care of Bima...
Array.indonesia: Harta...\nAku hanya berharap dia bisa lebih memperhatikan Bima...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_Kind01_005
Array.english: But it's not really my place to step into another family's business.
Array.indonesia: Tapi sebenarnya bukan urusanku untuk ikut campur dalam urusan keluarga orang lain.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_Kind01_006
Array.english: I'd appreciate it if you could keep an eye on him too, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan sangat menghargainya jika kamu juga bisa mengawasinya, Dave.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_InfoTalk01_001
Array.english: You really seem to enjoy playing with the kids, Perak.
Array.indonesia: Kamu sepertinya benar-benar menikmati bermain dengan anak-anak, Perak.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_InfoTalk01_002
Array.english: Haha, I do. Even after a long day, playing with them helps me forget all about it.
Array.indonesia: Haha, iya. Bahkan setelah hari yang panjang, bermain dengan mereka membantuku melupakan semua kelelahan itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_InfoTalk01_003
Array.english: Saniah's easy to play with, she just needs dolls or toys...
Array.indonesia: Saniah mudah diajak bermain, dia hanya butuh boneka atau mainan...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_InfoTalk01_004
Array.english: <size=33>But Eka's a handful since he's into games and comics.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tapi Eka itu susah diatur karena dia suka main game dan komik.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_InfoTalk01_005
Array.english: Games and comics aren't necessarily a bad thing, are they?
Array.indonesia: Game dan komik tidak selalu hal yang buruk, kan?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_InfoTalk01_006
Array.english: Haha, you're right. Still, exercise is better for their health.
Array.indonesia: Haha, kamu benar. Tapi, olahraga lebih baik untuk kesehatan mereka.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_InfoTalk01_007
Array.english: I used to play <color=#FF73C3>Ball</color> with him...\nbut it broke.
Array.indonesia: Dulu aku sering bermain <color=#FF73C3>Bola</color> dengannya...\ntapi bolanya rusak.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_InfoTalk01_008
Array.english: And it's not easy to get a new <color=#FF73C3>Ball</color> in this village.
Array.indonesia: Dan tidak mudah mendapatkan <color=#FF73C3>Bola</color> baru di desa ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_InfoTalk01_009
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(He'd be so happy if I gave him a new <color=#FF73C3>Ball</color> to play with Eka.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Dia pasti akan sangat senang kalau aku memberinya <color=#FF73C3>Ball</color> baru untuk dimainkan bersama Eka.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_NotKind01_001
Array.english: It's been harder to get ore since the boulder blocked the path to the forest.
Array.indonesia: Semakin sulit mendapatkan bijih sejak batu besar itu menghalangi jalan menuju hutan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_NotKind01_002
Array.english: If you bring me some, I'll smelt it into ingots for you.
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu membawakannya padaku, aku akan meleburnya menjadi ingot untukmu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_NotKind01_003
Array.english: <size=32>The young woman with glasses asks me several times a day if I have any ingots...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wanita muda berkacamata itu bertanya kepadaku beberapa kali sehari apakah aku punya ingot...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_NotKind01_004
Array.english: <size=33>Ah... Muna can be pretty persistent when she sets her mind to something...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ah... Muna bisa sangat gigih kalau sudah bertekad...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_NotKind01_005
Array.english: She probably needs them to upgrade the Jungle Gun.\nI'll find some and bring them to you.
Array.indonesia: Dia mungkin membutuhkannya untuk meningkatkan Jungle Gun.\nAku akan mencarinya dan membawakannya kepadamu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_InfoTalk02_001
Array.english: Perak, what kind of food do you like most?
Array.indonesia: Perak, makanan apa yang paling kamu sukai?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_InfoTalk02_002
Array.english: Ah... well, it's just...
Array.indonesia: Ah... yah, itu hanya...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_InfoTalk02_003
Array.english: Hm? What is it?
Array.indonesia: Hm? Ada apa?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_InfoTalk02_004
Array.english: It's just... it's not very common...
Array.indonesia: Hanya saja... itu tidak terlalu umum...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_InfoTalk02_005
Array.english: <size=33>I actually really like <color=#FF73C3>Snake Meat</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Sebenarnya aku sangat suka <color=#FF73C3>Daging Ular</color>.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_InfoTalk02_006
Array.english: Oh... is <color=#FF73C3>Snake Meat</color> any good?
Array.indonesia: Oh... apakah <color=#FF73C3>Daging Ular</color> enak?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_InfoTalk02_007
Array.english:
Well... it depends on the person... but to me,
it tastes like chicken, just chewier and even better.
Array.indonesia:
Yah... itu tergantung orangnya... tapi bagiku,
rasanya seperti ayam, hanya saja lebih kenyal dan bahkan lebih enak.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_InfoTalk02_008
Array.english: <size=33>And most importantly...\nit keeps you from getting tired at night!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Dan yang paling penting...\nitu bikin kamu nggak gampang capek di malam hari!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_InfoTalk02_009
Array.english: I'm pretty sure I ate snake meat the day Saniah was conceived too...
Array.indonesia: Aku cukup yakin aku juga makan daging ular pada hari Saniah dikandung...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_InfoTalk02_010
Array.english: ...I have no idea what you're talking about.
Array.indonesia: ...Aku nggak ngerti apa yang kamu bicarakan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_InfoTalk02_011
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Looks like Perak enjoys dishes made with <color=#FF73C3>Snake Meat</color>.\nI should make a note of that.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Sepertinya Perak suka hidangan yang terbuat dari <color=#FF73C3>Daging Ular</color>.\nAku harus mencatat itu.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Kind01_001
Array.english: Kids grow up so fast and drift away from their parents... That's just how it is.
Array.indonesia: Anak-anak tumbuh begitu cepat dan menjauh dari orang tua mereka... Begitulah adanya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Kind01_002
Array.english: I know that, but it still makes me a little sad sometimes.
Array.indonesia: Aku tahu itu, tapi kadang-kadang hal itu tetap membuatku sedikit sedih.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Kind01_003
Array.english: Come to think of it, I was probably like that at his age too.
Array.indonesia: Kalau dipikir-pikir, aku mungkin juga seperti itu saat seumurannya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Kind01_004
Array.english: I even dyed my hair and got my ears pierced,\ntrying to rebel.
Array.indonesia: Aku bahkan mewarnai rambut dan menindik telingaku,\nberusaha memberontak.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Kind01_005
Array.english: Oh, really?\nNow I'm curious.
Array.indonesia: Oh, beneran?\nSekarang aku jadi penasaran.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Kind01_006
Array.english: I actually have a photo...
Array.indonesia: Sebenarnya aku punya fotonya...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Kind01_007
Array.english: Ah... um...\nYou look much better now...
Array.indonesia: Ah... um...\nKamu terlihat jauh lebih baik sekarang...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_InfoTalk01_001
Array.english: When my husband was still around... my favorite time was when our whole family would play music together.
Array.indonesia: Saat suamiku masih ada... momen favoritku adalah ketika seluruh keluarga kami bermain musik bersama.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_InfoTalk01_002
Array.english: My husband was really good at the drums...\nand I used to play the <color=#FF73C3>Flute</color>.
Array.indonesia: Suamiku sangat jago bermain drum...\ndan aku dulu bermain <color=#FF73C3>seruling</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_InfoTalk01_003
Array.english: Oh... so you used to play music too, Cinta?
Array.indonesia: Oh... jadi kamu juga dulu main musik, Cinta?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_InfoTalk01_004
Array.english: Hehe... I learned from an explorer who stayed in this village when I was young.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... aku belajar dari seorang penjelajah yang tinggal di desa ini waktu aku masih kecil.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_InfoTalk01_005
Array.english: He gave me a flute before he left... so when Jaka was little, our family would often gather and play together.
Array.indonesia: Dia memberiku seruling sebelum pergi... jadi waktu Jaka masih kecil, keluarga kami sering berkumpul dan bermain musik bareng.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_InfoTalk01_006
Array.english: I'm sure the reason Jaka wants to pursue music now is because of those memories.
Array.indonesia: Aku yakin alasan Jaka ingin menekuni musik sekarang adalah karena kenangan-kenangan itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_InfoTalk01_007
Array.english: After my husband's accident... I let go of everything tied to those memories by setting them afloat on the lake...
Array.indonesia: Setelah kecelakaan suamiku... aku melepaskan segala sesuatu yang terkait dengan kenangan-kenangan itu dengan mengapungkannya di danau...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_InfoTalk01_008
Array.english: Sometimes, though, I feel like playing the <color=#FF73C3>Flute</color> again,\nhehe.
Array.indonesia: Namun, kadang-kadang, aku merasa ingin bermain <color=#FF73C3>seruling</color> lagi,\nhehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_InfoTalk01_009
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Cinta misses the days she played the <color=#FF73C3>Flute</color>.\nI should make a note of that.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Cinta merindukan masa-masa ketika dia bermain <color=#FF73C3>seruling</color>.\nAku harus mencatat itu.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_NotKind01_001
Array.english: <color=#F1DC2B>Jaka</color> became very withdrawn after his father disappeared.
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Jaka</color> menjadi sangat tertutup setelah ayahnya menghilang.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_NotKind01_002
Array.english: But it would've been even harder for him without his instrument.
Array.indonesia: Namun, hidupnya pasti akan jauh lebih sulit tanpa alat musiknya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_NotKind01_003
Array.english: Though he's so absorbed in practice, he hardly talks to me anymore.
Array.indonesia: Meskipun dia begitu asyik berlatih, dia hampir tidak pernah berbicara denganku lagi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_NotKind02_001
Array.english: There's so much to learn in the city, isn't there?
Array.indonesia: Ada banyak hal yang bisa dipelajari di kota, bukan?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_NotKind02_002
Array.english: Yes. There are many schools and people who can teach you.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Ada banyak sekolah dan orang yang bisa mengajarimu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_NotKind02_003
Array.english: I see. I wish <color=#F1DC2B>Jaka</color> could have studied in the city...
Array.indonesia: Begitu ya. Seandainya saja <color=#F1DC2B>Jaka</color> bisa belajar di kota...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_NotKind02_004
Array.english: But I wasn't able to provide that for him.
Array.indonesia: Tapi aku tidak mampu memberikannya kesempatan itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_NotKind02_005
Array.english: My husband did his best too, but...
Array.indonesia: Suamiku juga sudah berusaha sebaik mungkin, tapi...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_NotKind02_006
Array.english: Oh, please don't cry. There are a lot of bad people in the city.
Array.indonesia: Oh, tolong jangan menangis. Ada banyak orang jahat di kota.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_NotKind02_007
Array.english: <size=32>He'll learn so much more from the good people here in the village!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Dia akan belajar jauh lebih banyak dari orang-orang baik di desa ini!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_NotKind03_001
Array.english: After losing my husband, I thought about leaving this village...
Array.indonesia: Setelah kehilangan suamiku, aku sempat berpikir untuk meninggalkan desa ini...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_NotKind03_002
Array.english: <size=32>But honestly, nowhere feels as comfortable as here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tapi sejujurnya, tidak ada tempat yang terasa senyaman di sini.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_NotKind03_003
Array.english: The beautiful lake and the plants...
Array.indonesia: Danau yang indah dan tanaman-tanaman...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_NotKind03_004
Array.english: Even the view from up high.\nThey've helped me heal so much.
Array.indonesia: Bahkan pemandangan dari ketinggian.\nSemua itu telah sangat membantuku pulih.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_NotKind03_005
Array.english: Dave, I hope you won't just bury yourself in the case and actually take time to enjoy the village.
Array.indonesia: Dave, aku harap kamu tidak hanya tenggelam dalam kasus ini, tapi juga meluangkan waktu untuk menikmati desa ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_InfoTalk02_001
Array.english: I really love looking at Jaka's childhood photos.
Array.indonesia: Aku sangat suka melihat foto-foto masa kecil Jaka.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_InfoTalk02_002
Array.english: I can't believe how fast he grew up...\nit's just amazing.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak percaya betapa cepatnya dia tumbuh besar...\nsungguh menakjubkan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_InfoTalk02_003
Array.english: I'm so glad I can preserve those happy memories like this in photos.
Array.indonesia: Aku sangat senang bisa mengabadikan kenangan bahagia itu dalam foto-foto seperti ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_InfoTalk02_004
Array.english: But since I just keep them in a wooden box,\nthey sometimes fade or get damaged...
Array.indonesia: Tapi karena aku hanya menyimpannya di dalam kotak kayu,\nkadang-kadang foto-foto itu memudar atau rusak...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_InfoTalk02_005
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Cinta would love it if I gave her a <color=#FF73C3>Photo Album</color> to take care of her photos. I should make a note of it.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Cinta pasti akan senang kalau aku memberinya <color=#FF73C3>Album Foto</color> untuk merawat foto-fotonya. Aku harus mencatatnya.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Kind01_001
Array.english: The adults told me not to get too friendly with outsiders...
Array.indonesia: Orang-orang dewasa bilang padaku agar jangan terlalu akrab dengan orang luar...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Kind01_002
Array.english: They say they act nice, but lie a lot.
Array.indonesia: Mereka bilang orang-orang itu kelihatannya baik, tapi sering berbohong.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Kind01_003
Array.english: But you seem like a good person, mister.
Array.indonesia: Tapi kamu kelihatannya orang baik, Pak.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Kind02_001
Array.english: Mister, do you have any other fun mobile games?
Array.indonesia: Pak, apa kamu punya game ponsel seru lainnya?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Kind02_002
Array.english: Hmm... I don't have many installed...\nHow about this one?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Aku nggak banyak yang terpasang...\nGimana kalau yang ini?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Kind02_003
Array.english: <size=32>It's a game where you join the Earth Defense Force and protect the city from giant monsters.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ini game di mana kamu bergabung dengan Pasukan Pertahanan Bumi dan melindungi kota dari monster raksasa.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Kind02_004
Array.english: <size=32>You can also rescue citizens to generate resources.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kamu juga bisa menyelamatkan warga untuk mendapatkan sumber daya.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Kind02_005
Array.english: <size=32>Ooh..! Sounds fun!\nCan I try it for a bit?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wah..! Kedengarannya seru!\nBolehkah aku mencobanya sebentar?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Kind02_006
Array.english: Of course. Here you go.
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja. Ini dia.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Kind02_007
Array.english: <size=35>Ooh...!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wah...!!!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Kind02_008
Array.english: <size=40>Ooh...!!! Monster cards like this...!!! Awesome!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Wah...!!! Kartu monster seperti ini...!!! Keren banget!!!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Kind02_009
Array.english: <size=40>Tap... tap!!! Swipe!!! Hiyah!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Ketuk... ketuk!!! Geser!!! Hiyah!!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Kind02_010
Array.english: <size=40>Wow! This is so fun!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Wow! Ini seru banget!!!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Kind02_011
Array.english: <size=32>Hehe. Just as I thought, everyone loves monster games.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehe. Seperti yang kuduga, semua orang suka permainan monster.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Kind03_001
Array.english: I read in a book once that there are so many different kinds of dinosaurs.
Array.indonesia: Aku pernah baca di buku bahwa ada banyak sekali jenis dinosaurus.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Kind03_002
Array.english: I know, right? I heard there are over a thousand species.
Array.indonesia: Iya, kan? Aku dengar ada lebih dari seribu spesies.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Kind03_003
Array.english: <size=32>Wow...! Really? That many?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wah...! Benarkah? Sebanyak itu?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Kind03_004
Array.english: Mister, if you find any <color=#FF73C3>Dinosaur Bones</color>, could you bring them to me?
Array.indonesia: Pak, kalau kamu menemukan <color=#FF73C3>Tulang Dinosaurus</color>, bisakah kamu membawakannya kepadaku?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Kind03_005
Array.english: I've always wanted some... but I heard they're all underwater.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah lama ingin memilikinya... tapi kudengar semuanya ada di bawah air.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Kind03_006
Array.english: Okay. If I see any, I'll pick some up.
Array.indonesia: Oke. Kalau aku melihatnya, aku akan mengambilnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_InfoTalk01_001
Array.english: Mister, don't you have any new games on your phone?\nCan't you let me play again?
Array.indonesia: Pak, apa Pak tidak punya game baru di ponselnya?\nBisakah Pak membiarkanku bermain lagi?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_InfoTalk01_002
Array.english: Hmm... my battery's pretty low right now, so that's a problem.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... baterai saya hampir habis sekarang, jadi itu masalahnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_InfoTalk01_003
Array.english: Plus, the signal's bad here, so it's hard to download new games.
Array.indonesia: Lagipula, sinyalnya jelek di sini, jadi sulit mengunduh game baru.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_InfoTalk01_004
Array.english: <size=33>Ah! Mister, do you know a game console called <color=#FF73C3>SL63</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ah! Pak, apakah Kamu tahu konsol game bernama <color=#FF73C3>SL63</color>?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_InfoTalk01_005
Array.english: Hmm? Not really.
Array.indonesia: Hmm? Kurang lebih.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_InfoTalk01_006
Array.english: <size=32>Hehe, it's a mini console with 63 built-in games! You'll never get bored with it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehe, itu konsol mini dengan 63 game bawaan! Kamu nggak akan pernah bosan maininnya!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_InfoTalk01_007
Array.english: Oh... something like that exists?
Array.indonesia: Oh... ada yang kayak gitu?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_InfoTalk01_008
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(<color=#FF73C3>SL63</color>, huh? I should check if Rimbo's shop carries it.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(<color=#FF73C3>SL63</color>, ya? Aku harus cek apakah toko Rimbo jual itu.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_NotKind01_001
Array.english: <size=32>The dinosaur on Lake Beach... isn't it so cool?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Dinosaurus di Lake Beach... keren banget, kan?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_NotKind01_002
Array.english: To think creatures like that used to live long ago...
Array.indonesia: Siapa sangka makhluk seperti itu pernah hidup di masa lalu...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_NotKind01_003
Array.english: I hope more unique creatures wash up! Hehe.
Array.indonesia: Semoga makin banyak makhluk unik yang terdampar! Hehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_NotKind02_001
Array.english: My younger sister, <color=#F1DC2B>Saniah</color>, is really curious.
Array.indonesia: Adik perempuanku, <color=#F1DC2B>Saniah</color>, sangat penasaran.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_NotKind02_002
Array.english: A while ago, she chased a butterfly all the way to the forest... I got scolded by Mom for not watching her properly.
Array.indonesia: Beberapa waktu lalu, dia mengejar seekor kupu-kupu sampai ke hutan... Aku dimarahi Ibu karena tidak mengawasinya dengan baik.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_NotKind02_003
Array.english: Oh, you must have been really worried.\nShe still looks so young.
Array.indonesia: Oh, kamu pasti sangat khawatir.\nDia masih terlihat sangat muda.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_NotKind02_004
Array.english: Yeah. I was actually relieved the path was blocked by a big boulder.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Sebenarnya aku lega karena jalannya terhalang oleh batu besar.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_NotKind03_001
Array.english: Mister, what's city life like?
Array.indonesia: Pak, seperti apa kehidupan di kota?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_NotKind03_002
Array.english: Well, some people like it, but I prefer quiet places like this.
Array.indonesia: Yah, ada yang menyukainya, tapi aku lebih suka tempat-tempat tenang seperti ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_NotKind03_003
Array.english: There's lots of tasty food too.
Array.indonesia: Makanannya juga banyak yang enak.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_NotKind03_004
Array.english: Really? Some of the adults left saying they prefer the city.
Array.indonesia: Benarkah? Beberapa orang dewasa pergi sambil bilang mereka lebih suka kota.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_NotKind03_005
Array.english: But our whole family loves this village.
Array.indonesia: Tapi seluruh keluargaku menyukai desa ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_InfoTalk02_001
Array.english: <size=35>Ah... I'm curious...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ah... Aku penasaran...!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_InfoTalk02_002
Array.english: Hmm? What are you curious about?
Array.indonesia: Hmm? Apa yang membuatmu penasaran?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_InfoTalk02_003
Array.english: <size=32>Well, sometimes Uncle Rimbo brings me <color=#FF73C3>Manga</color>...\nand I'm dying to know what happens next.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Nah, kadang-kadang Paman Rimbo membawakan aku <color=#FF73C3>Manga</color>...\ndan aku sangat ingin tahu apa yang terjadi selanjutnya.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_InfoTalk02_004
Array.english: <size=32><color=#FF73C3>Manga</color> always cuts off right when it gets good...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32><color=#FF73C3>Manga</color> selalu terhenti tepat saat ceritanya mulai seru...!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_InfoTalk02_005
Array.english: <size=32>Ugh...! What happened to Sasuke after he got separated from his friends...? And what about the main character who merged with the Saw Shark Devil...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ugh...! Apa yang terjadi pada Sasuke setelah dia terpisah dari teman-temannya...? Dan bagaimana dengan tokoh utama yang menyatu dengan Iblis Hiu Gergaji...?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_InfoTalk02_006
Array.english: <size=35>Ugh... I'm so curious!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ugh... Aku sangat penasaran!!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_InfoTalk02_007
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(He'd probably love it if I gave him some <color=#FF73C3>Manga</color> as a gift. I should make a note of that.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Dia pasti akan senang kalau aku memberinya <color=#FF73C3>Manga</color> sebagai hadiah. Aku harus mencatat itu.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Kind01_001
Array.english: I really love <color=#1DFEAF>Butterflies</color>.
Array.indonesia: Aku benar-benar suka <color=#1DFEAF>Butterflies</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Kind01_002
Array.english: They're like colorful paper, but they fly in the sky.
Array.indonesia: Mereka seperti kertas berwarna-warni, tapi bisa terbang di langit.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Kind02_001
Array.english: Mister, Bima told me there was a really bad disease going around the city.
Array.indonesia: Pak, Bima bilang ada penyakit yang sangat parah sedang merebak di kota ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Kind02_002
Array.english: People who got sick were biting each other...\nso everyone started wearing white masks!!
Array.indonesia: Orang-orang yang sakit saling menggigit...\njadi semua orang mulai memakai masker putih!!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Kind02_003
Array.english: Hmm... I think that was for a different reason.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Menurutku itu karena alasan lain.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Kind02_004
Array.english: Anyway, when someone's sick, make sure to cover your mouth properly. So you don't spread the illness.
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun, kalau ada yang sakit, pastikan menutup mulut dengan benar. Supaya penyakitnya nggak menyebar.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Kind03_001
Array.english: <size=32>I saw a tiny person in the forest once!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku pernah melihat orang kecil di hutan!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Kind03_002
Array.english: I snuck out at night without Mom knowing to chase fireflies.
Array.indonesia: Aku menyelinap keluar di malam hari tanpa sepengetahuan Ibu untuk mengejar kunang-kunang.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Kind03_003
Array.english: <size=32>I saw a tiny person running toward the forest.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku melihat seorang anak kecil berlari menuju hutan.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Kind03_004
Array.english: I see. That's amazing.
Array.indonesia: Oh, begitu. Luar biasa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Kind03_005
Array.english: But sneaking out at night without your mom knowing is dangerous. I'll keep this a secret.
Array.indonesia: Tapi menyelinap keluar di malam hari tanpa sepengetahuan ibumu itu berbahaya. Aku akan merahasiakannya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_InfoTalk01_001
Array.english: <size=32>Mister, I like <color=#FF73C3>Dolls</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Pak, aku suka <color=#FF73C3>boneka</color>!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_InfoTalk01_002
Array.english: I see. What kind of <color=#FF73C3>Dolls</color> do you like?
Array.indonesia: Oh, begitu. <color=#FF73C3>Boneka</color> seperti apa yang kamu suka?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_InfoTalk01_003
Array.english: Hmm... I like animal dolls... and people dolls too...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Aku suka boneka binatang... dan boneka manusia juga...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_InfoTalk01_004
Array.english: <size=35>I like them all!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Aku suka semuanya!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_InfoTalk01_005
Array.english: Haha, I see. I'll remember that.
Array.indonesia: Haha, oh begitu. Aku akan mengingatnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_NotKind01_001
Array.english: Um... do outsiders really boil people alive and eat them as soup?
Array.indonesia: Um... benarkah orang luar merebus orang hidup-hidup dan memakannya sebagai sup?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_NotKind01_002
Array.english: <size=34>...Who told you that?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>...Who yang memberitahumu itu?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_NotKind01_003
Array.english: Bima did. He said they cut off the fingers and fry them separately.
Array.indonesia: Bima yang bilang. Katanya mereka memotong jari-jarinya dan menggorengnya secara terpisah.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_NotKind01_004
Array.english: He sure tells some strange stories.\nThat doesn't happen.
Array.indonesia: Dia memang suka menceritakan kisah-kisah aneh.\nItu tidak mungkin terjadi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_NotKind02_001
Array.english: Uncle Rimbo gave me a drink before, and it was super fizzy!
Array.indonesia: Paman Rimbo pernah ngasih aku minuman, dan rasanya super bersoda!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_NotKind02_002
Array.english: Oh, was it cola? It's the best on a hot day... haha.
Array.indonesia: Oh, itu cola? Itu yang paling enak di hari yang panas... haha.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_NotKind02_003
Array.english: <size=32>That's right! That was the name!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Benar! Itu namanya!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_NotKind02_004
Array.english: Bima told me they make it by bottling electricity,\nand that's why it's fizzy.
Array.indonesia: Bima bilang mereka membuatnya dengan membotolkan listrik,\ndan itulah sebabnya minuman itu berkarbonasi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_NotKind02_005
Array.english: Hmm... that's not quite it, but.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... itu tidak sepenuhnya benar, tapi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_NotKind03_001
Array.english: <size=30>Mister, did you fly here on a plane?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=30>Pak, apakah Kamu terbang ke sini dengan pesawat?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_NotKind03_002
Array.english: No. We came by boat, kiddo.
Array.indonesia: Tidak. Kami datang dengan kapal, Nak.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_NotKind03_003
Array.english: <size=32>I wanna ride a plane!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku mau naik pesawat!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_NotKind03_004
Array.english: I heard they put a bunch of birds in the wings to make it fly, right? That's so cool!
Array.indonesia: Aku dengar mereka menaruh banyak burung di sayapnya biar bisa terbang, kan? Keren banget!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_NotKind03_005
Array.english: R-Right. That would be really cool...
Array.indonesia: B-Benar. Itu pasti keren banget...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_InfoTalk02_001
Array.english: Aww...
Array.indonesia: Aduh...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_InfoTalk02_002
Array.english: Hmm? Why are you crying?
Array.indonesia: Hmm? Kenapa kamu menangis?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_InfoTalk02_003
Array.english: Mommy told me not to eat too many <color=#FF73C3>Snacks</color>.
Array.indonesia: Ibu bilang aku jangan makan terlalu banyak <color=#FF73C3>Camilan</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_InfoTalk02_004
Array.english: She said if I eat too many, my teeth and tongue will melt away!
Array.indonesia: Dia bilang kalau aku makan terlalu banyak, gigi dan lidahku akan meleleh!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_InfoTalk02_005
Array.english: Well, not your tongue, but... you should always brush your teeth well after eating <color=#FF73C3>Snacks</color>.
Array.indonesia: Yah, lidahmu sih nggak, tapi... kamu harus selalu menyikat gigi dengan baik setelah makan <color=#FF73C3>Snacks</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_InfoTalk02_006
Array.english: If you brush them well, I'll give you some <color=#FF73C3>Snacks</color>.
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu menyikatnya dengan baik, aku akan memberimu beberapa <color=#FF73C3>Snacks</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_InfoTalk02_007
Array.english: <size=32>Wow! Okay!\nI'll definitely brush my teeth well!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wah! Oke!\nAku pasti akan menyikat gigiku dengan baik!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Kind01_001
Array.english: Mister, do you know about a snake called an anaconda?
Array.indonesia: Pak, apakah Kamu tahu tentang ular yang disebut anaconda?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Kind01_002
Array.english: I think I've seen one in a movie. Isn't it a huge snake?
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya aku pernah melihatnya di film. Bukankah itu ular yang sangat besar?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Kind01_003
Array.english: It is! This is a secret...
Array.indonesia: Benar! Ini rahasia...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Kind01_004
Array.english: I went to the forest at night and saw a really,\nreally huge snake.
Array.indonesia: Aku pergi ke hutan pada malam hari dan melihat ular yang sangat,\nsangat besar.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Kind01_005
Array.english: It was way bigger than the tree in front of the chief's house!
Array.indonesia: Ukurannya jauh lebih besar daripada pohon di depan rumah kepala desa!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Kind01_006
Array.english: Oh, come on. There's no way a snake that big exists.\nSomeone in the village would've seen it by now.
Array.indonesia: Ah, ayolah. Tidak mungkin ada ular sebesar itu.\nPasti sudah ada orang di desa yang melihatnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Kind01_007
Array.english: It was dark, so things probably just looked bigger than they were.
Array.indonesia: Saat itu gelap, jadi mungkin benda-benda terlihat lebih besar dari ukuran aslinya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Kind01_008
Array.english: But it's true... Nobody believes me...
Array.indonesia: Tapi itu benar... Tidak ada yang percaya padaku...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Kind02_001
Array.english: My dad's always telling me to study...
Array.indonesia: Ayahku selalu menyuruhku belajar...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Kind02_002
Array.english: ...but all he does is drink and mess around.
Array.indonesia: ...tapi yang dia lakukan hanyalah minum dan main-main.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Kind02_003
Array.english: Sounds like you're talking about <color=#F1DC2B>Harta</color>.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya kamu sedang membicarakan <color=#F1DC2B>Harta</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Kind02_004
Array.english: He seemed like a fun, kind person.
Array.indonesia: Dia tampak seperti orang yang menyenangkan dan baik hati.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Kind02_005
Array.english: He's only like that with other adults...\nHe doesn't even spend time with me.
Array.indonesia: Dia cuma kayak gitu sama orang dewasa lain...\nDia bahkan nggak pernah ngabisin waktu bareng aku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Kind02_006
Array.english: Maybe it's because you handle everything so well on your own?
Array.indonesia: Mungkin karena kamu bisa ngurus semuanya sendiri dengan baik?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Kind02_007
Array.english: W-Well, that's true!\nI do handle everything pretty well!
Array.indonesia: Y-Ya, itu bener!\nAku memang bisa ngurus semuanya dengan cukup baik!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Kind02_008
Array.english: Maybe when you're a bit older, your dad will spend more time with you.
Array.indonesia: Mungkin kalau kamu udah sedikit lebih besar, ayahmu bakal lebih sering ngabisin waktu bareng kamu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Kind02_009
Array.english: Dads sometimes don't know how to act around their kids,\nso they keep their distance.
Array.indonesia: Ayah terkadang tidak tahu bagaimana bersikap di depan anak-anaknya,\njadi mereka menjaga jarak.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Kind02_010
Array.english: Really? Hehe.\nHearing that makes me feel a bit better.
Array.indonesia: Benarkah? Hehe.\nMendengar itu membuatku merasa sedikit lebih baik.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Kind03_001
Array.english: Rhinoceros beetles and stag beetles are really cool.
Array.indonesia: Kumbang badak dan kumbang tanduk benar-benar keren.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Kind03_002
Array.english: Insects wearing armor... it's amazing.
Array.indonesia: Serangga yang memakai baju besi... sungguh menakjubkan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Kind03_003
Array.english: There are a lot of really unique insects in this region.
Array.indonesia: Ada banyak serangga yang sangat unik di wilayah ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Kind03_004
Array.english: <size=32>Especially the <color=#1DFEAF>Femoralis Fancy Stag Beetle</color>...\nit's just unbelievably cool!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Terutama <color=#1DFEAF>Kumbang Rusa Femoralis Fancy</color>...\nkumbang itu benar-benar keren sekali!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_InfoTalk01_001
Array.english: <size=33>Mister, do you know the movie <color=#FF73C3>Robot Samurai</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Pak, apakah Kamu tahu film <color=#FF73C3>Robot Samurai</color>?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_InfoTalk01_002
Array.english: Of course! It's Bancho's favorite movie.
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja! Itu film favorit Bancho.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_InfoTalk01_003
Array.english: <size=32>Hehe, I see! It's really, really good!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehe, begitu ya! Film itu benar-benar, benar-benar bagus!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_InfoTalk01_004
Array.english: <size=32>There are so many explosions, my ears hurt though...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ada banyak sekali ledakan, tapi telingaku jadi sakit...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_InfoTalk01_005
Array.english: I heard they even released a <color=#FF73C3>Robot Samurai Action Figure</color>...!
Array.indonesia: Aku dengar mereka bahkan merilis <color=#FF73C3>Action Figure Robot Samurai</color>...!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_InfoTalk01_006
Array.english: Oh... really? That sounds cool.
Array.indonesia: Oh... beneran? Kedengarannya keren.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_InfoTalk01_007
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(A <color=#FF73C3>Robot Samurai Action Figure</color>, huh...\nHe'd probably love it if I got him one.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Sebuah <color=#FF73C3>Figur Aksi Robot Samurai</color>, ya...\nDia pasti akan senang kalau aku membelikannya satu.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_NotKind01_001
Array.english: Mister, if I told you... creatures similar to humans live deep in the sea, would you believe me?
Array.indonesia: Pak, kalau aku bilang... ada makhluk mirip manusia yang hidup di kedalaman laut, apakah kamu akan percaya?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_NotKind01_002
Array.english: Of course. I've even been to their village myself.
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja. Aku bahkan pernah ke desa mereka sendiri.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_NotKind01_003
Array.english: <size=32>...Ha, hahaha.\nSure you did!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>...Ha, hahaha.\nTentu saja!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_NotKind01_004
Array.english: I joke with my friends sometimes too, but that's going way too far.
Array.indonesia: Aku juga kadang bercanda dengan teman-temanku, tapi itu sudah keterlaluan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_NotKind02_001
Array.english: Mister, I read in a book once...
Array.indonesia: Pak, aku pernah membaca di sebuah buku...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_NotKind02_002
Array.english: that there's a giant squid in the sea that wrecks ships.
Array.indonesia: bahwa ada cumi-cumi raksasa di laut yang menghancurkan kapal.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_NotKind02_003
Array.english: Though they probably just mistook a big reef for it.
Array.indonesia: Meskipun mungkin mereka hanya salah mengira terumbu karang besar sebagai cumi-cumi itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_NotKind02_004
Array.english: No. They're real.
Array.indonesia: Tidak. Mereka itu nyata.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_NotKind02_005
Array.english: If you ever run into one, aim for the eyes.
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu pernah bertemu satu, bidik matanya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_NotKind02_006
Array.english: Oh, come on... what are you talking about?\nMister, you're such a show-off.
Array.indonesia: Ah, ayolah... apa yang kamu bicarakan?\nPak, kamu memang suka pamer.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_NotKind03_001
Array.english: Mister, have you ever seen a thresher shark?
Array.indonesia: Pak, apakah kamu pernah melihat hiu thresher?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_NotKind03_002
Array.english: Of course. It's a shark with a really long tail.
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja. Itu hiu dengan ekor yang sangat panjang.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_NotKind03_003
Array.english: Ooh... then have you seen a blue marlin too?
Array.indonesia: Ooh... kalau begitu, apakah kamu juga pernah melihat marlin biru?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_NotKind03_004
Array.english: Yep. It has a spear-like snout, so it looks awesome.\nBut it's dangerous.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Ia memiliki moncong seperti tombak, jadi terlihat keren.\nTapi ia berbahaya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_NotKind03_005
Array.english: <size=32>Oooooh...!! Maybe I should learn to dive...!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oooooh...!! Mungkin aku harus belajar menyelam...!!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_NotKind03_006
Array.english: Haha, that's a great idea. It's not hard once you get the hang of it.
Array.indonesia: Haha, itu ide yang bagus. Nggak sulit kok kalau sudah terbiasa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_InfoTalk02_001
Array.english: It must be nice having friends in the village to play with.
Array.indonesia: Pasti seru punya teman di desa buat main bareng.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_InfoTalk02_002
Array.english: Yeah, but... Eka and Saniah have to go home early in the evening.
Array.indonesia: Iya, tapi... Eka dan Saniah harus pulang lebih awal di sore hari.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_InfoTalk02_003
Array.english: Their parents make them come home before it gets dark.
Array.indonesia: Orang tua mereka mewajibkan mereka pulang sebelum gelap.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_InfoTalk02_004
Array.english: I see. It must be boring being alone.
Array.indonesia: Oh, begitu. Pasti membosankan kalau sendirian.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_InfoTalk02_005
Array.english: Well... sometimes, yeah...
Array.indonesia: Yah... kadang-kadang, iya...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_InfoTalk02_006
Array.english: I just play <color=#FF73C3>Games</color> or watch <color=#FF73C3>Anime</color>! Hehe.
Array.indonesia: Aku cuma main <color=#FF73C3>Game</color> atau nonton <color=#FF73C3>Anime</color>! Hehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_InfoTalk02_007
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... so Bima likes <color=#FF73C3>Games</color> and <color=#FF73C3>Manga</color>...\nI should make a note of that.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... jadi Bima suka <color=#FF73C3>Game</color> dan <color=#FF73C3>Manga</color>...\nAku harus catat itu.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_01_001
Array.english: Ah, Dave. This is quite a magnificent place.
Array.indonesia: Ah, Dave. Tempat ini sungguh menakjubkan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_01_002
Array.english: Not just the insects, but the fish here are completely different from the Blue Hole.
Array.indonesia: Bukan hanya serangga, tapi ikan-ikan di sini juga benar-benar berbeda dari Blue Hole.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_01_003
Array.english: Yes. It's a really beautiful village.\nAnd the villagers are friendly too.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Desa ini sangat indah.\nDan penduduk desa juga ramah.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_01_004
Array.english: <size=33>Not all of them, though.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tapi tidak semuanya, sih.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_01_005
Array.english: The fish here are fascinating, but...
Array.indonesia: Ikan-ikan di sini memang menarik, tapi...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_01_006
Array.english: <size=33>Readers always want something new!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Pembaca selalu menginginkan sesuatu yang baru!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_01_007
Array.english: This time, I'm going to amaze my readers with insects from the jungle!
Array.indonesia: Kali ini, aku akan membuat para pembacaku terkesima dengan serangga dari hutan!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_01_008
Array.english: Then... the editorial team will finally...\nHehehe.
Array.indonesia: Kalau begitu... tim redaksi akhirnya akan...\nHehehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_02_001
Array.english: <size=34>Dave! That giant dinosaur on Lake Beach...\nwhat on earth is it!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Dave! Dinosaurus raksasa di Lake Beach itu...\napa sih itu!?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_02_002
Array.english: Ah... I heard it drifted into this village out of nowhere. We actually came here to investigate it.
Array.indonesia: Ah... Kudengar dia hanyut ke desa ini entah dari mana. Sebenarnya kami datang ke sini untuk menyelidikinya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_02_003
Array.english: <size=32>Wow... that's incredible...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wah... luar biasa...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_02_004
Array.english: Dave, when you said there were dinosaurs in the depths of the Blue Hole, I didn't believe you...
Array.indonesia: Dave, waktu kamu bilang ada dinosaurus di kedalaman Blue Hole, aku nggak percaya...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_02_005
Array.english: <size=32>But seeing it with my own eyes... my journalistic instincts are kicking in...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tapi setelah melihatnya dengan mata kepalaku sendiri... naluri jurnalistikku mulai bekerja...!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_02_006
Array.english: <size=33>May I write an article about that dinosaur?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Bolehkah aku menulis artikel tentang dinosaurus itu?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_02_007
Array.english: Hmm... if an article comes out, people will flock to this village.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... kalau artikel itu terbit, orang-orang akan berbondong-bondong datang ke desa ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_02_008
Array.english: Wouldn't that disrupt the peace here and inconvenience the residents?
Array.indonesia: Bukankah itu akan mengganggu ketenangan di sini dan merepotkan para penduduk?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_02_009
Array.english: Hmm... that's true. And with all the AI images these days, a lot of people might not believe it anyway.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... benar juga. Lagipula, dengan banyaknya gambar buatan AI akhir-akhir ini, banyak orang mungkin tidak akan percaya juga.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_02_010
Array.english: <size=33>Alright then.\nI'll focus on covering insects for now!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Baiklah kalau begitu.\nUntuk saat ini, saya akan fokus meliput serangga!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_03_001
Array.english: Dave, are you keeping up with the <color=#72ff0a>Insectagram</color>?
Array.indonesia: Dave, apakah kamu mengikuti <color=#72ff0a>Insectagram</color>?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_03_002
Array.english: Yes. But there are still a lot of empty slots.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Tapi masih ada banyak slot kosong.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_03_003
Array.english: Haha! Insects have specific habitats, you know.
Array.indonesia: Haha! Serangga punya habitat khusus, lho.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_03_004
Array.english: Probably... if you explore new areas, you'll find different species!
Array.indonesia: Mungkin... kalau kamu menjelajahi area baru, kamu bakal nemuin spesies yang beda!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_03_005
Array.english: I'm sure someone like you can catch all the insects in this region.
Array.indonesia: Aku yakin orang kayak kamu pasti bisa menangkap semua serangga di wilayah ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_03_006
Array.english: <size=33>...Go for it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...Go untuk itu!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fukuo_01_001
Array.english: Hmm. Sir, take a look at this. Don't you see how strong the signal is?
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Pak, coba lihat ini. Kamu nggak lihat seberapa kuat sinyalnya?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fukuo_01_002
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... the gauge really is pretty high...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... penunjuknya memang cukup tinggi...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fukuo_01_003
Array.english: There's some kind of mysterious energy flowing through this area. I'm certain of it.
Array.indonesia: Ada semacam energi misterius yang mengalir di wilayah ini. Saya yakin akan hal itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fukuo_01_004
Array.english: But how does that UFO radar even work?
Array.indonesia: Tapi bagaimana sih radar UFO itu bisa berfungsi?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fukuo_01_005
Array.english: ...Well... my professor lent it to me...
Array.indonesia: ...Yah... profesor saya meminjamkannya kepada saya...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fukuo_01_006
Array.english: ...Considering how expensive it must be...\nI'm sure it uses some incredible technology...
Array.indonesia: ...Mengingat betapa mahalnya alat itu...\nAku yakin alat itu menggunakan teknologi yang luar biasa...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fukuo_01_007
Array.english: <size=35>...I think.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>...Iku rasa begitu.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fukuo_01_008
Array.english: <size=32>...You borrowed it from your professor for a hefty price?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>...Youkamu meminjamnya dari profesor dengan harga yang sangat mahal?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fukuo_01_009
Array.english: <size=35>Something about that sounds fishy...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ada yang terdengar mencurigakan... .</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fukuo_01_010
Array.english: Th-That kind of doubt interferes with the mysterious energy! Show some restraint!
Array.indonesia: R-Rasa curiga seperti itu mengganggu energi misterius ini! Tunjukkan sedikit pengendalian diri!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fukuo_02_001
Array.english: Phew. It's definitely hot here.
Array.indonesia: Wah. Di sini benar-benar panas.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fukuo_02_002
