Array.english: But the Inca civilization and the pyramids all originated in hot regions.
Array.indonesia: Tapi peradaban Inca dan piramida semuanya berasal dari daerah-daerah panas.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fukuo_02_003
Array.english: Surely, there must have been an advanced ancient civilization here as well...
Array.indonesia: Pasti, pasti ada peradaban kuno yang maju di sini juga...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fukuo_02_004
Array.english: And because of the signals left behind...\naliens will appear.
Array.indonesia: Dan karena sinyal-sinyal yang ditinggalkan...\nmakhluk luar angkasa akan muncul.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fukuo_02_005
Array.english: <size=33>That could even be today... hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Bahkan bisa jadi hari ini... hehe.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fukuo_03_001
Array.english: <size=35>Hah! Sir!! Did you hear that signal!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Hah! Pak!! Apakah Kamu mendengar sinyal itu!?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fukuo_03_002
Array.english: Huh? That sounded like a hornbill.
Array.indonesia: Hah? Itu terdengar seperti burung rangkong.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fukuo_03_003
Array.english: ...Hmm. It could be mimicking an Earth sound.
Array.indonesia: ...Hmm. Mungkin itu meniru suara dari Bumi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fukuo_AfterUFO01_001
Array.english: Hmm... they're a bit different from the aliens I was hoping for, but...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... mereka agak berbeda dari alien yang kuharapkan, tapi...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fukuo_AfterUFO01_002
Array.english: Still, I should count this as having seen aliens.
Array.indonesia: Meski begitu, aku harus menganggap ini sebagai pengalaman melihat alien.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Takeru_01_001
Array.english: Hmm... Sir. Back in Tokyo, when it rains, it goes on for quite a while.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. .. Pak. Di Tokyo, kalau hujan, biasanya berlangsung cukup lama.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Takeru_01_002
Array.english: But here, the rain just stops after a short while...
Array.indonesia: Tapi di sini, hujan langsung berhenti setelah sebentar...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Takeru_01_003
Array.english: <size=33>Don't you find that... rather mysterious?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Bukankah menurutmu itu... agak misterius?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Takeru_01_004
Array.english: Hmm... I think that's just because of the tropical climate...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Kurasa itu cuma karena iklim tropis...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Takeru_01_005
Array.english: Hah... you only see the world the way you've been taught.
Array.indonesia: Hah... kamu hanya melihat dunia sesuai dengan apa yang diajarkan padamu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Takeru_01_006
Array.english: We'll uncover the truth soon enough. Hehe.
Array.indonesia: Kita akan mengungkap kebenarannya sebentar lagi. Hehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Takeru_02_001
Array.english: You just... felt something and came to talk to me,\ndidn't you?
Array.indonesia: Kamu hanya... merasakan sesuatu dan datang untuk berbicara denganku,\nbukan begitu?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Takeru_02_002
Array.english: Huh? No... you just looked like you were deep in thought.
Array.indonesia: Hah? Tidak... kamu hanya terlihat sedang tenggelam dalam pikiran.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Takeru_02_003
Array.english: Hehe... I sent out brainwaves to make you come over.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... Aku mengirimkan gelombang otak agar kamu datang ke sini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Takeru_02_004
Array.english: It seems the mysterious energy of this place is amplifying my latent abilities.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya energi misterius tempat ini memperkuat kemampuan terpendamku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Takeru_02_005
Array.english: I should write this down...
Array.indonesia: Aku harus mencatat ini...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Takeru_02_006
Array.english: <size=32>Aliens can manipulate memories, you know.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Makhluk luar angkasa bisa memanipulasi ingatan, lho.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Takeru_03_001
Array.english: How did you end up all the way here from Japan?
Array.indonesia: Bagaimana kamu bisa sampai ke sini dari Jepang?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Takeru_03_002
Array.english: We were studying an ancient temple nearby.
Array.indonesia: Kami sedang meneliti sebuah kuil kuno di dekat sini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Takeru_03_003
Array.english: That's when Yasuto spotted a strange light flying this way.
Array.indonesia: Saat itulah Yasuto melihat cahaya aneh terbang ke arah sini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Takeru_03_004
Array.english: Fukuo's mystery energy detector also picked up a strong signal.
Array.indonesia: Detektor energi misterius milik Fukuo juga menangkap sinyal yang kuat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Takeru_03_005
Array.english: We followed that signal...\nand it led us here.
Array.indonesia: Kami mengikuti sinyal itu...\ndan sinyal itu membawa kami ke sini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Takeru_03_006
Array.english: I see... There have been some strange things happening around here.
Array.indonesia: Begitu ya... Ada beberapa hal aneh yang terjadi di sekitar sini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Takeru_03_007
Array.english: If you find anything during your research, let me know.
Array.indonesia: Jika kalian menemukan sesuatu selama penelitian kalian, beri tahu aku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Takeru_AfterUFO01_001
Array.english: Maybe we've romanticized aliens too much.
Array.indonesia: Mungkin kita sudah terlalu melebih-lebihkan makhluk luar angkasa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Takeru_AfterUFO01_002
Array.english: ...In reality, they could just be loud middle-aged men.
Array.indonesia: ...Pada kenyataannya, mereka mungkin hanya sekelompok pria paruh baya yang berisik.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Yasuto_01_001
Array.english: It's definitely hot here, but...\nI'm starting to feel cold.
Array.indonesia: Di sini memang panas sekali, tapi...\naku mulai merasa kedinginan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Yasuto_01_002
Array.english: I... I think I need a moment alone.
Array.indonesia: Aku... kurasa aku perlu waktu sebentar sendirian.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Yasuto_02_001
Array.english: UFOs exist... they're real... they're real...
Array.indonesia: UFO itu ada... itu nyata... itu nyata...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Yasuto_03_001
Array.english: Whew... I can't stop sweating.
Array.indonesia: Wah... aku nggak bisa berhenti berkeringat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Yasuto_03_002
Array.english: It's just because I'm getting closer to the truth...\nRight...?
Array.indonesia: Itu cuma karena aku semakin mendekati kebenaran...\nBenar...?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fukuo_UFOCamera01_001
Array.english: <size=33>Sir, hurry to the camera!\nYou might miss the UFO!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Pak, cepat ke kamera!\nKamu bisa ketinggalan UFO-nya!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fukuo_UFOCamera02_001
Array.english: <size=33>Is this finally the moment I've been waiting for...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Apakah ini akhirnya momen yang sudah lama kutunggu...?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fukuo_UFOCamera03_001
Array.english: <size=33>I've got a different feeling today.\nEveryone, stay sharp.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku punya firasat yang berbeda hari ini.\nSemuanya, tetap waspada.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Takeru_UFOCamera01_001
Array.english: <size=32>Takeru, hyper-focus mode ON.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Takeru, mode fokus ekstra AKTIF.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Takeru_UFOCamera02_001
Array.english: <size=32>I analyzed the village's terrain... and this hill offers the widest view.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku sudah menganalisis medan desa ini... dan bukit ini menawarkan pemandangan terluas.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Takeru_UFOCamera03_001
Array.english: <size=32>Today, I'll definitely... capture a UFO.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hari ini, aku pasti... akan menangkap UFO.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Yasuto_Sick01_001
Array.english: Haa haa...
Array.indonesia: Haa haa...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Yasuto_Sick03_001
Array.english: <size=32>...U...FO... I must...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>...U...FO... Saya harus...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fukuo_MeetMartin01_001
Array.english: Hmm... a UFO...\nIt's a bit different from what I imagined...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... UFO...\nAgak berbeda dari yang saya bayangkan...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fukuo_MeetMartin01_002
Array.english: <size=32>But it's definitely from space, that's for sure!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tapi ini pasti berasal dari luar angkasa, itu sudah pasti!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fukuo_MeetMartin01_003
Array.english: I can't wait to get back and show this to everyone.
Array.indonesia: Saya tidak sabar untuk kembali dan menunjukkan ini kepada semua orang.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fukuo_MeetMartin02_001
Array.english: It's been about two months since I left the city to search for traces of UFOs...
Array.indonesia: Sudah sekitar dua bulan sejak aku meninggalkan kota untuk mencari jejak UFO...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fukuo_MeetMartin02_002
Array.english: There were times I thought about giving up.
Array.indonesia: Ada saat-saat aku berpikir untuk menyerah.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fukuo_MeetMartin02_003
Array.english: Even if they're not the aliens we expected...\nI'm satisfied just knowing what the UFO really is.
Array.indonesia: Meskipun mereka bukan alien yang kita harapkan...\nAku sudah puas hanya dengan mengetahui apa sebenarnya UFO itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fukuo_MeetMartin03_001
Array.english: <size=33>Shh! I'm observing that alien guy.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ssst! Aku sedang mengamati makhluk alien itu.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fukuo_MeetMartin03_002
Array.english: He might just be pretending to be human for now, you know.
Array.indonesia: Siapa tahu dia hanya berpura-pura jadi manusia untuk saat ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Takeru_MeetMartin01_001
Array.english: Phew... a spacecraft that fell from the sky...
Array.indonesia: Wah... pesawat luar angkasa yang jatuh dari langit...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Takeru_MeetMartin01_002
Array.english: So they're not always saucer-shaped.\nThat's a good lesson.
Array.indonesia: Jadi, mereka tidak selalu berbentuk piring terbang.\nItu pelajaran yang bagus.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Takeru_MeetMartin02_001
Array.english: Hmm. In any case, our prediction was correct.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Bagaimanapun, prediksi kita benar.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Takeru_MeetMartin02_002
Array.english: From space, this place looks like a good landing spot.
Array.indonesia: Dari luar angkasa, tempat ini terlihat seperti tempat pendaratan yang bagus.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Takeru_MeetMartin02_003
Array.english: Which means real aliens might take notice of it too.
Array.indonesia: Artinya, alien sungguhan mungkin juga akan memperhatikannya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Takeru_MeetMartin02_004
Array.english: How exciting... hehe.
Array.indonesia: Seru sekali... hehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Takeru_MeetMartin03_001
Array.english: If you look closely at that guy... doesn't his hair stick up?
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu perhatikan baik-baik orang itu... bukankah rambutnya berdiri?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Takeru_MeetMartin03_002
Array.english: There was an old movie with an alien that had a pointy head.
Array.indonesia: Dulu ada film lama yang menampilkan alien berkepala runcing.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Takeru_MeetMartin03_003
Array.english: Maybe he's from that species.\nI should keep an eye on him.
Array.indonesia: Mungkin dia berasal dari spesies itu.\nAku harus mengawasinya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Yasuto_AfterFarewell01_001
Array.english: Ever since I got sick, I feel like my body's gotten even stronger.
Array.indonesia: Sejak aku sakit, rasanya tubuhku jadi semakin kuat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Yasuto_AfterFarewell01_002
Array.english: At this rate, I feel like I could stick to the ceiling.\nHaha.
Array.indonesia: Kalau begini terus, rasanya aku bisa menempel di langit-langit.\nHaha.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Yasuto_AfterFarewell02_001
Array.english: I've been wanting to study the history of this region.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah lama ingin mempelajari sejarah wilayah ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Yasuto_AfterFarewell02_002
Array.english: I'm sure it's connected to this mysterious power.
Array.indonesia: Aku yakin ini terkait dengan kekuatan misterius ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Yasuto_AfterFarewell03_001
Array.english: It's amazing to come all this way and end up working at a shop.
Array.indonesia: Sungguh luar biasa bisa datang sejauh ini dan akhirnya bekerja di sebuah toko.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Yasuto_AfterFarewell03_002
Array.english: I do miss home, but...\nthis is a rare opportunity, so I'll do my best
Array.indonesia: Aku memang merindukan rumah, tapi...\nini adalah kesempatan langka, jadi aku akan berusaha sebaik mungkin

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_MartinTweed_01_001
Array.english: When I was exploring another planet before...\nI came across a tropical rainforest like this.
Array.indonesia: Saat aku menjelajahi planet lain sebelumnya...\naku menemukan hutan hujan tropis seperti ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_MartinTweed_01_002
Array.english: I was looking for a planet suitable for animals to live on.
Array.indonesia: Aku sedang mencari planet yang cocok untuk dihuni hewan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_MartinTweed_01_003
Array.english: This place must be a paradise for wildlife too! Haha.
Array.indonesia: Tempat ini pasti juga surga bagi satwa liar! Haha.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_MartinTweed_02_001
Array.english: Looks like the GPS signal is weak in this area.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya sinyal GPS lemah di daerah ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_MartinTweed_02_002
Array.english: It seems even our state-of-the-art radar can't pinpoint my exact location yet.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya bahkan radar canggih kami pun belum bisa menentukan lokasi tepatku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_MartinTweed_02_003
Array.english: I think I'll need to stay a bit longer.\nPlease bear with me.
Array.indonesia: Kurasa aku harus tinggal sedikit lebih lama.\nMohon bersabar ya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_MartinTweed_03_001
Array.english: <size=37>Technologia!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Technologia!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_MartinTweed_04_001
Array.english: The lake will be purified by tomorrow.\nKindred's technology is incredible, haha.
Array.indonesia: Danau ini akan dibersihkan besok.\nTeknologi Kindred sungguh luar biasa, haha.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_MartinTweed_04_002
Array.english: By the way... why isn't the rescue ship responding?
Array.indonesia: Ngomong-ngomong... kenapa kapal penyelamatnya tidak merespons?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_MartinTweed_04_003
Array.english: I heard they left a while ago...
Array.indonesia: Aku dengar mereka sudah berangkat beberapa saat yang lalu...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_MartinTweed_VideoRewatch_001
Array.english: <size=32>Ah, that look... Could it be you want to watch our company's promo video...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ah, tatapan itu... Mungkinkah kamu ingin menonton video promosi perusahaan kita...?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_MartinTweed_VideoRewatch_002
Array.english: <size=35>Ah... um...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ah... um...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_MartinTweed_VideoRewatch_option01
Array.english: Yes, I'd love to see it
Array.indonesia: Ya, aku ingin sekali menontonnya

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_MartinTweed_VideoRewatch_option02
Array.english: No... I'm fine
Array.indonesia: Tidak... aku baik-baik saja

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_MartinTweed_VideoRewatch_Watch_001
Array.english: <size=34>Haha! Just as I thought!\nGo ahead and take a moment to enjoy it!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Haha! Seperti yang kuduga!\nSilakan luangkan waktu sejenak untuk menikmatinya!!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_MartinTweed_VideoRewatch_Watch_002
Array.english: ...With Kindred's advanced technology, you can even skip ahead.
Array.indonesia: ...Dengan teknologi canggih Kindred, kamu bahkan bisa melompat ke bagian selanjutnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_MartinTweed_VideoRewatch_NoWatch_001
Array.english: Hmm... you're not being very honest, are you?\nI hope you'll watch it later.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... kamu nggak jujur banget, ya?\nSemoga kamu nonton nanti.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_MartinTweed_VideoRewatch_AfterWatch_001
Array.english: <size=34>Haha! How is it?\nKindred's technology is amazing, isn't it?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Haha! Gimana?\nTeknologi Kindred luar biasa, kan?!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_MartinTweed_VideoRewatch_AfterWatch_002
Array.english: Though without equipment, there's not much I can actually do...
Array.indonesia: Walaupun tanpa peralatan, sebenarnya nggak banyak yang bisa aku lakukan...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_CharlieBonnet_01_001
Array.english: I'm tellin' ya, I just love that heat hangin' in the air.
Array.indonesia: Aku bilang, aku benar-benar suka panas yang menggantung di udara ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_CharlieBonnet_01_002
Array.english: <size=33>Gets my musical inspiration flowin'!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Itu bikin inspirasi musikku mengalir!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_CharlieBonnet_02_001
Array.english:
Sure wish our bandmates could've made the trip.
What a shame.
Array.indonesia:
Sayang sekali teman-teman band kita tidak bisa ikut dalam perjalanan ini.
Sungguh disayangkan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_CharlieBonnet_03_001
Array.english: Back when I was younger, I used to play my music loud as hell.
Array.indonesia: Dulu saat aku masih muda, aku biasa memutar musikku dengan volume yang sangat keras.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_CharlieBonnet_03_002
Array.english: But as I got older, I started leanin' more toward country.
Array.indonesia: Tapi seiring bertambahnya usia, aku mulai lebih menyukai musik country.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_CharlieBonnet_AfterJaka_01_001
Array.english: Well now... never thought I'd make it all the way out here and end up havin' such a fine jam session.
Array.indonesia: Nah, sekarang... nggak pernah kepikiran aku bakal sampai sejauh ini dan akhirnya bisa menikmati sesi musik yang seru banget.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_CharlieBonnet_AfterJaka_01_002
Array.english: <size=33>That young fella, Jaka. He's got that rock 'n' roll spirit!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Anak muda itu, Jaka. Dia punya semangat rock 'n' roll!!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Omnom_01_001
Array.english: (Om Nom is smiling brightly)
Array.indonesia: (Om Nom tersenyum cerah)

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Omnom_02_001
Array.english: (Om Nom's mouth is wide open, lookin' hungry)
Array.indonesia: (Mulut Om Nom terbuka lebar, terlihat lapar)

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Omnom_03_001
Array.english: (Om Nom is looking around curiously)
Array.indonesia: (Om Nom melihat sekeliling dengan rasa ingin tahu)

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Mita_01_001
Array.english: I ended up in this village out of nowhere, but I really like it here.
Array.indonesia: Aku tiba-tiba saja berada di desa ini, tapi aku benar-benar suka di sini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Mita_01_002
Array.english: <size=32>I guess I really like forest villages, hoho!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Sepertinya aku memang suka desa-desa di hutan, hoho!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Mita_02_001
Array.english: It's pretty hot in this village.
Array.indonesia: Di desa ini cukup panas.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Mita_02_002
Array.english: Wouldn't it be cooler if you took off your hat?
Array.indonesia: Bukankah akan lebih sejuk kalau kamu melepas topimu?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Mita_02_003
Array.english: <size=32>No way! I really, really love this hat!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tidak mungkin! Aku sangat, sangat menyukai topi ini!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Mita_03_001
Array.english: You know the tall chef at the shop...
Array.indonesia: Kamu tahu koki tinggi di toko itu...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Mita_03_002
Array.english: <size=32>He's such an amazing cook!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Dia koki yang luar biasa!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Mita_03_003
Array.english: I told him I was hungry and he made me something simple... and it was really, really delicious!
Array.indonesia: Aku bilang padanya kalau aku lapar, lalu dia membuatkan sesuatu yang sederhana... dan rasanya benar-benar, benar-benar lezat!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Mita_03_004
Array.english: <size=32>Of course! Bancho's cooking is the best in the world!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tentu saja! Masakan Bancho adalah yang terbaik di dunia!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Longbottom_01_001
Array.english: Our Two Point County has an abandoned museum.
Array.indonesia: Di Two Point County kita ada sebuah museum yang terbengkalai.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Longbottom_01_002
Array.english: I heard the previous curator was rather lazy and incompetent...
Array.indonesia: Aku dengar kurator sebelumnya agak malas dan tidak kompeten...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Longbottom_01_003
Array.english: So the new curator and I are working to bring the museum back to life!
Array.indonesia: Jadi, kurator baru dan aku sedang berusaha menghidupkan kembali museum itu!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Longbottom_01_004
Array.english: My role is to find things like dinosaur bones...\nand mysterious artifacts from ancient times.
Array.indonesia: Peranku adalah mencari benda-benda seperti tulang dinosaurus...\ndan artefak misterius dari zaman kuno.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Longbottom_01_005
Array.english: Your help, Dave, would be a great boost to our town's revival.
Array.indonesia: Bantuanmu, Dave, akan menjadi dorongan besar bagi kebangkitan kota kita.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Longbottom_02_001
Array.english: This region truly has such diverse wildlife.
Array.indonesia: Wilayah ini benar-benar memiliki keanekaragaman hayati yang luar biasa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Longbottom_02_002
Array.english: <size=32>Especially that... the bones of a giant dinosaur on the beach...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Terutama itu... tulang-tulang dinosaurus raksasa di pantai...!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Longbottom_02_003
Array.english: Those appear to be basilosaurus bones, which are quite rare worldwide...
Array.indonesia: Itu tampaknya tulang-tulang basilosaurus, yang cukup langka di seluruh dunia...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Longbottom_02_004
Array.english: To think something like that is just sitting here in the village...
Array.indonesia: Sungguh tak terbayangkan ada benda seperti itu tergeletak begitu saja di desa ini...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Longbottom_02_005
Array.english: <size=33>It seems I've come to the right place! Haha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Sepertinya aku datang ke tempat yang tepat! Haha!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Longbottom_03_001
Array.english: Setah Forest was fairly dangerous as well, but...
Array.indonesia: Hutan Setah juga cukup berbahaya, tapi...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Longbottom_03_002
Array.english: it's nothing compared to the freezing mine I explored before.
Array.indonesia: itu tak seberapa dibandingkan dengan tambang beku yang pernah aku jelajahi sebelumnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Longbottom_03_003
Array.english: The blizzards... the frostbite... Ugh... just thinking about it gives me chills.
Array.indonesia: Badai salju... radang dingin... Ugh... hanya memikirkannya saja sudah membuatku merinding.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rover_01_001
Array.english: There are some unstable frequencies in the village,\nthough...
Array.indonesia: Ada beberapa frekuensi yang tidak stabil di desa ini,\nmeskipun...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rover_01_002
Array.english: Compared to Solaris-3, this place is so much more peaceful. I don't sense any traces of Tacet Discords here, either.
Array.indonesia: Dibandingkan dengan Solaris-3, tempat ini jauh lebih damai. Aku juga tidak merasakan jejak Tacet Discords di sini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rover_01_003
Array.english: I think I'll stay for a while and rest.
Array.indonesia: Kurasa aku akan tinggal sebentar dan beristirahat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rover_02_001
Array.english: Something stirred in the bushes earlier, so I turned on my terminal...
Array.indonesia: Tadi ada sesuatu yang bergerak di semak-semak, jadi aku menyalakan terminalku...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rover_02_002
Array.english: It was just an ordinary insect.
Array.indonesia: Ternyata hanya serangga biasa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rover_02_003
Array.english: I suppose I can lower my guard a little here.
Array.indonesia: Kurasa aku bisa sedikit menurunkan kewaspadaanku di sini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rover_03_001
Array.english: There are so many different kinds of plants growing in this village.
Array.indonesia: Ada begitu banyak jenis tumbuhan yang tumbuh di desa ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rover_03_002
Array.english: If Baizhi were here... I'm sure she'd collect some samples and analyze their composition.
Array.indonesia: Kalau Baizhi ada di sini... aku yakin dia akan mengumpulkan beberapa sampel dan menganalisis komposisinya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rover_03_003
Array.english: I'm starting to miss her endless curiosity.
Array.indonesia: Aku mulai merindukan rasa ingin tahunya yang tak ada habisnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv5Reward_001
Array.english: The villagers have been telling me...
Array.indonesia: Para penduduk desa telah memberitahuku...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv5Reward_002
Array.english: ...that they hope you will visit from time to time,\neven after this investigation is over.
Array.indonesia: ...bahwa mereka berharap kamu akan berkunjung sesekali,\nbahkan setelah penyelidikan ini selesai.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv5Reward_003
Array.english: Is that so. That's truly heartening to hear.
Array.indonesia: Begitu ya. Sungguh menggembirakan mendengarnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv5Reward_004
Array.english: You mentioned that where you come from, the underwater terrain shifts and new things appear as well, did you not?
Array.indonesia: Kamu pernah menyebutkan bahwa di tempat asalmu, medan bawah air berubah-ubah dan hal-hal baru juga muncul, bukan?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv5Reward_005
Array.english: Yes. It was quite similar to here.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Kondisinya cukup mirip dengan di sini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv5Reward_006
Array.english: I see. Did you also have pots like the ones in our village lake?
Array.indonesia: Begitu ya. Apakah di sana juga ada pot-pot seperti yang ada di danau desa kita?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv5Reward_007
Array.english: Yes. The contents were different, but I often came across pots as well.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Isinya memang berbeda, tapi aku juga sering menemukan guci-guci seperti itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv5Reward_008
Array.english: Haha, then this <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color> should serve you well.
Array.indonesia: Haha, kalau begitu <color=#FF73C3>Hadiah</color> ini pasti akan sangat berguna bagimu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv5Reward_009
Array.english: It is a <color=#F1DC2B>Charm of Abundance</color> that allows you to obtain more items when opening a pot.
Array.indonesia: Ini adalah <color=#F1DC2B>Jimat Kelimpahan</color> yang memungkinkanmu mendapatkan lebih banyak barang saat membuka guci.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv5Reward_010
Array.english: Whether here... or in the place you come from...\nit should prove most useful.
Array.indonesia: Baik di sini... maupun di tempat asalmu... \nitu pasti akan sangat berguna.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv5Reward_011
Array.english: Oh... thank you, Chief.
Array.indonesia: Oh... terima kasih, Kepala Desa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv5Reward_012
Array.english: I've learned so much and met wonderful people in this village.
Array.indonesia: Aku telah belajar banyak dan bertemu orang-orang yang luar biasa di desa ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv5Reward_013
Array.english: It's all thanks to your warm welcome, Chief!
Array.indonesia: Semua ini berkat sambutan hangatmu, Kepala Desa!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv5Reward_014
Array.english: Haha, things would have turned out quite differently without your efforts.
Array.indonesia: Haha, segalanya pasti akan berjalan sangat berbeda tanpa usahamu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv5Reward_015
Array.english: Take your time to explore this land while you are here,\nand carry its memory with you when you leave.
Array.indonesia: Luangkan waktu untuk menjelajahi negeri ini selama kamu berada di sini,\ndan bawalah kenangan ini bersamamu saat kamu pergi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv5Reward_001
Array.english: Things would've been really tough if you hadn't come along with Dr. Bacon.
Array.indonesia: Segalanya pasti akan sangat sulit jika kamu tidak datang bersama Dr. Bacon.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv5Reward_002
Array.english: Without you, Dave... the investigation would've taken much longer...
Array.indonesia: Tanpa kamu, Dave... penyelidikan ini pasti akan memakan waktu jauh lebih lama...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv5Reward_003
Array.english: And without Bancho... we'd still be eating food that smells like hydrogen sulfide.
Array.indonesia: Dan tanpa Bancho... kita masih akan makan makanan yang berbau hidrogen sulfida.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv5Reward_004
Array.english: <size=33>...And Dr. Bacon would've been drinking even more beer.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...And Dr. Bacon pasti akan minum bir lebih banyak lagi.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv5Reward_005
Array.english: So, to show my gratitude, there's something I've been working on for quite a while...
Array.indonesia: Jadi, untuk menunjukkan rasa terima kasihku, ada sesuatu yang sudah lama aku kerjakan...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv5Reward_006
Array.english: <size=34>And it's finally finished, hehe!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Dan akhirnya selesai juga, hehe!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv5Reward_007
Array.english: <size=36>Ta-da! This is called an <color=#F1DC2B>Anti-Gravity Device</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Ta-da! Ini disebut <color=#F1DC2B>Alat Anti-Gravitasi</color>!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv5Reward_008
Array.english: An <color=#F1DC2B>Anti-Gravity Device</color>...? What's that?
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Alat Anti-Gravitasi</color>...? Apa itu?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv5Reward_009
Array.english: It's a tool that lets you bring back up to 2 items when you're rescued underwater.
Array.indonesia: Ini adalah alat yang memungkinkanmu membawa kembali hingga 2 barang saat diselamatkan di bawah air.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv5Reward_010
Array.english: <size=34>Oh... that's exactly what I needed!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh... itu persis yang kubutuhkan!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv5Reward_011
Array.english: Every time I messed up and could only bring back one item, I felt so bad about it...
Array.indonesia: Setiap kali aku gagal dan hanya bisa membawa satu barang, aku merasa sangat sedih...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv5Reward_012
Array.english: <size=33>Thank you so much! This is going to be a huge help!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Terima kasih banyak! Ini akan sangat membantu!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv5Reward_013
Array.english: Hehe... I wish I could've given it to you sooner...
Array.indonesia: Hehe... Seandainya saja aku bisa memberikannya lebih cepat...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv5Reward_014
Array.english: The research ended up needing more hands than I expected.
Array.indonesia: Penelitian ini ternyata membutuhkan lebih banyak tenaga daripada yang aku perkirakan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv5Reward_015
Array.english: <size=32>Anyway, I'll be counting on you from here on out too!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Bagaimanapun, aku akan mengandalkanmu mulai sekarang juga!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv5Reward_001
Array.english: Dave, how's that kick scooter been treatin' ya?
Array.indonesia: Dave, gimana kabar skutermu?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv5Reward_002
Array.english: It's been awesome. Honestly, I don't know how I would've managed without the scooter you gave me, Rimbo...
Array.indonesia: Luar biasa. Jujur, aku nggak tahu gimana caranya aku bisa bertahan tanpa skuter yang kamu kasih, Rimbo...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv5Reward_003
Array.english: I've been zipping all over the village, chatting with just about everyone.
Array.indonesia: Aku udah keliling desa ke sana-sini, ngobrol sama hampir semua orang.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv5Reward_004
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha, anything givin' ya trouble?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha, ada yang bikin kamu repot?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv5Reward_005
Array.english: Hmm... maybe it'd be nice if it was a bit faster...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... mungkin akan lebih bagus kalau skuter ini sedikit lebih cepat...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv5Reward_006
Array.english: And it kinda bogs down on beaches, which gets a little annoying.
Array.indonesia: Dan skuter ini agak tersendat di pantai, yang bikin sedikit kesal.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv5Reward_007
Array.english: I see, I see. In that case...
Array.indonesia: Oh, begitu. Kalau begitu...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv5Reward_008
Array.english: <size=36>Go on, give this a spin!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Ayo, coba skuter ini!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv5Reward_009
Array.english: Oh... isn't this an <color=#F1DC2B>Electric Scooter</color>?
Array.indonesia: Oh... bukankah ini <color=#F1DC2B>Skuter Listrik</color>?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv5Reward_010
Array.english: Hahaa! That's right.\nHad to splurge a bit, but I picked it up in the city!
Array.indonesia: Hahaa! Benar sekali.\nHarus sedikit boros, tapi aku membelinya di kota!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv5Reward_011
Array.english: I owe ya big time, Dave.\nThink of it as a <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color> from me.
Array.indonesia: Aku berhutang budi besar padamu, Dave.\nAnggap saja ini sebagai <color=#FF73C3>Hadiah</color> dariku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv5Reward_012
Array.english: Wow... I love it!\nAnd the red, your lucky color, looks awesome too!
Array.indonesia: Wow... aku suka banget!\nDan warnanya merah, warna keberuntunganmu, juga kelihatan keren banget!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv5Reward_013
Array.english: Hahaa! With that thing, I reckon we'll be runnin' into each other a whole lot more. If it ever acts up, you bring it straight to me.
Array.indonesia: Hahaa! Dengan skuter itu, kurasa kita bakal sering banget ketemu. Kalau ada masalah, bawa langsung ke aku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv5Reward_001
Array.english: Dave, you know how to restore your stamina out in the forest, don't you?
Array.indonesia: Dave, kamu tahu cara memulihkan staminamu di hutan, kan?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv5Reward_002
Array.english: Yes. I heard you just need to eat herbs.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Aku dengar kamu hanya perlu makan ramuan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv5Reward_003
Array.english: Hehe. That's right.
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Benar sekali.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv5Reward_004
Array.english: But if you grind them in a <color=#F1DC2B>Mortar</color> and turn them into a drink, you can recover much more.
Array.indonesia: Tapi kalau kamu menggilingnya di <color=#F1DC2B>lesung</color> dan menjadikannya minuman, kamu bisa pulih jauh lebih banyak.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv5Reward_005
Array.english: And if you mix different herbs together, you can even stack the effects.
Array.indonesia: Dan kalau kamu mencampurkan berbagai jenis ramuan, efeknya bahkan bisa ditumpuk.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv5Reward_006
Array.english: So, I was thinking...
Array.indonesia: Jadi, aku berpikir...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv5Reward_007
Array.english: I happen to have an extra <color=#F1DC2B>Mortar</color>.\nWhy don't you take it, Dave?
Array.indonesia: Kebetulan aku punya <color=#F1DC2B>lesung</color> cadangan.\nKenapa kamu tidak mengambilnya, Dave?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv5Reward_008
Array.english: It must be a hassle having to come to me every time you want to make herbal drinks.
Array.indonesia: Pasti merepotkan kalau harus datang kepadaku setiap kali kamu ingin membuat minuman ramuan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv5Reward_009
Array.english: Oh... I really appreciate it, but...\nare you sure it's okay for me to handle it on my own?
Array.indonesia: Oh... Aku sangat menghargainya, tapi...\napakah kamu yakin aku boleh mengurusnya sendiri?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv5Reward_010
Array.english: Hehe. I'll teach you all the recipes.
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Aku akan mengajari kamu semua resepnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv5Reward_011
Array.english: I'm sure you can handle anything, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Aku yakin kamu bisa mengatasinya, Dave.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv5Reward_012
Array.english: <size=32>Haha, thank you!\nI'll put it to good use!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha, terima kasih!\nAku akan memanfaatkannya dengan baik!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv5Reward_001
Array.english: Heheh, brother. You been enjoyin' the fishin'?
Array.indonesia: Heheh, bro. Kamu menikmati memancingnya?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv5Reward_option1
Array.english: Yeah! I'm really enjoying it
Array.indonesia: Ya! Aku benar-benar menikmatinya

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv5Reward_option2
Array.english: Nah... I haven't had much time for it
Array.indonesia: Nggak juga... Aku belum punya banyak waktu untuk itu

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv5Reward_option1_answer_001
Array.english: Yeah. You catch different stuff than you would in the lake, and it's a lotta fun.
Array.indonesia: Iya. Ikan yang ditangkap beda dari yang biasanya di danau, dan itu seru banget.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv5Reward_option1_answer_002
Array.english: Heheh, is that so.\nGlad to hear you're enjoyin' it.
Array.indonesia: Heheh, begitu ya.\nSenang dengar kamu menikmatinya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv5Reward_option1_answer_003
Array.english: You've been helpin' me out in all sorts of ways, brother... and pitchin' in around the village too...
Array.indonesia: Kamu udah banyak bantuin aku dalam berbagai hal, bro... dan ikut bantuin di desa juga...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv5Reward_option1_answer_004
Array.english: Figured I oughta give ya a proper <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color> before you head out.
Array.indonesia: Kupikir aku harus memberimu <color=#FF73C3>Hadiah</color> yang pantas sebelum kamu berangkat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv5Reward_option1_answer_005
Array.english: This here's called the <color=#F1DC2B>Utara Fishing Rod</color>,\na fine rod that lets ya catch two fish at once!
Array.indonesia: Ini namanya <color=#F1DC2B>Pancing Utara</color>,\npancing bagus yang memungkinkanmu menangkap dua ikan sekaligus!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv5Reward_option1_answer_006
Array.english: Oh... are you sure you wanna give me something this nice?
Array.indonesia: Oh... apa kamu yakin mau memberiku sesuatu yang sebagus ini?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv5Reward_option1_answer_007
Array.english: Heheh! Me, I like catchin' 'em one at a time better anyhow.
Array.indonesia: Heheh! Aku sih lebih suka menangkapnya satu per satu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv5Reward_option1_answer_008
Array.english: You folks gotta cook and all, so you'll be needin' it more than me, right?
Array.indonesia: Kalian kan harus memasak dan sebagainya, jadi kalian pasti lebih membutuhkannya daripada aku, kan?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv5Reward_option1_answer_009
Array.english: It really means a lot that you'd think of me like that.
Array.indonesia: Aku sangat tersentuh karena kamu memikirkanku seperti itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv5Reward_option1_answer_010
Array.english: Thanks to you, Basu, I got to try fishing...\nIt's been a great experience.
Array.indonesia: Berkat kamu, Basu, aku bisa mencoba memancing...\nIni pengalaman yang luar biasa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv5Reward_option1_answer_011
Array.english: Back at the Blue Hole, I was always diving,\nso I never really got the chance to fish.
Array.indonesia: Dulu di Blue Hole, aku selalu menyelam,\njadi aku nggak pernah benar-benar punya kesempatan untuk memancing.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv5Reward_option1_answer_012
Array.english: Heheh, glad it helped ya some.
Array.indonesia: Heheh, senang kalau itu sedikit membantumu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv5Reward_option1_answer_013
Array.english: You'll be headin' back home one day...\nbut our village ain't gonna forget ya, brother.
Array.indonesia: Suatu hari nanti kamu akan pulang ke rumah...\ntapi desa kita tidak akan melupakanmu, saudaraku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv5Reward_option1_answer_014
Array.english: Thank you for saying that, Basu.
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih sudah mengatakan itu, Basu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv5Reward_option2_answer_001
Array.english: No... with everything goin' on, I haven't really had the chance.
Array.indonesia: Tidak... dengan segala yang terjadi, aku belum benar-benar punya kesempatan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv5Reward_option2_answer_002
Array.english: Heheh, that so.\nHope you get yourself some time soon.
Array.indonesia: Heheh, benar juga.\nSemoga kamu bisa meluangkan waktu sebentar lagi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv5Reward_option2_answer_003
Array.english: Actually, there's somethin' I've been meanin' to give ya as a <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color>...
Array.indonesia: Sebenarnya, ada sesuatu yang sudah lama ingin kuberikan padamu sebagai <color=#FF73C3>Hadiah</color>...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv5Reward_option2_answer_004
Array.english: Oh... what is it?
Array.indonesia: Oh... apa itu?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv5Reward_option2_answer_005
Array.english: This here's called the <color=#F1DC2B>Utara Fishing Rod</color>,\na fine rod that lets ya catch two fish at once!
Array.indonesia: Ini namanya <color=#F1DC2B>Pancing Utara</color>,\npancing bagus yang memungkinkanmu menangkap dua ikan sekaligus!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv5Reward_option2_answer_006
Array.english: You've been busy helpin' out around the village...\nand doin' a lotta cookin' too...
Array.indonesia: Kamu sibuk membantu di desa...\ndan juga sering memasak...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv5Reward_option2_answer_007
Array.english: Catchin' two at a time oughta help ya out plenty, eh? Heheh.
Array.indonesia: Memancing dua ikan sekaligus pasti akan sangat membantumu, kan? Heheh.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv5Reward_option2_answer_008
Array.english: Oh... are you sure you wanna give me something this nice?
Array.indonesia: Oh... kamu yakin mau memberiku sesuatu yang sebagus ini?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv5Reward_option2_answer_009
Array.english: Heheh! Me, I like catchin' 'em one at a time better anyhow.
Array.indonesia: Heheh! Aku sih lebih suka menangkapnya satu per satu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv5Reward_option2_answer_010
Array.english: I see. Then I'll gladly accept it.
Array.indonesia: Begitu ya. Kalau begitu, aku akan menerimanya dengan senang hati.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv5Reward_option2_answer_011
Array.english: Thanks to you, Basu, I got to learn how to fish...\nI've made some great memories.
Array.indonesia: Berkat kamu, Basu, aku bisa belajar memancing...\nAku punya banyak kenangan indah.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv5Reward_option2_answer_012
Array.english: Heheh, that means a lot hearin' that.
Array.indonesia: Heheh, itu berarti banyak bagiku mendengarnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv5Reward_option2_answer_013
Array.english: You'll be headin' back home one day...\nbut our village ain't gonna forget ya, brother.
Array.indonesia: Suatu hari nanti kamu akan pulang ke rumah...\ntapi desa kita tidak akan melupakanmu, saudaraku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv5Reward_option2_answer_014
Array.english: Thank you for saying that, Basu.
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih sudah mengatakan itu, Basu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv5Reward_001
Array.english: Heh, you been putting that axe to good use?
Array.indonesia: Heh, kamu sudah memanfaatkan kapak itu dengan baik?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv5Reward_002
Array.english: Yeah. Thanks for lending it to me, Peneb. I've been using it a lot.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Terima kasih sudah meminjamkannya padaku, Peneb. Aku sudah sering menggunakannya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv5Reward_003
Array.english: Oh, should I be returning it soon?
Array.indonesia: Oh, apakah aku harus mengembalikannya segera?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv5Reward_004
Array.english: Heh, my arm's still not healed.\nJust hang on to it.
Array.indonesia: Heh, lenganku masih belum sembuh.\nSimpan saja dulu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv5Reward_005
Array.english: Oh, thank you. I'll make good use of it!
Array.indonesia: Oh, terima kasih. Aku akan memanfaatkannya dengan baik!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv5Reward_006
Array.english: Ah, speaking of the axe...
Array.indonesia: Ah, ngomong-ngomong soal kapak...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv5Reward_007
Array.english: If you rub some <color=#F1DC2B>Axe Oil</color> on it, it'll keep the blade nice and sharp.
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu mengoleskannya dengan <color=#F1DC2B>Minyak Kapak</color>, bilahnya bakal tetap tajam.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv5Reward_008
Array.english: <size=33>Here, take this as a <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ini, ambil ini sebagai <color=#FF73C3>Hadiah</color>.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv5Reward_009
Array.english: Oh... Peneb, that's really thoughtful of you...!
Array.indonesia: Oh... Peneb, kamu benar-benar baik hati...!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv5Reward_010
Array.english: Wh-what are you talking about! I just had some left over. It's not like I need more axes!
Array.indonesia: A-apa yang kamu bicarakan! Aku cuma punya sisa sedikit. Bukannya aku butuh kapak lagi!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv5Reward_011
Array.english: And... well, if you bring me some good lumber with it,\nthat'll at least keep me from getting bored.
Array.indonesia: Dan... yah, kalau kamu bawakan aku kayu yang bagus juga,\nsetidaknya itu bakal bikin aku nggak bosan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv5Reward_012
Array.english: Sure. If I come across any good lumber, I'll bring it to you!
Array.indonesia: Oke. Kalau aku nemu kayu yang bagus, aku bakal bawakan ke kamu!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv5Reward_001
Array.english: Dave, I heard Setah Forest has been pretty dangerous lately... Are you alright?
Array.indonesia: Dave, aku dengar Hutan Setah belakangan ini cukup berbahaya... Apa kamu baik-baik saja?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv5Reward_002
Array.english: The wild animals have gotten quite aggressive, yes.
Array.indonesia: Hewan-hewan liarnya memang sudah cukup agresif, ya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv5Reward_003
Array.english: I see...
Array.indonesia: Begitu ya...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv5Reward_004
Array.english: If this could be of any help to you...\nI'd like to give it to you as a <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color>.
Array.indonesia: Kalau ini bisa membantumu...\naku ingin memberikannya kepadamu sebagai <color=#FF73C3>Hadiah</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv5Reward_005
Array.english: Hmm? What is it?
Array.indonesia: Hmm? Apa itu?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv5Reward_006
Array.english: This is a <color=#F1DC2B>Lizard Charm</color> I bought during a trip once.
Array.indonesia: Ini adalah <color=#F1DC2B>Jimat Kadal</color> yang kubeli saat bepergian dulu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv5Reward_007
Array.english: I heard that carrying it with you...\ncan protect you from danger.
Array.indonesia: Kudengar kalau membawanya bersamamu...\nbisa melindungimu dari bahaya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv5Reward_008
Array.english: I mostly stay in the village, so I've never really noticed its effects myself.
Array.indonesia: Aku kebanyakan tinggal di desa, jadi aku sendiri belum pernah benar-benar merasakan efeknya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv5Reward_009
Array.english: I think it would be much more useful for you, Dave.\nWould you take it?
Array.indonesia: Menurutku, jimat ini akan jauh lebih berguna bagimu, Dave.\nMau menerimanya?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv5Reward_010
Array.english: Wow... for you to give me such a <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color>...\nThank you so much, Lipah!
Array.indonesia: Wow... kamu memberiku <color=#FF73C3>Hadiah</color> seperti ini...\nTerima kasih banyak, Lipah!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv5Reward_011
Array.english: Hehe, it's nothing. Things have calmed down a lot in the village thanks to you.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, nggak apa-apa. Keadaan di desa sudah jauh lebih tenang berkat kamu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv5Reward_012
Array.english: Oh, if you happen to see any lizards in the forest, could you bring them back? So they don't get eaten by the wild animals.
Array.indonesia: Oh, kalau kebetulan kamu melihat kadal di hutan, bisakah kamu membawanya kembali? Supaya mereka tidak dimakan oleh binatang liar.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv5Reward_013
Array.english: Got it! Don't worry, Lipah!
Array.indonesia: Oke! Jangan khawatir, Lipah!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv5Reward_001
Array.english: Huh...? Jepun, what's going on?
Array.indonesia: Hah...? Jepun, ada apa?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv5Reward_002
Array.english: Tch...! You're already up? Should've come earlier and just left it here.
Array.indonesia: Tch...! Kamu sudah bangun? Seharusnya datang lebih awal dan tinggalkan saja di sini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv5Reward_003
Array.english: What's that basket?
Array.indonesia: Keranjang apa itu?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv5Reward_004
Array.english: Hmph... it's nothing.\nJust had some fruit left over.
Array.indonesia: Hmph... bukan apa-apa.\nCuma sisa buah-buahan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv5Reward_005
Array.english: Didn't have anywhere to put it... so I figured I'd leave it here.
Array.indonesia: Nggak ada tempat buat nyimpennya... jadi kupikir mending ditinggalin di sini aja.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv5Reward_006
Array.english: You eat a lot, don't you?\nTake it and eat it if you want.
Array.indonesia: Kamu makan banyak, ya?\nAmbil saja dan makan kalau mau.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv5Reward_007
Array.english: Hmph... you could use it for cooking too, I guess.
Array.indonesia: Hmph... bisa juga dipakai buat masak, kayaknya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv5Reward_008
Array.english: Wow... bringing this for me...\nThank you so much.
Array.indonesia: Wah... membawakan ini untukku...\nTerima kasih banyak.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv5Reward_009
Array.english: <size=33>Wh-who said I brought it for you!\nI told you, it's just leftovers!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Si-siapa bilang aku membawakannya untukmu!\nSudah kubilang, ini cuma sisa makanan!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv5Reward_010
Array.english: Hehe, alright.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, oke deh.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv5Reward_001
Array.english: Dave, there are a lot of dangerous creatures in the lake, aren't there...?
Array.indonesia: Dave, ada banyak makhluk berbahaya di danau itu, kan...?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv5Reward_002
Array.english: Yeah... the fish can be pretty aggressive.
Array.indonesia: Iya... ikannya bisa cukup agresif.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv5Reward_003
Array.english: But Muna upgraded my weapons,\nso I'm managing just fine.
Array.indonesia: Tapi Muna sudah meningkatkan senjataku,\njadi aku bisa mengatasinya dengan baik.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv5Reward_004
Array.english: I see. I'm not sure if this will help, but...
Array.indonesia: Begitu ya. Aku nggak yakin ini bakal membantu, tapi...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv5Reward_005
Array.english: I'd like to give you this. It's a <color=#F1DC2B>Bracelet of Strength</color> my father gave me.
Array.indonesia: Aku mau kasih ini ke kamu. Ini adalah <color=#F1DC2B>Gelang Kekuatan</color> yang diberikan ayahku kepadaku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv5Reward_006
Array.english: I used to wear it when I trained, but...\nI think it would be more useful for you, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Dulu aku sering memakainya saat berlatih, tapi...\nMenurutku gelang ini bakal lebih berguna buat kamu, Dave.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv5Reward_007
Array.english: If you wear it underwater, you'll be able to use more strength when catching creatures.
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu memakainya di bawah air, kamu bisa menggunakan kekuatan lebih besar saat menangkap makhluk.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv5Reward_008
Array.english: Oh... are you sure I can accept something this precious?
Array.indonesia: Oh... kamu yakin aku boleh menerima sesuatu yang begitu berharga?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv5Reward_009
Array.english: Hehe... you've helped me far more than this, Dave!
Array.indonesia: Hehe... kamu sudah membantuku jauh lebih banyak daripada ini, Dave!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv5Reward_010
Array.english: I just did what anyone would do... really.
Array.indonesia: Aku hanya melakukan apa yang akan dilakukan siapa pun... sungguh.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv5Reward_011
Array.english: Thank you for the <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color>!\nI'll put it to good use, Uzme!
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih atas <color=#FF73C3>Hadiah</color>!\nAku akan memanfaatkannya dengan baik, Uzme!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_Lv5Reward_001
Array.english: Bro, feels like I've been the one gettin' help this whole time...
Array.indonesia: Bro, rasanya selama ini akulah yang selalu dibantu...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_Lv5Reward_002
Array.english: Won somethin' real nice off some guys from the next village the other day.
Array.indonesia: Beberapa hari yang lalu, aku memenangkan sesuatu yang sangat bagus dari beberapa orang di desa sebelah.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_Lv5Reward_003
Array.english: But turns out it only works underwater...
Array.indonesia: Tapi ternyata itu hanya berfungsi di bawah air...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_Lv5Reward_004
Array.english: Well, it's not like I ever go in the water.\nFigure it suits you way better!
Array.indonesia: Yah, lagipula aku kan nggak pernah masuk ke air.\nKayaknya itu lebih cocok buat kamu!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_Lv5Reward_005
Array.english: Hm? Isn't this just a regular <color=#F1DC2B>Gold Necklace</color>?
Array.indonesia: Hm? Bukankah ini cuma <color=#F1DC2B>Kalung Emas</color> biasa?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_Lv5Reward_006
Array.english: Heheh... this here's called the <color=#F1DC2B>Necklace of Laziness</color>...\nMakes everything around you all slow and sluggish.
Array.indonesia: Heheh... ini namanya <color=#F1DC2B>Kalung Kemalasan</color>...\nMembuat segala sesuatu di sekitarmu jadi lambat dan lesu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_Lv5Reward_007
Array.english: Well... wear it underwater and the fish should slow down a bit.
Array.indonesia: Yah... pakai saja di bawah air, dan ikan-ikan di sana seharusnya jadi sedikit lebih lambat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_Lv5Reward_008
Array.english: I see...! That's a pretty interesting item.
Array.indonesia: Oh, begitu...! Itu barang yang cukup menarik.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_Lv5Reward_009
Array.english: I'll put it to good use, Harta! Thanks!
Array.indonesia: Aku akan memanfaatkannya dengan baik, Harta! Terima kasih!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Lv5Reward_001
Array.english: Hehe... hey, you been filling your place up with fun stuff?
Array.indonesia: Hehe... hei, kamu udah mengisi tempatmu dengan barang-barang seru?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Lv5Reward_option1
Array.english: Yeah, got it looking pretty good
Array.indonesia: Iya, udah terlihat lumayan bagus

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Lv5Reward_option2
Array.english: Not really... no time for that
Array.indonesia: Nggak juga... nggak ada waktu buat itu

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Lv5Reward_option1_answer_001
Array.english: Yeah. I decorated it my own way.
Array.indonesia: Iya. Aku mendekorasinya dengan caraku sendiri.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Lv5Reward_option1_answer_002
Array.english: Good to hear.
Array.indonesia: Senang mendengarnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Lv5Reward_option1_answer_003
Array.english: Say, if you've still got some space...
Array.indonesia: Ngomong-ngomong, kalau kamu masih punya ruang...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Lv5Reward_option1_answer_004
Array.english: <size=33>How about setting up this <color=#F1DC2B>All-in-One Game Console</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Gimana kalau pasang <color=#F1DC2B>Konsol Game All-in-One</color> ini?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Lv5Reward_option1_answer_005
Array.english: Oh... isn't this pretty expensive?
Array.indonesia: Oh... bukankah ini cukup mahal?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Lv5Reward_option1_answer_006
Array.english: You bet! I won it in a bet a while back...\nbut it's so big I had nowhere to hide it!
Array.indonesia: Pasti! Aku menang taruhan beberapa waktu lalu...\ntapi ukurannya terlalu besar sampai-sampai aku nggak punya tempat buat menyembunyikannya!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Lv5Reward_option1_answer_007
Array.english: Consider it a <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color>, bro. Take it home and enjoy it.
Array.indonesia: Anggap saja ini <color=#FF73C3>Hadiah</color>, bro. Bawa pulang dan nikmati.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Lv5Reward_option1_answer_008
Array.english: Oh... thanks, Gesang.\nI'll fire it up next time I'm bored, hehe.
Array.indonesia: Oh... makasih, Gesang.\nAku bakal nyalain konsol ini pas lagi bosan nanti, hehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Lv5Reward_option2_answer_001
Array.english: No... I haven't really decorated much yet.
Array.indonesia: Nggak... aku belum banyak mendekorasi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Lv5Reward_option2_answer_002
Array.english: Well... you've been busy, can't blame you.
Array.indonesia: Yah... kamu kan sibuk, wajar aja.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Lv5Reward_option2_answer_003
Array.english: If you've still got some space...
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu masih punya ruang...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Lv5Reward_option2_answer_004
Array.english: <size=33>How about setting up this <color=#F1DC2B>All-in-One Game Console</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Gimana kalau pasang <color=#F1DC2B>Konsol Game All-in-One</color> ini?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Lv5Reward_option2_answer_005
Array.english: Oh... isn't this pretty expensive?
Array.indonesia: Oh... bukankah ini cukup mahal?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Lv5Reward_option2_answer_006
Array.english: You bet! I won it in a bet a while back...\nbut it's so big I had nowhere to hide it.
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja! Aku memenangkannya dalam taruhan beberapa waktu lalu...\ntapi ukurannya begitu besar sampai aku nggak punya tempat untuk menyembunyikannya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Lv5Reward_option2_answer_007
Array.english: Consider it a <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color>, bro. Take it home and enjoy it.
Array.indonesia: Anggap saja ini <color=#FF73C3>Hadiah</color>, bro. Bawa pulang dan nikmati.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Lv5Reward_option2_answer_008
Array.english: Oh... thanks, Gesang.\nI'll fire it up next time I'm bored, hehe.
Array.indonesia: Oh... terima kasih, Gesang.\nAku bakal nyalain konsol ini pas lagi bosan nanti, hehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_Lv5Reward_001
Array.english: Um... Dave.
Array.indonesia: Um... Dave.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_Lv5Reward_002
Array.english: Yes, Chandra? What's going on?
Array.indonesia: Ya, Chandra? Ada apa?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_Lv5Reward_003
Array.english: There are wild animals in Setah Forest with some rather unusual traits.
Array.indonesia: Ada binatang liar di Hutan Setah yang punya ciri-ciri agak aneh.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_Lv5Reward_004
Array.english: Certain attacks don't affect them at all.
Array.indonesia: Serangan tertentu sama sekali nggak berpengaruh pada mereka.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_Lv5Reward_005
Array.english: I have a charm called the <color=#F1DC2B>Eye of the Falcon</color> that I use to keep an eye on my husband...
Array.indonesia: Aku punya jimat bernama <color=#F1DC2B>Mata Elang</color> yang kugunakan untuk mengawasi suamiku...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_Lv5Reward_006
Array.english: When you carry it, you can faintly see the traits of wild animals.
Array.indonesia: Saat kamu membawanya, kamu bisa melihat sekilas ciri-ciri hewan liar.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_Lv5Reward_007
Array.english: ...Though it doesn't work on people or fish, unfortunately.
Array.indonesia: ...Sayangnya, jimat ini tidak berfungsi pada manusia atau ikan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_Lv5Reward_008
Array.english: <size=32>Here... I'd like you to have this, Dave.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ini... Aku ingin kamu memilikinya, Dave.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_Lv5Reward_009
Array.english: It should come in quite handy when you head into the forest, hohoho.
Array.indonesia: Ini pasti akan sangat berguna saat kamu masuk ke hutan, hohoho.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_Lv5Reward_010
Array.english: Oh... thank you...!
Array.indonesia: Oh... terima kasih...!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_Lv5Reward_011
Array.english: I'll make good use of it, Chandra!
Array.indonesia: Aku akan memanfaatkannya dengan baik, Chandra!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_Lv5Reward_012
Array.english: It's been quite entertaining since you arrived, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Sejak kamu datang, semuanya jadi sangat menghibur, Dave.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_Lv5Reward_013
Array.english: It's just a small <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color>, so please accept it.
Array.indonesia: Ini hanya <color=#FF73C3>Hadiah</color> kecil, jadi tolong terimalah.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Lv5Reward_001
Array.english: Dave, would you accept this, if you don't mind?
Array.indonesia: Dave, maukah kamu menerimanya, kalau kamu tidak keberatan?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Lv5Reward_002
Array.english: Hm? What is this?
Array.indonesia: Hm? Apa ini?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Lv5Reward_003
Array.english: It's a <color=#F1DC2B>Butterfly Necklace</color> I used to wear.
Array.indonesia: Ini adalah <color=#F1DC2B>Kalung Kupu-kupu</color> yang dulu sering aku pakai.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Lv5Reward_004
Array.english: With everything that was happening in the village,\nI wore it to calm myself...
Array.indonesia: Dengan segala yang terjadi di desa ini,\naku memakainya untuk menenangkan diri...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Lv5Reward_005
Array.english: Thanks to you and your friends, Dave, things have settled down, so I don't think I'll need it anymore.
Array.indonesia: Berkat kamu dan teman-temanmu, Dave, segalanya sudah kembali tenang, jadi kurasa aku tidak membutuhkannya lagi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Lv5Reward_006
Array.english: As a token of my gratitude... I'd like to give it to you as a <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color>.
Array.indonesia: Sebagai tanda terima kasihku... Aku ingin memberikannya kepadamu sebagai <color=#FF73C3>Hadiah</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Lv5Reward_007
Array.english: Are you sure?\nSomething might happen in the village again.
Array.indonesia: Kamu yakin?\nMungkin saja sesuatu akan terjadi lagi di desa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Lv5Reward_008
Array.english: Hehe... from now on, I can calm my heart through poetry.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... mulai sekarang, aku bisa menenangkan hatiku melalui puisi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Lv5Reward_009
Array.english: I think I've grown a little through all of this too, hehe!
Array.indonesia: Kurasa aku juga sudah sedikit tumbuh melalui semua ini, hehe!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Lv5Reward_010
Array.english: I understand, Kinah.\nI'll put it to good use. Thank you!
Array.indonesia: Aku mengerti, Kinah.\nAku akan memanfaatkannya dengan baik. Terima kasih!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Lv5Reward_001
Array.english: You've caught <color=#F1DC2B><myinfo=JungleFishCount/></color> fish since coming to this village...
Array.indonesia: Kamu sudah menangkap <color=#F1DC2B><myinfo=JungleFishCount/></color> ikan sejak datang ke desa ini...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Lv5Reward_002
Array.english: And you've picked <color=#F1DC2B><myinfo=JungleFlowerCount/></color> flowers. Some of those were the ones I asked for...
Array.indonesia: Dan kamu sudah memetik <color=#F1DC2B><myinfo=JungleFlowerCount/></color> bunga. Beberapa di antaranya adalah yang kuminta...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Lv5Reward_003
Array.english: Huh?! How do you know all that?\nDid you ask an AI?
Array.indonesia: Hah?! Bagaimana kamu tahu semua itu?\nApakah kamu bertanya pada AI?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Lv5Reward_004
Array.english: Hmm... AI...? What could that be...?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... AI...? Apa itu ya...?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Lv5Reward_005
Array.english: Perhaps now that things have settled a little...\nI'm beginning to sense the flow of the village again.
Array.indonesia: Mungkin sekarang setelah segalanya sedikit mereda...\nAku mulai merasakan kembali alur kehidupan desa ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Lv5Reward_006
Array.english: The spirits are always watching over what you have been doing here.
Array.indonesia: Para roh selalu mengawasi apa yang telah kamu lakukan di sini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Lv5Reward_007
Array.english: This may not be of immediate use to your work, but...
Array.indonesia: Ini mungkin tidak langsung berguna untuk pekerjaanmu, tapi...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Lv5Reward_008
Array.english: If you are ever curious, come visit this old woman anytime.
Array.indonesia: Jika suatu saat kamu penasaran, silakan kunjungi wanita tua ini kapan saja.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Lv5Reward_009
Array.english: If the spirits are watching, I guess I can't get away with anything bad in the village!
Array.indonesia: Jika para roh sedang mengawasi, kurasa aku tidak bisa lolos begitu saja jika melakukan hal buruk di desa ini!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Lv5Reward_010
Array.english: Hoho... everyone already knows you're not one to do such things.
Array.indonesia: Hoho... semua orang sudah tahu bahwa kamu bukan tipe orang yang akan melakukan hal-hal seperti itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Lv5Reward_011
Array.english: The spirits are watching over you all with gratitude as well.
Array.indonesia: Para roh juga mengawasi kalian semua dengan rasa syukur.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Lv5Reward_001
Array.english: Have you ever been moved to tears by music, mister?
Array.indonesia: Pernahkah kamu terharu sampai menangis karena musik, Tuan?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Lv5Reward_002
Array.english: Hmm... I went to a concert once... I ended up yawning because it was so boring...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Aku pernah pergi ke konser sekali... Akhirnya aku menguap karena sangat membosankan...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Lv5Reward_003
Array.english: *Sigh*... I suppose sensitivity really does fade with age.
Array.indonesia: *Huff*... Sepertinya kepekaan memang memudar seiring bertambahnya usia.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Lv5Reward_004
Array.english: For a man like you...\nI'll give you a <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color>.
Array.indonesia: Untuk pria sepertimu...\nAku akan memberimu <color=#FF73C3>Hadiah</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Lv5Reward_005
Array.english: This is the OST from a masterpiece of a game called <color=#F1DC2B>To the Moon</color>.
Array.indonesia: Ini adalah OST dari sebuah game masterpiece berjudul <color=#F1DC2B>To the Moon</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Lv5Reward_006
Array.english: Every time I listen to it... I can feel Johnny's longing for River, and it tugs at my heart.
Array.indonesia: Setiap kali aku mendengarkannya... aku bisa merasakan kerinduan Johnny pada River, dan itu menyentuh hatiku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Lv5Reward_007
Array.english: It's a piece with a beautiful melody, as if it's gathering scattered fragments of memory.
Array.indonesia: Ini adalah lagu dengan melodi yang indah, seolah-olah sedang mengumpulkan potongan-potongan kenangan yang tersebar.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Lv5Reward_008
Array.english: Oh... you know it too, Jaka?\nI really enjoyed playing it.
Array.indonesia: Oh... kamu juga tahu lagu ini, Jaka?\nAku benar-benar menikmati memainkannya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Lv5Reward_009
Array.english: It dealt with heavy themes, but thanks to the quirky Dr. Rosalene and Dr. Watts, it never felt overwhelming. I liked that balance.
Array.indonesia: Lagu ini mengangkat tema-tema yang berat, tapi berkat karakter unik Dr. Rosalene dan Dr. Watts, lagu ini tidak pernah terasa membebani. Aku suka keseimbangan itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Lv5Reward_010
Array.english: Hoho... your taste isn't as poor as I thought, mister.
Array.indonesia: Hoho... selera musikmu ternyata tidak seburuk yang kukira, Tuan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Lv5Reward_011
Array.english: Then use the CD player I gave you to listen to this music and experience that emotion once more.
Array.indonesia: Kalau begitu, gunakan pemutar CD yang kuberikan padamu untuk mendengarkan musik ini dan rasakan kembali emosi itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Lv5Reward_012
Array.english: Heh. I guess I'd better have a handkerchief ready for the tears.
Array.indonesia: Heh. Sepertinya aku harus menyiapkan sapu tangan untuk air mata.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Lv5Reward_013
Array.english: This must be a treasured CD from your collection...\nThank you, Jaka.
Array.indonesia: Ini pasti CD berharga dari koleksimu...\nTerima kasih, Jaka.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Lv5Reward_014
Array.english: Good music deserves to be shared with everyone! YEAH!
Array.indonesia: Musik yang bagus pantas dibagikan kepada semua orang! YEAH!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Lv5Reward_001
Array.english: Surely the hardest part of being underwater...\nmust be holding your breath.
Array.indonesia: Tentunya bagian tersulit saat berada di bawah air...\npasti menahan napas.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Lv5Reward_002
Array.english: Yeah... that's definitely the hardest part.
Array.indonesia: Ya... itu pasti bagian tersulitnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Lv5Reward_003
Array.english: Is that... air tank on your back really enough?
Array.indonesia: Apakah... tabung udara di punggungmu itu benar-benar cukup?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Lv5Reward_004
Array.english: Hmm... not really. But there are tools that refill your air underwater.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... tidak juga. Tapi ada alat yang bisa mengisi ulang udara di bawah air.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Lv5Reward_005
Array.english: I see...\nThen perhaps this <color=#F1DC2B>Necklace</color> might be of use.
Array.indonesia: Begitu...\nKalau begitu, mungkin <color=#F1DC2B>Kalung</color> ini bisa berguna.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Lv5Reward_006
Array.english: Huh? What is this?
Array.indonesia: Hah? Apa ini?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Lv5Reward_007
Array.english: This is what's known as an <color=#F1DC2B>Air Resonance Necklace</color>.
Array.indonesia: Ini yang dikenal sebagai <color=#F1DC2B>Kalung Resonansi Udara</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Lv5Reward_008
Array.english: After you refill your air underwater, the wearer's body resonates with the air for a short time.
Array.indonesia: Setelah kamu mengisi ulang udara di bawah air, tubuh pemakainya akan beresonansi dengan udara tersebut untuk waktu yang singkat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Lv5Reward_009
Array.english: You could say it lets you recover for a little longer.
Array.indonesia: Bisa dibilang, ini membuatmu bisa pulih sedikit lebih lama.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Lv5Reward_010
Array.english: Oh... that's actually pretty nice!
Array.indonesia: Oh... itu sebenarnya cukup bagus!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Lv5Reward_011
Array.english: It's just a bit surprising, seeing you be this considerate, Bonita.
Array.indonesia: Hanya saja agak mengejutkan, melihatmu begitu perhatian, Bonita.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Lv5Reward_012
Array.english: <size=32>C-considerate?! Th-that's not it at all...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>P-perhatian?! T-tidak sama sekali...!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Lv5Reward_013
Array.english: <size=33>Y-yes, exactly! It just means you should stay underwater longer!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Y-ya, tepat sekali! Itu cuma berarti kamu harus tetap di bawah air lebih lama!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Lv5Reward_014
Array.english: Got it. I'll try not to get in your way.
Array.indonesia: Paham. Aku akan berusaha tidak menghalangimu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Lv5Reward_015
Array.english: No... well... within reason... let's just get along properly.
Array.indonesia: Tidak... eh... dalam batas wajar... mari kita akur saja.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Lv5Reward_016
Array.english: Got it, Bonita! Thanks for the <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color>!
Array.indonesia: Paham, Bonita! Terima kasih atas <color=#FF73C3>Hadiah</color>-nya!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_Lv5Reward_001
Array.english: It's been quite a while since you came to the village.
Array.indonesia: Sudah cukup lama sejak kamu datang ke desa ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_Lv5Reward_002
Array.english: You're right. Time really flew by.
Array.indonesia: Kamu benar. Waktu benar-benar berlalu begitu cepat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_Lv5Reward_003
Array.english: I hope everything's okay back at the Blue Hole...
Array.indonesia: Semoga semuanya baik-baik saja di Blue Hole...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_Lv5Reward_004
Array.english:
I'd love for you to stay a little longer, Dave,
but I know you'll have to return home someday...
Array.indonesia:
Aku ingin sekali kamu tinggal sedikit lebih lama, Dave,
tapi aku tahu suatu hari nanti kamu harus pulang...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_Lv5Reward_005
Array.english: The kids have really grown fond of you too.
Array.indonesia: Anak-anak juga sudah sangat menyukaimu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_Lv5Reward_006
Array.english: Hehe... they really are such sweet, cheerful kids.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... mereka memang anak-anak yang manis dan ceria.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_Lv5Reward_007
Array.english: It might be a bit early, but... I prepared a <color=#F1DC2B>Handkerchief</color> as a keepsake for when you leave.
Array.indonesia: Mungkin masih agak terlalu dini, tapi... aku sudah menyiapkan <color=#F1DC2B>Saputangan</color> sebagai kenang-kenangan saat kamu pergi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_Lv5Reward_008
Array.english: Oh... did you embroider this yourself, Omila?
Array.indonesia: Oh... apakah kamu yang menyulam ini sendiri, Omila?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_Lv5Reward_009
Array.english: Yes... it's a little embarrassing, but I made it myself.
Array.indonesia: Ya... agak memalukan sih, tapi aku yang membuatnya sendiri.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_Lv5Reward_010
Array.english: If you keep it with you when you're sweating or going through tough times, I'm sure it'll bring you comfort.
Array.indonesia: Jika kamu membawanya saat berkeringat atau sedang menghadapi masa-masa sulit, aku yakin ini akan memberimu kenyamanan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_Lv5Reward_011
Array.english: Thank you for the <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color>, Omila! I'll never forget my time in this village!
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih atas <color=#FF73C3>Hadiah</color>-nya, Omila! Aku takkan pernah melupakan waktuku di desa ini!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_Lv5Reward_001
Array.english: You've done so much for the village, Dave...
Array.indonesia: Kamu sudah berbuat banyak untuk desa ini, Dave...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_Lv5Reward_002
Array.english: But there's not much I can offer in return...
Array.indonesia: Tapi tak banyak yang bisa aku berikan sebagai balasannya...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_Lv5Reward_003
Array.english: What are you talking about? Thanks to you, Perak, I can upgrade my tools and weapons!
Array.indonesia: Apa maksudmu? Berkat kamu, Perak, aku bisa meningkatkan peralatan dan senjataku!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_Lv5Reward_004
Array.english: It really means a lot to hear you say that.
Array.indonesia: Mendengar kamu mengatakan itu benar-benar berarti bagiku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_Lv5Reward_005
Array.english: Still, I'd like to do something for you...
Array.indonesia: Meski begitu, aku ingin melakukan sesuatu untukmu...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_Lv5Reward_006
Array.english: Would it be alright if I only charged <color=#FF73C3>Half</color> my usual fee as a small way of repaying you?
Array.indonesia: Bolehkah aku hanya mengenakan <color=#FF73C3>setengah</color> dari tarif biasanya sebagai bentuk balasan kecil untukmu?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_Lv5Reward_007
Array.english: Oh... are you sure? You really don't mind?
Array.indonesia: Oh... kamu yakin? Kamu benar-benar tidak keberatan?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_Lv5Reward_008
Array.english: Haha. Well, I've gotten used to the work by now...\nso I can make things more easily.
Array.indonesia: Haha. Yah, aku sudah terbiasa dengan pekerjaan ini sekarang...\njadi aku bisa membuatnya dengan lebih mudah.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_Lv5Reward_009
Array.english: But of course, I do have a family to support... so I hope you understand I still need to charge a little.
Array.indonesia: Tapi tentu saja, aku punya keluarga yang harus aku nafkahi... jadi aku harap kamu mengerti bahwa aku tetap perlu mengenakan sedikit biaya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_Lv5Reward_010
Array.english: Of course, that goes without saying.
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja, itu sudah pasti.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_Lv5Reward_011
Array.english: Thanks to you, I'll be able to forge the weapons I hadn't been able to upgrade yet with a lot less trouble.
Array.indonesia: Berkat kamu, aku bisa menempa senjata-senjata yang belum sempat aku tingkatkan dengan jauh lebih mudah.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_Lv5Reward_012
Array.english: Haha. Then I look forward to working with you again, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Haha. Kalau begitu, aku menantikan untuk bekerja sama denganmu lagi, Dave.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Lv5Reward_001
Array.english: Thanks to you, Dave, Jaka has become so much brighter...
Array.indonesia: Berkat kamu, Dave, Jaka jadi jauh lebih ceria...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Lv5Reward_002
Array.english: And I've been able to stop getting lost in memories of my husband too.
Array.indonesia: Dan aku pun bisa berhenti terjebak dalam kenangan tentang suamiku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Lv5Reward_003
