Array.english: It's not because of me...\nYou did this yourself, Cinta.
Array.indonesia: Itu bukan karena aku...\nKamu yang melakukannya sendiri, Cinta.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Lv5Reward_004
Array.english: When you say things like that, it almost makes me cry again...
Array.indonesia: Saat kamu mengatakan hal-hal seperti itu, aku hampir menangis lagi...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Lv5Reward_005
Array.english: I've decided to try getting a little closer to the other villagers too.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah memutuskan untuk mencoba sedikit lebih dekat dengan penduduk desa lainnya juga.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Lv5Reward_006
Array.english: I can't stay the pitiful widow forever!
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak bisa selamanya menjadi janda yang menyedihkan!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Lv5Reward_007
Array.english: As a way of letting go of the past, little by little...\nI'd like to give this to you as a <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color>, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Sebagai cara untuk melepaskan masa lalu, sedikit demi sedikit...\nAku ingin memberikan ini kepadamu sebagai <color=#FF73C3>Hadiah</color>, Dave.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Lv5Reward_008
Array.english: Huh? This is a <color=#F1DC2B>Belt</color>?
Array.indonesia: Hah? Ini <color=#F1DC2B>Sabuk</color>?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Lv5Reward_009
Array.english: Yes. My husband treasured it... He always wore it whenever he went somewhere dangerous.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Suamiku sangat menghargainya... Dia selalu memakainya setiap kali pergi ke tempat yang berbahaya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Lv5Reward_010
Array.english: He said if you block an attack at just the right moment, it can restore you... though I never really understood what he meant.
Array.indonesia: Dia bilang kalau kamu menangkis serangan pada saat yang tepat, ikat pinggang ini bisa memulihkanmu... meskipun aku tidak pernah benar-benar mengerti maksudnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Lv5Reward_011
Array.english: It seems like such an important belonging...\nAre you sure I can have it?
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya ini barang yang sangat berharga...\nKamu yakin aku boleh memilikinya?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Lv5Reward_012
Array.english: Of course. If it's used by someone who needs it,\nI'm sure my husband would be happy too.
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja. Jika benda ini digunakan oleh seseorang yang membutuhkannya,\naku yakin suamiku juga akan senang.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Lv5Reward_013
Array.english: If you're sure... I'll make good use of it, wouldn't want to let him down.
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu yakin... Aku akan memanfaatkannya dengan baik, tidak mau mengecewakannya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Lv5Reward_014
Array.english: I would truly appreciate that.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan sangat menghargainya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Lv5Reward_015
Array.english: We're glad to have you here. Enjoy your stay in the village.
Array.indonesia: Kami senang kamu ada di sini. Selamat menikmati masa tinggalmu di desa ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Lv5Reward_001
Array.english: Mister! Take this, mister!!
Array.indonesia: Pak! Ambil ini, Pak!!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Lv5Reward_002
Array.english: Huh? Isn't this a <color=#F1DC2B>Four-Leaf Clover</color>?
Array.indonesia: Hah? Bukankah ini <color=#F1DC2B>Semanggi Empat Daun</color>?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Lv5Reward_003
Array.english: Yes! That's right.\nI heard if you keep it, it brings you good luck.
Array.indonesia: Ya! Benar sekali.\nAku dengar kalau kamu menyimpannya, itu akan membawa keberuntungan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Lv5Reward_004
Array.english: Oh... you really know your stuff.
Array.indonesia: Oh... kamu benar-benar paham betul soal ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Lv5Reward_005
Array.english: It's something really special... Are you sure you want to give it to me?
Array.indonesia: Ini sesuatu yang sangat istimewa... Kamu yakin mau memberikannya padaku?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Lv5Reward_006
Array.english: Of course! I had so much fun because of you, mister...
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja! Aku sangat bersenang-senang berkat kamu, Pak...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Lv5Reward_007
Array.english: <size=32>And you do all sorts of dangerous things, mister!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Dan kamu melakukan segala macam hal berbahaya, Pak!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Lv5Reward_008
Array.english: <size=32>I want you to stay safe and healthy, mister!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku ingin kamu tetap aman dan sehat, Pak!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Lv5Reward_009
Array.english: Hehe, I will.\nI'll take good care of it.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, pasti.\nAku akan menjaganya dengan baik.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Lv5Reward_010
Array.english: Yes!! I gave it to you, mister!\nDon't forget, okay!
Array.indonesia: Ya!! Aku sudah memberikannya kepadamu, Pak!\nJangan lupa, ya!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Lv5Reward_011
Array.english: Of course. Thank you, Saniah.
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja. Terima kasih, Saniah.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv3Reward_001
Array.english: Come to think of it, I never properly thanked you for performing at the festival.
Array.indonesia: Kalau dipikir-pikir, aku belum pernah benar-benar berterima kasih padamu karena sudah tampil di festival.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv3Reward_002
Array.english: Not at all. I enjoyed it too.
Array.indonesia: Tidak apa-apa. Aku juga menikmatinya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv3Reward_003
Array.english: Hehe, I'm glad to hear that.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, aku senang mendengarnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv3Reward_004
Array.english: This is a traditional decoration from our village that we used at the festival... I'd like you to have it as a <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color>.
Array.indonesia: Ini adalah hiasan tradisional dari desa kami yang kami gunakan di festival... Aku ingin memberikannya kepadamu sebagai <color=#FF73C3>Hadiah</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv3Reward_005
Array.english: Oh... are you sure I can take this?
Array.indonesia: Oh... apakah kamu yakin aku boleh menerimanya?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv3Reward_006
Array.english: You've done so much for the village, so I thought it would be nice to bring a piece of it into your home.
Array.indonesia: Kamu sudah berbuat banyak untuk desa ini, jadi kupikir akan menyenangkan jika ada bagian dari desa ini di rumahmu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv3Reward_007
Array.english: <size=32>I'll be counting on you going forward.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku akan mengandalkanmu ke depannya.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv3Reward_008
Array.english: <size=32>Thank you, Chief!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Terima kasih, Kepala Desa!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv3Reward_001
Array.english: Come to think of it, I've only been receiving help from you, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Kalau dipikir-pikir, selama ini aku hanya menerima bantuan darimu, Dave.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv3Reward_002
Array.english: Not at all. We're working on this together.
Array.indonesia: Tidak sama sekali. Kita mengerjakan ini bersama-sama.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv3Reward_003
Array.english: Hehe... I heard the fish around here can be quite aggressive.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... Aku dengar ikan di sekitar sini bisa cukup agresif.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv3Reward_004
Array.english: I put together a few things that might help you strengthen your weapon, so please take them.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah menyiapkan beberapa barang yang mungkin bisa membantumu memperkuat senjatamu, jadi silakan ambil.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv3Reward_005
Array.english: Oh... <color=#F1DC2B>Black Iron Ingots</color> and <color=#F1DC2B>Tin Ingots</color>...?
Array.indonesia: Oh... <color=#F1DC2B>Batang Besi Hitam</color> dan <color=#F1DC2B>Batang Timah</color>...?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv3Reward_006
Array.english: <size=32>I was actually running a bit low...\nI'll put them to good use!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Sebenarnya persediaanku sudah mulai menipis...\nAku akan memanfaatkannya dengan baik!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv3Reward_007
Array.english: <size=32>Hehe! I'll be counting on you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehe! Aku mengandalkanmu!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv3Reward_001
Array.english: Dave, you fixin' up your room any?
Array.indonesia: Dave, kamu sudah mulai merapikan kamarmu?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv3Reward_option1
Array.english: Yeah, I've done a bit
Array.indonesia: Ya, sudah sedikit

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv3Reward_option2
Array.english: Not yet...
Array.indonesia: Belum...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv3Reward_option1_answer_001
Array.english: Hehe, a good night's sleep makes for a good day!
Array.indonesia: Hehe, tidur nyenyak bikin hari jadi menyenangkan!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv3Reward_option1_answer_002
Array.english: If you've got the space, how about puttin' this on display?
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu punya ruang, gimana kalau memajang ini?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv3Reward_option1_answer_003
Array.english: Oh... isn't this the truck you drive, Rimbo?
Array.indonesia: Oh... bukankah ini truk yang kamu kendarai, Rimbo?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv3Reward_option1_answer_004
Array.english: Haha, you've got a good eye.
Array.indonesia: Haha, matamu tajam banget.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv3Reward_option1_answer_005
Array.english: This truck here's a <color=#F1DC2B>Pony Pickup Truck</color> released in Korea back in 1976.
Array.indonesia: Truk ini adalah <color=#F1DC2B>Pony Pickup Truck</color> yang dirilis di Korea pada tahun 1976.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv3Reward_option1_answer_006
Array.english: It's based on a passenger car, so it rides real smooth.\nBuilt tough enough to still run just fine, too!
Array.indonesia: Truk ini didasarkan pada mobil penumpang, jadi pengendaraannya sangat mulus.\nDibuat cukup kokoh sehingga masih bisa berjalan dengan baik!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv3Reward_option1_answer_007
Array.english: Oh... it's that old?\nStill looks so classic and cool.
Array.indonesia: Oh... sudah setua itu?\nTetap terlihat klasik dan keren.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv3Reward_option1_answer_008
Array.english: Hehe, this here's a limited edition die-cast model I picked up...
Array.indonesia: Hehe, ini adalah model die-cast edisi terbatas yang aku beli...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv3Reward_option1_answer_009
Array.english: <size=32>I'd be mighty pleased if ya'd take it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku akan sangat senang kalau kamu mau menerimanya.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv3Reward_option1_answer_010
Array.english: Oh... this really means a lot.
Array.indonesia: Oh... ini benar-benar berarti bagiku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv3Reward_option1_answer_011
Array.english: <size=32>I'll gladly take it! Thank you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku dengan senang hati menerimanya! Terima kasih!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv3Reward_option2_answer_001
Array.english: Haha, I reckon you've been busy, so that's fair enough.
Array.indonesia: Haha, kurasa kamu sedang sibuk, jadi wajar saja.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv3Reward_option2_answer_002
Array.english: Then how about puttin' this on display instead?
Array.indonesia: Kalau begitu, bagaimana kalau kamu pajang ini saja?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv3Reward_option2_answer_003
Array.english: Oh... isn't this the truck you drive, Rimbo?
Array.indonesia: Oh... bukankah ini truk yang kamu kendarai, Rimbo?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv3Reward_option2_answer_004
Array.english: Haha, you've got a sharp eye.
Array.indonesia: Haha, matamu tajam sekali.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv3Reward_option2_answer_005
Array.english: This here's a <color=#F1DC2B>Pony Pickup Truck</color>, released in Korea back in '76.
Array.indonesia: Ini adalah <color=#F1DC2B>Pony Pickup Truck</color>, yang dirilis di Korea pada tahun '76.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv3Reward_option2_answer_006
Array.english: It's based on a passenger car, so it rides real smooth.\nBuilt tough enough to still run just fine, too!
Array.indonesia: Truk ini didasarkan pada mobil penumpang, jadi pengendaraannya sangat mulus.\nDibuat cukup kokoh sehingga masih bisa berjalan dengan baik!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv3Reward_option2_answer_007
Array.english: Oh... I didn't realize it was that old.\nEven now, it looks so classic and cool.
Array.indonesia: Oh... aku tidak menyadari kalau truk ini sudah setua itu.\nBahkan sekarang, truk ini terlihat sangat klasik dan keren.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv3Reward_option2_answer_008
Array.english: Haha, well, this is a limited edition die-cast model I picked up...
Array.indonesia: Haha, ya, ini adalah model die-cast edisi terbatas yang aku beli...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv3Reward_option2_answer_009
Array.english: <size=32>I'd be mighty pleased if you'd take it, Dave.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku akan sangat senang kalau kamu mau menerimanya, Dave.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv3Reward_option2_answer_010
Array.english: This is a really meaningful gift.
Array.indonesia: Ini adalah hadiah yang sangat bermakna.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv3Reward_option2_answer_011
Array.english: <size=32>I'll gladly take it! Thank you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku dengan senang hati menerimanya! Terima kasih!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv3Reward_001
Array.english: Dave, how's the investigation going?
Array.indonesia: Dave, bagaimana perkembangan penyelidikannya?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv3Reward_002
Array.english: It is going well, but the creatures have gotten a lot more aggressive.
Array.indonesia: Berjalan lancar, tapi makhluk-makhluk itu jadi jauh lebih agresif.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv3Reward_003
Array.english: I'm having a bit of trouble gathering ingredients.
Array.indonesia: Aku agak kesulitan mengumpulkan bahan-bahannya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv3Reward_004
Array.english: Hehe, I see.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, begitu ya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv3Reward_005
Array.english: I can't help with other ingredients...\nbut I can share some herbs and spices.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak bisa membantu dengan bahan-bahan lain...\ntapi aku bisa membagikan beberapa rempah dan bumbu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv3Reward_006
Array.english: I'll give you free <color=#F1DC2B>Herbs</color> or <color=#F1DC2B>Spices</color> every day.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan memberimu <color=#F1DC2B>Rempah</color> atau <color=#F1DC2B>Bumbu</color> gratis setiap hari.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv3Reward_007
Array.english: Oh... that would really help!\nThank you!
Array.indonesia: Oh... itu akan sangat membantu!\nTerima kasih!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv3Reward_008
Array.english: Hehe, just come to me when you need them.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, datang saja padaku kalau kamu membutuhkannya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv3Reward_009
Array.english: Oh, and I've added a few more ingredients to the shop.
Array.indonesia: Oh, dan aku sudah menambahkan beberapa bahan lagi ke toko.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv3Reward_010
Array.english: I'm counting on you.
Array.indonesia: Aku mengandalkanmu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv3Reward_001
Array.english: Ah, now that I think about it...
Array.indonesia: Ah, sekarang setelah kupikir-pikir...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv3Reward_002
Array.english: I've got a real sturdy fishin' rod...
Array.indonesia: Aku punya joran yang sangat kokoh...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv3Reward_003
Array.english: I once caught two Redtail Catfish with it.
Array.indonesia: Aku pernah menangkap dua Ikan Lele Ekor Merah dengan joran itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv3Reward_004
Array.english: Cooked one up real nice...
Array.indonesia: Satu aku masak dengan enak...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv3Reward_005
Array.english: And the other, I had <color=#F1DC2B>Taxidermied</color> as a souvenir.
Array.indonesia: Dan yang satunya lagi, aku <color=#F1DC2B>awetkan</color> sebagai kenang-kenangan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv3Reward_006
Array.english: If ya got the space, how 'bout puttin' it up in your room?
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu punya tempat, gimana kalau kamu pajang di kamarmu?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv3Reward_007
Array.english: Oh... are you giving it to me as a <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color>?
Array.indonesia: Oh... apa kamu memberikannya kepadaku sebagai <color=#FF73C3>Hadiah</color>?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv3Reward_008
Array.english: Hehe! This village has a way of tradin' <color=#FF73C3>Gifts</color>,\nso I can't be the only one gettin' 'em!
Array.indonesia: Hehe! Desa ini punya tradisi bertukar <color=#FF73C3>Hadiah</color>,\njadi aku pasti bukan satu-satunya yang mendapatkannya!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv3Reward_009
Array.english: I'll put it to good use, Basu! Thank you!
Array.indonesia: Aku akan memanfaatkannya dengan baik, Basu! Terima kasih!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv3Reward_001
Array.english: You know, your shop...
Array.indonesia: Kamu tahu, tokomu...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv3Reward_002
Array.english: Yes. Is there a problem?
Array.indonesia: Ya. Ada masalah?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv3Reward_003
Array.english: It's a shop in this village, but... it's missing that village style.
Array.indonesia: Ini memang toko di desa ini, tapi... kurang gaya desa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv3Reward_004
Array.english: So I made some decorations with traditional village patterns.
Array.indonesia: Jadi aku membuat beberapa hiasan dengan motif tradisional desa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv3Reward_005
Array.english: <size=32>Well, if you want them, go ahead and use them.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Nah, kalau kamu mau, silakan gunakan saja.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv3Reward_006
Array.english: Oh... are you giving them to me as a <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color>?
Array.indonesia: Oh... apakah kamu memberikannya kepadaku sebagai <color=#FF73C3>Hadiah</color>?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv3Reward_007
Array.english: <size=33>They're really amazing!\nGiving me a gift like this... you're the best!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ini benar-benar luar biasa!\nMemberiku hadiah seperti ini... kamu yang terbaik!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv3Reward_008
Array.english: <size=35>What...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Apa...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv3Reward_009
Array.english: <size=35>What are you talking about?<color=#ff61e3>♥</color>\nI just had some leftover wood, that's all!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Apa yang kamu bicarakan?<color=#ff61e3>♥</color>\nAku cuma punya sisa kayu, itu saja!?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv3Reward_010
Array.english: Yeah, I know.\nI'll put them to good use.
Array.indonesia: Ya, aku tahu.\nAku akan memanfaatkannya dengan baik.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv3Reward_001
Array.english: The big-eyed lizard you caught for me, Dave,\nis doing well and healthy.
Array.indonesia: Kadal bermata besar yang kamu tangkap untukku, Dave,\nsekarang baik-baik saja dan sehat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv3Reward_002
Array.english: I see. That's a relief.
Array.indonesia: Begitu. Syukurlah.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv3Reward_003
Array.english: If you're interested... would you like me to show you our <color=#F1DC2B>Breeding Pen</color>?
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu tertarik... maukah aku menunjukkan <color=#F1DC2B>Kandang Pembiakan</color> kami?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv3Reward_004
Array.english: Oh... really?
Array.indonesia: Oh... beneran?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv3Reward_005
Array.english: Yes. But the lizards I was raising before have grown well, so I moved them somewhere safe.
Array.indonesia: Iya. Tapi kadal-kadal yang aku pelihara sebelumnya sudah tumbuh dengan baik, jadi aku pindahkan ke tempat yang aman.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv3Reward_006
Array.english: Right now... I only have the one you gave me as a <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color>.
Array.indonesia: Saat ini... aku hanya punya yang kamu berikan padaku sebagai <color=#FF73C3>Hadiah</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv3Reward_007
Array.english: I see. Then I'll bring you more!
Array.indonesia: Oh, begitu. Kalau begitu, aku akan membawakanmu lebih banyak lagi!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv3Reward_008
Array.english:
Hehe. With the animals being more aggressive lately,
that would be better for the lizards too.
Array.indonesia:
Hehe. Karena hewan-hewan belakangan ini makin agresif,
itu juga akan lebih baik buat kadal-kadal itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv3Reward_009
Array.english: Then I'll be counting on you from now on.
Array.indonesia: Kalau begitu, mulai sekarang aku akan mengandalkanmu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv3Reward_001
Array.english: I heard you folks carry some strange things on your phones?
Array.indonesia: Aku dengar kalian membawa benda-benda aneh di ponsel kalian?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv3Reward_002
Array.english: Ah... you mean <color=#F1DC2B>Keychains</color>.
Array.indonesia: Ah... maksudmu <color=#F1DC2B>Gantungan Kunci</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv3Reward_003
Array.english: Yeah. They're a way to show your personality!
Array.indonesia: Iya. Itu cara untuk menunjukkan kepribadianmu!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv3Reward_004
Array.english: <size=32>Tsk! Personality, my foot! If you're using this village's ingredients, you ought to show some gratitude!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tsk! Kepribadian, ampun deh! Kalau kalian pakai bahan-bahan dari desa ini, kalian harusnya menunjukkan rasa syukur!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv3Reward_005
Array.english: <size=32>Take this <color=#F1DC2B>Keychain</color> made from coconut and use this instead!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ambil <color=#F1DC2B>Keychain</color> yang terbuat dari kelapa ini dan gunakan ini saja!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv3Reward_006
Array.english: Oh... this is a really nice keychain.
Array.indonesia: Oh... ini gantungan kunci yang sangat bagus.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv3Reward_007
Array.english: <size=32>I'm not giving it to you because it looks nice! It's to remind you to be grateful for the food you eat every day!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku tidak memberikannya kepadamu karena terlihat bagus! Ini untuk mengingatkanmu agar bersyukur atas makanan yang kamu makan setiap hari!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv3Reward_008
Array.english: Yes, of course I know that. Thank you! I'll make good use of it.
Array.indonesia: Ya, tentu saja aku tahu itu. Terima kasih! Aku akan memanfaatkannya dengan baik.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv3Reward_001
Array.english: I think the village has felt more lively since you all arrived, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Menurutku desa ini terasa lebih semarak sejak kalian semua datang, Dave.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv3Reward_002
Array.english: That's good to hear.
Array.indonesia: Senang mendengarnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv3Reward_003
Array.english: Bancho's food is so delicious, too. I don't know how he makes it taste this good with the same ingredients...
Array.indonesia: Makanan Bancho juga sangat lezat. Aku tidak tahu bagaimana dia bisa membuatnya terasa begitu enak dengan bahan-bahan yang sama...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv3Reward_004
Array.english: Actually, Bancho specializes in sushi, not grilling.\nHe just can't make it here.
Array.indonesia: Sebenarnya, Bancho spesialisnya sushi, bukan memanggang.\nDia memang tidak bisa membuatnya di sini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv3Reward_005
Array.english: <size=32>I see...\nI'd love to try it someday...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, begitu...\nAku ingin sekali mencobanya suatu hari nanti...!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv3Reward_006
Array.english: I thought it might be nice to decorate Bancho's shop a little more, so I prepared this...
Array.indonesia: Aku pikir mungkin akan bagus kalau toko Bancho didekorasi sedikit lagi, jadi aku menyiapkan ini...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv3Reward_007
Array.english: <size=33>...Do you think he'll like it?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...Do menurutmu dia akan menyukainya?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv3Reward_008
Array.english: Oh... it's really pretty! Did you make it yourself?
Array.indonesia: Oh... ini benar-benar cantik! Apa kamu yang membuatnya sendiri?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv3Reward_009
Array.english: Yes... I wove it using things I found on the beach,\nor that Rimbo sometimes brings me.
Array.indonesia: Ya... Aku menenunnya menggunakan benda-benda yang kutemukan di pantai,\natau yang kadang-kadang dibawa Rimbo untukku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv3Reward_010
Array.english: But... wouldn't he like it more if you gave it to him yourself?
Array.indonesia: Tapi... bukankah dia akan lebih menyukainya kalau kamu memberikannya sendiri?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv3Reward_011
Array.english: <size=34>Eek...! That would be far too embarrassing...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aduh...! Itu pasti terlalu memalukan...!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv3Reward_012
Array.english: <size=32>Alright. I'll make sure he gets it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Baiklah. Aku akan pastikan dia mendapatkannya!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_Lv3Reward_001
Array.english: Feels like I've just been on the receiving end and haven't done much for you.
Array.indonesia: Rasanya aku cuma terus menerima bantuan dan belum banyak berbuat untukmu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_Lv3Reward_002
Array.english: Not at all. I owe the village a lot.
Array.indonesia: Tidak sama sekali. Aku berhutang banyak pada desa ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_Lv3Reward_003
Array.english: Haha. Well, it's not much, but take this.
Array.indonesia: Haha. Yah, ini memang tidak seberapa, tapi ambil ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_Lv3Reward_004
Array.english: It's an <color=#F1DC2B>Amber Bead</color>... Won it in a bet with some folks from the next village.
Array.indonesia: Ini adalah <color=#F1DC2B>Manik Amber</color>... Aku mendapatkannya dari taruhan dengan beberapa orang dari desa sebelah.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_Lv3Reward_005
Array.english: They say it helps things grow... but I don't really know what that means.
Array.indonesia: Katanya ini membantu tanaman tumbuh... tapi aku nggak begitu paham maksudnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_Lv3Reward_006
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... thanks! I'm sure I'll find a use for it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... terima kasih! Pasti aku bisa memanfaatkannya!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Lv3Reward_001
Array.english: Oh, right... I brought something for you...
Array.indonesia: Oh, iya... aku bawa sesuatu untukmu...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Lv3Reward_002
Array.english: Oh... what is it?\nIs it food?
Array.indonesia: Oh... apa itu?\nMakanan?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Lv3Reward_003
Array.english: <size=32><color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color>. You know that game, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32><color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color>. Kamu tahu permainan itu, kan?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Lv3Reward_004
Array.english: Yeah. You and Harta showed me before.
Array.indonesia: Iya. Kamu dan Harta pernah nunjukin ke aku sebelumnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Lv3Reward_005
Array.english: Hehe. Well, there's this game I really like...
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Nah, ada permainan yang aku sangat suka...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Lv3Reward_006
Array.english: It's a puzzle game where you control a squishy character.
Array.indonesia: Itu permainan teka-teki di mana kamu mengendalikan karakter yang lentur.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Lv3Reward_007
Array.english: It's hilarious when they fall from high places.
Array.indonesia: Lucu banget kalau mereka jatuh dari tempat tinggi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Lv3Reward_008
Array.english: So I carved these wooden character blocks!
Array.indonesia: Jadi, aku mengukir balok-balok karakter kayu ini!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Lv3Reward_009
Array.english: They're not animal blocks, so they're easier to carry around without my wife noticing...
Array.indonesia: Ini bukan balok hewan, jadi lebih gampang dibawa-bawa tanpa ketahuan istriku. ..

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Lv3Reward_010
Array.english: But I think she's starting to get suspicious...
Array.indonesia: Tapi kayaknya dia mulai curiga...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Lv3Reward_011
Array.english: <color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color> is more fun with more blocks!
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Menumpuk Balok Hewan</color> lebih seru kalau baloknya banyak!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Lv3Reward_012
Array.english: I'll give these to you, so we can use them when we play.
Array.indonesia: Aku kasih ini ke kamu, biar kita bisa pakai pas main.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Lv3Reward_013
Array.english: These wooden blocks have interesting shapes.\nI'll put them to good use! Thanks, Gesang.
Array.indonesia: Balok kayu ini bentuknya menarik.\nAku bakal manfaatkan ini dengan baik! Terima kasih, Gesang.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_Lv3Reward_001
Array.english: Is the house comfortable?
Array.indonesia: Apakah rumahnya nyaman?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_Lv3Reward_002
Array.english: Yes. It leaked at first, but after Cobra fixed it,\nit's been fine.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Awalnya bocor, tapi setelah Cobra memperbaikinya,\nsekarang sudah baik-baik saja.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_Lv3Reward_003
Array.english: Still, if the ground's damp, there must be a chill coming up from below...
Array.indonesia: Meski begitu, kalau tanahnya lembap, pasti ada hawa dingin yang naik dari bawah...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_Lv3Reward_004
Array.english: Here... I wove this <color=#F1DC2B>Carpet</color> myself a while back.\nIf you need it, take it.
Array.indonesia: Ini... Aku menenun <color=#F1DC2B>karpet</color> ini sendiri beberapa waktu lalu.\nKalau kamu butuh, silakan ambil.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_Lv3Reward_005
Array.english: Oh... I didn't know you were this handy?
Array.indonesia: Oh... Aku tidak tahu kamu sehandal ini?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_Lv3Reward_006
Array.english: What, you thought I just sit around while my husband does all the work?
Array.indonesia: Apa, kamu kira aku cuma duduk-duduk saja sementara suamiku yang mengerjakan semuanya?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_Lv3Reward_007
Array.english: Ah... no, that's not what I meant...
Array.indonesia: Ah... tidak, bukan itu maksudku...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_Lv3Reward_008
Array.english: Anyway, I'll put it to good use!\nThank you.
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun, aku akan memanfaatkannya dengan baik!\nTerima kasih.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Lv3Reward_001
Array.english: Dave, have you been reading much?
Array.indonesia: Dave, apakah kamu sering membaca belakangan ini?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Lv3Reward_002
Array.english: Ah... well... I used to read a lot...\nbut I've been so busy since coming here...
Array.indonesia: Ah... ya... dulu aku sering membaca...\ntapi aku sangat sibuk sejak datang ke sini...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Lv3Reward_003
Array.english: I see... though I have a feeling it was mostly comics...
Array.indonesia: Begitu... meskipun aku merasa kebanyakan yang kamu baca itu komik...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Lv3Reward_004
Array.english: I have a <color=#F1DC2B>Bookshelf</color> I used to use. Would you like to put it in your room?
Array.indonesia: Aku punya <color=#F1DC2B>rak buku</color> yang dulu sering aku pakai. Mau aku taruh di kamarmu?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Lv3Reward_005
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... yes, I'd love that!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... ya, aku mau banget!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Lv3Reward_006
Array.english: Then... I'll give it to you as a <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color>, so you can keep it in your room and read when you have time.
Array.indonesia: Kalau begitu... Aku akan memberikannya kepadamu sebagai <color=#FF73C3>Hadiah</color>, jadi kamu bisa menyimpannya di kamarmu dan membacanya saat ada waktu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Lv3Reward_007
Array.english: Okay, I will.\nThanks for the thoughtful gift, Kinah.
Array.indonesia: Oke, aku akan melakukannya.\nTerima kasih atas hadiahnya yang penuh perhatian, Kinah.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Lv3Reward_001
Array.english: I'm so grateful you've come to help the village...
Array.indonesia: Aku sangat bersyukur kamu datang untuk membantu desa ini...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Lv3Reward_002
Array.english: I wanted to give you a <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color>, but I only just finished making it.
Array.indonesia: Aku ingin memberimu <color=#FF73C3>Hadiah</color>, tapi aku baru saja selesai membuatnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Lv3Reward_003
Array.english: Oh... you really didn't have to.
Array.indonesia: Oh... kamu sebenarnya tidak perlu repot-repot.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Lv3Reward_004
Array.english: Hehe... it's just a token of this old woman's gratitude, so please accept it.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... ini hanya tanda terima kasih dari wanita tua ini, jadi tolong terimalah.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Lv3Reward_005
Array.english: It's a decoration I made by weaving flowers from our village. I thought it would look nice in your shop.
Array.indonesia: Ini hiasan yang kubuat dengan menganyam bunga-bunga dari desa kami. Kupikir ini akan terlihat bagus di tokomu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Lv3Reward_006
Array.english: <size=32>Wow... it's really beautiful!?\nThank you so much! I'll put it to good use!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wah... ini benar-benar indah!?\nTerima kasih banyak! Aku akan memanfaatkannya dengan baik!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Lv3Reward_001
Array.english: It might be a coincidence, but...
Array.indonesia: Mungkin ini hanya kebetulan, tapi...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Lv3Reward_002
Array.english: Since you all arrived, my musical ideas have been flowing much more easily.
Array.indonesia: Sejak kalian semua datang, ide-ide musikku mengalir jauh lebih lancar.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Lv3Reward_003
Array.english: That's good to hear.\nMaybe it's thanks to the good food.
Array.indonesia: Senang mendengarnya.\nMungkin berkat makanan yang enak.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Lv3Reward_004
Array.english: <size=32>Hehe... perhaps.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehe... mungkin saja.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Lv3Reward_005
Array.english: This is an instrument I used to play...\nPlease take it if you'd like.
Array.indonesia: Ini adalah alat musik yang dulu sering aku mainkan...\nSilakan ambil jika kalian mau.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Lv3Reward_006
Array.english: Oh... but I don't know how to play.
Array.indonesia: Oh... tapi aku tidak tahu cara memainkannya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Lv3Reward_007
Array.english: Well... many people keep instruments as decorations in their rooms.
Array.indonesia: Yah... banyak orang yang menyimpan alat musik sebagai hiasan di kamar mereka.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Lv3Reward_008
Array.english: See you later, mister.
Array.indonesia: Sampai jumpa nanti, Pak.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Lv3Reward_001
Array.english: <size=33>Your posture is quite poor...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Posturmu cukup buruk...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Lv3Reward_002
Array.english: <size=35>That was out of nowhere.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Itu muncul begitu saja.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Lv3Reward_003
Array.english: If you don't make an effort to correct it, it will only get worse.
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu nggak berusaha memperbaikinya, situasinya bakal makin parah.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Lv3Reward_004
Array.english: Well... since you helped me a bit...\nI'll give you this to use.
Array.indonesia: Yah... karena kamu udah bantuin aku sedikit...\nAku bakal kasih ini buat kamu pakai.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Lv3Reward_005
Array.english: Huh?... What's this?
Array.indonesia: Hah?... Apa ini?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Lv3Reward_006
Array.english: <size=32>It's a <color=#F1DC2B>Yoga Mat</color>.\nYou use it to do yoga poses.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ini adalah <color=#F1DC2B>Matras Yoga</color>.\nKamu menggunakannya untuk melakukan pose yoga.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Lv3Reward_007
Array.english: Hmm... I see.\nI'm not sure how to use it, but... thanks anyway.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Begitu ya.\nAku tidak yakin bagaimana cara menggunakannya, tapi... terima kasih saja.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Lv3Reward_008
Array.english: Yoga helps relax the body and calm the mind.
Array.indonesia: Yoga membantu merilekskan tubuh dan menenangkan pikiran.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Lv3Reward_009
Array.english: I've seen you diving a lot... so you should make good use of it.
Array.indonesia: Aku sering melihatmu menyelam... jadi sebaiknya kamu memanfaatkannya dengan baik.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_Lv3Reward_001
Array.english: The food at your shop...\nhow is it so delicious?
Array.indonesia: Makanan di tokomu...\nkenapa bisa begitu lezat?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_Lv3Reward_002
Array.english: Hehe, Bancho's cooking is the best in the world!
Array.indonesia: Hehe, masakan Bancho adalah yang terbaik di dunia!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_Lv3Reward_003
Array.english: He can make anything taste amazing, no matter the ingredient.
Array.indonesia: Dia bisa membuat apa pun terasa luar biasa, apa pun bahannya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_Lv3Reward_004
Array.english: Haha, you really are proud of your friend.
Array.indonesia: Haha, kamu memang bangga sekali pada temanmu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_Lv3Reward_005
Array.english: I thought it would be nice if this delicious food were served on prettier tables.
Array.indonesia: Menurutku akan lebih bagus kalau makanan lezat ini disajikan di atas meja yang lebih cantik.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_Lv3Reward_006
Array.english: This is a <color=#F1DC2B>Table Decoration</color> with our village's traditional pattern... please take it if you'd like.
Array.indonesia: Ini adalah <color=#F1DC2B>Hiasan Meja</color> dengan motif tradisional desa kita... silakan ambil kalau kamu mau.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_Lv3Reward_007
Array.english: Oh... it's so pretty.\nThank you!
Array.indonesia: Oh... ini sangat cantik.\nTerima kasih!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_Lv3Reward_008
Array.english: Hehe. Please continue to take care of our village.
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Tolong terus jaga desa kami.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Lv3Reward_001
Array.english: Mister, what was the name of that dinosaur that washed up on Lake Beach?
Array.indonesia: Pak, apa nama dinosaurus yang terdampar di Pantai Danau itu?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Lv3Reward_option1
Array.english: Basilosaurus
Array.indonesia: Basilosaurus

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Lv3Reward_option2
Array.english: Biosaurus
Array.indonesia: Biosaurus

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Lv3Reward_option1_answer_001
Array.english: Oh! I think that's the right name, hehe!
Array.indonesia: Oh! Kurasa itu nama yang benar, hehe!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Lv3Reward_option1_answer_002
Array.english: I actually made that dinosaur out of clay!
Array.indonesia: Sebenarnya aku membuat dinosaurus itu dari tanah liat!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Lv3Reward_option1_answer_003
Array.english: I'll give this to you as a <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color>, mister.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan memberikan ini kepadamu sebagai <color=#FF73C3>Hadiah</color>, Pak.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Lv3Reward_option1_answer_004
Array.english: Oh... you did a really great job.
Array.indonesia: Oh... kamu membuatnya dengan sangat bagus.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Lv3Reward_option1_answer_005
Array.english: <size=32>Thanks. I'll put it on display!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Terima kasih. Aku akan memajangnya!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Lv3Reward_option2_answer_001
Array.english: Hmm... I don't think it had a name like that...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Sepertinya dinosaurus itu tidak punya nama seperti itu...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Lv3Reward_option2_answer_002
Array.english: Anyway, I made a clay model of that dinosaur!
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun, aku membuat model tanah liat dari dinosaurus itu!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Lv3Reward_option2_answer_003
Array.english: I'll give this to you as a <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color>, mister.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan memberikannya kepadamu sebagai <color=#FF73C3>Hadiah</color>, Pak.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Lv3Reward_option2_answer_004
Array.english: Oh... you did a really great job on this.
Array.indonesia: Oh... kamu benar-benar hebat membuatnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Lv3Reward_option2_answer_005
Array.english: <size=32>Thanks. I'll put it on display!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Terima kasih. Aku akan memajangnya!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Lv3Reward_001
Array.english: <size=33>I'm so happy you came to the village, mister!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku sangat senang kamu datang ke desa ini, Pak!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Lv3Reward_002
Array.english: Hehe, I'm really glad to hear that.\nThanks.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, aku sangat senang mendengarnya.\nTerima kasih.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Lv3Reward_003
Array.english: This is my favorite <color=#F1DC2B>Bunny Doll</color>.
Array.indonesia: Ini adalah <color=#F1DC2B>Boneka Kelinci</color> favoritku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Lv3Reward_004
Array.english: <size=32>I'll give it to you as a <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color>, mister!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku akan memberikannya kepadamu sebagai <color=#FF73C3>Hadiah</color>, Pak!!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Lv3Reward_005
Array.english: Oh... are you sure? Isn't this something you really like?
Array.indonesia: Oh... kamu yakin? Bukankah ini sesuatu yang sangat kamu sukai?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Lv3Reward_006
Array.english: It's okay! Daddy gave me lots of toys.
Array.indonesia: Tidak apa-apa! Ayah memberiku banyak mainan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Lv3Reward_007
Array.english: Alright, thanks.\nI'll take good care of it.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah, terima kasih.\nAku akan menjaganya dengan baik.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Lv3Reward_001
Array.english: Mister, did you know some artworks become incredibly valuable in the future?
Array.indonesia: Pak, tahukah kamu bahwa beberapa karya seni bisa menjadi sangat berharga di masa depan?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Lv3Reward_002
Array.english: Hmm. I've heard that. Like geniuses who were ahead of their time.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Aku pernah dengar itu. Seperti para jenius yang jauh lebih maju dari zamannya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Lv3Reward_003
Array.english: You seem like a nice person, mister, so I'm going to give you a special opportunity...
Array.indonesia: Kamu kelihatannya orang yang baik, Pak, jadi aku akan memberimu kesempatan istimewa...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Lv3Reward_004
Array.english: This is a <color=#F1DC2B>Robot Samurai Painting</color> I made myself.
Array.indonesia: Ini adalah <color=#F1DC2B>Lukisan Samurai Robot</color> yang saya buat sendiri.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Lv3Reward_005
Array.english: If you keep it, the world will want it someday.
Array.indonesia: Jika Kamu menyimpannya, suatu hari nanti dunia akan menginginkannya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Lv3Reward_006
Array.english: Uh... okay. Thanks.\nI really hope so...
Array.indonesia: Uh... oke. Terima kasih.\nSaya sangat berharap begitu...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Lv3Reward_007
Array.english: Hehe. You can thank me when it's worth hundreds of millions of gold.
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Kamu bisa berterima kasih kepada saya saat nilainya mencapai ratusan juta emas.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Marone_Lv3Reward_001
Array.english: Woof!
Array.indonesia: Woof!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Marone_Lv3Reward_002
Array.english: Huh? What's up?
Array.indonesia: Hah? Ada apa?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Marone_Lv3Reward_003
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Wags his tail happily)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Mengibaskan ekornya dengan gembira)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Marone_Lv3Reward_004
Array.english: Oh, he's holding something in his mouth.
Array.indonesia: Oh, dia sedang menggigit sesuatu di mulutnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Marone_Lv3Reward_005
Array.english: Is this for me?
Array.indonesia: Ini buat aku?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Marone_Lv3Reward_006
Array.english: Woof! Woof!
Array.indonesia: Guk! Guk!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Marone_Lv3Reward_007
Array.english: Haha, you're such a good boy.\nThank you.
Array.indonesia: Haha, kamu anak yang baik sekali.\nTerima kasih.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_InfoTalk_NotKind_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hm? What I like?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hm? Apa yang aku suka?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_InfoTalk_NotKind_002
Array.english: <size=32>Well... I don't think we're close enough to talk about that yet...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Yah... Aku rasa kita belum cukup dekat untuk membicarakan hal itu...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_InfoTalk_NotKind_003
Array.english: <size=32>Adults...\nthey just don't respect personal space.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Orang dewasa...\nmereka memang tidak menghormati ruang pribadi.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_InfoTalk_NotKind_004
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Seems like he won't tell me until we're closer...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Sepertinya dia tidak akan memberitahuku sampai kita lebih dekat...)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk_NotKind_001
Array.english: <size=32>Huh? What I like?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hah? Apa yang aku suka?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk_NotKind_002
Array.english: <size=32>Why do you want to know...!\nAre you up to something?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kenapa kamu mau tahu...!\nApa kamu lagi ngapain?!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk_NotKind_003
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Doesn't seem like he'll tell me until we're closer...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Sepertinya dia nggak bakal ngasih tahu aku sampai kita lebih dekat...)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_InfoTalk_NotKind_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm? What do I like?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm? Apa yang aku suka?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_InfoTalk_NotKind_002
Array.english: Wait... you're not planning to go tell my wife, are you?
Array.indonesia: Tunggu... kamu nggak berencana ngasih tahu istriku, kan?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_InfoTalk_NotKind_003
Array.english: I can't trust outsiders yet.
Array.indonesia: Aku belum bisa percaya sama orang luar.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_InfoTalk_NotKind_004
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Looks like he won't tell me until we're closer...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Sepertinya dia nggak bakal ngasih tahu aku sampai kita lebih dekat...)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_InfoTalk_NotKind_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hm? What do I like?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hm? Apa yang aku suka?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_InfoTalk_NotKind_002
Array.english: I'm not quite comfortable sharing that with a stranger yet.
Array.indonesia: Aku belum cukup nyaman untuk membagikan hal itu kepada orang asing.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_InfoTalk_NotKind_003
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Seems like she won't tell me until we're closer...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Sepertinya dia tidak akan memberitahuku sampai kita lebih dekat...)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_InfoTalk_NotKind_001
Array.english: <size=32>Why are you asking what I like?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kenapa kamu menanyakan apa yang aku suka?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_InfoTalk_NotKind_002
Array.english: Trying to win me over already...\nI get it, but you're getting ahead of yourself.
Array.indonesia: Sudah mencoba memikatku...\nAku mengerti, tapi kamu terlalu terburu-buru.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_InfoTalk_NotKind_003
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Seems like she won't tell me until we're closer...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Sepertinya dia tidak akan memberitahuku sampai kita lebih dekat...)</color>

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Bacon_01_001
Array.english: A dinosaur carcass in a lake at this altitude...\nThat's really fascinating.
Array.indonesia: Bangkai dinosaurus di danau pada ketinggian ini...\nItu benar-benar menarik.

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Bacon_01_002
Array.english: I know, right? And that species isn't known to have lived in freshwater.
Array.indonesia: Aku tahu, kan? Dan spesies itu tidak diketahui pernah hidup di air tawar.

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Bacon_01_003
Array.english: Like Muna said, there's a high chance there's an ocean beneath the lake.
Array.indonesia: Seperti yang dikatakan Muna, kemungkinan besar ada lautan di bawah danau itu.

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Bacon_01_004
Array.english: <size=33>This research is going to be fascinating!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Penelitian ini pasti akan sangat menarik!</size>

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Bancho_01_001
Array.english: Bancho, seriously... You're being too harsh after they've let us stay in the village.
Array.indonesia: Bancho, serius deh... Kamu terlalu keras setelah mereka mengizinkan kita tinggal di desa ini.

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Bancho_01_002
Array.english: Hmm. I may have gotten a bit carried away.\nMy apologies.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Mungkin aku sedikit terbawa suasana.\nMaafkan aku.

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Bancho_01_003
Array.english: Well... you already made a promise, so I guess we've got no choice but to cook something good.
Array.indonesia: Yah... kamu sudah berjanji, jadi kurasa kita tidak punya pilihan selain memasak sesuatu yang enak.

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Cobra_01_001
Array.english: <size=34>What was that? Speak up a bit!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Apa itu? Bicaralah lebih keras!</size>

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Cobra_01_002
Array.english: <size=34>Could you send some goods over here...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Bisakah kamu mengirimkan beberapa barang ke sini? ..</size>

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Cobra_01_003
Array.english: Tsk... the call won't go through.
Array.indonesia: Ck... panggilannya tidak tersambung.

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Cobra_01_004
Array.english: Quite a few apps aren't working either.\nGuess that's to be expected in a mountain village.
Array.indonesia: Cukup banyak aplikasi yang juga tidak berfungsi.\nSepertinya itu wajar di desa pegunungan.

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Chief_01_001
Array.english: Sorry about earlier, Chief.
Array.indonesia: Maaf soal tadi, Kepala.

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Chief_01_002
Array.english: It was not your fault.\nThere is no need to apologize.
Array.indonesia: Itu bukan salahmu.\nTidak perlu minta maaf.

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Chief_01_003
Array.english: However... That loud-mouthed chef had better show us something worthwhile!
Array.indonesia: Namun... Koki yang suka berkoar-koar itu sebaiknya menunjukkan sesuatu yang layak!

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Fisherman_01_001
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(He's really focused on fishing...\nBetter not disturb him.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Dia benar-benar fokus memancing...\nSebaiknya jangan ganggu dia.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Lathi_01_001
Array.english: I hope the ingredients I gave you turn out delicious.
Array.indonesia: Semoga bahan-bahan yang kuberikan padamu menghasilkan masakan yang lezat.

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Muna_01_001
Array.english: How long have you been here, Muna?
Array.indonesia: Sudah berapa lama kamu di sini, Muna

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Muna_01_002
Array.english: Oh, me? Um...\nI think it's been about two months.
Array.indonesia: Oh, aku? Hmm...\nSepertinya sudah sekitar dua bulan.

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Muna_01_003
Array.english: At first, the macaques would steal my snacks at night... it was really tough...
Array.indonesia: Awalnya, kera-kera itu suka mencuri camilan aku di malam hari... itu benar-benar menyulitkan...

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Muna_01_004
Array.english: <size=32>But after the earthquake blocked the forest path, the macaques stopped coming up!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tapi setelah gempa bumi menutup jalan setapak di hutan, kera-kera itu berhenti datang ke sini!</size>

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Muna_01_005
Array.english: It's a shame I can't explore the forest anymore...\nbut life's gotten a lot easier, hehe.
Array.indonesia: Sayang sekali aku nggak bisa menjelajahi hutan lagi...\ntapi hidup jadi jauh lebih mudah, hehe.

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Rimbo_01_001
Array.english: Shouldn't you be gettin' some rest on your first day?\nYou're quite the hard worker, aren't ya?
Array.indonesia: Bukankah seharusnya kamu istirahat di hari pertamamu?\nKamu memang pekerja keras, ya?

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Rimbo_01_002
Array.english: Bancho promised the village chief food...
Array.indonesia: Bancho berjanji akan memberi makanan kepada kepala desa...

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Rimbo_01_003
Array.english: <size=33>Haha! Guess the food didn't quite agree with ya!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Haha! Sepertinya makanan itu nggak cocok buatmu!</size>

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Rimbo_01_004
Array.english: Truth be told, the cookin' in this village was never all that great to begin with...
Array.indonesia: Sejujurnya, masakan di desa ini memang nggak pernah terlalu enak sejak awal...

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Rimbo_01_005
Array.english:
But lately, with the lake gettin' polluted,
it's been tastin' even worse.
Array.indonesia:
Tapi belakangan ini, karena danau yang tercemar,
rasanya jadi makin nggak enak.

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Rimbo_01_006
Array.english: <size=32>So if ya cook up somethin' tasty, the chief'll surely love it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Jadi, kalau kamu memasak sesuatu yang enak, kepala desa pasti akan menyukainya!</size>

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Lipah_01_001
Array.english: Hehe, are you having fun exploring the village?
Array.indonesia: Hehe, apakah kamu menikmati menjelajahi desa ini?

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Lipah_01_002
Array.english: It's your first day, so don't push yourself too hard.
Array.indonesia: Ini hari pertamamu, jadi jangan memaksakan diri terlalu keras.

Array.name: Call_Bacon_GoToJungle_001
Array.english: Heading back to <color=#F1DC2B>Utara Village</color> again?\nIt'll take about a day.
Array.indonesia: Mau kembali ke <color=#F1DC2B>Desa Utara</color> lagi?\nPerjalanannya akan memakan waktu sekitar satu hari.

Array.name: Call_Bacon_GoToJungle_option1
Array.english: Go back
Array.indonesia: Kembali

Array.name: Call_Bacon_GoToJungle_option2
Array.english: Don't go back
Array.indonesia: Jangan kembali

Array.name: Call_Bacon_GoToJungle_Go_001
Array.english: <size=32>Then let's get moving. If we hurry, we'll be there by tomorrow morning!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kalau begitu, ayo berangkat. Kalau kita bergegas, kita akan sampai di sana besok pagi!</size>

Array.name: Call_Bacon_GoToJungle_Stay_001
Array.english: I see. Just let me know when you want to go.
Array.indonesia: Begitu ya. Beri tahu saja aku kalau kamu mau berangkat.

Array.name: Call_Bacon_GoToJungle_Night_001
Array.english: It's pretty late right now. Could be dangerous.\nCall me again tomorrow.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang sudah cukup larut. Bisa berbahaya.\nHubungi aku lagi besok.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_Start_001
Array.english: <size=34>Did you happen to hear that loud noise last night?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kebetulan kamu mendengar suara keras tadi malam?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_Start_002
Array.english: Yeah, we heard a loud rumbling from far off.
Array.indonesia: Ya, kami mendengar suara gemuruh keras dari kejauhan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_Start_003
Array.english: Our researcher was out investigating that area...
Array.indonesia: Peneliti kami sedang menyelidiki daerah itu...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_Start_004
Array.english: <size=32>And she contacted me saying something strange happened.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Dan dia menghubungiku sambil mengatakan ada sesuatu yang aneh terjadi.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_Start_005
Array.english: Oh... I see...!\nShouldn't you go check it out?
Array.indonesia: Oh... Begitu...!\nBukankah sebaiknya kamu pergi memeriksanya?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_Start_006
Array.english: I suppose I should.\nBut...
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya memang sebaiknya begitu.\nTapi...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_Start_007
Array.english: <size=35>I'd like you folks to come along too!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Aku ingin kalian ikut juga!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_Start_008
Array.english: <size=34>Us... too?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kami... juga?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_Start_009
Array.english: Yes, we need to investigate a lake in the jungle...
Array.indonesia: Ya, kita perlu menyelidiki sebuah danau di hutan...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_Start_010
Array.english: And no one is better than you for underwater exploration, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Dan tidak ada yang lebih ahli darimu dalam eksplorasi bawah air, Dave.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_Start_011
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... I see...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... Begitu...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_Start_012
Array.english: The Blue Hole's been quiet lately, and you've helped us a lot, Dr. Bacon...
Array.indonesia: Blue Hole belakangan ini sepi, dan kamu sudah banyak membantu kami, Dr. Bacon...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_Start_013
Array.english: I'd love to go with you, but...
Array.indonesia: Aku ingin sekali ikut dengan kalian, tapi...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_Start_014
Array.english: <size=33>I'm not sure it's a good idea to leave Bancho running the shop alone...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku tidak yakin itu ide yang bagus untuk membiarkan Bancho mengurus toko sendirian...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_Start_015
Array.english: <size=35>Hahaha! No need to worry!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Hahaha! Tidak perlu khawatir!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_Start_016
Array.english: The researcher doesn't seem too fond of the local food there...
Array.indonesia: Peneliti itu sepertinya tidak terlalu suka makanan lokal di sana...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_Start_017
Array.english: <size=34>So I was hoping Bancho could come along too!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Jadi, aku berharap Bancho bisa ikut juga!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_Start_018
Array.english: <size=34>Oh...! Then we don't have to worry about the shop...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh...! Kalau begitu, kita tidak perlu khawatir soal toko...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_Start_019
Array.english: But would Bancho want to come along?\nHe seems pretty happy with things here.
Array.indonesia: Tapi, apakah Bancho mau ikut?\nDia kelihatannya cukup senang dengan keadaan di sini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_Start_020
Array.english: <size=32>Hahaha! Bancho needs to get out once in a while for some cooking inspiration!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hahaha! Bancho perlu keluar sesekali untuk mencari inspirasi memasak!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_Start_021
Array.english: <size=34>It'll be fun if we all go together. Let's head to the shop and try to convince him.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Pasti seru kalau kita pergi bareng-bareng. Ayo ke toko dan coba yakinkan dia.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BanchoSushi_001
Array.english: Bancho, how about we all take a trip and leave the shop \nfor a bit?
Array.indonesia: Bancho, gimana kalau kita semua jalan-jalan dan tinggalkan toko \nsebentar?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BanchoSushi_002
Array.english: <size=33>What's this all of a sudden?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kenapa tiba-tiba begini?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BanchoSushi_003
Array.english: We need to investigate a lake in the jungle...\nI think we could really use your cooking skills.
Array.indonesia: Kita perlu menyelidiki sebuah danau di hutan...\nMenurutku, kita benar-benar butuh keahlian memasakmu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BanchoSushi_004
Array.english: I've heard the food there is pretty terrible.
Array.indonesia: Kudengar makanan di sana cukup buruk.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BanchoSushi_005
Array.english: Hmm. Ingredients from a new region do sound interesting...
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Bahan-bahan dari wilayah baru memang terdengar menarik...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BanchoSushi_006
Array.english: But I'm not comfortable leaving the shop unattended.
Array.indonesia: Tapi aku nggak nyaman ninggalin toko tanpa pengawasan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BanchoSushi_007
Array.english: Bancho, you've been working nonstop this whole time. You haven't even been able to enjoy our team dinners since you're always busy cooking.
Array.indonesia: Bancho, kamu udah kerja tanpa henti selama ini. Kamu bahkan belum sempat menikmati makan malam bareng tim kita karena selalu sibuk masak.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BanchoSushi_008
Array.english: <size=33>A short trip to a new place might be just the change you need!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Perjalanan singkat ke tempat baru mungkin justru perubahan yang kamu butuhkan!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BanchoSushi_009
Array.english: Hmm... a lake means freshwater fish...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... danau berarti ikan air tawar...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BanchoSushi_010
Array.english: The Blue Hole only has saltwater fish, so it's been a while since I've cooked freshwater dishes.
Array.indonesia: Blue Hole hanya punya ikan air asin, jadi sudah lama aku tidak memasak hidangan ikan air tawar.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BanchoSushi_011
Array.english: <size=34>Alright. I'll come along.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Baiklah. Aku akan ikut.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BanchoSushi_012
Array.english: <size=34>Great decision!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Keputusan yang bagus!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BanchoSushi_013
Array.english: But... I'm still not comfortable leaving the shop to someone else.
Array.indonesia: Tapi... aku masih belum nyaman meninggalkan toko ini kepada orang lain.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BanchoSushi_014
Array.english: <size=34>Do you think I should close it for a while?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Menurutmu, apakah sebaiknya aku menutupnya untuk sementara?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BanchoSushi_015
Array.english: Yes. It won't be for long... I'll let the staff take a break while we're away.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Nggak akan lama kok... Aku bakal biarin staf istirahat selama kita pergi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BanchoSushi_016
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! Everyone gets a trip! Lucky us!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Semua orang bisa liburan! Kita beruntung sekali!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BanchoSushi_017
Array.english: <size=32>You'll probably need to wrap a few things up before we leave... Give me a <color=#F1DC2B>Call</color> when you're ready!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kamu mungkin perlu menyelesaikan beberapa hal sebelum kita berangkat... Hubungi aku <color=#F1DC2B>Telepon</color> kalau sudah siap!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BaconCall_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh, are you ready to go?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh, kamu sudah siap berangkat?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BaconCall_option1
Array.english: I'm ready!
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah siap!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BaconCall_option2
Array.english: Not yet...
Array.indonesia: Belum...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BaconCall_Go_001
Array.english: <size=33>Good! Then let's head to my boat!\nOff we go!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Bagus! Kalau begitu, ayo kita ke perahuku!\nAyo berangkat!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BaconCall_Stay_001
Array.english: Looks like you need a bit more time.\nCall me again when you're ready!
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya kamu butuh sedikit waktu lagi.\nTelepon aku lagi kalau sudah siap!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_BoatArrivalBancho_001
Array.english: Ugh...
Array.indonesia: Ugh...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_BoatArrivalBancho_002
Array.english: Bancho, are you still feeling sick?
Array.indonesia: Bancho, kamu masih merasa mual?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_BoatArrivalBancho_003
Array.english: ...Dr. Bacon's driving is way too rough...\nUgh...
Array.indonesia: ...Cara mengemudi Dr. Bacon terlalu kasar...\nUgh...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_BoatArrivalBancho_004
Array.english: I need to eat something when we get to town...\nI'm starving.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus makan sesuatu begitu kita sampai di kota...\nAku lapar sekali.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_BoatArrivalCobra_001
Array.english: Phew... It's been a while since I've been somewhere this humid.
Array.indonesia: Wah... Sudah lama aku tidak berada di tempat yang selembab ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_BoatArrivalCobra_002
Array.english: Not sure there's much money to be made in a place like this...
Array.indonesia: Aku ragu ada banyak uang yang bisa dihasilkan di tempat seperti ini...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_BoatArrivalCobra_003
Array.english: But if there really are dinosaurs, tourism could turn into a solid business... mwahaha!
Array.indonesia: Tapi kalau memang ada dinosaurus, pariwisata bisa jadi bisnis yang menjanjikan... mwahaha!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_BoatArrivalBacon_001
Array.english: We may have gotten a bit lost on the way...\nBut hey, we made it here safe and sound.
Array.indonesia: Mungkin kita sedikit tersesat di jalan...\nTapi, hei, kita sampai di sini dengan selamat.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_BoatArrivalBacon_002
Array.english: You suddenly stopped at some weird island and had us stay there forever, too...
Array.indonesia: Kamu tiba-tiba berhenti di sebuah pulau aneh dan membuat kita tinggal di sana selamanya juga...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_BoatArrivalBacon_003
Array.english: Hahaha! Exploring new places is a scholar's duty, isn't it?
Array.indonesia: Hahaha! Menjelajahi tempat-tempat baru adalah tugas seorang cendekiawan, bukan?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_BoatArrivalBacon_004
Array.english: ...If by that you mean drinking five cans of beer and not even getting started until the next afternoon.
Array.indonesia: ...Kalau yang kamu maksud adalah minum lima kaleng bir dan baru mulai menjelajah keesokan harinya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_BoatArrivalBacon_005
Array.english: ...Haha... it was just really hot that day.
Array.indonesia: ...Haha... hari itu memang sangat panas.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_BoatArrival_001
Array.english: <size=34>Hahaha! We finally made it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hahaha! Akhirnya kita sampai juga!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_BoatArrival_002
Array.english: Phew... that was way too far for a small boat.
Array.indonesia: Wah... itu terlalu jauh untuk perahu kecil.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_BoatArrival_003
Array.english: But... I don't see any town around here?
Array.indonesia: Tapi... aku nggak lihat ada kota di sekitar sini?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_BoatArrival_004
Array.english: Ugh...
Array.indonesia: Ugh...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_BoatArrival_005
Array.english: Bancho's been so seasick he hasn't been able to eat properly.
Array.indonesia: Bancho mabuk laut banget sampai nggak bisa makan dengan baik.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_BoatArrival_006
Array.english: Our guide should be here soon...\nLet's wait a bit.
Array.indonesia: Pemandu kita seharusnya sebentar lagi sampai...\nAyo kita tunggu sebentar.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_FindRimbo_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh! Looks like our guide has arrived!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh! Sepertinya pemandu kita sudah datang!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_FindRimbo_002
Array.english: <size=34>Go and talk to him.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Pergilah dan bicara dengannya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_RimboFirstTalk_001
Array.english: Hello... Are you the village guide by any chance?
Array.indonesia: Halo... Apakah Kamu kebetulan pemandu desa ini?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_RimboFirstTalk_002
Array.english: Oh, y'all must be the visitors from outta town.
Array.indonesia: Oh, kalian pasti pengunjung dari luar kota.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_RimboFirstTalk_003
Array.english: <size=32>You must be tired from that long ride.\nName's <color=#F1DC2B>Rimbo</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kalian pasti lelah setelah perjalanan panjang tadi.\nNamaku <color=#F1DC2B>Rimbo</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_RimboFirstTalk_004
Array.english: Nice to meet you, Rimbo.\nI'm Dave.
Array.indonesia: Senang bertemu denganmu, Rimbo.\nAku Dave.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_RimboFirstTalk_005
Array.english: And over there is my colleague...
Array.indonesia: Dan di sana ada rekanku...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_RimboFirstTalk_006
Array.english: <size=32>Hehe, looks like y'all had yourselves a long day. Let's save the introductions for the car!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehe, sepertinya kalian baru saja melewati hari yang panjang. Ayo kita tunda perkenalan sampai di dalam mobil!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_RimboFirstTalk_007
Array.english: Sounds good, haha.
Array.indonesia: Kedengarannya bagus, haha.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_DriveTalk_001
Array.english: Let me introduce myself again.\nName's <color=#F1DC2B>Rimbo</color>.
Array.indonesia: Biar aku perkenalkan diri lagi.\nNamaku <color=#F1DC2B>Rimbo</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_DriveTalk_002
Array.english: Kuhaha! That's a fine name.\nI'm Cobra, a businessman!
Array.indonesia: Kuhaha! Nama yang bagus.\nAku Cobra, seorang pengusaha!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_DriveTalk_003
Array.english: I'm Bacon. Got a message from my assistant \nin the village, so I came on over.
Array.indonesia: Aku Bacon. Dapat pesan dari asistenku \ndi desa, jadi aku mampir ke sini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_DriveTalk_004
Array.english: I'm Ban... Urp...!
Array.indonesia: Aku Ban... Urp...!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_DriveTalk_005
Array.english: <size=34>Haha! You folks sure are interesting!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Haha! Kalian memang orang-orang yang menarik!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_DriveTalk_006
Array.english: The place you're headin' to is called <color=#F1DC2B>Utara</color>...
Array.indonesia: Tempat yang kalian tuju itu namanya <color=#F1DC2B>Utara</color>...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_DriveTalk_007
Array.english: <size=33>It's an old village by a <color=#1DFEAF>lake where the terrain keeps shiftin'</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Itu adalah desa tua di tepi <color=#1DFEAF>danau yang medannya terus berubah</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_DriveTalk_008
Array.english: <size=34>Oh... that sounds like the Blue Hole...!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh... kedengarannya seperti Blue Hole... !?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_DriveTalk_009
Array.english: <size=33>There's another place like that? Well now.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ada tempat lain seperti itu? Wah, begitulah.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_DriveTalk_010
Array.english: But lately... strange things have started happenin'.
Array.indonesia: Tapi belakangan ini... hal-hal aneh mulai terjadi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_DriveTalk_011
Array.english: I heard a dinosaur carcass washed up.
Array.indonesia: Aku dengar ada bangkai dinosaurus yang terdampar.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_DriveTalk_012
Array.english:
Right. Well... round here, the lake meets the sea,
so unusual creatures do show up sometimes, but...
Array.indonesia:
Benar. Nah... di sekitar sini, danau bertemu dengan laut,
jadi makhluk-makhluk aneh memang kadang muncul, tapi...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_DriveTalk_013
Array.english: A dinosaur, though... never would've thought. To think somethin' like that still exists in our world... My, oh my.
Array.indonesia: Dinosaurus, sih... nggak pernah kepikiran. Nggak nyangka ada makhluk kayak gitu masih ada di dunia kita... Astaga.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_DriveTalk_014
Array.english: What about the villagers? Would it be okay for outsiders like us to visit...?
Array.indonesia: Gimana dengan penduduk desa? Apa boleh orang luar kayak kita berkunjung...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_DriveTalk_015
Array.english: Well... there are quite a few ruins round the village, \nso we do get outsiders now and then.
Array.indonesia: Nah... ada cukup banyak reruntuhan di sekitar desa, \njadi sesekali memang ada orang luar yang datang.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_DriveTalk_016
Array.english: Because of that, some folks are friendly toward strangers... while others tend to be more cautious.
Array.indonesia: Karena itu, sebagian orang bersikap ramah terhadap orang asing... sementara yang lain cenderung lebih waspada.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_DriveTalk_017
Array.english: Still, the village chief's a kind man, so y'all should be fine stayin' for a while.
Array.indonesia: Meski begitu, kepala desa adalah orang yang baik hati, jadi kalian seharusnya aman tinggal di sini untuk sementara waktu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_DriveTalk_018
Array.english: Oh, we're almost at the village. Road goes uphill from here, so it might get a little bumpy!
Array.indonesia: Oh, kita hampir sampai di desa. Jalan mulai menanjak dari sini, jadi mungkin akan sedikit bergelombang!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_DriveTalk_019
Array.english: Ugh...
Array.indonesia: Ugh...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_ArrivalVillage_001
Array.english: It's already evening!\nWelcome to <color=#F1DC2B>Utara Village</color>.
Array.indonesia: Sudah sore!\nSelamat datang di <color=#F1DC2B>Desa Utara</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_ArrivalVillage_002
Array.english: The village is built pretty high up.
Array.indonesia: Desa ini dibangun di ketinggian yang cukup tinggi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_ArrivalVillage_003
Array.english: Haha, that's why y'all get such a nice view.
Array.indonesia: Haha, makanya kalian bisa menikmati pemandangan yang begitu indah.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_IntroduceVillage_001
Array.english: <size=34>Hahaha! What a magnificent village!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hahaha! Desa yang luar biasa indah!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_IntroduceVillage_002
Array.english: I'm feeling lucky that there'll be plenty of interesting research material here.
Array.indonesia: Aku merasa beruntung karena pasti akan ada banyak bahan penelitian yang menarik di sini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_MeetMuna_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ooh...! Dr. Bacon, you actually made it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ooh...! Dr. Bacon, Kamu benar-benar berhasil datang!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_MeetMuna_002
Array.english: <size=32>How've you been?\nGood to see you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Apa kabar?\nSenang bertemu denganmu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_MeetMuna_003
Array.english: Ah, these are the guys helping with the investigation…\nI'm <color=#F1DC2B>Muna</color>. Hehe.
Array.indonesia: Ah, ini orang-orang yang membantu penyelidikan…\nAku <color=#F1DC2B>Muna</color>. Hehe.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_MeetMuna_004
Array.english: She used to work as my assistant... \nbut she's been on something like a sabbatical...
Array.indonesia: Dulu dia bekerja sebagai asistenku... \ntapi dia sedang mengambil semacam cuti panjang...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_MeetMuna_005
Array.english: Ah... wasn't there something about you going into hiding after a failed crypto investment...?
Array.indonesia: Ah... bukankah ada cerita tentang kamu yang menghilang setelah investasi kripto yang gagal...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_MeetMuna_006
Array.english: <size=33>...Oh no, I can't believe you brought that up...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...Oh tidak, aku nggak percaya kamu ngomongin itu...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_MeetMuna_007
Array.english: ...If you disappear without notice again, it won't be this easy to get reinstated, Muna.
Array.indonesia: ...Kalau kamu menghilang lagi tanpa kabar, nggak akan semudah ini buat dipekerjakan kembali, Muna.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_MeetMuna_008
Array.english: <size=33>N-Now that I've made back my initial investment, \nI've gotta work hard! Really hard!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>S-Sekarang setelah aku berhasil mengembalikan modal awalku, \naku harus bekerja keras! Sangat keras!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_MeetMuna_009
Array.english: Let's get to it then. Where's that dinosaur carcass you mentioned?
Array.indonesia: Ayo kita mulai. Di mana bangkai dinosaurus yang kamu sebutkan tadi?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_MeetMuna_010
Array.english: Ah, right! You should probably check that out first.
Array.indonesia: Ah, benar! Mungkin sebaiknya kamu periksa itu dulu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_MeetMuna_011
Array.english: <size=34>Come on, this way!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ayo, ke sini!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_FindBasiloBaby_001
