Array.english: <size=35>Wow! That's one massive dinosaur...!!\nHow on earth did it get here...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wah! Dinosaurus itu benar-benar besar...!!\nBagaimana bisa dia sampai di sini...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_FindBasiloBaby_002
Array.english: This is a freshwater lake...\nIsn't this a marine species?
Array.indonesia: Ini danau air tawar...\nBukankah ini spesies laut?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_FindBasiloBaby_003
Array.english: The bottom of this lake is connected to the ocean.
Array.indonesia: Dasar danau ini terhubung dengan laut.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_FindBasiloBaby_004
Array.english: The water forms layers due to differences in density between saltwater and freshwater... Maybe it came up from the sea... hmm.
Array.indonesia: Airnya membentuk lapisan-lapisan karena perbedaan kepadatan antara air asin dan air tawar... Mungkin dia datang dari laut... hmm.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_FindBasiloBaby_005
Array.english: <size=35>...Wait...! That dinosaur, its belly looks swollen...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>...Wait...! Dinosaurus itu, perutnya terlihat membengkak...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_FindBasiloBaby_006
Array.english: <size=35>Whoa...! You're right!\nWe should get out of here!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wah...! Kamu benar!\nKita harus segera pergi dari sini!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterExplosion_001
Array.english: <size=34>Ugh... what the heck was that...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ugh... apa sih itu...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterExplosion_002
Array.english: Hmm. I once read about a whale carcass that washed ashore and exploded.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Aku pernah membaca tentang bangkai paus yang terdampar dan meledak.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterExplosion_003
Array.english: Methane gas builds up from microbes in the stomach and causes an explosion... Doesn't have anything to do with the dinosaur itself, but...
Array.indonesia: Gas metana menumpuk akibat mikroba di dalam perut dan menyebabkan ledakan... Memang tidak ada hubungannya dengan dinosaurus itu sendiri, tapi...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterExplosion_004
Array.english: <size=35>Seeing it in person is pretty horrifying.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Melihatnya secara langsung cukup mengerikan.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterExplosion_005
Array.english: Ahem.
Array.indonesia: Ahem.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterExplosion_006
Array.english: Ah...! My apologies.\nMay I ask who you are, sir?
Array.indonesia: Ah...! Maafkan saya.\nBolehkah saya bertanya siapa Kamu, Pak?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterExplosion_007
Array.english: <size=33>I am <color=#F1DC2B>Panutah</color>, the village chief of Utara Village.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Saya adalah <color=#F1DC2B>Panutah</color>, kepala desa Desa Utara.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterExplosion_008
Array.english: Are you the outsiders who have come to investigate the strange occurrences in this village?
Array.indonesia: Apakah Kamu orang luar yang datang untuk menyelidiki kejadian aneh di desa ini?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterExplosion_009
Array.english: Yes, we experienced a similar phenomenon where we're from... So we're looking for a connection.
Array.indonesia: Ya, kami mengalami fenomena serupa di tempat asal kami... Jadi kami sedang mencari kaitannya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterExplosion_010
Array.english: Hmm... until recently, we had frequent earthquakes.\nThey've lessened quite a bit now, however.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... sampai baru-baru ini, kami sering mengalami gempa bumi.\nNamun, sekarang frekuensinya sudah berkurang cukup banyak.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterExplosion_011
Array.english: But... the lake has turned yellow and polluted... Carcasses of creatures we've never seen before keep floating up..
Array.indonesia: Tapi... danau itu telah berubah menjadi kuning dan tercemar... Bangkai makhluk-makhluk yang belum pernah kami lihat sebelumnya terus mengapung ke permukaan..

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterExplosion_012
Array.english: Strange things continue to happen. \nThe villagers are still anxious.
Array.indonesia: Hal-hal aneh terus terjadi. \nPenduduk desa masih merasa cemas.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterExplosion_013
Array.english: <size=32>Haha! That's exactly why we're here! \nDon't worry!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha! Itulah tepatnya alasan kami berada di sini! \nJangan khawatir!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterExplosion_014
Array.english: Hmm. The truth is, our village alone does not have the means to handle this.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Sebenarnya, desa kami sendiri tidak memiliki sarana untuk menangani hal ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterExplosion_015
Array.english: <size=32>First, I have prepared houses for you all in the village, \nso let us head there together.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Pertama-tama, saya telah menyiapkan rumah untuk kalian semua di desa, \njadi mari kita pergi ke sana bersama-sama.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_EatLocalFood_001
Array.english: For now, one of you should remain here.\nI'll see to the others' housing arrangements.
Array.indonesia: Untuk saat ini, salah satu dari kalian sebaiknya tetap di sini.\nAku akan mengurus tempat tinggal yang lain.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_EatLocalFood_002
Array.english: Bancho, you look like you could use some rest, \nso why don't you take this one first.
Array.indonesia: Bancho, sepertinya kamu butuh istirahat, \njadi kenapa kamu tidak mengurus yang ini dulu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_EatLocalFood_003
Array.english: <size=32>Phew... I'm terribly sorry...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wah... Maaf banget...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_EatLocalFood_004
Array.english: <size=32>Chief... do you happen to have... anything to eat...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kepala... apakah kebetulan kamu punya... sesuatu untuk dimakan...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_EatLocalFood_005
Array.english: That's right... Bancho must be starving since he threw up everything from seasickness.
Array.indonesia: Benar juga... Bancho pasti kelaparan karena dia muntah-muntah akibat mabuk laut.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_EatLocalFood_006
Array.english: Hmm. Well, I can prepare something simple rather quickly. Please wait a moment.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Baiklah, aku bisa menyiapkan sesuatu yang sederhana dengan cepat. Tunggu sebentar.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_EatLocalFood_007
Array.english: <size=33>Thank you. I apologize for the trouble.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Terima kasih. Maaf sudah merepotkan.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterEatLocalFood_001
Array.english: <size=35>Ugh... this is... really not good...\nIt's awful...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ugh... ini... benar-benar tidak enak...\nJijik sekali...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterEatLocalFood_002
Array.english: <size=34>B-Bancho! That's really rude! He went out of his way to prepare this for us...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>B-Bancho! Itu sangat tidak sopan! Dia sudah bersusah payah menyiapkan ini untuk kita...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterEatLocalFood_003
Array.english: <size=34>It was masked with a few spices, but the muddy taste hasn't completely gone away!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Rasanya memang disamarkan dengan beberapa bumbu, tapi rasa lumpurnya belum sepenuhnya hilang!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterEatLocalFood_004
Array.english: <size=34>And... if freshwater fish isn't cooked thoroughly, \nthere's a risk of parasites!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Dan... jika ikan air tawar tidak dimasak hingga matang, \nada risiko terkena parasit!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterEatLocalFood_005
Array.english: How can you serve undercooked freshwater fish like this...? \nI appreciate the gesture, Chief.
Array.indonesia: Bagaimana bisa kamu menyajikan ikan air tawar yang belum matang seperti ini... ? \nSaya menghargai niat baiknya, Kepala.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterEatLocalFood_006
Array.english: <size=34>To speak ill of the cuisine of our people...\nWhat a disrespectful young man!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Mengkritik masakan masyarakat kita...\nPemuda yang tidak sopan sekali!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterEatLocalFood_007
Array.english: The taste of the food has changed somewhat of late...\nbut that is due to the lake's pollution.
Array.indonesia: Rasa makanannya memang agak berubah belakangan ini...\ntapi itu disebabkan oleh polusi danau.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterEatLocalFood_008
Array.english: <size=34>I went out of my way to serve you, and this is how you respond!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku sudah bersusah payah untuk melayanimu, dan begitulah caramu menanggapinya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterEatLocalFood_009
Array.english: I'm sorry, Chief Panutah. Bancho's a chef, so...\nhe's very particular about food.
Array.indonesia: Maaf, Kepala Panutah. Bancho adalah seorang koki, jadi...\ndia sangat teliti soal makanan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterEatLocalFood_010
Array.english: A chef, you say... I've heard cooks from the city rely heavily on artificial seasonings.
Array.indonesia: Seorang koki, katamu... Aku dengar para juru masak dari kota sangat bergantung pada bumbu buatan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterEatLocalFood_011
Array.english: <size=33>You speak so because you do not understand the taste of nature.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kau berkata begitu karena kau tidak memahami cita rasa alam.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterEatLocalFood_012
Array.english: You go too far, Chief. Very well. I shall prepare a dish using only ingredients from this region.
Array.indonesia: Kau keterlaluan, Kepala. Baiklah. Aku akan menyiapkan hidangan yang hanya menggunakan bahan-bahan dari daerah ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterEatLocalFood_013
Array.english: <size=33>I will inform you when I am ready,\nso please grant me some time.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku akan memberitahumu saat sudah siap,\njadi tolong beri aku sedikit waktu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterEatLocalFood_014
Array.english: <size=32>Do as you wish. Tsk.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Lakukan saja sesukamu. Ckck.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterFoodTalk_001
Array.english: He's letting us stay here, and now you're making a scene... seriously.
Array.indonesia: Dia mengizinkan kita tinggal di sini, dan sekarang kamu malah bikin keributan... sungguh.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterFoodTalk_002
Array.english: I cannot accept that kind of cooking.\nIt's not good for the residents' health either.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak bisa menerima masakan seperti itu.\nItu juga tidak baik untuk kesehatan para penghuni.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterFoodTalk_003
Array.english: Hehe... I did think it tasted bad too...\nIt's kind of refreshing to hear you say it.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... Aku juga merasa rasanya tidak enak...\nAgak menyegarkan mendengar kamu mengatakannya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterFoodTalk_004
Array.english: Bancho, you're really something else. Well, since it's come to this, let's focus on making something good.
Array.indonesia: Bancho, kamu benar-benar luar biasa. Nah, karena sudah begini, mari kita fokus membuat sesuatu yang enak.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterFoodTalk_005
Array.english: <size=32>Good mindset. First, we should consider what kind of fish can be found in this area...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Pola pikir yang bagus. Pertama, kita harus mempertimbangkan jenis ikan apa yang bisa ditemukan di daerah ini...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterFoodTalk_006
Array.english: <size=32>Ah, <color=#F1DC2B>Tilapia</color> would be suitable. It's a fish that can produce a flavor most people enjoy.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ah, <color=#F1DC2B>Ikan nila</color> sepertinya cocok. Ikan ini menghasilkan rasa yang disukai kebanyakan orang.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterFoodTalk_007
Array.english: However, to eliminate the muddy taste...\nwe'll need things like fruits, herbs, and spices...
Array.indonesia: Namun, untuk menghilangkan rasa lumpurnya...\nkita butuh bahan-bahan seperti buah-buahan, rempah-rempah, dan bumbu...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterFoodTalk_008
Array.english: <size=32>I'll look around to see if there's anything suitable nearby.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku akan mencari-cari apakah ada bahan yang cocok di sekitar sini.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterFoodTalk_009
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, um... before you head into the lake...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, um... sebelum kalian pergi ke danau...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterFoodTalk_010
Array.english: <size=32>I made some tools while waiting for you all!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku sudah membuat beberapa alat sambil menunggu kalian semua!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterFoodTalk_011
Array.english: <size=35>Please come to my tent!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Silakan datang ke tenda saya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_UnlockMetagun_001
Array.english:
Maybe you've heard... This lake has a unique feature:
the terrain shifts over time.
Array.indonesia:
Mungkin kalian sudah dengar... Danau ini memiliki keunikan:
medannya berubah seiring waktu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_UnlockMetagun_002
Array.english: It's similar to the phenomenon Dr. Bacon was investigating at the Blue Hole.
Array.indonesia: Fenomena ini mirip dengan yang diteliti Dr. Bacon di Blue Hole.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_UnlockMetagun_003
Array.english: Which is why I have been assigned to investigate here...
Array.indonesia: Itulah sebabnya saya ditugaskan untuk menyelidiki di sini...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_UnlockMetagun_004
Array.english: Recently, earthquakes have become more frequent and the water's gotten murky, making the fish quite sensitive.
Array.indonesia: Belakangan ini, gempa bumi semakin sering terjadi dan airnya menjadi keruh, sehingga ikan-ikan menjadi sangat sensitif.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_UnlockMetagun_005
Array.english: As you saw, we've even found the remains of ancient creatures.
Array.indonesia: Seperti yang kalian lihat, kami bahkan telah menemukan sisa-sisa makhluk purba.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_UnlockMetagun_006
Array.english: <size=32>Well, honestly... it's pretty great for my research, hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Yah, sejujurnya... ini sangat bagus untuk penelitianku, hehe.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_UnlockMetagun_007
Array.english: Anyway, if you go into the lake without proper gear right now...
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun, jika kamu masuk ke danau tanpa perlengkapan yang memadai sekarang...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_UnlockMetagun_008
Array.english: You'll end up Krccckk!\n... just saying.
Array.indonesia: Kamu akan berakhir Krccckk!\n... sekadar peringatan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_UnlockMetagun_009
Array.english: Oh... I only brought a harpoon since I thought I'd just be exploring the lake... What should I do?
Array.indonesia: Oh... aku hanya membawa tombak karena kupikir aku hanya akan menjelajahi danau... Apa yang harus aku lakukan?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_UnlockMetagun_010
Array.english: <size=33>Hahahaha!! That's why I, Muna, prepared this!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahahaha!! Itulah mengapa aku, Muna, menyiapkan ini!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_UnlockMetagun_011
Array.english: <size=36>Behold... the <color=#F1DC2B>Jungle Gun</color>!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Lihatlah... <color=#F1DC2B>Jungle Gun</color>!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_UnlockMetagun_012
Array.english: <size=33>This gun can transform into four different forms, hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Senjata ini bisa berubah menjadi empat bentuk berbeda, hehe.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_UnlockMetagun_013
Array.english: Wow...! Don't tell me your lab makes weapons too, Dr. Bacon?
Array.indonesia: Wow...! Jangan-jangan laboratoriummu juga membuat senjata, Dr. Bacon?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_UnlockMetagun_014
Array.english: Not really...\nMuna just likes making weird stuff.
Array.indonesia: Tidak juga...\nMuna hanya suka membuat barang-barang aneh.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_UnlockMetagun_015
Array.english: Hehehe. I'll give you this <color=#F1DC2B>Jungle Gun</color> as...\na gift for helping with the investigation!
Array.indonesia: Hehehe. Aku akan memberimu <color=#F1DC2B>Jungle Gun</color> ini sebagai...\nhadiah karena telah membantu penyelidikan!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_UnlockMetagun_016
Array.english: <size=32>This looks really useful. Thanks, Muna!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ini kelihatannya sangat berguna. Terima kasih, Muna!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_StartCollectMission_001
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(I thought this would be easy, but... guess not.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Aku kira ini akan mudah, tapi... sepertinya tidak.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_StartCollectMission_002
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3><size=32>(First, I should go get the <color=#F1DC2B>Tilapia</color> Bancho mentioned.)</size></color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3><size=32>(Pertama-tama, aku harus pergi mengambil <color=#F1DC2B>Tilapia</color> yang disebutkan Bancho.)</size></color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_CollectMissionCheck_001
Array.english: So, did you get the <color=#F1DC2B>Tilapia</color> I asked for?
Array.indonesia: Jadi, apakah kamu sudah mendapatkan <color=#F1DC2B>Tilapia</color> yang aku minta?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_CollectMissionCheck_Option01
Array.english: I got it
Array.indonesia: Sudah aku dapatkan

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_CollectMissionCheck_Option02
Array.english: Not yet
Array.indonesia: Belum

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_CollectMissionCheck_GiveItem_NeedMore_001
Array.english: Not everything, but... I gathered this much for now.
Array.indonesia: Belum semuanya, tapi... untuk saat ini aku sudah mengumpulkan sebanyak ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_CollectMissionCheck_GiveItem_NeedMore_002
Array.english: Good work.\nI'll need the rest of the ingredients too.
Array.indonesia: Kerja bagus.\nAku juga butuh bahan-bahan lainnya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_CollectMissionCheck_GiveItem_NoItem_001
Array.english: Actually... I haven't gotten it yet.
Array.indonesia: Sebenarnya... aku belum mendapatkannya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_CollectMissionCheck_GiveItem_NoItem_002
Array.english: Try a bit harder, please.
Array.indonesia: Cobalah sedikit lebih keras, tolong.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_CollectMissionCheck_Refuse_001
Array.english: Um... I think I need a little more time.\nI'll look more carefully.
Array.indonesia: Um... kurasa aku butuh sedikit lebih banyak waktu.\nAku akan mencari dengan lebih teliti.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_NoNeedToDive01_001
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>I already have the tilapia. Let's gather the other ingredients.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>Aku sudah punya ikan tilapia. Ayo kita kumpulkan bahan-bahan lainnya.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_NoNeedToDive02_001
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>I've got all the ingredients. Let's go see Bancho.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>Saya sudah punya semua bahan. Ayo kita temui Bancho.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_IngredientsReady_001
Array.english: This lake is huge...\nI got the <color=#F1DC2B>Tilapia</color> you mentioned.
Array.indonesia: Danau ini sangat luas...\nSaya sudah mendapatkan <color=#F1DC2B>ikan nila</color> yang kamu sebutkan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_IngredientsReady_002
Array.english: Thank you.\nI looked around the area a bit...
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih.\nSaya sudah melihat-lihat sekitar area ini sebentar...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_IngredientsReady_003
Array.english: Fortunately, there was a <color=#F1DC2B>Calamansi</color> tree nearby,\nso I picked some fruit.
Array.indonesia: Untungnya, ada pohon <color=#F1DC2B>Calamansi</color> di dekat sini,\njadi aku memetik beberapa buahnya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_IngredientsReady_004
Array.english:
The scent of <color=#F1DC2B>Calamansi</color> helps neutralize the muddiness,
making it ideal for freshwater fish dishes.
Array.indonesia:
Aroma <color=#F1DC2B>Calamansi</color> membantu menetralkan rasa lumpur,
jadinya cocok banget buat masakan ikan air tawar.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_IngredientsReady_005
Array.english: However... it would be perfect if we had some herbs and spices to enhance the flavor...
Array.indonesia: Tapi... bakal lebih sempurna kalau kita punya rempah-rempah dan bumbu buat menambah rasa...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_HerbalistMissionTalk_001
Array.english: <size=34>Hmm... this smell...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hmm... bau ini...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_HerbalistMissionTalk_002
Array.english: Ah, you must be the outsiders who came to investigate the village. My eyesight isn't very good, so I rely on scent instead.
Array.indonesia: Ah, kalian pasti orang luar yang datang untuk menyelidiki desa ini. Penglihatan saya tidak terlalu baik, jadi saya mengandalkan penciuman saja.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_HerbalistMissionTalk_003
Array.english: Oh, hello. We were told some strange things have been happening recently.
Array.indonesia: Oh, halo. Kami diberitahu bahwa ada beberapa hal aneh yang terjadi belakangan ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_HerbalistMissionTalk_004
Array.english: So we came to investigate the lake here.
Array.indonesia: Jadi kami datang untuk menyelidiki danau di sini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_HerbalistMissionTalk_005
Array.english: Thank you. I can tell from your voice that you're a kind person.
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih. Dari suaramu, aku bisa tahu kalau kamu orang yang baik.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_HerbalistMissionTalk_006
Array.english: A while ago, there were frequent earthquakes...\nand now ancient creatures are washing ashore...
Array.indonesia: Beberapa waktu lalu, sering terjadi gempa bumi...\ndan sekarang makhluk-makhluk purba terdampar di pantai...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_HerbalistMissionTalk_007
Array.english: <size=33>So many troubling things have been happening lately.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Begitu banyak hal yang mengkhawatirkan terjadi belakangan ini.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_HerbalistMissionTalk_008
Array.english: I'm just an old woman who gathers and sells herbs... but if there's anything I can do to help, please let me know.
Array.indonesia: Saya hanyalah seorang wanita tua yang mengumpulkan dan menjual ramuan... tapi jika ada yang bisa saya bantu, tolong beri tahu saya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_HerbalistMissionTalk_009
Array.english: Forgive my asking so abruptly... but do you happen to have any herbs suitable for cooking?
Array.indonesia: Maaf saya bertanya begitu tiba-tiba... tapi apakah Kamu kebetulan memiliki ramuan yang cocok untuk memasak?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_HerbalistMissionTalk_010
Array.english: Ah, so you're a cook.\nI could smell the ingredients on you.
Array.indonesia: Ah, jadi Kamu seorang koki.\nSaya bisa mencium aroma bahan-bahan masakan dari Kamu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_HerbalistMissionTalk_011
Array.english: I have some <color=#F1DC2B>Lemongrass</color>...\nWhat do you think of that?
Array.indonesia: Aku punya sedikit <color=#F1DC2B>serai</color>...\nBagaimana menurutmu?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_HerbalistMissionTalk_012
Array.english: <size=33>Ah, perfect.\nMay I purchase some from you?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ah, sempurna.\nBolehkah aku membelinya darimu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_HerbalistMissionTalk_013
Array.english: Hohoho, of course. You've come all this way, so consider it a gift this time.
Array.indonesia: Hohoho, tentu saja. Kamu sudah datang sejauh ini, jadi anggap saja ini hadiah kali ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_HerbalistMissionTalk_014
Array.english: <size=34>Thank you. With this, I can make something decent.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Terima kasih. Dengan ini, aku bisa membuat sesuatu yang lumayan.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_HerbalistMissionTalk_015
Array.english: I hope it helps you make something delicious.
Array.indonesia: Semoga ini membantumu membuat sesuatu yang lezat.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_HerbalistMissionTalk_016
Array.english: I'm <color=#F1DC2B>Lathi</color>, and I live in the house on the right side of the village. If you ever need <color=#1DFEAF>Spices</color>, feel free to stop by anytime.
Array.indonesia: Namaku <color=#F1DC2B>Lathi</color>, dan aku tinggal di rumah di sisi kanan desa. Jika kamu butuh <color=#1DFEAF>Rempah-rempah</color>, silakan mampir kapan saja.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_ReadyToCook_001
Array.english: Hmm. This should suffice. Have the village chief come here around dinner time.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Ini seharusnya cukup. Suruh kepala desa datang ke sini sekitar waktu makan malam.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_ReadyToCook_002
Array.english: <size=32>It has been some time since I last worked with these ingredients, so I shall prepare them in advance.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Sudah lama sejak terakhir kali saya mengolah bahan-bahan ini, jadi saya akan menyiapkannya terlebih dahulu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_BeforeChiefArrives_001
Array.english: The chief should be here soon...
Array.indonesia: Kepala desa seharusnya segera tiba...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_BeforeEatBanchoFood_001
Array.english: Making an old man with bad legs like me come and go like this...
Array.indonesia: Membuat orang tua dengan kaki yang lemah seperti saya bolak-balik seperti ini...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_BeforeEatBanchoFood_002
Array.english: I expect it to be worth the trouble. Tsk.
Array.indonesia: Aku harap ini sepadan dengan repotnya. Ck.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_BeforeEatBanchoFood_003
Array.english: Please have a seat and wait a moment.\nI shall have the meal ready shortly.
Array.indonesia: Silakan duduk dan tunggu sebentar.\nAku akan segera menyiapkan hidangannya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterEatBanchoFood_001
Array.english: <size=38>What?! Are... are these truly the same ingredients?! The flavor is completely different...!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Apa?! Apa... apa ini benar-benar bahan-bahan yang sama?! Rasanya benar-benar berbeda...!!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterEatBanchoFood_002
Array.english: <size=38>The texture is similar, but... the aroma...! What an incredible aroma!!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Teksturnya mirip, tapi... aromanya...! Aroma yang luar biasa!!!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterEatBanchoFood_003
Array.english: <size=32>Freshwater fish tend to have a strong muddy flavor, so they must be thoroughly soaked in calamansi juice to remove it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ikan air tawar cenderung memiliki rasa lumpur yang kuat, jadi harus direndam secara menyeluruh dalam jus calamansi untuk menghilangkannya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterEatBanchoFood_004
Array.english: <size=32>Especially with the pungent smell from this lake... lemongrass must be used to properly mask it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Terutama dengan bau menyengat dari danau ini... serai harus digunakan untuk menutupinya dengan baik.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterEatBanchoFood_005
Array.english: Hmm... I shall admit it. You... seem to know a thing or two about cooking fish.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Aku harus mengakuinya. Kamu... sepertinya tahu satu dua hal tentang memasak ikan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterEatBanchoFood_006
Array.english: <color=#F1DC2B>Utara Lake</color> is known for its diverse fish population.\nSince you will be staying here for a while...
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Danau Utara</color> terkenal dengan keanekaragaman populasi ikannya.\nKarena kamu akan tinggal di sini untuk sementara waktu...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterEatBanchoFood_007
Array.english: <size=33>How would you feel about preparing meals for our residents?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Bagaimana kalau kamu yang menyiapkan makanan untuk penduduk desa kita?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterEatBanchoFood_008
Array.english: Hmm. I would like to repay your kindness for allowing us to stay in the village.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Aku ingin membalas kebaikanmu karena telah mengizinkan kami tinggal di desa ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterEatBanchoFood_009
Array.english:
However... if I must gather all the ingredients myself,
it may prove difficult to serve everyone properly...
Array.indonesia:
Namun... jika aku harus mengumpulkan semua bahan sendiri,
mungkin akan sulit untuk melayani semua orang dengan baik...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterEatBanchoFood_010
Array.english: That is understandable. One of our people in the northern part of the village grows <color=#1DFEAF>Papayas</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>Coconuts</color>.
Array.indonesia: Itu bisa dimengerti. Salah satu warga kami di bagian utara desa menanam <color=#1DFEAF>Pepaya</color> dan <color=#1DFEAF>Kelapa</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterEatBanchoFood_011
Array.english: <size=32>I shall grant you free access to those ingredients.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Saya akan memberikan Kamu akses gratis ke bahan-bahan tersebut.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterEatBanchoFood_012
Array.english: Oh, and the fish in the lake have been quite aggressive lately, so do take care.
Array.indonesia: Oh, dan ikan di danau belakangan ini cukup agresif, jadi harap berhati-hati.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterEatBanchoFood_013
Array.english:
If you're in danger, cut open a <color=#F1DC2B>Coconut</color> in the water,
and I'll send down a rescue pod.
Array.indonesia:
Jika kamu dalam bahaya, belah <color=#F1DC2B>Kelapa</color> di dalam air,
dan aku akan mengirimkan pod penyelamat.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterEatBanchoFood_014
Array.english: Oh, that's good to know. I heard the fish have become... incredibly aggressive.
Array.indonesia: Oh, bagus tahu itu. Aku dengar ikan-ikan itu sudah menjadi... sangat agresif.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterEatBanchoFood_015
Array.english: <size=31>Though there were some rather beautiful ones too.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Meskipun ada juga yang cukup indah.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterEatBanchoFood_016
Array.english: With all these strange occurrences, the residents may be a bit on edge. I hope you understand.
Array.indonesia: Dengan semua kejadian aneh ini, para penduduk mungkin sedikit gelisah. Aku harap kamu mengerti.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterEatBanchoFood_017
Array.english: With your cooking skills... I am certain you will be able to win them over.
Array.indonesia: Dengan keahlian memasakmu... aku yakin kamu akan bisa memenangkan hati mereka.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterEatBanchoFood_018
Array.english: Very well. I shall be counting on you. If you require anything, come visit the house to the north of the village.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah. Aku akan mengandalkanmu. Jika Kamu membutuhkan sesuatu, silakan mampir ke rumah di sebelah utara desa.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterChiefLeave_001
Array.english: Looks like you'll be running a shop here too, Bancho.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya Kamu juga akan mengelola sebuah toko di sini, Bancho.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterChiefLeave_002
Array.english: I am unsure how many residents will come...\nbut I need to cook anyway.
Array.indonesia: Saya tidak yakin berapa banyak penduduk yang akan datang...\ntapi saya tetap harus memasak.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterChiefLeave_003
Array.english: <size=32>If you come across any good ingredients, bring them to me.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Jika Kamu menemukan bahan-bahan masakan yang bagus, bawakan kepada saya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterChiefLeave_004
Array.english: <size=33>Got it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oke!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_GoToBed_001
Array.english: Phew... what a long day.
Array.indonesia: Wah... hari yang panjang sekali.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_GoToBed_002
Array.english: Came all this way and met so many new people...
Array.indonesia: Datang sejauh ini dan bertemu begitu banyak orang baru...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_GoToBed_003
Array.english: Looks like there's still a lot to do, but I'll just do what I can while I'm here.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya masih banyak yang harus dilakukan, tapi aku akan melakukan apa yang bisa kulakukan selama aku di sini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_GoToBed_004
Array.english: I should get a good night's sleep for tomorrow.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus tidur nyenyak untuk besok.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_RainyNight_001
Array.english: <size=34>The roof's leaking...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Atapnya bocor...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_RainyNight_002
Array.english: <size=33>So much for a good night's sleep...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Lupakan saja tidur nyenyak...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_Morning_Home_001
Array.english: <size=32>Yaaawn... I barely slept because of the rain...\nAnd now who could that be...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aaaah... Aku hampir nggak bisa tidur karena hujan...\nDan sekarang, siapa itu...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_Morning_Home_002
Array.english: <size=32>I should check it out.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku harus periksa.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_Morning_001
Array.english: <size=35>Hahaha! Morning! Did you sleep well?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Hahaha! Selamat pagi! Tidurmu nyenyak?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_Morning_002
Array.english: No... the roof was leaking all night, so I couldn't sleep well... My clothes are all damp too...
Array.indonesia: Nggak... atapnya bocor sepanjang malam, jadi aku nggak bisa tidur nyenyak... Pakaianku juga basah semua...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_Morning_003
Array.english: Yeah, that's what happens when a place is left unattended for too long.
Array.indonesia: Ya, begitulah kalau tempat ini dibiarkan kosong terlalu lama.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_Morning_004
Array.english: Let me help you fix it up. \nDave, could you gather some materials for me?
Array.indonesia: Biar aku bantu perbaikinya. \nDave, bisakah kamu mengumpulkan beberapa bahan untukku?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_Morning_005
Array.english: Oh, that'd be great. What do you need?
Array.indonesia: Oh, itu bagus sekali. Apa yang kamu butuhkan?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_Morning_006
Array.english: Let's see... some wooden planks... and we'll need some vines.
Array.indonesia: Coba aku pikirkan... beberapa papan kayu... dan kita juga butuh tanaman merambat.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_Morning_007
Array.english: You can get <color=#F1DC2B>Vines</color> from the lake...\nbut for <color=#F1DC2B>Wood</color>, we'll need some tools...
Array.indonesia: Kamu bisa mendapatkan <color=#F1DC2B>Tanaman Merambat</color> dari danau...\ntapi untuk <color=#F1DC2B>Kayu</color>, kita butuh beberapa alat...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_Morning_008
Array.english: <size=33><color=#1DFEAF>Carpentry Tools</color> aren't exactly something I could bring on the ship.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33><color=#1DFEAF>Alat Tukang Kayu</color> bukanlah sesuatu yang bisa kubawa ke kapal.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_Morning_009
Array.english: If there's someone in the village who can do <color=#1DFEAF>Carpentry Work</color>, they might be able to help.
Array.indonesia: Kalau ada orang di desa yang bisa melakukan <color=#1DFEAF>Pekerjaan Tukang Kayu</color>, mungkin dia bisa membantu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_Morning_010
Array.english: <size=33>Take a look around the village!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Coba lihat-lihat sekeliling desa ini!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterTalk01_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hello. Do you do <color=#1DFEAF>Carpentry Work</color> here?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Halo. Apakah Kamu <color=#1DFEAF>melakukan pekerjaan pertukangan</color> di sini?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterTalk01_002
Array.english: <size=34>Huh? Don't think I've seen you around.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hah? Sepertinya saya belum pernah melihat Kamu di sini sebelumnya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterTalk01_003
Array.english: I'm here to look into the strange things happening in the village. I'll be staying for a while. Nice to meet you.
Array.indonesia: Saya ke sini untuk menyelidiki hal-hal aneh yang terjadi di desa ini. Saya akan tinggal di sini untuk sementara waktu. Senang bertemu denganmu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterTalk01_004
Array.english: <size=32>Heh. Name's <color=#F1DC2B>Peneb</color>.\nI handle most of the handiwork around here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Heh. Namaku <color=#F1DC2B>Peneb</color>.\nSaya yang mengurus sebagian besar pekerjaan tangan di sini.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterTalk01_005
Array.english: Haven't been doing much lately though...\nTook a tumble down a hill during that earthquake.
Array.indonesia: Tapi akhir-akhir ini saya jarang bekerja...\nTerjatuh dari bukit saat gempa bumi itu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterTalk01_006
Array.english: So that's why you're wearing bandages.\nHope it heals up soon.
Array.indonesia: Jadi itu sebabnya kamu memakai perban.\nSemoga cepat sembuh.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterTalk01_007
Array.english: By the way... I need some <color=#F1DC2B>Wood</color>. Think you could help?
Array.indonesia: Ngomong-ngomong... Aku butuh <color=#F1DC2B>Kayu</color>. Bisakah kamu membantu?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterTalk01_008
Array.english: <size=33><color=#F1DC2B>Wood</color>? \nJust cut down a tree nearby.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33><color=#F1DC2B>Kayu</color>? \nBaru saja menebang pohon di dekat sini.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterTalk01_009
Array.english: We came here by boat, so we didn't bring many tools.
Array.indonesia: Kami datang ke sini dengan perahu, jadi kami tidak membawa banyak perkakas.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterTalk01_010
Array.english: I'd sell you some if I had any to spare... But with my arm like this, I haven't been able to swing an axe.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan menjualnya kepadamu jika aku punya sisa... Tapi dengan lengan seperti ini, aku belum bisa mengayunkan kapak.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterTalk01_011
Array.english: If you really need it... I can lend you my <color=#F1DC2B>Axe</color>. You'll have to get the wood yourself.
Array.indonesia: Jika kamu benar-benar membutuhkannya... Aku bisa meminjamkan <color=#F1DC2B>Kapak</color>-ku. Kamu harus mengambil kayunya sendiri.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterTalk01_012
Array.english: <size=34>Your <color=#F1DC2B>Axe</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34><color=#F1DC2B>Kapak</color>-mu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterTalk01_013
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Well... I've only done it once or twice...\nBut I guess that's how it goes out here.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Yah... Aku baru melakukannya sekali atau dua kali...\nTapi kurasa begitulah cara kerjanya di sini.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterTalk01_014
Array.english: <size=33>Thanks! I'll take good care of it and bring it back.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Terima kasih! Aku akan menjaganya dengan baik dan mengembalikannya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_FixReady_001
Array.english: Looks like I've got all the materials Cobra asked for.\nI should head back to him.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya aku sudah mendapatkan semua bahan yang diminta Cobra.\nAku sebaiknya kembali menemuinya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_ReadyToRepair_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh? You got the <color=#F1DC2B>Wood</color> and <color=#F1DC2B>Vines</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh? Kamu sudah dapat <color=#F1DC2B>Kayu</color> dan <color=#F1DC2B>Liana</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_ReadyToRepair_Option01
Array.english: Here you go
Array.indonesia: Ini dia

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_ReadyToRepair_Option02
Array.english: Not yet
Array.indonesia: Belum

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_ReadyToRepair_GiveItem_Finished_001
Array.english: <size=32>Here's all the <color=#F1DC2B>Wood</color> and <color=#F1DC2B>Vines</color> you asked for.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ini semua <color=#F1DC2B>Kayu</color> dan <color=#F1DC2B>Liana</color> yang kamu minta.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_ReadyToRepair_GiveItem_Finished_002
Array.english: <size=32>Good. Nice work.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Bagus. Kerja bagus.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_ReadyToRepair_GiveItem_Finished_003
Array.english: <size=32>Alright, let's fix this place up. That must've taken some effort, so just sit back and watch.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Baiklah, mari kita perbaiki tempat ini. Pasti butuh usaha, jadi duduk saja dan tonton.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_ReadyToRepair_GiveItem_NeedMore_001
Array.english: Here are the materials you asked for.
Array.indonesia: Ini bahan-bahan yang kamu minta.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_ReadyToRepair_GiveItem_NeedMore_002
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm? We're a bit short.\nGo get some more!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm? Kita masih kurang sedikit.\nPergilah cari lagi!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_ReadyToRepair_GiveItem_NeedMore_003
Array.english: <size=33><color=#F1DC2B>Vines</color> can be found at the lake, and you'll need tools for the <color=#F1DC2B>Wood</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33><color=#F1DC2B>Liana</color> bisa ditemukan di danau, dan kamu butuh alat untuk <color=#F1DC2B>Kayu</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_ReadyToRepair_GiveItem_NoItem_001
Array.english: Oops, I made a mistake. I think I need a bit more time!
Array.indonesia: Ups, aku salah. Sepertinya aku butuh sedikit waktu lagi!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_ReadyToRepair_RefuseGiveItem_001
Array.english: I think I need a little more time...\nPlease wait a bit.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya aku butuh sedikit waktu lagi...\nTolong tunggu sebentar.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_AfterFix_001
Array.english: <size=36>Hahaha! Very neat!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Hahaha! Keren banget!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_AfterFix_002
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... it looks much better now. Thanks.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... sekarang terlihat jauh lebih bagus. Terima kasih.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_AfterFix_003
Array.english: Well, there's not much I can sell around here...\nLeast I can do, right?
Array.indonesia: Yah, sepertinya nggak banyak yang bisa aku jual di sekitar sini...\nSetidaknya ini yang bisa aku lakukan, kan?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_AfterFix_004
Array.english: The place still feels a bit empty, though...
Array.indonesia: Tapi tempat ini masih terasa agak kosong...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_AfterFix_005
Array.english: The village chief said we can use it however we like,\nso let's decorate it with some <color=#F1DC2B>Furniture</color>.
Array.indonesia: Kepala desa bilang kita boleh menggunakannya sesuka hati,\njadi ayo kita hiasi dengan beberapa <color=#F1DC2B>perabotan</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_AfterFix02_001
Array.english: Come to think of it... Bancho's place could probably use a few things too.
Array.indonesia: Kalau dipikir-pikir... rumah Bancho mungkin juga butuh beberapa barang.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_AfterFix02_002
Array.english: <size=33>Why don't you go ask Bancho?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kenapa kamu nggak tanya Bancho saja?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_AfterFix02_003
Array.english: We've got food to prepare too, so we'll probably need a few things. Got it.
Array.indonesia: Kita juga harus menyiapkan makanan, jadi mungkin kita butuh beberapa barang. Oke.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BanchoStart_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hmm. What is it?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hmm. Ada apa?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BanchoStart_002
Array.english: Hey, how's the cooking going? Looks like the villagers will be coming too.
Array.indonesia: Hei, gimana masakannya? Sepertinya penduduk desa juga bakal datang.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BanchoStart_003
Array.english: Hmm. I have the basics prepared, so there is no issue,\nbut...
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Aku sudah menyiapkan bahan-bahan dasarnya, jadi tidak ada masalah,\ntapi...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BanchoStart_004
Array.english: The ingredients from this region seem better suited for skewers...
Array.indonesia: Bahan-bahan dari daerah ini sepertinya lebih cocok untuk sate...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BanchoStart_005
Array.english: <size=33>A proper <color=#F1DC2B>Skewer Grill</color> would be ideal.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Sebuah <color=#F1DC2B>Panggangan Sate</color> yang layak akan sangat ideal.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BanchoStart_006
Array.english: Hmm... a <color=#F1DC2B>Skewer Grill</color>... That's not something we can just make ourselves.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... sebuah <color=#F1DC2B>Panggangan Sate</color>... Itu bukan sesuatu yang bisa kita buat sendiri begitu saja.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BanchoStart_007
Array.english: Maybe the <color=#F1DC2B>Carpenter</color> could help us out?
Array.indonesia: Mungkin <color=#F1DC2B>Tukang Kayu</color> bisa membantu kita?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterTalk02_001
Array.english: Huh? A <color=#F1DC2B>Skewer Grill</color>? I can make one easy enough...
Array.indonesia: Hah? <color=#F1DC2B>Panggangan Tusuk Sate</color>? Aku bisa membuatnya dengan mudah...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterTalk02_002
Array.english: But like I said, my arm's messed up right now.\nGetting materials isn't easy.
Array.indonesia: Tapi seperti yang sudah kukatakan, lenganku sedang cedera sekarang.\nMendapatkan bahan-bahannya tidak mudah.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterTalk02_003
Array.english: Bring me what I need, and I'll make it.\nNo charge this time.
Array.indonesia: Bawakan aku yang kubutuhkan, dan aku akan membuatnya.\nGratis kali ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterTalk02_004
Array.english: <size=32>Got it. I'll go get them.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oke. Aku akan mengambilnya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterTalk02_005
Array.english: <size=34>What do you need?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Apa yang kamu butuhkan?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterTalk02_006
Array.english: <size=33>Bring me <color=#F1DC2B>3 Stones</color>. That'll do.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Bawakan aku <color=#F1DC2B>3 Batu</color>. Itu sudah cukup.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterTalk02_007
Array.english: <size=33>Grab a <color=#1DFEAF>Pickaxe</color> and mine some rocks around the village. Then bring them here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ambil <color=#1DFEAF>Cangkul</color> dan gali beberapa batu di sekitar desa. Lalu bawakan ke sini.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterTalk02_008
Array.english: Um... I don't have a <color=#1DFEAF>Pickaxe</color>...
Array.indonesia: Um... Aku tidak punya <color=#1DFEAF>Cangkul</color>...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterTalk02_009
Array.english: <size=33>Wait, you came here completely empty-handed?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tunggu, kamu datang ke sini dengan tangan kosong?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterTalk02_010
Array.english: We thought we were just investigating the lake...\nWe didn't bring many tools.
Array.indonesia: Kami kira kami hanya akan menyelidiki danau...\nKami tidak membawa banyak peralatan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterTalk02_011
Array.english: Figures, you outsiders are quite unprepared.
Array.indonesia: Sudah kuduga, kalian orang luar memang kurang persiapan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterTalk02_012
Array.english: I don't have a pickaxe either... hmm...
Array.indonesia: Aku juga tidak punya beliung... hmm...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterTalk02_013
Array.english: ...Try <color=#F1DC2B>Perak</color>. He might help!
Array.indonesia: ...Coba tanya <color=#F1DC2B>Perak</color>. Dia mungkin bisa membantu!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterTalk02_014
Array.english: When I bring him ore, he makes things for me... hehe.
Array.indonesia: Kalau aku bawa bijih padanya, dia bikin barang-barang buatku... hehe.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterTalk02_015
Array.english: <size=33>He's usually by the <color=#1DFEAF>Furnace</color> in the center of the village. Yellow belt. Can't miss him.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Dia biasanya ada di dekat <color=#1DFEAF>Tungku</color> di tengah desa. Sabuk kuning. Pasti mudah dikenali.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BroSisDadForgeFound_001
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(That person with the yellow belt must be <color=#F1DC2B>Perak</color>.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Orang dengan sabuk kuning itu pasti <color=#F1DC2B>Perak</color>.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BroSisDadForgeFound_002
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3><size=33>(I should go talk to him.)</size></color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3><size=33>(Aku harus pergi bicara dengannya.)</size></color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BroSisDadForgeStart_001
Array.english: Excuse me... are you the blacksmith <color=#F1DC2B>Perak</color>?
Array.indonesia: Permisi... apakah Kamu pandai besi <color=#F1DC2B>Perak</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BroSisDadForgeStart_002
Array.english:
Hm? You're one of the outsiders who came recently,
aren't you? I'm <color=#F1DC2B>Perak</color>...
Array.indonesia:
Hm? Kamu salah satu pendatang baru yang baru saja datang,
bukan? Aku <color=#F1DC2B>Perak</color>...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BroSisDadForgeStart_003
Array.english: Oh... I was wondering if I could get a <color=#1DFEAF>Pickaxe</color> from you.
Array.indonesia: Oh... Saya ingin tahu apakah saya bisa mendapatkan <color=#1DFEAF>Palu Tambang</color> dari Kamu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BroSisDadForgeStart_004
Array.english:
Hm... a <color=#1DFEAF>Pickaxe</color>. I don't have one on hand...
but I do have the materials to make one.
Array.indonesia:
Hm... <color=#1DFEAF>Palu Tambang</color>. Saya tidak punya yang siap pakai...
tapi saya punya bahan-bahannya untuk membuatnya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BroSisDadForgeStart_005
Array.english: <size=33>Then... could you make one for me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kalau begitu... bisakah Kamu membuatkannya untuk saya?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BroSisDadForgeStart_006
Array.english: It's not difficult... but the furnace fire went out after I finished repairing the house.
Array.indonesia: Nggak sulit sih... tapi api tungku padam setelah aku selesai memperbaiki rumah.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BroSisDadForgeStart_007
Array.english: <size=32>I'll need to add more charcoal to get it going again.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku perlu nambah arang biar apinya nyala lagi.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BroSisDadForgeStart_008
Array.english: <size=32>Could you bring me some <color=#F1DC2B>Bamboo</color> chunks from nearby?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Bisakah kamu bawakan aku beberapa potongan <color=#F1DC2B>Bambu</color> dari sekitar sini?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BroSisDadForgeStart_009
Array.english: Bamboo charcoal burns steadily.\nOnce the fire is ready, I can make the pickaxe quickly.
Array.indonesia: Arang bambu terbakar dengan stabil.\nBegitu apinya siap, aku bisa segera membuat beliung itu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BroSisDadForgeStart_010
Array.english: <color=#F1DC2B>Bamboo</color> grows on the outskirts of the village... It's hard for me to go far, since I need to watch the children.
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Bambu</color> tumbuh di pinggiran desa... Sulit bagiku untuk pergi jauh, karena aku harus menjaga anak-anak.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BroSisDadForgeStart_011
Array.english: Sure. I'll go find some!
Array.indonesia: Tentu. Aku akan pergi mencarinya!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_ForgeReady_001
Array.english: Looks like I've got all the <color=#F1DC2B>Bamboo</color> for charcoal.\nI should head back to the furnace.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya aku sudah mendapatkan semua <color=#F1DC2B>Bambu</color> untuk arang.\nAku sebaiknya kembali ke tungku.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_ReadyToForge_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, did you get all the bamboo chunks?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, apakah kamu sudah mendapatkan semua potongan bambu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_ReadyToForge_option01
Array.english: Got them
Array.indonesia: Sudah mendapatkannya

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_ReadyToForge_option02
Array.english: Not yet
Array.indonesia: Belum

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BroSisDadForgeComplete01_001
Array.english: Yes. Here are 3 chunks of <color=#F1DC2B>Bamboo</color>.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Ini ada 3 potong <color=#F1DC2B>Bambu</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BroSisDadForgeComplete01_002
Array.english: <size=32>Good. This should be enough to get the fire going!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Bagus. Ini seharusnya cukup untuk menyalakan api!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BroSisDadForgeComplete01_003
Array.english: <size=33>You needed a <color=#1DFEAF>Pickaxe</color>, right?\nGive me a moment.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kamu butuh <color=#1DFEAF>Palu Tambang</color>, kan?\nTunggu sebentar.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BroSisDadForgeComplete02_001
Array.english: Phew... Working the furnace in this heat...\nGets to you. But a promise is a promise.
Array.indonesia: Wah... Mengoperasikan tungku di cuaca panas begini...\nBikin capek. Tapi janji adalah janji.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BroSisDadForgeComplete02_002
Array.english: <size=33>Here. The <color=#1DFEAF>Pickaxe</color> I promised.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ini. <color=#1DFEAF>Palu Batu</color> yang aku janjikan.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BroSisDadForgeComplete02_003
Array.english: Oh... thank you! It looks really sturdy!
Array.indonesia: Oh... terima kasih! Kelihatannya sangat kokoh!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BroSisDadForgeComplete02_004
Array.english: The rock around here's tough. You'll need something like that to break it.
Array.indonesia: Batu di sekitar sini keras. Kamu butuh alat seperti itu untuk memecahkannya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BroSisDadForgeComplete02_005
Array.english: Since the furnace is running, let me know if you need anything else.
Array.indonesia: Selagi tungku sedang menyala, beri tahu aku kalau kamu butuh sesuatu lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BroSisDadForgeComplete02_006
Array.english: <size=34>Bring me some <color=#F1DC2B>Ore</color> and a bit of money, and I can make just about anything you need.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Bawakan aku sedikit <color=#F1DC2B>bijih</color> dan sedikit uang, dan aku bisa membuat hampir semua yang kamu butuhkan.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BroSisDadForgeComplete02_007
Array.english: <size=34>Thanks, Perak. I'll put this <color=#1DFEAF>Pickaxe</color> to good use.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Terima kasih, Perak. Aku akan memanfaatkan <color=#1DFEAF>Palu Tambang</color> ini dengan baik.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BroSisDadForgeComplete03_001
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Alright, time to gather materials for the skewer grill.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Baiklah, saatnya mengumpulkan bahan untuk pemanggang tusuk sate.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BroSisDadForgeComplete03_002
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(I need to mine rocks and bring back 3 <color=#F1DC2B>Stones</color>, right?)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Aku harus menambang batu dan membawa pulang 3 <color=#F1DC2B>Batu</color>, kan?)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_ReadyForge_GiveItem_NoItem_001
Array.english: <size=33>Huh? Doesn't look like I have any...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hah? Sepertinya aku nggak punya...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_ReadyForge_GiveItem_NoItem_002
Array.english: <size=34>Oh... my mistake...\nI'll go look again!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh... salahku...\nAku akan cari lagi!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_ReadyForge_RefuseGiveItem_001
Array.english: Ah, I need a bit more time.\nLet me keep looking!
Array.indonesia: Ah, aku butuh sedikit waktu lagi.\nBiar aku terus cari!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CraftReady_001
Array.english: I think I've got most of the materials for the skewer grill? Better head to the carpenter.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya aku sudah mendapatkan sebagian besar bahan untuk pemanggang tusuk sate? Sebaiknya aku pergi menemui tukang kayu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_ReadyToCraft_001
Array.english: <size=32>Did you get the stones I asked for?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Apakah kamu sudah mendapatkan batu yang aku minta?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_ReadyToCraft_Option01
Array.english: I got them
Array.indonesia: Sudah aku dapatkan

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_ReadyToCraft_Option02
Array.english: Not yet
Array.indonesia: Belum

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_ReadyToCraft_GiveItem_Finished_001
Array.english: Here, I brought 3 stones.
Array.indonesia: Ini, aku bawa 3 batu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterCraftReady_001
Array.english: Good. That should be enough to make a <color=#F1DC2B>Skewer Grill</color>.
Array.indonesia: Bagus. Itu seharusnya cukup untuk membuat <color=#F1DC2B>Panggangan Tusuk</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterCraftReady_002
Array.english: <size=32>Alright, watch closely.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Baiklah, perhatikan baik-baik.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_ReadyToCraft_GiveItem_NeedMore_001
Array.english: I brought the materials you asked for.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah membawa bahan-bahan yang kamu minta.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_ReadyToCraft_GiveItem_NeedMore_002
Array.english: Huh? That's not enough.
Array.indonesia: Hah? Itu belum cukup.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_ReadyToCraft_GiveItem_NeedMore_003
Array.english: ...Guess I miscounted. I'll bring more!
Array.indonesia: ...Sepertinya aku salah hitung. Aku akan bawa lagi!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_ReadyToCraft_GiveItem_NoItem_001
Array.english: <size=33>You sure you brought them? Don't mess with me.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kamu yakin sudah membawanya? Jangan main-main denganku.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_ReadyToCraft_RefuseGiveItem_001
Array.english: Ah, I need a bit more time.\nLet me keep looking!
Array.indonesia: Ah, aku butuh sedikit waktu lagi.\nBiarkan aku terus mencari!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterCraftDone_001
Array.english: <size=34>Wow! That was fast!\nThat's amazing!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wah! Cepat sekali!\nLuar biasa!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterCraftDone_002
Array.english: Heh...
Array.indonesia: Heh...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterCraftDone_003
Array.english: <size=34>...Heh. Hmph. Don't need your praise... hehe<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>...Heh. Hmph. Aku nggak butuh pujianmu... hehe<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterCraftDone_004
Array.english: <size=34>If my arm wasn't messed up, I'd be even faster... hehe<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kalau lenganku nggak cedera, aku pasti lebih cepat lagi... hehe<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterCraftDone_005
Array.english: ...Anyway, I made good use of the tools.\nYou can take them back now.
Array.indonesia: ...Pokoknya, aku sudah memanfaatkan alat-alat itu dengan baik.\nKamu bisa mengambilnya kembali sekarang.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterCraftDone_006
Array.english: Ahem. Keep 'em.\nCan't use 'em right now anyway.
Array.indonesia: Ahem. Simpan saja.\nLagipula, aku nggak bisa menggunakannya sekarang.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterCraftDone_007
Array.english:
Was getting a bit bored, anyway. Works out for me.
Bring the materials, I'll make what you need.
Array.indonesia:
Lagipula, aku mulai bosan. Bagus buatku.
Bawa bahan-bahannya, aku akan membuat apa yang kamu butuhkan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterCraftDone_008
Array.english: And yeah... I'll be charging from now on.
Array.indonesia: Dan ya... Mulai sekarang aku akan mengenakan biaya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterCraftDone_009
Array.english: Sounds good.\nI'll put the skewer grill to good use. Thanks!
Array.indonesia: Kedengarannya bagus.\nAku akan memanfaatkan pemanggang tusuk sate itu dengan baik. Terima kasih!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_MoveToBancho_001
Array.english: Now I should take this to Bancho.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang aku harus membawa ini ke Bancho.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_MoveToBancho_002
Array.english: <size=35>...This looks heavy.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>...This kelihatannya berat.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BanchoComplete_001
Array.english: <size=36>Huff... huff...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Huff... huff...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BanchoComplete_002
Array.english: Hmm. You actually brought a skewer grill. Much appreciated.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Kamu benar-benar membawa pemanggang tusuk sate. Terima kasih banyak.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BanchoComplete_003
Array.english: It's really heavy... Where should I put it?
Array.indonesia: Ini benar-benar berat... Di mana aku harus meletakkannya?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BanchoComplete_004
Array.english: Hmm. We'll need to furnish this place properly...\nI'm not particularly skilled at that.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Kita perlu melengkapi tempat ini dengan baik...\nAku tidak terlalu ahli dalam hal itu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BanchoComplete_005
Array.english: How about you handle the arrangement of furniture and equipment, as you did at the Blue Hole?
Array.indonesia: Bagaimana kalau kamu yang mengurus penataan furnitur dan peralatan, seperti yang kamu lakukan di Blue Hole?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BanchoComplete_006
Array.english: Got it. I'll take care of it.
Array.indonesia: Oke. Aku akan mengurusnya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BanchoTutorial_Start_001
Array.english: <size=33>Select <color=#F1DC2B>Interior</color> below.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Pilih <color=#F1DC2B>Interior</color> di bawah ini.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BanchoTutorial_Position_001
Array.english: Each piece of furniture has a designated spot where it can be placed.
Array.indonesia: Setiap furnitur memiliki tempat yang sudah ditentukan untuk diletakkan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BanchoTutorial_Grill_001
Array.english: The spot for the <color=#F1DC2B>skewer grill</color> is right here.\nLooking at the space, we could add more later.
Array.indonesia: Tempat untuk <color=#F1DC2B>panggangan sate</color> ada di sini.\nMelihat ruangannya, kita bisa menambahkan lebih banyak nanti.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BanchoEnd_001
Array.english: <size=35>The skewer grill is set. Thank you.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Panggangan sate sudah siap. Terima kasih.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BanchoEnd_002
Array.english: With this, I intend to prepare simple <color=#1DFEAF>Skewers</color> rather than full meals.
Array.indonesia: Dengan ini, saya bermaksud menyiapkan <color=#1DFEAF>sate</color> sederhana daripada hidangan lengkap.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BanchoEnd_003
Array.english: Some customers prefer something light to accompany their meal.
Array.indonesia: Beberapa pelanggan lebih suka hidangan ringan untuk menemani makanannya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BanchoEnd_004
Array.english: So, I would have you handle the <color=#1DFEAF>Skewers</color>. It should not be difficult, only the grilling time must be precise.
Array.indonesia: Jadi, saya ingin Kamu yang menangani <color=#1DFEAF>sate</color>. Seharusnya tidak sulit, hanya saja waktu pemanggangan harus tepat.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BanchoEnd_005
Array.english: Well... I think I can handle that.
Array.indonesia: Yah... saya rasa saya bisa mengatasinya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BanchoEnd_006
Array.english: <size=32>We've been working together for a while now, after all. Haha.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Lagipula, kita sudah bekerja sama cukup lama. Haha.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_BanchoEnd_007
Array.english: Very well. I will rely on you from here on.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah. Mulai sekarang aku akan mengandalkanmu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_Housing_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... the place is looking nice and clean now!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... tempat ini sekarang terlihat rapi dan bersih!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_Housing_002
Array.english: <size=32>Maybe I could add a few decorations...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Mungkin aku bisa menambahkan beberapa hiasan...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_Morning_Home_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm... it gets a bit chilly at night.\nFeels like there's a draft...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm... malam hari agak dingin.\nRasanya ada angin yang masuk...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_Morning_Home_002
Array.english: <size=32>Well... I guess I can't complain. \nI did take this place on short notice.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Yah... kurasa aku tidak bisa mengeluh. \nAku memang mengambil tempat ini dengan pemberitahuan mendadak.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaHelp_001
Array.english: <size=35>Oh, Dave! Uhm...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh, Dave! Uhm...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaHelp_002
Array.english: <size=33>Hmm? What's up, Muna?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hmm? Ada apa, Muna?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaHelp_003
Array.english: You're heading down to the lake, right?\nCould I ask you to help with some research?
Array.indonesia: Kamu mau ke danau, kan?\nBolehkah aku minta tolong untuk membantu penelitian?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaHelp_004
Array.english: Sure. I'd be happy to help if I can...
Array.indonesia: Tentu. Aku dengan senang hati akan membantu jika bisa...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaHelp_005
Array.english: <size=31>It smells like rotten eggs and stings...\nI don't think I can go very deep.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Bau seperti telur busuk dan terasa perih.. .\nAku rasa aku nggak bisa masuk terlalu dalam.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaHelp_006
Array.english: Ah, that's due to <color=#1DFEAF>Hydrogen Sulfide</color>. It's a gas produced by decaying organic matter. In other words, a toxic substance.
Array.indonesia: Ah, itu karena <color=#1DFEAF>hidrogen sulfida</color>. Itu adalah gas yang dihasilkan dari pembusukan bahan organik. Dengan kata lain, zat beracun.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaHelp_007
Array.english: It tends to accumulate where freshwater meets saltwater due to differences in density.
Array.indonesia: Gas ini cenderung menumpuk di tempat pertemuan air tawar dan air asin karena perbedaan kepadatan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaHelp_008
Array.english: <size=33>This lake probably had some to begin with.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Danau ini mungkin memang sudah mengandung gas itu sejak awal.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaHelp_009
Array.english: But I suspect the concentration increased significantly because massive creatures like dinosaurs died and piled up in a short period... Hmm.
Array.indonesia: Tapi aku curiga konsentrasinya meningkat secara signifikan karena makhluk-makhluk raksasa seperti dinosaurus mati dan menumpuk dalam waktu singkat... Hmm.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaHelp_010
Array.english: I see... Then this research might be difficult after all.
Array.indonesia: Begitu ya... Kalau begitu, penelitian ini mungkin akan sulit juga.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaHelp_011
Array.english: <size=32>Ha! What are you talking about?! Do you think Muna, the Dark Angel of this lab, would ask for something like that without a plan?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ha! Ngomong apa sih?! Kamu pikir Muna, Malaikat Kegelapan di lab ini, bakal minta hal kayak gitu tanpa rencana?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaHelp_012
Array.english: <size=35>Ta-da! Use this!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ta-da! Pakai ini!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaHelp_013
Array.english: <size=35>What's... this?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Apa... ini?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaHelp_014
Array.english: This is a <color=#F1DC2B>Purification Filter</color>. With this, some of the hydrogen sulfide should be filtered out, hehe.
Array.indonesia: Ini adalah <color=#F1DC2B>Filter Pemurnian</color>. Dengan ini, sebagian hidrogen sulfida seharusnya bisa disaring, hehe.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaHelp_015
Array.english: I made it in a hurry, so you won't be able to go too deep... \nBut I'll keep researching and see if I can improve it.
Array.indonesia: Aku membuatnya dengan terburu-buru, jadi kamu tidak akan bisa masuk terlalu dalam... \nTapi aku akan terus meneliti dan melihat apakah aku bisa memperbaikinya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaHelp_016
Array.english: Oh, I see. Still, looks like it'll help quite a lot with exploring \nthe lake.
Array.indonesia: Oh, begitu. Meski begitu, sepertinya ini akan sangat membantu dalam menjelajahi \ndanau itu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaHelp_017
Array.english: So what can I help you with?
Array.indonesia: Jadi, ada yang bisa saya bantu?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaHelp_018
Array.english: Well... I'm looking into some local folklore in this area.
Array.indonesia: Nah... Saya sedang meneliti beberapa cerita rakyat setempat di daerah ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaHelp_019
Array.english: Scientific analysis is important, but...
Array.indonesia: Analisis ilmiah memang penting, tapi...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaHelp_020
Array.english: Studying old legends can help us understand why these things are happening here.
Array.indonesia: Mempelajari legenda-legenda kuno bisa membantu kita memahami mengapa hal-hal ini terjadi di sini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaHelp_021
Array.english: I read through some writings from the village chief, and it seems the ancient Sunang people ventured deep into the lake.
Array.indonesia: Saya telah membaca beberapa tulisan dari kepala desa, dan tampaknya suku Sunang kuno pernah menjelajah jauh ke dalam danau.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaHelp_022
Array.english: <size=34>In other words, they knew how to get past\nthe <color=#1DFEAF>Hydrogen Sulfide</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Dengan kata lain, mereka tahu cara melewati\n<color=#1DFEAF>hidrogen sulfida</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaHelp_023
Array.english: <size=33>There must be traces of that at the bottom of the lake.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Pasti ada jejak-jejaknya di dasar danau.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaHelp_024
Array.english: <size=33>If you find any <color=#F1DC2B>Sculptures</color> at the bottom of the lake, could you bring them to me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Jika kamu menemukan <color=#F1DC2B>Patung-patung</color> di dasar danau, bisakah kamu membawanya kepadaku?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaHelp_025
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm. Got it. I'll look for them.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm. Baiklah. Aku akan mencarinya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaFilterUpgrade_001
Array.english: According to the literature, there are <color=#F1DC2B>3 Stone Tablets</color> in total... and they seem to be quite deep in the lake.
Array.indonesia: Menurut literatur, ada <color=#F1DC2B>3 Lempengan Batu</color> secara total... dan tampaknya letaknya cukup dalam di danau.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaFilterUpgrade_002
Array.english: As you know, the deeper you go, the higher the hydrogen sulfide concentration gets, so you'll need to upgrade your <color=#F1DC2B>Purification Filter</color>.
Array.indonesia: Seperti yang kamu tahu, semakin dalam kamu menyelam, semakin tinggi konsentrasi hidrogen sulfida, jadi kamu perlu meningkatkan <color=#F1DC2B>Filter Pemurnian</color>-mu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaFilterUpgrade_003
Array.english: Hmm... To upgrade it, I'll need to study contaminated materials further...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Untuk meningkatkannya, aku perlu mempelajari bahan-bahan yang terkontaminasi lebih lanjut...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaFilterUpgrade_004
Array.english: If you bring me some <color=#F1DC2B>Contaminated Dinosaur Bones</color>,\nI'll help you upgrade it.
Array.indonesia: Jika kamu membawakan aku beberapa <color=#F1DC2B>Tulang Dinosaurus yang Terkontaminasi</color>,\naku akan membantumu meningkatkan kemampuannya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaFilterUpgrade_005
Array.english: Well... this will take time, effort, and... my talent too... So I'll need a bit of funding as well.
Array.indonesia: Nah... ini akan membutuhkan waktu, usaha, dan... bakatku juga... Jadi aku juga butuh sedikit dana.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaFilterUpgrade_006
Array.english: <size=35>Hehe... hehehe...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Hehe... hehehe...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaFilterUpgrade_007
Array.english: ...G-Got it. I'll look for some <color=#F1DC2B>Contaminated Dinosaur Bones</color>.
Array.indonesia: ...O-Oke. Aku akan mencari beberapa <color=#F1DC2B>Tulang Dinosaurus yang Terkontaminasi</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_FindArtifact_001
Array.english: I think that's the <color=#F1DC2B>Sculpture</color> Muna was talking about?
Array.indonesia: Kurasa itu <color=#F1DC2B>Patung</color> yang dimaksud Muna?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_FindArtifact_002
Array.english: <size=32>Let's go grab it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ayo kita ambil!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_AfterFindArtifact_001
Array.english: <size=33>Alright. Let's head back up and take it to Muna.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Baiklah. Ayo kita kembali ke atas dan bawa ke Muna.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaTalk01_001
Array.english: Is this the <color=#F1DC2B>Sculpture</color> you mentioned?\nIt's pretty damaged.
Array.indonesia: Apakah ini <color=#F1DC2B>Patung</color> yang kamu sebutkan?\nKondisinya cukup rusak.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaTalk01_002
Array.english: <size=34>Ooh...! This sculpture is...\nAn ancient diver?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ooh...! Patung ini adalah...\nSeorang penyelam kuno?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaTalk01_003
Array.english: Hmm. Looking at this, I think I'm starting to understand. Using equipment like this... and doing this... hmm.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Melihat ini, sepertinya aku mulai mengerti. Menggunakan peralatan seperti ini... dan melakukan ini... hmm.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaTalk01_004
Array.english: <size=33>Okay! I'll look into it further.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oke! Aku akan menyelidikinya lebih lanjut.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaTalk01_01_001
Array.english: Ah, looking at the writings the village chief had...
Array.indonesia: Ah, melihat tulisan yang dimiliki kepala desa...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaTalk01_01_002
Array.english: The ancient Sunang people placed <color=#F1DC2B>Stone Tablets</color> deep in the lake to pray for safety.
Array.indonesia: Suku Sunang kuno menempatkan <color=#F1DC2B>Lempengan Batu</color> di kedalaman danau untuk berdoa memohon keselamatan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaTalk01_01_003
Array.english: Hmm. There might be clues on those <color=#F1DC2B>Stone Tablets</color>.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Mungkin ada petunjuk di <color=#F1DC2B>Lempengan Batu</color> itu.
