Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_WinMudSkipperBoss_005
Array.english: And with no real predators around, even more so.
Array.indonesia: Apalagi nggak ada predator yang beneran di sekitar sini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_WinMudSkipperBoss_006
Array.english: <size=33>Alright, let's grab that Sunang <color=#F1DC2B>Diving Equipment</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oke, ayo ambil <color=#F1DC2B>Peralatan Selam</color> Sunang itu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_MudSkipperBossRetry_001
Array.english: <size=32>That goby from before...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ikan goby tadi...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_MudSkipperBossRetry_002
Array.english:
<size=33>Ready to go?
Let's take it down once more!</size>
Array.indonesia:
<size=33>Siap berangkat?
Ayo kita selam lagi!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Find_OldFilter_001
Array.english: Oh... so this is what the ancient Sunang people used to dive...!
Array.indonesia: Oh... jadi inilah yang digunakan oleh masyarakat Sunang kuno untuk menyelam...!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Find_OldFilter_002
Array.english: Pretty well preserved for something this old.
Array.indonesia: Kondisinya masih cukup baik untuk benda seusia ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Find_OldFilter_003
Array.english: It's pretty intricate too. Looks like the Sunang had impressive technology.
Array.indonesia: Desainnya juga cukup rumit. Sepertinya suku Sunang memiliki teknologi yang mengagumkan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Find_OldFilter_004
Array.english: This fabric's really thick, should handle hydrogen sulfide \njust fine.
Array.indonesia: Kain ini sangat tebal, seharusnya bisa menahan hidrogen sulfida \ndengan baik.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Find_OldFilter_005
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! Then let's take it to Muna and have her upgrade the equipment!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Kalau begitu, ayo bawa ke Muna dan minta dia memperbarui perlengkapannya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_AfterFind_OldFilter_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, looks like Marone found a <color=#1DFEAF>Lift</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, sepertinya Marone menemukan <color=#1DFEAF>Lift</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_AfterFind_OldFilter_002
Array.english: <size=33>Let's ride it up!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ayo naik!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_AfterFind_OldFilter_003
Array.english: Uh... is it safe...?
Array.indonesia: Eh... apakah ini aman...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_AfterFind_OldFilter_004
Array.english: <size=33>Mwahaha! Marone found it!\nNothing to worry about!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Mwahaha! Marone menemukannya!\nNggak perlu khawatir!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Barricade_OldFilter_001
Array.english: <size=32>Going back now doesn't seem like a good idea.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kembali sekarang kayaknya bukan ide yang bagus.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Elevator_B2to1_01_001
Array.english: Phew... that rattling had me worried, but it works fine.
Array.indonesia: Fiuh... suara gemeretak tadi bikin aku khawatir, tapi ternyata berfungsi dengan baik.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Elevator_B2to1_001
Array.english: <size=32>It's already evening...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Sudah sore...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Elevator_B2to1_002
Array.english: <size=32>Let's head back before it gets any darker.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ayo kita pulang sebelum semakin gelap.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Elevator_B2to1_003
Array.english: Woof! Woof!
Array.indonesia: Guk! Guk!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Barricade_DrainageRoomDoor_001
Array.english: <size=32>What's this door...? There's something written on it...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Pintu apa ini...? Ada tulisan di atasnya...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Barricade_DrainageRoomDoor_002
Array.english: <size=32>I should ask Muna about it later.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Nanti aku harus tanya Muna soal ini.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Barricade_Ladder_001
Array.english: <size=32>There's a ladder here...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ada tangga di sini...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Barricade_Ladder_002
Array.english: <size=32>Maybe there used to be a way down there.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Mungkin dulu ada jalan ke bawah sana.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Before_Festival_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... it's pretty lively out here...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... di sini cukup ramai ya...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Before_Festival_002
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, Dave! Perfect timing!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, Dave! Tepat sekali waktunya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Before_Festival_003
Array.english: <size=32>There's a coming-of-age ceremony tonight!\nIt's about to start!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Malam ini ada upacara kedewasaan!\nSebentar lagi akan dimulai!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Before_Festival_004
Array.english: <size=33>Oh...? What a cute puppy...<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh...? Anjing kecil yang lucu...<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Before_Festival_004_02
Array.english: Woof!
Array.indonesia: Guk!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Before_Festival_005
Array.english: Oh, we found him stuck in a pit in the forest...\nHe kept following us after that.
Array.indonesia: Oh, kami menemukannya terjebak di lubang di hutan...\nSejak itu, dia terus mengikuti kami.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Before_Festival_006
Array.english: <size=32>He may look cute, but he's pretty fierce in a fight!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Dia mungkin terlihat imut, tapi dia cukup ganas saat bertarung!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Before_Festival_007
Array.english: <size=32>Hehe... I hope it stays in the village<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehe... Semoga dia tetap tinggal di desa<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Before_Festival_008
Array.english: Oh, right... Did you manage to bring back the items from \nthe temple?
Array.indonesia: Oh, iya... Apa kamu berhasil membawa pulang barang-barang dari \nkuil?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Before_Festival_009
Array.english: Yes. I think this is the <color=#F1DC2B>Breathing Apparatus</color> and <color=#F1DC2B>Cloth</color> the chief mentioned.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Kurasa ini adalah <color=#F1DC2B>Alat Pernapasan</color> dan <color=#F1DC2B>Kain</color> yang disebutkan kepala desa.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Before_Festival_010
Array.english: <size=32>Ooh... it really was there!!\nWhat a lucky day!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wah... ternyata memang ada di sana!!\nHari yang beruntung sekali!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Before_Festival_011
Array.english: Hehehe... nice work. I think I can come up with something interesting after studying this... hehe.
Array.indonesia: Hehehe... kerja bagus. Kurasa aku bisa menemukan sesuatu yang menarik setelah mempelajari ini... hehe.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Before_Festival_012
Array.english: Glad to hear that. I'm going to get some rest...\nI'm exhausted after that trip.
Array.indonesia: Senang mendengarnya. Aku mau istirahat sebentar...\nAku lelah banget setelah perjalanan tadi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Before_Festival_013
Array.english: <size=32>Haha! What are you talking about?! On a day like this, \nwe should enjoy the festival!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha! Ngomong apa sih?! Di hari seperti ini, \nkita harus menikmati festivalnya!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Before_Festival_014
Array.english: <size=33>Huh...? Me too...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hah...? Aku juga...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Before_Festival_015
Array.english: <size=34>Ku-haha!! Perfect timing, I was just getting hungry!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ku-haha!! Waktunya pas banget, aku baru aja mulai lapar!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Arrive_Festival_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hm? What's with the puppy?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hm? Ada apa dengan anak anjing itu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Arrive_Festival_002
Array.english: Oh... we found him in the forest... \nWould it be alright if he stayed in the village?
Array.indonesia: Oh... kami menemukannya di hutan... \nBolehkah dia tinggal di desa ini?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Arrive_Festival_003
Array.english: Sure, why not. \nJust make sure it doesn't get eaten by a crocodile!
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja, kenapa tidak. \nPastikan saja dia nggak dimakan buaya!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Arrive_Festival_004
Array.english: That's a scary thought...
Array.indonesia: Itu pemikiran yang menakutkan...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Arrive_Festival_005
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! Chief! Anyway...\nI'm starving, got anything to eat?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Kepala Desa! Ngomong-ngomong...\nAku lapar banget, ada makanan?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Arrive_Festival_006
Array.english: Heh, didn't you say the food in this village didn't taste good?
Array.indonesia: Heh, bukankah kamu bilang makanan di desa ini rasanya nggak enak?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Arrive_Festival_007
Array.english: Hahaha. That's a bit harsh! It's just that Bancho's got a picky palate!
Array.indonesia: Hahaha. Itu agak kasar! Cuma Bancho yang seleranya pilih-pilih aja!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Arrive_Festival_008
Array.english: Hehe. I'm joking.\nLet me get you something to eat and drink.
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Aku bercanda. \nBiar aku ambilkan sesuatu untuk dimakan dan diminum.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Arrive_Festival_009
Array.english: But under one condition...
Array.indonesia: Tapi dengan satu syarat...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Arrive_Festival_010
Array.english: <size=33>...A condition?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...A syarat?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Arrive_Festival_011
Array.english: Today is <color=#F1DC2B>Jaka</color>'s coming-of-age ceremony.\nHe still seems like a kid, but he's already grown.
Array.indonesia: Hari ini adalah upacara kedewasaan <color=#F1DC2B>Jaka</color>.\nDia masih terlihat seperti anak-anak, tapi dia sudah dewasa.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Arrive_Festival_012
Array.english: For these ceremonies, Peneb always played the <color=#F1DC2B>Drums</color>...\nBut as you know, he injured his arm and can't play.
Array.indonesia: Untuk upacara-upacara seperti ini, Peneb selalu memainkan <color=#F1DC2B>Gendang</color>...\nTapi seperti yang kamu tahu, dia mengalami cedera pada lengannya dan tidak bisa bermain.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Arrive_Festival_013
Array.english: <size=33>I spoke with Peneb...\nand he suggested you could take his place.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku sudah berbicara dengan Peneb...\ndan dia menyarankan agar kamu menggantikannya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Arrive_Festival_014
Array.english: Given how much you've helped the village, it would be just right for you to also participate in the celebration.
Array.indonesia: Mengingat betapa besarnya bantuanmu bagi desa ini, sudah sepantasnya kamu juga ikut serta dalam perayaan ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Arrive_Festival_015
Array.english: ...I appreciate it, but... \nI've never really played <color=#F1DC2B>Drums</color> before...
Array.indonesia: ...Aku menghargainya, tapi... \nAku belum pernah benar-benar memainkan <color=#F1DC2B>drum</color> sebelumnya...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Arrive_Festival_016
Array.english: <size=32>Hehe, don't overthink it. Just hit the center and the edge in rhythm with the beat.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehe, jangan dipikirkan terlalu dalam. Cukup pukul bagian tengah dan tepinya sesuai irama.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Arrive_Festival_017
Array.english: I'll give you a signal when it's your turn,\nso just enjoy the ceremony until then.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan memberimu isyarat saat giliranmu tiba,\njadi nikmati saja upacara ini sampai saat itu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Arrive_Festival_018
Array.english: <size=33>Hmm... Alright. Got it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hmm... Baiklah. Paham.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_1F_Barricade_001
Array.english: <size=32>It'd be a waste to turn back now.\nLet's keep going.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Sayang sekali kalau mundur sekarang.\nAyo lanjutkan.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_B1F_Barricade_001
Array.english: <size=33>It'd be a waste to turn back now.\nLet's keep going.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Sayang sekali kalau mundur sekarang.\nAyo lanjutkan.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_B2F_Barricade_001
Array.english: <size=34>It'd be a waste to turn back now.\nLet's keep going.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Sayang sekali kalau mundur sekarang.\nAyo lanjutkan.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Before_FestivalMinigame_001
Array.english: <size=35>Dave, now!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Dave, sekarang!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Before_FestivalMinigame_002
Array.english: <size=35>Listen to the rhythm and follow the beat!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Dengarkan ritmenya dan ikuti iramanya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_StartFreeTime_001
Array.english: <size=33>Haha, well done. You helped make Jaka's coming-of-age ceremony a success.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Haha, bagus sekali. Kamu telah membantu menyukseskan upacara kedewasaan Jaka.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_StartFreeTime_002
Array.english: You've come back from the Setah Forest. You must be tired... Take a look around and get some rest.
Array.indonesia: Kamu baru saja kembali dari Hutan Setah. Pasti lelah... Lihat-lihat sekeliling dan istirahatlah sebentar.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Cobra_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! This village's coconut wine is incredible!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Arak kelapa desa ini luar biasa!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Cobra_002
Array.english: <size=33>Feels like all the fatigue from the day is just melting away!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Rasanya semua kelelahan hari ini lenyap begitu saja!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Cobra_003
Array.english: <size=34>You're not having any?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kamu tidak mau mencicipi?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Cobra_004
Array.english: I was so tense today, I'm exhausted.\nAnd I even had to play the drums.
Array.indonesia: Aku sangat tegang hari ini, aku kelelahan.\nDan aku bahkan harus bermain drum.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Cobra_005
Array.english: <size=32>Hahaha! I can imagine. There's plenty of good food, \nat least fill your stomach!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hahaha! Aku bisa membayangkannya. Ada banyak makanan enak, \nsetidaknya isi perutmu dulu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Bancho_001
Array.english: What are you writing, Bancho?
Array.indonesia: Apa yang kamu tulis, Bancho?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Bancho_002
Array.english: I helped prepare some of the festival dishes earlier today... \nbut I'm not fully satisfied with them.
Array.indonesia: Aku membantu menyiapkan beberapa hidangan festival tadi... \ntapi aku belum sepenuhnya puas dengan hasilnya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Bancho_003
Array.english: I still haven't fully grasped the local herbs and spices, \nso the balance was off.
Array.indonesia: Aku masih belum sepenuhnya memahami rempah-rempah dan bumbu lokal, \njadi rasanya kurang seimbang.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Bancho_004
Array.english: <size=32>I thought they were really good, though?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Padahal menurutku rasanya enak banget, lho?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Bancho_005
Array.english: Your standards are too high, Bancho.\nAll the villagers are really enjoying it.
Array.indonesia: Standarmu terlalu tinggi, Bancho.\nSemua penduduk desa sangat menikmatinya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Bancho_006
Array.english: Still... learning new ingredients in a place like this is enlightening.
Array.indonesia: Meski begitu... mempelajari bahan-bahan baru di tempat seperti ini sungguh membuka wawasan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Bacon_001
Array.english: Dr. Bacon, you've already had quite a bit...
Array.indonesia: Dr. Bacon, kamu sudah makan cukup banyak...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Bacon_002
Array.english: <size=32>Hahaha! The festival atmosphere is amazing...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hahaha! Suasana festivalnya luar biasa...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Bacon_003
Array.english: <size=33>You need to unwind like this once in a while for things to go well!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kamu perlu bersantai seperti ini sesekali agar segala sesuatunya berjalan lancar!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Bacon_004
Array.english: <size=32>I'm really hitting it off with the locals here!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku benar-benar akrab dengan penduduk setempat di sini!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Bacon_005
Array.english: You still need to look at the Sunang civilization artifacts, \nso don't drink too much...
Array.indonesia: Kamu masih harus melihat artefak peradaban Sunang, \njadi jangan minum terlalu banyak...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Chief_001
Array.english: It's been a while since you arrived.\nHow are you settling in?
Array.indonesia: Sudah cukup lama sejak kamu tiba.\nBagaimana penyesuaianmu di sini?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Chief_002
Array.english: Yeah, I was worried at first. But once you get to know people, most of them are really kind.
Array.indonesia: Ya, awalnya aku khawatir. Tapi begitu mengenal orang-orangnya, kebanyakan dari mereka sangat baik.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Chief_003
Array.english: <size=35>Haha, glad to hear it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Haha, senang mendengarnya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Chief_004
Array.english: We've had quite a few strange outsiders pass through...
Array.indonesia: Sudah cukup banyak pendatang aneh yang lewat di sini...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Chief_005
Array.english: Some even damaged our heritage... or brought in invasive species...
Array.indonesia: Beberapa di antaranya bahkan merusak warisan budaya kami... atau membawa spesies invasif...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Chief_006
Array.english: <size=33>But you're different.\nYou're doing well.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tapi kamu berbeda.\nKamu beradaptasi dengan baik.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Chief_007
Array.english: <size=33>It's a good day, so relax and enjoy yourselves.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hari ini cuacanya bagus, jadi santai saja dan nikmati waktumu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Muna_001
Array.english: ...Cut the cloth like this... \nand the breathing apparatus goes here...
Array.indonesia: ...Potong kainnya seperti ini... \ndan alat bantu pernapasan diletakkan di sini...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Muna_002
Array.english: Hmm? Muna, aren't you enjoying the festival?
Array.indonesia: Hmm? Muna, apa kamu tidak menikmati festival ini?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Muna_003
Array.english: Hehe, I already ate.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, aku sudah makan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Muna_004
Array.english: I actually enjoy the festival more when I'm working on the things you bring me, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Sebenarnya aku lebih menikmati festival ini saat mengerjakan hal-hal yang kamu bawa untukku, Dave.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Rimbo_001
Array.english: That was a wonderful performance, Rimbo!
Array.indonesia: Itu penampilan yang luar biasa, Rimbo!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Rimbo_002
Array.english: <size=32>Haha, Dave, for your first time, ya kept the rhythm real well!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha, Dave, untuk pertama kalinya, kamu bisa menjaga iramanya dengan sangat baik!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Rimbo_003
Array.english: Hehe, glad I didn't mess it up.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, untung aku nggak mengacaukannya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Rimbo_004
Array.english: <size=32>Well then, go on and enjoy the festival!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Baiklah, silakan nikmati festivalnya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Herbalist_001
Array.english: Oh, are you enjoying the festival?
Array.indonesia: Oh, apakah kamu menikmati festivalnya?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Herbalist_002
Array.english: Yes, I really like the atmosphere.
Array.indonesia: Ya, aku sangat suka suasananya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Herbalist_003
Array.english: Heh. The festival, combined with the coming-of-age ceremony, is truly remarkable.
Array.indonesia: Heh. Festival ini, ditambah dengan upacara kedewasaan, sungguh luar biasa.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Herbalist_004
Array.english: I hope you enjoy your time here.
Array.indonesia: Semoga kamu menikmati waktumu di sini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Fisherman_001
Array.english: <size=33>I caught the fish they served at today's festival!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku berhasil menangkap ikan yang disajikan di festival hari ini!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Fisherman_002
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... really! It was delicious!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... beneran! Rasanya enak banget!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Fisherman_003
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! Reeled in some mighty fine fish!\nLuck was on my side today!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Aku berhasil menangkap ikan yang sangat bagus!\nHari ini keberuntungan ada di pihakku!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Carpenter_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hehe, it's nice to get out like this once in a while.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehe, enak juga sesekali keluar seperti ini.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Carpenter_002
Array.english: That makes sense, you're usually working at home.
Array.indonesia: Masuk akal, kamu biasanya kerja di rumah.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Carpenter_003
Array.english: Still, you need to recover, so don't drink too much.
Array.indonesia: Tapi, kamu perlu istirahat, jadi jangan minum terlalu banyak.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Lipah_001
Array.english: Hehe. Thank you for joining our festival.
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Terima kasih sudah ikut meramaikan festival kami.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Lipah_002
Array.english: <size=32>Your performance earlier was wonderful!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Penampilanmu tadi luar biasa!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Lipah_003
Array.english: ...Hehe, it was nothing.\nI'm just glad the chief invited us.
Array.indonesia: ...Hehe, nggak ada apa-apa.\nAku cuma senang kepala desa mengundang kita.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Lipah_004
Array.english: And the food's really good too...
Array.indonesia: Dan makanannya juga enak banget...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Farmer_001
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(He's completely absorbed in dancing.\nBetter not interrupt... or he'll give me an earful.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Dia benar-benar asyik menari.\nMendingan jangan diganggu... atau dia bakal ngomel-ngomel ke aku.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Uzme_001
Array.english: You did great today, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Kamu hebat banget hari ini, Dave.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Uzme_002
Array.english: Dad asked you out of nowhere. \nThat must've caught you off guard, huh?
Array.indonesia: Ayah tiba-tiba mengajakmu keluar. \nPasti bikin kamu kaget, ya?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Uzme_003
Array.english: Well... it did, but...
Array.indonesia: Yah... memang, tapi...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Uzme_004
Array.english: <size=32>It was still fun, though!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tapi tetap seru kok!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Uzme_005
Array.english: Haha, you did pretty well for your first time.
Array.indonesia: Haha, kamu lumayan bagus untuk pertama kalinya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Uzme_006
Array.english: I used to play something like this at the arcade back in the day.
Array.indonesia: Dulu aku sering main yang kayak gini di arcade.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Uzme_007
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, I see, haha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, begitu, haha!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Uzme_008
Array.english: Oh, about the food today...\nBancho helped out too.
Array.indonesia: Oh, soal makanan hari ini...\nBancho juga ikut membantu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Uzme_009
Array.english: Ah, that explains why it tasted so familiar.
Array.indonesia: Ah, itu menjelaskan kenapa rasanya begitu familiar.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Harta_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! Best part of festival day? Free booze!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Bagian terbaik dari hari festival? Minuman gratis!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Harta_002
Array.english: <size=32>And you can eat and drink all you want, \nthe chief won't say a word!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Dan kamu bisa makan dan minum sepuasnya, \nkepala desa tidak akan protes!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Gesang_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ugh... it's festival day and I can't even gamble...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ugh... ini hari festival dan aku bahkan tidak bisa berjudi...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Gesang_002
Array.english: Hm? Why not? It's supposed to be a fun day.
Array.indonesia: Hm? Kenapa tidak? Seharusnya ini hari yang menyenangkan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Gesang_003
Array.english: Over there... my wife's watching me...
Array.indonesia: Di sana... istriku sedang mengawasiku...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Gesang_004
Array.english: If I lose even a little money... she won't let me hear the end of it at home...!
Array.indonesia: Kalau aku kalah sedikit saja... dia nggak akan berhenti mengomeliku di rumah...!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Chandra_001
Array.english: <size=34>Shh...! Keep it down...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ssst...! Jangan berisik...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Chandra_002
Array.english: <size=32>I'm keeping an eye on him. Making sure he doesn't do anything foolish.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku mengawasinya. Memastikan dia tidak melakukan hal bodoh.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Chandra_003
Array.english: <size=32>Men always pick up bad habits the moment they let their guard down!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Pria selalu meniru kebiasaan buruk begitu mereka lengah!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_PoetryGirl_001
Array.english: The blazing sun turns to a bonfire, sharing the night with us.
Array.indonesia: Matahari yang terik berubah menjadi api unggun, menemani malam kita.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_PoetryGirl_002
Array.english: Even the ancient spirits move with the rhythm of the beating drums.
Array.indonesia: Bahkan roh-roh kuno bergerak mengikuti irama dentuman genderang.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_PoetryGirl_003
Array.english: Oh... that's a really beautiful poem.\nDid you just come up with it?
Array.indonesia: Oh... itu puisi yang sangat indah.\nApakah kamu baru saja membuatnya?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_PoetryGirl_004
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, you heard me...! \nHow embarrassing...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, kamu mendengarnya...! \nMalu banget...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_PoetryGirl_005
Array.english: Yes... I wrote it while watching the festival.
Array.indonesia: Ya... aku menulisnya sambil menonton festival.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_PoetryGirl_006
Array.english: It really made me see the festival in a new light.
Array.indonesia: Itu benar-benar membuatku melihat festival ini dari sudut pandang baru.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_FlowerGrandma_001
Array.english: Hehe... even this old soul finds joy in the festival.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... bahkan jiwa tua sepertiku pun menemukan kegembiraan dalam festival ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_FlowerGrandma_002
Array.english: The music and energy of the festival breathe new life into me.
Array.indonesia: Musik dan energi festival ini menghidupkanku kembali.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_YoungMan_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ugh... is alcohol always this strong...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ugh... apakah alkohol selalu sekuat ini...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_YoungMan_002
Array.english: <size=33>They say people drink it to dull the pain when getting tattoos...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Katanya orang-orang meminumnya untuk meredakan rasa sakit saat ditato...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_YoungMan_003
Array.english: <size=33>Why would anyone want this...</size>\n<size=45>Uuurgh!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kenapa ada orang yang mau begini...</size>\n<size=45>Uuurgh!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Princessy_001
Array.english: I sat in front of the bonfire too long and my makeup's running.
Array.indonesia: Aku duduk terlalu lama di depan api unggun dan riasanku luntur.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Princessy_002
Array.english: Even though it's a ceremony to honor our ancestors...
Array.indonesia: Meskipun ini upacara untuk menghormati leluhur kita...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Princessy_003
Array.english: <size=32>An event so steeped in drink and indulgence really isn't for me.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Acara yang begitu kental dengan minuman dan pesta pora ini benar-benar bukan untukku.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_BroSisMom_001
Array.english: Hehe, children really love festivals.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, anak-anak memang sangat menyukai festival.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_BroSisMom_002
Array.english: This festival honors our ancestors and celebrates coming of age, but...
Array.indonesia: Festival ini menghormati leluhur kita dan merayakan kedewasaan, tapi...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_BroSisMom_003
Array.english: They can come to understand that in time.\nFor now, they just need to have fun.
Array.indonesia: Mereka akan mengerti hal itu seiring berjalannya waktu.\nUntuk saat ini, mereka hanya perlu bersenang-senang.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_BroSisDad_001
Array.english: Preparing for the festival is physically tiring, but...
Array.indonesia: Mempersiapkan festival memang melelahkan secara fisik, tapi...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_BroSisDad_002
Array.english: <size=32>Seeing the children enjoy themselves makes all the exhaustion disappear, hahaha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Melihat anak-anak bersenang-senang membuat semua kelelahan lenyap, hahaha!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_YoungManMom_001
Array.english: Jaka's become an adult...
Array.indonesia: Jaka sudah menjadi dewasa...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_YoungManMom_002
Array.english: It feels like just yesterday he was a baby...\nTime really does fly.
Array.indonesia: Rasanya baru kemarin dia masih bayi...\nWaktu memang berlalu begitu cepat.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_YoungManMom_003
Array.english: Now that he's a proper adult, he'll be more mature.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang dia sudah jadi orang dewasa sejati, dia pasti akan lebih dewasa.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_YoungManMom_004
Array.english: Hehe... they say children are always children.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... orang-orang bilang anak-anak itu tetaplah anak-anak.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_YoungManMom_005
Array.english: Still, now that he's an adult, we should trust him more.
Array.indonesia: Meski begitu, sekarang dia sudah dewasa, kita harus lebih mempercayainya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_JDLC_KidBrother_001
Array.english: <size=34>Yah! Take that!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Yah! Terima ini!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_JDLC_KidBrother_002
Array.english: <size=33>The winner gets the biggest piece of meat!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Pemenangnya dapat potongan daging terbesar!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_JDLC_KidSister_001
Array.english: <size=33>The food is so good!!\nThis is amazing!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Makanannya enak banget!!\nIni luar biasa!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_001
Array.english: <size=34>Hah! Hyah!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hah! Hyah!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_002
Array.english: <size=34>Not backing down from my blade? Not bad!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Tidak mundur dari pedangku? Lumayan!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_JDLC_Marone_001
Array.english: Woof! Woof!
Array.indonesia: Guk! Guk!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_JDLC_Marone_002
Array.english: Looks like Marone's in a good mood too.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya Marone juga sedang dalam suasana hati yang baik.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_JDLC_Marone_003
Array.english: Woof!
Array.indonesia: Guk!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_FinishFestival_001
Array.english: <size=32>Phew... I'm starting to feel tired.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wah... Aku mulai merasa lelah.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_FinishFestival_002
Array.english: <size=32>Maybe I should head home and get some rest for tomorrow.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Mungkin aku harus pulang dan istirahat sebentar untuk besok.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_FinishFestival_Option01
Array.english: Head home
Array.indonesia: Pulang ke rumah

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_FinishFestival_Option02
Array.english: Stay a bit longer
Array.indonesia: Tetap di sini sebentar lagi

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_FinishFestival_GoHome_001
Array.english: <size=32>I think I've seen enough.\nLet's head home.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kurasa aku sudah cukup melihatnya.\nAyo pulang.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_FinishFestival_Stay_001
Array.english: <size=32>Since it's a festival...\nLet's look around a bit more before bed!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Karena ini festival...\nAyo kita lihat-lihat sebentar lagi sebelum tidur!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_DaveBeforeSleep_001
Array.english: A lot happened today.
Array.indonesia: Banyak hal yang terjadi hari ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_DaveBeforeSleep_002
Array.english: We went to that creepy forest... \nEven went deep into the temple...
Array.indonesia: Kita pergi ke hutan menyeramkan itu... \nBahkan masuk jauh ke dalam kuil...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_DaveBeforeSleep_003
Array.english: But I'm glad we could help the people of Utara Village.
Array.indonesia: Tapi aku senang kita bisa membantu penduduk Desa Utara.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_DaveBeforeSleep_004
Array.english: There are some eccentric folks... But everyone really seems to love this village.
Array.indonesia: Ada beberapa orang yang aneh... Tapi sepertinya semua orang benar-benar menyukai desa ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_DaveBeforeSleep_005
Array.english: Muna said she'd study that ancient diving equipment we brought back today, right?
Array.indonesia: Muna bilang dia akan mempelajari peralatan selam kuno yang kita bawa pulang hari ini, kan?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_DaveBeforeSleep_006
Array.english: Maybe she'll have something new to show us tomorrow!
Array.indonesia: Mungkin besok dia akan menunjukkan sesuatu yang baru kepada kita!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_DaveBeforeSleep_007
Array.english: I'm getting sleepy now that I'm full... yawn.
Array.indonesia: Aku mulai mengantuk sekarang setelah perutku kenyang... menguap.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_DaveBeforeSleep_008
Array.english: I'll get a good night's sleep and start fresh tomorrow!
Array.indonesia: Aku akan tidur nyenyak malam ini dan memulai hari dengan segar besok!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_Barricade_001
Array.english: <size=33>Since it's my first time at the festival...\nI shouldn't wander too far.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Karena ini pertama kalinya aku ke festival...\nAku sebaiknya tidak berkeliaran terlalu jauh.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_Barricade_Door_001
Array.english: <size=32>It feels rude to go into someone's house while everyone's out enjoying the festival...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Rasanya tidak sopan masuk ke rumah orang lain saat semua orang sedang keluar menikmati festival...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_DaveAsk_001
Array.english: Um... I'm trying to clear the boulder blocking the path to <color=#1DFEAF>Setah Forest</color>...
Array.indonesia: Um... Aku sedang mencoba menyingkirkan batu besar yang menghalangi jalan menuju <color=#1DFEAF>Hutan Setah</color>...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_DaveAsk_002
Array.english: <size=34>Could you give me a hand?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Bisakah kamu membantuku?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_CarpenterAlreadyAgreed_001
Array.english: Didn't I say I'd help earlier?
Array.indonesia: Bukankah tadi aku sudah bilang akan membantu?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_CarpenterAlreadyAgreed_002
Array.english: <size=32>Why don't you go gather more people?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kenapa kamu tidak pergi mencari lebih banyak orang saja?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_CarpenterYes_001
Array.english: <size=32>You want me to help push a boulder...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kamu mau aku bantu mendorong batu besar...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_CarpenterYes_002
Array.english: Well... my arm's injured. I can't use my full strength like this.
Array.indonesia: Yah... lenganku terluka. Aku tidak bisa menggunakan tenaga penuh dalam kondisi seperti ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_CarpenterYes_003
Array.english: But you still do amazing work with one hand.
Array.indonesia: Tapi kamu tetap bisa melakukan pekerjaan luar biasa dengan satu tangan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_CarpenterYes_004
Array.english: <size=32>Th-That's... don't say stuff like that...<color=#ff61e3>♥</color> It's really not a big deal<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I-Itu... jangan bilang begitu...<color=#ff61e3>♥</color> Sebenarnya itu bukan masalah besar<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_CarpenterYes_005
Array.english: ...Ahem. Well, yeah, I could push a boulder like that with one arm. Sure.
Array.indonesia: ...Ahem. Ya, aku bisa mendorong batu sebesar itu dengan satu lengan. Tentu saja.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_CarpenterYes_006
Array.english: Of course, I don't mean alone...\nOnce people gather, I'll join in.
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja, aku tidak bermaksud sendirian...\nBegitu orang-orang berkumpul, aku akan ikut bergabung.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_CarpenterYes_007
Array.english: <size=32>Thank you, Peneb!\nI'll see you at the boulder when we're ready!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Terima kasih, Peneb!\nSampai jumpa di dekat batu besar itu saat kita sudah siap!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_CarpenterNo_001
Array.english: <size=33>Push that huge boulder together...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Mendorong batu besar itu bersama-sama...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_CarpenterNo_002
Array.english: Well, my arm's a bit injured and all...\nThat might be difficult...
Array.indonesia: Yah, lenganku agak terluka dan sebagainya...\nItu mungkin sulit...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_CarpenterNo_003
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Seems like we need to be a bit closer before I can ask for favors...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Sepertinya kita perlu lebih dekat dulu sebelum aku bisa meminta bantuan...)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FarmerAlreadyAgreed_001
Array.english: Ha! I already said I'd help earlier...
Array.indonesia: Ha! Aku sudah bilang tadi kalau aku akan membantu...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FarmerAlreadyAgreed_002
Array.english: <size=34>Go gather more people!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Pergilah cari lebih banyak orang!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FarmerYes_001
Array.english: <size=32>A big boulder on the forest path...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Sebongkah batu besar di jalan setapak hutan...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FarmerYes_002
Array.english: Ha! You're not planning to make me do it while you sit around, are you?
Array.indonesia: Ha! Kamu nggak berencana bikin aku yang ngelakuinnya sementara kamu cuma duduk-duduk, kan?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FarmerYes_003
Array.english: Can't trust outsiders at all.
Array.indonesia: Orang luar memang nggak bisa dipercaya sama sekali.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FarmerYes_004
Array.english: Still... well, you've helped me out before,\nso I'll lend a hand with this.
Array.indonesia: Tapi... yah, kamu pernah membantuku sebelumnya,\njadi aku akan membantu kali ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FarmerYes_005
Array.english: <size=32>Thank you, Jepun! I'll see you at the boulder when everything's ready!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Terima kasih, Jepun! Sampai jumpa di batu besar itu saat semuanya sudah siap!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FarmerNo_001
Array.english: <size=32>Huh? You want me to help push a boulder?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hah? Kamu mau aku bantu mendorong batu besar itu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FarmerNo_002
Array.english: No way, that rock keeps wild animals from coming up here. It's so convenient.
Array.indonesia: Nggak mungkin, batu itu mencegah binatang liar naik ke sini. Sangat berguna.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FarmerNo_003
Array.english: Why bother moving that thing?\nOutsiders just don't think, do they.
Array.indonesia: Ngapain repot-repot memindahkan benda itu?\nOrang luar memang nggak pernah mikir, ya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FarmerNo_004
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Seems like we need to be a bit closer before I can ask for favors...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Sepertinya kita perlu lebih dekat dulu sebelum aku bisa minta tolong...)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FishermanAlreadyAgreed_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hm? Ya mean movin' that boulder?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hm? Maksudmu memindahkan batu besar itu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FishermanAlreadyAgreed_002
Array.english: <size=32>I already said I'd help earlier.\nYour memory ain't so good, is it?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku sudah bilang tadi kalau aku mau bantu.\nIngatanmu kurang bagus, ya?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FishermanYes_001
Array.english: <size=33>You mean that big boulder on the forest path?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Maksudmu batu besar di jalan setapak hutan itu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FishermanYes_002
Array.english: Well... if a few folks pitch in, it ain't impossible...
Array.indonesia: Yah... kalau beberapa orang ikut bantu, itu bukan hal yang mustahil...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FishermanYes_003
Array.english: <size=32>Good chance to show what I'm made of!\nAlright, I'll help ya out.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kesempatan bagus buat nunjukin kemampuan aku!\nOke, aku bakal bantu kamu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FishermanYes_004
Array.english: <size=32>Thanks, Basu!\nI'll see you at the boulder when we're ready!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Makasih, Basu!\nSampai jumpa di batu besar itu kalau kita udah siap!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FishermanNo_001
Array.english: <size=32>You wanna move that boulder on the forest path?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kamu mau memindahkan batu besar di jalan setapak hutan itu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FishermanNo_002
Array.english: <size=32>Well, I ain't feelin' too great today... Might wanna ask someone else.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Yah, aku nggak terlalu enak badan hari ini... Mungkin sebaiknya kamu minta tolong orang lain saja.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FishermanNo_003
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Seems like we need to be a bit closer before I can ask for favors...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Sepertinya kita perlu lebih dekat dulu sebelum aku bisa minta tolong...)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_HerbalistAlreadyAgreed_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hm? I did say I'd help you earlier...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hm? Tadi aku kan sudah bilang akan membantumu...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_HerbalistAlreadyAgreed_002
Array.english: <size=32>I can't do it alone, so I'll come once the others gather.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku tidak bisa melakukannya sendirian, jadi aku akan datang setelah yang lain berkumpul.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_HerbalistYes_001
Array.english: <size=32>You mean pushing that big boulder on the forest path together...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Maksudmu mendorong batu besar di jalan setapak hutan itu bersama-sama...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_HerbalistYes_002
Array.english: Hmm... all right.\nPlease gather more people.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... baiklah.\nTolong kumpulkan lebih banyak orang.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_HerbalistYes_003
Array.english: <size=32>Thank you! I'll see you at the rock when everything's ready!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Terima kasih! Sampai jumpa di batu itu saat semuanya sudah siap!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_HerbalistNo_001
Array.english: <size=32>You want me to help push that big boulder on the forest path...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kamu ingin aku membantu mendorong batu besar di jalan setapak hutan itu...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_HerbalistNo_002
Array.english: I'm getting on in years, so... I'm not sure I can be of much help. Sorry about that.
Array.indonesia: Umurku sudah tidak muda lagi, jadi... aku tidak yakin bisa banyak membantu. Maaf ya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_HerbalistNo_003
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Seems like we need to be a bit closer before I can ask for favors...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Sepertinya kita harus lebih dekat dulu sebelum aku bisa meminta bantuan...)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_LipahAlreadyAgreed_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh my... Didn't I already say I'd help move that boulder?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Astaga... Bukankah aku sudah bilang akan membantu memindahkan batu besar itu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_LipahAlreadyAgreed_002
Array.english: <size=32>You just wanted to make sure, didn't you? Hehe.\nDon't worry, I'll help you.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kamu cuma mau memastikan, kan? Hehe.\nJangan khawatir, aku akan membantumu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_LipahYes_001
Array.english: <size=32>You mean that big boulder on the forest path, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Maksudmu batu besar di jalan setapak hutan itu, kan?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_LipahYes_002
Array.english: Well... The animals have been having trouble getting past it too.
Array.indonesia: Yah... Hewan-hewan juga kesulitan melewatinya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_LipahYes_003
Array.english: Alright, we might as well clear it, hehe.\nJust let me know when everyone's ready.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah, mending kita singkirkan saja, hehe.\nBeri tahu aku saja kalau semua sudah siap.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_LipahYes_004
Array.english: <size=32>Thanks, Lipah!\nI'll meet you at the boulder once we're ready!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Terima kasih, Lipah!\nAku akan menemuimu di dekat batu besar itu begitu kita siap!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_LipahNo_001
Array.english: <size=32>You want us to push that big boulder on the forest path together...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kamu mau kita mendorong batu besar di jalan setapak hutan itu bersama-sama...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_LipahNo_002
Array.english: Hmm... I'd like it gone too, but... some people think it's fine the way it is...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Aku juga pengen batu itu hilang, tapi... ada yang bilang nggak apa-apa dibiarkan begitu saja...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_LipahNo_003
Array.english: Sorry. Maybe try asking someone else?
Array.indonesia: Maaf. Mungkin coba tanya orang lain aja?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_LipahNo_004
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Seems like we need to be a bit closer before I can ask for favors...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Sepertinya kita harus lebih dekat dulu sebelum aku bisa minta tolong...)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_RimboAlreadyAgreed_001
Array.english: <size=32>I already told ya I'd help, Dave.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku sudah bilang akan membantumu, Dave.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_RimboAlreadyAgreed_002
Array.english: Even I can't do it alone, so go round up a few more folks.
Array.indonesia: Bahkan aku pun tidak bisa melakukannya sendirian, jadi ajaklah beberapa orang lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_RimboYes_001
Array.english: <size=33>That big boulder on the forest path, huh...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Batu besar di jalan setapak hutan itu, ya...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_RimboYes_002
Array.english: <size=33>Well, reckon we can move it if we get a few folks together. Go on and round 'em up!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Yah, kurasa kita bisa memindahkannya kalau kita mengumpulkan beberapa orang. Ayo, kumpulkan mereka!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_RimboYes_003
Array.english: <size=32>Thanks, Rimbo!\nI'll meet you at the boulder once we're all set!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Terima kasih, Rimbo!\nAku akan menemuimu di batu besar itu begitu semuanya siap!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_RimboNo_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm... ya mean the boulder on the forest path?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm... Maksudmu batu besar di jalan setapak hutan itu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_RimboNo_002
Array.english: I'm not sure if the villagers really want it moved.
Array.indonesia: Aku nggak yakin apakah penduduk desa benar-benar mau batu itu dipindahkan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_RimboNo_003
Array.english: Reckon I'll think on it a bit more.
Array.indonesia: Kayaknya aku bakal memikirkannya lagi sebentar.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_RimboNo_004
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Seems like we need to be closer before I can ask for any favors...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Sepertinya kita harus lebih dekat dulu sebelum aku bisa minta bantuan...)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_UzmeAlreadyAgreed_001
Array.english: Ah... I believe I already said I'd help with that.
Array.indonesia: Ah... Seingatku aku sudah bilang akan membantu soal itu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_UzmeAlreadyAgreed_002
Array.english: Just let me know when you're ready.
Array.indonesia: Beri tahu saja aku kalau kamu sudah siap.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_UzmeYes_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, you mean moving the boulder.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, maksudmu memindahkan batu besar itu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_UzmeYes_002
Array.english: It's good that wild animals stay away, but...\nwe can't keep the path blocked forever.
Array.indonesia: Memang bagus kalau binatang liar menjauh, tapi...\nkita tidak bisa membiarkan jalan itu terhalang selamanya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_UzmeYes_003
Array.english: <size=33>I'll help you.\nLet me know when you're ready.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku akan membantumu.\nBeri tahu aku saat kamu sudah siap.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_UzmeYes_004
Array.english: <size=32>Thanks, Uzme!\nI'll meet you at the boulder later!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Terima kasih, Uzme!\nAku akan menemuimu di dekat batu besar itu nanti!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_UzmeNo_001
Array.english: <size=32>Ah... so you want to move that big boulder on the forest path...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ah... jadi kamu ingin memindahkan batu besar di jalan setapak hutan itu...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_UzmeNo_002
Array.english: Not everyone in the village might be happy about that... Let me think on it a bit more.
Array.indonesia: Mungkin tidak semua orang di desa akan senang dengan itu... Biar aku pikirkan dulu sebentar.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_UzmeNo_003
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Seems like we need to be a bit closer before I can ask for favors...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Sepertinya kita perlu lebih dekat dulu sebelum aku bisa meminta bantuan...)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_HartaAlreadyAgreed_001
Array.english: <size=33>Huh... didn't I already say I'd help?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Huh... bukankah aku sudah bilang akan membantu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_HartaAlreadyAgreed_002
Array.english: <size=32>Don't worry about me and go ask someone else!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Jangan khawatirkan aku dan tanyakan saja pada orang lain!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_HartaYes_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, you mean that boulder on the forest path?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, maksudmu batu besar di jalan setapak hutan itu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_HartaYes_002
Array.english: Well... I was bored anyway, so this works out.\nBeen a while since I got to flex my muscles! Haha.
Array.indonesia: Yah... Lagipula aku sedang bosan, jadi ini pas banget.\nSudah lama aku nggak bisa menggerakkan otot-ototku! Haha.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_HartaYes_003
Array.english: <size=32>Thanks, Harta!\nI'll meet you at the boulder later!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Terima kasih, Harta!\nAku akan menemuimu di dekat batu besar itu nanti!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_HartaNo_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ah... you want me to push that boulder on the forest path?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ah... kamu mau aku mendorong batu besar di jalan setapak hutan itu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_HartaNo_002
Array.english: Can't go helping outsiders too easily, it'd hurt my reputation. Sorry, pal.
Array.indonesia: Aku nggak bisa begitu saja membantu orang luar, itu bakal merusak reputasiku. Maaf, sobat.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_HartaNo_003
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Seems like we need to be a bit closer before I can ask for favors...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Sepertinya kita harus lebih dekat dulu sebelum aku bisa meminta bantuan...)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_GesangAlreadyAgreed_001
Array.english: <size=32>No, I told you. I'll help.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tidak, sudah kubilang. Aku akan membantu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_GesangAlreadyAgreed_002
Array.english: <size=32>Hey, don't raise your voice like that. I'll just get scolded again for sticking my nose where it doesn't belong.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hei, jangan berteriak seperti itu. Aku bakal dimarahi lagi karena ikut campur urusan orang lain.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_GesangYes_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm... You mean that boulder on the right side of the village?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm... Maksudmu batu besar di sisi kanan desa itu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_GesangYes_002
Array.english: Ugh... if I go sticking my nose into something like that, my wife will give me an earful...
Array.indonesia: Ugh... kalau aku ikut campur urusan kayak gitu, istriku bakal ngomel-ngomel...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_GesangYes_003
Array.english: But I owe you one, so I'll help. I'll head over once everything's ready.
Array.indonesia: Tapi aku berhutang budi padamu, jadi aku akan membantu. Aku akan ke sana begitu semuanya siap.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_GesangYes_004
Array.english: <size=32>Thanks, Gesang!\nI'll see you at the boulder later!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Terima kasih, Gesang!\nSampai jumpa di batu besar nanti!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_GesangNo_001
Array.english: <size=32>You want me to help move a boulder?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kamu mau aku bantu memindahkan batu besar?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_GesangNo_002
Array.english: If I help an outsider with something like that,\nmy wife will really let me have it...
Array.indonesia: Kalau aku bantu orang luar dengan hal seperti itu,\nistriku pasti bakal marah besar...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_GesangNo_003
Array.english: <size=34>Sorry. I hope you understand.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Maaf. Semoga kamu mengerti.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_GesangNo_004
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Seems like we'd need to be a bit closer before I can ask for favors...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Sepertinya kita harus lebih dekat dulu sebelum aku bisa minta tolong...)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_ChandraAlreadyAgreed_001
Array.english: <size=32>I already told you I'd help!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku sudah bilang akan membantumu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_ChandraAlreadyAgreed_002
Array.english: <size=32>Keep pushing and I might change my mind, you know?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Terus desak aku dan aku mungkin berubah pikiran, tahu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_ChandraYes_001
Array.english: <size=32>You mean that boulder on the forest path...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Maksudmu batu besar di jalan setapak hutan itu...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_ChandraYes_002
Array.english: Hmm... well, if a few others pitch in, I suppose I could help.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... yah, kalau ada beberapa orang lain yang ikut membantu, kurasa aku bisa membantu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_ChandraYes_003
Array.english: I'll meet you at the boulder when everything's ready.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan menemuimu di batu besar itu saat semuanya sudah siap.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_ChandraYes_004
Array.english: <size=32>Thank you, Chandra!\nI'll see you at the boulder later!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Terima kasih, Chandra!\nSampai jumpa di batu besar itu nanti!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_ChandraNo_001
Array.english: <size=32>You mean that big boulder on the far side of the village?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Maksudmu batu besar di ujung desa itu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_ChandraNo_002
Array.english: Hmm... the villagers might not like that.\nIt'd be difficult right now.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... penduduk desa mungkin tidak akan suka itu.\nSaat ini sepertinya sulit.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_ChandraNo_003
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Seems like we need to be a bit closer before I can ask for favors...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Sepertinya kita perlu lebih dekat dulu sebelum aku bisa meminta bantuan...)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_PoetryGirlAlreadyAgreed_001
Array.english: Oh... you asked me before, and I said I'd help.
Array.indonesia: Oh... kamu sudah pernah bertanya padaku sebelumnya, dan aku bilang akan membantu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_PoetryGirlAlreadyAgreed_002
Array.english: Did I speak too metaphorically and confuse you?
Array.indonesia: Apa aku bicara terlalu kiasan sampai bikin kamu bingung?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_PoetryGirlYes_001
Array.english: <size=32>The big boulder... over by the village, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Batu besar itu... di dekat desa, kan?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_PoetryGirlYes_002
Array.english: There must be stronger people around...\nWhy ask me...?
Array.indonesia: Pasti ada orang yang lebih kuat di sekitar sini...\nKenapa tanya aku...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_PoetryGirlYes_003
Array.english: But it does sound interesting. Humans forcing the flow of nature to change...
Array.indonesia: Tapi kedengarannya menarik. Manusia memaksa aliran alam untuk berubah.. .

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_PoetryGirlYes_004
Array.english: I think it might inspire some poetry.\nAlright... let's do it.
Array.indonesia: Kurasa itu bisa menginspirasi puisi.\nBaiklah... ayo kita lakukan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_PoetryGirlYes_005
Array.english: <size=32>Thank you, Kinah!\nI'll see you at the boulder later!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Terima kasih, Kinah!\nSampai jumpa di batu besar nanti!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_PoetryGirlNo_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... that big boulder on the forest path?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... batu besar di jalan setapak hutan itu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_PoetryGirlNo_002
Array.english: Well... I sometimes find poetic inspiration in that boulder.
Array.indonesia: Yah... kadang-kadang aku menemukan inspirasi puisi di batu besar itu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_PoetryGirlNo_003
Array.english: I'm afraid I can't help move it... I'm sorry.
Array.indonesia: Aku takut tidak bisa membantumu memindahkannya... Maaf.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_PoetryGirlNo_004
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Seems like we need to be a bit closer before I can ask for favors...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Sepertinya kita perlu lebih dekat dulu sebelum aku bisa meminta bantuan...)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FlowerGrandmaAlreadyAgreed_001
Array.english: I think I said I'd help earlier...
Array.indonesia: Seingatku, tadi aku sudah bilang akan membantu...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FlowerGrandmaAlreadyAgreed_002
Array.english: My memory must be getting a bit hazy...
Array.indonesia: Ingatanku pasti mulai agak kabur...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FlowerGrandmaYes_001
Array.english: <size=32>The big boulder... over by the village...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Batu besar itu... di dekat desa...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FlowerGrandmaYes_002
Array.english: If these old hands can be of any help, I'll lend them.
Array.indonesia: Kalau tangan tua ini bisa membantu, aku akan meminjamkannya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FlowerGrandmaYes_003
Array.english: <size=32>Thank you! I'll see you at the boulder when everything's ready!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Terima kasih! Sampai jumpa di batu besar itu saat semuanya sudah siap!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FlowerGrandmaNo_001
Array.english: <size=32>You want me to help push a boulder...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kamu ingin aku membantu mendorong batu besar...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FlowerGrandmaNo_002
Array.english: What help could someone like me be?\nSorry, but maybe you should ask someone else.
Array.indonesia: Apa gunanya bantuan dari orang sepertiku?\nMaaf, tapi mungkin sebaiknya kamu minta bantuan orang lain.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FlowerGrandmaNo_003
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Seems like we need to be closer before I can ask for any favors...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Sepertinya kita harus lebih dekat dulu sebelum aku bisa meminta bantuan...)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_YoungManAlreadyAgreed_001
Array.english: Huh? I said I'd help you, didn't I?
Array.indonesia: Hah? Aku kan sudah bilang akan membantumu, bukan?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_YoungManAlreadyAgreed_002
Array.english: Outsiders are always so suspicious...
Array.indonesia: Orang luar memang selalu curiga...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_YoungManYes_001
Array.english: <size=32>The big boulder on the forest path...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Batu besar di jalan setapak hutan...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_YoungManYes_002
Array.english: Well... there's not many people to ask anyway...\nI'll lend you a hand.
Array.indonesia: Yah... lagipula nggak banyak orang yang bisa ditanya...\nAku bakal bantuin kamu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_YoungManYes_003
Array.english: <size=32>Just this once.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Cuma kali ini aja.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_YoungManYes_004
Array.english: <size=32>Thanks!\nSee you at the boulder when everything's ready!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Terima kasih!\nSampai jumpa di batu besar itu kalau semuanya sudah siap!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_YoungManNo_001
Array.english: <size=32>So, we're moving that big boulder on the forest path?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Jadi, kita akan memindahkan batu besar di jalan setapak hutan itu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_YoungManNo_002
Array.english: Um... I need to practice my instrument...\nYou should ask someone else.
Array.indonesia: Um... Aku harus berlatih memainkan alat musikku...\nSebaiknya kamu minta tolong orang lain saja.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_YoungManNo_003
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Seems like we need to be a bit closer before I can ask for favors...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Sepertinya kita perlu lebih dekat dulu sebelum aku bisa meminta bantuan...)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_PrincessyAlreadyAgreed_001
Array.english: I already said I'd help, didn't I?
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah bilang akan membantu, kan?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_PrincessyAlreadyAgreed_002
Array.english: You'd better not rush me, or I might change my mind.
Array.indonesia: Sebaiknya jangan buru-buru, atau aku mungkin berubah pikiran.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_PrincessyYes_001
Array.english: <size=32>...You mean that big boulder on the far side of the village?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>... Maksudmu batu besar di ujung desa itu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_PrincessyYes_002
Array.english: I can do anything the guys can do, of course.
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja aku bisa melakukan apa pun yang bisa dilakukan para pria.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_PrincessyYes_003
Array.english: Don't assume I can't handle it just because I'm a delicate woman.
Array.indonesia: Jangan anggap aku tidak bisa mengatasinya hanya karena aku seorang wanita yang lembut.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_PrincessyYes_004
Array.english: Call me when you're ready.\nI've been quite busy lately.
Array.indonesia: Hubungi aku saat kamu sudah siap.\nAku cukup sibuk akhir-akhir ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_PrincessyYes_005
Array.english: Okay... I got it. Thanks for helping.
Array.indonesia: Oke... aku mengerti. Terima kasih sudah membantu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_PrincessyNo_001
Array.english: <size=32>So we're pushing that big boulder on the forest path together?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Jadi, kita akan mendorong batu besar di jalan setapak hutan itu bersama-sama?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_PrincessyNo_002
Array.english: Um... there are other people around, so why ask me specifically...?
Array.indonesia: Um... ada orang lain di sekitar sini, jadi kenapa harus memintaku secara khusus...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_PrincessyNo_003
Array.english: ...Don't get any funny ideas.\nI'm telling you now, I won't help.
Array.indonesia: ...Jangan punya pikiran aneh-aneh.\nAku bilang dari sekarang, aku nggak akan bantu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_PrincessyNo_004
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... what a strange person. Anyway, I think she needs to let her guard down a bit before she'll help.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... orang yang aneh. Bagaimanapun, kurasa dia perlu sedikit melepaskan kewaspadaannya dulu sebelum mau membantu.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BroSisMomAlreadyAgreed_001
Array.english: If you're talking about the boulder... like I said,\nI'll help.
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu ngomongin soal batu besar itu... seperti yang sudah kubilang,\naku akan membantu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BroSisMomAlreadyAgreed_002
Array.english: I'll head over once everyone else is ready.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan ke sana begitu semua orang sudah siap.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BroSisMomYes_001
Array.english: <size=32>...You mean that boulder on the far side of the village...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>...You maksudmu batu besar di ujung desa itu...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BroSisMomYes_002
Array.english: I'm not sure I'll be much help... but if you're okay with that, I'll help.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak yakin bisa banyak membantu... tapi kalau kamu tidak keberatan, aku akan membantu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BroSisMomYes_003
Array.english: <size=32>Thank you!\nI'll see you at the boulder later!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Terima kasih!\nSampai jumpa di batu besar nanti!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BroSisMomNo_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... we're pushing that boulder together?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... kita akan mendorong batu besar itu bersama-sama?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BroSisMomNo_002
Array.english: I'm not sure I'll be much help... Sorry, but you might want to ask someone else...
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak yakin bisa banyak membantu... Maaf, tapi mungkin sebaiknya kamu minta bantuan orang lain...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BroSisMomNo_003
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Seems like we need to be a bit closer before I can ask for favors...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Sepertinya kita perlu lebih dekat dulu sebelum aku bisa meminta bantuan...)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BroSisDadAlreadyAgreed_001
Array.english: Ah, as I mentioned earlier, I'm willing to help.
Array.indonesia: Ah, seperti yang sudah kubilang tadi, aku bersedia membantu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BroSisDadAlreadyAgreed_002
Array.english: I can't do it alone, so go gather a few more people.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak bisa melakukannya sendirian, jadi carilah beberapa orang lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BroSisDadYes_001
Array.english: <size=32>Ah... you mean that big boulder on the far side of the village?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ah... maksudmu batu besar di ujung desa itu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BroSisDadYes_002
Array.english: It looked really heavy... I should help too.
Array.indonesia: Kelihatannya sangat berat... Aku juga harus membantu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BroSisDadYes_003
Array.english: Understood. I'll help.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah. Aku akan membantu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BroSisDadYes_004
Array.english: <size=32>Thank you!\nI'll see you at the boulder later!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Terima kasih!\nSampai jumpa di dekat batu besar nanti!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BroSisDadNo_001
Array.english: <size=32>You want me to help push that big boulder on the forest path?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kamu mau aku bantu mendorong batu besar di jalan setapak hutan itu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BroSisDadNo_002
Array.english: Hmm... I think I should hear what the other villagers think first.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Kurasa aku harus dengar dulu pendapat penduduk desa lainnya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BroSisDadNo_003
Array.english: Some people actually like it the way it is.\nLet's talk about this again later.
Array.indonesia: Beberapa orang justru suka kalau dibiarkan seperti itu.\nAyo kita bahas ini lagi nanti.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BroSisDadNo_004
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Seems like we need to be a bit closer before I can ask for favors...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Sepertinya kita perlu lebih dekat dulu sebelum aku bisa meminta bantuan...)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_YoungManMomAlreadyAgreed_001
Array.english: As I said, I'm willing to help, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Seperti yang sudah kukatakan, aku bersedia membantu, Dave.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_YoungManMomAlreadyAgreed_002
Array.english: But I'm not particularly strong... so please ask a few others as well.
Array.indonesia: Tapi aku tidak terlalu kuat... jadi tolong minta bantuan beberapa orang lain juga.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_YoungManMomYes_001
Array.english: <size=32>You mean that big boulder on the far side of the village?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Maksudmu batu besar di ujung desa itu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_YoungManMomYes_002
Array.english: I'm not sure how much help I'll be...\nbut it'd be better if more people pitched in.
Array.indonesia: Aku nggak yakin seberapa besar bantuanku...\ntapi akan lebih baik kalau ada lebih banyak orang yang ikut membantu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_YoungManMomYes_003
Array.english: I'll help, so let me know when you're ready.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan bantu, jadi beri tahu aku kalau kamu sudah siap.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_YoungManMomYes_004
Array.english: <size=32>Thanks, Cinta!\nI'll see you at the boulder later!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Terima kasih, Cinta!\nSampai jumpa di batu besar nanti!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_YoungManMomNo_001
Array.english: <size=32>You want help pushing that big boulder on the forest path?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kamu butuh bantuan mendorong batu besar di jalan setapak hutan itu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_YoungManMomNo_002
Array.english: Wouldn't it be better to ask someone a bit stronger than me?
Array.indonesia: Bukankah lebih baik meminta bantuan orang yang sedikit lebih kuat dariku?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_YoungManMomNo_003
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Seems like we need to be a bit closer before I can ask for favors...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Sepertinya kita perlu lebih dekat dulu sebelum aku bisa meminta bantuan...)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_ChiefAgreed_001
Array.english: Well... I would like to help, but my legs aren't what they used to be, so I'm not sure I'd be much help.
Array.indonesia: Yah... Aku ingin membantu, tapi kakiku sudah tidak sekuat dulu, jadi aku tidak yakin bisa banyak membantu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_ChiefAgreed_002
Array.english: Try gathering around <color=#F1DC2B>3</color> other villagers.
Array.indonesia: Cobalah berkumpul dengan <color=#F1DC2B>3</color> penduduk desa lainnya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_ChiefAgreed_003
Array.english: They won't just help a stranger right away...\nYou'll need to build some rapport with them first.
Array.indonesia: Mereka tidak akan langsung membantu orang asing...\nKamu perlu membangun hubungan baik dengan mereka terlebih dahulu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_MunaAgreed_001
Array.english: <size=32>Ah! Of course I'll help!\nThere's a temple behind that forest, right?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ah! Tentu saja aku akan membantu!\nAda kuil di balik hutan itu, kan?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_MunaAgreed_002
Array.english: But the boulder's so huge... We'll need at least <color=#F1DC2B>3</color> more villagers besides me.
