Array.indonesia: Tapi batu besar itu sangat besar... Kita butuh setidaknya <color=#F1DC2B>3</color> penduduk desa lagi selain aku.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_CobraAgreed_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hm? You don't even need to ask!\nOf course I'll help!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hm? Kamu bahkan tidak perlu bertanya!\nTentu saja aku akan membantu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_CobraAgreed_002
Array.english: Still, we'll need more hands... Go gather around <color=#F1DC2B>3</color> more villagers.
Array.indonesia: Meski begitu, kita masih butuh lebih banyak tenaga... Pergilah kumpulkan <color=#F1DC2B>3</color> penduduk desa lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BanchoAgreed_001
Array.english: Hmm. You mean that big boulder on the far side of the village.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Maksudmu batu besar di ujung desa itu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BanchoAgreed_002
Array.english: If it's you asking, of course I should help. I'm curious about what kind of ingredients might come from the forest, too.
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu yang meminta, tentu saja aku harus membantu. Aku juga penasaran bahan apa saja yang bisa didapat dari hutan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BanchoAgreed_003
Array.english: Judging by the size, we'll need more villagers.
Array.indonesia: Melihat ukurannya, kita butuh lebih banyak penduduk desa.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BanchoAgreed_004
Array.english: Try convincing around <color=#F1DC2B>3</color> villagers to help.
Array.indonesia: Coba ajak sekitar <color=#F1DC2B>3</color> penduduk desa untuk membantu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BaconAgreed_001
Array.english: <size=32>You want to move that big boulder on the far side of the village?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kamu mau memindahkan batu besar di ujung desa itu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BaconAgreed_002
Array.english: I heard that's the only way to reach the ruins in the forest.
Array.indonesia: Aku dengar itu satu-satunya cara untuk mencapai reruntuhan di hutan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BaconAgreed_003
Array.english: Let's all work together and move it!\nAsk the <color=#F1DC2B>Villagers</color> for help too.
Array.indonesia: Ayo kita bekerja sama dan memindahkannya!\nMintalah bantuan kepada <color=#F1DC2B>penduduk desa</color> juga.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_Unlock_001
Array.english: <size=34>Dave, look at this!\n<color=#F1DC2B>Marone</color> brought back a bird from somewhere!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Dave, lihat ini!\n<color=#F1DC2B>Marone</color> membawa seekor burung dari suatu tempat!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_Unlock_002
Array.english: Woof! Woof!
Array.indonesia: Guk! Guk!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_Unlock_003
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... I thought he was just a cute pup, but looks like he's got some hunting instincts.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... Aku kira dia cuma anak anjing yang imut, tapi sepertinya dia punya naluri berburu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_Unlock_004
Array.english: <size=32>Come to think of it, I used to go bird hunting with a gun back in the day...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kalau dipikir-pikir, dulu aku sering berburu burung pakai senapan...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_Unlock_005
Array.english: <size=35>Would be fun to go with this little guy!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Pasti seru kalau pergi bareng si kecil ini!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_Unlock_006
Array.english: <size=32>If you spot any <color=#1DFEAF>Bushes</color> in the forest, check them out.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kalau kamu melihat <color=#1DFEAF>semak-semak</color> di hutan, periksa baik-baik.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_Unlock_007
Array.english: <size=33>There's a good chance birds are hiding in there! Perfect conditions for <color=#F1DC2B>Bird Hunting</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kemungkinan besar ada burung yang bersembunyi di sana! Kondisi yang sempurna untuk <color=#F1DC2B>Berburu Burung</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_ZoneEnter_001
Array.english: Woof! Woof!!
Array.indonesia: Guk! Guk!!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_ZoneEnter_002
Array.english: <size=34>Oh! There's a <color=#1DFEAF>Bush</color> over there!\nBet there are birds hiding inside!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh! Ada <color=#1DFEAF>semak</color> di sana!\nPasti ada burung yang bersembunyi di dalamnya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_ZoneEnter_003
Array.english: <size=34>How about we try some <color=#F1DC2B>Bird Hunting</color> to clear our heads?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Gimana kalau kita coba <color=#F1DC2B>Berburu Burung</color> buat menyegarkan pikiran?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_ZoneEnter_Option01
Array.english: Sounds good!
Array.indonesia: Kedengarannya bagus!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_ZoneEnter_Option02
Array.english: Maybe later
Array.indonesia: Mungkin nanti saja

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_ZoneEnter_Yes_001
Array.english: <size=34>Sounds good! Let's give it a try!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kedengarannya bagus! Ayo kita coba!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_ZoneEnter_Yes_002
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! Bird hunting after all this time! I'm fired up!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Berburu burung setelah sekian lama! Aku semangat banget!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_ZoneEnter_Yes_003
Array.english: <size=33>Wild birds are quite fast!\nDon't even blink!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Burung liar itu cukup cepat!\nJangan sampai kedip!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_ZoneEnter_No_001
Array.english: Hmm... I think we should handle other things first.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Menurutku kita sebaiknya urus hal lain dulu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_ZoneEnter_No_002
Array.english: <size=32>Fair enough.\nLet's aim for it next time!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Baiklah.\nAyo kita coba lain kali!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha!! That's what I'm talking about, the thrill!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha!! Itulah yang kumaksud, sensasi yang mendebarkan!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_Complete_002
Array.english: Marone... he's better at bringing things back than I expected. No need to train him at all.
Array.indonesia: Marone... dia lebih jago membawa barang pulang daripada yang kuduga. Nggak perlu dilatih sama sekali.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_Complete_003
Array.english: Woof! Woof!
Array.indonesia: Guk! Guk!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_Complete_004
Array.english: Right? And we even got some tasty-looking <color=#F1DC2B>Bird Meat</color> out of it...
Array.indonesia: Kan? Dan kita bahkan dapat <color=#F1DC2B>Daging Burung</color> yang kelihatannya enak...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_Complete_005
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! We can roast it out here or take it to Bancho!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Kita bisa memanggangnya di sini atau membawanya ke Bancho!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_Complete_006
Array.english: <size=34>The types of birds you get vary depending on where you <color=#F1DC2B>Hunt Birds</color>. Try other spots too!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Jenis burung yang kamu dapatkan bervariasi tergantung di mana kamu <color=#F1DC2B>Berburu Burung</color>. Coba tempat lain juga!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_ZoneEnterRetry_001
Array.english: <size=33>That <color=#F1DC2B>Bird Hunting</color> we skipped before...\nHow about now?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33><color=#F1DC2B>Berburu Burung</color> yang tadi kita lewatkan...\nBagaimana kalau sekarang?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_End_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hmm. I think we've done enough for today.\nGotta save some ammo.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hmm. Kurasa kita sudah cukup untuk hari ini.\nHarus menghemat amunisi.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_CatchStagBeetle_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... Is that a <color=#1DFEAF>Stag Beetle</color>...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... Apakah itu <color=#1DFEAF>Kumbang Rusa</color>...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_CatchStagBeetle_002
Array.english: First time I've seen one around here. When it comes to collecting, you can't beat stag beetles and rhinoceros beetles.
Array.indonesia: Ini pertama kalinya aku melihatnya di sekitar sini. Kalau soal mengoleksi, kumbang rusa dan kumbang badak memang tak ada duanya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_CatchStagBeetle_003
Array.english: <size=34>Alright. Let's see if I can catch one...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Baiklah. Ayo kita lihat apakah aku bisa menangkap satu...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_TornNet_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ah... the net tore.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ah... jaringnya robek.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_TornNet_002
Array.english: That stag beetle's jaws are strong... this net won't hold up.
Array.indonesia: Rahang kumbang tanduk itu kuat... jaring ini nggak bakal tahan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_TornNet_003
Array.english: First, I should go to <color=#F1DC2B>Muna</color> and have her fix it.
Array.indonesia: Pertama-tama, aku harus pergi ke <color=#F1DC2B>Muna</color> dan minta dia memperbaikinya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_MunaBeforeFixNet_001
Array.english: Oh... your net tore?
Array.indonesia: Oh... jaringmu robek?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_MunaBeforeFixNet_002
Array.english: Yeah... I was trying to catch a stag beetle.
Array.indonesia: Iya... aku lagi coba menangkap kumbang tanduk.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_MunaBeforeFixNet_003
Array.english: Fixing it's no problem!\nJust a second.
Array.indonesia: Memperbaikinya nggak masalah!\nTunggu sebentar.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_MunaAfterFixNet_001
Array.english: Here you go. Good as new, right?
Array.indonesia: Ini dia. Kembali seperti baru, kan?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_MunaAfterFixNet_002
Array.english: Thanks. But how am I supposed to catch stag beetles?
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih. Tapi gimana caranya aku menangkap kumbang tanduk?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_MunaAfterFixNet_003
Array.english: Oh, the stag beetles around here are incredibly tough.\nSame goes for rhinoceros beetles.
Array.indonesia: Oh, kumbang tanduk di sekitar sini sangat tangguh.\nBegitu juga dengan kumbang badak.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_MunaAfterFixNet_004
Array.english: I figured.\nMaybe I should just give up on those insects...
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah menduganya.\nMungkin aku sebaiknya menyerah saja mengejar serangga-serangga itu...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_UdoAppear_001
Array.english: <size=35>Oh...! Dave?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh...! Dave?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_UdoAppear_002
Array.english: <size=33>Huh...! Udo, what are you doing here?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Huh...! Udo, apa yang kamu lakukan di sini?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_UdoAppear_003
Array.english: What a coincidence... running into you here.
Array.indonesia: Kebetulan sekali... bisa bertemu kamu di sini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_UdoAppear_004
Array.english: Actually, our publishing house is launching a new magazine project...
Array.indonesia: Sebenarnya, penerbit kami sedang meluncurkan proyek majalah baru...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_UdoAppear_005
Array.english: It's called <color=#5dd3bb>Weekly Insects</color>!! We're covering insects from jungle regions like this.
Array.indonesia: Namanya <color=#5dd3bb>Weekly Insects</color>!! Kami akan meliput serangga dari kawasan hutan seperti ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_UdoAppear_006
Array.english: <size=33>If I can make this project a success...\nI'll finally... become editor-in-chief! Haha.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Jika aku bisa membuat proyek ini sukses...\nAku akhirnya... akan menjadi pemimpin redaksi! Haha.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_UdoAppear_007
Array.english: Dave, I see you're carrying a net...\nHave you caught any insects around here?
Array.indonesia: Dave, aku lihat kamu membawa jaring...\nApakah kamu sudah menangkap serangga di sekitar sini?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_UdoAppear_008
Array.english: Yeah. There are quite a few interesting ones.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Ada cukup banyak yang menarik.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_UdoAppear_009
Array.english: Ooh... well, since you're catching insects anyway,\nhow about helping me with my coverage?
Array.indonesia: Ooh... nah, karena kamu memang sedang menangkap serangga,\nbagaimana kalau kamu bantu aku dalam liputanku?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_UdoAppear_010
Array.english: The editorial team set me up with this <color=#72ff0a>Insectagram</color> app before I came here... You can check all the insects you've caught with it.
Array.indonesia: Tim redaksi sudah menyiapkan aplikasi <color=#72ff0a>Insectagram</color> ini untukku sebelum aku datang ke sini... Kamu bisa memeriksa semua serangga yang sudah kamu tangkap dengan aplikasi ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_UdoAppear_011
Array.english: Let me install it on your phone too, Dave...\nJust scan this QR code like this, and...
Array.indonesia: Biar aku pasang juga di ponselmu, Dave...\nCukup pindai kode QR ini seperti ini, dan...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_UdoAppear_012
Array.english:
Ta-da! Hehe. Now it's synced with mine!
Any insect you catch will be logged to my account too.
Array.indonesia:
Ta-da! Hehe. Sekarang sudah tersinkronisasi dengan milikku!
Setiap serangga yang kamu tangkap akan tercatat di akunku juga.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_UdoAppear_013
Array.english: <size=33>Uh... are you sure that's okay...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Eh... kamu yakin itu nggak masalah...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_UdoAppear_014
Array.english: Anyway... I think I can catch other insects if I approach them carefully, but...
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun... kurasa aku bisa menangkap serangga lain kalau mendekatinya dengan hati-hati, tapi...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_UdoAppear_015
Array.english:
<color=#1DFEAF>Stag Beetles</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>Rhinoceros Beetles</color>...
there's no way to catch those with a regular net.
Array.indonesia:
<color=#1DFEAF>Kumbang Rusa</color> dan <color=#1DFEAF>Kumbang Badak</color>...
tidak mungkin menangkap mereka dengan jaring biasa.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_UdoAppear_016
Array.english: Ha! The beetles around here are incredibly strong!\nThere's no way you'll catch them with just a net.
Array.indonesia: Ha! Kumbang-kumbang di sekitar sini sangat kuat!\nTidak mungkin kamu bisa menangkapnya hanya dengan jaring.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_UdoAppear_017
Array.english: From what I studied before coming here... if you place a similar species nearby, they'll start fighting.
Array.indonesia: Dari apa yang aku pelajari sebelum datang ke sini... jika kamu menempatkan spesies serupa di dekatnya, mereka akan mulai berkelahi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_UdoAppear_018
Array.english: The loser will be weakened...\nand that's when you catch it!
Array.indonesia: Yang kalah akan melemah...\ndan saat itulah kamu menangkapnya!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_UdoAppear_019
Array.english: Oh... I see. But how do I catch the beetle I need for the fight?
Array.indonesia: Oh... Oh, begitu. Tapi bagaimana cara menangkap kumbang yang kubutuhkan untuk pertarungan itu?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_UdoAppear_020
Array.english: Haha. For that, I'll give you this <color=#1DFEAF>Baby Stag Beetle</color>.\nTry it out with this one.
Array.indonesia: Haha. Untuk itu, aku akan memberimu <color=#1DFEAF>Bayi Kumbang Rusa</color> ini.\nCobalah dengan yang ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_UdoAppear_021
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... okay, got it.\nI'll try to catch some good ones.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... oke, paham.\nAku akan mencoba menangkap yang bagus-bagus.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_FirstBattle_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... there's a beetle...!\nShould I try to catch it?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... ada kumbang...!\nHaruskah aku mencoba menangkapnya?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_FirstBattle_002
Array.english: <size=32>Oh wait... a regular net would just tear right away...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh tunggu... jaring biasa pasti langsung robek...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_FirstBattle_003
Array.english: <size=33>I should try battling it with the <color=#1DFEAF>Baby Stag Beetle</color> Udo gave me.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku harus mencoba bertarung dengannya menggunakan <color=#1DFEAF>Kumbang Rusa Bayi</color> yang diberikan Udo padaku.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FirstNight_001
Array.english: <size=34>Huh? I hear some kind of loud noise.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hah? Aku mendengar suara keras.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FirstNight_002
Array.english: <size=32>Sounds like it's coming from the upper part of the village... I should go check it out.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Sepertinya datang dari bagian atas desa... Aku harus pergi memeriksanya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FirstAppearance_001
Array.english: Huff... huff... Excuse me... Have you seen anything glowing in the sky around here?!
Array.indonesia: Huff... huff... Maaf... Apakah kalian melihat sesuatu yang bersinar di langit di sekitar sini?!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FirstAppearance_002
Array.english: Uh...? Not that I've seen.
Array.indonesia: Eh...? Sepertinya tidak.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FirstAppearance_003
Array.english: But it has to be here... \nMy UFO radar is pointing straight at this village.
Array.indonesia: Tapi pasti ada di sini... \nRadar UFO-ku mengarah langsung ke desa ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FirstAppearance_004
Array.english: (Muttering...)
Array.indonesia: (Bergumam...)

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FirstAppearance_005
Array.english: Excuse me! Would it be okay if we stayed in this village for a while? *Pant*
Array.indonesia: Permisi! Bolehkah kami tinggal di desa ini sebentar? *Terengah-engah*

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FirstAppearance_006
Array.english: We came all this way... We can't leave without finding any trace of the UFO.
Array.indonesia: Kami sudah datang sejauh ini... Kami tidak bisa pergi tanpa menemukan jejak UFO itu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FirstAppearance_007
Array.english: Hmm... I'm not really the one who can give you permission...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Sebenarnya bukan aku yang bisa memberi izin...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FirstAppearance_008
Array.english: But the <color=#1DFEAF>Lake Beach</color> should be fine. Why don't you stay over there?
Array.indonesia: Tapi <color=#1DFEAF>Pantai Danau</color> seharusnya aman. Kenapa kalian tidak menginap di sana saja?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FirstAppearance_009
Array.english: Phew...Thank you. Okay.
Array.indonesia: Fiuh... Terima kasih. Baiklah.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FirstAppearance_010
Array.english: <size=32>Everyone! Let's rest up and search again tomorrow.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Semuanya! Ayo istirahat dulu dan lanjutkan pencarian besok.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FirstAppearance_011
Array.english: <size=32>In the name of the Shimano University Mystery Research Club! We will find that UFO!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Atas nama Klub Penelitian Misteri Universitas Shimano! Kita pasti akan menemukan UFO itu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FirstAppearance_012
Array.english: <size=38>Aye aye, sir!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Siap, Pak!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_NextNight_001
Array.english: Come to think of it... those weird students from yesterday. They said they were here to photograph a UFO.
Array.indonesia: Kalau dipikir-pikir... mahasiswa aneh kemarin itu. Mereka bilang datang ke sini untuk memotret UFO.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_NextNight_002
Array.english: <size=33>Don't tell me there's actually something there...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Jangan-jangan memang ada sesuatu di sana...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_NextNight_003
Array.english: I think they headed up the hill on the right side of the village…\nI should go check it out.
Array.indonesia: Menurutku mereka menuju ke atas bukit di sisi kanan desa…\nAku sebaiknya pergi mengeceknya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_NextNight_Retry_001
Array.english: Apropos...those weird students... They said they came to photograph UFOs, right?
Array.indonesia: Ngomong-ngomong... soal mahasiswa-mahasiswa aneh itu... Mereka bilang datang untuk memotret UFO, kan?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_NextNight_Retry_002
Array.english: I think they're up on the <color=#1DFEAF>hill on the right side</color> of the village... Let's follow them.
Array.indonesia: Menurutku mereka ada di atas <color=#1DFEAF>bukit di sisi kanan</color> desa... Ayo kita ikuti mereka.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FindUFO_001
Array.english: Hey, guys. Find anything?
Array.indonesia: Hei, teman-teman. Sudah menemukan sesuatu?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FindUFO_002
Array.english: Oh, Sir. Keep your voice down. \nI've got a good feeling about today.
Array.indonesia: Oh, Pak. Bisakah Kamu bicara lebih pelan? \nAku punya firasat baik tentang hari ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FindUFO_003
Array.english: Alright, got it. \nBut... weren't there three of you before...?
Array.indonesia: Baiklah, mengerti. \nTapi... bukankah tadi kalian bertiga...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FindUFO_004
Array.english: Sigh... Yasuto... He got bitten by a wild spider on the way here and came down with a high fever.
Array.indonesia: Huh... Yasuto... Dia digigit laba-laba liar dalam perjalanan ke sini dan demam tinggi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FindUFO_005
Array.english: He won't be able to join today's expedition.
Array.indonesia: Dia tidak bisa ikut ekspedisi hari ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FindUFO_006
Array.english: I see... So you're using that telescope to look for UFOs?
Array.indonesia: Begitu... Jadi kalian menggunakan teleskop itu untuk mencari UFO?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FindUFO_007
Array.english: That's right. I, Fukuo... In the name of Shimano University Mystery Research Club...
Array.indonesia: Benar. Aku, Fukuo... Atas nama Klub Penelitian Misteri Universitas Shimano...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FindUFO_008
Array.english: <size=34>Will prove the existence of UFOs today!\nYou're with me on this, right, Takeru!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Akan membuktikan keberadaan UFO hari ini!\nKamu setuju denganku, kan, Takeru!?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FindUFO_009
Array.english: <size=40>Aye aye, sir!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Baik, Pak!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FindUFO_010
Array.english: <size=32>Ah... Sir. Yasuto's <color=#1DFEAF>Telecamera</color>...\nCould you handle it for us?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ah... Pak. <color=#1DFEAF>Telecamera</color> milik Yasuto...\nBisakah Kamu mengurusnya untuk kami?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FindUFO_011
Array.english: <size=35>Huh...? Me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Hah...? Saya?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FindUFO_012
Array.english: Yes, Sir.\nWe can't let Yasuto's sacrifice be in vain!
Array.indonesia: Ya, Pak.\nKita tidak boleh membiarkan pengorbanan Yasuto sia-sia!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FindUFO_013
Array.english: Hmm... Alright. Can you tell me what I need to do?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Baiklah. Bisakah Kamu memberi tahu saya apa yang harus saya lakukan?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FindUFO_014
Array.english: <size=32>I'll show you. \nFirst, go to the <color=#1DFEAF>Telecamera</color> and look up at the sky.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Saya akan tunjukkan. \nPertama, pergilah ke <color=#1DFEAF>Telecamera</color> dan lihatlah ke langit.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FindUFO_Barricade_001
Array.english: The students asked me to check the telecamera.\nA UFO might actually show up, I should take a look.
Array.indonesia: Para siswa meminta saya untuk memeriksa Telecamera.\nMungkin benar-benar ada UFO yang muncul, saya sebaiknya memeriksanya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_TakePicture_001
Array.english: <size=35>Oh... A glowing object...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh... Benda yang bersinar...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_TakePicture_002
Array.english: <size=35>Wait?! What is that...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Tunggu?! Apa itu...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_TakePicture_003
Array.english: <size=34>Sir! Take a <color=#F1DC2B>Photo</color>!!\nSo Yasuto's soul can cherish the moment!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Pak! Ambil <color=#F1DC2B>Foto</color>!!\nAgar jiwa Yasuto bisa mengabadikan momen ini!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_TakePicture_004
Array.english: <size=35><color=#E3E3E3>(...Yasuto's still alive though.)</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35><color=#E3E3E3>(...Tapi Yasuto masih hidup kok.)</color></size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FirstPicture_001
Array.english: <size=33>Excellent! That's a great shot.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hebat! Itu foto yang bagus.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FirstPicture_002
Array.english: <size=33>But one photo might look fake.\nTake another!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tapi satu foto saja mungkin terlihat palsu.\nAmbil lagi!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_SecondPicture_001
Array.english: <size=34>Perfect!!! But...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Sempurna!!! Tapi...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_SecondPicture_002
Array.english: <size=33>I feel like it's getting closer...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku merasa itu semakin mendekat...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_SecondPicture_003
Array.english: <size=32>Maybe it just came out clearer? \nOne more shot and we'll know for sure.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Mungkin fotonya hanya lebih jelas? \nAmbil satu foto lagi dan kita akan tahu pasti.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_ThirdPicture_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hmm... It definitely looks bigger than before...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hmm... Itu jelas terlihat lebih besar dari sebelumnya...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_GrowingUFO_001
Array.english: <size=35>Whoa! It's really getting bigger...!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wah! Itu benar-benar semakin besar...!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_GrowingUFO_002
Array.english: <size=36>S-Sir! It's heading straight for us!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>T-Tuan! Itu menuju langsung ke arah kita!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_GrowingUFO_003
Array.english: <size=38>Aaahhh...!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Aaahhh...!!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FallingUFO_001
Array.english: *Pant* Is everyone okay?
Array.indonesia: *Terengah-engah* Apakah semua orang baik-baik saja?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FallingUFO_002
Array.english: Thank goodness it missed us... Fukuo, don't tell me you used that sealed psychokinetic energy to save us...?
Array.indonesia: Syukurlah benda itu meleset dari kita... Fukuo, jangan-jangan kamu menggunakan energi psikokinetik yang tersegel itu untuk menyelamatkan kita...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FallingUFO_003
Array.english: Who knows. \nMaybe I sensed the danger... and it just slipped out.
Array.indonesia: Siapa yang tahu. \nMungkin aku merasakan bahaya... dan energi itu tanpa sengaja keluar.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FallingUFO_004
Array.english: Right now, we should go after the crashed UFO first.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang, kita harus mengejar UFO yang jatuh itu dulu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FallingUFO_005
Array.english: You're so calm even in a situation like this, Fukuo.\nThat's real leadership.
Array.indonesia: Kamu begitu tenang bahkan dalam situasi seperti ini, Fukuo.\nItulah kepemimpinan sejati.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FallingUFO_006
Array.english: I can't believe there was actually a UFO...
Array.indonesia: Aku nggak percaya ternyata ada UFO...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FallingUFO_007
Array.english: Judging by the direction it fell, it's probably near the <color=#1DFEAF>Lake Beach</color>. Let's go check it out.
Array.indonesia: Dilihat dari arah jatuhnya, mungkin ada di dekat <color=#1DFEAF>Danau Beach</color>. Ayo kita periksa.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_EncounterUFO_001
Array.english: <size=35>Whoa...!? Is it really a spaceship?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wah...!? Apa ini benar-benar pesawat luar angkasa?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_EncounterUFO_002
Array.english: <size=35>*Pant* Told you, Sir...\nWe picked up a signal here...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>*Huff* Sudah kubilang, Pak...\nKami menangkap sinyal di sini...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_EncounterUFO_003
Array.english: <size=35>Our long investigation has finally paid off...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Penyelidikan panjang kita akhirnya membuahkan hasil...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_EncounterUFO_004
Array.english: <size=35>Shimano University Mystery Research Club...\nMay we shine forever!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Klub Penelitian Misteri Universitas Shimano...\nSemoga kita bersinar selamanya!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_EncounterUFO_005
Array.english: <size=35>Huh? Wait, I think someone's coming out...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Hah? Tunggu, sepertinya ada yang keluar...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_EncounterUFO_006
Array.english: <size=38>A-Alien lifeform...!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>S-Makhluk asing...!?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear01_001
Array.english: <size=35>...A middle-aged man...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>...A pria paruh baya...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear01_002
Array.english: <size=31>Ugh... where am I...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Ugh... di mana aku...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear01_003
Array.english: This is Utara Village.\nYou're in the jungle.
Array.indonesia: Ini adalah Desa Utara.\nKamu berada di hutan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear01_004
Array.english: More importantly... is this Earth?
Array.indonesia: Yang lebih penting... apakah ini Bumi?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear01_005
Array.english: <size=33>Aha! So you are an alien!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aha! Jadi kamu memang alien!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear01_006
Array.english:
Two eyes... one mouth... You copied the human form...
but the hair... you only got it half right...!
Array.indonesia:
Dua mata... satu mulut... Kamu meniru bentuk manusia...
tapi rambutnya... kamu cuma berhasil setengahnya...!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear01_007
Array.english: <size=32>Ugh... what is this guy talking about?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ugh... apa yang dibicarakan orang ini?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear01_008
Array.english: I'm the CEO of Kindred Aerospace, <color=#F1DC2B>Martin Tweed</color>.
Array.indonesia: Aku adalah CEO Kindred Aerospace, <color=#F1DC2B>Martin Tweed</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear01_009
Array.english: Kindred is the world's fourth-largest spacecraft manufacturer. You've heard of us, right?
Array.indonesia: Kindred adalah produsen pesawat luar angkasa terbesar keempat di dunia. Kamu pernah dengar tentang kami, kan?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear_option01
Array.english: Yes, I think I have
Array.indonesia: Ya, kurasa pernah

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear_option02
Array.english: Hmm... never heard of it
Array.indonesia: Hmm... belum pernah dengar

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear_yes_001
Array.english: <size=34>Ha! Even out here, we're known!\nOur marketing team's doing great.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ha! Bahkan di sini pun, kami terkenal!\nTim pemasaran kami bekerja dengan sangat baik.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear_no_001
Array.english: Hmm... what exactly does our marketing team do all day...?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... apa sebenarnya yang dilakukan tim pemasaran kami sepanjang hari...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear_no_002
Array.english: <size=34>Would you like to see our company's promo video?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Apakah Kamu ingin melihat video promosi perusahaan kami?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear_no_option01
Array.english: Yes, I'm curious
Array.indonesia: Ya, saya penasaran

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear_no_option02
Array.english: No... I'm good
Array.indonesia: Tidak... saya tidak perlu

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear_Watch_001
Array.english: <size=34>Haha! Then let's take a look!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Haha! Kalau begitu, mari kita lihat!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear_Watch_002
Array.english: ...With Kindred's cutting-edge technology, \nyou can even skip ahead.
Array.indonesia: ...Dengan teknologi mutakhir Kindred, \nkamu bahkan bisa melompat ke bagian selanjutnya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear_NoWatch_001
Array.english: Hmm... you must be busy.\nMaybe next time.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Kamu pasti sibuk.\nMungkin lain kali.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear_AfterWatch_001
Array.english: <size=34>Haha! What do you think? Kindred's technological prowess is amazing, isn't it?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Haha! Gimana menurutmu? Kemampuan teknologi Kindred luar biasa, kan?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear02_001
Array.english: By the way…\nThe signal here isn't great.
Array.indonesia: Ngomong-ngomong…\nSinyal di sini kurang bagus.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear02_002
Array.english: I was testing a prototype spacecraft, and the GPS got scrambled.
Array.indonesia: Aku lagi menguji prototipe pesawat luar angkasa, dan sinyal GPS-nya terganggu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear02_003
Array.english: Those engineers...\ncan't believe they missed that.
Array.indonesia: Para insinyur itu...\nAku nggak percaya mereka melewatkan hal itu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear02_004
Array.english: It'll take a while for my rescue signal to reach HQ.
Array.indonesia: Butuh waktu cukup lama sampai sinyal daruratku sampai ke markas besar.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear02_005
Array.english: <size=33>I'll be staying in this village until then.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku akan tinggal di desa ini sampai saat itu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear03_001
Array.english: Hmm... not an alien after all...\nI'm disappointed.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... ternyata bukan alien juga...\nAku kecewa.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear03_002
Array.english: If he came from space, doesn't that still make him an alien?
Array.indonesia: Kalau dia datang dari luar angkasa, bukankah itu tetap membuatnya jadi alien?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear03_003
Array.english: Well... aliens usually have, you know... big eyes and no hair...
Array.indonesia: Yah... alien biasanya punya, kamu tahu... mata besar dan tidak berambut...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear03_004
Array.english: <size=32>So in that sense... maybe he kind of counts?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Jadi dalam arti itu... mungkin dia bisa dibilang alien?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear03_005
Array.english: Anyway, we should head back and discuss this properly.
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun, kita sebaiknya kembali dan mendiskusikan ini dengan baik.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear03_006
Array.english: <size=33>Let's call it a day, Takeru!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ayo kita akhiri hari ini, Takeru!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear03_007
Array.english: <size=38>Aye aye, sir!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Baik, Pak!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_Farewell_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... Sir, perfect timing.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... Pak, waktunya pas banget.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_Farewell_002
Array.english: <size=32>Good news. \nOur friend Yasuto has fully recovered from his illness!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kabar baik. \nTeman kita Yasuto sudah pulih sepenuhnya dari penyakitnya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_Farewell_003
Array.english: Ah... the one who got bitten by a spider and couldn't join the investigation... That's a relief.
Array.indonesia: Ah... orang yang digigit laba-laba dan tidak bisa ikut dalam penyelidikan... Syukurlah.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_Farewell_004
Array.english: Phew... I had a nightmare all night about being chased by thousands of spiders.
Array.indonesia: Wah... semalaman aku mimpi buruk dikejar ribuan laba-laba.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_Farewell_005
Array.english: It's a real shame I couldn't take part in the investigation…\nbut thanks to you, Sir, we managed to get a photo of the UFO!
Array.indonesia: Sayang sekali aku tidak bisa ikut serta dalam penyelidikan…\ntapi berkat Kamu, Pak, kami berhasil mendapatkan foto UFO itu!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_Farewell_006
Array.english: There's definitely some kind of mysterious power in this village.
Array.indonesia: Pasti ada semacam kekuatan misterius di desa ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_Farewell_007
Array.english: So, about that... Fukuo, Takeru...
Array.indonesia: Jadi, soal itu... Fukuo, Takeru...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_Farewell_008
Array.english: <size=35>I've decided to stay in this village.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Aku sudah memutuskan untuk tinggal di desa ini.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_Farewell_009
Array.english: <size=33>What?! You're not coming with us on our grand journey?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Apa?! Kamu nggak mau ikut kami dalam perjalanan besar kami?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_Farewell_010
Array.english: It's not like that. I just feel like there are more mysteries to uncover here.
Array.indonesia: Bukan begitu. Aku hanya merasa masih ada banyak misteri yang harus diungkap di sini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_Farewell_011
Array.english: I'd love for you guys to stay too, but...
Array.indonesia: Aku juga ingin kalian tetap tinggal, tapi...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_Farewell_012
Array.english: <size=33>You have a duty...\nto seek out other mysteries.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kamu punya tugas...\nuntuk mencari misteri-misteri lainnya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_Farewell_013
Array.english: *Sniff*... You're right. It's a choice we must make for the greater good.
Array.indonesia: *Hiks*... Kamu benar. Ini adalah pilihan yang harus kita ambil demi kebaikan yang lebih besar.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_Farewell_014
Array.english: <size=32>*Sniff*... It's an unavoidable fate.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>*Hiks*... Itu adalah takdir yang tak terelakkan.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_Farewell_015
Array.english: Yasuto, your noble sacrifice will be remembered!\nEven if we part ways here...
Array.indonesia: Yasuto, pengorbanan muliamu akan dikenang!\nMeskipun kita harus berpisah di sini...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_Farewell_016
Array.english: <size=33>The Shimano University Mystery Research Club will always be together!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Klub Penelitian Misteri Universitas Shimano akan selalu bersatu!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_Farewell_017
Array.english: <size=38>Aye aye, sirrrrr!!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Baik, Pakkkkk!!!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_NewEmployee_001
Array.english: As I mentioned, I'm planning to stay here for a while.
Array.indonesia: Seperti yang sudah kubilang, aku berencana tinggal di sini untuk sementara waktu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_NewEmployee_002
Array.english: Right. Get some rest and keep up with your research.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah. Istirahatlah dan lanjutkan penelitianmu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_NewEmployee_003
Array.english: But just staying doing nothing but research feels a bit awkward, so...
Array.indonesia: Tapi, hanya tinggal di sini tanpa melakukan apa-apa selain penelitian terasa agak aneh, jadi...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_NewEmployee_004
Array.english: <size=33>Would it be alright if I worked at your restaurant?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Bolehkah aku bekerja di restoranmu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_NewEmployee_005
Array.english: My father runs a ramen shop. I know a bit about cooking and serving.
Array.indonesia: Ayahku punya warung ramen. Aku sedikit tahu soal memasak dan melayani pelanggan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_NewEmployee_006
Array.english: <size=32>That sounds great! We've actually been a bit short-handed.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kedengarannya bagus! Sebenarnya kami sedang kekurangan tenaga kerja.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_NewEmployee_007
Array.english: <size=33>I'm sure Bancho will be happy to hear that, haha.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku yakin Bancho akan senang mendengarnya, haha.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_NewEmployee_008
Array.english: <size=32>Haha, thank you for having me.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha, terima kasih sudah menerima saya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_NewEmployee_009
Array.english: Oh, now that I think about it...
Array.indonesia: Oh, sekarang setelah saya pikir-pikir...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_NewEmployee_010
Array.english: <size=33>This morning, I noticed webs coming out of my hands.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Pagi ini, saya melihat jaring-jaring keluar dari tangan saya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_NewEmployee_011
Array.english: <size=35>Huh? Like... like that character?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Hah? Seperti... seperti karakter itu?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_NewEmployee_012
Array.english: Yeah... when I bend my wrist like this, white threads come out...
Array.indonesia: Ya... saat aku menekuk pergelangan tanganku seperti ini, benang-benang putih keluar...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_NewEmployee_013
Array.english: Maybe we could use this to help with <color=#1DFEAF>Serving</color>?
Array.indonesia: Mungkin kita bisa memanfaatkan ini untuk membantu <color=#1DFEAF>Serving</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_NewEmployee_014
Array.english: It might work. Then let's meet at the shop when you're ready!
Array.indonesia: Mungkin bisa berhasil. Kalau begitu, ayo ketemu di toko saat kamu sudah siap!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_MissionStart01_001
Array.english: <size=35>Whoa..?! Do I smell...\nHydrogen sulfide!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wah..?! Apakah aku mencium bau...\nhidrogen sulfida!?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_MissionStart01_002
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... hello.\nYes, that's right. You have a keen nose.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... halo.\nYa, benar. Hidungmu tajam sekali.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_MissionStart01_003
Array.english: I know that smell well. We sometimes get it during experiments at the lab. But why is it so strong near the lake...?
Array.indonesia: Aku kenal baik bau itu. Kadang-kadang kita menciumnya saat melakukan eksperimen di lab. Tapi kenapa baunya begitu kuat di dekat danau...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_MissionStart02_001
Array.english: Hehe, I'm Muna, a researcher.\nI couldn't help overhearing... let me explain.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, aku Muna, seorang peneliti.\nAku tidak sengaja mendengarnya... biar aku jelaskan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_MissionStart02_002
Array.english: Hydrogen sulfide forming layers from biological remains is a natural phenomenon.
Array.indonesia: Pembentukan lapisan hidrogen sulfida dari sisa-sisa makhluk hidup adalah fenomena alam.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_MissionStart02_003
Array.english: But as you may have seen from the carcass at Lake Beach, ancient creatures started rising from the bottom of the lake one day.
Array.indonesia: Tapi seperti yang mungkin sudah kamu lihat dari bangkai di Lake Beach, suatu hari makhluk purba mulai muncul dari dasar danau.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_MissionStart02_004
Array.english: They were either poisoned by hydrogen sulfide on the way up... or couldn't adapt to the lake's composition and died...
Array.indonesia: Mereka mungkin teracuni oleh hidrogen sulfida saat naik ke permukaan... atau tidak bisa beradaptasi dengan komposisi danau sehingga mati...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_MissionStart02_005
Array.english:
The buildup of corpses keeps fueling the cycle,
increasing the hydrogen sulfide concentration...
Array.indonesia:
Penumpukan bangkai terus memicu siklus ini,
meningkatkan konsentrasi hidrogen sulfida...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_MissionStart02_006
Array.english: <size=32>...That's what this genius, Muna, has figured out. Hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>...Thatulah yang telah ditemukan oleh jenius bernama Muna ini. Hehe.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_MissionStart02_007
Array.english: I see... This situation isn't normal...\nAt this rate, the lake's ecosystem could be in danger.
Array.indonesia: Begitu... Situasi ini tidak normal...\nJika terus begini, ekosistem danau bisa terancam.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_MissionStart02_008
Array.english: Is there a place at the bottom of the lake where <color=#1DFEAF>Clean Water</color> flows out? If so, we might be able to use some parts from my spacecraft...
Array.indonesia: Apakah ada tempat di dasar danau di mana <color=#1DFEAF>Air Bersih</color> mengalir keluar? Jika ada, mungkin kita bisa menggunakan beberapa bagian dari pesawat ruang angkasa saya...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_MissionStart02_009
Array.english: Hmm. I think I might have seen something like that...\nI'll check.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Sepertinya aku pernah melihat sesuatu seperti itu...\nAku akan memeriksanya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_MissionStart02_010
Array.english: It'll take a while for the rescue team to arrive anyway…\nTime to show what I can do, haha!
Array.indonesia: Lagipula, tim penyelamat masih butuh waktu cukup lama untuk tiba…\nSaatnya menunjukkan kemampuanku, haha!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_MissionStart02_011
Array.english: <size=33>Let me know if you find a spot with clean water! \nAnd tell me what the terrain looks like too.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Beritahu aku jika kamu menemukan tempat dengan air bersih! \nDan beri tahu aku juga seperti apa medannya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PureWaterFound_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hm? Is that...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hm? Apa itu...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PureWaterFound_002
Array.english: <size=33>Martin said to let him know if I found where <color=#1DFEAF>Clean Water</color> is coming out.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Martin bilang untuk memberitahunya kalau aku menemukan tempat di mana <color=#1DFEAF>Air Bersih</color> mengalir.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PureWaterFound_003
Array.english: <size=34>I should head back up and tell him!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku harus kembali ke atas dan memberitahunya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PureWaterFound_Far01_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm...? I hear water flowing from somewhere...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm...? Aku mendengar suara air mengalir dari suatu tempat...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PureWaterFound_Far02_001
Array.english: <size=33><color=#1DFEAF>Clean Water</color> is coming out from over there.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33><color=#1DFEAF>Air Bersih</color> mengalir dari sana.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PureWaterFound_Far02_002
Array.english: <size=32>Martin asked me to let him know if I found where the clean water comes out.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Martin meminta aku untuk memberitahunya jika aku menemukan tempat di mana air bersih itu mengalir.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_GrapplingGunAcquired_001
Array.english: <size=34>Ugh... the lake still smells like hydrogen sulfide...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ugh... danau ini masih berbau hidrogen sulfida...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_GrapplingGunAcquired_002
Array.english: <size=32>Did you happen to find where that <color=#1DFEAF>Clean Water</color> I mentioned earlier comes from...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Apakah kamu kebetulan menemukan dari mana asal <color=#1DFEAF>Air Bersih</color> yang aku sebutkan tadi...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_GrapplingGunAcquired_003
Array.english:
Yes. I found a spot where <color=#1DFEAF>Clean Water</color> is flowing out,
and I was just about to tell you.
Array.indonesia:
Ya. Aku menemukan tempat di mana <color=#1DFEAF>Air Bersih</color> mengalir,
dan aku baru saja mau memberitahumu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_GrapplingGunAcquired_004
Array.english: The current was really strong, so I couldn't get inside.
Array.indonesia: Arusnya sangat kencang, jadi aku tidak bisa masuk ke dalamnya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_GrapplingGunAcquired_005
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... if it's spring water, that's even better!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... kalau itu air mata air, itu malah lebih bagus!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_GrapplingGunAcquired_006
Array.english: <size=32>If we connect some pipes, we can draw up\na large amount of water.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kalau kita sambungkan beberapa pipa, kita bisa mengambil\nbanyak air.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_GrapplingGunAcquired_007
Array.english: Did you see anything inside we could latch onto?
Array.indonesia: Apa kamu lihat ada sesuatu di dalam yang bisa kita jadikan pengait?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_GrapplingGunAcquired_008
Array.english: Hmm... there were signs of ancient ruins, so there should be something to hook onto... Why?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... ada tanda-tanda reruntuhan kuno, jadi seharusnya ada sesuatu yang bisa dijadikan pengait... Kenapa?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_GrapplingGunAcquired_009
Array.english:
While I was checking the wreckage of my spacecraft,
I found some wire and hooks. So...
Array.indonesia:
Saat aku memeriksa reruntuhan pesawat ruang angkasa milikku,
aku menemukan beberapa kawat dan kait. Jadi...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_GrapplingGunAcquired_010
Array.english: <size=34>Ta-da! I made this <color=#F1DC2B>Hook Gun</color>!\nHere, take it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ta-da! Aku membuat <color=#F1DC2B>Hook Gun</color> ini!\nIni, ambil!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_GrapplingGunAcquired_011
Array.english: If there's something to latch onto, you can use this to move quickly. It should help you push through the current too.
Array.indonesia: Jika ada sesuatu yang bisa dipasang, kamu bisa menggunakan ini untuk bergerak dengan cepat. Ini seharusnya juga membantumu melawan arus.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_GrapplingGunAcquired_012
Array.english: Oh... I see. That does sound useful.
Array.indonesia: Oh... begitu. Kedengarannya memang berguna.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_GrapplingGunAcquired_013
Array.english: Haha! Then... could you go into that cave where the clean water is coming from and connect this <color=#1DFEAF>Pipe</color>?
Array.indonesia: Haha! Kalau begitu... bisakah kamu masuk ke gua tempat air bersih itu berasal dan menyambungkan <color=#1DFEAF>Pipa</color> ini?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_GrapplingGunAcquired_014
Array.english: Once it's connected, bring the pipe out and attach it to the <color=#F1DC2B>Purification Device</color> I'll lower down.
Array.indonesia: Setelah tersambung, bawa pipa itu keluar dan pasangkan ke <color=#F1DC2B>Alat Pemurnian</color> yang akan aku turunkan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_GrapplingGunAcquired_015
Array.english: Alright. Got it. I'll check it out.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah. Paham. Aku akan periksa.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PipingInstallationStart01_001
Array.english: Martin asked me to connect a <color=#1DFEAF>Pipe</color> where the clean water flows out.
Array.indonesia: Martin meminta aku untuk memasang <color=#1DFEAF>Pipa</color> di tempat air bersih mengalir keluar.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PipingInstallationStart02_001
Array.english: <size=33>Should I try using the hook gun on that <color=#F1DC2B>Latch</color> sticking out?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Haruskah aku mencoba menggunakan pistol pengait pada <color=#F1DC2B>Kait</color> yang menonjol itu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PipingInstallationCheck01_001
Array.english: Whew... moving that fast made my ears pop.
Array.indonesia: Wah... bergerak secepat itu bikin telingaku terasa tersumbat.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PipingInstallationCheck02_001
Array.english: <size=32>Alright, let's install the <color=#1DFEAF>Pipe</color> at that water source like Martin said.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Baiklah, mari pasang <color=#1DFEAF>Pipa</color> di sumber air itu seperti yang dikatakan Martin.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PipingInstallationDone_001
Array.english: <size=34>Alright, it's secured! Now let's grab the pipe and ride the current back out.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Baiklah, sudah terpasang dengan aman! Sekarang ayo ambil pipa itu dan ikuti arus untuk kembali ke luar.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PurificationSystemIn_001
Array.english: <size=34>Phew... that made me dizzy.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wah... itu bikin aku pusing.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PurificationSystemIn_002
Array.english: <size=32>Martin, I connected the pipe and brought it back!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Martin, aku sudah menyambungkan pipa dan membawanya kembali!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PurificationSystemIn_003
Array.english: <size=36>Oh, that's a perfect spot!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Oh, itu tempat yang sempurna!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PurificationSystemIn_004
Array.english: <size=32>Alright then, I'll send the <color=#F1DC2B>Purification Device</color> down to you.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Baiklah, aku akan mengirimkan <color=#F1DC2B>Alat Pemurnian</color> kepadamu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PurificationSystemConnectStart_001
Array.english: <size=33>Wow... so this is the <color=#F1DC2B>Purification Device</color>. It's pretty big.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wah... jadi ini dia <color=#F1DC2B>Alat Pemurnian</color>. Ukurannya cukup besar.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PurificationSystemConnectStart_002
Array.english: <size=32>Haha! Took quite a bit of work to build!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha! Butuh usaha yang lumayan untuk membuatnya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PurificationSystemConnectStart_003
Array.english: <size=33>Now go ahead and connect the <color=#1DFEAF>Pipe</color> you brought to it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Sekarang silakan sambungkan <color=#1DFEAF>Pipa</color> yang kamu bawa ke perangkat itu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PurificationSystemConnectStart_Barricade_001
Array.english: <size=32>I need to connect the pipe to the purification device!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku harus menyambungkan pipa ke perangkat pemurnian!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PurificationSystemConnectEnd_001
Array.english: <size=34>Ooh...! The device is working!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ooh...! Perangkatnya berfungsi!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PurificationSystemConnectEnd_002
Array.english: <size=33>Haha! Just as expected, Kindred technology works perfectly anywhere!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Haha! Seperti yang diharapkan, teknologi Kindred bekerja dengan sempurna di mana saja!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PurificationSystemConnectEnd_003
Array.english: <size=32>The lake should be much clearer by tomorrow.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Danau itu seharusnya sudah jauh lebih jernih besok.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PurificationSystemConnectEnd_004
Array.english: <size=32>Glad it turned into a nice parting gift! I'll try contacting the rescue ship again.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Senang ini jadi hadiah perpisahan yang bagus! Aku akan coba menghubungi kapal penyelamat lagi.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_EmployeeOnboarding01_001
Array.english: Hm? What's wrong? Is something wrong with the lake purification?
Array.indonesia: Hm? Ada apa? Apakah ada masalah dengan pemurnian danau?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_EmployeeOnboarding01_002
Array.english: Ah... I checked this morning, and the lake's been completely purified.
Array.indonesia: Ah... Aku sudah memeriksanya pagi ini, dan danau itu sudah sepenuhnya dimurnikan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_EmployeeOnboarding01_003
Array.english: But... the rescue ship that was supposed to arrive today was attacked by alien creatures and crashed.
Array.indonesia: Tapi... kapal penyelamat yang seharusnya tiba hari ini diserang oleh makhluk asing dan jatuh.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_EmployeeOnboarding01_004
Array.english: Man... they're in the middle of upgrading to a new model... \nand that was the only one in operation.
Array.indonesia: Astaga... mereka sedang dalam proses upgrade ke model baru... \ndan itu satu-satunya yang beroperasi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_EmployeeOnboarding01_005
Array.english: It's going to take a while before the next rescue ship arrives...
Array.indonesia: Butuh waktu cukup lama sebelum kapal penyelamat berikutnya tiba...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_EmployeeOnboarding01_006
Array.english: <size=32>Would it be alright if I stayed in the village a bit longer to help out?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Bolehkah aku tinggal di desa ini sedikit lebih lama untuk membantu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_EmployeeOnboarding01_007
Array.english: Oh... sure. We'd love to have you, but...
Array.indonesia: Oh... tentu saja. Kami senang sekali kalau kamu bisa membantu, tapi...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_EmployeeOnboarding01_008
Array.english: The only thing you could really help with right now is at the restaurant. Would that be okay?
Array.indonesia: Satu-satunya hal yang benar-benar bisa kamu bantu saat ini adalah di restoran. Apakah itu tidak masalah?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_EmployeeOnboarding01_009
Array.english: <size=33>Ooh! You mean that place that always smells amazing?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wah! Maksudmu tempat yang baunya selalu enak itu?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_EmployeeOnboarding01_010
Array.english: I'm not exactly a master chef, but...\nI did build an automated assistance device.
Array.indonesia: Aku memang bukan koki handal, tapi...\naku sudah membuat alat bantu otomatis.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_EmployeeOnboarding01_011
Array.english: <size=32>This should make things a bit easier, haha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ini seharusnya bikin segalanya jadi lebih mudah, haha!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_EmployeeOnboarding01_012
Array.english: I'll help out at the shop until the next rescue contact comes through.
Array.indonesia: Aku bakal bantu di toko sampai ada kontak penyelamatan berikutnya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_EmployeeOnboarding01_013
Array.english: <size=33>That sounds great! See you at the shop!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kedengarannya bagus! Sampai jumpa di toko!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_Unlock01_001
Array.english: <size=35>Oh, hey! You made it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh, hai! Kamu datang juga!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_Unlock01_002
Array.english: <size=32>Wanna try that <color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color> challenge I mentioned?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Mau coba tantangan <color=#F1DC2B>Menumpuk Balok Hewan</color> yang aku sebutkan tadi?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_Unlock_option01_001
Array.english: I'm in!
Array.indonesia: Aku ikut!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_Unlock_option01_002
Array.english: Maybe next time.
Array.indonesia: Mungkin lain kali.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_Unlock01_No_001
Array.english: Aww... that's too bad.\nCome find me when you feel like it.
Array.indonesia: Aduh... sayang sekali.\nDatang saja temui aku kalau kamu sudah siap.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_Unlock02_001
Array.english: <size=34>Hehe. Now that's my kind of guy!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hehe. Nah, itulah tipe cowok yang aku suka!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_Unlock02_002
Array.english: The rules are simple. We take turns stacking these <color=#F1DC2B>Animal Blocks</color>, and whoever knocks them over first loses.
Array.indonesia: Aturannya sederhana. Kita bergiliran menumpuk <color=#F1DC2B>Animal Blocks</color> ini, dan siapa pun yang menjatuhkannya lebih dulu, dia kalah.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_Unlock02_003
Array.english: Best way to learn? Try it yourself.\nLet's get started.
Array.indonesia: Cara terbaik untuk belajar? Cobalah sendiri.\nAyo kita mulai.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_Unlock01_Retry_001
Array.english: <size=34>How about it, wanna have a go at <color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Bagaimana, mau coba <color=#F1DC2B>Menumpuk Balok Hewan</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_End_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... this is pretty fun!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... ini lumayan seru!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_End_002
Array.english: <size=32>Heh, glad to hear it, pal.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Heh, senang mendengarnya, sobat.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_End_003
Array.english: Plenty of folks around here love this game too.
Array.indonesia: Banyak orang di sini juga suka permainan ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_End_004
Array.english: Win a match, and I'll give you a <color=#F1DC2B>New Animal Block</color>.
Array.indonesia: Menangkan satu pertandingan, dan aku akan memberimu <color=#F1DC2B>Blok Hewan Baru</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_End_005
Array.english: Bring me <color=#1DFEAF>3</color> of them... and I'll have a little something for you.
Array.indonesia: Bawakan aku <color=#1DFEAF>3</color> di antaranya... dan aku akan memberimu hadiah kecil.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_End_006
Array.english: <size=35>The more you collect, the more fun it gets. Hahaha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Semakin banyak yang kamu kumpulkan, semakin seru permainannya. Hahaha!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_End_007
Array.english: <size=32>Alright, you're past the beginner stage...\nSo let's play for <color=#F1DC2B>Doni</color> this time.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Baiklah, kamu sudah melewati tahap pemula...\nJadi, mari kita bertaruh untuk <color=#F1DC2B>Doni</color> kali ini.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_End_008
Array.english: <size=34>How about we wager <color=#F1DC2B>30 Doni</color>? Just to make things interesting. You can raise the stakes if you want, hahaha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Bagaimana kalau kita bertaruh <color=#F1DC2B>30 Doni</color>? Hanya untuk membuatnya lebih seru. Kamu bisa menaikkan taruhannya kalau mau, hahaha!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_NoMoney_001
Array.english: Huh? You don't have enough money.\nCome back next time.
Array.indonesia: Hah? Kamu nggak punya cukup uang.\nDatang lagi lain kali.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_NoMoney_002
Array.english: <size=33>You'll need at least <color=#F1DC2B>30 Doni</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kamu butuh setidaknya <color=#F1DC2B>30 Doni</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_Start_001
Array.english: Oh... you thinking about a <color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color> match?
Array.indonesia: Oh... kamu mau main <color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_Start_Yes_001
Array.english: <size=34>Heh, let's get started.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Heh, ayo kita mulai.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_Start_End_001
Array.english: <size=33>Haha, that was fun.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Haha, itu seru.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_Start_End_002
Array.english: <size=33>Come by again when you're bored.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Mampir lagi kalau kamu lagi bosan.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_Limit_001
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>I think I've played enough for today...\nBetter take it easy.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>Kayaknya aku udah cukup main hari ini...\nSebaiknya istirahat dulu.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_FirstNight_001
Array.english: I'm pretty used to life in the village now.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah cukup terbiasa dengan kehidupan di desa ini sekarang.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_FirstNight_002
Array.english: Preparing ingredients in this heat is tough, though...
Array.indonesia: Tapi, menyiapkan bahan-bahan di cuaca panas begini memang berat...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_FirstAppearance_001
Array.english: <size=34>Hm? At this hour...\nWhat brings you here?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hm? Di jam segini...\nApa yang membawamu ke sini?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_FirstAppearance_002
Array.english: <size=32>Whew... finally found some civilization. Thought I was gonna end up spendin' the night out in them woods.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wah... akhirnya nemu peradaban. Sempat kira bakal nginep di hutan itu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_FirstAppearance_003
Array.english: <size=35>Lemme wet my whistle first...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Biar aku minum dulu...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_FirstAppearance_004
Array.english: <size=34>Whoa... gasoline...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wah... bensin...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_FirstAppearance_005
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! It's water!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Ini air!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_FirstAppearance_006
Array.english: Back home in Tennessee, it gets real hot... so during shows,\nI fill this up with water and sip on it.
Array.indonesia: Di kampung halamanku di Tennessee, cuacanya sangat panas... jadi saat manggung,\naku mengisi botol ini dengan air dan meminumnya sedikit demi sedikit.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_FirstAppearance_007
Array.english: It's just as hot out here, no joke... I was wanderin' around earlier and nearly got light-headed.
Array.indonesia: Di sini juga sama panasnya, nggak main-main... Tadi aku jalan-jalan sebentar dan hampir pusing.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_FirstAppearance_008
Array.english: You look like a musician...\nhow'd you end up here?
Array.indonesia: Kamu terlihat seperti musisi...\nbagaimana kamu bisa sampai di sini?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_FirstAppearance_009
Array.english: Oh, just lookin' for some inspiration for my new album.
Array.indonesia: Oh, cuma cari inspirasi buat album baruku.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_FirstAppearance_010
Array.english: I was after a whole new kind of place...\nand this area fit the bill just right.
Array.indonesia: Aku sedang mencari tempat yang benar-benar baru...\ndan daerah ini pas banget.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_FirstAppearance_011
Array.english: Nothin' but woods as far as the eye can see, flowers everywhere... and critters I've never seen in my life.
Array.indonesia: Hanya hutan sejauh mata memandang, bunga di mana-mana... dan binatang-binatang yang belum pernah aku lihat seumur hidupku.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_FirstAppearance_012
Array.english: <size=32>I only meant to look around a bit, but I got turned around and ended up all the way out here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku cuma mau lihat-lihat sebentar, tapi aku tersesat dan akhirnya sampai sejauh ini.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_FirstAppearance_013
Array.english: But man...\nhaulin' two guitars around's about to do me in.
Array.indonesia: Tapi, wah...\nmembawa dua gitar ini hampir membuatku kelelahan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_FirstAppearance_014
Array.english: Y'all know anywhere nearby I could crash for a bit?\nI'm about ready to kick my feet up.
Array.indonesia: Kalian tahu tempat di sekitar sini di mana aku bisa beristirahat sebentar?\nAku sudah siap untuk bersantai.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_FirstAppearance_015
Array.english: Hmm... If you stay near the <color=#1DFEAF>Lake Beach</color>, you should be fine without bothering the villagers.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Kalau kamu tinggal di dekat <color=#1DFEAF>Lake Beach</color>, seharusnya nggak ada masalah dan nggak bakal mengganggu penduduk desa.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_FirstAppearance_016
Array.english: <size=33>Lucky me! I sure appreciate it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Beruntung sekali aku! Aku sangat menghargainya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_FirstAppearance_017
Array.english: <size=35>Oh, by the way... name's <color=#F1DC2B>Charlie Bonnet III</color>.\nDon't you forget it! Rock 'n' roll, y'hear?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh, ngomong-ngomong... namaku <color=#F1DC2B>Charlie Bonnet III</color>.\nJangan sampai lupa! Rock 'n' roll, dengar?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_ AfterLeave_001
Array.english: Coming all this way just to write music...\nYou must really love it.
Array.indonesia: Datang sejauh ini hanya untuk menulis lagu...\nKamu pasti sangat menyukainya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaInterest_001
Array.english: Um... that guy who just showed up at Lake Beach...
Array.indonesia: Um... pria yang baru saja muncul di Lake Beach itu...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaInterest_002
Array.english: <size=34>Is he a musician?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Apakah dia seorang musisi?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaInterest_003
Array.english: Yeah, I think so. He said he came all this way to work on a new song.
Array.indonesia: Ya, kurasa begitu. Katanya dia datang sejauh ini untuk menggarap lagu baru.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaInterest_004
Array.english: <size=33>I saw him playing as I walked by...\nHe was really good!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku melihatnya sedang bermain saat aku lewat...\nDia sangat hebat!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaInterest_005
Array.english: Really? Then why not go talk to him?
Array.indonesia: Benarkah? Kalau begitu, kenapa tidak pergi berbicara dengannya?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaInterest_006
Array.english: <size=34>What?! But that guy...\nHe was drinking oil!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Apa?! Tapi cowok itu...\nDia minum minyak!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaInterest_007
Array.english: He said it was water...
Array.indonesia: Katanya itu air...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaInterest_008
Array.english: <size=32>If you're nervous, I can go with you. What do you think?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kalau kamu gugup, aku bisa ikut. Gimana menurutmu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaInterest_009
Array.english: Uh... okay.
Array.indonesia: Uh... oke.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaMeetChalie01_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hm? Who's this young fella?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hm? Siapa anak muda ini?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaMeetChalie01_002
Array.english: He's a friend of mine who plays music here...\nHe got curious after hearing your guitar.
Array.indonesia: Dia teman aku yang main musik di sini...\nDia jadi penasaran setelah dengar gitar kamu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaMeetChalie01_003
Array.english: <size=34>Hahaha! A fella who knows his music!!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hahaha! Anak muda yang paham musik!!!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaMeetChalie01_004
Array.english: Now hold on, is that a local instrument you're carryin'? \nSix strings too, kinda like a guitar.
Array.indonesia: Tunggu dulu, apakah itu alat musik lokal yang kamu bawa? \nEnam senar juga, mirip gitar.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaMeetChalie01_005
Array.english: Yes. It's called <color=#1DFEAF>Panting</color>... \nA traditional string instrument from this region.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Namanya <color=#1DFEAF>Panting</color>... \nAlat musik senar tradisional dari daerah ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaMeetChalie01_006
Array.english: <size=34>Ooh... Mind givin' me a little taste?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ooh... Bolehkah kamu mainkan sedikit untukku?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaMeetChalie01_007
Array.english: <size=36>W-What?! That's... so sudden...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>A-Apa?! Itu... terlalu mendadak...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaMeetChalie01_008
Array.english: <size=33>Have some confidence! You're a great player!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Percayalah pada dirimu! Kamu pemain yang hebat!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaMeetChalie01_009
Array.english: Ugh... okay, just a short one...
Array.indonesia: Ugh... oke, cuma sebentar aja...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaMeetChalie02_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ooh... that's real nice...! Your chord work and finger movement are solid!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wah... itu bagus banget...! Permainan akord dan gerakan jarimu mantap!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaMeetChalie02_002
Array.english: Been playin' a while, ain't ya?
Array.indonesia: Sudah lama main, ya?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaMeetChalie02_003
Array.english: <size=32>Say... I've got an electric sittin' around. \nWanna give it a try?</size>
