Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ngomong-ngomong... aku punya gitar listrik yang nganggur. \nMau coba mainin?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaMeetChalie02_004
Array.english: <size=34>What?! An electric guitar?!\nI've never played one before?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Apa?! Gitar listrik?!\nAku belum pernah mainin itu sebelumnya?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaMeetChalie02_005
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! Don't you worry!\nIt's all just strings and frets, ain't it?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Jangan khawatir!\nItu kan cuma senar dan fret, kan?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaMeetChalie02_006
Array.english: <size=32>I'll handle the vocals and rhythm on my acoustic. You just sprinkle in some nice fills when it feels right.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku yang ngurusin vokal dan ritme pakai gitar akustikku. Kamu tinggal tambahin beberapa fill yang bagus pas rasanya pas.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaMeetChalie02_007
Array.english: <size=33>Just go with your gut, buddy. Play what feels right!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ikuti saja instingmu, sobat. Mainkan apa yang terasa pas!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_PlaytheGuitar_Ask_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh no... what should I do...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh tidak... apa yang harus aku lakukan...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_PlaytheGuitar_Option01
Array.english: Give it a try! <color=#fde221><size=20>(A mini-game will begin.)</size></color>
Array.indonesia: Coba saja! <color=#fde221><size=20>(Sebuah mini-game akan dimulai.)</size></color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_PlaytheGuitar_Option02
Array.english: Maybe next time
Array.indonesia: Mungkin lain kali

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_StartGame_001
Array.english: <size=35>Alright! Let's do this!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oke! Ayo kita mulai!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_StartGame_002
Array.english: <size=33>Haha! Love that energy!\nI'll start us off, you just follow my lead.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Haha! Aku suka semangatmu!\nAku yang akan memulai, kamu tinggal ikuti saja.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_NextTime_001
Array.english: I... I think I need a bit more time.\nI'll come back!
Array.indonesia: Aku... kurasa aku butuh sedikit waktu lagi.\nAku akan kembali!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_NextTime_002
Array.english: <size=32>Haha! Don't you go gettin' all nervous on me now! No rush, come by when you're ready!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha! Jangan sampai kamu jadi gugup sekarang! Nggak perlu terburu-buru, mampir aja kalau kamu sudah siap!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_Retry_001
Array.english: <size=32>Now... I think I can play with that guy!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Sekarang... kayaknya aku bisa main sama orang itu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_Retry_Option01
Array.english: Start right away <color=#fde221><size=20>(The mini-game will begin.)</size></color>
Array.indonesia: Mulai sekarang juga <color=#fde221><size=20>(Mini-game akan dimulai.)</size></color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_Retry_Option02
Array.english: Tell him you'll do it later
Array.indonesia: Katakan padanya kamu akan melakukannya nanti

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_Retry_Now_001
Array.english: <size=33>Sounds exciting!\nLet's head to Lake Beach right now.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kedengarannya seru!\nAyo langsung ke Lake Beach sekarang.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_Retry_Later_001
Array.english: Oh... I've got something I need to finish.\nI'll come back later!
Array.indonesia: Oh... Aku ada sesuatu yang harus kuselesaikan.\nAku akan kembali nanti!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_Retry_Move_001
Array.english: The musician should be over by Lake Beach.
Array.indonesia: Musisi itu seharusnya ada di sekitar Lake Beach.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_Retry_Start_001
Array.english: Well looky here! Somebody's ready to rock!\nThis here's the electric for ya.
Array.indonesia: Wah, lihat ini! Ada yang siap beraksi!\nIni gitar listriknya buat kamu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_Retry_Start_002
Array.english: <size=32>I'm gonna lay down the rhythm, you go ahead and throw a nice solo on top.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku akan mainkan ritmenya, kamu silakan mainkan solo yang keren di atasnya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_NewEmployee_001
Array.english: <size=34>Hahaha! That was a blast!!\nYou've got real talent!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hahaha! Itu seru banget!!\nKamu benar-benar berbakat!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_NewEmployee_002
Array.english: Wow!! The electric guitar really hits you right in the chest!
Array.indonesia: Wow!! Gitar listriknya benar-benar menghentak di dada!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_NewEmployee_003
Array.english: <size=33>Hehe. Ain't this place somethin'?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hehe. Tempat ini luar biasa, kan?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_NewEmployee_004
Array.english: I think I'll stick around a while and let the music come to me. Might even write a song about this town.
Array.indonesia: Kurasa aku akan tinggal sebentar dan membiarkan musik mengalir ke dalam diriku. Mungkin aku bahkan akan menulis lagu tentang kota ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_NewEmployee_005
Array.english: Oh... could I learn some music from you while you're here?
Array.indonesia: Oh... bolehkah aku belajar musik darimu selagi kamu di sini?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_NewEmployee_006
Array.english: <size=34>Of course! I'll teach ya here and there when we get the chance!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Tentu saja! Aku akan mengajari kamu sesekali kalau ada kesempatan!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_NewEmployee_007
Array.english: Say, speakin' of... somebody nearby's got some barbecue goin', and it smells incredible!
Array.indonesia: Ngomong-ngomong... ada seseorang di dekat sini yang sedang memanggang barbekyu, dan baunya luar biasa!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_NewEmployee_008
Array.english: Oh, that's Bancho's place. He's with us.\nI help out there too.
Array.indonesia: Oh, itu rumah Bancho. Dia bersama kita.\nAku juga membantu di sana.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_NewEmployee_009
Array.english: Ooh... back in Nashville, we got some famous barbecue too. \nI used to fire up the grill for my family all the time.
Array.indonesia: Ooh... di Nashville, kami juga punya barbekyu yang terkenal. \nDulu aku sering memanggang untuk keluargaku.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_NewEmployee_010
Array.english: <size=33>Well now... how 'bout I help out at the shop while I'm stayin' here?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Nah... gimana kalau aku bantu-bantu di toko selama aku tinggal di sini?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_NewEmployee_011
Array.english: I'm runnin' low on supplies, and it don't feel right freeloadin'.
Array.indonesia: Persediaanku mulai menipis, dan rasanya nggak enak kalau cuma numpang gratis.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_NewEmployee_012
Array.english: <size=32>Oh...! That'd be amazing!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh...! Itu bakal luar biasa!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_NewEmployee_013
Array.english: <size=35>See you at the shop, Charlie!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Sampai jumpa di toko, Charlie!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_Start_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hmm? Dr. Bacon, what are you digging up?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hmm? Dr. Bacon, apa yang sedang Kamu gali?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_Start_002
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, Dave. This is... something called an <color=#E6ABFF>Utara Crystal</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, Dave. Ini adalah... sesuatu yang disebut <color=#E6ABFF>Kristal Utara</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_Start_003
Array.english: It's a unique mineral found only in this region... I've been studying it since it might be useful for crafting tools.
Array.indonesia: Ini adalah mineral unik yang hanya ditemukan di wilayah ini... Aku sudah menelitinya karena mungkin berguna untuk membuat perkakas.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_Start_004
Array.english: <size=33>Take a look at this!\nCan you feel that energy coming off it?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Lihat ini!\nBisakah kamu merasakan energi yang terpancar darinya?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_Start_005
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... there's a kind of shimmering light flowing through it...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... ada semacam cahaya berkilauan yang mengalir melaluinya...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_Start_006
Array.english: Haha! It's a fascinating material.
Array.indonesia: Haha! Bahan ini sungguh menarik.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_Start_007
Array.english: The only issue is you can only extract a small amount from each crystal... I could use your help with that.
Array.indonesia: Satu-satunya masalah adalah kamu hanya bisa mengekstrak sedikit dari setiap kristal... Aku butuh bantuanmu untuk itu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_Start_008
Array.english: Hmm? How can I help?
Array.indonesia: Hmm? Bagaimana aku bisa membantu?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_Start_009
Array.english: You should be able to find solidified <color=#E6ABFF>Utara Crystals</color> scattered around the village and the lake.
Array.indonesia: Kamu seharusnya bisa menemukan <color=#E6ABFF>Kristal Utara</color> yang telah mengeras tersebar di sekitar desa dan danau.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_Start_010
Array.english: <size=33>Bring me around <color=#1DFEAF>7</color> of them.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Bawakan aku sekitar <color=#1DFEAF>7</color> di antaranya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_Start_011
Array.english: I'll study those and try to make some tools you can use at the lake.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan meneliti kristal-kristal itu dan mencoba membuat beberapa alat yang bisa kamu gunakan di danau.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_Start_012
Array.english: Oh... I was just wishing I had some of Cobra's tools.\nPerfect timing.
Array.indonesia: Oh... Aku baru saja berharap punya beberapa alat milik Cobra.\nWaktunya pas banget.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_Start_013
Array.english: <size=32>I'll collect them whenever I come across any in the village or lake.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku akan mengumpulkannya setiap kali menemukannya di desa atau danau.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_End_001
Array.english: Oh, did you manage to gather 7 <color=#E6ABFF>Utara Crystals</color>?
Array.indonesia: Oh, apakah kamu sudah berhasil mengumpulkan 7 <color=#E6ABFF>Kristal Utara</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_CheckDelivery_Option01
Array.english: Yes, here they are
Array.indonesia: Ya, ini dia

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_CheckDelivery_Option02
Array.english: Not yet...
Array.indonesia: Belum...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_GiveItem_Finished_001
Array.english: Here they are.
Array.indonesia: Ini dia.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_GiveItem_Finished_002
Array.english: <size=33>Ooh...! This should be more than enough!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wah...! Ini pasti lebih dari cukup!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_GiveItem_Finished_003
Array.english: First, I've made some simple tools using the crystals \nI gathered.
Array.indonesia: Pertama, aku sudah membuat beberapa alat sederhana menggunakan kristal-kristal \nyang kukumpulkan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_GiveItem_Finished_004
Array.english: <size=33>If you bring me more <color=#E6ABFF>Utara Crystals</color>, I can continue my research!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kalau kamu membawakan aku lebih banyak <color=#E6ABFF>Kristal Utara</color>, aku bisa melanjutkan penelitianku!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_GiveItem_Finished_005
Array.english: <size=34>Got it. I'll pick them up whenever I spot any!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Baiklah. Aku akan mengambilnya kapan pun aku menemukannya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_GiveItem_NoItem_001
Array.english: Oh, I haven't found them all yet!\nI'll keep looking.
Array.indonesia: Oh, aku belum menemukan semuanya!\nAku akan terus mencari.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_RefuseGiveItem_001
Array.english: Hmm... I haven't found them yet. \nI'll search around the village and lake a bit more.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Aku belum menemukannya. \nAku akan mencari di sekitar desa dan danau sedikit lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerStart_001
Array.english: <size=32>Ugh... this won't do...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ugh... ini nggak bisa begini...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerStart_002
Array.english: Hm? Rimbo, something on your mind?
Array.indonesia: Hm? Rimbo, ada yang mengganggu pikiranmu?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerStart_003
Array.english: Ah, well... I had a <color=#F1DC2B>Red Feather</color> charm hanging in my truck, \nbut it broke.
Array.indonesia: Ah, ya... aku punya jimat <color=#F1DC2B>Red Feather</color> yang digantung di trukku, \ntapi jimat itu rusak.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerStart_004
Array.english: It's supposed to keep you safe on the road, so...\nhavin' it busted's got me a bit uneasy.
Array.indonesia: Jimat itu seharusnya melindungimu di jalan, jadi...\njimatnya rusak bikin aku agak gelisah.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerStart_005
Array.english: I see. If I come across a <color=#F1DC2B>Red Feather</color>, want me to grab it for you?
Array.indonesia: Begitu ya. Kalau aku nemu <color=#F1DC2B>Red Feather</color>, mau aku ambilkan buatmu?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerStart_006
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, I'd sure appreciate that!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, aku pasti bakal sangat berterima kasih!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerStart_007
Array.english: Past the <color=#1DFEAF>Lake Beach</color>, there's a spot where birds gather…\nYou might find one there.
Array.indonesia: Di sebelah <color=#1DFEAF>Pantai Danau</color>, ada tempat di mana burung-burung berkumpul…\nKamu mungkin bisa menemukannya di sana.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerStart_008
Array.english: Got it. I'll check around the <color=#1DFEAF>Lake Beach</color>.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah. Aku akan memeriksa sekitar <color=#1DFEAF>Pantai Danau</color>.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerFindItem_001
Array.english: Hm? That looks like the <color=#F1DC2B>Red Feather</color> Rimbo mentioned.
Array.indonesia: Hm? Itu sepertinya <color=#F1DC2B>Red Feather</color> yang disebutkan Rimbo.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerFindItem_002
Array.english: <size=32>Should I go pick it up?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haruskah aku mengambilnya?</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerItemMove_001
Array.english: <size=34>Whoa?! What's with that sudden gust...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wah?! Ada apa dengan hembusan angin tiba-tiba itu...?!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerItemMove_002
Array.english: <size=35>It's going to blow away...\nI should move in slowly and grab it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Itu akan terbang terbawa angin...\nAku harus mendekat perlahan dan mengambilnya.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerFailMissionItem_001
Array.english: Ugh... I lost it. If I run toward it, it flies away.
Array.indonesia: Ugh... Aku kehilangan benda itu. Kalau aku berlari ke arahnya, benda itu malah terbang menjauh.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerFailMissionItem_002
Array.english: Next time I see it, I'll approach more slowly.
Array.indonesia: Lain kali kalau aku melihatnya lagi, aku akan mendekatinya lebih pelan.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerRetryMissionItem_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, it's the <color=#F1DC2B>Red Feather</color> I missed earlier!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, itu <color=#F1DC2B>Red Feather</color> yang tadi kulewatkan!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerRetryMissionItem_002
Array.english: Running toward it made it fly away, right?
Array.indonesia: Berlari ke arahnya membuatnya terbang menjauh, kan?

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerRetryMissionItem_003
Array.english: <size=33>This time, I'll catch it for sure.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kali ini, aku pasti akan menangkapnya.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerGetMissionItem_001
Array.english: <size=32>Phew... finally caught it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wah... akhirnya berhasil menangkapnya.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerGetMissionItem_002
Array.english: It looks even prettier up close. \nMust be from a magnificent bird.
Array.indonesia: Terlihat lebih cantik lagi kalau dilihat dari dekat. \nPasti berasal dari burung yang megah.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerGetMissionItem_003
Array.english: <size=32>I should take it to Rimbo!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku harus membawanya ke Rimbo!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerDelivery_001
Array.english: <size=35>Oh! <color=#F1DC2B>Did ya get the red feather</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh! <color=#F1DC2B>Kamu sudah dapat bulu merah</color> itu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerDelivery_Option01
Array.english: Yes, I got it
Array.indonesia: Ya, sudah kudapat

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerDelivery_Option02
Array.english: Not yet...
Array.indonesia: Belum...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerGiveItem_Finished_001
Array.english: This is it, right? The <color=#F1DC2B>Red Feather</color>.
Array.indonesia: Ini dia, kan? <color=#F1DC2B>Bulu Merah</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerGiveItem_Finished_002
Array.english: <size=34>Oh! That's the one!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh! Itu dia!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerGiveItem_Finished_003
Array.english: Hehe, now I can fix my charm. Might sound like superstition, but I haven't had a single accident since I hung it up.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, sekarang aku bisa memperbaiki jimatku. Mungkin terdengar seperti takhayul, tapi aku belum pernah mengalami kecelakaan sama sekali sejak menggantungkannya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerGiveItem_Finished_004
Array.english: <size=33>Thank ya, Dave.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Terima kasih, Dave.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerGiveItem_Finished_005
Array.english: Oughta give ya somethin' in return...
Array.indonesia: Seharusnya aku membalas kebaikanmu...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerGiveItem_Finished_006
Array.english: <size=33>Ah! The village is pretty big, so gettin' around ain't easy... Why don't ya take this <color=#F1DC2B>Kick Scooter</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ah! Desa ini cukup besar, jadi berkeliling di sini nggak gampang... Kenapa kamu nggak ambil <color=#F1DC2B>Kick Scooter</color> ini saja!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerGiveItem_Finished_007
Array.english: <size=32>It's red, which just so happens to be my lucky color, haha.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Warnanya merah, yang kebetulan adalah warna keberuntunganku, haha.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerGiveItem_Finished_008
Array.english: <size=34>Oh... a <color=#F1DC2B>Kick Scooter</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh... sebuah <color=#F1DC2B>Kick Scooter</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerGiveItem_Finished_009
Array.english: <size=33>Hehe. This will make getting around a lot easier!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hehe. Ini akan membuat perjalananmu jauh lebih mudah!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerGiveItem_Finished_010
Array.english: <size=34>Hehe. Then I reckon I'll be seein' ya more often!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hehe. Kalau gitu, kayaknya aku bakal lebih sering ketemu kamu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerGiveItem_NeedMore_001
Array.english: Here you go.
Array.indonesia: Ini dia.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerGiveItem_NeedMore_002
Array.english: Hmm? Feels like somethin's missin'.\nTake another look, will ya?
Array.indonesia: Hmm? Rasanya ada yang kurang.\nCoba lihat lagi, ya?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerGiveItem_NoItem_001
Array.english: Ah... guess I was mistaken.\nI haven't found it yet.
Array.indonesia: Ah... kayaknya aku salah.\nAku belum menemukannya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerGiveItem_NoItem_002
Array.english: <size=32>I'll keep looking.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku akan terus mencari.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerRefuseGiveItem_001
Array.english: Not yet... I'll keep looking a bit longer.
Array.indonesia: Belum... Aku akan terus mencari sebentar lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerStart_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm... they all flew away...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm... mereka semua terbang pergi...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerStart_002
Array.english: What's wrong?
Array.indonesia: Ada apa?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerStart_003
Array.english: The <color=#F1DC2B>Fireflies</color> I kept in a jar for light at home...\nthey all escaped.
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Kunang-kunang</color> yang aku simpan di toples untuk penerangan di rumah...\nsemuanya kabur.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerStart_004
Array.english: I had them instead of lanterns so the lizards wouldn't be uncomfortable at night.
Array.indonesia: Aku memelihara mereka sebagai pengganti lentera agar kadal-kadal tidak merasa tidak nyaman di malam hari.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerStart_005
Array.english: I see...\nIs there anything I can help with?
Array.indonesia: Begitu...\nAda yang bisa kubantu?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerStart_006
Array.english: Ah... I tried catching them again, but it's not going very well...
Array.indonesia: Ah... Aku sudah mencoba menangkapnya lagi, tapi sepertinya tidak berhasil...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerStart_007
Array.english: <size=32>Could you catch <color=#F1DC2B>3 Fireflies</color> for me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Bisakah kamu menangkap <color=#F1DC2B>3 kunang-kunang</color> untukku?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerStart_008
Array.english: Oh... but I don't have anything to catch them with...
Array.indonesia: Oh... tapi aku tidak punya alat untuk menangkapnya...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerStart_009
Array.english: Ah! Right...\nThen...
Array.indonesia: Ah! Benar juga...\nKalau begitu...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerStart_010
Array.english: <size=33>Here, take this <color=#1DFEAF>Bug Net</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ini, ambil <color=#1DFEAF>Jaring Serangga</color> ini.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerStart_011
Array.english: Oh... this should work!
Array.indonesia: Oh... ini pasti bisa!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerStart_012
Array.english: <size=32>Leave it to me, haha.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Serahkan saja padaku, haha.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerDelivery_001
Array.english: Oh, Dave. Were you able to catch the <color=#F1DC2B>Fireflies</color>?
Array.indonesia: Oh, Dave. Apakah kamu sudah berhasil menangkap <color=#F1DC2B>Kunang-kunang</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerDelivery_Option01
Array.english: Yes, I got them
Array.indonesia: Ya, aku sudah menangkapnya

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerDelivery_Option02
Array.english: Hmm... not yet
Array.indonesia: Hmm... belum

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerGiveItem_Finished_001
Array.english: <size=31>Here are <color=#F1DC2B>3 Fireflies</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Ini <color=#F1DC2B>3 kunang-kunang</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerGiveItem_Finished_002
Array.english: <size=34>Oh my, thank you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wah, terima kasih!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerGiveItem_Finished_003
Array.english: Now I can have some light at night so the lizards won't be uncomfortable.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang aku bisa punya sedikit cahaya di malam hari agar kadal-kadal itu tidak merasa tidak nyaman.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerGiveItem_Finished_004
Array.english: <size=33>Thank you, Dave.\nYou're really very kind.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Terima kasih, Dave.\nKamu benar-benar sangat baik.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerGiveItem_Finished_005
Array.english: <size=33>Ha... haha! It's nothing, really...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ha... haha! Sebenarnya nggak ada apa-apa...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerGiveItem_Finished_006
Array.english: Please keep up the good work.
Array.indonesia: Tolong teruskan kerja bagusmu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerGiveItem_NeedMore_001
Array.english: <size=33>Here you go, Lipah.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ini untukmu, Lipah.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerGiveItem_NeedMore_002
Array.english: Oh, that's not 3 yet.\nI'll need a little more.
Array.indonesia: Oh, itu belum 3.\nAku butuh sedikit lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerGiveItem_NoItem_001
Array.english: Actually, I haven't caught them yet.\nI'll let you know when I do!
Array.indonesia: Sebenarnya, aku belum menangkapnya.\nAku akan memberitahumu kalau sudah!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerRefuseGiveItem_001
Array.english: <size=33>Not yet. I'll catch them next time!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Belum. Aku akan menangkapnya lain kali!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_NotEnoughtimeToDive_001
Array.english: I should hurry\nif I want to get into the lake.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus bergegas\nkalau mau masuk ke danau.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_TimeOverToDive_001
Array.english: If I go into the lake again, I'll be worn out tonight.\nBetter save it for tomorrow.
Array.indonesia: Kalau aku masuk ke danau lagi, aku pasti kelelahan malam ini.\nMendingan ditunda sampai besok.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_GoodMorning_001
Array.english: <size=33>Yaaawn. Slept well...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aaaah... Ngantuk. Tidur nyenyak...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_GoodMorning_002
Array.english: <size=33>Alright, let's make the most of today!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oke, ayo manfaatkan hari ini sebaik-baiknya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_GoodMorning02_001
Array.english: <size=35>Yaaawn...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Aaaah... </size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_GoodMorning02_002
Array.english: <size=32>I dreamed about food, now I'm starving...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku bermimpi tentang makanan, sekarang aku lapar sekali...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_Morning_LateWakeup_001
Array.english: <size=32>Went to bed late... feeling a bit stiff.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tidur larut... badan terasa sedikit kaku.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_Morning_LateWakeup_002
Array.english: <size=32>Still, gotta get moving.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tapi, harus mulai bergerak.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_Morning_LateWakeup02_001
Array.english: <size=32>Yaaawn. Morning already.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aaaah. Sudah pagi.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_Morning_LateWakeup02_002
Array.english: <size=32>Stayed up a bit too late last night... still tired.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tadi malam begadang agak terlalu larut... masih lelah.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_Morning_LateWakeupMAX_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, it's already this late?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, sudah segini larut?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_Morning_LateWakeupMAX_002
Array.english: <size=32>I totally overslept...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku benar-benar ketiduran...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_Morning_LateWakeupMAX02_001
Array.english: <size=32>Ugh... already this late...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ugh... sudah segini larut...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_Morning_LateWakeupMAX02_002
Array.english: <size=30>Stayed up late and slept like a rock.\nBetter get moving.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=30>Begadang dan tidur nyenyak banget.\nMendingan mulai bergerak.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_SushiBarTime_001
Array.english: <size=33>It's about time to head to the restaurant.\nLet's go help with prep.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Sudah waktunya berangkat ke restoran.\nAyo bantu persiapan.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_AfterWorkDefault01_001
Array.english: <size=32>Phew, long day.\nMaybe I'll look around a bit before bed?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wah, hari yang panjang.\nMungkin aku bakal jalan-jalan sebentar sebelum tidur?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_NightPenalty_001
Array.english: I'm getting pretty tired... If I stay up much longer,\nit'll affect tomorrow.
Array.indonesia: Aku mulai merasa sangat lelah... Kalau aku begadang lebih lama lagi,\nitu akan berpengaruh pada besok hari.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_NightPenalty_Option01
Array.english: Keep going <color=#fde221><size=20>(You'll wake up late tomorrow)</size></color>
Array.indonesia: Teruslah begadang <color=#fde221><size=20>(Kamu akan bangun terlambat besok)</size></color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_NightPenalty_Option02
Array.english: <image=UI_Jungle_Dialogue_Noti_Icon_Sleep, preset=Dialogue_KR/>Go to bed
Array.indonesia: <image=UI_Jungle_Dialogue_Noti_Icon_Sleep, preset=Dialogue_KR/>Pergilah tidur

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_NightPenalty_PlayMore_001
Array.english: I'm a bit tired, but... let's explore just a bit more.
Array.indonesia: Aku agak lelah, tapi... ayo kita jelajahi sedikit lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_NightPenalty_GoToBed_001
Array.english: <size=32>I should get some rest for tomorrow.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Seharusnya aku istirahat dulu buat besok.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_NightFinish_001
Array.english: Ugh... too tired to go on... Z... Z... Z...
Array.indonesia: Ugh... terlalu lelah buat lanjut... Z... Z... Z...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_NightWarning01_001
Array.english: If I stay up too late, tomorrow's gonna be rough...\nHmm?
Array.indonesia: Kalau aku begadang terlalu larut, besok pasti bakal berat...\nHmm?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_NightWarning02_001
Array.english: I'm so sleepy my eyes are starting to close... ugh.
Array.indonesia: Aku ngantuk banget sampai mataku mulai terpejam... ugh.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_NightBedTimeFirstDay_001
Array.english: Hmm... the bed looks a bit stiff.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... tempat tidurnya kelihatan agak keras.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_NightBedTimeFirstDay_002
Array.english: But the village chief went out of his way to set this up for me.
Array.indonesia: Tapi kepala desa sudah repot-repot menyiapkan ini untukku.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_NightBedTimeFirstDay_003
Array.english: I'm so tired, I'll probably fall asleep right away anyway...
Array.indonesia: Aku sangat lelah, mungkin aku akan langsung tertidur juga...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_NightBedTime_001
Array.english: <size=33>Time to call it a night.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Waktunya tidur.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_LateNightBedTime_001
Array.english: <size=33>It's getting pretty late...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Sudah cukup larut...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_NightBedTime_Option01
Array.english: <image=UI_Jungle_Dialogue_Noti_Icon_Sleep, preset=Dialogue_KR/>Go to sleep
Array.indonesia: <image=UI_Jungle_Dialogue_Noti_Icon_Sleep, preset=Dialogue_KR/>Tidurlah

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_NightBedTime_Option02
Array.english: Look around a bit more
Array.indonesia: Lihat-lihat sebentar lagi

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_NightBedTime_PlayMore_001
Array.english: Not that sleepy yet. I'll look around a bit more.
Array.indonesia: Belum terlalu mengantuk. Aku akan melihat-lihat sebentar lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_NightBedTime_GoToBed_001
Array.english: Better get some sleep for tomorrow. Yawn.
Array.indonesia: Lebih baik tidur dulu untuk besok. Menguap.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_GetNPCRequestMission_001
Array.english: <size=32>Got a request. I should jot it down.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ada permintaan. Sebaiknya aku menuliskannya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCBarricade_TimeOverToDive_001
Array.english: Can't go back in there today.\nLet's get the shop ready.
Array.indonesia: Tidak bisa kembali ke sana hari ini.\nAyo siapkan tokonya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Common_NotNowMinigame_001
Array.english: <size=34>Hmm... now's not really the time for games.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hmm... sekarang bukan waktunya main-main.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Introduce_DaveHouse01_001
Array.english: <size=32>Greetings, outsider.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Salam, orang luar.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Introduce_DaveHouse01_002
Array.english: Yes, Chief? What is it?
Array.indonesia: Ya, Kepala? Ada apa?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Introduce_DaveHouse01_003
Array.english: I was so occupied discussing cooking earlier that I neglected to mention...
Array.indonesia: Tadi aku terlalu sibuk membicarakan masakan sampai lupa menyebutkan...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Introduce_DaveHouse02_001
Array.english: <size=34>You may use this house as well.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kamu juga boleh menggunakan rumah ini.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Introduce_DaveHouse02_002
Array.english: It is a bit old, but... It should suffice for you to stay in for a while.
Array.indonesia: Memang agak tua, tapi... Seharusnya cukup untuk kamu tinggal sementara waktu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Introduce_DaveHouse02_003
Array.english: Oh, and you are... a diver, was it?
Array.indonesia: Oh, dan kamu... seorang penyelam, kan?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Introduce_DaveHouse02_004
Array.english: Yes. I'm a professional with quite a bit of experience.\nHaha.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Saya seorang profesional dengan pengalaman yang cukup banyak.\nHaha.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Introduce_DaveHouse02_005
Array.english: I see. If you wish to enter the lake, use the deck over there.
Array.indonesia: Begitu. Jika kamu ingin masuk ke danau, gunakan dek di sana.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Introduce_DivingDeck_001
Array.english: The lake is not in great condition at the moment,\nso do not go too deep.
Array.indonesia: Kondisi danau sedang tidak terlalu baik saat ini,\njadi jangan masuk terlalu dalam.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_SushibarGrade_001
Array.english: <size=32>It seems you are ready to open.\nMost impressive.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Sepertinya kamu sudah siap untuk membuka usaha.\nSungguh mengesankan.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_SushibarGrade_002
Array.english: Oh, Chief! Thanks to you, we got everything sorted out quickly.
Array.indonesia: Oh, Kepala! Berkat Kamu, semuanya bisa diselesaikan dengan cepat.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_SushibarGrade_003
Array.english: We're planning to start serving food to the villagers today. We've stocked up on ingredients as well.
Array.indonesia: Kami berencana mulai menyajikan makanan kepada penduduk desa hari ini. Bahan-bahannya juga sudah kami siapkan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_SushibarGrade_004
Array.english: I have informed the villagers that you will be opening a restaurant... but I am unsure how many will come.
Array.indonesia: Saya sudah memberi tahu penduduk desa bahwa Kamu akan membuka restoran... tapi saya tidak yakin berapa banyak yang akan datang.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_SushibarGrade_005
Array.english: As you build rapport with the residents, they will gradually lower their guard.
Array.indonesia: Seiring Kamu membangun hubungan baik dengan penduduk, mereka akan perlahan-lahan menurunkan kewaspadaan mereka.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_SushibarGrade_006
Array.english: <size=33>If I leave you a <color=#ff885f>Badge</color> of recognition here, the villagers may trust you a bit more.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Jika saya meninggalkan <color=#ff885f>Lencana</color> pengakuan di sini, mungkin penduduk desa akan lebih mempercayai Kamu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_SushibarGrade_007
Array.english: <size=33>For now, I shall hang this <color=#ff885f>Mouse-Deer Badge</color> here. The villagers will take it as a sign that the food is good.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Untuk saat ini, saya akan menggantung <color=#ff885f>Lencana Rusa Tikus</color> ini di sini. Penduduk desa akan menganggapnya sebagai tanda bahwa makanannya enak.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_SushibarGrade_008
Array.english: Oh, thank you! Let's hope the villagers feel more at ease now!
Array.indonesia: Oh, terima kasih! Semoga para penduduk desa merasa lebih tenang sekarang!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_SushibarGrade_009
Array.english: Hmm. But how do I raise the <color=#ff885f>Badge</color>'s Rating?
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Tapi bagaimana cara menaikkan Peringkat <color=#ff885f>Lencana</color> ini?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_SushibarGrade_010
Array.english: I shall tell you a few conditions.\nFulfill them, and I will grant you a new badge.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan memberitahumu beberapa syarat.\nPenuhi syarat-syarat itu, dan aku akan memberimu lencana baru.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_SushibarGrade_011
Array.english: Got it. We'll do well.
Array.indonesia: Paham. Kita pasti bisa melakukannya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_001
Array.english: <size=32>Haa... haa... finally... a village... with people...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haa... haa... akhirnya... sebuah desa... dengan orang-orang...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_002
Array.english: <size=36>...Sato?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>...Sato?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_003
Array.english: <size=32>Huh...?! Dave? Is that you...?\nWhat are the odds...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Huh...?! Dave? Apa itu kamu...?\nSiapa sangka...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_004
Array.english: <size=33>W-Water... please... just water first...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>A-Air... tolong... air dulu saja...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_005
Array.english: <size=33>Y-Yeah... here!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Y-Ya... ini!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_006
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Gulp... gulp...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Teguk... teguk...)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_007
Array.english: <size=35>Phew!! That hit the spot!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wah!! Itu pas banget!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_008
Array.english: What are you doing out here?
Array.indonesia: Apa yang kamu lakukan di sini?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_009
Array.english: Oh, I'm staying in the village with Dr. Bacon while we do some research in the jungle.
Array.indonesia: Oh, aku tinggal di desa bersama Dr. Bacon sementara kami melakukan penelitian di hutan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_010
Array.english: Ohhh, got it! Well, since we ran into each other...
Array.indonesia: Ohhh, paham! Nah, karena kita kebetulan bertemu...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_011
Array.english: <size=34>Mind if I stay here for a while too?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Bolehkah aku tinggal di sini sebentar juga?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_012
Array.english: Of course. You can stay near the tents, away from the villagers.
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja. Kamu bisa tinggal di dekat tenda-tenda, jauh dari penduduk desa.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_013
Array.english: How did you end up all the way out here?
Array.indonesia: Bagaimana kamu bisa sampai sejauh ini?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_014
Array.english: I was using this new app called <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color>...\nand next thing I knew, I was here.
Array.indonesia: Aku sedang menggunakan aplikasi baru bernama <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color>...\ndan tiba-tiba saja, aku sudah ada di sini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_015
Array.english: <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color>...?\nIs that different from Marinca?
Array.indonesia: <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color>...?\nApakah itu berbeda dari Marinca?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_016
Array.english: Yes! Exactly! There were some complaints about the original app...
Array.indonesia: Ya! Tepat sekali! Ada beberapa keluhan tentang aplikasi aslinya...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_017
Array.english: People would swim forever, walk for ages to collect Marinca... but none of it was being tracked!
Array.indonesia: Orang-orang berenang tanpa henti, berjalan berjam-jam untuk mengumpulkan Marinca... tapi tidak ada yang tercatat!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_018
Array.english: <size=33>So they made a spin-off app, <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color>!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Jadi mereka membuat aplikasi spin-off, <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color>!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_019
Array.english: <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color> tracks your steps... and even your swimming distance!
Array.indonesia: <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color> mencatat langkahmu... dan bahkan jarak renangmu!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_020
Array.english: <size=32>All that gets turned into points to grow a <color=#1DFEAF>Giant Flower</color> \nin the app!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Semua itu diubah menjadi poin untuk menumbuhkan <color=#1DFEAF>Bunga Raksasa</color> \ndi dalam aplikasi!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_021
Array.english: When the <color=#1DFEAF>Giant Flower</color> blooms, you're supposed to get some kind of reward... Though, I haven't confirmed that yet. Still working on my collection.
Array.indonesia: Saat <color=#1DFEAF>Bunga Raksasa</color> mekar, kamu seharusnya mendapatkan semacam hadiah... Meskipun, aku belum memastikannya. Masih mengumpulkan koleksiku.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_022
Array.english: <size=33>Oh! By the way...\nDid you bring your phone?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh! Ngomong-ngomong...\nKamu bawa ponselmu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_023
Array.english: Yeah... but most apps don't work here. It's too remote.
Array.indonesia: Ya... tapi kebanyakan aplikasi nggak bisa dipakai di sini. Terlalu terpencil.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_024
Array.english: Haha! That's the best part! <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color> uses the Space Network. No connection issues, even out here!
Array.indonesia: Haha! Itu bagian terbaiknya! <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color> menggunakan Space Network. Nggak ada masalah koneksi, bahkan di sini!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_025
Array.english: Actually, it's still in beta, so you need a friend code... \nAnd you're in luck, I've got one left!
Array.indonesia: Sebenarnya, ini masih dalam versi beta, jadi kamu butuh kode teman... \nDan kamu beruntung, aku masih punya satu!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_026
Array.english: <size=34>Wanna take your first step as a Marinca Bloom collector?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Mau mulai langkah pertamamu sebagai kolektor Marinca Bloom?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option01
Array.english: Sounds fun!
Array.indonesia: Kedengarannya seru!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option02
Array.english: Not right now...
Array.indonesia: Nggak sekarang...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option01Answer_001
Array.english: <size=32>That sounds great!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kedengarannya keren!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option01Answer_002
Array.english: But... how do I get started?
Array.indonesia: Tapi... gimana cara memulainya?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option01Answer_003
Array.english: Haha! Take out your phone.\nI'll send you the code!
Array.indonesia: Haha! Keluarkan ponselmu.\nAku akan mengirimkan kodenya!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option01Answer_004
Array.english: Hm? I got some kind of link.
Array.indonesia: Hm? Aku dapat semacam tautan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option01Answer_005
Array.english: <size=33>Haha! Just install it from there!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Haha! Cukup instal dari sana!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option01Answer_006
Array.english: Basically, just like Marinca. Catch fish, unlock cards, completion goes up automatically.
Array.indonesia: Pada dasarnya, sama seperti Marinca. Tangkap ikan, buka kartu, tingkat penyelesaiannya naik secara otomatis.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option01Answer_007
Array.english: But just collecting cards isn't enough to grow the <color=#F1DC2B>Seed</color>.
Array.indonesia: Tapi hanya mengumpulkan kartu saja tidak cukup untuk menumbuhkan <color=#F1DC2B>Seed</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option01Answer_008
Array.english: You'll need to keep its health up...
Array.indonesia: Kamu harus menjaga kesehatannya...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option01Answer_009
Array.english: For that, you'll need <color=#F1DC2B>Nutrients</color> and <color=#F1DC2B>Water</color>.
Array.indonesia: Untuk itu, kamu butuh <color=#F1DC2B>Nutrients</color> dan <color=#F1DC2B>Water</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option01Answer_010
Array.english: I see. And how do I get those?
Array.indonesia: Oh, begitu. Lalu, bagaimana cara mendapatkannya?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option01Answer_011
Array.english: That's where <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color> works its magic! \nYour steps and swimming distance get converted into points!
Array.indonesia: Di situlah <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color> menunjukkan kehebatannya! \nLangkah dan jarak renangmu akan diubah menjadi poin!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option01Answer_012
Array.english: Anyway, better to try it yourself than listen to me ramble!
Array.indonesia: Pokoknya, lebih baik kamu mencobanya sendiri daripada mendengarkan omong kosongku!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option01Answer_013
Array.english: I'll be around the village, so just ask if you need anything.
Array.indonesia: Aku bakal ada di sekitar desa, jadi kalau butuh apa-apa, tanya aja.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option01Answer_014
Array.english: <size=35>Chu... I mean, Monmon!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Chu... Maksudku, Monmon!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option02Answer_001
Array.english: I've got a lot to focus on right now...\nso this might be a bit tough.
Array.indonesia: Aku lagi punya banyak hal yang harus dikerjakan sekarang...\njadi ini mungkin bakal agak sulit.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option02Answer_002
Array.english: <size=32>Ha! Dave! \nThat's exactly who <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color> is for!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ha! Dave! \nItulah tepatnya untuk siapa <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color> diciptakan!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option02Answer_003
Array.english: The distance you cover underwater...\nThe steps you take on land...
Array.indonesia: Jarak yang kamu tempuh di bawah air...\nLangkah-langkah yang kamu ambil di darat...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option02Answer_004
Array.english: It all gets tracked and converted into\n<color=#F1DC2B>Nutrients</color> and <color=#F1DC2B>Water</color>!
Array.indonesia: Semuanya dilacak dan diubah menjadi\n<color=#F1DC2B>Nutrisi</color> dan <color=#F1DC2B>Air</color>!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option02Answer_005
Array.english: <color=#F1DC2B>Nutrients</color> and <color=#F1DC2B>Water</color>...?\nHow do I use those?
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Nutrisi</color> dan <color=#F1DC2B>Air</color>...?\nBagaimana cara menggunakannya?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option02Answer_006
Array.english: <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color> works pretty much like Marinca. Catch fish, unlock cards, and your completion goes up automatically.
Array.indonesia: <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color> bekerja hampir sama seperti Marinca. Tangkap ikan, buka kartu, dan tingkat penyelesaianmu akan naik secara otomatis.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option02Answer_007
Array.english: But collecting cards alone isn't enough to grow the <color=#F1DC2B>Seed</color>.
Array.indonesia: Namun, mengumpulkan kartu saja tidak cukup untuk menumbuhkan <color=#F1DC2B>Benih</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option02Answer_008
Array.english: You'll need to keep its health up...
Array.indonesia: Kamu harus menjaga kesehatannya tetap prima...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option02Answer_009
Array.english: For that, you'll need <color=#F1DC2B>Nutrients</color> and <color=#F1DC2B>Water</color>.
Array.indonesia: Untuk itu, kamu membutuhkan <color=#F1DC2B>Nutrisi</color> dan <color=#F1DC2B>Air</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option02Answer_010
Array.english: Anyway, better to try it yourself than listen to me ramble!
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun, lebih baik kamu mencobanya sendiri daripada mendengarkan omong kosongku!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option02Answer_011
Array.english: I just sent you an invite link, go ahead and install it!
Array.indonesia: Aku baru saja mengirimmu tautan undangan, silakan instal!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option02Answer_012
Array.english: I'll be resting in the village, so feel free to ask if you need anything.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan beristirahat di desa, jadi jangan ragu untuk bertanya jika kamu membutuhkan sesuatu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option02Answer_013
Array.english: <size=35>Chu... I mean, Monmon!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Chu... maksudku, Monmon!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_BeforeTalk_001
Array.english: Hmm. Just as I thought, not many villagers are coming by.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Seperti yang kuduga, tidak banyak penduduk desa yang mampir.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_BeforeTalk_002
Array.english: Yeah...\nI think they're a bit wary of us.
Array.indonesia: Ya...\nKurasa mereka agak waspada terhadap kita.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_FirstMeet_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hello... you must be the outsiders?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Halo... kalian pasti orang luar, ya?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_FirstMeet_002
Array.english: Who are you...?\nOh, were you the one who brought us food...?
Array.indonesia: Siapa kamu...?\nOh, apakah kamu yang membawakan kami makanan...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_FirstMeet_003
Array.english: Yes, I'm <color=#F1DC2B>Uzme</color>, the village chief's daughter.
Array.indonesia: Ya, aku <color=#F1DC2B>Uzme</color>, putri kepala desa.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_FirstMeet_004
Array.english: <size=33>Thank you for the food yesterday.\nThe taste was quite terri...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Terima kasih atas makanannya kemarin.\nRasanya cukup mengerikan...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_FirstMeet_005
Array.english: <size=39>Bancho!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=39>Bancho!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_FirstMeet_006
Array.english: Hahaha, it's okay! I tried a proper chef's cooking at the restaurant earlier... and it was on a whole different level.
Array.indonesia: Hahaha, tidak apa-apa! Tadi aku mencoba masakan koki profesional di restoran... dan rasanya benar-benar beda level.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_FirstMeet_007
Array.english: <size=34>Call me Bancho.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Panggil saja aku Bancho.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_FirstMeet_008
Array.english: <size=32>Nice to meet you, Bancho...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Senang bertemu denganmu, Bancho...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_FirstMeet_009
Array.english: <size=32>And who's this with you?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Dan siapa yang bersamamu ini?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_FirstMeet_010
Array.english: I'm Dave. A professional diver.
Array.indonesia: Aku Dave. Seorang penyelam profesional.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_FirstMeet_011
Array.english: Nice to meet you, Dave.\nIf you don't mind...
Array.indonesia: Senang bertemu denganmu, Dave.\nKalau kamu tidak keberatan...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_FirstMeet_012
Array.english: <size=34>How about I show you around the village?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Bagaimana kalau aku ajak kamu berkeliling desa?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_FirstMeet_013
Array.english: Oh... that sounds great. I've been curious about a lot of things while exploring.
Array.indonesia: Oh... kedengarannya bagus. Aku penasaran dengan banyak hal selama menjelajah.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_FirstMeet_014
Array.english: Haha... You'll be staying here for a while... I thought it'd be nice if you got to know the village a bit better.
Array.indonesia: Haha... Kamu akan tinggal di sini untuk sementara waktu... Kupikir akan menyenangkan jika kamu mengenal desa ini sedikit lebih baik.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_FirstMeet_015
Array.english: Hmm. I have some cleaning up to do...\nThank you for the offer, but you two go ahead.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Aku harus membersihkan beberapa hal...\nTerima kasih atas tawarannya, tapi kalian berdua silakan saja.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_FirstMeet_016
Array.english: <size=42><color=#E3E3E3>(...)</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42><color=#E3E3E3>(...)</color></size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_Stone_001
Array.english: Have you heard... about the recent earthquakes?
Array.indonesia: Apa kamu sudah dengar... tentang gempa bumi baru-baru ini?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_Stone_002
Array.english: Yes. I heard the fish have become more sensitive because of it.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Aku dengar ikan-ikan jadi lebih sensitif karena itu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_Stone_003
Array.english: That's right. Recently, there was a major earthquake, and rocks fell... The path to <color=#1DFEAF>Setah Forest</color> has been blocked.
Array.indonesia: Benar. Baru-baru ini terjadi gempa bumi besar, dan batu-batu berjatuhan... Jalan menuju <color=#1DFEAF>Hutan Setah</color> telah terhalang.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_Stone_004
Array.english: It's good that wild animals can't get in, but... I'm worried, since things that never used to happen are happening lately.
Array.indonesia: Memang bagus bahwa hewan liar tidak bisa masuk, tapi... aku khawatir, karena hal-hal yang dulu tidak pernah terjadi kini mulai terjadi belakangan ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_NightDive_001
Array.english: Now, crocodiles come to the lake to rest at night.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang, buaya datang ke danau untuk beristirahat di malam hari.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_NightDive_002
Array.english: They won't attack without warning, but...\nIt's still best not to go into the lake at night.
Array.indonesia: Mereka tidak akan menyerang tanpa peringatan, tapi...\nTetap saja sebaiknya jangan masuk ke danau pada malam hari.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_NightDive_003
Array.english: When I was young, my father... was injured by a crocodile while trying to save me.
Array.indonesia: Ketika aku masih kecil, ayahku... terluka oleh buaya saat mencoba menyelamatkanku.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_NightDive_004
Array.english: So that's why he has trouble with his leg...
Array.indonesia: Itulah sebabnya kakinya mengalami masalah...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_Beach_001
Array.english: This is the sandy beach. It's where villagers gather by the bonfire or enjoy the night air.
Array.indonesia: Ini adalah pantai berpasir. Di sinilah penduduk desa berkumpul di sekitar api unggun atau menikmati udara malam.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_Beach_002
Array.english: It's a beautiful place, but that dinosaur carcass does smell \na bit...
Array.indonesia: Tempatnya indah, tapi bangkai dinosaurus itu memang berbau \nsedikit...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_Beach_003
Array.english: I heard it suddenly floated in at night and startled the residents.
Array.indonesia: Kudengar bangkai itu tiba-tiba hanyut ke sini pada malam hari dan mengejutkan para penduduk.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_Beach_004
Array.english: I can imagine how shocking that must've been.
Array.indonesia: Aku bisa membayangkan betapa mengejutkannya hal itu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_CampFire_001
Array.english: There are some men sitting by the bonfire today.
Array.indonesia: Hari ini ada beberapa pria yang duduk di dekat api unggun.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_CampFire_002
Array.english: <size=32>I wonder if they're gossiping about their wives? Hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku penasaran, apakah mereka sedang bergosip tentang istri-istri mereka? Hehe.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_GiftUnlock_001
Array.english: I... come here to look at the lake when I have a lot on my mind.
Array.indonesia: Aku... datang ke sini untuk melihat danau saat pikiranku sedang penuh.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_GiftUnlock_002
Array.english: Dave, do you have any worries?
Array.indonesia: Dave, apakah kamu punya kekhawatiran?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_GiftUnlock_003
Array.english: Well... I'm a bit worried that the villagers aren't really coming to our restaurant, even though we worked hard preparing the ingredients.
Array.indonesia: Yah... Aku agak khawatir penduduk desa tidak benar-benar datang ke restoran kita, padahal kita sudah bekerja keras menyiapkan bahan-bahannya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_GiftUnlock_004
Array.english: Haha. The villagers probably won't be quick to try an outsider's cooking.
Array.indonesia: Haha. Penduduk desa mungkin tidak akan langsung mau mencoba masakan orang luar.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_GiftUnlock_005
Array.english: Try talking with them, or...
Array.indonesia: Coba bicaralah dengan mereka, atau...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_GiftUnlock_006
Array.english: <size=35>How about giving them <color=#FF73C3>Gifts</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Bagaimana kalau kita memberi mereka <color=#FF73C3>Hadiah</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_GiftUnlock_007
Array.english: It's a tradition in our village to give and receive <color=#FF73C3>Gifts</color>.
Array.indonesia: Memberi dan menerima <color=#FF73C3>Hadiah</color> adalah tradisi di desa kita.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_GiftUnlock_008
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, that sounds like a good idea!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, kedengarannya ide yang bagus!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_GiftUnlock_009
Array.english: Everyone has different tastes... so it'd be a good idea to learn their preferences.
Array.indonesia: Setiap orang punya selera yang berbeda... jadi sebaiknya kita cari tahu preferensi mereka.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_MiniMapUnlock_001
Array.english: Oh, now that I think about it... have you had any trouble getting around the village?
Array.indonesia: Oh, sekarang setelah aku memikirkannya... apakah kamu mengalami kesulitan berkeliling desa?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_MiniMapUnlock_002
Array.english: Actually... the houses all look pretty similar,\nand I'm not used to it yet, so it's a bit confusing.
Array.indonesia: Sebenarnya... semua rumah terlihat cukup mirip,\ndan aku belum terbiasa, jadi agak membingungkan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_MiniMapUnlock_003
Array.english: Hehe! That happens when you're new somewhere.
Array.indonesia: Hehe! Itu biasa terjadi saat kamu baru di suatu tempat.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_MiniMapUnlock_004
Array.english: <size=33>Here... this is a <color=#1DFEAF>Map</color> of the village.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ini... ini adalah <color=#1DFEAF>Peta</color> desa.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_MiniMapUnlock_005
Array.english: With this, you'll be able to find people and places much more easily.
Array.indonesia: Dengan ini, kamu akan bisa menemukan orang dan tempat dengan jauh lebih mudah.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_MiniMapUnlock_006
Array.english: <size=35>Oh... this will really help.\nThank you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh... ini benar-benar akan membantu.\nTerima kasih!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_MiniMapUnlock_007
Array.english: Same goes for Bancho... I'm happy when everyone feels comfortable here.
Array.indonesia: Begitu juga dengan Bancho... Aku senang kalau semua orang merasa nyaman di sini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_FirstEntryHazardZone_001
Array.english: Oh... It's actually fine with the <color=#F1DC2B>Purification Filter</color>.\nBetter explore before it runs out!
Array.indonesia: Oh... Sebenarnya tidak apa-apa dengan <color=#F1DC2B>Filter Pemurnian</color>.\nLebih baik kita jelajahi sebelum habis!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_FirstDay_HazardZoneLook_001
Array.english: <size=33>Down there... it looks really murky...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Di bawah sana... kelihatannya sangat keruh...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_FirstDay_HazardZoneLook_002
Array.english: <color=#F1DC2B>Tilapia</color> usually stay near the surface...\nSo I don't need to go too deep.
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Ikan nila</color> biasanya berada di dekat permukaan... \nJadi aku tidak perlu turun terlalu dalam.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_Lake_A_WoodenBarricade_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm? This area's blocked off with stakes.\nI wonder why...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm? Area ini diblokir dengan tiang-tiang.\nAku penasaran kenapa...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_HazardWarning_NeedFilterUpgrade_001
Array.english: <size=32>Ugh... the hydrogen sulfide is too dense down here. I'd better not go any deeper with this <color=#F1DC2B>Purification Filter</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ugh... hidrogen sulfida di sini terlalu pekat. Sebaiknya aku tidak turun lebih dalam lagi dengan <color=#F1DC2B>Filter Pemurnian</color> ini.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_HazardWarning_NeedFilterUpgrade_002
Array.english: <size=32>Come to think of it, Muna said she could modify the <color=#F1DC2B>Purification Filter</color>. I should go see her later.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kalau dipikir-pikir, Muna bilang dia bisa memodifikasi <color=#F1DC2B>Filter Pemurnian</color>. Nanti aku harus menemuinya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_FitstLookEscapeBell_001
Array.english: <size=32>That stone with the coconut must be the escape tool the chief mentioned. I'll have to use it when getting out of the water.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Batu yang ada kelapanya itu pasti alat pelarian yang disebutkan kepala suku. Aku harus menggunakannya saat keluar dari air.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_FitstLookWaterCave_001
Array.english: <size=32>Clean water's coming out from inside there?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Air bersih keluar dari dalam sana?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_FitstLookWaterCave_002
Array.english: <size=32>But the current's too strong to get close...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tapi arusnya terlalu kuat untuk mendekat...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_MonkeyFirstAppear_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh no! A <color=#F1DC2B>Macaque</color> is trying to steal the guest's food!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh tidak! Seekor <color=#F1DC2B>Monyet</color> mencoba mencuri makanan para tamu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_MonkeyFirstAppear_002
Array.english: Hmm. Looks like clearing that big rock let the macaques come up from the forest.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Sepertinya setelah batu besar itu disingkirkan, monyet-monyet itu bisa keluar dari hutan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_MonkeyFirstAppear_003
Array.english: <size=33>Drive off the <color=#F1DC2B>Macaques</color> before they snatch the guests' food!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Usir <color=#F1DC2B>monyet-monyet</color> itu sebelum mereka merebut makanan para tamu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_FitstLookCleanLake_001
Array.english: <size=34>The lake's really cleared up, hasn't it?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Danau ini benar-benar sudah jernih, ya?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_FitstLookCleanLake_002
Array.english: <size=34>Looks like there are some new fish, too.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Sepertinya ada ikan-ikan baru juga.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_FitstLookCleanLake_003
Array.english: <size=34>Now the villagers have one less thing to worry about!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Sekarang penduduk desa punya satu hal kurang yang perlu dikhawatirkan!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_SkewerFirstOrder_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... a <color=#F1DC2B>Skewer</color> order just came in.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... pesanan <color=#F1DC2B>Sate</color> baru saja masuk.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_SkewerFirstOrder_002
Array.english: <size=32>I'll have to grill and serve it myself, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku harus memanggang dan menyajikannya sendiri, kan?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_SkewerFirstOrder_003
Array.english: <size=32>Better not leave it on too long... or it'll burn.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Sebaiknya jangan dibiarkan terlalu lama... atau akan gosong.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_FirstUseGrill_001
Array.english: <size=32>This is the <color=#F1DC2B>Skewer Grill</color> Peneb made for us.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ini adalah <color=#F1DC2B>Skewer Grill</color> yang dibuat Peneb untuk kita.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_FirstUseGrill_002
Array.english: <size=32>Bancho has to stay in the kitchen, so I'll handle the grilling and serving.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Bancho harus tetap di dapur, jadi aku yang akan mengurus memanggang dan menyajikannya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_FirstUseGrill_003
Array.english: <size=32>Better not leave them on too long or they'll burn.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Sebaiknya jangan dibiarkan terlalu lama, kalau tidak akan gosong.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_RPG_TryMinigame_001
Array.english:
<size=34>Dave, what's with the game all of a sudden!
Focus up!</size>
Array.indonesia:
<size=34>Dave, kenapa tiba-tiba main game!
Fokus dong!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_RPG_TryMinigame_002
Array.english: <size=32>Fair enough... I'll do it later.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Baiklah... aku akan melakukannya nanti.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_CanNotGoBluehole_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm... I've got something important to do right now, so maybe I shouldn't head to the Bluehole.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm... Aku punya urusan penting sekarang, jadi mungkin sebaiknya aku tidak pergi ke Bluehole.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Bacon_Interaction_Select_01
Array.english: <size=34>What is it, Dave?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ada apa, Dave?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Bancho_Interaction_Select_01
Array.english: <size=34>What can I do for you?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ada yang bisa kubantu?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Cobra_Interaction_Select_01
Array.english: <size=34>Hahaha! What's up!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hahaha! Ada apa!</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Chief_Interaction_Select_Lv01_01
Array.english: <size=34>What is it?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ada apa?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Chief_Interaction_Select_Lv03_01
Array.english: <size=34>What brings you here?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Apa yang membawamu ke sini?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Carpenter_Interaction_Select_Lv01_01
Array.english: <size=34>Hmm? What is it?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hmm? Ada apa?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Carpenter_Interaction_Select_Lv03_01
Array.english: <size=34>Something up?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ada masalah?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Farmer_Interaction_Select_Lv01_01
Array.english: <size=34>I'm busy, what is it?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku sedang sibuk, ada apa?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Farmer_Interaction_Select_Lv03_01
Array.english: <size=34>What's the matter?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ada apa?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Fisherman_Interaction_Select_Lv01_01
Array.english: <size=34>What's goin' on?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ada apa?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Fisherman_Interaction_Select_Lv03_01
Array.english: <size=34>Need help with somethin'?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Butuh bantuan untuk sesuatu?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Herbalist_Interaction_Select_Lv01_01
Array.english: <size=34>Why'd you call me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kenapa kamu meneleponku?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Herbalist_Interaction_Select_Lv03_01
Array.english: <size=34>What can I do for you, Dave?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Chief_Interaction_Return_Lv03_01

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Carpenter_Interaction_Return_Lv01_01
Array.english: <size=34>Hm? Got more to say?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Carpenter_Interaction_Return_Lv03_01

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Farmer_Interaction_Return_Lv01_01

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Farmer_Interaction_Return_Lv03_01
Array.english: <size=34>If you need something else, just say it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kalau kamu butuh sesuatu lagi, bilang saja.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Fisherman_Interaction_Return_Lv01_01
Array.english: <size=34>Got somethin' else on your mind?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ada hal lain yang ada di pikiranmu?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Fisherman_Interaction_Return_Lv03_01
Array.english: <size=34>If there's more, go on and say it.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Herbalist_Interaction_Return_Lv01_01
Array.english: <size=34>Is there something else you'd like to discuss?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Herbalist_Interaction_Return_Lv03_01

Array.indonesia: <size=34>Silakan, sampaikan saja apa yang ada di pikiranmu.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Lipah_Interaction_Return_Lv01_01
Array.english: <size=34>Is there something else you'd like to say?</size>
