Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Lipah_Interaction_Return_Lv03_01
Array.english: <size=34>Feel free to say whatever you like.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Jangan ragu untuk mengatakan apa pun yang kamu inginkan.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Muna_Interaction_Return_Lv02_01
Array.english: <size=34>Anything else you're curious about?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ada hal lain yang ingin kamu tanyakan?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Muna_Interaction_Return_Lv03_01
Array.english: <size=34>Wanna talk a bit more?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Mau ngobrol lagi sebentar?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Rimbo_Interaction_Return_Lv02_01
Array.english: <size=34>You've got more to say, don't ya?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kamu masih punya yang mau diungkapkan, kan?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Rimbo_Interaction_Return_Lv03_01
Array.english: <size=34>Ask me anything, Dave.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Tanya saja apa pun, Dave.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Uzme_Interaction_Return_Lv02_01
Array.english: <size=34>You have something more to discuss?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ada hal lain yang ingin kamu bahas?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Uzme_Interaction_Return_Lv03_01
Array.english: <size=34>Shall we talk a bit more?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Mau kita ngobrol lagi sebentar?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Bacon_Talk_Select_01
Array.english: <size=34>I've got time, go ahead!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku punya waktu, silakan!</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Bancho_Talk_Select_01
Array.english: <size=34>What would you like to talk about?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Mau ngobrolin apa?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Cobra_Talk_Select_01
Array.english: <size=34>Go on. I'm listening.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Silakan. Aku mendengarkan.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Chief_Talk_Select_Lv01_01
Array.english: <size=34>What's on your mind?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Apa yang ada di pikiranmu?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Chief_Talk_Select_Lv03_01
Array.english: <size=34>No need to hesitate.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Nggak perlu ragu-ragu.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Carpenter_Talk_Select_Lv01_01
Array.english: <size=34>Something you're curious about?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ada yang bikin kamu penasaran?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Carpenter_Talk_Select_Lv03_01
Array.english: <size=34>Heh. Got a question? Spit it out.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Heh. Ada pertanyaan? Langsung aja.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Farmer_Talk_Select_Lv01_01
Array.english: <size=34>Geez... I'm busy, so what is it?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Astaga... Aku lagi sibuk, jadi apa sih?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Farmer_Talk_Select_Lv03_01
Array.english: <size=34>If you've got something to say, go ahead.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kalau ada yang mau kamu katakan, silakan.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Fisherman_Talk_Select_Lv01_01
Array.english: <size=34>What're ya curious about?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Apa yang bikin kamu penasaran?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Fisherman_Talk_Select_Lv03_01
Array.english: <size=34>Ah, got somethin' to say?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ah, ada yang mau kamu katakan?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Herbalist_Talk_Select_Lv01_01
Array.english: <size=34>Go ahead and speak up.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Silakan bicara.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Herbalist_Talk_Select_Lv03_01
Array.english: <size=34>Whatever it is, just say it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Apa pun itu, katakan saja.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Lipah_Talk_Select_Lv01_01
Array.english: <size=34>What are you curious about?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Apa yang ingin kamu tanyakan?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Lipah_Talk_Select_Lv03_01
Array.english: <size=34>Ask me anything, Dave. Hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Tanya apa saja, Dave. Hehe.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Muna_Talk_Select_Lv02_01
Array.english: <size=34>Sure. What should we talk about?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Tentu. Mau ngobrolin apa?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Muna_Talk_Select_Lv03_01
Array.english: <size=34>Oh, sounds good. What do you wanna know?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh, kedengarannya bagus. Apa yang mau kamu tahu?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Rimbo_Talk_Select_Lv02_01
Array.english: <size=34>What's on your mind?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Apa yang ada di pikiranmu?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Rimbo_Talk_Select_Lv03_01
Array.english: <size=34>Go on, say whatever you like.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ayo, katakan apa saja yang kamu mau.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Uzme_Talk_Select_Lv02_01
Array.english: <size=34>What would you like to chat about?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Tentang apa kamu ingin ngobrol?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Uzme_Talk_Select_Lv03_01
Array.english: <size=34>Ask me anything, Dave.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Tanya apa saja, Dave.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Bacon_Interaction_End_01
Array.english: <size=33>The jungle's quite a fascinating place.\nStay safe out there!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hutan itu tempat yang cukup menarik.\nHati-hati di sana!</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Bancho_Interaction_End_01
Array.english: <size=33>If you come across any interesting ingredients, \nlet me know.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kalau kamu menemukan bahan-bahan menarik, \nberi tahu aku.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Cobra_Interaction_End_01
Array.english: <size=33>If you need help, just give me a shout.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kalau butuh bantuan, panggil saja aku.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Chief_Interaction_End_Lv01_01
Array.english: <size=33>You're here to investigate, but try not to cause too much trouble.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kamu di sini untuk menyelidiki, tapi usahakan jangan bikin masalah terlalu banyak.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Chief_Interaction_End_Lv03_01
Array.english: <size=33>If you need anything, let me know.\nI'll see what I can do.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kalau kamu butuh apa-apa, beri tahu aku.\nAku akan lihat apa yang bisa aku lakukan.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Carpenter_Interaction_End_Lv01_01
Array.english: <size=33>Oof, my arms are killing me. Time for a break.\nLet's talk again later.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wah, lenganku sakit sekali. Waktunya istirahat.\nKita bicara lagi nanti.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Carpenter_Interaction_End_Lv03_01
Array.english: <size=33>Thanks to you, I don't have to go far to work. That's nice. Come by more often.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Berkat kamu, aku tidak perlu pergi jauh untuk bekerja. Itu bagus. Mampir lagi ya.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Farmer_Interaction_End_Lv01_01
Array.english: <size=33>I'm busy, so don't bother me too much.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku sibuk, jadi jangan terlalu sering menggangguku.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Farmer_Interaction_End_Lv03_01
Array.english: <size=33>Take care. Don't worry about the farm. I'm the expert here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Jaga diri baik-baik. Jangan khawatir soal peternakan. Aku yang ahli di sini.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Fisherman_Interaction_End_Lv01_01
Array.english: <size=33>Watch your step. Make too much noise and you'll scare the fish off.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hati-hati langkahmu. Kalau terlalu berisik, ikan-ikannya bakal kabur.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Fisherman_Interaction_End_Lv03_01
Array.english: <size=33>If ya need anything, come find me. I'm always up for talkin' about fishin', haha.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kalau butuh apa-apa, cari aku aja. Aku selalu siap ngobrol soal memancing, haha.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Herbalist_Interaction_End_Lv01_01
Array.english: Well, take care.\nStop by if you need spices.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah, jaga diri ya.\nMampir saja kalau butuh rempah-rempah.

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Herbalist_Interaction_End_Lv03_01
Array.english: Well, take care.\nCome by anytime you need herbs or spices.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah, jaga diri ya.\nMampir kapan saja kalau butuh bumbu atau rempah-rempah.

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Lipah_Interaction_End_Lv01_01
Array.english: <size=32>I hope you'll come to appreciate the beauty of life in this village, Dave.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Semoga kamu bisa menghargai keindahan hidup di desa ini, Dave.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Lipah_Interaction_End_Lv03_01
Array.english: <size=33>It was nice talking with you, Dave. Feel free to stop by anytime for a chat.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Senang bisa ngobrol sama kamu, Dave. Jangan ragu mampir kapan saja buat ngobrol.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Muna_Interaction_End_Lv02_01
Array.english: <size=34>Hope that helped!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Semoga ini membantu!</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Muna_Interaction_End_Lv03_01
Array.english: <size=33>Hehe, if you need anything, just let me know anytime.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hehe, kalau butuh apa-apa, bilang aja kapan saja.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Rimbo_Interaction_End_Lv02_01
Array.english: <size=32>If you've got somethin' to sell...\nor need a ride somewhere, just give me a shout.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kalau kamu punya barang yang mau dijual...\natau butuh tumpangan ke suatu tempat, bilang saja padaku.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Rimbo_Interaction_End_Lv03_01
Array.english: <size=32>Seeing you around the village feels natural now, Dave. Haha.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Sekarang rasanya sudah biasa melihatmu di sekitar desa, Dave. Haha.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Uzme_Interaction_End_Lv02_01
Array.english: <size=34>Well then, have a great day, Dave.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Baiklah, semoga harimu menyenangkan, Dave.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Uzme_Interaction_End_Lv03_01
Array.english: <size=34>It was nice talking with you, Dave.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Senang bisa ngobrol sama kamu, Dave.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCBarricade_NightDivingBlock_01
Array.english: <size=32>There are so many crocodiles...! Going in at night doesn't seem like a good idea.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ada banyak sekali buaya...! Masuk ke sana di malam hari sepertinya bukan ide yang bagus.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCBarricade_DivingBlock_LateAfternoon
Array.english: <size=32>If I go into the lake now, I won't make it back before the restaurant opens.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kalau aku masuk ke danau sekarang, aku nggak bakal bisa balik sebelum restoran buka.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCBarricade_Ingame_FirstDay_Bottom_001
Array.english: <size=32>Ugh...\nThe smell's too strong to go any deeper.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ugh...\nBaunya terlalu menyengat untuk masuk lebih dalam.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCBarricade_Ingame_FirstDay_Right_001
Array.english: <size=32>I shouldn't wander too far right now. Better stay near the village.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku sebaiknya tidak menjelajah terlalu jauh sekarang. Lebih baik tetap di dekat desa.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCBarricade_DoorLocked_Night_001
Array.english: The door's closed.\nBetter not bother them. I'll come back later.
Array.indonesia: Pintunya tertutup.\nLebih baik tidak mengganggu mereka. Aku akan kembali nanti.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCBarricade_TownOutBlock_001
Array.english: It'd be dangerous to just head out. I should ask Rimbo how to get to the dock.
Array.indonesia: Akan berbahaya kalau langsung pergi begitu saja. Aku harus tanya Rimbo cara menuju dermaga.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCBarricade_Ingame_EscapeBell_001
Array.english: <size=32>The rescue pod's on its way. I should stay close.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kapal penyelamat sedang dalam perjalanan. Aku sebaiknya tetap di dekat sini.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCBarricade_Ingame_chapter02_001
Array.english: <size=32>Ugh, the hydrogen sulfide here is really thick... I can't go down there in this condition.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ugh, hidrogen sulfida di sini benar-benar pekat... Aku tidak bisa turun ke sana dalam kondisi seperti ini.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCBarricade_Ingame_chapter02try_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ugh, the hydrogen sulfide down there is too strong. Better not go down right now.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ugh, hidrogen sulfida di bawah sana terlalu pekat. Lebih baik tidak turun sekarang.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCBarricade_Ingame_Basilosaurus_001
Array.english: <size=33>If I go any further, I'll get eaten...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kalau aku melangkah lebih jauh, aku akan dimakan...!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Chief_Normal_001
Array.english: <size=31>Hmm... this isn't really my kind of drink.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Hmm... minuman ini sebenarnya bukan seleraku.</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Chief_Normal_002
Array.english: <size=32>I prefer the local coconut liquor... or <color=#FF73C3>Wine</color> suits my palate much better.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku lebih suka minuman kelapa lokal... atau <color=#FF73C3>anggur</color> jauh lebih cocok dengan seleraku.</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Chief_Normal_003
Array.english: <size=33>Why not give it to someone who'd appreciate it more?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kenapa tidak memberikannya kepada orang yang lebih menghargainya?</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Chief_Normal02_001
Array.english: Well... I appreciate the thought, but...\nsomeone else would probably make better use of it.
Array.indonesia: Yah... aku menghargai niatmu, tapi...\norang lain mungkin akan memanfaatkannya dengan lebih baik.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Chief_Normal02_002
Array.english: <size=32>I'll have to pass. Try offering it to someone else.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku harus menolaknya. Coba tawarkan ke orang lain.</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Chief_Good_001
Array.english:
<size=33><color=#F1DC2B>{0}</color>, is it?
Very well, I'll accept it.</size>
Array.indonesia:
<size=33><color=#F1DC2B>{0}</color>, ya?
Baiklah, aku akan menerimanya.</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Chief_Excelent_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... this is a bottle of <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>, isn't it?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... ini sebotol <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>, kan?</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Chief_Excelent_002
Array.english: <size=33>This happens to be a Merlot, my favorite variety. The smooth taste is exquisite.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ternyata ini Merlot, varietas favoritku. Rasanya yang lembut sungguh nikmat.</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Chief_Excelent_003
Array.english: <size=32>I'll savor it little by little, haha.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku akan menikmatinya sedikit demi sedikit, haha.</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Muna_Normal_001
Array.english: <size=32>Um... I'm not much of a drinker.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Um... Aku bukan orang yang suka minum.</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Muna_Normal_002
Array.english: <size=32>It makes it hard to focus on my research. Maybe give it to someone else?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hal itu membuatku sulit berkonsentrasi pada penelitianku. Mungkin sebaiknya kuberikan ke orang lain?</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Muna_Normal02_001
Array.english: Um... I'm sorry.\nI think someone else might like this more.
Array.indonesia: Um... Maaf.\nKurasa mungkin ada orang lain yang lebih menyukai ini.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Muna_Good_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... <color=#F1DC2B>{0}</color>, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... <color=#F1DC2B>{0}</color>, kan?</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Muna_Good_002

Array.english: Hehe. I hope we can keep getting along well.
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Semoga kita bisa terus akur.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Lipah_Excelent01_3TierOrangeBlackBigEye_001
Array.english: <size=33>Wow! A <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color><color=#ff61e3>♥</color>!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wow! Sebuah <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color><color=#ff61e3>♥</color>!!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Lipah_Excelent01_3TierOrangeBlackBigEye_002
Array.english: <size=31>What a pretty little thing, with those orange and black stripes!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Benda kecil yang cantik sekali, dengan garis-garis oranye dan hitam itu!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Lipah_Excelent01_3TierOrangeBlackBigEye_003
Array.english: <size=32>Right? It looks like a tiger!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Iya kan? Kelihatannya seperti harimau!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Lipah_Excelent01_3TierOrangeBlackBigEye_004
Array.english: It's one of my favorite species, so I kept a <color=#FF73C3>Keychain</color> of it...
Array.indonesia: Itu salah satu spesies favoritku, jadi aku menyimpan <color=#FF73C3>gantungan kunci</color> bergambar harimau...

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Lipah_Excelent01_3TierOrangeBlackBigEye_005
Array.english: But since you brought me the real thing, I'd like to give you this <color=#FF73C3>Keychain</color> as a thank you.
Array.indonesia: Tapi karena kamu membawakan aku yang asli, aku ingin memberimu <color=#FF73C3>gantungan kunci</color> ini sebagai ucapan terima kasih.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Lipah_Excelent01_3TierOrangeBlackBigEye_006
Array.english: <size=34>Oh... thank you...\nIt's really beautiful.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh... terima kasih...\nIni benar-benar indah.</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Lipah_Excelent01_3TierOrangeBlackBigEye_007
Array.english: Hehe. I hope we can keep getting along well.
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Semoga kita bisa terus akur.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Farmer_Normal_001
Array.english: <size=31>Huh? Isn't this something kids play with?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Hah? Bukankah ini mainan anak-anak?</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Farmer_Normal_002
Array.english: <size=32>What, are you making fun of me...?\nGive it to someone else!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Apa, kamu sedang mengolok-olokku...?\nBerikan saja ke orang lain!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Farmer_Normal02_001
Array.english: <size=32>You think you can win me over with flowers?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kamu pikir bisa memikatku dengan bunga?</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Farmer_Normal02_002
Array.english: <size=32>Not a chance!\nTake it back.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tidak mungkin!\nAmbil kembali.</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Farmer_Normal03_001
Array.english: <size=33>...Hmm.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...Hmm.</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Farmer_Normal03_002
Array.english: <size=32>No matter how I look at it, I've got no use for this. Take it back.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Bagaimanapun aku melihatnya, aku nggak butuh ini. Ambil kembali.</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Farmer_Good_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ha! <color=#F1DC2B>{0}</color>, for me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ha! <color=#F1DC2B>{0}</color>, buat aku?</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Farmer_Good_002
Array.english: Hmph... It'll come in handy somewhere.\nI'll thank you for now, I guess.
Array.indonesia: Hmph... Nanti pasti berguna di suatu tempat.\nAku akan berterima kasih dulu, kurasa.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Farmer_Good02_001
Array.english: Hmm... <color=#F1DC2B>{0}</color>, huh....
Array.indonesia: Hmm... <color=#F1DC2B>{0}</color>, ya....

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Farmer_Good02_002
Array.english: Can't say I know much about this thing, but...\nEh, looks like you were tryin', so I'll hang on to it.
Array.indonesia: Aku nggak tahu banyak soal benda ini, tapi...\nEh, sepertinya kamu udah berusaha, jadi aku simpan aja.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Farmer_Excelent_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh?! Is this a <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh?! Apa ini <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>?!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Farmer_Excelent_002
Array.english: <size=32>When you're out in the field for a while, you start craving something cold.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kalau sudah lama di lapangan, kamu pasti mulai ngidam sesuatu yang dingin.</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Farmer_Excelent_003
Array.english: <size=32>I can keep it here and have a drink when I need one.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku bisa menyimpannya di sini dan minum saat membutuhkannya.</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Farmer_Excelent_004
Array.english: <size=33>Ha! Thanks for this!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ha! Terima kasih ya!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Farmer_Excelent02_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hmm? Isn't this <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hmm? Bukankah ini <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>?</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Farmer_Excelent02_002
Array.english: <size=32>Ha! You've got a sharper eye than I thought.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ha! Matamu lebih tajam dari yang aku kira.</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Farmer_Excelent02_003
Array.english: <size=32>My back's been killing me from squatting so long lately, but now I can get the weeding done quicker.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Punggungku sakit sekali karena terlalu lama jongkok belakangan ini, tapi sekarang aku bisa menyelesaikan penyiangan lebih cepat.</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Farmer_Excelent02_004
Array.english: <size=34>Well, thanks for now, I guess!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Yah, terima kasih untuk saat ini, kurasa!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Uzme_Normal_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... is this <color=#F1DC2B>Alcohol</color>...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... apakah ini <color=#F1DC2B>Minuman beralkohol</color>...?</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Uzme_Normal_002
Array.english: <size=33>Hmm... I think Dad's been sneaking drinks behind my back...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hmm... sepertinya Ayah diam-diam minum di belakang punggungku...</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Uzme_Normal_003
Array.english: <size=32>It'd be awkward to keep this at home... I should give it to someone else.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Akan canggung kalau menyimpannya di rumah... Sebaiknya aku berikan ke orang lain.</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Uzme_Normal02_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh my, how pretty.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wah, cantik sekali.</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Uzme_Normal02_002
Array.english: <size=32>But wouldn't the village children like these more?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tapi bukankah anak-anak desa akan lebih menyukai ini?</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Uzme_Normal03_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh my, I appreciate the thought, but I think someone else would like this more than I would.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wah, aku menghargai niatmu, tapi kurasa orang lain akan lebih menyukai ini daripada aku.</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Uzme_Good_001
Array.english: <size=33><color=#F1DC2B>{0}</color>, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33><color=#F1DC2B>{0}</color>, kan?</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Uzme_Good_002
Array.english: What an unexpected gift.\nThank you, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Hadiah yang tak terduga.\nTerima kasih, Dave.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Uzme_Excelent_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh my! <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>...!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Astaga! <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>...!?</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Uzme_Excelent_002
Array.english: This village is quite far from the sea, but sometimes <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color> washes up like this.
Array.indonesia: Desa ini cukup jauh dari laut, tapi kadang-kadang <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color> terdampar seperti ini.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Uzme_Excelent_003
Array.english: <size=32>Isn't the color beautiful? Hoho.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Warnanya indah, bukan? Hoho.</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Uzme_Excelent_004
Array.english: <size=34>I'll display it nicely in my room.\nThank you so much.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku akan memajangnya dengan rapi di kamarku.\nTerima kasih banyak.</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Uzme_Excelent02_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh my, is this a <color=#FF73C3>Coral Necklace</color>...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wah, apakah ini <color=#FF73C3>Kalung Karang</color>...?</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Uzme_Excelent02_002
Array.english: Who could have woven it so beautifully...?
Array.indonesia: Siapa yang bisa menganyamnya seindah ini...?

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Uzme_Excelent02_003
Array.english: Doesn't quite look like your handiwork, Dave. Hehe.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya bukan hasil karyamu, Dave. Hehe.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Uzme_Excelent02_004
Array.english: Heh. I found it in the sea beneath the lake.\nI thought you'd like it, so I brought it to you.
Array.indonesia: Heh. Aku menemukannya di laut di bawah danau.\nKupikir kamu akan menyukainya, jadi aku membawakannya untukmu.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Uzme_Excelent02_005
Array.english: Heh, how thoughtful of you.\nThank you. I'll treasure it!
Array.indonesia: Heh, kamu sangat perhatian.\nTerima kasih. Aku akan menyimpannya dengan baik!

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Harta_Normal_001
Array.english: Hmm... <color=#F1DC2B>{0}</color>...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... <color=#F1DC2B>{0}</color>...

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Harta_Normal_002
Array.english: I think someone else might like this more...\nWhy not give it to them?
Array.indonesia: Menurutku mungkin ada orang lain yang lebih suka ini...\nKenapa tidak memberikannya kepada mereka saja?

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Harta_Normal_003
Array.english: Thanks for thinking of me anyway.
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih sudah memikirkanku.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Harta_Normal02_001
Array.english: Hmm... I think kids would like this more?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Menurutku anak-anak mungkin lebih suka ini?

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Harta_Good_001
Array.english: <size=32>Ooh... <color=#F1DC2B>{0}</color>, huh?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ooh... <color=#F1DC2B>{0}</color>, ya?</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Harta_Good_002
Array.english: Hehe, thanks.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, terima kasih.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Harta_Excelent_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh...! This is a <color=#F1DC2B>{0}</color>, isn't it?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh...! Ini <color=#F1DC2B>{0}</color>, kan?</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Harta_Excelent_002
Array.english: They say carrying gold brings good luck, hehe.
Array.indonesia: Katanya membawa emas membawa keberuntungan, hehe.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Harta_Excelent_003
Array.english: Wow... thanks for this, pal.\nYou really know what I like.
Array.indonesia: Wow... terima kasih ya, sobat.\nKamu benar-benar tahu apa yang aku suka.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Harta_Excelent_004
Array.english: <size=33>With taste like that, I bet the girls love you, haha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Dengan selera seperti itu, aku yakin cewek-cewek pasti suka sama kamu, haha!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Harta_Excelent_005
Array.english: <size=33>Anyway, thanks. Let's hang out again sometime.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Pokoknya, terima kasih. Ayo main bareng lagi lain kali.</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Harta_Excelent02_001
Array.english: <size=34>Haha! Did I mention I like <color=#FF73C3>Alchohol</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Haha! Apa aku sudah bilang kalau aku suka <color=#FF73C3>alkohol</color>?</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Harta_Excelent02_002
Array.english: <size=32>What? You could tell just by looking?\nAw, come on...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Apa? Kamu bisa tahu cuma dengan melihatnya?\nAh, ayolah...</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Harta_Excelent02_003
Array.english: <size=32>Well, you're right!\nI'll enjoy this, hahaha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ya, kamu benar!\nAku akan menikmati ini, hahaha!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Gesang_Normal_001
Array.english: <size=34>Whoa...! If I bring something like this home, I'll get in trouble!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wah...! Kalau aku bawa pulang barang kayak gini, aku bakal kena masalah!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Gesang_Normal_002
Array.english: <size=34>Give it to someone else...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kasih aja ke orang lain...!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Gesang_Normal_003
Array.english: I can just mooch some later...
Array.indonesia: Nanti aku bisa minta sedikit aja...

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Gesang_Normal02_001
Array.english: This looks like something a girl like <color=#F1DC2B>Saniah</color> would enjoy.
Array.indonesia: Ini kelihatannya sesuatu yang akan disukai cewek seperti <color=#F1DC2B>Saniah</color>.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Gesang_Normal02_002
Array.english: I don't need it, so take it back.
Array.indonesia: Aku nggak butuh ini, jadi bawa balik aja.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Gesang_Normal03_001
Array.english: If I bring useless stuff home, my wife will tear me apart.
Array.indonesia: Kalau aku bawa barang nggak berguna ke rumah, istriku bakal marah besar.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Gesang_Normal03_002
Array.english: Give this to someone else...\nand get me something better.
Array.indonesia: Kasih ini ke orang lain...\ndan beliin aku yang lebih bagus.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Gesang_Good_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hm? <color=#F1DC2B>{0}</color>, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hm? <color=#F1DC2B>{0}</color>, kan?</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Gesang_Good_002
Array.english: I'll have to hide this somewhere my wife won't find it.\nThanks.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus menyembunyikan ini di tempat yang nggak bakal ketahuan istriku.\nMakasih.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Gesang_Excelent_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh! <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>, no way!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh! <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>, nggak mungkin!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Gesang_Excelent_002
Array.english: How'd you know I like this?\nYou've got a good eye.
Array.indonesia: Kok kamu tahu aku suka ini?\nKamu punya selera yang bagus.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Gesang_Excelent_003
Array.english: My wife's definitely gonna ask where I got this.\nBetter hide it well.
Array.indonesia: Istriku pasti bakal nanya dari mana aku dapet ini.\nMending disembunyiin baik-baik.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Gesang_Excelent02_001
Array.english: <size=32>Chandra likes <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Chandra suka <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>, kan?</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Gesang_Excelent02_002
Array.english: I should take this home and score some points, huh?\nHehe, thanks.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus bawa pulang ini biar dapat pujian, ya?\nHehe, makasih.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Chandra_Normal_001
Array.english: Ugh... If I keep something like this at home,\nmy husband might take an interest in it.
Array.indonesia: Ugh... Kalau aku simpan barang kayak gini di rumah,\nsuamiku mungkin bakal tertarik sama ini.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Chandra_Normal_002
Array.english: Please give it to someone else.\nOr just throw it away!
Array.indonesia: Tolong kasih ke orang lain aja.\nAtau buang aja!

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Chandra_Normal02_001
Array.english: I'm not really fond of animals... Maybe give it to someone else?
Array.indonesia: Aku nggak terlalu suka binatang... Mungkin sebaiknya diberikan ke orang lain?

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Chandra_Normal03_001
Array.english: I don't like having too many things at home.
Array.indonesia: Aku nggak suka punya terlalu banyak barang di rumah.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Chandra_Normal03_002
Array.english: Why not give this to someone else?
Array.indonesia: Kenapa nggak kasih ini ke orang lain aja?

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Chandra_Good_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh my, <color=#F1DC2B>{0}</color>, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Astaga, <color=#F1DC2B>{0}</color>, kan?</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Chandra_Good_002
Array.english: Giving out gifts like this... you're more thoughtful than you look, outsider.
Array.indonesia: Memberi hadiah seperti ini... kamu lebih perhatian daripada yang terlihat, orang luar.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Chandra_Good_003
Array.english: I'll gladly take it, hehe.
Array.indonesia: Aku dengan senang hati menerimanya, hehe.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Chandra_Excelent_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh my, a <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Astaga, sebuah <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>?</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Chandra_Excelent_002
Array.english: How did you know I love pearls...\nOh my...
Array.indonesia: Bagaimana kamu tahu aku suka mutiara...\nAstaga...

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Chandra_Excelent_003
Array.english: I should have my husband make me a new accessory.\nThank you!
Array.indonesia: Seharusnya aku minta suamiku membuatkan aku aksesori baru.\nTerima kasih!

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Normal_001
Array.english: Hmm... this kind of book...\nI don't think it's my taste...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... buku seperti ini...\nSepertinya bukan seleraku...

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Normal_002
Array.english: Wouldn't it be better to give it to someone else?
Array.indonesia: Bukankah lebih baik memberikannya kepada orang lain?

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Normal02_001
Array.english: <size=32>Ah...! I... don't really like insects...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ah...! Aku... sebenarnya tidak terlalu suka serangga...</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Normal02_002
Array.english: <size=33>I'm sorry, but... could you put that away...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Maaf, tapi... bisakah kamu menyimpannya...</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Normal03_001
Array.english: <size=32>Well... I appreciate the thought, but...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Yah... aku menghargai niatmu, tapi...</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Normal03_002
Array.english: <size=32>It's not really my taste.\nWouldn't someone else like it more?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ini bukan seleraku.\nBukankah orang lain akan lebih menyukainya?</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Good_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh wow, <color=#F1DC2B>{0}</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wah, <color=#F1DC2B>{0}</color>?</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Good_002
Array.english: Thank you for thinking of me, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih sudah memikirkanku, Dave.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Excelent_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh my...! A <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Astaga...! Sebuah <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>?</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Excelent_002
Array.english: This is the book I've been wanting to read.\nI was sad I couldn't find it...
Array.indonesia: Ini buku yang sudah lama ingin kubaca.\nAku sedih karena tidak bisa menemukannya...

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Excelent_003
Array.english: Thank you, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih, Dave.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Excelent02_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh my...! <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Astaga...! <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>?</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Excelent02_002
Array.english: I needed this just now...\nHow did you know?
Array.indonesia: Aku sangat membutuhkannya sekarang...\nBagaimana kamu tahu?

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Excelent02_003
Array.english: Thanks to you, I can write poetry without worry.\nThank you, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Berkat kamu, aku bisa menulis puisi tanpa khawatir.\nTerima kasih, Dave.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Normal_001
Array.english: Hmm... this is...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... ini...

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Normal_002
Array.english: I think young children would like this more.\nBut thank you for the thought.
Array.indonesia: Menurutku anak-anak kecil akan lebih menyukai ini.\nTapi terima kasih atas perhatiannya.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Normal02_001
Array.english: Hoho... I should stop drinking for my health.
Array.indonesia: Hoho... aku harus berhenti minum demi kesehatanku.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Normal02_002
Array.english: You should give it to someone who enjoys it.
Array.indonesia: Kamu sebaiknya memberikannya kepada seseorang yang menyukainya.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Normal03_001
Array.english: As I get older, I find I need less and less.
Array.indonesia: Seiring bertambahnya usia, aku merasa kebutuhanku semakin berkurang.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Normal03_002
Array.english: I'm quite alright, so why not give it to someone else?
Array.indonesia: Aku baik-baik saja, jadi mengapa tidak memberikannya kepada orang lain?

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Good_001
Array.english: <size=32>Ooh... Is this for me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ooh... Apakah ini untukku?</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Good_002
Array.english: Gifts are always lovely...\nThank you.
Array.indonesia: Hadiah selalu menyenangkan...\nTerima kasih.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Excelent_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ooh...! Oh my, a <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wah...! Astaga, sebuah <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>...!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Excelent_002
Array.english: You went all the way to Surga Falls to pick this for me?
Array.indonesia: Kamu pergi jauh-jauh ke Air Terjun Surga hanya untuk mengambil ini untukku?

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Excelent_003
Array.english: Thank you so much.\nMay the spirits always watch over you.
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih banyak.\nSemoga roh-roh selalu melindungimu.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Excelent02_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hoho... Are you giving me this <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hoho... Kamu mau ngasih <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color> ini ke aku?</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Excelent02_002
Array.english: <size=33>My shoulder's been bothering me lately...\nThis is just what I needed.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Bahu aku belakangan ini sering sakit...\nIni persis yang aku butuhkan.</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Excelent02_003
Array.english: Thank you so much.\nMay the spirits always watch over you.
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih banyak.\nSemoga roh-roh selalu melindungimu.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungMan_Normal_001
Array.english: Ah... this is... hmm.
Array.indonesia: Ah... ini... hmm.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungMan_Normal_002
Array.english: I need to focus on my music, so I don't really need this.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus fokus pada musikku, jadi aku sebenarnya tidak butuh ini.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungMan_Normal_003
Array.english: Maybe you should give it to someone else.
Array.indonesia: Mungkin sebaiknya kamu memberikannya kepada orang lain.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungMan_Normal02_001
Array.english: Hmm... I don't have the headspace to care for a living creature right now.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Aku tidak punya waktu luang untuk merawat makhluk hidup saat ini.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungMan_Normal02_002
Array.english: You should find someone else to give it to.
Array.indonesia: Sebaiknya kamu cari orang lain untuk memberikannya.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungMan_Normal03_001
Array.english: <size=33>What? I'm not old enough to drink yet!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Apa? Aku belum cukup umur untuk minum!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungMan_Good_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hm? <color=#F1DC2B>{0}</color>, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hm? <color=#F1DC2B>{0}</color>, kan?</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungMan_Good_002
Array.english: Not right now, but...\nI might need it someday.
Array.indonesia: Tidak sekarang, tapi...\nMungkin suatu hari nanti aku akan membutuhkannya.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungMan_Good_003
Array.english: <size=32>Thanks anyway.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Terima kasih anyway.</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungMan_Excelent_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh...! A <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh...! Sebuah <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>!?</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungMan_Excelent_002
Array.english: Hmm. I usually stream my music, but...\n<color=#FF73C3>CDs</color> are fun to collect.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Biasanya aku mendengarkan musik lewat streaming, tapi...\n<color=#FF73C3>CD</color> itu seru untuk dikoleksi.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungMan_Excelent_003
Array.english: I'll add this to my collection, hehe.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan menambahkan ini ke koleksiku, hehe.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungMan_Excelent02_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh...! Could this be a <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh...! Mungkinkah ini <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>!?</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungMan_Excelent02_002
Array.english: <size=32>Most of this world is just noise...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Sebagian besar dunia ini hanyalah kebisingan...</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungMan_Excelent02_003
Array.english: <size=32>With this, I can shut everything out and lose myself in the music.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Dengan ini, aku bisa mengabaikan segalanya dan larut dalam musik.</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungMan_Excelent02_004
Array.english: <size=34>Hehe, you really understand an artist's heart. Thank you, mister.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hehe, kamu benar-benar mengerti hati seorang seniman. Terima kasih, Pak.</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungManAfter_Normal_001
Array.english: Oh wow... what is this...?
Array.indonesia: Wah... apa ini...?

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungManAfter_Normal_002
Array.english: Hmm... this doesn't really inspire me.\nWhy not give it to someone else?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... ini nggak terlalu menginspirasi aku.\nKenapa nggak diberikan saja ke orang lain?

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungManAfter_Normal02_001
Array.english: Oh... a <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>, huh...
Array.indonesia: Oh... sebuah <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>, ya...

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungManAfter_Normal02_002
Array.english: As a musician, there's not much I can do with this.\nI'll have to pass.
Array.indonesia: Sebagai musisi, aku nggak bisa berbuat banyak dengan ini.\nAku harus menolaknya.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungManAfter_Normal03_001
Array.english: They say musicians enjoy a drink, but...
Array.indonesia: Katanya musisi suka minum, tapi...

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungManAfter_Normal03_002
Array.english: My coming-of-age ceremony was rough enough.\nI don't feel like drinking anymore...
Array.indonesia: Upacara kedewasaan saya sudah cukup berat.\nSaya tidak ingin minum lagi...

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungManAfter_Good_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh wow... <color=#F1DC2B>{0}</color> for me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wah... <color=#F1DC2B>{0}</color> untuk saya?</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungManAfter_Good_002
Array.english: <size=32>Not bad!\nThanks, yeah!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Lumayan!\nTerima kasih, ya!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungManAfter_Excelent_001
Array.english: <size=32>Wow! Is this a <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wow! Apa ini <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>?!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungManAfter_Excelent_002
Array.english: This plastic CD case... There's something about it you just don't get with digital.
Array.indonesia: Kotak CD plastik ini... Ada sesuatu di dalamnya yang tidak bisa kamu rasakan dari versi digital.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungManAfter_Excelent_003
Array.english: <size=33>What a thoughtful gift!\nI really like it, yeah!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hadiah yang sangat perhatian!\nAku benar-benar menyukainya, ya!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungManAfter_Excelent02_001
Array.english: <size=33>Wow! Is this really a <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wow! Apakah ini benar-benar <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>!?</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungManAfter_Excelent02_002
Array.english: <size=32>Most of this world is just noise...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Sebagian besar dunia ini hanyalah kebisingan...</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungManAfter_Excelent02_003
Array.english: <size=32>Now I can shut everything out and become one with the music.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Sekarang aku bisa mengabaikan segalanya dan menyatu dengan musik.</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungManAfter_Excelent02_004
Array.english: <size=34>You really understand an artist's heart.\nThank you, mister!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kamu benar-benar memahami hati seorang seniman.\nTerima kasih, Pak!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Princessy_Normal_001
Array.english: Hmm... what's this...?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... apa ini...?

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Princessy_Normal_002
Array.english: <size=34>Oh! <color=#F1DC2B>{0}</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh! <color=#F1DC2B>{0}</color>!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Princessy_Normal_003
Array.english: Giving living things as gifts...\nis terribly inconsiderate.
Array.indonesia: Memberikan makhluk hidup sebagai hadiah...\nitu sangat tidak bijaksana.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Princessy_Normal_004
Array.english: <size=34>You should take it back!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kamu harus mengembalikannya!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Princessy_Normal02_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm... I'm not the type to chase fleeting pleasures like this.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm... Aku bukan tipe orang yang mengejar kesenangan sesaat seperti ini.</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Princessy_Normal02_002
Array.english: <size=32>I appreciate the gesture, but I'll have to decline.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku menghargai niat baikmu, tapi aku harus menolaknya.</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Princessy_Normal03_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm... when giving a gift, you should consider what the other person likes.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm... saat memberikan hadiah, kamu harus mempertimbangkan apa yang disukai orang lain.</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Princessy_Normal03_002
Array.english: <size=32>This... lacks that consideration.\nThink it over.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ini... kurang mempertimbangkan hal itu.\nPikirkan lagi.</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Princessy_Good_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh my... <color=#F1DC2B>{0}</color>...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Astaga... <color=#F1DC2B>{0}</color>...?</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Princessy_Good_002
Array.english: I suppose I can thank you for now, but this alone won't win me over.
Array.indonesia: Kurasa aku bisa berterima kasih padamu untuk saat ini, tapi ini saja tidak akan membuatku terkesan.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Princessy_Excelent_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh wow!! This is...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wah!! Ini...</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Princessy_Excelent_002
Array.english: <size=35>It's merch... with <color=#FF73C3>Rover</color>'s face on it...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ini merchandise... dengan wajah <color=#FF73C3>Rover</color> di atasnya...!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Princessy_Excelent_003
Array.english: How did you know I'd want this...
Array.indonesia: Bagaimana kamu tahu aku akan menginginkan ini...

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Princessy_Excelent_004
Array.english: <size=34>I can feel my resonance amplifying... Hah...<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku bisa merasakan resonansiku semakin kuat... Hah...<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Princessy_Excelent_005
Array.english: I have no choice but to praise you for this.\nI'll treasure it.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak punya pilihan selain memujimu untuk ini.\nAku akan menyimpannya dengan baik.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_BroSisMom_Normal_001
Array.english: Oh my... what is this...
Array.indonesia: Astaga... apa ini...

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_BroSisMom_Normal_002
Array.english: I don't think this is suitable for a home with children. I'm sorry, but I can't accept it.
Array.indonesia: Menurutku ini tidak cocok untuk rumah yang ada anak-anaknya. Maaf, tapi aku tidak bisa menerimanya.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_BroSisMom_Good_001
Array.english: Oh? <color=#F1DC2B>{0}</color>?
Array.indonesia: Oh? <color=#F1DC2B>{0}</color>?

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_BroSisMom_Good_002
Array.english: Hehe. I was actually curious about this...\nThank you.
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Sebenarnya aku penasaran dengan ini...\nTerima kasih.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_BroSisMom_Excelent_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh my... this is my favorite <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Astaga... ini favoritku <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>...!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_BroSisMom_Excelent_002
Array.english: Such beautiful craftsmanship...\nThank you so much.
Array.indonesia: Pengerjaannya sangat indah...\nTerima kasih banyak.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_BroSisMom_Excelent02_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... my child would love this!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... anak saya pasti akan menyukai ini!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_BroSisMom_Excelent02_002
Array.english: I can't believe you thought of this...\nThank you.
Array.indonesia: Saya tidak percaya Kamu memikirkan hal ini...\nTerima kasih.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_BroSisDad_Normal_001
Array.english: Hmm? A gift?
Array.indonesia: Hmm? Hadiah?

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_BroSisDad_Normal_002
Array.english: Ah... this is... well.
Array.indonesia: Ah... ini... ya.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_BroSisDad_Normal_003
Array.english: Wouldn't someone else make better use of it?\nI'll pass.
Array.indonesia: Bukankah orang lain akan lebih memanfaatkannya?\nAku lewat saja.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_BroSisDad_Good_001
Array.english: <size=32>Is this for me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ini untukku?</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_BroSisDad_Good_002
Array.english: Thank you for thinking of me when you're so busy.
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih sudah memikirkanku padahal kamu sedang sangat sibuk.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_BroSisDad_Good02_001
Array.english: Ah, <color=#F1DC2B>Bamboo</color>.
Array.indonesia: Ah, <color=#F1DC2B>Bamboo</color>.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_BroSisDad_Good02_002
Array.english: Hehe. I'll use these right away when the fire gets low.\nThank you.
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Aku akan langsung pakai ini saat apinya mulai meredup.\nTerima kasih.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_BroSisDad_Good03_001
Array.english: Hehe. <color=#F1DC2B>Ore</color> is always welcome.\nI'll put it to good use.
Array.indonesia: Hehe. <color=#F1DC2B>Ore</color> selalu diterima.\nAku akan memanfaatkannya dengan baik.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_BroSisDad_Excelent_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh...! <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh...! <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>?!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_BroSisDad_Excelent_002
Array.english: Haha, this will be perfect for playing with the kids.
Array.indonesia: Haha, ini bakal pas banget buat main bareng anak-anak.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_BroSisDad_Excelent_003
Array.english: <size=32>Eka and Saniah will love it.\nThank you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Eka dan Saniah pasti suka banget.\nTerima kasih!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_BroSisDad_Excelent02_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... the kids are going to love this!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... anak-anak pasti akan menyukainya!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_BroSisDad_Excelent02_002
Array.english: <size=32>Haha, thank you so much for thinking of us!\nYou're very kind!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha, terima kasih banyak sudah memikirkan kami!\nKamu sangat baik!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungManMom_Normal_001
Array.english: Oh my... a gift for me...?
Array.indonesia: Astaga... hadiah untukku...?

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungManMom_Normal_002
Array.english: I appreciate the thought, but... I don't think this really suits me...
Array.indonesia: Aku menghargai niat baikmu, tapi... kurasa ini nggak cocok buatku...

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungManMom_Normal_003
Array.english: I'll pass it along to someone else...
Array.indonesia: Aku akan memberikannya ke orang lain...

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungManMom_Good_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... you brought me a gift...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... kamu membawakan hadiah untukku...</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungManMom_Good_002
Array.english: <color=#F1DC2B>{0}</color>, I see...
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>{0}</color>, begitu ya...

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungManMom_Good_003
Array.english: You even thought of me...\nI'm touched.
Array.indonesia: Kamu bahkan memikirkanku...\nAku terharu.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungManMom_Excelent_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh my... what's this...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Astaga... apa ini...?</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungManMom_Excelent_002
Array.english: A <color=#FF73C3>Flute</color>, I see... Like the one I used to play with my husband...
Array.indonesia: Sebuah <color=#FF73C3>seruling</color>, begitu... Seperti yang dulu aku mainkan bersama suamiku...

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungManMom_Excelent_003
Array.english: You remembered something I mentioned in passing...\nI'm sorry. Those memories just came flooding back...
Array.indonesia: Kamu ingat sesuatu yang pernah aku sebutkan sekilas...\nMaaf. Kenangan-kenangan itu tiba-tiba membanjiri pikiranku...

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungManMom_Excelent_004
Array.english: Thank you... thank you so much.
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih... terima kasih banyak.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungManMom_Excelent02_001
Array.english: Oh my... a <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>...?
Array.indonesia: Astaga... sebuah <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>...?

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungManMom_Excelent02_002
Array.english: I've just been keeping old photos in a box...\nNow I can organize them properly.
Array.indonesia: Aku hanya menyimpan foto-foto lama di dalam sebuah kotak...\nSekarang aku bisa mengaturnya dengan rapi.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_YoungManMom_Excelent02_003
Array.english: Thank you so much...
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih banyak...

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBrother_Normal_001
Array.english: Oh... a gift...!
Array.indonesia: Oh... hadiah...!

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBrother_Normal_003
Array.english: Um... isn't this a bit much to give a kid?\nI don't need it.
Array.indonesia: Um... bukankah ini terlalu berlebihan untuk diberikan kepada seorang anak?\nAku tidak membutuhkannya.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBrother_Normal02_001
Array.english: Isn't giving something this expensive to a kid a bit much?
Array.indonesia: Bukankah memberi sesuatu yang semahal ini kepada seorang anak itu terlalu berlebihan?

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBrother_Normal02_002
Array.english: I don't need it!\nGive it to someone else!
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak membutuhkannya!\nBerikan saja kepada orang lain!

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBrother_Normal03_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm... I'm not sure what this is.\nI don't need it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm... Aku nggak tahu ini apa.\nAku nggak butuh ini!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBrother_Normal04_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, <color=#F1DC2B>Saniah</color> would probably like this more than me, don't you think?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, <color=#F1DC2B>Saniah</color> mungkin bakal lebih suka ini daripada aku, nggak sih?</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBrother_Good_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, it's <color=#F1DC2B>{0}</color>?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, ini <color=#F1DC2B>{0}</color>?!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBrother_Good_002
Array.english: Hehe, I'm sure I'll find a use for it.\nThanks, mister!
Array.indonesia: Hehe, aku yakin bakal bisa memanfaatkannya.\nTerima kasih, Pak!

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBrother_Good02_001
Array.english: <size=32>Whoa... a big-eyed lizard...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wah... kadal bermata besar...</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBrother_Good02_002
Array.english: They're hard to catch. How'd you get it?
Array.indonesia: Mereka sulit ditangkap. Gimana kamu bisa dapetin itu?

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBrother_Good02_003
Array.english: I gotta show this to Bima, hehe.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus tunjukkan ini ke Bima, hehe.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBrother_Excelent_001
Array.english: <size=34>Whoa! This is... a <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>, right?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wah! Ini... <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>, kan?!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBrother_Excelent_002
Array.english: Looks like it even has games already on it...?
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya sudah ada game di dalamnya...?

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBrother_Excelent_003
Array.english: Hehehe. You're the best, mister.\nThanks!
Array.indonesia: Hehehe. Kamu yang terbaik, Pak.\nTerima kasih!

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBrother_Excelent02_001
Array.english: <size=34>Ooh... isn't this a <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wah... bukankah ini <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>?!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBrother_Excelent02_002
Array.english: <size=33>It's super cool, right?\nThis one's really popular these days!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Keren banget, kan?\nYang ini lagi populer banget belakangan ini!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBrother_Excelent02_003
Array.english: <size=33>Hehe, thanks!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hehe, makasih!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBrother_Excelent03_001
Array.english: <size=34>Ooh... <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wah... <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBrother_Excelent03_002
Array.english: <size=33>I heard this one's really fun...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kudengar yang ini seru banget...!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBrother_Excelent03_003
Array.english: <size=34>It's not volume one, but... starting from the middle is still fun, right? Hehe!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Memang bukan jilid pertama, tapi... mulai dari tengah juga tetap seru, kan? Hehe!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBrother_Excelent04_001
Array.english: <size=34>Ooh... <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>, right?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ooh... <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>, kan?!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBrother_Excelent04_002
Array.english: <size=32>Hehe... dinosaur bones really get my imagination going!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehe... tulang-tulang dinosaurus benar-benar membangkitkan imajinasiku!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBrother_Excelent04_003
Array.english: <size=32>Huge dinosaurs fighting each other...\nThat must've been awesome, right?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Dinosaurus raksasa yang saling bertarung...\nPasti keren banget, kan?!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBrother_Excelent04_004
Array.english: <size=32>I remember betting with my friends when I was little on which dinosaur was the strongest.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku ingat dulu waktu kecil pernah bertaruh sama teman-temanku soal dinosaurus mana yang paling kuat.</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBrother_Excelent04_005
Array.english: <size=32>Hehe, right? I'll keep this safe in my treasure stash. Thanks, mister!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehe, kan? Aku bakal simpan ini dengan aman di tempat harta karunku. Makasih, Pak!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBrother_Excelent05_001
Array.english: <size=35>Wow...! That's a <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>, right?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wah...! Itu kan <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>, ya?!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBrother_Excelent05_002
Array.english: <size=32>How did you catch it?\nYou're amazing, mister!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Bagaimana kamu bisa menangkapnya?\nKamu luar biasa, Pak!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidSister_Normal_001
Array.english: Ah... what's this...?
Array.indonesia: Ah... apa ini...?

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidSister_Normal_002
Array.english: I don't really know what it is...\nI don't want it...
Array.indonesia: Aku nggak tahu apa ini...\nAku nggak mau ini...

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidSister_Normal02_001
Array.english: I think Eka and Bima would like this...
Array.indonesia: Kurasa Eka dan Bima akan suka ini...

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidSister_Normal02_002
Array.english: I'm okay...!
Array.indonesia: Aku baik-baik saja...!

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidSister_Good_001
Array.english: <size=32>Wow... you're giving this to me...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wah... kamu mau memberikannya kepadaku...?</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidSister_Good_002
Array.english: Hehe... thank you...\nI like it.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... terima kasih...\nAku suka.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidSister_Good02_001
Array.english: Wow... what a cool bug...!
Array.indonesia: Wow... serangga yang keren banget...!

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidSister_Good02_002
Array.english: Thank you!
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih!

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidSister_Good03_001
Array.english: <size=32>Wow... a big-eyed lizard...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wow... kadal bermata besar...!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidSister_Good03_002
Array.english: <size=32>This is for me?\nThank you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ini buat aku?\nTerima kasih!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidSister_Excelent_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... what a super cute <color=#FF73C3>Doll</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... boneka <color=#FF73C3>yang super imut</color>!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidSister_Excelent_002
Array.english: <size=32>It's so soft and squishy!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Lembut dan empuk banget!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidSister_Excelent_003
Array.english: Thank you, mister! Hehe.
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih, Pak! Hehe.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidSister_Excelent02_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color> for me!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color> buat aku!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidSister_Excelent02_002
Array.english: <size=33>This looks so yummy!\nI'm not sharing with my brother!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ini kelihatannya enak banget!\nAku nggak bakal bagi-bagi sama kakakku!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidSister_Excelent02_003
Array.english: <size=33>Thank you so much!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Terima kasih banyak!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Normal_001
Array.english: Oh... is this for me?
Array.indonesia: Oh... ini buat aku?

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Normal_002
Array.english: Um... this is... well...
Array.indonesia: Um... ini... ya...

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Normal_003
Array.english: You really don't know what kids like.\nI'll pass.
Array.indonesia: Kamu benar-benar tidak tahu apa yang disukai anak-anak.\nAku lewat saja.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Normal02_001
Array.english: Hmm... giving something this expensive to a kid...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... memberi sesuatu yang semahal ini kepada seorang anak...

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Normal02_002
Array.english: You should learn a bit more about how things work, mister.
Array.indonesia: Kamu sebaiknya belajar sedikit lebih banyak tentang bagaimana segala sesuatunya bekerja, Nak.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Normal02_003
Array.english: Give it to someone else!
Array.indonesia: Berikan saja kepada orang lain!

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Normal03_001
Array.english: Hmm... I think <color=#F1DC2B>Saniah</color> would like this more than me?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Menurutku <color=#F1DC2B>Saniah</color> bakal lebih suka ini daripada aku?

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Good_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh! <color=#F1DC2B>{0}</color>, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh! <color=#F1DC2B>{0}</color>, kan?</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Good_002
Array.english: Hm, you've managed to pique my interest.\nThanks, mister!
Array.indonesia: Hm, kamu berhasil membangkitkan minatku.\nTerima kasih, Pak!

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Good02_001
Array.english: <size=33>Whoa... a big-eyed lizard...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wah... kadal bermata besar...</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Good02_002
Array.english: <size=32>They're really fast...\nHow did you catch it?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Mereka sangat cepat...\nBagaimana kamu bisa menangkapnya?</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Good02_003
Array.english: <size=32>I can keep this, right?\nThanks.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku boleh menyimpannya, kan?\nTerima kasih.</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Excelent_001
Array.english: <size=33>Whoa! This is it, right?! A <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wah! Ini dia, kan?! Seekor <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>?!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Excelent_002
Array.english: <size=35>Isn't the <color=#FF73C3>Robot Samurai</color> so cool?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Bukankah <color=#FF73C3>Robot Samurai</color> itu keren banget?</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Excelent_003
Array.english: <size=33>Wow... this one even has moving joints.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wah... yang ini bahkan punya sendi yang bisa bergerak.</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Excelent_004
Array.english: <size=32>You've got good taste, mister!\nThanks!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Selera kamu bagus, Pak!\nTerima kasih!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Excelent02_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, this is a <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color> with 63 built-in games!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, ini <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color> dengan 63 game bawaan!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Excelent02_002
Array.english: <size=32>This'll keep me from getting bored for a while, hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ini bakal bikin aku nggak bosan untuk sementara waktu, hehe.</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Excelent02_003
Array.english: <size=33>Thanks, mister!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Terima kasih, Pak!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Excelent03_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ooh... <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ooh... <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>...!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Excelent03_002
Array.english: <size=32>Don't tell my dad, but... I secretly used his money to buy volume one and read it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Jangan bilang ke ayahku, tapi... aku diam-diam pakai uangnya buat beli jilid pertama dan membacanya.</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Excelent03_003
Array.english: <size=33>This is really fun.\nYou should read it too, hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ini benar-benar seru.\nKamu juga harus membacanya, hehe.</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Excelent04_001
Array.english: <size=33>Whoa! This is a <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wah! Ini <color=#FF73C3>{0}</color>...!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Excelent04_002
Array.english: <size=32>When I tried catching it with a net, it tore right through and got away... How did you catch it?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Saat aku mencoba menangkapnya dengan jaring, jaringnya robek dan dia kabur... Gimana caranya kamu bisa menangkapnya?!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Excelent04_003
Array.english: <size=33>Hehe, I gotta show this to Eka and Saniah!\nThanks!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hehe, aku harus tunjukin ini ke Eka dan Saniah!\nMakasih!</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Harta_Interaction_Select_Kind01
Array.english: Seeing you around so much, you're starting to feel like one of us. Hehe.
Array.indonesia: Sering ketemu kamu, rasanya kamu udah kayak salah satu dari kita. Hehe.

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Harta_Talk_Select_Kind01
Array.english: <size=33>Perfect timing, I was just getting bored.\nWhat should we talk about?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Waktunya pas banget, aku lagi bosan nih.\nMau ngobrolin apa, ya?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Harta_Interaction_Return_Kind01
Array.english: <size=33>Want to talk about something else?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Mau ngobrolin hal lain?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Harta_Interaction_End_Kind01
Array.english: <size=33>Alright, see you next time.\nCome by again.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oke, sampai jumpa lain kali.\nMampir lagi ya.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Harta_Interaction_Select_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=33>Hm? What's up?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hm? Ada apa?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Harta_Talk_Select_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=33>Well... I don't really have much to say.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Yah... aku nggak punya banyak yang mau dibicarakan.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Harta_Interaction_Return_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=33>Got anything else to talk about?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ada topik lain yang mau dibicarakan?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Harta_Interaction_End_NotKind01
Array.english: Next time you come by, bring something nice, hehe.
Array.indonesia: Lain kali mampir, bawa sesuatu yang enak, hehe.

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Gesang_Interaction_Select_Kind01
Array.english: Everything alright?
Array.indonesia: Semuanya baik-baik saja?

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Gesang_Talk_Select_Kind01
Array.english: Yeah, what's up?
Array.indonesia: Iya, ada apa?

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Gesang_Interaction_Return_Kind01
Array.english: Need anything else?
Array.indonesia: Butuh sesuatu lagi?

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Gesang_Interaction_End_Kind01
Array.english: Heading out already? It's been a while, but it was nice catching up.
Array.indonesia: Sudah mau pulang? Sudah lama nggak ketemu, tapi senang bisa ngobrol lagi.

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Gesang_Interaction_Select_NotKind01
Array.english: ...You're not here because my wife sent you, are you...?
Array.indonesia: ...Kamu nggak di sini karena istriku yang menyuruhmu, kan...?

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Gesang_Talk_Select_NotKind01
Array.english: Uh... um... I'm not really up for a long talk...
Array.indonesia: Uh... um... Aku nggak terlalu mau ngobrol lama-lama...

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Gesang_Interaction_Return_NotKind01
Array.english: ...Still got something to say...?
Array.indonesia: ...Masih ada yang mau kamu katakan...?

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Gesang_Interaction_End_NotKind01
Array.english: Just forget what I said earlier.\nGot it?
Array.indonesia: Lupakan saja apa yang aku katakan tadi.\nPaham?

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Chandra_Interaction_Select_Kind01
Array.english: <size=34>Go ahead, speak freely.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Silakan, bicara saja dengan bebas.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Chandra_Talk_Select_Kind01
Array.english: <size=34>What would you like to talk about?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Mau ngobrolin apa?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Chandra_Interaction_Return_Kind01
Array.english: <size=34>If you need anything else, just say so.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kalau butuh apa-apa lagi, bilang aja.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Chandra_Interaction_End_Kind01
Array.english: <size=32>Take care out there.\nDon't get eaten by a crocodile.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hati-hati di luar sana.\nJangan sampai dimakan buaya.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Chandra_Interaction_Select_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>Need something?\nI'm a bit busy...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Butuh sesuatu?\nAku agak sibuk...</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Chandra_Talk_Select_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>What do you want to talk about?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Mau ngobrolin apa?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Chandra_Interaction_Return_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>What else?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ada lagi?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Chandra_Interaction_End_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=33>Don't go putting ideas in my husband's head about the city.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Jangan sampai bikin suamiku kepikiran soal kota.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_PoetryGirl_Interaction_Select_Kind01
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, is there something you'd like to share?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, ada yang ingin kamu ceritakan?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_PoetryGirl_Talk_Select_Kind01
Array.english: <size=33>What would you like to talk about?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tentang apa yang ingin kamu bicarakan?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_PoetryGirl_Interaction_Return_Kind01
Array.english: <size=33>Looks like you have more to say.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Sepertinya kamu masih punya banyak yang ingin dikatakan.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_PoetryGirl_Interaction_End_Kind01
Array.english: <size=33>Danger comes without warning here, like the rain. Take care of yourself.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Bahaya datang tanpa peringatan di sini, seperti hujan. Jaga dirimu baik-baik.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_PoetryGirl_Interaction_Select_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, what would you like to share?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, apa yang ingin kamu bagikan?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_PoetryGirl_Talk_Select_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=33>It's nice to have a light conversation sometimes.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kadang-kadang, obrolan ringan memang menyenangkan.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_PoetryGirl_Interaction_Return_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=33>Anything else you'd like to talk about?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ada hal lain yang ingin kamu bicarakan?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_PoetryGirl_Interaction_End_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=33>Well then, I'll get back to my writing...\nFarewell.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Baiklah, aku akan kembali menulis...\nSelamat tinggal.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_FlowerGrandma_Interaction_Select_Kind01
Array.english: <size=33>Say whatever's on your mind.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Katakan saja apa yang ada di pikiranmu.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_FlowerGrandma_Talk_Select_Kind01
Array.english: <size=33>Looks like you have something to ask this old lady.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Sepertinya kamu punya sesuatu yang ingin ditanyakan kepada wanita tua ini.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_FlowerGrandma_Interaction_Return_Kind01
Array.english: <size=33>It's alright. Go on, say it again.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tidak apa-apa. Ayo, katakan lagi.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_FlowerGrandma_Interaction_End_Kind01
Array.english: <size=33>Travel safely.\nMay Setah Forest's blessing be with you.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Selamat jalan.\nSemoga berkah Hutan Setah menyertaimu.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_FlowerGrandma_Interaction_Select_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=33>What brings you here, young outsider?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Apa yang membawamu ke sini, pemuda pendatang?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_FlowerGrandma_Talk_Select_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=33>Yes, I'm listening.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ya, aku mendengarkan.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_FlowerGrandma_Interaction_Return_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=33>Looks like you have more questions, young one.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Sepertinya kamu punya lebih banyak pertanyaan, Nak.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_FlowerGrandma_Interaction_End_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=33>Take care now.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Jaga dirimu baik-baik.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_YoungMan_Interaction_Select_Kind01
Array.english: <size=33>What can I do for you?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ada yang bisa kubantu?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_YoungMan_Talk_Select_Kind01
Array.english: <size=33>Yes. I'm listening.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ya. Aku mendengarkan.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_YoungMan_Interaction_Return_Kind01
Array.english: <size=33>Seems like you have more to say.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Sepertinya kamu masih punya banyak yang ingin dikatakan.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_YoungMan_Interaction_End_Kind01
Array.english: <size=33>Good talk. See you around.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Percakapan yang menyenangkan. Sampai jumpa.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_YoungManAfter_Interaction_End_Kind01
Array.english: <size=33>Good talk. Woah! Yeah.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Pembicaraan yang bagus. Wah! Ya.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_YoungMan_Interaction_Select_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=33>Hmm... what's up?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hmm... ada apa?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_YoungMan_Talk_Select_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=33>Yes... go ahead.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ya... silakan.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_YoungMan_Interaction_Return_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=33>Need something else?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Butuh sesuatu lagi?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_YoungMan_Interaction_End_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=33>You're cutting into my practice time.\nLater.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kamu mengganggu waktu latihanku.\nSampai jumpa.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_YoungManAfter_Interaction_End_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=33>I was just about to come up with a good melody... Well, take care.</size>
