Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku baru saja mau menciptakan melodi yang bagus... Yah, jaga dirimu baik-baik.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Princessy_Interaction_Select_Kind01
Array.english: <size=33>Oh? Sounds like you have something specific to say to me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh? Sepertinya kamu punya sesuatu yang spesifik untuk dikatakan padaku?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Princessy_Talk_Select_Kind01
Array.english: <size=33>I'm not quite ready, but... go on.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku belum sepenuhnya siap, tapi... silakan saja.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Princessy_Interaction_Return_Kind01
Array.english: <size=33>You really want to keep talking...\nI suppose I can't stop you.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kamu benar-benar ingin terus ngobrol...\nSepertinya aku nggak bisa menghentikanmu.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Princessy_Interaction_End_Kind01
Array.english: <size=31>I appreciate you wanting to chat, but...\nDon't let it interfere with your work.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Aku menghargai keinginanmu untuk ngobrol, tapi...\nJangan sampai itu mengganggu pekerjaanmu.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Princessy_Interaction_Select_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>Wait. Don't come any closer.\nTalk from there.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Tunggu. Jangan mendekat.\nBicaralah dari sana.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Princessy_Talk_Select_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>You didn't come just to chat, did you?\nKeep it short. And simple.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kamu tidak datang hanya untuk mengobrol, kan?\nBuatlah singkat. Dan sederhana.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Princessy_Interaction_Return_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>What do you need now?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Apa yang kamu butuhkan sekarang?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Princessy_Interaction_End_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=31>I thought you were here to investigate...\nStay focused.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Kupikir kamu di sini untuk menyelidiki...\nTetap fokus.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_BroSisMom_Interaction_Select_Kind01
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, what's going on?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, ada apa?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_BroSisMom_Talk_Select_Kind01
Array.english: <size=33>Ah, what should we talk about?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ah, apa yang harus kita bicarakan?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_BroSisMom_Interaction_Return_Kind01
Array.english: <size=33>Need something else?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Butuh sesuatu lagi?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_BroSisMom_Interaction_End_Kind01
Array.english: <size=33>Well, have a good day. If anything happens with the kids, let me know right away.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Baiklah, semoga harimu menyenangkan. Kalau ada apa-apa dengan anak-anak, beri tahu aku segera.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_BroSisMom_Interaction_Select_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=33>Ah... what's the matter?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ah... ada apa?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_BroSisMom_Talk_Select_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=33>What should we talk about?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Mau ngobrolin apa?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_BroSisMom_Interaction_Return_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=33>Need something else?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Butuh yang lain?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_BroSisMom_Interaction_End_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=33>I should go get some snacks for the kids.\nSee you later.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku harus pergi beli camilan untuk anak-anak.\nSampai jumpa nanti.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_BroSisDad_Interaction_Select_Kind01
Array.english: <size=34>Need something?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Butuh sesuatu?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_BroSisDad_Talk_Select_Kind01
Array.english: <size=34>Haha, chatting's nice too.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Haha, ngobrol juga seru, lho.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_BroSisDad_Interaction_Return_Kind01
Array.english: <size=34>Looks like you have more to say.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Sepertinya kamu masih punya banyak yang ingin dibicarakan.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_BroSisDad_Interaction_End_Kind01
Array.english: <size=34>Take care in the village.\nLet me know if you need anything.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Jaga diri baik-baik di desa.\nBeri tahu aku kalau kamu butuh sesuatu.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_BroSisDad_Interaction_Select_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>Oh, is there something you're curious about?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh, ada yang ingin kamu tanyakan?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_BroSisDad_Talk_Select_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>Go ahead.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Silakan.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_BroSisDad_Interaction_Return_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>Looks like you have more to say?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Sepertinya kamu masih punya yang ingin dikatakan?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_BroSisDad_Interaction_End_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>Well then, make yourself comfortable.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Baiklah, silakan duduk santai.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_YoungManMom_Interaction_Select_Kind01
Array.english: <size=34>What can I do for you?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ada yang bisa saya bantu?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_YoungManMom_Talk_Select_Kind01
Array.english: <size=34>What would you like to talk about?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Tentang apa yang ingin kamu bicarakan?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_YoungManMom_Interaction_Return_Kind01
Array.english: <size=34>Sure, let's talk a bit more.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Tentu, mari kita bicara sedikit lagi.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_YoungManMom_Interaction_End_Kind01
Array.english: <size=34>Thank you for helping our village.\nI hope you've been comfortable here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Terima kasih sudah membantu desa kami.\nSemoga kamu merasa nyaman di sini.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_YoungManMom_Interaction_Select_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>Is there something you need...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ada yang kamu butuhkan...?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_YoungManMom_Talk_Select_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>Yes. Go ahead.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ya. Silakan.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_YoungManMom_Interaction_Return_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>You have more to say.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kamu masih punya hal lain yang ingin disampaikan.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_YoungManMom_Interaction_End_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>I'm counting on you to help take care of things in the village.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku mengandalkanmu untuk membantu mengurus berbagai hal di desa ini.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidBrother_Interaction_Select_Kind01
Array.english: <size=34>Hehe, Dave! Hi!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hehe, Dave! Hai!</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidBrother_Talk_Select_Kind01
Array.english: <size=34>Got any fun stories?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ada cerita seru?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidBrother_Interaction_Return_Kind01
Array.english: <size=34>Hehe. What else are you curious about?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hehe. Apa lagi yang ingin kamu tahu?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidBrother_Interaction_End_Kind01
Array.english: <size=34>Oh, you're leaving? Okay!\nCome talk to me again soon!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh, kamu mau pergi? Oke!\nAyo mampir lagi nanti!</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidBrother_Interaction_Select_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>Oh, hello mister!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh, halo Pak!</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidBrother_Talk_Select_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>What should we talk about?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Mau ngobrolin apa ya?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidBrother_Interaction_Return_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>Got more questions?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ada pertanyaan lain?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidBrother_Interaction_End_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>See you later, mister!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Sampai jumpa nanti, Pak!</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidSister_Interaction_Select_Kind01
Array.english: <size=34>Hello, mister...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Halo, Pak...!</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidSister_Talk_Select_Kind01
Array.english: <size=34>What should we talk about...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Mau ngobrolin apa ya...?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidSister_Interaction_Return_Kind01
Array.english: <size=34>Want to talk more?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Mau ngobrol lagi?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidSister_Interaction_End_Kind01
Array.english: <size=34>Outsiders aren't as scary as I thought, hehe.\nLet's talk again, mister.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Orang luar ternyata tidak semenakutkan yang aku kira, hehe.\nAyo kita ngobrol lagi, Pak.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidSister_Interaction_Select_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>Oh, it's Mister Outsider. Hello.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh, ini Pak Orang Luar. Halo.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidSister_Talk_Select_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>Mom says I'll get in trouble if I talk to outsiders too much.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ibu bilang aku bakal kena marah kalau terlalu sering ngobrol sama orang luar.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidSister_Interaction_Return_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>Got something else to talk about?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ada topik lain yang mau dibicarakan?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidSister_Interaction_End_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>Goodbye.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Sampai jumpa.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidBroFriend_Interaction_Select_Kind01
Array.english: <size=34>Dave, what's up?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Dave, ada apa?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidBroFriend_Talk_Select_Kind01
Array.english: <size=34>What do you want to hear about!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kamu mau dengar cerita apa!?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidBroFriend_Interaction_Return_Kind01
Array.english: <size=34>Glad you liked my story. Haha.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Senang kamu suka ceritaku. Haha.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidBroFriend_Interaction_End_Kind01
Array.english: <size=34>See you next time! Hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Sampai jumpa lagi! Hehe.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidBroFriend_Interaction_Select_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>Oh... mister, what brings you here?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh... Pak, ada apa di sini?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidBroFriend_Talk_Select_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>You seem to have a lot of questions.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Sepertinya kamu punya banyak pertanyaan.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidBroFriend_Interaction_Return_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>I shouldn't say too much...\nWhat else are you curious about?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku sebaiknya tidak bicara terlalu banyak...\nApa lagi yang ingin kamu ketahui?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidBroFriend_Interaction_End_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>Take care! Hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Jaga diri ya! Hehe.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_DoNotSkip_001
Array.english: <size=34>I should look around the village and see what there is to do.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku sebaiknya berkeliling desa dan melihat apa saja yang bisa dilakukan.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_Fishing_FishingLine_Warning_001
Array.english: Hmm... I might need a better <color=#F1DC2B>Fishing Line</color>...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Mungkin aku butuh <color=#F1DC2B>Tali Pancing</color> yang lebih bagus...

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_Fishing_FishingRod_Warning_003
Array.english: I should probably attach some <color=#F1DC2B>Bait</color>.
Array.indonesia: Mungkin aku harus memasang <color=#F1DC2B>Umpan</color>.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_GrowAGarden_NoSeed_Warning_001
Array.english: Hmm... I don't have any seeds. I should go buy some from Jepun.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Aku tidak punya benih. Aku harus pergi membelinya dari Jepun.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_MoveToForestScene_001
Array.english: Should I head to Setah Forest?
Array.indonesia: Haruskah aku pergi ke Hutan Setah?

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_MoveToForestScene_Option01
Array.english: Go
Array.indonesia: Pergi

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_MoveToForestScene_Option02
Array.english: Don't go
Array.indonesia: Jangan pergi

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_MoveToForestScene_Move_001
Array.english: <size=32>I think I'm ready!\nLet's head into the forest!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku rasa aku sudah siap!\nAyo masuk ke hutan!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_MoveToForestScene_NotNow_001
Array.english: I need to prepare a bit more.\nBetter to go later.
Array.indonesia: Aku perlu bersiap-siap sedikit lagi.\nLebih baik pergi nanti.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_MoveToForestScene_Barricade_Night_001
Array.english: <size=32><color=#C3C3C3>It'd be dangerous to go into the forest at night. I'll go with Cobra tomorrow.</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32><color=#C3C3C3>Akan berbahaya kalau masuk ke hutan di malam hari. Aku akan pergi bersama Cobra besok.</color></size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_MoveToForestScene_Barricade_Common_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hmm... I think it's better not to go right now.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hmm... Menurutku lebih baik tidak pergi sekarang.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_MoveScene_ForestToVillage_001
Array.english: <size=34>Should I head back to the village?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Haruskah aku kembali ke desa?</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_MoveScene_ForestToVillage_Option01
Array.english: Head back <color=#fde221><size=20>(Time Passes)</size></color>
Array.indonesia: Kembali <color=#fde221><size=20>(Waktu Berlalu)</size></color>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_MoveScene_ForestToVillage_Option02
Array.english: Stay in the forest
Array.indonesia: Tetap di hutan

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_MoveScene_ForestToVillage_Move_001
Array.english: I think I've been here long enough. Better head back to the village and rest.
Array.indonesia: Kurasa aku sudah cukup lama di sini. Lebih baik kembali ke desa dan beristirahat.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_MoveScene_ForestToVillage_NotNow_001
Array.english: I still have things to do.\nI should look around a bit more.
Array.indonesia: Aku masih punya hal yang harus dilakukan.\nAku harus melihat-lihat sebentar lagi.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_MoveScene_EnterDungeon_001
Array.english: <size=34>Should I enter the temple?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Haruskah aku masuk ke kuil?</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_MoveScene_EnterDungeon_Option01
Array.english: Enter
Array.indonesia: Masuk

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_MoveScene_EnterDungeon_Option02
Array.english: Stay in the forest
Array.indonesia: Tetap di hutan

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_MoveScene_EnterDungeon_Move_001
Array.english: <size=33>Looks a bit scary, but...\nLet's go in!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kelihatannya agak menakutkan, tapi...\nAyo masuk!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_MoveScene_EnterDungeon_NotNow_001
Array.english: I should prepare a bit more...\nLet's come back later.
Array.indonesia: Sebaiknya aku bersiap-siap dulu...\nAyo kembali nanti saja.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart_001
Array.english: <size=35>Excuse me, you there!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Maaf, kamu di sana!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart_002
Array.english: <size=33>...Yes?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>... Ya?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart_003
Array.english: <size=33>This fishy smell… isn't there anything you can do about it?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Bau amis ini… apa kamu bisa ngapain-ngapain?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart_004
Array.english: Hmm… I keep it sealed up as much as I can, but…
Array.indonesia: Hmm… Aku udah nyegelnya sebisa mungkin, tapi…

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart_005
Array.english:
It doesn't come through in the food at all, you know!
Would you like to try a piece?
Array.indonesia:
Bau itu sama sekali nggak nyebar ke makanannya, lho!
Mau coba sepotong?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart_006
Array.english:
<size=33>No thank you! Smells of old moss and muddy earth…
Just thinking about it makes me queasy.</size>
Array.indonesia:
<size=33>Tidak, terima kasih! Bau lumut tua dan tanah berlumpur…
Hanya membayangkannya saja sudah membuatku mual.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart_007
Array.english:
You go a bit too far, my lady.
Surely this evening you caught a whiff of well-cooked dishes drifting through the air.
Array.indonesia:
Kamu agak berlebihan, Nona.
Pasti tadi malam kamu mencium aroma hidangan yang dimasak dengan baik tercium di udara.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart_008
Array.english:
<size=33>…That must be from the spices, surely.
There's no way that scent could come from fish.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>…Itu pasti berasal dari bumbu, pasti.\ nTidak mungkin aroma itu berasal dari ikan.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart_009
Array.english:
In that case…
would you partake of an aquatic creature that is not a fish?
Array.indonesia:
Kalau begitu…
mau mencoba makhluk air yang bukan ikan?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart_010
Array.english: <size=32>Pardon…? What sort of creature do you mean?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Maaf…? Makhluk seperti apa yang Kamu maksud?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart_011
Array.english: <size=33>A creature that lives in the water yet carries no fishy smell…Allow me to serve you a dish prepared from such a creature!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Makhluk yang hidup di air namun tidak berbau amis… Izinkan saya menyajikan hidangan yang dibuat dari makhluk tersebut!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart_012
Array.english: <size=32>I haven't the faintest idea what you're talking about.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Saya sama sekali tidak mengerti apa yang Kamu bicarakan.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart_013
Array.english: <size=33>Come again in <color=#F1DC2B>2 days</color>. By then, I shall have prepared a dish even you, my lady, would marvel at.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Silakan datang lagi dalam <color=#F1DC2B>2 hari</color>. Saat itu, saya akan menyiapkan hidangan yang bahkan Kamu, Nyonya, pun akan kagum melihatnya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart_014
Array.english:
Such bold claims… 
I do hope you intend to take responsibility for your words.
Array.indonesia:
Pernyataan yang begitu berani… 
Aku harap kamu berniat bertanggung jawab atas kata-katamu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart_015
Array.english: No matter how heavily you smother it in spices, you cannot fool this Bonita's discerning palate.
Array.indonesia: Sekalipun kamu membumbui hidangan itu sekuat-kuatnya, kamu takkan bisa menipu selera Bonita yang tajam ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart02_001
Array.english: ...You made another promise...
Array.indonesia: ...Kamu telah membuat janji lagi...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart02_002
Array.english: Rather than outright refusal, it would be better to show her the true taste.
Array.indonesia: Daripada menolak mentah-mentah, lebih baik tunjukkan padanya rasa yang sesungguhnya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart02_003
Array.english: I believe a dish of truly fine flavor has the power to break through prejudice.
Array.indonesia: Aku yakin hidangan dengan rasa yang benar-benar lezat memiliki kekuatan untuk menembus prasangka.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart02_004
Array.english: <size=32>I, Bancho, shall awaken a new sense of taste within her!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku, Bancho, akan membangkitkan selera baru dalam dirinya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart02_005
Array.english: Hmm... so what ingredients should I prepare?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... jadi bahan apa yang harus aku siapkan?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart02_006
Array.english: <color=#F1DC2B>Crocodile</color> would be ideal. \nThere are some fierce ones in this lake.
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Buaya</color> akan menjadi pilihan yang ideal. \nAda beberapa yang ganas di danau ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart02_007
Array.english: <size=32>I'll use a <color=#1DFEAF>Black Caiman Tail</color> to show the lady a whole new flavor!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku akan menggunakan <color=#1DFEAF>Ekor Caiman Hitam</color> untuk memperkenalkan rasa yang benar-benar baru kepada nona itu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart02_008
Array.english: ...Uhm... using something that dangerous as an ingredient...?
Array.indonesia: ...Uhm... menggunakan sesuatu yang seberbahaya itu sebagai bahan...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart02_009
Array.english: Still, it'd be nice if Bonita could try your cooking.
Array.indonesia: Meski begitu, alangkah baiknya jika Bonita bisa mencicipi masakanmu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart02_010
Array.english: Do you need anything else?
Array.indonesia: Apa kamu butuh bahan lain?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart02_011
Array.english: Besides the Black Caiman Tail...\nI'll need <color=#1DFEAF>Thai Chili</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>Palm Sugar</color>.
Array.indonesia: Selain Ekor Caiman Hitam...\nAku butuh <color=#1DFEAF>Cabai Thailand</color> dan <color=#1DFEAF>Gula Aren</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart02_012
Array.english: Okay. Got it. I'll go get them.
Array.indonesia: Oke. Paham. Aku akan membelinya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart02_013
Array.english: Besides the Black Caiman Tail...\nI'll need <color=#1DFEAF>Thai Chili</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>Palm Sugar</color>.
Array.indonesia: Selain Ekor Buaya Hitam...\nAku butuh <color=#1DFEAF>Cabai Thailand</color> dan <color=#1DFEAF>Gula Aren</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart02_014
Array.english: Okay. Got it. I'll go get them.
Array.indonesia: Oke. Paham. Aku akan membelinya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterTutorial_Start_001
Array.english: <size=33>Select <color=#F1DC2B>Craft</color> below!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Pilih <color=#F1DC2B>Kerajinan</color> di bawah ini!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaTalk_01_001
Array.english: The more I think about it, the less I want to attend this dinner.
Array.indonesia: Semakin aku memikirkannya, semakin aku tidak ingin menghadiri makan malam ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaTalk_01_002
Array.english: Preparing a dish with meat I'm unfamiliar with...\nI'm already losing my appetite.
Array.indonesia: Memasak hidangan dengan daging yang tidak aku kenal...\nAku sudah mulai kehilangan selera makan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaTalk_01_003
Array.english: There's only one reason I accepted the invitation.
Array.indonesia: Hanya ada satu alasan mengapa aku menerima undangan ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaTalk_01_004
Array.english: <size=32>It's just flavor created by seasoning!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Itu hanyalah rasa yang dihasilkan oleh bumbu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaTalk_01_005
Array.english: <size=32>The point being, there is no such thing as a fish dish without a fishy smell!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Intinya, tidak ada hidangan ikan yang tidak berbau amis!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaTalk_01_006
Array.english: I'll taste it myself and tell everyone.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan mencicipinya sendiri dan memberitahu semua orang.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaTalk_02_001
Array.english: The villagers keep talking more and more about your restaurant's food.
Array.indonesia: Para penduduk desa semakin sering membicarakan makanan di restoranimu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaTalk_02_002
Array.english: Everyone is so... short-sighted.
Array.indonesia: Semua orang begitu... picik.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaTalk_02_003
Array.english: It's just that the lake was polluted, so the food doesn't taste as good. That's all.
Array.indonesia: Hanya saja danau itu tercemar, jadi makanannya tidak terasa seenak biasanya. Itu saja.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaTalk_02_004
Array.english: But I shouldn't criticize without trying it...\nso you'd better be ready.
Array.indonesia: Tapi aku tidak boleh mengkritik tanpa mencobanya...\njadi sebaiknya kamu bersiap-siap.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaTalk_02_005
Array.english: <size=32>Because I'm going to prove it's nothing more than spices and seasoning!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Karena aku akan membuktikan bahwa itu tidak lebih dari rempah-rempah dan bumbu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterCraftDone_010
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... and...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... dan...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaTalk_03_001
Array.english: Sigh... if you're not confident, just give up.
Array.indonesia: Huh... kalau kamu nggak yakin, mendingan menyerah aja.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterCraftDone_011
Array.english: <size=32>I made this <color=#F1DC2B>Sign Decoration</color> as a test... take it if you want.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku bikin <color=#F1DC2B>Dekorasi Papan</color> ini buat uji coba... ambil aja kalau mau.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterCraftDone_012
Array.english: Oh... I'll use it when I feel like changing things up.
Array.indonesia: Oh... Aku akan menggunakannya saat ingin mengubah suasana.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaTalk_03_002
Array.english: You're making all these bold claims, but you can't even handle the ingredients properly.
Array.indonesia: Kamu membuat klaim-klaim berani seperti itu, tapi kamu bahkan tidak bisa menangani bahan-bahannya dengan benar.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaTalk_03_003
Array.english: I need to at least taste it so I can point out just how pretentious this dish is...
Array.indonesia: Setidaknya aku harus mencicipinya agar bisa menunjukkan betapa soknya hidangan ini...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaTalk_03_004
Array.english: I expect everything to be properly prepared by the time I come back.
Array.indonesia: Aku berharap semuanya sudah disiapkan dengan benar saat aku kembali.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaComplete01_001
Array.english:
<size=32>Ugh… a crocodile's tail…
In the end, isn't this nothing more than a lizard-shaped fish?</size>
Array.indonesia:
<size=32>Ugh… ekor buaya…
Pada akhirnya, bukankah ini tidak lebih dari ikan berbentuk kadal?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaComplete01_002
Array.english:
…It is an entirely different class of creature.
Do try a single bite first, my lady.
Array.indonesia:
…Ini adalah makhluk dari kelas yang sama sekali berbeda.
Cobalah satu gigitan dulu, Nyonya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaComplete01_003
Array.english: Well… since you went through all this trouble, \nI shall try just a bite.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah… karena Kamu sudah bersusah payah, \nsaya akan mencicipi satu suap saja.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaComplete02_001
Array.english: <size=33>How is it?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Bagaimana rasanya?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaComplete02_002
Array.english: <size=34>Oh…! it's good…! It's delicious!! It's almost like chicken, \nbut with just a touch more bite to it!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh…! Enak…! Lezat sekali!! Rasanya hampir seperti ayam, \ntapi dengan tekstur yang sedikit lebih renyah!!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaComplete02_003
Array.english: <size=34>The spice of the <color=#1DFEAF>Thai Chili</color>...\nis resonating with the richness of the crocodile meat...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Rasa pedas dari <color=#1DFEAF>cabai Thailand</color>...\nsangat selaras dengan kekayaan rasa daging buaya...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaComplete02_004
Array.english: <size=34>And… that sweet finish at the end is palm sugar! With such fragrance and texture, I could happily eat several more dishes!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Dan… rasa manis di akhir itu berasal dari gula aren! Dengan aroma dan tekstur seperti ini, aku bisa dengan senang hati menyantap beberapa porsi lagi!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaComplete02_005
Array.english: I am pleased. With the right cooking method, the fishy smell you so dislike can be removed entirely.
Array.indonesia: Aku senang mendengarnya. Dengan metode memasak yang tepat, bau amis yang sangat Kamu benci bisa dihilangkan sepenuhnya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaComplete02_006
Array.english: The crocodile tail is, in truth, a part with little fishy smell to begin with… If this has made you a touch more familiar with such fare, then I am glad.
Array.indonesia: Ekor buaya, sebenarnya, adalah bagian yang memang sudah memiliki bau amis yang sangat sedikit… Jika ini membuat Kamu sedikit lebih akrab dengan hidangan semacam ini, maka saya senang.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaComplete02_007
Array.english: I have also removed the fishy smell from the other fish dishes with salt and mirin. Perhaps you might try one another time.
Array.indonesia: Saya juga telah menghilangkan bau amis dari hidangan ikan lainnya dengan garam dan mirin. Mungkin Kamu bisa mencobanya lain kali.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaComplete02_008
Array.english:
…Well… it is not as though I am entirely won over, 
but…
Array.indonesia:
…Yah… bukan berarti saya sepenuhnya terpikat, 
tapi…

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaComplete02_009
Array.english: <size=33>If you can keep things at this level, then stopping by your shop now and then would not be so bad after all.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Jika kamu bisa mempertahankan kualitasnya seperti ini, maka mampir ke tokomu sesekali tidak akan terlalu buruk juga.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaComplete02_010
Array.english: Everyone keeps saying your food is delicious... and honestly, it was a bit awkward not being able to join those conversations.
Array.indonesia: Semua orang terus bilang masakanmu enak… dan jujur saja, rasanya agak canggung tidak bisa ikut dalam percakapan-percakapan itu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaComplete02_011
Array.english:
<size=32>We'll have plenty of good ingredients ready, 
so feel free to drop by anytime!</size>
Array.indonesia:
<size=32>Kami akan menyiapkan banyak bahan-bahan berkualitas, 
jadi silakan mampir kapan saja!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaComplete02_012
Array.english: I'd like to give you something in return...
Array.indonesia: Aku ingin membalas kebaikanmu...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaComplete02_013
Array.english: But all I have is Rover merch...
Array.indonesia: Tapi yang kumiliki hanyalah merchandise Rover...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaComplete02_014
Array.english: <size=34>No, it's okay...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Tidak, tidak apa-apa...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaComplete02_015
Array.english: <size=33>Huh?! The Rover merch is suddenly glowing...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hah?! Merch Rover itu tiba-tiba bersinar...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_RoverAppear01_001
Array.english: <size=32>I felt some kind of resonance...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku merasakan semacam resonansi...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_RoverAppear01_002
Array.english: <size=40>R-Rover...?! Is it really you, Rover?!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>R-Rover...?! Benarkah itu kamu, Rover?!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_RoverAppear01_003
Array.english: <size=33>Yes... Do you perhaps know me...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ya... Apakah kamu mungkin mengenalku...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_RoverAppear01_004
Array.english: <size=32>Yes. I'm Resonator Bonita.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ya. Aku Resonator Bonita.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_RoverAppear01_005
Array.english: ...You're on a slightly different frequency... It feels different from what I sense from the people of Solaris-3...
Array.indonesia: ...Frekuensimu sedikit berbeda... Rasanya berbeda dari apa yang aku rasakan dari penduduk Solaris-3...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_RoverAppear01_006
Array.english: Would it be alright if I stayed in this village for a while?
Array.indonesia: Bolehkah aku tinggal di desa ini sebentar?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_RoverAppear01_007
Array.english: I've traveled quite far, so I need some time to regroup.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah bepergian cukup jauh, jadi aku butuh waktu untuk beristirahat sejenak.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_RoverAppear01_008
Array.english: <size=42>...Of course, Rover<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>...Of tentu saja, Rover<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_RoverAppear01_009
Array.english: Bonita... we should ask the village chief...
Array.indonesia: Bonita... sebaiknya kita tanya kepala desa...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_RoverAppear01_010
Array.english: But I think the Lake Beach area should be fine.
Array.indonesia: Tapi menurutku daerah Lake Beach seharusnya aman.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_RoverAppear01_011
Array.english: Anywhere is fine. Thank you.
Array.indonesia: Di mana saja tidak masalah. Terima kasih.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_RoverAppear01_012
Array.english: By the way... it smells amazing in this shop!
Array.indonesia: Ngomong-ngomong... aroma di toko ini luar biasa!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_RoverAppear01_013
Array.english: A scent like this only comes from perfectly balanced ingredients... I can tell.
Array.indonesia: Aroma seperti ini hanya bisa dihasilkan dari bahan-bahan yang seimbang sempurna... Aku bisa merasakannya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_RoverAppear01_014
Array.english: I used to cook a bit myself...\nIf you'd like, I can help out at the shop.
Array.indonesia: Dulu aku juga pernah sedikit-sedikit memasak...\nKalau kamu mau, aku bisa bantu di toko.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_RoverAppear01_015
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... that would be great!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... itu bagus sekali!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_RoverAppear01_016
Array.english: Now that Bonita will be coming for meals too...\nI think we'll be even busier.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang Bonita juga akan datang untuk makan...\nAku rasa kita akan semakin sibuk.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_RoverAppear01_017
Array.english: Of course<color=#ff61e3>♥</color> I'll be having dinner here every day now<color=#ff61e3>♥</color> \nWhether it's fish or meat...
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja<color=#ff61e3>♥</color> Mulai sekarang aku akan makan malam di sini setiap hari<color=#ff61e3>♥</color> \nBaik itu ikan maupun daging...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_RoverAppear01_018
Array.english: Oh, as thanks for letting me stay, I'll share one of my favorite recipes.
Array.indonesia: Oh, sebagai ucapan terima kasih karena sudah mengizinkanku tinggal di sini, aku akan membagikan salah satu resep favoritku.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_RoverAppear01_019
Array.english: <size=33>Well then... I'll be in your care for a while.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kalau begitu... aku akan berada di bawah perawatanmu untuk sementara waktu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaFail_001
Array.english: Did you get the dish I asked for ready?
Array.indonesia: Apakah hidangan yang kuminta sudah siap?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaFail_002
Array.english: About that... we're not quite ready with the ingredients yet... My apologies.
Array.indonesia: Soal itu... bahan-bahannya belum sepenuhnya siap... Maafkan aku.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaFail_003
Array.english: Hah... I knew this would happen.
Array.indonesia: Hah... Aku tahu ini akan terjadi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaFail_004
Array.english: All talk and no accountability.
Array.indonesia: Banyak omong kosong, tapi tidak ada tindakan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaFail_005
Array.english: That's harsh! Getting the ingredients was harder than I expected!
Array.indonesia: Itu kasar sekali! Mencari bahan-bahannya lebih sulit dari yang kuduga!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaFail_006
Array.english: <size=32>I'll have everything ready in <color=#F1DC2B>2 Days</color>, so please come back then.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku akan menyiapkan semuanya dalam <color=#F1DC2B>2 hari</color>, jadi tolong datang lagi saat itu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaFail_007
Array.english: I'd like to refuse, but if I end things here, I won't be able to point out just how flawed this dish is...
Array.indonesia: Aku ingin menolak, tapi kalau aku menghentikan ini di sini, aku tidak akan bisa menunjukkan betapa buruknya hidangan ini...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaFail_008
Array.english: Alright. I'll come back in <color=#F1DC2B>2 Days</color>.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah. Aku akan kembali dalam <color=#F1DC2B>2 hari</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaFail_009
Array.english: <size=32>I don't want another wasted trip.\nI'm a busy person, you know.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku tidak mau perjalanan ini sia-sia lagi.\nAku orang sibuk, lho.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_TwoPointMuseum_Start_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hm? I think someone's collapsed over there...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hm? Sepertinya ada yang pingsan di sana...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_TwoPointMuseum_Start_002
Array.english: <size=32>Looks like it...! Go check on him!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Sepertinya begitu...! Pergi periksa dia!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_LongbottomFound_001
Array.english: Are you alright...?
Array.indonesia: Kamu baik-baik saja...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_LongbottomFound_002
Array.english: Hmm... looks like he's unconscious.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... sepertinya dia pingsan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_LongbottomFound_003
Array.english: Looking at him, it seems like dehydration...\nWe should get some water into him.
Array.indonesia: Melihat kondisinya, sepertinya dia mengalami dehidrasi...\nKita harus memberinya minum.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_LongbottomFound_004
Array.english: Good thing I have some with me. Here...
Array.indonesia: Untungnya aku bawa air. Ini...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_AfterWater_001
Array.english: <size=34>Phew...! I'm alive...!!\nThank you...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wah...! Aku masih hidup...!!\nTerima kasih...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_AfterWater_002
Array.english: I'm <color=#F1DC2B>William Longbottom</color>, a prehistory specialist.\nPlease, call me William.
Array.indonesia: Aku <color=#F1DC2B>William Longbottom</color>, seorang ahli prasejarah.\nTolong, panggil saja aku William.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_AfterWater_003
Array.english: That was close. Any later and it would've been bad.\nSo what brings you all the way out here?
Array.indonesia: Hampir saja. Kalau terlambat sedikit lagi, pasti akan berakibat buruk.\nJadi, apa yang membawa kalian sampai ke sini?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_AfterWater_004
Array.english: Ah, I'm helping the <color=#F1DC2B>Two Point Museum</color> collect prehistoric fossils.
Array.indonesia: Ah, aku sedang membantu <color=#F1DC2B>Museum Two Point</color> mengumpulkan fosil prasejarah.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_AfterWater_005
Array.english: My research shows... there are <color=#F1DC2B>Unihornus</color> fossils in this area.
Array.indonesia: Penelitian saya menunjukkan... ada fosil <color=#F1DC2B>Unihornus</color> di daerah ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_AfterWater_006
Array.english: <size=32><color=#F1DC2B>Unihornus</color>...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32><color=#F1DC2B>Unihornus</color>...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_AfterWater_007
Array.english: <size=32>Yes! A giant dinosaur with a horn on its head!! There wasn't much proof it existed, but traces have been found in this region!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ya! Seekor dinosaurus raksasa dengan tanduk di kepalanya!! Tidak banyak bukti keberadaannya, tapi jejak-jejaknya telah ditemukan di wilayah ini!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_AfterWater_008
Array.english: I'd almost collected all the bones in this forest...\nbut then I fell and lost most of them.
Array.indonesia: Aku hampir mengumpulkan semua tulang di hutan ini...\ntapi kemudian aku terjatuh dan kehilangan sebagian besar di antaranya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_AfterWater_009
Array.english: I counted... and I'll need <color=#1DFEAF>42 More</color> to complete the collection.
Array.indonesia: Aku menghitung... dan aku masih membutuhkan <color=#1DFEAF>42 lagi</color> untuk melengkapi koleksiku.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_AfterWater_010
Array.english: <size=33>...That's quite a lot.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...Thattu cukup banyak.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_AfterWater_011
Array.english: Sir... I'm sorry, but could you help me find these <color=#F1DC2B>Unihornus Bones</color>?
Array.indonesia: Pak... Maaf, tapi bisakah Kamu membantuku menemukan <color=#F1DC2B>Tulang Unihornus</color> ini?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_AfterWater_012
Array.english: In my current state... I don't think I can keep exploring.
Array.indonesia: Dalam keadaanku sekarang... Saya rasa saya tidak bisa terus menjelajah.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_AfterWater_013
Array.english: Hehe. That sounds pretty interesting. Why don't we help? \nI'll pitch in too!
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Kedengarannya cukup menarik. Kenapa kita tidak membantu saja? \nSaya juga akan ikut membantu!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_AfterWater_014
Array.english: If even Muna's helping...\nAlright then.
Array.indonesia: Kalau Muna pun ikut membantu...\nBaiklah kalau begitu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_AfterWater_015
Array.english: So how do we find the <color=#F1DC2B>Unihornus Bones</color>?
Array.indonesia: Jadi, bagaimana cara kita menemukan <color=#F1DC2B>Tulang Unihornus</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_AfterWater_016
Array.english: After I passed out, it seems the forest animals took the bones from my bag.
Array.indonesia: Setelah aku pingsan, sepertinya hewan-hewan hutan mengambil tulang-tulang itu dari tasku.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_AfterWater_017
Array.english: If you fight the animals, they might drop some of what they took.
Array.indonesia: Kalau kalian bertarung melawan hewan-hewan itu, mungkin mereka akan menjatuhkan sebagian dari apa yang mereka ambil.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_AfterWater_018
Array.english: As I mentioned... I'd really appreciate it if you could collect the remaining <color=#1DFEAF>42</color>.
Array.indonesia: Seperti yang sudah kusebutkan... aku akan sangat berterima kasih kalau kalian bisa mengumpulkan sisa <color=#1DFEAF>42</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_AfterWater_019
Array.english: Got it. We'll search thoroughly.
Array.indonesia: Paham. Kita akan mencari secara menyeluruh.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_AfterWater_020
Array.english: For now, you should head to the village and rest.\nI'll have Rimbo come pick you up.
Array.indonesia: Untuk saat ini, sebaiknya kamu pergi ke desa dan beristirahat.\nAku akan minta Rimbo menjemputmu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_VillageWilliam_001
Array.english: I wonder... if William fully recovered?
Array.indonesia: Aku penasaran... apakah William sudah pulih sepenuhnya?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_VillageWilliam_002
Array.english: He's probably over by Lake Beach... I should go check on him?
Array.indonesia: Dia mungkin ada di dekat Danau Beach... sebaiknya aku pergi memeriksanya?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_BeachWilliam_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh! You're back!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh! Kamu sudah kembali!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_BeachWilliam_002
Array.english: Thanks to you, I've fully recovered.\nThe chef took good care of me.
Array.indonesia: Berkat kamu, aku sudah pulih sepenuhnya.\nKoki di sana merawatku dengan baik.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_BeachWilliam_003
Array.english: I was a bit out of it earlier... but I did mention the <color=#F1DC2B>Unihornus Bones</color>, right?
Array.indonesia: Tadi aku agak linglung... tapi aku sudah menyebutkan <color=#F1DC2B>Tulang Unihornus</color>, kan?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_BeachWilliam_004
Array.english: Yes. You asked us to find the remaining ones.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Kamu meminta kami untuk mencari yang tersisa.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_BeachWilliam_005
Array.english: That's right. I'd like to go with you, but...
Array.indonesia: Benar. Aku ingin ikut denganmu, tapi...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_BeachWilliam_006
Array.english: The forest creatures are pretty aggressive...\nIt's not easy for me to head out there.
Array.indonesia: Makhluk-makhluk hutan itu cukup agresif...\nTidak mudah bagiku untuk pergi ke sana.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_BeachWilliam_007
Array.english: Instead, I've been assembling some dinosaur bones here at Lake Beach. Want to take a look?
Array.indonesia: Sebagai gantinya, aku telah merakit beberapa tulang dinosaurus di sini, di Lake Beach. Mau lihat?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_ShowBoneCollection_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... dinosaur fossils...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... fosil dinosaurus...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_ShowBoneCollection_002
Array.english: Yes. I've been assembling the Unihornus bones I had.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Aku sedang merakit tulang-tulang Unihornus yang kumiliki.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_ShowBoneCollection_003
Array.english: I'll use this as a base and gradually fit in the bones you bring me.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan menggunakan ini sebagai dasar dan secara bertahap menyusun tulang-tulang yang kamu bawa kepadaku.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_ShowBoneCollection_004
Array.english: It's a much bigger dinosaur than I expected...
Array.indonesia: Dinosaurus ini jauh lebih besar dari yang kuduga...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_ShowBoneCollection_005
Array.english: Got it. I'll bring you the <color=#F1DC2B>Unihornus Bones</color> as soon as I collect them.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah. Aku akan membawakanmu <color=#F1DC2B>Tulang-tulang Unihornus</color> segera setelah aku mengumpulkannya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_ShowBoneCollection_006
Array.english: Yes. I'm sorry to impose on you like this.\nI'll be counting on you.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Maaf sudah merepotkanmu seperti ini.\nAku akan mengandalkanmu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_WillamCollectingTalk01_001
Array.english: To attract more visitors to the museum, we need to keep showcasing new exhibits.
Array.indonesia: Untuk menarik lebih banyak pengunjung ke museum, kita harus terus menampilkan pameran baru.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_WillamCollectingTalk01_002
Array.english: And for that, we have to explore places like this to find unique specimens!
Array.indonesia: Dan untuk itu, kita harus menjelajahi tempat-tempat seperti ini untuk menemukan spesimen unik!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_WillamCollectingTalk02_001
Array.english: Previously, I collected various dinosaur fossils from a place called the Bone Lands.
Array.indonesia: Sebelumnya, aku mengumpulkan berbagai fosil dinosaurus dari tempat bernama Bone Lands.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_WillamCollectingTalk02_002
Array.english: Even then, finding Unihornus bones wasn't easy...
Array.indonesia: Bahkan saat itu, menemukan tulang Unihornus pun tidak mudah...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_WillamCollectingTalk02_003
Array.english: But I'm glad you're helping me this time!
Array.indonesia: Tapi aku senang kamu membantuku kali ini!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_WillamHornTalk01_001
Array.english: I think I lost the horn in the swamp.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya aku kehilangan tanduknya di rawa.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_WillamHornTalk01_002
Array.english: A snakehead suddenly lunged at me, and I grabbed my bag and ran.
Array.indonesia: Seekor ular kepala tiba-tiba menerjangku, dan aku langsung mengambil tasku lalu berlari.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_WillamHornTalk01_003
Array.english: Please find it for me... I'm begging you.
Array.indonesia: Tolong temukan itu untukku... Aku memohon padamu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_CollectComplete_001
Array.english: Looks like I've collected all the <color=#F1DC2B>Unihornus Bones</color>.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya aku sudah mengumpulkan semua <color=#F1DC2B>Tulang Unihornus</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_CollectComplete_002
Array.english: <size=32>I should take them to William at Lake Beach!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku harus membawanya ke William di Lake Beach!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_CollectDeliver_001
Array.english: I've gathered all the <color=#F1DC2B>Unihornus Bones</color> you mentioned.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah mengumpulkan semua <color=#F1DC2B>Tulang Unihornus</color> yang kamu sebutkan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_CollectDeliver_002
Array.english: <size=32>Oh!! Really!! Thank you so much!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh!! Benarkah!! Terima kasih banyak!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_CollectDeliver_003
Array.english: Now, let me try assembling the bones you brought.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang, biarkan aku mencoba merakit tulang-tulang yang kamu bawa.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_NoHorn_001
Array.english: Hmm... oh no...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... oh tidak...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_NoHorn_002
Array.english: What's wrong?
Array.indonesia: Ada apa?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_NoHorn_003
Array.english: <size=32><color=#F1DC2B>The Horn</color> is missing...\nI'm sure it was with the other bones...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32><color=#F1DC2B>Tanduk</color>-nya hilang...\nAku yakin tadi masih ada bersama tulang-tulang lainnya...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_NoHorn_004
Array.english: <size=32>Without the horn, the Unihornus isn't complete...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tanpa tanduknya, Unihornus tidak akan lengkap...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_NoHorn_005
Array.english: Hmm... do you have any idea where it might be?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... apa kamu tahu di mana tanduk itu mungkin berada?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_NoHorn_006
Array.english: Now that you mention it... a giant <color=#F1DC2B>Snakehead</color> suddenly lunged at me in the forest swamp, and I ran in a panic...
Array.indonesia: Sekarang kamu menyebutkannya... seekor <color=#F1DC2B>Snakehead</color> raksasa tiba-tiba menerjangku di rawa hutan, dan aku lari panik...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_NoHorn_007
Array.english: Maybe I dropped it then...
Array.indonesia: Mungkin aku menjatuhkannya saat itu...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_NoHorn_008
Array.english: I see. I'll check when I go back to the forest.
Array.indonesia: Begitu ya. Aku akan memeriksanya saat kembali ke hutan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_NoHorn_009
Array.english: <size=32>Thank you...!\nThe <color=#1DFEAF>Swamp</color> is near where I collapsed.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Terima kasih...!\n<color=#1DFEAF>Rawa</color> itu berada di dekat tempat aku pingsan.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_NoHorn_010
Array.english: <size=32>There were a lot of dangerous animals there, so make sure you're well prepared...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ada banyak hewan berbahaya di sana, jadi pastikan kamu sudah siap dengan baik...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_SwampBossAppear_001
Array.english: <size=32>I think this is the area William mentioned...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kurasa ini daerah yang disebutkan William...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_SwampBossAppear_002
Array.english: <size=32>But I don't see the Unihornus horn anywhere...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tapi aku tidak melihat tanduk Unihornus di mana pun...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_SwampBossStart_001
Array.english: <size=32>Whoa...! That's a massive snakehead...!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wah...! Itu ikan kepala ular yang sangat besar...!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_SwampBossStart_002
Array.english: <size=32>That must be the thing that attacked William!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Itu pasti makhluk yang menyerang William!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_SwampBossStart_003
Array.english: The <color=#F1DC2B>Horn</color> he mentioned... Do you think that thing swallowed it?
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Tanduk</color> yang dia sebutkan... Menurutmu, apakah makhluk itu menelannya?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_SwampBossStart_004
Array.english: Hmm... I'm not sure, but either way, we can't investigate with that thing around.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Aku tidak yakin, tapi bagaimanapun juga, kita tidak bisa menyelidikinya selama makhluk itu masih di sekitar sini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_SwampBossStart_005
Array.english: <size=32>Hahaha! The answer's obvious! Let's take it down with everything we've got!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hahaha! Jawabannya jelas! Ayo kita kalahkan makhluk itu dengan segala yang kita miliki!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_SwampBossClear_001
Array.english: Phew... Those fins were thrashing so much, it was hard to focus.
Array.indonesia: Fiuh... Sirip-siripnya bergerak-gerak begitu kencang, sampai-sampai sulit untuk fokus.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_SwampBossClear_002
Array.english: Just as we thought, that thing had swallowed the <color=#F1DC2B>Unihornus Horn</color>.
Array.indonesia: Seperti yang kita duga, makhluk itu telah menelan <color=#F1DC2B>Tanduk Unihornus</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_SwampBossClear_003
Array.english: <size=32>It's so hard and smooth... Really magnificent...! Hehehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tanduknya begitu keras dan halus... Sungguh luar biasa...! Hehehe.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_SwampBossClear_004
Array.english: This looks like the final piece of the Unihornus skeleton.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya ini adalah bagian terakhir dari kerangka Unihornus.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_SwampBossClear_005
Array.english: Let's head back to the village and give it to William at Lake Beach!
Array.indonesia: Ayo kembali ke desa dan serahkan ini kepada William di Lake Beach!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_SwampBossRetry_001
Array.english: <size=33>That colossal snakehead from before...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ikan kepala ular raksasa tadi...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_SwampBossRetry_002
Array.english: <size=32>I'm sure that thing swallowed the <color=#F1DC2B>Unihornus Horn</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku yakin makhluk itu telah menelan <color=#F1DC2B>Tanduk Unihornus</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_SwampBossRetry_003
Array.english: <size=34>This time, we'll defeat it for sure!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kali ini, kita pasti akan mengalahkannya!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_MissionComplete01_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ohhh! You found it! The <color=#F1DC2B>Unihornus Horn</color>!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ohhh! Kamu menemukannya! <color=#F1DC2B>Tanduk Unihornus</color>!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_MissionComplete01_002
Array.english: Yeah... a snakehead had swallowed it.
Array.indonesia: Ya... seekor kepala ular telah menelannya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_MissionComplete01_003
Array.english: I'm so sorry you had to go through all that trouble because of me...
Array.indonesia: Maaf banget kamu harus repot-repot karena aku...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_MissionComplete01_004
Array.english: But thanks to you, we finally have all the Unihornus bones!
Array.indonesia: Tapi berkat kamu, akhirnya kita punya semua tulang Unihornus!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_MissionComplete01_005
Array.english: Now, let me place the horn...
Array.indonesia: Sekarang, biar aku pasang tanduknya...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_MissionComplete02_001
Array.english: <size=33>Wow... Look at this...! Isn't it amazing...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wow... Lihat ini...! Luar biasa, kan...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_MissionComplete02_002
Array.english: That one horn really makes a huge difference.
Array.indonesia: Tanduk itu benar-benar membuat perbedaan besar.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_MissionComplete02_003
Array.english: <size=32>It looks incredible.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Terlihat luar biasa.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_MissionComplete02_004
Array.english: Hahaha! Thank you so much!
Array.indonesia: Hahaha! Terima kasih banyak!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_MissionComplete02_005
Array.english: <size=33>But there's one problem...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tapi ada satu masalah...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_MissionComplete02_006
Array.english: Before you got back, I contacted the museum to arrange transport for the fossil...
Array.indonesia: Sebelum kamu kembali, aku menghubungi museum untuk mengatur pengiriman fosil itu...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_MissionComplete02_007
Array.english: They said they don't have a helicopter available right now...
Array.indonesia: Mereka bilang saat ini tidak ada helikopter yang tersedia...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_MissionComplete02_008
Array.english: And honestly, even when they do send one, it's such an old helicopter that it'll take quite a while to get here.
Array.indonesia: Dan sejujurnya, bahkan jika mereka mengirimkannya, helikopter itu sudah sangat tua sehingga akan memakan waktu cukup lama untuk sampai ke sini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_MissionComplete02_009
Array.english:
So, I was thinking... Until the helicopter's ready,
how about I help out around the village?
Array.indonesia:
Jadi, aku berpikir... Sampai helikopternya siap,
gimana kalau aku membantu di sekitar desa?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_MissionComplete02_010
Array.english: I'd like to repay the chef who prepared those meals for me as well.
Array.indonesia: Saya juga ingin membalas kebaikan koki yang telah menyiapkan makanan untuk saya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_MissionComplete02_011
Array.english: In that case, maybe you could help out at the restaurant in the evenings!
Array.indonesia: Kalau begitu, mungkin kamu bisa membantu di restoran pada malam hari!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_MissionComplete02_012
Array.english:
You mean cooking and serving!
No problem at all!
Array.indonesia:
Maksudmu memasak dan menyajikan makanan!
Tidak masalah sama sekali!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_MissionComplete02_013
Array.english: Then let me display this Unihornus skeleton here for now.
Array.indonesia: Kalau begitu, izinkan saya memajang kerangka Unihornus ini di sini untuk sementara.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_MissionComplete02_014
Array.english: It'll be a great attraction for villagers who don't get many chances to visit faraway museums!
Array.indonesia: Ini akan jadi daya tarik yang hebat bagi penduduk desa yang jarang punya kesempatan mengunjungi museum-museum yang jauh!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_InprogressPushRock01_001
Array.english: I need 3 villagers to move the boulder. I should ask around for help.
Array.indonesia: Aku butuh 3 penduduk desa untuk memindahkan batu besar itu. Sebaiknya aku minta bantuan ke sekitar sini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_InprogressPushRock02_001
Array.english: Alright! I've found 3 people to help move the boulder.\nLet's go see the village chief.
Array.indonesia: Oke! Aku sudah menemukan 3 orang yang mau membantu memindahkan batu besar itu.\nAyo kita temui kepala desa.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_BattleTutorial_End_001
Array.english: <size=32>Alright, Dave! Looks like you're warmed up!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Baiklah, Dave! Sepertinya kamu sudah siap!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_BattleTutorial_End_002
Array.english: <size=32>Keep an eye on your health and stay focused!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Perhatikan kesehatanmu dan tetap fokus!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_WhatMudSkipper_001
Array.english: <size=35>Huh? Eyes in the ground...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Hah? Mata di tanah...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Barricade_Elevator_001
Array.english: <size=32>I should take the elevator up first.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Sebaiknya aku naik lift dulu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Elevator_Ask_001
Array.english: <size=32>Should I take the lift?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haruskah aku naik lift?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Elevator_Ask_option01
Array.english: Ride
Array.indonesia: Naiklah

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Elevator_Ask_option02
Array.english: Let's look around a bit more
Array.indonesia: Ayo kita lihat-lihat sebentar lagi

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Elevator_Ask_Go_001
Array.english: Time to head back.\nLet's take the lift.
Array.indonesia: Waktunya pulang.\nAyo kita naik lift.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Elevator_Ask_Go_002
Array.english: Hope it works properly...
Array.indonesia: Semoga liftnya berfungsi dengan baik...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Elevator_Ask_Stay_001
Array.english: I should look around a bit more before I go.\nBecause I might have missed something.
Array.indonesia: Sebaiknya aku melihat-lihat sebentar lagi sebelum pergi.\nKarena mungkin ada yang terlewatkan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Elevator_Awake_001
Array.english: <size=32>Now that I've got the ancient Sunang <color=#F1DC2B>Diving Equipment</color>, should we head back to the village?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Sekarang setelah aku mendapatkan <color=#F1DC2B>Peralatan Selam</color> kuno milik Sunang, apakah kita sebaiknya kembali ke desa?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Elevator_Awake_002
Array.english: <size=32>Let's try activating the elevator on the left that Marone found.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ayo coba nyalakan lift di sebelah kiri yang ditemukan Marone.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MunaKnock_001
Array.english: <size=34>Yawn... who could it be this early in the morning...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ngantuk... siapa ya yang datang sedini ini...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MunaKnock_002
Array.english: <size=33>Sounds like Muna.\nI should go check.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Sepertinya Muna.\nAku harus cek dulu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MunaComing_001
Array.english: Hehe... sorry for dropping by so early.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... maaf sudah mampir sedini ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MunaComing_002
Array.english: I overdid it yesterday. Between the forest and the festival drinks, I'm feeling pretty sluggish today.
Array.indonesia: Kemarin aku kelelahan. Antara hutan dan minuman di festival, hari ini aku merasa agak lesu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MunaComing_003
Array.english: Well... it's about the breathing apparatus and cloth you brought yesterday...
Array.indonesia: Nah... ini soal alat bantu pernapasan dan kain yang kamu bawa kemarin...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MunaComing_004
Array.english: Could you come to my tent? Hehe.
Array.indonesia: Bisakah kamu datang ke tendaku? Hehe.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_JungleSuitGet_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ta-da! This is the new suit I made using the breathing apparatus and fabric you brought yesterday!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ta-da! Ini adalah pakaian baru yang kubuat menggunakan alat bantu pernapasan dan kain yang kamu bawa kemarin!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_JungleSuitGet_002
Array.english: <size=33>It filters out most of the hydrogen sulfide...\nand keeps it from seeping into your skin!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ini menyaring sebagian besar hidrogen sulfida...\ndan mencegahnya meresap ke kulitmu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_JungleSuitGet_003
Array.english: <size=35>Oh...! That's amazing!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh...! Luar biasa!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_JungleSuitGet_004
Array.english: <size=31>You made this in just one day...\nThat's seriously impressive.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Kamu membuatnya hanya dalam satu hari...\nItu sungguh mengesankan.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_JungleSuitGet_005
Array.english: <size=32>Hehehe!! So, why don't you try on this masterpiece by the genius Muna!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehehe!! Jadi, kenapa kamu tidak mencoba karya agung dari jenius Muna ini!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_JungleSuitGet_006
Array.english: <size=32>Alright. I'll put it on and head to the deck.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Baiklah. Aku akan memakainya dan pergi ke dek.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_JungleSuitGet02_001
Array.english: <size=35>Oh... it fits perfectly!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh... pas banget!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_JungleSuitGet02_002
Array.english: So, how does it feel to actually wear it?!
Array.indonesia: Jadi, bagaimana rasanya memakainya?!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_JungleSuitGet02_003
Array.english: It feels sturdy with no gaps, yet so light.\nI can't believe this is made from ancient materials.
Array.indonesia: Rasanya kokoh tanpa celah, tapi sangat ringan.\nAku nggak percaya ini terbuat dari bahan kuno.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_JungleSuitGet02_004
Array.english: Hehe...! With that, even the hydrogen sulfide layer won't be a problem. I've tested it with all sorts of strong chemicals.
Array.indonesia: Hehe...! Dengan ini, bahkan lapisan hidrogen sulfida pun nggak akan jadi masalah. Aku sudah mengujinya dengan berbagai macam bahan kimia yang kuat.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_JungleSuitGet02_005
Array.english: Thanks. I'll head down to the <color=#F1DC2B>Sea</color> beneath the lake.
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih. Aku akan turun ke <color=#F1DC2B>Laut</color> di bawah danau.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_LakeBottomHazardPass_001
Array.english: <size=32>Thanks to the new suit, the hydrogen sulfide doesn't sting at all.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Berkat pakaian pelindung baru ini, hidrogen sulfida sama sekali tidak terasa menyengat.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_LakeBottomHazardPass_002
Array.english: <size=32>Let's head down to the sea below!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ayo turun ke laut di bawah sana!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_LakeBottomAreaEnter01_001
Array.english: The atmosphere here feels completely different from the lake...?!
Array.indonesia: Suasana di sini terasa sangat berbeda dari danau...?!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_LakeBottomAreaEnter01_002
Array.english: An ancient civilization... No, wait, there are signs it was used until recently.
Array.indonesia: Sebuah peradaban kuno... Tunggu, ada tanda-tanda bahwa tempat ini masih digunakan hingga baru-baru ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_LakeBottomAreaEnter01_003
Array.english: And... ancient creatures...?\nHow are they living here?
Array.indonesia: Dan... makhluk purba...?\nBagaimana mereka bisa hidup di sini?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_LakeBottomAreaEnter01_004
Array.english: <size=32>Something feels off.\nLet's go a bit further down.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ada yang terasa janggal.\nAyo kita turun sedikit lebih jauh.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_LakeBottomAreaEnter02_001
Array.english: That blue thing... could it be...?
Array.indonesia: Benda biru itu... mungkinkah...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_LakeBottomAreaEnter02_002
Array.english: <size=32><color=#63F9FF>A Divine Tree Fruit</color>?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32><color=#63F9FF>Buah Pohon Suci</color>?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_LakeBottomAreaEnter02_003
Array.english: Hmm... the one I saw before was yellow...\nCould this be a different variety...?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... yang aku lihat sebelumnya berwarna kuning...\nMungkinkah ini varietas yang berbeda...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_LakeBottomAreaEnter02_004
Array.english: It's a bit creepy, but since I'm here, I should take a closer look.
Array.indonesia: Agak menyeramkan, tapi karena aku sudah di sini, sebaiknya aku melihatnya lebih dekat.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MahoniCave_BottomDoorFind01_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ahh...?! Ancient creatures are coming out of a passage in the floor...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ahh...?! Makhluk purba keluar dari celah di lantai...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MahoniCave_BottomDoorFind01_002
Array.english: <size=32>Dave! Dave... can you hear me?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Dave! Dave... apa kamu dengar aku?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MahoniCave_BottomDoorFind01_003
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, Dr. Bacon... yes, I can hear you clearly.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, Dr. Bacon... ya, aku bisa mendengarmu dengan jelas.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MahoniCave_BottomDoorFind01_004
Array.english: <size=32>The door in the floor... it's opening, and ancient creatures are coming out...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Pintu di lantai... sedang terbuka, dan makhluk-makhluk purba keluar...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MahoniCave_BottomDoorFind01_005
Array.english: <size=32>I'm watching through the camera feed.\nThat's definitely...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku sedang melihatnya lewat siaran kamera.\nItu pasti...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MahoniCave_BottomDoorFind01_006
Array.english: <size=32>...the gate to the ancient past described in the Sunang civilization writings...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>...the gerbang menuju masa lalu purba yang dijelaskan dalam tulisan-tulisan peradaban Sunang...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MahoniCave_BottomDoorFind01_007
Array.english: <size=32>So it really existed...! The writings said it was sealed... \nhow did it open...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Jadi, gerbang itu benar-benar ada...! Tulisan-tulisan itu menyebutkan bahwa gerbang itu telah disegel... \nbagaimana bisa gerbang itu terbuka...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MahoniCave_BottomDoorFind01_008
Array.english: <size=32>Could it have been opened by that big earthquake we had at the Blue Hole?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Mungkinkah gerbang itu terbuka akibat gempa bumi besar yang terjadi di Blue Hole?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MahoniCave_BottomDoorFind02_001
Array.english: <size=32>What was that huge tremor just now, Dave!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Apa itu getaran hebat barusan, Dave!?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MahoniCave_BottomDoorFind02_002
Array.english: <size=33>A giant dinosaur is trying to come through the gate...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Seekor dinosaurus raksasa sedang mencoba masuk melalui gerbang itu...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MahoniCave_BottomDoorFind02_003
Array.english: <size=32>It's stuck and can't get through right now... but given its size, it's only a matter of time before it breaks through!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Dia terjebak dan belum bisa lewat sekarang... tapi mengingat ukurannya, hanya masalah waktu sebelum dia berhasil menerobos!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MahoniCave_BottomDoorFind02_004
Array.english: <size=32>The water's too deep, so the signal's weak...\nand the camera isn't working, so I can't see it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Airnya terlalu dalam, jadi sinyalnya lemah...\ndan kameranya tidak berfungsi, jadi aku tidak bisa melihatnya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MahoniCave_BottomDoorFind02_005
Array.english: <size=33>Dave, could you take a <color=#1DFEAF>Photo</color> of it for me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Dave, bisakah kamu mengambil <color=#1DFEAF>foto</color> makhluk itu untukku?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MahoniCave_BottomDoorFind02_006
Array.english: <size=33>...What? In this situation?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...What? Dalam situasi seperti ini?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MahoniCave_BottomDoorFind02_007
Array.english: <size=32>Please. I need to know what kind of creature it is to assess the situation!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tolong. Aku perlu tahu makhluk apa itu untuk menilai situasinya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MahoniCave_BottomDoorFind02_008
Array.english: <size=32>Ugh... alright. I'll try to get a shot.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ugh... baiklah. Aku akan coba ambil fotonya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MahoniCave_BasiloPhotoBarricade_001
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Dr. Bacon asked me to take a <color=#1DFEAF>Photo</color> of that giant dinosaur.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Dr. Bacon memintaku untuk mengambil <color=#1DFEAF>foto</color> dinosaurus raksasa itu.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MahoniCave_BasiloPhotoBarricade_002
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(It's terrifying, but... I should try to take it carefully.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Menakutkan sekali, tapi... aku harus mencoba mengambilnya dengan hati-hati.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MahoniCave_BasiloPhotoClear_001
Array.english: <size=33>Alright. I think this one turned out pretty well.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Baiklah. Kurasa foto ini hasilnya cukup bagus.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MahoniCave_BasiloPhotoClear_002
Array.english: <size=33>Let's head back to the village and show it to Dr. Bacon!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ayo kembali ke desa dan tunjukkan foto ini kepada Dr. Bacon!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_Stethacanthus_Enter01_001
Array.english: <size=33>Whoa...! A spear just came flying out of nowhere...!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wah...! Tiba-tiba ada tombak yang melesat entah dari mana...!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_Stethacanthus_Enter01_002
Array.english: <size=32>Who's down here this deep...? Don't tell me it's the Sea People...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Siapa yang ada di kedalaman ini...? Jangan-jangan itu Suku Laut...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_Stethacanthus_Enter01_003
Array.english: <size=33>I should get out of the way first.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku harus menjauh dulu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_Stethacanthus_Start01_001
Array.english: Phew... I think I barely shook them off...
Array.indonesia: Fiuh... Sepertinya aku berhasil menghindarinya...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_Stethacanthus_Start01_002
Array.english: But where am I...?
Array.indonesia: Tapi di mana aku...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_Stethacanthus_Start02_001
Array.english: <size=33>What the heck is that...?! A shark...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Apa-apaan itu...?! Hiu...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_Stethacanthus_Start03_001
Array.english: <size=33>Whoa...! The cage broke...!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wah...! Kandang ini pecah...!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_Stethacanthus_Start04_001
Array.english: Ugh... the exit's blocked too...
Array.indonesia: Ugh... jalan keluarnya juga terhalang...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_Stethacanthus_Start04_002
Array.english: I've got no choice but to take it down...
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak punya pilihan selain menghabisinya...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_Stethacanthus_End_Looting_001
Array.english: Phew... that was one weird-looking creature.
Array.indonesia: Fiuh... itu makhluk yang penampilannya aneh sekali.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_Stethacanthus_End_Looting_002
Array.english: Maybe I should check if there's anything worth taking from the shark.
Array.indonesia: Mungkin aku harus memeriksa apakah ada sesuatu yang layak diambil dari hiu itu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MahoniCave_Stethacanthus_End_Looting_Barricade_001
Array.english: Let's see if there's anything we can take from the shark before we leave.
Array.indonesia: Ayo kita lihat apakah ada sesuatu yang bisa kita ambil dari hiu itu sebelum kita pergi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_Stethacanthus_End_ReturnTown_001
Array.english: Phew... what appeared earlier seemed to be Sea People...
Array.indonesia: Wah... yang muncul tadi sepertinya adalah Suku Laut...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_Stethacanthus_End_ReturnTown_002
Array.english: Unlike the Sea People from the Blue Hole, they were extremely hostile.
Array.indonesia: Tidak seperti Suku Laut dari Blue Hole, mereka sangat agresif.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_Stethacanthus_End_ReturnTown_003
Array.english: For now, I should head up to the village and give Dr. Bacon the <color=#F1DC2B>Photos</color>.
Array.indonesia: Untuk saat ini, aku sebaiknya pergi ke desa dan memberikan <color=#F1DC2B>Foto-foto</color> itu kepada Dr. Bacon.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh...! You're safe! What a relief!!</size>
