Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh...! Kamu selamat! Lega sekali!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_002
Array.english: <size=31>I was worried sick when the comms cut out.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Aku sangat khawatir saat komunikasi terputus.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_003
Array.english: We suddenly ran into a shark with a weird anvil on its head...
Array.indonesia: Tiba-tiba kami bertemu hiu dengan benda aneh berbentuk landasan tempa di kepalanya...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_004
Array.english: That shark looked like some kind of ancient creature too.
Array.indonesia: Hiu itu juga tampak seperti makhluk purba.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_005
Array.english:
An anvil on its head...
Could it be a <color=#F1DC2B>Stethacanthus</color>...?!
Array.indonesia:
Landasan tempa di kepalanya...
Mungkinkah itu <color=#F1DC2B>Stethacanthus</color>...?!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_006
Array.english: Hmm. None of these creatures should be alive in this era...
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Tak seharusnya ada makhluk-makhluk ini yang masih hidup di zaman sekarang...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_007
Array.english: Show me the <color=#F1DC2B>Photos</color> you took, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Tunjukkan <color=#F1DC2B>Foto-foto</color> yang kamu ambil, Dave.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_008
Array.english: Sure. Here they are.
Array.indonesia: Tentu. Ini dia.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_009
Array.english: <size=31>This... it's the same species as the one that washed up on the beach a while back!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Ini... ini spesies yang sama dengan yang terdampar di pantai beberapa waktu lalu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_010
Array.english: Judging by its larger size... it might be the mother.
Array.indonesia: Dilihat dari ukurannya yang lebih besar... mungkin ini induknya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_011
Array.english: So it came out looking for its baby?
Array.indonesia: Jadi, dia keluar untuk mencari bayinya?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_012
Array.english: It probably knows by instinct that its baby is dead.\nThat's why it's in such a rage right now.
Array.indonesia: Mungkin dia tahu secara naluriah bahwa bayinya sudah mati.\nItulah mengapa dia begitu marah saat ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_013
Array.english: I feel a bit sorry for it, but... if it keeps coming out like this, \nit'll destroy the whole lake and village.
Array.indonesia: Aku agak kasihan padanya, tapi... jika dia terus keluar seperti ini, \ndia akan menghancurkan seluruh danau dan desa.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_014
Array.english: But even if we try to send it back now, it'll be pointless with the gate still open.
Array.indonesia: Tapi meskipun kita mencoba mengembalikannya sekarang, itu akan sia-sia selama gerbang masih terbuka.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_015
Array.english: The ones who manage this area, the Sea People...\nshould know how to operate that gate.
Array.indonesia: Mereka yang mengelola daerah ini, Suku Laut...\nseharusnya tahu cara mengoperasikan gerbang itu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_016
Array.english: <size=33>Ah... the ones who suddenly attacked me...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ah... mereka yang tiba-tiba menyerangku...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_017
Array.english: Hmm... according to the local writings, these Sea People are \na tribe called the <color=#1DFEAF>Mahoni</color>.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... menurut tulisan-tulisan setempat, Suku Laut ini adalah \nsebuah suku bernama <color=#1DFEAF>Mahoni</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_018
Array.english: They're quite hostile toward humans entering their territory... or so it says.
Array.indonesia: Mereka cukup bermusuhan terhadap manusia yang memasuki wilayah mereka... setidaknya begitu yang tertulis.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_019
Array.english: Hmm. We'll need to work with them to close that gate...\nThis won't be easy.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Kita harus bekerja sama dengan mereka untuk menutup gerbang itu...\nIni tidak akan mudah.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_020
Array.english: Oh, Dave. Do you still have the <color=#F1DC2B>Sea People Translator</color>?
Array.indonesia: Oh, Dave. Apakah kamu masih punya <color=#F1DC2B>Penerjemah Suku Laut</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_021
Array.english: Yes. It's still attached to my gear.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Alat itu masih terpasang di perlengkapan saya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_022
Array.english: Great! Then why don't you try talking to the Sea People directly and ask them to close the gate?
Array.indonesia: Bagus! Kalau begitu, kenapa kamu tidak mencoba berbicara langsung dengan Suku Laut dan meminta mereka untuk menutup gerbang itu?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_023
Array.english: <size=32>What? But they attacked me on sight!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Apa? Tapi mereka langsung menyerangku begitu melihatku!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_024
Array.english: True, but... they must be having quite a bit of trouble with that ancient creature too. We share the same goal.
Array.indonesia: Benar, tapi... mereka pasti juga mengalami banyak kesulitan dengan makhluk purba itu. Kita memiliki tujuan yang sama.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_025
Array.english: If you meet their chief, I'm sure you'll find a way to work together!
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu bertemu dengan pemimpin mereka, aku yakin kamu pasti bisa menemukan cara untuk bekerja sama!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_026
Array.english: Hmm... I doubt they'll even agree to meet me.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Aku ragu mereka mau setuju untuk bertemu denganku.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_027
Array.english: <size=32>Then just break in and meet them face-to-face!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kalau begitu, masuk saja paksa dan temui mereka langsung!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_028
Array.english: All Mahoni devices run on energy from <color=#63F9FF>Blue Divine Tree Fruit</color>.
Array.indonesia: Semua perangkat Mahoni beroperasi menggunakan energi dari <color=#63F9FF>Buah Pohon Ilahi Biru</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_029
Array.english: Which means... the entrance to their settlement is sealed with that same energy.
Array.indonesia: Artinya... pintu masuk ke pemukiman mereka disegel dengan energi yang sama.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_030
Array.english: If we can harness that energy... we can break into their settlement and meet the Mahoni chief!
Array.indonesia: Jika kita bisa memanfaatkan energi itu... kita bisa menerobos masuk ke pemukiman mereka dan bertemu dengan pemimpin Mahoni!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_031
Array.english: <size=34>...That sounds like a pretty reckless solution.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>...That kedengarannya seperti solusi yang cukup nekat.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_032
Array.english: It's a forced approach, but it does make sense in a way.
Array.indonesia: Memang cara yang terpaksa, tapi dalam arti tertentu masuk akal juga.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_033
Array.english: Hmm... so I need to go down to the deep sea and get some <color=#63F9FF>Divine Tree Berries</color>?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... jadi aku harus turun ke laut dalam dan mengambil beberapa <color=#63F9FF>Buah Pohon Ilahi</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_034
Array.english: That'd be pretty risky. They're heavy, and... you could get attacked by ancient creatures on the way back.
Array.indonesia: Itu bakal cukup berisiko. Buahnya berat, dan... kamu bisa diserang makhluk purba saat pulang.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_035
Array.english: <size=32>Ah! About that <color=#F1DC2B>Temple</color> you visited, Dave!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ah! Soal <color=#F1DC2B>Kuil</color> yang kamu kunjungi tadi, Dave!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_036
Array.english: <size=32>Was there any way to go further down from the basement?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Apakah ada cara untuk turun lebih dalam lagi dari ruang bawah tanah?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_037
Array.english: Hmm... I think I saw a ladder, but...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Sepertinya aku melihat tangga, tapi...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_038
Array.english: <size=33>The water's too high, so I won't be able to go down.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Airnya terlalu tinggi, jadi aku tidak bisa turun.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_039
Array.english: <size=32>Just as I thought! Muna's prediction was right again!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Seperti yang kuduga! Ramalan Muna benar lagi!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_040
Array.english: This Divine Tree seems to extend all the way down to the temple's basement. Which means you can harvest <color=#63F9FF>Blue Divine Tree Berries</color> down there.
Array.indonesia: Pohon Suci ini sepertinya menjulur sampai ke ruang bawah tanah kuil. Artinya, kamu bisa memetik <color=#63F9FF>Buah Pohon Suci Biru</color> di sana.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_041
Array.english: Hmm... even if that's true, how do we drain the water?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... meskipun itu benar, bagaimana cara kita mengeringkan airnya?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_042
Array.english: Hehe. Leave the ancient contraptions to me.\nThat's my specialty.
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Serahkan saja alat-alat kuno itu padaku.\nItu keahlianku.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_043
Array.english: <size=33>First, take me to the <color=#F1DC2B>Temple</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Pertama, bawa aku ke <color=#F1DC2B>Kuil</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_044
Array.english: There are a lot of dangerous wild animals there.\nAre you sure you'll be okay?
Array.indonesia: Ada banyak hewan liar berbahaya di sana.\nKamu yakin akan baik-baik saja?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_045
Array.english: Hehe, don't worry.\nI've had some special training myself.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, jangan khawatir.\nAku sendiri sudah menjalani pelatihan khusus.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_046
Array.english: I'll get everything ready today, so let's meet at the forest entrance <color=#F1DC2B>Tomorrow</color>, hahaha!!
Array.indonesia: Aku akan menyiapkan semuanya hari ini, jadi ayo kita bertemu di pintu masuk hutan <color=#F1DC2B>Besok</color>, hahaha!!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_047
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>Hmm... is this really a good idea...?</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>Hmm... apakah ini benar-benar ide yang bagus...?</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_DaveMorning_001
Array.english: Muna asked me to go to the temple with her, right?
Array.indonesia: Muna memintaku untuk pergi ke kuil bersamanya, kan?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_DaveMorning_002
Array.english: Once I'm done here, I'll head toward the forest.
Array.indonesia: Begitu aku selesai di sini, aku akan menuju ke hutan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_RimboSignpost_001
Array.english: Hmm? Rimbo. Are you setting something up?
Array.indonesia: Hmm? Rimbo. Apa kamu sedang menyiapkan sesuatu?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_RimboSignpost_002
Array.english: Ah, now that the forest path's open, I've been lookin' around and puttin' up some <color=#1DFEAF>Signposts</color>.
Array.indonesia: Ah, sekarang jalan setapak di hutan sudah terbuka, aku sudah keliling-keliling dan memasang beberapa <color=#1DFEAF>rambu-rambu</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_RimboSignpost_003
Array.english: If ya call me from one of them <color=#1DFEAF>Signposts</color> in the forest,\nI'll come pick ya up in the truck right away.
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu memanggilku dari salah satu <color=#1DFEAF>Tanda Arah</color> di hutan itu,\naku akan segera menjemputmu dengan truk.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_RimboSignpost_004
Array.english: Not just the village... you can go anywhere there's a <color=#1DFEAF>Signpost</color> set up.
Array.indonesia: Bukan hanya desa... kamu bisa pergi ke mana saja yang ada <color=#1DFEAF>Tanda Arah</color> yang dipasang.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_RimboSignpost_005
Array.english: Oh... the forest's pretty dangerous, so that's a relief!
Array.indonesia: Oh... hutan itu cukup berbahaya, jadi itu melegakan!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_RimboSignpost_006
Array.english: <size=31>Hehe! You've been workin' hard for the village,\nso I gotta help out somehow!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Hehe! Kamu sudah bekerja keras untuk desa,\njadi aku harus membantu sebisa mungkin!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_MunaJoin_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh! You're already here...!\nI'm a bit late... hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh! Kamu sudah di sini...!\nAku agak terlambat... hehe.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_MunaJoin_002
Array.english: You seem excited.\nDid you bring your weapon?
Array.indonesia: Kamu kelihatan bersemangat.\nKamu bawa senjatamu?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_MunaJoin_003
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! Of course!! We're heading into the jungle! \nAnd the ruins!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Tentu saja!! Kita akan masuk ke hutan! \nDan reruntuhan!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_MunaJoin_004
Array.english: <size=33>Ta-da!! It's a <color=#F1DC2B>Whip</color>, see!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ta-da!! Ini adalah <color=#F1DC2B>Cambuk</color>, lihat!!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_MunaJoin_005
Array.english: <size=32>I'll take them all down with this, swish swish! \nSo don't you worry!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku akan menghabisi mereka semua dengan ini, swish swish! \nJadi jangan khawatir!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_MunaJoin_006
Array.english: <size=32>Hahaha! Sounds good. Let's get going then!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hahaha! Kedengarannya bagus. Ayo berangkat!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_BeforeEntertheDungeon_001
Array.english: <size=32>Ooh... so this is the Murau Temple...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ooh... jadi ini Kuil Murau...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_BeforeEntertheDungeon_002
Array.english: I can smell a mysterious adventure brewing... hehehe.
Array.indonesia: Aku bisa mencium aroma petualangan misterius yang akan terjadi... hehehe.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_BeforeEntertheDungeon_003
Array.english: <size=32>Alright, let's head in!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Baiklah, ayo masuk!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_ElevatorReminder_001
Array.english: <size=31>...Hm? What's that?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>...Hm? Apa itu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_ElevatorReminder_002
Array.english: Oh, right! That's the elevator I used to come up last time!
Array.indonesia: Oh, benar! Itu lift yang kugunakan untuk naik terakhir kali!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_ElevatorReminder_003
Array.english: <size=32>Hahaha, that's right.\nIt'll be much easier if we take that down!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hahaha, benar juga.\nAkan jauh lebih mudah kalau kita turun lewat situ!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_Arrived_001
Array.english: This is where the ancient breathing apparatus was.
Array.indonesia: Di sinilah alat bantu pernapasan kuno itu berada.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_Arrived_002
Array.english: Hmm. This is probably where most of the rituals were performed.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Mungkin di sinilah sebagian besar ritual dilakukan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_Arrived_003
Array.english: But the fact that there's a ladder on the right...
Array.indonesia: Tapi fakta bahwa ada tangga di sebelah kanan...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_Arrived_004
Array.english: <size=31>Means there's a way down!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Artinya ada jalan ke bawah!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_Arrived_005
Array.english: That makes sense.\nLet's take a look around.
Array.indonesia: Masuk akal.\nAyo kita lihat-lihat sekeliling.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_DrainageRoom_001
Array.english: Oh... this door... I think I can open it.
Array.indonesia: Oh... pintu ini... sepertinya aku bisa membukanya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_DrainageRoom_002
Array.english: Huh? I don't see any kind of mechanism nearby.
Array.indonesia: Hah? Aku tidak melihat ada mekanisme apa pun di dekatnya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_DrainageRoom_003
Array.english: Hehe... this door opens by touch.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... pintu ini terbuka saat disentuh.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_DrainageRoom_004
Array.english: ...Did they have something like that in ancient times?
Array.indonesia: ...Apakah di zaman kuno sudah ada hal seperti itu?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_DrainageRoom_005
Array.english: The more I study the Sunang civilization, the more fascinating it gets.
Array.indonesia: Semakin aku mempelajari peradaban Sunang, semakin menarik peradaban itu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_DrainageRoom_006
Array.english: There are markings here that match the ones in the ancient texts...
Array.indonesia: Ada tanda-tanda di sini yang cocok dengan yang ada di teks-teks kuno...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_DrainageRoom_007
Array.english: <size=32>And look, only those markings on the door have handprints on them!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Dan lihat, hanya tanda-tanda di pintu ini yang memiliki jejak tangan!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_DrainageRoom_008
Array.english: <size=33>I'm sure if I touch these...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku yakin kalau aku menyentuh ini...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_DrainageRoomOpen_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! This genius Muna was right!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Muna yang jenius ini benar!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_DrainageRoomOpen_002
Array.english: <size=32>There's definitely a drainage system inside.\nLet's go in.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Pasti ada sistem drainase di dalam.\nAyo masuk.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_DrainageRoom_Lever_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, you're right.\nThere really is a drainage system here!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, kamu benar.\nBenar-benar ada sistem drainase di sini!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_DrainageRoom_Lever_002
Array.english: <size=32>Hehe... I'll give it a pull then.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehe... Aku akan mencobanya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_DrainageRoom_AfterLever_001
Array.english: Oh! Now that the water's gone down, I can climb down the ladder.
Array.indonesia: Oh! Sekarang airnya sudah surut, aku bisa turun lewat tangga.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_DrainageRoom_AfterLever_002
Array.english: <size=32>Hehe, let's head back to the ladder!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehe, ayo kembali ke tangga!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_FindLadder_001
Array.english: Alright then, shall we head down?
Array.indonesia: Baiklah, mau turun?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_FindLadder_002
Array.english: There might be something dangerous down there...\nAre you sure about this?
Array.indonesia: Mungkin ada sesuatu yang berbahaya di bawah sana...\nKamu yakin mau ini?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_FindLadder_003
Array.english: Haha!! I've got you two with me, what's there to be afraid of!
Array.indonesia: Haha!! Aku kan bersama kalian berdua, apa yang perlu ditakuti!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_FindLadder_004
Array.english: ...Oh, of course, you too, Marone!
Array.indonesia: ...Oh, tentu saja, kamu juga, Marone!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_FindLadder_005
Array.english: Woof! Woof!
Array.indonesia: Guk! Guk!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_FindLadder_006
Array.english: You're unbelievable.\nAlright, let's head down.
Array.indonesia: Kalian sungguh luar biasa.\nBaiklah, ayo kita turun.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_Arrived_001
Array.english: Oh! Just as I thought, there are <color=#63F9FF>Blue Divine Tree Berries</color>!
Array.indonesia: Oh! Seperti yang kuduga, ada <color=#63F9FF>Buah Pohon Ilahi Biru</color>!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_Arrived_002
Array.english: Hmm... but they're too high up to reach.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... tapi posisinya terlalu tinggi untuk dijangkau.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_Arrived_003
Array.english: You're right. Let's head a bit further in for now.
Array.indonesia: Benar juga. Ayo kita masuk sedikit lebih jauh dulu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_1stPuzzle_001
Array.english: Hmm. There's some kind of device here too.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Ada semacam alat di sini juga.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_1stPuzzle_002
Array.english: Hmm... If we want to move forward, we should try activating it first.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Kalau kita mau lanjut, sebaiknya kita coba aktifkan dulu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_1stPuzzleSolve_001
Array.english: <size=31>Oh... a bridge just appeared...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Oh... jembatan baru saja muncul...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_1stPuzzleSolve_002
Array.english: <size=32>Hehe. Let's cross over.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehe. Ayo kita seberangi.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_2ndtPuzzle_001
Array.english: Hmm. Looks like there's another device like the last one.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Sepertinya ada perangkat lain yang mirip dengan yang tadi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_2ndtPuzzle_002
Array.english: Haha! This one looks a bit more complicated than before... \nbut for the great Muna, it's a piece of cake!
Array.indonesia: Haha! Yang ini kelihatannya sedikit lebih rumit daripada yang sebelumnya... \ntapi bagi Muna yang hebat, ini mudah sekali!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_2ndtPuzzle_003
Array.english: <size=32>Let's look around and see what we can find!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ayo kita lihat-lihat dan cari tahu apa yang bisa kita temukan!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_2ndtPuzzleSolve_001
Array.english: <size=35>Hehehe, success!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Hehehe, berhasil!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_2ndtPuzzleSolve_002
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! Looks like there's no more water ahead! \nLet's keep going!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Sepertinya tidak ada lagi air di depan! \nAyo lanjutkan!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_FindFruit_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh! I think I can reach that <color=#63F9FF>Blue Divine Tree Fruit</color> up ahead!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh! Kurasa aku bisa meraih <color=#63F9FF>Buah Pohon Ilahi Biru</color> di depan sana!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_FindFruit_002
Array.english: <size=32>Ugh... but it's kinda creepy here.\nLet's grab it and head back up.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ugh... tapi tempat ini agak menyeramkan.\nAyo ambil buahnya dan kembali ke atas.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_MeetFringehead_001
Array.english: <size=34>Whoa! What kind of fish is that?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wah! Ikan apa itu?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_MeetFringehead_002
Array.english: <size=34>Looks like... a giant Fringehead...!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Sepertinya... Fringehead raksasa...!?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_MeetFringehead_003
Array.english: <size=32>Well... it's seawater here, so I guess that makes sense.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Yah... di sini air laut, jadi kurasa itu masuk akal.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_MeetFringehead_004
Array.english: <size=33>We'll have to take it down before we can get past here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kita harus mengalahkannya dulu sebelum bisa melewati sini.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_MeetFringehead_005
Array.english: <size=32>In that case...\nI'll have to give it a taste of my whip!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kalau begitu...\nAku harus memberinya rasa cambukku!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_MeetFringehead_006
Array.english: Woof!
Array.indonesia: Woof!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_WinFringehead_001
Array.english: Phew... that startled me.
Array.indonesia: Wah... itu bikin aku kaget.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_WinFringehead_002
Array.english: Nothing else will get in our way now, right?
Array.indonesia: Nggak ada lagi yang bakal menghalangi kita sekarang, kan?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_WinFringehead_003
Array.english: Hurry, grab the <color=#63F9FF>Blue Divine Tree Fruit</color> and let's head back up.
Array.indonesia: Cepat, ambil <color=#63F9FF>Buah Pohon Ilahi Biru</color> dan ayo kita kembali ke atas.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_MeetFringeheadRetry_001
Array.english: Looks like we'll have to defeat that Fringehead before we can get the <color=#63F9FF>Blue Divine Tree Fruit</color>....
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya kita harus mengalahkan Fringehead itu dulu sebelum bisa mendapatkan <color=#63F9FF>Buah Pohon Ilahi Biru</color>....

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_MeetFringeheadRetry_002
Array.english:
<size=33>Hahaha! I'm ready!
Let's go at it again!!</size>
Array.indonesia:
<size=33>Hahaha! Aku siap!
Ayo kita serang lagi!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_GetFruit_001
Array.english: Wow... so this is a <color=#63F9FF>Blue Divine Tree Fruit</color>...\nWhat a radiant glow... it's beautiful...
Array.indonesia: Wow... jadi ini dia <color=#63F9FF>Buah Pohon Ilahi Biru</color>...\nCahayanya begitu bersinar... indah sekali...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_GetFruit_002
Array.english: Be careful. It has strong energy, so it could explode if handled improperly.
Array.indonesia: Hati-hati. Buah ini memiliki energi yang kuat, jadi bisa meledak jika ditangani dengan tidak benar.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_GetFruit_003
Array.english: Got it. I've stored it safely in my bag, so shall we head back up now?!
Array.indonesia: Paham. Aku sudah menyimpannya dengan aman di tasku, jadi apakah kita sudah bisa kembali ke atas sekarang?!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_GetFruit_004
Array.english: But how do we get back up?
Array.indonesia: Tapi bagaimana cara kita naik kembali?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_GetFruit_005
Array.english: Usually, places like this have some kind of mechanism to get back up...
Array.indonesia: Biasanya, tempat seperti ini punya semacam mekanisme untuk naik kembali...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_GetFruit_006
Array.english: Shall we search ahead?
Array.indonesia: Maukah kita mencari di depan?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_GetFruit_Barricade_001
Array.english: There's got to be an easier way up.\nLet me check ahead.
Array.indonesia: Pasti ada cara yang lebih mudah untuk naik.\nBiarkan aku memeriksa di depan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_GotoWildBoar01_001
Array.english: There's a rope with a handle up ahead...
Array.indonesia: Ada tali dengan pegangan di depan...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_GotoWildBoar02_001
Array.english: <size=33>Alright!\nI bet if I pull that...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oke!\nAku yakin kalau aku menarik itu...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_GotoWildBoar03_001
Array.english: <size=33>As expected! Now, let's climb up this ladder!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Seperti yang kuduga! Sekarang, ayo kita naik tangga ini!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_GotoWildBoar03_002
Array.english: Woof! Woof!
Array.indonesia: Woof! Guk!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_AfterWildBoar_001
Array.english: Looks like that boar brought the whole cave down.\nNo way up from here.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya babi hutan itu menghancurkan seluruh gua.\nTidak ada jalan naik dari sini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_WildBoar_StepTail_001
Array.english: Hm? What is it?
Array.indonesia: Hm? Ada apa?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_WildBoar_StepTail_002
Array.english: Oh, I think I just stepped on something mushy...
Array.indonesia: Oh, sepertinya aku baru saja menginjak sesuatu yang lembek...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_WildBoar_StepTail_003
Array.english: <size=32>Did you step in some monkey poop or something? Hahaha!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Apakah kamu menginjak kotoran monyet atau semacamnya? Hahaha!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_WildBoar_StepTail_004
Array.english: <size=34>Ugh... it's so gross...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ugh... jijik banget...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_WildBoar_Outside_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! Fresh air feels so much better!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Udara segar terasa jauh lebih enak!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_WildBoar_Outside_002
Array.english: <size=32>Phew. Still, I'm glad we made it out safely.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wah. Tapi, aku senang kita berhasil keluar dengan selamat.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_WildBoar_Start_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm...? Did something just shake really hard...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm...? Apa tadi ada sesuatu yang bergetar sangat keras...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_WildBoar_Start_002
Array.english: <size=34>Aaah...!! I think something's coming out...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aaah...!! Kayaknya ada sesuatu yang mau keluar...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_WildBoar_Minigame_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh, Rimbo!! How'd you get all the way out here?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh, Rimbo!! Gimana kamu bisa sampai ke sini?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_WildBoar_Minigame_002
Array.english: <size=33>You hadn't come by in a while, so I figured somethin' might be up and came to check... Glad I did!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kamu sudah lama nggak mampir, jadi aku pikir mungkin ada sesuatu yang terjadi dan datang untuk mengecek... Untung aku datang!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_WildBoar_Minigame_003
Array.english: <size=35>There are plenty of trees up ahead!\nHold on tight!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ada banyak pohon di depan!\nPegang erat-erat!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_WildBoar_Runaway_001
Array.english: <size=35>There are plenty of trees up ahead!\nHold on tight!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ada banyak pohon di depan!\nPegang erat-erat!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_WildBoar_End_001
Array.english: Phew... that was a close one.
Array.indonesia: Wah... nyaris saja.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_WildBoar_End_002
Array.english: I'm alive thanks to you, Rimbo...
Array.indonesia: Aku masih hidup berkat kamu, Rimbo...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_WildBoar_End_003
Array.english: Haha, you got lucky! Let's head back to the village together.
Array.indonesia: Haha, kamu beruntung! Ayo kita kembali ke desa bersama-sama.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_WildBoar_End02_001
Array.english: Phew... That was one massive boar...\nI barely got away.
Array.indonesia: Wah... Itu babi hutan yang sangat besar...\nAku nyaris saja lolos.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_WildBoar_End02_002
Array.english: At least I made it back with the <color=#63F9FF>Blue Divine Tree Fruit</color> in one piece.
Array.indonesia: Setidaknya aku berhasil kembali dengan <color=#63F9FF>Buah Pohon Ilahi Biru</color> dalam keadaan utuh.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_WildBoar_End02_003
Array.english: <size=33>I should go tell Dr. Bacon about this!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku harus memberitahu Dr. Bacon tentang ini!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_BaconTalk_001
Array.english: <size=34>Ooh! This is a <color=#63F9FF>Blue Divine Tree Fruit</color>!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wah! Ini adalah <color=#63F9FF>Buah Pohon Ilahi Biru</color>!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_BaconTalk_002
Array.english: It was a real pain to get.\nA wild boar even chased me...
Array.indonesia: Sungguh merepotkan untuk mendapatkannya.\nBahkan ada babi hutan yang mengejarku...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_BaconTalk_003
Array.english: Haha. But you made it back safe and sound, didn't you!
Array.indonesia: Haha. Tapi kamu berhasil kembali dengan selamat, kan!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_BaconTalk_004
Array.english: Now, if we attach this <color=#63F9FF>Blue Divine Tree Fruit</color> to the harpoon, we'll be able to activate the Sea People's contraption.
Array.indonesia: Nah, kalau kita pasang <color=#63F9FF>Buah Pohon Ilahi Biru</color> ini ke tombak, kita bisa mengaktifkan alat buatan Suku Laut.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_BaconTalk_005
Array.english: Hmm. I'll work on it today.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Aku akan mengerjakannya hari ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_BaconTalk_006
Array.english: Come back <color=#F1DC2B>Tomorrow</color> and you'll be able to see it, hehe.
Array.indonesia: Kembalilah <color=#F1DC2B>Besok</color> dan kamu akan bisa melihatnya, hehe.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniHook_MunaKnock_001
Array.english: <size=32>That's Muna's voice...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Itu suara Muna...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniHook_MunaKnock_002
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... right, we were going to modify the harpoon with the <color=#63F9FF>Blue Divine Tree Fruit</color>, weren't we? Is it already done?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... Benar, kita kan mau memodifikasi tombak dengan <color=#63F9FF>Buah Pohon Ilahi Biru</color>, kan? Sudah selesai belum?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniHook_MunaTalk_001
Array.english: Hehe... look at this.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... lihat ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniHook_MunaTalk_002
Array.english: <size=33>I modified the harpoon like I said yesterday! Ta-da!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku sudah memodifikasi tombak seperti yang kukatakan kemarin! Ta-da!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniHook_MunaTalk_003
Array.english: <size=33>Oh...! It's glowing blue... looks so cool...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh...! Berpendar biru... kelihatan keren banget...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniHook_MunaTalk_004
Array.english: <size=32>Hehe... I channeled the energy from the <color=#63F9FF>Blue Divine Tree Fruit</color> into it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehe... Aku menyalurkan energi dari <color=#63F9FF>Buah Pohon Ilahi Biru</color> ke dalamnya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniHook_MunaTalk_005
Array.english: <size=33>If you touch the Mahoni contraptions with this harpoon, they should react.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kalau kamu menyentuh alat-alat Mahoni dengan tombak ini, seharusnya mereka bereaksi.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniHook_MunaTalk_006
Array.english: <size=32>I can't think of any other way to talk to the Mahoni chief.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku tidak bisa memikirkan cara lain untuk berbicara dengan kepala suku Mahoni.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniHook_MunaTalk_007
Array.english: <size=32>Got it. I should head back down to the lake.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oke. Aku harus kembali ke danau.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_MainGateFruit_001
Array.english: <size=31>If I hit the <color=#63F9FF>Blue Divine Tree Fruit</color> above the door with my modified harpoon, it should react, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Jika aku menembakkan <color=#63F9FF>Buah Pohon Ilahi Biru</color> di atas pintu dengan tombak modifikasiku, seharusnya akan bereaksi, kan?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_MainGateFruit_Barricade_001
Array.english: <size=32>I need to hurry and meet the Mahoni chief to ask how to close the gate.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku harus buru-buru menemui kepala suku Mahoni untuk menanyakan cara menutup gerbang itu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_MainGateFruit_Barricade_002
Array.english: <size=32>If I hit the <color=#63F9FF>Blue Divine Tree Fruit</color> above the gate with my harpoon, it should react. I'd better try it now.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kalau aku menembak <color=#63F9FF>Buah Pohon Ilahi Biru</color> di atas gerbang itu dengan tombakku, seharusnya akan bereaksi. Sebaiknya aku mencobanya sekarang.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_MainGateOpen_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh wow... it's actually working...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wah... ternyata berhasil...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_MainGateOpen_002
Array.english: <size=32>Muna, you might seem clumsy, but you're actually pretty skilled.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Muna, kamu mungkin terlihat canggung, tapi sebenarnya kamu cukup terampil.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_MainGateOpen_003
Array.english: <size=32>It's a bit scary, but... I have no choice but to ask the chief for help to close the ancient gate.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Agak menakutkan, tapi... aku tidak punya pilihan selain meminta bantuan kepala suku untuk menutup gerbang kuno itu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_MainGateOpen_004
Array.english: <size=34>Let's go through the gate!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ayo kita lewat gerbang itu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_LivingArea_001
Array.english: <size=33>Whoa...! I didn't expect it to be right here...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wah...! Aku tidak menyangka gerbangnya ada di sini...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_LivingArea_002
Array.english: <size=32>It looks really angry...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kelihatannya sangat marah...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_LivingArea02_001
Array.english: <size=32>First, I need to get out through that hole...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Pertama-tama, aku harus keluar lewat lubang itu...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_WaterWayArea_001
Array.english: <size=32>Phew... unlike the Sea People in the Blue Hole, these ones are extremely aggressive. I need to be careful.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wah... tidak seperti Suku Laut di Blue Hole, makhluk-makhluk ini sangat agresif. Aku harus berhati-hati.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_WaterWayArea_002
Array.english: <size=32>Luckily, there's a path I can use here too.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Untungnya, ada jalan setapak yang bisa aku lewati di sini juga.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_WaterWayArea_003
Array.english: <size=33>Let's keep moving for now!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ayo kita terus maju dulu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_WaterWayArea_Barricade_001
Array.english: <size=33>No going back now...\nLet's keep moving forward.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tidak ada jalan kembali sekarang...\nAyo kita terus maju.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_PatrolArea1_Start_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ah...! The guards are watching the path from here...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ah...! Para penjaga sedang mengawasi jalan setapak dari sini...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_PatrolArea1_Start_002
Array.english: Is there any way I can sneak past them without being noticed...?
Array.indonesia: Adakah cara agar aku bisa menyelinap melewati mereka tanpa ketahuan...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_PatrolArea1_Start02_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hmm... If I hide behind those <color=#1DFEAF>Water Plants</color>, I might be able to slip by...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hmm... Jika aku bersembunyi di balik <color=#1DFEAF>Tanaman Air</color> itu, mungkin aku bisa lolos...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_PatrolArea1_Busted_001
Array.english: <size=35>Ahh...! They spotted me!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ahh...! Mereka melihatku!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_PatrolArea1_Busted_002
Array.english: <size=32>No choice...\nI need to make them back off a bit first.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tidak ada pilihan...\nAku harus membuat mereka mundur sedikit dulu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_PatrolArea1_End_001
Array.english: <size=32>Phew... fighting Sea People with weapons...\nThis isn't easy...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wah... bertarung melawan Orang Laut dengan senjata...\nIni tidak mudah...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_PatrolArea1_End_002
Array.english: <size=32>He opened the door while retreating.\nLet's head there.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Dia membuka pintu sambil mundur.\nAyo kita ke sana.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_PatrolArea2_Start_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh...! There are guards here too...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh...! Di sini juga ada penjaga...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_PatrolArea2_Start_002
Array.english: Let's try sneaking past again without being seen.
Array.indonesia: Ayo coba menyelinap lagi tanpa ketahuan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_PatrolArea2_Busted_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ugh! Why are they so sharp-eyed...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ugh! Kenapa mata mereka begitu tajam...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_PatrolArea2_Busted_002
Array.english: <size=32>They probably know this area inside out.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Mereka mungkin sudah sangat hafal daerah ini.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_PatrolArea2_Busted_003
Array.english: <size=32>No choice...\nI need to get out of here first.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tidak ada pilihan...\nAku harus keluar dari sini dulu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_PatrolArea2_End_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm... is it a tradition to leave doors open...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm... apakah membiarkan pintu terbuka itu tradisi...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_PatrolArea2_End_002
Array.english: <size=32>Maybe the chief's room is up ahead?\nLet's go a bit further.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Mungkin kamar kepala suku ada di depan?\nAyo kita lanjut sedikit lagi.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_BossArea_Enter01_001
Array.english: <size=32>Thank goodness I made it back up.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Syukurlah aku berhasil kembali ke atas.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_BossArea_Enter01_002
Array.english: <size=32>Now, which way is the chief's room...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Nah, ke mana arah kamar kepala suku...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_BossArea_Enter02_001
Array.english: <size=32>Whoa...! He looks incredibly strong...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wah...! Dia terlihat sangat kuat...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_BossArea_Enter02_002
Array.english: <size=31>I don't think he's noticed me yet...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Sepertinya dia belum menyadari kehadiranku...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_BossArea_Enter02_003
Array.english: <size=32>Maybe I can slip past him...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Mungkin aku bisa menyelinap melewatinya...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_BossArea_Enter03_001
Array.english: <size=32>Ugh... knew it wouldn't be that easy...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ugh... sudah kuduga ini tidak akan semudah itu...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_BossArea_Enter03_002
Array.english: <size=33>He's got a big <color=#F1DC2B>Shield</color>...\nThis won't be easy...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Dia punya <color=#F1DC2B>Perisai</color> yang besar...\nIni tidak akan mudah...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_BossArea_End01_001
Array.english: I heard a loud noise from inside...
Array.indonesia: Aku mendengar suara keras dari dalam...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_BossArea_End01_002
Array.english: <size=32>That must be the Mahoni chief!\nLet's follow them!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Itu pasti kepala suku Mahoni!\nAyo kita ikuti mereka!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk01_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... that voice is...\npretty unique...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... suara itu...\ncukup unik...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk01_002
Array.english: It sounds like he's saying something to me...\nBut what is he saying?
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya dia sedang mengatakan sesuatu kepadaku...\nTapi apa yang dia katakan?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk01_003
Array.english: Oh! Right, I brought the <color=#F1DC2B>Sea People Translator</color> with me.\nI should turn it on.
Array.indonesia: Oh! Benar, aku membawa <color=#F1DC2B>Penerjemah Suku Laut</color> bersamaku.\nAku harus menyalakannya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_001
Array.english: <size=35>What are you fiddling with over there?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Apa yang kamu utak-atik di sana?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_002
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Oh... the Sea People translator is working here too...?!)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Oh... Penerjemah Suku Laut juga berfungsi di sini...?!)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_003
Array.english: <size=33>Um... I'm here to see the chief.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Um... Aku ke sini untuk menemui kepala suku.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_004
Array.english: <size=35>Me...? For what reason...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Aku...? Untuk apa...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_005
Array.english: You must know about the ancient creatures roaming outside... and the giant dinosaur stuck there, right?
Array.indonesia: Kamu pasti tahu tentang makhluk purba yang berkeliaran di luar... dan dinosaurus raksasa yang terjebak di sana, kan?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_006
Array.english: Of course. We can't even go outside properly because of them.
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja. Kita bahkan tidak bisa keluar dengan tenang karena mereka.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_007
Array.english: A massive earthquake some time ago...\nopened a gate that had been sealed since ancient times.
Array.indonesia: Gempa bumi besar beberapa waktu lalu...\nmembuka gerbang yang telah tersegel sejak zaman purba.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_008
Array.english: To seal the gate again, we need to insert the <color=#1DFEAF>Star Relic</color> into it...
Array.indonesia: Untuk menyegel gerbang itu kembali, kita perlu memasukkan <color=#1DFEAF>Relik Bintang</color> ke dalamnya...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_009
Array.english: <size=33>but it's pointless as long as that giant dinosaur is stuck there...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>tapi itu sia-sia selama dinosaurus raksasa itu terjebak di sana...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_010
Array.english: <size=33>What if...\nwe could make the dinosaur back off?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Bagaimana kalau...\nkita bisa membuat dinosaurus itu mundur?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_011
Array.english: <size=36>Hmm? What are you talking about?\nMake it back off...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Hmm? Apa yang kamu bicarakan?\nMembuatnya mundur...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_012
Array.english: <size=32>I've got some capable friends with me! I'm sure they can draw it back!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku punya beberapa teman yang cakap bersamaku! Aku yakin mereka bisa membuatnya mundur!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_013
Array.english: <size=32>And while it's backing up, you Sea People can close the gate... and mission accomplished!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Dan saat dia mundur, kalian, Orang Laut, bisa menutup gerbang itu... dan misi selesai!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_014
Array.english: Hmm... asking us to help you, are you...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... kamu meminta kami untuk membantumu, ya...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_015
Array.english: It's not impossible, but... I'm not keen on trusting humans and working together.
Array.indonesia: Bukan tidak mungkin, tapi... aku tidak terlalu suka mempercayai manusia dan bekerja sama dengan mereka.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_016
Array.english: You see, humans are such a selfish species...
Array.indonesia: Kamu tahu, manusia adalah spesies yang sangat egois...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_017
Array.english: We've been betrayed several times before...\nso most of our tribe doesn't think highly of humans.
Array.indonesia: Kami sudah berkali-kali dikhianati sebelumnya...\njadi sebagian besar suku kami tidak memandang manusia dengan baik.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_018
Array.english: Hmm... but shouldn't we solve this problem together...?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... tapi bukankah sebaiknya kita menyelesaikan masalah ini bersama-sama...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_019
Array.english: Given the situation, we probably should.\nI know you're suffering too.
Array.indonesia: Mengingat situasinya, sepertinya memang sebaiknya begitu.\nAku tahu kalian juga sedang menderita.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_020
Array.english: In that case...
Array.indonesia: Kalau begitu...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_021
Array.english: <size=32>To test your strength... how about you solve one of our tribe's problems?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Untuk menguji kekuatanmu... bagaimana kalau kamu menyelesaikan salah satu masalah suku kami?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_022
Array.english: <size=32>Us Mahoni are a militant people, so we trust strength...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kami, suku Mahoni, adalah orang-orang yang militan, jadi kami percaya pada kekuatan...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_023
Array.english: <size=34>and there is one issue troubling our people.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>dan ada satu masalah yang mengganggu rakyat kami.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_024
Array.english: <size=35>I have a bad feeling about this...\nWhat is it?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Aku punya firasat buruk soal ini...\nApa itu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_025
Array.english: There's one particularly ferocious creature among those that came through the gate...
Array.indonesia: Ada satu makhluk yang sangat ganas di antara mereka yang masuk melalui gerbang...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_026
Array.english: We managed to trap it in the <color=#F1DC2B>Right Residential Area</color>...
Array.indonesia: Kami berhasil menjebaknya di <color=#F1DC2B>Kawasan Pemukiman Kanan</color>...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_027
Array.english: But it has sharp teeth and can chew through the walls…\nIt'll surely break out once the food runs out.
Array.indonesia: Tapi makhluk itu memiliki gigi tajam dan bisa menggerogoti dinding…\nPasti akan kabur begitu makanannya habis.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_028
Array.english: <size=34>Defeat it, and the whole tribe will acknowledge you.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kalahkan makhluk itu, dan seluruh suku akan mengakui kehebatanmu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_029
Array.english: Ugh... just hearing that sounds terrifying...
Array.indonesia: Ugh... hanya mendengarnya saja sudah menakutkan...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_030
Array.english: If that's the only way to get you on our side...\nI guess I have no choice.
Array.indonesia: Jika itu satu-satunya cara agar kamu berpihak pada kami...\nSepertinya aku tidak punya pilihan lain.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_031
Array.english: I'll get ready and head to the <color=#F1DC2B>Right Residential Area</color>.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan bersiap-siap dan pergi ke <color=#F1DC2B>Kawasan Pemukiman Kanan</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_032
Array.english: Oh... you've got guts.\nI like that.
Array.indonesia: Oh... kamu berani sekali.\nAku suka itu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_033
Array.english: Torang! Clear the stones blocking the entrance.\nLet the human pass.
Array.indonesia: Torang! Singkirkan batu-batu yang menghalangi pintu masuk.\nBiarkan manusia itu lewat.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_034
Array.english: <size=36>Y-Yes! Understood.\nWe'll have it cleared by <color=#F1DC2B>Tomorrow</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Y-Ya! Dimengerti.\nKami akan menyingkirkannya paling lambat <color=#F1DC2B>Besok</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_035
Array.english: Human, head to the <color=#F1DC2B>Right Residential Area</color> tomorrow.\nI'll have the gate opened for you.
Array.indonesia: Manusia, pergilah ke <color=#F1DC2B>Kawasan Pemukiman Kanan</color> besok.\nAku akan memerintahkan agar gerbang dibuka untukmu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_036
Array.english: I'll order the others to stand down...\nThey won't attack you anymore.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan memerintahkan yang lain untuk mundur...\nMereka tidak akan menyerangmu lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_037
Array.english: ...As long as you don't do anything foolish.
Array.indonesia: ...Selama kamu tidak melakukan hal bodoh.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_BeforeGateOpen_001
Array.english: <size=34>Hey! Didn't you hear? I'm working on this until <color=#F1DC2B>Tomorrow</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hei! Apa kamu tidak dengar? Aku sedang mengerjakan ini sampai <color=#F1DC2B>Besok</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_BeforeGateOpen_002
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, and...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, dan...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_BeforeGateOpen_003
Array.english: <size=33>Earlier, I was holding back so I wouldn't damage the village.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tadi, aku menahan diri agar tidak merusak desa.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_BeforeGateOpen_004
Array.english: <size=34>If I went all out, I could knock you out with a single strike!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kalau aku mengeluarkan seluruh kekuatan, aku bisa mengalahkanmu dengan satu pukulan saja!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_BeforeGateOpen_005
Array.english: <size=32>Hmph. I'll have these rocks cleared by <color=#F1DC2B>Tomorrow</color>, so come back then.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmph. Aku akan membersihkan batu-batu ini sebelum <color=#F1DC2B>Besok</color>, jadi kembalilah saat itu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_BeforeGateOpen_Soldier01_001
Array.english: Hey, hey... don't get in our way.
Array.indonesia: Hei, hei... jangan menghalangi kami.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_BeforeGateOpen_Soldier01_002
Array.english: We gotta hustle if we want these rocks cleared by <color=#F1DC2B>Tomorrow</color>.
Array.indonesia: Kita harus bergegas kalau mau batu-batu ini dibersihkan sebelum <color=#F1DC2B>Besok</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_BeforeGateOpen_Soldier02_001
Array.english: Heard you went after the chief while he was worn out from training?
Array.indonesia: Kudengar kamu menyerang kepala suku saat dia kelelahan setelah latihan?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_BeforeGateOpen_Soldier02_002
Array.english: Someone at your level won't stand a chance against the beast in there.
Array.indonesia: Seseorang sekelasmu nggak bakal punya peluang melawan monster di dalam sana.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_BeforeGateOpen_Soldier02_003
Array.english: You're gonna regret it...tch.
Array.indonesia: Kamu bakal menyesalinya... tch.

Array.name: dialogue_Barricade_MahoniCheifTooClose_001
Array.english: <size=34>Hey! Don't come any closer, human.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hei! Jangan mendekat, manusia.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk01_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... Dave! You're safe!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... Dave! Kamu selamat!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk01_002
Array.english: <size=33>Let's head to the tent, get some rest, and talk.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ayo kita ke tenda, istirahat sebentar, dan ngobrol.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk02_001
Array.english: You look exhausted... \nSo? Did you manage to meet the Mahoni chief?
Array.indonesia: Kamu kelihatan kelelahan... \nJadi? Apa kamu berhasil bertemu dengan kepala suku Mahoni?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk02_002
Array.english: Yes... getting there wasn't easy, but...\nI managed to meet him.
Array.indonesia: Ya... perjalanan ke sana tidak mudah, tapi...\naku berhasil bertemu dengannya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk02_003
Array.english: I see. Good work.\nWhat did he say?
Array.indonesia: Begitu. Kerja bagus.\nApa yang dia katakan?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk02_004
Array.english: Well... they're having a lot of trouble with those ancient creatures that suddenly showed up.
Array.indonesia: Nah... mereka sedang mengalami banyak masalah dengan makhluk-makhluk purba yang tiba-tiba muncul.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk02_005
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... then working together should be more than possible!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... kalau begitu, bekerja sama pasti bisa dilakukan!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk02_006
Array.english: But... the tribe is very hostile toward humans...
Array.indonesia: Tapi... suku itu sangat memusuhi manusia...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk02_007
Array.english: They gave me a task to prove myself: defeat a ferocious ancient creature.
Array.indonesia: Mereka memberiku tugas untuk membuktikan diriku: mengalahkan makhluk purba yang ganas.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk02_008
Array.english: They said it's a creature that can chew through walls with its teeth...
Array.indonesia: Mereka bilang itu makhluk yang bisa menggerogoti dinding dengan giginya...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk02_009
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... that's probably a <color=#F1DC2B>Xiphactinus</color>...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... itu mungkin <color=#F1DC2B>Xiphactinus</color>...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk02_010
Array.english: It's known for its drill-like teeth...\nand for being extremely aggressive.
Array.indonesia: Makhluk itu terkenal karena giginya yang seperti bor...\ndan karena sifatnya yang sangat agresif.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk02_011
Array.english: <size=34>...Suddenly I don't want to go down there anymore.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>...Suddenly Aku tidak mau turun ke sana lagi.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk02_012
Array.english: But if the Basilosaurus down below makes its way up to the lake, things will get much worse.
Array.indonesia: Tapi kalau Basilosaurus di bawah sana berhasil naik ke danau, situasinya bakal jadi jauh lebih parah.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk02_013
Array.english: I understand...
Array.indonesia: Aku mengerti...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk02_014
Array.english: By the way, we need to make the Basilosaurus back off before the Sea People close the gate. How do we do that?
Array.indonesia: Ngomong-ngomong, kita harus bikin Basilosaurus itu mundur sebelum Orang Laut menutup gerbang. Gimana caranya?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk02_015
Array.english: Hehe... I've got an idea.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... Aku punya ide.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk02_016
Array.english: <size=33>I've got some emergency <color=#F1DC2B>Mini Bombs</color>... hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku punya beberapa <color=#F1DC2B>Mini Bombs</color> darurat... hehe.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk02_017
Array.english: <size=35>...Why do you have those?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>...Why, apa kamu punya itu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk02_018
Array.english: I was planning to use them for self-defense in case I got attacked by wild animals in the jungle.
Array.indonesia: Aku berencana menggunakannya untuk membela diri kalau-kalau aku diserang binatang liar di hutan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk02_019
Array.english: Let me think about how we can use them first.
Array.indonesia: Biar aku pikirkan dulu cara menggunakannya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk02_020
Array.english: For now, the priority is to defeat the <color=#F1DC2B>Xiphactinus</color> and get the Mahoni tribe on our side.
Array.indonesia: Untuk saat ini, prioritasnya adalah mengalahkan <color=#F1DC2B>Xiphactinus</color> dan membuat Suku Mahoni berpihak pada kita.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk02_021
Array.english: <size=32>It's a dangerous creature... so make sure you're fully prepared before going in.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Itu makhluk berbahaya... jadi pastikan kamu sudah benar-benar siap sebelum masuk ke sana.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_Reminder_001
Array.english: Hmm. The Sea People said they'd clear the rocks blocking the cave where the <color=#F1DC2B>Xiphactinus</color> is trapped, right?
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Orang-orang Laut bilang mereka akan membersihkan batu-batu yang menghalangi gua tempat <color=#F1DC2B>Xiphactinus</color> terperangkap, kan?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_Reminder_002
Array.english: I should head back down to the lake bed once everything's ready.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus kembali ke dasar danau begitu semuanya siap.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_GateGuard_001
Array.english: Oh... you cleared all the rocks.
Array.indonesia: Oh... kamu sudah membersihkan semua batu itu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_GateGuard_002
Array.english: I thought my shoulder was gonna give out.
Array.indonesia: Aku kira bahuku hampir patah.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_GateGuard_003
Array.english: I could go in and take it down myself... but moving those rocks took more out of me than I expected.
Array.indonesia: Aku bisa masuk dan mengalahkannya sendiri... tapi memindahkan batu-batu itu lebih melelahkan daripada yang kuduga.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_GateGuard_004
Array.english: But since it's the chief's order... I'll let you take this one.
Array.indonesia: Tapi karena ini perintah kepala suku... aku akan membiarkan kamu yang mengurus yang ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_GateGuard_005
Array.english: <size=32>Just don't end up as its next meal.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Jangan sampai kamu jadi santapan berikutnya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_GateGuard02_001
Array.english: Looks like the way into the settlement is open now.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya jalan masuk ke pemukiman itu sudah terbuka sekarang.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_GateGuard02_002
Array.english: So there's a really vicious ancient creature inside...?
Array.indonesia: Jadi, ada makhluk purba yang sangat ganas di dalam...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_GateGuard02_003
Array.english: <size=32>I'll probably need some pretty strong gear.\nI'll head in once I'm ready.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku mungkin butuh perlengkapan yang cukup kuat.\nAku akan masuk begitu sudah siap.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_DungeonEnter_001
Array.english: Hmm... the place is completely wrecked...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... tempat ini benar-benar hancur berantakan...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_DungeonEnter_002
Array.english: Sounds like it's as violent as I heard.\nBetter be careful...
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya makhluk itu memang seganas yang kudengar.\nSebaiknya berhati-hati...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_BossEnter_001
Array.english: Judging by all these fish bones, the <color=#F1DC2B>Xiphactinus</color> must be up ahead.
Array.indonesia: Dilihat dari tulang-tulang ikan ini, <color=#F1DC2B>Xiphactinus</color> pasti ada di depan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_BossEnter_002
Array.english: <size=32>Should I go in now...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haruskah aku masuk sekarang...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_BossEnter_Select_Yes
Array.english: I'm ready.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah siap.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_BossEnter_Select_No
Array.english: I'm not ready yet
Array.indonesia: Aku belum siap

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_Appear_001
Array.english: <size=33>That's the <color=#F1DC2B>Xiphactinus</color>...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Itu <color=#F1DC2B>Xiphactinus</color>...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_Appear_002
Array.english: It looks even more vicious than I heard...
Array.indonesia: Kelihatannya bahkan lebih ganas dari yang kudengar...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_Appear_003
Array.english: But I have to take it down if I want the Mahoni tribe on our side.
Array.indonesia: Tapi aku harus mengalahkannya jika ingin suku Mahoni berada di pihak kita.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_Appear_004
Array.english: No matter how strong it looks, there has to be an opening. \nI should watch how it moves first.
Array.indonesia: Tidak peduli seberapa kuat penampilannya, pasti ada celahnya. \nAku harus mengamati gerakannya dulu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_FightBarricade_001
Array.english: <size=32>I was told I need to defeat it to get the Mahoni tribe on our side. I can't back down now!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku diberitahu bahwa aku harus mengalahkannya agar Suku Mahoni berada di pihak kita. Aku tidak bisa mundur sekarang!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_CarvingBarricade_001
Array.english: <size=32>Let me see if there's anything worth taking with me...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Biarkan aku lihat apakah ada sesuatu yang layak dibawa...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_Carving_001
Array.english: Hmm... now that I'm seeing it up close...\nit actually looks kind of tasty...?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... sekarang setelah aku melihatnya dari dekat...\nsebenarnya terlihat cukup lezat...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_Carving_002
Array.english: <size=32>I should check if there are any parts worth taking.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku harus memeriksa apakah ada bagian yang layak diambil.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_End_001
Array.english: <size=32>Alright. That should do it.\nI should head back to the chief's room.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Baiklah. Seharusnya sudah cukup.\nAku harus kembali ke kamar kepala suku.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_ChiefReport_001
Array.english: I took care of that ferocious ancient creature.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah menghabisi makhluk purba yang ganas itu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_ChiefReport_002
Array.english: Oh... impressive...\nI have to admit, that's something.
Array.indonesia: Oh... mengesankan...\nAku harus akui, itu luar biasa.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_ChiefReport_003
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(I still can't get used to that voice...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Aku masih belum bisa terbiasa dengan suara itu...)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_ChiefReport_004
Array.english: <size=34>What are you thinking about!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Apa yang kamu pikirkan!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_ChiefReport_005
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, nothing at all!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, tidak apa-apa!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_ChiefReport_006
Array.english: <size=32>Well... you kept your promise, so...\nI'll help you close the gate.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Yah... kamu sudah menepati janji, jadi...\nAku akan membantumu menutup gerbang.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_ChiefReport_007
Array.english: As we discussed... for us to close the gate,\nyou'll need to make that giant creature back off first.
Array.indonesia: Seperti yang kita bicarakan... agar kita bisa menutup gerbang,\nkamu harus membuat makhluk raksasa itu mundur terlebih dahulu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_ChiefReport_008
Array.english: <size=32>Do you have a plan in mind?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Apakah kamu sudah punya rencana?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_ChiefReport_009
Array.english: Yes. We have some <color=#F1DC2B>Mini Bombs</color>.\nIf we hit it with those, it should back off.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Kita punya beberapa <color=#F1DC2B>Bom Mini</color>.\nJika kita menyerangnya dengan itu, makhluk itu seharusnya mundur.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_ChiefReport_010
Array.english: <size=32>Tsk. Humans still rely on such crude methods.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ck. Manusia masih mengandalkan metode kasar seperti itu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_ChiefReport_011
Array.english: I'll have Torang insert the star relic the moment the creature backs off.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan menyuruh Torang memasukkan relik bintang begitu makhluk itu mundur.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_ChiefReport_012
Array.english: I never thought the Mahoni would work with humans...\nOur ancestors would have something to say about this.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak pernah menyangka suku Mahoni akan bekerja sama dengan manusia...\nNenek moyang kita pasti akan berkomentar tentang hal ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_ChiefReportEnd_001
Array.english: Fortunately, I managed to get the Mahoni tribe on our side.
Array.indonesia: Untungnya, aku berhasil membuat suku Mahoni berada di pihak kita.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_ChiefReportEnd_002
Array.english: Now I just need to use Muna's <color=#F1DC2B>Mini Bombs</color> to make the Basilosaurus back off a bit.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang aku hanya perlu menggunakan <color=#F1DC2B>Bom Mini</color> milik Muna untuk membuat Basilosaurus mundur sedikit.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_ChiefReportEnd_003
Array.english: She said she'd figure out how to set them up...
Array.indonesia: Dia bilang dia akan mencari cara untuk memasangnya...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_ChiefReportEnd_004
Array.english: First, let's head back up to the village.
Array.indonesia: Pertama, mari kita kembali ke desa.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Bomb_Receive01_001
Array.english: <size=32>You're here!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kamu sudah di sini!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Bomb_Receive01_002
Array.english: About those <color=#F1DC2B>Mini Bombs</color>... \nI've been thinking about how to set them up...
Array.indonesia: Soal <color=#F1DC2B>Mini Bombs</color> itu... \nAku sudah memikirkan cara memasangnya...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Bomb_Receive01_003
Array.english: If I go down in the diving bell, it'll be hard to position them... and if I use a drone, the depth makes it hard to see anything...
Array.indonesia: Kalau aku turun dengan lonceng selam, akan sulit untuk mengatur posisinya... dan kalau aku pakai drone, kedalamannya membuat sulit melihat apa pun...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Bomb_Receive01_004
Array.english: <size=34>I think it'd be best if someone went down there and set them up directly...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Menurutku akan lebih baik kalau ada yang turun ke sana dan memasangnya langsung...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Bomb_Receive01_005
Array.english: Someone who can actually go that deep...
Array.indonesia: Seseorang yang benar-benar bisa turun sedalam itu...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Bomb_Receive02_001
Array.english: <size=34>...Got it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>...Got.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Bomb_Receive02_002
Array.english: So what do I need to do?
Array.indonesia: Jadi, apa yang harus aku lakukan?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Bomb_Receive02_003
Array.english: <size=32>It's actually really simple. Just drop this <color=#F1DC2B>Mini Bomb</color> into the Basilosaurus's mouth!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Sebenarnya sangat sederhana. Cukup lemparkan <color=#F1DC2B>Mini Bomb</color> ini ke dalam mulut Basilosaurus!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Bomb_Receive02_004
Array.english: <size=32>Then boom! It'll get startled and back off!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Lalu boom! Ia akan terkejut dan mundur!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Bomb_Receive02_005
Array.english: Wouldn't blowing up a bomb inside it hurt it too much?
Array.indonesia: Bukankah meledakkan bom di dalam tubuhnya akan sangat menyakitinya?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Bomb_Receive02_006
Array.english: Nah... for something that size, it's nothing!
Array.indonesia: Ah... buat makhluk sebesar itu, itu nggak ada apa-apanya!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Bomb_Receive02_007
Array.english: For a human, it'd be like...\neating a single spicy pepper?
Array.indonesia: Buat manusia, itu kayak...\nmakan satu cabai pedas?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Bomb_Receive02_008
Array.english: Hmm... alright.\nI just do it like when I took that photo?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... oke.\nAku tinggal melakukannya seperti saat aku ambil foto itu?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Bomb_Receive02_009
Array.english: <size=31>Yep, yep. Pretty much the same!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Iya, iya. Hampir sama!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Bomb_Receive02_010
Array.english: Oh, just in case, you should take a <color=#F1DC2B>Spare Bomb</color> with you too.
Array.indonesia: Oh, untuk jaga-jaga, sebaiknya kamu bawa <color=#F1DC2B>Bom Cadangan</color> juga.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Bomb_Receive02_011
Array.english: This one needs a bit of prep, though...\nI'll give it to you tomorrow morning.
Array.indonesia: Yang ini butuh sedikit persiapan, sih...\nAku akan memberikannya padamu besok pagi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Bomb_Receive02_012
Array.english: <size=32>You must be tired, so get some rest today, hehe!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kamu pasti lelah, jadi istirahatlah hari ini, hehe!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Bomb_Receive02_013
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! This should wrap things up nicely!\nGood luck out there!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Sepertinya ini akan menyelesaikannya dengan baik!\nSemoga berhasil di sana!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Start_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, Dave. Thanks to you, my Insectagram is filling up nicely. Thank you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, Dave. Berkat kamu, Insectagram-ku semakin penuh. Terima kasih!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Start_002
Array.english: But... they're mostly common insects...
Array.indonesia: Tapi... kebanyakan serangga biasa saja...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Start_003
Array.english: I don't really have anything to write for the upcoming special 10th issue...
Array.indonesia: Aku sebenarnya nggak punya bahan apa-apa untuk edisi spesial ke-10 yang akan datang...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Start_004
Array.english: By any chance...
Array.indonesia: Kebetulan...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Start_005
Array.english: <size=34>I have a feeling you're about to ask for a favor...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku merasa kamu mau minta tolong...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Start_006
Array.english: Hehe... have you heard the rumor about a giant red stag beetle in <color=#1DFEAF>Setah Forest</color>?
