Array.indonesia: Hehe... apakah kamu pernah mendengar rumor tentang kumbang tanduk merah raksasa di <color=#1DFEAF>Hutan Setah</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Start_007
Array.english: No... that's my first time hearing it.
Array.indonesia: Tidak... ini pertama kalinya aku mendengarnya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Start_008
Array.english: According to our magazine's research, there's a <color=#1DFEAF>Giant Stag Beetle</color> in this forest... about three times the size of a normal one, with flame-like patterns.
Array.indonesia: Menurut penelitian majalah kami, ada <color=#1DFEAF>Kumbang Tanduk Raksasa</color> di hutan ini... ukurannya sekitar tiga kali lipat dari yang biasa, dengan pola seperti api.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Start_009
Array.english: <size=33>If you could catch that for me, this special issue would be a huge success!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kalau kamu bisa menangkapnya untukku, edisi khusus ini pasti akan sukses besar!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Start_010
Array.english: ...I'm begging you.
Array.indonesia: ...Aku mohon padamu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Start_011
Array.english: ...Hmm. Alright. But how am I supposed to catch something that big?
Array.indonesia: ...Hmm. Baiklah. Tapi bagaimana caranya aku menangkap sesuatu sebesar itu?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Start_012
Array.english: Hmm. Of course, catching it with just one bug won't work like before.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Tentu saja, menangkapnya hanya dengan satu serangga tidak akan berhasil seperti sebelumnya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Start_013
Array.english: I saw people in a nearby village catching large stag beetles... by battling them with multiple bugs.
Array.indonesia: Aku melihat orang-orang di desa terdekat menangkap kumbang tanduk raksasa... dengan melawan mereka menggunakan beberapa serangga sekaligus.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Start_014
Array.english: <size=32>How about you try using multiple bugs at once, Dave?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Bagaimana kalau kamu mencoba menggunakan beberapa serangga sekaligus, Dave?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Start_015
Array.english: Hmm... multiple bugs, huh...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... beberapa serangga, ya...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Start_016
Array.english: <size=32>Alright, I'll look for that giant beetle in the forest.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Baiklah, aku akan mencari kumbang raksasa itu di hutan.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_FindBoss_001
Array.english: <size=34>Whoa...! Is that the giant stag beetle Udo mentioned...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wah...! Apakah itu kumbang tanduk raksasa yang disebutkan Udo...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_FindBoss_002
Array.english: <size=32>It's red and massive... looks really strong...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Warnanya merah dan sangat besar... kelihatannya sangat kuat...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_FindBoss_003
Array.english: <size=32>I should send out several beetles at once.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku harus mengirimkan beberapa kumbang sekaligus.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_WinBoss_001
Array.english: <size=32>Phew... that was intense.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wah... itu seru banget.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_WinBoss_002
Array.english: <size=32>Now that I've caught it safely, I should bring it to Udo.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Sekarang setelah aku berhasil menangkapnya dengan selamat, aku harus membawanya ke Udo.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_LoseBoss_001
Array.english: <size=32>It's strong, as expected...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Dia kuat, seperti yang kuduga...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_LoseBoss_002
Array.english: <size=32>I should catch some stronger insects...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku harus menangkap serangga yang lebih kuat...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_RetryBoss_001
Array.english: <size=33><color=#F1DC2B>The Flame-Patterned Stag Beetle</color> from before...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33><color=#F1DC2B>Kumbang Rusa Pola Api</color> yang tadi...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_RetryBoss_002
Array.english: <size=32>Should I go for a rematch...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haruskah aku mencoba bertarung lagi...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_FightBoss_option01
Array.english: Battle
Array.indonesia: Pertarungan

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_FightBoss_option02
Array.english: I'll try next time
Array.indonesia: Aku akan mencobanya lain kali

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Giveup_001
Array.english: I don't think I'm ready to take that on yet...\nI should do it later.
Array.indonesia: Kurasa aku belum siap menghadapi itu...\nSebaiknya aku melakukannya nanti.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Unsatisfied_001
Array.english: Hmm... I'll need at least three to take that on.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Aku butuh setidaknya tiga ekor untuk menghadapinya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Unsatisfied_002
Array.english: Let's catch a few more and try again.
Array.indonesia: Ayo tangkap beberapa lagi dan coba lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Satisfied_001
Array.english: <size=33>Alright! Let's take on that flame-patterned stag beetle!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oke! Ayo kita hadapi kumbang tanduk bermotif api itu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Complete_001
Array.english: Here... I caught that flame-patterned stag beetle for you.
Array.indonesia: Ini... Aku sudah menangkap kumbang tanduk bermotif api itu untukmu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Complete_002
Array.english: <size=32>Wow...! I've never seen this species before!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wah...! Aku belum pernah melihat spesies ini sebelumnya!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Complete_003
Array.english: That vivid red pattern... that incredible size...
Array.indonesia: Pola merah cerah itu.. . ukurannya yang luar biasa...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=33>This is more than enough for a headline!\nThank you!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ini lebih dari cukup untuk dijadikan berita utama!\nTerima kasih!!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Complete_005
Array.english: Now that the article's covered... I'd like to repay you somehow, Dave...
Array.indonesia: Sekarang setelah artikelnya sudah beres... Aku ingin membalas budimu dengan cara apa pun, Dave...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Complete_006
Array.english: <size=32>Is there anything I can help with at Bancho's restaurant?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Adakah yang bisa kubantu di restoran Bancho?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Complete_007
Array.english: Oh... do you know how to cook or serve?
Array.indonesia: Oh... apa kamu bisa masak atau melayani tamu?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Complete_008
Array.english: I used to work part-time at a restaurant before joining the magazine.
Array.indonesia: Dulu aku pernah kerja paruh waktu di restoran sebelum bergabung dengan majalah ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Complete_009
Array.english: Customers loved it when I took their photos! Hehe!
Array.indonesia: Para pelanggan senang banget kalau aku fotoin mereka! Hehe!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Complete_010
Array.english: <size=32>If you're offering, we'd love the help!\nI'm counting on you.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kalau kamu menawarkan, kami pasti senang banget kalau dibantu!\nAku andalkan kamu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Start_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hah...! Dave...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hah...! Dave...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Start_002
Array.english: <size=34>You've caught every insect in this region?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kamu sudah menangkap semua serangga di wilayah ini?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Start_003
Array.english: <size=32>Yeah... looks like it.\nIt wasn't easy.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ya... sepertinya begitu.\nItu tidak mudah.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Start_004
Array.english: <size=32>But thanks to you, Udo, I got to see a lot of fascinating insects!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tapi berkat kamu, Udo, aku bisa melihat banyak serangga yang menarik!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Start_005
Array.english: <size=33>Hehe, I'm glad to hear that.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hehe, aku senang mendengarnya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Start_006
Array.english: <size=33>Then I'll submit my completion report to the editor-in-chief...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kalau begitu, aku akan menyerahkan laporan penyelesaianku ke pemimpin redaksi...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Start_007
Array.english: <size=50>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Start_008
Array.english: <size=33>Huh!? There's still one uncaught species...?!\nThat can't be right...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hah!? Masih ada satu spesies yang belum tertangkap...?!\nItu tidak mungkin benar...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Start_009
Array.english: <size=32>Aaah...!!! This is the <color=#F1DC2B>Golden Tiger Beetle</color>...!?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aaah...!!! Ini adalah <color=#F1DC2B>Kumbang Macan Emas</color>...!?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Start_010
Array.english: I see... I must've been mistaken... To think the <color=#F1DC2B>Golden Tiger Beetle</color> lives in this region...
Array.indonesia: Begitu... Pasti aku salah... Siapa sangka <color=#F1DC2B>Kumbang Macan Emas</color> hidup di wilayah ini...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Start_011
Array.english: Without catching this one, I can't truly say the encyclopedia is complete... *sigh*...
Array.indonesia: Tanpa menangkap yang satu ini, aku tidak bisa benar-benar mengatakan bahwa ensiklopedia ini sudah lengkap... *huff*...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Start_012
Array.english: I feel terrible asking you for even more help, Dave...\nI really shouldn't...
Array.indonesia: Aku merasa sangat bersalah meminta bantuanmu lagi, Dave...\nSeharusnya aku tidak melakukannya...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Start_013
Array.english: <size=33>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Start_014
Array.english: <size=48>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=48>...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Start_015
Array.english: <size=32>...Alright.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>...Alright.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Start_016
Array.english: Where does the <color=#F1DC2B>Golden Tiger Beetle</color> live?
Array.indonesia: Di mana <color=#F1DC2B>Kumbang Macan Emas</color> tinggal?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Start_017
Array.english: Well... it says the B2 of <color=#1DFEAF>Murau Temple</color>...
Array.indonesia: Nah... katanya di B2 <color=#1DFEAF>Kuil Murau</color>...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Start_018
Array.english: Ah... that place with the drainage system...
Array.indonesia: Ah... tempat yang punya sistem drainase itu...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Start_019
Array.english: Alright...\nI'll go take a look.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah...\nAku akan pergi melihatnya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Start_020
Array.english: <size=34>Whoa! Dave!!\nI'll never forget this!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wah! Dave!!\nAku tidak akan pernah melupakan ini!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Arrived_001
Array.english: Hmm... Udo said the <color=#F1DC2B>Golden Tiger Beetle</color> lives here, right?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Udo bilang <color=#F1DC2B>Kumbang Macan Emas</color> tinggal di sini, kan?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Arrived_002
Array.english: <size=33>Let's see if I can find it...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ayo kita lihat apakah aku bisa menemukannya...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Found_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh...! Is that a <color=#F1DC2B>Golden Tiger Beetle</color> over there...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh...! Apakah itu <color=#F1DC2B>Kumbang Harimau Emas</color> di sana...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Found_002
Array.english: It's massive... Just like that flame-patterned stag beetle, I'll probably need to send out three at once.
Array.indonesia: Ukurannya besar sekali... Sama seperti kumbang tanduk bermotif api itu, sepertinya aku harus mengirimkan tiga ekor sekaligus.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_WinBoss_001
Array.english: <size=32>Phew... that was tough...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wah... itu sulit sekali...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_WinBoss_002
Array.english: <size=32>But I managed to catch it.\nLooks like I picked the right team!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tapi aku berhasil menangkapnya.\nSepertinya aku memilih tim yang tepat!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_WinBoss_003
Array.english: <size=32>This was the last one, right...?\nLet's bring it to Udo.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ini yang terakhir, kan...?\nAyo kita bawa ke Udo.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_LoseBoss_001
Array.english: <size=32>It's strong, just like I thought...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Dia kuat, seperti yang kuduga...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_LoseBoss_002
Array.english: <size=32>I should catch some stronger insects...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku harus menangkap serangga yang lebih kuat...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_RetryBoss_001
Array.english: <size=33>That <color=#F1DC2B>Golden Tiger Beetle</color> from before...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33><color=#F1DC2B>Kumbang Macan Emas</color> tadi...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_RetryBoss_002
Array.english: <size=32>Should I go for a rematch...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haruskah aku mencoba bertarung lagi...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_FightBoss_option01
Array.english: Battle
Array.indonesia: Pertarungan

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_FightBoss_option02
Array.english: I'll try next time
Array.indonesia: Aku akan mencobanya lain kali

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Giveup_001
Array.english: I don't think I'm ready to take that on yet...\nLet's do it later.
Array.indonesia: Kurasa aku belum siap menghadapi itu...\nAyo kita lakukan nanti.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Unsatisfied_001
Array.english: Hmm... I'll need at least three to take that on.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Aku butuh setidaknya tiga ekor untuk menghadapinya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Unsatisfied_002
Array.english: Let's catch a few more and try again.
Array.indonesia: Ayo tangkap beberapa lagi dan coba lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Satisfied_001
Array.english: <size=33>Alright! Let's take on that <color=#F1DC2B>Golden Tiger Beetle</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Baiklah! Ayo kita tangkap <color=#F1DC2B>Kumbang Macan Emas</color> itu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Complete_001
Array.english: Here... I caught the <color=#F1DC2B>Golden Tiger Beetle</color> you asked for.
Array.indonesia: Ini... Aku sudah menangkap <color=#F1DC2B>Kumbang Macan Emas</color> yang kamu minta.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Complete_002
Array.english: <size=32>Whoaa...!! What a sturdy, massive specimen...\nThis... is cover-worthy material!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wah...!! Spesimen yang kokoh dan besar sekali...\nIni... layak dijadikan sampul!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Complete_003
Array.english: Dave, thank you so much. Thanks to you, I was able to cover every insect in this region.
Array.indonesia: Dave, terima kasih banyak. Berkat kamu, aku bisa meliput semua serangga di wilayah ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Complete_004
Array.english: I had a lot of fun too.
Array.indonesia: Aku juga sangat bersenang-senang.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Complete_005
Array.english: I even brought a <color=#F1DC2B>Model</color> to photograph in case I couldn't find any giant insects, but looks like I won't need it.
Array.indonesia: Aku bahkan membawa <color=#F1DC2B>Model</color> untuk difoto kalau-kalau aku tidak menemukan serangga raksasa, tapi sepertinya aku tidak akan membutuhkannya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Complete_006
Array.english: ...Wouldn't that be misleading your readers?
Array.indonesia: ...Bukankah itu akan menyesatkan pembaca?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Complete_007
Array.english: <size=33>N-no, not at all! It's just a bit of staging to help readers understand!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>T-tidak, sama sekali tidak! Itu hanya sedikit pengaturan agar pembaca lebih mudah memahami!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Complete_008
Array.english: Hmm... but I only heard it was a giant beetle,\nso I ended up making it way too big.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... tapi aku hanya mendengar kalau itu kumbang raksasa,\njadi akhirnya aku membuatnya terlalu besar.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Complete_009
Array.english: Looks like I won't need it anymore...
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya aku tidak akan membutuhkannya lagi...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Complete_010
Array.english: If you have space to display it, how about taking it home as a keepsake, Dave?
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu punya tempat untuk memajangnya, gimana kalau kamu bawa pulang sebagai kenang-kenangan, Dave?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Complete_011
Array.english: Oh... I appreciate it, but... it seems a bit too big to keep inside the house...
Array.indonesia: Oh... aku menghargainya, tapi... sepertinya agak terlalu besar untuk disimpan di dalam rumah...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Complete_012
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm... then how about hanging it above the door?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm... kalau begitu, bagaimana kalau digantung di atas pintu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Complete_013
Array.english: <size=31>Hmm... that's actually not a bad idea.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Hmm... itu sebenarnya ide yang tidak buruk.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Complete_014
Array.english: <size=33>I'll try hanging it above my door!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku akan coba menggantungnya di atas pintuku!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Complete_015
Array.english: Hehe. Then I'll stay in the village a bit longer and keep working on the article.
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Kalau begitu, aku akan tinggal di desa ini sedikit lebih lama dan terus mengerjakan artikelnya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Complete_016
Array.english: <size=33>Thank you again for all your help, Dave!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Terima kasih lagi atas semua bantuannya, Dave!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_UzmeYes_001
Array.english: <size=34>Alright! I won't go easy on you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Baiklah! Aku nggak akan membiarkanmu menang dengan mudah!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_UzmeNo_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, heading out? Let's play together next time.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, mau pergi? Ayo main bareng lain kali.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_UzmeEnd_001
Array.english: <size=33>I won! I used to play with my dad a lot when I was little, hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku menang! Dulu aku sering main sama ayahku waktu masih kecil, hehe.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_UzmeEnd_002
Array.english: <size=32>That was enough fun for today. Let's play again another time after you've practiced.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Cukup seru untuk hari ini. Ayo main lagi lain kali setelah kamu berlatih.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_UzmeReward_001
Array.english: <size=34>You're really good! I thought I was pretty decent myself.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kamu benar-benar jago! Aku kira aku juga lumayan.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_UzmeReward_002
Array.english: <size=33>I'll give you this <color=#1DFEAF>Gorilla Block</color> my dad gave me a while back.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku akan memberimu <color=#1DFEAF>Gorilla Block</color> ini yang diberikan ayahku beberapa waktu lalu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_UzmeReward_003
Array.english: <size=32>It'll be even more fun if you mix it in with the others blocks.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Akan lebih seru lagi kalau kamu mencampurnya dengan balok-balok lainnya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_UzmeStart_Betting_001
Array.english: <size=33>Shall we have an <color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color> challenge?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Mau coba tantangan <color=#F1DC2B>Menumpuk Balok Hewan</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_UzmeStart_BettingEnd_001
Array.english: <size=32>That was fun, hehe.\nCome talk to me again when you have time.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Itu seru, hehe.\nAyo ngobrol lagi sama aku kalau kamu punya waktu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_UzmeStart_Betting_Nomoney_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... you're a bit short on cash.\nYou need at least <color=#1DFEAF>30 Doni</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... kamu agak kekurangan uang.\nKamu butuh setidaknya <color=#1DFEAF>30 Doni</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PanutaStart_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh? <color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color>, you say?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh? <color=#F1DC2B>Menumpuk Balok Hewan</color>, katamu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PanutaYes_001
Array.english: <size=33>Haha, let's have a round.\nI don't hold back, so be ready.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Haha, ayo main satu putaran.\nAku nggak bakal menahan diri, jadi bersiaplah.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PanutaNo_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hm? Leaving already?\nI was going to go easy on you... See you around.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hm? Sudah mau pergi?\nAku sebenarnya mau main santai sama kamu... Sampai jumpa lagi.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PanutaEnd_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh dear... I ended up winning.\nPerhaps I should have gone easier.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Astaga... Ternyata aku yang menang.\nMungkin seharusnya aku lebih bersikap lembut.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PanutaEnd_002
Array.english: <size=32>That's enough for today.\nCome back after you've practiced more.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Cukup untuk hari ini.\nKembalilah setelah kamu berlatih lebih banyak.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PanutaReward_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh...? You're quite good.\nI let my guard down...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh...? Kamu cukup bagus.\nAku lengah...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PanutaReward_002
Array.english: <size=32>This is my prized <color=#1DFEAF>Sun Bear Block</color>. It'll be more enjoyable if you add it to your collection.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ini adalah <color=#1DFEAF>Sun Bear Block</color> kesayanganku. Akan lebih seru kalau kamu menambahkannya ke koleksimu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PanutaReward_003
Array.english: <size=32>Well then, let's play again next time we have a chance.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Baiklah, mari main lagi lain kali kalau ada kesempatan.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PanutaStart_Betting_001
Array.english: <size=32><color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color>, would you like to challenge me to a match?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32><color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color>, maukah kamu menantangku bertanding?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PanutaStart_BettingEnd_001
Array.english: <size=32>Haha, that was enjoyable.\nLet's play again when we have time.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha, itu seru.\nAyo main lagi kalau ada waktu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PanutaStart_Betting_Nomoney_001
Array.english: <size=32>Ah, but I'm a bit short on money. You need at least <color=#1DFEAF>30 Doni</color> for it to be worthwhile. Come back next time.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ah, tapi uangku agak pas-pasan. Kamu butuh setidaknya <color=#1DFEAF>30 Doni</color> biar worth it. Datang lagi lain kali.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_BasuStart_001
Array.english: <size=32>Huh? You know <color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hah? Kamu tahu <color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_BasuYes_001
Array.english: <size=32>It's been a while... but I reckon I'm still better than ya.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Sudah lama... tapi kayaknya aku masih lebih jago darimu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_BasuYes_002
Array.english: <size=33>Alright then, let's have a match.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Baiklah, ayo bertanding.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_BasuNo_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, not playin'? I was gonna go easy on ya.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, nggak mau main? Aku sebenarnya mau ngasih kamu kesempatan.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_BasuEnd_001
Array.english: <size=33>Well now, I went and won!\nGuess I haven't lost my touch, haha.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Nah, ternyata aku menang!\nSepertinya aku masih jago, haha.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_BasuEnd_002
Array.english: <size=32>All that focus's got me tuckered out. That's all I've got in me for today.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Fokus terus-terusan itu bikin aku capek banget. Itu saja yang bisa aku lakukan hari ini.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_BasuReward_001
Array.english: <size=32>Aw shucks... made a bit of a mistake there.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aduh... aku bikin kesalahan kecil tadi.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_BasuReward_002
Array.english: <size=32>You win. Take this as a gift.\nIt's an <color=#1DFEAF>Anaconda Block</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kamu menang. Anggap saja ini hadiah.\nIni adalah <color=#1DFEAF>Anaconda Block</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_BasuReward_003
Array.english: <size=32>It'll be more fun if ya add it to yer collection.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Akan lebih seru kalau kamu tambahkan ke koleksimu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_BasuStart_Betting_001
Array.english: <size=33><color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color> wanna play a round?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33><color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color> mau main satu putaran?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_BasuStart_Betting_002
Array.english: <size=32>I'm feelin' real good today...\nAin't gonna go easy on ya!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku merasa sangat baik hari ini...\nAku nggak bakal ngasih kamu kesempatan, lho!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_BasuStart_BettingEnd_001
Array.english: <size=33>Haha, that was fun.\nLet's play again sometime.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Haha, itu seru banget.\nAyo main lagi lain kali.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_BasuStart_Betting_Nomoney_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hehe, looks like you're a little short on cash, don't ya? You'll need at least <color=#1DFEAF>30 Doni</color> to really enjoy it, hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehe, sepertinya kamu lagi kehabisan uang, ya? Kamu butuh setidaknya <color=#1DFEAF>30 Doni</color> buat bener-bener nikmatin ini, hehe.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PerakStart_001
Array.english: <size=32>Haha, <color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha, <color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PerakYes_001
Array.english: <size=32>It's a traditional game in our village...\nThink you can beat me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ini permainan tradisional di desa kita...\nKamu pikir bisa ngalahin aku?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PerakYes_002
Array.english: <size=33>Well, I like your confidence.\nLet's get started!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wah, aku suka kepercayaan dirimu.\nAyo mulai!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PerakNo_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, not playing?\nCome on, don't be scared.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, nggak mau main?\nAyolah, jangan takut.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PerakEnd_001
Array.english: <size=32>Haha! Told you!\nI've been playing since I was a kid.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha! Kan sudah kubilang!\nAku sudah main ini sejak kecil.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PerakEnd_002
Array.english: <size=32>Alright, let's call it a day for now. I'll take you on again another time.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Baiklah, mari kita akhiri dulu untuk hari ini. Nanti aku akan bertanding lagi denganmu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PerakReward_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ah... can't believe I lost.\nLet my guard down a bit.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ah... nggak nyangka aku kalah.\nAku agak lengah.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PerakReward_002
Array.english: <size=33>That was an impressive match.\nHere, take this <color=#1DFEAF>Rhinoceros Hornbill Block</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Pertandingan yang mengesankan.\nIni, ambil ini <color=#1DFEAF>Blok Rhinoceros Hornbill</color></size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PerakStart_Betting_001
Array.english: <size=32><color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color>, huh?\nAlright, go ahead.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32><color=#F1DC2B>Menumpuk Blok Hewan</color>, ya?\nBaiklah, silakan.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PerakStart_BettingEnd_001
Array.english: <size=33>Haha, that was fun.\nCome find me when you want to play again.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Haha, itu seru.\nCari aku kalau mau main lagi.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PerakStart_Betting_Nomoney_001
Array.english: <size=32>...You need at least <color=#1DFEAF>30 Doni</color>.\nAsk me again when you have it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>...You butuh setidaknya <color=#1DFEAF>30 Doni</color>.\nTanya aku lagi kalau sudah punya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_GesangStart_001
Array.english: <size=33>...You want to play <color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...You mau main <color=#F1DC2B>Menumpuk Balok Hewan</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_GesangYes_001
Array.english: <size=32>...If my wife sees this, I'm in trouble...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>...If kalau istriku lihat ini, aku bakal kena masalah...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_GesangYes_002
Array.english: <size=32>I'd better win this quick before that happens... hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Mending aku menangin ini cepet sebelum itu terjadi... hehe.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_GesangNo_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hm? Not playing?\nI was looking forward to a little fun for once.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hm? Nggak main?\nAku udah nggak sabar pengen bersenang-senang sebentar.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_GesangNo_002
Array.english: <size=32>Well, hit me up next time you've got a minute!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ya udah, hubungi aku lagi kalau kamu punya waktu luang!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_GesangEnd_001
Array.english: <size=33>Haha! I won!\nYou didn't go easy on me, did you?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Haha! Aku menang!\nKamu nggak ngasih ampun, ya?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_GesangEnd_002
Array.english: <size=33>If I keep playing... my wife's gonna catch me.\nI'll call it a day for now.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kalau aku terus main... istriku bakal ketahuan.\nAku berhenti dulu ya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_GesangReward_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh man...! I lost.\nI used to be better than this.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Astaga...! Aku kalah.\nDulu aku lebih jago dari ini.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_GesangReward_002
Array.english: <size=32>Well, a loss is a loss. Here. Take it. \nIt's a <color=#1DFEAF>Chicken Block</color> I made myself.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Yah, kalah ya kalah. Ini. Ambil. \nIni adalah <color=#1DFEAF>Chicken Block</color> yang kubuat sendiri.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_GesangReward_003
Array.english: <size=32>Let's play again sometime when we both have time.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ayo main lagi lain kali kalau kita berdua punya waktu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_GesangStart_Betting_001
Array.english: <size=32><color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color> is fun, ain't it... hehe.\nHow about a round?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32><color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color> itu seru, kan... hehe.\nGimana kalau main satu putaran lagi?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_GesangStart_BettingEnd_001
Array.english: <size=32>Ah, that was fun.\nHit me up again sometime, hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ah, itu seru.\nHubungi aku lagi lain kali, hehe.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_GesangStart_Betting_Nomoney_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm... you should have at least <color=#1DFEAF>30 Doni</color> on you.\nOtherwise it's just chump change isn't it?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm... kamu seharusnya punya setidaknya <color=#1DFEAF>30 Doni</color>.\nKalau tidak, itu cuma uang receh, kan?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_MissionAllClear_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh! You beat the villagers and collected all three blocks!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh! Kamu mengalahkan para penduduk desa dan mengumpulkan ketiga balok itu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_MissionAllClear_002
Array.english: <size=32>You're better than you look, ain't ya? Hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kamu lebih hebat dari yang terlihat, kan? Hehe.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_MissionAllClear_003
Array.english: They were all pretty good.\nI barely won.
Array.indonesia: Mereka semua cukup tangguh.\nAku nyaris kalah.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_MissionAllClear_004
Array.english: You can now use these blocks in battle.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang kamu bisa menggunakan balok-balok ini dalam pertempuran.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_MissionAllClear_005
Array.english: Truth is...\nI lost these in a bet a while back.
Array.indonesia: Sebenarnya...\nAku kehilangan ini dalam sebuah taruhan beberapa waktu lalu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_MissionAllClear_006
Array.english: Thanks for getting them back for me.\nWouldn't feel right not to repay you.
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih sudah mengembalikannya untukku.\nRasanya tidak pantas kalau aku tidak membalas kebaikanmu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_MissionAllClear_007
Array.english: Here, this is an ornament made from animal blocks...\nGo ahead and hang it up in your shop!
Array.indonesia: Ini, ini adalah hiasan yang terbuat dari balok-balok hewan...\nSilakan gantung di tokomu!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_MissionAllClear_008
Array.english: <size=32>Well then, I'll be seein' ya around! Hahaha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Baiklah, sampai jumpa lagi! Hahaha!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_001
Array.english: Oh... you're not open yet...
Array.indonesia: Oh... tokomu belum buka...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_002
Array.english: Oh, Cinta, hello.\nIs there something you need?
Array.indonesia: Oh, Cinta, halo.\nAda yang kamu butuhkan?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_003
Array.english: The chef here...\nI heard he can make all kinds of dishes...
Array.indonesia: Koki di sini...\nKudengar dia bisa membuat berbagai macam hidangan...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_004
Array.english: <size=32>I was hoping Bancho could cook something for me.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku berharap Bancho bisa memasakkan sesuatu untukku.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_005
Array.english: Well... if it's possible, I'll do my best.\nWhat is it?
Array.indonesia: Baiklah... kalau memungkinkan, aku akan berusaha sebaik mungkin.\nApa itu?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_006
Array.english: <size=33>By any chance... do you know a plant called the <color=#FF73C3>Ostrich Fern</color>...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kebetulan... apakah kamu tahu tanaman yang disebut <color=#FF73C3>Ostrich Fern</color>...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_007
Array.english: Of course. It's a plant that grows in damp areas in the mountains. Its crisp, crunchy texture is exquisite.
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja. Itu adalah tanaman yang tumbuh di daerah lembap di pegunungan. Teksturnya yang renyah dan kriuk sangat lezat.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_008
Array.english: Just as I heard, you're very knowledgeable... Chef.
Array.indonesia: Seperti yang kudengar, kamu sangat berpengetahuan... Chef.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_009
Array.english: Could you make a dish with <color=#FF73C3>Ostrich Fern</color> simmered in coconut milk?
Array.indonesia: Bisakah kamu membuat hidangan dengan <color=#FF73C3>Ostrich Fern</color> yang direbus dalam santan?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_010
Array.english: Hmm. I specialize in fish.\nFor vegetables, someone else might be better.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Saya spesialis masakan ikan.\nUntuk sayuran, mungkin ada orang lain yang lebih ahli.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_011
Array.english: ...I see. I'm sorry...
Array.indonesia: ...Begitu ya. Maaf...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_012
Array.english: It's something my late husband used to make for me...\nPerhaps it's better left as a memory.
Array.indonesia: Itu adalah hidangan yang biasa dibuat almarhum suamiku untukku...\nMungkin lebih baik dibiarkan sebagai kenangan saja.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_013
Array.english: Uh... n-no.\nI didn't say I couldn't do it.
Array.indonesia: Uh... t-tidak.\nAku tidak bilang aku tidak bisa melakukannya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_014
Array.english: But looking around the village... \nI don't think I saw anything like that?
Array.indonesia: Tapi kalau melihat-lihat di sekitar desa... \nSepertinya aku tidak melihat tanaman seperti itu?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_015
Array.english: Oh... <color=#FF73C3>Ostrich Fern</color> grows on the hill near Suruga Falls.
Array.indonesia: Oh... <color=#FF73C3>Ostrich Fern</color> tumbuh di bukit dekat Air Terjun Suruga.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_016
Array.english: Oh, you mean near the shooting range. But there are so many vines growing there, it looks hard to get in.
Array.indonesia: Oh, maksudmu di dekat lapangan tembak. Tapi ada begitu banyak tanaman merambat yang tumbuh di sana, sepertinya sulit untuk masuk.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_017
Array.english: Since the villagers don't go there much these days,\nthat would make sense.
Array.indonesia: Karena penduduk desa jarang ke sana akhir-akhir ini,\nitu masuk akal.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_018
Array.english: If we had my husband's <color=#F1DC2B>Machete</color>, we could cut through it easily.
Array.indonesia: Kalau kita punya <color=#F1DC2B>parang</color> milik suamiku, kita bisa menebasnya dengan mudah.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_019
Array.english: Oh, then could I borrow it?
Array.indonesia: Oh, kalau begitu bolehkah aku meminjamnya?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_020
Array.english:
Well... I gave it to the carpenter <color=#F1DC2B>Peneb</color>...
He was close with my husband.
Array.indonesia:
Hmm... Aku sudah memberikannya kepada tukang kayu <color=#F1DC2B>Peneb</color>...
Dia dekat dengan suamiku.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_021
Array.english: If you speak with <color=#F1DC2B>Peneb</color>,\nhe might lend it to you.
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu bicara dengan <color=#F1DC2B>Peneb</color>,\ndia mungkin akan meminjamkannya kepadamu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_022
Array.english: I see.\nThen I'll go ask him.
Array.indonesia: Begitu ya.\nKalau begitu aku akan menanyakannya kepadanya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_Machete_001
Array.english: By any chance... do you still have the <color=#F1DC2B>Machete</color> Cinta's husband used to carry?
Array.indonesia: Kebetulan... apakah kamu masih punya <color=#F1DC2B>parang</color> yang dulu dibawa suami Cinta?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_Machete_002
Array.english: Oh, of course.\nWhy do you ask?
Array.indonesia: Oh, tentu saja.\nKenapa kamu tanya?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_Machete_003
Array.english: Well, I want to head up to the waterfall on the hill...\nbut the vines are too overgrown.
Array.indonesia: Nah, aku mau pergi ke air terjun di bukit...\ntapi tanaman merambatnya terlalu lebat.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_Machete_004
Array.english: Ah, a machete will cut right through those, haha!
Array.indonesia: Ah, parang bisa memotongnya dengan mudah, haha!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_Machete_005
Array.english: Oh. Could I borrow it then?
Array.indonesia: Oh. Bolehkah aku meminjamnya?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_Machete_006
Array.english: Aw... just lending it out is no fun.
Array.indonesia: Aduh... cuma meminjamkan saja nggak seru.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_Machete_007
Array.english: As you know, I'm injured and can't go chop wood.\nMy hands are itching to get back to work...
Array.indonesia: Seperti yang kamu tahu, aku sedang cedera dan nggak bisa menebang kayu.\nTanganku gatal pengen kembali bekerja...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_Machete_008
Array.english: How about you bring me 2 pieces of <color=#F1DC2B>Rubberwood</color>?
Array.indonesia: Bagaimana kalau kamu bawakan aku 2 potong <color=#F1DC2B>Kayu Karet</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_Machete_009
Array.english: Rubber trees only grow in <color=#1DFEAF>Setah Forest</color>... and in my condition, there's no way I can head in there.
Array.indonesia: Pohon karet hanya tumbuh di <color=#1DFEAF>Hutan Setah</color>... dan dalam kondisiku sekarang, mustahil aku bisa masuk ke sana.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_Machete_010
Array.english: Hmm. You mean the forest on the way to the ruins.\nAlright, got it.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Maksudmu hutan di jalan menuju reruntuhan.\nOke, paham.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_Delivery_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, did you bring me 2 <color=#F1DC2B>Rubberwood</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, apa kamu sudah membawakan aku 2 <color=#F1DC2B>kayu karet</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_Option01
Array.english: I got them
Array.indonesia: Sudah aku dapatkan

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_Option02
Array.english: Not yet...
Array.indonesia: Belum...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_Finished_001
Array.english: Yes. Here it is.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Ini dia.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_Finished_002
Array.english: <size=33>Ooh... you actually brought it back?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wah... kamu benar-benar membawanya kembali?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_Finished_003
Array.english: A promise is a promise!\nHere's the <color=#F1DC2B>Machete</color>.
Array.indonesia: Janji adalah janji!\nIni <color=#F1DC2B>parang</color>-nya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_Finished_004
Array.english: Just swing it at the vines and they'll clear out easily.
Array.indonesia: Ayunkan saja ke arah tanaman merambat dan mereka akan terpotong dengan mudah.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_Finished_005
Array.english: Be careful not to cut yourself and end up bandaged like me.
Array.indonesia: Hati-hati jangan sampai terluka dan berakhir dibalut perban seperti aku.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_NeedMore_001
Array.english: Here, I brought it.
Array.indonesia: Ini, aku sudah membawanya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_NeedMore_002
Array.english: Hmm... this doesn't look like enough?\nI need 2 <color=#F1DC2B>Rubberwood</color>.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... sepertinya ini belum cukup?\nAku butuh 2 <color=#F1DC2B>Kayu Karet</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_NoItem_001
Array.english: <size=32>Ah... I don't have any on me right now.\nI'll bring them next time.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ah... Aku tidak membawanya sekarang.\nAku akan membawanya lain kali.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_RefuseGiveItem_001
Array.english: <size=32>I'll keep looking.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku akan terus mencarinya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Cinta_ReadytoCook_001
Array.english: <size=33>Alright, I got all the ingredients for the braised ostrich fern. Let's head to the shop and serve it to <color=#F1DC2B>Cinta</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Baiklah, aku sudah mendapatkan semua bahan untuk masakan pakis burung unta rebus. Ayo kita pergi ke toko dan menyajikannya kepada <color=#F1DC2B>Cinta</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Cinta_AfterEatDish_001
Array.english: <size=38>Th-this is... The coconut milk gently wrapping around the bitterness of the <color=#FF73C3>Ostrich Fern</color>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>I-ini... Santan yang dengan lembut menyelimuti rasa pahit dari <color=#FF73C3>Paku Unta</color>...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Cinta_AfterEatDish_002
Array.english: <size=37>It reminds me of the taste... when he smiled and made it for me for the first time...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Ini mengingatkanku pada rasanya... saat dia tersenyum dan membuatnya untukku untuk pertama kalinya...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Cinta_AfterEatDish_003
Array.english: I-I'm sorry. The tears are coming again...
Array.indonesia: M-maaf. Air mata mulai mengalir lagi...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Cinta_AfterEatDish_004
Array.english: It was my first time making it, so I'm glad you liked it.
Array.indonesia: Itu pertama kalinya aku membuatnya, jadi aku senang kamu menyukainya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Cinta_AfterEatDish_005
Array.english: ...It's not that it was good... He was clumsy the first time he made it as well.
Array.indonesia: ...Bukan karena rasanya enak... Dia juga canggung saat pertama kali membuatnya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Cinta_AfterEatDish_006
Array.english: <size=36>...Hmm.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>...Hmm.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Cinta_AfterEatDish_007
Array.english: Anyway, thank you so much for bringing back those memories.
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun, terima kasih banyak sudah membangkitkan kenangan itu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Cinta_AfterEatDish_008
Array.english: This is a small gift... \nIf you like it, please hang it up in the shop.
Array.indonesia: Ini hadiah kecil... \nKalau kamu suka, silakan gantung di toko.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Cinta_AfterEatDish_009
Array.english: My husband was so happy when he caught a leopard and made this... but I don't need it anymore.
Array.indonesia: Suamiku sangat senang saat dia menangkap seekor macan tutul dan membuat ini... tapi aku sudah tidak membutuhkannya lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Cinta_AfterEatDish_010
Array.english: Oh... this is amazing.\nThank you!
Array.indonesia: Oh... ini luar biasa.\nTerima kasih!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Cinta_AfterEatDish_011
Array.english: Well then... I'll be counting on you from now on.\nThank you... for the meal.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah... mulai sekarang aku akan mengandalkanmu.\nTerima kasih... atas makanannya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_01_HerbalistStart_001
Array.english: Ah, outsider. Good to see you.\nCould I ask you a favor?
Array.indonesia: Ah, orang luar. Senang bertemu denganmu.\nBolehkah aku meminta bantuanmu?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_01_HerbalistStart_002
Array.english: Sure, what can I help you with?
Array.indonesia: Tentu, apa yang bisa kubantu?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_01_HerbalistStart_003
Array.english: I've been mixing various herbs, and I think I could use some more <color=#F1DC2B>Bamboo Shoots</color>.
Array.indonesia: Aku sedang mencampur berbagai ramuan, dan kurasa aku butuh lebih banyak <color=#F1DC2B>Tunas Bambu</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_01_HerbalistStart_004
Array.english: <size=33>Could you gather <color=#F1DC2B>3 Bamboo Shoots</color> from nearby?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Bisakah kamu mengumpulkan <color=#F1DC2B>3 Tunas Bambu</color> dari sekitar sini?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_01_HerbalistStart_005
Array.english: Sure. That shouldn't be a problem.
Array.indonesia: Tentu. Itu seharusnya tidak jadi masalah.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_01_HerbalistStart_006
Array.english: Bamboo shoots... They should be near bamboo, right?
Array.indonesia: Rebung... Pasti ada di dekat bambu, kan?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_01_HerbalistStart_007
Array.english: You're quite sharp, hehe.\nI'll be counting on you.
Array.indonesia: Kamu cukup jeli, hehe.\nAku mengandalkanmu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_01_CheckDelivery_001
Array.english: <size=33>Have you managed to find the <color=#F1DC2B>3 Bamboo Shoots</color> I asked for?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Apakah kamu sudah berhasil menemukan <color=#F1DC2B>3 rebung</color> yang aku minta?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_01_CheckDelivery_Option01
Array.english: Yes, I found them
Array.indonesia: Ya, aku sudah menemukannya

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_01_CheckDelivery_Option02
Array.english: Not yet
Array.indonesia: Belum

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_01_GiveItem_Finished_001
Array.english: Here are the bamboo shoots you asked for.
Array.indonesia: Ini rebung yang kamu minta.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_01_GiveItem_Finished_002
Array.english: Oh, thank you. This will be enough for my research.
Array.indonesia: Oh, terima kasih. Ini sudah cukup untuk penelitianku.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_01_GiveItem_Finished_003
Array.english: It's not much, but please accept this as a token of my gratitude, outsider.
Array.indonesia: Memang tidak banyak, tapi tolong terima ini sebagai tanda terima kasihku, orang asing.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_01_GiveItem_NeedMore_001
Array.english: Here you go.
Array.indonesia: Ini untukmu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_01_GiveItem_NeedMore_002
Array.english: Hmm... it's not enough. Could you get me some more, please?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... ini belum cukup. Bisakah kamu membawakan aku lagi, tolong?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_01_GiveItem_NeedMore_003
Array.english: Ah... you're right. Okay, I'll look for more.
Array.indonesia: Ah... kamu benar. Oke, aku akan mencari lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_01_GiveItem_NoItem_001
Array.english:
Oh... I think I was mistaken.
I'll look for it again.
Array.indonesia:
Oh... sepertinya aku salah.
Aku akan mencarinya lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_01_RefuseGiveItem_001
Array.english: I haven't gotten it yet. I'll bring it later.
Array.indonesia: Aku belum mendapatkannya. Nanti aku bawa.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanStart_001
Array.english: Good grief... just can't seem to catch any.
Array.indonesia: Astaga... sepertinya aku nggak bisa menangkap satupun.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanStart_002
Array.english: Hmm? Something wrong, Basu?
Array.indonesia: Hmm? Ada yang salah, Basu?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanStart_003
Array.english: Well... there's this fish called a <color=#F1DC2B>Walking Catfish</color>...\nThey're mighty tasty when grilled.
Array.indonesia: Nah... ada ikan yang namanya <color=#F1DC2B>Walking Catfish</color>...\nRasanya enak banget kalau dipanggang.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanStart_004
Array.english: But they just won't bite a hook.\nThey hide in the mud, you see.
Array.indonesia: Tapi mereka nggak mau menggigit kail.\nMereka bersembunyi di lumpur, lho.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanStart_005
Array.english: Could you maybe catch <color=#1DFEAF>3</color> for me next time you go to the lake?
Array.indonesia: Bisakah kamu menangkap <color=#1DFEAF>3</color> buat aku lain kali kalau kamu ke danau?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanStart_006
Array.english: I don't think catching them would be hard if I spot them…\nbut won't they be hard to find if they're hiding in the mud?
Array.indonesia: Menurutku menangkapnya nggak akan sulit kalau aku melihatnya…\ntapi bukankah akan sulit menemukannya kalau mereka bersembunyi di lumpur?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanStart_007
Array.english: <size=33>Haha, ain't no need to worry! \nThey'll jump out and go after anything that passes by!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Haha, nggak perlu khawatir! \nMereka bakal melompat keluar dan mengejar apa pun yang lewat!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanStart_008
Array.english: <size=34>Oh... I see. Right...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh... begitu ya. Benar...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanStart_009
Array.english: Haha, best grilled whole...\nso bring 'em back <color=#1DFEAF>Alive</color>.
Array.indonesia: Haha, paling enak dipanggang utuh...\njadi bawa pulang <color=#1DFEAF>dalam keadaan hidup</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanStart_010
Array.english: If you've got a <color=#F1DC2B>Net</color>, you could catch 'em all at once.
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu punya <color=#F1DC2B>Jaring</color>, kamu bisa menangkap mereka semua sekaligus.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanDelivery_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, did ya happen to catch the <color=#F1DC2B>Walking Catfish</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, kebetulan kamu menangkap <color=#F1DC2B>Ikan Lele Berjalan</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanDelivery_Option01
Array.english: Here you go
Array.indonesia: Ini dia

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanDelivery_Option02
Array.english: Not yet...
Array.indonesia: Belum...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanGiveItem_Finished_000
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, did ya manage to catch the <color=#F1DC2B>Walking Catfish</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, apa kamu berhasil menangkap <color=#F1DC2B>Walking Catfish</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanGiveItem_Finished_001
Array.english: They were tough to find, hidin' in the mud...
Array.indonesia: Mereka susah dicari, bersembunyi di lumpur...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanGiveItem_Finished_002
Array.english: <size=34>But I caught them anyway, haha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Tapi aku tetap berhasil menangkapnya, haha!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanGiveItem_Finished_003
Array.english: <size=34>Oh! Thanks a bunch!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh! Terima kasih banyak!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanGiveItem_Finished_004
Array.english: Doesn't look too tasty just lookin' at it...\nbut they say it's amazing fried.
Array.indonesia: Kelihatannya nggak terlalu enak kalau cuma dilihat...\ntapi katanya enak banget kalau digoreng.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanGiveItem_Finished_005
Array.english: <size=33>Hope I get to try it at your shop sometime!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Semoga aku bisa mencobanya di tokomu suatu saat nanti!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanGiveItem_NeedMore_001
Array.english: Here you go.
Array.indonesia: Ini dia.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanGiveItem_NeedMore_002
Array.english: Hmm... this ain't quite enough. Come back when you've got what you promised.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... ini belum cukup. Kembalilah saat kamu sudah membawa apa yang kamu janjikan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanGiveItem_NoItem_001
Array.english: Oops, I was mistaken.\nI haven't caught it yet.
Array.indonesia: Ups, aku salah.\nAku belum menangkapnya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanGiveItem_NoItem_002
Array.english: <size=32>I should write it down properly so I don't mess up.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku harus menuliskannya dengan benar agar tidak salah.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanRefuseGiveItem_001
Array.english: <size=32>Not yet...\nI'll keep looking.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Belum...\nAku akan terus mencarinya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeStart_001
Array.english: <size=33>He's so stubborn...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Dia sangat keras kepala...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeStart_002
Array.english: Is something bothering you?
Array.indonesia: Ada yang mengganggumu?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeStart_003
Array.english: Ah... I'm sorry. It's about my father.
Array.indonesia: Ah... maaf. Ini tentang ayahku.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeStart_004
Array.english: Ah... your father... the village chief.
Array.indonesia: Ah... ayahmu... kepala desa.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeStart_005
Array.english: Yes. The reason my dad's leg is like that...\nis actually my fault.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Alasan kaki ayahku seperti itu...\nsebenarnya adalah kesalahanku.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeStart_006
Array.english: <size=32>When I was young, he got hurt trying to save me from a vicious saltwater crocodile.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Saat aku masih kecil, dia terluka saat mencoba menyelamatkanku dari buaya air asin yang ganas.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeStart_007
Array.english: That's why I promised myself I'd never grow up to be weak... and I've trained every single day since.
Array.indonesia: Itulah mengapa aku berjanji pada diriku sendiri bahwa aku tidak akan pernah tumbuh menjadi orang yang lemah... dan sejak itu aku berlatih setiap hari.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeStart_008
Array.english: But...\nthat doesn't make my dad's leg any better.
Array.indonesia: Tapi...\nitu tidak membuat kaki ayahku membaik.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeStart_009
Array.english: He often gets severe pain when it rains...\nbut he really hates using medicine.
Array.indonesia: Dia sering merasakan sakit yang parah saat hujan...\ntapi dia sangat benci menggunakan obat.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeStart_010
Array.english: Applying medicine would ease the pain a bit...\nbut he's stubborn about the strangest things.
Array.indonesia: Mengoleskan obat akan sedikit meredakan rasa sakitnya...\ntapi dia keras kepala soal hal-hal yang paling aneh.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeStart_011
Array.english: I've been secretly applying it while he sleeps...\nbut I'm about to run out.
Array.indonesia: Aku diam-diam mengoleskannya saat dia tidur...\ntapi persediaanku hampir habis.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeStart_012
Array.english: The medicine is made from an aquatic plant called <color=#F1DC2B>Hornwort</color>. If you find any in the lake, could you bring it to me?
Array.indonesia: Obat itu terbuat dari tanaman air bernama <color=#F1DC2B>Hornwort</color>. Kalau kamu menemukannya di danau, bisakah kamu membawakannya untukku?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeStart_013
Array.english: <size=33>I think about <color=#1DFEAF>5 Stalks</color> should be enough.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kurasa sekitar <color=#1DFEAF>5 tangkai</color> sudah cukup.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeStart_014
Array.english: Got it. I'll pick some up if I see any in the lake.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah. Aku akan memetiknya kalau melihatnya di danau.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeDelivery_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, did you manage to get the <color=#F1DC2B>Hornwort</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, apakah kamu sudah berhasil mendapatkan <color=#F1DC2B>Hornwort</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeDelivery_Option01
Array.english: I got them
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah mendapatkannya

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeDelivery_Option02
Array.english: Not yet...
Array.indonesia: Belum...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeGiveItem_Finished_001
Array.english: Here, I brought five <color=#F1DC2B>Hornwort</color>.
Array.indonesia: Ini, aku bawa lima <color=#F1DC2B>Hornwort</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeGiveItem_Finished_002
Array.english: Oh... this is it! This should be enough to make Dad's medicine.
Array.indonesia: Oh... ini dia! Ini seharusnya cukup untuk membuat obat Ayah.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeGiveItem_Finished_003
Array.english: Thank you, Dave.\nI'll be sure to repay you someday.
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih, Dave.\nSuatu hari nanti aku pasti akan membalas budimu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeGiveItem_Finished_004
Array.english: You really don't have to. \nI already owe you and the chief so much.
Array.indonesia: Kamu benar-benar tidak perlu. \nAku sudah berhutang banyak padamu dan kepala desa.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeGiveItem_Finished_005
Array.english: Hehe, it's my duty to help you feel at home in the village. \nI'll be counting on you.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, ini tugasku untuk membantumu merasa betah di desa ini. \nAku akan mengandalkanmu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeGiveItem_NeedMore_001
Array.english: I brought the <color=#F1DC2B>Hornwort</color> you asked for.
Array.indonesia: Aku membawa <color=#F1DC2B>Hornwort</color> yang kamu minta.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeGiveItem_NeedMore_002
Array.english: Oh... thank you, but I need <color=#1DFEAF>5 Stalks</color> to make the medicine. This isn't quite enough.
Array.indonesia: Oh... terima kasih, tapi aku butuh <color=#1DFEAF>5 Batang</color> untuk membuat obatnya. Ini belum cukup.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeGiveItem_NeedMore_003
Array.english: Ah... I must have misread the amount.\nI'll go get more.
Array.indonesia: Ah... Sepertinya aku salah baca jumlahnya.\nAku akan ambil lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeGiveItem_NoItem_001
Array.english: <size=32>Um... I was mistaken.\nI haven't gotten it yet.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Um... Aku salah.\nAku belum mendapatkannya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeRefuseGiveItem_001
Array.english: <size=32>I haven't found it yet...\nI'll keep looking a bit longer.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku belum menemukannya...\nAku akan terus mencari sebentar lagi.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaHideNSeek_Option001
Array.english: Alright
Array.indonesia: Baiklah

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaHideNSeek_Option002
Array.english: Not right now
Array.indonesia: Nanti saja, deh

Array.name: JDLCSideMission_06_EkaStart_Title
Array.english: Hide-and-seek
Array.indonesia: Petak umpet

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaRepeat_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, you mean the <color=#F1DC2B>Hide-and-Seek</color> we didn't finish last time?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, maksudmu <color=#F1DC2B>Petak Umpet</color> yang belum kita selesaikan terakhir kali?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaRepeat_002
Array.english: <size=32>Let's play hide-and-seek together.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ayo main petak umpet bareng.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaRepeat_003
Array.english: Hehe. You're not scared of my stealth skills again, are you?
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Kamu nggak takut lagi sama kemampuan bersembunyi aku, kan?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaRepeat_004
Array.english: <size=33>Wanna play hide-and-seek again?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Mau main petak umpet lagi?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaRetry_001
Array.english: Hehe. You couldn't find us last time.
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Kamu nggak bisa nemuin kita terakhir kali.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaRetry_002
Array.english: I was just hidden too well... Maybe I should've gone easy on you.
Array.indonesia: Aku cuma bersembunyi terlalu baik... Mungkin aku seharusnya nggak terlalu keras sama kamu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaRetry_003
Array.english: We won! Hehe.
Array.indonesia: Kita menang! Hehe.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaRetry_004
Array.english: Wanna play hide-and-seek with us again?
Array.indonesia: Mau main petak umpet sama kita lagi?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaRetry_005
Array.english: The rules are the same!\nWe'll hide in the village, and if you find us, you win.
Array.indonesia: Aturannya sama!\nKita bakal bersembunyi di desa, dan kalau kamu nemuin kita, kamu menang.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaRetry_006
Array.english: Just close your eyes and open them when I count to three. Got it?
Array.indonesia: Tutup saja matamu dan buka saat aku menghitung sampai tiga. Paham?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaStart_001
Array.english: <size=33>Mister, mister! Have you ever played <color=#F1DC2B>Hide-and-Seek</color> before?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Pak, Pak! Pernahkah kamu bermain <color=#F1DC2B>Petak Umpet</color> sebelumnya?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaStart_002
Array.english: Huh? Yeah, I used to play it a lot with my friends when I was a kid.
Array.indonesia: Hah? Ya, dulu aku sering memainkannya bersama teman-temanku saat masih kecil.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaStart_003
Array.english: <size=32>Wow. Then please play with us.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wah. Kalau begitu, tolong mainlah bersama kami.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaStart_004
Array.english: Wanna play <color=#F1DC2B>Hide-and-Seek</color> with us?
Array.indonesia: Mau main <color=#F1DC2B>Petak Umpet</color> bersama kami?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaStart_005
Array.english: If you find all three of us... we'll give you our precious treasure!
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu berhasil menemukan kami bertiga... kami akan memberimu harta karun kami yang berharga!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaStart_006
Array.english: Oh... treasure, huh? That sounds pretty tempting.
Array.indonesia: Oh... harta karun, ya? Kedengarannya cukup menggoda.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaStart_007
Array.english: <size=32>Wait!? You're really giving that away?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tunggu!? Kalian benar-benar mau memberikannya begitu saja?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaStart_008
Array.english: Hehe. We know this village inside out.\nNo way he'll find us that easily!
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Kami tahu desa ini luar dalam.\nTidak mungkin dia bisa menemukan kami semudah itu!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaStart_009
Array.english: <size=32>Please play with us, mister.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tolong mainlah bersama kami, Pak.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaAsk_001
Array.english: <size=33>So, wanna play hide-and-seek?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Jadi, mau main petak umpet?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaYes_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hehe! Alright!\nYou won't find us that easily!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehe! Oke!\nKamu nggak bakal nemuin kita semudah itu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaYes_002
Array.english: <size=32>We're really good at hiding behind trees or in the bushes, haha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kita jago banget nyembunyi di balik pohon atau di semak-semak, haha!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaYes_003
Array.english: <size=32>Wow... this sounds fun.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wah... kedengarannya seru.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaYes_004
Array.english: <size=32>No peeking! Okay, let's start!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Jangan intip! Oke, ayo mulai!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaCount_001
Array.english: <size=38>One... two... three!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Satu... dua... tiga!!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaNo_001
Array.english: Aww... giving up already because you think you can't find us?
Array.indonesia: Aduh... sudah menyerah karena kamu pikir nggak bisa menemukan kami?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaNo_002
Array.english: <size=32>Hahaha! I'll make it easier for you.\nDon't worry too much!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hahaha! Aku akan membuatnya lebih mudah untukmu.\nJangan terlalu khawatir!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaNo_003
Array.english: Aww... come play with us.
Array.indonesia: Aduh... ayo main bareng kita.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaNo_004
Array.english: Come talk to me when you're ready! Hehe.
Array.indonesia: Ayo ngobrol sama aku kalau kamu sudah siap! Hehe.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaFind_001
Array.english: <size=34>So this is where you were. Found you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Jadi di sinilah kamu. Ketemu deh!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaFind_002
Array.english: <size=34>Tsk, you got me!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Tsk, kamu berhasil menangkapku!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaFind_003
Array.english: <size=32>You're pretty good, huh?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kamu lumayan jago, ya?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_SaniahFind_001
Array.english: <size=34>There you are!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Itu kamu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_SaniahFind_002
Array.english: Huh...? But I hid so well...! You're really good, mister.
Array.indonesia: Hah...? Tapi aku bersembunyi dengan sangat baik...! Kamu benar-benar jago, Pak.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_BimaFind_001
Array.english: <size=34>Found it! So this is where it was!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ketemu! Jadi di sinilah letaknya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_BimaFind_002
Array.english: <size=32>Ah...! How did you see through my perfect camouflage?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ah...! Bagaimana kamu bisa menembus kamuflase sempurna aku?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_BimaFind_003
Array.english: You've got incredible eyes, mister.\nI admit it.
Array.indonesia: Matamu luar biasa, Pak.\nAku akui itu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_AllFind_001
Array.english: <size=33>You found all three of us!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kamu menemukan kami bertiga!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_AllFind_002
Array.english: Guess I underestimated you... oops.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya aku meremehkanmu... oops.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_AllFind_003
Array.english: <size=32>That was fun!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Itu seru!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_AllFind_004
Array.english: Hehe. Don't underestimate my eyes, trained underwater.
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Jangan meremehkan penglihatanku, yang terlatih di bawah air.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_AllFind_005
Array.english: <size=32>Hehe. I'll keep my promise!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehe. Aku akan menepati janjiku!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_AllFind_006
Array.english: Here, this is... a <color=#F1DC2B>Red Sunang Stone</color> I found by the lake!
Array.indonesia: Ini, ini adalah... sebuah <color=#F1DC2B>Batu Sunang Merah</color> yang kutemukan di tepi danau!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_AllFind_007
Array.english: <size=34>I've been hiding it in secret... but I'll give it to you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku sudah menyembunyikannya diam-diam... tapi aku akan memberikannya padamu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_AllFind_008
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... thanks!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... terima kasih!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_AllFind_009
Array.english: I can use this ore to make my weapons stronger.\nI'll make good use of it!
Array.indonesia: Aku bisa menggunakan bijih ini untuk memperkuat senjataku.\nAku akan memanfaatkannya dengan baik!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_AllFind_010
Array.english: So it's not just a regular gem?\nEven better if it helps!
Array.indonesia: Jadi ini bukan sekadar permata biasa?\nAkan lebih baik lagi kalau bisa membantu!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_AllFind_011
Array.english: <size=32>Alright then, let's play again next time I find something cool!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Baiklah, kalau begitu, ayo main lagi lain kali kalau aku menemukan sesuatu yang keren!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_Retry_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh! You're gonna get me some <color=#F1DC2B>Driftwood</color>?\nAbout 5 pieces should do.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh! Kamu akan membelikanku <color=#F1DC2B>Kayu Apung</color>?\nSekitar 5 potong sudah cukup.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_Retry_002
Array.english: <size=32>I'll carve you a nice animal sculpture in return... so please help me out.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Sebagai balasannya, aku akan mengukir patung hewan yang bagus untukmu... jadi tolong bantu aku.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_Retry_003
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... what should I do?)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... apa yang harus aku lakukan?)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_001
Array.english: Hmm... I'm almost out of <color=#F1DC2B>Driftwood</color>...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Kayu apungku hampir habis <color=#F1DC2B>Driftwood</color>...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_002
Array.english: Hello?
Array.indonesia: Halo?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_003
Array.english: <size=35>Yikes!! I'm sorry!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Astaga!! Maaf!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_004
Array.english: ...Ah... oh, it's you.\nYou startled me.
Array.indonesia: ...Ah... oh, ternyata kamu.\nKamu bikin aku kaget.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_005
Array.english: Oh, sorry... You looked lost in thought.
Array.indonesia: Oh, maaf... Kamu terlihat sedang melamun.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_006
Array.english: Ah... well... I've been secretly carving sculptures to make a bit of pocket money without my wife knowing...
Array.indonesia: Ah... ya... aku diam-diam membuat patung untuk mendapatkan sedikit uang saku tanpa sepengetahuan istriku...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_007
Array.english: But I've run out of the <color=#F1DC2B>Driftwood</color> I use for carving.
Array.indonesia: Tapi <color=#F1DC2B>Driftwood</color> yang aku gunakan untuk memahat sudah habis.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_008
Array.english: I could probably find some near the lake... but I'm worried my wife will question me if she sees me there.
Array.indonesia: Mungkin aku bisa menemukannya di dekat danau... tapi aku khawatir istriku akan bertanya-tanya kalau dia melihatku di sana.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_009
Array.english: Ah... I saw you going into the lake before...
Array.indonesia: Ah... tadi aku melihatmu masuk ke danau...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_010
Array.english: Could you maybe get me about 5 pieces of <color=#F1DC2B>Driftwood</color>?
Array.indonesia: Bisakah kamu membantuku mengambil sekitar 5 potong <color=#F1DC2B>Kayu Apung</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_011
