Array.english: I'll carve you a nice animal block as thanks...\nPretty please?
Array.indonesia: Aku akan mengukir blok hewan yang bagus untukmu sebagai ucapan terima kasih...\nTolong dong?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_012
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... what should I do? I hope I don't get scolded too.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... apa yang harus aku lakukan? Semoga aku tidak dimarahi juga.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_Option01
Array.english: Got it
Array.indonesia: Oke, paham

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_Option02
Array.english: I don't think I can do it
Array.indonesia: Aku rasa aku tidak bisa melakukannya

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_Yes_001
Array.english: Got it. So I just need to bring you some <color=#F1DC2B>Driftwood</color> from the lake, right?
Array.indonesia: Oke, paham. Jadi, aku cuma perlu membawakanmu <color=#F1DC2B>kayu apung</color> dari danau, kan?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_Yes_002
Array.english: <size=35>Oh! Yes! Thank you!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh! Iya! Terima kasih!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_Yes_003
Array.english: Then I'm counting on you...\nAnd if anyone asks, don't say I sent you...
Array.indonesia: Kalau gitu, aku andalkan kamu...\nDan kalau ada yang tanya, jangan bilang aku yang suruh...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_No_001
Array.english: Hmm... I'm afraid I can't...\nI think I'd get in trouble too.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Aku takut tidak bisa...\nAku rasa aku juga akan kena masalah.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_No_002
Array.english: Hmm... that's a problem...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... itu masalah...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_No_003
Array.english: If you change your mind, let me know!\nI really need it...
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu berubah pikiran, beri tahu aku!\nAku benar-benar membutuhkannya...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangDelivery_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... did you bring me <color=#F1DC2B>5 Driftwood</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... apakah kamu membawakan aku <color=#F1DC2B>5 Kayu Apung</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangDelivery_Option01
Array.english: I got it
Array.indonesia: Sudah aku dapatkan

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangDelivery_Option02
Array.english: Not yet...
Array.indonesia: Belum...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished01_001
Array.english: Yes. Here are 5 pieces of <color=#F1DC2B>Driftwood</color>.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Ini 5 potong <color=#F1DC2B>Kayu Apung</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished01_002
Array.english: <size=33>Ooh...! Nice...!\nThese are good quality.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wah...! Bagus...!\nKualitasnya bagus.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished01_003
Array.english: Hehe... I'll use these to carve more animal blocks and make some pocket money.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... Aku akan pakai ini untuk mengukir lebih banyak balok hewan dan mendapatkan uang saku.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished01_Reward_001
Array.english: Oh, right.\nI promised to make one and give it to you, didn't I?
Array.indonesia: Oh, benar.\nAku kan sudah janji akan membuat satu dan memberikannya padamu, kan?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished01_Reward_002
Array.english: <size=33>Hey, which do you like better, dogs or cats?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hei, mana yang lebih kamu suka, anjing atau kucing?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished01_Option01
Array.english: A loyal dog
Array.indonesia: Anjing yang setia

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished01_Option02
Array.english: A cute cat
Array.indonesia: Kucing yang imut

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished01_Dog_001
Array.english: Haha! They say people who like dogs are more outgoing than cat people.
Array.indonesia: Haha! Katanya orang yang suka anjing lebih ramah daripada yang suka kucing.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished01_Dog_002
Array.english: Let's hang out and play Animal Block Stacking sometime!
Array.indonesia: Ayo kita main bareng dan main "Menumpuk Balok Hewan" suatu saat nanti!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished01_Dog_003
Array.english: Hold on a sec.\nI'll carve it right away.
Array.indonesia: Tunggu sebentar.\nAku akan segera mengukirnya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished01_Cat_001
Array.english: Oh... they say people who like cats are more sensitive than dog people.
Array.indonesia: Oh... katanya orang yang suka kucing lebih sensitif daripada pecinta anjing.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished01_Cat_002
Array.english: You don't quite look the type, though.
Array.indonesia: Tapi kamu nggak kelihatan seperti tipe orang seperti itu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished01_Cat_003
Array.english: <size=33>What's that supposed to mean...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Apa maksudnya itu...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished01_Cat_004
Array.english: Haha! Just kidding.\nThey say cat lovers are sensitive... guess it's true.
Array.indonesia: Haha! Cuma bercanda.\nKatanya pecinta kucing itu sensitif... sepertinya memang benar.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished01_Cat_005
Array.english: Alright, give me a second.\nI'll have it ready in no time.
Array.indonesia: Oke, tunggu sebentar.\nAku akan segera menyiapkannya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished02_001
Array.english: <size=34>Here you go! What do you think?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ini dia! Gimana menurutmu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished02_002
Array.english: <size=34>Oh...! It feels kinda different?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh...! Rasanya agak beda ya?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished02_003
Array.english: I think I've seen something like this in a famous vampire game...
Array.indonesia: Kayaknya aku pernah lihat yang kayak gini di game vampir terkenal...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished02_004
Array.english: Hehe... yeah, I played it on my friend's console when he came from the city, and it was really fun.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... iya, aku mainin di konsol temanku pas dia datang dari kota, dan seru banget.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished02_005
Array.english: I thought of the animals from that game when I made this.
Array.indonesia: Aku teringat hewan-hewan dari game itu saat membuat ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished02_006
Array.english: <size=32>That's awesome. Thanks!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Keren banget. Makasih!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished02_007
Array.english: <size=32>Use it for our animal block stacking matches, hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Gunakan ini untuk pertandingan menumpuk balok hewan kita, hehe.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_NeedMore_001
Array.english: Here you go.
Array.indonesia: Ini dia.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_NeedMore_002
Array.english: Hmm... I need 5...\nbut this isn't quite enough.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Aku butuh 5...\ntapi ini belum cukup.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_NeedMore_003
Array.english: Oh, you're right.\nI'll go find some more.
Array.indonesia: Oh, kamu benar.\nAku akan cari lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_NoItem_001
Array.english: Oh, I don't have it. I must've been mistaken.\nI'll come back once I get it.
Array.indonesia: Oh, aku nggak punya. Pasti aku salah.\nAku akan kembali setelah mendapatkannya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangRefuseGiveItem_001
Array.english: <size=32>I haven't gotten it yet. I'll keep looking.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku belum mendapatkannya. Aku akan terus mencarinya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahStart_001
Array.english: Oh, outsider! Um...
Array.indonesia: Oh, orang luar! Um...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahStart_002
Array.english: Yes? Go ahead.
Array.indonesia: Ya? Silakan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahStart_003
Array.english: <size=32>I heard there are fish in the lake that kiss each other. \nIs that true?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku dengar ada ikan di danau yang saling berciuman. \nBenarkah itu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahStart_004
Array.english: Oh, you mean <color=#F1DC2B>Kissing Gouramis</color>. They're interesting fish, the way they press their lips together.
Array.indonesia: Oh, maksudmu <color=#F1DC2B>Gourami Berciuman</color>. Ikan-ikan itu menarik, cara mereka menempelkan bibir satu sama lain.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahStart_005
Array.english: <size=34>Oh~ that's so romantic<color=#ff61e3>♥</color>\nFish that kiss...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh~ itu sangat romantis<color=#ff61e3>♥</color>\nIkan yang berciuman...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahStart_006
Array.english: <size=33>Um... could you catch some of those fish for me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Um... bisakah kamu menangkap beberapa ikan itu untukku?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahStart_007
Array.english: <size=34>Huh? But if I catch them... they won't be able to kiss anymore...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hah? Tapi kalau aku menangkapnya... mereka nggak bakal bisa berciuman lagi, kan...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahStart_008
Array.english: <size=33>Hmm... then could you catch them alive for me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hmm... kalau gitu, bisakah kamu menangkapnya dalam keadaan hidup untukku?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahStart_009
Array.english: I want to write about them... but I think I need to see them for myself to feel inspired.
Array.indonesia: Aku mau nulis tentang mereka... tapi kayaknya aku perlu lihat sendiri biar terinspirasi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahStart_010
Array.english: Hmm... alive, huh...\nI'll do my best.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... hidup, ya. ..\nAku akan berusaha sebaik mungkin.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahStart_011
Array.english: <size=34>Wow! Thank you! Then please bring me a living <color=#1DFEAF>Pair</color>... \nI'm counting on you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wah! Terima kasih! Kalau begitu, tolong bawakan aku sepasang <color=#1DFEAF>Pair</color> yang masih hidup... \nAku mengandalkanmu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahDelivery_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh, did you manage to catch a pair of <color=#F1DC2B>Kissing Gourami</color>s?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh, apakah kamu berhasil menangkap sepasang <color=#F1DC2B>Kissing Gourami</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahDelivery_Option01
Array.english: Here you go
Array.indonesia: Ini dia

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahDelivery_Option02
Array.english: Not yet...
Array.indonesia: Belum...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahGiveItem_Finished_000
Array.english: <size=34>Oh, did you manage to catch a pair of <color=#F1DC2B>Kissing Gourami</color>s?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh, apakah kamu berhasil menangkap sepasang <color=#F1DC2B>Kissing Gourami</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahGiveItem_Finished_001
Array.english: Here's a pair of <color=#F1DC2B>Kissing Gourami</color>s.
Array.indonesia: Ini sepasang <color=#F1DC2B>Kissing Gourami</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahGiveItem_Finished_002
Array.english: <size=33>Wow! They're such cute fish! I'll put them in the tank right away and watch them kiss!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wow! Ikan-ikan ini lucu sekali! Aku akan segera memasukkannya ke dalam akuarium dan melihat mereka berciuman!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahGiveItem_Finished_003
Array.english: In the murky lake our time together stood still the warmth of your tiny lips...
Array.indonesia: Di danau yang keruh waktu kita bersama seakan berhenti kehangatan bibirmu yang mungil...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahGiveItem_Finished_004
Array.english: In the silent water your faint heartbeat reaches me through your lips...
Array.indonesia: Di air yang sunyi detak jantungmu yang samar mencapainya padaku melalui bibirmu...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahGiveItem_Finished_005
Array.english: Hehe, it just came to me, so I said it out loud.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, itu tiba-tiba terlintas di benakku, jadi aku mengucapkannya dengan lantang.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahGiveItem_Finished_006
Array.english: Wow, that was a beautiful poem.\nYou've got real talent!
Array.indonesia: Wow, itu puisi yang indah.\nKamu benar-benar berbakat!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahGiveItem_Finished_007
Array.english: But I heard when Kissing Gouramis "kiss," it's actually a territorial fight.
Array.indonesia: Tapi aku dengar saat Ikan Gourami "berciuman", sebenarnya itu adalah pertarungan teritorial.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahGiveItem_Finished_008
Array.english: <size=33>Ah... did you have to say that...?\nYou just ruined the mood.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ah... apa kamu harus bilang begitu...?\nKamu baru saja merusak suasana.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahGiveItem_Finished_009
Array.english: Anyway, thanks.\nHere, take this as a small gift from me.
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun, terima kasih.\nIni, terimalah ini sebagai hadiah kecil dariku.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahGiveItem_NeedMore_001
Array.english: Here you are.
Array.indonesia: Ini untukmu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahGiveItem_NeedMore_002
Array.english: Oh... um... this is just one... I need a pair of <color=#F1DC2B>Kissing Gourami</color>s.
Array.indonesia: Oh... um... ini cuma satu... Aku butuh sepasang <color=#F1DC2B>Gourami Berciuman</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahGiveItem_NeedMore_003
Array.english: <size=33>You're right. I got the number wrong.\nI'll look for more.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kamu benar. Aku salah menghitung jumlahnya.\nAku akan cari lagi.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahGiveItem_NoItem_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... I must have mistaken it for something else. I'll look again.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... Pasti aku salah mengira itu sesuatu yang lain. Aku akan mencari lagi.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahRefuseGiveItem_001
Array.english: <size=33>Not yet.\nI think I need a bit more time.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Belum.\nSepertinya aku butuh sedikit waktu lagi.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_09_MeilanStart_001
Array.english: Excuse me... young traveler.
Array.indonesia: Maaf... pelancong muda.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_09_MeilanStart_002
Array.english: Yes? What is it?
Array.indonesia: Ya? Ada apa?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_09_MeilanStart_003
Array.english: If it's not too much trouble... could you do this old woman a small favor?
Array.indonesia: Kalau tidak merepotkan... bisakah kamu membantu wanita tua ini dengan hal kecil?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_09_MeilanStart_004
Array.english: There's a flower called the <color=#F1DC2B>Evening Primrose</color> that only blooms at night... but my eyesight isn't what it used to be, so it's hard for me to go out after dark.
Array.indonesia: Ada bunga bernama <color=#F1DC2B>Evening Primrose</color> yang hanya mekar di malam hari... tapi penglihatan saya sudah tidak sebaik dulu, jadi sulit bagi saya untuk keluar setelah gelap.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_09_MeilanStart_005
Array.english: Of course, I'll pick some if I come across them.\nWhat color are they?
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja, saya akan memetiknya jika kebetulan menemukannya.\nWarnanya apa?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_09_MeilanStart_006
Array.english: Thank you. There are two types of evening primroses, pink and yellow... If you don't mind, I'd be grateful if you could bring me <color=#1DFEAF>three of each</color>.
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih. Ada dua jenis evening primrose, yaitu yang berwarna merah muda dan kuning... Jika kamu tidak keberatan, aku akan sangat berterima kasih jika kamu bisa membawakan aku <color=#1DFEAF>masing-masing tiga</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_09_MeilanStart_007
Array.english: Got it. I'll look for the <color=#F1DC2B>Pink and Yellow Evening Primroses</color>.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah. Aku akan mencari <color=#F1DC2B>Evening Primrose Merah Muda dan Kuning</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_09_MeilanDelivery_001
Array.english: Oh... you brought me <color=#F1DC2B>Evening Primroses</color>?
Array.indonesia: Oh... kamu membawakan aku <color=#F1DC2B>bunga evening primrose</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_09_MeilanDelivery_Option01
Array.english: I got them
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah mendapatkannya

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_09_MeilanDelivery_Option02
Array.english: Not yet...
Array.indonesia: Belum...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_09_MeilanGiveItem_Finished_001
Array.english: Yes. Here are the <color=#F1DC2B>Evening Primroses</color> I gathered for you.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Ini <color=#F1DC2B>bunga evening primrose</color> yang aku petik untukmu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_09_MeilanGiveItem_Finished_002
Array.english: Oh my... they're truly beautiful... I've never been able to see them bloom like this during the day...
Array.indonesia: Astaga... bunga-bunga ini benar-benar indah... Aku belum pernah bisa melihatnya mekar seperti ini di siang hari...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_09_MeilanGiveItem_Finished_003
Array.english: Thanks to you, young man, I can finally see them this way. Thank you.
Array.indonesia: Berkat kamu, Nak, akhirnya aku bisa melihatnya seperti ini. Terima kasih.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_09_MeilanGiveItem_Finished_004
Array.english: Hehe, it's nothing. Just let me know if you need anything else.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, nggak apa-apa. Bilang aja kalau kamu butuh yang lain.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_09_MeilanGiveItem_NeedMore_001
Array.english: I brought the <color=#F1DC2B>Evening Primroses</color> you asked for.
Array.indonesia: Aku bawa <color=#F1DC2B>Bunga Primrose Malam</color> yang kamu minta.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_09_MeilanGiveItem_NeedMore_002
Array.english:
I asked for <color=#1DFEAF>3</color> pink and <color=#1DFEAF>3</color> yellow evening primroses,
but it seems you're a bit short...
Array.indonesia:
Aku meminta <color=#1DFEAF>3</color> bunga evening primrose merah muda dan <color=#1DFEAF>3</color> kuning,
tapi sepertinya jumlahnya kurang...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_09_MeilanGiveItem_NeedMore_003
Array.english: Ah... I must have written it down wrong.\nI'll go find more.
Array.indonesia: Ah... Pasti aku salah menuliskannya.\nAku akan mencari lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_09_MeilanGiveItem_NoItem_001
Array.english: Ah... I misunderstood.\nI haven't gathered them yet.
Array.indonesia: Ah... Saya salah paham.\nSaya belum memetiknya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_09_MeilanGiveItem_NoItem_002
Array.english: I'll keep looking.
Array.indonesia: Saya akan terus mencari.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_09_MeilanRefuseGiveItem_001
Array.english: I think I need a bit more time... I'll come back once I have them.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya saya butuh sedikit waktu lagi... Saya akan kembali setelah mendapatkannya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaStart_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh no... what should I do...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh tidak... apa yang harus saya lakukan...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaStart_002
Array.english: Hmm? What's wrong?
Array.indonesia: Hmm? Ada apa?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaStart_003
Array.english: Ah... I was doing the dishes and stepped away for a moment when I heard the kids...
Array.indonesia: Ah... Aku sedang mencuci piring dan menjauh sejenak saat mendengar suara anak-anak...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaStart_004
Array.english: And a few of my dishes got swept away by the current...
Array.indonesia: Dan beberapa piringku terbawa arus...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaStart_005
Array.english: Luckily, I found most of them... but I can't find my favorite <color=#F1DC2B>Floral Plate</color>...
Array.indonesia: Untungnya, aku menemukan sebagian besar... tapi aku tidak bisa menemukan <color=#F1DC2B>Piring Bunga</color> favoritku...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaStart_006
Array.english: My mother gave it to me as a wedding gift...
Array.indonesia: Ibuku memberikannya kepadaku sebagai hadiah pernikahan...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaStart_007
Array.english: I see...
Array.indonesia: Begitu...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaStart_008
Array.english: <size=32>If it fell into the lake, I can look for it next time I go in.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kalau jatuh ke danau, aku bisa mencarinya lain kali saat aku ke sana.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaStart_009
Array.english: Oh, really? I heard you're a good swimmer, so I was thinking of asking you...
Array.indonesia: Oh, beneran? Aku dengar kamu jago berenang, jadi aku mau minta tolong...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaStart_010
Array.english: Thank you so much for offering first.
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih banyak sudah menawarkan diri duluan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaStart_011
Array.english: <size=32>Don't worry! I'm sure I can find it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Jangan khawatir! Aku yakin bisa menemukannya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaFindPlate_001
Array.english: Hmm? That plate looks like the <color=#F1DC2B>Floral Plate</color> Omila mentioned...
Array.indonesia: Hmm? Piring itu mirip dengan <color=#F1DC2B>Piring Bunga</color> yang disebutkan Omila...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaFindPlate_002
Array.english: <size=34>I should take it with me!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku harus membawanya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaDelivery_001
Array.english: Did you... manage to find the <color=#F1DC2B>Floral Plate</color>?
Array.indonesia: Apa kamu... sudah berhasil menemukan <color=#F1DC2B>Piring Bunga</color> itu?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaDelivery_Option01
Array.english: I brought it
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah membawanya

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaDelivery_Option02
Array.english: Not yet...
Array.indonesia: Belum...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaGiveItem_Finished_001
Array.english: Could this be the <color=#F1DC2B>Floral Plate</color> you mentioned?
Array.indonesia: Mungkinkah ini <color=#F1DC2B>Piring Bunga</color> yang kamu sebutkan?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaGiveItem_Finished_002
Array.english: <size=34>Oh my! You really found it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Astaga! Kamu benar-benar menemukannya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaGiveItem_Finished_003
Array.english: Thank you so much...\nI don't know how to repay you.
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih banyak...\nAku tidak tahu bagaimana cara membalas kebaikanmu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaGiveItem_Finished_004
Array.english: Oh, now that I think about it, you're grilling skewers at your shop, right?
Array.indonesia: Oh, sekarang aku ingat, kamu memanggang sate di tokomu, kan?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaGiveItem_Finished_005
Array.english: Yeah. It's a bit of a hassle, with all the smoke and how long it takes.
Array.indonesia: Iya. Agak merepotkan sih, soalnya asapnya banyak dan butuh waktu lama.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaGiveItem_Finished_006
Array.english: Hehe, why don't you try using this <color=#F1DC2B>Fan</color>?
Array.indonesia: Hehe, kenapa kamu nggak coba pakai <color=#F1DC2B>Kipas</color> ini?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaGiveItem_Finished_007
Array.english: I used to use it when cooking for the kids...\nFanning the flames helps things cook faster.
Array.indonesia: Dulu aku sering menggunakannya saat memasak untuk anak-anak...\nMengipasi api membantu makanan matang lebih cepat.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaGiveItem_Finished_008
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... this would be perfect for grilling skewers!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... ini pasti cocok banget buat memanggang sate!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaGiveItem_Finished_009
Array.english: <size=35>I'll put it to good use. Thanks!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Aku akan memanfaatkannya dengan baik. Terima kasih!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaGiveItem_NoItem_001
Array.english: Oh, my mistake. I'll look for it again.
Array.indonesia: Oh, maaf, salahku. Aku akan mencarinya lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaRefuseGiveItem_001
Array.english: Not yet...\nI'll keep looking a bit longer.
Array.indonesia: Belum...\nAku akan terus mencari sebentar lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaStart_001
Array.english: Ah, um... by any chance...
Array.indonesia: Ah, um... kebetulan...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaStart_002
Array.english: What is it?
Array.indonesia: Ada apa?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaStart_003
Array.english: If you have a moment, could you do me a favor?
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu punya waktu, bisakah kamu membantuku?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaStart_004
Array.english: Of course. Go ahead.
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja. Silakan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaStart_005
Array.english: My son, <color=#F1DC2B>Jaka</color>, spends all day playing his instrument...\nand his meals are completely irregular.
Array.indonesia: Anakku, <color=#F1DC2B>Jaka</color>, menghabiskan sepanjang hari bermain alat musiknya...\ndan jadwal makannya benar-benar tidak teratur.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaStart_006
Array.english: A while ago, he got mouth sores and could barely speak...
Array.indonesia: Beberapa waktu lalu, dia mengalami sariawan dan hampir tidak bisa bicara...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaStart_007
Array.english: So I want to at least give him some fruit...\nbut he gets irritated if I interrupt his practice.
Array.indonesia: Jadi, aku ingin setidaknya memberinya buah...\ntapi dia jadi kesal kalau aku mengganggu latihannya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaStart_008
Array.english: It's a delicate age.
Array.indonesia: Ini masa-masa yang sensitif.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaStart_009
Array.english: <size=33>Fortunately, he absolutely loves a fruit called <color=#F1DC2B>Starfruit</color>...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Untungnya, dia sangat menyukai buah yang disebut <color=#F1DC2B>Starfruit</color>...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaStart_010
Array.english: He says it's the perfect fruit for a future star like himself, or something like that...
Array.indonesia: Dia bilang itu buah yang sempurna untuk bintang masa depan seperti dirinya, atau semacam itu...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaStart_011
Array.english: <size=32>The problem is, I've run out of the ones I saved…\nso I'm sorry to ask, but could you get some for me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Masalahnya, persediaan yang aku simpan sudah habis…\njadi maaf ya, bisakah kamu membelikannya untukku?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaStart_012
Array.english: Alright, got it.\nWhere can I find them?
Array.indonesia: Oke, paham.\nDi mana aku bisa menemukannya?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaStart_013
Array.english: Ah, they grow near the <color=#1DFEAF>Lake Beach</color>.
Array.indonesia: Ah, buah itu tumbuh di dekat <color=#1DFEAF>Pantai Danau</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaStart_014
Array.english: Oh, you mean where that dinosaur carcass washed ashore.
Array.indonesia: Oh, maksudmu di tempat bangkai dinosaurus itu terdampar.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaStart_015
Array.english: Alright. I'll see what I can find!
Array.indonesia: Baiklah. Aku akan coba cari!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaStart_016
Array.english: Thank you...\nIn that case, could I ask for about <color=#1DFEAF>4</color>?
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih...\nKalau begitu, bisakah aku minta sekitar <color=#1DFEAF>4</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaDelivery_001
Array.english: <size=32>Did you... manage to get the <color=#F1DC2B>Starfruit</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Apakah kamu... sudah berhasil mendapatkan <color=#F1DC2B>Starfruit</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaDelivery_Option01
Array.english: Yes, here you go
Array.indonesia: Ya, ini dia

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaDelivery_Option02
Array.english: Not yet
Array.indonesia: Belum

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaGiveItem01_001
Array.english: Here are the <color=#F1DC2B>Starfruits</color>.
Array.indonesia: Ini <color=#F1DC2B>Starfruit</color>-nya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaGiveItem01_002
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... you really brought them...\nYou must be busy... thank you so much...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... kamu benar-benar membawakannya...\nKamu pasti sibuk... terima kasih banyak...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaGiveItem01_003
Array.english: ...I'm sorry to keep asking for favors...
Array.indonesia: ...Maaf ya, aku terus-terusan meminta bantuan...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaGiveItem01_004
Array.english: Jaka gets a bit embarrassed when his mother gives him things...
Array.indonesia: Jaka merasa sedikit malu ketika ibunya memberinya sesuatu...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaGiveItem01_005
Array.english: Could you please give these to <color=#F1DC2B>Jaka</color> for me...?
Array.indonesia: Bisakah kamu memberikan ini kepada <color=#F1DC2B>Jaka</color> untukku...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaGiveItem01_006
Array.english: It's no trouble at all.\nLeave it to me.
Array.indonesia: Tidak merepotkan sama sekali.\nSerahkan saja padaku.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaGiveItem01_007
Array.english: Thank you. Please wait just a moment.\nLet me slice them so they're easier to eat.
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih. Tunggu sebentar ya.\nAku potong dulu biar lebih mudah dimakan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaGiveItem02_001
Array.english: <size=32>Here, please give him this.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ini, tolong berikan ini padanya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaGiveItem02_002
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... they really are star-shaped, huh?\nThat's amazing.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... benar-benar berbentuk bintang, ya?\nLuar biasa.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaGiveItem02_003
Array.english: Hehe, he's still just a kid, thinking eating star-shaped fruit will make him a star.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, dia masih anak-anak, mengira makan buah berbentuk bintang akan membuatnya jadi bintang.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaGiveItem02_004
Array.english: I see. I'll make sure he gets them, so don't worry too much, Cinta.
Array.indonesia: Begitu ya. Aku akan pastikan dia mendapatkannya, jadi jangan terlalu khawatir, Cinta.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaGiveItem02_005
Array.english: Thank you...
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaGiveItem_NoItem_001
Array.english: Oh, my mistake. I'll look for it again.
Array.indonesia: Oh, maaf. Aku akan mencarinya lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaRefuseGiveItem_001
Array.english: Not yet...\nI'll keep looking a bit longer.
Array.indonesia: Belum...\nAku akan terus mencari sebentar lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_JakaGetGift_001
Array.english: Drifting away~ more and more each day~♪\nLike a binturong wandering the forest~♪
Array.indonesia: Semakin menjauh~ setiap hari~♪\nSeperti binturong yang berkelana di hutan~♪

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_JakaGetGift_002
Array.english: Uh...
Array.indonesia: Uh...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_JakaGetGift_003
Array.english: Ahh... interrupting me again... \nI was just getting to the best part...
Array.indonesia: Ahh... mengganggu aku lagi... \nAku baru saja sampai di bagian terbaiknya...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_JakaGetGift_004
Array.english: Ah... sorry.\nBut I have something for you.
Array.indonesia: Ah... maaf.\nTapi aku punya sesuatu untukmu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_JakaGetGift_005
Array.english: <size=34>Hm? What is it?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hm? Apa itu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_JakaGetGift_006
Array.english: <size=33>Here... your mom asked me to bring you <color=#FF73C3>Starfruit</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ini... ibumu minta aku membawakanmu <color=#FF73C3>buah belimbing</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_JakaGetGift_007
Array.english: <size=33>Ooh...! My favorite...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ooh...! Favoritku...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_JakaGetGift_008
Array.english: Ahem... just leave it there. I'll eat it when I feel like it.
Array.indonesia: Ahem... taruh saja di sana. Aku akan memakannya nanti kalau sudah pengen.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_JakaGetGift_009
Array.english: Okay. Make sure you thank your mom later.
Array.indonesia: Oke. Pastikan kamu berterima kasih ke ibumu nanti.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_JakaGetGift_010
Array.english: <size=33>I-I'll do it when I feel like it!\nRespect my freedom!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>A-Aku akan melakukannya nanti kalau sudah pengen!\nHormati kebebasanku!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_JakaGetGiftComplete_001
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(I should tell her Jaka liked it to put her mind at ease.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Aku harus bilang ke dia kalau Jaka suka, biar dia tenang.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_JakaGetGiftComplete_002
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Let's go tell <color=#F1DC2B>Cinta</color>.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Ayo kita bilang ke <color=#F1DC2B>Cinta</color>.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_GoBackCinta_001
Array.english: I just gave Jaka the <color=#F1DC2B>Starfruit</color>.
Array.indonesia: Aku baru saja kasih Jaka <color=#F1DC2B>belimbing</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_GoBackCinta_002
Array.english: <size=33>Ah... thank you.\nDid Jaka like it?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ah... terima kasih.\nApakah Jaka menyukainya?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_GoBackCinta_003
Array.english: Yeah. He clearly liked it, just tried to hide it.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Dia jelas menyukainya, hanya saja berusaha menyembunyikannya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_GoBackCinta_004
Array.english: I told him to thank his mother.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah menyuruhnya mengucapkan terima kasih kepada ibunya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_GoBackCinta_005
Array.english: Hehe... I can't picture him actually doing that.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... Aku tidak bisa membayangkan dia benar-benar melakukannya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_GoBackCinta_006
Array.english: Anyway, thank you for taking care of such a troublesome request.
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun, terima kasih sudah mengurus permintaan yang merepotkan ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_GoBackCinta_007
Array.english: This is just a small token of my appreciation...\nplease take it.
Array.indonesia: Ini cuma sedikit tanda terima kasihku...\nsilakan ambil.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_GoBackCinta_008
Array.english: Oh... it was nothing, really.\nI'll make good use of it.
Array.indonesia: Oh... nggak apa-apa, sungguh.\nAku bakal memanfaatkannya dengan baik.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaStart_001
Array.english: Geez... where am I supposed to get that...
Array.indonesia: Astaga... di mana aku harus mendapatkannya...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaStart_002
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, outsider! Think you can help me out?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, orang luar! Bisakah kamu membantuku?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaStart_003
Array.english: Wh-what's going on?
Array.indonesia: A-ada apa ini?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaStart_004
Array.english: Well... I went to the village nearby a while back and lost at gambling...
Array.indonesia: Nah... Beberapa waktu lalu aku pergi ke desa terdekat dan kalah judi...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaStart_005
Array.english: I pretended to be drunk and slipped out.
Array.indonesia: Aku pura-pura mabuk dan kabur diam-diam.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaStart_006
Array.english: But now those guys from that village are suddenly coming over...
Array.indonesia: Tapi sekarang orang-orang dari desa itu tiba-tiba datang...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaStart_007
Array.english: I need to pay off the debt... but I don't have anything on me right now...
Array.indonesia: Aku harus melunasi utang... tapi aku nggak punya apa-apa di saku sekarang...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaStart_008
Array.english: Guess it's fate we ran into each other. Help me out, pal...
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya ini takdir kita bisa bertemu. Tolong bantu aku, sobat...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaStart_009
Array.english: Hmm... what do you need?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... apa yang kamu butuhkan?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaStart_010
Array.english: First, I need something valuable...\nOh, right! Could you grab some <color=#F1DC2B>Amber</color> from the lake?
Array.indonesia: Pertama, aku butuh sesuatu yang berharga...\nOh, iya! Bisakah kamu mengambil <color=#F1DC2B>Amber</color> dari danau?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaStart_011
Array.english: I heard it's highly valued over there.
Array.indonesia: Aku dengar benda itu sangat berharga di sana.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaStart_012
Array.english: Isn't amber made from tree resin? Why would it be in the lake?
Array.indonesia: Bukankah ambar terbuat dari getah pohon? Kenapa bisa ada di danau?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaStart_013
Array.english: You might've heard, this area used to be land in ancient times.
Array.indonesia: Mungkin kamu sudah dengar, daerah ini dulunya adalah daratan pada zaman purba.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaStart_014
Array.english: Then the water level rose and everything got submerged.\nThe amber's probably from back then.
Array.indonesia: Lalu permukaan air naik dan semuanya terendam.\nAmbar itu mungkin berasal dari masa itu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaStart_015
Array.english: Then it must be pretty valuable. Alright, I'll keep an eye out.
Array.indonesia: Kalau begitu, pasti harganya lumayan mahal. Oke, aku akan perhatikan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaStart_016
Array.english: Hehe... thanks a lot.\nYou're saving my life here.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... terima kasih banyak.\nKamu benar-benar menyelamatkanku.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaStart_017
Array.english: ...Oh, I did the math, and I'll need about <color=#1DFEAF>3</color> to pay it off. \nI'm counting on you.
Array.indonesia: ...Oh, aku sudah menghitungnya, dan aku butuh sekitar <color=#1DFEAF>3</color> untuk melunasinya. \nAku mengandalkanmu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaStart_018
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(What a hopeless guy...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Dasar cowok yang nggak ada harapan...)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaDelivery_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, hey! Did you get the <color=#F1DC2B>Amber</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, hei! Apa kamu sudah dapat <color=#F1DC2B>Amber</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaDelivery_Option01
Array.english: I brought it
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah membawanya

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaDelivery_Option02
Array.english: Not yet...
Array.indonesia: Belum...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Finished_001
Array.english: Here are the 3 <color=#F1DC2B>Ambers</color> you asked for.
Array.indonesia: Ini 3 <color=#F1DC2B>Amber</color> yang kamu minta.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Finished_002
Array.english: <size=33>Ooh! That's exactly it!\nNice work, thanks!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wah! Itu dia!\nBagus banget, makasih!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_001
Array.english: <size=35>Hey, Harta! Got the Doni ready?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Hei, Harta! Doni sudah siap?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_002
Array.english: Good grief... can't believe you don't trust me.\nThese three <color=#F1DC2B>Ambers</color> should be more than enough.
Array.indonesia: Astaga... nggak nyangka kamu nggak percaya sama aku.\nTiga <color=#F1DC2B>Ambers</color> ini seharusnya lebih dari cukup.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_003
Array.english: Ha! This covers the debt, but...
Array.indonesia: Ha! Ini cukup buat melunasi utang, tapi...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_004
Array.english: <size=35>You still owe interest, don't you?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Kamu masih punya utang bunga, kan?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_005
Array.english: What? It's only been three days and you're already talking interest? That's too much.
Array.indonesia: Apa? Baru tiga hari dan kamu sudah bicara soal bunga? Itu keterlaluan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_006
Array.english: If you don't have the money, just hand over some of this stuff. Like these animal blocks... and those liquor bottles...
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu nggak punya uang, serahkan saja beberapa barang ini. Seperti balok-balok hewan ini... dan botol-botol minuman keras itu...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_007
Array.english: <size=32>That's unreasonable!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Itu nggak masuk akal!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_008
Array.english: <size=33>What's this? Who's this guy that looks like a coconut liquor bottle?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Apa ini? Siapa orang ini yang mirip botol minuman keras kelapa?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_009
Array.english: <size=34>If you're that upset, how about a game? Win, and I'll let it slide.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kalau kamu sebegitu kesalnya, bagaimana kalau main game? Kalau menang, aku akan memaafkanmu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_010
Array.english: <size=32>It's simple. Just find the cup with the amber under it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Caranya sederhana. Cari saja cangkir yang di bawahnya ada batu amber.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_011
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Huh? Isn't this the same game I played in the Sea People Village...?)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hah? Bukankah ini permainan yang sama yang aku mainkan di Desa Suku Laut...?)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_012
Array.english: <size=35>Alright! Let's do it.\nIf I win, you'll clear Harta's debt, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Baiklah! Ayo kita main.\nKalau aku menang, kamu akan melunasi utang Harta, kan?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_013
Array.english: <size=32>Haha, you've got guts! Let's see what you've got.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha, kamu berani sekali! Ayo lihat kemampuanmu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_1st lose_001
Array.english: <size=34>Haha! That one doesn't count, just a warm-up!\nNow let's do it for real!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Haha! Yang tadi nggak dihitung, cuma pemanasan!\nSekarang ayo main yang beneran!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_win_1st_001
Array.english: <size=32>Tch, not bad...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tch, lumayan...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_win_1st_002
Array.english: <size=33>Hey hey! Move over, Nagzu.\nI'm good at this.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hei hei! Mundur sedikit, Nagzu.\nAku jago dalam hal ini.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_win_1st_003
Array.english: <size=32>Haha, that's right! Kiyu.\nGo on, show them.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha, benar sekali! Kiyu.\nAyo, tunjukkan pada mereka.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_2nd_lose_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh dear... did I mix them too fast...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Astaga... apa aku mencampurnya terlalu cepat...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_2nd_lose_002
Array.english: <size=32>Looks like I went a bit too easy on a beginner, hehe.\nI'll give you another chance.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Sepertinya aku terlalu memanjakan pemula ini, hehe.\nAku akan memberimu kesempatan lagi.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_win_2nd_001
Array.english: <size=34>Ooh! Outsider! Nice job!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wah! Outsider! Kerja bagus!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_win_2nd_002
Array.english: <size=33>Ugh... you're pretty good...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ugh... kamu lumayan jago...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_win_2nd_003
Array.english: <size=35>Tsk... that's enough Kiyu, Nagzu.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ck... sudah cukup, Kiyu, Nagzu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_win_2nd_004
Array.english: <size=32>We'll call it here, Harta.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kita akhiri di sini saja, Harta.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_win_2nd_005
Array.english: <size=32>I'll count today's fun as payment.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku akan anggap keseruan hari ini sebagai pembayarannya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_win_2nd_006
Array.english: <size=33>Next time, pay up on time!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Lain kali, bayar tepat waktu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_win_2nd_007
Array.english: <size=32>Or win!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Atau menang!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_win_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh, outsider! Nice job!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh, pendatang baru! Kerja bagus!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_win_002
Array.english: <size=32>Ah... I really underestimated you...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ah... Aku benar-benar meremehkanmu...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_win_003
Array.english: <size=32>Well... a deal's a deal... I'll just take this amber. I'll waive the interest.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Yah... janji adalah janji... Aku hanya akan mengambil amber ini. Aku akan membebaskan bunganya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_win_004
Array.english: <size=33>Next time, play fair and square!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Lain kali, mainlah dengan jujur dan adil!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Finished02_001
Array.english: Phew... that took years off my life.
Array.indonesia: Fiuh... itu membuat umurku berkurang beberapa tahun.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Finished02_002
Array.english: Don't make bets like that again...
Array.indonesia: Jangan bertaruh seperti itu lagi...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Finished02_003
Array.english: Haha! I was a bit tipsy that day...!
Array.indonesia: Haha! Aku agak mabuk hari itu...!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Finished02_004
Array.english: Anyway, thanks outsider. Here, take this as a small token of my gratitude.
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun, terima kasih, orang luar. Ini, ambil ini sebagai tanda terima kasihku.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_NeedMore_001
Array.english: Here you go.
Array.indonesia: Ini dia.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_NeedMore_002
Array.english: Hmm... didn't I say I needed 3 <color=#F1DC2B>Ambers</color>?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... bukankah aku bilang aku butuh 3 <color=#F1DC2B>Amber</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_NeedMore_003
Array.english: I'll need more.
Array.indonesia: Aku butuh lebih banyak.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_NoItem_001
Array.english: Oh, my mistake. I'll look again.
Array.indonesia: Oh, maaf. Aku akan cari lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaRefuseGiveItem_001
Array.english: Not yet... I'll look a bit more.
Array.indonesia: Belum... Aku akan cari sebentar lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_ChandraStart_001
Array.english: <size=33>No... where on earth is he going at this hour...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tidak... ke mana sih dia pergi pada jam segini...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_ChandraStart_002
Array.english: What's wrong?
Array.indonesia: Ada apa?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_ChandraStart_003
Array.english: Well... my husband Gesang keeps sneaking off somewhere every night.
Array.indonesia: Nah... suamiku, Gesang, terus-terusan menyelinap ke suatu tempat setiap malam.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_ChandraStart_004
Array.english: I'm worried... what if he's seeing another woman behind my back...? Oh... no... it couldn't be... that girl Lipah...?
Array.indonesia: Aku khawatir... bagaimana kalau dia selingkuh di belakangku...? Oh... tidak... tidak mungkin... gadis bernama Lipah itu...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_ChandraStart_005
Array.english: Hmm. Have you tried asking him directly?
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Sudah coba tanya langsung padanya?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_ChandraStart_006
Array.english: <size=32>If I ask, he'll get scared and stop! Then I'll never find out the real reason!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kalau aku tanya, dia pasti takut dan berhenti! Lalu aku nggak akan pernah tahu alasan sebenarnya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_ChandraStart_007
Array.english: He seemed pretty close with Harta...\nMaybe Harta knows something?
Array.indonesia: Dia kelihatannya cukup dekat dengan Harta...\nMungkin Harta tahu sesuatu?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_ChandraStart_008
Array.english: That's possible.\nBut he wouldn't tell me even if I asked.
Array.indonesia: Bisa jadi.\nTapi dia nggak akan ngasih tahu aku meski aku tanya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_ChandraStart_009
Array.english: The other day, it was raining and he ran off without even folding the laundry, so I went looking for him and found him making a bet with Harta!
Array.indonesia: Beberapa hari yang lalu, saat hujan, dia kabur tanpa melipat cucian, jadi aku mencarinya dan mendapati dia sedang bertaruh dengan Harta!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_ChandraStart_010
Array.english: I dragged him straight back... but Harta was furious since he was about to win.
Array.indonesia: Aku langsung menyeretnya pulang... tapi Harta marah besar karena dia hampir menang.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_ChandraStart_011
Array.english: <size=33>Right, you should ask Harta for me.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Benar, kamu sebaiknya tanya Harta untukku.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_ChandraStart_012
Array.english: <size=33>Huh? Me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hah? Aku?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_ChandraStart_013
Array.english: <size=31>Yes. I saw you two playing that Animal Block Stacking together, so you must be close...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Iya. Aku lihat kalian berdua main Animal Block Stacking bareng, jadi pasti kalian dekat...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_ChandraStart_014
Array.english: <size=33>Just ask him casually!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tanya aja dia dengan santai!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_ChandraStart_015
Array.english: Ugh... I really don't want to get dragged into this...
Array.indonesia: Ugh... Aku benar-benar tidak mau terseret ke dalam masalah ini...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_ChandraStart_016
Array.english: ...Alright, fine. I'll ask him.
Array.indonesia: ...Baiklah, terserah. Aku akan menanyakannya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideHartaTalk_001
Array.english: Do you... happen to know where Gesang goes at night?
Array.indonesia: Apa kamu... kebetulan tahu ke mana Gesang pergi di malam hari?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideHartaTalk_002
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, did Chandra put you up to this...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, apa Chandra yang menyuruhmu melakukan ini...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideHartaTalk_003
Array.english: Yeah... I don't like getting mixed up in other people's business either... but she was pretty intense about it.
Array.indonesia: Ya... Aku juga nggak suka ikut campur urusan orang lain... tapi dia lumayan ngotot soal itu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideHartaTalk_004
Array.english: <size=34>I really don't know...!\nI swear I'm not covering for him...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku beneran nggak tahu...!\nAku bersumpah aku nggak membelanya...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideHartaTalk_005
Array.english: <size=34>...You know something, don't you?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>...Youu tahu sesuatu, kan?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideHartaTalk_006
Array.english: No... well... we made a bet the other day...
Array.indonesia: Nggak... eh... kita bertaruh beberapa hari yang lalu...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideHartaTalk_007
Array.english: <size=32>...and I lost. By a hair, I tell ya!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>...and Aku kalah. Tipis banget, deh!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideHartaTalk_008
Array.english: But I didn't have any Doni left, so instead...\nI gave him a <color=#F1DC2B>Cell Phone</color> I found in the forest...
Array.indonesia: Tapi aku udah nggak punya Doni lagi, jadi sebagai gantinya...\naku kasih dia <color=#F1DC2B>ponsel</color> yang aku temuin di hutan...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideHartaTalk_009
Array.english: <size=33>Ever since then, he hasn't asked me to bet at all.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Sejak saat itu, dia sama sekali tidak pernah mengajakku bertaruh lagi.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideHartaTalk_010
Array.english: <size=33>Come to think of it...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kalau dipikir-pikir...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideHartaTalk_011
Array.english: <size=32>I think I saw him running toward <color=#1DFEAF>Surga Falls</color> at night recently!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Sepertinya aku melihatnya berlari menuju <color=#1DFEAF>Air Terjun Surga</color> pada suatu malam baru-baru ini!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideHartaTalk_012
Array.english: <size=34>Looked like something exciting was going on... I called out to him a few times from behind, but he didn't even turn around!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Sepertinya ada sesuatu yang seru sedang terjadi... Aku memanggilnya beberapa kali dari belakang, tapi dia bahkan tidak menoleh!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideHartaTalk_013
Array.english: Hmm. I see.\nI'll have to check out <color=#1DFEAF>Surga Falls</color> at night.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Begitu ya.\nAku harus mampir ke <color=#1DFEAF>Surga Falls</color> di malam hari.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideHartaTalk_014
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, but don't tell Chandra...\nCould you go check it out yourself?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, tapi jangan bilang ke Chandra...\nBisakah kamu pergi ke sana sendiri?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideHartaTalk_015
Array.english: If Chandra goes, things will get complicated...\nYou should go and persuade him to come home.
Array.indonesia: Kalau Chandra ikut, situasinya bakal jadi rumit...\nSebaiknya kamu pergi dan bujuk dia pulang.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideHartaTalk_016
Array.english: You're probably right.\nAlright. I'll go alone.
Array.indonesia: Kamu mungkin benar.\nBaiklah. Aku akan pergi sendirian.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideFoundGesang_001
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Oh... Gesang's over there.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Oh... Gesang ada di sana.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideFoundGesang_002
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Looks like he's on his phone...\nI should go talk to him.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Sepertinya dia lagi main ponsel...\nAku sebaiknya pergi ngobrol sama dia.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideFoundGesang_Barricade
Array.english: I should see what Gesang's up to.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus lihat apa yang sedang dilakukan Gesang.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideGesangMad_001
Array.english: Gesang... what are you doing out here this late?
Array.indonesia: Gesang... apa yang kamu lakukan di sini sampai larut begini?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideGesangMad_002
Array.english: <size=35>Aaaah!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Aaaah!!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideGesangMad_003
Array.english: ...Oh, it's you. I thought...
Array.indonesia: ...Oh, ternyata kamu. Aku kira...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideGesangMad_004
Array.english: Chandra's looking for you. She says you've been sneaking out every night...
Array.indonesia: Chandra sedang mencarimu. Katanya kamu sering kabur diam-diam setiap malam...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideGesangMad_005
Array.english: I think you should head back before she gets really mad.
Array.indonesia: Menurutku sebaiknya kamu pulang sebelum dia benar-benar marah.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideGesangMad_006
Array.english: <size=34>Ugh... that old hag...!!\nTrying to interrupt my time with Mita...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ugh... si nenek sihir itu...!!\nBerani-beraninya mengganggu waktuku bersama Mita...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideGesangMad_007
Array.english: <size=32>Mita... never yells at me...\nalways... just gives me a warm smile... hehe...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Mita... nggak pernah marah-marah sama aku...\nselalu... cuma ngasih senyuman hangat... hehe...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideGesangMad_008
Array.english: <size=34>She's nothing like that mean wife of mine!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Dia sama sekali nggak kayak istriku yang kejam itu!!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideGesangMad_009
Array.english: Hmm... you don't look like you're in your right mind...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... kamu kelihatannya nggak waras...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideGesangMad_010
Array.english: This isn't good...\nI should go get Chandra.
Array.indonesia: Ini nggak bagus...\nAku harus panggil Chandra.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideMitaAppear_001
Array.english: <size=35>Wait! Who do you think you are, trying to take my man away all of a sudden!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Tunggu! Kamu pikir kamu siapa, tiba-tiba mau merebut pacarku!?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideMitaAppear_002
Array.english: <size=34>Whoa... who are you?!\nWhere did you come from...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wah... siapa kamu?!\nDari mana kamu datang...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideMitaAppear_003
Array.english: <size=32>I'm <color=#E36462>Mita</color>.\nAnd I won't let you take Gesang away from me.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku <color=#E36462>Mita</color>.\nDan aku tidak akan membiarkanmu merebut Gesang dariku.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideMitaAppear_004
Array.english: <size=34>Gesang has someone waiting for him! And you don't even exist in the real world.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Gesang sudah ditunggu seseorang! Dan kamu bahkan tidak ada di dunia nyata.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideMitaAppear_005
Array.english: <size=32>Hehe... then I'll just take Gesang to my world.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehe... kalau begitu, aku akan membawa Gesang ke dunianya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideMitaAppear_006
Array.english: <size=34>Come on, Gesang! Let's go to my world together! We can be together forever...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ayo, Gesang! Mari kita pergi ke dunianya bersama-sama! Kita bisa bersama selamanya...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideFollowMita_001
Array.english: <size=35>Whoa...!? They both got sucked into the phone...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wah...!? Mereka berdua tersedot ke dalam ponsel...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideFollowMita_002
Array.english: <size=32>At this rate, Gesang won't make it back...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kalau begini terus, Gesang nggak bakal bisa balik...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideFollowMita_003
Array.english: <size=34>This looks dangerous, but...\nI have to follow them.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ini kelihatannya berbahaya, tapi...\nAku harus mengikuti mereka.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame01_Start_001
Array.english: <size=33>Whoa...? Where am I...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wah...? Di mana aku...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame01_Start_002
Array.english: Dave...? What are you doing here?
Array.indonesia: Dave...? Apa yang kamu lakukan di sini?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame01_Start_003
Array.english: <size=33><color=#E36462>You promised to play a game with me, <color=#E36462>Mita</color>.</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33><color=#E36462>Kamu janji mau main game bareng aku, <color=#E36462>Mita</color>.</color></size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame01_Start_004
Array.english: Huh...? What are you talking about...?
Array.indonesia: Hah...? Apa yang kamu bicarakan...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame01_Start_005
Array.english: Hah... so you don't remember...
Array.indonesia: Hah... jadi kamu tidak ingat...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame01_Start_006
Array.english: See this <color=#F1DC2B>Timer</color> in the middle?
Array.indonesia: Lihat <color=#F1DC2B>Timer</color> di tengah ini?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame01_Start_007
Array.english: It's a game where we see who hits the <color=#F1DC2B>Timer</color> first when it reaches 0!
Array.indonesia: Ini permainan di mana kita lihat siapa yang menekan <color=#F1DC2B>Timer</color> lebih dulu saat angkanya mencapai 0!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame01_Start_008
Array.english: If you miss the timing... or press it when a skull appears...
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu ketinggalan waktunya... atau menekannya saat tengkorak muncul...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame01_Start_009
Array.english: <size=33>You just smash their head with this hammer next to me!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kamu tinggal menghantam kepala mereka dengan palu yang ada di sampingku ini!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame01_Start_010
Array.english: <size=34>Smash their head with a hammer...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Menghantam kepala mereka dengan palu...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame01_Start_011
Array.english: It's fine.\nYou'll get used to it as we play.
Array.indonesia: Nggak apa-apa.\nKamu bakal terbiasa seiring kita main.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame01_Start_012
Array.english: <size=34>First to win 3 rounds takes it!\nLet's begin!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Yang pertama menang 3 ronde, dia yang menang!\nAyo mulai!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame01_Retry_001
Array.english: Hmm... need a moment to adjust?\nYou can try again.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... butuh waktu sebentar untuk menyesuaikan diri?\nKamu bisa mencoba lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame02_Start_001
Array.english: <size=34>Heh... you beat <color=#E36462>Mita</color>...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Heh... kamu mengalahkan <color=#E36462>Mita</color>...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame02_Start_002
Array.english: <size=33>...Did you really want to take Gesang away from me that badly?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...Did, kamu benar-benar ingin merebut Gesang dariku sejauh itu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame02_Start_003
Array.english: <size=35>Ugh...!! Where am I...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ugh...!! Di mana aku...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame02_Start_004
Array.english: <size=33>Oh! Gesang's coming to...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh! Gesang mulai sadar...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame02_Start_005
Array.english: <size=32>Alright... then...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Baiklah... kalau begitu...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame02_Start_006
Array.english: <size=33>If I activate that device over there, he'll get pulled back to reality!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kalau aku mengaktifkan perangkat di sana, dia akan ditarik kembali ke dunia nyata!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame02_Start_007
Array.english: <size=34>Hmph... there's no way you can solve it.\nBut go ahead and try!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hmph... mustahil kamu bisa menyelesaikannya.\nTapi silakan coba saja!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame02_Retry_001
Array.english: <size=34>Ahaha! See? I told you it wouldn't work!\nGo on, try again... it'll be the same.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ahaha! Lihat? Sudah kubilang itu tidak akan berhasil!\nAyo, coba lagi... hasilnya akan sama saja.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame03_Start_001
Array.english: <size=34>Whoa...?! Where am I?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wah...?! Di mana aku?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame03_Start_002
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, you're awake Gesang.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, kamu sudah bangun, Gesang.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame03_Start_003
Array.english: We're... inside the phone you won in that bet...
Array.indonesia: Kita... ada di dalam ponsel yang kamu menangkan dari taruhan itu...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame03_Start_004
Array.english: A girl named <color=#E36462>Mita</color>... I think she trapped you in here.
Array.indonesia: Seorang gadis bernama <color=#E36462>Mita</color>... kurasa dia yang menjebakmu di sini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame03_Start_005
Array.english: <size=32>Mi... Mita? That's the girl from the game on this phone, right...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Mi... Mita? Itu gadis dari game di ponsel ini, kan...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame03_Start_006
Array.english: <size=33>...She was so cute, I couldn't stop playing for days... hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...Sheu sangat imut, aku nggak bisa berhenti main selama berhari-hari... hehe.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame03_Start_007
Array.english: <size=35>Ge...sang... stay... here with me... forever...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ge...sang... tetaplah... di sini bersamaku... selamanya...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame03_Start_008
Array.english: <size=34>Aaaah...!? Mita...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aaaah...!? Mita...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame03_Start_009
Array.english: <size=34>Looks like some kind of system failure...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Sepertinya ada semacam kegagalan sistem...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame03_Start_010
Array.english: <size=33>There's a car over there.\nIf we want out, now's our chance! Get in!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ada mobil di sana.\nKalau kita mau keluar, sekarang saatnya! Ayo masuk!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame03_Start_011
Array.english: <size=35>I won't let you... escape...\nI'll trap you here forever...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Aku tidak akan membiarkanmu... melarikan diri...\nAku akan menjebakmu di sini selamanya. ..</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame03_Start_012
Array.english: What is going on...?
Array.indonesia: Apa yang sedang terjadi...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame03_Retry_001
Array.english: <size=32>...Gesang... is... mine... forever...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>...Gesang... adalah... milikku... selamanya...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame03_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=34>Alright! I destroyed Mita's core!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Baiklah! Aku telah menghancurkan inti Mita!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame03_Complete_002
Array.english: <size=35>Ugh...! No...!\nDon't... leave me... behind...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ugh...! Tidak...!\nJangan... tinggalkan aku... sendirian...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete01_001
Array.english: Phew... finally back to reality.
Array.indonesia: Fiuh... akhirnya kembali ke kenyataan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete01_002
Array.english: What just happened...? All I did was play a game on that phone I got from Harta...
Array.indonesia: Apa yang baru saja terjadi...? Yang kulakukan hanyalah bermain game di ponsel yang kudapat dari Harta...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete01_003
Array.english: ...You'd be in real trouble if Chandra hadn't sent me looking for you.
Array.indonesia: ... Kamu pasti dalam masalah besar kalau Chandra tidak mengirimku untuk mencarimu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete01_004
Array.english: <size=34>W-Wait, my wife sent you?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>T-Tunggu, istriku yang mengirimmu?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete01_005
Array.english: <size=33>Oh no... I'm dead...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh tidak... aku mati...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete01_006
Array.english: Um...
Array.indonesia: Um...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete01_007
Array.english: <size=35>Whoa...?! M-Mita...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wah...?! M-Mita...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete01_008
Array.english: Yes... that's my name...\nBut where am I?
Array.indonesia: Ya... itu namaku...\nTapi di mana aku?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete01_009
Array.english: Hmm...? You don't remember anything?
Array.indonesia: Hmm...? Kamu tidak ingat apa-apa?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete01_010
Array.english: No... there are many versions of Mita...\nI think you met a different one.
Array.indonesia: Tidak... ada banyak versi Mita...\nKurasa kamu bertemu dengan yang lain.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete01_011
Array.english: Hmm... if that's true, I can't really blame you...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... kalau memang begitu, aku nggak bisa menyalahkanmu...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete01_012
Array.english: I'm overwhelmed too, suddenly ending up here...\nAnd I don't know how to get back yet.
Array.indonesia: Aku juga bingung, tiba-tiba saja aku ada di sini...\nDan aku belum tahu cara pulang.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete01_013
Array.english: Um... would it be alright if I stayed in this village for a while?
Array.indonesia: Um... bolehkah aku tinggal di desa ini sebentar?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete01_014
Array.english: Well, it's not really up to me... but staying near the beach should be fine.
Array.indonesia: Yah, sebenarnya bukan aku yang memutuskan... tapi tinggal di dekat pantai seharusnya tidak masalah.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete01_015
Array.english: <size=33>Wow! Thank you!!\nIs there anything I can help with?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wah! Terima kasih!!\nAda yang bisa kubantu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete01_016
Array.english: <size=32>I can't just sit around doing nothing!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku tidak bisa hanya duduk-duduk tanpa melakukan apa-apa!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete01_017
Array.english: Oh, this guy and his friend run a restaurant.\nLooks like they could use an extra hand.
Array.indonesia: Oh, pria ini dan temannya punya restoran.\nSepertinya mereka butuh bantuan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete01_018
Array.english: <size=32>How about helping out at the restaurant?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Bagaimana kalau membantu di restoran itu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete01_019
Array.english: <size=32>Sounds great! I'm actually pretty good at cooking and serving!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kedengarannya bagus! Sebenarnya aku cukup jago memasak dan melayani tamu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete01_020
Array.english: Hmm... alright. That works.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... oke. Itu bisa.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete01_021
Array.english: <size=32>Come by the restaurant in the evening!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Mampir ke restoran nanti malam!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete02_001
Array.english: <size=33>That aside...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ngomong-ngomong...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete02_002
Array.english: <size=33>...I should go talk to Chandra, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...Iu harus ngobrol sama Chandra, kan?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete02_003
Array.english: <size=33>Hiiiieee!! Help me...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hiiiieee!! Tolong aku...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete03_001
Array.english: <size=33>...What did you say...?\nYou went to some strange world?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...What apa kamu bilang...?\nKamu pergi ke dunia aneh?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete03_002
Array.english: <size=35>If you're going to defend him, at least make it believable!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Kalau mau membelanya, setidaknya buat alasannya terdengar meyakinkan!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete03_003
Array.english: But it's true...
Array.indonesia: Tapi itu benar...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete03_004
Array.english: I can't believe that's the best excuse you could come up with... You're both pathetic.
Array.indonesia: Aku nggak percaya itu alasan terbaik yang bisa kalian pikirkan... Kalian berdua benar-benar menyedihkan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete03_005
Array.english: Honey, you're on dish duty for the rest of the month,\ngot it?!
Array.indonesia: Sayang, kamu bertugas mencuci piring sampai akhir bulan ini,\nngerti?!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete03_006
Array.english: *Sigh*... Alright... I must've been possessed or something...
Array.indonesia: *Huff*... Baiklah... Aku pasti sedang kerasukan atau semacamnya...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete03_007
Array.english: Mita suddenly started saying sweet things...
Array.indonesia: Mita tiba-tiba mulai mengucapkan kata-kata manis...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete03_008
Array.english: <size=33>Oh! Maybe we shouldn't get into that...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh! Mungkin kita sebaiknya tidak membahas itu...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete03_009
Array.english: <size=35>What was that just now...? Mi...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Tadi itu apa...? Mi...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete03_010
Array.english: Oh, I meant Harta!\nHe said Harta tricked him...!
Array.indonesia: Oh, maksudku Harta!\nDia bilang Harta menipunya...!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete03_011
Array.english: Hmm... Alright.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Baiklah.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete03_012
Array.english: Anyway, thanks for bringing him back.\nI'll deal with him myself.
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun, terima kasih sudah membawanya kembali.\nAku akan mengurusnya sendiri.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete03_013
Array.english: <size=35>...*Sniffle*...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>...*Hiks*...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_14_JacaStart_001
Array.english: In the flowing waterfall~ I let my sorrow drift away~♪
Array.indonesia: Di air terjun yang mengalir~ Aku membiarkan kesedihanku hanyut~♪

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_14_JacaStart_002
Array.english: Does the flying hornbill~ understand my heart~♪
Array.indonesia: Apakah burung rangkong yang terbang~ memahami hatiku~♪

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_14_JacaStart_003
Array.english: The blue sky...\n...Oh!
Array.indonesia: Langit biru...\n... Oh!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_14_JacaStart_004
Array.english: Ah... my pick snapped...\nGuess I got a little too into it.
