Array.indonesia: Ah... pick-ku patah...\nSepertinya aku terlalu asyik memainkannya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_14_JacaStart_005
Array.english: That was great, though... shame about the pick.
Array.indonesia: Itu hebat, sih... sayang pick-nya patah.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_14_JacaStart_006
Array.english: Oh, mister outsider... Could you get me a <color=#F1DC2B>Black Piranha Tooth</color> from the lake?
Array.indonesia: Oh, Tuan Pendatang... Bisakah kau membawakan aku <color=#F1DC2B>Gigi Piranha Hitam</color> dari danau?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_14_JacaStart_007
Array.english: It's harder than the red-bellied piranha tooth I'm using now.
Array.indonesia: Itu lebih keras daripada gigi piranha perut merah yang aku pakai sekarang.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_14_JacaStart_008
Array.english: Just one will do. Before this idea slips away...\nplease hurry.
Array.indonesia: Cukup satu saja. Sebelum ide ini hilang...\ntolong cepat.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_14_JacaDelivery_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, did you get the <color=#F1DC2B>Black Piranha Tooth</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, apakah kamu sudah mendapatkan <color=#F1DC2B>Gigi Piranha Hitam</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_14_JacaDelivery_Option01
Array.english: Yeah, I got it
Array.indonesia: Ya, sudah kudapat

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_14_JacaDelivery_Option02
Array.english: Not yet
Array.indonesia: Belum

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_14_JacaGiveItem_Finished_001
Array.english: <size=32>Here, I brought the <color=#F1DC2B>Black Piranha Tooth</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ini, aku bawa <color=#F1DC2B>Gigi Piranha Hitam</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_14_JacaGiveItem_Finished_002
Array.english: Ooh... this sharpness... this hardness... it's a work of art.
Array.indonesia: Wah... ketajamannya... kekerasannya... ini benar-benar sebuah karya seni.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_14_JacaGiveItem_Finished_003
Array.english: Thank you, hehe.
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih, hehe.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_14_JacaGiveItem_Finished_004
Array.english: <size=32>This is a <color=#F1DC2B>CD Player</color> I got from Rimbo. Take it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ini adalah <color=#F1DC2B>Pemutar CD</color> yang aku dapat dari Rimbo. Ambil saja.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_14_JacaGiveItem_Finished_005
Array.english: Oh... are you sure? \nShouldn't you keep it for listening to music?
Array.indonesia: Oh... kamu yakin? \nBukankah sebaiknya kamu menyimpannya untuk mendengarkan musik?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_14_JacaGiveItem_Finished_006
Array.english: ...Who even listens to music on CDs anymore?\nEveryone streams it now.
Array.indonesia: ...Siapa sih yang masih mendengarkan musik dari CD sekarang?\nSemua orang streaming sekarang.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_14_JacaGiveItem_Finished_007
Array.english: <size=33><color=#FF73C3>CDs</color> are just for collecting these days.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33><color=#FF73C3>CD</color> sekarang ini cuma buat koleksi aja.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_14_JacaGiveItem_Finished_008
Array.english: Uh... right.\nAnyway, thanks. I'll make good use of it.
Array.indonesia: Uh... bener juga.\nPokoknya, makasih. Aku bakal memanfaatkannya dengan baik.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_14_JacaGiveItem_NoItem_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ah... my mistake.\nI haven't gotten it yet.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ah... maaf, salah ngomong.\nAku belum dapet itu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_14_JacaRefuseGiveItem_001
Array.english: <size=33>Not yet. I'll keep looking.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Belum. Aku akan terus mencarinya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaStart_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hey, mister! That restaurant you opened there…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hei, Pak! Restoran yang kamu buka di sana…</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaStart_002
Array.english:
<size=34>The fishy smell is dreadful…
isn't that a bit inconsiderate of you?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Bau ikannya mengerikan…\bukankah itu agak tidak sopan?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaStart_003
Array.english:
Ah… I'm so sorry. 
I'll be a little more careful with how I store them.
Array.indonesia:
Ah… Maaf banget. 
Aku bakal lebih hati-hati lagi dalam menyimpannya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaStart_004
Array.english: <size=32>I'm already feeling dizzy.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku udah mulai pusing.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaStart_005
Array.english: <size=33>This fishy smell has completely killed my appetite.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Bau amis ini benar-benar bikin nafsu makanku hilang.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaStart_006
Array.english: So, why don't you…
Array.indonesia: Jadi, kenapa kamu nggak…

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaStart_007
Array.english: <size=34>Go get me some <color=#F1DC2B>Water Chestnuts</color> from the lake.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Pergi ambilkan aku <color=#F1DC2B>kacang air</color> dari danau.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaStart_008
Array.english: <size=34>They're the best for stimulating your appetite.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Itu yang paling bagus buat merangsang nafsu makan.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaStart_009
Array.english:
Since you're the one who ruined mine...
you should at least do that much.
Array.indonesia:
Karena kamu yang merusak nafsu makanku...
setidaknya kamu harus melakukan itu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaStart_010
Array.english: <color=#1DFEAF>5</color> should be enough. They probably grow on the far right side of the lake.
Array.indonesia: <color=#1DFEAF>5</color> seharusnya cukup. Mungkin tumbuh di sisi paling kanan danau.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaStart_011
Array.english: Ugh... fine.
Array.indonesia: Ugh... baiklah.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaDelivery_001
Array.english: <size=34><color=#F1DC2B>Water Chestnuts</color>... did you get them?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34><color=#F1DC2B>Kacang air</color>... sudah kamu ambil?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaDelivery_Option01
Array.english: I got them
Array.indonesia: Sudah aku ambil

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaDelivery_Option02
Array.english: Not yet...
Array.indonesia: Belum...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaGiveItem_Finished_001
Array.english: <size=33>This is it, right? <color=#F1DC2B>Water Chestnut</color>. It was hidden somewhere I almost missed.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ini dia, kan? <color=#F1DC2B>Kacang Air</color>. Ternyata tersembunyi di suatu tempat sampai hampir kulewatkan.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaGiveItem_Finished_002
Array.english: <size=35>Oh...! That's exactly it!\nJust looking at it makes me hungry!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh...! Itu dia tepatnya!\nHanya dengan melihatnya saja sudah bikin aku lapar!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaGiveItem_Finished_003
Array.english: Why on earth would anyone eat smelly fish, when you can make plenty of delicious dishes with just vegetables and meat?
Array.indonesia: Kenapa sih ada orang yang mau makan ikan bau, padahal bisa bikin banyak hidangan lezat cuma dengan sayuran dan daging?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaGiveItem_Finished_004
Array.english: For my skin's sake, I shall have chicken breast topped with blanched water chestnuts tonight.
Array.indonesia: Demi kesehatan kulitku, malam ini aku akan makan dada ayam dengan taburan kastanye air yang sudah direbus.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaGiveItem_Finished_005
Array.english:
Well… I suppose I must thank you for what you brought.
But from now on, do be a little more careful about the smell of fish.
Array.indonesia:
Yah… kurasa aku harus berterima kasih atas apa yang kamu bawa.
Tapi mulai sekarang, tolong lebih hati-hati soal bau ikannya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaGiveItem_NeedMore_001
Array.english: Here, I brought the <color=#F1DC2B>Water Chestnuts</color>.
Array.indonesia: Ini, aku bawa <color=#F1DC2B>biji kastanye air</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaGiveItem_NeedMore_002
Array.english: <size=32>Haah... I said <color=#1DFEAF>5</color>, didn't I...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haah... Aku bilang <color=#1DFEAF>5</color>, kan...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaGiveItem_NeedMore_003
Array.english: Yeah, I'm a bit short...\nI'll go find more.
Array.indonesia: Ya, aku agak kekurangan...\nAku akan cari lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaGiveItem_NoItem_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... I must've mistaken it for something else.\nI'll keep looking.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... Pasti aku salah mengira itu sesuatu yang lain.\nAku akan terus mencari.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaRefuseGiveItem_001
Array.english: <size=32>Not yet. I'll search a bit more.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Belum. Aku akan mencari sedikit lagi.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahStart_001
Array.english: I've heard people in the city are always in a rush,\nbusy all the time.
Array.indonesia: Aku dengar orang-orang di kota selalu terburu-buru,\nsibuk sepanjang waktu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahStart_002
Array.english: Hmm... not always, but yeah, it does tend to be like that.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... tidak selalu, tapi ya, memang cenderung seperti itu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahStart_003
Array.english: Living a full, busy day is nice, but... sometimes, if you slow down and look around, you notice new things.
Array.indonesia: Menjalani hari yang padat dan sibuk memang menyenangkan, tapi... terkadang, jika kamu melambat dan melihat sekeliling, kamu akan menyadari hal-hal baru.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahStart_004
Array.english: ...I'd like to write a poem about that.\nIs there anything I could use as inspiration?
Array.indonesia: ...Aku ingin menulis puisi tentang hal itu.\nAdakah sesuatu yang bisa kugunakan sebagai inspirasi?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahStart_005
Array.english: Hmm... if we're talking about something slow...\nmaybe a <color=#F1DC2B>Snail</color>?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... kalau kita bicara tentang sesuatu yang lambat...\nmungkin seekor <color=#F1DC2B>Siput</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahStart_006
Array.english: <size=32>Wow! That's a great idea! Watching a snail move slowly might really inspire me!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wah! Itu ide yang bagus! Melihat siput bergerak perlahan mungkin benar-benar bisa menginspirasiku!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahStart_007
Array.english: But <color=#F1DC2B>Snails</color> only come out when it rains... If I try to write while watching them, my notebook will get soaked.
Array.indonesia: Tapi <color=#F1DC2B>Siput</color> hanya muncul saat hujan... Kalau aku mencoba menulis sambil mengamati mereka, buku catatanku akan basah kuyup.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahStart_008
Array.english: Sorry to ask out of nowhere, but... \ncould you catch three <color=#F1DC2B>Snails</color> for me?
Array.indonesia: Maaf bertanya begitu saja, tapi... \nbisakah kamu menangkap tiga <color=#F1DC2B>Siput</color> untukku?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahStart_009
Array.english: Well, they're not dangerous...\nI'll grab some if I see them.
Array.indonesia: Yah, mereka tidak berbahaya...\nAku akan menangkap beberapa kalau aku melihatnya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahStart_010
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, thank you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, terima kasih!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahStart_011
Array.english: <color=#F1DC2B>Snails</color> only appear when it rains. You should be able to find them in grassy areas.
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Siput</color> hanya muncul saat hujan. Kamu seharusnya bisa menemukannya di area berumput.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahDelivery_001
Array.english: Oh, did you bring me the <color=#F1DC2B>Snails</color>?
Array.indonesia: Oh, apakah kamu sudah membawakan <color=#F1DC2B>Siput</color> untukku?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahDelivery_Option01
Array.english: Yes, I got them
Array.indonesia: Ya, aku sudah mendapatkannya

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahDelivery_Option02
Array.english: Not yet...
Array.indonesia: Belum...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahGiveItem_Finished_001
Array.english: Here are the three <color=#F1DC2B>Snails</color> you asked for.
Array.indonesia: Ini tiga <color=#F1DC2B>Siput</color> yang kamu minta.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahGiveItem_Finished_002
Array.english: They're so slimy.\nThe container's covered in mucus.
Array.indonesia: Mereka sangat berlendir.\nWadahnya penuh dengan lendir.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahGiveItem_Finished_003
Array.english: Hehe, I suppose it can't be helped if they want to crawl on grass and trees.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, kurasa memang tak bisa dihindari kalau mereka ingin merayap di rumput dan pohon.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahGiveItem_Finished_004
Array.english: Watching them move so slowly is already inspiring me again. Hmm...
Array.indonesia: Melihat mereka bergerak begitu lambat sudah membuatku terinspirasi lagi. Hmm...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahGiveItem_Finished_005
Array.english: O brave snails... walking across dewy blades of grass, untouched by the world's pace...
Array.indonesia: Wahai siput-siput pemberani... berjalan melintasi helai rumput yang berembun, tidak terpengaruh oleh hiruk-pikuk dunia...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahGiveItem_Finished_006
Array.english: Not even minding each other's steps, your composure is steady and upright, just like your shells.
Array.indonesia: Bahkan tak saling memperdulikan langkah satu sama lain, keteguhan kalian tetap kokoh dan tegak, persis seperti cangkang kalian.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahGiveItem_Finished_007
Array.english: ...I just said it as it came to me, so it might sound a bit awkward, hehe.
Array.indonesia: ... Aku cuma ngomong apa adanya, jadi mungkin kedengarannya agak canggung, hehe.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahGiveItem_Finished_008
Array.english: Not at all. It was really good! Coming up with a poem like that on the spot is amazing!
Array.indonesia: Nggak sama sekali. Itu bagus banget! Bisa bikin puisi kayak gitu di tempat itu luar biasa!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahGiveItem_Finished_009
Array.english: Now that I think about it, I read a book about snails once.
Array.indonesia: Kalau dipikir-pikir, aku pernah baca buku tentang siput.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahGiveItem_Finished_010
Array.english: Wow, I'm curious.\nWhat was it about?
Array.indonesia: Wah, aku penasaran.\nTentang apa bukunya?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahGiveItem_Finished_011
Array.english: Well... there was this student who only came to school on rainy days... and then a snail shell suddenly started growing on his back.
Array.indonesia: Nah... ada seorang siswa yang hanya datang ke sekolah saat hari hujan... lalu cangkang siput tiba-tiba mulai tumbuh di punggungnya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahGiveItem_Finished_012
Array.english: Then he turned into a real snail... and his friends started turning into snails too... that's the story.
Array.indonesia: Kemudian dia berubah menjadi siput sungguhan... dan teman-temannya pun mulai berubah menjadi siput juga... begitulah ceritanya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahGiveItem_Finished_013
Array.english: Hmm... yeah. I don't think that's really my kind of story.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... ya. Sepertinya cerita itu bukan jenis cerita yang aku suka.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahGiveItem_Finished_014
Array.english: Anyway, thank you! I got some great inspiration.
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun, terima kasih! Aku dapat inspirasi yang bagus.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahGiveItem_Finished_015
Array.english:
This is just a small token of my thanks.
It's a beautiful coral I found on the beach.
Array.indonesia:
Ini hanya sedikit tanda terima kasihku.
Ini karang indah yang kutemukan di pantai.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahGiveItem_NeedMore_001
Array.english: Here, I brought you the <color=#F1DC2B>Snails</color>.
Array.indonesia: Ini, aku bawakan <color=#F1DC2B>Snails</color> untukmu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahGiveItem_NeedMore_002
Array.english: Hmm... this isn't quite enough. I think I need at least three for inspiration.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... ini belum cukup. Kurasa aku butuh setidaknya tiga untuk inspirasi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahGiveItem_NeedMore_003
Array.english: <size=32>Please find a few more!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tolong cari beberapa lagi!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahGiveItem_NoItem_001
Array.english: Oh... I got it wrong.\nI'll look again.
Array.indonesia: Oh... aku salah.\nAku akan cari lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahRefuseGiveItem_001
Array.english: I haven't got them ready yet. I'll keep looking a bit longer.
Array.indonesia: Aku belum menyiapkannya. Aku akan terus mencari sebentar lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangStart_001
Array.english: <size=34>Ugh... this is bad...\nI'm gonna get in trouble...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ugh... ini buruk...\nAku bakal kena masalah...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangStart_002
Array.english: What's wrong?
Array.indonesia: Ada apa?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangStart_003
Array.english: <size=33>My wife's birthday is coming up, and I have no idea what to get her!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ulang tahun istriku sebentar lagi, dan aku nggak tahu harus kasih apa!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangStart_004
Array.english: Hmm. Maybe some jewelry or accessories?
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Mungkin perhiasan atau aksesori?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangStart_005
Array.english: She'd probably like that, but... where am I supposed to find something like that on short notice?
Array.indonesia: Dia mungkin akan suka itu, tapi... di mana aku bisa menemukan barang seperti itu dalam waktu sesingkat ini?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangStart_006
Array.english: <size=34>Oh!! Wait, I just remembered. There are <color=#F1DC2B>Freshwater Pearls</color> in the lake!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh!! Tunggu, aku baru ingat. Ada <color=#F1DC2B>Mutiara Air Tawar</color> di danau!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangStart_007
Array.english: I gave her one I won from Basu in a bet once.\nShe loved it.
Array.indonesia: Aku pernah memberinya satu yang kudapatkan dari Basu dalam sebuah taruhan.\nDia sangat menyukainya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangStart_008
Array.english: <size=33>Hey... I heard you're pretty good at diving... Could you get me some <color=#F1DC2B>Freshwater Pearls</color> from the lake?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hei... Aku dengar kamu cukup jago menyelam... Bisakah kamu ambilkan aku beberapa <color=#F1DC2B>Mutiara Air Tawar</color> dari danau itu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangStart_009
Array.english: <size=32>I think I could make something if I had about <color=#1DFEAF>3</color>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kurasa aku bisa membuat sesuatu kalau punya sekitar <color=#1DFEAF>3</color>...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangStart_010
Array.english: <size=32>Think of it as saving a man's life...\nPlease!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Anggap saja ini menyelamatkan nyawa seseorang...\nTolong!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangStart_011
Array.english: Come to think of it, yeah, there are pearls in the lake.
Array.indonesia: Kalau dipikir-pikir, ya, memang ada mutiara di danau itu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangStart_012
Array.english: Alright. I'll bring some back if I find any.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah. Aku akan membawakannya kalau aku menemukannya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangDelivery_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... did you bring me some <color=#F1DC2B>Freshwater Pearls</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... apa kamu membawakan aku <color=#F1DC2B>Mutiara Air Tawar</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangDelivery_Option01
Array.english: I got them
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah mendapatkannya

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangDelivery_Option02
Array.english: Not yet...
Array.indonesia: Belum...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangGiveItem_Finished_001
Array.english: Here, I got you 3 <color=#F1DC2B>Freshwater Pearls</color>.
Array.indonesia: Ini, aku bawakan 3 <color=#F1DC2B>Mutiara Air Tawar</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangGiveItem_Finished_002
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... thank you!! This should do it, hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... terima kasih!! Ini seharusnya cukup, hehe.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangGiveItem_Finished_003
Array.english: When my wife gets mad, it lasts a whole month...\nIt's terrifying...
Array.indonesia: Kalau istriku marah, bisa bertahan sebulan penuh...\nMenakutkan sekali...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangGiveItem_Finished_004
Array.english: <size=32>Hehe. It's not much, but here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehe. Memang tidak banyak, tapi ini.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangGiveItem_NeedMore_001
Array.english: Here you go.
Array.indonesia: Ini untukmu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangGiveItem_NeedMore_002
Array.english: Hmm... I need three...\nbut this isn't quite enough.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Aku butuh tiga...\ntapi ini belum cukup.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangGiveItem_NeedMore_003
Array.english: Ah, you're right.\nI'll go find more.
Array.indonesia: Ah, kamu benar.\nAku akan cari lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangGiveItem_NoItem_001
Array.english: Oh, I don't have it. Must've been mistaken.\nI'll come back when I get it.
Array.indonesia: Oh, aku nggak punya. Pasti salah lihat.\nAku bakal balik lagi kalau udah dapet.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangRefuseGiveItem_001
Array.english: <size=32>Haven't found them yet. I'll keep looking.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Belum ketemu juga. Aku akan terus mencari.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunStart_001
Array.english: <size=34>Ugh... my shoulder's killing me...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ugh... bahuku sakit sekali...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunStart_002
Array.english: What's wrong, Jepun?
Array.indonesia: Ada apa, Jepun?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunStart_003
Array.english: The chief asked me to plant some <color=#F1DC2B>Mangoes</color>...\nbut there's not enough space in the field.
Array.indonesia: Kepala desa menyuruhku menanam beberapa <color=#F1DC2B>mangga</color>...\ntapi tidak ada cukup ruang di ladang.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunStart_004
Array.english: I could clear some room by cutting down a coconut tree…\nbut if a coconut hits my head, I'm done for.
Array.indonesia: Aku bisa bikin ruang dengan menebang pohon kelapa…\ntapi kalau kelapa jatuh ke kepalaku, aku tamat.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunStart_005
Array.english: So I've been picking the coconuts first.\nDid it all day and now my shoulder's killing me.
Array.indonesia: Jadi, aku memetik kelapa-kelapa itu dulu.\nMelakukannya seharian dan sekarang bahuku sakit sekali.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunStart_006
Array.english: <size=32>Wish someone would give me a hand...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Andai saja ada yang mau bantuin aku...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunStart_option01
Array.english: I'll help you
Array.indonesia: Aku akan membantumu

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunStart_option02
Array.english: Sorry, can't right now
Array.indonesia: Maaf, sekarang tidak bisa

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunStart_Yes_001
Array.english: <size=32>Want me to give you a hand?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Mau aku bantu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunStart_Yes_002
Array.english: <size=34>You?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kamu?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunStart_Yes_003
Array.english: <size=33>Ha! No outsider helps for nothing!\nWhat's your angle?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ha! Tidak ada orang luar yang membantu tanpa pamrih!\nApa maksudmu?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunStart_Yes_004
Array.english: Those coconuts from your farm helped me make some great drinks for my customers.
Array.indonesia: Kelapa-kelapa dari kebunmu itu membantuku membuat minuman enak untuk pelangganku.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunStart_Yes_005
Array.english: <size=34>So I want to return the favor!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Jadi, aku ingin membalas budi!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunStart_Yes_006
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm... not sure I buy that...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm... aku ragu dengan alasan itu...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunStart_Yes_007
Array.english: <size=34>Fine... go knock a few down!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Baiklah... silakan jatuhkan beberapa!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunStart_Yes_008
Array.english: <size=32>Use this <color=#1DFEAF>Long Pole</color> to smack the coconuts a few times and they'll drop.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Gunakan <color=#1DFEAF>Tongkat Panjang</color> ini untuk memukul kelapa beberapa kali, dan kelapa-kelapa itu akan jatuh.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunStart_Yes_009
Array.english: But it'll hurt if one lands on you.
Array.indonesia: Tapi akan sakit kalau ada yang jatuh menimpa kamu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunStart_Yes_010
Array.english: <size=35>So watch it and dodge!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Jadi, hati-hati dan hindari!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunStart_No_001
Array.english: <size=34>Tsk! Useless when it actually matters!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ck! Tak berguna saat benar-benar dibutuhkan!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunStart_No_002
Array.english: <size=32>I heard they've been using my coconuts well at the shop...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kudengar kelapa-kelapaku dimanfaatkan dengan baik di toko...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunStart_No_003
Array.english: <size=33>If you want to pay me back, I'll give you another shot!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kalau kamu mau membalas budiku, aku akan memberimu kesempatan lagi!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunRetry_001
Array.english: Hmm... wish someone would help me gather coconuts...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... andai saja ada yang mau membantuku mengumpulkan kelapa...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_JepunMinigame_EasySuccess_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ha! Better than I expected!\nGo on, try the next tree!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ha! Lebih baik dari yang kuduga!\nAyo, coba pohon berikutnya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunEnd_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... already got them all?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... sudah habis semua?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunEnd_002
Array.english: Hmm... this should be enough to plant a <color=#F1DC2B>Mango</color> tree.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... ini seharusnya cukup untuk menanam pohon <color=#F1DC2B>Mangga</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunEnd_003
Array.english: The soil here is special, so anything you plant grows fast.
Array.indonesia: Tanah di sini istimewa, jadi apa pun yang kamu tanam akan tumbuh dengan cepat.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunEnd_004
Array.english: I should be able to harvest the <color=#F1DC2B>Mangoes</color> soon and send them to your shop.
Array.indonesia: Aku seharusnya bisa memanen <color=#F1DC2B>Mangga</color> segera dan mengirimkannya ke tokomu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunEnd_005
Array.english: Wow... that fast?
Array.indonesia: Wow... secepat itu?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunEnd_006
Array.english: <size=32>I'll send them over in the evening, so go wait at the shop!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku akan mengirimkannya sore nanti, jadi tunggu saja di toko!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_AfterJepun_001
Array.english: A sharp-looking farmer came by and gave me some <color=#F1DC2B>Mangoes</color>.
Array.indonesia: Seorang petani yang tampak gagah datang dan memberiku beberapa <color=#F1DC2B>Mangga</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_AfterJepun_002
Array.english: <size=33>Wow, they really do grow fast!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wah, memang tumbuh cepat sekali!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_AfterJepun_003
Array.english: He gave them to me, but what should I make with them?
Array.indonesia: Dia memberikannya kepadaku, tapi apa yang harus kubuat dengan ini?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_AfterJepun_004
Array.english: Hmm. I've only been serving coconut juice so far.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Sejauh ini aku hanya menyajikan jus kelapa.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_AfterJepun_005
Array.english: <size=32>How about we try a <color=#F1DC2B>Mango Shake</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Bagaimana kalau kita coba <color=#F1DC2B>Mango Shake</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_AfterJepun_006
Array.english: <size=33>Oh...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_AfterJepun_007
Array.english: <size=34>...Just thinking about it sounds delicious...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>...Just kalau dipikir-pikir kedengarannya enak...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_AfterJepun_008
Array.english: I'll get the equipment ready. \nI'm sure customers will start ordering right away.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan menyiapkan peralatannya. \nAku yakin pelanggan akan langsung memesan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_AfterJepun_009
Array.english: <size=33>Got it! I bet they'll love it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oke! Pasti mereka akan menyukainya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_001
Array.english: Ever seen a <color=#FF73C3>Piraiba Catfish</color>?
Array.indonesia: Pernah lihat <color=#FF73C3>Ikan Lele Piraiba</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option01
Array.english: Of course
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option02
Array.english: What kind of fish was that again...
Array.indonesia: Ikan apa sih itu...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option01Answer_001
Array.english: <size=33>Of course. It's that giant freshwater catfish, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tentu saja. Itu ikan lele air tawar raksasa, kan?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option01Answer_002
Array.english: I heard its mouth is big enough to swallow a person.
Array.indonesia: Katanya mulutnya cukup besar untuk menelan seorang manusia.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option01Answer_003
Array.english: <size=33>Why do you ask?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kenapa kamu tanya?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option01Answer_004
Array.english: Ah... I just love catfish dishes. \nBeen wantin' to catch one real bad...
Array.indonesia: Ah... Aku cuma suka masakan ikan lele. \nSudah lama banget pengen nangkep satu...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option01Answer_005
Array.english: But there's no way I can catch it with a fishing rod.
Array.indonesia: Tapi nggak mungkin aku bisa nangkepnya pakai pancing.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option01Answer_006
Array.english: Even if I hook one, it's so strong it just snaps everything.
Array.indonesia: Bahkan kalau aku berhasil memancingnya, dia sangat kuat sampai bisa putusin semua tali pancing.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option01Answer_007
Array.english:
If you run into a <color=#FF73C3>Piraiba Catfish</color> while diving,
could ya bring me some of its meat?
Array.indonesia:
Kalau kamu ketemu <color=#FF73C3>Ikan Lele Piraiba</color> saat menyelam,
cantik bawain aku sedikit dagingnya?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option01Answer_008
Array.english: I heard it's way more vicious than the Walking Catfish you asked for before...?
Array.indonesia: Aku dengar ikan itu jauh lebih ganas daripada Ikan Lele Berjalan yang kamu minta sebelumnya...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option01Answer_009
Array.english: I know, but... please, I'm beggin' ya.\nI'll make it up to ya, I swear.
Array.indonesia: Aku tahu, tapi... tolonglah, aku memohon padamu.\nAku akan membalas budimu, aku bersumpah.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option01Answer_010
Array.english: Hmm... alright.\nBut I'll need to be well-equipped.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... baiklah.\nTapi aku perlu perlengkapan yang memadai.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option02Answer_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm... I think I've seen one... but I'm not sure.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm... Kayaknya aku pernah lihat satu... tapi aku nggak yakin.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option02Answer_002
Array.english: <size=34>Haha, can't believe ya don't know that big, nasty fella... Guess jungle fish ain't your thing, huh?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Haha, nggak nyangka kamu nggak kenal makhluk besar dan menjijikkan itu... Kayaknya ikan hutan bukan kesukaanmu, ya?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option02Answer_003
Array.english: <size=32>N-No, I do!\nJust mixed up the name for a second.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>N-Nggak, aku suka!\nCuma kebingungan sebentar soal namanya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option02Answer_004
Array.english: Anyway... I love catfish dishes, so I really wanna catch one...
Array.indonesia: Ngomong-ngomong... Aku suka masakan ikan lele, jadi aku benar-benar pengen menangkap satu...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option02Answer_005
Array.english: <size=33>But there's no way I can catch it with a fishing rod.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tapi nggak mungkin aku bisa menangkapnya pakai pancing.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option02Answer_006
Array.english: Even if I hook one, it's so strong it just snaps the line.
Array.indonesia: Bahkan kalau aku berhasil mengaitkannya, dia sangat kuat sampai putus tali pancingnya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option02Answer_007
Array.english:
If you run into a <color=#FF73C3>Piraiba Catfish</color> while diving,
could ya bring me some of its meat?
Array.indonesia:
Kalau kamu ketemu <color=#FF73C3>Ikan Lele Piraiba</color> saat menyelam,
cantik bawain aku sedikit dagingnya, ya?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option02Answer_008
Array.english: <size=32>Didn't you just say it's huge and dangerous?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Bukankah kamu baru saja bilang kalau ikan itu besar dan berbahaya?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option02Answer_009
Array.english: <size=33>...Haha! With your skills, you'll be just fine!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...Haha! Dengan keahlianmu, kamu pasti bakal baik-baik saja!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option02Answer_010
Array.english: I'll make it worth your while, so please help me out.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan memberi imbalan yang sepadan, jadi tolong bantu aku.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option02Answer_011
Array.english: Hmm... alright.\nBut I'll need to be well-equipped.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... baiklah.\nTapi aku perlu perlengkapan yang memadai.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanDelivery_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, did ya manage to get some <color=#FF73C3>Piraiba Catfish</color> meat?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, apakah kamu berhasil mendapatkan daging <color=#FF73C3>Ikan Lele Piraiba</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanDelivery_Option01
Array.english: Here you go
Array.indonesia: Ini dia

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanDelivery_Option02
Array.english: Not yet...
Array.indonesia: Belum...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanGiveItem_Finished_001
Array.english: Ugh... that thing was insanely aggressive.\nIt nearly swallowed me whole.
Array.indonesia: Ugh... makhluk itu sangat agresif.\nHampir saja dia menelanku utuh.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanGiveItem_Finished_002
Array.english: <size=32>Still... I managed to get some meat.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tapi... aku berhasil mendapatkan sedikit dagingnya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanGiveItem_Finished_003
Array.english: <size=34>Oh! Thank ya!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh! Terima kasih!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanGiveItem_Finished_004
Array.english: Believe it or not, catfish meat's real tender with a nice bite.
Array.indonesia: Percaya atau tidak, daging ikan lele ini sangat empuk dengan tekstur yang pas.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanGiveItem_Finished_005
Array.english: <size=33>If I make some <color=#FF73C3>Steamed Piraiba Catfish</color> with this, it'll be pure heaven!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kalau aku masak <color=#FF73C3>Ikan Lele Piraiba Kukus</color> pakai ini, rasanya pasti surga banget!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanGiveItem_Finished_006
Array.english: Oh right, since ya helped me out, I should give ya somethin' in return.
Array.indonesia: Oh iya, karena kamu udah bantuin aku, aku harus kasih sesuatu sebagai balasannya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanGiveItem_Finished_007
Array.english: No matter how good ya are, diving at night's still dangerous.
Array.indonesia: Sehebat apa pun kamu, menyelam di malam hari tetap berbahaya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanGiveItem_Finished_008
Array.english: <size=33>Here, take this <color=#F1DC2B>Fishing Rod</color>. It'll make catchin' fish easier.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ini, ambil <color=#F1DC2B>Pancing</color> ini. Ini akan memudahkanmu menangkap ikan.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanGiveItem_Finished_009
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... now that you mention it, it's been forever since I went <color=#F1DC2B>Fishing</color>...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... sekarang kamu sebutkan, sudah lama sekali sejak terakhir kali aku <color=#F1DC2B>memancing</color>...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanGiveItem_Finished_010
Array.english: You're right, the lake's dangerous, so it'd be safer to <color=#F1DC2B>Fish</color> too!
Array.indonesia: Kamu benar, danau itu berbahaya, jadi akan lebih aman kalau kita <color=#F1DC2B>memancing</color> juga!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanGiveItem_Finished_011
Array.english: Hehe, plenty of spots to <color=#F1DC2B>Fish</color> besides the lake!
Array.indonesia: Hehe, ada banyak tempat untuk <color=#F1DC2B>memancing</color> selain di danau!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanGiveItem_Finished_012
Array.english: <size=33>You might even hook something you won't find in the lake, so keep your eyes peeled.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kamu bahkan mungkin bisa menangkap sesuatu yang tidak ada di danau, jadi perhatikan baik-baik.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanGiveItem_Finished_013
Array.english: Oh, and if ya wanna catch tougher fish...\nyou'll need a better <color=#F1DC2B>Fishing Rod</color> and <color=#F1DC2B>Bait</color>...
Array.indonesia: Oh, dan kalau kamu mau menangkap ikan yang lebih kuat...\nkamu butuh <color=#F1DC2B>Pancing</color> dan <color=#F1DC2B>Umpan</color> yang lebih bagus...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanGiveItem_Finished_014
Array.english: I can set ya up later if ya bring some Doni.\nTakes a bit of work to make 'em.
Array.indonesia: Nanti aku bisa nyiapin buat kamu kalau kamu bawa Doni.\nButuh sedikit usaha buat bikinnya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanGiveItem_Finished_015
Array.english: <size=32>The spot in front of my place is perfect for fishin', so use it anytime!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tempat di depan rumahku sangat cocok untuk memancing, jadi silakan gunakan kapan saja!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanGiveItem_NeedMore_001
Array.english: Here you go.
Array.indonesia: Ini dia.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanGiveItem_NeedMore_002
Array.english: Hmm... this ain't quite enough. Come back when you've got the full amount.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... ini belum cukup. Kembalilah saat kamu sudah punya jumlah yang lengkap.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanGiveItem_NoItem_001
Array.english: Oops, my mistake.\nHaven't caught it yet.
Array.indonesia: Ups, kesalahanku.\nBelum berhasil menangkapnya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanGiveItem_NoItem_002
Array.english: <size=32>I should write it down properly so I don't mess it up again.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku harus menuliskannya dengan benar agar tidak salah lagi.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanRefuseGiveItem_001
Array.english: <size=32>Not yet...\nI'll keep looking.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Belum...\nAku akan terus mencarinya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PerakStart_001
Array.english: Hmm... but I'd need some wood to make it...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... tapi aku butuh kayu untuk membuatnya...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PerakStart_002
Array.english: Is something wrong?
Array.indonesia: Ada yang salah?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PerakStart_003
Array.english: Oh, Dave. It's just... Saniah's been really into this character lately...
Array.indonesia: Oh, Dave. Hanya saja... Saniah belakangan ini sangat menyukai karakter ini...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PerakStart_004
Array.english: I want to make her a toy of it... but metal feels a bit unsafe.
Array.indonesia: Aku ingin membuatkan mainan karakter itu untuknya... tapi logam terasa agak tidak aman.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PerakStart_005
Array.english: I see. What character is it?
Array.indonesia: Begitu. Karakter apa itu?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PerakStart_006
Array.english: It's from a game Bima showed her...\ncalled <color=#F1DC2B>Clumsy Slime</color>, I think.
Array.indonesia: Itu dari game yang ditunjukkan Bima padanya...\nnamanya <color=#F1DC2B>Clumsy Slime</color>, kurasa.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PerakStart_007
Array.english: Oh, you mean from <color=#1DFEAF>Terraria</color>, right? \nThose Slime Town Pets are adorable!
Array.indonesia: Oh, maksudmu dari <color=#1DFEAF>Terraria</color>, kan? \nHewan peliharaan Slime Town itu lucu banget!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PerakStart_008
Array.english: Though they're pretty rare...
Array.indonesia: Walaupun mereka cukup langka...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PerakStart_009
Array.english: I see. Saniah really loves that one.
Array.indonesia: Oh, begitu. Saniah benar-benar suka yang itu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PerakStart_010
Array.english: She says the arrow stuck in its head is hilarious...\nStrange taste, huh?
Array.indonesia: Katanya panah yang menancap di kepalanya itu lucu banget...\nSelera yang aneh, ya?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PerakStart_011
Array.english: If I want to make it out of wood…\nI'd probably have to ask <color=#F1DC2B>Peneb</color>...
Array.indonesia: Kalau aku mau bikin dari kayu…\nMungkin aku harus tanya <color=#F1DC2B>Peneb</color>...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PerakStart_012
Array.english: But I can't leave the furnace right now...\nCould you ask him if he has any wood?
Array.indonesia: Tapi aku nggak bisa meninggalkan tungku sekarang...\nBisakah kamu tanya dia apakah dia punya kayu?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PerakStart_013
Array.english: Sure. No problem. I'll ask him.
Array.indonesia: Tentu. Nggak masalah. Aku akan tanya dia.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_AskPeneb_001
Array.english: Do you know any wood that's good for making a toy for Saniah?
Array.indonesia: Apa kamu tahu kayu apa yang bagus buat bikin mainan buat Saniah?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_AskPeneb_002
Array.english: Hmm? For a kid like Saniah, something smooth and light would be best.
Array.indonesia: Hmm? Untuk anak seusia Saniah, yang halus dan ringan akan paling cocok.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_AskPeneb_003
Array.english: The wood around here tends to be pretty rough...
Array.indonesia: Kayu di sekitar sini biasanya cukup kasar...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_AskPeneb_004
Array.english: There's a tree in the forest called the <color=#F1DC2B>Purity Tree</color>... It's tough to cut, but very light. Perfect for kids' toys!!
Array.indonesia: Ada pohon di hutan yang disebut <color=#F1DC2B>Pohon Kemurnian</color>... Sulit ditebang, tapi sangat ringan. Sempurna untuk mainan anak-anak!!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_AskPeneb_005
Array.english: A <color=#F1DC2B>Purity Tree</color>?\nWhat does it look like...?
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Pohon Kemurnian</color>?\nSeperti apa bentuknya...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_AskPeneb_006
Array.english: Hmm... hold on... I'll sketch it for you.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... tunggu sebentar... Aku akan menggambarkannya untukmu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_AskPeneb_007
Array.english: It looks like this...\nI'll mark the location on your map!
Array.indonesia: Bentuknya seperti ini...\nAku akan menandai lokasinya di peta kamu!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_AskPeneb_008
Array.english: Got it. I'll go take a look.
Array.indonesia: Oke. Aku akan pergi melihatnya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_AskPeneb_009
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, wait! This tree is really tough.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, tunggu! Pohon ini sangat keras.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_AskPeneb_010
Array.english: It won't be easy to chop down... You'll probably need something like a <color=#F1DC2B>Black Iron Axe</color>.
Array.indonesia: Tidak akan mudah untuk menebangnya... Kamu mungkin butuh sesuatu seperti <color=#F1DC2B>Kapak Besi Hitam</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_AskPeneb_NoGoldAxe_001
Array.english: Hmm... my current axe won't cut it. I'll need to gather materials and ask Perak for help.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... kapak yang aku punya sekarang tidak akan cukup. Aku harus mengumpulkan bahan-bahan dan meminta bantuan Perak.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_AskPeneb_YesGoldAxe_001
Array.english: <size=32>Then I can use the axe I have now!\nI'll go find it in the forest!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kalau begitu, aku bisa pakai kapak yang aku punya sekarang!\nAku akan mencarinya di hutan!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_FindTree_001
Array.english: Hmm. This must be the <color=#F1DC2B>Purity Tree</color> Peneb mentioned...?
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Ini pasti <color=#F1DC2B>Pohon Kemurnian</color> yang disebutkan Peneb...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_FindTree_NoGoldAxe_001
Array.english: Just like he said, it's incredibly sturdy...\nI'll need something like a <color=#F1DC2B>Black Iron Axe</color>...
Array.indonesia: Persis seperti yang dia katakan, benda ini sangat kokoh...\nAku butuh sesuatu seperti <color=#F1DC2B>Kapak Besi Hitam</color>...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_FindTree_NoGoldAxe_002
Array.english: I should gather some <color=#F1DC2B>Black Iron Ore</color> and ask Perak for help.
Array.indonesia: Sebaiknya aku mengumpulkan sedikit <color=#F1DC2B>Bijih Besi Hitam</color> dan meminta bantuan Perak.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_FindTree_YesGoldAxe_001
Array.english: <size=33>Alright. Let's give this a swing!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Baiklah. Ayo kita coba ayunkan ini!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_AfterCutTree_001
Array.english: Phew... this thing's solid.
Array.indonesia: Wah... benda ini kokoh sekali.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_AfterCutTree_002
Array.english: But the grain's so smooth.\nPerfect for making toys.
Array.indonesia: Tapi seratnya sangat halus.\nSempurna untuk membuat mainan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_BossAppear_001
Array.english: <size=34>Hm? Did those bushes just move...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hm? Apakah semak-semak itu baru saja bergerak...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_BossAppear02_001
Array.english: <size=35>Whoa...?! That's a giant toad...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wah...?! Itu katak raksasa...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_BossAppear02_002
Array.english: <size=34>Looks like the noise from chopping the tree ticked it off... It's really angry.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Sepertinya suara penebangan pohon tadi membuatnya marah... Dia benar-benar kesal.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_BossAppear02_003
Array.english: Looks like we'll have to defeat it to get the <color=#F1DC2B>Purity Wood</color>...
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya kita harus mengalahkannya untuk mendapatkan <color=#F1DC2B>Kayu Kemurnian</color>...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_BossAppear02_004
Array.english: Looks that way...
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya begitu...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_BossAppear02_005
Array.english: <size=33>It's definitely poisonous. Be careful!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kata-katanya pasti beracun. Hati-hati!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_BossAppear_Retry_001
Array.english: Looks like I'll have to defeat that toad to get the <color=#F1DC2B>Purity Wood</color>.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya aku harus mengalahkan katak itu untuk mendapatkan <color=#F1DC2B>Kayu Kemurnian</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_BossAppear_Retry_002
Array.english: <size=34>If you're ready, let's start the fight!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kalau kamu sudah siap, ayo mulai pertarungannya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_BossAppear_Retry_Option01_001
Array.english: Start the battle
Array.indonesia: Mulai pertarungan

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_BossAppear_Retry_Option01_002
Array.english: Retreat
Array.indonesia: Mundur

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_BossAppear_Retry_No_001
Array.english: <size=32>I should prepare a bit more and come back.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku sebaiknya bersiap-siap lagi dulu sebelum kembali.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_BossWin_001
Array.english: <size=32>Phew... that was rough.\nI really hate toads.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wah... itu lumayan berat.\nAku benar-benar benci katak.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_BossWin_002
Array.english: <size=32>Hahaha! Nice work! By the way, toad meat stays poisonous even when cooked, so don't even think about taking it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hahaha! Kerja bagus! Ngomong-ngomong, daging katak tetap beracun meski sudah dimasak, jadi jangan pernah berpikir untuk mengambilnya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_BossWin_003
Array.english: <size=33>Alright, let's grab this <color=#F1DC2B>Purity Wood</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Baiklah, ayo kita ambil <color=#F1DC2B>Kayu Kemurnian</color> ini!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_GetTimber_001
Array.english: Oh, it really is sturdy and light, isn't it?
Array.indonesia: Oh, memang kokoh dan ringan, ya?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_GetTimber_002
Array.english: Let's head back to the village and give it to Peneb.
Array.indonesia: Ayo kita kembali ke desa dan berikan ini kepada Peneb.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_GetTimber_Barricade_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hm? Where are you going?\nYou need to grab the <color=#F1DC2B>Purity Wood</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hm? Mau ke mana?\nKamu harus mengambil <color=#F1DC2B>Kayu Kemurnian</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PenebDelivery_001
Array.english: Huh? Did you bring the <color=#F1DC2B>Purity Wood</color>?
Array.indonesia: Hah? Apa kamu sudah membawa <color=#F1DC2B>Kayu Kemurnian</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PenebDelivery_Option01
Array.english: Yes, here it is
Array.indonesia: Ya, ini dia

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PenebDelivery_Option02
Array.english: Not yet...
Array.indonesia: Belum...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PenebGiveItem_Finished_001
Array.english: I brought the <color=#F1DC2B>Purity Wood</color>.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah membawa <color=#F1DC2B>Kayu Kemurnian</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PenebGiveItem_Finished_002
Array.english: Oh... I heard that place is crawling with dangerous creatures. How'd you manage to get it!?
Array.indonesia: Oh... Aku dengar tempat itu dipenuhi makhluk berbahaya. Gimana kamu bisa mendapatkannya!?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PenebGiveItem_Finished_003
Array.english: <size=33>...You could've told me that earlier.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...Youu bisa bilang ke aku lebih awal.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PenebGiveItem_Finished_004
Array.english:
Hehe, anyway, I'll make Saniah a toy with this.
Just give me a moment.
Array.indonesia:
Hehe, anyway, aku bakal bikin mainan buat Saniah pakai ini.
Tunggu sebentar ya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PenebComplete_001
Array.english: Phew... it's so tough, my wrist's killing me.
Array.indonesia: Wah... kayu ini sangat keras, pergelangan tanganku sakit sekali.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PenebComplete_002
Array.english: Here you go. I tried to match the character Saniah likes as closely as I could.
Array.indonesia: Ini dia. Aku berusaha meniru karakter yang disukai Saniah sebaik mungkin.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PenebComplete_003
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... you did an amazing job!\nSaniah's gonna love it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... hasil karyamu luar biasa!\nSaniah pasti akan menyukainya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PenebComplete_004
Array.english:
<size=33>It's nothing...<color=#ff61e3>♥</color> 
Way easier than that big village sculpture<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>
Array.indonesia:
<size=33>Bukan apa-apa...<color=#ff61e3>♥</color> 
Jauh lebih mudah daripada patung besar di desa itu<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PenebComplete_005
Array.english: Ahem... anyway, I hope Saniah likes it.
Array.indonesia: Ahem... bagaimanapun, semoga Saniah menyukainya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PenebGiveItem_NoItem_001
Array.english: Oh, my mistake. I'll look for it again.
Array.indonesia: Oh, maaf. Aku akan mencarinya lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PenebGiveItem_Refuse_001
Array.english: <size=32>Not yet...\nI'll keep looking.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Belum...\nAku akan terus mencarinya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PeraknSaniah_001
Array.english: Here's a <color=#F1DC2B>Clumsy Slime</color> wooden toy.\nPeneb made it.
Array.indonesia: Ini mainan kayu <color=#F1DC2B>Clumsy Slime</color>.\nPeneb yang membuatnya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PeraknSaniah_002
Array.english: <size=33>Ooh... this is really well made...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wah... ini dibuat dengan sangat bagus...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PeraknSaniah_003
Array.english: The smooth finish and light weight...\nit's perfect for a kid's toy.
Array.indonesia: Permukaannya halus dan bobotnya ringan...\nsangat cocok untuk mainan anak-anak.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PeraknSaniah_004
Array.english: I'll have to thank Peneb later.
Array.indonesia: Nanti aku harus berterima kasih kepada Peneb.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PeraknSaniah_005
Array.english: Glad you like it.\nHope Saniah does too.
Array.indonesia: Senang kamu menyukainya.\nSemoga Saniah juga menyukainya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PeraknSaniah_006
Array.english: Hehe, let's call her over.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, ayo panggil dia ke sini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PeraknSaniah02_001
Array.english: Saniah, come here. Dave brought you something you'll like.
Array.indonesia: Saniah, kemarilah. Dave membawakan sesuatu yang pasti akan kamu sukai.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PeraknSaniah02_002
Array.english: <size=34>...Whoa! Isn't this <color=#F1DC2B>Clumsy Slime</color>!?\nWooow...!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>...Whoa! Bukankah ini <color=#F1DC2B>Clumsy Slime</color>!?\nWooow...!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PeraknSaniah02_003
Array.english: <size=33>I can even pull the arrow out of its head! Wow! Thank you so, so much!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku bahkan bisa mencabut panah dari kepalanya! Wow! Terima kasih banyak, banget!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PeraknSaniah03_001
Array.english: Seeing her this happy is really sweet.
Array.indonesia: Melihat dia sebahagia ini sungguh manis.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PeraknSaniah03_002
Array.english: Hehe, Dave. Thanks so much.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, Dave. Terima kasih banyak.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PeraknSaniah03_003
Array.english: <size=33>As a small token of my thanks... I'll give you a <color=#1DFEAF>20%</color> discount on all my work from now on!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Sebagai tanda terima kasih kecil... aku akan memberimu diskon <color=#1DFEAF>20%</color> untuk semua pekerjaanku mulai sekarang!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PeraknSaniah03_004
Array.english: Oh... are you sure about that?
Array.indonesia: Oh... kamu yakin dengan itu?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PeraknSaniah03_005
Array.english: Haha. Seeing Saniah this happy, I can't not do something!
Array.indonesia: Haha. Melihat Saniah sebahagia ini, aku tidak bisa tidak melakukan sesuatu!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PeraknSaniah03_006
Array.english: Well then, I'll be counting on you from now on.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah, mulai sekarang aku akan mengandalkanmu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_PanutaStart_001
Array.english: Hmm... the offerings I leave at the sacred tree keep disappearing...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... persembahan yang aku tinggalkan di pohon suci terus menghilang...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_PanutaStart_002
Array.english: Could it be monkeys stealing them?
Array.indonesia: Mungkinkah monyet-monyet yang mencurinya?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_PanutaStart_003
Array.english: If it were fruit, I'd say it's monkeys...\nbut strangely, they only take the <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color>.
Array.indonesia: Kalau itu buah, aku bakal bilang itu monyet...\ntapi anehnya, mereka cuma mengambil <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_PanutaStart_004
Array.english: <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color>...? What's that?
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color>...? Apa itu?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_PanutaStart_005
Array.english: Ah, right. I haven't told you about it yet.
Array.indonesia: Ah, iya. Aku belum menceritakannya padamu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_PanutaStart_006
Array.english: <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color> is a traditional snack in our village. It's made with coconut milk and rice, so it's soft and sweet.
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color> adalah makanan ringan tradisional di desa kami. Terbuat dari santan dan beras, jadi teksturnya lembut dan rasanya manis.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_PanutaStart_007
Array.english: We use <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color> not just as food, but also as offerings to our ancestors.
Array.indonesia: Kami menggunakan <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color> tidak hanya sebagai makanan, tetapi juga sebagai persembahan untuk leluhur kami.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_PanutaStart_008
Array.english: That's why I leave them in front of this sacred tree...\nbut lately, they've been disappearing every night.
Array.indonesia: Itulah mengapa aku meletakkannya di depan pohon suci ini...\ntapi belakangan ini, \nKui@2@ itu selalu menghilang setiap malam.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_PanutaStart_009
Array.english: It leaves the fruit and other food behind, and only takes the <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color>... It's quite strange.
Array.indonesia: Makhluk itu meninggalkan buah dan makanan lainnya, dan hanya mengambil <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color>... Cukup aneh.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_PanutaStart_010
Array.english: Rimbo says this started after a strange cardboard box labeled <color=#A8DC23>Om Nom</color> appeared near the village.
Array.indonesia: Rimbo bilang hal ini dimulai setelah sebuah kotak kardus aneh bertuliskan <color=#A8DC23>Om Nom</color> muncul di dekat desa.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_PanutaStart_011
Array.english: Hmm... could there be a connection to the cardboard box?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... mungkinkah ada kaitannya dengan kotak kardus itu?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_PanutaStart_012
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, don't you have a <color=#1DFEAF>Camera</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, apa kalian tidak punya <color=#1DFEAF>Kamera</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_PanutaStart_013
Array.english: Yes... we brought one to take pictures underwater.
Array.indonesia: Ya... kami membawa satu untuk memotret di bawah air.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_PanutaStart_014
Array.english: Then could you take a picture of whoever's been taking the offerings at night?
Array.indonesia: Kalau begitu, bisakah kalian memotret siapa pun yang mengambil persembahan di malam hari?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_PanutaStart_015
Array.english: If it's not monkeys, it might be the village children... \nand if so, they'll need to be scolded.
Array.indonesia: Kalau bukan monyet, mungkin anak-anak desa... \ndan kalau begitu, mereka perlu dimarahi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_PanutaStart_016
Array.english: We don't want them eating it before you get a shot...\nso I'll give you a few <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color>.
Array.indonesia: Kita tidak mau mereka memakannya sebelum kamu sempat memotret...\njadi aku akan memberimu beberapa <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_PanutaStart_017
Array.english: Place them in front of the sacred tree at night,\nand watch with your <color=#1DFEAF>Camera</color>.
Array.indonesia: Letakkan di depan Pohon Suci pada malam hari,\ndan awasi dengan <color=#1DFEAF>Kamera</color>-mu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_PanutaStart_018
Array.english: <size=32>Alright. Stealing the village's offerings...\nLet's find out who it is.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Baiklah. Mencuri persembahan desa...\nAyo kita cari tahu siapa pelakunya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_Night_001
Array.english: The chief asked me to film whoever's been stealing the <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color>, right?
Array.indonesia: Kepala desa meminta saya untuk merekam siapa pun yang telah mencuri <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color>, kan?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_Night_002
Array.english: I should set up a camera near <color=#F1DC2B>Sacred Tree</color>.
Array.indonesia: Saya harus memasang kamera di dekat <color=#F1DC2B>Pohon Suci</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_Night_Retry_001
Array.english: Oh right... the chief asked me to film whoever's been stealing the <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color>.
Array.indonesia: Oh iya... kepala desa meminta saya untuk merekam siapa pun yang telah mencuri <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_Night_Retry_002
Array.english: I should place the <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color> under the sacred tree and set up the camera.
Array.indonesia: Aku sebaiknya meletakkan <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color> di bawah pohon suci dan memasang kamera.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_KuiReady_001
Array.english: Alright, this should be enough <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color>...
Array.indonesia: Baiklah, <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color> ini seharusnya sudah cukup...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_KuiReady_002
Array.english: Maybe I'll set the <color=#1DFEAF>Camera</color> up a little farther away?
Array.indonesia: Mungkin aku akan memasang <color=#1DFEAF>Kamera</color> sedikit lebih jauh?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_SetCamera_001
Array.english: Alright, camera's set...
Array.indonesia: Baiklah, kamera sudah terpasang...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_SetCamera_002
Array.english: Now let's wait for the thief to show up.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang mari kita tunggu si pencuri muncul.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_NotComing_001
Array.english: Hmm... doesn't look like anyone's coming...\nWas this a bust?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... sepertinya nggak ada yang datang...\nApakah ini gagal?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_OmNomComing_001
Array.english: <size=33>Huh!? What's that?\nA green creature...!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hah!? Apa itu?\nMakhluk hijau...!?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_OmNomComing_002
Array.english: <size=33>Gotta snap a photo first...!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Harus foto dulu...!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_CameraComplete_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... it ran off toward the forest...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... dia lari ke arah hutan...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_CameraComplete_002
Array.english: I've never seen anything like that...\nCould it be native to this region?
Array.indonesia: Aku belum pernah melihat yang seperti itu...\nMungkinkah makhluk itu asli daerah ini?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_CameraComplete_003
Array.english: I should ask the chief about it tomorrow.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus tanya kepala desa besok.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_CameraNextDay_001
Array.english: I checked yesterday...
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah memeriksanya kemarin...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_CameraNextDay_002
Array.english: <size=32>A green creature like this was stealing the <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Makhluk hijau seperti ini yang mencuri <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_CameraNextDay_003
Array.english: Hmm...? I've never seen anything like this...\nDoesn't seem native to this area.
Array.indonesia: Hmm...? Aku belum pernah melihat yang seperti ini...\nSepertinya bukan makhluk asli daerah ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_CameraNextDay_004
Array.english: I see. No wonder it looked so strange.
Array.indonesia: Begitu. Pantas saja kelihatannya aneh sekali.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_CameraNextDay_005
Array.english: If we leave it alone, the offerings will keep disappearing.
Array.indonesia: Kalau kita biarkan begitu saja, persembahan akan terus menghilang.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_CameraNextDay_006
Array.english: <size=32>We'll have to catch it or drive it off!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kita harus menangkapnya atau mengusirnya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_CameraNextDay_007
Array.english: It really seems to like Kui... What if we lure it with Kui on a string?
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya makhluk itu sangat menyukai Kui... Bagaimana kalau kita memancingnya dengan Kui yang diikat pada seutas tali?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_CameraNextDay_008
Array.english: That's a good idea. First, we need to find where it's hiding.
Array.indonesia: Itu ide yang bagus. Pertama-tama, kita harus mencari tahu di mana ia bersembunyi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_CameraNextDay_009
Array.english: I saw some <color=#F1DC2B>Footprints</color> earlier...\nWhy don't you follow them?
Array.indonesia: Tadi aku melihat beberapa <color=#F1DC2B>Jejak Kaki</color>...\nKenapa kamu tidak mengikuti jejaknya?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_CameraNextDay_010
Array.english: <size=32>Alright. I'll check the <color=#F1DC2B>Footprints</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Baiklah. Aku akan memeriksa <color=#F1DC2B>Jejak Kaki</color> itu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_CheckFootstep_001
Array.english: Here are the green creature's <color=#F1DC2B>Footprints</color>.
Array.indonesia: Ini <color=#F1DC2B>Jejak Kaki</color> makhluk hijau itu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_CheckFootstep_002
Array.english: <size=33>Let's follow them one by one!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ayo kita ikuti satu per satu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_FootstepFollow_001
Array.english: Hmm... strange-looking tracks.\nLet's keep following them.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... jejak yang terlihat aneh.\nAyo kita terus ikuti.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_FootstepSecond_001
Array.english: <size=32>The tracks keep going.\nLet's follow them.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Jejaknya terus berlanjut.\nAyo kita ikuti.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_FootstepEnd_001
Array.english: <size=31>Huh? The tracks end here?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Hah? Jejaknya berakhir di sini?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_FootstepEnd_002
Array.english: <size=32>Could it be... up near that cliff?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Mungkinkah... di dekat tebing itu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_GameStart_001
Array.english: There it is, hiding over there... that little guy.
Array.indonesia: Itu dia, bersembunyi di sana... si kecil itu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_GameStart_002
Array.english: Alright, let's tie the <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color> the chief gave me to a string and lure him out.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah, mari kita ikat <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color> yang diberikan kepala suku kepadaku ke seutas tali dan memancingnya keluar.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_Stage01Clear_001
Array.english: You really love Kui...
Array.indonesia: Kamu benar-benar menyayangi Kui...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_Stage01Clear_002
Array.english: Just a few more tries and I can pull him up!
Array.indonesia: Tinggal beberapa kali lagi dan aku bisa menariknya ke atas!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_GameComplete_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh! He fell asleep with the candy in his mouth!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh! Dia tertidur dengan permen di mulutnya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_GameComplete_002
Array.english: <size=32>Let's pull him up now!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ayo tarik dia ke atas sekarang!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_OmNomCapture_001
Array.english: It's actually pretty cute up close...
Array.indonesia: Ternyata cukup imut kalau dilihat dari dekat...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_OmNomCapture_002
Array.english: Doesn't look like it'll wake up anytime soon,\nso I'll take it to the chief like this.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya dia tidak akan bangun dalam waktu dekat,\njadi aku akan membawanya ke kepala suku seperti ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_MissionComplete01_001
Array.english: Hmm... that's a very unusual creature.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... itu makhluk yang sangat tidak biasa.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_MissionComplete01_002
Array.english: I know. What should we do with it?
Array.indonesia: Aku tahu. Apa yang harus kita lakukan dengannya?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_MissionComplete02_001
Array.english: <size=32>Haha, this little guy... looks like he really likes this place, probably because of the food!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha, si kecil ini... sepertinya dia benar-benar suka tempat ini, mungkin karena makanannya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_MissionComplete02_002
Array.english: <size=32>If you're okay with it, how about we let him stay here?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kalau kamu setuju, gimana kalau kita biarkan dia tinggal di sini?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_MissionComplete02_003
Array.english: <size=33>Huh? Here at the restaurant...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hah? Di restoran ini...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_MissionComplete02_004
Array.english: Well... if Bancho's okay with it...
Array.indonesia: Yah... kalau Bancho setuju...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_MissionComplete02_005
Array.english: Heh. Why not.
Array.indonesia: Heh. Kenapa tidak.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_MissionComplete02_006
Array.english: As long as he doesn't eat all my ingredients.
Array.indonesia: Asal dia tidak memakan semua bahan masakanku.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_MissionComplete02_007
Array.english: Then let's have him run some small errands,\nsince he seems to like it here.
Array.indonesia: Kalau begitu, mari kita minta dia membantu beberapa tugas kecil,\nkarena sepertinya dia suka di sini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_MissionComplete02_008
Array.english: What should we call him?
Array.indonesia: Apa kita harus memanggilnya apa?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_MissionComplete02_009
Array.english: The box he came in had <color=#A8DC23>Om Nom</color> written on it...\nWhy not call him that?
Array.indonesia: Kotak tempat dia datang bertuliskan <color=#A8DC23>Om Nom</color>...\nKenapa tidak memanggilnya begitu saja?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_MissionComplete02_010
Array.english: <size=33><color=#A8DC23>Om Nom</color>... what a cute name!\nIt fits him perfectly!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33><color=#A8DC23>Om Nom</color>... nama yang lucu sekali!\nSangat cocok untuknya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_BoxInteraction_001
Array.english: A box just appeared out of nowhere...\nWonder what was inside?
Array.indonesia: Sebuah kotak tiba-tiba muncul entah dari mana...\nApa ya isinya?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_KuiEmptyInteraction_001
Array.english: The Kui that green creature ate...\nLooks pretty tasty.
Array.indonesia: Kui yang dimakan makhluk hijau itu...\nKelihatannya cukup lezat.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLakeEvent_TigerFishLook01_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hmm...? Looks like the Goliath Tigerfish is being chased by something.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hmm...? Sepertinya Ikan Harimau Goliath sedang dikejar sesuatu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLakeEvent_TigerFishLook02_001
Array.english: <size=33>Whoa...! Is that the freshwater shark Basu was talking about...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wah...! Apakah itu hiu air tawar yang dibicarakan Basu...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLakeEvent_TigerFishLook02_002
Array.english: <size=32>Seeing a shark in a lake feels so strange...\nI'll have to be careful around here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Melihat hiu di danau terasa sangat aneh...\nAku harus berhati-hati di sekitar sini.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_MorningHouse_001
Array.english: Hmm... it's kind of noisy outside.\nWhat's going on...?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... di luar agak berisik.\nAda apa ya...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_Village_001
Array.english: <size=34>It's him...\n<color=#F1DC2B>Sulong</color>...!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Itu dia...\n<color=#F1DC2B>Sulong</color>...!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_Village_002
Array.english: The beast that disappeared... Why is he back all of a sudden...?
Array.indonesia: Binatang buas yang menghilang... Kenapa dia tiba-tiba kembali...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_Village_003
Array.english: Judging by the bite marks, he's gotten even bigger...
Array.indonesia: Dilihat dari bekas gigitannya, dia jadi semakin besar...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_Village_004
Array.english: <size=33>A bull shark... dead?\nWhat happened here...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hiu banteng... mati?\nApa yang terjadi di sini...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_Village_005
Array.english: The saltwater crocodile that injured my father's leg...\nI think <color=#F1DC2B>Sulong</color> is back.
Array.indonesia: Buaya air asin yang melukai kaki ayahku...\nKurasa <color=#F1DC2B>Sulong</color> sudah kembali.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_Village_006
Array.english:
A saltwater crocodile... The one Basu mentioned?
The one that moves between freshwater and saltwater?
Array.indonesia:
Buaya air asin... Yang disebutkan Basu?
Yang bisa berpindah antara air tawar dan air asin?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_Village_007
Array.english: Yes... they're one of the largest crocodile species.
Array.indonesia: Ya... mereka termasuk salah satu spesies buaya terbesar.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_Village_008
Array.english: This area's a perfect habitat, since the sea and the lake are connected.
Array.indonesia: Daerah ini merupakan habitat yang sempurna, karena laut dan danau terhubung.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_Village_009
Array.english: But they don't usually come up to the village to hunt.\nThey're actually quite timid.
Array.indonesia: Tapi biasanya mereka tidak datang ke desa untuk berburu.\nMereka sebenarnya cukup pemalu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_Village_010
Array.english: But there was one exception...\n<color=#F1DC2B>Sulong</color> was different.
