Array.indonesia: Tapi ada satu pengecualian...\n<color=#F1DC2B>Sulong</color> berbeda.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_Village_011
Array.english: Even when he wasn't fully grown, he was bigger than the others...and he'd come up to the village and hunt our chickens.
Array.indonesia: Bahkan saat dia belum dewasa sepenuhnya, ukurannya sudah lebih besar dari yang lain... dan dia sering datang ke desa untuk memburu ayam-ayam kami.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_Village_012
Array.english: When I was a child... <color=#F1DC2B>Sulong</color> came at me while I was playing by the water.
Array.indonesia: Ketika aku masih kecil... <color=#F1DC2B>Sulong</color> menyerangku saat aku sedang bermain di tepi sungai.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_Village_013
Array.english: My father stepped in to protect me...\nand <color=#F1DC2B>Sulong</color> bit his leg...
Array.indonesia: Ayahku melangkah maju untuk melindungiku...\ndan <color=#F1DC2B>Sulong</color> menggigit kakinya...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_Village_014
Array.english: Since then, my father walked with a limp...\nand I've trained to protect the village from <color=#F1DC2B>Sulong</color>.
Array.indonesia: Sejak saat itu, ayahku berjalan pincang...\ndan aku berlatih untuk melindungi desa dari <color=#F1DC2B>Sulong</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_Village_015
Array.english: Oh... sorry. I got carried away talking about the past.
Array.indonesia: Oh... maaf. Aku terlalu asyik bercerita tentang masa lalu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_Village_016
Array.english: That's quite a story... But why would he suddenly reappear after all this time?
Array.indonesia: Itu cerita yang luar biasa... Tapi mengapa dia tiba-tiba muncul kembali setelah sekian lama?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_Village_017
Array.english: We set up a <color=#1DFEAF>Barrier</color> of stakes along his path to stop him.
Array.indonesia: Kami memasang <color=#1DFEAF>Penghalang</color> dari tiang-tiang di sepanjang jalannya untuk menghentikannya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_Village_018
Array.english: Maybe... now that he's fully grown, Sulong broke through the <color=#1DFEAF>Barrier</color>...
Array.indonesia: Mungkin... sekarang setelah dia tumbuh dewasa, Sulong berhasil menembus <color=#1DFEAF>Penghalang</color> itu...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_Village_019
Array.english: Dave... I'm sorry, but could you check if the <color=#1DFEAF>Barrier</color> at the lake is still intact?
Array.indonesia: Dave... Maaf, tapi bisakah kamu memeriksa apakah <color=#1DFEAF>Penghalang</color> di danau masih utuh?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_Village_020
Array.english: It's set up about <color=#1DFEAF>10m</color> deep, at the left end of the lake.
Array.indonesia: Penghalang itu dipasang sedalam sekitar <color=#1DFEAF>10m</color>, di ujung kiri danau.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_Village_021
Array.english: Sure, I'll check it out.
Array.indonesia: Tentu, aku akan memeriksanya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_WallCheck_001
Array.english: <size=33>Huh...? Just like Uzme said... The <color=#1DFEAF>Barrier</color>'s broken...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hah...? Persis seperti yang dikatakan Uzme... <color=#1DFEAF>Penghalang</color> itu rusak...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_WallCheck_002
Array.english: <size=32>Did that saltwater crocodile really break through it...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Apakah buaya air asin itu benar-benar menerobosnya...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_WallCheck_003
Array.english: <size=32>I should head back to the village and tell Uzme first.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku sebaiknya kembali ke desa dan memberi tahu Uzme dulu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCBarricade_Ingame_SulongZone_BeforeReport_001
Array.english: <size=33>I shouldn't go in yet.\nI need to tell Uzme about the <color=#1DFEAF>Barrier</color> first.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku sebaiknya belum masuk dulu.\nAku harus memberi tahu Uzme tentang <color=#1DFEAF>Penghalang</color> itu dulu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCBarricade_Ingame_SulongZone_NotInSunset_001
Array.english:
It doesn't seem to be the time Uzme mentioned yet.
I should come back at sunset.
Array.indonesia:
Sepertinya belum waktunya seperti yang disebutkan Uzme.
Aku sebaiknya kembali saat matahari terbenam.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_001
Array.english: Um... about the <color=#1DFEAF>Barrier</color> at the lake you mentioned...
Array.indonesia: Um... soal <color=#1DFEAF>Penghalang</color> di danau yang kamu sebutkan...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_002
Array.english: <size=33>You were right. It was completely destroyed.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kamu benar. Penghalang itu hancur total.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_003
Array.english: Haaah... I knew it...
Array.indonesia: Haaah... Aku sudah tahu...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_004
Array.english: To break those sturdy stakes... \nit must have grown stronger over time.
Array.indonesia: Untuk mematahkan tiang-tiang kokoh itu... \npasti makhluk itu semakin kuat seiring waktu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_005
Array.english: If we leave it alone, it'll keep attacking livestock and people... just like before.
Array.indonesia: Kalau kita biarkan begitu saja, makhluk itu akan terus menyerang ternak dan orang-orang... seperti sebelumnya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_006
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>Hmm... Dave... I think you should handle this for the village.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>Hmm... Dave... menurutku kamu yang harus menangani ini demi desa.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_007
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>...I was already thinking the same thing.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>...Iu juga sudah kupikirkan.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_008
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>I just didn't have the nerve to say it out loud...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>Aku hanya tidak berani mengatakannya dengan lantang...</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_009
Array.english: <size=35>Uzme... what if I go hunt the Sulong?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Uzme... bagaimana kalau aku yang pergi memburu Sulong?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_010
Array.english: <size=32>What...? Even if you're a master diver, taking on something that dangerous...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Apa...? Meskipun kamu penyelam ulung, menghadapi sesuatu yang seberbahaya itu...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_011
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! Dave's a pro who's taken down everything from giant deep-sea creatures to dinosaurs. Looks can be deceiving!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Dave itu profesional yang sudah mengalahkan segala macam makhluk, mulai dari makhluk laut dalam raksasa hingga dinosaurus. Penampilan bisa menipu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_012
Array.english: <size=34>...'looks can be deceiving'?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>...'penampilan bisa menipu'?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_013
Array.english: I'd love to take it down myself, but... the Sulong is nocturnal and stays in the water most of the time... so... ugh...
Array.indonesia: Aku ingin sekali mengalahkannya sendiri, tapi... Sulong itu aktif di malam hari dan kebanyakan waktunya dihabiskan di dalam air... jadi... ugh...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_014
Array.english: If it's nocturnal, couldn't we attack during the day while it's sleeping?
Array.indonesia: Kalau dia aktif di malam hari, bukankah kita bisa menyerangnya di siang hari saat dia sedang tidur?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_015
Array.english: Well... I looked into its habits before, and it seems to hide in its den during the day and come out at night.
Array.indonesia: Yah... Aku sudah meneliti kebiasaannya sebelumnya, dan sepertinya ia bersembunyi di sarangnya pada siang hari dan keluar pada malam hari.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_016
Array.english: That means it's hard to find during the day,\neven if you search underwater.
Array.indonesia: Itu berarti sulit menemukannya pada siang hari,\nbahkan jika kamu mencarinya di bawah air.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_017
Array.english: <size=34>However...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Namun...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_018
Array.english: <size=33>it's a different story at <color=#F1DC2B>Dusk</color>, when the sun starts to set.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>ceritanya berbeda saat <color=#F1DC2B>senja</color>, ketika matahari mulai terbenam.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_019
Array.english: <size=33>Sulong will have just woken up, so it won't be at full strength... and you'll still have enough light to see!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Sulong baru saja bangun, jadi kekuatannya belum pulih sepenuhnya... dan kamu masih punya cukup cahaya untuk melihat!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_020
Array.english: Oh... that makes sense.\nWe'd have a better shot at <color=#F1DC2B>Dusk</color>.
Array.indonesia: Oh... itu masuk akal.\nKita akan punya peluang lebih baik di <color=#F1DC2B>Senja</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_021
Array.english: Uzme will tell you when the time is right.\nWe're counting on you.
Array.indonesia: Uzme akan memberitahumu saat waktunya tepat.\nKami mengandalkanmu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_022
Array.english: Got it.\nI'll make sure my gear is ready too.
Array.indonesia: Paham.\nAku juga akan memastikan perlengkapanku siap.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_023
Array.english: I'm sorry I can't help directly, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Maaf aku tidak bisa membantu secara langsung, Dave.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_024
Array.english: Instead, I'll give you some <color=#F1DC2B>Ore</color> I have.\nHope it helps you upgrade your gear.
Array.indonesia: Sebagai gantinya, aku akan memberimu beberapa <color=#F1DC2B>Bijih</color> yang kumiliki.\nSemoga ini membantumu meningkatkan perlengkapanmu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_Sulong_WallCheck_001
Array.english: <color=#F1DC2B>Sulong</color> should be on the move by now.
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Sulong</color> seharusnya sudah berangkat sekarang.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_StartFail_001
Array.english: Didn't see Sulong today. I'll check again tomorrow around sunset.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak melihat Sulong hari ini. Aku akan memeriksanya lagi besok sekitar matahari terbenam.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BattleEnter_001
Array.english: I can sense something dangerous inside...
Array.indonesia: Aku bisa merasakan sesuatu yang berbahaya di dalamnya...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BattleEnter_002
Array.english: Looks like Uzme was right... <color=#F1DC2B>Sulong</color> really is here at this hour.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya Uzme benar... <color=#F1DC2B>Sulong</color> memang ada di sini pada jam ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BattleEnter_003
Array.english: This is going to be a tough fight...\nLet me check my gear first.
Array.indonesia: Ini akan menjadi pertarungan yang berat...\nBiarkan aku memeriksa perlengkapanku dulu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_FightStart_001
Array.english: <size=33>Whoa...! So that's <color=#F1DC2B>Sulong</color>...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wah...! Jadi itu dia <color=#F1DC2B>Sulong</color>...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_FightStart_002
Array.english: <size=32>It's way bigger than I thought...\nUh... what should I do...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ukurannya jauh lebih besar dari yang kubayangkan...\nUh... apa yang harus kulakukan...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_FightStart_003
Array.english: <size=33>I can't back down now! For the chief and the village! I've fought bigger things back in the Blue Hole!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku tidak bisa mundur sekarang! Demi kepala suku dan desa! Aku pernah melawan makhluk yang lebih besar di Blue Hole!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_FightStart_004
Array.english: <size=32>If I watch its movements carefully, there has to be an opening.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kalau aku perhatikan gerakannya dengan cermat, pasti ada celahnya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_FightStart_ReTry_001
Array.english: <size=32>I wasn't prepared enough before.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tadi aku belum cukup siap.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_FightStart_ReTry_002
Array.english: <size=33>This time, I'll stay focused and take it down for sure!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kali ini, aku akan tetap fokus dan pasti akan mengalahkannya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_FightEnd_CarvingStart_001
Array.english: <size=32>Phew... what a massive and vicious creature.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wah... makhluk yang sangat besar dan ganas.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_FightEnd_CarvingStart_002
Array.english: <size=33>Still, the village won't be attacked anymore now!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tapi, desa ini tidak akan diserang lagi sekarang!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_FightEnd_CarvingStart_003
Array.english: <size=32>I heard crocodile meat's pretty good... Maybe I should see if there's anything worth taking.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku dengar daging buaya lumayan enak... Mungkin aku harus lihat apakah ada yang layak diambil.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_FightEnd_CarvingEnd_001
Array.english: <size=33>This should be enough.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ini seharusnya sudah cukup.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_FightEnd_CarvingEnd_002
Array.english: <size=33>Let's head back and tell Uzme.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ayo kita kembali dan beri tahu Uzme.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_FightFail_001
Array.english: <size=32>I can't take it on yet...\nI should prepare more and try again...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku belum bisa menghadapinya...\nAku harus mempersiapkan diri lebih baik dan mencoba lagi...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_End_001
Array.english: <size=34>Dave, you're safe!\nWhat happened to <color=#F1DC2B>Sulong</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Dave, kamu selamat!\nApa yang terjadi dengan <color=#F1DC2B>Sulong</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_End_002
Array.english: <size=32>I barely managed to take it down...\nIt was incredibly vicious.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku nyaris saja berhasil mengalahkannya...\nMakhluk itu sangat ganas.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_End_003
Array.english: <size=33>Oh my... really? It's finally gone... I don't know how to thank you...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Astaga... beneran? Akhirnya hilang juga... Aku nggak tahu harus berterima kasih gimana...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_End_004
Array.english: That's incredible...\nYou defeated Sulong...
Array.indonesia: Luar biasa...\nKamu berhasil mengalahkan Sulong...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_End_005
Array.english: Now we're finally at peace... It was terrifying knowing that thing was roaming around.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang kita akhirnya bisa hidup tenang... Sungguh menakutkan mengetahui makhluk itu berkeliaran di sekitar sini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_End_006
Array.english: Everyone was so scared they wouldn't even leave their homes... We barely spoke to each other.
Array.indonesia: Semua orang begitu ketakutan sampai-sampai tidak berani keluar rumah... Kami hampir tidak saling berbicara.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_End_007
Array.english: The villagers managed to band together and drive it off once... but I feared it would return.
Array.indonesia: Para penduduk desa sempat bersatu dan mengusirnya sekali... tapi aku takut makhluk itu akan kembali.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_End_008
Array.english: Thanks to you... we can finally protect our village in peace. Thank you.
Array.indonesia: Berkat kamu... kita akhirnya bisa melindungi desa kita dengan tenang. Terima kasih.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_End_009
Array.english: I owed you all anyway.\nI'm just glad I could help.
Array.indonesia: Lagipula, aku memang berhutang budi pada kalian semua.\nAku hanya senang bisa membantu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_End_010
Array.english: Hehe, I wish all outsiders were like you.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, andai saja semua orang luar seperti kamu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_End_011
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, about that <color=#F1DC2B>Sulong's Tooth</color> you brought...\nThey say it grants mysterious strength.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, soal <color=#F1DC2B>Gigi Sulong</color> yang kamu bawa itu. ..\nKonon, benda itu memberikan kekuatan misterius.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_End_012
Array.english: <size=33>I made it into a <color=#F1DC2B>Bracelet</color> so you can wear it. Go on, take it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku menjadikannya sebuah <color=#F1DC2B>Gelang</color> agar kamu bisa memakainya. Silakan, ambil saja.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_End_013
Array.english: Oh... thank you. I'll make good use of it.
Array.indonesia: Oh... terima kasih. Aku akan memanfaatkannya dengan baik.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_End_014
Array.english: It's a good thing Sulong is gone, but...
Array.indonesia: Untungnya Sulong sudah pergi, tapi...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ugh... no matter how much I cut them, they just keep growing back... What's going on here...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ugh... seberapa pun aku memotongnya, mereka terus tumbuh kembali... Apa yang terjadi di sini...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_002
Array.english: Huh...? What's going on?
Array.indonesia: Hah...? Ada apa ini?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_003
Array.english: <size=32>Sigh... it's these <color=#F1DC2B>Weeds</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Huff... Ini <color=#F1DC2B>gulma</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_004
Array.english: Some strange power must be flowing through this garden... \nNo matter how much I cut the <color=#F1DC2B>Weeds</color>, they grow right back.
Array.indonesia: Pasti ada kekuatan aneh yang mengalir di kebun ini... \nSeberapa pun aku memotong <color=#F1DC2B>gulma</color> itu, mereka tetap tumbuh kembali.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_005
Array.english: If I pulled them all out at once, they wouldn't have roots to grow back from...
Array.indonesia: Kalau aku mencabut semuanya sekaligus, mereka tidak akan punya akar untuk tumbuh kembali...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_006
Array.english: <size=33>But I've been at it all day, and my back's killing me.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tapi aku sudah mengerjakannya sepanjang hari, dan punggungku sakit sekali.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_007
Array.english: So, outsider.\nHow about helping out for once?
Array.indonesia: Jadi, orang luar.\nBagaimana kalau sekali-sekali kamu membantu?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_008
Array.english: <size=33>How about you cut some of these <color=#F1DC2B>Weeds</color></size>?
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Bagaimana kalau kamu memotong beberapa <color=#F1DC2B>gulma</color></size> ini?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_009
Array.english: <size=33>Huh? Me...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hah? Aku...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_010
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(What should I do...? Should I help him clear out the weeds?)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Apa yang harus aku lakukan...? Haruskah aku membantunya membersihkan rumput liar?)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_option01
Array.english: I'll help
Array.indonesia: Aku akan membantu

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_option02
Array.english: I'll help later
Array.indonesia: Aku akan membantu nanti

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_Yes_001
Array.english: Sure, I'll help.\nWhat do I need to do?
Array.indonesia: Tentu, aku akan membantu.\nApa yang harus aku lakukan?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_Yes_002
Array.english: Ooh... finally making yourself useful, huh.
Array.indonesia: Wah... akhirnya kamu mulai berguna, ya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_Yes_003
Array.english: You gotta pull all the <color=#F1DC2B>Weeds</color> you see here.
Array.indonesia: Kamu harus mencabut semua <color=#F1DC2B>gulma</color> yang kamu lihat di sini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_Yes_004
Array.english: But some of them are long... You'll need to wiggle those a bit to make 'em easier to pull.
Array.indonesia: Tapi ada yang panjang-panjang... Kamu perlu menggerak-gerakkan sedikit agar lebih mudah dicabut.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_Yes_005
Array.english: Well, you'll get the hang of it once you try.\nAnd there's one more thing to watch out for...
Array.indonesia: Nah, kamu bakal ngerti caranya begitu kamu coba.\nDan ada satu hal lagi yang harus diperhatikan...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_Yes_006
Array.english: The weeds in this garden grow crazy fast. If you take too long, the ones you pulled will grow back.
Array.indonesia: Gulma di kebun ini tumbuh sangat cepat. Kalau kamu terlalu lama, yang sudah kamu cabut bakal tumbuh lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_Yes_007
Array.english: <size=33>So stay focused and get it done right!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Jadi, tetap fokus dan selesaikan dengan benar!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_No_001
Array.english: Hmm... I'm a bit busy right now. Can I come back later and help?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Aku agak sibuk sekarang. Bolehkah aku kembali nanti untuk membantu?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_No_002
Array.english: <size=33>Ha! If you don't wanna help, just say so. All these excuses!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ha! Kalau kamu nggak mau bantu, bilang aja. Banyak banget alasannya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_No_003
Array.english: <size=32>Gonna take a while for my back to heal... I'll be watchin' to see if you come back.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Butuh waktu lama buat punggungku sembuh... Aku bakal nungguin kamu balik.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_Retry_001
Array.english: <size=32>Ugh... these damn weeds...\nWhy do they grow so fast...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ugh... rumput liar sialan ini...\nKenapa tumbuh secepat itu...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_Retry_002
Array.english: <size=32>Huh? Changed your mind?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hah? Berubah pikiran?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunEnd_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh...? You got rid of all the weeds?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh...? Kamu sudah membasmi semua rumput liar itu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunEnd_002
Array.english: Phew... I was rushing to pull them all out before they grew back. I'm outta breath.
Array.indonesia: Fiuh... Aku buru-buru mencabut semuanya sebelum tumbuh lagi. Aku kehabisan napas.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunEnd_003
Array.english: Ha! Good work!\nHere, have a glass of coconut juice.
Array.indonesia: Ha! Kerja bagus!\nIni, minum segelas air kelapa.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunEnd_004
Array.english: (Gulp... gulp...)
Array.indonesia: (Gulp... gulp...)

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunEnd_005
Array.english: <size=34>Wow! That was delicious! I feel totally refreshed!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wow! Itu enak sekali! Aku merasa segar banget!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunEnd_006
Array.english: Ha! My farm's coconuts are the best.
Array.indonesia: Ha! Kelapa dari kebunku yang terbaik.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunEnd_007
Array.english: Oh, about that garden...
Array.indonesia: Oh, soal kebun itu...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunEnd_008
Array.english: <size=33>I'm thinkin' of planting some crops there.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku lagi mikir buat menanam beberapa tanaman di sana.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunEnd_009
Array.english: Crops grow crazy fast here... so if I plant fruits and vegetables, they'll be huge in no time!
Array.indonesia: Tanaman tumbuh super cepat di sini... jadi kalau aku menanam buah dan sayuran, mereka bakal jadi besar dalam sekejap!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunEnd_010
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... that's a great idea!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... itu ide yang bagus!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunEnd_011
Array.english: <size=31>Ha! Should be mostly ready by tomorrow, so swing by if you're curious!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Ha! Seharusnya sudah hampir siap besok, jadi mampir saja kalau kamu penasaran!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunStart_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ugh... those damn things...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ugh... makhluk-makhluk sialan itu...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunStart_002
Array.english: Huh? The farm's a mess?
Array.indonesia: Hah? Kebunnya berantakan?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunStart_003
Array.english: <size=33>A whole bunch of <color=#F1DC2B>Macaques</color> came in last night and tore the whole place up!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Sekelompok <color=#F1DC2B>monyet</color> datang tadi malam dan mengacaukan seluruh tempat ini!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunStart_004
Array.english: <size=32>The crops grew just like I expected... but those damn <color=#F1DC2B>Macaques</color> went and snatched them all!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tanaman-tanaman itu tumbuh persis seperti yang kuduga... tapi <color=#F1DC2B>monyet</color> sialan itu malah mencuri semuanya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunStart_005
Array.english: They only pull this at night when everyone's asleep...\nso it's hard to get help in time...
Array.indonesia: Mereka cuma ngelakuin ini di malam hari pas semua orang lagi tidur...\njadi susah banget dapet bantuan tepat waktu...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunStart_006
Array.english: <size=32>Hey, you!\nHow about helpin' me drive off those <color=#F1DC2B>Monkeys</color>!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hei, kamu!\nGimana kalau bantu aku mengusir <color=#F1DC2B>Monyet-monyet</color> itu!?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunStart_007
Array.english: <size=32>Huh? Me...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hah? Aku...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunStart_008
Array.english: <size=32>Yeah! Instead of just mooching off the village, do something useful for once!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Iya! Daripada cuma numpang hidup di desa, lakukan sesuatu yang berguna sekali-sekali!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunStart_009
Array.english: Uhm... alright.\nWhat should I do?
Array.indonesia: Uhm... oke.\nApa yang harus aku lakukan?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunStart_010
Array.english: <size=34>Come back this evening!\nWe'll talk then!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kembalilah malam ini!\nKita akan membicarakannya nanti!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_DaveGotoJepun_001
Array.english: Jepun asked me to get rid of those <color=#F1DC2B>Monkeys</color>.
Array.indonesia: Jepun memintaku untuk mengusir <color=#F1DC2B>monyet-monyet</color> itu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_DaveGotoJepun_002
Array.english: <size=32>I should head over to Jepun's farm.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku harus pergi ke kebun Jepun.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunNight_001
Array.english: <size=35>Hey...! What took you so long?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Hei...! Kenapa lama sekali?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunNight_002
Array.english: Ah... sorry.\nI came straight here after closing the shop...
Array.indonesia: Ah... maaf.\nAku langsung ke sini setelah menutup toko...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunNight_003
Array.english: <size=34>Those damn monkeys already made off with the <color=#1DFEAF>Dragon Fruits</color> I harvested!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Monyet-monyet sialan itu sudah mencuri <color=#1DFEAF>Buah Naga</color> yang aku panen!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunNight_004
Array.english: I gotta stay here and protect what's left...
Array.indonesia: Aku harus tetap di sini dan melindungi yang tersisa...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunNight_005
Array.english: <size=32>You go get those dragon fruits back from the Monkeys, brat!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kamu pergi ambil kembali buah naga itu dari monyet-monyet itu, bocah!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunNight_006
Array.english: ...Alright, fine.\nWhat do I need to do?
Array.indonesia: ...Baiklah, terserah.\nApa yang harus aku lakukan?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunNight_007
Array.english: Those bastards took about 10 <color=#1DFEAF>Dragon Fruits</color>.
Array.indonesia: Bajingan-bajingan itu mengambil sekitar 10 <color=#1DFEAF>Buah Naga</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunNight_008
Array.english: <size=33>Grab a broom and teach those Monkeys a lesson!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ambil sapu dan beri pelajaran pada monyet-monyet itu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunNight_009
Array.english: They'll drop the <color=#1DFEAF>Dragon Fruits</color>, and you grab 'em!
Array.indonesia: Mereka akan menjatuhkan <color=#1DFEAF>Buah Naga</color>, dan kamu ambil saja!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunNight_010
Array.english: The <color=#F1DC2B>Monkeys</color> are running all over the place,\nor hiding somewhere.
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Monyet-monyet</color> itu berlari ke sana-sini,\natau bersembunyi di suatu tempat.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunNight_011
Array.english: <size=34>Get those <color=#1DFEAF>Dragon Fruits</color> back before they get too far!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ambil kembali <color=#1DFEAF>Buah Naga</color> itu sebelum mereka pergi terlalu jauh!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunNight02_001
Array.english: <size=34>Aaah!! Look, a whole group of <color=#F1DC2B>Monkeys</color> just showed up...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aaah!! Lihat, sekelompok <color=#F1DC2B>Monyet</color> baru saja muncul...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunNight02_002
Array.english: <size=33>Oh...! You're right...! There's a lot of them...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh...! Kamu benar...! Jumlahnya banyak sekali...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunNight02_003
Array.english: <size=32>Ha! Like I said, go teach them a lesson!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ha! Seperti yang kukatakan, ajari mereka pelajaran!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunEnd_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ha! Nice work!\nThose monkeys... they've all backed off!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ha! Kerja bagus!\nMonyet-monyet itu... mereka semua sudah mundur!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunEnd_002
Array.english: Whew... those things are fast.
Array.indonesia: Wah... makhluk-makhluk itu cepat sekali.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunEnd_003
Array.english: Still, after that, they won't dare come back anytime soon! \nGood work.
Array.indonesia: Meski begitu, setelah itu, mereka nggak akan berani balik lagi dalam waktu dekat! \nKerja bagus.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunEnd_004
Array.english: It's not much of a reward, but...
Array.indonesia: Ini memang bukan hadiah yang sepadan, tapi...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunEnd_005
Array.english: <size=33>Why don't you have this <color=#1DFEAF>Garden</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kenapa kamu nggak punya <color=#1DFEAF>Taman</color> ini?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunEnd_006
Array.english: <size=33>Huh...? Me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hah...? Aku?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunEnd_007
Array.english: I've already got my hands full with coconuts and papayas.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah sibuk dengan kelapa dan pepaya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunEnd_008
Array.english: Besides dragon fruits, I've got all kinds of seeds...\nHow about you plant and grow them?
Array.indonesia: Selain buah naga, aku punya berbagai macam benih...\nBagaimana kalau kamu yang menanam dan merawatnya?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunEnd_009
Array.english: I gotta clean up the mess those monkeys made...
Array.indonesia: Aku harus membersihkan kekacauan yang dibuat monyet-monyet itu...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunEnd_010
Array.english: Stop by again tomorrow.\nI'll explain everything then.
Array.indonesia: Mampir lagi besok.\nAku akan menjelaskan semuanya nanti.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunEnd_011
Array.english: Okay, got it. See you tomorrow.
Array.indonesia: Oke, paham. Sampai jumpa besok.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_Barricade01_001
Array.english: <size=32>The monkeys couldn't have gone this far...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Monyet-monyet itu tidak mungkin pergi sejauh ini...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_Barricade02_001
Array.english: <size=32>The monkeys wouldn't have gone inside the tent...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Monyet-monyet itu tidak mungkin masuk ke dalam tenda...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_Barricade03_001
Array.english: <size=32>There are people around...\nthey wouldn't have gone into the house.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ada orang di sekitar sini...\nmereka tidak mungkin masuk ke dalam rumah.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_DaveSleepy_001
Array.english: Phew... running around's left me worn out...
Array.indonesia: Wah... berlari-lari tadi membuatku kelelahan...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_DaveSleepy_002
Array.english: I'll have a quick look around, then turn in.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan melihat-lihat sebentar, lalu tidur.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunReward_001
Array.english: <size=32>Ha! So you're here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ha! Jadi kamu di sini.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunReward_002
Array.english: Like I said, plants grow unusually fast in this <color=#1DFEAF>Garden</color>.
Array.indonesia: Seperti yang kukatakan, tanaman tumbuh sangat cepat di <color=#1DFEAF>Taman</color> ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunReward_003
Array.english: If you plant crops here, you'll be able to harvest them in no time.
Array.indonesia: Jika kamu menanam tanaman di sini, kamu bisa memanennya dalam waktu singkat.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunReward_004
Array.english: But... I still need to deliver coconuts and papayas to your shop...
Array.indonesia: Tapi... aku masih harus mengantarkan kelapa dan pepaya ke tokomu...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunReward_005
Array.english: <size=32>so it's hard for me to plant and harvest here often.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>jadi sulit bagiku untuk sering menanam dan memanen di sini.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunReward_006
Array.english: That's why I figured you could plant and grow them yourself and use them at the shop!
Array.indonesia: Itulah mengapa aku berpikir kamu bisa menanam dan membesarkannya sendiri, lalu menggunakannya di toko!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunReward_007
Array.english: Oh... that sounds like a good idea.
Array.indonesia: Oh... kedengarannya ide yang bagus.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunReward_008
Array.english: But how do I get <color=#F1DC2B>seeds</color>?
Array.indonesia: Tapi bagaimana cara mendapatkan <color=#F1DC2B>benih</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunReward_009
Array.english: Well... you might find some lying around...\nbut I've got some <color=#F1DC2B>Seeds</color> and <color=#F1DC2B>Fertilizer</color> on me.
Array.indonesia: Nah... mungkin kamu bisa menemukan beberapa yang berserakan...\ntapi aku punya beberapa <color=#F1DC2B>Benih</color> dan <color=#F1DC2B>Pupuk</color> di sini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunReward_010
Array.english: <size=32>I'll give you some <color=#1DFEAF>Dragon Fruit</color> seeds, so go ahead and try it out!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku akan memberimu beberapa <color=#1DFEAF>biji Buah Naga</color>, jadi silakan dicoba!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunReward_011
Array.english: If you need other <color=#F1DC2B>Seeds</color>, just let me know.\nI'll sell you what I've got on hand.
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu butuh <color=#F1DC2B>biji</color> lainnya, bilang saja.\nAku akan menjual apa yang aku punya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunReward_012
Array.english: Things grow so fast here that seeds spoil quickly,\nso what I have changes from time to time.
Array.indonesia: Tanaman di sini tumbuh begitu cepat sehingga benih cepat busuk,\njadi apa yang saya miliki berubah dari waktu ke waktu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunReward_013
Array.english: And you can also gather materials you don't need and turn them into <color=#F1DC2B>Fertilizer</color>.
Array.indonesia: Kamu juga bisa mengumpulkan bahan-bahan yang tidak kamu butuhkan dan mengubahnya menjadi <color=#F1DC2B>Pupuk</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunReward_014
Array.english: Use <color=#F1DC2B>Fertilizer</color> to grow things faster and harvest even more!
Array.indonesia: Gunakan <color=#F1DC2B>Pupuk</color> untuk menumbuhkan tanaman lebih cepat dan memanen hasil yang lebih banyak lagi!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunReward_015
Array.english: Hmm... a mysterious <color=#F1DC2B>Garden</color> where everything grows fast...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... sebuah <color=#F1DC2B>Taman</color> misterius di mana segala sesuatu tumbuh dengan cepat...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunReward_016
Array.english: <size=32>Got it! I'll give it a shot!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oke! Aku akan mencobanya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Start_001
Array.english: Wow... you've caught quite a few fish, haven't you?
Array.indonesia: Wah... kamu sudah menangkap cukup banyak ikan, ya?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Start_002
Array.english: I got a notification about a new rare card activation... Let's see...
Array.indonesia: Aku mendapat pemberitahuan tentang aktivasi kartu langka baru... Coba kita lihat...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Start_003
Array.english: <size=34>Whoa! Is this... a <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color>!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wah! Apakah ini... seekor <color=#F1DC2B>kura-kura penggigit</color>!?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Start_004
Array.english: Huh? <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtles</color> aren't native to this region, though. That's strange.
Array.indonesia: Hah? <color=#F1DC2B>Kura-kura penggigit</color> bukan hewan asli daerah ini. Aneh sekali.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Start_005
Array.english: Hmm... but the chances of the World Marinca Association making a mistake are very slim.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... tapi kemungkinan Asosiasi Marinca Dunia melakukan kesalahan sangat kecil.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Start_006
Array.english: How about asking the locals around here what's going on?
Array.indonesia: Bagaimana kalau kita tanya penduduk setempat di sekitar sini apa yang sedang terjadi?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Start_007
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... who would know...?)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... siapa yang tahu...?)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Start_008
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(I guess Chief <color=#F1DC2B>Panutah</color>, who knows the village well...\nand Mr. <color=#F1DC2B>Basu</color>, who fishes a lot, might know.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Mungkin Kepala Desa <color=#F1DC2B>Panutah</color>, yang sangat mengenal desa ini...\ndan Pak <color=#F1DC2B>Basu</color>, yang sering memancing, mungkin tahu.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskBasu_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hmm? A <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color>...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hmm? Seekor <color=#F1DC2B>kura-kura penggigit</color>...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskBasu_002
Array.english: Well now... I dunno...
Array.indonesia: Nah, sekarang... Aku nggak tahu...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskBasu_003
Array.english:
But now that I think about it... 
I was fishin' before, and I caught a fish...
Array.indonesia:
Tapi sekarang kalau dipikir-pikir... 
Tadi aku lagi memancing, dan aku menangkap seekor ikan...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskBasu_004
Array.english: <size=32>and then this real long neck shot out and snatched my fish right up!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>lalu leher yang sangat panjang itu muncul tiba-tiba dan langsung merebut ikanku!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskBasu_005
Array.english: Back then I thought I'd seen a ghost or somethin'...
Array.indonesia: Waktu itu aku kira aku melihat hantu atau semacamnya...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskBasu_006
Array.english: <size=32>but come to think of it, its face looked like a turtle!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>tapi kalau dipikir-pikir lagi, wajahnya mirip kura-kura!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskBasu_007
Array.english: Maybe that was a <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color>, I reckon.\nThere ain't no turtles in this lake, ya see.
Array.indonesia: Mungkin itu <color=#F1DC2B>kura-kura penggigit</color>, menurutku.\nSoalnya, nggak ada kura-kura di danau ini, lho.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskBasu_008
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... a turtle with a really long neck...\nThat sounds like a <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color>...?)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... kura-kura dengan leher yang sangat panjang... \nItu terdengar seperti <color=#F1DC2B>kura-kura snapping</color>...?)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskPanuta_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hmm...? A <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color>...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hmm...? Seekor <color=#F1DC2B>kura-kura snapping</color>...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskPanuta_002
Array.english: Ah, you mean the one with the pointy shell and long neck?
Array.indonesia: Ah, maksudmu yang cangkangnya runcing dan lehernya panjang?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskPanuta_003
Array.english: Yes, that's right. That kind of turtle.
Array.indonesia: Ya, benar. Kura-kura jenis itu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskPanuta_004
Array.english: Tsk... must be that turtle the TV crew brought here back then.
Array.indonesia: Ck... pasti itu kura-kura yang dibawa kru TV ke sini dulu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskPanuta_005
Array.english: What...? A TV crew?
Array.indonesia: Apa...? Kru TV?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskPanuta_006
Array.english: That's right. About 10 years ago... \nthey came to the village to film a survival show.
Array.indonesia: Benar. Sekitar 10 tahun yang lalu... \nmereka datang ke desa ini untuk syuting acara bertahan hidup.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskPanuta_007
Array.english: They'd pretend to starve, then eat catered food when the cameras were off...
Array.indonesia: Mereka pura-pura kelaparan, lalu makan makanan yang disediakan saat kamera dimatikan...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskPanuta_008
Array.english: They even brought in animals that don't belong here just for the show.
Array.indonesia: Mereka bahkan membawa hewan-hewan yang bukan asli sini hanya untuk acara itu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskPanuta_009
Array.english: And when filming wrapped, they just left without cleaning up!
Array.indonesia: Dan setelah syuting selesai, mereka pergi begitu saja tanpa membersihkan apa pun!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskPanuta_010
Array.english: The <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color> they brought for that biting scene...
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Kura-kura penggigit</color> yang mereka bawa untuk adegan gigitan itu...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskPanuta_011
Array.english: <size=32>They must've just left it behind too.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Mereka pasti juga meninggalkannya begitu saja.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskPanuta_012
Array.english: I figured there was no way it could survive this long in this environment...
Array.indonesia: Aku pikir mustahil kura-kura itu bisa bertahan selama ini di lingkungan ini...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskPanuta_013
Array.english: But Basu said he spotted a huge turtle recently... and there have been dead fish with strange bite marks...
Array.indonesia: Tapi Basu bilang dia baru-baru ini melihat seekor kura-kura raksasa... dan ada ikan mati dengan bekas gigitan yang aneh...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskPanuta_014
Array.english: <size=32>Don't tell me it's really in this lake? \nThat could be disastrous for the local wildlife.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Jangan bilang kura-kura itu benar-benar ada di danau ini? \nItu bisa menjadi bencana bagi satwa liar setempat.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskPanuta_015
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(A <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color> abandoned by a TV crew 10 years ago... Could it really have survived this long...?)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Seekor <color=#F1DC2B>kura-kura snapping</color> yang ditinggalkan oleh kru TV 10 tahun lalu... Mungkinkah ia benar-benar bisa bertahan selama ini...?)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskEnd_001
Array.english: Alright. I think I've got enough info on the <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color>.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah. Sepertinya aku sudah cukup mendapat info tentang <color=#F1DC2B>kura-kura penggigit</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskEnd_002
Array.english: <size=33>Let's go tell Sato.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ayo kita beri tahu Sato.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_ReportSato_001
Array.english: I looked into it... and it seems a <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color> left behind by a TV crew years ago has been living here.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah menyelidikinya... dan sepertinya <color=#F1DC2B>kura-kura penggigit</color> yang ditinggalkan oleh kru TV bertahun-tahun lalu telah tinggal di sini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_ReportSato_002
Array.english: But... I heard it's gotten pretty big.
Array.indonesia: Tapi... aku dengar ukurannya sudah cukup besar.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_ReportSato_003
Array.english: Some people even saw it catching fish in the lake.
Array.indonesia: Beberapa orang bahkan melihatnya menangkap ikan di danau.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_ReportSato_004
Array.english: So that's what happened...! \nNo wonder there's a species here that doesn't belong.
Array.indonesia: Jadi begitulah yang terjadi...! \nTak heran ada spesies yang tidak seharusnya ada di sini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_ReportSato_005
Array.english: Meanwhile... I did some research while you were investigating.
Array.indonesia: Sementara itu... Aku melakukan riset saat kamu sedang menyelidiki.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_ReportSato_006
Array.english: This <color=#F1DC2B>Digital Monster Radar</color>...\nor DMR for short, can show its approximate location.
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Radar Monster Digital</color> ini...\natau disingkat DMR, bisa menunjukkan perkiraan lokasinya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_ReportSato_007
Array.english: <size=32>It's showing a turtle-shaped signal at a <color=#1DFEAF>Depth of 60m on the Left Side</color> of the lake.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Radar ini menunjukkan sinyal berbentuk kura-kura pada <color=#1DFEAF>kedalaman 60 m di sisi kiri</color> danau.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_ReportSato_008
Array.english: The villagers seem to be having trouble because of it...
Array.indonesia: Penduduk desa tampaknya mengalami kesulitan karena hal itu...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_ReportSato_009
Array.english: <size=35>How about you go catch it for us?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Bagaimana kalau kamu yang menangkapnya untuk kita?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_ReportSato_010
Array.english: <size=33>...Isn't this just to fill your Marinca collection?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...Isn bukankah ini hanya untuk melengkapi koleksi Marinca-mu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_ReportSato_011
Array.english: ...Well, there is that added bonus, haha.
Array.indonesia: ...Yah, memang ada bonus tambahan itu, haha.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_ReportSato_012
Array.english: I've set it to show a <color=#F1DC2B>Yellow Signal</color> at the suspected location, so follow it when you see it.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah mengaturnya agar menampilkan <color=#F1DC2B>Sinyal Kuning</color> di lokasi yang diduga, jadi ikuti sinyal itu saat kamu melihatnya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_ReportSato_013
Array.english: It can do that too...?
Array.indonesia: Dia bisa melakukan itu juga...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_ReportSato_014
Array.english: Got it. Well... catching one turtle shouldn't be a problem.
Array.indonesia: Oke. Yah... menangkap satu kura-kura seharusnya tidak jadi masalah.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_ReportSato_015
Array.english: <color=#1DFEAF>Left Side, 60m Deep</color>, right?\nI'll go check it out.
Array.indonesia: <color=#1DFEAF>Sisi Kiri, Kedalaman 60 m</color>, kan?\nAku akan memeriksanya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_EntranceBlocked01_001
Array.english: <size=32>The signal's coming from here...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Sinyalnya berasal dari sini...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_EntranceBlocked01_002
Array.english: Could there be a <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color> inside...?
Array.indonesia: Mungkinkah ada <color=#F1DC2B>kura-kura penggigit</color> di dalamnya...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_EntranceBlocked01_003
Array.english: I should cut through these roots.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus memotong akar-akar ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_EntranceBlocked02_001
Array.english: Hmm... these roots are pretty thick...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... akar-akar ini cukup tebal...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_EntranceBlocked02_002
Array.english: My <color=#F1DC2B>Machete</color> isn't sharp enough to cut them right now.
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Parang</color>-ku tidak cukup tajam untuk memotongnya sekarang.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_EntranceBlocked02_003
Array.english: I should head back up first.
Array.indonesia: Sebaiknya aku kembali ke atas dulu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_EntranceBlocked03_001
Array.english: <size=33>Whoa...!? What was that...!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wah...!? Apa itu tadi. ..!?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_EntranceBlocked03_002
Array.english: <size=32>...That was way too strong to be just a turtle...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>...That itu terlalu kuat untuk sekadar seekor kura-kura...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_EntranceBlocked03_003
Array.english: <size=32>...Don't tell me there are other creatures in there too...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>...Don't bilang ada makhluk lain di sana juga...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_TurtleReportSato_001
Array.english: I found where the <color=#F1DC2B>snapping turtle</color> is...
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah menemukan di mana <color=#F1DC2B>kura-kura penggigit</color> itu berada...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_TurtleReportSato_002
Array.english: <size=32>But it's absolutely massive...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tapi ukurannya benar-benar raksasa...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_TurtleReportSato_003
Array.english: Ha! All the more reason we need to catch it for the villagers! We have to protect this beautiful village!
Array.indonesia: Ha! Justru itu alasan kita harus menangkapnya demi para penduduk desa! Kita harus melindungi desa yang indah ini!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_TurtleReportSato_004
Array.english: Hmm... but to get deeper inside, I need to cut through some thick roots...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... tapi untuk masuk lebih dalam, aku harus memotong beberapa akar yang tebal...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_TurtleReportSato_005
Array.english: My <color=#F1DC2B>Machete</color> is too dull. No way I can cut them.
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Parang</color>-ku terlalu tumpul. Tidak mungkin aku bisa memotongnya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_TurtleReportSato_006
Array.english: I see... If there's someone in the village who's good with tools, they might be able to help...
Array.indonesia: Begitu... Kalau ada orang di desa yang jago menggunakan perkakas, mungkin dia bisa membantu...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_TurtleReportSato_007
Array.english: Come to think of it, <color=#F1DC2B>Perak</color> might be able to help with the machete.
Array.indonesia: Kalau dipikir-pikir, <color=#F1DC2B>Perak</color> mungkin bisa membantu dengan parangnya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_TurtleReportSato_008
Array.english: Looks like there's someone who could use a hand.\nGo on then, take a look.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya ada seseorang yang butuh bantuan.\nAyo, coba lihat.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_TalkToPerak_001
Array.english: Hmm? You want me to sharpen your <color=#F1DC2B>Machete</color> even more?
Array.indonesia: Hmm? Kamu mau aku mengasah <color=#F1DC2B>parang</color>-mu sampai lebih tajam lagi?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_TalkToPerak_002
Array.english: Hmm... from what I can tell, it's already pretty sharp...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... menurutku, ini sudah cukup tajam...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_TalkToPerak_003
Array.english: Of course, I can make it even sharper.
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja, aku bisa membuatnya lebih tajam lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_TalkToPerak_004
Array.english: <size=33>If I had that whetstone...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kalau saja aku punya batu asah itu...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_TalkToPerak_005
Array.english: <size=32>That... whetstone?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Batu... asah itu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_TalkToPerak_006
Array.english: Yes. It's made from a rare, pure white <color=#F1DC2B>Deep-Sea Ore</color> found in the sea beneath the lake.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Batu asah itu terbuat dari <color=#F1DC2B>Bijih Laut Dalam</color> yang langka dan berwarna putih murni, yang ditemukan di laut di bawah danau.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_TalkToPerak_007
Array.english: My father passed it down to me... \nbut it's worn down over time and can't be used anymore.
Array.indonesia: Ayahku mewariskannya kepadaku... \ntapi batu asah itu sudah aus seiring waktu dan tidak bisa digunakan lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_TalkToPerak_008
Array.english: I see. I can dive down there now, so I'll bring it back if I find it.
Array.indonesia: Begitu. Aku bisa menyelam ke sana sekarang, jadi aku akan membawanya kembali jika menemukannya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_TalkToPerak_009
Array.english: Oh... I'd already given up on it...\nIf you can find it, I'd really appreciate it.
Array.indonesia: Oh... Aku sudah putus asa...\nKalau kamu bisa menemukannya, aku akan sangat berterima kasih.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_FindDeepSeaStone_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... could that white stone be the <color=#F1DC2B>Deep-Sea Ore</color> Perak mentioned...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... apakah batu putih itu adalah <color=#F1DC2B>Bijih Laut Dalam</color> yang disebutkan Perak...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_FindDeepSeaStone_002
Array.english: <size=32>I bet I can mine it with a pickaxe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku yakin bisa menambangnya dengan beliung.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_PickDeepSeaStone_001
Array.english: <size=35>Alright, I got the <color=#F1DC2B>Deep-Sea Ore</color>.\nLet's take it to Perak!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Baiklah, aku sudah mendapatkan <color=#F1DC2B>Bijih Laut Dalam</color>.\nAyo kita bawa ke Perak!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_SeaStoneToPerak01_001
Array.english: Here... I found this <color=#F1DC2B>Deep-Sea Ore</color> in the sea beneath the lake. Is this it?
Array.indonesia: Ini... Aku menemukan <color=#F1DC2B>Bijih Laut Dalam</color> ini di laut di bawah danau. Apakah ini yang dimaksud?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_SeaStoneToPerak01_002
Array.english: Oh... yes, it is. This white, solid texture... It's the same material as the whetstone my father passed down!
Array.indonesia: Oh... ya, benar. Tekstur putih dan padat ini... Bahan ini sama dengan batu asah yang diwariskan ayahku!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_SeaStoneToPerak01_003
Array.english: Give me a moment.\nI'll sharpen your machete.
Array.indonesia: Tunggu sebentar.\nAku akan mengasah parangmu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_SeaStoneToPerak02_001
Array.english: Here you go.\nThis should be enough to cut even thick roots.
Array.indonesia: Ini dia.\nIni seharusnya cukup untuk memotong akar yang tebal sekalipun.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_SeaStoneToPerak02_002
Array.english: Oh... thank you!
Array.indonesia: Oh... terima kasih!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_SeaStoneToPerak02_003
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Alright, I should head back down to where the <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color> is.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Baiklah, aku harus kembali ke tempat <color=#F1DC2B>kura-kura penggigit</color> itu berada.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_BeforeMacheteSato_001
Array.english: Are you looking for a way to sharpen your <color=#F1DC2B>Machete</color>?
Array.indonesia: Apakah kamu sedang mencari cara untuk mengasah <color=#F1DC2B>parang</color>-mu?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_BeforeMacheteSato_002
Array.english: It'd be great if someone in the village could help.
Array.indonesia: Akan sangat bagus jika ada orang di desa yang bisa membantu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AfterMacheteSato_001
Array.english: I managed to sharpen my <color=#F1DC2B>Machete</color> with some help from the villagers.
Array.indonesia: Aku berhasil mengasah <color=#F1DC2B>parang</color>-ku dengan bantuan penduduk desa.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AfterMacheteSato_002
Array.english: <size=32>Wow... excellent!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wah... hebat!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AfterMacheteSato_003
Array.english: ...Then I'll leave the <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color>...\nin your hands.
Array.indonesia: ...Kalau begitu, aku serahkan <color=#F1DC2B>kura-kura penggigit</color>...\nitu kepadamu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_EntranceReturn_001
Array.english: <size=32>There's a <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color> in here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ada seekor <color=#F1DC2B>kura-kura penggigit</color> di sini.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_EntranceReturn_002
Array.english: <size=32>Let's try cutting these roots with the <color=#F1DC2B>Machete</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ayo coba potong akar-akar ini dengan <color=#F1DC2B>parang</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_EntranceOpen_001
Array.english: <size=32>Alright! It's definitely cutting well!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oke! Ini benar-benar memotong dengan baik!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_EntranceOpen_002
Array.english: <size=32>So... should I go deeper...?\nI've got a bad feeling about this...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Jadi... haruskah aku masuk lebih dalam...?\nAku punya firasat buruk soal ini...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_EntranceOpen_003
Array.english: <size=32>Well, how big can a turtle really get?\nBetter catch it quick!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Yah, seberapa besar sih kura-kura bisa tumbuh?\nLebih baik tangkap saja secepatnya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_BossEncounter_001
Array.english: <size=34>Whoa!! It got this big...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wah!! Ternyata sebesar ini...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_BossBattleStart_001
Array.english: <size=34>...Its neck... stretched out so far...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Leher ...Itu... memanjang sejauh ini...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_BossBattleStart_002
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm... I don't think I can just catch it and leave...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm... kurasa aku tidak bisa begitu saja menangkapnya lalu pergi...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_BossBattleStart_003
Array.english: <size=32>And... it looks pretty angry...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Dan... kelihatannya cukup marah...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_BossBattleStart_004
Array.english: <size=32>No choice. The villagers asked for this...\nI'll have to take it down!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Nggak ada pilihan. Penduduk desa yang minta ini...\nAku harus mengalahkannya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_BossEncounter_Fail_001
Array.english: Oh... I should've gone to the <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color>'s den...
Array.indonesia: Oh... Seharusnya aku pergi ke sarang <color=#F1DC2B>kura-kura penggigit</color>...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_BossEncounter_Fail_002
Array.english: <size=32>Let's not miss it next time.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Jangan sampai ketinggalan lagi lain kali.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_BattleComplete_Fail_001
Array.english: <size=32>That thing was seriously tough... I'll need to prepare better and try again.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Makhluk itu benar-benar tangguh... Aku harus bersiap lebih baik dan mencobanya lagi.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_BossEncounter_Retry_001
Array.english: <size=32>Seeing it again... it's still horrifying...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Melihatnya lagi... masih mengerikan...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_BossEncounter_Retry_002
Array.english: <size=32>It's been disrupting the ecosystem here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Makhluk itu telah mengganggu ekosistem di sini.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_BossEncounter_Retry_003
Array.english: <size=32>I have to take it down no matter what!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku harus menghabisinya apa pun yang terjadi!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_End_Looting_001
Array.english: Phew... what a bizarre turtle... It was like having a tiny nightmare.
Array.indonesia: Wah... kura-kura yang aneh sekali... Rasanya seperti mengalami mimpi buruk dalam skala kecil.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_End_Looting_002
Array.english: Before I leave...
Array.indonesia: Sebelum aku pergi...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_End_Looting_003
Array.english: I should check if there's anything I can take with me.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus memeriksa apakah ada sesuatu yang bisa kubawa.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_End_Looting_Barricade_001
Array.english: Before I leave, I should see if there's anything I can take from the <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color>.
Array.indonesia: Sebelum aku pergi, aku harus lihat apakah ada sesuatu yang bisa aku ambil dari <color=#F1DC2B>kura-kura penggigit</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_End_ReturnTown_001
Array.english: Alright. Let's head back up and tell Sato.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah. Ayo kita kembali ke atas dan beri tahu Sato.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Complete_001
Array.english: Sato, well...
Array.indonesia: Sato, nah...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Complete_002
Array.english: <size=34>Thanks!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Terima kasih!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Complete_003
Array.english: ...Huh? I haven't even said anything yet...
Array.indonesia: ...Hah? Aku bahkan belum mengatakan apa-apa...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=33>Woo! I got a notification on my <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color> right away!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Woo! Aku langsung mendapat notifikasi di <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color>-ku!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Complete_005
Array.english: A <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color> card... this is rare.
Array.indonesia: Kartu <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color>... ini langka.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Complete_006
Array.english: My Marinca collector ranking is gonna shoot up! Heh.
Array.indonesia: Peringkat kolektor Marinca-ku pasti akan melonjak! Heh.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Complete_007
Array.english: This village... I really like it here.
Array.indonesia: Desa ini... Aku benar-benar suka di sini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Complete_008
Array.english: Feels like I can collect a lot of rare cards here...
Array.indonesia: Rasanya aku bisa mengumpulkan banyak kartu langka di sini...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Complete_009
Array.english: <size=32>How about I stick around and help out?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Bagaimana kalau aku tinggal di sini dan membantu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Complete_010
Array.english: ...Huh? I mean, I'd appreciate the help, but...
Array.indonesia: ...Hah? Maksudku, aku menghargai bantuannya, tapi...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Complete_011
Array.english: Our research isn't just about fish, you know?
Array.indonesia: Penelitian kita bukan cuma soal ikan, lho?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Complete_012
Array.english: Haha. When it comes to researching fish, we're already partners!
Array.indonesia: Haha. Kalau soal meneliti ikan, kita sudah jadi mitra!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Complete_013
Array.english: Besides...\nI owe Bancho for the meals back at the Blue Hole.
Array.indonesia: Lagipula...\nAku berhutang budi pada Bancho atas makanan yang dia berikan di Blue Hole.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Complete_014
Array.english: He's still making amazing food here even with limited facilities.
Array.indonesia: Dia masih bisa membuat makanan yang luar biasa di sini meski fasilitasnya terbatas.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Complete_015
Array.english:
If there's anything I can help with at the restaurant,
I'd be happy to... What do you think?
Array.indonesia:
Kalau ada yang bisa aku bantu di restoran,
aku dengan senang hati... Gimana menurutmu?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Complete_016
Array.english: Oh... I'm sure Bancho would really appreciate that.
Array.indonesia: Oh... Aku yakin Bancho pasti akan sangat menghargainya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Complete_017
Array.english: Hehe. I won't be collecting Marinca much in the evenings anyway, so I can help out then.
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Lagipula, aku nggak akan sering mengumpulkan Marinca di malam hari, jadi aku bisa bantu saat itu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Complete_018
Array.english: Then just let me know whenever you need something.
Array.indonesia: Kalau begitu, beri tahu saja kalau kamu butuh sesuatu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Complete_019
Array.english: <size=34>...Monmon.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>...Monmon.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Jepun_Coconut_001
Array.english: <size=34>Hah... hah... so this is it...\nThe place the outsider's running.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hah... hah... jadi ini dia...\nTempat yang dikelola orang luar itu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Jepun_Coconut_002
Array.english: Oh, are you the farmer who supplies the coconuts and papayas?
Array.indonesia: Oh, apakah kamu petani yang memasok kelapa dan pepaya?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Jepun_Coconut_003
Array.english: <size=32>That's right. Name's <color=#F1DC2B>Jepun</color>.\nI run the farm up north.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Benar. Namaku <color=#F1DC2B>Jepun</color>.\nAku mengelola kebun di utara.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Jepun_Coconut_004
Array.english: Don't know what you're here for, but...
Array.indonesia: Aku nggak tahu apa tujuanmu ke sini, tapi...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Jepun_Coconut_005
Array.english: <size=33>You're probably here to tell us what we're missing compared to the city... then leave.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kamu mungkin ke sini buat ngasih tahu kita apa yang kita lewatkan dibanding di kota... terus pergi.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Jepun_Coconut_006
Array.english: Ah... no. That's not my intention at all...
Array.indonesia: Ah... tidak. Itu sama sekali bukan niatku...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Jepun_Coconut_007
Array.english: <size=33>The chief asked, so I'll deliver the crops.\nJust stay out of my way.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kepala desa yang meminta, jadi aku akan mengantarkan hasil panen ini.\nJangan menghalangi jalanku.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Jepun_Coconut_008
Array.english: And you'd better appreciate the premium coconuts.\nGrew them with my own blood and sweat.
Array.indonesia: Dan sebaiknya kamu menghargai kelapa premium ini.\nAku menanamnya dengan darah dan keringatku sendiri.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Jepun_Coconut02_001
Array.english: Um... he's pretty hostile.
Array.indonesia: Um... dia cukup bermusuhan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Jepun_Coconut02_002
Array.english: Just as the chief said, some villagers are wary of outsiders.
Array.indonesia: Seperti yang dikatakan kepala desa, beberapa penduduk desa waspada terhadap orang luar.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Jepun_Coconut02_003
Array.english: I guess not every outsider treats people here with respect...
Array.indonesia: Kurasa tidak semua orang luar memperlakukan orang-orang di sini dengan hormat...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Jepun_Coconut02_004
Array.english: Still, if we help them with what they need,\nwe might be able to bridge the gap.
Array.indonesia: Meski begitu, jika kita membantu mereka dengan apa yang mereka butuhkan,\nmungkin kita bisa menjembatani kesenjangan ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_WoodenStatue01_001
Array.english: A peculiar-looking statue.
Array.indonesia: Patung yang tampak aneh.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_WoodenStatue02_001
Array.english: It's a tall statue.\nMust've been tough to set up.
Array.indonesia: Itu patung yang tinggi.\nPasti susah banget pasangnya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_WoodenStatue03_001
Array.english: That's a scary-looking statue...
Array.indonesia: Patung itu kelihatan menyeramkan...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_WoodenStatue04_001
Array.english: It's a large face carving... I wonder if it's meant to be an ancestor of the village.
Array.indonesia: Itu ukiran wajah yang besar... Aku penasaran, apakah itu dimaksudkan sebagai leluhur desa.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_StoneMalayanTapir_001
Array.english: That long snout is unusual...\nWas it called a Malayan tapir?
Array.indonesia: Moncong panjangnya tidak biasa...\nApakah itu disebut tapir Malaya?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_WoodBear01_001
Array.english: It's a wooden bear. Nicely made.
Array.indonesia: Itu beruang kayu. Dibuat dengan rapi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_WoodBear_001
Array.english: It's a wooden bear...\nLooks nicely carved.
Array.indonesia: Itu beruang kayu...\nTerlihat diukir dengan rapi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_StoneStatues01_001
Array.english: What a cute statue.\nIs it supposed to be children?
Array.indonesia: Patung yang lucu sekali.\nApakah itu dimaksudkan sebagai anak-anak?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_StoneBear01_001
Array.english: I see a lot of bear statues.\nWhat could they mean?
Array.indonesia: Aku melihat banyak patung beruang.\nApa maknanya?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_StoneBear02_001
Array.english: Two bear statues. Could they be a couple...? Or siblings?
Array.indonesia: Dua patung beruang. Mungkinkah mereka sepasang...? Atau saudara kandung?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_Bench_Day_001
Array.english: <size=35>Maybe I should take a break...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Mungkin aku harus istirahat sebentar...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_Bench_Night_001
Array.english: At this hour, I'd better just rest at home.
Array.indonesia: Pada jam segini, lebih baik aku istirahat saja di rumah.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_KulKul_001
Array.english:
It's a giant wooden bell...
Wonder when they use it.
Array.indonesia:
Itu lonceng kayu raksasa...
Penasaran kapan mereka menggunakannya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_PapayaFarm_001
Array.english: Looks like they grow papayas and coconuts here.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya di sini mereka menanam pepaya dan kelapa.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_PapayaCart_001
Array.english: A ripe papaya...\nLooks good.
Array.indonesia: Pepaya matang...\nKelihatannya enak.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_CobraHammock_001
Array.english: Are you sleeping here, Cobra?\nSeems uncomfortable.
Array.indonesia: Kamu tidur di sini, Cobra?\nKelihatannya tidak nyaman.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_ChiefHouseShield_001
Array.english: Is this some kind of ancient shield?\nLooks pretty cool.
Array.indonesia: Apakah ini semacam perisai kuno?\nKelihatannya keren banget.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_LipahHouseFlowers_001
Array.english: It's so colorful and beautifully maintained...\nNice to see.
Array.indonesia: Warnanya begitu cerah dan terawat dengan indah...\nSenang melihatnya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_MunaTentStuff_001
Array.english: These tools are incredible! So this is what she used to make the Jungle Gun.
Array.indonesia: Alat-alat ini luar biasa! Jadi inilah yang dia gunakan untuk membuat Jungle Gun.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_BaconTentStuff_001
Array.english: Wow... research equipment.\nI Better not touch anything.
Array.indonesia: Wow... peralatan penelitian.\nSebaiknya aku tidak menyentuh apa pun.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_LassiMushrooms_001
Array.english: These must be the mushrooms Lathi grows.
Array.indonesia: Ini pasti jamur yang ditanam Lathi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_BasiloBaby_Day01_001
Array.english: That's a huge whale...\nWait, is it not a whale?
Array.indonesia: Itu paus yang sangat besar...\nTunggu, bukankah itu bukan paus?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_BasiloBaby_Day02_001
Array.english: Ugh... the stench is awful.\nIt's rotting.
Array.indonesia: Ugh... baunya mengerikan.\nItu sedang membusuk.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_BasiloBaby_Day04_001
Array.english: It's quite rotten.\nI can see all the way through it.
Array.indonesia: Sudah cukup membusuk.\nAku bisa melihat tembus ke dalamnya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_BasiloBaby_Day06_001
Array.english: Now there's only bones left. The bones look similar to a whale's.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang yang tersisa hanya tulang-tulang. Tulang-tulang itu mirip tulang paus.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_CobraDesk_001
Array.english: Just a notebook and beer...\nDidn't he pack way too light?
Array.indonesia: Hanya buku catatan dan bir...\nBukankah dia membawa barang terlalu sedikit?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_JepunHouse_Hearth_001
Array.english: A fire pit in the middle of the room...?\nIsn't that dangerous?
Array.indonesia: Lubang api di tengah ruangan...?\nBukankah itu berbahaya?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_LassiHouse_HerbDesk01_001
