Array.english: Looks like herbs are being dried here.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya ada ramuan yang sedang dikeringkan di sini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_LassiHouse_Mortar_001
Array.english: Looks like a mortar for grinding herbs.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya ini lesung untuk menggiling ramuan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_LassiHouse_HerbDesk02_001
Array.english: There are a lot of herbs I've never seen before.
Array.indonesia: Ada banyak ramuan yang belum pernah aku lihat sebelumnya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_LassiHouse_Incense_001
Array.english: This grass has a really refreshing scent.
Array.indonesia: Rumput ini memiliki aroma yang sangat menyegarkan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_BasuHouse_FishDesk_001
Array.english: That's a pretty cool wooden fish carving.
Array.indonesia: Ukiran ikan dari kayu itu cukup keren.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_BasuHouse_FishTool_001
Array.english: Huh... the fishing nets here look a bit different.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... jaring ikannya di sini terlihat agak berbeda.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_BasuHouse_FishingRod_001
Array.english: That's a pretty long fishing rod... Do you really need one that long to catch anything decent?
Array.indonesia: Itu pancing yang cukup panjang... Apa benar-benar perlu yang sepanjang itu untuk menangkap ikan yang layak?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_ChiefHouse_Fabric_001
Array.english: What a beautiful traditional cloth. I wonder if he wove it himself?
Array.indonesia: Kain tradisional yang sangat indah. Aku penasaran, apakah dia menenunnya sendiri?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_ChiefHouse_Desk01_001
Array.english: I smell alcohol...\nIs that a liquor bottle?
Array.indonesia: Aku mencium bau alkohol...\nApakah itu botol minuman keras?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_ChiefHouse_Bed01_001
Array.english: This must be where the village chief sleeps.\nIt's pretty modest.
Array.indonesia: Ini pasti tempat tidur kepala desa.\nCukup sederhana.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_ChiefHouse_Bed02_001
Array.english: This must be Uzme's bed.\nBetter not touch it.
Array.indonesia: Ini pasti tempat tidur Uzme.\nSebaiknya jangan disentuh.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_ChiefHouse_Flower_001
Array.english: Uzme must really love flowers.
Array.indonesia: Uzme pasti sangat menyukai bunga.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_ChiefHouse_Gamelan_001
Array.english: Looks like a traditional ornament from this region.\nThose horns are impressive.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya hiasan tradisional dari daerah ini.\nTanduk-tanduk itu mengesankan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_PenebHouse_WoodenStatue01_001
Array.english: Working indoors must kick up a lot of dust.
Array.indonesia: Bekerja di dalam ruangan pasti menimbulkan banyak debu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_PenebHouse_Tool_001
Array.english: That's a lot of tools.\nMust be tough working with one arm.
Array.indonesia: Banyak sekali perkakasnya.\nPasti sulit bekerja dengan satu tangan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_PenebHouse_Mask_001
Array.english: This mask would be pretty creepy at night.
Array.indonesia: Topeng ini pasti cukup menyeramkan di malam hari.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_PenebHouse_WoodenStatue02_001
Array.english: That's a huge face.\nI wonder who it's modeled after.
Array.indonesia: Wajahnya sangat besar.\nAku penasaran siapa yang menjadi modelnya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_BanchoHouse_CookTool01_001
Array.english: Bancho, you're at the cooking research even out here.
Array.indonesia: Bancho, kamu sedang melakukan penelitian masakan bahkan di sini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_BanchoHouse_PastPicture_001
Array.english: Must be from his younger days... Wow, such thick hair back then.
Array.indonesia: Pasti dari masa mudanya... Wah, rambutnya tebal sekali saat itu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_BanchoHouse_BookShelf_001
Array.english: That's a lot of cookbooks. Must've been heavy to bring all these.
Array.indonesia: Banyak sekali buku resep. Pasti berat membawa semuanya ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_BanchoHouse_Ingredients_001
Array.english: Looks like ingredients from this region are being studied.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya bahan-bahan dari daerah ini sedang diteliti.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_PerakHouse_KidToy_001
Array.english: There are a lot of toys.\nMust be kids around here.
Array.indonesia: Ada banyak mainan.\nPasti ada anak-anak di sekitar sini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_PerakHouse_Doodle_001
Array.english: Graffiti on the wall...\nThat'll be tough to clean off.
Array.indonesia: Coretan di dinding...\nPasti susah dibersihkan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_LipahHouse_lizardSculpture01_001
Array.english: This place is full of lizard-related stuff.
Array.indonesia: Tempat ini penuh dengan barang-barang yang berhubungan dengan kadal.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_LipahHouse_Terrarium_001
Array.english: Looks like enclosures for insects and lizards.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya kandang untuk serangga dan kadal.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_BaconHouse_Beer_001
Array.english: ...Drinking again yesterday?
Array.indonesia: ...Mabuk lagi kemarin?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_MunaHouse_Blueprint_001
Array.english: Complex formulas...\nNo idea what any of it means.
Array.indonesia: Rumus-rumus rumit...\nNggak ngerti artinya apa-apa.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_GesangChandraHouse_Club_001
Array.english: A club with a rope...? Probably for dealing with wild animals.
Array.indonesia: Tongkat dengan tali...? Mungkin buat menangani hewan liar.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_VillageTree_001
Array.english: That's a really old tree. Feels like it's protecting the village.
Array.indonesia: Itu pohon yang sangat tua. Rasanya seperti sedang melindungi desa ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_StandingBear_001
Array.english: A sculpture of a standing bear. Would be scary if it were real.
Array.indonesia: Patung beruang yang sedang berdiri. Pasti menakutkan kalau itu asli.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_PapayaFarm_Mango_001
Array.english: These mangoes look ripe...
Array.indonesia: Mangga-mangga ini kelihatannya sudah matang...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_Forest_Sign01_001
Array.english: Murau Temple
Array.indonesia: Kuil Murau

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_Forest_Sign02_001
Array.english: ↑ Murau Temple\n→ Small Pond
Array.indonesia: ↑ Kuil Murau\n→ Kolam Kecil

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_Forest_Sign03_001
Array.english: ← Swamp\n→ Murau Temple
Array.indonesia: ← Rawa\n→ Kuil Murau

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_BullSharkInVillage_001
Array.english: Whoa... something bit and killed a shark this big...\nLook at those bite marks...
Array.indonesia: Wah... ada sesuatu yang menggigit dan membunuh hiu sebesar ini...\nLihat bekas gigitannya...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_AfterEnding_Statue_Dave_001
Array.english: Having a wooden statue of myself right in front of the house feels a bit embarrassing...
Array.indonesia: Memiliki patung kayu diriku sendiri tepat di depan rumah terasa agak memalukan...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_AfterEnding_Statue_Dave_002
Array.english: But Peneb did a great job on it.
Array.indonesia: Tapi Peneb mengerjakannya dengan sangat baik.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_AfterEnding_Statue_Dave_003
Array.english: ...Though I wouldn't have minded if he'd made it a bit slimmer.
Array.indonesia: ...Meskipun aku tidak akan keberatan jika dia membuatnya sedikit lebih ramping.

Array.name: JDLC_InteractionObject_Bench_Day_Option01
Array.english: Take a break <color=#fde221><size=20>(Time passes)</size></color>
Array.indonesia: Istirahat sebentar <color=#fde221><size=20>(Waktu berlalu)</size></color>

Array.name: JDLC_InteractionObject_Bench_Day_Option02
Array.english: Keep going
Array.indonesia: Lanjutkan saja

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_Bench_Day_UseBench_001
Array.english: I should take a quick break.
Array.indonesia: Aku sebaiknya istirahat sebentar.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_Bench_Day_NotUse_001
Array.english: I'm good for now...\nI'll take a break later.
Array.indonesia: Aku baik-baik saja untuk saat ini...\nAku akan istirahat nanti.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_SatoBoat_001
Array.english: That's the boat Sato came in.\nIt looks oddly familiar...
Array.indonesia: Itu perahu yang ditumpangi Sato.\nTerlihat anehnya familiar...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Interaction_Harta_Sleep_001
Array.english: He's still sleeping at this hour...?\nBetter not wake him.
Array.indonesia: Dia masih tidur pada jam segini...?\nSebaiknya jangan bangunkan dia.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Interaction_Yasto_Sick_001
Array.english: A sleeping bag in this heat...?\nMust be really sick.
Array.indonesia: Kantong tidur di cuaca panas begini...?\nPasti sedang sangat sakit.
