Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Udo_Interaction_Select_01
Array.english: <size=34>Hey, Dave.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hai, Dave.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Udo_Talk_Select_01
Array.english: <size=34>What do you want to talk about?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Mau ngobrolin apa?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Udo_Interaction_Return_01
Array.english: <size=34>Hehe, I don't mind chatting a bit longer.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hehe, aku nggak keberatan ngobrol sedikit lebih lama.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Udo_Interaction_End_01
Array.english: <size=33>Alright then, I'll be counting on you as always... hehe!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oke deh, aku bakal mengandalkanmu seperti biasa... hehe!</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Sato_Interaction_Select_01
Array.english: <size=34>Hey, Dave.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hai, Dave.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Sato_Talk_Select_01
Array.english: <size=34>Looks like we've got more to talk about.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Sepertinya masih ada banyak hal yang bisa kita bicarakan.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Sato_Interaction_Return_01
Array.english: <size=34>Go ahead, I've got time.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Silakan, aku punya waktu.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Sato_Interaction_End_01
Array.english: <size=33>A town full of interesting creatures.\nI'll take a look around.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Sebuah kota yang penuh dengan makhluk-makhluk menarik.\nAku akan melihat-lihat sebentar.</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Lipah_Good02_001
Array.english: Oh my, a <color=#F1DC2B>Firefly</color>.
Array.indonesia: Wah, seekor <color=#F1DC2B>Firefly</color>.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Lipah_Good02_002
Array.english: Thanks to the ones you caught for me before... I've been using them to light up the night so the lizards don't get scared.
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih atas yang kamu tangkap untukku sebelumnya... Aku sudah menggunakannya untuk menerangi malam agar kadal-kadal itu tidak ketakutan.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Lipah_Good02_003
Array.english: It'd be nice to have a few more, hehe.\nI'll gladly take it.
Array.indonesia: Akan menyenangkan kalau punya beberapa lagi, hehe.\nAku dengan senang hati menerimanya.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Lipah_Good03_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh my, a <color=#F1DC2B>{0}</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wah, <color=#F1DC2B>{0}</color>?</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Lipah_Good03_002
Array.english: What a cute little bug.
Array.indonesia: Serangga kecil yang lucu sekali.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Lipah_Good03_003
Array.english: I'll watch it for a bit, then let it go in a flowerbed or near a tree. Thank you.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan mengamatinya sebentar, lalu melepaskannya di hamparan bunga atau di dekat pohon. Terima kasih.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire01_Start_001
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Maybe I should join in by the bonfire...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Mungkin aku harus ikut bergabung di dekat api unggun...)</color>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire01_Start_Option01
Array.english: Join in
Array.indonesia: Bergabunglah

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire01_Start_Option02
Array.english: Don't join
Array.indonesia: Jangan bergabung

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire01_Join_001
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(I should go talk for a bit.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Aku sebaiknya pergi ngobrol sebentar.)</color>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire01_NotJoin_001
Array.english: I should try talking again later.
Array.indonesia: Aku sebaiknya coba ngobrol lagi nanti.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire01_DeepTalk_001
Array.english: What brings you out here this late?
Array.indonesia: Apa yang membawamu ke sini selarut ini?

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire01_DeepTalk_002
Array.english: Oh, just getting some fresh air. What were you talking about?
Array.indonesia: Oh, cuma mau menghirup udara segar. Tadi kalian lagi ngomongin apa?

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire01_DeepTalk_003
Array.english: Funny you ask, Peneb was just talking about you.
Array.indonesia: Lucu juga kamu nanya, Peneb baru aja ngomongin kamu.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire01_DeepTalk_004
Array.english: Said he's able to work again thanks to the lumber you brought him.
Array.indonesia: Katanya dia bisa kerja lagi berkat kayu yang kamu bawa buat dia.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire01_DeepTalk_005
Array.english: Well, I could still work at my spot, just couldn't go out and chop wood, hehe.
Array.indonesia: Yah, aku masih bisa bekerja di tempatku, cuma nggak bisa keluar buat menebang kayu, hehe.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire01_DeepTalk_006
Array.english: If you're that good with one arm... you'll be even better once it heals!
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu sehebat itu dengan satu tangan... kamu pasti bakal lebih hebat lagi setelah sembuh!

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire01_DeepTalk_007
Array.english: <size=34>H-hey, you haven't even seen me work, so don't go throwing around empty compliments~<color=#ff61e3>♥</color>!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>H-hei, kamu bahkan belum pernah lihat aku kerja, jadi jangan sembarangan ngasih pujian kosong~<color=#ff61e3> ♥</color>!!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire01_DeepTalk_008
Array.english: ...Ahem. Anyway, thanks to you, I can recover without getting bored.
Array.indonesia: ...Ahem. Bagaimanapun, berkat kamu, aku bisa pulih tanpa merasa bosan.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire01_DeepTalk_009
Array.english: Hahaha, he even caught me a fish I couldn't catch with a rod.
Array.indonesia: Hahaha, dia bahkan menangkap ikan untukku yang tidak bisa kutangkap dengan pancing.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire01_DeepTalk_010
Array.english: <size=33>He's a pretty skilled diver!\nI'm impressed.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Dia penyelam yang cukup terampil!\nAku terkesan.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire01_DeepTalk_011
Array.english: Well... he does keep asking for this and that,\nwhich gets annoying, but...
Array.indonesia: Yah... dia memang terus-terusan minta ini dan itu,\nyang kadang bikin kesal, tapi...

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire01_DeepTalk_012
Array.english: Still, having someone new around makes the village feel a bit livelier.
Array.indonesia: Meski begitu, kehadiran orang baru membuat desa ini terasa sedikit lebih semarak.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire01_DeepTalk_013
Array.english: Hehe... glad to hear that.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... senang mendengarnya.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire01_DeepTalk_014
Array.english: Like you probably know... we run a restaurant in the evenings.
Array.indonesia: Seperti yang mungkin sudah kamu tahu... kami mengelola sebuah restoran di malam hari.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire01_DeepTalk_015
Array.english: Feel free to drop by anytime.\nBancho's cooking is amazing!
Array.indonesia: Silakan mampir kapan saja.\nMasakan Bancho luar biasa!

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire02_DeepTalk_001
Array.english: <size=35>Come on, hurry up and carve it, Gesang!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ayo, cepat potong itu, Gesang!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire02_DeepTalk_002
Array.english: <size=33>Don't rush me... I might cut myself...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Jangan buru-buru... aku bisa terluka...</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire02_DeepTalk_003
Array.english: What are you making?
Array.indonesia: Apa yang sedang kamu buat?

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire02_DeepTalk_004
Array.english: <size=32>Say... where you're from, do you have things like <color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color> challenges?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ngomong-ngomong... di tempat asalmu, apakah ada permainan seperti <color=#F1DC2B>Menumpuk Balok Hewan</color>?</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire02_DeepTalk_005
Array.english: <size=33>Huh? What's that?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hah? Apa itu?</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire02_DeepTalk_006
Array.english: Ah. City folks really are no fun.
Array.indonesia: Ah. Orang kota memang nggak seru.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire02_DeepTalk_007
Array.english: You stack animal blocks, and whoever knocks them over loses...
Array.indonesia: Kamu menumpuk balok-balok hewan, dan siapa pun yang menjatuhkannya kalah.. .

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire02_DeepTalk_008
Array.english: A few of mine broke... so I've got <color=#F1DC2B>Gesang</color> here making me some new ones.
Array.indonesia: Beberapa milikku pecah... jadi aku minta <color=#F1DC2B>Gesang</color> di sini buat bikin yang baru buatku.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire02_DeepTalk_009
Array.english: <size=32>Figured he could make a little side cash while he's at it... behind his scary wife's back, hahaha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Pikirku dia bisa dapat uang tambahan sambil ngelakuin itu... di belakang punggung istrinya yang menakutkan, hahaha!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire02_DeepTalk_010
Array.english: <size=34>H-Hey! Don't say stuff like that in front of outsiders!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>H-Hei! Jangan bilang hal seperti itu di depan orang luar!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire02_DeepTalk_011
Array.english: <size=33>But it's true, isn't it? You can't even buy a few coconut drinks with that tiny allowance.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tapi itu benar, kan? Kamu bahkan nggak bisa beli beberapa minuman kelapa dengan uang saku sekecil itu.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire02_DeepTalk_012
Array.english: If word gets out about this... I might not get any allowance at all...
Array.indonesia: Kalau hal ini bocor... aku mungkin nggak bakal dapet uang saku sama sekali...

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire02_DeepTalk_013
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Guess it's the same everywhere...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Sepertinya di mana-mana sama saja...)</color>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire02_DeepTalk_014
Array.english: Outsider, if you're interested in the <color=#1DFEAF>Animal Block Stacking Challenge</color>, come find me in the afternoon.
Array.indonesia: Orang luar, kalau kamu tertarik dengan <color=#1DFEAF>Tantangan Menumpuk Balok Hewan</color>, temui aku sore nanti.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire02_DeepTalk_015
Array.english: <size=33>I tend to sleep in a bit, hahaha.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku biasanya tidur agak lama, hahaha.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire02_DeepTalk_016
Array.english: <size=33>I'll be by the blocked boulder.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku akan berada di dekat batu besar yang tersumbat itu.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Muna01_Start_001
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Muna's looking at something...\nShould I go talk to her?)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Muna sedang melihat sesuatu...\nHaruskah aku pergi bicara dengannya?)</color>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Muna01_Start_Option01
Array.english: Talk to her
Array.indonesia: Bicara dengannya

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Muna01_Start_Option02
Array.english: Leave her be
Array.indonesia: Biarkan saja dia

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Muna01_StartEvent_001
Array.english: Did you find anything unusual?
Array.indonesia: Apa kamu menemukan sesuatu yang tidak biasa?

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Muna01_StartEvent_002
Array.english: Oh, Dave. It's nothing major.
Array.indonesia: Oh, Dave. Nggak ada yang serius.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Muna01_StartEvent_003
Array.english: I was just examining the soil around here.\nJust like in my research, it's quite acidic.
Array.indonesia: Aku cuma memeriksa tanah di sekitar sini.\nSama seperti dalam penelitianku, tanahnya cukup asam.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Muna01_StartEvent_004
Array.english: It's hard to grow crops in acidic soil.
Array.indonesia: Sulit menanam tanaman di tanah yang asam.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Muna01_StartEvent_005
Array.english: Which means the farmer in the village must be putting in a lot of care.
Array.indonesia: Artinya, petani di desa itu pasti merawat tanamannya dengan sangat teliti.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Muna01_StartEvent_006
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... so she means that grumpy guy.\nGuess he treats his crops well.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... jadi yang dia maksud itu pria pemarah itu.\nSepertinya dia merawat tanamannya dengan baik.)</color>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Muna01_StartEvent_007
Array.english: By the way... I heard things got pretty intense with Dr. Bacon in the Blue Hole.
Array.indonesia: Ngomong-ngomong... aku dengar situasinya cukup memanas dengan Dr. Bacon di Blue Hole.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Muna01_StartEvent_008
Array.english: Yeah. Honestly, I only went because they said I could eat all the sushi I wanted...
Array.indonesia: Ya. Jujur, aku ke sana cuma karena mereka bilang aku boleh makan sushi sepuasnya...

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Muna01_StartEvent_009
Array.english: But it was still fun!\nAnd I made a lot of good friends.
Array.indonesia: Tapi tetap seru!\nDan aku dapat banyak teman baru.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Muna01_StartEvent_010
Array.english: Heh... just seeing the photos, it looked like a blast.\nI'm jealous...
Array.indonesia: Heh... cuma lihat fotonya aja, kelihatannya seru banget.\nAku iri...

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Muna01_StartEvent_011
Array.english: Next time, take me with you!\nI'll study up a lot!
Array.indonesia: Lain kali, ajak aku juga!\nAku bakal belajar banyak!

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Muna01_StartEvent_012
Array.english: Haha, it'd be fun to go together.
Array.indonesia: Haha, pasti seru kalau kita pergi bareng.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Muna01_StartEvent_013
Array.english: Though hopefully it's not as dangerous as last time.
Array.indonesia: Meskipun semoga nggak seberbahaya terakhir kali.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Muna01_NotNow_001
Array.english: (Looks like she's busy, better not bother her...)
Array.indonesia: (Sepertinya dia lagi sibuk, mendingan nggak ganggu dia...)

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Muna01_Repeat_001
Array.english: The sea people... deep-sea glaciers... giant squid...\nI want to see them too...
Array.indonesia: Orang-orang laut... gletser laut dalam... cumi-cumi raksasa...\nAku juga ingin melihatnya...

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Muna01_Repeat_002
Array.english: <size=35>I'm jealous...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Aku iri...</size>

Array.name: RelationEvent_Muna01_SelectText
Array.english: Subject of observation
Array.indonesia: Objek pengamatan

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_Start_001
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hm? Peneb's fixing one of the village sculptures.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hm? Peneb sedang memperbaiki salah satu patung desa.)</color>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_Start_002
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Should I go talk to him?)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Haruskah aku pergi bicara dengannya?)</color>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_Start_Option01
Array.english: Go talk to him
Array.indonesia: Pergi bicara dengannya

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_Start_Option02
Array.english: Better not disturb him
Array.indonesia: Lebih baik jangan mengganggunya

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_001
Array.english: Peneb, are you fixing the sculpture?
Array.indonesia: Peneb, apakah kamu sedang memperbaiki patung itu?

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_002
Array.english: Yeah. Gotta touch it up now and then to keep the shine.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Harus diperbaiki sesekali agar tetap berkilau.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_003
Array.english: Especially after it rains, you should wipe it down with a soft cloth...
Array.indonesia: Terutama setelah hujan, sebaiknya kamu menyekanya dengan kain lembut...

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_004
Array.english: then apply some walnut oil like this to keep it looking good, hehe.
Array.indonesia: lalu oleskan sedikit minyak kenari seperti ini agar tetap terlihat bagus, hehe.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_005
Array.english: Oh, and to keep pests away... set some fragrant plants nearby and you're all set!
Array.indonesia: Oh, dan untuk mengusir hama... letakkan beberapa tanaman harum di dekatnya dan selesai sudah!

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_006
Array.english: Oh... so you're not just good at making them,\nbut maintaining them too?
Array.indonesia: Oh... jadi kamu tidak hanya pandai membuatnya,\ntapi juga merawatnya?

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_007
Array.english: <size=33>...It's just common sense, nothing special...<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...Itu cuma akal sehat, nggak ada yang istimewa...<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_008
Array.english: ...Well, I made them myself. So it's only right I take care of them.
Array.indonesia: ...Yah, aku yang membuatnya sendiri. Jadi wajar saja kalau aku yang merawatnya.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_009
Array.english: Can you imagine how upset my ancestors would be if pests ruined these sculptures?
Array.indonesia: Bisa bayangkan betapa kesalnya leluhurku kalau hama merusak patung-patung ini?

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_010
Array.english: <size=33>Anyway... was there something you wanted to ask about the sculptures?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ngomong-ngomong... ada yang ingin kamu tanyakan tentang patung-patung itu?</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_011
Array.english: Oh, now that you mention it...
Array.indonesia: Oh, kalau begitu...

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_Option01
Array.english: Does this village worship bears?
Array.indonesia: Apakah desa ini memuja beruang?

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_Option02
Array.english: What's with that scary face carving?
Array.indonesia: Ada apa dengan ukiran wajah menakutkan itu?

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_Bear_001
Array.english: Ah, you mean the Sun Bear. That's right. This village has worshiped bears since ancient times.
Array.indonesia: Ah, maksudmu Beruang Matahari. Benar sekali. Desa ini telah memuja beruang sejak zaman kuno.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_Bear_002
Array.english: The pattern on the Sun Bear's chest glows with a golden light.
Array.indonesia: Pola di dada Beruang Matahari bersinar dengan cahaya keemasan.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_Bear_003
Array.english: It's seen as a sacred guardian that protects the village, keeping it warm and prosperous
Array.indonesia: Ia dianggap sebagai penjaga suci yang melindungi desa, menjaganya tetap hangat dan sejahtera.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_Face_001
Array.english: Ah, that scary face represents an ancient guardian spirit.
Array.indonesia: Ah, wajah menakutkan itu melambangkan roh penjaga kuno.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_Face_002
Array.english: <size=32>Just because they're evil spirits doesn't mean they're fearless!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hanya karena mereka roh jahat, bukan berarti mereka tak kenal takut!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_Face_003
Array.english: If there's a carving that fierce watching over the village, they wouldn't dare come near.
Array.indonesia: Jika ada ukiran yang begitu garang menjaga desa ini, mereka takkan berani mendekat.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_Face_004
Array.english: Though... I gotta admit, it still startles me sometimes at night
Array.indonesia: Meskipun... aku harus akui, kadang-kadang di malam hari aku masih terkejut melihatnya.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_Complete_001
Array.english: Phew... I should wrap this up soon and get some rest.
Array.indonesia: Huh... Aku sebaiknya segera menyelesaikan ini dan istirahat sebentar.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_Complete_002
Array.english: Would be nice if my arm felt better... but if I leave this too long, it won't be fixable later.
Array.indonesia: Alangkah baiknya jika lenganku sudah membaik... tapi kalau aku membiarkannya terlalu lama, nanti tidak akan bisa diperbaiki lagi.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_Complete_003
Array.english: Now that I know what these statues mean, I should appreciate them more.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang setelah aku tahu arti patung-patung ini, aku harus lebih menghargainya.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_NotNow_001
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(He looks busy, better ask later.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Dia kelihatan sibuk, lebih baik ditanya nanti.)</color>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_Repeat_001
Array.english: Still working on it, huh.
Array.indonesia: Masih mengerjakannya, ya.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_Repeat_002
Array.english: I'm trying to finish it properly, so it's taking a bit longer, hehe.
Array.indonesia: Aku berusaha menyelesaikannya dengan baik, jadi butuh waktu sedikit lebih lama, hehe.

Array.name: RelationEvent_Carpenter01_SelectText
Array.english: Repairing the statue
Array.indonesia: Memperbaiki patung

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_Start_001
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Basu doesn't seem to be in a good mood.\nShould I ask what's wrong?)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Basu sepertinya sedang tidak dalam suasana hati yang baik.\nHaruskah aku tanya apa yang salah?)</color>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_Start_Option01
Array.english: Ask why he's angry
Array.indonesia: Tanya kenapa dia marah

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_Start_Option02
Array.english: Leave him be
Array.indonesia: Biarkan saja dia

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_StartEvent_001
Array.english: Basu, is something wrong?
Array.indonesia: Basu, ada apa?

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_StartEvent_002
Array.english: Ah... well, the thing is... I set up some traps to catch new fish...
Array.indonesia: Ah... begini, masalahnya... Aku pasang beberapa perangkap untuk menangkap ikan baru...

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_StartEvent_003
Array.english: <size=33>But them dang crocodiles went and tore 'em all up and took the fish!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tapi buaya-buaya sialan itu malah merobek semuanya dan mengambil ikannya!! </size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_StartEvent_004
Array.english: They've always been mean, but ever since the quake muddied the water... They've gotten even worse.
Array.indonesia: Mereka memang selalu jahat, tapi sejak gempa membuat air menjadi keruh... Mereka jadi semakin parah.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_StartEvent_005
Array.english: Oh, speakin' of which, you said you dive in the ocean,\nright?
Array.indonesia: Oh, ngomong-ngomong, kamu bilang kamu menyelam di laut,\nkan?

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_StartEvent_006
Array.english: Yeah. I taught diving and helped with explorations too.
Array.indonesia: Iya. Aku pernah mengajar menyelam dan membantu eksplorasi juga.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_StartEvent_007
Array.english: <size=33>Well now, I reckon you've seen sharks before!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Nah, kurasa kamu pasti pernah melihat hiu sebelumnya!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_StartEvent_008
Array.english: Say, did you know there are sharks in freshwater too?
Array.indonesia: Ngomong-ngomong, tahukah kamu kalau ada hiu di air tawar juga?

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_StartEvent_Option01
Array.english: I think I've heard of it
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya aku pernah dengar tentang itu

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_StartEvent_Option02
Array.english: Never heard of it
Array.indonesia: Belum pernah dengar tentang itu

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_StartEvent_Option01Answer_001
Array.english: Ah, I think I've heard of it.\nBull shark, right?
Array.indonesia: Ah, kayaknya aku pernah dengar.\nHiu banteng, kan?

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_StartEvent_Option01Answer_002
Array.english: That's the one! Lives in the ocean, but it can swim up rivers.
Array.indonesia: Itu dia! Hidup di laut, tapi bisa berenang naik ke sungai.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_StartEvent_Option01Answer_003
Array.english: Heard one even made it all the way up here to Utara Lake...
Array.indonesia: Katanya ada yang bahkan berhasil sampai ke Danau Utara...

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_StartEvent_Option01Answer_004
Array.english: <size=33>Crocodiles and sharks both? That'd be the worst... \nYou take care now!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Buaya dan hiu sekaligus? Itu pasti yang paling parah... \nHati-hati ya!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_StartEvent_Option02Answer_001
Array.english: A shark that comes up the river... never heard of that before!
Array.indonesia: Hiu yang berenang ke hulu sungai... belum pernah dengar sebelumnya!

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_StartEvent_Option02Answer_002
Array.english: Hehe, it's a species called the bull shark that originally lives in the sea... but it seems they swim up rivers too.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, itu spesies yang disebut hiu banteng yang aslinya hidup di laut... tapi sepertinya mereka juga berenang ke hulu sungai.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_StartEvent_Option02Answer_003
Array.english: Someone even spotted one here in Utara Lake...
Array.indonesia: Bahkan ada yang melihat satu ekor di Danau Utara ini...

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_StartEvent_Option02Answer_004
Array.english: Crocodiles and now sharks... makes me want to go in the lake even less.
Array.indonesia: Buaya dan sekarang hiu... bikin aku makin enggan masuk ke danau.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_StartEvent_Option02Answer_005
Array.english: <size=34>You be careful too.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kamu juga hati-hati ya.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_NotNow_001
Array.english: He's in a bad mood...\nbetter leave him alone.
Array.indonesia: Dia lagi kesal...\nmending biarin aja dia.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_Repeat_001
Array.english: Ugh... these damn crocodiles... my precious fish...
Array.indonesia: Ugh... buaya sialan ini... ikan kesayanganku...

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_Repeat_002
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Ah... he mentioned earlier that crocodiles ate all the fish in his trap.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Ah... tadi dia bilang buaya-buaya itu memakan semua ikan di perangkapnya.)</color>

Array.name: RelationEvent_Fisherman01_SelectText
Array.english: Reason for anger
Array.indonesia: Alasan kemarahannya

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_Start_001
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(What is she doing by the door?)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Apa yang dia lakukan di dekat pintu?)</color>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_Start_Option01
Array.english: Ask her
Array.indonesia: Tanyakan padanya

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_Start_Option02
Array.english: Leave it
Array.indonesia: Biarkan saja

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_StartEvent_001
Array.english: Chandra, what are you doing by the door?
Array.indonesia: Chandra, apa yang kamu lakukan di dekat pintu?

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_StartEvent_002
Array.english: Oh, it's nothing much. I'm just watching my husband <color=#F1DC2B>Gesang</color> in case he tries to sneak out at night.
Array.indonesia: Oh, nggak ada apa-apa. Aku cuma ngawasin suamiku <color=#F1DC2B>Gesang</color>, jaga-jaga kalau dia coba kabur diam-diam di malam hari.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_StartEvent_003
Array.english: <size=33>He got caught sneaking out once before!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Dia pernah ketahuan kabur diam-diam sebelumnya!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_StartEvent_004
Array.english: He was off gambling with... that guy, Harta, I think?
Array.indonesia: Dia pergi berjudi dengan... pria itu, Harta, kayaknya?

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_StartEvent_005
Array.english: Hmm. He's an adult though. Shouldn't he have some free time?
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Tapi dia kan sudah dewasa. Bukankah dia berhak punya waktu luang?

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_StartEvent_006
Array.english: <size=34>What are you talking about?!\nFamily comes first!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Apa-apaan itu?!\nKeluarga itu yang utama!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_StartEvent_007
Array.english: And besides, he's so handsome, other women might hit on him...
Array.indonesia: Lagipula, dia ganteng banget, wanita lain mungkin bakal naksir dia...

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_StartEvent_008
Array.english: <size=34>Right? Isn't my husband handsome?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Benar kan? Bukankah suamiku tampan?</size>

Array.name: RelationEvent_Chandra01_Option01
Array.english: Yeah. Really handsome
Array.indonesia: Iya. Sangat tampan.

Array.name: RelationEvent_Chandra01_Option02
Array.english: Hmm... I didn't notice
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Aku nggak sadar.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_Happy_001
Array.english: <size=32>O-Of course! He's incredibly handsome.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>T-Tentu saja! Dia sangat tampan.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_Happy_002
Array.english: <size=33>Ohoho! See? I knew it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ohoho! Lihat? Aku tahu!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_Happy_003
Array.english: Even when I'm mad, one look at his face and it all just melts away!
Array.indonesia: Bahkan saat aku marah, sekali melihat wajahnya, semua kemarahan langsung lenyap!

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_Happy_004
Array.english: So even outsiders can see it. I really married well.
Array.indonesia: Jadi orang luar pun bisa melihatnya. Aku benar-benar beruntung menikah dengannya.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_Happy_005
Array.english: <size=33>Or rather, he's the one who married well, right? Ohoho!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Atau lebih tepatnya, dia yang beruntung menikah denganku, kan? Ohoho!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_NotHappy_001
Array.english: Hmm... I'm not sure...\nI've never really thought about it.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Aku nggak yakin...\nAku belum pernah benar-benar memikirkannya.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_NotHappy_002
Array.english: Wow... you really have no taste.
Array.indonesia: Wah... seleramu benar-benar nggak ada.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_NotHappy_003
Array.english: Outsiders have such strange taste... honestly.
Array.indonesia: Orang luar itu seleranya aneh banget... jujur aja.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_NotHappy_004
Array.english: Haven't you noticed all the women in the village sneaking glances at him?
Array.indonesia: Apa kamu nggak sadar kalau semua wanita di desa ini diam-diam melirik dia?

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_NotHappy_005
Array.english: Especially that Lipah... that sly little thing.\nAlways smiling like that.
Array.indonesia: Terutama Lipah itu... si licik kecil itu.\nSelalu tersenyum seperti itu.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_NotHappy_006
Array.english: Anyway, if you ever see my husband doing anything suspicious, tell me. Got it?
Array.indonesia: Pokoknya, kalau kamu pernah melihat suamiku melakukan sesuatu yang mencurigakan, beri tahu aku. Mengerti?

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_NotHappy_007
Array.english: Yeah... if I notice anything.
Array.indonesia: Ya... kalau aku melihat sesuatu.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_NotNow_001
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Better not ask.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Mendingan jangan tanya.)</color>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_Repeat_001
Array.english: You have to keep a close eye on him or he'll sneak out.
Array.indonesia: Kamu harus terus mengawasinya atau dia akan kabur diam-diam.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_Repeat_002
Array.english: If he picks up a bad habit, he'll never shake it.
Array.indonesia: Kalau dia mulai punya kebiasaan buruk, dia nggak akan pernah bisa lepas darinya.

Array.name: RelationEvent_Chandra01_SelectText
Array.english: What is she doing?
Array.indonesia: Apa yang dia lakukan?

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Gesang01_NotNow_001
Array.english: (Looks like he's busy, better not bother him...)
Array.indonesia: (Sepertinya dia lagi sibuk, mendingan jangan ganggu dia...)

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Princessy01_Start_001
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Huh? What kind of exercise is she doing?)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hah? Olahraga apa yang dia lakukan?)</color>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Princessy01_Start_Option01
Array.english: Ask what she's doing
Array.indonesia: Tanyakan apa yang dia lakukan

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Princessy01_Start_Option02
Array.english: Leave it
Array.indonesia: Biarkan saja

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Princessy01_StartEvent_001
Array.english: Are you doing some kind of exercise?
Array.indonesia: Apa kamu sedang berolahraga?

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Princessy01_StartEvent_002
Array.english: <size=34>Oh my... I can't believe you were watching me like that!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Astaga... Aku nggak percaya kamu mengintipku seperti itu!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Princessy01_StartEvent_003
Array.english: Ah... no, I wasn't spying... I just saw you moving strangely in the middle of the path...
Array.indonesia: Ah... tidak, aku tidak sedang mengintip... Aku hanya melihatmu bergerak aneh di tengah jalan...

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Princessy01_StartEvent_004
Array.english: Phew... these are <color=#F1DC2B>Yoga</color> poses.
Array.indonesia: Fiuh... ini adalah <color=#F1DC2B>pose Yoga</color>.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Princessy01_StartEvent_005
Array.english: <size=32>Yoga's pretty well-known...\nYou've heard of it, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Yoga cukup terkenal...\nKamu pernah dengar, kan?</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Princessy01_StartEvent_Option01
Array.english: The one where you shoot fire!
Array.indonesia: Yang itu, di mana kamu menyemburkan api!

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Princessy01_StartEvent_Option02
Array.english: Exercise and meditation in one!
Array.indonesia: Olahraga dan meditasi dalam satu!

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Princessy01_StartEvent_Option01_answer_001
Array.english: <size=32>Of course! It's that technique where you breathe fire, right?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tentu saja! Itu teknik di mana kamu menyemburkan api, kan?!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Princessy01_StartEvent_Option01_answer_002
Array.english: <size=33>...Excuse me? What kind of nonsense is that?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...Excuseku? Omong kosong apa itu?</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Princessy01_StartEvent_Option01_answer_003
Array.english: <color=#F1DC2B>Yoga</color> is a practice that trains both the mind and body,\noriginating from India.
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Yoga</color> adalah latihan yang melatih pikiran dan tubuh,\nberasal dari India.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Princessy01_StartEvent_Option01_answer_004
Array.english: Through meditation, you control your mind...\nand release tension in your body as well.
Array.indonesia: Melalui meditasi, kamu mengendalikan pikiranmu...\ndan melepaskan ketegangan di tubuhmu juga.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Princessy01_StartEvent_Option01_answer_005
Array.english: By controlling your breathing and using muscles you don't normally use... it lets you produce a stable frequency.
Array.indonesia: Dengan mengendalikan pernapasan dan menggunakan otot-otot yang biasanya tidak kamu gunakan... hal itu memungkinkanmu menghasilkan frekuensi yang stabil.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Princessy01_StartEvent_Option01_answer_006
Array.english: <size=33>A frequency...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Frekuensi...?</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Princessy01_StartEvent_Option01_answer_007
Array.english: Never mind. I shouldn't be explaining this to a layperson.
Array.indonesia: Sudahlah. Seharusnya aku tidak menjelaskan ini kepada orang awam.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Princessy01_StartEvent_Option01_answer_008
Array.english: <size=33>Anyway, the nice thing about yoga is you can do it anytime, anywhere...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Bagaimanapun, hal yang menyenangkan dari yoga adalah kamu bisa melakukannya kapan saja, di mana saja...</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Princessy01_StartEvent_Option01_answer_009
Array.english: <size=33>You should learn it for your health too!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kamu juga sebaiknya mempelajarinya demi kesehatanmu!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Princessy01_StartEvent_Option01_answer_010
Array.english: Yeah... maybe I'll think about it later...
Array.indonesia: Ya... mungkin aku akan memikirkannya nanti...

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Princessy01_StartEvent_Option02_answer_001
Array.english: Yeah. It's a practice that harmonizes the body, mind,\nand spirit!
Array.indonesia: Ya. Ini adalah latihan yang menyelaraskan tubuh, pikiran,\ndan jiwa!

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Princessy01_StartEvent_Option02_answer_002
Array.english: <size=33>Oh my, you actually know a bit?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wah, ternyata kamu tahu sedikit?</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Princessy01_StartEvent_Option02_answer_003
Array.english: That's right. <color=#F1DC2B>Yoga</color> is a practice that trains both the mind and body, originating from India.
Array.indonesia: Benar. <color=#F1DC2B>Yoga</color> adalah latihan yang melatih pikiran dan tubuh, yang berasal dari India.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Princessy01_StartEvent_Option02_answer_004
Array.english: By controlling your breath and using muscles you don't normally use... it lets you produce a stable frequency.
Array.indonesia: Dengan mengontrol napas dan menggunakan otot-otot yang biasanya tidak kamu gunakan... itu memungkinkanmu menghasilkan frekuensi yang stabil.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Princessy01_StartEvent_Option02_answer_005
Array.english: <size=33>A frequency...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Frekuensi...?</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Princessy01_StartEvent_Option02_answer_006
Array.english: Never mind. I shouldn't have said that to someone like you.
Array.indonesia: Sudahlah. Seharusnya aku tidak mengatakan itu kepada orang sepertimu.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Princessy01_StartEvent_Option02_answer_007
Array.english: Anyway, the nice thing about yoga is you can do it anytime, anywhere...
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun, hal yang menyenangkan dari yoga adalah kamu bisa melakukannya kapan saja, di mana saja...

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Princessy01_StartEvent_Option02_answer_008
Array.english: <size=33>You should learn it for your health too!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kamu juga sebaiknya mempelajarinya demi kesehatanmu!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Princessy01_StartEvent_Option02_answer_009
Array.english: Yeah. My body's been feeling a bit stiff lately,\nso I should think about it
Array.indonesia: Ya. Tubuhku terasa agak kaku belakangan ini,\njadi aku sebaiknya memikirkannya

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Princessy01_NotNow_001
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Better not disturb her.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Sebaiknya jangan ganggu dia.)</color>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Princessy01_Repeat_001
Array.english: Hmm... I was right in the middle of meditating...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Aku sedang asyik bermeditasi...

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Princessy01_Repeat_002
Array.english: You've kind of broken my flow.\nTalk to me later.
Array.indonesia: Kamu agak mengganggu konsentrasiku.\nBicaralah denganku nanti.

Array.name: RelationEvent_Princessy01_SelectText
Array.english: Exercise?
Array.indonesia: Olahraga?

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_BroSisDad01_Start_001
Array.english: <size=33><color=#E3E3E3>(Huh? He's working on the furnace at night.\nShould I talk to him?)</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33><color=#E3E3E3>(Hah? Dia sedang mengerjakan tungku di malam hari.\nHaruskah aku bicara dengannya?)</color></size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_BroSisDad01_Start_Option01
Array.english: Ask what he's doing
Array.indonesia: Tanyakan apa yang dia lakukan

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_BroSisDad01_Start_Option02
Array.english: Leave him be
Array.indonesia: Biarkan saja dia

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_BroSisDad01_StartEvent_001
Array.english: Hello, Perak.\nDo you work at night too?
Array.indonesia: Halo, Perak.\nKamu juga bekerja di malam hari?

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_BroSisDad01_StartEvent_002
Array.english: Oh, not really...\nJust cleaning out the furnace.
Array.indonesia: Oh, tidak juga...\nHanya membersihkan tungku.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_BroSisDad01_StartEvent_003
Array.english: Isn't it hard to see at night?
Array.indonesia: Bukankah sulit melihat di malam hari?

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_BroSisDad01_StartEvent_004
Array.english: That's true...\nBut it's better to work when the sun's out.
Array.indonesia: Benar juga...\nTapi lebih baik bekerja saat matahari terbit.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_BroSisDad01_StartEvent_005
Array.english: And when I'm done with work, I have to look after the kids.
Array.indonesia: Dan setelah selesai bekerja, aku harus mengurus anak-anak.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_BroSisDad01_StartEvent_006
Array.english: I see... It must be tough looking after two kids.
Array.indonesia: Begitu ya... Pasti berat mengurus dua anak.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_BroSisDad01_StartEvent_007
Array.english: <size=33>It's tiring, but seeing them gives me strength!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Memang melelahkan, tapi melihat mereka memberi aku kekuatan!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_BroSisDad01_StartEvent_008
Array.english: You wouldn't really get it unless you've had kids.
Array.indonesia: Kamu nggak akan benar-benar mengerti kecuali kamu sudah punya anak.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_BroSisDad01_StartEvent_009
Array.english: <size=33>Ever think about having kids, Dave?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Pernah kepikiran punya anak, Dave?</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_BroSisDad01_StartEvent_option1
Array.english: I'm curious
Array.indonesia: Aku penasaran

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_BroSisDad01_StartEvent_option2
Array.english: I'm not ready yet...
Array.indonesia: Aku belum siap...

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_BroSisDad01_StartEvent_option1_answer_001
Array.english: Hehe... I'd like to experience that someday,\nif I get the chance.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... Aku ingin merasakan pengalaman itu suatu hari nanti,\njika aku mendapat kesempatan.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_BroSisDad01_StartEvent_option1_answer_002
Array.english: <size=32>Haha! The way you look after people, you'd make a great dad!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha! Dengan cara kamu merawat orang lain, kamu pasti akan jadi ayah yang hebat!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_BroSisDad01_StartEvent_option1_answer_003
Array.english: Oh... I wasn't thinking that far ahead!\nI've still got a lot to do...!
Array.indonesia: Oh... Aku belum memikirkan sejauh itu!\nMasih banyak yang harus aku lakukan...!

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_BroSisDad01_StartEvent_option1_answer_004
Array.english: Hehe... if that day comes, you better tell the whole village, alright?
Array.indonesia: Hehe... kalau hari itu tiba, kamu harus kasih tahu seluruh desa, ya?

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_BroSisDad01_StartEvent_option1_answer_005
Array.english: Yeah... if it happens.
Array.indonesia: Iya... kalau itu terjadi.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_BroSisDad01_StartEvent_option2_answer_001
Array.english: Oh... I'm not ready for that yet...!
Array.indonesia: Oh... aku belum siap untuk itu...!

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_BroSisDad01_StartEvent_option2_answer_002
Array.english: Haha, I wasn't exactly ready when I became a dad either!
Array.indonesia: Haha, aku juga belum benar-benar siap saat jadi ayah!

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_BroSisDad01_StartEvent_option2_answer_003
Array.english: It was a rainy night... Omila and I were taking shelter in a hut...
Array.indonesia: Malam itu hujan... Omila dan aku berlindung di sebuah gubuk...

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_BroSisDad01_StartEvent_option2_answer_004
Array.english: We were freezing, so we sat a little closer... \n<size=34>and then my hand...</size>
Array.indonesia: Kami kedinginan, jadi kami duduk sedikit lebih dekat... \n<size=34>lalu tanganku...</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_BroSisDad01_StartEvent_option2_answer_005
Array.english: <size=33>Whoa...! What are you even talking about?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wah...! Apa sih yang kamu bicarakan?!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_BroSisDad01_StartEvent_option2_answer_006
Array.english: <size=33>Oh...! I was just telling you how we ended up having our first kid...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh...! Aku cuma cerita gimana akhirnya kita punya anak pertama...!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_BroSisDad01_StartEvent_option2_answer_007
Array.english: Anyway, having kids brings a whole new kind of joy.\nJust remember that.
Array.indonesia: Pokoknya, punya anak itu bawa kebahagiaan yang benar-benar baru.\nIngat aja itu.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_BroSisDad01_NotNow_001
Array.english: <size=33><color=#E3E3E3>(It's late, better not bother him.)</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33><color=#E3E3E3>(Sudah larut, mendingan jangan ganggu dia.)</color></size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_BroSisDad01_Repeat_001
Array.english: I prep things at night like this so tomorrow's easier.
Array.indonesia: Aku menyiapkan segala sesuatunya di malam hari seperti ini agar besok lebih mudah.

Array.name: RelationEvent_BroSisDad01_SelectText
Array.english: Furnace maintenance?
Array.indonesia: Perawatan tungku pemanas?

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_YoungMan01_Start_001
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Come to think of it, why doesn't he have any tattoos...? Should I ask?)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Kalau dipikir-pikir, kenapa dia nggak punya tato...? Haruskah aku tanya?)</color>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_YoungMan01_Start_Option01
Array.english: Ask
Array.indonesia: Tanya saja

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_YoungMan01_Start_Option02
Array.english: Leave it
Array.indonesia: Biarkan saja

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_YoungMan01_StartEvent_001
Array.english: I've been wondering...\nwhy don't you have any tattoos?
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah lama penasaran...\nkenapa kamu tidak punya tato?

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_YoungMan01_StartEvent_002
Array.english: Huh? Only adults get tattoos...
Array.indonesia: Hah? Hanya orang dewasa yang punya tato...

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_YoungMan01_StartEvent_003
Array.english: <size=33>You have to go through the <color=#fde221>Coming-of-Age Ceremony</color> to get one...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kamu harus menjalani <color=#fde221>Upacara Kedewasaan</color> untuk mendapatkannya...</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_YoungMan01_StartEvent_004
Array.english: Oh, I see. Everyone else in the village has them,\nbut you don't.
Array.indonesia: Oh, begitu. Semua orang di desa ini punya,\ntapi kamu tidak.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_YoungMan01_StartEvent_005
Array.english: It's a village tradition, so I guess I'll have to...\nbut I heard it really hurts...
Array.indonesia: Itu tradisi desa, jadi kurasa aku harus...\ntapi kudengar itu sangat sakit...

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_YoungMan01_StartEvent_006
Array.english: Ugh... do I really have to...? My coming-of-age ceremony's coming up soon too... ugh...
Array.indonesia: Ugh... apa aku benar-benar harus...? Upacara kedewasaan aku juga sebentar lagi... ugh...

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_YoungMan01_StartEvent_007
Array.english: You're becoming an adult soon. Congrats in advance.
Array.indonesia: Kamu akan segera menjadi dewasa. Selamat sebelumnya.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_YoungMan01_StartEvent_008
Array.english: What's so great about becoming an adult...?\nJust more chores around the village...!
Array.indonesia: Apa hebatnya menjadi dewasa...?\nHanya tugas-tugas tambahan di desa...!

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_YoungMan01_StartEvent_009
Array.english: All I want is to lose myself in music with my <color=#1DFEAF>Panting</color>...
Array.indonesia: Yang aku inginkan hanyalah larut dalam musik bersama <color=#1DFEAF>Panting</color>...

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_YoungMan01_StartEvent_010
Array.english: Music is... the only real joy this village allows...
Array.indonesia: Musik adalah... satu-satunya kesenangan sejati yang diizinkan di desa ini...

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_YoungMan01_StartEvent_011
Array.english: I get that, but people say being an adult can be pretty fun in its own way.
Array.indonesia: Aku mengerti itu, tapi orang-orang bilang menjadi dewasa bisa cukup menyenangkan dengan caranya sendiri.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_YoungMan01_StartEvent_012
Array.english: You can drink beer... and...
Array.indonesia: Kamu bisa minum bir... dan...

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_YoungMan01_StartEvent_013
Array.english: <size=31>Oh, and you can play that game where you steal cars and drive around the city!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Oh, dan kamu bisa main game yang isinya mencuri mobil dan berkeliling kota!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_YoungMan01_StartEvent_014
Array.english: ...I have no idea what you're talking about.\nI want to be alone now.
Array.indonesia: ...Aku nggak ngerti apa yang kamu bicarakan.\nAku mau sendirian sekarang.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_YoungMan01_StartEvent_015
Array.english: <size=35>Yikes.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Astaga.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_YoungMan01_NotNow_001
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Better not talk to him right now.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Sebaiknya jangan bicara dengannya sekarang.)</color>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_YoungMan01_Repeat_001
Array.english: Drawing pictures by stabbing needles into your skin...
Array.indonesia: Menggambar dengan menusukkan jarum ke kulitmu...

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_YoungMan01_Repeat_002
Array.english: Ugh... just thinking about it makes me sting all over...
Array.indonesia: Ugh... cuma memikirkannya saja sudah bikin seluruh tubuhku terasa perih...

Array.name: RelationEvent_YoungMan01_SelectText
Array.english: About the tattoos
Array.indonesia: Tentang tato-tato itu

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_YoungManMom01_Start_001
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(She's staring out at the lake, lost in thought...\nShould I talk to her?)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Dia sedang menatap ke arah danau, tenggelam dalam lamunan...\nHaruskah aku berbicara dengannya?)</color>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_YoungManMom01_Start_Option01
Array.english: Try talking to her
Array.indonesia: Cobalah berbicara dengannya

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_YoungManMom01_Start_Option02
Array.english: Don't talk to her
Array.indonesia: Jangan berbicara dengannya

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_YoungManMom01_StartEvent_001
Array.english: Cinta... hey.
Array.indonesia: Cinta... hei.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_YoungManMom01_StartEvent_002
Array.english: Oh, Dave. I didn't realize you were here.
Array.indonesia: Oh, Dave. Aku tidak menyadari kalau kamu ada di sini.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_YoungManMom01_StartEvent_003
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, sorry if I interrupted.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, maaf kalau aku mengganggu.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_YoungManMom01_StartEvent_004
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, no. I'm sorry...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, tidak. Maaf...!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_YoungManMom01_StartEvent_005
Array.english: It just reminded me of when he and <color=#F1DC2B>Jaka</color> used to play by the lake.
Array.indonesia: Itu hanya mengingatkanku pada saat dia dan <color=#F1DC2B>Jaka</color> biasa bermain di tepi danau.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_YoungManMom01_StartEvent_006
Array.english: Back then, the lake was clearer, and the creatures weren't so fierce.
Array.indonesia: Dulu, danau itu lebih jernih, dan makhluk-makhluk di sana tidak seganas sekarang.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_YoungManMom01_StartEvent_007
Array.english: If only he hadn't gone off saying he'd find glowing ancient ore in that forest cave...
Array.indonesia: Andai saja dia tidak pergi dengan mengatakan akan mencari bijih kuno yang bercahaya di gua hutan itu...

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_YoungManMom01_StartEvent_008
Array.english: He said he'd sell it to pay for <color=#F1DC2B>Jaka</color>'s education in the city.
Array.indonesia: Dia bilang akan menjualnya untuk membiayai pendidikan <color=#F1DC2B>Jaka</color> di kota.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_YoungManMom01_StartEvent_009
Array.english: <size=33>Oh my, I'm saying too much.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Astaga, aku bicara terlalu banyak.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_YoungManMom01_StartEvent_010
Array.english: No, it's okay. I just came at a bad time.
Array.indonesia: Tidak, tidak apa-apa. Aku hanya datang di waktu yang tidak tepat.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_YoungManMom01_StartEvent_011
Array.english: It's alright. The villagers feel sorry for me, so...\nthey don't really talk to me much.
Array.indonesia: Tidak apa-apa. Penduduk desa merasa kasihan padaku, jadi...\nmereka tidak terlalu banyak bicara denganku.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_YoungManMom01_StartEvent_012
Array.english: <size=32>It was nice to talk freely for a change, Dave.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Senang rasanya bisa bicara dengan bebas untuk sekali-sekali, Dave.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_YoungManMom01_StartEvent_013
Array.english: I'm glad I could help.\nHave a good night, Cinta.
Array.indonesia: Aku senang bisa membantu.\nSelamat malam, Cinta.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_YoungManMom01_NotNow_001
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(I shouldn't disturb her right now.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Aku sebaiknya tidak mengganggunya sekarang.)</color>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_YoungManMom01_Repeat_001
Array.english: Utara Lake used to be much clearer.
Array.indonesia: Danau Utara dulu jauh lebih jernih.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_YoungManMom01_Repeat_002
Array.english: But it gradually got murky... and now you can barely see into the water.
Array.indonesia: Tapi perlahan-lahan airnya menjadi keruh... dan sekarang kamu hampir tidak bisa melihat ke dalam air.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_YoungManMom01_Repeat_003
Array.english: Dinosaur carcasses have been washing up too...\nIt makes me anxious sometimes.
Array.indonesia: Bangkai-bangkai dinosaurus juga terdampar di sana...\nKadang-kadang hal itu membuatku cemas.

Array.name: RelationEvent_YoungManMom01_SelectText
Array.english: Watching the lake
Array.indonesia: Menatap danau itu

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Marone_Interaction_Select
Array.english: (Looks at you with a pleased expression)
Array.indonesia: (Menatapmu dengan ekspresi senang)

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Marone_Interaction_End
Array.english: Woof! Woof!
Array.indonesia: Guk! Guk!

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_LongBottom_Interaction_Select01
Array.english: <size=33>What would you like to talk about?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tentang apa yang ingin kamu bicarakan?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_LongBottom_Talk_Select01
Array.english: <size=32>I'm open to any topic.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku terbuka untuk topik apa pun.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_LongBottom_Interaction_Return01
Array.english: <size=32>What else would you like to talk about?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Apa lagi yang ingin kamu bicarakan?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_LongBottom_Interaction_End01
Array.english: <size=33>Sorry to show up out of the blue and ask for a favor... but I'd really appreciate your help.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Maaf tiba-tiba datang dan meminta bantuan... tapi aku benar-benar menghargai bantuannya.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_GrillContainer_001
Array.english: <size=32>How's that skewer grill I made you?\nPutting it to good use?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Bagaimana dengan pemanggang tusuk sate yang kubuat untukmu?\nSudah dimanfaatkan dengan baik?</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_GrillContainer_002
Array.english: Yeah! Customers love it.\nIt's all thanks to you, Peneb.
Array.indonesia: Ya! Pelanggan menyukainya.\nItu semua berkatmu, Peneb.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_GrillContainer_003
Array.english: Ahem... well... it's nothing...\nIf my arm were fine, I could make ten a day.
Array.indonesia: Ahem... yah... nggak ada apa-apa...\nKalau lenganku baik-baik saja, aku bisa bikin sepuluh sehari.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_GrillContainer_004
Array.english: But when things get busy, I'm worried they'll burn if I don't take them off in time.
Array.indonesia: Tapi kalau lagi ramai, aku khawatir sate-satenya bakal gosong kalau nggak aku angkat tepat waktu.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_GrillContainer_005
Array.english: <size=33>Ha! Then just use a <color=#F1DC2B>Skewer Rack</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ha! Kalau begitu, gunakan saja <color=#F1DC2B>Rak Tusuk Sate</color>!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_GrillContainer_006
Array.english: Well... they'll cool down eventually, but it'll keep them warm for a while.
Array.indonesia: Yah... pada akhirnya memang akan mendingin, tapi itu akan membuatnya tetap hangat untuk sementara waktu.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_GrillContainer_007
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... I see! That sounds great!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... begitu! Kedengarannya bagus!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_GrillContainer_008
Array.english: But... how do I get one?
Array.indonesia: Tapi... bagaimana cara mendapatkannya?

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_GrillContainer_009
Array.english: Well... bring me five pieces of <color=#F1DC2B>Rubberwood</color> and three <color=#F1DC2B>Banana Leaves</color>, and I'll make one for you.
Array.indonesia: Nah... bawakan aku lima potong <color=#F1DC2B>Kayu Karet</color> dan tiga <color=#F1DC2B>Daun Pisang</color>, dan aku akan membuatkannya untukmu.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_GrillContainer_010
Array.english: Normally I'd charge you some Doni too...
Array.indonesia: Biasanya aku juga akan memintamu membayar dengan Doni...

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_GrillContainer_011
Array.english: But you've been helping the village, so I'll just take the materials this time.
Array.indonesia: Tapi kamu sudah membantu desa ini, jadi kali ini aku hanya akan mengambil bahan-bahannya saja.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_GrillContainer_012
Array.english: Oh, and rubber trees grow near the <color=#1DFEAF>Setah Forest</color>,\nso keep an eye out.
Array.indonesia: Oh, dan pohon karet tumbuh di dekat <color=#1DFEAF>Hutan Setah</color>,\njadi perhatikan baik-baik.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_GrillContainer_013
Array.english: Thanks.\nI'll check around the forest.
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih.\nAku akan mencari di sekitar hutan.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_GrillContainer_Delivery_001
Array.english: Oh, you brought the materials for the <color=#F1DC2B>Skewer Rack</color>?
Array.indonesia: Oh, kamu sudah membawa bahan-bahan untuk <color=#F1DC2B>Rak Tusuk Sate</color>?

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_GrillContainer_Option01
Array.english: I brought them
Array.indonesia: Aku membawanya

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_GrillContainer_Option02
Array.english: Not yet...
Array.indonesia: Belum...

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_GrillContainer_Finished01_001
Array.english: Yeah, here's the rubberwood and banana leaves.
Array.indonesia: Ya, ini kayu karet dan daun pisangnya.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_GrillContainer_Finished01_002
Array.english: Ooh, perfect.\nGive me a moment.
Array.indonesia: Wah, sempurna.\nTunggu sebentar.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_GrillContainer_Finished02_001
Array.english: <size=32>Alright, here you go.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Baiklah, ini dia.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_GrillContainer_Finished02_002
Array.english: That was fast, Peneb.\nGreat work.
Array.indonesia: Cepat sekali, Peneb.\nKerja bagus.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_GrillContainer_Finished02_003
Array.english: ...Y-You don't have to force compliments just because I made it for free... ahem.
Array.indonesia: ...K-Kamu nggak perlu memaksakan pujian hanya karena aku membuatnya gratis... ahem.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_GrillContainer_Finished02_004
Array.english: Now I can keep the skewers warm and serve them properly.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang aku bisa menjaga sate tetap hangat dan menyajikannya dengan benar.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_GrillContainer_Finished02_005
Array.english: <size=34>Thank you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Terima kasih!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_GrillContainer_NoItem_001
Array.english: Ah, my mistake. I haven't found them yet.\nI'll keep looking.
Array.indonesia: Ah, maaf. Aku belum menemukannya.\nAku akan terus mencari.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_GrillContainer_RefuseGiveItem_001
Array.english: Not yet. I'll keep looking.
Array.indonesia: Belum. Aku akan terus mencari.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Muna_LV4Huddle_Start_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ugh... not again. This stupid mouse...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ugh... lagi-lagi. Mouse bodoh ini...!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Muna_LV4Huddle_Start_002
Array.english: Hm? What's wrong all of a sudden?
Array.indonesia: Hm? Ada apa tiba-tiba?

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Muna_LV4Huddle_Start_003
Array.english: I was trying to write up my research notes on my laptop... \nbut the <color=#F1DC2B>Mouse</color> keeps disconnecting.
Array.indonesia: Aku sedang mencoba menulis catatan penelitianku di laptop... \ntapi <color=#F1DC2B>mouse</color>-nya terus terputus.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Muna_LV4Huddle_Start_004
Array.english: And the trackpad on this thing is terrible...\nso it's really inconvenient without a <color=#F1DC2B>Mouse</color>.
Array.indonesia: Dan trackpad di laptop ini jelek banget...\njadi sangat merepotkan tanpa <color=#F1DC2B>mouse</color>.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Muna_LV4Huddle_Start_005
Array.english: I doubt anyone here would have one, right? Sigh...
Array.indonesia: Aku ragu ada yang punya di sini, kan? Huh...

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Muna_LV4Huddle_Start_006
Array.english: Rimbo goes to the city a lot. Maybe he could get one for you.
Array.indonesia: Rimbo sering ke kota. Mungkin dia bisa membelikan satu untukmu.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Muna_LV4Huddle_Start_007
Array.english: <size=34>Oh!! Right!\nMaybe Rimbo could get one for me!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh!! Benar!\nMungkin Rimbo bisa membelikan satu untukku!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Muna_LV4Huddle_Start_008
Array.english: I'll go ask him then.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan menanyakannya padanya nanti.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Muna_LV4Huddle_Start_009
Array.english: <size=34>Ah... wait. Hey...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ah... tunggu. Hei...</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Muna_LV4Huddle_Start_010
Array.english: ...If possible, could you ask for a <color=#F1DC2B>Foldable Mouse</color>...?\nIt's easier to carry around... hehe.
Array.indonesia: ...Kalau bisa, bisakah kamu minta <color=#F1DC2B>Mouse Lipat</color>...?\nLebih gampang dibawa-bawa... hehe.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Muna_LV4Huddle_Start_011
Array.english: ...That's a pretty specific request. Alright.
Array.indonesia: ...Itu permintaan yang cukup spesifik. Oke.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Muna_LV4Huddle_RimboTalk01_001
Array.english: Rimbo, could you maybe get me a <color=#F1DC2B>Foldable Mouse</color> from the city?
Array.indonesia: Rimbo, bisakah kamu membelikan aku <color=#F1DC2B>Mouse Lipat</color> dari kota?

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Muna_LV4Huddle_RimboTalk01_002
Array.english: Huh? Not just any mouse, but a foldable one...?
Array.indonesia: Hah? Bukan mouse biasa, tapi yang bisa dilipat...?

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Muna_LV4Huddle_RimboTalk01_003
Array.english: Well, I reckon I could ask the electronics shop I deal with.
Array.indonesia: Yah, kurasa aku bisa tanya ke toko elektronik yang biasa aku kunjungi.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Muna_LV4Huddle_RimboTalk01_004
Array.english: <size=32>But since it's not a regular item, I'll probably have to trade somethin' for it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tapi karena ini bukan barang biasa, mungkin aku harus menukarnya dengan sesuatu.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Muna_LV4Huddle_RimboTalk01_005
Array.english: Oh, come to think of it, the shop owner was wonderin' if there were any electric eels around here!
Array.indonesia: Oh, kalau dipikir-pikir, pemilik toko itu bertanya-tanya apakah ada belut listrik di sekitar sini!

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Muna_LV4Huddle_RimboTalk01_006
Array.english: He'd probably love it if I brought him somethin' like an <color=#F1DC2B>Electric Eel Power Organ</color>.
Array.indonesia: Dia pasti akan senang kalau aku membawakannya sesuatu seperti <color=#F1DC2B>Organ Listrik Belut Listrik</color>.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Muna_LV4Huddle_RimboTalk01_007
Array.english: <size=34>Oh... <color=#F1DC2B>Electric Eel</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh... <color=#F1DC2B>Ikan Lele Listrik</color>?</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Muna_LV4Huddle_RimboTalk01_008
Array.english: That's right! He was curious how a fish could generate electricity, so it'd be the perfect gift.
Array.indonesia: Benar! Dia penasaran bagaimana ikan bisa menghasilkan listrik, jadi itu akan jadi hadiah yang sempurna.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Muna_LV4Huddle_RimboTalk01_009
Array.english: An <color=#F1DC2B>Electric Eel</color>... I think I've seen one in the lake...\nI'll go take a look.
Array.indonesia: Seekor <color=#F1DC2B>Ikan Lele Listrik</color>... Sepertinya aku pernah melihatnya di danau...\nAku akan pergi melihatnya.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Muna_LV4Huddle_FindMissionItem_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... that's the <color=#F1DC2B>Electric Eel</color> Rimbo was talking about, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... itu kan <color=#F1DC2B>Electric Eel</color> yang dibicarakan Rimbo, ya?</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Muna_LV4Huddle_FindMissionItem_002
Array.english: <size=32>Better be careful not to get electrocuted while catching it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Sebaiknya hati-hati agar tidak tersengat listrik saat menangkapnya.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Muna_LV4Huddle_GetMissionItem_001
Array.english: <size=33>Alright. I got the <color=#F1DC2B>Electric Eel Power Organ</color>.\nTime to take it to Rimbo.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Baiklah. Aku sudah dapat <color=#F1DC2B>Electric Eel Power Organ</color>.\nWaktunya membawanya ke Rimbo.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Muna_LV4Huddle_GiveItemToRimbo_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... is that an <color=#F1DC2B>Electric Eel Power Organ</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... itu <color=#F1DC2B>Electric Eel Power Organ</color>?</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Muna_LV4Huddle_GiveItemToRimbo_002
Array.english: <size=34>Hehe, just lookin' at it gives me the tingles!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hehe, cuma lihat aja udah bikin merinding!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Muna_LV4Huddle_GiveItemToRimbo_003
Array.english: I already talked to the electronics shop guy and got a <color=#F1DC2B>Foldable Mouse</color> in advance.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah ngobrol sama penjaga toko elektronik dan beli <color=#F1DC2B>Foldable Mouse</color> duluan.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Muna_LV4Huddle_GiveItemToRimbo_004
Array.english: Oh... you're back already. Thanks.
Array.indonesia: Oh... kamu udah balik. Makasih.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Muna_LV4Huddle_GiveItemToRimbo_005
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Alright, I should bring this mouse to Muna.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Oke, aku harus bawa mouse ini ke Muna.)</color>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Muna_LV4Huddle_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=35>Ooh! That's it! The foldable mouse!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wah! Itu dia! Mouse lipat!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Muna_LV4Huddle_Complete_002
Array.english: <size=33>Hehe... I can't believe you actually found the exact model I wanted...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hehe... Aku nggak nyangka kamu benar-benar menemukan model yang aku inginkan...!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Muna_LV4Huddle_Complete_003
Array.english: This is gonna make my research so much faster! Hehehe.
Array.indonesia: Ini bakal bikin penelitianku jadi jauh lebih cepat! Hehehe.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Muna_LV4Huddle_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=35>Thank you, Dave!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Terima kasih, Dave!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Lipah_LV3Huddle_Pre_001
Array.english: Thank you again for catching those fireflies for me.
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih lagi sudah menangkap kunang-kunang itu untukku.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Lipah_LV3Huddle_Pre_002
Array.english: Oh, don't mention it.\nI even got a <color=#1DFEAF>Bug Net</color> out of it.
Array.indonesia: Oh, nggak usah disebut-sebut.\nAku bahkan dapat <color=#1DFEAF>Jaring Serangga</color> dari situ.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Lipah_LV3Huddle_Pre_003
Array.english: Hehe, thanks to them, I can light up my room at night so my <color=#FF73C3>Lizards</color> don't get scared.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, berkat mereka, aku bisa menerangi kamarku di malam hari agar <color=#FF73C3>kadal-kadalku</color> nggak ketakutan.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Lipah_LV3Huddle_Pre_004
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Looks like Lipah really loves <color=#FF73C3>Lizards</color>...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Sepertinya Lipah benar-benar menyukai <color=#FF73C3>kadal</color>...)</color>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Lipah_LV3Huddle_Start_001
Array.english: Oh, Dave. Have you happened to see any <color=#FF73C3>Lizards</color> around the village?
Array.indonesia: Oh, Dave. Apa kamu kebetulan melihat <color=#FF73C3>kadal</color> di sekitar desa?

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Lipah_LV3Huddle_Start_002
Array.english: Yeah, I think so... but they're so quick, I couldn't get a good look.
Array.indonesia: Ya, sepertinya begitu... tapi mereka sangat cepat, jadi aku tidak bisa melihatnya dengan jelas.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Lipah_LV3Huddle_Start_003
Array.english: Hehe. You might already know this, but I raise <color=#FF73C3>Lizards</color>.
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Mungkin kamu sudah tahu ini, tapi aku memelihara <color=#FF73C3>Lizards</color>.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Lipah_LV3Huddle_Start_004
Array.english: Some people are scared of big, aggressive lizards...
Array.indonesia: Beberapa orang takut pada kadal besar yang agresif...

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Lipah_LV3Huddle_Start_005
Array.english: but the <color=#FF73C3>Big-Eyed Lizards</color> I raise are gentle and really adorable.
Array.indonesia: tapi <color=#FF73C3>Kadal Bermata Besar</color> yang aku pelihara itu jinak dan sangat menggemaskan.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Lipah_LV3Huddle_Start_006
Array.english: But... because they taste good, they often end up as prey for wild animals.
Array.indonesia: Tapi... karena rasanya enak, mereka sering jadi mangsa hewan liar.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Lipah_LV3Huddle_Start_007
Array.english: That's why I keep them at home, to protect and breed them.
Array.indonesia: Makanya aku memelihara mereka di rumah, buat melindungi dan membiakkannya.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Lipah_LV3Huddle_Start_008
Array.english: Oh... those big eyes really are cute. Hehe.
Array.indonesia: Oh... mata besar mereka memang lucu banget. Hehe.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Lipah_LV3Huddle_Start_009
Array.english: Right? If you're interested, Dave, why not try catching one?
Array.indonesia: Iya kan? Kalau kamu tertarik, Dave, kenapa nggak coba menangkap satu?

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Lipah_LV3Huddle_Start_010
Array.english: Huh? Me?\nI don't even have a place to keep it...
Array.indonesia: Hah? Aku?\nAku bahkan nggak punya tempat buat memeliharanya...

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Lipah_LV3Huddle_Start_011
Array.english: Hehe. Don't worry about raising it.\nJust bring it to me.
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Jangan khawatir soal memeliharanya.\nBawa saja ke aku.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Lipah_LV3Huddle_Start_012
Array.english: They come in all kinds of colors and patterns...\nbut the most common one is the <color=#F1DC2B>Blue Big-Eye</color>.
Array.indonesia: Mereka punya berbagai macam warna dan pola...\ntapi yang paling umum adalah <color=#F1DC2B>Blue Big-Eye</color>.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Lipah_LV3Huddle_Start_013
Array.english: Hmm... sounds interesting, but... they run off the moment I get close.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... kedengarannya menarik, tapi... mereka langsung kabur begitu aku mendekat.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Lipah_LV3Huddle_Start_014
Array.english: Hehe. You won't catch one just by walking up to it.
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Kamu nggak bakal bisa menangkapnya hanya dengan mendekatinya begitu saja.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Lipah_LV3Huddle_Start_015
Array.english: Big-Eye Lizards are timid, but they let their guard down completely when they're eating.
Array.indonesia: Kadal Mata Besar memang pemalu, tapi mereka benar-benar lengah saat sedang makan.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Lipah_LV3Huddle_Start_016
Array.english: They're cute, but... that's exactly why they get caught by predators so easily.
Array.indonesia: Mereka lucu, tapi... itulah tepatnya mengapa mereka begitu mudah ditangkap oleh predator.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Lipah_LV3Huddle_Start_017
Array.english: I'll give you some <color=#F1DC2B>Lizard Bait</color>.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan memberimu sedikit <color=#F1DC2B>Umpan Kadal</color>.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Lipah_LV3Huddle_Start_018
Array.english: Place it a short distance away, then step back... wait for it to start eating, and you'll be able to catch it.
Array.indonesia: Letakkan di jarak yang tidak terlalu jauh, lalu mundur... tunggu sampai mereka mulai makan, dan kamu akan bisa menangkapnya.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Lipah_LV3Huddle_Start_019
Array.english: Oh... so I just set this down near one and wait?
Array.indonesia: Oh... jadi aku tinggal meletakkan ini di dekat salah satunya dan menunggu?

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Lipah_LV3Huddle_Start_020
Array.english: Yes. If you need more lizard bait...\nI can sell you some.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Kalau kamu butuh umpan kadal lagi...\naku bisa jual ke kamu.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Lipah_LV3Huddle_Start_021
Array.english: Alright. Got it.\nI'll give it a try.
Array.indonesia: Oke. Paham.\nAku akan mencobanya.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Lipah_LV3Huddle_GetLizard_001

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Chief_Day_Inside_001
Array.english: There's quite a bit of dust here.
Array.indonesia: Ada cukup banyak debu di sini.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Chief_Day_Inside_002
Array.english: My knees are acting up again...
Array.indonesia: Lututku kambuh lagi...

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Uzme_Day_Inside_002
Array.english: Maybe I should read for a bit.
Array.indonesia: Mungkin aku harus membaca sebentar.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Uzme_Day_Inside_003
Array.english: Where did I put my dumbbells...
Array.indonesia: Di mana ya aku meletakkan dumbelku...

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Uzme_Day_Inside_001
Array.english: Should I store my instrument somewhere else?
Array.indonesia: Haruskah aku menyimpan alat musikku di tempat lain?

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Uzme_Day_Inside_004
Array.english: Wish it were evening already...
Array.indonesia: Andai saja sudah malam...

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Uzme_Day_Inside_005
Array.english: Gotta finish that seashell decoration.
Array.indonesia: Harus menyelesaikan hiasan kerang itu.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Chief_Day_Inside_008
Array.english: Hmm...
Array.indonesia: Hmm...

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Chief_Day_Inside_009
Array.english: I see.
Array.indonesia: Oh, begitu.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Carpenter_Day_Inside_001
Array.english: Alright... it's coming together.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah... mulai terlihat bentuknya.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Carpenter_Day_Inside_002
Array.english: Maybe shave this side down a bit more.
Array.indonesia: Mungkin sisi ini perlu dikikis sedikit lagi.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Carpenter_Relation_001
Array.english: This part's broken too... oh no.
Array.indonesia: Bagian ini juga rusak... oh tidak.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Fisherman_Day_Inside_001
Array.english: My net's worn out.
Array.indonesia: Jaringku sudah usang.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Fisherman_Day_Inside_002
Array.english: Reckon I should tidy up my tools.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya aku harus merapikan perkakasku.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Farmer_Relation_001
Array.english: Hmm...
Array.indonesia: Hmm...

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Farmer_Relation_002
Array.english: Bananas, huh...
Array.indonesia: Pisang, ya...

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Gesang_Day_Inside_001
Array.english: This goes like this...
Array.indonesia: Begini caranya...
