Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Gesang_Day_Inside_002
Array.english: Hehe... this is kinda fun.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... ini lumayan seru.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Cinta_Relation_001
Array.english: *Sniff*...
Array.indonesia: *Hirup*...

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Cinta_Relation_002
Array.english: Nice, cool breeze...
Array.indonesia: Angin sepoi-sepoi yang segar...

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Kina_Relation_001
Array.english: Maybe a different word fits better...
Array.indonesia: Mungkin kata lain lebih cocok...

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Kina_Relation_002
Array.english: Blue butterfly, did you come from the forest
Array.indonesia: Kupu-kupu biru, apakah kamu datang dari hutan?

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Kina_Relation_003
Array.english: The scent of grass after the rain
Array.indonesia: Aroma rumput setelah hujan

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Kina_Relation_004
Array.english: Oh discus-like fish, how do you swim
Array.indonesia: Oh ikan seperti discus, bagaimana kamu berenang?

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Fisherman_RainCheck_001
Array.english: Rain just won't let up.
Array.indonesia: Hujan tak kunjung reda.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Fisherman_RainCheck_002
Array.english: Fish bite better in the rain, though.
Array.indonesia: Tapi ikan lebih mudah menggigit umpan saat hujan.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Fisherman_RainCheck_003
Array.english: Still... not keen on fishin' in it.
Array.indonesia: Meski begitu... aku tetap nggak suka memancing saat hujan.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Fisherman_RainCheck_004
Array.english: Reckon I'll fix up my gear today.
Array.indonesia: Kayaknya aku bakal merapikan peralatan pancingku hari ini.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Fisherman_RainCheck_005
Array.english: Phew... everything got soaked.
Array.indonesia: Waduh... semuanya basah kuyup.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Farmer_AvoidRain_001
Array.english: Rain again all of a sudden!
Array.indonesia: Tiba-tiba hujan lagi!

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Carpenter_Relation_002
Array.english: My arm's still aching...
Array.indonesia: Lenganku masih sakit...

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Fisherman_Relation_001
Array.english: Been catchin' fewer fish lately.
Array.indonesia: Belakangan ini hasil tangkapanku makin sedikit.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Carpenter_Relation_003
Array.english: Hey, you've got that outsider friend, don't you?
Array.indonesia: Hei, kamu punya teman dari luar kota itu, kan?

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Carpenter_Relation_004
Array.english: Why not ask him for a hand?
Array.indonesia: Kenapa nggak minta bantuannya?

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Fisherman_Relation_002
Array.english: If this keeps up, business'll take a hit.
Array.indonesia: Kalau begini terus, bisnisku bakal terganggu.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Gesang_Relation_003
Array.english: If I stay out too long, she'll come lookin' for me.
Array.indonesia: Kalau aku terlalu lama di luar, dia pasti akan mencariku.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Gesang_Relation_004
Array.english: I'm focused, don't talk to me.
Array.indonesia: Aku sedang fokus, jangan ganggu aku.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Gesang_Relation_005
Array.english: Better finish up and head home.
Array.indonesia: Mendingan aku selesaikan ini dan pulang saja.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Harta_Relation_001
Array.english: Maybe slow it down a bit.
Array.indonesia: Mungkin sebaiknya pelan-pelan saja.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Harta_Relation_002
Array.english: Mess it up and you'll have to start over.
Array.indonesia: Kalau sampai gagal, kamu harus mulai dari awal lagi.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Carpenter_Day_Inside_003
Array.english: Gotta work indoors when it rains.
Array.indonesia: Harus bekerja di dalam ruangan saat hujan.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Carpenter_Day_Inside_004
Array.english: Maybe it's the rain...\nmy injury's acting up...
Array.indonesia: Mungkin karena hujan...\ncedera saya kambuh lagi...

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Farmer_Day_Inside_001
Array.english: At least the rain helps the crops.
Array.indonesia: Setidaknya hujan membantu tanaman.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_WorkTalk_Farmer_Day_Inside_002
Array.english: Don't go wandering around too much.
Array.indonesia: Jangan berkeliaran terlalu jauh.

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_Yasuto_01_001
Array.english: After that spider bite, I can shoot webs from my hands now.
Array.indonesia: Setelah digigit laba-laba itu, sekarang saya bisa menembakkan jaring dari tangan saya.

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_Yasuto_01_002
Array.english: I can pull food from a distance, so it'll help with work too.
Array.indonesia: Aku bisa menarik makanan dari jarak jauh, jadi ini juga akan membantu pekerjaan.

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_Yasuto_02_001
Array.english: I wonder if Fukuo and Takeru are doing okay.
Array.indonesia: Aku penasaran apakah Fukuo dan Takeru baik-baik saja.

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_Yasuto_02_002
Array.english: Even if they have psychokinesis... there must be dangerous alien creatures too.
Array.indonesia: Meskipun mereka memiliki kemampuan psikokinesis... pasti ada makhluk asing yang berbahaya juga.

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_CB3_01_001
Array.english: Haha! This town's giving me a lot of inspiration.
Array.indonesia: Haha! Kota ini memberiku banyak inspirasi.

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_CB3_01_002
Array.english: I think I'll be able to write a lot of fun songs when I get back.
Array.indonesia: Aku rasa aku bisa menulis banyak lagu seru saat kembali nanti.

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_CB3_01_003
Array.english: About the restaurant... or the villagers here...
Array.indonesia: Tentang restoran itu... atau penduduk desa di sini...

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_CB3_01_004
Array.english: <size=34>Or even your story!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Atau bahkan ceritamu!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_CB3_01_005
Array.english: Hehe... then write me as the cool hero who saved the village.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... kalau begitu, gambarkan aku sebagai pahlawan keren yang menyelamatkan desa.

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_CB3_02_001
Array.english: Even in the evening, it's still hot near the skewer grill.
Array.indonesia: Bahkan di malam hari, udara di dekat panggangan sate masih terasa panas.

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_CB3_02_002
Array.english: But it makes that after-work beer taste even better.
Array.indonesia: Tapi itu membuat bir setelah pulang kerja terasa lebih nikmat.

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_Mita_01_001
Array.english: It's much hotter here than where I'm from.
Array.indonesia: Di sini jauh lebih panas daripada tempat asalku.

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_Mita_01_002
Array.english: Well, it is a jungle village.
Array.indonesia: Yah, ini memang desa di tengah hutan.

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_Mita_01_003
Array.english: At least we're up high, so it's a bit cooler.
Array.indonesia: Setidaknya kita berada di ketinggian, jadi udaranya sedikit lebih sejuk.

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_Mita_01_004
Array.english: I do miss my fridge at home sometimes...
Array.indonesia: Kadang-kadang aku memang kangen kulkas di rumah...

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_Mita_01_005
Array.english: But other than that, I like it here.\nIt's a fun place.
Array.indonesia: Tapi selain itu, aku suka di sini.\nTempat ini seru.

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_Rover_01_001
Array.english: I can't sense the Tacet Discords' aura here.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak bisa merasakan aura Tacet Discords di sini.

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_Rover_01_002
Array.english: I need to find more Resonators to fight the Lament...
Array.indonesia: Aku harus mencari lebih banyak Resonator untuk melawan Lament...

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_Rover_01_003
Array.english: This is a good spot to take a short break before heading out again.
Array.indonesia: Ini tempat yang bagus untuk beristirahat sejenak sebelum berangkat lagi.

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_Rover_02_001
Array.english: It's nice to put the sword down once in a while and watch the guests enjoy themselves.
Array.indonesia: Senang rasanya sesekali meletakkan pedang dan melihat para tamu bersenang-senang.

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_Rover_02_002
Array.english: I travel hoping scenes like this will last long in the world.
Array.indonesia: Aku bepergian dengan harapan pemandangan seperti ini akan bertahan lama di dunia.

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_MartinTweed_01_001
Array.english: Our Kindred's robotic arms can be used for cooking as well.
Array.indonesia: Lengan robot Kindred kita juga bisa digunakan untuk memasak.

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_MartinTweed_01_002
Array.english: <size=32>...Though only for cutting and grilling.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>...Though hanya untuk memotong dan memanggang.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_MartinTweed_02_001
Array.english: There are all kinds of ingredients on other planets too.
Array.indonesia: Ada berbagai macam bahan makanan di planet lain juga.

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_MartinTweed_02_002
Array.english: It'd be fun to take you there someday, haha!
Array.indonesia: Pasti seru kalau suatu hari nanti bisa mengajak kalian ke sana, haha!

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_Longbottom_01_001
Array.english: Hope you all stop by the Two Point Museum sometime.
Array.indonesia: Semoga kalian semua mampir ke Museum Two Point suatu saat nanti.

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_Longbottom_01_002
Array.english: If we had a restaurant there, visitors would love it.
Array.indonesia: Kalau kita punya restoran di sana, pengunjung pasti akan menyukainya.

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_Longbottom_02_001
Array.english: When you're a professional, you get injured a lot...\nor even end up with strange curses.
Array.indonesia: Kalau jadi profesional, sering banget cedera...\natau bahkan kena kutukan aneh.

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_Longbottom_02_002
Array.english: It's nice that this village is peaceful and none of that happens, haha.
Array.indonesia: Senang rasanya desa ini damai dan hal-hal seperti itu nggak terjadi, haha.

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_Longbottom_03_001
Array.english: Exploring at this hour is pretty dangerous.
Array.indonesia: Menjelajah pada jam segini cukup berbahaya.

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_Longbottom_03_002
Array.english: Working at the shop is much safer and more enjoyable!
Array.indonesia: Bekerja di toko jauh lebih aman dan menyenangkan!

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_Longbottom_04_001
Array.english: I heard you've explored all kinds of seas, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Kudengar kamu sudah menjelajahi berbagai macam laut, Dave.

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_Longbottom_04_002
Array.english: Yeah, I've been to quite a few places.
Array.indonesia: Ya, aku sudah ke cukup banyak tempat.

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_Longbottom_04_003
Array.english: But nothing as unusual as the Blue Hole.
Array.indonesia: Tapi tidak ada yang seunik Blue Hole.

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_Longbottom_04_004
Array.english: Haha! Two Point County, where I used to explore,\nwas a pretty strange place too!
Array.indonesia: Haha! Two Point County, tempat aku dulu sering menjelajah,\njuga tempat yang cukup aneh!

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_Longbottom_04_005
Array.english: Ever heard of a Lionheadfish?\nIt's got the head of a lion, I swear!
Array.indonesia: Pernah dengar tentang Ikan Kepala Singa?\nKepalanya benar-benar seperti singa, aku bersumpah!

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_Longbottom_04_006
Array.english: Oh... so fish like that really exist.
Array.indonesia: Oh... jadi ikan seperti itu benar-benar ada.

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_Longbottom_04_007
Array.english: <size=32>I'd love to go explore there someday too!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku juga ingin menjelajah ke sana suatu hari nanti!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_OmNom_01_001
Array.english: (Om Nom is smiling with delight.)
Array.indonesia: (Om Nom tersenyum gembira.)

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_OmNom_01_002
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Looks like he's enjoying serving customers.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Sepertinya dia menikmati melayani pelanggan.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_OmNom_02_001
Array.english: (Om Nom smacks his lips as he eyes the food.)
Array.indonesia: (Om Nom mendecakkan bibirnya sambil memandangi makanan.)

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_OmNom_02_002
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(He won't eat up all the ingredients, will he...?)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Dia tidak akan memakan semua bahan-bahannya, kan...?)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_Udo_01_001
Array.english: My grandmother used to run a restaurant on an island.
Array.indonesia: Nenekku dulu punya restoran di sebuah pulau.

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_Udo_01_002
Array.english: I was too young to really help back then...
Array.indonesia: Saat itu aku masih terlalu kecil untuk benar-benar membantu...

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_Udo_01_003
Array.english: But I picked things up just by watching, so don't worry.
Array.indonesia: Tapi aku belajar banyak hanya dengan mengamati, jadi jangan khawatir.

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_Udo_02_001
Array.english: There are quite a few insects that only come out at night.
Array.indonesia: Ada cukup banyak serangga yang hanya muncul di malam hari.

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_Udo_02_002
Array.english: I'd appreciate it if you could take a look around after closing.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan sangat berterima kasih jika kamu bisa melihat-lihat sekitar setelah tutup.

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_Udo_02_003
Array.english: ...Of course, I'll be investigating too, haha!
Array.indonesia: ...Tentu saja, aku juga akan menyelidikinya, haha!

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_Sato_01_001
Array.english: Been wandering on expeditions for so long... it's been a while since I stayed in one place like this.
Array.indonesia: Sudah lama berkelana dalam ekspedisi... sudah lama aku tidak tinggal di satu tempat seperti ini.

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_Sato_01_002
Array.english: Heh. Nice chance to clear my head while going through my cards.
Array.indonesia: Heh. Kesempatan bagus untuk menenangkan pikiran sambil memeriksa kartu-kartuku.

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_Sato_02_001
Array.english: The smell of grilled fish really gets your appetite going.
Array.indonesia: Aroma ikan panggang benar-benar membangkitkan selera makan.

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_Sato_02_002
Array.english: All that weight I lost on those rough adventures is coming right back.
Array.indonesia: Semua berat badan yang hilang selama petualangan berat itu kini kembali lagi.

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_Sato_02_003
Array.english: Well... guess I'll just have to work it off at the shop, haha.
Array.indonesia: Yah... sepertinya aku harus membakarnya di toko saja, haha.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_JungleCreatureRadar_001
Array.english: <size=33>I don't think I've ever seen this insect before? Should I get closer?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Sepertinya aku belum pernah melihat serangga ini sebelumnya? Haruskah aku mendekat?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Jungle_SushiBar_Error_001
Array.english: You cannot add items to the menu after closing.
Array.indonesia: Kamu tidak bisa menambahkan item ke menu setelah tutup.

Array.name: dialog_Jungle_SushiBar_Error_002
Array.english: At least one skewer grill must be placed.
Array.indonesia: Setidaknya satu pemanggang tusuk sate harus ditempatkan.

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Infotalk_Title
Array.english: Favorite things
Array.indonesia: Hal-hal favorit

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_01_001
Array.english: Haaa... first an ancient creature...\nand now a human?
Array.indonesia: Haaa... pertama makhluk purba...\ndan sekarang manusia?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_01_002
Array.english: What a mess...
Array.indonesia: Sungguh berantakan...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_01_003
Array.english: <size=33>Don't make it any worse, got it?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Jangan bikin makin parah, ngerti?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_02_001
Array.english: I almost got chewed out by Torang for letting that human get away...
Array.indonesia: Aku hampir dimarahi Torang karena membiarkan manusia itu kabur...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_02_002
Array.english: But since Torang let him get away too...\nhe'll probably let it slide this time, right?
Array.indonesia: Tapi karena Torang juga membiarkannya kabur...\ndia mungkin akan membiarkannya kali ini, kan?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_03_001
Array.english: A human showing up with a weapon fitted with a <color=#63F9FF>Blue Divine Tree Fruit</color>...
Array.indonesia: Seorang manusia muncul dengan senjata yang dilengkapi <color=#63F9FF>Buah Pohon Ilahi Biru</color>...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_03_002
Array.english: <size=32>That's just cheating.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Itu namanya curang.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_04_001
Array.english: That vicious creature... it destroyed my entire home.
Array.indonesia: Makhluk kejam itu... dia menghancurkan seluruh rumahku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_04_002
Array.english: You're going to the settlement to take it down, aren't you?
Array.indonesia: Kamu akan pergi ke pemukiman untuk mengalahkannya, kan?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_04_003
Array.english: I never thought I'd find myself rooting for a human...
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak pernah menyangka akan mendukung seorang manusia...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_04_004
Array.english: <size=33>Please... defeat it! That beast!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tolong... kalahkan dia! Binatang itu!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_05_001
Array.english: <size=34>Eek... please don't hurt me...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aduh... tolong jangan sakiti aku...!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_05_002
Array.english: ...I'm not here to hurt anyone. I just came to speak with the chief.
Array.indonesia: ...Aku tidak di sini untuk menyakiti siapa pun. Aku hanya datang untuk berbicara dengan kepala suku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_05_003
Array.english: Our ancestors probably believed words like that too...\nand paid for it with their lives...
Array.indonesia: Nenek moyang kita mungkin juga percaya kata-kata seperti itu...\ndan harus membayarnya dengan nyawa mereka...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_05_004
Array.english: There must be a reason my grandmother always told me never to trust humans.
Array.indonesia: Pasti ada alasan mengapa nenekku selalu bilang padaku untuk tidak pernah mempercayai manusia.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_06_001
Array.english: Haa... attacking me right when I was worn out from training...
Array.indonesia: Haa... menyerangku tepat saat aku kelelahan setelah berlatih...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_06_002
Array.english: Humans really are as cowardly as I've heard.
Array.indonesia: Manusia memang sepengecut yang kudengar.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_06_003
Array.english: I'll handle what the chief ordered first...\nbut next time we fight, you'd better be ready!
Array.indonesia: Aku akan menangani perintah kepala suku dulu...\ntapi lain kali kita bertarung, lebih baik kau siap!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_07_001
Array.english: Broke right through the traps we set for that ancient creature.
Array.indonesia: Langsung menembus jebakan yang kita pasang untuk makhluk purba itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_07_002
Array.english: Were humans always this clever...?
Array.indonesia: Apakah manusia selalu secerdas ini...?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_08_001
Array.english: Heard you're heading out to take down the monster in the settlement over there?
Array.indonesia: Kudengar kau akan berangkat untuk menghabisi monster di pemukiman di sana?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_08_002
Array.english: Yeah. The chief said he wouldn't cooperate unless I did.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Kepala suku bilang dia tidak akan bekerja sama kecuali aku melakukannya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_08_003
Array.english: Haha... the chief's got a mean streak, doesn't he.
Array.indonesia: Haha... kepala suku itu memang kejam, ya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_08_004
Array.english: No way a human takes that thing down alone.
Array.indonesia: Tidak mungkin manusia bisa mengalahkan makhluk itu sendirian.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_08_005
Array.english: <size=32>I saw it chomping down on a Vulture Shark in there, I'm telling you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku melihatnya sedang mengunyah Hiu Burung Nasar di sana, aku serius!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_08_006
Array.english: Uh... don't scare me like that...
Array.indonesia: Eh... jangan bikin aku takut gitu...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_09_001
Array.english: Haa... I finally blocked it off with rocks,\nand now I have to clear them again...
Array.indonesia: Haa... akhirnya aku memblokirnya dengan batu,\ndan sekarang aku harus membersihkannya lagi...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_09_002
Array.english: I've opened the path for you, so don't go chickening out and running away, human!
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah membuka jalan untukmu, jadi jangan jadi pengecut dan kabur, manusia!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_09_003
Array.english: It's no honor for the great Torang to have fought a coward like that.
Array.indonesia: Bukan suatu kehormatan bagi Torang yang agung untuk bertarung melawan pengecut seperti itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_99_001
Array.english: Do not underestimate the monster we've sealed in the settlement to the right.
Array.indonesia: Jangan meremehkan monster yang telah kami kurung di pemukiman di sebelah kanan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_99_002
Array.english: It's the kind of beast that can gnaw and tear through almost anything with its teeth...
Array.indonesia: Itu adalah jenis binatang buas yang bisa menggerogoti dan merobek hampir semua benda dengan giginya...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_99_003
Array.english: Even the rocks blocking the entrance... if it sets its mind to it, it could break right through.
Array.indonesia: Bahkan batu-batu yang menghalangi pintu masuk... kalau makhluk itu bertekad, dia bisa menghancurkannya begitu saja.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_99_004
Array.english: <size=33>We need to take it down before it gets hungry!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kita harus mengalahkannya sebelum dia lapar!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_01_AfterXiphactinus_001
Array.english: You actually took that thing down?\nThat's... pretty impressive...
Array.indonesia: Kamu benar-benar berhasil mengalahkan makhluk itu?\nItu... cukup mengesankan...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_01_AfterXiphactinus_002
Array.english: Then I guess it's time to deal with the dinosaur below!
Array.indonesia: Kalau begitu, sepertinya sudah waktunya menghadapi dinosaurus di bawah sana!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_02_AfterXiphactinus_001
Array.english: Wait, you really defeated the monster in the residential quarters?
Array.indonesia: Tunggu, kamu benar-benar mengalahkan monster di kawasan pemukiman?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_02_AfterXiphactinus_002
Array.english: Human... you're tougher than you look.\nGotta give you that.
Array.indonesia: Manusia... kamu lebih tangguh dari yang terlihat.\nHarus aku akui itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_03_AfterXiphactinus_001
Array.english: Honestly didn't think you'd make it back...\nI'm a little surprised.
Array.indonesia: Sejujurnya, aku tidak menyangka kamu bisa kembali...\nAku agak terkejut.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_03_AfterXiphactinus_002
Array.english: Let's not pick any more fights from now on... hehe.
Array.indonesia: Mulai sekarang, jangan cari ribut lagi, ya... hehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_04_AfterXiphactinus_001
Array.english: Ooh... you really took down that monster?
Array.indonesia: Wah... kamu benar-benar mengalahkan monster itu?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_04_AfterXiphactinus_002
Array.english: Now we can finally go back home!
Array.indonesia: Sekarang kita akhirnya bisa pulang!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_04_AfterXiphactinus_003
Array.english: It's probably a mess right now, but...
Array.indonesia: Mungkin situasinya berantakan sekarang, tapi...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_05_AfterXiphactinus_001
Array.english: Is it true you really beat that fanged fish?
Array.indonesia: Benarkah kamu benar-benar mengalahkan ikan bertaring itu?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_05_AfterXiphactinus_002
Array.english: Yeah. It wasn't easy, though.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Tapi itu tidak mudah.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_05_AfterXiphactinus_003
Array.english: Wow... never thought we'd end up getting help from a human...
Array.indonesia: Wow... tidak pernah terpikirkan kita akhirnya mendapat bantuan dari manusia...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_05_AfterXiphactinus_004
Array.english: Now we can finally go back home. Hoho.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang kita akhirnya bisa pulang. Hoho.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_06_AfterXiphactinus_001
Array.english: <size=32>Ha! You actually took that thing down all by yourself?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ha! Kamu benar-benar mengalahkan makhluk itu sendirian?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_06_AfterXiphactinus_002
Array.english: Hmm... it was already pretty beat up from when I trapped it...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... makhluk itu sudah cukup babak belur sejak aku menjebaknya...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_06_AfterXiphactinus_003
Array.english: That must've weakened it.
Array.indonesia: Pasti itu yang melemahkannya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_06_AfterXiphactinus_004
Array.english: <size=34>You should be thanking me, human! Hahaha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kamu seharusnya berterima kasih padaku, manusia! Hahaha!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_07_AfterXiphactinus_001
Array.english: Ohh... you actually pulled it off...
Array.indonesia: Ohh... kamu benar-benar berhasil...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_07_AfterXiphactinus_002
Array.english: Well, thanks for that, haha!
Array.indonesia: Yah, terima kasih ya, haha!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_08_AfterXiphactinus_001
Array.english: Can't even breathe properly underwater, and a human still manages to help us...
Array.indonesia: Bahkan nggak bisa bernapas dengan baik di bawah air, tapi manusia tetap bisa membantu kita...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_08_AfterXiphactinus_002
Array.english: Not exactly our proudest moment.
Array.indonesia: Bukan momen yang paling membanggakan buat kita.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_99_AfterXiphactinus_001
Array.english: Didn't you say you found a way to make the dinosaur back off?
Array.indonesia: Bukankah kamu bilang sudah menemukan cara buat bikin dinosaurus itu mundur?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_99_AfterXiphactinus_002
Array.english: Once it moves away from the gate, we'll shut it.
Array.indonesia: Begitu dia menjauh dari gerbang, kita akan menutupnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_99_AfterXiphactinus_003
Array.english: Hurry and get things ready with your friends.
Array.indonesia: Cepat siapkan semuanya bersama teman-temanmu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_01_AfterEnding_001
Array.english: I heard you got eaten by that dinosaur...
Array.indonesia: Kudengar kamu dimakan oleh dinosaurus itu...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_01_AfterEnding_002
Array.english: Next thing I knew, it was split in half and lying there...
Array.indonesia: Tiba-tiba saja, dia terbelah dua dan tergeletak di sana...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_01_AfterEnding_003
Array.english: Are you some kind of incredible fighter?
Array.indonesia: Apa kamu semacam petarung yang luar biasa?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_02_AfterEnding_001
Array.english: Hey... don't you think you're wandering around our territory a bit too freely?
Array.indonesia: Hei... bukankah kamu terlalu bebas berkeliaran di wilayah kami?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_02_AfterEnding_002
Array.english: Well... the chief says it's fine, but...\nhumans still feel a bit strange to be around.
Array.indonesia: Yah... kepala suku bilang tidak apa-apa, tapi...\nmanusia masih terasa agak aneh di sekitar sini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_03_AfterEnding_001
Array.english: The gate's closed now, but there are still plenty of ancient creatures left.
Array.indonesia: Gerbangnya sudah ditutup sekarang, tapi masih banyak makhluk purba yang tersisa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_03_AfterEnding_002
Array.english: A lot came up during that time... some species have settled around here.
Array.indonesia: Banyak hal terjadi selama waktu itu... beberapa spesies telah menetap di sekitar sini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_03_AfterEnding_003
Array.english: Well, guess we'll have to learn to live with them.
Array.indonesia: Yah, sepertinya kita harus belajar hidup berdampingan dengan mereka.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_04_AfterEnding_001
Array.english: Ugh... the settlement's a total mess.
Array.indonesia: Ugh... pemukiman ini benar-benar berantakan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_04_AfterEnding_002
Array.english: But it looks like we've almost fixed everything.
Array.indonesia: Tapi sepertinya kita hampir menyelesaikan semuanya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_04_AfterEnding_003
Array.english: Human... thanks for now.
Array.indonesia: Manusia... terima kasih untuk saat ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_05_AfterEnding_001
Array.english: Thanks to you, we can come back home again.
Array.indonesia: Berkat kamu, kita bisa pulang lagi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_05_AfterEnding_002
Array.english: Torang cleared the debris, so things are mostly sorted out now.
Array.indonesia: Torang sudah membersihkan puing-puingnya, jadi sekarang semuanya sudah hampir beres.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_05_AfterEnding_003
Array.english: The ancient creatures are a bit scary, but...\nI'm still glad we can move around like before.
Array.indonesia: Makhluk purba itu memang agak menakutkan, tapi...\naku tetap senang kita bisa bergerak-gerak seperti dulu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_05_AfterEnding_004
Array.english: Maybe humans aren't so bad after all, hehe.
Array.indonesia: Mungkin manusia tidak seburuk itu juga, hehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_06_AfterEnding_001
Array.english: Ha... to think he ripped that massive dinosaur clean in half...
Array.indonesia: Ha... siapa sangka dia bisa membelah dinosaurus raksasa itu menjadi dua...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_06_AfterEnding_002
Array.english: What exactly did you do... human?
Array.indonesia: Apa sebenarnya yang kamu lakukan... manusia?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_06_AfterEnding_003
Array.english: That wasn't exactly on purpose...
Array.indonesia: Itu sebenarnya tidak disengaja...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_06_AfterEnding_004
Array.english: <size=32>Hey... I'm not fighting anymore, so don't come any closer!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hei... aku tidak akan bertarung lagi, jadi jangan mendekat!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_07_AfterEnding_001
Array.english: Phew. No more earthquakes... and those monsters are gone too...
Array.indonesia: Wah. Gempa bumi sudah berhenti... dan monster-monster itu juga sudah hilang...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_07_AfterEnding_002
Array.english: It's been a while since things felt this peaceful, haha.
Array.indonesia: Sudah lama rasanya tidak se damai ini, haha.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_07_AfterEnding_003
Array.english: Part of that's thanks to you, so feel free to come by anytime, but...
Array.indonesia: Sebagian berkat kamu, jadi silakan mampir kapan saja, tapi...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_07_AfterEnding_004
Array.english: <size=32>Don't bring any other humans though!\nThey smell weird!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tapi jangan bawa manusia lain ya!\nBau mereka aneh!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_08_AfterEnding_001
Array.english: Hate to admit it, but you did help this time, human.
Array.indonesia: Aku benci mengakuinya, tapi kali ini kamu memang membantu, manusia.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_08_AfterEnding_002
Array.english: Well... a strategic alliance, I guess?
Array.indonesia: Yah... aliansi strategis, kurasa?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_08_AfterEnding_003
Array.english: Let's team up when we need to from now on, hehe.
Array.indonesia: Mulai sekarang, mari kita bekerja sama saat diperlukan, hehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_99_AfterEnding_001
Array.english: Phew... when you got swallowed by that dinosaur,\nI thought we were in real trouble.
Array.indonesia: Wah... saat kamu ditelan dinosaurus itu,\naku pikir kita benar-benar dalam masalah.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_99_AfterEnding_002
Array.english: Then suddenly there was a boom from inside,\nand it split in half.
Array.indonesia: Lalu tiba-tiba terdengar ledakan dari dalam,\ndan dinosaurus itu terbelah dua.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_99_AfterEnding_003
Array.english: After you fell through the gate, you didn't come back up for a long time...
Array.indonesia: Setelah kamu jatuh melewati gerbang, kamu tidak muncul kembali untuk waktu yang lama...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_99_AfterEnding_004
Array.english: We were about to give up and close it...\nwhen you suddenly burst out, haha.
Array.indonesia: Kami hampir menyerah dan menutupnya...\nketika tiba-tiba kamu muncul dengan tiba-tiba, haha.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_99_AfterEnding_005
Array.english: It looked dangerous, so Torang swam you up to the surface.
Array.indonesia: Kelihatannya berbahaya, jadi Torang membawamu berenang ke permukaan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_99_AfterEnding_006
Array.english: So that's what happened... No wonder I made it up without my respirator...
Array.indonesia: Jadi begitulah yang terjadi... Pantas saja aku bisa naik ke permukaan tanpa alat bantu pernapasan...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_99_AfterEnding_007
Array.english: If I'd known that croc would charge in like that,\nI would've been more careful.
Array.indonesia: Kalau aku tahu buaya itu akan menyerang begitu saja,\naku pasti akan lebih berhati-hati.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_99_AfterEnding_008
Array.english: No, it's thanks to your help that I'm alive like this.
Array.indonesia: Tidak, berkat bantuanmu aku masih hidup seperti ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_99_AfterEnding_009
Array.english: Haha, things are settled for now, so don't worry and go handle your business.
Array.indonesia: Haha, semuanya sudah beres untuk saat ini, jadi jangan khawatir dan urus saja urusanmu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mahoni_99_AfterEnding_010
Array.english: If you feel like visiting, come by anytime.
Array.indonesia: Kalau mau mampir, datang saja kapan saja.

Array.name: NPC_GiftReward_FruitsBag01_001
Array.english: Looks like Jepun filled up the fruit basket again.\nI should check it out.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya Jepun mengisi keranjang buah lagi.\nAku harus memeriksanya.

Array.name: NPC_GiftReward_KidBrother01_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hehe... I caught this while crayfish fishing!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hehe... Aku menangkap ini saat memancing udang karang!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftReward_KidBrother01_002
Array.english: <size=32>This is for you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ini untukmu!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftReward_KidBrother01_003
Array.english:
<size=32>Oh... Isn't it a {0}? 
Thanks, Eka!</size>
Array.indonesia:
<size=32>Oh... Bukankah ini {0}? 
Terima kasih, Eka!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftReward_KidBroFriend01_001
Array.english: I, uh... found this while wandering around...
Array.indonesia: Aku, eh... menemukan ini saat berkeliling...

Array.name: NPC_GiftReward_KidBroFriend01_002
Array.english: <size=32>Figured you might need it, so here you go, mister.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kupikir kamu mungkin membutuhkannya, jadi ini untukmu, Pak.</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftReward_KidBroFriend01_003
Array.english: <size=32>That's really thoughtful of you, Bima. I'll put it to good use!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kamu sangat perhatian, Bima. Aku akan memanfaatkannya dengan baik!</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftReward_Marone01_001
Array.english: Woof!
Array.indonesia: Guk!

Array.name: NPC_GiftReward_Marone01_002
Array.english: Hm? Is this for me?
Array.indonesia: Hm? Ini buat aku?

Array.name: NPC_GiftReward_Marone01_003
Array.english: <size=32>Thanks. I'll put it to good use.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Terima kasih. Aku akan memanfaatkannya dengan baik.</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftReward_Marone02_001
Array.english: Woof! Woof!
Array.indonesia: Guk! Guk!

Array.name: NPC_GiftReward_Marone02_002
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... a <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color> today, too?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... <color=#FF73C3>Hadiah</color> hari ini juga?</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftReward_Marone02_003
Array.english: <size=33>Thanks! I'll put it to good use.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Terima kasih! Aku akan memanfaatkannya dengan baik.</size>

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Marone_Good_001
Array.english: Woof!
Array.indonesia: Guk!

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Marone_Good_002
Array.english: (Marone happily wags his tail.)
Array.indonesia: (Marone mengibas-ngibaskan ekornya dengan gembira.)

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Marone_Good_003
Array.english: You like that, huh?\nGlad you enjoy it.
Array.indonesia: Kamu suka itu, ya?\nSenang kamu menikmatinya.

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Marone_Excelent_001
Array.english: Woof! Woof!
Array.indonesia: Guk! Guk!

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Marone_Excelent_002
Array.english: (Marone wags his tail excitedly.)
Array.indonesia: (Marone mengibas-ngibaskan ekornya dengan penuh semangat.)

Array.name: NPC_GiftDialogue_JDLC_Marone_Excelent_003
Array.english: This little guy...\nHe likes <color=#FF73C3>Well-Done Meat</color>, so he's got good taste.
Array.indonesia: Si kecil ini...\nDia suka <color=#FF73C3>Daging Matang</color>, jadi seleranya bagus.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_MunaKnock_001
Array.english: *Yaaawn*... Sounds like Muna...
Array.indonesia: *Yaaawn*... Kayaknya Muna...

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_MunaKnock_002
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... right, she said she'd prepare a <color=#F1DC2B>Mini Bomb</color> for the deep-sea dinosaur, didn't she...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... benar juga, dia bilang akan menyiapkan <color=#F1DC2B>Mini Bomb</color> untuk dinosaurus laut dalam, kan...</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_MunaKnockOutside01_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hehe, Dave. Both <color=#F1DC2B>Mini Bombs</color> are ready!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehe, Dave. Kedua <color=#F1DC2B>Mini Bomb</color> sudah siap!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_MunaKnockOutside01_002
Array.english: First, throw one into the Basilosaurus's mouth...
Array.indonesia: Pertama, lemparkan satu ke dalam mulut Basilosaurus...

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_MunaKnockOutside01_003
Array.english: If something goes wrong or it doesn't react,\nuse the spare one!
Array.indonesia: Kalau ada yang salah atau dia tidak bereaksi,\ngunakan yang cadangan!

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_MunaKnockOutside01_004
Array.english: <size=32>Okay, got it.\nDon't worry, Muna!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oke, paham.\nJangan khawatir, Muna!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_MunaKnockOutside01_005
Array.english: I know you've been down there before, but...\njust in case, be careful...!
Array.indonesia: Aku tahu kamu pernah ke sana sebelumnya, tapi...\nuntuk jaga-jaga, hati-hati...!

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_MunaKnockOutside02_001
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(If I use the <color=#F1DC2B>Mini Bomb</color> to make the Basilosaurus back off...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Kalau aku pakai <color=#F1DC2B>Mini Bomb</color> buat bikin Basilosaurus mundur...)</color>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_MunaKnockOutside02_002
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(...then the Sea People will close the gate again, right?)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(...maka Sea People bakal menutup gerbang lagi, kan?)</color>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_MunaKnockOutside02_003
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Doesn't seem like there should be any problems, but...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Sepertinya tidak akan ada masalah, tapi...)</color>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_MunaKnockOutside02_004
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Muna's right. Anything could happen, so I'd better be fully prepared before heading down.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Muna benar. Apa pun bisa terjadi, jadi lebih baik aku bersiap sepenuhnya sebelum turun.)</color>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_BasiloEncounter01_001
Array.english: <size=32>Ugh... seeing it again, it really does look vicious...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ugh... melihatnya lagi, makhluk itu benar-benar terlihat ganas...!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_BasiloEncounter01_002
Array.english: <size=32>So I just throw the bomb Muna gave me into its mouth to make it back off, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Jadi, aku tinggal melempar bom yang diberikan Muna ke mulutnya agar makhluk itu mundur, kan?</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_BasiloEncounter02_001
Array.english: <size=34>Whoa!! It's suddenly sucking in a huge breath...!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wah!! Tiba-tiba makhluk itu menarik napas dalam-dalam...!!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_BasiloEncounter02_002
Array.english: <size=35>I need to get up, fast...!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Aku harus segera bangun...!!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_BasiloEncounter03_001
Array.english: <size=36>...The signal just...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Sinyal...Theu tiba-tiba...?!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_BasiloEncounter03_002
Array.english: <size=37>Dave? Dave...!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Dave? Dave...!?</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_BasiloInside_Wakeup_001
Array.english: <size=32>Dave...? Can you hear me...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Dave...? Apa kamu bisa mendengarku...?</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_BasiloInside_Wakeup_002
Array.english: <size=35>...Ugh... where am I...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>...Ugh... di mana aku...?</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_BasiloInside_Wakeup_003
Array.english: Phew... Dave, you're okay. \nI was worried when the comms suddenly cut out.
Array.indonesia: Wah... Dave, kamu baik-baik saja. \nAku khawatir saat komunikasi tiba-tiba terputus.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_BasiloInside_Wakeup_004
Array.english: Hmm... it's damp in here... and there are all these creepy-looking organs...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... di sini lembap... dan ada banyak organ yang tampak menyeramkan...

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_BasiloInside_Wakeup_005
Array.english: That must be the inside of the Basilosaurus.
Array.indonesia: Itu pasti bagian dalam Basilosaurus.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_BasiloInside_Wakeup_006
Array.english: <size=33>...You got swallowed whole earlier.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...Youu yang tadi ditelan utuh.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_BasiloInside_Wakeup_007
Array.english: You still have both <color=#F1DC2B>Mini Bombs</color> I gave you, right?
Array.indonesia: Kamu masih punya kedua <color=#F1DC2B>Mini Bombs</color> yang kuberikan, kan?

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_BasiloInside_Wakeup_008
Array.english: Yes. I've got them.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Aku masih memilikinya.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_BasiloInside_Wakeup_009
Array.english: Good.\nYou should be somewhere near its stomach right now...
Array.indonesia: Bagus.\nKamu seharusnya berada di dekat perutnya sekarang...

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_BasiloInside_Wakeup_010
Array.english: <size=32>If you can make your way up...\nhead toward the <color=#1DFEAF>Heart</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kalau kamu bisa naik ke atas...\narah ke <color=#1DFEAF>Jantung</color>.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_BasiloInside_Wakeup_011
Array.english: <size=32>The <color=#1DFEAF>Heart</color>...?\nIsn't that way too dangerous?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32><color=#1DFEAF>Jantung</color>...?\nBukankah itu terlalu berbahaya?</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_BasiloInside_Wakeup_012
Array.english: Like I said, these bombs will only startle it a bit.
Array.indonesia: Seperti yang sudah kukatakan, bom-bom ini hanya akan membuatnya sedikit terkejut.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_BasiloInside_Wakeup_013
Array.english: The shock needs to be strong enough to force its mouth open. That's your only way out.
Array.indonesia: Guncangannya harus cukup kuat untuk memaksa mulutnya terbuka. Itu satu-satunya jalan keluarmu.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_BasiloInside_Wakeup_014
Array.english: If you just stay there... the stomach acid will dissolve everything but your bones...
Array.indonesia: Jika kamu tetap di sana... asam lambung akan melarutkan segalanya kecuali tulang-tulangmu...

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_BasiloInside_Wakeup_015
Array.english: <size=32>Uh... alright.\nI'll head up for now.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Uh... oke.\nAku akan naik dulu.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_BasiloInside_GastricAcid_001
Array.english: <size=33>Whoa...! Gastric acid is pouring out...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wah...! Asam lambung mengalir deras...!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_BasiloInside_GastricAcid_002
Array.english: <size=32>That would really sting if it touched me...\nI've got to dodge around it carefully.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Itu pasti akan sangat perih kalau menyentuhku...\nAku harus menghindarinya dengan hati-hati.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_BasiloInside_AbscessElevator_001
Array.english: <size=32>Phew... it's seriously spacious in here...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wah... tempat ini benar-benar luas...</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_BasiloInside_AbscessElevator_002
Array.english: <size=32>And something smells awful...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Dan ada bau yang sangat tidak sedap...</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_BasiloInside_AbscessElevator_003
Array.english: <size=32>I can't stay here.\nI need to keep moving up.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku tidak bisa tinggal di sini.\nAku harus terus naik.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_HeartRoom_BombInstall_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, Dave! You made it all the way to the Basilosaurus's <color=#1DFEAF>Heart</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, Dave! Kamu berhasil sampai ke <color=#1DFEAF>Jantung</color> Basilosaurus!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_HeartRoom_BombInstall_002
Array.english: <size=32>Yeah... I think so....</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ya... kurasa begitu....</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_HeartRoom_BombInstall_003
Array.english: <size=31>Is there somewhere nearby where you can set up a <color=#F1DC2B>Mini Bomb</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Ada tempat di dekat sini di mana kamu bisa memasang <color=#F1DC2B>Bom Mini</color>?</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_HeartRoom_BombInstall_004
Array.english: <size=32>The video feed isn't working, so I can't see anything....</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Siaran videonya tidak berfungsi, jadi aku tidak bisa melihat apa-apa....</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_HeartRoom_BombInstall_005
Array.english: Hmm... even a small blast right next to the heart could be dangerous...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... ledakan kecil sekalipun tepat di samping jantungnya bisa berbahaya...

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_HeartRoom_BombInstall_006
Array.english: I'll set it a little farther away.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan meletakkannya sedikit lebih jauh.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_HeartRoom_BombInstall_007
Array.english: <size=33>Yes, yes. That'll be more than enough to startle it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ya, ya. Itu sudah lebih dari cukup untuk membuatnya kaget!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_HeartRoom_BombInstall02_001
Array.english: Alright...\nThis should be a good spot, right?
Array.indonesia: Baiklah...\nTempat ini seharusnya bagus, kan?

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_HeartRoom_BombInstall02_002
Array.english: Now let's get somewhere safe and wait.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang mari kita cari tempat yang aman dan tunggu.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_HeartRoom_Explosion_001
Array.english: <size=34>Whoa...! Everything's going haywire... what's happening?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wah...! Semuanya jadi kacau balau... apa yang terjadi?!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_HeartRoom_Explosion_002
Array.english: <size=35>Ah! Looks like I messed up the yield calculation…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ah! Sepertinya aku salah menghitung hasilnya…</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_HeartRoom_Explosion_003
Array.english: Oh... that should've been addition, not multiplication…
Array.indonesia: Oh... seharusnya itu penjumlahan, bukan perkalian…

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_HeartRoom_Explosion_004
Array.english: <size=32>I'm so sorry...! In this state, its mouth is completely shut, there's no way out through the top anymore.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Maaf banget...! Dalam keadaan seperti ini, mulutnya tertutup rapat, jadi nggak ada jalan keluar dari atas lagi.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_HeartRoom_Explosion_005
Array.english: <size=34>Could you maybe get out from below instead?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Bisakah kamu keluar dari bawah saja?!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_HeartRoom_Explosion_006
Array.english: <size=32>Oh...! Water's already flooding in and rising....</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh...! Air sudah mulai masuk dan naik....</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_HeartRoom_Explosion_007
Array.english: <size=33>Looks like I'll need to put on the diving suit to move around.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Sepertinya aku harus memakai pakaian selam untuk bergerak.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_HeartRoom_Explosion_008
Array.english: <size=32>Ah... this is all because I didn't prepare properly...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ah... ini semua karena aku tidak mempersiapkan diri dengan baik...</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_HeartRoom_Explosion_009
Array.english: <size=33>Please come back safe... Dave.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tolong pulang dengan selamat... Dave.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_BasiloInside_EscapeStart_001
Array.english: <size=32>Whoa...! The organs are convulsing...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wah...! Organ-organ tubuhku kejang-kejang...!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_BasiloInside_EscapeStart_002
Array.english: <size=32>If I'm not careful I'll get trapped in here...!\nI need to get out fast...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kalau aku tidak hati-hati, aku akan terjebak di sini...!\nAku harus segera keluar...!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_BasiloInside_IntestineEnter_001
Array.english: <size=32>There's an opening down below!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ada celah di bawah sana!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_BasiloInside_IntestineEnter_002
Array.english: <size=33>But... that's gotta be... uh...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tapi... itu pasti... eh...</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_BasiloInside_IntestineEnter_003
Array.english: <size=33>Doesn't look like I have much choice...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Sepertinya aku tidak punya banyak pilihan...</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_BasiloInside_IntestineStart_001
Array.english: <size=32>Yeah, just as I thought... the large intestine... Ugh... this smell is awful...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ya, seperti yang kuduga... usus besar... Ugh... baunya mengerikan...</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_BasiloInside_IntestineStart_002
Array.english: <size=32>The current's too strong to go back up...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Arusnya terlalu kuat untuk kembali ke atas...</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_BasiloInside_IntestineStart_003
Array.english: <size=32>I'll just ride the current down...\nThere's gotta be a way out...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku akan mengikuti arus ke bawah saja...\nPasti ada jalan keluar...!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_BasiloInside_ExitArrive_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... it's a dead end...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... ini jalan buntu...</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_BasiloInside_ExitArrive_002
Array.english: <size=32>Which means this hole is... uh....</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Artinya lubang ini... eh....</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_BasiloInside_ExitArrive_003
Array.english: <size=32>The muscles are relaxed right now...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Otot-ototku rileks sekarang...</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_BasiloInside_ExitArrive_004
Array.english: <size=32>No choice... I'll have to force it open and get out through here...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tidak ada pilihan... Aku harus memaksanya terbuka dan keluar dari sini...!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_HollowEarth_Arrive_001
Array.english: <size=35>Whoaaaa...?! What is this place...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wahhh...?! Tempat apa ini...?!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_HollowEarth_Arrive_002
Array.english: <size=35>...Everything is upside down...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>...Everythingu terbalik...!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_HollowEarth_Escape_001
Array.english: <size=33>It's full of ancient creatures... Is there another world inside the Earth...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Penuh dengan makhluk purba... Apakah ada dunia lain di dalam Bumi...?!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_HollowEarth_Escape_002
Array.english: <size=34>Ugh... maybe it's the reversed gravity, but it's hard to breathe...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ugh... mungkin karena gravitasi terbalik, tapi sulit bernapas...</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_HollowEarth_Escape_003
Array.english: <size=33>I need to get back to where I was...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku harus kembali ke tempat semula...!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_HollowEarth_Escape02_001
Array.english: <size=33>Whoa...! A huge dinosaur is coming this way... \nwhat do I do...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wah...! Seekor dinosaurus raksasa sedang mendekat ke arah sini... \napa yang harus kulakukan...!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_HollowEarth_Escape02_002
Array.english: <size=32>That's it! The <color=#F1DC2B>Spare Bomb</color> Muna gave me!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Itu dia! <color=#F1DC2B>Bom Cadangan</color> yang diberikan Muna padaku!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_HollowEarth_Escape02_003
Array.english: <size=32>I'll detonate it and use the pressure to shoot back up...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku akan meledakkannya dan memanfaatkan tekanannya untuk melesat kembali ke atas...!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_HollowEarth_Escape02_004
Array.english: <size=32>...Though I hope she didn't mess up the yield on this one too....</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>...Though Semoga dia tidak salah menghitung daya ledaknya kali ini juga....</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_HollowEarth_Escape02_005
Array.english: <size=32>My tank's running low, so there's no other option...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tangki bensinku hampir kosong, jadi nggak ada pilihan lain...!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_HollowEarth_Escape02_006
Array.english: <size=35>Ah, it'll work out somehow...!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ah, pasti ada jalan keluarnya...!!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_CobraRescue_Wait_001
Array.english: Hmph... Dave's taking his sweet time getting back.
Array.indonesia: Hmph... Dave lama banget baliknya.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_CobraRescue_Wait_002
Array.english: Ugh... it's my fault for giving him that faulty bomb...
Array.indonesia: Ugh... ini salahku karena memberinya bom yang rusak itu...

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_CobraRescue_Wait_003
Array.english: But I made the spare one properly...!\nI should've given him only that one...
Array.indonesia: Tapi aku membuat bom cadangannya dengan benar...!\nSeharusnya aku hanya memberinya yang itu saja...

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_CobraRescue_Wait_004
Array.english: Let's wait a bit longer.\nHe's tougher than he looks, he'll make it back safe....
Array.indonesia: Ayo kita tunggu sebentar lagi.\nDia lebih tangguh dari kelihatannya, dia pasti akan kembali dengan selamat....

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_CobraRescue_Found_001
Array.english: <size=35>Oh...! That's...!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh...! Itu...!?</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_CobraRescue_Found_002
Array.english: <size=36>It's Dave!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Itu Dave!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_CobraRescue_Found_003
Array.english: <size=35>He's alive! Thank goodness!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Dia masih hidup! Syukurlah!!!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_CobraRescue_Croc_001
Array.english: <size=34>Wait...! A swarm of crocodiles is heading this way...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Tunggu...! Sekelompok buaya sedang menuju ke sini...!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_CobraRescue_Croc_002
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm... those are Black Caimans...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm... itu adalah buaya hitam...</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_CobraRescue_Croc_003
Array.english: <size=35>This is getting dangerous!\nEveryone, fall back!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ini semakin berbahaya!\nSemuanya, mundur!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_CobraRescue_Cutscene_001
Array.english: This distance won't work...
Array.indonesia: Jarak ini tidak akan cukup...

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_CobraRescue_Cutscene_002
Array.english: <size=33>Damn it! I'll have to go in myself...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Sial! Aku harus masuk sendiri...!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_CobraRescue_Cutscene_003
Array.english: <size=34>What...!? You're going in yourself...!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Apa...!? Kamu mau masuk sendiri...!?</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_CobraRescue_Cutscene_004
Array.english: <size=33>I can't just stand here and watch!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku tidak bisa hanya berdiri di sini dan menonton!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_CobraRescue_Cutscene_005
Array.english: <size=32>Those crocodiles are vicious...!\nThink this through!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Buaya-buaya itu ganas...!\nPikirkan baik-baik!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_CobraRescue_Cutscene_006
Array.english: <size=32>Don't worry!\nI'll get him out fast!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Jangan khawatir!\nAku akan segera menyelamatkannya!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DaveHouse_Ending_001
Array.english: ...What happened...?
Array.indonesia: ...Apa yang terjadi...?

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DaveHouse_Ending_002
Array.english: I was definitely in a sea full of ancient creatures...?
Array.indonesia: Aku pasti berada di laut yang penuh dengan makhluk purba...?

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DaveHouse_Ending_003
Array.english: <size=32>Oh...! You're awake!\nGlad to see you're alright!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh...! Kamu sudah bangun!\nSenang melihat kamu baik-baik saja!!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DaveHouse_Ending_004
Array.english: <size=35>Wha...! Cobra, your arm...!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Apa...! Cobra, lenganmu...!!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DaveHouse_Ending_005
Array.english: He got hurt pulling you out when you surfaced in the lake...
Array.indonesia: Dia terluka saat menarikmu keluar ketika kamu muncul ke permukaan danau...

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DaveHouse_Ending_005_2
Array.english: Ah, I see… I can’t believe this happened because of me… \nI’m so, so sorry…
Array.indonesia: Ah, begitu… Aku nggak percaya ini terjadi karena aku… \nMaaf banget, maaf banget…

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DaveHouse_Ending_006
Array.english: <size=32>Ha ha! \nDon't worry about it! We all made it out fine, didn't we!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ha ha! \nJangan dipikirin! Kita semua selamat, kan!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DaveHouse_Ending_007
Array.english: <size=32>Lathi's ointment is working wonders - it'll heal up in no time!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Salep Lathi sangat ampuh — lukanya akan sembuh dalam sekejap!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DaveHouse_Ending_008
Array.english: I'm so sorry, Dave... \nI'm the one who gave you that faulty bomb...
Array.indonesia: Aku sangat menyesal, Dave... \nAkulah yang memberimu bom yang rusak itu...

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DaveHouse_Ending_009
Array.english: But I'm just so glad you made it back... sniff...
Array.indonesia: Tapi aku sangat senang kamu berhasil kembali... huhu...

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DaveHouse_Ending_010
Array.english: Phew... I honestly don't even know how I made it back...
Array.indonesia: Fiuh... Sejujurnya aku bahkan tidak tahu bagaimana aku bisa kembali...

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DaveHouse_Ending_011
Array.english: I got too close and messed everything up.
Array.indonesia: Aku terlalu dekat dan merusak segalanya.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DaveHouse_Ending_012
Array.english: <size=32>Don't say that.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Jangan bilang begitu.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DaveHouse_Ending_013
Array.english: Thanks to you, the sea dragon is gone...\nAnd the Sea People closed the gate in that rift.
Array.indonesia: Berkat kamu, naga laut itu sudah hilang...\nDan Suku Laut telah menutup gerbang di celah itu.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DaveHouse_Ending_014
Array.english: That's a relief...\nSo the Chief kept his promise after all.
Array.indonesia: Lega sekali...\nJadi, Kepala Suku memang menepati janjinya.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DaveHouse_Ending_015
Array.english: We've accomplished what we came here to do.\nWell done, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Kita sudah menyelesaikan tugas yang harus kita lakukan di sini.\nKerja bagus, Dave.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DaveHouse_Ending_016
Array.english: It's all thanks to you guys and the villagers.
Array.indonesia: Semua ini berkat kalian dan para penduduk desa.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DaveHouse_Ending_017
Array.english: I should head out and say hi to everyone in the village.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus pergi dan menyapa semua orang di desa.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DaveHouse_Ending_018
Array.english: <size=34>Oh, you shouldn't be moving around just yet!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh, kamu belum boleh bergerak-gerak dulu!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DaveHouse_Ending_019
Array.english: <size=32>Um... the village is...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Um... desa itu...</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DaveHouse_Ending_020
Array.english: <size=36>I'll send up the drone and show you! Hehe!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Aku akan menerbangkan drone dan memperlihatkannya padamu! Hehe!!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DaveHouse_AfterEnding_001
Array.english: Must be thanks to the herbs... I'm already feeling a lot better.
Array.indonesia: Pasti berkat ramuan-ramuan itu... Aku sudah merasa jauh lebih baik.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DaveHouse_AfterEnding_002
Array.english: <size=32>Maybe I'll head out for a walk.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Mungkin aku akan jalan-jalan sebentar.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DaveHouse_AfterEnding_Statue_001
Array.english: Hm? Peneb... what brings you here?
Array.indonesia: Hm? Peneb... apa yang membawamu ke sini?

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DaveHouse_AfterEnding_Statue_002
Array.english: <size=32>Hey, pal! You're up.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hei, sobat! Kamu sudah bangun.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DaveHouse_AfterEnding_Statue_003
Array.english: <size=32>You're lookin' pretty good.\nI was actually kinda worried about ya!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kamu terlihat cukup baik.\nAku sebenarnya agak khawatir sama kamu!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DaveHouse_AfterEnding_Statue_004
Array.english: A lot happened...\nbut after some rest, I'm feeling better.
Array.indonesia: Banyak hal yang terjadi...\ntapi setelah istirahat sebentar, aku merasa lebih baik.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DaveHouse_AfterEnding_Statue_005
Array.english: <size=32>Heh! Knew a guy like you would bounce back fast.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Heh! Aku tahu orang sepertimu pasti cepat pulih.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DaveHouse_AfterEnding_Statue_006
Array.english: I made this as a little thank-you for helping the village... Mind if I set it up here?
Array.indonesia: Aku bikin ini sebagai ucapan terima kasih kecil karena sudah membantu desa... Boleh aku taruh di sini?

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DaveHouse_AfterEnding_Statue_007
Array.english: <size=33>This is... me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ini... aku?</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DaveHouse_AfterEnding_Statue_008
Array.english: Heh, that's right. You went above and beyond for this village - figured we should leave something behind, right?
Array.indonesia: Heh, betul. Kamu sudah berbuat lebih dari yang diharapkan untuk desa ini — kupikir kita harus meninggalkan sesuatu sebagai kenang-kenangan, kan?

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DaveHouse_AfterEnding_Statue_009
Array.english: <size=32>Even after you're gone, everyone here will remember you through this.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Bahkan setelah kamu pergi, semua orang di sini akan mengingatmu melalui ini.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DaveHouse_AfterEnding_Statue_010
Array.english: <size=32>Thank you! I really love it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Terima kasih! Aku benar-benar menyukainya!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DaveHouse_AfterEnding_Statue_011
Array.english: <size=34>Heh. Take care, pal!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Heh. Jaga dirimu baik-baik, sobat!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_MahoniCoconutDivingBellEvent_001
Array.english: Hm? Chief, what brings you here?
Array.indonesia: Hm? Kepala Desa, ada apa kamu ke sini?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_MahoniCoconutDivingBellEvent_002
Array.english: I hear you've been down beneath the lake.
Array.indonesia: Kudengar kamu sudah turun ke dasar danau.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_MahoniCoconutDivingBellEvent_003
Array.english: Yes. There's a surprisingly deep sea down there.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Laut di sana ternyata sangat dalam.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_MahoniCoconutDivingBellEvent_004
Array.english: So it's true.\nJust as it's written in the ancient texts.
Array.indonesia: Jadi itu benar.\nPersis seperti yang tertulis dalam teks-teks kuno.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_MahoniCoconutDivingBellEvent_005
Array.english: Swimming all the way down there and back can't be easy.
Array.indonesia: Berenang ke sana dan kembali pasti tidak mudah.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_MahoniCoconutDivingBellEvent_006
Array.english: I can't go down there with you to help...
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak bisa turun ke sana bersamamu untuk membantumu...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_MahoniCoconutDivingBellEvent_007
Array.english: But I've set up a <color=#F1DC2B>Coconut Signal</color> to help you come back up more easily.
Array.indonesia: Tapi aku sudah memasang <color=#F1DC2B>Sinyal Kelapa</color> untuk membantumu naik kembali dengan lebih mudah.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_MahoniCoconutDivingBellEvent_008
Array.english: Oh...! When did you set it up that deep down there?
Array.indonesia: Oh...! Kapan kamu memasangnya sedalam itu di bawah sana?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_MahoniCoconutDivingBellEvent_009
Array.english: Haha. Setting it up is simple. You just lower the device into the water.
Array.indonesia: Haha. Memasangnya mudah saja. Kamu tinggal menurunkan perangkat itu ke dalam air.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_MahoniCoconutDivingBellEvent_010
Array.english: I just had Perak help me extend the rope on the <color=#F1DC2B>Rescue Pod</color> \na bit.
Array.indonesia: Aku baru saja minta bantuan Perak untuk memperpanjang tali di <color=#F1DC2B>Rescue Pod</color> \nsedikit.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_MahoniCoconutDivingBellEvent_011
Array.english: <size=32>Well then, stay safe down there.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Baiklah, jaga dirimu di sana.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DuffCall_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hm...? Duff?\nWhat's the occasion?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hm...? Duff?\nAda apa?</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DuffCall_002
Array.english: <size=32>It's been a while.\nHow've you been?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32> Sudah lama ya.\nApa kabar?</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DuffCall_003
Array.english: I heard about Cobra...\nSomething bad happened.
Array.indonesia: Aku dengar soal Cobra...\nAda hal buruk yang terjadi.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DuffCall_004
Array.english: ...He got hurt trying to save me....
Array.indonesia: ...Dia terluka saat mencoba menyelamatkanku....

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DuffCall_005
Array.english: <size=32>Don't blame yourself, Dave.\nKeep your head up.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Jangan salahkan dirimu sendiri, Dave.\nTetap semangat.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DuffCall_006
Array.english: I think there's something I can do about this...
Array.indonesia: Kurasa ada yang bisa kulakukan soal ini...

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DuffCall_007
Array.english: <size=32>Give me a day.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Beri aku waktu satu hari.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DuffCall_008
Array.english: Oh... alright, got it.
Array.indonesia: Oh... oke, paham.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DuffCall_009
Array.english: <size=32>Time to unseal the Stella energy once more.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Saatnya membuka segel energi Stella sekali lagi.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_DuffCall_010
Array.english: <size=34>I'll be in touch.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku akan menghubungimu.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_Prosthetic01_001
Array.english: A call from Duff?\nHe said he'd try something, right?
Array.indonesia: Telepon dari Duff?\nDia bilang akan mencoba sesuatu, kan?

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_Prosthetic01_002
Array.english: Dave. Step outside for a moment.
Array.indonesia: Dave. Keluar sebentar.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_Prosthetic01_003
Array.english: <size=33>...With Cobra.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...With Cobra.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_Prosthetic02_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hm? A delivery out of nowhere?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hm? Kiriman yang muncul entah dari mana?</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_Prosthetic02_002
Array.english: Looks like Duff sent it.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya Duff yang mengirimnya.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_Prosthetic02_003
Array.english: <size=33>Let's open it up.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ayo kita buka.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_Prosthetic03_001
Array.english: <size=35>Whoa...! Is this a <color=#F1DC2B>Prosthetic Arm</color>?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wah...! Apa ini <color=#F1DC2B>Lengan Prostetik</color>?!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_Prosthetic03_002
Array.english: <size=32>Wow... I can't believe he made something like this... \nIt's amazing.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wow... Aku nggak percaya dia bisa bikin sesuatu kayak gini... \nKeren banget.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_Prosthetic03_003
Array.english: <size=32>Go ahead and try it on, Cobra.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Coba aja pakai, Cobra.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_Prosthetic03_004
Array.english: <size=33>Don't mind if I do! Hang on a sec.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Nggak apa-apa dong! Tunggu sebentar.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_Prosthetic04_001
Array.english: <size=35>Ha ha ha!! Fits like a glove!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ha ha ha!! Pas banget kayak sarung tangan!!!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_Prosthetic04_002
Array.english: <size=32>Wow... it looks incredibly natural. And cool!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wow... kelihatannya sangat alami. Dan keren!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_Prosthetic04_003
Array.english: <size=32>Feels even stronger than before!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Rasanya bahkan lebih kuat dari sebelumnya!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_Prosthetic04_004
Array.english: <size=34>I should send Duff a thank-you.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku harus kirim ucapan terima kasih ke Duff.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_UnlockIronpunch_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! This prosthetic arm... is pretty sturdy!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Lengan palsu ini... lumayan kokoh!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_UnlockIronpunch_002
Array.english: <size=32>I could try out some new moves with this.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku bisa mencoba beberapa gerakan baru dengan ini.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Start_001
Array.english: Hoho... looks like you wish to ask the spirit something.
Array.indonesia: Hoho... sepertinya kamu ingin bertanya sesuatu kepada roh itu.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Start_002
Array.english: I can see what you've been doing here, you know...\nNow, let me see.
Array.indonesia: Aku tahu apa yang selama ini kamu lakukan di sini, lho...\nNah, biar aku lihat.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Start_003
Array.english: <size=50>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>...</size>

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Start_004
Array.english: <size=33>I can hear the voice of the spirit...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku bisa mendengar suara roh itu...</size>

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Select_001
Array.english: I can see what you've been doing here, you know...\nNow, let me see.
Array.indonesia: Aku tahu apa yang selama ini kamu lakukan di sini, lho...\nNah, biar aku lihat.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_Start_001
Array.english: I can see what you've been doing here, you know...\nNow, let me see.
Array.indonesia: Aku bisa melihat apa yang telah kamu lakukan di sini, lho...\nSekarang, biar aku lihat.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_Fish_001
Array.english: The number of fish you've caught in this region is...\n<myinfo=JungleFishCount/> in total.
Array.indonesia: Jumlah ikan yang telah kamu tangkap di wilayah ini adalah...\n<myinfo=JungleFishCount/> secara total.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_Fish_Less_001
Array.english: It doesn't seem you've caught many yet.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya kamu belum menangkap banyak.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_Fish_Less_002
Array.english:
The spirit says all sorts of fish live in this lake,
so do look around more.
Array.indonesia:
Roh itu mengatakan berbagai jenis ikan hidup di danau ini,
jadi cobalah jelajahi lebih jauh.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_Fish_Mid_001
Array.english: It seems you've caught a fair number of fish.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya kamu sudah menangkap cukup banyak ikan.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_Fish_Mid_002
Array.english: The villagers do enjoy your cooking.
Array.indonesia: Para penduduk desa sangat menikmati masakanmu.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_Fish_Mid_003
Array.english: A new dish can truly lift one's spirits.\nKeep up the good work.
Array.indonesia: Hidangan baru benar-benar bisa mengangkat semangat seseorang.\nTeruslah bekerja dengan baik.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_Fish_More_001
Array.english: Hoho, it seems you've caught quite a lot.
Array.indonesia: Hoho, sepertinya kamu sudah menangkap cukup banyak.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_Fish_More_002
Array.english: The spirit has blessed the fish that sustain our villagers.
Array.indonesia: Roh itu telah memberkati ikan-ikan yang menjadi sumber penghidupan penduduk desa kami.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_Flower_001
Array.english: The number of flowers you've gathered in this region is... <myinfo=JungleFlowerCount/> in total.
Array.indonesia: Jumlah bunga yang telah kamu kumpulkan di wilayah ini adalah... <myinfo=JungleFlowerCount/> secara total.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_Flower_Less_001
Array.english: It doesn't seem you've gathered many yet.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya kamu belum mengumpulkan banyak.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_Flower_Less_002
Array.english: This region is full of beautiful flowers.\nTake your time searching for them.
Array.indonesia: Wilayah ini penuh dengan bunga-bunga indah.\nLuangkan waktumu untuk mencarinya.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_Flower_More_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hoho, you've gathered quite a lot of flowers!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hoho, kamu sudah mengumpulkan cukup banyak bunga!</size>

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_Flower_More_002
Array.english: You've even gathered some for this old soul before...\nThank you once again.
Array.indonesia: Kamu bahkan sudah mengumpulkan beberapa untuk orang tua ini sebelumnya...\nTerima kasih sekali lagi.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_Insect_001
Array.english: The number of insects you've collected in this region is... <myinfo=JungleInsectCount/> in total.
Array.indonesia: Jumlah serangga yang telah kamu kumpulkan di wilayah ini adalah... <myinfo=JungleInsectCount/> secara total.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_Insect_Less_001
Array.english: It doesn't seem you've encountered many yet.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya kamu belum menemukan banyak serangga.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_Insect_Less_002
Array.english: There are many rare insects here you won't find elsewhere, so do look carefully.
Array.indonesia: Ada banyak serangga langka di sini yang tidak akan kamu temukan di tempat lain, jadi perhatikanlah dengan saksama.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_Insect_More_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hoho, it seems you've encountered quite a few insects.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hoho, sepertinya kamu sudah menemukan cukup banyak serangga.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_Insect_More_002
Array.english: This region is full of insects, both in the village and the forest.
Array.indonesia: Wilayah ini penuh dengan serangga, baik di desa maupun di hutan.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_Insect_More_003
Array.english: If there are any you haven't found yet, do take your time searching.
Array.indonesia: Jika ada yang belum kamu temukan, luangkan waktu untuk mencarinya.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_Tree_001
