Array.english: The number of trees you've felled in this region is...\n<myinfo=JungleTreeCount/> in total.
Array.indonesia: Jumlah pohon yang telah kamu tebang di wilayah ini adalah...\n<myinfo=JungleTreeCount/> secara keseluruhan.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_Tree_Less_001
Array.english: You haven't cut down many yet.
Array.indonesia: Kamu belum menebang banyak.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_Tree_Less_002
Array.english: You mustn't chop them down recklessly... but this land is rich in resources, so use what you need...
Array.indonesia: Kamu tidak boleh menebangnya sembarangan... tetapi tanah ini kaya akan sumber daya, jadi gunakanlah apa yang kamu butuhkan...

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_Tree_Less_003
Array.english: ...so the spirit says.
Array.indonesia: ...demikian kata roh tersebut.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_Tree_More_001
Array.english: Hoo... you've felled quite a number of trees.
Array.indonesia: Hoo... kamu sudah menebang cukup banyak pohon.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_Tree_More_002
Array.english: As long as it's for good use, the spirit gladly grants permission.
Array.indonesia: Selama digunakan untuk kebaikan, roh tersebut dengan senang hati memberikan izin.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_Tree_More_003
Array.english: Do not worry, and put them to use where they help the village.
Array.indonesia: Jangan khawatir, dan manfaatkanlah untuk kepentingan desa.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_Ore_001
Array.english: The amount of ore you've mined in this region is...\n<myinfo=JungleGatheredOreCount/> in total.
Array.indonesia: Jumlah bijih yang telah kamu tambang di wilayah ini adalah...\n<myinfo=JungleGatheredOreCount/> secara total.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_Ore_Less_001
Array.english: It doesn't seem you've mined much yet.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya kamu belum menambang banyak.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_Ore_Less_002
Array.english: The resources in this region recover remarkably quickly.
Array.indonesia: Sumber daya di wilayah ini pulih dengan sangat cepat.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_Ore_Less_003
Array.english: The spirit says to use them generously, with a grateful heart.
Array.indonesia: Roh tersebut menyarankan agar kamu menggunakannya dengan murah hati, dengan hati yang bersyukur.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_Ore_More_001
Array.english: It seems you've mined quite a lot of ore.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya kamu sudah menambang cukup banyak bijih.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_Ore_More_002
Array.english: As you know, this region is abundant in resources and they replenish swiftly.
Array.indonesia: Seperti yang kamu ketahui, wilayah ini kaya akan sumber daya dan sumber daya tersebut pulih dengan cepat.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_Ore_More_003
Array.english: The spirit asks that you use them for good purposes,\nso do not worry.
Array.indonesia: Roh tersebut meminta agar kamu menggunakannya untuk tujuan yang baik,\njadi jangan khawatir.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_Flower_Mid_001
Array.english: Hoo... it seems you've searched for flowers quite a bit.
Array.indonesia: Hoo... sepertinya kamu sudah cukup banyak mencari bunga.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_Flower_Mid_002
Array.english: A wide variety of flowers bloom here.\nTake your time and observe them.
Array.indonesia: Beragam jenis bunga mekar di sini.\nLuangkan waktu dan amati mereka.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_Insect_Mid_001
Array.english: Hoo... it seems you've encountered a fair number of insects.
Array.indonesia: Hoo... sepertinya kamu sudah menjumpai cukup banyak serangga.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_Insect_Mid_002
Array.english: This region is home to many unusual insects.\nDo take a closer look.
Array.indonesia: Wilayah ini menjadi rumah bagi banyak serangga yang tidak biasa.\nSilakan lihat lebih dekat.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_Tree_Mid_001
Array.english: It seems you've felled a fair number of trees.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya kamu sudah menebang cukup banyak pohon.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_Tree_Mid_002
Array.english: Different types of wood serve different purposes.\nUse them wisely.
Array.indonesia: Jenis kayu yang berbeda memiliki kegunaan yang berbeda pula.\nGunakanlah dengan bijak.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_Ore_Mid_001
Array.english: It seems you've mined a fair amount of ore.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya kamu sudah menambang cukup banyak bijih.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_Ore_Mid_002
Array.english: Ore can be crafted into many kinds of tools.\nUse them without hesitation.
Array.indonesia: Bijih dapat diolah menjadi berbagai macam alat.\nGunakanlah tanpa ragu.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_ServeDish_001
Array.english: The meals served at your restaurant is <myinfo=JungleServedMealCount/> in total.
Array.indonesia: Jumlah hidangan yang disajikan di restoranmu adalah <myinfo=JungleServedMealCount/> secara total.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_ServeDish_Less_001
Array.english: The villagers find it delicious, so the spirit says to serve a bit more.
Array.indonesia: Penduduk desa menganggapnya lezat, jadi roh itu menyarankan untuk menyajikan sedikit lebih banyak.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_ServeDish_Mid_001
Array.english: You've filled the bellies of quite a few people.
Array.indonesia: Kamu telah mengenyangkan perut cukup banyak orang.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_ServeDish_Mid_002
Array.english: The spirit thanks you for keeping the villagers in good health.
Array.indonesia: Roh itu berterima kasih kepadamu karena telah menjaga kesehatan penduduk desa.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_ServeDish_More_001
Array.english: You've truly prepared meals for many people.
Array.indonesia: Kamu benar-benar telah menyiapkan hidangan untuk banyak orang.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_ServeDish_More_002
Array.english: Hoho... this old soul has eaten well too.\nThank you once again.
Array.indonesia: Hoho... jiwa tua ini juga sudah makan dengan enak.\nTerima kasih sekali lagi.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_ServeSkewer_001
Array.english: Your shop has served skewers to customers <myinfo=JungleServedSkewerCount/> times.
Array.indonesia: Toko Kamu telah menyajikan sate kepada pelanggan sebanyak <myinfo=JungleServedSkewerCount/> kali.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_ServeSkewer_Less_001
Array.english: Many customers are fond of skewers. Do take good care in preparing them.
Array.indonesia: Banyak pelanggan yang menyukai sate. Harap perhatikan baik-baik saat menyiapkannya.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_ServeSkewer_Mid_001
Array.english: You've served quite a number of customers.\nIt must be hard work.
Array.indonesia: Kamu telah melayani cukup banyak pelanggan.\nPasti kerja keras.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_ServeSkewer_More_001
Array.english: Hoho, you've served skewers to many villagers.
Array.indonesia: Hoho, kamu sudah menyajikan sate kepada banyak penduduk desa.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_ServeSkewer_More_002
Array.english: Grilling must take quite some effort...\nThank you for always preparing such delicious food.
Array.indonesia: Memanggang pasti membutuhkan usaha yang cukup besar...\nTerima kasih karena selalu menyiapkan makanan yang begitu lezat.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_NotMetVillager_001
Array.english: Hmm... there are still <myinfo=JungleVillagersNotMet/> villagers you have yet to meet.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... masih ada <myinfo=JungleVillagersNotMet/> penduduk desa yang belum kamu temui.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_NotMetVillager_More_001
Array.english: It seems you haven't had much time to spend with the villagers.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya kamu belum punya banyak waktu untuk menghabiskan waktu bersama penduduk desa.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_NotMetVillager_More_002
Array.english: <size=32>Try to take things a bit more slowly.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Cobalah untuk sedikit lebih santai.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_NotMetVillager_Less_001
Array.english: Hoo... you've met quite a few villagers.
Array.indonesia: Hoo... kamu sudah bertemu dengan cukup banyak penduduk desa.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_NotMetVillager_Less_002
Array.english: <size=32>There are still many more to meet, so do take a look around.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Masih banyak lagi yang harus kamu temui, jadi silakan lihat-lihat sekeliling.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_NotMetVillager_None_001
Array.english: Hoo... it seems you've met all the villagers.
Array.indonesia: Hoo... sepertinya kamu sudah bertemu dengan semua penduduk desa.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_NotMetVillager_None_002
Array.english: <size=32>I hope you've made many good memories here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Semoga kamu telah menciptakan banyak kenangan indah di sini.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_MaxRelation_001
Array.english: There are <myinfo=JungleVillagersMaxRelation/> villagers you are on close terms with.
Array.indonesia: Ada <myinfo=JungleVillagersMaxRelation/> penduduk desa yang sudah dekat denganmu.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_MaxRelation_Less_001
Array.english: It seems you're still a bit distant from the villagers.\nTry to get a little closer.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya kamu masih agak berjarak dengan para penduduk desa.\nCobalah untuk lebih mendekati mereka.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_MaxRelation_More_001
Array.english: You've built bonds with many villagers.
Array.indonesia: Kamu telah menjalin ikatan dengan banyak penduduk desa.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_MaxRelation_More_002
Array.english: They are all good people, so getting to know more of them will do you well.
Array.indonesia: Mereka semua orang baik, jadi mengenal mereka lebih jauh akan bermanfaat bagimu.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_MaxRelation_All_001
Array.english: It seems you are on good terms with all the villagers.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya kamu memiliki hubungan yang baik dengan semua penduduk desa.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_MaxRelation_All_002
Array.english: I sensed a good energy from you. The villagers felt the same.
Array.indonesia: Aku merasakan energi positif darimu. Penduduk desa juga merasakan hal yang sama.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_MaxRelation_All_003
Array.english: I shall be in your care as well from now on.
Array.indonesia: Mulai sekarang, aku juga akan berada di bawah perawatanmu.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_NotCustomer_001
Array.english: <myinfo=JungleVillagersNotCustomer/> villagers have yet to try your cooking.
Array.indonesia: <myinfo=JungleVillagersNotCustomer/> penduduk desa belum pernah mencicipi masakanmu.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_NotCustomer_More_001
Array.english: People tend to be cautious of food made by outsiders.
Array.indonesia: Orang-orang cenderung waspada terhadap makanan yang dibuat oleh orang luar.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_NotCustomer_More_002
Array.english: Try approaching them a little more actively.
Array.indonesia: Cobalah mendekati mereka dengan sedikit lebih proaktif.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_NotCustomer_Less_001
Array.english: Try having a few more conversations with the villagers.
Array.indonesia: Cobalah berbincang-bincang lebih sering dengan penduduk desa.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_NotCustomer_Less_002
Array.english: Once they taste your cooking, they are sure to enjoy it.
Array.indonesia: Begitu mereka mencicipi masakanmu, mereka pasti akan menyukainya.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_NotCustomer_None_001
Array.english: All the villagers have tried your cooking.
Array.indonesia: Semua penduduk desa sudah mencicipi masakanmu.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_NotCustomer_None_002
Array.english: Thank you for preparing such good food for this village.
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih telah menyiapkan makanan yang begitu lezat untuk desa ini.

Array.name: JDLC_EyeOfSpirit_Info_NotCustomer_None_003
Array.english: Seeing everyone eat happily warms this old soul's heart.
Array.indonesia: Melihat semua orang makan dengan gembira menghangatkan hati orang tua ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_EndingTalk_001
Array.english: I'm truly relieved you made it back safely.
Array.indonesia: Aku benar-benar lega kamu berhasil kembali dengan selamat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_EndingTalk_002
Array.english: I was worried you might have ended up as that ancient creature's meal.
Array.indonesia: Aku khawatir kamu mungkin akan menjadi santapan makhluk purba itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_EndingTalk_003
Array.english: Don't worry!\nI'm not that easy to take down!
Array.indonesia: Jangan khawatir!\nAku tidak semudah itu dikalahkan!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_EndingTalk_004
Array.english: Believe it or not, I've fought dinosaurs even deeper in the Blue Hole.
Array.indonesia: Percaya atau tidak, aku pernah bertarung melawan dinosaurus di bagian Blue Hole yang lebih dalam lagi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_EndingTalk_005
Array.english: Hoho, is that so? Your body has not fully recovered yet, so do not push yourself too hard.
Array.indonesia: Hoho, benarkah? Tubuhmu belum pulih sepenuhnya, jadi jangan memaksakan diri terlalu keras.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_EndingTalk_001
Array.english: How are you feeling?
Array.indonesia: Bagaimana kabarmu?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_EndingTalk_002
Array.english: I'm alright. I felt a bit dizzy yesterday...\nbut I'm much better now.
Array.indonesia: Aku baik-baik saja. Kemarin aku merasa sedikit pusing...\ntapi sekarang sudah jauh lebih baik.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_EndingTalk_003
Array.english: That's a relief... You went through all that danger because of me... I'm really sorry...
Array.indonesia: Syukurlah... Kamu menghadapi semua bahaya itu karena aku... Aku benar-benar minta maaf...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_EndingTalk_004
Array.english: Not at all. Thanks to you, I got to see somewhere incredible.
Array.indonesia: Tidak apa-apa. Berkat kamu, aku bisa melihat tempat yang luar biasa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_EndingTalk_005
Array.english: <size=33>An... incredible place?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tempat... yang luar biasa?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_EndingTalk_006
Array.english: Yeah. A place where gravity was completely reversed.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Tempat di mana gravitasi benar-benar terbalik.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_EndingTalk_007
Array.english: And it was full of ancient creatures...
Array.indonesia: Dan di sana penuh dengan makhluk purba...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_EndingTalk_008
Array.english: <size=33>Wait...! Could it be... another world inside the Earth?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tunggu...! Mungkinkah... dunia lain di dalam Bumi?!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_EndingTalk_009
Array.english: It was a theory that gained a lot of attention in the 18th century... The idea that an ancient ecosystem exists inside the Earth.
Array.indonesia: Itu adalah teori yang mendapat banyak perhatian pada abad ke-18... Gagasan bahwa ada ekosistem purba di dalam Bumi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_EndingTalk_010
Array.english: Well... academically it has a lot of flaws,\nso it's not really discussed much these days...
Array.indonesia: Yah... secara akademis teori itu memiliki banyak kelemahan,\njadi sekarang ini tidak terlalu banyak dibahas...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_EndingTalk_011
Array.english: ...Honestly, I always thought there might be some truth to it. Hehe.
Array.indonesia: ...Sejujurnya, aku selalu berpikir mungkin ada benarnya juga. Hehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_EndingTalk_012
Array.english: <size=33>I hope what you saw wasn't just a hallucination...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Semoga apa yang kamu lihat tadi bukan sekadar halusinasi...!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk_001
Array.english: Cobra... how's your arm?
Array.indonesia: Cobra... bagaimana keadaan lenganmu?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk_002
Array.english: Hm... feels more natural than I expected.\nStill not fully used to it, though.
Array.indonesia: Hm... rasanya lebih alami dari yang kuduga.\nTapi aku masih belum sepenuhnya terbiasa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk_003
Array.english: Picking things up and carrying stuff's no problem at all...
Array.indonesia: Mengambil dan membawa barang-barang sama sekali tidak jadi masalah...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk_004
Array.english: Though the bathroom's got me a bit worried...\nFeels like the toilet paper's gonna tear.
Array.indonesia: Meskipun kamar mandi membuatku sedikit khawatir...\nRasanya seperti tisu toiletnya bakal robek.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk_005
Array.english: <size=32>Uh... you really didn't have to go into that much detail.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Uh... kamu sebenarnya nggak perlu menjelaskan sejauh itu.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk_006
Array.english: To think you got hurt like this trying to save me...\nIt really gets to me.
Array.indonesia: Bayangkan, kamu sampai terluka begini cuma buat menyelamatkanku...\nItu benar-benar bikin aku sedih.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk_007
Array.english: Gahaha! Don't sweat it!
Array.indonesia: Gahaha! Jangan dipikirin!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk_008
Array.english: <size=33>Who knows, maybe this arm'll let me do all kinds of new things!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Siapa tahu, mungkin lengan ini bakal bikin aku bisa melakukan berbagai hal baru!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_EndingTalk_001
Array.english: Dave, are ya feelin' alright?
Array.indonesia: Dave, kamu baik-baik aja?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_EndingTalk_002
Array.english: Yeah. I don't even remember how I made it back to the village.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Aku bahkan nggak ingat gimana caranya aku bisa balik ke desa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_EndingTalk_003
Array.english: Heard ya ended up inside a dinosaur's belly, didn't ya.
Array.indonesia: Dengar-dengar kamu sampai masuk ke dalam perut dinosaurus, kan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_EndingTalk_004
Array.english: How in the world'd ya get outta a place like that...\nI can't even picture it.
Array.indonesia: Gimana sih kamu bisa keluar dari tempat kayak gitu...\nAku bahkan nggak bisa bayangin.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_EndingTalk_005
Array.english: Well... I used a bomb, and then... yeah...
Array.indonesia: Yah... Aku pakai bom, terus... ya...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_EndingTalk_006
Array.english: Haha! No need to get into it, must've been rough on ya!
Array.indonesia: Haha! Nggak usah dijelasin, pasti berat banget buat kamu!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_EndingTalk_007
Array.english:
<size=32>Get yourself a good meal and bounce back quick, 
ya hear?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Makan yang enak dan cepat pulih, dengar?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_EndingTalk_001
Array.english: I'm so glad you've come back safely.
Array.indonesia: Aku senang banget kamu pulang dengan selamat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_EndingTalk_002
Array.english: Thanks to your herbs, Lathi, my wounds healed quickly.
Array.indonesia: Berkat ramuanmu, Lathi, lukaku sembuh dengan cepat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_EndingTalk_003
Array.english: Hehe. I blended the finest-quality herbs just for you.
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Aku mencampur ramuan berkualitas terbaik khusus untukmu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_EndingTalk_004
Array.english: I'm glad they worked so well.
Array.indonesia: Aku senang ramuan itu bekerja dengan sangat baik.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_EndingTalk_005
Array.english: <size=32>I'll get back on my feet and bring you more ingredients soon!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku akan segera pulih dan membawakanmu bahan-bahan lagi!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_EndingTalk_001
Array.english: Ohh... brother, you're all healed up already?
Array.indonesia: Ohh... kakak, kamu sudah sembuh total?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_EndingTalk_002
Array.english: Heard ya got swallowed by a dinosaur...\nMighty lucky ya got out.
Array.indonesia: Dengar-dengar kamu ditelan dinosaurus...\nBeruntung banget kamu bisa selamat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_EndingTalk_003
Array.english: Yeah... I thought I'd never make it back...
Array.indonesia: Iya... aku pikir aku nggak bakal bisa balik lagi...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_EndingTalk_004
Array.english: I was real worried I'd lose my fishin' buddy.
Array.indonesia: Aku benar-benar khawatir bakal kehilangan teman memancingku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_EndingTalk_005
Array.english: <size=32>So how'd ya actually get out of there?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Jadi, gimana sih kamu bisa keluar dari sana?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_EndingTalk_006
Array.english: <size=33>Umm... you probably don't want to hear...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Umm... kamu mungkin nggak mau dengar...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_EndingTalk_007
Array.english: <size=32>Hahaha! Well, I'm just glad you made it back!\nLet's have some good times again!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hahaha! Yah, aku cuma senang kamu berhasil kembali!\nAyo kita bersenang-senang lagi!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_EndingTalk_001
Array.english: Ah, that reminds me... how's that white-haired guy's arm?
Array.indonesia: Ah, itu mengingatkanku... bagaimana keadaan lengan pria berambut putih itu?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_EndingTalk_002
Array.english: I lent him my bandages back then, remember.
Array.indonesia: Aku meminjamkan perban kepadanya saat itu, ingat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_EndingTalk_003
Array.english:
Right. Luckily, Duff made him a <color=#F1DC2B>Prosthetic Arm</color>, 
so we fitted it right away.
Array.indonesia:
Benar. Untungnya, Duff membuatkan dia <color=#F1DC2B>Lengan Palsu</color>, 
jadi kami langsung memasangkannya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_EndingTalk_004
Array.english: Duff? A friend of yours?
Array.indonesia: Duff? Temanmu?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_EndingTalk_005
Array.english: It was a nasty accident, but I'm glad he's recovering well.
Array.indonesia: Itu kecelakaan yang parah, tapi aku senang dia pulih dengan baik.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_EndingTalk_006
Array.english: Yeah. Hope your arm heals up soon too, Peneb.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Semoga lenganmu juga cepat sembuh, Peneb.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_EndingTalk_001
Array.english: Oh... Dave, are you sure you should be up and about?
Array.indonesia: Oh... Dave, kamu yakin sudah boleh beraktivitas lagi?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_EndingTalk_002
Array.english: Yeah... Lipah. I recovered pretty quickly.
Array.indonesia: Ya... Lipah. Aku pulih cukup cepat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_EndingTalk_003
Array.english: It seems Lathi's herbs really did the trick.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya ramuan Lathi benar-benar manjur.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_EndingTalk_004
Array.english: <size=32>I'm so glad to hear that!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku sangat senang mendengarnya!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_EndingTalk_005
Array.english: I heard you were swallowed by a giant dinosaur...
Array.indonesia: Kudengar kamu ditelan oleh dinosaurus raksasa...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_EndingTalk_006
Array.english: Yeah...\nWell, more like an ancient whale, to be precise...
Array.indonesia: Ya...\nSebenarnya, lebih tepatnya paus purba...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_EndingTalk_007
Array.english: It was really dangerous...\nBut I somehow made it out.
Array.indonesia: Itu benar-benar berbahaya...\nTapi entah bagaimana aku berhasil keluar.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_EndingTalk_008
Array.english: I can't believe you went through all that for our village... Thank you. Truly.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak percaya kamu mengalami semua itu demi desa kita... Terima kasih. Sungguh.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_EndingTalk_009
Array.english: Not at all. I couldn't have done any of it without everyone here.
Array.indonesia: Sama-sama. Aku tidak akan bisa melakukan semua itu tanpa bantuan semua orang di sini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_EndingTalk_010
Array.english: If I was any help at all, that's more than enough for me!
Array.indonesia: Kalau aku bisa sedikit membantu, itu sudah lebih dari cukup bagiku!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_EndingTalk_001
Array.english: <size=32>Ha! Heard you've been through the wringer, outsider!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ha! Kudengar kamu baru saja melewati masa-masa sulit, orang luar!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_EndingTalk_002
Array.english: <size=32>I was starting to wonder who'd take care of the fields if you didn't make it back.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku mulai bertanya-tanya siapa yang akan mengurus ladang-ladang kalau kamu tidak kembali.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_EndingTalk_003
Array.english: Well... looks like the worst is over, so take care of yourself.
Array.indonesia: Yah... sepertinya yang terburuk sudah berlalu, jadi jaga dirimu baik-baik.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_EndingTalk_004
Array.english: <size=32>I've still got plenty for you to help with, you know.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Masih banyak yang bisa kamu bantu, lho.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_EndingTalk_NotKind_001
Array.english: <size=32>Ha! Haven't seen you in a while. Thought you ran off...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ha! Sudah lama tidak melihatmu. Kupikir kamu kabur...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_EndingTalk_NotKind_002
Array.english: <size=32>Heard you got swallowed by a dinosaur!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Dengar-dengar kamu ditelan dinosaurus!?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_EndingTalk_NotKind_003
Array.english: Yeah... that happened.
Array.indonesia: Ya... itu memang terjadi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_EndingTalk_NotKind_004
Array.english: <size=32>How did you even make it back in one piece?\nBeats me.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Bagaimana kamu bisa kembali dengan selamat?\nAku juga nggak tahu.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_EndingTalk_NotKind_005
Array.english: <size=32>If you're hurt, eat some of the coconuts.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kalau kamu terluka, makanlah beberapa kelapa.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_EndingTalk_NotKind_006
Array.english: <size=32>They're ripe. Good for you.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kelapa-kelapa itu sudah matang. Baik untukmu.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_EndingTalk_001
Array.english: Dave, looks like you're able to walk around again.
Array.indonesia: Dave, sepertinya kamu sudah bisa berjalan-jalan lagi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_EndingTalk_002
Array.english: Yeah, thanks to the Chief looking after me,\nI healed up quickly.
Array.indonesia: Ya, berkat Kepala Desa yang merawatku,\naku cepat sembuh.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_EndingTalk_003
Array.english: Hehe, that's wonderful news. The village felt so empty without you, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, itu kabar yang luar biasa. Desa ini terasa sangat sepi tanpa kamu, Dave.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_EndingTalk_004
Array.english: You felt like someone who'd been here for ages.
Array.indonesia: Kamu terasa seperti orang yang sudah lama tinggal di sini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_EndingTalk_005
Array.english: Really? It does feel natural to be here now, actually.
Array.indonesia: Benarkah? Sebenarnya, sekarang rasanya sudah wajar berada di sini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_EndingTalk_006
Array.english: Hehe. Even after you leave, please come visit anytime.\nYou'll always be welcome.
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Bahkan setelah kamu pergi, silakan mampir kapan saja.\nKamu akan selalu disambut dengan senang hati.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_EndingTalk_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hahaha! Hey, brother! You made it back!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hahaha! Hei, bro! Kamu berhasil kembali!!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_EndingTalk_002
Array.english: <size=32>You might be the only man alive who's come back from inside a dinosaur's gut.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kamu mungkin satu-satunya orang di dunia yang berhasil kembali dari dalam perut dinosaurus.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_EndingTalk_003
Array.english: <size=32>Once you're feeling better, let's grab a drink. Sound good?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Begitu kamu sudah merasa lebih baik, ayo kita minum-minum. Setuju?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_EndingTalk_004
Array.english: <size=32>You're buying, right, Harta? Then I'm in!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kamu yang traktir, kan, Harta? Kalau gitu, aku ikut!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_EndingTalk_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh! Brother, are ya alright?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh! Saudaraku, kamu baik-baik saja?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_EndingTalk_002
Array.english: <size=32>Ya can't even swim 'round with the crocodiles out there... And ya went that deep, that's somethin' else.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kamu bahkan nggak bisa berenang di sekitar buaya-buaya di sana... Dan kamu masuk sedalam itu, itu luar biasa.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_EndingTalk_003
Array.english: <size=34>Real glad to see ya again!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Senang banget bisa ketemu kamu lagi!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_EndingTalk_004
Array.english: It was something I had to do.
Array.indonesia: Itu sesuatu yang harus aku lakukan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_EndingTalk_005
Array.english: <size=32>The village should be safer now...\nLet's hang out together sometime!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Desa ini seharusnya lebih aman sekarang...\nAyo kita jalan-jalan bareng lain kali!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_EndingTalk_001
Array.english: Oh my... I heard you had quite the ordeal.
Array.indonesia: Astaga... Aku dengar kamu mengalami cobaan yang cukup berat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_EndingTalk_002
Array.english: No matter how important it was, you shouldn't push yourself like that.
Array.indonesia: Tidak peduli seberapa pentingnya, kamu tidak seharusnya memaksakan diri seperti itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_EndingTalk_003
Array.english: Everyone was worried sick, you know.
Array.indonesia: Semua orang sangat khawatir, lho.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_EndingTalk_004
Array.english: Even Jepun, who usually can't stand outsiders,\ncame asking about you!
Array.indonesia: Bahkan Jepun, yang biasanya tidak suka orang luar,\ndatang menanyakan kabarmu!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_EndingTalk_005
Array.english: Well... looks like everything's settled down now,\nso take it easy for a while.
Array.indonesia: Yah... sepertinya semuanya sudah tenang sekarang,\njadi istirahatlah sebentar.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_EndingTalk_001
Array.english: <size=33>Dave! You came back...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Dave! Kamu sudah kembali...!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_EndingTalk_002
Array.english: I heard you were swallowed by a dinosaur...\nI thought I'd never see you again.
Array.indonesia: Aku dengar kamu ditelan dinosaurus...\nAku pikir aku tidak akan pernah melihatmu lagi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_EndingTalk_003
Array.english: Yeah... I wasn't sure I'd make it back either.
Array.indonesia: Ya... aku juga tidak yakin bisa kembali.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_EndingTalk_004
Array.english: Hehe... I'm really so glad.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... aku benar-benar sangat senang.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_EndingTalk_005
Array.english: Someday... if I get the chance, I'd love to write a novel about your story.
Array.indonesia: Suatu hari nanti... kalau aku punya kesempatan, aku ingin sekali menulis novel tentang kisahmu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_EndingTalk_006
Array.english: Huh...? A story about me?
Array.indonesia: Hah...? Kisah tentang aku?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_EndingTalk_007
Array.english: Yes. A tale of an outsider hero who saved the village.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Kisah tentang pahlawan pendatang yang menyelamatkan desa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_EndingTalk_008
Array.english: Heh... just hearing that makes me blush.
Array.indonesia: Heh... cuma dengar itu aja udah bikin aku malu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_EndingTalk_001
Array.english: To see you return safely like this...\nWhat a relief.
Array.indonesia: Melihatmu kembali dengan selamat seperti ini...\nSungguh melegakan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_EndingTalk_002
Array.english: I've been praying to the spirits all this time...\nPerhaps it truly made a difference.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah berdoa kepada para roh selama ini...\nMungkin doaku benar-benar berpengaruh.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_EndingTalk_003
Array.english: I see.\nThank you, Grandma Meiran.
Array.indonesia: Begitu ya.\nTerima kasih, Nenek Meiran.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_EndingTalk_004
Array.english: Maybe I should offer a prayer to the village's guardian tree as well.
Array.indonesia: Mungkin aku juga harus berdoa kepada pohon penjaga desa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_EndingTalk_005
Array.english: Hoho. The spirits will be pleased.
Array.indonesia: Hoho. Roh-roh pasti akan senang.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_EndingTalk_001
Array.english: Oh... Mister, you're back!
Array.indonesia: Oh... Tuan, kamu sudah kembali!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_EndingTalk_002
Array.english: Escaping from inside a dinosaur...
Array.indonesia: Melarikan diri dari dalam tubuh seekor dinosaurus...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_EndingTalk_003
Array.english: <size=33>That's absolutely mind-blowing!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Itu benar-benar luar biasa!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_EndingTalk_004
Array.english: An unbreakable spirit that pulls through from the brink of death...
Array.indonesia: Semangat yang tak tergoyahkan yang berhasil bertahan dari ambang kematian...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_EndingTalk_005
Array.english: <size=33>This... is music!\nA blazing rhythm that sets hearts racing!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ini... adalah musik!\nIrama yang membara yang membuat jantung berdebar kencang!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_EndingTalk_006
Array.english: I'm just glad this music didn't turn into a rhapsody of sorrow.
Array.indonesia: Aku hanya bersyukur musik ini tidak berubah menjadi rapsodi kesedihan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_EndingTalk_007
Array.english: Guess I'll see you around the village from now on, hehe! \nYEAH!
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya aku akan sering bertemu kamu di desa mulai sekarang, hehe! \nYA!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_EndingTalk_001
Array.english: Oh my, you've already recovered?
Array.indonesia: Wah, kamu sudah pulih?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_EndingTalk_002
Array.english: Yeah. Thanks to everyone in the village, I bounced back pretty fast.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Berkat semua orang di desa, aku pulih dengan cukup cepat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_EndingTalk_003
Array.english: Well... I suppose you're tougher than you look...\nNot that I was worried or anything...
Array.indonesia: Yah... sepertinya kamu lebih tangguh daripada yang terlihat...\nBukan berarti aku khawatir atau apa...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_EndingTalk_004
Array.english: Well... if anything's bothering you...
Array.indonesia: Yah... kalau ada yang mengganggumu...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_EndingTalk_005
Array.english: I can show you some yoga poses to loosen up your muscles.
Array.indonesia: Aku bisa mengajarkanmu beberapa pose yoga untuk melemaskan ototmu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_EndingTalk_006
Array.english: Oh... then I'd appreciate it if you could teach me sometime.
Array.indonesia: Oh... kalau begitu, aku akan sangat berterima kasih kalau kamu bisa mengajari aku suatu saat nanti.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_EndingTalk_007
Array.english: Well, fine. Just don't use that as an excuse to come see me too often!
Array.indonesia: Ya sudah, baiklah. Tapi jangan jadikan itu alasan untuk sering-sering datang menemuiku!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_EndingTalk_001
Array.english: Oh my... are you really okay to be up and about already?
Array.indonesia: Astaga... kamu benar-benar sudah bisa beraktivitas lagi?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_EndingTalk_002
Array.english: Yeah. After a few days of rest, I recovered pretty quickly.
Array.indonesia: Iya. Setelah istirahat beberapa hari, aku pulih dengan cukup cepat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_EndingTalk_003
Array.english: Hehe. That must be because you take good care of your nutrition.
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Pasti karena kamu menjaga asupan gizi dengan baik.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_EndingTalk_004
Array.english: Absolutely! Can't give it your all on an empty stomach!
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja! Nggak bisa ngasih yang terbaik kalau perut kosong!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_EndingTalk_005
Array.english: Then I'll have to treat you to something delicious one of these days.
Array.indonesia: Kalau begitu, suatu hari nanti aku harus mentraktirmu sesuatu yang enak.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_EndingTalk_006
Array.english: Heh... just thinking about it makes my mouth water.
Array.indonesia: Heh... cuma membayangkannya saja sudah bikin aku ngiler.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_EndingTalk_001
Array.english: Dave, how are you feeling?
Array.indonesia: Dave, gimana kabarmu?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_EndingTalk_002
Array.english: Yeah, I'm fine.\nThough Cobra got badly hurt because of me...
Array.indonesia: Ya, aku baik-baik saja.\nMeskipun Cobra terluka parah karena aku...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_EndingTalk_003
Array.english: Ah, I saw him...\nHe's got an iron arm, doesn't he.
Array.indonesia: Ah, aku melihatnya...\nLengannya sekuat besi, ya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_EndingTalk_004
Array.english: If that arm ever rusts or gives him trouble,\nI'll take care of it myself.
Array.indonesia: Kalau lengan itu berkarat atau bikin dia repot,\naku yang akan mengurusnya sendiri.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_EndingTalk_005
Array.english: Oh... that'd be a huge help, Perak!
Array.indonesia: Oh... itu bakal sangat membantu, Perak!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_EndingTalk_006
Array.english: Heh. If there's somethin' I can do, I'll do it.
Array.indonesia: Heh. Kalau ada yang bisa aku lakukan, aku akan melakukannya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_EndingTalk_007
Array.english: Just like all of you did for this village.
Array.indonesia: Sama seperti yang kalian semua lakukan untuk desa ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_EndingTalk_001
Array.english: Oh... Dave... I'm so relieved you're safe.
Array.indonesia: Oh... Dave... Aku sangat lega kamu selamat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_EndingTalk_002
Array.english: I was so worried we might lose someone again.
Array.indonesia: Aku sangat khawatir kita akan kehilangan seseorang lagi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_EndingTalk_003
Array.english: I'm back safe and sound, so please don't worry, Cinta.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah kembali dengan selamat, jadi tolong jangan khawatir, Cinta.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_EndingTalk_004
Array.english: Hehe... with you back, Dave, the village will feel lively again.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... dengan kembalinya kamu, Dave, desa ini akan terasa semarak kembali.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_EndingTalk_005
Array.english: The village feels almost strange without you and your friends around now.
Array.indonesia: Desa ini terasa agak aneh tanpa kehadiranmu dan teman-temanmu sekarang.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_EndingTalk_006
Array.english: I know you'll have to leave someday...\nbut I hope you stay with us as long as you can.
Array.indonesia: Aku tahu suatu hari nanti kamu harus pergi...\ntapi aku harap kamu tetap bersama kami selama mungkin.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_EndingTalk_001
Array.english: Mister! I heard you went inside a dinosaur's belly!\nIs it true?!
Array.indonesia: Pak! Aku dengar kamu masuk ke dalam perut dinosaurus!\nBenarkah?!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_EndingTalk_002
Array.english: Yeah. It's true.\nNot like I went in on purpose, though.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Itu benar.\nTapi bukan berarti aku masuk ke sana dengan sengaja, lho.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_EndingTalk_003
Array.english: <size=33>Whoooa! That's so cool!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wahhh! Keren banget!!!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_EndingTalk_004
Array.english: Mister, you're such a great swimmer, so you must've punched through the water and escaped in style, right!?
Array.indonesia: Pak, kamu perenang yang hebat, jadi pasti kamu menembus air dan melarikan diri dengan gaya, kan!?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_EndingTalk_005
Array.english: <size=34>...Uh, well. S-something like that.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>...Uh, ya. S-semacam itu.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_EndingTalk_006
Array.english: <size=32>Wow! I wanna go on adventures like you someday, mister!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wow! Suatu hari nanti aku juga mau berpetualang seperti Pak!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_EndingTalk_007
Array.english: If you want that, you've gotta stay healthy.\nMake sure you eat all your meals, okay?
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu mau begitu, kamu harus jaga kesehatan.\nPastikan kamu makan semua makananmu, ya?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_EndingTalk_008
Array.english: And be good to your mom and dad, so they don't have to worry, alright?
Array.indonesia: Dan bersikaplah baik kepada ibu dan ayahmu, biar mereka tidak perlu khawatir, oke?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_EndingTalk_009
Array.english: <size=34>Okay. Got it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oke. Paham!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_EndingTalk_001
Array.english: <size=35>Whoaaa! It's mister!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wahhh! Itu kamu, Pak!!!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_EndingTalk_002
Array.english: <size=35>You suddenly disappeared, so I got soooo worried...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Kamu tiba-tiba menghilang, jadi aku sangat khawatir...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_EndingTalk_003
Array.english: <size=32>Daddy said you'd definitely come back, mister...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ayah bilang kamu pasti bakal balik, Pak...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_EndingTalk_004
Array.english: <size=32>I'm so happy you came back like thiiis!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku sangat senang kamu kembali seperti ini!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_EndingTalk_005
Array.english: Heheh. I'm sorry I made you worry, Sania.\nThat's on me.
Array.indonesia: Heheh. Maaf sudah membuatmu khawatir, Sania.\nItu salahku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_EndingTalk_006
Array.english: But mister's super tough and strong, so you don't need to worry, okay?
Array.indonesia: Tapi Pak itu super tangguh dan kuat, jadi kamu nggak perlu khawatir, oke?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_EndingTalk_007
Array.english: <size=32>I know that! Now let's play and have fun agaaain!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku tahu itu! Sekarang ayo main dan bersenang-senang lagi!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_EndingTalk_001
Array.english: Oh. Mister, you came back.
Array.indonesia: Oh. Pak, kamu sudah kembali.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_EndingTalk_002
Array.english: My dad said a dinosaur swallowed you...
Array.indonesia: Ayahku bilang kamu ditelan dinosaurus...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_EndingTalk_003
Array.english: There's stomach acid inside, right? If you're not careful, it can melt you... Were you really okay?
Array.indonesia: Di dalamnya ada asam lambung, kan? Kalau nggak hati-hati, bisa melelehkanmu... Kamu benar-benar baik-baik saja?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_EndingTalk_004
Array.english: You really know your stuff, Bima. Smart as always.
Array.indonesia: Kamu benar-benar paham, Bima. Pintar seperti biasa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_EndingTalk_005
Array.english: Mister's really strong underwater, you know.\nSomething like that's no problem!
Array.indonesia: Pak itu sangat kuat di bawah air, lho.\nHal seperti itu bukan masalah!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_EndingTalk_006
Array.english: Hmph. Pride comes before a fall, you know.
Array.indonesia: Hmph. Kesombongan mendahului kejatuhan, lho.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_EndingTalk_007
Array.english: Playing with you is fun, mister... So please be careful out there, okay?
Array.indonesia: Bermain denganmu seru, Pak... Jadi tolong hati-hati di luar sana, ya?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_DaveHouseFirstEnter_001
Array.english: <size=32>Looks like no one's used this place in a while.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Sepertinya sudah lama tidak ada yang menggunakan tempat ini.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_DaveHouseFirstEnter_002
Array.english: <size=32>Still, there's a bed...\nGood enough for now.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tapi, ada tempat tidur...\nCukup untuk saat ini.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_DaveHouseFirstEnter_003
Array.english: <size=32>I should fix the place up a bit later.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Nanti aku harus merapikan tempat ini sedikit.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Duff_01_001
Array.english: Hmm... no answer...\nMust be busy watching anime again.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... tidak ada jawaban...\nPasti lagi sibuk nonton anime.

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Cobra_01_001
Array.english: Hm? What is it?
Array.indonesia: Hm? Ada apa?

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Cobra_01_002
Array.english: <size=32>You're nearby, come talk to me in person!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kamu ada di dekat sini, datanglah dan bicara langsung denganku!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Cobra_02_001
Array.english: Hm? What is it?
Array.indonesia: Hm? Ada apa?

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Cobra_02_002
Array.english: <size=32>You're nearby, come talk to me in person!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kamu ada di dekat sini, datang saja bicara langsung denganku!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Bacon_01_001
Array.english: Is there something urgent you want to discuss?
Array.indonesia: Ada hal mendesak yang ingin kamu bicarakan?

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Bacon_01_002
Array.english: I'm in the village, so come talk to me anytime.
Array.indonesia: Aku di desa, jadi datang saja bicara denganku kapan saja.

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Bancho_01_001
Array.english: Hmm. I'd prefer to speak in person rather than over the phone.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Aku lebih suka bicara langsung daripada lewat telepon.

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Otto_01_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh! Long time no see.\nHow have you been?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh! Lama nggak ketemu.\nGimana kabarmu?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Otto_01_002
Array.english: Yeah. I'm out in the jungle right now with Bancho, Cobra, and Dr. Bacon for some research.
Array.indonesia: Iya. Aku lagi di hutan bareng Bancho, Cobra, dan Dr. Bacon buat riset.

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Otto_01_003
Array.english: <size=34>The jungle... you went all the way out there?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hutan... kamu sampai ke sana?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Otto_01_004
Array.english: Speaking of jungles, that reminds me of a story...\nBack in the day, I got lost in the deep woods myself.
Array.indonesia: Ngomong-ngomong soal hutan, itu mengingatkanku pada sebuah cerita...\nDulu, aku sendiri pernah tersesat di hutan belantara.

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Otto_01_005
Array.english: <size=33>I was looking around when suddenly a huge bear appeared right in front of me!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku sedang melihat-lihat sekeliling ketika tiba-tiba seekor beruang besar muncul tepat di depanku!!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Otto_01_006
Array.english: Less than ten meters away. I couldn't decide whether to fight or play dead...
Array.indonesia: Jaraknya kurang dari sepuluh meter. Aku bingung harus melawan atau berpura-pura mati...

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Otto_01_007
Array.english: Then I spotted a tree right next to me.\nSo I quickly climbed up...!
Array.indonesia: Lalu aku melihat sebuah pohon tepat di sebelahku.\nJadi aku segera memanjatnya...!

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Otto_01_008
Array.english: ...Ah, your voice is starting to fade...\nLet's talk again later, Mr. Otto.
Array.indonesia: ...Ah, suaramu mulai meredup...\nAyo kita bicara lagi nanti, Pak Otto.

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Otto_02_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh. What's up?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh. Ada apa?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Otto_02_002
Array.english: Yeah. I'm pretty far from home... and I was worried about the crops at the farm.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Aku cukup jauh dari rumah... dan aku khawatir dengan tanaman di kebun.

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Otto_02_003
Array.english: <size=33>Haha! Don't worry.\nI've been taking good care of them.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Haha! Jangan khawatir.\nAku sudah merawatnya dengan baik.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Otto_02_004
Array.english: <size=32>Still, when you get back, be sure to stop by.\nFarming is all about care and attention.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tapi, kalau kamu sudah pulang, pastikan mampir ke sini.\nBertani itu soal perawatan dan perhatian.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Ellie_01_001
Array.english: Oh, mister. Long time no see.
Array.indonesia: Oh, Pak. Lama nggak ketemu.

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Ellie_01_002
Array.english: I heard you went to the jungle...\nis that true?
Array.indonesia: Aku dengar kamu pergi ke hutan...\nbenarkah itu?

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Ellie_01_003
Array.english: Yeah. I came to a village called Utara to help with Dr.\nBacon's research.
Array.indonesia: Iya. Aku datang ke sebuah desa bernama Utara untuk membantu penelitian Dr.\nBacon.

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Ellie_01_004
Array.english: Hehe... did you call because you missed my voice?
Array.indonesia: Hehe... apa kamu menelepon karena kangen suaraku?

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Ellie_01_005
Array.english: What?! No way...! I was just wondering if there's anything that might help your research.
Array.indonesia: Apa?! Nggak mungkin...! Aku cuma penasaran apakah ada hal yang bisa membantu penelitianmu.

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Ellie_01_006
Array.english: <size=34>Haha, just kidding!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Haha, cuma bercanda!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Ellie_01_007
Array.english: <size=32>Make sure to do plenty of research and tell me what you find. And watch out for snakes!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Pastikan kamu melakukan banyak penelitian dan ceritakan padaku apa yang kamu temukan. Dan hati-hati sama ular!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Yoshie_01_001
Array.english: Oh my, it's been a while…
Array.indonesia: Astaga, sudah lama sekali…

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Yoshie_01_002
Array.english: How is life in the jungle village treating you?
Array.indonesia: Bagaimana kabarmu di desa hutan itu?

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Yoshie_01_003
Array.english: Yes. Thanks to you taking care of the staff,\nI was able to come here without worry.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Berkat kamu yang mengurus para staf,\naku bisa datang ke sini tanpa khawatir.

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Yoshie_01_004
Array.english: Hoho, that is simply my job.
Array.indonesia: Hoho, itu memang tugasku.

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Yoshie_01_005
Array.english: Oh dear... I do hope Bancho isn't picking fights with the village's chefs...
Array.indonesia: Astaga... Aku harap Bancho tidak sedang bertengkar dengan para koki desa...

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Yoshie_01_006
Array.english: Or getting carried away with new ingredients and making something bizarre.
Array.indonesia: Atau terlalu bersemangat dengan bahan-bahan baru dan membuat sesuatu yang aneh.

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Yoshie_01_007
Array.english: <size=32>Haha, that's part of Bancho's charm!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha, itu bagian dari pesona Bancho!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Yoshie_01_008
Array.english: In any case... I wish you a safe trip and a successful return. Please don't worry about the Blue Hole.
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun juga... Semoga perjalananmu aman dan kembali dengan selamat. Tolong jangan khawatir soal Blue Hole.

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Sato_01_001
Array.english: Hmm... no answer. Maybe he has it on silent?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... tidak ada jawaban. Mungkin ponselnya dalam mode senyap?

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Vincent_01_001
Array.english: Oh... what is it?\nIt's been a while. Long time no talk.
Array.indonesia: Oh... ada apa?\nSudah lama ya. Sudah lama tidak ngobrol.

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Vincent_01_002
Array.english: Hello, Vincent. I was just wondering how you've been.
Array.indonesia: Halo, Vincent. Aku cuma penasaran gimana kabarmu.

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Vincent_01_003
Array.english: I'm currently in a jungle village.
Array.indonesia: Saat ini aku berada di sebuah desa di hutan.

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Vincent_01_004
Array.english: Hoo... the jungle, you say. No doubt a place full of new ingredients. Interesting.
Array.indonesia: Hoo... hutan, katamu. Pasti tempat yang penuh dengan bahan-bahan baru. Menarik.

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Vincent_01_005
Array.english: I just had a splendid idea. Listen.
Array.indonesia: Aku baru saja mendapat ide yang luar biasa. Dengarkan.

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Vincent_01_006
Array.english: We should plan a new program where chefs compete using ingredients from that jungle.
Array.indonesia: Kita harus merencanakan program baru di mana para koki bersaing menggunakan bahan-bahan dari hutan itu.

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Vincent_01_007
Array.english: I'll call it <color=#00d98f>Chef in the Wild</color>!!\nAnd of course, Bancho will be in it too!
Array.indonesia: Aku akan menamainya <color=#00d98f>Chef in the Wild</color>!!\nDan tentu saja, Bancho juga akan ikut serta!

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Vincent_01_008
Array.english: Oh... it's interesting, but...
Array.indonesia: Oh... menarik sih, tapi...

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Vincent_01_009
Array.english: I'm sure it would inconvenience the villagers. Things have only just settled down after recent incidents.
Array.indonesia: Aku yakin hal itu akan merepotkan penduduk desa. Situasi baru saja mulai tenang setelah insiden-insiden baru-baru ini.

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Vincent_01_010
Array.english: I see. A pity, but... your reasoning is sound. Makes sense.
Array.indonesia: Begitu ya. Sayang sekali, tapi... alasanmu masuk akal. Masuk akal.

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Vincent_01_011
Array.english: Then we'll talk again another time.\nUntil then, keep honing your culinary skills.
Array.indonesia: Kalau begitu, kita bicarakan lagi lain waktu.\nSampai saat itu, terus asah keterampilan memasakmu.

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Udo_01_001
Array.english: Hmm... no answer. Maybe she's busy?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... tidak ada jawaban. Mungkin dia sibuk?

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Lois_01_001
Array.english: Oh my. It's been a while.
Array.indonesia: Astaga. Sudah lama sekali.

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Lois_01_002
Array.english: How have you been? I heard you've closed the restaurant for a while.
Array.indonesia: Apa kabar? Kudengar kamu menutup restoran untuk sementara waktu.

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Lois_01_003
Array.english: Yes. I'm in the jungle right now, so I closed the shop for the time being.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Saat ini aku sedang berada di hutan, jadi aku menutup toko untuk sementara.

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Lois_01_004
Array.english: If you stay closed too long, customers might forget about you.
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu tutup terlalu lama, pelanggan mungkin akan melupakanmu.

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Lois_01_005
Array.english: I'm sure you have your reasons... but I do hope you'll get back to running things once you return.
Array.indonesia: Aku yakin kamu punya alasanmu sendiri... tapi aku harap kamu bisa kembali mengelola restoran begitu kamu pulang.

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Lois_01_006
Array.english: Because I'm eager to taste Bancho's cooking again as soon as possible, hoho.
Array.indonesia: Karena aku nggak sabar pengen nyicipin masakan Bancho lagi secepatnya, hoho.

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Lois_01_007
Array.english: All right, Lois. I'll learn a lot here and bring it all back!
Array.indonesia: Baiklah, Lois. Aku bakal belajar banyak di sini dan bawa pulang semua ilmunya!

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Mxmtoon_01_001
Array.english: Oh, it's been a while!
Array.indonesia: Oh, sudah lama sekali!

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Mxmtoon_01_002
Array.english: Yeah. I just wanted to check in and see how you've been.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Aku cuma mau ngobrol sebentar dan nanya kabarmu gimana.

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Mxmtoon_01_003
Array.english: Hehe. I'm working on a new album right now.
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Aku lagi ngerjain album baru sekarang.

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Mxmtoon_01_004
Array.english: The time I spent with you all really helped me a lot!
Array.indonesia: Waktu yang aku habiskan bareng kalian semua bener-bener ngebantu aku banget!

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Mxmtoon_01_005
Array.english: Glad to hear that. We're in the jungle village right now.
Array.indonesia: Senang dengar itu. Kita lagi di desa hutan sekarang.

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Mxmtoon_01_006
Array.english: Wow..! Another new adventure!
Array.indonesia: Wow..! Petualangan baru lagi!

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Mxmtoon_01_007
Array.english: It's not somewhere dangerous, is it?\nPlease come back safely.
Array.indonesia: Bukan tempat yang berbahaya, kan?\nTolong pulang dengan selamat.

Array.name: NPC_Phone_Talk_Mxmtoon_01_008
Array.english: So I can come visit again and eat some chirashi sushi!
Array.indonesia: Supaya aku bisa datang berkunjung lagi dan makan chirashi sushi!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_EndingTalk_001
Array.english: Seeing you and Cobra get hurt like that... I feel I asked too much of you. I'm sorry.
Array.indonesia: Melihat kamu dan Cobra terluka seperti itu... Aku merasa sudah meminta terlalu banyak darimu. Maaf.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_EndingTalk_002
Array.english: Don't be sorry. If it weren't for you, we never would've met the people of this village.
Array.indonesia: Jangan minta maaf. Kalau bukan karena kamu, kami tidak akan pernah bertemu dengan penduduk desa ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_EndingTalk_003
Array.english: There was more going on than expected...\nbut it was a great experience.
Array.indonesia: Ternyata ada lebih banyak hal yang terjadi daripada yang kami duga...\ntapi itu pengalaman yang luar biasa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_EndingTalk_004
Array.english: <size=32>Glad to hear it! Lucky lucky!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Senang mendengarnya! Beruntung sekali!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_EndingTalk_005
Array.english: If there's ever anything I can help with, just give me a call!
Array.indonesia: Kalau ada yang bisa kubantu, hubungi saja aku!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_EndingTalk_001
Array.english: Hmph. Though my duty lies in cooking...
Array.indonesia: Hmph. Meskipun tugasku memang memasak...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_EndingTalk_002
Array.english: I feel heavy at heart that I couldn't be of more help in your time of crisis.
Array.indonesia: Hatiku terasa berat karena tidak bisa lebih membantu saat kamu sedang dalam krisis.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_EndingTalk_003
Array.english: Aw, what are you saying? It's your cooking that gives me the strength to keep going!
Array.indonesia: Ah, apa yang kamu katakan? Justru masakanmu yang memberiku kekuatan untuk terus maju!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_EndingTalk_004
Array.english: If that is so, then I am relieved.
Array.indonesia: Kalau begitu, aku lega.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_EndingTalk_005
Array.english: <size=32>In my younger days, I trained a bit in martial arts... If you ever need it, just let me know.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Dulu, saat masih muda, aku pernah berlatih bela diri sebentar... Kalau kamu butuh, bilang saja.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_EndingTalk_006
Array.english: Oh... really?
Array.indonesia: Oh... beneran?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_EndingTalk_007
Array.english: That'd be cool to see... but I think Bancho the chef is the best Bancho there is.
Array.indonesia: Pasti seru kalau bisa lihat... tapi menurutku Bancho si koki adalah Bancho terbaik yang pernah ada.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_EndingTalk_008
Array.english: Keep the delicious food coming!
Array.indonesia: Terus sajikan makanan lezatnya!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_EndingTalk_001
Array.english: I heard you went through something incredible, Dave!
Array.indonesia: Aku dengar kamu mengalami sesuatu yang luar biasa, Dave!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_EndingTalk_002
Array.english: Well... a lot happened, you could say.
Array.indonesia: Yah... banyak hal yang terjadi, bisa dibilang begitu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_EndingTalk_003
Array.english: Part of me wants to cover that story and write an article...
Array.indonesia: Sebagian diriku ingin meliput cerita itu dan menulis artikel...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_EndingTalk_004
Array.english: <size=33>But an article must never lose its direction!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tapi sebuah artikel tidak boleh kehilangan arahnya!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_EndingTalk_005
Array.english: This time, I'll focus on covering the insects.
Array.indonesia: Kali ini, aku akan fokus meliput serangga.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_EndingTalk_006
Array.english: Let me know if you find any rare bugs again, hehe.
Array.indonesia: Beri tahu aku kalau kamu menemukan serangga langka lagi, hehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_EndingTalk_001
Array.english: I heard you got swallowed by a dinosaur.
Array.indonesia: Aku dengar kamu ditelan oleh dinosaurus.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_EndingTalk_002
Array.english: <size=33>Were you... perhaps collecting Marinca?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Apakah kamu... mungkin sedang mengumpulkan Marinca?!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_EndingTalk_003
Array.english: It wasn't that. I just got hurt during some research...
Array.indonesia: Bukan begitu. Aku hanya terluka saat melakukan penelitian...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_EndingTalk_004
Array.english: Is that so. Do not get injured while collecting Marinca.
Array.indonesia: Begitu ya. Jangan sampai terluka saat mengumpulkan Marinca.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_EndingTalk_005
Array.english: The World Marinca Association deducts points from collectors who get injured.
Array.indonesia: Asosiasi Marinca Dunia akan mengurangi poin para kolektor yang terluka.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_EndingTalk_006
Array.english: <size=32>Safe collection is the first principle, you see.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Pengumpulan yang aman adalah prinsip utama, lho.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_EndingTalk_007
Array.english: Hmm… that’s a lot of dangerous fish requests for an association that puts safety first…
Array.indonesia: Hmm… banyak sekali permintaan ikan berbahaya untuk sebuah asosiasi yang mengutamakan keselamatan…

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_EndingTalk_008
Array.english: Anyway, just be careful when you’re collecting Marinca from now on.
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun, berhati-hatilah saat mengumpulkan Marinca mulai sekarang.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_EndingTalk_009
Array.english: <size=33>...Mon mon.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...Mon mon.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Yasuto_EndingTalk_001
Array.english: The villagers were really worried about you...
Array.indonesia: Para penduduk desa sangat mengkhawatirkanmu...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Yasuto_EndingTalk_002
Array.english: I'm glad you came back safe and sound.
Array.indonesia: Aku senang kamu kembali dengan selamat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Yasuto_EndingTalk_003
Array.english: Please keep running the shop like always.
Array.indonesia: Tolong terus jalankan toko seperti biasa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_MartinTweed_EndingTalk_001
Array.english: From the looks of it, you went somewhere very deep.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya, kamu pergi ke tempat yang sangat dalam.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_MartinTweed_EndingTalk_002
Array.english: Yeah. The door in the lake was connected to an ancient sea.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Pintu di danau itu terhubung ke lautan purba.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_MartinTweed_EndingTalk_003
Array.english: I know it's hard to believe...
Array.indonesia: Aku tahu ini sulit dipercaya...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_MartinTweed_EndingTalk_004
Array.english: <size=35>I believe you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Aku percaya padamu!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_MartinTweed_EndingTalk_005
Array.english: Reports of another world existing within the Earth have come up from time to time, you know.
Array.indonesia: Laporan tentang adanya dunia lain di dalam Bumi memang sesekali muncul, lho.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_MartinTweed_EndingTalk_006
Array.english: <size=32>If this is true...\nit would be quite a revolutionary discovery.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Jika ini benar...\nitu akan menjadi penemuan yang sangat revolusioner.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_MartinTweed_EndingTalk_007
Array.english: I'll have to add it to our Kindred research list, haha.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus menambahkannya ke daftar penelitian Kindred kita, haha.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_CharlieBonnet_EndingTalk_001
Array.english: Well now, I was gettin’ worried not seein’ you ‘round.
Array.indonesia: Nah, aku mulai khawatir karena nggak lihat kamu di sekitar sini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_CharlieBonnet_EndingTalk_002
Array.english: Heard you got yourself hurt… Looks like you’re mendin’ up real nice, though.”
Array.indonesia: Dengar-dengar kamu terluka… Tapi sepertinya kamu sudah mulai membaik.”

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_CharlieBonnet_EndingTalk_003
Array.english: This village just ain’t the same without ya.\nYou take care of yourself now, y’hear?
Array.indonesia: Desa ini nggak sama lagi tanpa kamu.\nJaga dirimu baik-baik, ya?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Mita_EndingTalk_001
Array.english: Oh my, Dave. I heard you got hurt...
Array.indonesia: Astaga, Dave. Aku dengar kamu terluka...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Mita_EndingTalk_002
Array.english: Yeah, I did. But I'm all better now.
Array.indonesia: Iya, benar. Tapi sekarang aku sudah sembuh total.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Mita_EndingTalk_003
Array.english: Hehe! What a relief! It's all thanks to Bancho's delicious cooking, right?
Array.indonesia: Hehe! Lega banget! Itu semua berkat masakan lezat Bancho, kan?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Mita_EndingTalk_004
Array.english: Of course. Nothing beats a good meal for healing!
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja. Nggak ada yang bisa mengalahkan makanan enak buat penyembuhan!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Longbottom_EndingTalk_001
Array.english: Are you feeling alright now?
Array.indonesia: Kamu sudah merasa baik-baik saja sekarang?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Longbottom_EndingTalk_002
Array.english: Yeah. Thanks to everyone, I bounced back pretty quick.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Berkat kalian semua, aku pulih dengan cukup cepat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Longbottom_EndingTalk_003
Array.english: Exploration always comes with some danger, doesn't it?
Array.indonesia: Eksplorasi selalu disertai risiko, bukan?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Longbottom_EndingTalk_004
Array.english: The best thing you can do is prepare well and have an emergency plan ready!
Array.indonesia: Hal terbaik yang bisa kamu lakukan adalah mempersiapkan diri dengan baik dan menyiapkan rencana darurat!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rover_EndingTalk_001
Array.english: Your frequency, Dave...\nIt went silent for a moment.
Array.indonesia: Frekuensimu, Dave...\nFrekuensimu diam sejenak.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rover_EndingTalk_002
Array.english: Then... it started to come back, resonating with the frequencies of those around you.
Array.indonesia: Lalu... sinyal itu mulai kembali, beresonansi dengan frekuensi orang-orang di sekitarmu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rover_EndingTalk_003
Array.english: I don't know exactly what happened to you...
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak tahu persis apa yang terjadi padamu...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rover_EndingTalk_004
Array.english: But I'm really glad you're back.
Array.indonesia: Tapi aku sangat senang kamu sudah kembali.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Sato_001
Array.english: Hoho, a village festival.\nSo lively.
Array.indonesia: Hoho, festival desa.\nSungguh meriah.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Sato_002
Array.english: Even I let my guard down today and enjoyed the food.
Array.indonesia: Bahkan aku pun melepaskan kewaspadaanku hari ini dan menikmati makanannya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Sato_003
Array.english: There should be days like this once in a while, hm!
Array.indonesia: Seharusnya ada hari-hari seperti ini sesekali, hm!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Udo_001
Array.english: Hehe, you can't have great food without great music.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, makanan enak tidak lengkap tanpa musik yang bagus.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Udo_002
Array.english: The performance was great overall...\nbut the drums were a bit off...
Array.indonesia: Pertunjukannya secara keseluruhan bagus...\ntapi drumnya agak tidak pas...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Udo_003
Array.english: <size=35>Ah... uh... about that...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ah... eh... soal itu...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Udo_004
Array.english: Well, I guess that's part of the experience! Hehe.
Array.indonesia: Yah, kurasa itu bagian dari pengalamannya! Hehe.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Yasuto_001
Array.english: Now that the shop's closed, it feels a bit quiet.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang toko sudah tutup, rasanya agak sepi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Yasuto_002
Array.english: I'll recharge today and come back stronger tomorrow.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan mengisi ulang tenaga hari ini dan kembali dengan semangat baru besok.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_MartinTweed_001
Array.english: Haha! The festival food here is really something!
Array.indonesia: Haha! Makanan festival di sini benar-benar luar biasa!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_MartinTweed_002
Array.english: Of course, Kindred Food Lab products are great too...
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja, produk Kindred Food Lab juga enak...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_MartinTweed_003
Array.english: <size=33>But nothing beats the taste of nature!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tapi tidak ada yang bisa mengalahkan rasa alam!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Rover_001
Array.english: Thanks for letting me stay and rest here for a while.
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih sudah mengizinkan aku tinggal dan beristirahat di sini sebentar.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Rover_002
Array.english: This village has many people with warm, gentle frequencies.
Array.indonesia: Desa ini dihuni banyak orang dengan getaran yang hangat dan lembut.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Rover_003
Array.english: If there's anything I can do, I'd be happy to help.
Array.indonesia: Jika ada yang bisa aku bantu, aku akan dengan senang hati membantu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCLakeEvent_Piranha_FirstEncounter_001
Array.english: <size=33>That's…a <color=#F1DC2B>Red-Bellied Piranha</color>…!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Itu… seekor <color=#F1DC2B>Piranha Perut Merah</color>…!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCLakeEvent_Piranha_FirstEncounter_002
Array.english: <size=33>A different kind of ferocity from sea creatures…. \nI'd better be careful.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Keganasan yang berbeda dari makhluk laut…. \nSebaiknya aku berhati-hati.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCLakeEvent_GiantSturgeon_BottomSweep_001
Array.english: <size=34>Is that…a <color=#F1DC2B>Giant Sturgeon</color>…?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Apakah itu… seekor <color=#F1DC2B>Sturgeon Raksasa</color>…?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCLakeEvent_GiantSturgeon_BottomSweep_002
Array.english: <size=32>Sweeping the bottom for food, huh…. \nLooks incredibly tough… I'd better be careful.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Sedang mencari makan di dasar perairan, ya…. \nKelihatannya sangat tangguh… Sebaiknya aku berhati-hati.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCLakeEvent_BlackCaiman_Ambush_001
Array.english: <size=35>Whoa…! That's a huge <color=#F1DC2B>Black Caiman</color>…!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wah…! Itu <color=#F1DC2B>Buaya Hitam</color> yang sangat besar…!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCLakeEvent_BlackCaiman_Ambush_002
Array.english:
<size=32>Seeing it underwater is terrifying...
If those jaws clamp down on me, I'm done for...</size>
Array.indonesia:
<size=32>Melihatnya di bawah air sungguh menakutkan...
Jika rahang itu menggigitku, aku tamat...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCLakeEvent_Basilosaurs_Dead_001
Array.english: <size=34>Ah…the Basilosaurus's body…!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ah…tubuh Basilosaurus…!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCLakeEvent_Basilosaurs_Dead_002
Array.english: This one was probably looking for its young too,\nand got caught up in something strange….
Array.indonesia: Yang ini mungkin juga sedang mencari anaknya,\ndan terjebak dalam sesuatu yang aneh….

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCLakeEvent_Basilosaurs_Dead_003
Array.english: It's heartbreaking, but…\nI hope it understands.
Array.indonesia: Memang menyedihkan, tapi…\nsemoga ia mengerti.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCLakeEvent_Basilosaurs_Dead_004
Array.english: If there's anything here we can still use…\nwe'll accept it with gratitude.
Array.indonesia: Jika ada sesuatu di sini yang masih bisa kita manfaatkan…\nkita akan menerimanya dengan rasa syukur.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCLakeEvent_BullShark_001
Array.english: <size=34>Huh… isn't that the <color=#F1DC2B>Bull Shark</color> that Sulong used to prey on…?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Huh… bukankah itu <color=#F1DC2B>Hiu Banteng</color> yang dulu sering diburu oleh Sulong…?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCLakeEvent_BullShark_002
Array.english: After Sulong died, it claimed this place for itself….
Array.indonesia: Setelah Sulong mati, hiu itu mengklaim tempat ini untuk dirinya sendiri….

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCLakeEvent_BullShark_003
Array.english: There are tons of aggressive fish around too…\nI'd better be careful.
Array.indonesia: Ada banyak sekali ikan agresif di sekitar sini juga…\nSebaiknya aku berhati-hati.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_MarincaBloom_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=35>Oho! The Rafflesia is in full bloom!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oho! Rafflesia sedang mekar penuh!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_MarincaBloom_Complete_002
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... yeah. It's enormous.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... ya. Ukurannya sangat besar.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_MarincaBloom_Complete_003
Array.english: The smell is awful, though...
Array.indonesia: Tapi baunya sangat menyengat...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_MarincaBloom_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=33>Haha! That's why I've got tissues stuffed up my nose!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Haha! Itulah mengapa hidungku penuh dengan tisu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_MarincaBloom_Complete_005
Array.english:
Anyway... thanks to you, I was able to gather
all the Marincas in this area.
Array.indonesia:
Bagaimanapun... berkat kamu, aku bisa mengumpulkan
semua Marinca di daerah ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_MarincaBloom_Complete_006
Array.english: You've done a lot for me, so the least I can do is say thank you.
Array.indonesia: Kamu sudah banyak membantuku, jadi setidaknya aku bisa mengucapkan terima kasih.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_MarincaBloom_Complete_007
Array.english: <size=35>Take this!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ambil ini!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_MarincaBloom_Complete_008
Array.english: Hmm? What is this?
Array.indonesia: Hmm? Apa ini?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_MarincaBloom_Complete_009
Array.english: <size=33>It's a <color=#F1DC2B>Rafflesia Roof Decoration</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33> Ini adalah <color=#F1DC2B>Hiasan Atap Rafflesia</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_MarincaBloom_Complete_010
Array.english: I brought it to motivate myself to complete Marinca Bloom, but…
Array.indonesia: Aku membawanya untuk memotivasi diriku sendiri agar bisa menyelesaikan Marinca Bloom, tapi…

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_MarincaBloom_Complete_011
Array.english: <size=33>Come to think of it, I don't have a house right now, haha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kalau dipikir-pikir, aku nggak punya rumah sekarang, haha!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_MarincaBloom_Complete_012
Array.english: <size=33>Hang it on the roof of your house.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Gantungkan di atap rumahmu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_MarincaBloom_Complete_013
Array.english: Oh... thank you.
Array.indonesia: Oh... terima kasih.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_MarincaBloom_Complete_014
Array.english: <size=34>But it won't smell, will it?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Tapi nggak bakal bau, kan?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_MarincaBloom_Complete_015
Array.english: Haha, it's made of plastic, so no need to worry about the smell!
Array.indonesia: Haha, ini terbuat dari plastik, jadi nggak perlu khawatir soal baunya!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_MarincaBloom_Complete_016
Array.english: Well, I'll be staying in this village for a while, so don't be a stranger!
Array.indonesia: Yah, aku bakal tinggal di desa ini untuk sementara waktu, jadi jangan sungkan mampir!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_OutsiderTent_Rover_001
Array.english: A dog-shaped bathtub...?\nInteresting.
Array.indonesia: Bak mandi berbentuk anjing...?\nMenarik.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_OutsiderTent_Mita_001
Array.english: How did she even bring that chair here...?
Array.indonesia: Bagaimana dia bisa membawa kursi itu ke sini...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_OutsiderTent_Mystery_Guitar_001
Array.english: Charlie's guitar case.\nPretty cool.
Array.indonesia: Kotak gitar Charlie.\nKeren banget.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_AfterGetReward_001
Array.english: Now that I'm back at the Blue Hole, I kind of miss the lively bustle of Utara Village.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang setelah aku kembali ke Blue Hole, aku agak merindukan keramaian Desa Utara.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_AfterGetReward_002
Array.english: I should stop by someday to say hello.
Array.indonesia: Suatu hari nanti aku harus mampir untuk menyapa.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_ByeUtara01_001
Array.english: ...What brings you all here...?
Array.indonesia: ...Apa yang membawa kalian semua ke sini...?

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_ByeUtara01_002
Array.english: I heard you're leaving the village. \nWe couldn't let you go without saying goodbye.
