Array.indonesia: Kudengar kamu akan meninggalkan desa ini. \nKami tidak bisa membiarkanmu pergi tanpa mengucapkan selamat tinggal.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_ByeUtara01_003
Array.english: Thank you for staying in our village.\nThanks to you, the lake has settled down just like before.
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih sudah tinggal di desa kami.\nBerkat kamu, danau ini sudah kembali tenang seperti semula.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_ByeUtara01_004
Array.english: And that cook of yours had quite the skill, too.
Array.indonesia: Dan koki kalian itu juga sangat terampil, lho.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_ByeUtara01_005
Array.english: You flatter me.\nI believe it's all thanks to the villagers who helped us.
Array.indonesia: Kalian terlalu memuji saya.\nSaya yakin ini semua berkat para penduduk desa yang telah membantu kami.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_ByeUtara01_006
Array.english: Everyone in the village will remember you.\nYou've given us fond memories.
Array.indonesia: Semua orang di desa ini akan mengingat kalian.\nKalian telah memberi kami kenangan indah.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_ByeUtara01_007
Array.english: Likewise. I'll never forget my memories of this place!
Array.indonesia: Begitu juga dengan saya. Saya tidak akan pernah melupakan kenangan saya di tempat ini!

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_ByeUtara01_008
Array.english: It's only a small gift...\nbut it carries our wish that you'll remember this village.
Array.indonesia: Ini hanya hadiah kecil...\ntapi di dalamnya terkandung harapan kami agar kamu mengingat desa ini.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_ByeUtara02_001
Array.english: Oh... Thank you!\nThis will look great in Bancho's restaurant!
Array.indonesia: Oh... Terima kasih!\nIni akan terlihat bagus di restoran Bancho!

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_ByeUtara02_002
Array.english: Hehe. Feel free to drop by anytime.\nEveryone will be missing you.
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Silakan mampir kapan saja.\nSemua orang akan merindukanmu.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_TalkBancho_001
Array.english: Hmm. Come to think of it...
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Kalau dipikir-pikir...

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_TalkBancho_002
Array.english: Based on what I learned in the jungle, I've come up with a few new <color=#F1DC2B>dishes</color>.
Array.indonesia: Berdasarkan apa yang aku pelajari di hutan, aku sudah menciptakan beberapa <color=#F1DC2B>hidangan</color> baru.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_TalkBancho_003
Array.english: Oh... but the ingredients here are different. Will that work?
Array.indonesia: Oh... tapi bahan-bahannya di sini berbeda. Apakah itu akan berhasil?

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_TalkBancho_004
Array.english: What matters is how you season it and how you grill it.\nSaltwater fish will do just fine!
Array.indonesia: Yang penting adalah cara membumbui dan memanggangnya.\nIkan air asin pun akan cocok!

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_TalkBancho_005
Array.english: <size=32>I can't wait to see even more variety in your cooking, Bancho!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku tidak sabar ingin melihat variasi masakanmu yang lebih banyak lagi, Bancho!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCMainMission_07_01_TalkBancho_006
Array.english: <size=33>It'll bring back memories of what we ate in the jungle, too...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Itu juga akan membangkitkan kenangan tentang apa yang kita makan di hutan...</size>

Array.name: JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindBasarr_Hint
Array.english: That one was always interested in the giant saltwater crocodile.
Array.indonesia: Orang itu selalu tertarik pada buaya air asin raksasa.

Array.name: JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindDanu_Hint
Array.english: That one often talked about the caiman.
Array.indonesia: Dia sering membicarakan caiman.

Array.name: JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindKarang_Hint
Array.english: That one always wondered what the Sea People's chief looks like.
Array.indonesia: Dia selalu penasaran seperti apa rupa kepala suku Orang Laut.

Array.name: JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindMahesa_Hint
Array.english: He said he wanted to ride the fast currents like a slide.
Array.indonesia: Dia bilang ingin menaiki arus deras seperti seluncuran.

Array.name: JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindMutu_Hint
Array.english: He hates the dark, so he's probably near the water's edge.
Array.indonesia: Dia benci kegelapan, jadi dia mungkin berada di tepi air.

Array.name: JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSegera_Hint
Array.english: He often talked about a shark with an anvil on its back.
Array.indonesia: Dia sering membicarakan hiu yang memiliki landasan tempa di punggungnya.

Array.name: JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSemak_Hint
Array.english: That one loves camouflaging himself and hiding behind trees.
Array.indonesia: Dia suka menyamarkan diri dan bersembunyi di balik pohon.

Array.name: JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindUndu_Hint
Array.english: He always wondered what lies in the deepest part of this lake.
Array.indonesia: Dia selalu penasaran apa yang ada di bagian terdalam danau ini.

Array.name: JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindWulan_Hint
Array.english: That one's quite the scaredy-cat... he might be hiding inside something sturdy.
Array.indonesia: Dia cukup penakut... mungkin dia bersembunyi di dalam sesuatu yang kokoh.

Array.name: JDLC_Spirits_Event_FindFirstSpirit01_001
Array.english: Hm? The <color=#F1DC2B>necklace</color> the spirit chief gave me is glowing.
Array.indonesia: Hm? <color=#F1DC2B>kalung</color> yang diberikan kepala roh kepadaku sedang bersinar.

Array.name: JDLC_Spirits_Event_FindFirstSpirit01_002
Array.english: Is there a lost <color=#F1DC2B>spirit</color> nearby...?
Array.indonesia: Apakah ada <color=#F1DC2B>roh</color> yang tersesat di dekat sini...?

Array.name: JDLC_Spirits_Event_FindFirstSpirit02_001
Array.english: Ah... there's a spirit over there that looks lost...?!
Array.indonesia: Ah... ada roh di sana yang terlihat tersesat...?!

Array.name: JDLC_Spirits_Event_FindFirstSpirit02_002
Array.english: I should rescue it and send it back to the village.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus menyelamatkannya dan mengembalikannya ke desa.

Array.name: JDLC_Spirits_Event_FindFirstSpirit02_003
Array.english: Hmm... but it'll probably run away if I get close...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... tapi dia mungkin akan lari kalau aku mendekat...

Array.name: JDLC_Spirits_Event_FindFirstSpirit02_004
Array.english: <size=32>That's right! I have the <color=#1DFEAF>Bug Net</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Benar juga! Aku punya <color=#1DFEAF>Jaring Serangga</color>!</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Spirits_Event_FindFirstSpirit02_005
Array.english: It's just the right size. \nI'll catch it with this first, then talk it over.
Array.indonesia: Ukurannya pas banget. \nAku akan menangkapnya dengan ini dulu, baru membicarakannya.

Array.name: JDLC_Spirits_Idle_Barung_01
Array.english: Fiddling with a fishhook...
Array.indonesia: Mengutak-atik kail...

Array.name: JDLC_Spirits_Idle_Barung_02
Array.english: Straightening their clothes...
Array.indonesia: Merapikan pakaian mereka...

Array.name: JDLC_Spirits_Idle_Barung_03
Array.english: Scratching their head...
Array.indonesia: Menggaruk kepala...

Array.name: JDLC_Spirits_Idle_Basarr_01
Array.english: Wandering around...
Array.indonesia: Berkeliling...

Array.name: JDLC_Spirits_Tutorial_Condition_001
Array.english: There, that looks like a good assignment.

Array.name: JDLC_Spirits_Tutorial_Condition_002
Array.english: Oh, but Luu's <color=#F1DC2B>condition</color> doesn't look so great today.
Array.indonesia: Oh, tapi kondisi <color=#F1DC2B>Luu</color> hari ini sepertinya kurang bagus.

Array.name: JDLC_Spirits_Tutorial_Condition_003
Array.english: We Surs really love <color=#F1DC2B>fruit</color>.
Array.indonesia: Kami, para Surs, sangat menyukai <color=#F1DC2B>buah</color>.

Array.name: JDLC_Spirits_Tutorial_End_001
Array.english: There, that's how you assign our Surs and request gathering.
Array.indonesia: Nah, begitulah cara menugaskan para Surs kami dan meminta mereka mengumpulkan sesuatu.

Array.name: JDLC_Spirits_Tutorial_End_002
Array.english: Now try it yourself, wherever you like.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang coba sendiri, di mana pun kamu mau.

Array.name: JDLC_Spirits_Tutorial_End_003
Array.english: As you rescue more Surs, I'll tell them to help you as well.
Array.indonesia: Semakin banyak Surs yang kamu selamatkan, aku akan meminta mereka untuk membantumu juga.

Array.name: JDLC_Spirits_Tutorial_End_004
Array.english: Oh, and if Surga Falls feels a bit far to visit...
Array.indonesia: Oh, dan jika Surga Falls terasa agak jauh untuk dikunjungi...

Array.name: JDLC_Spirits_Tutorial_End_005
Array.english: you can use this <color=#F1DC2B>Crystal Orb</color> to assign the Surs right away.
Array.indonesia: kamu bisa menggunakan <color=#F1DC2B>Crystal Orb</color> ini untuk menugaskan para Surs segera.

Array.name: JDLC_Spirits_Tutorial_End_006
Array.english: Just carrying it won't do. Remember, it must be placed in your home.
Array.indonesia: Hanya membawanya saja tidak cukup. Ingat, benda ini harus diletakkan di rumahmu.

Array.name: JDLC_Spirits_Tutorial_End_007
Array.english: Now then... please help our lost ones find their way back here.
Array.indonesia: Nah... tolong bantu mereka yang tersesat untuk menemukan jalan pulang ke sini.

Array.name: JDLC_Spirits_Tutorial_GiveFruits_001
Array.english: If a Sur's condition looks poor, try feeding them <color=#F1DC2B>fruit</color>.
Array.indonesia: Jika kondisi seorang Sur terlihat buruk, coba beri mereka <color=#F1DC2B>buah</color>.

Array.name: JDLC_Spirits_Tutorial_GiveFruits_002
Array.english: You happen to have a banana, so try giving it to Luu.
Array.indonesia: Kebetulan kamu punya pisang, jadi coba berikan kepada Luu.

Array.name: JDLC_Spirits_Tutorial_SelectDispatch_001
Array.english: This is where you decide where to send the Sur.
Array.indonesia: Di sinilah kamu memutuskan ke mana akan mengirim Sur tersebut.

Array.name: JDLC_Spirits_Tutorial_SelectDispatch_002
Array.english: But be careful: you can't send a Sur somewhere that doesn't suit their traits.
Array.indonesia: Namun berhati-hatilah: kamu tidak bisa mengirim Sur ke tempat yang tidak sesuai dengan sifatnya.

Array.name: JDLC_Spirits_Tutorial_SelectDispatch_003
Array.english: Each Sur can gather somewhat different things.
Array.indonesia: Setiap Sur dapat mengumpulkan benda-benda yang sedikit berbeda.

Array.name: JDLC_Spirits_Tutorial_SelectDispatch_004
Array.english: What they gather depends on both the region and the Sur, so assign them with care.
Array.indonesia: Apa yang mereka kumpulkan bergantung pada wilayah dan Sur itu sendiri, jadi tetapkan penugasan mereka dengan hati-hati.

Array.name: JDLC_Spirits_Tutorial_SelectSpirit_001
Array.english: Here you can see where the Surs... that is, the spirits... are assigned.
Array.indonesia: Di sini kamu bisa melihat ke mana para Sur... maksudku, roh-roh... ditugaskan.

Array.name: JDLC_Spirits_Tutorial_SelectSpirit_002
Array.english: Right now, only three Surs are in the village.
Array.indonesia: Saat ini, hanya ada tiga Sur di desa.

Array.name: JDLC_Spirits_Tutorial_SelectSpirit_003
Array.english: First, let's try assigning <color=#F1DC2B>Luu</color>. He's good at finding ingredients.
Array.indonesia: Pertama, mari kita coba menugaskan <color=#F1DC2B>Luu</color>. Dia pandai mencari bahan-bahan.

Array.name: JDLC_Spirits_Tutorial_Start_001
Array.english: Before you head into the lake, let me show you how to assign the Surs.
Array.indonesia: Sebelum kamu pergi ke danau, biarkan aku menunjukkan cara menugaskan para Sur.

Array.name: JDLC_Spirits_Tutorial_Start_002
Array.english: Here, try pressing <color=#F1DC2B>Assign Spirit</color>.
Array.indonesia: Di sini, coba tekan <color=#F1DC2B>Tugaskan Roh</color>.

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Marula_Interaction_End_01
Array.english: Then feel free to talk to me anytime.
Array.indonesia: Silakan hubungi saya kapan saja.

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Marula_Interaction_Return_01
Array.english: Is there something else you need?
Array.indonesia: Ada hal lain yang Kamu butuhkan?

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Marula_Interaction_Select_01
Array.english: Is there something I can help you with?
Array.indonesia: Ada yang bisa saya bantu?

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Marula_Talk_Select_01
Array.english: If you have something to say, go ahead.
Array.indonesia: Jika ada yang ingin Kamu sampaikan, silakan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_JungleEnding_001
Array.english: I was able to study many recipes in the jungle.
Array.indonesia: Aku berhasil mempelajari banyak resep di hutan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_JungleEnding_002
Array.english: But... without the same ingredients, it's hard to recreate those flavors here.
Array.indonesia: Tapi... tanpa bahan-bahan yang sama, sulit untuk meniru rasa-rasa itu di sini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_JungleEnding_003
Array.english: It seems the finest recipes truly call for the finest ingredients.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya resep terbaik memang membutuhkan bahan-bahan terbaik.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_JungleReturn_001
Array.english: I must say, I'm still a bit more at home with ingredients from the sea.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus akui, aku masih lebih nyaman menggunakan bahan-bahan dari laut.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_JungleReturn_002
Array.english: Of course, cooking with freshwater fish and fruit has been a great learning experience.
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja, memasak dengan ikan air tawar dan buah-buahan telah menjadi pengalaman belajar yang luar biasa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_JungleReturn_003
Array.english: I ought to take my time and study it while I'm at the village.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus meluangkan waktu dan mempelajarinya selagi aku berada di desa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Basu_BullSharkAppear_001
Array.english: Come to think of it... ever since ya took down Sulong, I been seein' fish carcasses floatin' up all chewed to bits.
Array.indonesia: Kalau dipikir-pikir... sejak kamu mengalahkan Sulong, aku sering melihat bangkai ikan mengapung yang sudah dimakan habis.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Basu_BullSharkAppear_002
Array.english: Could be that shark's roamin' around again now that its predator's gone.
Array.indonesia: Mungkin hiu itu berkeliaran lagi sekarang setelah predatornya sudah tidak ada.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Basu_BullSharkAppear_003
Array.english: Them two species got similar habits. Both come out around sundown and all.
Array.indonesia: Kedua spesies itu punya kebiasaan yang mirip. Keduanya muncul saat matahari terbenam dan sebagainya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Basu_BullSharkAppear_004
Array.english: Just in case, be careful headin' into the lake come evenin'.
Array.indonesia: Untuk berjaga-jaga, berhati-hatilah saat pergi ke danau menjelang malam.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk02_001
Array.english: Come to think of it...
Array.indonesia: Kalau dipikir-pikir...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk02_002
Array.english: How did you escape from the lake with your arm injured like that?
Array.indonesia: Bagaimana kamu bisa melarikan diri dari danau dengan lengan terluka seperti itu?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk02_003
Array.english: <size=32>Ah! Well, you see...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ah! Begini, kamu tahu...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk02_End_001
Array.english: <size=32>So that's what happened...\nI feel like I caused everyone a lot of trouble.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Jadi begitulah yang terjadi...\nAku merasa telah membuat semua orang repot.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk02_End_002
Array.english: <size=32>Don't be so hard on yourself! The villagers were overjoyed to see you safe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Jangan terlalu menyalahkan dirimu sendiri! Penduduk desa sangat gembira melihatmu selamat.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk02_End_003
Array.english: <size=32>The hero who saved the village from crisis had returned, after all!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Pahlawan yang menyelamatkan desa dari krisis akhirnya telah kembali!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk02_End_004
Array.english: <size=32>Hehe... that's a little embarrassing.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehe... itu agak memalukan.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk02_End_005
Array.english: <size=32>Cobra... the villagers... I'm just so grateful to you all.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Cobra... penduduk desa... Aku sungguh sangat berterima kasih kepada kalian semua.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk02_End_006
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! Anyone would've done the same in my place!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Siapa pun pasti akan melakukan hal yang sama jika berada di posisiku!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk02_End_007
Array.english: <size=34>You're Dave, the diver we all love, after all.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Lagipula, kamu adalah Dave, penyelam yang kita semua sayangi.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk02_Scene01_001
Array.english: <size=33>The moment she saw I was hurt...\nUzme jumped right into the lake!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Begitu dia melihat aku terluka...\nUzme langsung melompat ke danau!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk02_Scene02_001
Array.english: <size=32>She swam over to me at incredible speed...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Dia berenang ke arahku dengan kecepatan luar biasa...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk02_Scene03_001
Array.english: <size=33>And knocked out all the crocodiles with her bare fists!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Dan mengalahkan semua buaya dengan tinjunya yang telanjang!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk02_Scene03_002
Array.english: <size=32>Whoa... Uzme is incredible...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wah... Uzme sungguh luar biasa...!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk02_Scene03_003
Array.english: <size=32>Come to think of it, she did say she trained to protect herself from the crocodiles.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kalau dipikir-pikir, dia memang pernah bilang kalau dia berlatih untuk melindungi diri dari buaya.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk02_Scene03_004
Array.english: <size=32>She showed up right when I thought it was truly over. I couldn't have been more grateful...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Dia muncul tepat saat aku mengira semuanya sudah benar-benar berakhir. Aku sangat bersyukur...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk02_Scene03_005
Array.english: <size=32>But it was just too much for Uzme to drag the both of us out on her own.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tapi terlalu berat bagi Uzme untuk menyeret kami berdua keluar sendirian.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk02_Scene03_006
Array.english: <size=32>And just as the downed crocodiles started creeping back toward us...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Dan tepat saat buaya-buaya yang sudah terkapar mulai merayap kembali ke arah kami...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk02_Scene04_001
Array.english: <size=32>The village blacksmith, <color=#F1DC2B>Perak</color>, threw us a rope!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Pandai besi desa, <color=#F1DC2B>Perak</color>, melemparkan tali kepada kami!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk02_Scene05_001
Array.english: <size=32>Uzme held on tight to the rope...\nand the villagers pulled with all their might.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Uzme memegang tali itu dengan erat...\ndan para penduduk desa menariknya dengan sekuat tenaga.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_JungleEnding_001
Array.english: Being alone on the boat makes me miss the hustle and bustle of Utara Village.
Array.indonesia: Berada sendirian di perahu ini membuatku merindukan keramaian Desa Utara.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_JungleEnding_002
Array.english: Right? It feels empty without Rimbo's hearty laugh or the sound of Jaka's Panting.
Array.indonesia: Benar, kan? Rasanya hampa tanpa tawa riang Rimbo atau suara napas terengah-engah Jaka.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_JungleEnding_003
Array.english: We can head back anytime, so let's go visit again when we've got time!
Array.indonesia: Kita bisa balik kapan saja, jadi ayo kita mampir lagi kalau ada waktu!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_JungleReturn_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hahaha! Nothing beats the cool weather here in the Blue Hole!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hahaha! Nggak ada yang bisa ngalahin cuaca sejuk di Blue Hole ini!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_JungleReturn_002
Array.english: Right? It did get pretty hot in Utara Village during the day.
Array.indonesia: Iya kan? Di Desa Utara memang lumayan panas siangnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_JungleReturn_003
Array.english: Though I guess that's why so many tasty fruits grow there.
Array.indonesia: Meskipun kurasa itulah sebabnya banyak buah lezat tumbuh di sana.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Otto_JungleEnding_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh! You folks are back now?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh! Kalian sudah kembali sekarang?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Otto_JungleEnding_002
Array.english: Yes. Our research in the jungle village is all done.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Penelitian kami di desa hutan sudah selesai.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Otto_JungleEnding_003
Array.english: Did somethin' bad happen out there?\nThat Cobra fella's arm...
Array.indonesia: Apa ada hal buruk yang terjadi di sana?\nLengan si Cobra itu...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Otto_JungleEnding_004
Array.english: Yes... There were some dangerous moments...\nCobra got hurt trying to save me.
Array.indonesia: Ya... Ada beberapa momen berbahaya...\nCobra terluka saat mencoba menyelamatkanku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Otto_JungleEnding_005
Array.english: My my... That's a real shame.\nDon't you go blamin' yourself too much.
Array.indonesia: Astaga... Itu sungguh disayangkan.\nJangan terlalu menyalahkan dirimu sendiri.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Otto_JungleEnding_006
Array.english: Still, that fella was drinkin' his beer as cheerful as ever.
Array.indonesia: Meski begitu, orang itu tetap minum birnya dengan riang seperti biasa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Otto_JungleEnding_007
Array.english: <size=33>Looked like he had a mighty good time travelin' with ya!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Sepertinya dia benar-benar menikmati perjalanannya bersamamu!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Otto_JungleEnding_008
Array.english: Havin' a good partner is a real blessin', for you and for him both.
Array.indonesia: Memiliki rekan yang baik adalah berkah yang sesungguhnya, baik bagimu maupun baginya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Otto_JungleEnding_009
Array.english: If you feel sorry about somethin', you just treat each other better from now on! Ya got that?
Array.indonesia: Jika kamu merasa menyesal tentang sesuatu, mulai sekarang perlakukanlah satu sama lain dengan lebih baik! Paham?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Otto_JungleEnding_010
Array.english: You're right.\nWhat matters more is being better to each other from now on.
Array.indonesia: Kamu benar.\nYang lebih penting adalah saling memperlakukan satu sama lain dengan lebih baik mulai sekarang.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Otto_JungleReturn_001
Array.english: Ha! I was wonderin' why I hadn't seen you folks around...
Array.indonesia: Ha! Aku penasaran kenapa aku nggak pernah lihat kalian di sekitar sini...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Otto_JungleReturn_002
Array.english: Heard ya went off to some jungle far away. Is that true?
Array.indonesia: Dengar-dengar kalian pergi ke hutan yang jauh. Benarkah itu?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Otto_JungleReturn_003
Array.english: Yes. We went to help Dr. Bacon with his research,\nso we've been staying over there.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Kami pergi membantu Dr. Bacon dalam penelitiannya,\njadi kami tinggal di sana.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Otto_JungleReturn_004
Array.english: Whew... The weather there must be awful muggy.
Array.indonesia: Wah... Cuaca di sana pasti sangat lembap.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Otto_JungleReturn_005
Array.english: Come to think of it, I've been in a tropical rainforest myself once!
Array.indonesia: Kalau dipikir-pikir, aku sendiri pernah ke hutan hujan tropis sekali!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Otto_JungleReturn_006
Array.english: My buddies talked me into it, sayin' there was treasure hidden in some old ruins...
Array.indonesia: Teman-temanku membujukku, bilang ada harta karun tersembunyi di reruntuhan tua...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Otto_JungleReturn_007
Array.english: But then... on the way, I tripped over this huge log and fell flat...
Array.indonesia: Tapi kemudian... di tengah jalan, aku tersandung batang kayu besar dan terjatuh telentang...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Otto_JungleReturn_008
Array.english: <size=33>Turns out it was one enormous anaconda!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ternyata itu seekor anaconda raksasa!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Otto_JungleReturn_009
Array.english: <size=33>So I just socked it right on the snout...\nPOW! And it started backin' away real slow!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Jadi aku langsung meninju hidungnya...\nPOW! Dan dia mulai mundur perlahan-lahan!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Otto_JungleReturn_010
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(...It's been a while since I heard one of Otto's stories. Pretty fun, actually.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(...Sudah lama aku tidak mendengar cerita dari Otto. Sebenarnya cukup seru.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Otto_JungleReturn_011
Array.english: <size=32>Anyway, I'm takin' good care of the farm, so don't you worry one bit!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Pokoknya, aku merawat pertanian ini dengan baik, jadi jangan khawatir sedikit pun!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sammy_JungleEnding_001
Array.english: Hey, Dave! You're back!
Array.indonesia: Hei, Dave! Kamu sudah balik!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sammy_JungleEnding_002
Array.english: It was hella boring around the Blue Hole without you three, you know.
Array.indonesia: Tempat di sekitar Blue Hole itu bener-bener membosankan tanpa kalian bertiga, tahu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sammy_JungleEnding_003
Array.english: It was straight-up... a roar in the silence, a need for defiance... YEAH!
Array.indonesia: Itu benar-benar... raungan di tengah keheningan, hasrat untuk memberontak... YA!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sammy_JungleEnding_004
Array.english: Haha. You've still got that vibe going, Sammy.
Array.indonesia: Haha. Kamu masih punya aura itu, Sammy.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sammy_JungleEnding_005
Array.english: I heard a whole lot went down out there.\nThe jungle sounds like one dangerous place, yo.
Array.indonesia: Aku dengar banyak hal terjadi di sana.\nHutan itu terdengar seperti tempat yang berbahaya, bro.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sammy_JungleEnding_006
Array.english: Someday I wanna turn your story into a song, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Suatu hari nanti aku mau mengubah ceritamu jadi lagu, Dave.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sammy_JungleEnding_007
Array.english: For the title, I'll channel how it felt steppin' into the jungle for the first time... Welcome to the...
Array.indonesia: Untuk judulnya, aku bakal menggambarkan bagaimana rasanya masuk ke hutan untuk pertama kalinya... Selamat datang di...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sammy_JungleEnding_008
Array.english: Ah... A title like that is gonna land you in big trouble later...!
Array.indonesia: Ah.. . Judul seperti itu bakal bikin kamu kena masalah besar nanti...!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sammy_JungleReturn_001
Array.english: Hey, what's up! Long time no see, Dave!
Array.indonesia: Hei, apa kabar! Lama nggak ketemu, Dave!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sammy_JungleReturn_002
Array.english: Yeah. I've been staying in a jungle village far away.\nJust stopped by for a bit.
Array.indonesia: Iya. Aku tinggal di sebuah desa di hutan yang jauh.\nCuma mampir sebentar.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sammy_JungleReturn_003
Array.english: Haha! I bet you came 'cause you were worried about the farm, right?
Array.indonesia: Haha! Pasti kamu datang karena khawatir sama kebunnya, kan?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sammy_JungleReturn_004
Array.english: No worries.\nMe and my pops are taking real good care of it! YEAH.
Array.indonesia: Tenang aja.\nAku dan ayahku merawatnya dengan sangat baik! YEAH.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Barung_01_001
Array.english: Nothing's as fun as fishing.
Array.indonesia: Nggak ada yang lebih seru dari memancing.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Barung_01_002
Array.english: You never know what you'll catch! That thrill gets me every time!
Array.indonesia: Kamu nggak pernah tahu apa yang bakal kamu tangkap! Sensasi itu selalu bikin aku ketagihan!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Barung_02_001
Array.english: I heard humans can't stay underwater for long.
Array.indonesia: Aku dengar manusia nggak bisa bertahan lama di bawah air.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Barung_02_002
Array.english: We Surs can stay in the water forever!
Array.indonesia: Kami, kaum Surs, bisa bertahan di air selamanya!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Barung_02_003
Array.english: Though there's no avoiding getting hungry...
Array.indonesia: Meskipun rasa lapar tetap tak terhindarkan...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Basarr_01_001
Array.english: Hehe... I want some tasty fruit.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... Aku pengen buah yang enak.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Basarr_02_001
Array.english: Being underwater felt so stuffy.\nThe village really is better.
Array.indonesia: Berada di bawah air terasa sangat pengap.\nDesa memang jauh lebih baik.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Danu_01_001
Array.english: Aren't you the human who saved me back then?
Array.indonesia: Bukankah kamu manusia yang menyelamatkanku dulu?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Danu_01_002
Array.english: I was hiding from the crocodile, but...\ncome to think of it, crocodiles can't even see us!
Array.indonesia: Aku sedang bersembunyi dari buaya, tapi...\nkalau dipikir-pikir, buaya bahkan tidak bisa melihat kita!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Danu_02_001
Array.english: There are lots of fish here in Utara Lake.
Array.indonesia: Ada banyak ikan di Danau Utara ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Danu_02_002
Array.english: Coming down to watch them once in a while is pretty fun, too.
Array.indonesia: Sesekali turun ke sini untuk melihat mereka juga cukup seru.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Karang_01_001
Array.english: I'd only heard legends about the Sea People living deep in the lake.
Array.indonesia: Aku hanya pernah mendengar legenda tentang Suku Laut yang tinggal di kedalaman danau.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Karang_01_002
Array.english: Seeing it in person was absolutely amazing.
Array.indonesia: Melihatnya secara langsung sungguh menakjubkan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Karang_01_003
Array.english: <size=32>The Sea People's chief especially was so dignified!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Terutama kepala suku Suku Laut itu, dia begitu berwibawa!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Karang_01_004
Array.english: ...Until he started talking, that is.
Array.indonesia: ...Sampai dia mulai berbicara, sih.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Karang_02_001
Array.english: The Sea People here in the lake are really good with weapons.
Array.indonesia: Suku Laut di danau ini sangat ahli dalam menggunakan senjata.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Karang_02_002
Array.english: I saw them hunting fish, and they were so quick!
Array.indonesia: Aku melihat mereka berburu ikan, dan mereka sangat gesit!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Kicco_01_001
Array.english: You know how the crops in this village grow super fast, right?
Array.indonesia: Kamu tahu kan, tanaman di desa ini tumbuh super cepat?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Kicco_01_002
Array.english: That's because we Surs keep looking after them! Hehe.
Array.indonesia: Itu karena kami, kaum Surs, terus merawatnya! Hehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Kicco_02_001
Array.english: It's great to be back and see my friends again.\nThe village really is the best.
Array.indonesia: Senang rasanya bisa kembali dan bertemu teman-temanku lagi.\nDesa ini benar-benar yang terbaik.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Kicco_02_002
Array.english: I heard the terrain there keeps changing…\nEven spirits would get confused by that!
Array.indonesia: Aku dengar medan di sana terus berubah…\nBahkan roh pun pasti bingung karenanya!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Luu_01_001
Array.english: Hehe. I love this village. There's so much tasty food here.
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Aku suka desa ini. Ada banyak makanan enak di sini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Luu_01_002
Array.english: The fruit especially tastes absolutely amazing.
Array.indonesia: Terutama buah-buahan yang rasanya benar-benar luar biasa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Luu_02_001
Array.english: Being stuck in the lake with no fruit to eat was rough.
Array.indonesia: Terjebak di danau tanpa buah untuk dimakan itu menyiksa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Luu_02_002
Array.english: Thanks for saving me, human.
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih sudah menyelamatkanku, manusia.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Mahesa_01_001
Array.english: I don't know why I'm so sleepy all day...
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak tahu kenapa aku mengantuk sepanjang hari...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Mahesa_01_002
Array.english: Listening to the sound of the falls always puts me to sleep...
Array.indonesia: Mendengarkan suara air terjun selalu membuatku tertidur...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Mahesa_02_001
Array.english: Drifting along the currents in the lake was really fun.
Array.indonesia: Mengapung mengikuti arus di danau itu benar-benar seru.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Mahesa_02_002
Array.english: I totally forgot I was supposed to go back to the village...!
Array.indonesia: Aku benar-benar lupa kalau seharusnya aku kembali ke desa...!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Marula_01_001
Array.english: We have protected this region for a very long time.
Array.indonesia: Kami telah melindungi wilayah ini sejak lama.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Marula_01_002
Array.english: And yet we never knew there was such a huge passage beneath the lake.
Array.indonesia: Namun, kami tidak pernah tahu ada lorong sebesar itu di bawah danau.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Marula_01_003
Array.english: Thank you for warding off a great misfortune.
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih telah mencegah malapetaka besar.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Marula_02_001
Array.english: You lot seem to have come from a faraway land, yes?
Array.indonesia: Kalian sepertinya datang dari negeri yang jauh, ya?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Marula_02_002
Array.english: Yes. Strange phenomena started happening in this region, so we came to investigate.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Fenomena aneh mulai terjadi di wilayah ini, jadi kami datang untuk menyelidikinya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Marula_02_003
Array.english: The energy here was unstable, but it has settled greatly since you all arrived.
Array.indonesia: Energi di sini tadinya tidak stabil, tapi sudah jauh lebih tenang sejak kalian semua tiba.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Marula_02_004
Array.english: You've come a long way. Well done, all of you.
Array.indonesia: Kalian telah menempuh perjalanan yang jauh. Kerja bagus, kalian semua.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Marula_02_005
Array.english: I'm just glad we could be of some help to this village.
Array.indonesia: Aku senang kami bisa sedikit membantu desa ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Marula_02_006
Array.english: Heh. For a human from foreign lands, you have a good heart.\nI like you.
Array.indonesia: Heh. Untuk seorang manusia dari negeri asing, kamu memiliki hati yang baik.\nAku suka kamu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Mutu_01_001
Array.english: I only just learned that fruit doesn't grow in the lake.
Array.indonesia: Baru saja aku tahu bahwa buah tidak tumbuh di danau.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Mutu_01_002
Array.english: I searched forever, and all I found were water chestnuts.
Array.indonesia: Aku mencari berlama-lama, dan yang kutemukan hanyalah kastanye air.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Mutu_01_003
Array.english: Land fruit really suits my taste best.
Array.indonesia: Buah darat benar-benar paling cocok dengan seleraku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Mutu_02_001
Array.english: If you need anything from the forest, just say the word.
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu butuh apa pun dari hutan, bilang saja.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Mutu_02_002
Array.english: I'll taste it first to check for poison, so don't you worry!
Array.indonesia: Aku akan mencicipinya dulu untuk memastikan tidak beracun, jadi jangan khawatir!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Segera_01_001
Array.english: It's a shame I didn't get to see the shark with the anvil, but...
Array.indonesia: Sayang sekali aku tidak sempat melihat hiu dengan landasan tempa itu, tapi...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Segera_01_002
Array.english: Still, I'm glad I made it back to the village.
Array.indonesia: Meski begitu, aku senang bisa kembali ke desa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Segera_02_001
Array.english: Come to think of it, I saw a pointy shell in the sea beneath the lake.
Array.indonesia: Kalau dipikir-pikir, aku melihat cangkang runcing di laut di bawah danau.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Segera_02_002
Array.english: It looked like a spear...\nbut it had legs and moved around!
Array.indonesia: Kelihatannya seperti tombak...\ntapi benda itu punya kaki dan bisa bergerak-gerak!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Semak_01_001
Array.english: Shh. Keep it down!
Array.indonesia: Ssst. Jangan berisik!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Semak_01_002
Array.english: Someone might be listening in on us.
Array.indonesia: Mungkin ada yang mendengarkan percakapan kita.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Semak_02_001
Array.english: If you need anything from the forest, let me know.
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu butuh sesuatu dari hutan, bilang aja.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Semak_02_002
Array.english: I'll sneak in and grab it before anyone even notices.
Array.indonesia: Aku bakal menyelinap masuk dan mengambilnya sebelum ada yang sadar.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_LastSpirit_001
Array.english: Looks like I've rescued all 9 of the lost spirits.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya aku sudah menyelamatkan kesembilan arwah yang tersesat.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_LastSpirit_002
Array.english: Once I'm back up, I should stop by <color=#1DFEAF>Surga Falls</color>.
Array.indonesia: Begitu aku sudah pulih, aku harus mampir ke <color=#1DFEAF>Air Terjun Surga</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Undu_01_001
Array.english: Thanks for saving me from the lake.
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih sudah menyelamatkanku dari danau.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Undu_01_002
Array.english: It was way deeper than I expected, what a shock...\nI saw a dinosaur corpse down there.
Array.indonesia: Kedalamannya jauh lebih dalam dari yang kuduga, sungguh mengejutkan...\nAku melihat bangkai dinosaurus di sana.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Undu_02_001
Array.english: I'm 350 years old, but I'd never seen the creatures at the bottom of the lake before.
Array.indonesia: Umurku sudah 350 tahun, tapi aku belum pernah melihat makhluk-makhluk di dasar danau itu sebelumnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Undu_02_002
Array.english: There's still so much I don't know about the world.
Array.indonesia: Masih banyak hal yang belum kuketahui tentang dunia ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Wulan_01_001
Array.english: The lake was really scary...
Array.indonesia: Danau itu benar-benar menakutkan...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Wulan_01_002
Array.english: Thanks for saving me...\nIf you hadn't, I'd still be stuck in that clam.
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih sudah menyelamatkanku...\nKalau bukan karena kamu, aku pasti masih terjebak di dalam kerang itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Wulan_02_001
Array.english: I'm never going into the lake again.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak akan pernah masuk ke danau itu lagi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Wulan_02_002
Array.english: But here in the village, feel free to ask me for anything.
Array.indonesia: Tapi di desa ini, jangan ragu untuk meminta apa pun padaku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_ShopOpen_001
Array.english: Ah, come to think of it, I haven't told you about <color=#F1DC2B>Jelly</color> yet.
Array.indonesia: Ah, kalau dipikir-pikir, aku belum menceritakan tentang <color=#F1DC2B>Jelly</color> kepadamu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_ShopOpen_002
Array.english: Beetles absolutely love <color=#F1DC2B>Jelly</color>.
Array.indonesia: Kumbang sangat menyukai <color=#F1DC2B>Jelly</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_ShopOpen_003
Array.english: If you give <color=#F1DC2B>Insect jelly</color> to a fainted beetle, it'll recover in no time.
Array.indonesia: Jika kamu memberi <color=#F1DC2B>Jelly serangga</color> kepada kumbang yang pingsan, dia akan segera pulih.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_ShopOpen_004
Array.english: There's also <color=#F1DC2B>Jelly</color> you can use during battle.
Array.indonesia: Ada juga <color=#F1DC2B>Jelly</color> yang bisa kamu gunakan saat bertarung.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_ShopOpen_005
Array.english: Some power up your type... others boost your defense...
Array.indonesia: Ada yang meningkatkan kekuatan tipe kamu... ada pula yang meningkatkan pertahananmu...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_ShopOpen_006
Array.english: I've got some <color=#F1DC2B>Jelly</color> with me, so I'll share a few with you.
Array.indonesia: Aku bawa beberapa <color=#F1DC2B>Jelly</color>, jadi aku akan membagikan beberapa padamu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_ShopOpen_007
Array.english: Just let me know if you need more!
Array.indonesia: Beri tahu saja kalau kamu butuh lebih banyak!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_ShopOpen_008
Array.english: <size=32>...I'll give you a good price, hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>...Ikan memberimu harga yang bagus, hehe.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_End_015
Array.english: With that fierce predator gone, the <color=#F1DC2B>Bull Sharks</color> that were hiding may start roaming about.
Array.indonesia: Dengan hilangnya predator ganas itu, <color=#F1DC2B>Bull Sharks</color> yang bersembunyi mungkin mulai berkeliaran.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_End_016
Array.english: They're also active when the sun sets.\nThat's probably how that one got caught by Sulong.
Array.indonesia: Mereka juga aktif saat matahari terbenam.\nMungkin itulah sebabnya yang satu itu tertangkap oleh Sulong.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_End_017
Array.english: <size=32>Just in case, do be careful.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Untuk berjaga-jaga, harap berhati-hati.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_FastMove_001
Array.english: A boar attacked Rimbo's truck...
Array.indonesia: Seekor babi hutan menyerang truk Rimbo...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_FastMove_002
Array.english: Better not call the truck into the forest for now.
Array.indonesia: Sebaiknya jangan bawa truk ke dalam hutan untuk saat ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_FindFootPrint_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh! Are these boar tracks...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh! Apakah ini jejak babi hutan...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_FindFootPrint_002
Array.english: If we follow the tracks...\nwe might find the boar!
Array.indonesia: Kalau kita ikuti jejaknya...\nmungkin kita bisa menemukan babi hutan itu!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_FindFootPrint_003
Array.english: You'd best be well prepared before you head in...
Array.indonesia: Sebaiknya kamu bersiap-siap dengan baik sebelum masuk ke sana...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_GetTusk_001
Array.english: That <color=#1DFEAF>Tusk</color> is enormous...!
Array.indonesia: <color=#1DFEAF>Taring</color> itu sangat besar...!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_GetTusk_002
Array.english: I can't believe it was attacking us with this...
Array.indonesia: Aku nggak percaya dia menyerang kita dengan ini...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_GetTusk_003
Array.english: <size=33>Let's go see Rimbo now!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ayo kita temui Rimbo sekarang!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_GetTusk_Barricade_001
Array.english: Oh, why don't we take that broken <color=#1DFEAF>Tusk</color> with us?
Array.indonesia: Oh, kenapa kita tidak membawa <color=#1DFEAF>Tusk</color> yang patah itu bersama kita?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Meet_001
Array.english: <size=33>Aah...! It's that boar that chased us at the temple...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aah...! Itu babi hutan yang mengejar kita di kuil...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Meet_002
Array.english: <size=33>It looks really, really angry...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kelihatannya sangat, sangat marah...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Meet_003
Array.english: <size=32>We'd better calm it down before it does any more damage to the village...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Sebaiknya kita menenangkannya sebelum ia menimbulkan kerusakan lebih lanjut di desa...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Meet_004
Array.english: <size=34>Stay focused, everyone!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Tetap fokus, semuanya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Morning_001
Array.english: Hm? Rimbo, what's the matter?
Array.indonesia: Hm? Rimbo, ada apa?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Morning_002
Array.english: Well... ya remember that boar that fell off the cliff, don'tcha?
Array.indonesia: Nah... kamu ingat babi hutan yang jatuh dari tebing itu, kan?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Morning_003
Array.english: Looks like that fella's still alive and kickin'.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya makhluk itu masih hidup dan sehat-sehat saja.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Morning_004
Array.english: <size=32>Come on over here for a sec.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ayo ke sini sebentar.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_NightNoise_001
Array.english: <size=34>Huh? I thought I heard a loud noise...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hah? Aku kira aku mendengar suara keras...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_NightNoise_002
Array.english: <size=32>Was it just a dream...? I should get back to sleep...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Apa itu cuma mimpi...? Mending aku tidur lagi...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Retry_001
Array.english: <size=34>It's that giant boar...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Itu babi hutan raksasa itu...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Retry_002
Array.english: <size=32>This time, we'll send it back home for good!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kali ini, kita akan mengembalikannya ke rumahnya selamanya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Retry_003
Array.english: <size=32>Watch out for its charge attacks!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hati-hati dengan serangan serbuannya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_RimboTalk02_001
Array.english: <size=32>Here ya go.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ini dia.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_RimboTalk02_002
Array.english: Oh... it looks great...!
Array.indonesia: Oh... kelihatannya keren...!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_RimboTalk02_003
Array.english: <size=33>I'll hang it up in front of my house as a keepsake!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku akan menggantungnya di depan rumahku sebagai kenang-kenangan!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_RimboTalk_001
Array.english: We took down the giant boar in Setah Forest.\nIt won't be coming down to the forest anymore.
Array.indonesia: Kita berhasil mengalahkan babi hutan raksasa di Hutan Setah.\nDia tidak akan turun ke hutan lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_RimboTalk_002
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... mighty fine work!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... kerja yang luar biasa!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_RimboTalk_003
Array.english: <size=33>I got the truck all fixed up in the meantime, too.\nJust give me a holler whenever ya need a ride through the forest!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku juga sudah memperbaiki truknya.\nKalo butuh tumpangan buat melintasi hutan, panggil aja aku!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_RimboTalk_004
Array.english: Oh, right! I brought back the boar's <color=#1DFEAF>Tusk</color>.\nNot sure what to do with it, though.
Array.indonesia: Oh, iya! Aku bawa pulang <color=#1DFEAF>taring</color> babi hutan itu.\nTapi aku nggak tahu harus ngapain sama taringnya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_RimboTalk_005
Array.english: My, that's a big one!\nSomethin' this size'd look better hangin' outside the house than in.
Array.indonesia: Wah, itu besar sekali!\nBenda sebesar ini kayaknya lebih cocok digantung di luar rumah daripada di dalam.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_RimboTalk_006
Array.english: Lemme fix it up for ya real nice, haha.
Array.indonesia: Biar aku perbaiki buat kamu dengan rapi, haha.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Start_001
Array.english: <size=33>Take a look at this here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Lihat ini.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Start_002
Array.english: <size=32>The headlights are completely wrecked!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Lampu depannya hancur total!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Start_003
Array.english: Somethin' came and rammed into it durin' the night...\nJudgin' by the marks, looks like boar tusks to me.
Array.indonesia: Ada sesuatu yang menabraknya semalam...\nDilihat dari bekasnya, menurutku itu taring babi hutan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Start_004
Array.english: The truck I can fix up later...\nBut with that boar all riled up, drivin' through <color=#1DFEAF>Setah Forest</color> ain't gonna be easy.
Array.indonesia: Truknya bisa aku perbaiki nanti...\nTapi dengan babi hutan yang sedang marah itu, berkendara melintasi <color=#1DFEAF>Hutan Setah</color> pasti nggak akan mudah.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Start_005
Array.english: If I take this truck in there, that thing's sure to ram it again.
Array.indonesia: Kalau aku bawa truk ini ke sana, binatang itu pasti akan menabraknya lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Start_006
Array.english: Yeah, probably...
Array.indonesia: Ya, mungkin saja...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Start_007
Array.english: And it might come back to attack the village again, too.
Array.indonesia: Dan mungkin saja dia akan kembali untuk menyerang desa lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Start_008
Array.english: I'll head into <color=#1DFEAF>Setah Forest</color> with Cobra and Muna and check things out.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan pergi ke <color=#1DFEAF>Hutan Setah</color> bersama Cobra dan Muna untuk memeriksa situasinya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Start_009
Array.english: <size=32>If that boar comes at us, we'll teach it a lesson and send it right back home!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kalau babi hutan itu menyerang kita, kita bakal kasih pelajaran dan kirim balik ke rumahnya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Start_010
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... that's mighty reassurin'. \nMuch obliged if ya could!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... itu benar-benar menenangkan. \nTerima kasih banyak kalau bisa!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Start_011
Array.english: I'm countin' on ya, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Aku andalkan kamu, Dave.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Start_012
Array.english: Oh, and unlike the forest trail, the path to the <color=#F1DC2B>beach</color> is safe. Just say the word if ya need it!
Array.indonesia: Oh, dan tidak seperti jalan setapak di hutan, jalan menuju <color=#F1DC2B>pantai</color> itu aman. Cukup bilang saja kalau kalian membutuhkannya!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Win_001
Array.english: Phew... I think we sent it back home safely...
Array.indonesia: Wah... sepertinya kita sudah mengembalikannya ke rumah dengan selamat...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Win_002
Array.english: It probably won't come down to the forest anymore.
Array.indonesia: Mungkin babi hutan itu tidak akan turun ke hutan lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Win_003
Array.english: Now we can get around in Rimbo's truck again!
Array.indonesia: Sekarang kita bisa berkeliling lagi dengan truk Rimbo!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Win_004
Array.english: Oh, there's a <color=#1DFEAF>Tusk</color> on the ground. It must've broken off during the fight.
Array.indonesia: Oh, ada <color=#1DFEAF>Tusk</color> di tanah. Pasti patah saat pertarungan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Win_005
Array.english: <size=33>I'll take it as a souvenir, hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku akan ambil itu sebagai suvenir, hehe.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Complete_001
Array.english: Oh... do I feel somehow lighter?
Array.indonesia: Oh... apa aku merasa sedikit lebih ringan?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Complete_002
Array.english: Now you can carry one more <color=#F1DC2B>charm</color> with you.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang kamu bisa membawa satu <color=#F1DC2B>jimat</color> lagi bersamamu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Complete_003
Array.english: <size=32>Whoa... so that's what spirit powers can do...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wah... jadi begitulah kekuatan roh bisa berbuat...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=34>Thank you so much!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Terima kasih banyak!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Complete_005
Array.english: Heh heh... using our powers for things like this is what makes them worthwhile.
Array.indonesia: Heh heh... menggunakan kekuatan kita untuk hal-hal seperti ini lah yang membuatnya berharga.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Complete_006
Array.english: Well then, we'll be right here. Come visit anytime.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah, kami akan tetap di sini. Silakan mampir kapan saja.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Complete_007
Array.english: Once again, thank you for saving our village, human.
Array.indonesia: Sekali lagi, terima kasih telah menyelamatkan desa kami, manusia.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Complete_008
Array.english: <size=32>Wherever you go, never lose that warm heart of yours.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ke mana pun kamu pergi, jangan pernah kehilangan hati hangatmu itu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindAllSpirits_001
Array.english: Thanks to you, all the Surs made it back to the village safely.
Array.indonesia: Berkat kamu, semua Surs berhasil kembali ke desa dengan selamat.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindAllSpirits_002
Array.english: As I told you...\nwe Surs have long watched over this region.
Array.indonesia: Seperti yang sudah kukatakan...\nkami, para Surs, telah lama menjaga wilayah ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindAllSpirits_003
Array.english: So that this land stays bountiful...
Array.indonesia: Agar tanah ini tetap subur...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindAllSpirits_004
Array.english: and the people of Utara Village stay healthy...
Array.indonesia: dan penduduk Desa Utara tetap sehat...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindAllSpirits_005
Array.english: we'll keep watching over you and helping from behind the scenes.
Array.indonesia: kami akan terus menjagamu dan membantu dari balik layar.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindAllSpirits_006
Array.english: So don't worry too much, whenever you may leave.
Array.indonesia: Jadi jangan terlalu khawatir, kapan pun kamu pergi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindAllSpirits_007
Array.english: Knowing the spirits are protecting them puts my mind at ease too.
Array.indonesia: Mengetahui bahwa roh-roh melindungi mereka juga membuatku tenang.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindAllSpirits_008
Array.english: They're truly wonderful people.\nPlease keep looking after them.
Array.indonesia: Mereka benar-benar orang-orang yang luar biasa.\nTolong terus jaga mereka.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindAllSpirits_009
Array.english: Heh. You truly are a human worthy of the villagers' deep trust.
Array.indonesia: Heh. Kamu benar-benar manusia yang layak mendapatkan kepercayaan mendalam dari para penduduk desa.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindAllSpirits_010
Array.english: But... accepting such great help and doing nothing in return? That is not our tradition.
Array.indonesia: Tapi... menerima bantuan sebesar ini tanpa membalas apa pun? Itu bukan tradisi kami.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindAllSpirits_011
Array.english: We'd like to combine our powers and awaken a new ability in you.
Array.indonesia: Kami ingin menggabungkan kekuatan kami dan membangkitkan kemampuan baru dalam dirimu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindAllSpirits_012
Array.english: <size=33>Come over here for a moment.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ayo kemari sebentar.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindBasarr_001
Array.english: Ohh... how did you know I was here, human?
Array.indonesia: Ohh... bagaimana kamu tahu aku ada di sini, manusia?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindBasarr_002
Array.english: I smelled a saltwater crocodile and came looking, but then I got lost...
Array.indonesia: Aku mencium bau buaya air asin dan datang mencari, tapi kemudian aku tersesat...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindBasarr_003
Array.english: And now the crocodile's gone too...\nI want to go home...
Array.indonesia: Dan sekarang buayanya juga sudah pergi...\nAku ingin pulang...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindDanu_001
Array.english: Did you see the black crocodile that was around here?
Array.indonesia: Apakah kamu melihat buaya hitam yang tadi ada di sekitar sini?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindDanu_002
Array.english: It looked scarier than I expected, so I was hiding...\nHelp me get out of here!
Array.indonesia: Dia terlihat lebih menakutkan dari yang kuduga, jadi aku bersembunyi...\nTolong bantu aku keluar dari sini!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindKarang_001
Array.english: Whoa... so that's the Sea People's chief...!
Array.indonesia: Wah... jadi itu pemimpin Suku Laut...!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindKarang_002
Array.english: It's huge...!
Array.indonesia: Dia sangat besar...!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindKarang_003
Array.english: Oh, everyone's waiting up top?\nGot it... I should head up soon.
Array.indonesia: Oh, semua orang sedang menunggu di atas?\nOke... Aku sebaiknya segera naik ke atas.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindMahesa_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hm? Did you come looking for me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hm? Apa kamu datang mencariku?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindMahesa_002
Array.english: I was just playing, riding the currents like a slide...
Array.indonesia: Aku cuma main-main, menunggangi arus seperti seluncuran...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindMahesa_003
Array.english: Oh, I'll head back now, so not a word to Elder Marula!
Array.indonesia: Oh, aku akan kembali sekarang, jadi jangan bilang apa-apa ke Tetua Marula!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindMutu_001
Array.english: I was looking around for something to eat and got lost...
Array.indonesia: Aku sedang mencari-cari sesuatu untuk dimakan dan tersesat...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindMutu_002
Array.english: I don't really know where the others went.
Array.indonesia: Aku nggak tahu ke mana yang lain pergi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindMutu_003
Array.english: I'm hungry now, so I'm heading back to the village!
Array.indonesia: Aku lapar sekarang, jadi aku balik ke desa!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSegera_001
Array.english: Hmm... it should be right around here...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... seharusnya ada di sekitar sini...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSegera_002
Array.english: What are you looking for?
Array.indonesia: Apa yang kamu cari?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSegera_003
Array.english: I heard there's a shark with an anvil on its back...\nWhy isn't it here...?
Array.indonesia: Aku dengar ada hiu dengan landasan tempa di punggungnya...\nKenapa dia nggak ada di sini...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSegera_004
Array.english: Umm... about that, actually, I...
Array.indonesia: Umm... soal itu, sebenarnya, aku...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSegera_005
Array.english: ...Anyway, your friends are waiting in the village. Let's head back together.
Array.indonesia: ...Pokoknya, teman-temanmu sedang menunggumu di desa. Ayo kita pulang bersama.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSegera_006
Array.english: ...Okay.
Array.indonesia: ...Oke.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSemak_001
Array.english: Hah...! I've been spotted...!
Array.indonesia: Hah...! Aku ketahuan...!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSemak_002
Array.english: Fine, I admit defeat.\nI'll return to the village!
Array.indonesia: Baiklah, aku menyerah.\nAku akan kembali ke desa!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_001
Array.english: <size=35>...Human, you can see me!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>...Human, kamu bisa melihatku!?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_002
Array.english: Yes... it seems so.\nI can even hear you talk...!
Array.indonesia: Ya... sepertinya begitu.\nAku bahkan bisa mendengar suaramu...!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_003
Array.english: That necklace...\nI see. Those who could speak with us always wore that.
Array.indonesia: Kalung itu...\nAku mengerti. Mereka yang bisa berbicara dengan kita selalu mengenakan itu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_004
Array.english: So, what brings you here all of a sudden...?
Array.indonesia: Jadi, apa yang membawamu ke sini tiba-tiba...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_005
Array.english: Grandma Meilan from the village said the spirits' power has weakened, and asked me to come take a look.
Array.indonesia: Nenek Meilan dari desa bilang kekuatan roh-roh telah melemah, dan memintaku untuk datang melihat-lihat.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_006
Array.english: Did something happen...?
Array.indonesia: Apakah terjadi sesuatu...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_007
Array.english: Ah... so it's about that...\nWe heard Utara Lake was not doing well...
Array.indonesia: Ah... jadi tentang itu...\nKami dengar Danau Utara sedang dalam kondisi tidak baik...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_008
Array.english: A few of our own went to check on the lake.
Array.indonesia: Beberapa orang dari kami pergi memeriksa danau itu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_009
Array.english: But when they didn't come back...\nothers went looking for them... and then more went looking...
Array.indonesia: Tapi ketika mereka tidak kembali... \nyang lain pergi mencari mereka... lalu semakin banyak yang ikut mencari...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_010
Array.english: <size=33>In the end, <color=#1DFEAF>9</color> of us went missing!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Akhirnya, <color=#1DFEAF>9</color> dari kami hilang!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_011
Array.english: <size=34>...That's quite a lot.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>...Thatu jumlah yang cukup banyak.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_012
Array.english: We cannot send any more of our Surs.
Array.indonesia: Kami tidak bisa mengirimkan Surs kami lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_013
Array.english: Come to think of it...\nI believe I've seen you going into the lake...
Array.indonesia: Kalau dipikir-pikir...\nSepertinya aku pernah melihatmu masuk ke danau...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_014
Array.english: <size=33>Would you be willing to rescue our Surs?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Apakah kamu bersedia menyelamatkan Surs kami?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_015
Array.english: <size=33>Huh...? Where would I even find the spirits...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hah...? Di mana aku bisa menemukan roh-roh itu...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_016
Array.english: I've spent at least 200 years with them.\nI have a rough idea of where they'd be.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah menghabiskan setidaknya 200 tahun bersama mereka.\nAku punya gambaran kasar di mana mereka berada.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_017
Array.english: I'll write down the places that come to mind, so go take a look.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan mencatat tempat-tempat yang terlintas di benakku, jadi silakan periksa.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_018
Array.english: Hmm... so there are <color=#F1DC2B>spirits</color> in the lake, right?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... jadi ada <color=#F1DC2B>roh</color> di danau itu, kan?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_019
Array.english: That's right. And I won't ask you to do it for nothing.
Array.indonesia: Benar. Dan aku tidak akan meminta kamu melakukannya tanpa imbalan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_020
Array.english: In return for finding our Surs, the Surs who remain here will bring you ingredients and minerals.
Array.indonesia: Sebagai imbalan karena telah menemukan Surs kami, para Surs yang masih tinggal di sini akan membawakanmu bahan-bahan dan mineral.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_021
Array.english: The spirits will bring me ingredients?
Array.indonesia: Roh-roh itu akan membawakan bahan-bahan untukku?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_023
Array.english: That's right. We're asking a great deal of you, so we ought to do something in return.
Array.indonesia: Benar. Kami meminta banyak hal darimu, jadi kami harus memberikan imbalan.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_024
Array.english: If you're willing to go that far...\nthen I can't just sit back either.
Array.indonesia: Jika kalian bersedia melangkah sejauh itu...\nmaka aku juga tidak bisa hanya duduk diam.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_025
Array.english: <size=32>Alright. I'll go take a look around.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Baiklah. Aku akan pergi melihat-lihat.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindUndu_001
Array.english: This lake was way deeper than I thought...
Array.indonesia: Danau ini jauh lebih dalam dari yang kubayangkan...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindUndu_002
Array.english: I didn't know how to get back up. Perfect timing!
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak tahu cara naik kembali. Waktunya pas sekali!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindUndu_003
Array.english: <size=33>Lead the way, human!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tunjukkan jalannya, manusia!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindWulan_001
Array.english: <size=33>Waaah... somebody save me...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Waaah... tolong selamatkan aku...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindWulan_002
Array.english: <size=32>Huh...? A human...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hah...? Seorang manusia...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindWulan_003
Array.english: Wulan... right? Your friends are waiting in the village. Let's go together.
Array.indonesia: Wulan... kan? Teman-temanmu sedang menunggumu di desa. Ayo kita pergi bersama.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindWulan_004
Array.english: <size=33>Whaa...? How can a human speak our language...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Whaa...? Kok manusia bisa bicara bahasa kita...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindWulan_005
Array.english: ...I-I'll come with you, just save me...!
Array.indonesia: ...A-aku akan ikut denganmu, tolong selamatkan aku...!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Start_001
Array.english: Do you have a moment to talk...?
Array.indonesia: Apa kamu punya waktu sebentar untuk bicara...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Start_002
Array.english: Ah, yes, Chief. We just closed up for the day, so now's fine.\nWhat can I do for you?
Array.indonesia: Ah, ya, Kepala Desa. Kami baru saja tutup untuk hari ini, jadi sekarang tidak masalah.\nAda yang bisa kubantu?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Start_003
Array.english: Do you remember what this old man once told you about the <color=#F1DC2B>spirits</color>...?
Array.indonesia: Apa kamu ingat apa yang pernah dikatakan orang tua ini kepadamu tentang <color=#F1DC2B>roh-roh</color>...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Start_004
Array.english: Yes. You said there are <color=#F1DC2B>spirits</color> protecting this village.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Kamu bilang ada <color=#F1DC2B>roh-roh</color> yang melindungi desa ini.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Start_005
Array.english: That's right... I could always feel their energy watching over this village, but...
Array.indonesia: Benar... Saya selalu bisa merasakan energi mereka yang menjaga desa ini, tapi...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Start_006
Array.english: Lately, the energy of the <color=#F1DC2B>spirits</color> has grown much weaker.
Array.indonesia: Belakangan ini, energi <color=#F1DC2B>roh-roh</color> itu semakin melemah.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Start_007
Array.english: I'd love to go see what's happening myself, but...\nas you can see, this old woman's eyes aren't what they used to be.
Array.indonesia: Saya ingin sekali pergi melihat sendiri apa yang terjadi, tapi...\nseperti yang Kamu lihat, penglihatan wanita tua ini sudah tidak sebaik dulu lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Start_008
Array.english: <size=33>...You can actually see them?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...You, apakah kamu benar-benar bisa melihat mereka?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Start_009
Array.english: Only those who have earned the village's deep trust can see them.\nRight now, that's only Meilan...
Array.indonesia: Hanya mereka yang telah mendapatkan kepercayaan mendalam dari desa ini yang bisa melihat mereka.\nSaat ini, hanya Meilan yang bisa...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Start_010
Array.english: <size=32>You can't... see them, Chief?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kamu tidak bisa... melihat mereka, Kepala Desa?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Start_011
Array.english: ...Well... it seems that Uzme fellow doesn't quite trust me enough...
Array.indonesia: ...Yah... sepertinya si Uzme itu belum cukup mempercayai saya...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Start_012
Array.english: <size=34>...I see.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>...I melihatnya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Start_013
Array.english: It's weaker than before, but...\nI can still feel the spirits' energy at <color=#1DFEAF>Surga Falls</color>.
Array.indonesia: Kekuatannya memang lebih lemah dari sebelumnya, tapi...\nsaya masih bisa merasakan energi roh-roh di <color=#1DFEAF>Air Terjun Surga</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Start_014
Array.english: If you wear this <color=#F1DC2B>Spirit Necklace</color>, you'll be able to see the spirits.
Array.indonesia: Jika kamu memakai <color=#F1DC2B>Kalung Roh</color> ini, kamu akan bisa melihat roh-roh itu.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Start_015
Array.english: Hmm... <color=#F1DC2B>spirits</color>, huh...\nAlright. I'll go take a look.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... <color=#F1DC2B>roh</color>, ya...\nBaiklah. Aku akan pergi melihat-lihat.

Array.name: Homi_desc

Array.indonesia: Pepaya hijau yang belum sepenuhnya matang. Teksturnya renyah dan rasanya manis-asam.

Array.name: BambooShoot_desc
Array.english: A young bamboo shoot with a clean, subtle flavor.

Array.name: Bamboo_desc
Array.english: A large herbaceous plant with hollow, segmented stems. Flexible and sturdy, it's used for crafts and construction.

Array.name: WildTomato_desc
Array.english: A bright red wild-grown tomato with an exquisite sweet-and-sour flavor.
Array.indonesia: Tomat liar berwarna merah cerah dengan rasa manis-asam yang istimewa.

Array.name: Pineapple_desc
Array.english: A fruit that resembles a pinecone. Some people even put it on pizza.
Array.indonesia: Buah yang menyerupai buah pinus. Beberapa orang bahkan menaruhnya di atas pizza.

Array.name: KingTrumpetMushroom_desc
Array.english: A mushroom with a mild aroma and a chewy texture.
Array.indonesia: Jamur dengan aroma yang lembut dan tekstur yang kenyal.

Array.name: Taro_desc
Array.english: A root vegetable with a texture similar to sweet potato with a slight sweetness. When cooked, it releases a slippery mucus.
Array.indonesia: Sayuran umbi dengan tekstur mirip ubi jalar dan rasa sedikit manis. Saat dimasak, sayuran ini mengeluarkan lendir yang licin.

Array.name: Cassava_desc
Array.english: A bush-grown plant whose texture changes significantly depending on how it's cooked. It's used to make tapioca pearls.
Array.indonesia: Tanaman semak yang teksturnya berubah secara signifikan tergantung cara memasaknya. Digunakan untuk membuat mutiara tapioka.

Array.name: WaterSpinach_desc
Array.english: Its hollow stems give it a crisp texture, and it grows in clusters near water or in damp soil.
Array.indonesia: Batangnya yang berongga memberikan tekstur renyah, dan tumbuh berkelompok di dekat air atau di tanah lembap.

Array.name: Loot_CapirlimeLeaf_desc
Array.english: Known for its fresh, exotic aroma, it's often used to add flavor to dishes.
Array.indonesia: Terkenal karena aromanya yang segar dan eksotis, sering digunakan untuk menambah cita rasa pada hidangan.

Array.name: Loot_Shallot_desc
Array.english: Similar to onions, but milder and slightly sweeter.
Array.indonesia: Mirip dengan bawang, tetapi rasanya lebih lembut dan sedikit lebih manis.

Array.name: Banana_desc
Array.english: Soft white flesh inside a yellow peel. Delicious.
Array.indonesia: Daging buahnya putih dan lembut di dalam kulit kuning. Lezat.

Array.name: BananaBlossom_desc
Array.english: It has a reddish-purple outer skin and pale yellow inner petals.
Array.indonesia: Memiliki kulit luar berwarna merah keunguan dan kelopak bagian dalam berwarna kuning pucat.

Array.name: BananaLeaf_desc
Array.english: A green banana leaf. A versatile ingredient used for both cooking and decoration.
Array.indonesia: Daun pisang hijau. Bahan serbaguna yang digunakan baik untuk memasak maupun hiasan.

Array.name: Calamansi_desc
Array.english: A fruit with a sharp, tangy flavor, often used in sauces and dressings.
Array.indonesia: Buah dengan rasa tajam dan asam, sering digunakan dalam saus dan bumbu salad.

Array.name: Mangosteen_desc
Array.english: Its flesh, shaped like garlic cloves, is as soft and moist as ice cream.
Array.indonesia: Daging buahnya, berbentuk seperti siung bawang putih, selembut dan selembab es krim.

Array.name: Starfruit_desc
Array.english: A fruit with a star-shaped cross-section. Very sour when unripe, but sweet when fully ripe.
Array.indonesia: Buah dengan penampang berbentuk bintang. Sangat asam saat masih mentah, tetapi manis saat sudah matang sepenuhnya.

Array.name: Watermelon_desc
Array.english: Green on the outside with red flesh inside. Refreshing and sweet with every bite.
Array.indonesia: Berwarna hijau di bagian luar dengan daging buah berwarna merah di bagian dalam. Menyegarkan dan manis di setiap gigitan.

Array.name: HoneydewMelon_desc
Array.english: A vine-grown melon found in warm regions, with smooth skin and juicy flesh.
Array.indonesia: Melon yang tumbuh merambat di daerah beriklim hangat, dengan kulit halus dan daging buah yang berair.

Array.name: DragonFruit_desc
Array.english: The fruit of a tropical cactus that climbs other trees, with flesh filled with tiny seeds.
Array.indonesia: Buah dari kaktus tropis yang merambat di pohon lain, dengan daging buah yang dipenuhi biji-biji kecil.

Array.name: Durian_desc
Array.english: A tropical rainforest fruit known for its thorny skin and strong, polarizing scent.
Array.indonesia: Buah hutan hujan tropis yang terkenal karena kulitnya yang berduri dan aromanya yang kuat serta kontroversial.

Array.name: Pineapple_Colored_desc

Array.indonesia: Nanas mutan berkulit merah, dengan rasa manis namun pedas.

Array.indonesia: Semangka mutan berkulit keemasan, yang terkenal karena rasa manisnya yang luar biasa.

Array.indonesia: Melon honeydew mutan berkulit merah muda, yang terkenal karena aromanya yang lembut seperti mawar.

Array.indonesia: Buah naga mutan berkulit ungu, dengan rasa tajam dan bersoda seperti minuman bersoda.

Array.indonesia: Durian mutan berkulit merah muda pucat. Aromanya... tidak berubah.

Array.name: CommonAlbatross_desc
