Array.name: Furniture_Bed_Desc
Array.english: An old bed that came with the house. Still perfectly fine to sleep on.
Array.indonesia: Tempat tidur tua yang sudah ada di rumah ini. Masih sangat nyaman untuk tidur.

Array.name: Furniture_Bed_Bamboo_Desc
Array.english: A bed made of bamboo. It's firm but stable.
Array.indonesia: Tempat tidur yang terbuat dari bambu. Kokoh namun stabil.

Array.name: Furniture_Bed_Timber_Desc
Array.english: A bed made of woven rattan. It's lightweight and well-ventilated.\nIts natural texture gives the room a cozy feel.
Array.indonesia: Tempat tidur yang terbuat dari anyaman rotan. Ringan dan memiliki sirkulasi udara yang baik.\nTekstur alaminya memberikan nuansa nyaman pada ruangan.

Array.name: Furniture_Bed_MahoganyTimber_Desc
Array.english: A bed made of mahogany wood, known for its sturdy build and deep color.\nIt adds a rich, stable atmosphere to the room.
Array.indonesia: Tempat tidur yang terbuat dari kayu mahoni, yang terkenal karena konstruksinya yang kokoh dan warnanya yang pekat.\nTempat tidur ini menambah suasana yang mewah dan tenang di dalam ruangan.

Array.name: Furniture_Bed_TeakTimber_Desc
Array.english: A bed made of teak wood, known for its resistance to moisture and wear.\nIts natural tone and texture create a calm, stable atmosphere.
Array.indonesia: Tempat tidur yang terbuat dari kayu jati, yang terkenal karena ketahanannya terhadap kelembapan dan keausan.\nWarna dan tekstur alaminya menciptakan suasana yang tenang dan stabil.

Array.name: Furniture_Closet_Desc
Array.english: An old wooden wardrobe. The door doesn't close properly,\nbut at least there's no mold.
Array.indonesia: Lemari pakaian kayu tua. Pintunya tidak menutup dengan rapat,\ntetapi setidaknya tidak ada jamur.

Array.name: Furniture_Closet_Bamboo_Desc
Array.english: A wardrobe woven from bamboo.\nIts see-through design gives it a light, airy feel.
Array.indonesia: Lemari pakaian yang anyaman dari bambu.\nDesainnya yang tembus pandang memberikan kesan ringan dan lapang.

Array.name: Furniture_Closet_Timber_Desc
Array.english: A wardrobe made of rattan.\nThe rounded top and smooth texture give it a refined look.
Array.indonesia: Lemari pakaian yang terbuat dari rotan.\nBagian atas yang membulat dan teksturnya yang halus memberikan tampilan yang elegan.

Array.name: Furniture_Closet_MahoganyTimber_Desc
Array.english: A wardrobe made of mahogany wood.\nIts deep color and solid texture create a luxurious feel.
Array.indonesia: Lemari pakaian dari kayu mahoni.\nWarna yang pekat dan teksturnya yang kokoh menciptakan kesan mewah.

Array.name: Furniture_Closet_TeakTimber_Desc
Array.english: A wardrobe made of teak wood.\nIts muted tone and ornate patterns give it an antique feel.
Array.indonesia: Lemari pakaian dari kayu jati.\nWarna yang lembut dan pola hiasannya memberikan kesan antik.

Array.name: Furniture_Table_Old_Desc
Array.english: An old chair and table set.\nWorn in places, but still usable.
Array.indonesia: Satu set kursi dan meja tua.\nAda bagian yang sudah aus, tetapi masih bisa digunakan.

Array.name: Furniture_Table_Bamboo_Desc
Array.english: A chair and table set made of bamboo.\nIts natural tones fit in just about anywhere.
Array.indonesia: Satu set kursi dan meja yang terbuat dari bambu.\nWarna alaminya cocok di hampir semua tempat.

Array.name: Furniture_Table_Timber_Desc
Array.english: A chair and table set made of rattan.\nSimple, clean design.
Array.indonesia: Satu set kursi dan meja yang terbuat dari rotan.\nDesainnya sederhana dan rapi.

Array.name: Furniture_Table_MahoganyTimber_Desc
Array.english: A chair and table set made of mahogany.\nThe carved patterns on the round table add a nice touch.
Array.indonesia: Satu set kursi dan meja yang terbuat dari kayu mahoni.\nPola ukiran pada meja bundar tersebut menambah sentuhan yang indah.

Array.name: Furniture_Table_TeakTimber_Desc
Array.english: A chair and table set made of teak wood.\nThe detailed carvings show true craftsmanship.
Array.indonesia: Satu set kursi dan meja yang terbuat dari kayu jati.\nUkiran yang detail menunjukkan keahlian pengerjaan yang sesungguhnya.

Array.name: Furniture_Old_Carpet_Desc
Array.english: An old, worn-out carpet.\nNot much to look at.
Array.indonesia: Sebuah karpet tua yang sudah usang.\nTidak terlalu menarik dipandang.

Array.name: Furniture_Vine_Carpet_Desc
Array.english: A carpet woven from vines.\nAll the thorns have been removed, so it's safe to lie on.
Array.indonesia: Sebuah karpet yang ditenun dari tanaman merambat.\nSemua duri telah dibuang, sehingga aman untuk berbaring di atasnya.

Array.name: Furniture_Fish_Carpet_Desc
Array.english: A fish-shaped carpet.\nAdds a casual vibe to any room.
Array.indonesia: Karpet berbentuk ikan.\nMenambahkan nuansa santai ke ruangan mana pun.

Array.name: Furniture_BigBlue_Carpet_Desc
Array.english: A large blue carpet.\nDetailed embroidery gives it a luxurious feel.
Array.indonesia: Karpet biru berukuran besar.\nSulaman yang detail memberikan kesan mewah.

Array.name: Furniture_BigRed_Carpet_Desc
Array.english: A large round carpet.\nDensely woven with the village's traditional patterns.
Array.indonesia: Karpet bundar berukuran besar.\nDitenun rapat dengan motif tradisional desa.

Array.name: Furniture_Chandra_Carpet_Desc
Array.english: A carpet woven by Chandra herself, featuring vibrant traditional patterns.
Array.indonesia: Sebuah karpet yang ditenun sendiri oleh Chandra, menampilkan pola tradisional yang cerah.

Array.name: Furniture_Flower_Vase_Desc
Array.english: A large pot filled with beautiful red flowers.
Array.indonesia: Sebuah pot besar berisi bunga-bunga merah yang indah.

Array.name: Furniture_Wall_Bookcase_Desc
Array.english: An old, worn-out cabinet.
Array.indonesia: Sebuah lemari tua yang sudah usang.

Array.name: Furniture_Trashbin_Desc
Array.english: A trash can that's been here a while.\nCleaned out inside.
Array.indonesia: Sebuah tempat sampah yang sudah lama ada di sini.\nBagian dalamnya sudah dibersihkan.

Array.name: Furniture_DaveDuffleBag_desc
Array.english: The duffel bag Dave brought on his trip.
Array.indonesia: Tas ransel yang dibawa Dave dalam perjalanannya.

Array.name: GameMachine_Desc
Array.english: An all-in-one gaming console with a built-in joystick for classic arcade games.
Array.indonesia: Konsol game all-in-one dengan joystick terintegrasi untuk permainan arcade klasik.

Array.name: LassiMortar_Desc
Array.english: A mortar and pestle from Lathi, used to grind and prepare herbs.
Array.indonesia: Lesung dan alu dari Lathi, digunakan untuk menggiling dan menyiapkan rempah-rempah.

Array.name: PonyTruck_Desc
Array.english: A die-cast model of a Pony pickup truck from Rimbo.
Array.indonesia: Model die-cast truk pikap Pony dari Rimbo.

Array.name: CatfishModel_Desc
Array.english: A taxidermy Redtail Catfish model from Basu.
Array.indonesia: Model ikan lele ekor merah yang diawetkan dari Basu.

Array.name: BunnyPlush_Desc
Array.english: A rabbit plush Saniah cherished and gifted to you.
Array.indonesia: Boneka kelinci yang sangat disayangi Saniah dan diberikan kepadamu.

Array.name: ClayBasilo_Desc
Array.english: A Basilosaurus clay figure made by Eka.
Array.indonesia: Patung tanah liat Basilosaurus buatan Eka.

Array.name: OldPanting_Desc
Array.english: An instrument Jaka used to play. Still sounds pretty good.
Array.indonesia: Alat musik yang dulu dimainkan Jaka. Suaranya masih cukup bagus.

Array.name: BookShelf_Desc
Array.english: A bookshelf from Kinah, already stocked with a few books.
Array.indonesia: Rak buku dari Kinah, yang sudah diisi beberapa buku.

Array.name: MitaWallDeco_Desc
Array.english: A wall decoration identical to the one in Mita's kitchen.
Array.indonesia: Hiasan dinding yang identik dengan yang ada di dapur Mita.

Array.name: RobotSamuraiPicture_Desc
Array.english: A robot samurai drawing by Bima. He insists it'll be famous someday...
Array.indonesia: Gambar robot samurai karya Bima. Dia bersikeras bahwa suatu hari nanti gambar ini akan terkenal...

Array.name: ChiefHat_Desc
Array.english: Panutah's ceremonial headpiece from the bamboo festival, given as a sign of trust.
Array.indonesia: Hiasan kepala upacara milik Panutah dari festival bambu, diberikan sebagai tanda kepercayaan.

Array.name: YogaMat_Desc
Array.english: A yoga mat Bonita used. It still has faint indent marks.
Array.indonesia: Matras yoga yang pernah digunakan Bonita. Masih ada bekas lekukan samar di atasnya.

Array.name: GameOSTCD_Desc
Array.english: The ending song from <To The Moon> that moved Jaka.\nMight want a handkerchief before listening.
Array.indonesia: Lagu penutup dari <To The Moon> yang mengharukan Jaka.\nMungkin sebaiknya siapkan sapu tangan sebelum mendengarkannya.

Array.name: Menu_Tilapia_Calamansi_Steamed_Desc
Array.english: A steamed tilapia dish with calamansi and lemongrass. The citrusy aroma and flavor of calamansi help cut the muddy taste of freshwater fish.
Array.indonesia: Hidangan ikan nila kukus dengan calamansi dan serai. Aroma dan rasa jeruk dari calamansi membantu menghilangkan rasa lumpur pada ikan air tawar.

Array.name: Menu_Tropical_Fish_Steamed_Desc
Array.english: A coconut milk-steamed dish with Brown Discus, \nand Blue Discus. The vibrant colors make it as appetizing as it looks.
Array.indonesia: Hidangan kukus dengan santan yang berisi Ikan Discus Coklat, \ndan Ikan Discus Biru. Warna-warnanya yang cerah membuatnya terlihat sama menggugah selera seperti rasanya.

Array.name: Menu_BlackCaiman_Taco_Desc
Array.english: A taco made with grilled Black Caiman meat. Surprisingly tender, with an even more surprising flavor.
Array.indonesia: Taco yang dibuat dari daging Buaya Hitam panggang. Teksturnya sangat empuk, dengan rasa yang bahkan lebih mengejutkan.

Array.name: Menu_Clarias_Fried_Desc
Array.english: A whole walking catfish deep-fried and served with sambal sauce and cilantro. Crispy outside, moist inside.
Array.indonesia: Ikan lele berjalan utuh yang digoreng renyah dan disajikan dengan saus sambal serta daun ketumbar. Bagian luarnya renyah, bagian dalamnya lembut.

Array.name: Menu_Gourami_Fried_Desc
Array.english: A fried trio of kissing gourami, chocolate gourami, and pearl gourami served with sambal sauce. Each offers a slightly different texture.
Array.indonesia: Trio ikan goreng yang terdiri dari kissing gourami, chocolate gourami, dan pearl gourami, disajikan dengan saus sambal. Masing-masing menawarkan tekstur yang sedikit berbeda.

Array.name: Menu_LargeMouthBass_Boiled_Desc
Array.english: A clay pot dish of largemouth bass simmered with fish sauce. The lightly caramelized fish has a rich, sweet flavor.
Array.indonesia: Hidangan dalam panci tanah liat berupa ikan bass mulut besar yang direbus perlahan dengan kecap ikan. Ikan yang sedikit karamel ini memiliki rasa yang kaya dan manis.

Array.name: Menu_Pirarucu_Banana_Lasagna_Desc
Array.english: A lasagna-style dish layered with fried banana slices and pirarucu meat. Sweet and savory flavors come together for a satisfying bite.
Array.indonesia: Hidangan bergaya lasagna yang berlapis-lapis dengan irisan pisang goreng dan daging pirarucu. Perpaduan rasa manis dan gurih menghadirkan sensasi yang memuaskan di setiap gigitan.

Array.name: Menu_LemonYellowLab_Banana_Fried_Desc
Array.english: An assorted fry of Banana Cichlid, bananas, and banana blossoms. A bright yellow dish that lifts your mood.
Array.indonesia: Campuran gorengan berupa ikan cichlid pisang, pisang, dan bunga pisang. Hidangan berwarna kuning cerah yang mengangkat suasana hati.

Array.name: Menu_AsianArowana_Steak_Desc
Array.english: Asian Arowana cut into steaks, marinated in tamarind, and grilled. Topped with fried shallots for added texture.
Array.indonesia: Ikan Arowana Asia yang dipotong menjadi steak, direndam dalam air asam jawa, dan dipanggang. Dihiasi dengan bawang merah goreng untuk menambah tekstur.

Array.name: Menu_Piranha_Head_Soup_Desc
Array.english: A spicy soup made with the heads of red-bellied and black piranhas. Looks intense, tastes great.
Array.indonesia: Sup pedas yang dibuat dari kepala ikan piranha perut merah dan piranha hitam. Tampilannya terlihat kuat, rasanya luar biasa.

Array.name: Menu_BambooShoot_Soup_Desc
Array.english: A soup made with bamboo shoots, egg and king oyster mushrooms. Clean, deep broth with a pleasantly smooth texture.
Array.indonesia: Sup yang terbuat dari rebung, telur, dan jamur tiram raja. Kaldu yang segar dan kaya rasa dengan tekstur yang lembut dan nikmat.

Array.name: Menu_KingTrumpetMushroom_Pepper_StirFried_Desc
Array.english: Thinly sliced king oyster mushrooms stir-fried with Thai chili. Spicy, sharp, and delightfully chewy.
Array.indonesia: Irisan tipis jamur tiram raja yang ditumis dengan cabai Thailand. Pedas, tajam, dan kenyal yang menggugah selera.

Array.name: Menu_Banana_HaloHalo_Desc
Array.english: A dessert made with bananas, pineapples, and mangosteens. Sweet and tangy flavors blend beautifully.
Array.indonesia: Hidangan penutup yang terbuat dari pisang, nanas, dan manggis. Rasa manis dan asam berpadu dengan indah.

Array.name: Menu_Bananablossom_Salad_Desc
Array.english: A salad of finely chopped banana flower with calamansi and cilantro. Soft texture balanced by bright, tangy flavors.
Array.indonesia: Salad bunga pisang yang dicincang halus dengan calamansi dan ketumbar. Teksturnya yang lembut diimbangi dengan rasa yang segar dan asam.

Array.name: Menu_Mudcarp_BananaLeaf_Grilled_Desc
Array.english: Mud carp stuffed with lemongrass and calamansi, then grilled. The aromatics help reduce the muddy taste.
Array.indonesia: Ikan lele lumpur yang diisi dengan serai dan calamansi, lalu dipanggang. Aroma rempah-rempah tersebut membantu mengurangi rasa lumpur.

Array.name: Menu_GrassCarp_BambooShoot_Steamed_Desc
Array.english: Grass carp steamed in fish sauce and topped with shredded bamboo shoots. Crisp and tender textures in harmony.
Array.indonesia: Ikan lele rumput yang dikukus dalam saus ikan dan diberi taburan rebung parut. Teksturnya yang renyah dan empuk berpadu secara harmonis.

Array.name: Menu_IndonesianTigerPerch_Sate_Desc
Array.english: A skewer dish made by grinding indonesian tiger perch into a paste, shaping it onto lemongrass, and grilling it. Fragrant and full of flavor.
Array.indonesia: Hidangan tusuk sate yang dibuat dengan menggiling ikan kumbang Indonesia hingga menjadi pasta, dibentuk di atas serai, lalu dipanggang. Harum dan kaya rasa.

Array.name: Menu_PiraibaCatfish_Tamarind_Soup_Desc
Array.english: A soup simmered with piraiba catfish, tamarind, and lemongrass. A bright, tangy dish.
Array.indonesia: Sup yang direbus dengan ikan lele piraiba, asam jawa, dan serai. Hidangan yang segar dan asam.

Array.name: Menu_ElectricEel_Sliced_Desc
Array.english: Sliced smoked electric eel and fire eel. Cilantro and calamansi enhance the rich umami.
Array.indonesia: Irisan belut listrik dan belut api yang diasap. Daun ketumbar dan calamansi memperkaya rasa umami yang kaya.

Array.name: Menu_GiantFreshWaterStingray_Barbecued_Desc
Array.english: Charcoal-grilled stingray topped with sambal sauce. The sauce seeps deep into the meat.
Array.indonesia: Ikan pari yang dipanggang dengan arang dan disiram saus sambal. Sausnya meresap dalam ke dalam daging.

Array.name: Menu_NilePerch_Chips_Fried_Desc
Array.english: Crispy fried Nile perch skin served with fish sauce and shallots. All about the crunch.
Array.indonesia: Kulit ikan nila yang digoreng renyah, disajikan dengan saus ikan dan bawang merah. Krenyesnya yang menggugah selera.

Array.name: Menu_ArmoredCatfish_Boiled_Desc
Array.english: Armored catfish steamed with coconut milk and Thai chili. Spicy and savory with tender meat.
Array.indonesia: Ikan lele bersisik yang dikukus dengan santan dan cabai Thailand. Pedas dan gurih dengan daging yang empuk.

Array.name: Menu_BullShark_BirdsEyeChili_StirFried_Desc
Array.english: Bull shark stir-fried with Thai chili. A bold, spicy dish with a powerful bite.
Array.indonesia: Hiu banteng yang ditumis dengan cabai Thailand. Hidangan berani dan pedas dengan rasa yang kuat.

Array.name: Menu_GiantSnakehead_Soup_Desc
Array.english: A whole snakehead fish simmered from head to tail. Also known as a health dish.
Array.indonesia: Ikan gabus utuh yang direbus dari kepala hingga ekor. Juga dikenal sebagai hidangan sehat.

Array.name: Menu_FiddleheadFern_Boiled_Desc
Array.english: Ostrich fern braised in coconut milk. Crunchy with a mild sweetness.
Array.indonesia: Pakis burung unta yang direbus dalam santan. Renyah dengan rasa manis yang lembut.

Array.name: Menu_WaterCashewnutDuck_Grilled_Desc
Array.english: Duck stuffed with stir-fried shallots, lemongrass, and water chestnuts, wrapped and grilled in an oven.
Array.indonesia: Bebek yang diisi dengan bawang merah tumis, serai, dan bengkuang, dibungkus, lalu dipanggang dalam oven.

Array.name: Menu_WaterCashewnutQuail_Boild_Desc
Array.english: Quail slowly simmered with shallots, minced water chestnuts, and fish sauce.
Array.indonesia: Burung puyuh yang direbus perlahan bersama bawang merah, bengkuang cincang, dan kecap ikan.

Array.name: Menu_WaterCashewnutVege_StirFried_Desc
Array.english: A stir-fried mix of sliced water chestnuts and vegetables. Known for its crisp texture.
Array.indonesia: Tumisan campuran irisan bengkuang dan sayuran. Terkenal karena teksturnya yang renyah.

Array.name: Menu_BlueGill_Steamed_Desc
Array.english: A fragrant steamed bluegill dish with herbs and aromatic vegetables.
Array.indonesia: Hidangan ikan bluegill kukus yang harum dengan rempah-rempah dan sayuran aromatik.

Array.name: Menu_StripedSnakehead_Fried_Desc
Array.english: A whole striped snakehead fried crispy, served with water spinach and bamboo shoots.
Array.indonesia: Ikan gabus bergaris utuh yang digoreng renyah, disajikan dengan kangkung dan rebung.

Array.name: Menu_Tambaqui_Grilled_Desc
Array.english: Lightly grilled tambaqui steak, highlighting its unique shape and color, served with tamarind sauce.
Array.indonesia: Steak tambaqui yang dipanggang ringan, menonjolkan bentuk dan warnanya yang unik, disajikan dengan saus asam jawa.

Array.name: Menu_MalayanMahseer_Boild_Desc
Array.english: A refreshing, spicy steamed Malayan Mahseer fish dish infused with lemongrass and chili.
Array.indonesia: Hidangan ikan Mahseer Melayu yang disajikan dengan cara dikukus, segar dan pedas, dengan aroma serai dan cabai.

Array.name: Menu_RedtailCatfish_Fried_Desc
Array.english: Fried redtail catfish tail and body tossed in sambal sauce.
Array.indonesia: Ekor dan tubuh ikan lele ekor merah yang digoreng, lalu dicampur dengan saus sambal.

Array.name: Menu_Ammonite_Salad_Desc
Array.english: A spicy ammonite salad served with blanched water spinach and sambal sauce.
Array.indonesia: Salad ammonite pedas yang disajikan bersama kangkung rebus dan saus sambal.

Array.name: Menu_Ophthalmosaurus_Grilled_Desc
Array.english: A grilled dish featuring a whole Ophthalmosaurus head roasted intact for a striking presentation.
Array.indonesia: Hidangan panggang yang menampilkan kepala Ophthalmosaurus utuh yang dipanggang utuh untuk penyajian yang mencolok.

Array.name: Menu_ClownFeatherback_Taro_Fried_Desc
Array.english: Crispy croquettes made with taro and clown meat, fried to perfection.
Array.indonesia: Kroket renyah yang terbuat dari talas dan daging ikan badut, digoreng hingga sempurna.

Array.name: Menu_GoliathTigerfish_Salad_Desc
Array.english: A fresh, aromatic salad with Goliath Tigerfish, herbs, and fish sauce.
Array.indonesia: Salad segar dan harum dengan ikan Goliath Tigerfish, rempah-rempah, dan saus ikan.

Array.name: Menu_KingSalmon_Steak_Desc
Array.english: Grilled sockeye salmon steak with rich red flesh, served with sambal sauce, calamansi, and shallots.
Array.indonesia: Steak salmon sockeye panggang dengan daging merah yang kaya rasa, disajikan dengan saus sambal, calamansi, dan bawang merah.

Array.name: Menu_Sacabambaspis_Sate_Desc
Array.english: Skewered Sacabambaspis served with bamboo shoots, cassava, and sambal sauce.
Array.indonesia: Sacabambaspis tusuk sate yang disajikan dengan rebung, singkong, dan saus sambal.

Array.name: Menu_EagleShark_Stew_Desc
Array.english: A clear stew made with taro, water chestnuts, and fish sauce, preserving the aquilolamna's wing shape.
Array.indonesia: Sup bening yang terbuat dari talas, kastanye air, dan kecap ikan, yang mempertahankan bentuk sayap aquilolamna.

Array.name: Menu_CrayfishSambal_StirFried_Desc
Array.english: A stir-fry of red swamp crayfish and cilantro in sambal sauce. The chewy crayfish pairs with the bold, spicy flavor for a unique texture.
Array.indonesia: Tumis udang karang rawa merah dan ketumbar dengan saus sambal. Tekstur udang karang yang kenyal berpadu dengan rasa pedas yang kuat, menciptakan sensasi unik.

Array.name: Menu_CrayfishLemongrass_Steamed_Desc
Array.english: A dish that highlights the natural flavors of the ingredients, enhanced only by the aroma of lemongrass with no added seasoning.

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_TimeController
Array.english: <size=24>In the jungle, time flows in <color=#F1DC2B>Real Time</color>.\nDuring the day, dive in the lake or gather resources to prepare for the restaurant at night.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>In the jungle, time flows in <color=#F1DC2B>Real Time</color>.\nDuring the day, dive into the lake or gather resources to prepare for the restaurant at night.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_EscapeBell
Array.english: <size=24>Use a <color=#F1DC2B>Coconut Pod</color> to quickly return to the village!\nCut the coconut tied to the rock to call a rescue pod!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Use a <color=#F1DC2B>Coconut Pod</color> to quickly return to the village!\nCut the coconut tied to the rock to summon a rescue pod!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_MetaGun
Array.english: <size=24>You've received a <color=#F1DC2B>Jungle Gun</color>!\nThe Jungle Gun can transform into different types of firearms.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>You’ve received a <color=#F1DC2B>Jungle Gun</color>!\nThe Jungle Gun can transform into different types of firearms.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_MetaGun_Tech
Array.english: <size=24>You can <color=#F1DC2B>Upgrade</color> your Jungle Gun into different forms through Muna.\nGather the required materials to upgrade your weapon!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>You can <color=#F1DC2B>upgrade</color> your Jungle Gun into different forms via Muna.\nGather the required materials to upgrade your weapon!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_MetaGun_Swap
Array.english:
<Touch><size=24>The Jungle Gun can <color=#F1DC2B>switch</color> forms for different situations!
<color=#F1DC2B>Hold <image=枪支切换, preset=Dialogue_KR/></color> and <color=#F1DC2B>drag</color> to switch forms.</size></Touch> <size=24>The Jungle Gun can <color=#F1DC2B>switch</color> forms for different situations!
Use <image=InGame.MetaGunChange, preset=Dialogue_KR/> to switch forms.</size>
Array.indonesia:
<Touch><size=24>The Jungle Gun can <color=#F1DC2B>switch</color> forms to suit different situations!
<color=#F1DC2B>Hold <image=枪支切换, preset=Dialogue_KR/></color> and <color=#F1DC2B>drag</color> to switch forms.</size></Touch> <size=24>The Jungle Gun can <color=#F1DC2B>switch</color> forms to suit different situations!
Use <image=InGame.MetaGunChange, preset=Dialogue_KR/> to switch forms.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_HerbalistShop
Array.english: <size=24>Herbalist Lathi buys and sells various <color=#F1DC2B>Spices</color>.\nPick up the ingredients you need for cooking!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Herbalist Lathi buys and sells various <color=#F1DC2B>spices</color>.\nPick up the ingredients you need for cooking!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_Gift
Array.english: <size=24>You can now give gifts to villagers!\nIf they like your gift, you'll gain a lot of <color=#F1DC2B>Affinity</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>You can now give gifts to villagers!\nIf they like your gift, you’ll gain a lot of <color=#F1DC2B>affinity</color>.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_BanchoSushi
Array.english: <size=24>In Utara Village, you'll be running the <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho Grill</color>, specializing in grilled dishes.\nGather quality ingredients and serve up delicious grilled food!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>In Utara Village, you’ll be running the <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho Grill</color>, specialising in grilled dishes.\nGather quality ingredients and serve up delicious grilled food!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_Collecting_Wood
Array.english: <size=24>You can now use an <color=#F1DC2B>Axe</color> to gather lumber.\nLook for a <color=#F1DC2B>Tree</color> you can chop nearby!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>You can now use an <color=#F1DC2B>Axe</color> to gather timber.\nLook for a <color=#F1DC2B>Tree</color> you can chop down nearby!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_Collecting_Rock
Array.english: <size=24>You can now use a <color=#F1DC2B>Pickaxe</color> to gather stone!\nTry mining a <color=#F1DC2B>Boulder</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>You can now use a <color=#F1DC2B>Pickaxe</color> to gather stone!\nTry mining a <color=#F1DC2B>Boulder</color>!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_BanchoSushi_Furniture_01
Array.english: <size=24>Gather materials and bring them to <color=#F1DC2B>Peneb</color> to craft <color=#F1DC2B>Furniture</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Gather materials and take them to <color=#F1DC2B>Peneb</color> to craft <color=#F1DC2B>Furniture</color>.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_BanchoSushi_Furniture_02
Array.english: <size=24>Place crafted furniture from the restaurant's <color=#F1DC2B>Interior</color> menu.\nCraft more to decorate your shop!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Place the crafted furniture using the restaurant’s <color=#F1DC2B>Interior</color> menu.\nCraft more to decorate your shop!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_BanchoSushi_Grill
Array.english: <size=24>You can now use the <color=#F1DC2B>Grill</color>!\nTry grilling different ingredients and serving them!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>You can now use the <color=#F1DC2B>Grill</color>!\nTry grilling different ingredients and serving them!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_BanchoSushi_Grade
Array.english:
<size=24>Run your shop well to earn higher-grade <color=#ff885f>Badges</color>.
These <color=#ff885f>Badges</color> are awarded by Village Chief Panutah.</size>
Array.indonesia:
<size=24>Run your shop well to earn higher-grade <color=#ff885f>Badges</color>.
These <color=#ff885f>Badges</color> are awarded by Village Chief Panutah.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_HydrogenSulfide_01
Array.english: <size=24>The lake is filled with <color=#F1DC2B>Hydrogen Sulfide</color>.\nWithout protection, your oxygen will deplete rapidly.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>The lake is filled with <color=#F1DC2B>Hydrogen Sulphide</color>.\nWithout protection, your oxygen will run out quickly.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_HydrogenSulfide_02
Array.english: <size=24>To dive deep into the hydrogen sulfide-filled lake,\na <color=#F1DC2B>Purification Filter</color> is essential.\nBe sure to monitor your filter's remaining charge as you explore!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Untuk menyelam jauh ke dalam danau yang dipenuhi hidrogen sulfida,\nsebuah <color=#F1DC2B>Filter Pemurnian</color> sangatlah penting.\nPastikan untuk memantau sisa daya filtermu saat menjelajah!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_Sneak
Array.english:
<Touch><size=24>Sneak closer and grab the red feather!
Move slowly with <image=移动模式按钮3, preset=Dialogue_KR/> and approach quietly.
This trick also works for bug catching!</size></Touch> <size=24>Sneak closer and grab the red feather!
Move slowly with <image=Dave.SubInteraction2, preset=Dialogue_KR/> and approach quietly.
This trick also works for bug catching!</size>
Array.indonesia:
<Touch><size=24>Pendekati secara diam-diam dan ambil bulu merah itu!
Bergeraklah perlahan dengan <image=移动模式按钮3, preset=Dialogue_KR/> dan dekati dengan tenang.
Trik ini juga bisa digunakan untuk menangkap serangga!</size></Touch> <size=24>Pendekati secara diam-diam dan ambil bulu merah itu!
Bergeraklah perlahan dengan <image=Dave.SubInteraction2, preset=Dialogue_KR/> dan dekati dengan tenang.
Trik ini juga bisa digunakan untuk menangkap serangga!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_Fishing
Array.english: <size=24>You got a <color=#F1DC2B>Fishing Rod</color> from Basu the fisherman.\nTry fishing wherever you see the fishing icon!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Kamu mendapatkan <color=#F1DC2B>Pancing</color> dari Basu, sang nelayan.\nCobalah memancing di mana pun kamu melihat ikon memancing!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_Fishing_01
Array.english: <size=24>Once fishing starts, tap <image=开始钓鱼, preset=Dialogue_KR/> or shake your phone to cast the line!\n(Default joystick mode. Motion controls require a gyroscope and can be changed in Settings.)</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Setelah memancing dimulai, ketuk <image=开始钓鱼, preset=Dialogue_KR/> atau goyangkan ponselmu untuk melempar pancing!\n (Mode joystick default. Kontrol gerak memerlukan giroskop dan dapat diubah di Pengaturan.)</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_Fishing_02
Array.english: <size=24>When the fish struggles, follow the icon prompts\nand drag the joystick left/right <image=收线, preset=Dialogue_KR/> or tilt your phone to reel it in!\n(Default joystick mode. Motion controls require a gyroscope and can be changed in Settings.)</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Saat ikan meronta, ikuti petunjuk ikon\ndan seret joystick ke kiri/kanan <image=收线, preset=Dialogue_KR/> atau miringkan ponselmu untuk menariknya!\n(Mode joystick default. Kontrol gerak memerlukan giroskop dan dapat diubah di Pengaturan.)</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_BugNet
Array.english: <size=24>You got a familiar <color=#F1DC2B>Bug Net</color>!\nSneak up on bugs with <image=Dave.SubInteraction2, preset=Dialogue_KR/> to catch them more easily.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Kamu mendapatkan <color=#F1DC2B>Jaring Serangga</color> yang sudah tidak asing lagi!\nPendekati serangga secara diam-diam dengan <image=Dave.SubInteraction2, preset=Dialogue_KR/> agar lebih mudah menangkapnya.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_Kickboard_01
Array.english: <size=24>You got a <color=#F1DC2B>Kick Scooter</color> from Rimbo!\nUse it to move around the village faster.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Kamu mendapatkan <color=#F1DC2B>Skuter Tendang</color> dari Rimbo!\nGunakan untuk bergerak lebih cepat di sekitar desa.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_Kickboard_02
Array.english:
<size=24>Try dashing to go even faster!
Just don't crash!</size>
Array.indonesia:
<size=24>Cobalah berlari kencang untuk bergerak lebih cepat!
Tapi jangan sampai jatuh!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_Bed
Array.english: <size=24>At home, you can use your <color=#F1DC2B>Bed</color> to sleep until the next day or rest for a certain amount of time.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Di rumah, kamu bisa menggunakan <color=#F1DC2B>Tempat Tidur</color> untuk tidur hingga keesokan harinya atau beristirahat selama waktu tertentu.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_NightTime
Array.english: <size=24>You can still do activities after business hours.\nBut if you stay up too late, it will affect your performance the next day.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Kamu masih bisa melakukan aktivitas setelah jam kerja.\nTapi jika kamu begadang terlalu larut, hal itu akan memengaruhi performa kamu keesokan harinya.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_FilterUpgade
Array.english: <size=24>You can upgrade your <color=#F1DC2B>Purification Filter</color> to dive deeper!\nCheck with Muna for the required materials!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Kamu bisa meningkatkan <color=#F1DC2B>Filter Pemurnian</color> agar bisa menyelam lebih dalam!\nTanyakan pada Muna mengenai bahan-bahan yang dibutuhkan!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_RequestMission
Array.english:
<size=24>Villagers' requests are recorded in the <color=#F1DC2B>Resident Note</color>.
Villagers whose Friendship has grown will visit the restaurant.</size>
Array.indonesia:
<size=24>Permintaan penduduk desa dicatat di <color=#F1DC2B>Catatan Penduduk</color>.
Penduduk desa yang tingkat Persahabatannya telah meningkat akan mengunjungi restoran.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_InsectCollector_01
Array.english: <size=24>The insects you catch are now recorded in the <color=#F1DC2B>Insectagram</color>.\nTry to collect all the insects that live in this area!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Serangga yang kamu tangkap kini dicatat di <color=#F1DC2B>Insectagram</color>.\nCobalah mengumpulkan semua serangga yang hidup di daerah ini!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_InsectCollector_02
Array.english: <size=24>An alert will sound when a new <color=#F1DC2B>Insect</color> is nearby.\nYou can turn it off in the Insectagram app.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Suara peringatan akan berbunyi saat ada <color=#F1DC2B>Serangga</color> baru di dekatmu.\nKamu bisa mematikannya di aplikasi Insectagram.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_InsectCollector_03
Array.english: <size=24>You can battle other beetles using the lesser stag beetle Udo gave you!\nWin the fight and try to catch the insect!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Kamu bisa bertarung melawan kumbang lain menggunakan kumbang tanduk kecil yang diberikan Udo!\nMenangkan pertarungan dan coba tangkap serangga tersebut!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_InsectCollector_04
Array.english: <size=24>Collect different insects to complete your field guide and earn rewards!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Kumpulkan serangga yang berbeda untuk melengkapi buku panduan lapanganmu dan dapatkan hadiah!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_GrillContainer
Array.english: <size=24>If you place a <color=#F1DC2B>Skewer Rack</color>, you can store well-cooked skewers.\nSkewers on the holder will get cold over time, so you must serve them quickly.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Jika kamu menempatkan <color=#F1DC2B>Rak Tusuk Sate</color>, kamu bisa menyimpan tusuk sate yang sudah matang.\nTusuk sate di rak akan menjadi dingin seiring waktu, jadi kamu harus menyajikannya dengan cepat.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_Grill_HowToUse_01
Array.english: <size=24>Customers will now order <color=#F1DC2B>Skewers</color>.\nDave needs to pick the ingredients, cook them, and serve them himself!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Pelanggan sekarang akan memesan <color=#F1DC2B>Sate</color>.\nDave harus memilih bahan-bahannya, memasaknya, dan menyajikannya sendiri!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_Grill_HowToUse_02
Array.english: <size=24>You can choose from available ingredients and cook them at the <color=#F1DC2B>Grill</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Kamu dapat memilih dari bahan-bahan yang tersedia dan memasaknya di <color=#F1DC2B>Panggangan</color>.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_Grill_HowToUse_03
Array.english: <size=24>Leave <color=#F1DC2B>Skewers</color> on the grill too long and they'll burn!\nCook them until the green marker appears,\nthen serve them to customers!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Biarkan <color=#F1DC2B>Sate</color> terlalu lama di atas panggangan dan sate tersebut akan gosong!\nMasaklah hingga penanda hijau muncul,\nlalu sajikan kepada pelanggan!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_Lizard
Array.english: <size=24>Place <color=#F1DC2B>Lizard Bait</color> from your inventory near a lizard!\nWhile it's eating, sneak up using <image=Dave.SubInteraction2, preset=Dialogue_KR/> and catch it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Letakkan <color=#F1DC2B>Umpan Kadal</color> dari inventaris Kamu di dekat seekor kadal!\nSaat ia sedang makan, dekati diam-diam menggunakan <image=Dave.SubInteraction2, preset=Dialogue_KR/> dan tangkaplah!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_SunangEmitter01
Array.english: <size=24>You can now use the <color=#F1DC2B>Laser Emitter</color>!\nCollect Sunang Stones in the lake and use them to upgrade your Jungle Gun.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Kini kamu bisa menggunakan <color=#F1DC2B>Pemancar Laser</color>!\nKumpulkan Batu Sunang di danau dan gunakan untuk meningkatkan senjata Jungle Gun-mu.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_SunangEmitter02
Array.english: <size=24>You can <color=#F1DC2B>Upgrade</color> your <color=#F1DC2B>Laser Emitter</color> through Muna.\nUpgrading lets you obtain higher-grade Sunang Stones.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Kamu bisa <color=#F1DC2B>Meningkatkan</color> <color=#F1DC2B>Laser Emitter</color>-mu melalui Muna.\nDengan meningkatkan, kamu bisa mendapatkan Batu Sunang dengan kualitas yang lebih tinggi.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_Machete
Array.english: <size=24>You can now use the <color=#F1DC2B>Machete</color>.\nUse it to clear away vines.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Kamu sekarang bisa menggunakan <color=#F1DC2B>Machete</color>.\nGunakan untuk memotong tanaman merambat.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_RimboShooting_01
Array.english: <size=24>You can now use Rimbo's <color=#F1DC2B>Shooting Range</color>.\nHit the targets to earn points!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Kini Kamu dapat menggunakan <color=#F1DC2B>Lapangan Tembak</color> milik Rimbo.\nTembak sasaran untuk mendapatkan poin!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_RimboShooting_02
Array.english: <size=24>Running low on ammo? Try <color=#F1DC2B>Reloading</color>.\n<color=#F1DC2B>Reloading</color> takes time, so timing is key.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Kehabisan amunisi? Cobalah <color=#F1DC2B>Mengisi Ulang</color>.\n<color=#F1DC2B>Mengisi ulang</color> membutuhkan waktu, jadi waktu yang tepat sangat penting.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_RimboShooting_03
Array.english: <Touch><size=24>Use <image=射击轮盘, preset=Dialogue_KR/> to aim.\nIt makes shooting easier, but focus time is limited.</size></Touch><size=24>Use <image=InGame.Aim, preset=Dialogue_KR/> to aim.\nIt makes shooting easier, but focus time is limited.</size>
Array.indonesia: <Touch><size=24>Gunakan <image=射击轮盘, preset=Dialogue_KR/> untuk membidik.\nIni memudahkan menembak, tetapi waktu fokus terbatas.</size></Touch><size=24>Gunakan <image=InGame.Aim, preset=Dialogue_KR/> untuk membidik.\nIni memudahkan menembak, tetapi waktu fokus terbatas.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_RimboShooting_04
Array.english: <size=24>Score more points to earn higher ranks and better rewards.\nTry different difficulties and ranks!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Raih lebih banyak poin untuk mendapatkan peringkat yang lebih tinggi dan hadiah yang lebih baik.\nCobalah tingkat kesulitan dan peringkat yang berbeda!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_ATS
Array.english: <size=24>You can now play <color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color> with Harta.\nCarefully place the blocks to build a tower!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Kini kamu bisa bermain <color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color> bersama Harta.\nTempatkan balok-balok dengan hati-hati untuk membangun menara!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_GrillStaff
Array.english: <size=24><color=#F1DC2B>Yasuto</color> has joined Bancho Grill as a staff member!\nHe can use special spiderweb techniques.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24><color=#F1DC2B>Yasuto</color> telah bergabung dengan Bancho Grill sebagai anggota staf!\nDia bisa menggunakan teknik jaring laba-laba khusus.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_MiniMap
Array.english: <size=24>You received a <color=#F1DC2B>Village Map</color> from Uzme.\nYou can now check the location of the residents on the map.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Kamu menerima <color=#F1DC2B>Peta Desa</color> dari Uzme.\nKini kamu bisa memeriksa lokasi para penduduk di peta.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_RimboShop
Array.english: <size=24>Rimbo sells <color=#FF73C3>Gift Items</color> he brings from the city.\nThe selection changes daily, so pick items based on each villager's preferences!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Rimbo menjual <color=#FF73C3>Barang Hadiah</color> yang dia bawa dari kota.\nPilihannya berubah setiap hari, jadi pilihlah barang sesuai dengan selera masing-masing penduduk desa!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_BirdHunting
Array.english: <size=24>Try shooting down flying birds with your gun!\nYou can get different kinds of bird meat.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Cobalah menembak jatuh burung-burung yang terbang dengan senapanmu!\nKamu bisa mendapatkan berbagai jenis daging burung.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_HookGun
Array.english:
<Touch><size=24>You can use your hook gun at spots marked with this icon: <image=InGame.Interaction, preset=Dialogue_KR/>
Tap <image=InGame.Interaction, preset=Dialogue_KR/> to quickly pull yourself over.
Hold <image=InGame.Interaction, preset=Dialogue_KR/> and drag to aim!</size></Touch> <size=24>You can use your hook gun at spots marked with this icon: <image=InGame.Interaction, preset=Dialogue_KR/>
Aim at the hook and tap <image=InGame.Fire, preset=Dialogue_KR/> to quickly pull yourself over!</size>
Array.indonesia:
<Touch><size=24>Kamu bisa menggunakan senapan kait di tempat-tempat yang ditandai dengan ikon ini: <image=InGame.Interaction, preset=Dialogue_KR/>
Ketuk <image=InGame.Interaction, preset=Dialogue_KR/> untuk segera menarik diri ke sana.
Tahan <image=InGame.Interaction, preset=Dialogue_KR/> dan seret untuk membidik!</size></Touch> <size=24>Kamu bisa menggunakan senapan kait di tempat-tempat yang ditandai dengan ikon ini: <image=InGame.Interaction, preset=Dialogue_KR/>
Bidik ke arah kait dan ketuk <image=InGame.Fire, preset=Dialogue_KR/> untuk segera menarik diri ke sana!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_MonkeyDefense01
Array.english: <size=24><color=#F1DC2B>Macaques</color> have come up from Setah Forest!\nIf you don't chase them off quickly, they'll steal the customers' food!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24><color=#F1DC2B>Monyet ekor panjang</color> telah muncul dari Hutan Setah!\nJika kamu tidak segera mengusir mereka, mereka akan mencuri makanan para pelanggan!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_MonkeyDefense02
Array.english: <size=24>Use the <color=#F1DC2B>Feather Duster</color> to chase away the macaques!\nIf you don't drive them off completely, they'll come back for more!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Gunakan <color=#F1DC2B>Kuas Bulu</color> untuk mengusir kera-kera itu!\nJika kamu tidak mengusir mereka sepenuhnya, mereka akan kembali lagi!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_Marone
Array.english: <size=24><color=#F1DC2B>Marone</color> the puppy has joined your party.\nMarone will automatically attack during combat.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24><color=#F1DC2B>Marone</color> anak anjing itu telah bergabung dengan rombonganmu.\nMarone akan menyerang secara otomatis saat pertempuran.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_CoconutMinigame
Array.english: <size=24>Use a bamboo pole to knock down and harvest <color=#F1DC2B>Coconuts</color>.\nBe ready to dodge quickly when they fall!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Gunakan tongkat bambu untuk menjatuhkan dan memetik <color=#F1DC2B>Kelapa</color>.\nBersiaplah untuk menghindar dengan cepat saat kelapa-kelapa itu jatuh!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_MangoShake
Array.english: <size=24>Villagers will now order <color=#F1DC2B>Mango Shakes</color>.\nMake and serve them quickly within the time limit!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Penduduk desa sekarang akan memesan <color=#F1DC2B>Mango Shakes</color>.\nBuat dan sajikan dengan cepat sebelum batas waktu habis!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_JungleSuit
Array.english: <size=24>This is a jungle suit made with ancient Sunang technology.\nIt even lets you pass through the dense hydrogen sulfide layer at the bottom of the lake!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Ini adalah pakaian hutan yang dibuat dengan teknologi Sunang kuno.\nPakaian ini bahkan memungkinkanmu menembus lapisan hidrogen sulfida yang pekat di dasar danau!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_BaconLab01
Array.english: <size=24>You can now buy items for use in the lake at <color=#F1DC2B>Bacon's Lab</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Kini kamu bisa membeli barang-barang untuk digunakan di danau di <color=#F1DC2B>Laboratorium Bacon</color>!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_BaconLab02
Array.english: <size=24>Collect <color=#E6ABFF>Utara Crystals</color> to level up the lab,\nunlocking new items as it grows.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Kumpulkan <color=#E6ABFF>Kristal Utara</color> untuk menaikkan level lab,\ndan membuka item baru seiring pertumbuhannya.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_JakaGuitar01
Array.english: <Touch><size=24>Jaka is playing the electric guitar! Each string maps to a button.\nTap the notes to play along.</size></Touch> <size=24>Jaka is playing the electric guitar! Each string maps to a button.\nPlay them using <image=Concert.GuitarPlayBtn1, preset=Dialogue_KR/>, <image=Concert.GuitarPlayBtn2, preset=Dialogue_KR/>, <image=Concert.GuitarPlayBtn3, preset=Dialogue_KR/>, <image=Concert.GuitarPlayBtn4, preset=Dialogue_KR/>, <image=Concert.GuitarPlayBtn5, preset=Dialogue_KR/>, <image=Concert.GuitarPlayBtn6, preset=Dialogue_KR/>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <Touch><size=24>Jaka sedang memainkan gitar listrik! Setiap senar dipetakan ke sebuah tombol.\nKetuk not-notnya untuk ikut bermain.</size></Touch> <size=24>Jaka sedang memainkan gitar listrik! Setiap senar dipetakan ke sebuah tombol.\nMainkan dengan menggunakan <image=Concert.GuitarPlayBtn1, preset=Dialogue_KR/>, <image=Concert.GuitarPlayBtn2, preset=Dialogue_KR/>, <image=Concert.GuitarPlayBtn3, preset=Dialogue_KR/>, <image=Concert.GuitarPlayBtn4, preset=Dialogue_KR/>, <image=Concert.GuitarPlayBtn5, preset=Dialogue_KR/>, <image=Concert.GuitarPlayBtn6, preset=Dialogue_KR/>.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_JakaGuitar02
Array.english: <size=24>When a long note appears, hold the button until it ends.\nKeep the rhythm to put on a great performance!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Saat nada panjang muncul, tahan tombol tersebut hingga nada berakhir.\nPertahankan ritme untuk menampilkan pertunjukan yang hebat!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_Festival01
Array.english: <size=24>Time to play the drums for the village festival!\nHit the small blue circles with <image=Concert.RhythmBtn3, preset=Dialogue_KR/> or <image=Concert.RhythmBtn4, preset=Dialogue_KR/>.\nWhen a large blue circle appears, press <image=Concert.RhythmBtn3, preset=Dialogue_KR/> and <image=Concert.RhythmBtn4, preset=Dialogue_KR/> together!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Saatnya bermain drum untuk festival desa!\nPukul lingkaran biru kecil dengan <image=Concert.RhythmBtn3, preset=Dialogue_KR/> atau <image=Concert.RhythmBtn4, preset=Dialogue_KR/>.\nSaat lingkaran biru besar muncul, tekan <image=Concert.RhythmBtn3, preset=Dialogue_KR/> dan <image=Concert.RhythmBtn4, preset=Dialogue_KR/> secara bersamaan!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_Festival02
Array.english: <size=24>The small red circles are for hitting the rim of the drum.\nYou can play them by pressing <image=Concert.RhythmBtn1, preset=Dialogue_KR/> or <image=Concert.RhythmBtn2, preset=Dialogue_KR/>.\nWhen a large red circle appears, press <image=Concert.RhythmBtn1, preset=Dialogue_KR/> and <image=Concert.RhythmBtn2, preset=Dialogue_KR/> simultaneously!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Lingkaran merah kecil digunakan untuk memukul pinggiran drum.\nKamu bisa memainkannya dengan menekan <image=Concert.RhythmBtn1, preset=Dialogue_KR/> atau <image=Concert.RhythmBtn2, preset=Dialogue_KR/>.\nSaat lingkaran merah besar muncul, tekan <image=Concert.RhythmBtn1, preset=Dialogue_KR/> dan <image=Concert.RhythmBtn2, preset=Dialogue_KR/> secara bersamaan!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_Festival03
Array.english: <size=24>When a yellow bar appears, mash any of these buttons: <image=Concert.RhythmBtn3, preset=Dialogue_KR/>, <image=Concert.RhythmBtn4, preset=Dialogue_KR/>, <image=Concert.RhythmBtn1, preset=Dialogue_KR/>, <image=Concert.RhythmBtn2, preset=Dialogue_KR/>!\nNow, keep the rhythm and enjoy the performance!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Saat bilah kuning muncul, tekan salah satu tombol ini: <image=Concert.RhythmBtn3, preset=Dialogue_KR/>, <image=Concert.RhythmBtn4, preset=Dialogue_KR/>, <image=Concert.RhythmBtn1, preset=Dialogue_KR/>, <image=Concert.RhythmBtn2, preset=Dialogue_KR/>!\nSekarang, pertahankan ritmenya dan nikmati pertunjukannya!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_GrillFan
Array.english: <size=24>You got a <color=#F1DC2B>Fan</color>!\nUse it to grill skewers faster at the shop.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Kamu mendapatkan <color=#F1DC2B>Kipas</color>!\nGunakan untuk memanggang sate lebih cepat di toko.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_HouseExpansion
Array.english: <size=24>Gather materials and bring them to Cobra to expand your house.\nMake your home bigger and more comfortable!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Kumpulkan bahan-bahan dan bawa ke Cobra untuk memperluas rumahmu.\nJadikan rumahmu lebih besar dan lebih nyaman!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_Housing
Array.english: <size=24>You can now decorate Dave's house.\nCraft furniture and customize your home!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Kini kamu bisa mendekorasi rumah Dave.\nBuat furnitur dan sesuaikan rumahmu!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_Forge
Array.english: <size=24>You can upgrade tools and smelt ore at <color=#F1DC2B>Perak's Blacksmith</color>.\nGather materials to craft better tools!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Kamu bisa meningkatkan alat dan melebur bijih di <color=#F1DC2B>Tukang Besi Perak</color>.\nKumpulkan bahan untuk membuat alat yang lebih baik!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_MarincaBloom01
Array.english: <size=24><color=#F1DC2B>Marinca Bloom</color> is now available in the jungle.\nView fish cards and grow a <color=#F1DC2B>Rafflesia Flower</color> in the app.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24><color=#F1DC2B>Marinca Bloom</color> kini tersedia di hutan.\nLihat kartu ikan dan tanam <color=#F1DC2B>Bunga Rafflesia</color> di aplikasi.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_MarincaBloom02
Array.english: <size=24>Walking around the village or diving earns <color=#F1DC2B>Nutrients</color> and <color=#F1DC2B>Water</color>.\nUse them to grow your flower over time.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Berjalan-jalan di desa atau menyelam akan memberi Kamu <color=#F1DC2B>Nutrisi</color> dan <color=#F1DC2B>Air</color>.\nGunakan keduanya untuk menumbuhkan bunga Kamu seiring waktu.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_MarincaBloom03
Array.english: <size=24>Flowers with low <color=#F1DC2B>Health</color> can't grow to the next stage.\nGive them water and nutrients until they bloom...\nWho knows? Something good might happen.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Bunga dengan <color=#F1DC2B>Kesehatan</color> yang rendah tidak dapat tumbuh ke tahap berikutnya.\nBerikan air dan nutrisi hingga bunga tersebut mekar...\nSiapa tahu? Mungkin sesuatu yang baik akan terjadi.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_BeetleBattle
Array.english: <size=24>Select an insect to enter into a beetle battle.\nEach insect has a type, with a rock-paper-scissors style matchup between them.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Pilih serangga untuk mengikuti pertarungan kumbang.\nSetiap serangga memiliki tipe, dengan sistem pertarungan bergaya batu-gunting-kertas di antara mereka.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_BeetleBattleEnter
Array.english: <size=24><color=#F1DC2B>Scissors</color> uses a horn attack, <color=#F1DC2B>Rock</color> charges, and <color=#F1DC2B>Paper</color> heals.\nWin intense battles to collect new insects!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24><color=#F1DC2B>Gunting</color> menggunakan serangan tanduk, <color=#F1DC2B>Batu</color> melakukan serangan bertenaga, dan <color=#F1DC2B>Kertas</color> menyembuhkan.\nMenangkan pertarungan sengit untuk mengumpulkan serangga baru!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_IronPunch
Array.english: <size=24>Cobra channels power into his prosthetic arm and unleashes a punch.\nIt's a powerful skill that can instantly kill the enemy with a certain chance!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Cobra menyalurkan kekuatan ke lengan palsunya dan melepaskan pukulan.\nIni adalah keterampilan kuat yang dapat langsung membunuh musuh dengan peluang tertentu!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_PushtheRock
Array.english: <size=24>Ask <color=#F1DC2B>3 Villagers</color> to help push the boulder.\nVillagers with Affinity level 3 or higher are likely to help.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Mintalah <color=#F1DC2B>3 Penduduk Desa</color> untuk membantu mendorong batu besar.\nPenduduk desa dengan tingkat Afinitas 3 atau lebih tinggi kemungkinan besar akan membantu.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_WildBoarChasing
Array.english: <Touch><size=24><color=#F1DC2B>Swipe left/right on the screen</color> or <color=#F1DC2B>push the left joystick left/right</color> to dodge obstacles.\nRun from the chasing boar!</size></Touch> <size=24>Use <image=UI.Left, preset=Dialogue_KR/><image=UI.Right, preset=Dialogue_KR/> to dodge obstacles.\nRun from the chasing boar!</size>
Array.indonesia: <Touch><size=24><color=#F1DC2B>Geser ke kiri/kanan di layar</color> atau <color=#F1DC2B>gerakkan joystick kiri ke kiri/kanan</color> untuk menghindari rintangan.\nLari dari babi hutan yang mengejar!</size></Touch> <size=24>Gunakan <image=UI.Left, preset=Dialogue_KR/><image=UI.Right, preset=Dialogue_KR/> untuk menghindari rintangan.\nLari dari babi hutan yang mengejar!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_DungeonPuzzle
Array.english: <size=24>The Murau Temple is full of ancient contraptions.\nOperate the devices to venture deeper into the temple!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Kuil Murau penuh dengan alat-alat kuno.\nOperasikan alat-alat tersebut untuk menjelajah lebih dalam ke dalam kuil!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_MonkeyCatching
Array.english: <size=24>Punish the monkeys that stole the Dragon Fruit!\nIf you sneak up on them from behind while they're eating,\nthey won't notice you.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Hukum monyet-monyet yang mencuri Buah Naga!\nJika kamu menyelinap dari belakang saat mereka sedang makan,\nmereka tidak akan menyadari kehadiranmu.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_CuttheRope
Array.english: <size=24>Cut the rope with the candy to lure out the thief who stole Kui!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Potong tali yang ada permennya untuk memancing pencuri yang mencuri Kui!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_GrowaGarden
Array.english: <size=24>You can now grow various crops in Jepun's <color=#F1DC2B>Garden</color>.\nHarvest the incredibly fast-growing crops and cook new dishes!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Kini kamu bisa menanam berbagai tanaman di <color=#F1DC2B>Kebun</color> milik Jepun.\nPanen tanaman yang tumbuh sangat cepat dan masak hidangan baru!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_BreedingFarm
Array.english: <size=24>You can see all the lizards you've gifted at the <color=#F1DC2B>Lizard Terrarium</color> in Lipah's house!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Kamu bisa melihat semua kadal yang telah kamu berikan sebagai hadiah di <color=#F1DC2B>Terarium Kadal</color> di rumah Lipah!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_FastTravel
Array.english: <size=24>You can fast travel to different locations using the <color=#F1DC2B>Signposts</color> Rimbo set up!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Kamu bisa melakukan perjalanan cepat ke berbagai lokasi menggunakan <color=#F1DC2B>Tanda Arah</color> yang dipasang oleh Rimbo!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_CDPlayer
Array.english: <size=24>You got a <color=#F1DC2B>CD Player</color> from Jaka!\nInstall it in Dave's house and play some music!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Kamu mendapat <color=#F1DC2B>Pemutar CD</color> dari Jaka!\nPasang di rumah Dave dan putar musik!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_FestivalKeyGuide01
Array.english: <size=24>When a <color=#F1DC2B>Blue</color> rhythm icon appears, press one of the indicated buttons.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Saat ikon ritme <color=#F1DC2B>Biru</color> muncul, tekan salah satu tombol yang ditunjukkan.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_FestivalKeyGuide02
Array.english: <size=24>When a <color=#F1DC2B>Red</color> rhythm icon appears, press one of the indicated buttons.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Saat ikon ritme <color=#F1DC2B>Merah</color> muncul, tekan salah satu tombol yang ditunjukkan.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_FestivalKeyGuide03
Array.english: <size=24><color=#F1DC2B>Small Icons</color> require <color=#F1DC2B>One Hand</color>, and <color=#F1DC2B>Large Icons</color> require \npressing with <color=#F1DC2B>Both Hands at Once</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24><color=#F1DC2B>Ikon Kecil</color> memerlukan <color=#F1DC2B>Satu Tangan</color>, dan <color=#F1DC2B>Ikon Besar</color> memerlukan \nmenekan dengan <color=#F1DC2B>Kedua Tangan Sekaligus</color>!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_FestivalKeyGuide04
Array.english: <size=24>While a <color=#F1DC2B>Yellow</color> rhythm icon is showing, \n<color=#F1DC2B>Mash Any Button Repeatedly</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Saat ikon ritme <color=#F1DC2B>Kuning</color> ditampilkan, \n<color=#F1DC2B>Tekan Tombol Apa Saja Berulang Kali</color>.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_FestivalKeyGuide_Keyboard01
Array.english: <Touch><size=24>When a <color=#F1DC2B>blue</color> rhythm icon appears, tap the <color=#F1DC2B>blue highlighted area outside the drum</color>.</size></Touch> <size=24>When a <color=#F1DC2B>blue</color> rhythm icon appears, tap the indicated key.</size>
Array.indonesia: <Touch><size=24>Saat ikon ritme <color=#F1DC2B>biru</color> muncul, ketuk <color=#F1DC2B>area yang disorot biru di luar drum</color>.</size></Touch> <size=24>Saat ikon ritme <color=#F1DC2B>biru</color> muncul, ketuk tombol yang ditunjukkan.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_FestivalKeyGuide_Keyboard02
Array.english: <Touch><size=24>When a <color=#F1DC2B>red</color> rhythm icon appears, tap the <color=#F1DC2B>highlighted area inside the drum</color>.</size></Touch> <size=24>When a <color=#F1DC2B>red</color> rhythm icon appears, tap the indicated key.</size>
Array.indonesia: <Touch><size=24>Saat ikon ritme <color=#F1DC2B>merah</color> muncul, ketuk <color=#F1DC2B>area yang disorot di dalam drum</color>.</size></Touch> <size=24>Saat ikon ritme <color=#F1DC2B>merah</color> muncul, ketuk tombol yang ditunjukkan.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_FestivalKeyGuide_Keyboard03
Array.english: <Touch><size=24>Tap <color=#F1DC2B>small icons</color> with one finger, and <color=#F1DC2B>large icons</color> with two fingers at the same time!</size></Touch> <size=24>Tap <color=#F1DC2B>small icons</color> with <color=#F1DC2B>one hand</color>, and <color=#F1DC2B>large icons</color> with <color=#F1DC2B>both hands</color> at the same time!</size>
Array.indonesia: <Touch><size=24>@Ketuk <color=#F1DC2B>ikon kecil</color> dengan satu jari, dan <color=#F1DC2B>ikon besar</color> dengan dua jari secara bersamaan!</size></Touch> <size=24>Ketuk <color=#F1DC2B>ikon kecil</color> dengan <color=#F1DC2B>satu tangan</color>, dan <color=#F1DC2B>ikon besar</color> dengan <color=#F1DC2B>kedua tangan</color> secara bersamaan!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_FestivalKeyGuide_Keyboard04
Array.english: <Touch><size=24>When a <color=#F1DC2B>yellow</color> rhythm icon appears, <color=#F1DC2B>spam-tap anywhere</color>!</size></Touch> <size=24>When a <color=#F1DC2B>yellow</color> rhythm icon appears, <color=#F1DC2B>mash any key repeatedly</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <Touch><size=24>Saat ikon ritme <color=#F1DC2B>kuning</color> muncul, <color=#F1DC2B>ketuk berulang-ulang di mana saja</color>!</size></Touch> <size=24>Saat ikon ritme <color=#F1DC2B>kuning</color> muncul, <color=#F1DC2B>tekan tombol apa saja berulang-ulang</color>.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_BeetleBattleFaint
Array.english: <size=24>The insect is stunned!\nIt needs to rest until the next day.\nTo recover immediately, use the <color=#F1DC2B>Insect Jelly</color> sold by Udo.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Serangga itu pingsan!\nIa perlu beristirahat hingga keesokan harinya.\nUntuk memulihkannya segera, gunakan <color=#F1DC2B>Jeli Serangga</color> yang dijual oleh Udo.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_CraftPotion
Array.english: <size=24>You can make various recovery drinks at the <color=#F1DC2B>Mortar</color> in Lathi's house.\nCombine the herbs you've gathered to create stronger effects!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Kamu bisa membuat berbagai minuman pemulih di <color=#F1DC2B>Mortar</color> di rumah Lathi.\nGabungkan ramuan yang telah kamu kumpulkan untuk menciptakan efek yang lebih kuat!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_Miside01
Array.english: <size=24>Press the button when the green check mark appears after the countdown!\nFirst to press wins!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Tekan tombol saat tanda centang hijau muncul setelah hitungan mundur!\nYang pertama menekan menang!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_Miside02
Array.english: <size=24>Move the <color=#F1DC2B>Lever</color> up and down to guide the laser to the goal!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Gerakkan <color=#F1DC2B>Tuas</color> ke atas dan ke bawah untuk mengarahkan laser ke sasaran!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_Miside03
Array.english: <size=24>Destroy Mita's core!\nDodge every attack, then use your booster to launch a bomb at the core.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Hancurkan inti Mita!\nHindari setiap serangan, lalu gunakan booster-mu untuk meluncurkan bom ke inti tersebut.</size>
