Array.english: A Monster Snapping Turtle?
Array.indonesia: Kura-kura Penjepit Raksasa?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Name_410012813
Array.english: Beat the Snapping Turtle!
Array.indonesia: Kalahkan Kura-kura Penjepit!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Name_410012114
Array.english: The Legendary Beetle
Array.indonesia: Kumbang Legendaris

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050001
Array.english: Let's go talk to Bancho.
Array.indonesia: Ayo kita bicara dengan Bancho.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050002
Array.english: I was supposed to call <color=#4AFFDB>Bacon</color> once I'm ready, right?
Array.indonesia: Aku seharusnya menelepon <color=#4AFFDB>Bacon</color> begitu aku siap, kan?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050003
Array.english: A guide was supposed to show me to the village... that must be him!
Array.indonesia: Seharusnya ada pemandu yang menuntunku ke desa... pasti dia!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050004
Array.english: I need to prepare a dish to present to the village chief. Catch me some <color=#4AFFDB>Tilapia</color> from the lake.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus menyiapkan hidangan untuk disajikan kepada kepala desa. Tolong tangkapkan aku beberapa <color=#4AFFDB>Tilapia</color> dari danau.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050005
Array.english: I've got everything Bancho asked for. Let's go give it to him.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah menyiapkan semua yang diminta Bancho. Ayo kita berikan padanya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050006
Array.english: Please take this dish to the village chief.
Array.indonesia: Tolong bawa hidangan ini ke kepala desa.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050007
Array.english: Phew. What a long day... time to get some sleep.
Array.indonesia: Wah. Hari yang panjang sekali... saatnya tidur.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050008
Array.english: To fix the house, we'll need vines and wood. Ask the village carpenter for help.
Array.indonesia: Untuk memperbaiki rumah, kita butuh rotan dan kayu. Minta bantuan tukang kayu desa.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050009
Array.english: To fix the house, we'll need <color=#4AFFDB>5 Pieces of Wood</color> and <color=#4AFFDB>2 Vines</color>. You can find wood from nearby trees and vines in the water!
Array.indonesia: Untuk memperbaiki rumah, kita butuh <color=#4AFFDB>5 Potong Kayu</color> dan <color=#4AFFDB>2 Rotan</color>. Kamu bisa menemukan kayu dari pohon-pohon di sekitar sini dan rotan di air!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050010
Array.english: I've got all the materials. Let's go see Cobra!
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah punya semua bahan. Ayo kita temui Cobra!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050011
Array.english: The house is all fixed now, so go check with Bancho if he needs anything!
Array.indonesia: Rumah sudah diperbaiki, jadi pergilah tanyakan pada Bancho apakah dia membutuhkan sesuatu!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050012
Array.english: I should ask the village <color=#4AFFDB>Carpenter</color> to build me a skewer grill.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus meminta <color=#4AFFDB>Tukang Kayu</color> desa untuk membuatkan aku pemanggang tusuk sate.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410058012
Array.english: If you need a <color=#4AFFDB>Pickaxe</color>, go see our village <color=#4AFFDB>Blacksmith, Perak</color>.
Array.indonesia: Jika kamu membutuhkan <color=#4AFFDB>Palu</color>, temui <color=#4AFFDB>Pandai Besi desa kita, Perak</color>.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410058013
Array.english: To make a pickaxe, I need to start a fire.\nBring me 3 <color=#4AFFDB>Chunks of Bamboo</color>.
Array.indonesia: Untuk membuat palu, aku harus menyalakan api.\nBawakan aku 3 <color=#4AFFDB>Potongan Bambu</color>.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050013
Array.english: The carpenter, <color=#4AFFDB>Peneb</color>, asked me to get \n<color=#4AFFDB>3 Stones</color>, right?
Array.indonesia: Tukang kayu, <color=#4AFFDB>Peneb</color>, meminta saya untuk mengambil \n<color=#4AFFDB>3 Batu</color>, kan?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050015
Array.english: Peneb made me a <color=#4AFFDB>Skewer Grill</color>.\nLet's take it to Bancho
Array.indonesia: Peneb membuatkan saya sebuah <color=#4AFFDB>Panggangan Tusuk</color>.\nAyo kita bawa ke Bancho

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050020
Array.english: Muna asked me to find the <color=#4AFFDB>Ancient Statue</color> in the lake, right?
Array.indonesia: Muna meminta saya untuk mencari <color=#4AFFDB>Patung Kuno</color> di danau, kan?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050021
Array.english: I got the <color=#4AFFDB>Ancient Statue</color>. Let's go see Muna!
Array.indonesia: Saya sudah mendapatkan <color=#4AFFDB>Patung Kuno</color>. Ayo kita temui Muna!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050022
Array.english: Please take photos of the <color=#4AFFDB>3 Stone Tablets</color> in the lake.\nYou'll need to upgrade your purification filter in advance!
Array.indonesia: Tolong ambil foto <color=#4AFFDB>3 Lempengan Batu</color> di danau.\nKamu harus meningkatkan filter pemurnianmu terlebih dahulu!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050023
Array.english: I took photos of the 3 stone tablets. Let's go see Muna!
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah memotret 3 lempengan batu. Ayo kita temui Muna!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410058024
Array.english: Could you get me a <color=#4AFFDB>Broken Breathing Apparatus</color> from the depths of the lake?
Array.indonesia: Bisakah kamu mengambilkan <color=#4AFFDB>Alat Bantu Pernapasan yang Rusak</color> dari dasar danau?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410058125
Array.english: Let's pick up the <color=#4AFFDB>Shiny Object</color> and take it with us.
Array.indonesia: Ayo kita ambil <color=#4AFFDB>Benda Berkilau</color> dan bawa bersama kita.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410058025
Array.english: I got the <color=#4AFFDB>Broken Breathing Apparatus</color>. Let's go see Muna
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah mendapatkan <color=#4AFFDB>Alat Bantu Pernapasan Rusak</color>. Ayo kita temui Muna

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050024
Array.english: The path to the ancient ruins is blocked by a boulder... I should ask the village chief for help.
Array.indonesia: Jalan menuju reruntuhan kuno terhalang oleh sebuah batu besar... Sebaiknya aku meminta bantuan kepala desa.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050025
Array.english: You'll need <color=#4AFFDB>3 Villagers</color> to push that boulder. Build some rapport and ask them.
Array.indonesia: Kamu membutuhkan <color=#4AFFDB>3 Penduduk Desa</color> untuk mendorong batu besar itu. Bangun hubungan baik dengan mereka dan mintalah bantuan.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410059025
Array.english: If you're ready to push the boulder, come talk to me.
Array.indonesia: Jika kamu sudah siap mendorong batu besar itu, datanglah dan bicara denganku.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050026
Array.english: The villagers agreed to help! Let's go push the boulder!
Array.indonesia: Para penduduk desa setuju untuk membantu! Ayo kita dorong batu besar itu!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050027
Array.english: I'm supposed to head to the forest with Cobra, right? Let's meet him at the entrance.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus pergi ke hutan bersama Cobra, kan? Ayo kita temui dia di pintu masuk.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050028
Array.english: It's a bit creepy, but... let's head into the forest.
Array.indonesia: Agak menyeramkan sih, tapi... ayo masuk ke hutan.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050029
Array.english: There should be an <color=#4AFFDB>Ancient Breathing Apparatus</color> in the ruins deep in the forest. Let's find it.
Array.indonesia: Seharusnya ada <color=#4AFFDB>Alat Bantu Pernapasan Kuno</color> di reruntuhan di dalam hutan. Ayo kita cari.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050030
Array.english: I think I heard something whimpering... let's head toward the sound.
Array.indonesia: Kayaknya aku dengar suara rengekan... ayo kita ke arah suara itu.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050031
Array.english: The puppy looks scared.\nI should give it something to eat to calm it down.
Array.indonesia: Anak anjing itu terlihat ketakutan.\nAku harus memberinya sesuatu untuk dimakan agar dia tenang.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410058031
Array.english: I should grill the raw meat before giving it to him.\nLet's find a <color=#4AFFDB>Campfire</color>
Array.indonesia: Aku harus memanggang daging mentah itu sebelum memberikannya kepadanya.\nAyo cari <color=#4AFFDB>Api Unggun</color>

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050032
Array.english: Let's grill some raw meat at the campfire and bring it to the puppy!
Array.indonesia: Ayo panggang daging mentah di api unggun dan bawakan ke anak anjing itu!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050033
Array.english: Alright, that should be cooked just right. Let's head back to the puppy.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah, sepertinya sudah matang pas. Ayo kembali ke anak anjing itu.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050034
Array.english: Let's explore Setah Forest with Marone.
Array.indonesia: Ayo jelajahi Hutan Setah bersama Marone.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050035
Array.english: These are ruins from the ancient Sunang civilization. It's a bit scary, but... I have to go in, right?
Array.indonesia: Ini adalah reruntuhan dari peradaban Sunang kuno. Agak menakutkan, tapi... aku harus masuk, kan?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050036
Array.english: Let's operate the device and head down to the lower floor.
Array.indonesia: Ayo operasikan perangkat ini dan turun ke lantai bawah.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050037
Array.english: Let's operate the device and head down to the lower floor.
Array.indonesia: Ayo kita operasikan perangkat ini dan turun ke lantai bawah.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050038
Array.english: Hmm. There's a huge door. I need to find a relic that fits that slot.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Ada pintu besar. Aku harus menemukan relik yang cocok dengan slot itu.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050039
Array.english: Hmm. There's a huge door. I need to find a relic that fits that slot.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Ada pintu besar. Aku harus menemukan relik yang cocok dengan slot itu.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050040
Array.english: Let's find the <color=#4AFFDB>Ancient Breathing Apparatus</color> Muna mentioned.
Array.indonesia: Ayo cari <color=#4AFFDB>Alat Bantu Pernapasan Kuno</color> yang disebutkan Muna.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050041
Array.english: Let's find the <color=#4AFFDB>Ancient Breathing Apparatus</color> Muna mentioned.
Array.indonesia: Ayo cari <color=#4AFFDB>Alat Bantu Pernapasan Kuno</color> yang disebutkan Muna.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050042
Array.english: This must be the <color=#4AFFDB>Ancient Breathing Apparatus</color> Muna mentioned. Let's take it back up.
Array.indonesia: Ini pasti <color=#4AFFDB>Alat Bantu Pernapasan Kuno</color> yang disebutkan Muna. Ayo bawa kembali ke atas.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050043
Array.english: Looks like Marone found the way up. Let's hop on!
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya Marone sudah menemukan jalan ke atas. Ayo naik!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050044
Array.english: We should be able to take the elevator back up.
Array.indonesia: Seharusnya kita bisa naik lift kembali ke atas.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050046
Array.english: Sounds like someone's knocking. Let's check outside.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya ada yang mengetuk. Ayo periksa di luar.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410058040
Array.english: Muna said she'd study the ancient breathing apparatus and cloth, right? Let's go see her.
Array.indonesia: Muna bilang dia akan mempelajari alat pernapasan kuno dan kain itu, kan? Ayo temui dia.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050047
Array.english: Alright! Now that I've got the <color=#4AFFDB>Jungle Suit</color>, let's head down to the lake's depths!
Array.indonesia: Oke! Sekarang setelah aku punya <color=#4AFFDB>Jungle Suit</color>, ayo turun ke dasar danau!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050048
Array.english: He asked me to check the bottom of the ancient cave, right? I'd better be careful heading down.
Array.indonesia: Dia meminta aku memeriksa dasar gua kuno itu, kan? Sebaiknya aku berhati-hati saat turun.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050049
Array.english: I need to take a photo of the giant sea dragon stuck in the door!
Array.indonesia: Aku harus memotret naga laut raksasa yang terjebak di pintu itu!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050050
Array.english: Let's head back to the village and show Dr. Bacon the photo.
Array.indonesia: Ayo kembali ke desa dan tunjukkan foto itu kepada Dr. Bacon.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050051
Array.english: What's that anvil-like thing on its back? What a bizarre-looking shark...!
Array.indonesia: Apa itu benda seperti landasan tempa di punggungnya? Hiu yang penampilannya sungguh aneh...!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050052
Array.english: Phew... that was close. Maybe I should take some of the shark meat with me.
Array.indonesia: Wah... nyaris saja. Mungkin aku harus membawa sedikit daging hiu itu.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050053
Array.english: I should head back to the village and report to Dr. Bacon.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus kembali ke desa dan melapor kepada Dr. Bacon.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050054
Array.english: I was supposed to meet Muna on the path to the forest, right?
Array.indonesia: Aku seharusnya bertemu Muna di jalan menuju hutan, kan?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050055
Array.english: To get the Blue Divine Tree Fruit, I need to go deep into Murau Temple.
Array.indonesia: Untuk mendapatkan Buah Pohon Ilahi Biru, aku harus masuk jauh ke dalam Kuil Murau.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410058055
Array.english: I need to drain the temple's B2 level. Let's head to where the diving gear was.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus mengeringkan air di lantai B2 kuil. Ayo kita pergi ke tempat peralatan selam itu berada.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050056
Array.english: If I drain the water, I should be able to go deeper... Let's find the drainage device.
Array.indonesia: Kalau aku mengeringkan airnya, seharusnya aku bisa masuk lebih dalam... Ayo cari alat pengering airnya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050057
Array.english: Oh... the water's drained! Let's take the ladder down.
Array.indonesia: Oh... airnya sudah kering! Ayo turun lewat tangga.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050058
Array.english: Alright. Let's grab the Blue Divine Tree Fruit and head back to the village.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah. Ayo ambil Buah Pohon Suci Biru dan kembali ke desa.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050059
Array.indonesia: Sempurna. Ayo kita ambil buah biru dari pohon suci itu dan kembali ke desa.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050060
Array.english: Alright. I've got the Blue Divine Tree Fruit. Let's head back up!
Array.indonesia: Baiklah. Aku sudah mendapatkan Buah Pohon Suci Biru. Ayo kita naik kembali!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050061
Array.english: A huge boar's chasing us! Gotta run, fast!
Array.indonesia: Seekor babi hutan raksasa mengejar kita! Harus lari, cepat!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050062
Array.english: I barely made it out. Let's tell Dr. Bacon.
Array.indonesia: Aku nyaris saja lolos. Ayo kita beri tahu Dr. Bacon.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050063
Array.english: Sounds like someone's knocking at the door. Let's check outside.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya ada yang mengetuk pintu. Ayo kita periksa di luar.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050064
Array.english: Let's use the blue harpoon Muna made to enter the Mahoni settlement in the deep sea.
Array.indonesia: Ayo gunakan tombak biru buatan Muna untuk masuk ke pemukiman Mahoni di laut dalam.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050065
Array.english: I just need to hit the Divine Tree Fruit above the main gate with the blue harpoon, right?
Array.indonesia: Aku hanya perlu mengenai Buah Pohon Suci di atas gerbang utama dengan tombak biru itu, kan?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050066
Array.english: The gate's open, let's go in!
Array.indonesia: Gerbangnya sudah terbuka, ayo masuk!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050067
Array.english: The Mahoni tribe is on high alert... I need to find a way to the chief's chamber somehow.
Array.indonesia: Suku Mahoni dalam keadaan siaga tinggi... Aku harus mencari cara untuk mencapai ruang kepala suku.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050068
Array.english: I'll have to take down the huge Sea People blocking the path if I want to go further...
Array.indonesia: Aku harus mengalahkan Suku Laut raksasa yang menghalangi jalan jika ingin melangkah lebih jauh...

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410058068
Array.english: How can we make the Basilosaurus retreat... Let's talk it over with Dr. Bacon.
Array.indonesia: Bagaimana cara membuat Basilosaurus mundur... Ayo kita diskusikan dengan Dr. Bacon.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050069
Array.english: The entrance to where that fierce ancient fish is should be open now. \nLet's head down into the deep sea.
Array.indonesia: Pintu masuk ke tempat ikan purba yang ganas itu seharusnya sudah terbuka sekarang. \nAyo kita turun ke laut dalam.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050070
Array.english: Ugh... this is creepy... The Xiphactinus is just ahead, right...?
Array.indonesia: Ugh... ini menyeramkan... Xiphactinus ada tepat di depan, kan...?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050071
Array.english: Whoa...! That fish looks terrifying...! But I have to keep my promise... I'll have to take it down somehow.
Array.indonesia: Wah...! Ikan itu kelihatan menakutkan...! Tapi aku harus menepati janjiku... Aku harus mengalahkannya dengan cara apa pun.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050072
Array.english: Phew... let's see if there's anything we can take from the Xiphactinus.
Array.indonesia: Fiuh... mari kita lihat apakah ada sesuatu yang bisa kita ambil dari Xiphactinus.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050073
Array.english: I should let the Sea People chief know I defeated the Xiphactinus.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus memberi tahu kepala Suku Laut bahwa aku telah mengalahkan Xiphactinus.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050074
Array.english: Muna said she'd look into how to use the bombs, right?
Array.indonesia: Muna bilang dia akan mencari tahu cara menggunakan bom-bom itu, kan?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052001
Array.english: For my herb research, I need <color=#4AFFDB>3 Bamboo Shoots</color>. You should find them near bamboo trees.
Array.indonesia: Untuk penelitian ramuanku, aku butuh <color=#4AFFDB>3 Tunas Bambu</color>. Kamu bisa menemukannya di dekat pohon bambu.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052003
Array.english: Rimbo asked me to get <color=#4AFFDB>Red Feathers</color> for his charms, right? I think he said they're near the beach.
Array.indonesia: Rimbo memintaku untuk mengambil <color=#4AFFDB>Bulu Merah</color> untuk jimatnya, kan? Seingatku, dia bilang bulu-bulu itu ada di dekat pantai.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052004
Array.english: Alright. Let's take these <color=#4AFFDB>Red Feathers</color> to Rimbo.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah. Ayo kita bawa <color=#4AFFDB>Bulu Merah</color> ini ke Rimbo.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052005
Array.english:
<color=#4AFFDB>Walking Catfish</color> can't be caught with a fishing rod.
I'd appreciate it if you could catch three of them alive for me.
Array.indonesia:
<color=#4AFFDB>Ikan Lele Berjalan</color> tidak bisa ditangkap dengan pancing.
Aku akan sangat berterima kasih jika kamu bisa menangkap tiga ekor di antaranya dalam keadaan hidup untukku.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052007
Array.english: Please catch <color=#4AFFDB>3 Fireflies</color> for me. Just so you know, they only appear at night.
Array.indonesia: Tolong tangkap <color=#4AFFDB>3 Fireflies</color> untukku. Sekadar info, mereka hanya muncul di malam hari.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052008
Array.english: To make Dad's medicine, I need five stalks of <color=#4AFFDB>Hornwort</color>. You can find it in the lake.
Array.indonesia: Untuk membuat obat Ayah, aku butuh lima batang <color=#4AFFDB>Hornwort</color>. Kamu bisa menemukannya di danau.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052009
Array.english: Whatever you do, don't look near the trees! Especially the big ones!
Array.indonesia: Apa pun yang terjadi, jangan lihat ke arah pohon-pohon! Terutama yang besar-besar!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052010
Array.english: I'm not going anywhere near grassy areas with butterflies. I really mean it!
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak akan mendekati area berumput yang ada kupu-kupu. Aku serius!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052011
Array.english: Hehe. I'll be hiding behind one of the statues. I won't tell you which one!
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Aku akan bersembunyi di balik salah satu patung. Aku tidak akan memberitahumu yang mana!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052012
Array.english: Wow... I'm impressed you found all of us. Come to my house and I'll give you something I treasure!
Array.indonesia: Wow... Aku kagum kamu bisa menemukan kami semua. Datanglah ke rumahku dan aku akan memberimu sesuatu yang sangat berharga bagiku!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052013
Array.english: Just get me <color=#4AFFDB>5 Driftwood</color> from the lake. Then I'll carve you a new animal block!
Array.indonesia: Tolong ambilkan aku <color=#4AFFDB>5 Kayu Apung</color> dari danau. Nanti aku akan mengukir blok hewan baru untukmu!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052014
Array.english: Please get me two Kissing Gouramis. And make sure they're alive!
Array.indonesia: Tolong ambilkan aku dua ekor ikan gourami berciuman. Dan pastikan mereka masih hidup!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410058014
Array.english: I caught live kissing gouramis. Let's take them to Kinah.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah menangkap ikan gourami berciuman yang masih hidup. Ayo kita bawa ke Kinah.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052015
Array.english: I'd love to see a moonflower that only blooms at night. They come in pink and yellow. Could you bring me three of each?
Array.indonesia: Aku ingin sekali melihat bunga bulan yang hanya mekar di malam hari. Warnanya ada yang merah muda dan kuning. Bisakah kamu membawakan aku tiga dari masing-masing?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052016
Array.english: If you find my favorite floral-patterned plate in the lake, please bring it to me...!
Array.indonesia: Jika kamu menemukan piring bermotif bunga favoritku di danau, tolong bawakan padaku...!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052017
Array.english: Please get some starfruit. Jaka loves them.
Array.indonesia: Tolong ambilkan buah belimbing. Jaka sangat menyukainya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052018
Array.english: Could you give the prepared starfruit to Jaka?
Array.indonesia: Bisakah kamu memberikan buah belimbing yang sudah disiapkan itu kepada Jaka?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052818
Array.english: I should let Cinta know I delivered it to Jaka.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus memberi tahu Cinta bahwa aku sudah menyerahkannya kepada Jaka.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052019
Array.english: Could you get me just 3 pieces of amber from the water?
Array.indonesia: Bisakah kamu mengambilkan aku 3 potong amber dari air?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052819
Array.english: Let's win the match against the people from the neighboring village.
Array.indonesia: Ayo kita menangkan pertandingan melawan orang-orang dari desa tetangga.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052023
Array.english: Those smelly fish... I'll just have water chestnuts. Please bring me 5.
Array.indonesia: Ikan-ikan yang bau itu... Aku lebih baik makan kastanye air saja. Tolong bawakan aku 5 buah.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052025
Array.english: I want to write a poem about a rainy day. Please catch 3 snails for me.
Array.indonesia: Aku ingin menulis puisi tentang hari hujan. Tolong tangkap 3 siput untukku.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052027
Array.english: If I don't celebrate her birthday, the whole next year will be rough, won't it? Please get me 3 <color=#4AFFDB>Freshwater Pearls</color> from the lake.
Array.indonesia: Kalau aku tidak merayakan ulang tahunnya, setahun ke depan pasti akan sulit, kan? Tolong ambilkan aku 3 <color=#4AFFDB>Mutiara Air Tawar</color> dari danau.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052028
Array.english: Let's gather some coconuts at Jepun's Farm!
Array.indonesia: Ayo kita kumpulkan kelapa di Kebun Jepun!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052029
Array.english: I need some <color=#E6ABFF>Utara Crystals</color>, which can only be found in this region. Bring me 7.
Array.indonesia: Aku butuh <color=#E6ABFF>Kristal Utara</color>, yang hanya bisa ditemukan di wilayah ini. Bawakan aku 7.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052030
Array.english: Let's bring Basu one piece of Piraiba catfish meat.
Array.indonesia: Ayo bawakan Basu satu potong daging ikan lele Piraiba.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052031
Array.english: Let's ask Peneb if he can make a wooden toy.
Array.indonesia: Ayo tanya Peneb apakah dia bisa membuat mainan kayu.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052831
Array.english: To cut down the Purity Tree, I'll need something as strong as Black Iron Axe. Let's gather some black iron and go see Perak.
Array.indonesia: Untuk menebang Pohon Kemurnian, aku butuh sesuatu sekuat Kapak Besi Hitam. Ayo kumpulkan besi hitam dan temui Perak.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052032
Array.english: Let's look for a Purity Tree in Setah Forest.
Array.indonesia: Ayo cari Pohon Kemurnian di Hutan Setah.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052033
Array.english: I cut down the Purity Tree! Let's gather the timber.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah menebang Pohon Kemurnian! Ayo kumpulkan kayunya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052034
Array.english: A giant toad...?! I have to defeat it to gather the timber.
Array.indonesia: Seekor katak raksasa...?! Aku harus mengalahkannya untuk mengumpulkan kayunya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052035
Array.english: Phew... now let's gather the <color=#4AFFDB>Purity Timber</color> and bring it to Peneb.
Array.indonesia: Wah... sekarang mari kita kumpulkan <color=#4AFFDB>Kayu Kemurnian</color> dan bawa ke Peneb.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052036
Array.english: Peneb made me a wooden toy using the <color=#4AFFDB>Purity Timber</color>.
Array.indonesia: Peneb membuatkan aku mainan kayu menggunakan <color=#4AFFDB>Kayu Kemurnian</color>.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052037
Array.english: Let's give the wooden toy to Perak!
Array.indonesia: Mari kita berikan mainan kayu itu kepada Perak!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052040
Array.english: Let's ask Harta where Gesang went.
Array.indonesia: Mari kita tanya Harta ke mana Gesang pergi.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052041
Array.english: He said Gesang was near Surga Falls... should I check it out?
Array.indonesia: Dia bilang Gesang ada di dekat Air Terjun Surga... haruskah aku memeriksanya?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052042
Array.english: Gesang's acting a bit strange... Let's go talk to him.
Array.indonesia: Gesang bertingkah agak aneh... Ayo kita bicara dengannya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052043
Array.english: Ugh...! Where am I...!? I need to win these games they're making me play.
Array.indonesia: Ugh...! Di mana aku...!? Aku harus memenangkan permainan-permainan yang mereka paksa aku mainkan ini.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052044
Array.english: Phew... Looks like Gesang's come to his senses. Let's go tell Chandra.
Array.indonesia: Wah... Sepertinya Gesang sudah sadar kembali. Ayo kita beri tahu Chandra.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052046
Array.english: Looks like the forest animals took the dinosaur bones called <color=#4AFFDB>Unihornus</color>. Let's help find them.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya hewan-hewan hutan telah mengambil tulang dinosaurus bernama <color=#4AFFDB>Unihornus</color>. Ayo bantu mencarinya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052045
Array.english: I wonder if William has recovered. Let's head to Lake Beach.
Array.indonesia: Aku penasaran apakah William sudah pulih. Ayo kita pergi ke Lake Beach.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052846
Array.english:
I've found all the <color=#4AFFDB>Unihornus</color> bones.
Let's go see William at Lake Beach.
Array.indonesia:
Aku sudah menemukan semua tulang <color=#4AFFDB>Unihornus</color>.
Ayo kita temui William di Lake Beach.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052047
Array.english:
He said he lost the <color=#4AFFDB>Unihornus</color> horn in the swamp, right?
Should I go check?
Array.indonesia:
Dia bilang dia kehilangan tanduk <color=#4AFFDB>Unihornus</color> di rawa, kan?
Haruskah aku pergi memeriksanya?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052048
Array.english:
Whoa! That's a massive snakehead...!
Could it have swallowed the Unihornus horn?!
Array.indonesia: Wah! Itu ikan kepala ular yang sangat besar...!\ nMungkinkah dia menelan tanduk Unihornus?!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052049
Array.english: Let's defeat the colossal snakehead and get the Unihornus horn back!
Array.indonesia: Ayo kita kalahkan ikan kepala ular raksasa itu dan ambil kembali tanduk Unihornus!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052849
Array.english:
I found the <color=#4AFFDB>Unihornus</color> horn.
Let's head to William at Lake Beach.
Array.indonesia:
Aku menemukan tanduk <color=#4AFFDB>Unihornus</color>.
Ayo kita temui William di Lake Beach.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052050
Array.english: Who's been stealing the Kui left as an offering? Let's wait until night.
Array.indonesia: Siapa yang mencuri Kui yang ditinggalkan sebagai persembahan? Ayo kita tunggu sampai malam.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052051
Array.english: I need to take a photo of the candy thief. First, let's set up the Kui.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus memotret pencuri permen itu. Pertama, ayo kita pasang Kui.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052851
Array.english: Now that I've set up the Kui, let's install the camera.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang setelah Kui terpasang, ayo pasang kameranya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052052
Array.english: What's that green creature?! Let's take a photo of it!
Array.indonesia: Makhluk hijau apa itu?! Ayo kita foto dia!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052053
Array.english: Hmm... what a strange-looking creature. I should show the photo to the village chief.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... makhluk yang tampak aneh sekali. Aku harus menunjukkan foto ini kepada kepala desa.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052054
Array.english: Let's find the candy thief. Should I start with the tree where the Kui was?
Array.indonesia: Ayo cari pencuri permen itu. Haruskah aku mulai dari pohon tempat Kui itu diletakkan?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052055
Array.english: Oh! Footprints from that green creature. I should be able to follow them.
Array.indonesia: Oh! Jejak kaki makhluk hijau itu. Seharusnya aku bisa mengikutinya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052056
Array.english: More footprints here. Alright, let's follow them!
Array.indonesia: Ada jejak kaki lagi di sini. Baiklah, ayo kita ikuti jejaknya!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052057
Array.english: It feels like I'm getting closer. Let me keep following the footprints.
Array.indonesia: Rasanya aku semakin dekat. Aku akan terus mengikuti jejak-jejak ini.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052058
Array.english: The footprints stop at the cliff up ahead. Let me get closer.
Array.indonesia: Jejak-jejak itu berhenti di tebing di depan. Aku akan mendekat.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052059
Array.english: Gotcha, you little guy! Let's take him to the village chief and let him know!
Array.indonesia: Tertangkap, makhluk kecil! Ayo kita bawa dia ke kepala desa dan beri tahu dia!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052060
Array.english: The weeds in my garden are growing way too fast. Please pull them out for me!
Array.indonesia: Gulma di kebunku tumbuh terlalu cepat. Tolong cabutkan untukku!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052061
Array.english: Phew. I pulled all the weeds. Let's let Jepun know.
Array.indonesia: Wah. Aku sudah mencabut semua gulma. Ayo beri tahu Jepun.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052062
Array.english: The monkeys wrecked my whole garden! Come back at night and help me chase them off!
Array.indonesia: Monyet-monyet itu menghancurkan seluruh kebunku! Kembalilah malam ini dan bantu aku mengusir mereka!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052063
Array.english: Let's help Jepun chase away the monkeys that ruined his garden!
Array.indonesia: Ayo bantu Jepun mengusir monyet-monyet yang merusak kebunnya!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052064
Array.english: You naughty monkeys...! I'll teach you a lesson!
Array.indonesia: Kalian monyet nakal...! Aku akan memberi kalian pelajaran!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052065
Array.english: Phew... I think we drove all the monkeys away. Let's talk to Jepun.
Array.indonesia: Wah... sepertinya kita sudah mengusir semua monyet. Ayo kita bicara dengan Jepun.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052066
Array.english: Check the stakes blocking Sulong's habitat. Left side of the lake... about 10m in.
Array.indonesia: Periksa tiang-tiang yang menghalangi habitat Sulong. Di sisi kiri danau... sekitar 10 m ke dalam.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052067
Array.english: The stakes are all broken? I should let Uzme know.
Array.indonesia: Semua tiang patah? Aku harus memberi tahu Uzme.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052868
Array.english: Head into the lake at sunset, before it gets dark. That's when Sulong appears.
Array.indonesia: Masuklah ke danau saat matahari terbenam, sebelum gelap. Saat itulah Sulong muncul.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052068
Array.english: Sulong's hiding spot was about 10m in on the left side of the lake, right?
Array.indonesia: Tempat persembunyian Sulong ada sekitar 10 m ke dalam di sisi kiri danau, kan?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052069
Array.english: Ugh... It's a massive saltwater crocodile...! Let's take it down for the village!
Array.indonesia: Ugh... Itu buaya air asin raksasa...! Ayo kita taklukkan untuk desa!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052070
Array.english: Phew... Should we see if there's anything we can salvage from Sulong's carcass?
Array.indonesia: Wah... Haruskah kita lihat apakah ada yang bisa diselamatkan dari bangkai Sulong?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052022
Array.english: I need a pick to play. Please get me one tooth from a black piranha!
Array.indonesia: Aku butuh alat penggalian untuk bermain. Tolong ambilkan aku satu gigi dari piranha hitam!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052026
Array.english: Bring me 5 rubberwood timbers and 3 banana leaves, and I'll make you a skewer rack!
Array.indonesia: Bawakan aku 5 balok kayu karet dan 3 daun pisang, dan aku akan membuatkanmu rak tusuk sate!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052071
Array.english: Now let's head up and let Uzme know we defeated Sulong.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang ayo kita naik ke atas dan beri tahu Uzme bahwa kita sudah mengalahkan Sulong.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052101
Array.english: My net's torn. Maybe Muna can fix it?
Array.indonesia: Jaringku robek. Mungkin Muna bisa memperbaikinya?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052111
Array.english: The students who came to photograph the UFO seem to have gone up the hill. Should I follow them?
Array.indonesia: Para siswa yang datang untuk memotret UFO sepertinya sudah naik ke bukit. Haruskah aku mengikuti mereka?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052102
Array.english: Is it really a UFO...? I should take a picture.
Array.indonesia: Apakah itu benar-benar UFO...? Aku harus memotretnya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052103
Array.english: Is it really a UFO...? I should take a picture.
Array.indonesia: Apakah itu benar-benar UFO...? Aku harus memotretnya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052104
Array.english: Is it really a UFO...? I should take a picture.
Array.indonesia: Apakah itu benar-benar UFO...? Aku harus memotretnya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052105
Array.english: Something fell on the beach. Let's go check it out!
Array.indonesia: Ada sesuatu yang jatuh di pantai. Ayo kita periksa!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052106
Array.english: Let's ask Rimbo if there's a place to practice shooting.
Array.indonesia: Ayo tanya Rimbo apakah ada tempat untuk berlatih menembak.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052107
Array.english: Come on up the ladder.
Array.indonesia: Ayo naik tangga.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052108
Array.english: Let's do some shooting practice.
Array.indonesia: Ayo kita berlatih menembak.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052109
Array.english: If there's a spot in the lake with clean water, I might be able to purify it.
Array.indonesia: Kalau ada tempat di danau yang airnya bersih, mungkin aku bisa menjernihkannya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052110
Array.english: Martin asked me to let him know if I find a source of clean water, right?
Array.indonesia: Martin kan minta aku kasih tahu kalau aku nemu sumber air bersih, ya?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052112
Array.english: If you connect the pipe to the device I gave you, it'll work, hahaha.
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu nyambungin pipa ke alat yang aku kasih, itu bakal berfungsi, hahaha.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052113
Array.english: Martin asked me to install the pipe inside, right?\nLooks like I can use the hook to get across.
Array.indonesia: Martin meminta aku memasang pipa di dalam, kan?\nSepertinya aku bisa menggunakan kait untuk menyeberang.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052114
Array.english: If you connect the pipe to the device I gave you, it'll work, hahaha.
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu menyambungkan pipa ke alat yang kuberikan, itu akan berfungsi, hahaha.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052115
Array.english: Should I go thank Martin?
Array.indonesia: Haruskah aku pergi mengucapkan terima kasih kepada Martin?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052116
Array.english: Let's help Jaka meet the guitarist.
Array.indonesia: Ayo bantu Jaka bertemu dengan gitaris itu.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052117
Array.english: Should I head into the cave where the clean water is coming from?
Array.indonesia: Haruskah aku masuk ke gua tempat air bersih itu berasal?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052118
Array.english: Harta said he'd tell me about the Animal Block Stacking challenge, right? Let's go find him.
Array.indonesia: Harta bilang dia akan memberitahuku tentang tantangan Menumpuk Balok Hewan, kan? Ayo cari dia.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052119
Array.english: Let's challenge Harta to an Animal Block Stacking match!
Array.indonesia: Ayo tantang Harta dalam pertandingan Menumpuk Balok Hewan!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052120
Array.english: There are 3 villagers who enjoy Animal Block Stacking. Find 'em and come back when you've beaten 'em all!
Array.indonesia: Ada 3 penduduk desa yang suka Menumpuk Balok Hewan. Temukan mereka dan kembali setelah kamu mengalahkan mereka semua!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052121
Array.english: Alright. I've collected 3 animal blocks. Let's go see Harta.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah. Aku sudah mengumpulkan 3 balok hewan. Ayo temui Harta.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052122
Array.english: Marone's got a bird in his mouth? Where did he catch it?
Array.indonesia: Marone memegang seekor burung di mulutnya? Di mana dia menangkapnya?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052123
Array.english: Hahaha! Let's go bird hunting!
Array.indonesia: Hahaha! Ayo berburu burung!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410058007
Array.english: Sounds like someone's at the door. Let's go check.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya ada yang mengetuk pintu. Ayo kita periksa.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410058023
Array.english: Sounds like Muna's voice? Let's go outside.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya itu suara Muna? Ayo kita keluar.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052201
Array.english: I heard Muna's mouse is broken. Couldn't Rimbo get one from the city?
Array.indonesia: Aku dengar mouse Muna rusak. Apa Rimbo tidak bisa mendapatkan satu dari kota?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052202
Array.english: Rimbo said he'd trade me the mouse for an <color=#4AFFDB>Electric Eel Generator</color>, right?
Array.indonesia: Rimbo bilang dia bakal menukar mouse itu dengan <color=#4AFFDB>Generator Belut Listrik</color>, kan?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052203
Array.english: I got the <color=#4AFFDB>Electric Eel Generator</color>! Let's take it to Rimbo.
Array.indonesia: Aku udah dapet <color=#4AFFDB>Generator Belut Listrik</color>! Ayo kita bawa ke Rimbo.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052200
Array.english: This must be the foldable mouse. I should take it to Muna.
Array.indonesia: Ini pasti mouse lipatnya. Aku harus bawa ini ke Muna.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052204
Array.english: Please catch a Blue Big Eyed Lizard for me using lizard bait.
Array.indonesia: Tolong tangkapkan seekor Kadal Bermata Besar Biru untukku menggunakan umpan kadal.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410056101
Array.english: To get to the waterfall next to the shooting range, I need a machete. I heard Peneb has one?
Array.indonesia: Untuk mencapai air terjun di sebelah lapangan tembak, aku butuh parang. Kudengar Peneb punya satu?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410056102
Array.english: I can't just lend you the machete. Bring me 2 rubber tree timbers and we'll trade!
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak bisa begitu saja meminjamkan parangnya padamu. Bawakan aku 2 balok kayu pohon karet dan kita akan bertukar!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410056072
Array.english: Let's cut through the vines with the machete and head into the waterfall area.
Array.indonesia: Ayo kita potong tanaman merambat dengan parang dan masuk ke area air terjun.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410056082
Array.english: <color=#4AFFDB>Braised Ostrich Fern</color> ingredients: 3 ostrich ferns and 2 bottles of coconut milk.
Array.indonesia: Bahan-bahan <color=#4AFFDB>Tumis Pakis Burung Unta</color>: 3 pakis burung unta dan 2 botol santan.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410056103
Array.english: Let's serve Shinta the <color=#4AFFDB>Braised Ostrich Fern</color> she asked for.
Array.indonesia: Ayo kita sajikan <color=#4AFFDB>Tumis Pakis Burung Unta</color> yang diminta Shinta.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410056110
Array.english: If she tries my <color=#4AFFDB>Crocodile Tail Dish</color>, she'll change her mind. Bring me the ingredients I need.
Array.indonesia: Kalau dia mencicipi <color=#4AFFDB>Hidangan Ekor Buaya</color> buatanku, dia pasti akan berubah pikiran. Bawakan aku bahan-bahan yang kubutuhkan.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410056111
Array.english: Let's serve Bonita the <color=#4AFFDB>Crocodile Tail Dish</color>.
Array.indonesia: Ayo sajikan <color=#4AFFDB>Hidangan Ekor Buaya</color> kepada Bonita.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052124
Array.english: The <color=#4AFFDB>Flamecrest Stag</color> is in Setah Forest, right? Let's go find it.
Array.indonesia: <color=#4AFFDB>Rusa Flamecrest</color> ada di Hutan Setah, kan? Ayo kita cari.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052125
Array.english: I found the <color=#4AFFDB>Flamecrest Stag</color>! Let's catch it!
Array.indonesia: Aku menemukan <color=#4AFFDB>Rusa Flamecrest</color>! Ayo kita tangkap!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052126
Array.english: Let's take the captured <color=#4AFFDB>Flamecrest Stag</color> to Udo!
Array.indonesia: Ayo bawa <color=#4AFFDB>Rusa Flamecrest</color> yang sudah ditangkap ke Udo!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052127
Array.english: A <color=#4AFFDB>Snapping Turtle</color> that doesn't live around here was spotted? Maybe the village chief and Basu know something.
Array.indonesia: Ada <color=#4AFFDB>Kura-kura Snapping</color> yang bukan berasal dari daerah sini terlihat? Mungkin kepala desa dan Basu tahu sesuatu.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052128
Array.english: Alright, I got some info on the <color=#4AFFDB>Snapping Turtle</color>. Let's go tell Sato.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah, aku dapat info tentang <color=#4AFFDB>Snapping Turtle</color>. Ayo kita beri tahu Sato.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052129
Array.english: They said a <color=#4AFFDB>Snapping Turtle</color> signal was detected 60m deep on the left, right? Let's go check it out.
Array.indonesia: Katanya sinyal <color=#4AFFDB>Snapping Turtle</color> terdeteksi di kedalaman 60m di sebelah kiri, kan? Ayo kita periksa.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052130
Array.english: Hmm... these roots are too tough to get through. Let's report back to Sato for now.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... akar-akar ini terlalu keras untuk ditembus. Untuk saat ini, mari kita laporkan kembali ke Sato.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052131
Array.english: Let's ask Perak to upgrade the machete.
Array.indonesia: Ayo minta Perak untuk meningkatkan kualitas parang itu.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052132
Array.english: If you bring me <color=#4AFFDB>Deep Sea Ore</color> from beneath the lake, I can make that machete much sharper. It's tough stuff, though... you'll need at least a black iron pickaxe.
Array.indonesia: Jika kamu membawakan aku <color=#4AFFDB>Bijih Laut Dalam</color> dari dasar danau, aku bisa membuat parang itu jauh lebih tajam. Tapi ini benda yang keras... kamu butuh setidaknya beliung besi hitam.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052133
Array.english: Nice. Got the <color=#4AFFDB>Deep Sea Ore</color>. Let's bring it to Perak.
Array.indonesia: Bagus. Sudah dapat <color=#4AFFDB>Deep Sea Ore</color>. Ayo bawa ke Perak.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052134
Array.english: With this machete, I should be able to cut through the roots. The roots were around 60m deep, on the left side... right?
Array.indonesia: Dengan parang ini, aku seharusnya bisa memotong akar-akar itu. Akar-akar itu ada di kedalaman sekitar 60m, di sisi kiri... kan?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052135
Array.english: Alright. Cut through the roots! Let's head into the <color=#4AFFDB>Snapping Turtle</color>'s habitat...!
Array.indonesia: Baiklah. Potong akarnya! Ayo masuk ke habitat <color=#4AFFDB>Kura-kura Penjepit</color>...!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052136
Array.english: Its neck reaches that far...? Keep your distance and take down the <color=#4AFFDB>Snapping Turtle</color>!
Array.indonesia: Lehernya bisa menjangkau sejauh itu...? Jaga jarak dan kalahkan <color=#4AFFDB>Kura-kura Penjepit</color>!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052137
Array.english: Phew... I can't believe a turtle could be that vicious. Let's see if there's anything worth taking.
Array.indonesia: Wah... Aku nggak nyangka kura-kura bisa segitu ganasnya. Ayo kita lihat ada barang berharga yang bisa diambil.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052138
Array.english: Let's go tell Sato we took down the <color=#4AFFDB>Snapping Turtle</color>.
Array.indonesia: Ayo kita beri tahu Sato kalau kita sudah mengalahkan <color=#4AFFDB>Snapping Turtle</color>.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052139
Array.english: The <color=#4AFFDB>Golden Tiger Beetle</color> is on B2 of Murau Temple, right? Let's go find it.
Array.indonesia: <color=#4AFFDB>Golden Tiger Beetle</color> ada di lantai B2 Kuil Murau, kan? Ayo kita cari.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052140
Array.english: The <color=#4AFFDB>Golden Tiger Beetle</color> should be around here somewhere... let's look carefully.
Array.indonesia: <color=#4AFFDB>Kumbang Harimau Emas</color> seharusnya ada di sekitar sini... mari kita perhatikan dengan saksama.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052141
Array.english: That's one massive <color=#4AFFDB>Golden Tiger Beetle</color>...! I'll need to send out at least three beetles...
Array.indonesia: Itu <color=#4AFFDB>Kumbang Harimau Emas</color> yang sangat besar...! Aku harus mengirim setidaknya tiga kumbang...

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052142
Array.english: Let's bring the captured <color=#4AFFDB>Golden Tiger Beetle</color> to Udo!
Array.indonesia: Ayo bawa <color=#4AFFDB>Kumbang Harimau Emas</color> yang sudah ditangkap ke Udo!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410058075
Array.english: Muna said she'd have the <color=#4AFFDB>mini bomb</color> ready, right? Let's head out and meet her.
Array.indonesia: Muna bilang dia sudah menyiapkan <color=#4AFFDB>bom mini</color>, kan? Ayo berangkat dan temui dia.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052858
Array.english: If I tie some <color=#4AFFDB>Kui</color> candy to a rope and lower it down, I'm sure I can catch it!
Array.indonesia: Kalau aku mengikat permen <color=#4AFFDB>Kui</color> ke tali dan menurunkannya, aku yakin bisa menangkapnya!

Array.name: UI_Subtitle_MartinTweed_IntroVideo_001
Array.english: Once again we would like to thank you for joining the Pioneer program
Array.indonesia: Sekali lagi, kami ingin mengucapkan terima kasih atas partisipasi Anda dalam program Pioneer

Array.name: UI_Subtitle_MartinTweed_IntroVideo_002
Array.english: here at Kindred Aerospace.
Array.indonesia: di Kindred Aerospace.

Array.name: UI_Subtitle_MartinTweed_IntroVideo_003
Array.english: For the 8th year running
Array.indonesia: Untuk tahun ke-8 berturut-turut,

Array.name: UI_Subtitle_MartinTweed_IntroVideo_004
Array.english: Kindred has been voted the FOURTH BEST interstellar exploration company by our peers
Array.indonesia: Kindred terpilih sebagai perusahaan eksplorasi antarbintang TERBAIK KE-EMPAT oleh rekan-rekan kami,

Array.name: UI_Subtitle_MartinTweed_IntroVideo_005
Array.english: and the resulting boost in government funding
Array.indonesia: dan peningkatan dana pemerintah yang dihasilkan

Array.name: UI_Subtitle_MartinTweed_IntroVideo_006
Array.english: has allowed us to launch even more happy explorers across undiscovered space.
Array.indonesia: telah memungkinkan kami meluncurkan lebih banyak lagi penjelajah yang bahagia ke seluruh ruang angkasa yang belum terjamah.

Array.name: UI_Subtitle_MartinTweed_IntroVideo_007
Array.english: As you continue to explore your wonderful new planet
Array.indonesia: Saat Anda terus menjelajahi planet baru yang menakjubkan ini,

Array.name: UI_Subtitle_MartinTweed_IntroVideo_008
Array.english: we hope that you'll carry the Kindred Value System in your heart
Array.indonesia: kami berharap Anda akan membawa Sistem Nilai Kindred di dalam hati Anda,

Array.name: UI_Subtitle_MartinTweed_IntroVideo_009
Array.english: and that one day it will be YOUR planet that will provide a future home for humanity!
Array.indonesia: dan suatu hari nanti planet ANDA-lah yang akan menjadi rumah masa depan bagi umat manusia!

Array.name: UI_Subtitle_MartinTweed_IntroVideo_010
Array.english: Onward to adventure!
Array.indonesia: Maju terus menuju petualangan!

Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hmm. Sepertinya kamu sudah siap untuk evaluasi restoran?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Jungle_SushiBar_GradeUP_Common_002
Array.english: <size=34>Alright, let's head over together.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Baiklah, ayo kita pergi bersama.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Jungle_SushiBar_GradeUP_BanchoGrill_001
Array.english: <size=32>I think it's about time to ask the village chief for a rating upgrade...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kurasa sudah waktunya meminta kepala desa untuk meningkatkan peringkat...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Jungle_SushiBar_GradeUP_BanchoGrill_002
Array.english: <size=32>I should invite him over for an evaluation.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku harus mengundangnya untuk evaluasi.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Desc_JDLC_Chief
Array.english: The village chief. He takes great pride in the village.
Array.indonesia: Kepala desa. Dia sangat bangga dengan desanya.

Array.name: NPC_Desc_JDLC_Muna
Array.english: Dr. Bacon's assistant. Capable, but a bit clumsy.
Array.indonesia: Asisten Dr. Bacon. Cakap, tapi agak ceroboh.

Array.name: NPC_Desc_JDLC_Rimbo
Array.english: The village driver. Often travels to the city for supplies.
Array.indonesia: Sopir desa. Sering bepergian ke kota untuk membeli persediaan.

Array.name: NPC_Desc_JDLC_Herbalist
Array.english: A woman who gathers herbs and spices. Always well-stocked for cooking.
Array.indonesia: Seorang wanita yang mengumpulkan rempah-rempah dan bumbu. Selalu memiliki persediaan yang cukup untuk memasak.

Array.name: NPC_Desc_JDLC_Fisherman
Array.english: A young fisherman who makes a living from the lake. Apparently, he can't swim.
Array.indonesia: Seorang nelayan muda yang mencari nafkah dari danau. Rupanya, dia tidak bisa berenang.

Array.name: NPC_Desc_JDLC_Carpenter
Array.english: The village carpenter. His arm is injured, so he needs help gathering materials.
Array.indonesia: Tukang kayu desa. Lengannya terluka, jadi dia butuh bantuan untuk mengumpulkan bahan-bahan.

Array.name: NPC_Desc_JDLC_Lipah
Array.english: A kind and beautiful young woman. She seems to love flowers and living things.
Array.indonesia: Seorang wanita muda yang baik hati dan cantik. Dia tampaknya menyukai bunga dan makhluk hidup.

Array.name: NPC_Desc_JDLC_Farmer_Rank0
Array.english: A farmer with somewhat intimidating eyes. He doesn't seem to have fond memories of outsiders.
Array.indonesia: Seorang petani dengan tatapan yang agak menakutkan. Ia tampaknya tidak memiliki kenangan indah tentang orang luar.

Array.name: NPC_Desc_JDLC_Farmer
Array.english: A village farmer. Very wary of outsiders.
Array.indonesia: Seorang petani desa. Sangat waspada terhadap orang luar.

Array.name: NPC_Desc_JDLC_Uzme
Array.english: The chief's daughter. Despite her strong build, she's gentle and kind.
Array.indonesia: Putri kepala desa. Meskipun bertubuh kekar, ia lembut dan baik hati.

Array.name: NPC_Desc_JDLC_Harta
Array.english: A friendly local guy. Doesn't really seem to do much, though.
Array.indonesia: Seorang pria lokal yang ramah. Namun, sepertinya ia tidak banyak berbuat apa-apa.

Array.name: NPC_Desc_JDLC_Gesang
Array.english: Very mindful of his wife Chandra. Looks like he wants to sneak off and have some fun.
Array.indonesia: Sangat memperhatikan istrinya, Chandra. Sepertinya dia ingin menyelinap pergi dan bersenang-senang.

Array.name: NPC_Desc_JDLC_Chandra
Array.english: A somewhat intimidating woman. She doesn't seem to fully trust her husband, Gesang.
Array.indonesia: Seorang wanita yang agak menakutkan. Dia tampaknya tidak sepenuhnya mempercayai suaminya, Gesang.

Array.name: NPC_Desc_JDLC_PoetryGirl
Array.english: A literary girl who loves books. Always carries a notebook to write poetry.
Array.indonesia: Seorang gadis sastrawan yang mencintai buku. Selalu membawa buku catatan untuk menulis puisi.

Array.name: NPC_Desc_JDLC_FlowerGrandma
Array.english: A kind-looking grandmother. She seems to adore flowers.
Array.indonesia: Seorang nenek yang tampak baik hati. Dia tampaknya sangat menyukai bunga.

Array.name: NPC_Desc_JDLC_YoungMan
Array.english: A young man absorbed in music. His coming-of-age ceremony is approaching.
Array.indonesia: Seorang pemuda yang asyik dengan musik. Upacara kedewasaannya semakin dekat.

Array.name: NPC_Desc_JDLC_YoungManAfter
Array.english: A young man who has completed his coming-of-age ceremony. Something about him... feels different.
Array.indonesia: Seorang pemuda yang telah menyelesaikan upacara kedewasaannya. Ada sesuatu tentang dirinya... yang terasa berbeda.

Array.name: NPC_Desc_JDLC_Princessy
Array.english: A young woman with a big misunderstanding. She keeps telling me to stop staring at her...
Array.indonesia: Seorang gadis muda yang mengalami kesalahpahaman besar. Dia terus-menerus menyuruhku untuk berhenti menatapnya...

Array.name: NPC_Desc_JDLC_BroSisMom
Array.english: Eka and Saniah's mother. She has a calm and gentle personality.
Array.indonesia: Ibu Eka dan Saniah. Dia memiliki kepribadian yang tenang dan lembut.

Array.name: NPC_Desc_JDLC_BroSisDad
Array.english: Eka and Saniah's father. The village blacksmith.
Array.indonesia: Ayah Eka dan Saniah. Pandai besi desa.

Array.name: NPC_Desc_JDLC_YoungManMom
Array.english: Jaka's mother. Raising him alone after losing her husband. She looks full of sorrow.
Array.indonesia: Ibu Jaka. Membesarkannya sendirian setelah kehilangan suaminya. Dia tampak penuh kesedihan.

Array.name: NPC_Desc_JDLC_KidBrother
Array.english: Saniah's older brother. Mischievous and acts like a leader.
Array.indonesia: Kakak laki-laki Saniah. Nakal dan suka bertingkah seperti pemimpin.

Array.name: NPC_Desc_JDLC_KidSister
Array.english: Eka's younger sister. An innocent and adorable little girl.
Array.indonesia: Adik perempuan Eka. Seorang gadis kecil yang polos dan menggemaskan.

Array.name: NPC_Desc_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Rank0
Array.english: Eka's friend. Tends to exaggerate when he talks.
Array.indonesia: Teman Eka. Sering melebih-lebihkan saat berbicara.

Array.name: NPC_Desc_JDLC_KidBroFriend
Array.english: Harta's son. Likes to brag a lot.
Array.indonesia: Anak laki-laki Harta. Suka sekali membual.

Array.name: NPC_Desc_JDLC_Marone
Array.english: A puppy found trapped in a pit in Setah Forest. Named him after a cartoon character.
Array.indonesia: Seekor anak anjing yang ditemukan terjebak di dalam lubang di Hutan Setah. Dia menamainya sesuai nama karakter kartun.

Array.name: UI_Jungle_SushiBer_Research_Empty
Array.english: *Let's upgrade the Restaurant!\n*More villagers will start coming.
Array.indonesia: *Ayo tingkatkan Restoran!\n*Akan ada lebih banyak penduduk desa yang datang.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Perfect_Chief
Array.english: That was excellent!
Array.indonesia: Itu luar biasa!

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Good_Chief
Array.english: Pretty decent.
Array.indonesia: Cukup bagus.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Soso_Chief
Array.english: Not bad.
Array.indonesia: Lumayan.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Angry_Chief
Array.english: Hmm... how rude.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... kasar sekali.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Perfect_Muna
Array.english: Heh... it was really good though... hehe.
Array.indonesia: Heh... padahal rasanya enak banget... hehe.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Good_Muna
Array.english: Mmm... that was good.
Array.indonesia: Mmm... enak sekali.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Soso_Muna
Array.english: Not bad at all.
Array.indonesia: Tidak buruk sama sekali.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Angry_Muna
Array.english: Tired from all that diving?
Array.indonesia: Lelah setelah menyelam-selam tadi?

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Perfect_Rimbo
Array.english: That was mighty tasty.
Array.indonesia: Itu sangat lezat.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Good_Rimbo
Array.english: Better than what I had in the city.
Array.indonesia: Lebih enak daripada yang aku makan di kota.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Soso_Rimbo
Array.english: Not bad, I reckon.
Array.indonesia: Lumayan, menurutku.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Angry_Rimbo
Array.english: A bit disappointin', this one.
Array.indonesia: Yang ini agak mengecewakan.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Perfect_Herbalist
Array.english: The aroma was quite nice.
Array.indonesia: Aromanya cukup enak.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Good_Herbalist
Array.english: Good use of herbs and spices.
Array.indonesia: Bumbu dan rempah-rempahnya digunakan dengan baik.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Soso_Herbalist
Array.english: Not bad, but... hmm.
Array.indonesia: Lumayan, tapi... hmm.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Angry_Herbalist
Array.english: Feels like I came for nothing today.
Array.indonesia: Rasanya aku datang ke sini sia-sia hari ini.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Perfect_Fisherman
Array.english: Was fish from our lake always this tasty?
Array.indonesia: Apakah ikan dari danau kita selalu seenak ini?

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Good_Fisherman
Array.english: Wow... those flavors are somethin' else.
Array.indonesia: Wow... rasanya benar-benar luar biasa.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Soso_Fisherman
Array.english: Well, it was edible, I reckon.
Array.indonesia: Yah, menurutku masih bisa dimakan.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Angry_Fisherman
Array.english: I'd rather just catch and eat my own fish.
Array.indonesia: Aku lebih suka menangkap dan memakan ikanku sendiri.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Perfect_Carpenter
Array.english: Oh... yeah, that's good.
Array.indonesia: Oh... ya, ini enak.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Good_Carpenter
Array.english: Didn't expect much, but... pretty tasty.
Array.indonesia: Awalnya nggak berharap banyak, tapi... lumayan enak.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Soso_Carpenter
Array.english: Hmm... nothing special.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... nggak ada yang istimewa.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Angry_Carpenter
Array.english: What a waste of time.
Array.indonesia: Buang-buang waktu saja.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Perfect_Lipah
Array.english: Wow! That was really good.
Array.indonesia: Wow! Itu benar-benar enak.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Good_Lipah
Array.english: Food from outside is tasty too...!
Array.indonesia: Makanan dari luar juga enak...!

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_SoSo_Lipah
Array.english: Hmm... I think village food might be better...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... kayaknya makanan desa lebih enak...

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Angry_Lipah
Array.english: Hmm... feels like a letdown.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... rasanya mengecewakan.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Perfect_Farmer
Array.english: No complaints here, that was good.
Array.indonesia: Nggak ada keluhan, itu enak.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Good_Farmer
Array.english: Well... it was good enough to come back next time.
Array.indonesia: Yah... rasanya cukup enak buat bikin aku balik lagi lain kali.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_SoSo_Farmer
Array.english: Filled me up, at least.
Array.indonesia: Setidaknya bikin aku kenyang.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Angry_Farmer
Array.english: If this is it, just close the shop!
Array.indonesia: Kalau cuma begini, mending tutup aja tokonya!

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Perfect_Uzme
Array.english: Ah... that stirred something in me.
Array.indonesia: Ah... itu bikin aku tergerak.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Good_Uzme
Array.english: It was good...!
Array.indonesia: Enak banget...!

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_SoSo_Uzme
Array.english: Not the best, but it was okay.
Array.indonesia: Bukan yang terbaik, tapi lumayan.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Angry_Uzme
Array.english: Hmm... how is this even possible...?!
Array.indonesia: Hmm... gimana bisa begini...?!

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Perfect_Harta
Array.english: Wow... that was really tasty.
Array.indonesia: Wow... itu benar-benar enak.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Good_Harta
Array.english: Chef, you're pretty good!
Array.indonesia: Koki, kamu lumayan jago!

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_SoSo_Harta
Array.english: Hmm... not really my thing.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... bukan seleraku sih.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Angry_Harta
Array.english: Ugh... came all this way for nothing. Tsk.
Array.indonesia: Ugh... jauh-jauh datang ke sini ternyata sia-sia. Ckck.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Perfect_Gesang
Array.english: That was really good...
Array.indonesia: Itu benar-benar enak...

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Good_Gesang
Array.english: Worth the trip, haha.
Array.indonesia: Layak dikunjungi, haha.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_SoSo_Gesang
Array.english: Hmm... a bit disappointing...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... agak mengecewakan...

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Angry_Gesang
Array.english: Did I come all this way for this?
Array.indonesia: Apa aku datang jauh-jauh ke sini cuma buat ini?

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Perfect_Chandra
Array.english: So foreign food can taste this good?
Array.indonesia: Jadi, makanan asing bisa seenak ini?

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Good_Chandra
Array.english: Worth coming back once in a while.
Array.indonesia: Layak dikunjungi sesekali.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_SoSo_Chandra
Array.english: What I make at home tastes better.
Array.indonesia: Masakan yang aku buat di rumah lebih enak.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Angry_Chandra
Array.english: Ugh... I'm busy, why did I come.
Array.indonesia: Ugh... aku sibuk, kenapa sih aku datang.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Perfect_PoetryGirl
Array.english: It felt like sunshine spreading through my mouth!
Array.indonesia: Rasanya seperti sinar matahari yang menyebar di mulutku!

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Good_PoetryGirl
Array.english: This makes me want to write a poem.
Array.indonesia: Ini membuatku ingin menulis puisi.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_SoSo_PoetryGirl
Array.english: Hmm... a bit bland...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... agak hambar...

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Angry_PoetryGirl
Array.english: Hmm... it'll be better next time, right?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... pasti akan lebih enak lain kali, kan?

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Perfect_FlowerGrandma
Array.english: Thank you for such a lovely meal.
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih atas hidangan yang begitu lezat.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Good_FlowerGrandma
Array.english: That was delicious. I'll have to come back.
Array.indonesia: Itu enak sekali. Aku harus datang lagi.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_SoSo_FlowerGrandma
Array.english: The taste wasn't bad.
Array.indonesia: Rasanya lumayan.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Angry_FlowerGrandma
Array.english: Waiting gets a bit harder as you get older.
Array.indonesia: Semakin tua, semakin sulit menunggu.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Perfect_YoungMan
Array.english: You guys can really cook. Wow.
Array.indonesia: Kalian benar-benar jago masak. Wow.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Good_YoungMan
Array.english: Oh... you're pretty good.
Array.indonesia: Oh... kamu lumayan bagus.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_SoSo_YoungMan
Array.english: Hmm... not quite what I expected.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... tidak seperti yang kuharapkan.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Angry_YoungMan
Array.english: Should've just practiced instead.
Array.indonesia: Seharusnya aku berlatih saja.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Perfect_Princessy
Array.english: You didn't make mine extra tasty on purpose, did you?
Array.indonesia: Kamu tidak sengaja membuat masakanku lebih enak, kan?

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Good_Princessy
Array.english: It had such an elegant flavor. Very fitting.
Array.indonesia: Rasanya sangat elegan. Sangat pas.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_SoSo_Princessy
Array.english: Hmm... is this what foreign food is like?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... apakah makanan asing memang seperti ini?

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Angry_Princessy
Array.english: Making me wait like that. How rude!
Array.indonesia: Membuatku menunggu seperti itu. Sungguh tidak sopan!

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Perfect_BroSisMom
Array.english: That felt really warm and comforting.
Array.indonesia: Rasanya sangat hangat dan menenangkan.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Good_BroSisMom
Array.english: You're really good at cooking.
Array.indonesia: Kamu benar-benar jago masak.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_SoSo_BroSisMom
Array.english: I'm full. Thank you.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah kenyang. Terima kasih.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Angry_BroSisMom
Array.english: Hmm... you must've been really busy...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... kamu pasti sangat sibuk...

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Perfect_BroSisDad
Array.english: Wow... you guys can cook, huh?
Array.indonesia: Wah... kalian bisa masak, ya?

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Good_BroSisDad
Array.english: That was good. Nice meal.
Array.indonesia: Itu enak. Makanannya enak.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_SoSo_BroSisDad
Array.english: Food just needs to fill you up.
Array.indonesia: Makanan itu cuma buat ngisi perut aja.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Angry_BroSisDad
Array.english: I'm starving and came here for nothing.
Array.indonesia: Aku lapar banget dan datang ke sini sia-sia.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Perfect_YoungManMom
Array.english: That was really delicious... thank you...
Array.indonesia: Itu benar-benar enak... terima kasih...

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Good_YoungManMom
Array.english: You're really skilled...
Array.indonesia: Kalian benar-benar jago...

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_SoSo_YoungManMom
Array.english: Thanks for the meal. I'll come again.
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih atas makanannya. Aku akan datang lagi.

Array.name: Talk_Sushibar_Feedback_Angry_YoungManMom
Array.english: I guess I came when you were too busy...
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya aku datang saat kalian sedang terlalu sibuk...

Array.name: Mission_Group_Name_410018018
Array.english: Opening the Sea People Settlement
Array.indonesia: Membuka Pemukiman Suku Laut

Array.name: Mission_Group_Name_410018019
Array.english: Muna's Bomb Preparation
Array.indonesia: Persiapan Bom Muna

Array.name: Mission_Group_Name_410010020
Array.english: Bombs Away
Array.indonesia: Lempar Bom

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410058069
Array.english: The Sea People said they'd clear the path they'd blocked with rocks, right? Let's wait until tomorrow.
Array.indonesia: Suku Laut bilang mereka akan membersihkan jalan yang mereka blokir dengan batu, kan? Ayo kita tunggu sampai besok.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410010020
Array.english: I need to drive the Basilosaurus away from the gate!
Array.indonesia: Aku harus mengusir Basilosaurus dari gerbang!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410058074
Array.english: They said they'd have the <color=#4AFFDB>mini bomb</color> ready by tomorrow, right? Let's look around the village while we wait.
Array.indonesia: Mereka bilang <color=#4AFFDB>bom mini</color> akan siap besok, kan? Ayo kita kelilingi desa sambil menunggu.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050075
Array.english: I need to toss a mini bomb into the Basilosaurus's mouth to scare it off!
Array.indonesia: Aku harus melemparkan bom mini ke dalam mulut Basilosaurus untuk menakut-nakutinya!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050076
Array.english: Ugh... stuck inside a dinosaur... it's damp and the stench is awful. Let's head up like Muna said.
Array.indonesia: Ugh... terjebak di dalam tubuh dinosaurus... lembap dan baunya mengerikan. Ayo naik ke atas seperti yang dikatakan Muna.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050077
Array.english: We said we'd plant the bomb away from the heart, right? Let's find a good spot.
Array.indonesia: Kita kan sudah sepakat untuk menanam bom jauh dari jantungnya, kan? Ayo cari tempat yang bagus.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050078
Array.english: I need to get as far from the bomb as possible.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus menjauh sejauh mungkin dari bom itu.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050079
Array.english: Whoa... everything's a complete mess...! I need to get out of here now!
Array.indonesia: Wah... semuanya berantakan banget...! Aku harus segera keluar dari sini!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050080
Array.english: The crocodiles are heading straight for Dave! I have to save him!
Array.indonesia: Buaya-buaya itu langsung menyerang Dave! Aku harus menyelamatkannya!

Array.name: Mission_Condition_410038066
Array.english: Wait until tomorrow
Array.indonesia: Tunggu sampai besok

Array.name: Mission_Condition_410038071
Array.english: Wait until tomorrow
Array.indonesia: Tunggu sampai besok

Array.name: Mission_Condition_410038072
Array.english: Go outside
Array.indonesia: Keluar ke luar

Array.name: Mission_Condition_410030072
Array.english: Approach the deep-sea dinosaur
Array.indonesia: Dekati dinosaurus laut dalam

Array.name: Mission_Condition_410030073
Array.english: Head up to the heart chamber
Array.indonesia: Naik ke ruang jantung

Array.name: Mission_Condition_410030074
Array.english: Plant the bomb
Array.indonesia: Pasang bom

Array.name: Mission_Condition_410030075
Array.english: Get away from the bomb
Array.indonesia: Jauhi bom

Array.name: Mission_Condition_410030076
Array.english: Escape the heart chamber
Array.indonesia: Melarikan diri dari ruang jantung

Array.name: Mission_Condition_410030077
Array.english: Defeat the crocodiles
Array.indonesia: Kalahkan buaya-buaya itu

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_BeetleBattleEnter02
Array.english: <size=24>You can use up to 2 <color=#F1DC2B>jellies</color> in a battle.\nUse them at the right moment to turn the fight in your favor!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Kamu bisa menggunakan hingga 2 <color=#F1DC2B>jelly</color> dalam pertempuran.\nGunakanlah pada saat yang tepat untuk membalikkan keadaan pertempuran demi keuntungamu!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_ExtraCharm
Array.english: <size=24>The power of the spirits has unlocked an extra charm slot!\nYou can now equip up to 3 charms.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Kekuatan roh telah membuka slot jimat tambahan!\nKini kamu bisa melengkapi hingga 3 jimat.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_InsectJelly01
Array.english: <size=24>A variety of <color=#F1DC2B>jellies</color> are now in stock at Udo's Shop!\nEach <color=#F1DC2B>jelly</color> has its own effect in the Beetle Battle.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Berbagai macam <color=#F1DC2B>jelly</color> kini tersedia di Toko Udo!\nSetiap <color=#F1DC2B>jelly</color> memiliki efeknya masing-masing dalam Pertempuran Kumbang.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_InsectJelly_BossBattle
Array.english: <size=24>In a boss battle, each insect can eat up to 2 <color=#F1DC2B>jellies</color>.\nHowever, a <color=#F1DC2B>jelly</color>'s effect only activates while that insect is in battle.\nUse <color=#F1DC2B>jellies</color> at the right moment to claim victory!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Dalam pertarungan bos, setiap serangga dapat memakan hingga 2 <color=#F1DC2B>jelly</color>.\nNamun, efek <color=#F1DC2B>jelly</color> hanya aktif selama serangga tersebut sedang bertarung.\nGunakan <color=#F1DC2B>jelly</color> pada saat yang tepat untuk meraih kemenangan!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_Spirits01
Array.english: <size=24>Place spirits in each area, and they will bring you that area's ingredients every morning.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Tempatkan roh di setiap area, dan mereka akan membawakanmu bahan-bahan dari area tersebut setiap pagi.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_Spirits02
Array.english: <size=24>The amount of ingredients a spirit brings back depends on its <color=#F1DC2B>condition</color>. \nRestore its health with the mutant fruit it likes!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Jumlah bahan yang dibawa pulang oleh roh bergantung pada <color=#F1DC2B>kondisinya</color>. \nPulihkan kesehatannya dengan buah mutan yang disukainya!</size>

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052072
Array.english: Leave the giant boar alone and it'll keep raiding the village. Let's hunt it down in the forest!
Array.indonesia: Jika babi hutan raksasa itu dibiarkan begitu saja, ia akan terus menyerang desa. Ayo kita buru dia di hutan!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052073
Array.english: Whoa... it looks furious...! Better be careful...!
Array.indonesia: Wah... kelihatannya sangat marah...! Lebih baik berhati-hati...!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052074
Array.english: Phew... that boar was tough. I'd better go tell Rimbo.
Array.indonesia: Fiuh... babi hutan itu tangguh. Sebaiknya aku memberitahu Rimbo.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052873
Array.english: It won't be raiding the village anymore, right? Let's take the broken tusk to Rimbo to celebrate our victory.
Array.indonesia: Ia tidak akan menyerang desa lagi, kan? Ayo bawa taring yang patah itu ke Rimbo untuk merayakan kemenangan kita.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410054143
Array.english: The spirits are lost at the lake... I'd better go save them.
Array.indonesia: Roh-roh tersesat di danau... Sebaiknya aku pergi menyelamatkan mereka.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410054144
Array.english: The spirit chief said he had a favor to ask, right? Let's head over to Surga Falls.
Array.indonesia: Kepala roh bilang dia punya permintaan, kan? Ayo kita pergi ke Air Terjun Surga.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410059239
Array.english: The spirits who went to investigate the strange happenings at the lake haven't come back... I'd better go find them!
Array.indonesia: Roh-roh yang pergi menyelidiki kejadian aneh di danau belum kembali... Sebaiknya aku pergi mencarinya!
