Array.name: UI_Merchant_Herbalist_Shop_Talk_001
Array.english: Herbs and spices are essential for cooking.
Array.indonesia: Tanaman herbal dan rempah-rempah sangat penting dalam memasak.

Array.name: UI_Merchant_Herbalist_Shop_Talk_002
Array.english: Different kinds of plants grow in the village and the forest.
Array.indonesia: Berbagai jenis tanaman tumbuh di desa dan hutan.

Array.name: UI_Merchant_Herbalist_Shop_Talk_003
Array.english: There are herbs and spices \nyou'd easily mistake for weeds \nand pass by.
Array.indonesia: Ada tanaman herbal dan rempah-rempah \nyang mudah disalahartikan sebagai gulma \ndan terlewatkan begitu saja.

Array.name: UI_Merchant_Herbalist_Shop_Talk_004
Array.english: This area has plenty of high-quality herbs.
Array.indonesia: Daerah ini memiliki banyak rempah-rempah berkualitas tinggi.

Array.name: UI_Merchant_Rimbo_Shop_Talk_001
Array.english: Some villagers like items from \nthe city, too.
Array.indonesia: Beberapa penduduk desa juga menyukai barang-barang dari \nkota.

Array.name: UI_Merchant_Rimbo_Shop_Talk_002
Array.english: Each villager's got their own tastes.
Array.indonesia: Setiap penduduk desa punya selera masing-masing.

Array.name: UI_Merchant_Rimbo_Shop_Talk_003
Array.english: Hard-to-get items cost a bit more, ya know.
Array.indonesia: Barang-barang yang sulit didapat harganya sedikit lebih mahal, lho.

Array.name: UI_Merchant_Rimbo_Shop_Talk_004
Array.english: Been stockin' some popular items lately.
Array.indonesia: Akhir-akhir ini aku sudah menyetok beberapa barang populer.

Array.name: UI_Merchant_Farmer_Shop_Talk_001
Array.english: I've got seeds you can plant in your garden.
Array.indonesia: Aku punya benih yang bisa kamu tanam di kebunmu.

Array.name: UI_Merchant_Farmer_Shop_Talk_002
Array.english: Plants grow really fast here!
Array.indonesia: Tanaman tumbuh sangat cepat di sini!

Array.name: UI_Merchant_Farmer_Shop_Talk_003
Array.english: Seeds are dirt cheap compared to fruit.
Array.indonesia: Benih harganya sangat murah dibandingkan buah.

Array.name: UI_Merchant_Lipah_Shop_Talk_001
Array.english: If you catch any rare lizards, please bring them to me.
Array.indonesia: Jika kamu menangkap kadal langka, tolong bawa ke aku.

Array.name: UI_Merchant_Lipah_Shop_Talk_002
Array.english: Big Eyed lizards only live in this region.
Array.indonesia: Kadal Mata Besar hanya hidup di wilayah ini.

Array.name: UI_Merchant_Lipah_Shop_Talk_003
Array.english: Big Eyed lizards are timid, so you need to approach them slowly.
Array.indonesia: Kadal Bermata Besar itu pemalu, jadi kamu harus mendekatinya perlahan.

Array.name: UI_Merchant_Lipah_Shop_Talk_004
Array.english: There are several kinds of big-eyed lizards.
Array.indonesia: Ada beberapa jenis kadal Bermata Besar.

Array.name: UI_Merchant_Peneb_Shop_Talk_001
Array.english: Bring me materials and some Doni, \nI'll whip it up quick. Hehe.
Array.indonesia: Bawakan aku bahan-bahan dan sedikit Doni, \naku akan segera menyelesaikannya. Hehe.

Array.name: UI_Merchant_Peneb_Shop_Talk_002
Array.english: Shop's looking a bit empty... \nShould spruce it up a bit, eh?
Array.indonesia: Toko ini terlihat agak sepi... \nSepertinya perlu sedikit dipercantik, ya?

Array.name: UI_Merchant_Peneb_Shop_Talk_003
Array.english: Don't you worry about my arm.
Array.indonesia: Jangan khawatir soal lenganku.

Array.name: UI_Merchant_Peneb_Shop_Talk_004
Array.english: Need to upgrade your axe or pickaxe? Go see Perak.
Array.indonesia: Perlu meningkatkan kapak atau beliungmu? Temui Perak.

Array.name: LoadingTip_JungleLobby_001
Array.english: In Utara Village, time flows in real time. Use the pause function when you need a moment to think.
Array.indonesia: Di Desa Utara, waktu berjalan secara real-time. Gunakan fungsi jeda jika Anda membutuhkan waktu sejenak untuk berpikir.

Array.name: LoadingTip_JungleLobby_002
Array.english: Each villager has their own favorite foods and gifts.
Array.indonesia: Setiap penduduk desa memiliki makanan dan hadiah favorit masing-masing.

Array.name: LoadingTip_JungleLobby_003
Array.english: As you explore the village, you can gather various items.
Array.indonesia: Saat menjelajahi desa, Anda dapat mengumpulkan berbagai barang.

Array.name: LoadingTip_JungleLobby_004
Array.english: You might find useful items inside villagers' homes.
Array.indonesia: Anda mungkin menemukan barang-barang berguna di dalam rumah penduduk desa.

Array.name: LoadingTip_JungleLobby_005
Array.english: Some creatures only appear when it rains.
Array.indonesia: Beberapa makhluk hanya muncul saat hujan.

Array.name: LoadingTip_JungleLobby_006
Array.english: When it rains, fruit color mutations happen more often in Jepun's Garden.
Array.indonesia: Saat hujan, mutasi warna buah lebih sering terjadi di Kebun Jepun.

Array.name: LoadingTip_JungleLobbyNight_001
Array.english: At night, you may find plants and insects that don't appear during the day.
Array.indonesia: Pada malam hari, kamu mungkin menemukan tumbuhan dan serangga yang tidak muncul pada siang hari.

Array.name: LoadingTip_JungleSushi_001
Array.english: Cooking with ingredients villagers like will raise their affinity.
Array.indonesia: Memasak dengan bahan-bahan yang disukai penduduk desa akan meningkatkan kedekatanmu dengan mereka.

Array.name: LoadingTip_JungleSushi_002
Array.english: If you've ever burned your skewers... try placing them on the holding rack for a bit.
Array.indonesia: Jika tusuk sate-mu pernah gosong... coba letakkan di rak penahan sebentar.

Array.name: LoadingTip_JungleSushi_003
Array.english: If a customer orders both a dish and skewers, serve one first to buy time.
Array.indonesia: Jika ada pelanggan yang memesan hidangan dan sate sekaligus, sajikan salah satunya terlebih dahulu untuk mengulur waktu.

Array.name: LoadingTip_JungleSushi_004
Array.english: If skewers sit on the holding rack too long, they'll cool down and lose flavor.
Array.indonesia: Jika sate dibiarkan terlalu lama di rak penampung, sate akan mendingin dan kehilangan rasanya.

Array.name: LoadingTip_JungleSushi_005
Array.english: When all seats are full, villagers will line up and wait. Only until closing time, of course.
Array.indonesia: Saat semua tempat duduk terisi penuh, penduduk desa akan mengantri dan menunggu. Tentu saja, hanya sampai waktu tutup.

Array.name: LoadingTip_JungleSushi_006
Array.english: Collected ingredients are automatically added to your inventory.
Array.indonesia: Bahan-bahan yang dikumpulkan akan secara otomatis ditambahkan ke inventaris Anda.

Array.name: LoadingTip_JungleBeach_001
Array.english: You can return to the Blue Hole by heading to the beach with Rimbo.
Array.indonesia: Anda bisa kembali ke Blue Hole dengan pergi ke pantai bersama Rimbo.

Array.name: LoadingTip_JungleBeach_002
Array.english: The jungle is dangerous at night. Even a skilled driver like Rimbo won't leave the village.
Array.indonesia: Hutan sangat berbahaya di malam hari. Bahkan pengemudi terampil seperti Rimbo pun tidak akan meninggalkan desa.

Array.name: LoadingTip_JungleDive_001
Array.english: The Jungle Gun can change into various forms. Use <image=InGame.MetaGunChange, preset=Dialogue_KR/> to switch forms as needed!
Array.indonesia: Jungle Gun dapat berubah menjadi berbagai bentuk. Gunakan <image=InGame.MetaGunChange, preset=Dialogue_KR/> untuk mengganti bentuk sesuai kebutuhan!

Array.name: LoadingTip_JungleDive_002
Array.english: The lake is full of hydrogen sulfide, so you'll need a purification filter to operate.\nKeep an eye on the filter's remaining capacity!
Array.indonesia: Danau ini penuh dengan hidrogen sulfida, jadi kamu memerlukan filter pemurni untuk beroperasi.\nPerhatikan sisa kapasitas filternya!

Array.name: LoadingTip_JungleDive_003
Array.english: To call the escape pod, cut the coconuts tied underwater and let them float to the surface
Array.indonesia: Untuk memanggil kapsul penyelamat, potong kelapa yang diikat di bawah air dan biarkan mengapung ke permukaan

Array.name: LoadingTip_JungleLobbyNight_002
Array.english: Nighttime is when you can hear stories from the villagers. Don't miss out! Go take a look around.
Array.indonesia: Pada malam hari, kamu bisa mendengarkan cerita dari penduduk desa. Jangan sampai ketinggalan! Cobalah berkeliling.

Array.name: LoadingTip_JungleDive_004
Array.english: To take on tougher fish, you'll need a stronger weapon. Ask Muna to upgrade your Jungle Gun!
Array.indonesia: Untuk menghadapi ikan yang lebih tangguh, kamu memerlukan senjata yang lebih kuat. Minta Muna untuk meningkatkan Jungle Gun-mu!

Array.name: LoadingTip_JungleDive_103_01
Array.english: Use the Machete to clear paths blocked by vines.
Array.indonesia: Gunakan Machete untuk membersihkan jalur yang terhalang oleh tanaman merambat.

Array.name: LoadingTip_JungleDive_104_01
Array.english: Fire your Hook Gun at the rings placed around the lake to move around quickly!
Array.indonesia: Tembakkan Hook Gun ke cincin-cincin yang dipasang di sekeliling danau untuk berpindah tempat dengan cepat!

Array.name: LoadingTip_JungleDive_111_01
Array.english: A Jungle Gun with armor-piercing upgrades can even punch through an ammonite's tough shell.
Array.indonesia: Senapan Hutan dengan peningkatan peluru penembus armor bahkan bisa menembus cangkang keras ammonit.

Array.name: LoadingTip_JungleDive_111_02
Array.english: Harvesting an ammonite can restore a small amount of oxygen.
Array.indonesia: Memanen ammonit dapat memulihkan sedikit oksigen.

Array.name: LoadingTip_JungleDive_112_01
Array.english: You can deal damage to a Stylonurus hiding on the seafloor by dropping a trilobite on it.
Array.indonesia: Kamu bisa memberikan kerusakan pada Stylonurus yang bersembunyi di dasar laut dengan menjatuhkan trilobit ke atasnya.

Array.name: LoadingTip_JungleForest_001
Array.english: Approach enemies first and press <image=Dave.Interaction, preset=ContentsGuide_KR/> to perform a preemptive strike.
Array.indonesia: Dekati musuh terlebih dahulu dan tekan <image=Dave.Interaction, preset=ContentsGuide_KR/> untuk melakukan serangan mendahului.

Array.name: LoadingTip_JungleForest_002
Array.english: When an exclamation mark appears just before an enemy attack, press <image=UI.Ok, preset=ContentsGuide_KR/> to greatly reduce the damage.
Array.indonesia: Saat tanda seru muncul tepat sebelum serangan musuh, tekan <image=UI.Ok, preset=ContentsGuide_KR/> untuk mengurangi kerusakan secara signifikan.

Array.name: LoadingTip_JungleForest_003
Array.english: When attacking, time your press of <image=UI.Ok, preset=ContentsGuide_KR/> with the exclamation mark to deal extra damage.
Array.indonesia: Saat menyerang, atur waktu penekanan <image=UI.Ok, preset=ContentsGuide_KR/> agar bertepatan dengan tanda seru untuk memberikan kerusakan tambahan.

Array.name: LoadingTip_JungleForest_004
Array.english: Resting at a campfire restores both HP and AP.
Array.indonesia: Beristirahat di api unggun akan memulihkan HP dan AP.

Array.name: LoadingTip_JungleForest_005
Array.english: At a campfire, you can cook recovery items. Prepare some in advance to get ready for battle.
Array.indonesia: Di api unggun, kamu bisa memasak item pemulihan. Siapkan beberapa item terlebih dahulu agar siap bertempur.

Array.name: LoadingTip_JungleForest_006
Array.english: Some enemies wind up for a big attack. Brace yourself with a guard to reduce the damage!
Array.indonesia: Beberapa musuh akan mengayunkan senjata untuk serangan besar. Bersiaplah dengan posisi bertahan untuk mengurangi kerusakan!

Array.name: LoadingTip_JungleForest_007
Array.english: Chests contain tools that can help you on your journey. Don't miss them - check inside!
Array.indonesia: Peti harta karun berisi alat-alat yang dapat membantumu dalam perjalanan. Jangan lewatkan — periksa isinya!

Array.name: LoadingTip_JungleForest_008
Array.english: You can use a Kola Nut to revive a knocked-out companion.
Array.indonesia: Kamu bisa menggunakan Kola Nut untuk menghidupkan kembali rekan yang pingsan.

Array.name: LoadingTip_JungleForest_009
Array.english: You can save anytime using your phone while exploring the forest.
Array.indonesia: Kamu bisa menyimpan permainan kapan saja menggunakan ponselmu saat menjelajahi hutan.

Array.name: LoadingTip_JungleDungeon_001
Array.english: Use the elevator to quickly travel to any floor you want.
Array.indonesia: Gunakan lift untuk berpindah dengan cepat ke lantai mana pun yang kamu inginkan.

Array.name: Skip_Morning_popup
Array.english: Skip time?\nYou'll head to the restaurant to open up.
Array.indonesia: Lewati waktu?\nKamu akan pergi ke restoran untuk membukanya.

Array.name: UI_Jungle_Craft_Upgrade_Pick_Desc_01
Array.english: A standard pickaxe made of tin. Lightweight and suitable for simple mining.

Array.name: UI_Jungle_Craft_Upgrade_Pick_Desc_02

Array.indonesia: Palu tambang yang disempurnakan dari besi hitam. Daya tahan dan kekuatan yang ditingkatkan.

Array.indonesia: Kapak dasar yang terbuat dari timah. Ringan, sehingga cocok untuk menebang kayu.

Array.name: UI_Jungle_Craft_Upgrade_Ax_Desc_02

Array.indonesia: Kapak yang diperkuat yang terbuat dari besi hitam. Daya potongnya yang ditingkatkan meningkatkan efisiensi kerja.

Array.name: UI_Jungle_Craft_Upgrade_Ax_Desc_03
Array.english: A sturdy axe made of silver. Its durability and cutting speed have been improved.
Array.indonesia: Kapak kokoh yang terbuat dari perak. Daya tahan dan kecepatan potongnya telah ditingkatkan.

Array.name: UI_Jungle_Craft_Upgrade_Ax_Desc_04

Array.english: If you don't like an item, try <color=#F1DC2B>Reordering</color> it.

Array.name: NPC_BaconLab_Talk_Buy03
Array.english: That should come in handy underwater!
Array.indonesia: Itu pasti berguna di bawah air!

Array.name: NPC_BaconLab_Talk_Buy04
Array.english: Thanks!\nI'll put this Doni toward my research!
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih!\nAku akan menggunakan Doni ini untuk penelitianku!

Array.name: NPC_BaconLab_Talk_Buy05
Array.english: Well done! I refresh my items daily,\nso be sure to stop by again!
Array.indonesia: Bagus sekali! Aku memperbarui barang-barangku setiap hari,\njadi pastikan untuk mampir lagi!

Array.name: dialog_ShotGun_New_Get
Array.english: Oooh, a <color=#1DFEAF>Triple Axel</color>, huh. This wild horse can finish enemies with just three bullets at close range.
Array.indonesia: Oooh, <color=#1DFEAF>Triple Axel</color>, ya. Senjata liar ini bisa menghabisi musuh hanya dengan tiga peluru dari jarak dekat.

Array.name: dialog_SniperGun_New_Get
Array.english: *Huff* The Red Angel of War…penetrates targets marked with its laser sight, lies here..
Array.indonesia: *Huff* Malaikat Perang Merah… menembus target yang ditandai dengan bidik lasernya, ada di sini..

Array.name: dialog_PowerRifle_New_Get
Array.english: Wow, such a demonic tool in a place like this! Have a taste of it and you can never go back to ordinary rifles, hah.
Array.indonesia: Wow, senjata yang begitu mengerikan di tempat seperti ini! Coba rasakan sendiri dan kamu tidak akan pernah bisa kembali ke senapan biasa, hah.

Array.name: dialog_SleepGun_New_Get
Array.english: The non-lethal tranquilizer gun <color=#1DFEAF>Hush Dart</color>...Successfully tranquilized fish can be sold expensively... you could say.
Array.indonesia: Senapan bius non-mematikan <color=#1DFEAF>Hush Dart</color>...Successfully, ikan yang dibius bisa dijual dengan harga mahal… bisa dibilang begitu.

Array.name: dialog_GrenadeLauncher_New_Get
Array.english: That’s an MSGL-type launcher. Whoops, the technical jargon just slipped out of me. It’s a <color=#1DFEAF>multi-shot grenade launcher</color> with a whole lot of firepower.
Array.indonesia: Itu peluncur tipe MSGL. Ups, istilah teknisnya tanpa sengaja terucap. Itu adalah <color=#1DFEAF>peluncur granat multi-tembakan</color> dengan daya tembak yang sangat besar.

Array.name: dialog_NetGun_New_Get
Array.english: Oooh! To think you’ve found the <color=#1DFEAF>Net Gun</color>...It’s specialized for capturing live fish. I’m looking forward to tonight’s sales... you could say.
Array.indonesia: Oooh! Siapa sangka kamu menemukan <color=#1DFEAF>Net Gun</color>...Itu khusus untuk menangkap ikan hidup. Aku menantikan penjualan malam ini... bisa dibilang begitu.

Array.name: dialog_StickyBombGun_New_Get
Array.english: That one has a death-like grip...It turns the surroundings into a burning hellscape…That’s a cursed Soul Gun in your hands...
Array.indonesia: Senjata itu memiliki cengkeraman yang mematikan... Ia mengubah lingkungan sekitar menjadi neraka yang membara… Itu adalah Soul Gun terkutuk di tanganmu...

Array.name: dialog_UziSMG_New_Get
Array.english: A superstar among submachineguns with a superb rate of fire.\nFound a gem!
Array.indonesia: Bintang di antara senapan mesin ringan dengan laju tembakan yang luar biasa.\nMenemukan permata!

Array.name: dialog_IceGun_New_Get
Array.english: Whoa...A bone-chilling gun that can freeze anything...!\nA shiver runs down my spine.
Array.indonesia: Wah... Senjata yang membuat merinding yang bisa membekukan apa saja...!\nSebuah getaran dingin menjalar di tulang punggungku.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Normal_DrainGun_New_Get
Array.english: Hmm? A strange weapon. It looks like it could even suck up souls…
Array.indonesia: Hmm? Senjata yang aneh. Sepertinya bahkan bisa menyedot jiwa…

Array.english: "I’m nobody’s inferior, in both work skills and looks. Haha!"

Array.english: "I like this place. I want to try working here."
Array.indonesia: "Aku suka tempat ini. Aku ingin mencoba bekerja di sini."

Array.name: dialog_Staff_HireCompleted_Yusuke
Array.english: "Finally, a chance to show you the results of my training."

Array.english: "Ugh... uh…"

Array.name: dialog_Staff_HireCompleted_Tohoku

Array.name: dialog_Staff_HireCompleted_Yone
Array.english: "I’ll show you what spicy work looks like!"
Array.indonesia: "Aku akan tunjukkan seperti apa kerja yang seru itu!"

Array.name: dialog_Staff_HireCompleted_Elnino
Array.english: "Speed and finesse are key."
Array.indonesia: "Kecepatan dan keahlian adalah kuncinya."

Array.name: dialog_Staff_HireCompleted_11
Array.english: "I’ll stick meticulously to principle."
Array.indonesia: "Aku akan berpegang teguh pada prinsip."

Array.name: dialog_Staff_HireCompleted_12
Array.english: "I’ll show you I’m still going strong."
Array.indonesia: "Aku akan tunjukkan bahwa aku masih kuat."

Array.name: dialog_Staff_HireCompleted_13
Array.english: "Data analysis reveals that this sushi bar has high potential."
Array.indonesia: "Analisis data menunjukkan bahwa bar sushi ini memiliki potensi tinggi."

Array.name: dialog_Staff_HireCompleted_Maki
Array.english: "I’ll become an amazing cook, like I promised my father."
Array.indonesia: "Aku akan menjadi koki hebat, seperti yang aku janjikan pada ayahku."

Array.name: dialog_Staff_HireCompleted_15_CohhCarnage
Array.english: "It's always been my dream to work by the ocean side."
Array.indonesia: "Bekerja di tepi laut selalu menjadi impianku."

Array.name: dialog_Staff_HireCompleted_16_Raptor
Array.english: "I'm Raptor. Join me and my gaming friends from all over the world."
Array.indonesia: "Aku Raptor. Bergabunglah denganku dan teman-teman gamerku dari seluruh dunia."

Array.name: dialog_Staff_HireCompleted_17_Drae
Array.english: "If you need a Sushi taste tester, I'm your man!"

Array.name: dialog_Staff_HireCompleted_18_Raul
Array.english: "Cooking is power! Power comes from the muscles!"
Array.indonesia: "Memasak itu kekuatan! Kekuatan berasal dari otot!"

Array.name: dialog_Staff_HireCompleted_19_Davina
Array.english: "I feel the spirit of adventure here!"

Array.name: dialog_Staff_HireCompleted_20_Itsuki

Array.name: dialog_Staff_HireCompleted_21_Masayoshi

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission01_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, <color=#F1DC2B>Dave</color> you got here quickly.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, <color=#F1DC2B>Dave</color> kamu sampai di sini dengan cepat.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission01_002
Array.english: Well…I was told to hurry here…\nI was on vacation you know.
Array.indonesia: Yah… aku disuruh buru-buru ke sini…\nAku lagi liburan, lho.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission01_003
Array.english: So, where's the sushi at?
Array.indonesia: Jadi, di mana sushinya?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission01_004
Array.english: Ha ha ha! Don't rush yourself!\nHave a look around.
Array.indonesia: Ha ha ha! Jangan terburu-buru!\nCoba lihat-lihat dulu.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission01_005
Array.english: Look at this <color=#90CDFF>Giant Blue Hole</color>…\nI've never seen anything like this.
Array.indonesia: Lihat ini <color=#90CDFF>Giant Blue Hole</color>…\nAku belum pernah melihat yang seperti ini sebelumnya.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission01_006
Array.english: It's not just the size. Every time you enter the <color=#90CDFF>Giant Blue Hole</color>, \nthe terrain and ecology change. Which means…
Array.indonesia: Bukan hanya ukurannya. Setiap kali kamu memasuki <color=#90CDFF>Giant Blue Hole</color>, \nmedan dan ekosistemnya berubah. Artinya…

Array.english: <size=34>This could be an incredible business\nopportunity!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ini bisa jadi peluang bisnis\nyang luar biasa!!!</size>

Array.indonesia: <size=33>Bisnis macam apa…?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission01_009
Array.english: …Well, we can discuss that later..\nI heard you took a break from diving. How about warming up?
Array.indonesia: …Yah, kita bisa membicarakannya nanti..\nKudengar kamu sedang istirahat dari menyelam. Bagaimana kalau pemanasan dulu?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission01_010
Array.english: <size=32>I'll guide you from here.\nGo ahead and go on in.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku akan memandumu dari sini.\nSilakan masuk saja.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission01_011
Array.english: Hm…I don't have a good feeling about this…
Array.indonesia: Hm… Aku merasa ada yang tidak beres…

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission02_001_01
Array.english: Nice form! Ha ha ha ha!\nAlright, how about try stretching out a bit.
Array.indonesia: Bagus sekali! Ha ha ha ha!\nBaiklah, bagaimana kalau coba melakukan peregangan sebentar.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission02_001_02
Array.english: <size=36>Try moving to the marked area.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Coba pindah ke area yang ditandai.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission02_001_03
Array.english: Use <image=InGame.LongDash, preset=Dialogue_CN/> to move quickly.\n But you'll use up oxygen faster, so watch yourself!<Touch> Tilt the Left Joystick all the way to move faster.\n But you'll use up oxygen faster, so watch yourself!</Touch>
Array.indonesia: Gunakan <image=InGame.LongDash, preset=Dialogue_CN/> untuk bergerak cepat.\n Tapi oksigenmu akan habis lebih cepat, jadi hati-hati!<Touch> Miringkan Joystick Kiri sepenuhnya untuk bergerak lebih cepat.\n Tapi oksigenmu akan habis lebih cepat, jadi hati-hati!</Touch>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission02_002
Array.english: Good! Looks like your skills are intact!\nYour moves are as nimble as a freshwater snail.
Array.indonesia: Bagus! Sepertinya keterampilanmu masih utuh!\nGerakanmu secepat siput air tawar.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission02_002_2
Array.english: Let’s now practice using the weapon you’ll need in contingencies, the <color=#F1DC2B>Dive Knife</color>.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang mari berlatih menggunakan senjata yang akan kamu butuhkan dalam keadaan darurat, yaitu <color=#F1DC2B>Pisau Selam</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission02_003
Array.english: <size=30>Try using the Survival Knife on small fish.\nYou can use <image=InGame.Melee, preset=Dialogue_EN/>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=30>Cobalah gunakan <size=30>Pisau Survival\n pada ikan kecil.\nKamu bisa menggunakan <image=InGame.Melee, preset=Dialogue_EN/>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission02_004
Array.english: <size=33>Well done!\nSmooth and quick!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Bagus sekali!\nLancar dan cepat!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission02_005
Array.english: And finally...\nYou haven’t forgotten how to use the <color=#F1DC2B>Harpoon</color>, have you?
Array.indonesia: Dan terakhir...\nKamu belum lupa cara menggunakan <color=#F1DC2B>Harpoon</color>, kan?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission02_006
Array.english: The <color=#F1DC2B>Harpoon</color>? Well, I haven’t used one in a long time...\nDo you aim first? And then... Hmm...
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Harpoon</color>? Yah, sudah lama sekali aku tidak menggunakannya...\nApakah harus membidik dulu? Lalu... Hmm...

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission02_007
Array.english: Hmm... Looks like you’ll need some practice.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Sepertinya kamu perlu berlatih lagi.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission02_007_02
Array.english: Let’s try using the Harpoon to catch... \nlet’s say... three fish.
Array.indonesia: Ayo coba gunakan Harpoon untuk menangkap... \nkatakanlah... tiga ikan.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission02_008
Array.english: <size=30>Use <image=InGame.Aim, preset=Dialogue_CN/> to aim! Fire with <image=InGame.Fire, preset=Dialogue_CN/>!\n Go ahead, give it a try.</size><Touch> Press and hold the harpoon button on the right to aim, then release to fire!\n Go ahead, give it a try.</Touch>
Array.indonesia: <size=30>Gunakan <image=InGame.Aim, preset=Dialogue_CN/> untuk membidik! Tembak dengan <image=InGame.Fire, preset=Dialogue_CN/>!\n Silakan, coba saja.</size><Touch> Tekan dan tahan tombol harpoon di sebelah kanan untuk membidik, lalu lepaskan untuk menembak!\n Silakan, coba saja.</Touch>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission02_009
Array.english: I think that should get you back on track in no time.
Array.indonesia: Kurasa itu akan membuatmu kembali ke jalur yang benar dalam sekejap.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission02_010
Array.english: <size=33>Alright, come back up to the boat.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Baiklah, kembali ke perahu.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_001
Array.english: Okay. Now that you got the hang of it, \nlet's get down to business!
Array.indonesia: Oke. Sekarang setelah kamu menguasainya, \nayo mulai bekerja!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_002
Array.english: <size=33>Dave, you love sushi, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Dave, kamu suka sushi, kan?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_003
Array.english: For sure! That soft fish meat with oily rice…\nOh man! That's just the best!
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja! Daging ikan yang lembut dengan nasi berminyak…\nWah! Itu benar-benar yang terbaik!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_004
Array.english: Aha! Well listen up. I have a friend who is a <color=#F1DC2B>sushi chef</color>\nwho left the business for a while.
Array.indonesia: Aha! Nah, dengarkan baik-baik. Aku punya teman yang merupakan <color=#F1DC2B>koki sushi</color>\nyang sempat meninggalkan bisnis ini untuk sementara waktu.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_005
Array.english: He has a bit of a sharp tongue, and a slight temper…\nBut he has one skill that I can guarantee is unmatched in the world.
Array.indonesia: Dia agak blak-blakan, dan sedikit pemarah…\nTapi dia punya satu keahlian yang aku jamin tak tertandingi di dunia.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_006
Array.english: <size=30>It is right here that I started a restaurant \nwith my friend that sells one of a kind sushi!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=30>Di sinilah aku membuka restoran \nbersama temanku yang menjual sushi yang benar-benar unik!!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_007
Array.english: The sushi sold here is made from fresh fish caught \nin the <color=#90CDFF>Blue Hole</color>, where fish from all over the world can be found!
Array.indonesia: Sushi yang dijual di sini terbuat dari ikan segar yang ditangkap \ndi <color=#90CDFF>Blue Hole</color>, tempat di mana ikan dari seluruh dunia bisa ditemukan!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_008
Array.english: <size=34>Don't you think people will just go nuts for it?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Bukankah orang-orang pasti akan tergila-gila dengan ini?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_009
Array.english: <size=34>Yum… I'm already craving it!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wah… Aku sudah ngidam banget!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_010
Array.english: Haha, I bet!!\nSo…
Array.indonesia: Haha, pasti!!\nJadi…

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_011
Array.english: <size=35>Why don't you join in on this awesome venture\nas well? What do you say?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Kenapa kamu tidak ikut serta dalam usaha keren ini\njuga? Bagaimana menurutmu?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_012
Array.english: I mean…I love eating but…\nI don't know a thing about cooking.
Array.indonesia: Maksudku… aku suka makan tapi…\naku sama sekali tidak tahu apa-apa tentang memasak.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_013
Array.english: <size=32>Nothing to worry about!\nThe restaurant is all ready…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Nggak usah khawatir!\nRestorannya sudah siap…</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_014
Array.english: <size=33>All you need to do is dive to get the ingredients!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Yang perlu kamu lakukan hanyalah menyelam untuk mengambil bahan-bahannya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_015
Array.english: <size=38>Doesn't sound too bad, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Kedengarannya nggak terlalu buruk, kan?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_option1
Array.english: Accept
Array.indonesia: Setuju

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_option2
Array.english: Decline
Array.indonesia: Tolak

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_option1_linked_001
Array.english: Um…I don't really have any money on me…\nI don’t think I can pay…
Array.indonesia: Um… Aku nggak bawa uang sama sekali…\nSepertinya aku nggak bisa bayar…

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_option1_linked_002
Array.english: Hm…That reminds me…
Array.indonesia: Hm… Itu mengingatkanku…

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_option1_linked_003
Array.english: <size=32>I just remembered that a while ago you broke my underwater drone.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku baru ingat kalau beberapa waktu lalu kamu merusak drone bawah airku.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_option1_linked_004
Array.english: The repair cost was about 500 Gold...\nbut I didn't charge you for it.
Array.indonesia: Biaya perbaikannya sekitar 500 Emas...\ntapi aku nggak menagihmu untuk itu.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_option1_linked_005
Array.english: Um, it broke after 5 seconds of use.\nIt was broken already wasn't it?
Array.indonesia: Um, itu rusak setelah dipakai 5 detik.\nItu kan udah rusak sebelumnya, kan?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_option1_linked_006
Array.english: <size=32>What do you mean?!\nIt…it was totally fine!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Maksudmu apa?!\nItu…itu baik-baik saja kok!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_option1_linked_007
Array.english: Well…Okay.\nSo what should I do?
Array.indonesia: Yah… Oke.\nJadi, apa yang harus aku lakukan?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_option2_linked_001
Array.english: <size=35>So I can eat as much sushi as I want?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Jadi, aku bisa makan sushi sepuasnya?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_option2_linked_002
Array.english: <size=36>Yeah…sure.</size>\n<color=#C3C3C3><size=26>You have to pay though...</size></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Iya… tentu saja.</size>\n<color=#C3C3C3><size=26>Tapi kamu harus bayar...</size></size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_option2_linked_003
Array.english: <size=32>Can't wait to check it out!\nA sushi restaurant next to a Blue Hole!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Nggak sabar mau coba!\nRestoran sushi di sebelah Blue Hole!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_01_AfterOption_001
Array.english: It was supposed to open tonight.\nBut I'm not sure if it's ready.
Array.indonesia: Seharusnya buka malam ini.\nTapi aku nggak yakin udah siap.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_01_AfterOption_002
Array.english: <size=34>Let's go have a chat at the restaurant!\nAh ha ha!!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ayo kita ngobrol di restoran itu!\nAh ha ha!!!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_02_001
Array.english: <size=34>Hey! <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color>! \nAre we all ready to open?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hei! <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color>! \nApakah kita semua sudah siap untuk buka?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_02_002
Array.english: As you can see.\nIt's ready just in time.
Array.indonesia: Seperti yang kamu lihat.\nSudah siap tepat waktu.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_02_003
Array.english: <size=33>Oh…It's already…finished?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh…Sudah…selesai?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_02_004
Array.english: <size=31>You?\nAh, you are the fisherman Cobra was talking about.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Kamu?\nAh, kamu adalah nelayan yang dibicarakan Cobra.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_02_005
Array.english: <size=33>Well, I'm more of a diver than a fisherman.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Sebenarnya, aku lebih ke penyelam daripada nelayan.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_02_006
Array.english: Alright. Anyway, it's nice to meet you. \nI'm <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color>.\r<size=34>So, you like sushi?</size>
Array.indonesia: Btw senang bertemu denganmu. \nAku <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color>Jadi, kamu suka sushi?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_02_007
Array.english: I sure do!!\nTuna belly…eel, sea urchin…
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja!!\nPerut tuna…belut, landak laut…

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_02_008
Array.english: Oh boy…\nJust thinking about it makes my mouth water.
Array.indonesia: Wah…\nHanya dengan membayangkannya saja sudah membuatku ngiler.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_02_009
Array.english: <size=36>Hmm. Just as mediocre as expected!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Hmm. Biasa saja seperti yang kuduga!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_02_010
Array.english: Sushi is a food that combines the <color=#F1DC2B>soul</color> of sea and land.\nIt symbolizes Mother Nature herself.
Array.indonesia: Sushi adalah makanan yang menggabungkan <color=#F1DC2B>jiwa</color> laut dan darat.\nSushi melambangkan Ibu Pertiwi sendiri.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_02_011
Array.english: Most people, however, have only tasted\nmore accessible fish just like you...
Array.indonesia: Namun, kebanyakan orang hanya pernah mencicipi\nikan yang lebih mudah didapat, sama seperti kamu...

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_02_012
Array.english: <size=35>How empty a life is one that ends without ever tasting\nthe beauty mother nature can offer!!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Betapa hampa hidup seseorang yang berakhir tanpa pernah mencicipi\nkeindahan yang ditawarkan Ibu Pertiwi!!!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_02_013
Array.english: <size=38>My calling is to bring the taste of mother nature to everyon.…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Panggilan hidupku adalah menghadirkan cita rasa Ibu Pertiwi kepada semua orang.…</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_03_001
Array.english: <size=42>An…an earthquake?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>G…gempa bumi?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_03_002
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm…The interior is really quite a mess.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm…Bagian dalamnya benar-benar berantakan.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_03_003
Array.english: Yeah…\nIt looks like we will have to delay the opening today.
Array.indonesia: Ya…\nSepertinya kita harus menunda pembukaan hari ini.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_03_004
Array.english: <size=34>You know what…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kau tahu apa…</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_03_005
Array.english: I spent all my money getting this restaurant ready...\nI'll have to recover the <color=#F1DC2B>repair cost</color> through doing business….
Array.indonesia: Aku menghabiskan semua uangku untuk menyiapkan restoran ini...\nAku harus menutupi <color=#F1DC2B>biaya perbaikan</color> dengan berbisnis….

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_03_006
Array.english: <size=40>…In this state?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>…Dalam keadaan seperti ini?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_03_007
Array.english: <size=34>…Bwahaha!\nIn the end the importance of a restaurant is the taste!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>…Bwahaha!\nPada akhirnya, yang terpenting dari sebuah restoran adalah rasanya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_03_008
Array.english: <size=35>First we need ingredients…\nDid you bring anything?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Pertama-tama kita butuh bahan-bahan…\nKamu bawa sesuatu?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_03_009
Array.english: Well, I have something I just caught…
Array.indonesia: Nah, aku punya sesuatu yang baru saja kutangkap…

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_03_010
Array.english: <size=55>…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=55>…</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_03_011
Array.english: <size=34>Only three fish?...\nThis won't be nearly enough to serve the guests!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hanya tiga ikan?...\nIni nggak akan cukup buat menyajikan para tamu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_03_012
Array.english: <size=34>Please go and catch <color=#1DFEAF>7 more fish</color> first.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Tolong pergi dan tangkap <color=#1DFEAF>7 ekor ikan lagi</color> dulu.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_03_013
Array.english: <size=37>Oh, and…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Oh, dan…</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_03_014
Array.english: <size=35>The restaurant is going to be open only \nin the <color=#F1DC2B>evening</color></size>.
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Restoran ini hanya akan buka \npada <color=#F1DC2B>malam hari</color></size>.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_03_015
Array.english: <size=31>Hm. Won't that decrease sales?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Hm. Bukankah itu akan mengurangi penjualan?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_03_016
Array.english: <size=31>So you think it's right to invite customers without\nadequate preparation just to make a little more money?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Jadi menurutmu, apakah benar mengundang pelanggan tanpa\npersiapan yang memadai hanya demi mendapatkan sedikit uang tambahan?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_03_017
Array.english: <size=29>It is a chef's duty to prepare the best possible food with meticulous precision, just as a warrior sharpens his sword on a whetstone!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=29>Tugas seorang koki adalah menyiapkan hidangan terbaik dengan ketelitian yang cermat, sama seperti seorang prajurit mengasah pedangnya di batu asah!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_03_018
Array.english: <size=32>You will need to get me the best quality ingredients \nduring the day.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kamu harus menyiapkan bahan-bahan berkualitas terbaik untukku \nsepanjang hari.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_03_019
Array.english: <size=37>Okay.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Oke.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission04_001
Array.english: It seems <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color> is really passionate about his work...
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color> benar-benar bersemangat dengan pekerjaannya...

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission04_002
Array.english: He may not talk about personal stuff\nbut this guy can talk about sushi all night. Bwahaha!
Array.indonesia: Dia mungkin tidak suka membicarakan hal-hal pribadi\ntapi orang ini bisa ngobrol soal sushi sepanjang malam. Bwahaha!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission04_003
Array.english: I haven’t seen Bancho so enthusiastic since <color=#9E7BFF>the incident</color>.\nIt’s nice to see him like this.
Array.indonesia: Aku belum pernah melihat Bancho begitu antusias sejak <color=#9E7BFF>insiden itu</color>.\nSenang melihatnya seperti ini.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission04_004
Array.english: <size=38><color=#9E7BFF>The incident</color>…?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38><color=#9E7BFF>Insiden itu</color>…?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission04_005
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>Oops…Maybe I shouldn't have brought it up…</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Ups… Mungkin aku tidak seharusnya mengungkitnya…</color>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission04_006
Array.english: Well, anyway we need more ingredients, \nso go catch <color=#1DFEAF>7 fish</color> first!
Array.indonesia: Yah, bagaimanapun juga kita butuh lebih banyak bahan, \njadi pergilah tangkap <color=#1DFEAF>7 ikan</color> dulu!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission05_001
Array.english: <size=34>Alright, looks like you caught quite a few!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oke, sepertinya kamu sudah menangkap cukup banyak!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission05_002
Array.english: <size=32>At this rate we’ll make boatloads of money in no time.\nBwahaha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kalau begini terus, kita bakal dapat banyak uang dalam sekejap.\nBwahaha!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission05_003
Array.english: <size=33>My my, would you look at the time.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wah, lihatlah jamnya.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission05_004
Array.english: We’ll have to hurry up and get things ready.\nWhy don’t you head to the sushi bar?
Array.indonesia: Kita harus buru-buru menyiapkan semuanya.\nKenapa kamu nggak pergi ke bar sushi aja?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission06_001
Array.english: <size=33>By the way, you’ll only be able to dive\n<color=#F1DC2B>once in the morning and once in the afternoon</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ngomong-ngomong, kamu cuma bisa menyelam\n<color=#F1DC2B>sekali di pagi hari dan sekali di sore hari</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission06_002
Array.english: <size=33>Get the ingredients ready before the dinner \nhours start!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Siapkan bahan-bahannya sebelum jam makan malam \ndimulai!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_001
Array.english: <size=33><color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color>, \nHow are the preparations coming along?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33><color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color>, \nBagaimana persiapannya?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_002
Array.english: <size=33>Hmm. I think we’re mostly set.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hmm. Kurasa kita sudah hampir siap.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_003
Array.english: <size=33>That’s good. \nHere’s to a great evening!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Bagus. \nSemoga malam ini menyenangkan!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_004
Array.english: <size=34>Where do you think you’re going?\nDidn’t you hear from Cobra?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kamu mau ke mana?\nKamu tidak dengar kabar dari Cobra?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_005
Array.english: <size=33>You're to help me run the sushi bar\nfrom today onwards!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kamu harus membantuku mengelola bar sushi\nmulai hari ini!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_006
Array.english: <size=34>What? I... I don’t understand...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Apa? Aku.. . Aku tidak mengerti...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_007
Array.english: Cobra told me that there would be somebody to help with \nthe ingredients and serving. He said all I needed to do is cook.
Array.indonesia: Cobra bilang akan ada seseorang yang membantu dengan \nbahan-bahan dan penyajian. Katanya yang perlu aku lakukan hanyalah memasak.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_008
Array.english: <size=34>And who else is there for that, but you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Dan siapa lagi yang bisa melakukannya selain kamu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_009
Array.english: Wait, I’ve never worked at a restaurant before...
Array.indonesia: Tunggu, aku belum pernah bekerja di restoran sebelumnya...

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_010
Array.english: <size=32>The guests will be here soon!\nI’ll give you a quick primer, so pay attention!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Para tamu akan segera datang!\nAku akan memberikan penjelasan singkat, jadi perhatikan baik-baik!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_010_2
Array.english: <size=36>What?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Apa?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_011
Array.english: <size=33>Open the <color=#F1DC2B>Ingredients</color> below.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Buka bagian <color=#F1DC2B>Bahan-bahan</color> di bawah ini.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_012
Array.english: Here, you can check your fish, crops, sauces,\nand all the other materials you have.\r<size=34>For now, that's all you need to know.\nCome back later for more information.</size>
Array.indonesia: Di sini, kamu bisa memeriksa ikan, hasil panen, saus,\ndan semua bahan lain yang kamu miliki.\r<size=34>Untuk saat ini, hanya itu yang perlu kamu ketahui.\nKembalilah nanti untuk informasi lebih lanjut.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_013
Array.english: Alright.\nNow I’ll show you how to register actual items to the <color=#F1DC2B>Menu</color>.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah.\nSekarang aku akan menunjukkan cara mendaftarkan item yang sebenarnya ke <color=#F1DC2B>Menu</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_014
Array.english: New recipes need to be added to the <color=#F1DC2B>Menu</color> before \nthey can be sold to customers.\rThere’s a sushi recipe for the fish you acquired earlier,\nso try registering that to the <color=#F1DC2B>Menu</color>.
Array.indonesia: Resep baru harus ditambahkan ke <color=#F1DC2B>Menu</color> sebelum \ndapat dijual kepada pelanggan.\rAda resep sushi untuk ikan yang kamu dapatkan tadi,\njadi coba daftarkan itu ke <color=#F1DC2B>Menu</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_015
Array.english: <size=33>Alright. \nThat probably wasn’t that hard.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Baiklah. \nItu mungkin tidak terlalu sulit.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_015_2
Array.english: Setting ingredients to <color=#F1DC2B>Auto-supply</color>\nwill make things a bit more convenient.
Array.indonesia: Mengatur bahan-bahan ke <color=#F1DC2B>Pasokan Otomatis</color>\nakan membuat segalanya sedikit lebih mudah.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_015_3
Array.english: Let me repeat: Only food on the <color=#F1DC2B>Menu</color> can be sold.\nIf you run out of ingredients, you’ll have to replace items on the menu or refill the ingredients.
Array.indonesia: Izinkan saya mengulangi: Hanya makanan yang ada di <color=#F1DC2B>Menu</color> yang dapat dijual.\nJika bahan-bahannya habis, kamu harus mengganti item di menu atau mengisi ulang bahan-bahannya.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_015_4
Array.english: You can also <color=#F1DC2B>Enhance</color> the flavor of the dishes,\nso try it out when you have enough ingredients.
Array.indonesia: Kamu juga bisa <color=#F1DC2B>Meningkatkan</color> cita rasa hidangan,\njadi cobalah saat bahan-bahannya sudah cukup.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_016
Array.english: <size=35>Now, use the ingredients you caught to fill out \nthe <color=#F1DC2B>Menu</color> as much as you can!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Sekarang, gunakan bahan-bahan yang sudah kamu dapatkan untuk mengisi \n<color=#F1DC2B>Menu</color> sebanyak mungkin!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_017
Array.english: Now then, \nlet’s take a look at how you can deliver the food...
Array.indonesia: Nah, \nmari kita lihat bagaimana cara mengantarkan makanan...

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_2_Start_001
Array.english: <size=36>How long are you going to stand there talking!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Sampai kapan kamu akan berdiri di sana sambil ngobrol!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_2_Start_002
Array.english: <size=35>Give me a cup of <color=#F1DC2B>Green Tea</color> to quench my thirst!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Berikan aku secangkir <color=#F1DC2B>Teh Hijau</color> untuk menghilangkan dahagaku!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_2_Start_003
Array.english: <size=31>Hmm... Have you perhaps...\npoured <color=#F1DC2B>Green Tea</color> before?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Hmm... Apa kamu pernah...\nmenuangkan <color=#F1DC2B>Teh Hijau</color> sebelumnya?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_2_Start_004
Array.english: No... Only soft drinks, I think...
Array.indonesia: Tidak... Hanya minuman ringan, kurasa...

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_2_Start_005
Array.english: Tsk. I’ll tell you how. Go over to Cobra.
Array.indonesia: Ckck. Aku akan mengajari kamu caranya. Pergilah ke Cobra.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_2_End_001
Array.english: <size=32>Bwahaha! As expected, Bancho’s <color=#F1DC2B>Green Tea</color> is \nquite something.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hahaha! Seperti yang diduga, <color=#F1DC2B>Teh Hijau</color> milik Bancho itu \nbenar-benar luar biasa.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission08_001
Array.english: <size=30>Mm! That tea really got my appetite going!\nIs there <color=#F1DC2B>something to eat</color>, perhaps?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=30>Mm! Teh itu benar-benar bikin aku laper!\nApa ada <color=#F1DC2B>makanan</color>, mungkin?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission08_002
Array.english: Demanding as always.\nWhy don’t you try serving him some food, while you’re at it?
Array.indonesia: Selalu saja menuntut.\nKenapa kamu tidak coba menyajikan makanan untuknya, sekalian saja?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission08_003
Array.english: <size=32>Come over to where I am and take this food.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Datanglah ke tempatku dan ambil makanan ini.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission08_004
Array.english: <size=40>Hello!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Halo!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission08_005
Array.english: <size=32>You sent the package last week, you say?\nWhat in the world! Let me check on that!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kamu bilang paketnya sudah dikirim minggu lalu?\nAstaga! Biar aku periksa dulu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission08_006
Array.english: Cobra didn’t even eat...\nHe’s always distracted like that.\rThe food...\ncan’t be reused, so we’ll have to throw it out.
Array.indonesia: Cobra bahkan belum makan...\nDia selalu teralihkan seperti itu.\rMakanannya...\ntidak bisa dipakai lagi, jadi kita harus membuangnya.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission08_007
Array.english: <size=34>It seems like such a waste to throw it away.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Rasanya sayang sekali kalau dibuang.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission08_008
Array.english: <size=32>Bancho Sushi never reuses food!\nWe do not put food made for guests on the table twice!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Bancho Sushi tidak pernah menggunakan kembali makanan!\nKami tidak pernah menyajikan makanan yang dibuat untuk tamu di meja dua kali!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission08_009
Array.english: <size=32>Well... alright.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Baiklah... oke.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission08_010
Array.english: Everything looks 'bout ready.\nHm. I haven't cooked for customers in a while. Kinda nervous.
Array.indonesia: Semuanya sepertinya sudah siap.\nHm. Sudah lama aku tidak memasak untuk pelanggan. Agak gugup.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission08_011
Array.english: <size=35>Don't forget to press <color=#F1DC2B><image=Dave.Sushi_OpenConfirm, preset=Dialogue_EN/></color> after filling the <color=#F1DC2B>Menu</color> \nfor business to begin.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Jangan lupa tekan <color=#F1DC2B><image=Dave.Sushi_OpenConfirm, preset=Dialogue_EN/></color> setelah mengisi <color=#F1DC2B>Menu</color> \nagar bisnis bisa dimulai.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_IDiver_Start_001
Array.english: <size=36>Now then, let me tell you how to use <color=#72ff0a>iDiver</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Nah, sekarang, biar aku jelaskan cara menggunakan <color=#72ff0a>iDiver</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_IDiver_Start_002
Array.english: I’ll install the app for you, so unlock your <color=#72ff0a>phone</color> first!
Array.indonesia: Aku akan menginstal aplikasinya untukmu, jadi buka kunci <color=#72ff0a>ponsel</color>-mu dulu!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_IDiver_End_001
Array.english: Good!\nNow you’ll be able to venture a bit deeper.
Array.indonesia: Bagus!\nSekarang kamu bisa menjelajah sedikit lebih dalam.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_IDiver_End_002
Array.english: Once you have enough money, use <color=#72ff0a>iDiver</color> to enhance\nyour equipment. You can enhance your suit as well as your Cargo Box and Oxygen Tank.
Array.indonesia: Setelah kamu memiliki cukup uang, gunakan <color=#72ff0a>iDiver</color> untuk meningkatkan\nperalatanmu. Kamu bisa meningkatkan pakaian selammu serta Cargo Box dan Tangki Oksigenmu.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_IDiver_End_003
Array.english: <size=33>Never forget that anything can happen in deep waters!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Jangan pernah lupa bahwa apa pun bisa terjadi di perairan dalam!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_IDiver_End_004
Array.english: <size=42>I’ll be in touch!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>Aku akan menghubungimu lagi!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Staff_Start_001
Array.english: Ahem. Let me tell you how to recruit <color=#F1DC2B>staff</color>.
Array.indonesia: Ahem. Izinkan saya memberi tahu Anda cara merekrut <color=#F1DC2B>staf</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Staff_Start_002
Array.english: <size=35>Pay close attention to what I say!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Perhatikan baik-baik apa yang saya katakan!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Staff_Hire_001
Array.english: <size=40>Good.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Bagus.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Staff_Hire_002
Array.english: The recruitment results become available <color=#F1DC2B>the following day</color>.
Array.indonesia: Hasil perekrutan akan tersedia <color=#F1DC2B>keesokan harinya</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Staff_Hire_003
Array.english: I’ll tell you more tomorrow.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan memberitahumu lebih lanjut besok.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Staff_Hire_list_001
Array.english: Well! There’s an <color=#F1DC2B>applicant</color> for the Bancho Sushi Hiring Notice!\nTime to have a looksy.
Array.indonesia: Wah! Ada <color=#F1DC2B>pelamar</color> untuk Pengumuman Lowongan Kerja Bancho Sushi!\n Saatnya melihat-lihat.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Staff_Employ_001
Array.english: Ooh. I wasn’t expecting an applicant so quickly.
Array.indonesia: Wah. Aku tidak menyangka akan ada pelamar secepat ini.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Staff_Employ_002
Array.english: Let’s check out who we have.
Array.indonesia: Ayo kita lihat siapa yang melamar.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Staff_Employ_list_001
Array.english: This is a pretty nice resume we have here.
Array.indonesia: Ini resume yang cukup bagus.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Staff_Employ_list_002
Array.english: Let’s <color=#F1DC2B>hire</color> this person right away.
Array.indonesia: Ayo <color=#F1DC2B>merekrut</color> orang ini segera.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Staff_Placement_001
Array.english: Alright. Looks like we have our first staff.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah. Sepertinya kita sudah punya staf pertama.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Staff_Placement_002
Array.english: Hired staff must be <color=#F1DC2B>placed</color>.
Array.indonesia: Staf yang sudah direkrut harus <color=#F1DC2B>ditempatkan</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Staff_Placement_List_001
Array.english: Staff can be placed in the <color=#F1DC2B>Kitchen</color> or the <color=#F1DC2B>Dining Area</color>.
Array.indonesia: Staf dapat ditempatkan di <color=#F1DC2B>Dapur</color> atau <color=#F1DC2B>Ruang Makan</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Staff_Placement_List_002
Array.english: Add them to your <color=#F1DC2B>Kitchen</color> to cook more quickly,\nand to your <color=#F1DC2B>Dining Area</color> to serve food more quickly.
Array.indonesia: Tambahkan mereka ke <color=#F1DC2B>Dapur</color> agar memasak lebih cepat,\ndan ke <color=#F1DC2B>Ruang Makan</color> agar menyajikan makanan lebih cepat.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Staff_Placement_List_003
Array.english: As for our first staff...\nLet’s try a <color=#F1DC2B>Dining Area</color> assignment for now.
Array.indonesia: Adapun staf pertama kita...\nMari kita coba penugasan di <color=#F1DC2B>Ruang Makan</color> untuk saat ini.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Staff_End_001
Array.english: I think that should be enough to go on for now.
Array.indonesia: Saya rasa itu sudah cukup untuk saat ini.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Staff_End_002
Array.english: I’m stating the obvious, but...\nthings will get tough without staff to help once more customers start coming in.
Array.indonesia: Ini memang sudah jelas, tapi...\nsegala sesuatunya akan menjadi sulit tanpa bantuan staf begitu lebih banyak pelanggan mulai berdatangan.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Staff_End_003
Array.english: There’s also <color=#F1DC2B>Training</color> to consider, besides hiring.\nThat’s all for now.
Array.indonesia: Selain perekrutan, ada juga <color=#F1DC2B>Pelatihan</color> yang perlu dipertimbangkan.\nSekian dulu untuk saat ini.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_1_End_001
Array.english: Good!\nPluck the weeds out like that and I’ll do the watering.
Array.indonesia: Bagus!\nCabut gulma seperti itu dan aku yang akan menyiramnya.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_1_End_002
Array.english: I’m pretty sure that even that picky director would be satisfied with rice of this quality.
Array.indonesia: Aku cukup yakin bahkan direktur yang pemilih itu pun akan puas dengan beras berkualitas seperti ini.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_1_End_003
Array.english: As I said before, I’ll update you on the growth of the rice\nstarting tomorrow with the <color=#72ff0a>FarmNow</color> app!
Array.indonesia: Seperti yang sudah aku katakan sebelumnya, aku akan memberi tahu kamu perkembangan pertumbuhan padi\nmulai besok melalui aplikasi <color=#72ff0a>FarmNow</color>!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_2_Harvest_phone_001
Array.english: <size=34>Hoho, the rice has already grown!\nThere’s an odd energy to this region.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hoho, padi sudah tumbuh!\nAda energi aneh di wilayah ini.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_2_Harvest_phone_002
Array.english: <size=35>Come over to the <color=#F1DC2B>Farm</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ayo mampir ke <color=#F1DC2B>Farm</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_2_Start_001
Array.english: The rice has already grown!\nLet’s try <color=#F1DC2B>harvesting</color> it!
Array.indonesia: Padi sudah tumbuh!\nAyo kita coba <color=#F1DC2B>memanen</color> padi ini!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_2_End_001
Array.english: <size=35>You’ve got the hang of <color=#F1DC2B>harvesting</color> now, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Kamu sudah paham cara <color=#F1DC2B>memanen</color> sekarang, kan?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_2_End_002
Array.english: Yes. But can I plant more rice immediately\nafter harvesting?
Array.indonesia: Ya. Tapi, bisakah aku menanam padi lagi segera\nsetelah panen?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_2_End_003
Array.english: Ah, well, the land needs some time to recover, \nyou know.
Array.indonesia: Ah, tanahnya butuh waktu untuk pulih, \nkamu tahu.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_2_End_004
Array.english: You just need to wait <color=#F1DC2B>half a day</color>\nand you’ll be able to plant more rice.
Array.indonesia: Kamu hanya perlu menunggu <color=#F1DC2B>setengah hari</color>\ndan kamu bisa menanam padi lagi.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_2_End_005
Array.english: In any case, rice this quality should satisfy\nthat director guy as well.
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun, beras dengan kualitas seperti ini seharusnya juga memuaskan\nsi direktur itu.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_2_End_006
Array.english: <size=36>I should get this to Bancho.\nThank you, Otto!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Aku harus mengantarkan ini ke Bancho.\nTerima kasih, Otto!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_2_End_007
Array.english: <size=34>Come by every now and then to manage the land.\nIt’d be such a waste for crops to fall victim to insects!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Mampirlah sesekali untuk mengurus lahan ini.\nSayang sekali kalau panen jadi korban serangga!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_Start_001
Array.english: Ya get yourself some sleep Dave?
Array.indonesia: Sudah tidur, Dave?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_Start_002
Array.english: Um, Yeah. I guess.
Array.indonesia: Um, ya. Kurasa begitu.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_Start_003
Array.english: Yesterday you said you needed ingredients for \n<color=#1DFEAF>vegetable sushi</color> right?
Array.indonesia: Kemarin kamu bilang butuh bahan-bahan untuk \n<color=#1DFEAF>sushi sayuran</color>, kan?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_Start_004
Array.english: Yeah. Some customers were looking for that.\nBut I think Sushi tastes best when made from fish.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Ada beberapa pelanggan yang mencarinya.\nTapi menurutku sushi paling enak kalau dibuat dari ikan.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_Start_005
Array.english: Come on over to the <color=#F1DC2B>Farm</color> first!\nI got somethin' to show ya!
Array.indonesia: Ayo mampir dulu ke <color=#F1DC2B>Peternakan</color>!\nAku punya sesuatu yang mau kutunjukkan padamu!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_Intro_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh? There's a new space!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh? Ada tempat baru!?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_Intro_002
Array.english: Heh heh. That's right. \nJust growin' rice would be boring, now wouldn' it?
Array.indonesia: Heh heh. Benar sekali. \nCuma menanam padi aja pasti membosankan, kan?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_Intro_003
Array.english: I tinkered around yesterday and made a <color=#F1DC2B>garden</color> next to it.
Array.indonesia: Kemarin aku coba-coba dan bikin <color=#F1DC2B>kebun</color> di sebelahnya.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_Intro_004
Array.english: <size=34>A <color=#F1DC2B>garden</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Sebuah <color=#F1DC2B>kebun</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_Intro_005
Array.english: You betcha! \nA place where you can grow vegetables and fruits!
Array.indonesia: Pasti dong! \nTempat di mana kamu bisa menanam sayuran dan buah-buahan!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_Intro_006
Array.english: Not just for <color=#1DFEAF>Vegetable Sushi</color>, but all sorts of stuff for dishes.
Array.indonesia: Bukan hanya untuk <color=#1DFEAF>Sushi Sayuran</color>, tapi juga berbagai bahan untuk masakan.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_Intro_007
Array.english: <size=34>Oh…Sounds great!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh… Kedengarannya bagus!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_Step01_001
Array.english: Now, since you’ll have to manage the farms yourself, I’ll give you an explanation.\nListen up.
Array.indonesia: Nah, karena kamu harus mengelola kebun-kebun itu sendiri, aku akan memberikan penjelasannya.\nDengarkan baik-baik.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_Step01_002
Array.english: First of all, I’ll give you some <color=#F1DC2B>Tools</color> and <color=#F1DC2B>Seeds</color> you’ll \nneed to farm with. Take them.
Array.indonesia: Pertama-tama, aku akan memberimu beberapa <color=#F1DC2B>Alat</color> dan <color=#F1DC2B>Benih</color> yang akan \nkamu butuhkan untuk bertani. Ambil ini.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_Step02_001
Array.english: <size=36>Now try planting the <color=#F1DC2B>eggplant</color> and <color=#F1DC2B>carrot</color> seeds \nI gave you in the soil.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Sekarang coba tanam benih <color=#F1DC2B>terong</color> dan <color=#F1DC2B>wortel</color> yang \naku berikan padamu di tanah.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_Step02_002
Array.english: There are <size=35>3 bundles in each, so you can fill \n<color=#F1DC2B>one row</color> with two packs!</size>
Array.indonesia: Masing-masing berisi <size=35>3 ikat, jadi kamu bisa mengisi \n<color=#F1DC2B>satu baris</color> dengan dua bungkus!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Otto_FarmOpen_Weather_Dialogue_Sunny_01
Array.english: <size=36>After planting, don't forget to use the <color=#F1DC2B>watering can</color> to water them.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Setelah menanam, jangan lupa gunakan <color=#F1DC2B>kaleng penyiram</color> untuk menyiraminya.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Otto_FarmOpen_Weather_Dialogue_Sunny_02
Array.english: <size=38>…You get all that?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>…Kamu paham semua itu?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Otto_FarmOpen_Weather_Dialogue_Rainy_01
Array.english: <size=36>There ya go. You got it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Nah, begitulah. Kamu sudah mengerti!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Otto_FarmOpen_Weather_Dialogue_Rainy_02
Array.english: Now time to water them…
Array.indonesia: Sekarang saatnya menyiram tanaman-tanaman itu…

Array.name: dialog_Side_Otto_FarmOpen_Weather_Dialogue_Rainy_03
Array.english: There’s no need to pour water on rainy days like this...\nBut try for practice now.
Array.indonesia: Nggak perlu menyiram tanaman di hari hujan seperti ini...\nTapi coba saja untuk latihan sekarang.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_End_001
Array.english: Well, you learn quick.\nI knew you’d make a great farmer.
Array.indonesia: Wah, kamu cepat belajar.\nAku tahu kamu bakal jadi petani yang hebat.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_End_002
Array.english: What you get back from the crops, \nis equal to the work put in...
Array.indonesia: Hasil yang kamu dapatkan dari tanaman, \nsama dengan usaha yang kamu keluarkan...

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_End_003
Array.english: <size=36>Stop by often to pull the<color=#F1DC2B> weeds </color>and<color=#F1DC2B> water </color>the plants.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Sering-seringlah mampir untuk mencabut<color=#F1DC2B> gulma </color>dan<color=#F1DC2B> menyiram </color>tanaman.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_End_004
Array.english: The status of the crops can be checked in the <color=#72ff0a>FarmNow</color> app, so don't forget to take care of them!
Array.indonesia: Status tanaman bisa dicek di aplikasi <color=#72ff0a>FarmNow</color>, jadi jangan lupa merawatnya!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_End_005
Array.english: <size=35>Got it! With these I can prepare the ingredients for <color=#1DFEAF> Vegetable Sushi</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oke! Dengan ini aku bisa menyiapkan bahan-bahan untuk <color=#1DFEAF> Sushi Sayuran</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_harvest_call_001
Array.english: Hey, Dave! The crops planted a couple of days ago are ready to be harvested.
Array.indonesia: Hei, Dave! Tanaman yang ditanam beberapa hari yang lalu sudah siap dipanen.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_harvest_call_002
Array.english: <size=35>Seriously?\nThey grow so fast!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Serius?\nMereka tumbuh begitu cepat!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_harvest_call_003
Array.english: Haha, all kinds of unexpected things happen \nat the Blue Hole!
Array.indonesia: Haha, berbagai hal tak terduga terjadi \ndi Blue Hole!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_harvest_call_004
Array.english: <size=32>We need to prepare the ingredients for <color=#1DFEAF>Vegetable Sushi</color> before the customers come. Hurry to the farm!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kita harus menyiapkan bahan-bahan untuk <color=#1DFEAF>Sushi Sayuran</color> sebelum pelanggan datang. Cepat ke kebun!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_harvest_01_001
Array.english: The weather here is incredible!\nThe crops are growing so well!
Array.indonesia: Cuaca di sini luar biasa!\nTanaman-tanaman tumbuh dengan sangat baik!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_harvest_01_002
Array.english: <size=36>Go harvest them for yourself!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Ayo panen sendiri!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_harvest_02_001
Array.english: <size=37>Wow! The <color=#F1DC2B>Eggplants</color> and <color=#F1DC2B>Carrots</color> look really nice!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Wah! <color=#F1DC2B>Terong</color> dan <color=#F1DC2B>Wortel</color> terlihat sangat bagus!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_harvest_02_002
Array.english: Visit often and show your love, and the plants will \nrepay in kind.
Array.indonesia: Kunjungi sering-sering dan tunjukkan kasih sayangmu, dan tanaman-tanaman itu akan \nmembalasnya dengan baik.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_harvest_02_003
Array.english: Now, take them all and go help make <color=#1DFEAF>Vegetable Sushi</color>.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang, ambil semuanya dan bantu buat <color=#1DFEAF>Sushi Sayuran</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_harvest_02_004
Array.english: I have other vegetable seeds as well. \nI will sell them at a reasonable price if you want them.
Array.indonesia: Aku juga punya benih sayuran lainnya. \nAku akan menjualnya dengan harga yang wajar jika kamu mau.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_harvest_02_005
Array.english: <size=34>And don’t forget that good ingredients\nare what make a good dish.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Dan jangan lupa bahwa bahan-bahan yang bagus\nadalah kunci hidangan yang lezat.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_harvest_02_006
Array.english: <size=32>Thanks! Now all I need to make <color=#1DFEAF>Vegetable Sushi</color> is \nsome White Rice.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Terima kasih! Sekarang yang aku butuhkan untuk membuat <color=#1DFEAF>Sushi Sayuran</color> hanyalah \nnasi putih.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_harvest_02_007
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>By the way, who ordered Vegetable Sushi...?</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Ngomong-ngomong, siapa yang memesan Sushi Sayuran...?</color>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_ChickenFarm_call_001
Array.english: <size=36>Hello, Dave. Have a good night’s sleep?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Halo, Dave. Tidur nyenyak semalam?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_ChickenFarm_call_002
Array.english: Yes. Did you spend enough time talking with Sammy yesterday?
Array.indonesia: Ya. Kemarin kamu sudah cukup lama ngobrol sama Sammy?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_ChickenFarm_call_003
Array.english: Of course, we had not seen each other for so long before yesterday, so we definitely had a good time!
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja, kami sudah lama nggak ketemu sebelum kemarin, jadi kami pasti seru banget!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_ChickenFarm_call_004
Array.english: By the way...\nI want to show you something.
Array.indonesia: Ngomong-ngomong...\nAku mau nunjukin sesuatu ke kamu.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_ChickenFarm_call_005
Array.english: <size=37>Come to the <color=#F1DC2B>Farm</color> if you have time!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Datanglah ke <color=#F1DC2B>Peternakan</color> kalau kamu punya waktu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_001
Array.english: <size=43>Huh? Chickens?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=43>Hah? Ayam?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_002
Array.english: <size=40>And…um…Sammy, \nwhat happened to your clothes??</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Dan… um… Sammy, \nada apa dengan bajumu??</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_003
Array.english: Hey, yo! I talked to my pops yesterday and\ngot all sentimental, you know what I’m saying?
Array.indonesia: Hei, yo! Kemarin aku ngobrol sama ayahku dan\njadi sedih gitu, kamu ngerti kan maksudku?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_004
Array.english: I became a rapper because I love music,\nbut I got tired of that celeb life.
Array.indonesia: Aku jadi rapper karena aku cinta musik,\ntapi aku bosan sama kehidupan selebriti itu.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_005
Array.english: I think we could use them to cook with...\nI’ll give them to you when you get here. Take them to the cook.
Array.indonesia: Menurutku kita bisa pakai ini buat masak...\nAku bakal kasih ke kamu pas kamu sampai di sini. Bawa ke juru masak.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_006
Array.english: So, you quit music?
Array.indonesia: Jadi, kamu berhenti dari dunia musik?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_007
Array.english: No, no. I will stay here to enjoy my rural life and nature\nwhile writing new songs, yeah.
Array.indonesia: Nggak, nggak. Aku bakal tetap di sini buat menikmati kehidupan pedesaan dan alam\nsambil nulis lagu baru, ya.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_008
Array.english: You know, I can release new songs at any time online these days, it’s so easy to do that.
Array.indonesia: Kamu tahu, sekarang ini aku bisa merilis lagu baru kapan saja secara online, sangat mudah melakukannya.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_009
Array.english: Aha...\nBy the way, what’s up with that <color=#F1DC2B>Chicken</color>?
Array.indonesia: Aha...\nNgomong-ngomong, ada apa dengan <color=#F1DC2B>Ayam</color> itu?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_010
Array.english: Heh, I shared some food with neighbors\nand they gave me this chicken in return.
Array.indonesia: Heh, aku berbagi makanan dengan tetangga\ndan mereka memberiku ayam ini sebagai balasannya.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_011
Array.english: I wanted to make a yummy fried chicken,\nbut my son wanted to let it lay <color=#F1DC2B>Eggs</color>.
Array.indonesia: Aku pengen bikin ayam goreng yang enak,\ntapi anakku malah pengen biarin ayam itu bertelur <color=#F1DC2B>Telur</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_012
Array.english: And he made a <color=#1DFEAF>Chicken Farm</color> over night!\nHe reminds me of my younger self.
Array.indonesia: Dan dia bikin <color=#1DFEAF>Peternakan Ayam</color> dalam semalam!\nDia bikin aku inget diriku waktu kecil.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_013
Array.english: Haha, and I got inspiration from\nthe rhythm of the hammer, you know!
Array.indonesia: Haha, dan aku mendapat inspirasi dari\nirama palu itu, lho!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_014
Array.english: It warms my heart to see you and your son together.
Array.indonesia: Hatiku terasa hangat melihat kamu dan anakmu bersama.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_015
Array.english: Speaking of the chicken, from now on, \nI will offer you <color=#F1DC2B>Eggs</color> at my farm.
Array.indonesia: Ngomong-ngomong soal ayam itu, mulai sekarang, \naku akan memberimu <color=#F1DC2B>telur</color> di peternakanku.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_016
Array.english: <size=36>Oh? <color=#F1DC2B>Eggs</color>, you say?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Oh? <color=#F1DC2B>Telur</color>, katamu?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_017
Array.english: I can’t give you more than one egg because there is only one chicken on the farm.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak bisa memberimu lebih dari satu telur karena hanya ada satu ayam di peternakan.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_018
Array.english: If you want more chickens, ask <color=#F1DC2B>Sammy</color>!
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu mau ayam lagi, tanya saja <color=#F1DC2B>Sammy</color>!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_019
Array.english: Remember, only one egg per chicken a day, no more.
Array.indonesia: Ingat, hanya satu telur per ayam per hari, tidak lebih.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_020
Array.english: There are two grades for eggs: <color=#1DFEAF>Grade A and B</color>.\nGood-grade chickens lay good-grade eggs.
Array.indonesia: Ada dua kelas telur: <color=#1DFEAF>Kelas A dan B</color>.\nAyam berkualitas baik bertelur berkualitas baik.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_021
Array.english: <size=37>I will stay here with my pops.\nCome visit me often, yo!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Aku akan tinggal di sini bersama ayahku.\nSering-seringlah mampir, ya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_022
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3><color=#F1DC2B>Eggs</color>, huh?\nBancho’s menu will be expanded for sure!</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3><color=#F1DC2B>Telur</color>, ya?\nMenu Bancho pasti akan bertambah!</color>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_PhoneCall_01
Array.english: Did you sleep well?\nYesterday I told you I’d tell you something good.
Array.indonesia: Tidurmu nyenyak?\nKemarin aku bilang akan memberitahumu sesuatu yang bagus.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_PhoneCall_02
Array.english: <size=37>Take the boat and come behind the restaurant.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Naik perahu dan datanglah ke belakang restoran.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_Visit_01
Array.english: <size=40>Wow! What is this place?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Wah! Tempat apa ini?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_Visit_02
Array.english: Looks like you’re doing quite a lot of hard work\ncatching fish every day.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya kamu bekerja cukup keras\nmenangkap ikan setiap hari.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_Visit_03
Array.english: So I got to making a <color=#F1DC2B>Fish Farm</color>\nand finished it in a single day yesterday!
Array.indonesia: Jadi, aku mulai membuat <color=#F1DC2B>Tempat Pembudidayaan Ikan</color>\ndan menyelesaikannya dalam satu hari kemarin!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_Visit_04
Array.english: <size=38>What... A single day?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Apa... Hanya satu hari?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_Visit_05
Array.english: In any case... This is where you can grow fish\nand also let them multiply.
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun... Di sinilah kamu bisa membesarkan ikan\ndan juga membiarkannya berkembang biak.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_Visit_06
Array.english: I’ll explain slowly, so listen closely.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan menjelaskannya perlahan, jadi dengarkan baik-baik.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_Visit_07
Array.english: <size=38>First, come over to the <color=#1DFEAF>First Section</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Pertama, datanglah ke <color=#1DFEAF>Bagian Pertama</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_SimplePopUp_01
Array.english: Fish farms need to have the right environments for their fish.\nEach section has fish from a different depth.
Array.indonesia: Tempat budidaya ikan harus memiliki lingkungan yang tepat untuk ikannya.\nSetiap bagian memiliki ikan dari kedalaman yang berbeda.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_SimplePopUp_02
Array.english: This is where you can grow fish that live at depths of <color=#1DFEAF>0-50m</color>.
Array.indonesia: Di sinilah kamu bisa membudidayakan ikan yang hidup pada kedalaman <color=#1DFEAF>0-50 m</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_SimplePopUp_03
Array.english: Each section has limited space and once the density\nreaches <color=#1DFEAF>100%</color>, no more fish can fit.
Array.indonesia: Setiap bagian memiliki ruang terbatas dan begitu kepadatan\nmencapai <color=#1DFEAF>100%</color>, tidak ada lagi ikan yang bisa dimasukkan.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_SimplePopUp_04
Array.english: Of course, you can pay a bit of money to <color=#F1DC2B>expand them</color>...\nHahaha.
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja, kamu bisa membayar sedikit uang untuk <color=#F1DC2B>memperluasnya</color>...\nHahaha.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_SimplePopUp_05
Array.english: Each section is equipped with its own camera\nso you can look inside.
