Array.indonesia: Setiap bagian dilengkapi dengan kamera sendiri\nsehingga kamu bisa melihat ke dalamnya.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_SimplePopUp_06
Array.english: Now, come along.
Array.indonesia: Ayo, ikutlah.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_DetailPopUp_01_01
Array.english: Nice, isn’t it?\nI added a few fish to start you off.
Array.indonesia: Bagus, bukan?\nAku sudah menambahkan beberapa ikan sebagai permulaan.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_DetailPopUp_01_02
Array.english: Wow... It’s like an aquarium.
Array.indonesia: Wow... Rasanya seperti akuarium.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_DetailPopUp_01_03
Array.english: Just staring into the water\nis enough to make you all peaceful inside...
Array.indonesia: Hanya dengan menatap air\nsaja sudah cukup untuk membuat hatimu tenang...

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_DetailPopUp_01_04
Array.english: <size=35>But that isn’t the purpose of this Fish Farm, \nof course!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Tapi bukan itu tujuan dari Peternakan Ikan ini, \ntentu saja!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_DetailPopUp_01_05
Array.english: I’ll teach you how to pluck them out so they can be eaten...\nPay attention.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan mengajari kamu cara menangkap ikan-ikan itu agar bisa dimakan...\nPerhatikan baik-baik.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_DetailPopUp_02_01
Array.english: Fish in the Fish Farm can be sent to Bancho Sushi\nto be used as ingredients or sold directly.
Array.indonesia: Ikan di Peternakan Ikan bisa dikirim ke Bancho Sushi\nuntuk dijadikan bahan baku atau dijual langsung.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_DetailPopUp_02_02
Array.english: <size=35>Even if you fail to catch fish because you are so busy exploring, you won’t need to worry!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Bahkan jika kamu gagal menangkap ikan karena terlalu sibuk menjelajah, kamu tidak perlu khawatir!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_FirstTutorial_End_01
Array.english: But how do we add fish to the farm?\nSimply catching them will... kill them.
Array.indonesia: Tapi bagaimana cara menambahkan ikan ke peternakan?\nHanya dengan menangkapnya saja... ikan-ikan itu akan mati.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_FirstTutorial_End_02
Array.english: <size=35>Good question! \nYou can farm them by collecting <color=#F1DC2B>Fish Eggs</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Pertanyaan yang bagus! \nKamu bisa membudidayakannya dengan mengumpulkan <color=#F1DC2B>Telur Ikan</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_FirstTutorial_End_03
Array.english: If you capture some fish alive, you’ll sometimes get\n<color=#F1DC2B>Fish Eggs</color>.
Array.indonesia: Jika kamu menangkap ikan dalam keadaan hidup, terkadang kamu akan mendapatkan\n<color=#F1DC2B>Telur Ikan</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_FirstTutorial_End_04
Array.english: Those eggs will automatically be sent here.\nOh, and one more thing...
Array.indonesia: Telur-telur itu akan otomatis dikirim ke sini.\nOh, dan satu hal lagi...

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_FirstTutorial_End_05
Array.english: If you have two or more of the same type,\nthey can also <color=#1DFEAF>multiply</color>!
Array.indonesia: Jika kamu memiliki dua atau lebih jenis yang sama,\nmereka juga bisa <color=#1DFEAF>berkembang biak</color>!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_FirstTutorial_End_06
Array.english: <size=38>Wow... I see!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Wah... begitu ya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_FirstTutorial_End_07
Array.english: I’ve placed two fish each,\nso you should be able to see the results tomorrow.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah menempatkan dua ekor ikan masing-masing,\njadi kamu seharusnya bisa melihat hasilnya besok.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_FirstTutorial_End_08
Array.english: <size=38>Try coming back <color=#F39321>tomorrow</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Coba kembali <color=#F39321>besok</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_SystemBlock_01
Array.english: Come on! Just wait a day, Dave!\nI’m sure new fish will be waiting to greet you tomorrow!
Array.indonesia: Ayo dong! Tunggu saja satu hari, Dave!\nAku yakin ikan-ikan baru akan menantimu besok!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_Second_PhoneCall_01
Array.english: Dave, the fish in the farm yesterday...\nThey multiplied!
Array.indonesia: Dave, ikan-ikan di kolam kemarin...\nMereka sudah berkembang biak!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_Second_PhoneCall_02
Array.english: <size=36>Hurry on over to the <color=#F1DC2B>Fish Farm</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Cepatlah ke <color=#F1DC2B>Tempat Pembiakan Ikan</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_Second_Visit_01
Array.english: I’ve marked the sections with new fish\nwith <color=#ff61e3>hearts</color> so they’re easy to recognize.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah menandai bagian-bagian yang berisi ikan baru\ndengan <color=#ff61e3>hati</color> agar mudah dikenali.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_Second_Visit_02
Array.english: Go and see for yourself.
Array.indonesia: Pergilah dan lihat sendiri.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_Second_NewFishPopUp_00
Array.english: <size=36>Wow... The mysteries of nature never cease to amaze me...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Wah... Misteri alam tak pernah berhenti membuatku takjub...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_Second_NewFishPopUp_01
Array.english: I’ll tell you once the eggs hatch.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan memberitahumu begitu telur-telurnya menetas.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_Second_NewFishPopUp_02
Array.english: I’ll mark them with <color=#ff61e3>hearts</color> if fish have multiplied.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan menandainya dengan <color=#ff61e3>hati</color> jika ikan-ikan itu sudah bertambah banyak.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_Second_NewFishPopUp_03
Array.english: Speaking of eggs...
Array.indonesia: Ngomong-ngomong soal telur...

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_Second_NewFishPopUp_04
Array.english: <size=40>I’m reminded of my <color=#9E7BFF>son</color>, who I haven’t seen in a long time...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Aku jadi teringat <color=#9E7BFF>anak laki-lakiku</color>, yang sudah lama tidak kutemui...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_Second_NewFishPopUp_05
Array.english: <size=38>You... have a son?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Kamu... punya anak laki-laki?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_Second_NewFishPopUp_06
Array.english: <size=28>It was a windy and rainy day... I went too far out on my ship,\nand the storm flipped my ship over...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=28>Saat itu hari sedang berangin dan hujan... Aku melayari kapal terlalu jauh,\ndan badai itu membalikkan kapalku...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_Second_NewFishPopUp_07
Array.english: I haven’t been able to go back\nto see my son since... *sniff*
Array.indonesia: Aku belum bisa kembali\nuntuk menemui putraku sejak saat itu... *huhu*

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_Second_NewFishPopUp_08
Array.english: Well... I didn’t know that...
Array.indonesia: Yah... aku tidak tahu itu...

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_Second_NewFishPopUp_09
Array.english: Alright.\nI’ll come by often to check.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah.\nAku akan sering mampir untuk mengecek.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_Second_NewFishPopUp_10
Array.english: <size=36>Thanks to you, Otto,\nI’ll feel much less pressure to catch fish!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Berkat kamu, Otto,\naku akan merasa jauh lebih lega dalam menangkap ikan!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Grab_Start_001
Array.english: Here, these are special <color=#F1DC2B>Diving Gloves</color>\nmade in our research facility!
Array.indonesia: Ini, ini adalah <color=#F1DC2B>Sarung Tangan Selam</color>\nkhusus yang dibuat di fasilitas penelitian kami!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Grab_Start_002
Array.english: With these, you’ll be able to pick up various objects in the water!
Array.indonesia: Dengan ini, kamu bisa mengambil berbagai benda di dalam air!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Grab_Start_003
Array.english: <size=32>Why don’t you test them out yourself?\nEnter the water!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kenapa kamu tidak mencobanya sendiri?\nMasuklah ke dalam air!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Grab_Step01_001
Array.english: Objects that can be picked up\nwill show a <color=#F1DC2B>button</color> when you go near them.
Array.indonesia: Benda-benda yang bisa diambil\nakan menampilkan <color=#F1DC2B>tombol</color> saat kamu mendekatinya.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Grab_Step01_002
Array.english: First try grabbing the <color=#1DFEAF>pile of rocks</color> over there and dropping them.
Array.indonesia: Pertama-tama, coba ambil <color=#1DFEAF>tumpukan batu</color> di sana dan jatuhkan.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Grab_Step01_003
Array.english: That’s weak wood, so you should be able to break through.
Array.indonesia: Kayunya rapuh, jadi kamu seharusnya bisa menembusnya.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Grab_Step02_001
Array.english: <size=32>Wow! Very nice!\nLet’s try going down!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wah! Bagus sekali!\nAyo coba turun!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Grab_Step03_001
Array.english: The current’s strong!\nGrab that <color=#1DFEAF>Anchor</color> so it won’t sweep you away!
Array.indonesia: Arusnya kuat!\nPegang <color=#1DFEAF>Jangkar</color> itu agar kamu tidak terbawa arus!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Grab_Step04_001
Array.english: Good! You can grab onto objects like that to anchor yourself.\nThat’ll come in handy in places with strong currents.
Array.indonesia: Bagus! Kamu bisa memegang benda-benda seperti itu untuk menahan diri.\nItu akan berguna di tempat-tempat dengan arus yang kuat.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Grab_Step05_001
Array.english: Oh! I see something shiny back there!\nGrab the <color=#1DFEAF>Stake</color> in front of you and pull.
Array.indonesia: Oh! Aku melihat sesuatu yang berkilau di belakang sana!\nPegang <color=#1DFEAF>Tiang</color> di depanmu dan tarik.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Grab_Step06_001
Array.english: Awesome!! Since the path is open, grab the treasure up top\nbefore coming up!
Array.indonesia: Keren!! Karena jalannya sudah terbuka, ambil harta karun di atas\nsebelum naik!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Grab_End_001
Array.english: Alright, see you in the boat!
Array.indonesia: Baiklah, sampai jumpa di perahu!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Warning_01
Array.english: Let’s train somewhere close for now!
Array.indonesia: Ayo berlatih di tempat yang dekat dulu!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Warning_02
Array.english: Always watch your oxygen levels!\nThis time I’ll give you an extra Oxygen Tank!
Array.indonesia: Selalu perhatikan tingkat oksigenmu!\nKali ini aku akan memberimu Tabung Oksigen ekstra!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Warning_03
Array.english: Dave... All this costs money...
Array.indonesia: Dave... Semua ini butuh uang...

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Start_01
Array.english: <size=37>Dave, have you read the email you just got?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Dave, sudahkah kamu membaca email yang baru saja kamu terima?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Start_02
Array.english: Yes! It says that there will be a <color=#F1DC2B>Tuna Party</color> soon!
Array.indonesia: Ya! Di situ tertulis bahwa akan ada <color=#F1DC2B>Pesta Tuna</color> sebentar lagi!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Start_03
Array.english: Right! And tuna is sushi’s best friend!\nWe can sell them for a good profit!
Array.indonesia: Benar! Dan tuna adalah sahabat terbaik sushi!\nKita bisa menjualnya dengan untung besar!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Start_04
Array.english: I haven’t seen tuna in the Blue Hole for a while.\nIt’s the beginning of tuna season now.
Array.indonesia: Sudah lama aku tidak melihat tuna di Blue Hole.\nSekarang sudah awal musim tuna.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Start_05
Array.english: <size=38>We will be able to make a fortune using this party!\nHahaha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Kita bisa meraup untung besar dari pesta ini!\nHahaha!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Start_06
Array.english: Hm, but isn’t it difficult to catch tuna?\nI hear that they are very fast swimmers.
Array.indonesia: Hm, tapi bukankah sulit menangkap tuna?\nKudengar mereka berenang sangat cepat.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Start_07
Array.english: <size=35>Wahaha! That’s why investment is needed!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wahaha! Itulah mengapa kita perlu berinvestasi!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Start_08
Array.english: In the afternoon, I will bring a <color=#1DFEAF>tool that can catch tuna</color>.\nI will see you later then!
Array.indonesia: Sore nanti, aku akan membawa <color=#1DFEAF>alat yang bisa menangkap tuna</color>.\nSampai jumpa nanti!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Item_01
Array.english: Well, let’s <color=#F1DC2B>Hunt Tuna</color> for real, shall we?
Array.indonesia: Baiklah, mari kita <color=#F1DC2B>Berburu Tuna</color> yang sesungguhnya, ya?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Item_02
Array.english: <size=38>Take this.\nIt’s a <color=#1DFEAF>Steel Net Sensor Trap</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Ambil ini.\nIni adalah <color=#1DFEAF>Perangkap Jaring Baja Ber sensor</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Item_03
Array.english: Even the swiftest and biggest tuna\ncannot escape this trap!
Array.indonesia: Bahkan tuna tercepat dan terbesar sekalipun\ntidak bisa lolos dari perangkap ini!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Item_04
Array.english: And I got a secret weapon for today’s hunt!
Array.indonesia: Dan aku punya senjata rahasia untuk perburuan hari ini!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Item_05
Array.english: <size=38>The <color=#1DFEAF>Underwater Drone</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38><color=#1DFEAF>Drone Bawah Air</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Item_06
Array.english: It took me quite some time to replace the one you broke \nlast time. It’s very expensive stuff to buy, you know?
Array.indonesia: Butuh waktu cukup lama bagiku untuk mengganti yang kamu rusak \nterakhir kali. Barang ini sangat mahal, lho?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Item_07
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>But that wasn’t my fault! It broke the moment I activated it...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Tapi itu bukan salahku! Drone itu rusak begitu aku mengaktifkannya...</color>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Item_08
Array.english: <size=35>I made a big investment for moments like this!\nThis is what a business man does!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Aku berinvestasi besar-besaran untuk momen seperti ini!\nInilah yang dilakukan seorang pengusaha!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Item_09
Array.english: Let me show you how to use that. Just follow my instructions.
Array.indonesia: Biarkan aku tunjukkan cara menggunakannya. Ikuti saja instruksiku.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Item_10
Array.english: <size=38>Dive in the water!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Selam ke dalam air!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_BeforeCatch_01
Array.english: Aha, I sense a school of tuna coming this way.\nGreat luck!
Array.indonesia: Aha, aku merasakan sekelompok tuna sedang mendekat ke arah sini.\nBeruntung sekali!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_BeforeCatch_02
Array.english: <size=37>Lay the <color=#1DFEAF>Net Trap with Large Sensor</color> in their path!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Letakkan <color=#1DFEAF>Jaring Perangkap dengan Sensor Besar</color> di jalur mereka!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Catch_01
Array.english: <size=38>Nice! We got tuna!\nGo near the net!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Bagus! Kita dapat tuna!\nDekati jaringnya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Catch_02
Array.english: Hm...\nThe fish is too big for me to drag up...
Array.indonesia: Hm...\nIkan ini terlalu besar untuk aku tarik ke atas...

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Catch_03
Array.english: Hahaha!\nThat’s why I prepared this <color=#1DFEAF>Underwater Drone</color>!
Array.indonesia: Hahaha!\nItulah mengapa aku menyiapkan <color=#1DFEAF>Drone Bawah Air</color> ini!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Catch_04
Array.english: <size=38>Let’s call the drone to bring in the fish.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Ayo panggil drone itu untuk menarik ikan tersebut.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Salvage_01
Array.english: Oh, it can get this big tuna without a problem!\nI am impressed!
Array.indonesia: Oh, drone ini bisa menangkap tuna sebesar ini tanpa masalah!\nAku terkesan!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Salvage_02
Array.english: It’s very powerful, so if you ever catch a big fish,\nuse the drone.
Array.indonesia: Drone ini sangat kuat, jadi kalau kamu berhasil menangkap ikan besar,\ngunakan drone ini.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Salvage_03
Array.english: You will need one of these drones to keep the grade \nof your catch. Fish with wounds can’t have a high grade.
Array.indonesia: Kamu akan membutuhkan drone ini untuk menjaga \nkualitas tangkapanmu. Ikan yang terluka tidak bisa mendapat nilai kualitas tinggi.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Salvage_04
Array.english: <size=37>I will lend that drone to you for now.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Aku akan meminjamkan drone itu kepadamu untuk sementara.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Salvage_05
Array.english: It’s the basic model without any options because it’s expensive. Bring that to <color=#F1DC2B>iDiver</color> if you want upgrades.
Array.indonesia: Ini model dasar tanpa opsi tambahan karena harganya mahal. Bawa drone itu ke <color=#F1DC2B>iDiver</color> jika kamu ingin melakukan upgrade.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Salvage_06
Array.english: <size=37>Now, let’s collect as many ingredients as we can before the tuna party!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Sekarang, ayo kumpulkan bahan-bahan sebanyak mungkin sebelum pesta tuna!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Appear_01
Array.english: Oh! I see <color=#1DFEAF>Tuna</color>!
Array.indonesia: Oh! Aku melihat <color=#1DFEAF>Tuna</color>!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Appear_02
Array.english: The fish is big but fast...
Array.indonesia: Ikan itu besar tapi cepat...

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Appear_03
Array.english: I would love to catch them...\nShould I use a <color=#1DFEAF>tool</color>?
Array.indonesia: Aku ingin sekali menangkapnya...\nHaruskah aku menggunakan <color=#1DFEAF>alat</color>?

Array.name: dialog_Ingredient_search_01
Array.english: Dave! Don't you wonder how the <color=#1DFEAF>Underwater Drones</color> locate sea creatures with such precision?
Array.indonesia: Dave! Apa kamu tidak penasaran bagaimana <color=#1DFEAF>Drone Bawah Air</color> bisa menemukan makhluk laut dengan begitu tepat?

Array.name: dialog_Ingredient_search_02
Array.english: Now that I think of it, it is pretty interesting. How do they do it?
Array.indonesia: Sekarang setelah kupikir-pikir, itu cukup menarik. Bagaimana mereka melakukannya?

Array.name: dialog_Ingredient_search_03
Array.english: <size=34>Muwahaha! It's because the boat has a scanning feature!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Muwahaha! Itu karena perahu itu punya fitur pemindaian!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Ingredient_search_04
Array.english: <size=34>Oh, what is that?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh, apa itu?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Ingredient_search_05
Array.english: It's a feature that shows the locations of various vegetation around Blue Hole.
Array.indonesia: Itu adalah fitur yang menampilkan lokasi berbagai vegetasi di sekitar Blue Hole.

Array.name: dialog_Ingredient_search_06
Array.english: It helps identify the exact location for the drones to navigate to.
Array.indonesia: Fitur ini membantu mengidentifikasi lokasi tepat yang harus dituju oleh drone.

Array.name: dialog_Ingredient_search_07
Array.english: This feature can also help you spot ingredients or materials you're searching for.
Array.indonesia: Fitur ini juga bisa membantumu menemukan bahan atau material yang sedang kamu cari.

Array.name: dialog_Ingredient_search_08
Array.english: That's neat! I always have a hard time finding the things I need.
Array.indonesia: Keren! Aku selalu kesulitan menemukan barang-barang yang kubutuhkan.

Array.name: dialog_Ingredient_search_09
Array.english: Well, you do need to be close to whatever you're looking for to know its exact location...\nBut it should still be useful.
Array.indonesia: Yah, kamu memang harus berada di dekat apa pun yang kamu cari untuk mengetahui lokasinya yang tepat...\nTapi fitur ini seharusnya tetap berguna.

Array.name: dialog_Ingredient_search_10
Array.english: <size=33>I added the <color=#F1DC2B>Tracking</color> button to where it will be most practical.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku menambahkan tombol <color=#F1DC2B>Pelacakan</color> ke tempat yang paling praktis.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Ingredient_search_11
Array.english: <size=34>Activate it to track what you need!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aktifkan tombol itu untuk melacak apa yang kamu butuhkan!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_MimaRestaurant_Step01_001
Array.english: <size=35>Long time no see, Dave!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Lama tidak bertemu, Dave!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_MimaRestaurant_Step01_002
Array.english: I wanted to tell you that I am back in the restaurant business,\nbut couldn’t find your number, hoho!
Array.indonesia: Aku ingin memberitahumu bahwa aku kembali ke bisnis restoran,\ntapi tidak bisa menemukan nomormu, hoho!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_MimaRestaurant_Step01_003
Array.english: <size=36>The famous local dish of the village, Mima’s <color=#F1DC2B>Sea Weed Dumplings</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Hidangan lokal terkenal dari desa ini, <color=#F1DC2B>Pangsit Rumput Laut</color> buatan Mima!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_MimaRestaurant_Step01_004
Array.english: The dumpling skin is tight enough to maintain its form\neven in the water. You should try some!
Array.indonesia: Kulit pangsitnya cukup kencang sehingga bentuknya tetap utuh\nbahkan di dalam air. Kamu harus mencobanya!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_MimaRestaurant_Step01_005
Array.english: <size=35>How am I supposed to eat it underwater?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Bagaimana caranya aku memakannya di bawah air?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_MimaRestaurant_Step01_007
Array.english: <size=50>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_MimaRestaurant_Step01_008
Array.english: <size=38>Hahaha!\nWhy don’t you try one now?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Hahaha!\nKenapa kamu tidak mencobanya sekarang?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_MimaRestaurant_Step01_009
Array.english: <size=35>I will make you a special version!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Aku akan membuatkanmu versi spesial!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_MimaRestaurant_Step01_010
Array.english: <size=33>I am always down for delicious food!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku selalu siap menikmati makanan lezat!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_MimaRestaurant_Step02_001
Array.english: <size=35>Wow! It’s really delicious!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wow! Ini benar-benar enak!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_MimaRestaurant_Step02_002
Array.english: I feel like I am energized.
Array.indonesia: Aku merasa penuh energi.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_MimaRestaurant_Step02_003
Array.english: Oh, it’s not just a feeling. It actually energizes you!
Array.indonesia: Oh, itu bukan sekadar perasaan. Ini benar-benar memberi energi padamu!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_MimaRestaurant_Step02_004
Array.english: Each dumpling contains different stuffing, so take your pick.
Array.indonesia: Setiap pangsit berisi isian yang berbeda, jadi silakan pilih.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_MimaRestaurant_Step02_005
Array.english: Oh, the effect of Sea Weed Dumplings dissipates when you leave the water,\nso visit me whenever you need the effect!
Array.indonesia: Oh, efek Pangsit Rumput Laut akan hilang begitu kamu keluar dari air,\njadi kunjungi aku kapan pun kamu butuh efeknya!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_MimaRestaurant_Step02_006
Array.english: <size=35>See you around, Dave!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Sampai jumpa, Dave!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_StartCall_001
Array.english: Ah, Ms. Lois?
Array.indonesia: Ah, Nona Lois?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_StartCall_002
Array.english: <size=32>The <color=#F1DC2B>branch</color> is ready for business.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Cabang <color=#F1DC2B>tersebut</color> sudah siap beroperasi.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_StartCall_003
Array.english: <size=34>That quickly?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Secepat itu?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_StartCall_004
Array.english: *Smiling* The administrative agility of the B&C Group is \nthe top in the industry.
Array.indonesia: *Tersenyum* Kelincahan administratif Grup B&C adalah \nyang terbaik di industri ini.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_StartCall_005
Array.english: <size=32>Visit the <color=#F1DC2B>branch</color> with Bancho.\nI will see you there.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kunjungi <color=#F1DC2B>cabang</color> bersama Bancho.\nAku akan menemuimu di sana.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_FirstImpressions_001
Array.english: <size=35>Oh! This is the <color=#F1DC2B>branch</color>!\nThe place gives off a tropical vibe!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh! Ini dia <color=#F1DC2B>cabang</color>!\nTempat ini memancarkan suasana tropis!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_FirstImpressions_002
Array.english: Not exactly my taste,\nbut it blends in well with the surrounding environment.
Array.indonesia: Bukan benar-benar selera saya,\ntapi tempat ini menyatu dengan baik dengan lingkungan sekitarnya.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_FirstImpressions_003
Array.english: <size=34>Ho ho! This is a time-proven theme for restaurants on the beach.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ho ho! Ini adalah tema yang sudah teruji waktu untuk restoran di tepi pantai.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_FirstImpressions_004
Array.english: <size=33>Let me explain how to run your branch.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Izinkan saya menjelaskan cara mengelola cabang Anda.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_CheckStaffMenu_001
Array.english: <size=32>Obviously, you need <color=#1DFEAF>staff members</color> to run your business.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tentu saja, Anda membutuhkan <color=#1DFEAF>anggota staf</color> untuk menjalankan bisnis Anda.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_CheckStaffMenu_002
Array.english: <size=34>Open the <color=#1DFEAF>Staff</color> menu below.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Buka menu <color=#1DFEAF>Staf</color> di bawah ini.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_CheckStaffMenu01_001
Array.english: You need at least <color=#1DFEAF>three</color> staff members to run the store.
Array.indonesia: Anda membutuhkan setidaknya <color=#1DFEAF>tiga</color> anggota staf untuk mengelola toko tersebut.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_CheckStaffMenu01_002
Array.english: Hm, do I need that many?
Array.indonesia: Hm, apakah saya membutuhkan sebanyak itu?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_CheckStaffMenu01_003
Array.english: Yes, because neither you nor Dave will be there at the branch.
Array.indonesia: Ya, karena baik Anda maupun Dave tidak akan berada di cabang tersebut.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_CheckStaffMenu01_004
Array.english: So you need to hire a <color=#F1DC2B>manager</color> to supervise \nthe business there.
Array.indonesia: Jadi, Anda perlu mempekerjakan seorang <color=#F1DC2B>manajer</color> untuk mengawasi \nbisnis di sana.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_CheckStaffMenu01_005
Array.english: And of course, you need to staff the <color=#1DFEAF>Dining Area</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>Kitchen</color> as well, just like at the HQ.
Array.indonesia: Dan tentu saja, Anda juga perlu mengisi staf di <color=#1DFEAF>Area Makan</color> dan <color=#1DFEAF>Dapur</color>, sama seperti di kantor pusat.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_CheckStaffMenu01_006
Array.english: That is why you need a minimum of three staff members to open and run the branch.
Array.indonesia: Itulah mengapa Anda membutuhkan minimal tiga orang staf untuk membuka dan mengelola cabang tersebut.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_CheckStaffMenu01_007
Array.english: Hm, a manager...
Array.indonesia: Hm, seorang manajer...

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_CheckStaffMenu02_001
Array.english: <size=34>Right! \nThe <color=#F1DC2B>manager</color> is the most important!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Benar! \nSi <color=#F1DC2B>manajer</color> adalah yang paling penting!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_CheckStaffMenu02_002
Array.english: It’s because the number of ingredients available and the number of customers depend on the stats of your manager.
Array.indonesia: Hal ini karena jumlah bahan baku yang tersedia dan jumlah pelanggan bergantung pada statistik manajer Anda.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_CheckStaffMenu02_003
Array.english: It is best to appoint a staff member with the highest stats to the manager position.
Array.indonesia: Sebaiknya tunjuk staf dengan statistik tertinggi untuk posisi manajer.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_CheckStaffMenu02_004
Array.english: Oh...If I appoint a manager, \nthey will run the business on their own?
Array.indonesia: Oh.. .Jika saya menunjuk seorang manajer, \napakah dia akan menjalankan bisnis sendiri?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_CheckStaffMenu02_005
Array.english: Nope. Your manager cannot run the business \nagainst the operation policy of the HQ.
Array.indonesia: Tidak. Manajer Anda tidak dapat menjalankan bisnis \nbertentangan dengan kebijakan operasional kantor pusat.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_CheckStaffMenu02_006
Array.english: You need to set an <color=#1DFEAF>Operation Policy</color> to give guidance to the manager, according to which the manager will prepare the menu appropriately.
Array.indonesia: Anda perlu menetapkan <color=#1DFEAF>Kebijakan Operasional</color> untuk memberikan panduan kepada manajer, yang akan menjadi acuan bagi manajer dalam menyiapkan menu dengan tepat.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_CheckStaffMenu02_007
Array.english: <size=30>So, I could instruct the manager what to serve as I see fit, right? Like expensive dishes or dishes with the most ingredients first?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=30>Jadi, saya bisa menginstruksikan manajer apa yang harus disajikan sesuai keinginan saya, kan? Misalnya hidangan mahal atau hidangan dengan bahan terbanyak terlebih dahulu?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_CheckStaffMenu02_008
Array.english: <size=33>Yes, exactly.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ya, tepat sekali.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_CheckIngredientMenu_001
Array.english: <size=34>Let’s talk about ingredients.\nOpen the <color=#1DFEAF>Ingredient</color> menu below.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Mari kita bahas soal bahan-bahan.\nBuka menu <color=#1DFEAF>Bahan</color> di bawah ini.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_IngredientMenu01_001
Array.english: The grade of your manager determines the <color=#1DFEAF>ingredients</color> used \nat the branch.
Array.indonesia: Tingkat manajer Anda menentukan <color=#1DFEAF>bahan-bahan</color> yang digunakan \ndi cabang tersebut.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_IngredientMenu01_002
Array.english: Check the <color=#1DFEAF>ingredients</color> currently available and predict \nthe sales revenue.
Array.indonesia: Periksa <color=#1DFEAF>bahan-bahan</color> yang saat ini tersedia dan perkirakan \npendapatan penjualan.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_IngredientMenu01_003
Array.english: Well, it seems like there are no ingredients at the branch \nat the moment.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya tidak ada bahan-bahan di cabang \nsaat ini.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_IngredientMenu01_004
Array.english: That’s because it’s not open yet. You can bring ingredients from the HQ or the Fish Farm at any time.
Array.indonesia: Itu karena cabang tersebut belum buka. Anda dapat membawa bahan-bahan dari Kantor Pusat atau Peternakan Ikan kapan saja.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_IngredientMenu02_001
Array.english: <size=35>Would you click the <color=#1DFEAF>Deliver</color> button below?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Bisakah Anda mengklik tombol <color=#1DFEAF>Kirim</color> di bawah ini?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_IngredientMenu03_001
Array.english: <size=34>You can send or receive ingredients from here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kamu bisa mengirim atau menerima bahan-bahan dari sini.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_IngredientMenu03_002
Array.english: As I said earlier, your manager cannot use ingredients\nwhose grade is higher than theirs.
Array.indonesia: Seperti yang sudah saya katakan sebelumnya, manajermu tidak bisa menggunakan bahan-bahan\nyang tingkat kualitasnya lebih tinggi daripada milik mereka.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_Complete_001
Array.english: I am sure that you now understand what to do with the branch.
Array.indonesia: Saya yakin sekarang Anda sudah mengerti apa yang harus dilakukan dengan cabang tersebut.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_Complete_002
Array.english: <size=34>Ba Ha ha! I now own a second restaurant!\nThat means twice the revenue!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ha ha ha! Sekarang saya punya restoran kedua!\nItu berarti pendapatan dua kali lipat!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_Complete_003
Array.english: Only if you run it successfully, I might add.
Array.indonesia: Asalkan Anda mengelolanya dengan sukses, saya tambahkan.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_Complete_004
Array.english: We will see how it goes, okay?
Array.indonesia: Kita lihat saja nanti bagaimana hasilnya, oke?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_Complete_005
Array.english: Let more people experience your culinary revolution.\nI am sure they will love your recipes.
Array.indonesia: Biarkan lebih banyak orang merasakan revolusi kulinermu.\nAku yakin mereka akan menyukai resep-resepmu.

Array.name: dialog_Night_Warning_01
Array.english: The restaurant is still open,\nso let’s not go too far.
Array.indonesia: Restoran masih buka,\njadi jangan pergi terlalu jauh.

Array.name: dialog_TimeSkip_Warning_001
Array.english: An important customer is coming today.\nLet's go to Bancho Sushi.
Array.indonesia: Ada pelanggan penting yang datang hari ini.\nAyo kita ke Bancho Sushi.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission02_001
Array.english: <size=34>Ah... But…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ah... Tapi…</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission02_002
Array.english: As Dr. Bacon said, if the remains of Sea People are found here,\ncustomers will indeed come, but…
Array.indonesia: Seperti yang dikatakan Dr. Bacon, jika sisa-sisa Sea People ditemukan di sini,\npelanggan memang akan datang, tapi…

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission02_003
Array.english: This area is kind of remote. \nSo, I think I will need a way to advertise the store until then.
Array.indonesia: Daerah ini agak terpencil. \nJadi, kurasa aku perlu cara untuk mempromosikan toko ini sampai saat itu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission02_004
Array.english: Yeah…These days it's just about impossible to attract \ncustomers without publicity.
Array.indonesia: Ya… Saat ini hampir mustahil menarik \npelanggan tanpa promosi.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission02_005
Array.english: <size=33>Ah!!! \nHave you tried the social media app named <color=#ff61e3>Cooksta</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ah!!! \nSudahkah kamu mencoba aplikasi media sosial bernama <color=#ff61e3>Cooksta</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission02_006
Array.english: You mean…the social media app young people use to\npost pictures of the food they eat?
Array.indonesia: Maksudmu… aplikasi media sosial yang dipakai anak muda untuk\nmengunggah foto makanan yang mereka makan?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission02_007
Array.english: Yeah. That's how all businesses are promoting\nthemselves lately!
Array.indonesia: Iya. Begitulah cara semua bisnis mempromosikan\ndiri mereka belakangan ini!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission02_008
Array.english: I simply can’t understand why people would waste their time\nlike that.
Array.indonesia: Aku benar-benar nggak ngerti kenapa orang-orang mau buang-buang waktu\nseperti itu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission02_009
Array.english: <size=35>Sushi makes an impression on the heart,\nnot photographs!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Sushi meninggalkan kesan di hati,\nbukan foto-foto!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission02_010
Array.english: Hmm... even so, isn’t it better to use it than to keep\npeople ignorant of your food, <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color>?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... meski begitu, bukankah lebih baik menggunakannya daripada membiarkan\norang-orang tidak tahu tentang makananmu, <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color>?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission02_011
Array.english: <size=36>…You have a point there...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>…Kamu ada benarnya juga...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission02_012
Array.english: Making an account is simple, so let’s try it out.\rYou first register and make the hashtag #bancho_sushi\nthen...
Array.indonesia: Membuat akun itu mudah, jadi ayo kita coba.\rPertama-tama, kamu daftar dan buat tagar #bancho_sushi\nlalu...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission02_013
Array.english: <size=43>Done!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=43>Selesai!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission02_014
Array.english: Hmm... Well, it’s not as complicated as I expected...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Wah, ternyata tidak serumit yang aku kira...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission02_015
Array.english: Now customers happy with your food will follow <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho Sushi</color>.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang, pelanggan yang puas dengan makananmu akan mengikuti <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho Sushi</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission02_016
Array.english: Hm. I'm not sure about this…but okay. \nI got it.
Array.indonesia: Hm. Aku ragu-ragu soal ini… tapi oke. \nAku mengerti.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission02_017
Array.english: I'll also install the <color=#ff61e3>Cooksta</color> app on my phone\nand check the followers' posts!
Array.indonesia: Aku juga akan menginstal aplikasi <color=#ff61e3>Cooksta</color> di ponselku\ndan memeriksa postingan para pengikut!

Array.name: dialog_Side_SecondDayDuff_001
Array.english: Dave, did you get to loosen up yesterday?
Array.indonesia: Dave, apakah kamu sempat bersantai kemarin?

Array.name: dialog_Side_SecondDayDuff_002
Array.english: Hmm... I saw a lot of nasty fish.\nIt won’t be easy to go any deeper.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Aku melihat banyak ikan yang menjijikkan.\nTidak akan mudah untuk menyelam lebih dalam lagi.

Array.name: dialog_Side_SecondDayDuff_003
Array.english: Hmm... I did notice that the fish in the <color=#90CDFF>Blue Hole</color>\nhave an odd violent streak.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Aku memang memperhatikan bahwa ikan-ikan di <color=#90CDFF>Blue Hole</color>\nmemiliki sifat agresif yang aneh.

Array.name: dialog_Side_SecondDayDuff_004
Array.english: Perhaps something puts them on edge?
Array.indonesia: Mungkin ada sesuatu yang membuat mereka gelisah?

Array.name: dialog_Side_SecondDayDuff_005
Array.english: Speaking of which, why don’t you also take a <color=#1DFEAF>Gun</color>\nin addition to the Harpoon?
Array.indonesia: Ngomong-ngomong, kenapa kamu tidak membawa juga <color=#1DFEAF>Senjata</color>\nselain Harpoon?

Array.name: dialog_Side_SecondDayDuff_006
Array.english: <size=38>A <color=#1DFEAF>Gun</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Sebuah <color=#1DFEAF>Pistol</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_SecondDayDuff_007
Array.english: I have a friend who’s knowledgeable about guns...\nI’ll introduce you to him.
Array.indonesia: Aku punya teman yang paham soal senjata...\nAku akan memperkenalkanmu padanya.

Array.name: dialog_Side_IntroduceDuff_001
Array.english: Wow...<color=#F1DC2B>Cobra</color>, it’s been a while. \nWho is the goofy looking guy next to you?
Array.indonesia: Wow...<color=#F1DC2B>Cobra</color>, sudah lama tidak bertemu. \nSiapa pria yang kelihatan konyol di sebelahmu?

Array.name: dialog_Side_IntroduceDuff_002
Array.english: Sorry, that wasn’t the nicest thing to say to a stranger.\nI’m <color=#F1DC2B>Dave</color>, a professional diver.
Array.indonesia: Maaf, itu bukan ucapan yang sopan untuk orang asing.\nAku <color=#F1DC2B>Dave</color>, seorang penyelam profesional.

Array.name: dialog_Side_IntroduceDuff_003
Array.english: Interesting. I thought divers were athletic and muscular...\nYou seem to defy my prior knowledge.
Array.indonesia: Menarik. Aku kira penyelam itu atletis dan berotot...\nKamu sepertinya bertentangan dengan pengetahuan aku sebelumnya.

Array.name: dialog_Side_IntroduceDuff_004
Array.english: <size=35>People who live in glass houses...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Orang yang tinggal di rumah kaca...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_IntroduceDuff_005
Array.english: So, what’s this about? \nI’d like you to get straight to the point...
Array.indonesia: Jadi, ada apa ini? \nAku ingin kamu langsung ke intinya...

Array.name: dialog_Side_IntroduceDuff_006
Array.english: I’ve begun a very interesting business. Hahaha!
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah memulai bisnis yang sangat menarik. Hahaha!

Array.name: dialog_Side_IntroduceDuff_006_02
Array.english: And now I’m in need of some weapons.\n<color=#F1DC2B>Duff</color>, I need your help.
Array.indonesia: Dan sekarang aku butuh beberapa senjata.\n<color=#F1DC2B>Duff</color>, aku butuh bantuanmu.

Array.name: dialog_Side_IntroduceDuff_007
Array.english: Hmm... Season 2 of <color=#1DFEAF>Stra Stella</color> just ended anyway…\nI’ll give you a listen.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Musim 2 <color=#1DFEAF>Stra Stella</color> baru saja berakhir...\nAku akan mendengarkannya.

Array.name: dialog_Side_IntroduceDuff_008
Array.english: Alright. I actually discovered a fascinating <color=#90CDFF>Giant Blue Hole</color>. \nThe terrain and ecology inside it changes every time you go inside.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah. Sebenarnya aku menemukan <color=#90CDFF>Giant Blue Hole</color> yang sangat menarik. \nMedan dan ekologi di dalamnya berubah setiap kali kamu masuk ke dalamnya.

Array.name: dialog_Side_IntroduceDuff_008_02
Array.english: Oddly, any equipment found inside breaks down \nwhen brought out.
Array.indonesia: Anehnya, peralatan apa pun yang ditemukan di dalamnya akan rusak \nsaat dibawa keluar.

Array.name: dialog_Side_IntroduceDuff_009
Array.english: <size=34>I’d like you to make us a weapon that can be \nused inside.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku ingin kamu membuatkan kami senjata yang bisa \ndigunakan di dalam sana.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_IntroduceDuff_010
Array.english: Hmm... That is rather interesting. You’ve piqued my interest \nas a weapon researcher...you could say.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Itu cukup menarik. Kamu telah membangkitkan minatku \nsebagai peneliti senjata... bisa dibilang begitu.

Array.name: dialog_Side_IntroduceDuff_011
Array.english: My hypothesis is that…anything that’s not made from materials found in the <color=#90CDFF>Blue Hole</color> will continue to break down.\rThis will be especially true of <color=#1DFEAF>Guns</color>, which have precision parts.
Array.indonesia: Hipotesisku adalah bahwa… apa pun yang tidak terbuat dari bahan yang ditemukan di <color=#90CDFF>Blue Hole</color> akan terus rusak.\rHal ini terutama berlaku untuk <color=#1DFEAF>Senjata Api</color>, yang memiliki komponen presisi.

Array.name: dialog_Side_IntroduceDuff_012
Array.english: Hmm... \nSo we’ll have to get the materials from the sea ourselves...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... \nJadi, kita harus mengambil bahan-bahan itu dari laut sendiri...

Array.name: dialog_Side_IntroduceDuff_013
Array.english: Heh. Dave, you’ll have to prove yourself as a diver\nto this master <color=#F1DC2B>Duff</color>.
Array.indonesia: Heh. Dave, kamu harus membuktikan diri sebagai penyelam\nkepada sang ahli <color=#F1DC2B>Duff</color> ini.

Array.name: dialog_Side_IntroduceDuff_014
Array.english: I’m not sure why I should have to prove myself to you...\nJust tell me what you need.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak yakin mengapa aku harus membuktikan diri kepadamu...\nKatakan saja apa yang kamu butuhkan.

Array.name: dialog_Side_IntroduceDuff_015
Array.english: Since it appears you have no guns at all, let’s start with something easy. I think I’ll need <color=#1DFEAF>1 Rope and 1 Scrap Iron</color>...
Array.indonesia: Karena sepertinya kamu sama sekali tidak punya senjata, mari kita mulai dengan sesuatu yang mudah. Kurasa aku butuh <color=#1DFEAF>1 Tali dan 1 Besi Bekas</color>...

Array.name: dialog_Side_IntroduceDuff_016
Array.english: You heard him, right Dave?\nEnter the Blue Hole and bring back <color=#1DFEAF>Rope</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>Scrap Iron</color>.
Array.indonesia: Kamu dengar kan, Dave?\nMasuklah ke Blue Hole dan bawakan <color=#1DFEAF>Tali</color> serta <color=#1DFEAF>Besi Bekas</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Side_IntroduceDuff_017
Array.english: By the way, if you run out of oxygen midway,\nyou’ll only be able to make it back with <color=#F1DC2B>1 item</color>. \nAlways keep that in mind!
Array.indonesia: Ngomong-ngomong, kalau oksigenmu habis di tengah jalan,\nkamu hanya bisa kembali dengan <color=#F1DC2B>1 barang</color>. \nSelalu ingat itu!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff01_Complete_001
Array.english: Well. To think you’d actually manage to bring it back...\nI expected you to quietly expire in the depths... you could say.
Array.indonesia: Wah. Siapa sangka kamu benar-benar berhasil membawanya kembali...\nAku kira kamu akan mati diam-diam di kedalaman... bisa dibilang begitu.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff01_Complete_002
Array.english: <size=50>….</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>….</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff01_Complete_003
Array.english: Seems I have underestimated you slightly.\nVery well.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya aku sedikit meremehkanmu.\nBaiklah.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff01_Complete_004
Array.english: I’ll show you how to make the <color=#1DFEAF>Basic Underwater Rifle</color> with \nthese materials.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan menunjukkan caranya membuat <color=#1DFEAF>Senapan Bawah Air Dasar</color> dengan \nbahan-bahan ini.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff01_Complete_005
Array.english: First of all, download <color=#72ff0a>Duff’s Weapon Shop</color> on your phone.\nIt’s well optimized. Only 42MB... you could say.
Array.indonesia: Pertama-tama, unduh <color=#72ff0a>Duff’s Weapon Shop</color> di ponselmu.\nAplikasinya sudah dioptimalkan dengan baik. Hanya 42MB... bisa dibilang begitu.

Array.name: Tutorial08_DuffWeapon_End_01
Array.english: Heh. With a neat explanation like that,\neven someone like you should have understood.
Array.indonesia: Heh. Dengan penjelasan yang jelas seperti itu,\nbahkan orang sepertimu seharusnya sudah mengerti.

Array.name: Tutorial08_DuffWeapon_End_02
Array.english: <size=36>Well, I guess...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Yah, kurasa...</size>

Array.name: Tutorial08_DuffWeapon_End_03
Array.english: <size=36>Oh, and one more thing.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Oh, dan satu hal lagi.</size>

Array.name: Tutorial08_DuffWeapon_End_04
Array.english: <size=33>I’ve taken some measures to allow you to open\n<color=#F1DC2B>Weapon Chests</color> underwater.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku sudah mengambil beberapa langkah agar kamu bisa membuka\n<color=#F1DC2B>Peti Senjata</color> di bawah air.</size>

Array.name: Tutorial08_DuffWeapon_End_05
Array.english: <size=36>Wow...<color=#F1DC2B>Weapon Chests</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Wah...<color=#F1DC2B>Peti Senjata</color>?</size>

Array.name: Tutorial08_DuffWeapon_End_06
Array.english: You can’t bring them out of the sea,\nbut they can still come in handy... you could say.
Array.indonesia: Kamu tidak bisa membawanya keluar dari laut,\ntapi peti-peti itu tetap bisa berguna... bisa dibilang begitu.

Array.name: Tutorial08_DuffWeapon_End_07
Array.english: Oh, but I’ll collect info about the weapons you pick up\nand create <color=#1DFEAF>Blueprints</color> for you.
Array.indonesia: Oh, tapi aku akan mengumpulkan informasi tentang senjata yang kamu temukan\ndan membuat <color=#1DFEAF>Blueprint</color> untukmu.

Array.name: Tutorial08_DuffWeapon_End_08
Array.english: Weapons made with a <color=#1DFEAF>Blueprint</color> won’t break down\nunderwater... you could say.
Array.indonesia: Senjata yang dibuat dengan <color=#1DFEAF>Blueprint</color> tidak akan rusak\ndi bawah air... bisa dibilang begitu.

Array.name: Tutorial08_DuffWeapon_End_09
Array.english: In any case, this master will be watching you.\n<color=#ff61e3>GOODBYE-TERNITY★</color>.
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun juga, sang master ini akan mengawasi kamu.\n<color=#ff61e3>GOODBYE-TERNITY★</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_001
Array.english: <size=33>Are you <color=#F1DC2B>Dave</color> by any chance?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Apakah kamu <color=#F1DC2B>Dave</color> kebetulan?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_002
Array.english: Yes. What is it, sir?
Array.indonesia: Ya. Ada apa, Pak?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_003
Array.english: Wow! I’m always right about these things! Haha!
Array.indonesia: Wow! Aku selalu benar soal hal-hal seperti ini! Haha!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_004
Array.english: Nice to meet you. I’m <color=#F1DC2B>Dr. Bacon</color>. \nI’m an archeologist who studies the Sea People civilization.
Array.indonesia: Senang bertemu denganmu. Saya <color=#F1DC2B>Dr. Bacon</color>. \nSaya seorang arkeolog yang meneliti peradaban Sea People.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_005
Array.english: <size=33>The... <color=#1DFEAF>Sea People civilization</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Peradaban... <color=#1DFEAF>Sea People</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_006
Array.english: Haha! I’ll explain it to you!\nAren’t you lucky, to have an expert like me tell you about them!
Array.indonesia: Haha! Saya akan menjelaskannya kepada Anda!\nAnda beruntung sekali, bisa mendengar penjelasan dari seorang ahli seperti saya!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_007
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>Um... Maybe I shouldn’t have asked...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Um... Mungkin sebaiknya aku tidak bertanya...</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_008
Array.english: <color=#1DFEAF>The Sea People civilization</color> lives in legends.\nThey are said to have occupied this region a very long time ago.
Array.indonesia: <color=#1DFEAF>Peradaban Sea People</color> hanya ada dalam legenda.\nKonon, mereka pernah mendiami wilayah ini sejak zaman dahulu kala.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_009
Array.english: They worshipped fish and had gills allowing them \nto live underwater.
Array.indonesia: Mereka menyembah ikan dan memiliki insang yang memungkinkan mereka \nhidup di bawah air.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_010
Array.english: They lived in the depths, allowing them to flourish\nwithout any concern for invasions by other civilizations...
Array.indonesia: Mereka tinggal di kedalaman laut, sehingga memungkinkan mereka berkembang\ntanpa perlu khawatir akan invasi dari peradaban lain...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_011
Array.english: But sudden changes to the sea bottom brought about their abrupt downfall...
Array.indonesia: Namun, perubahan mendadak pada dasar laut menyebabkan kehancuran mereka secara tiba-tiba...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_011_2
Array.english: That’s about all there is to the story.
Array.indonesia: Kurang lebih begitulah ceritanya.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_012
Array.english: Everyone thinks it's a myth and nothing more, \nof course...
Array.indonesia: Semua orang menganggapnya hanya mitos belaka, \ntentu saja...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_013
Array.english: <size=34>But proof that they were real was found\nright in the vicinity of this place!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Namun, bukti bahwa mereka benar-benar ada ditemukan\ntepat di sekitar tempat ini!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_014
Array.english: <size=38>Huh?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Hah?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_015
Array.english: This is an amazing find, \none that could turn the whole academic world upside down.\r<size=32>An ancient civilization under the sea…\nyou’d only see such things in comic books or games!</size>
Array.indonesia: Ini adalah penemuan yang luar biasa, \nyang bisa mengguncang seluruh dunia akademis.\r<size=32>Peradaban kuno di bawah laut…\nhal seperti itu biasanya hanya ada di komik atau game!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_016
Array.english: What makes you so sure they were real?
Array.indonesia: Apa yang membuatmu begitu yakin bahwa mereka benar-benar ada?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_017
Array.english: My assistant closely analyzed an artifact found nearby\nand found that it is from no known civilization.
Array.indonesia: Asistenku menganalisis secara mendalam sebuah artefak yang ditemukan di dekat sini\ndan menemukan bahwa artefak itu berasal dari peradaban yang tidak dikenal.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_018
Array.english: It’s dated to around 1,500 years ago as well...\nThere were no civilizations in these parts back then.
Array.indonesia: Artefak itu juga diperkirakan berusia sekitar 1.500 tahun…\nTidak ada peradaban di wilayah ini pada masa itu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_019
Array.english: Hmm, that is interesting.\nBut what business do you have with me?
Array.indonesia: Hmm, itu menarik.\nTapi apa urusanmu denganku?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_020
Array.english: Well, you see...My assistant’s cryptocurrency investments didn’t pan out and he won’t be around for a good while...
Array.indonesia: Nah, begini... Investasi kripto asistenku gagal dan dia tidak akan ada di sini untuk sementara waktu...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_021
Array.english: <size=36>That’s why I’d like you to help me!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Itulah mengapa aku ingin kamu membantuku!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_022
Array.english: <size=33>Oh...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_023
Array.english: My assistant told me that the artifact was found \n<color=#1DFEAF>70m</color> or so below the surface... please go take a look!
Array.indonesia: Asistenku memberitahuku bahwa artefak itu ditemukan \n<color=#1DFEAF>70m</color> atau lebih di bawah permukaan... tolong periksalah!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_024
Array.english: We’re busy with the sushi bar.\nI don’t think we can...
Array.indonesia: Kami sedang sibuk di bar sushi.\nKurasa kami tidak bisa...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_025
Array.english: <size=35>Haha! Sorry to interrupt the conversation!\nI’m <color=#F1DC2B>Cobra</color>! I work with Dave.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Haha! Maaf mengganggu percakapan kalian!\nAku <color=#F1DC2B>Cobra</color>! Aku bekerja sama dengan Dave.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_026
Array.english: <size=33>Of course we should help you.\nWe’ll gladly do so. Yahahah!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tentu saja kami harus membantumu.\nKami akan dengan senang hati melakukannya. Yahahah!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_027
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>What? We don’t have the time to swim around\nsearching for artifacts...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Apa? Kita nggak punya waktu buat berenang-renang\nmencari artefak...</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_030
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>Think about it! If an underwater civilization is discovered,\ncountless people will flock here.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Coba pikirin! Kalau peradaban bawah laut ditemukan,\nbanyak orang bakal berbondong-bondong ke sini.</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_031
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3><size=35>Bancho Sushi will be bursting at the seams!</size></color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3><size=35>Bancho Sushi bakal penuh sesak!</size></color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_033_2
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3><size=32>Um... I suppose you have a point.</size></color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3><size=32>Um... Kurasa kamu benar juga.</size></color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_034
Array.english: <size=36>Alright. I’ll help!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Baiklah. Aku akan membantu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_035
Array.english: <size=32>Haha! Isn’t that lucky!\nOh, of course, I won’t be asking you to work for free.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha! Beruntung sekali!\nOh, tentu saja, aku tidak akan meminta kamu bekerja secara gratis.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_036
Array.english: <size=32>I’ll upgrade the <color=#F1DC2B>Diving Suit</color> you’re wearing for free!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku akan meningkatkan <color=#F1DC2B>Pakaian Selam</color> yang kamu pakai secara gratis!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_037
Array.english: <size=36>Wow!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Wah!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_038
Array.english: With an enhanced Diving Suit, you’ll be able to venture deeper.\nThis is essential for exploration.
Array.indonesia: Dengan Pakaian Selam yang ditingkatkan, kamu bisa menjelajah lebih dalam.\nIni sangat penting untuk eksplorasi.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_039
Array.english: These days even such things can be handled by an app.\nTechnological advancements are amazing, eh?
Array.indonesia: Saat ini, hal-hal seperti itu pun bisa ditangani oleh sebuah aplikasi.\nKemajuan teknologi sungguh menakjubkan, ya?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_040
Array.english: <size=34>Let’s first install the <color=#72ff0a>iDiver</color> app on the phone before \nwe proceed!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Mari kita instal dulu aplikasi <color=#72ff0a>iDiver</color> di ponsel sebelum \nkita melanjutkan!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_Complete_01
Array.english: <size=35>Alright! You brought it out safely!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Baiklah! Kamu sudah mengeluarkannya dengan selamat!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_Complete_02
Array.english: It seems to be in very good condition.\nAlmost as if it was stored somewhere until recently...
Array.indonesia: Kondisinya tampak sangat baik.\nSeolah-olah baru saja disimpan di suatu tempat hingga baru-baru ini...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_Complete_03
Array.english: Hmm... Very interesting.\nThis may be the find of the century, even...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Sangat menarik.\nIni mungkin penemuan abad ini, bahkan...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_Complete_04
Array.english: Alright! Dave! Let’s continue to work together and uncover \nthe secrets of the <color=#1DFEAF>Sea People civilization</color>!
Array.indonesia: Baiklah! Dave! Mari kita terus bekerja sama dan mengungkap \nrahasia peradaban <color=#1DFEAF>Sea People</color>!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_Complete_05
Array.english: <size=33>What? I thought I’d only be helping you once...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Apa? Aku kira aku hanya akan membantumu sekali saja...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_Complete_06
Array.english: <size=38>Bwahaha! Of course, say no more!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Bwahaha! Tentu saja, tak perlu dikatakan lagi!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_Complete_07
Array.english: <size=36>Just put our restaurant\nat the top of the list of affiliates!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Cukup letakkan restoran kita\ndi urutan teratas daftar afiliasi!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_Complete_08
Array.english: <size=50>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_Complete_09
Array.english: <size=32>That won’t be hard to do!\nI’ve a very lucky feeling about this!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Itu tidak akan sulit!\nAku merasa ini akan membawa keberuntungan!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_Complete_10
Array.english: <size=40>I’ll be in touch!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Aku akan menghubungimu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission04_001
Array.english: <size=36>Uh, Dave... are you busy?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Eh, Dave... kamu sibuk?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission04_002
Array.english: Not at the moment.\nWhat is it?
Array.indonesia: Saat ini tidak.\nAda apa?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission04_003
Array.english: We have a <color=#1DFEAF>strange customer</color> at the sushi bar...
Array.indonesia: Ada <color=#1DFEAF>pelanggan aneh</color> di bar sushi...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission04_004
Array.english: <size=34>Could you come over for a moment?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Bisakah kamu datang sebentar?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission04_005
Array.english: As the manager this is something I can't overlook!\nI’ll come over right away!
Array.indonesia: Sebagai manajer, ini adalah sesuatu yang tidak bisa saya abaikan!\nSaya akan segera ke sana!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission04_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=40>Huh? Who dares interrupt me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Hah? Siapa yang berani mengganggu saya?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_001
Array.english: <size=36>I’m sorry, we’re not open yet.\nYou can’t come in like this!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Maaf, kami belum buka.\nKamu tidak boleh masuk begitu saja!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_002
Array.english: Well, aren’t you strict! I was simply saying a few words. \nI haven’t been to the beach in a while and it brings back old memories!
Array.indonesia: Wah, kamu benar-benar ketat! Aku hanya ingin berbincang sebentar. \nSudah lama aku tidak ke pantai dan ini membangkitkan kenangan lama!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_003
Array.english: <size=34>I was an amazing diver before \nI took a harpoon in the knee!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Dulu aku penyelam yang hebat \nsebelum lututku tertusuk tombak!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_004
Array.english: So you were a diver...\nI’m also a diver.
Array.indonesia: Jadi, kamu pernah jadi penyelam...\nAku juga penyelam.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_005
Array.english: <size=32>Heh heh! Then you must know the diver’s dream of swimming in all the seas of the world!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Heh heh! Kalau begitu, kamu pasti tahu impian setiap penyelam: berenang di semua lautan di dunia!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_006
Array.english: <size=34>Forests of coral! Pods of sperm whales!\nFights to the death with tiger sharks!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hutan karang! Kawanan paus sperma!\nPertarungan sampai mati dengan hiu macan!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_007
Array.english: Hmm... \nThat brings to mind a dish I’d really love to eat.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... \nItu mengingatkanku pada hidangan yang sangat ingin kucicipi.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_008
Array.english: <size=40>What dish do you mean?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Hidangan apa yang kamu maksud?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_009
Array.english: When I was little, \nthe <color=#F1DC2B>Moray Eel Curry</color> at my fishing village was famous...\r<size=32>I can’t forget its taste.</size>
Array.indonesia: Saat aku masih kecil, \n<color=#F1DC2B>Kari Belut Moray</color> di desa nelayan tempatku tinggal itu terkenal...\r<size=32>Aku tak bisa melupakan rasanya.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_010
Array.english: If you could make that dish, perhaps...\nI’ll give you a nice gift, hehe.
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu bisa membuat hidangan itu, mungkin...\nAku akan memberimu hadiah yang bagus, hehe.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_011
Array.english: <size=36>Hmm. <color=#F1DC2B>Moray Eel Curry</color>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Hmm. <color=#F1DC2B>Kari Belut Moray</color>...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_012
Array.english: <color=#1DFEAF>Moray Eels</color> hide in the rocks, making them difficult to catch.\nHow do you get one?
Array.indonesia: <color=#1DFEAF>Belut Moray</color> bersembunyi di balik bebatuan, sehingga sulit ditangkap.\nBagaimana cara menangkapnya?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_013
Array.english: Heh heh! You know how to dive,\nbut you don’t know much of the ecology, do you?
Array.indonesia: Heh heh! Kamu tahu cara menyelam,\ntapi kamu tidak terlalu paham soal ekologi, kan?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_014
Array.english: <size=32><color=#1DFEAF>Moray Eels</color> are nocturnal and only come out at night.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32><color=#1DFEAF>Ular laut</color> adalah hewan nokturnal dan hanya keluar pada malam hari.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_015
Array.english: Do you have gear for night diving?
Array.indonesia: Apakah kamu punya perlengkapan untuk menyelam malam?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_016
Array.english: Oh... I did get a <color=#1DFEAF>Flashlight</color> recently...
Array.indonesia: Oh... Aku memang baru saja membeli <color=#1DFEAF>senter</color>...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_017
Array.english: <size=40>That should do just fine!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Itu sudah cukup!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_018
Array.english: Moray Eels are nocturnal!\nPlease go <color=#F1DC2B>night diving</color> and catch a Moray Eel to fulfill my wish.
Array.indonesia: Belut moray itu aktif di malam hari!\nTolong lakukan <color=#F1DC2B>menyelam malam</color> dan tangkap seekor belut moray untuk memenuhi keinginanku.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_019
Array.english: Hmm... I haven’t gone diving at night for a while...\nMaybe I will try it...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Sudah lama aku tidak menyelam di malam hari...\nMungkin aku akan mencobanya...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=50>*Sob* That’s the taste I remember!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>*Hiks* Itu rasa yang aku ingat!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_Complete_002
Array.english: Oh, I’m glad you like it.
Array.indonesia: Oh, aku senang kamu menyukainya.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_Complete_003
Array.english: The food brings back memories...
Array.indonesia: Makanan ini membangkitkan kenangan...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_Complete_004
Array.english: One time a young man who lived with a sick mother\nin my village was bitten by a Moray Eel,\nkeeping them from going into the sea any longer.
Array.indonesia: Suatu kali, seorang pemuda yang tinggal bersama ibunya yang sakit\ndi desaku digigit oleh seekor belut moray,\nsehingga mereka tidak berani lagi masuk ke laut.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_Complete_005
Array.english: <size=32>I was twelve then, and I went out into the pitch-black darkness and plunged a Harpoon into that Moray Eel’s gills!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Saat itu aku berusia dua belas tahun, dan aku keluar ke kegelapan pekat lalu menusukkan tombak ke insang belut moray itu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_Complete_006
Array.english: I brought them the dead Moray Eel, and the mother\nmade me <color=#1DFEAF>Moray Curry</color> in thanks.
Array.indonesia: Aku membawakan mereka belut moray yang sudah mati itu, dan sang ibu\nmembuatkanku <color=#1DFEAF>Kari Belut Moray</color> sebagai ucapan terima kasih.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_Complete_007
Array.english: Thinking of that woman’s kind eyes\nbrings tears to my eyes... *sniff*
Array.indonesia: Mengingat mata penuh kebaikan wanita itu\nmembuat air mata mengalir di mataku... *hiks*

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_Complete_008
Array.english: <size=38>In any case, thanks for the food.\nThat was some fantastic cooking!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Bagaimanapun, terima kasih atas makanannya.\nMasakannya sungguh luar biasa!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_001
Array.english: Oh right, I said I’d tell you something nice, right?
Array.indonesia: Oh iya, aku kan bilang akan menceritakan sesuatu yang menyenangkan, kan?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_002
Array.english: Nearly forgot amid all that nostalgia,\nhaha!
Array.indonesia: Hampir lupa di tengah semua kenangan itu,\nhaha!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_003
Array.english: <size=34>Come see me in the <color=#1DFEAF>empty lot</color> behind this building.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Datanglah menemuiku di <color=#1DFEAF>lahan kosong</color> di belakang gedung ini.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Farm_Call_01
Array.english: <size=35>Hello there, Dave. \nHave a good night’s sleep?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Halo, Dave. \nTidur nyenyak semalam?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Farm_Call_02
Array.english: Well... I suppose so.\nYou sound tired.
Array.indonesia: Yah... Kurasa begitu.\nKamu terdengar lelah.

Array.name: dialog_Farm_Call_03
Array.english: <size=33>Haha! Well, I stayed up all night working on something!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Haha! Yah, aku begadang semalaman mengerjakan sesuatu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Farm_Call_04
Array.english: What were you working on?
Array.indonesia: Apa yang kamu kerjakan?

Array.name: dialog_Farm_Call_05
Array.english: I’ll show you. Get on the boat and come on over\n<color=#F1DC2B>next to the Fish Farm</color>!
Array.indonesia: Aku akan tunjukkan padamu. Naiklah ke perahu dan datanglah ke\n<color=#F1DC2B>sebelah Peternakan Ikan</color>!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=40>Wow... What is this place?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Wah... Tempat apa ini?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_Complete_002
Array.english: Hehe. I tried some food at the restaurant...\nThe sushi has Annam rice mixed in, doesn’t it?
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Aku mencoba beberapa hidangan di restoran itu...\nSushi-nya dicampur dengan beras Annam, kan?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_Complete_003
Array.english: Yes…\nThat’s the only rice we can manage to find around here...
Array.indonesia: Ya…\nItu satu-satunya beras yang bisa kami temukan di sekitar sini...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_Complete_004
Array.english: <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color> has got superb skills, but... \nYou won’t meet that picky movie director’s standards with that kind of grain.
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color> memang punya keterampilan luar biasa, tapi... \nKamu nggak bakal bisa memenuhi standar sutradara film yang pilih-pilih itu dengan beras seperti itu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_Complete_005
Array.english: Since you’re staying here a bit longer anyway,\nI thought you might help me grow some <color=#1DFEAF>White Rice</color>.
Array.indonesia: Karena kamu bakal tinggal di sini lebih lama,\naku pikir kamu bisa bantu aku menanam <color=#1DFEAF>Beras Putih</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_Complete_006
Array.english: <size=35>Wow! That’s very nice!\nThank you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wah! Itu sangat baik!\nTerima kasih!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_Complete_007
Array.english: Hmm... The thing is, I’m not much of a farmer...\nWhat should I do first?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Masalahnya, aku bukan petani yang handal...\nApa yang harus kulakukan dulu?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_Complete_008
Array.english: I’ve seen how busy you are all day.\nI’ll help you a little with <color=#F1DC2B>growing the rice</color>.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah melihat betapa sibuknya kamu sepanjang hari.\nAku akan membantumu sedikit dalam <color=#F1DC2B>menanam padi</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_Complete_009
Array.english: It takes about a year in the real world to grow rice,\nbut this is no rice farming game, is it?
Array.indonesia: Di dunia nyata, menanam padi butuh waktu sekitar satu tahun,\ntapi ini bukan permainan bertani padi, kan?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_Complete_010
Array.english: You’ll be able to see results in <color=#1DFEAF>2-3 days</color>.
Array.indonesia: Kamu akan bisa melihat hasilnya dalam <color=#1DFEAF>2-3 hari</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_Complete_011
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, but the thing is... I’ve injured my legs...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, tapi masalahnya... kakiku terluka...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_Complete_012
Array.english: <size=32>You’ll have to pluck out the <color=#1DFEAF>weeds</color>.\nThat’ll prevent insects from harming the crop.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kamu harus mencabut <color=#1DFEAF>gulma</color>.\nItu akan mencegah serangga merusak tanaman.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_Complete_013
Array.english: <size=32>Of course!\nIf we can have good rice, plucking <color=#1DFEAF>weeds</color> is no problem!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tentu saja!\nKalau kita bisa dapat beras yang bagus, mencabut <color=#1DFEAF>gulma</color> bukanlah masalah!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_Complete_014
Array.english: To think there’s a rice paddy right behind the restaurant...\nThat's really great! Haha, thanks!
Array.indonesia: Siapa sangka ada sawah tepat di belakang restoran...\nItu benar-benar hebat! Haha, terima kasih!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_Complete_015
Array.english: <size=34>Bwahaha! Glad to see you like it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Bwahaha! Senang melihat kamu menyukainya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_Complete_016
Array.english: Oh! As for the state of the rice paddy... Technology has come\na long way and you can use a <color=#F1DC2B>mobile app</color> to check on it.
Array.indonesia: Oh! Mengenai kondisi sawah... Teknologi sudah \nberkembang pesat dan kamu bisa menggunakan <color=#F1DC2B>aplikasi seluler</color> untuk memeriksanya.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_Complete_017
Array.english: <size=32>The app’s called <color=#72ff0a>FarmNow</color>.\nI’ll update you on the status every morning through the app.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aplikasinya bernama <color=#72ff0a>FarmNow</color>.\nAku akan memberi tahu kamu statusnya setiap pagi melalui aplikasi itu.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_Complete_018
Array.english:
<size=36>Hmm. That reminds me...
I remember when I used to be a novice farmer.</size><size=25><color=#C8C8C8>I’d gone to a farming village in Thailand on a very hot day. 
I was resting in the shade and a white-haired village chief came over,
looked right into my eyes, and told me...</color></size>
Array.indonesia:
<size=36>Hmm. Itu mengingatkanku...
Aku ingat saat aku masih menjadi petani pemula.</size><size=25><color=#C8C8C8>Aku pernah pergi ke sebuah desa pertanian di Thailand pada hari yang sangat panas. 
Aku sedang beristirahat di tempat teduh dan seorang kepala desa berambut putih menghampiri,
menatap mataku langsung, dan berkata kepadaku...</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_Complete_019
Array.english: <size=52>Enough!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=52>Cukup!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_Complete_020
Array.english: Now, now, cool your temper...\nAs it happens, I see some <color=#1DFEAF>weeds</color> over there.
Array.indonesia: Sudahlah, sudahlah, tenangkan dirimu...\nKebetulan, aku melihat beberapa <color=#1DFEAF>gulma</color> di sana.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_Complete_021
Array.english: <size=43>Go and pluck them.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=43>Pergilah dan cabutlah.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_001
Array.english: <size=36>Hey Dave!\nI’ve got the luckiest news!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Hei Dave!\nAku punya kabar paling beruntung!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_002
Array.english: What is it, <color=#F1DC2B>Dr. Bacon</color>?\nYou look happy.
Array.indonesia: Ada apa, <color=#F1DC2B>Dr. Bacon</color>?\nKamu terlihat senang.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_003
Array.english: I analyzed the artifact you brought me\nand a large amount of an unknown substance was detected.
Array.indonesia: Aku telah menganalisis artefak yang kamu bawa padaku\ndan terdeteksi sejumlah besar zat yang tidak dikenal.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_004
Array.english: I think it must be iron compressed deep underwater,\nbut it gives off a unique wavelength...
Array.indonesia: Menurutku itu pasti besi yang terkompresi di kedalaman laut,\ntapi zat itu memancarkan panjang gelombang yang unik...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_005
Array.english: <size=36>I went ahead and developed a <color=#1DFEAF>Radar</color>\nto track those waves!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Aku sudah mengembangkan sebuah <color=#1DFEAF>Radar</color>\nuntuk melacak gelombang-gelombang itu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_006
Array.english: Oh... And why is that news... lucky?
Array.indonesia: Oh... Dan kenapa kabar itu... beruntung?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_007
Array.english: Haha! Being coy today, are we?\nThis <color=#1DFEAF>Radar</color> is bound to come in useful on your next expedition!
Array.indonesia: Haha! Lagi malu-malu hari ini, ya?\n<color=#1DFEAF>Radar</color> ini pasti akan berguna dalam ekspedisi kamu berikutnya!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_008
Array.english: What do you mean, my next expedition?\nCobra forced me to go along last time...
Array.indonesia: Maksudmu, ekspedisi aku berikutnya?\nCobra memaksa aku ikut terakhir kali...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_009
Array.english: Hmm... I was given a contract with your name on it.\nThe cancellation charge for breaking the contract is over 20...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Aku diberi kontrak yang mencantumkan namamu.\nBiaya pembatalan jika melanggar kontrak itu lebih dari 20...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_010
Array.english: <size=36>What?\nWhat in the world were you two talking about?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Apa?\nApa sih yang kalian berdua bicarakan?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_011
Array.english: Haha! Don’t be so by-the-book!\nCheck the signal for me to test out the <color=#1DFEAF>Radar</color>!
Array.indonesia: Haha! Jangan terlalu kaku!\nPeriksa sinyalnya untukku agar aku bisa menguji <color=#1DFEAF>Radar</color>!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_012
Array.english: *Sigh* Give it to me...\nI’ll tell you if it works, and no more...
Array.indonesia: *Huff* Berikan padaku...\nAku akan memberitahumu jika berfungsi, dan tidak lebih...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_1_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=38>Wow! So this is the place!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Wow! Jadi ini tempatnya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_1_Complete_002
Array.english: Let’s see... hmm...\nThe signal is coming from <color=#1DFEAF>inside</color>...
Array.indonesia: Coba kita lihat... hmm...\nSinyalnya berasal dari <color=#1DFEAF>dalam</color>...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_1_Complete_003
Array.english: <size=31>There are letters I’ve never seen before written on the pillar!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Ada huruf-huruf yang belum pernah aku lihat sebelumnya tertulis di pilar itu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_1_Complete_004
Array.english: Hmm... If we had a tool of some sort, we could move aside that <color=#1DFEAF>pile of rocks</color> and try going inside...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Kalau kita punya alat apa pun, kita bisa menyingkirkan <color=#1DFEAF>tumpukan batu</color> itu dan mencoba masuk ke dalam...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_1_Complete_005
Array.english: <size=34>I think it would be best to talk this over with <color=#F1DC2B>Cobra</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Menurutku sebaiknya kita membicarakan ini dengan <color=#F1DC2B>Cobra</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_1_Complete_006
Array.english: <size=40>Come on up for now!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Ayo naik dulu!</size>
