Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_1_MermanWhisper_001
Array.english: <size=45>???</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=45>???</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_1_MermanWhisper_002
Array.english: <size=36>Hmm... I thought I heard something...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Hmm... Sepertinya aku mendengar sesuatu...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_Complete_001
Array.english: Hmm. I found a place with a signal from the Sea People civilization...
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Aku menemukan tempat yang memancarkan sinyal dari peradaban Sea People...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_Complete_002
Array.english: <size=36>I can’t hold back my academic thirst\nto check it out!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Aku nggak bisa menahan rasa ingin tahu akademisku\nuntuk memeriksanya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_Complete_003
Array.english: <size=34>I’m at an important symposium right now...\nPlease talk it over with <color=#F1DC2B>Cobra</color> first!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku lagi ada di simposium penting sekarang...\nTolong bicarakan dulu dengan <color=#F1DC2B>Cobra</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=38>I’ll come by tomorrow!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Aku bakal mampir besok!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission08_001
Array.english: <size=36>Huh? How to get rid of rock piles?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Hah? Bagaimana cara menghilangkan tumpukan batu?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission08_002
Array.english: <size=35>You’ll have to use a <color=#1DFEAF>Bomb</color>, of course!\nHahaha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Tentu saja kamu harus menggunakan <color=#1DFEAF>Bom</color>!\nHahaha!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission08_003
Array.english: Is it okay to detonate bombs underwater?
Array.indonesia: Apakah aman meledakkan bom di bawah air?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission08_004
Array.english: Weren’t you talking about a rock pile somewhere deep below?\nI’m sure it’ll be fine...
Array.indonesia: Bukankah kamu tadi bicara tentang tumpukan batu di kedalaman laut?\nPasti nggak apa-apa...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission08_005
Array.english: <size=34>Let’s put a little trust in the sea’s regenerative power!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ayo kita percayai sedikit saja kekuatan regeneratif laut!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission08_006
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>He’s trying to gloss things over again...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Dia mencoba mengabaikan masalah lagi...</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission08_007
Array.english: <size=36>But there’s an issue.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Tapi ada masalah.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission08_008
Array.english: The delivery ships haven’t been arriving lately...\nI need to get a delivery from a Bomb expert I know...
Array.indonesia: Kapal pengiriman belum datang belakangan ini...\nAku perlu mengambil kiriman dari seorang ahli bom yang kukenal...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission08_009
Array.english: Apparently the ship’s gone off the radar.\nI think it’s sunk...
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya kapal itu hilang dari radar.\nKurasa kapal itu tenggelam...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission08_010
Array.english: If I could use the <color=#1DFEAF>Drone</color> I ordered,\nwe could retrieve the supplies...
Array.indonesia: Kalau aku bisa pakai <color=#1DFEAF>Drone</color> yang sudah aku pesan,\nkita bisa mengambil persediaan itu...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission08_011
Array.english: <size=33>Dave, could you go into the sea and retrieve\n<color=#1DFEAF>Drone Materials</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Dave, bisakah kamu masuk ke laut dan mengambil\n<color=#1DFEAF>Bahan Drone</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission08_012
Array.english: <size=31><color=#1DFEAF>Drone Materials</color>?\nHow am I supposed to find them in the ocean? \nIt’s huge!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31><color=#1DFEAF>Bahan Drone</color>?\nBagaimana caranya aku menemukannya di laut? \nLaut itu luas sekali!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission08_013
Array.english: <size=34>Delivery boxes are likely to have been carried by the ocean currents. Look for a <color=#F1DC2B>place with ocean currents!</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kotak-kotak pengiriman kemungkinan besar terbawa arus laut. Carilah <color=#F1DC2B>tempat yang ada arus lautnya!</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission08_014
Array.english: <size=38>Hmm, that sounds dangerous...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Hmm, kedengarannya berbahaya...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission08_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=34>Alright! \nWe should be able to deploy a drone with this!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Baiklah! \nKita seharusnya bisa meluncurkan drone dengan ini!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission08_Complete_002
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm? You look pretty exhausted.\nHahaha.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm? Kamu terlihat cukup kelelahan.\nHahaha.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission08_Complete_003
Array.english: <size=34>Well, the sea currents did knock me around a bit...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Yah, arus laut memang membuatku terombang-ambing sedikit...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission08_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=34>Haha... I see!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Haha... Oh, begitu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission08_Complete_005
Array.english: It’ll take a bit of time to repair the drone and deploy it.\nYou're gonna have to wait.
Array.indonesia: Butuh sedikit waktu untuk memperbaiki drone dan mengoperasikannya.\nKamu harus menunggu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission08_Complete_006
Array.english: <size=33>It should be done by <color=#F1DC2B>tomorrow morning</color>!\nGo about your business until then!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Seharusnya sudah selesai <color=#F1DC2B>besok pagi</color>!\nLakukan saja urusanmu sampai saat itu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_PreYosie_001
Array.english: It’s already evening...
Array.indonesia: Sudah malam...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_PreYosie_002
Array.english: I feel stiff...\nEven so, <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho’s</color> working alone. I should probably help.
Array.indonesia: Tubuhku terasa kaku...\nMeski begitu, <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color> sedang bekerja sendirian. Sepertinya aku harus membantunya.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_PreYosie_003
Array.english: <size=33>It’s not easy to manage with two people\nwith more customers coming in...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tidak mudah mengurusnya berdua\ndengan semakin banyaknya pelanggan yang datang...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_001
Array.english: <size=45>Good morning!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=45>Selamat pagi!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_002
Array.english: Sorry I couldn’t come by yesterday because of the symposium.\nDid you speak with Cobra?
Array.indonesia: Maaf aku tidak bisa mampir kemarin karena ada simposium.\nApakah kamu sudah bicara dengan Cobra?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_003
Array.english: Oh, come to think of it, I got materials\nsince Cobra said he was repairing a drone yesterday...
Array.indonesia: Oh, kalau dipikir-pikir, aku sudah dapat bahan-bahannya\nkarena Cobra bilang dia sedang memperbaiki drone kemarin...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_004
Array.english: Oh! A bit late, aren’t I? Hahaha!\nI repaired the drone just fine thanks to you! I got some supplies as well.
Array.indonesia: Oh! Agak terlambat, ya? Hahaha!\nAku berhasil memperbaiki drone itu berkat kamu! Aku juga dapat beberapa persediaan.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_005
Array.english: Here’s the <color=#1DFEAF>Bombs</color> you asked for.\n<size=43>Also...</size>
Array.indonesia: Ini <color=#1DFEAF>Bom</color> yang kamu minta.\n<size=43>Juga...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_006
Array.english: <size=35>Oh, thank you!\nDr. Bacon, will these do?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh, terima kasih!\nDr. Bacon, apakah ini cukup?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_007
Array.english: <size=32>Alright! Let’s head back to that <color=#F1DC2B>rock pile</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Baiklah! Ayo kembali ke <color=#F1DC2B>tumpukan batu</color> itu.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_008
Array.english: <size=48>Oh, wait!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=48>Oh, tunggu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_009
Array.english: <size=32>I haven’t finished!\nStarting today…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku belum selesai!\nMulai hari ini…</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_010
Array.english: <size=40>The <color=#F1DC2B>Cobra Shop</color> is officially open!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40><color=#F1DC2B>Toko Cobra</color> resmi dibuka!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_011
Array.english: <size=35>Huh? What is that?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Hah? Apa itu?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_012
Array.english: Hahaha! Deliveries have stopped,\nbut with the drone in working order,
Array.indonesia: Hahaha! Pengiriman sudah berhenti,\ntapi karena drone-nya sudah berfungsi,

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_013
Array.english: I can transport <color=#1DFEAF>three types of items</color> in a day.
Array.indonesia: aku bisa mengangkut <color=#1DFEAF>tiga jenis barang</color> dalam sehari.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_014
Array.english: Talk to me and select the <color=#F1DC2B>Cobra Shop</color> to see a list that \nchanges every day.
Array.indonesia: Bicaralah padaku dan pilih <color=#F1DC2B>Toko Cobra</color> untuk melihat daftar yang \nberubah setiap hari.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_015
Array.english: I’ll also buy some stuff you don’t need.\nCheck out the <color=#F1DC2B>Sell</color> tab as well.
Array.indonesia: Aku juga akan membeli beberapa barang yang tidak kamu butuhkan.\nLihat juga tab <color=#F1DC2B>Jual</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_019
Array.english: I have a feeling you’ll charge high prices...\nBut it’s nice to be able to prepare.
Array.indonesia: Aku merasa kamu akan mematok harga tinggi...\nTapi senang rasanya bisa bersiap-siap.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_020
Array.english: <size=28>Hahaha! I won’t charge high prices just because I’ve got \nthe only business here, so don’t be afraid to visit often!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=28>Hahaha! Aku tidak akan mematok harga tinggi hanya karena aku \nsatu-satunya yang berbisnis di sini, jadi jangan ragu untuk sering mampir!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_021
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>I feel like you let your business tactic slip just now...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Rasanya kamu baru saja tanpa sengaja membocorkan taktik bisnismu...</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_022
Array.english: In any case, it’s time to head back to the <color=#F1DC2B>rock pile</color>\nwhere the signal from the Sea People was detected.
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun, sudah waktunya kembali ke <color=#F1DC2B>tumpukan batu</color>\ntempat sinyal dari Suku Laut terdeteksi.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_GiveCamera_001
Array.english: Ah,  just in case there is something worth documenting inside…
Array.indonesia: Ah,  sekadar jaga-jaga kalau ada sesuatu yang layak didokumentasikan di dalamnya…

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_GiveCamera_002
Array.english: <size=33>How about taking this <color=#1DFEAF>Underwater Camera</color> with you?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Bagaimana kalau kamu bawa <color=#1DFEAF>Kamera Bawah Air</color> ini?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_GiveCamera_003
Array.english: <size=35>A Camera?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Kamera?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_GiveCamera_004
Array.english: That's right! It will be important for research to\nrecord important data with photos!
Array.indonesia: Benar sekali! Akan sangat penting bagi penelitian untuk\nmerekam data penting dengan foto!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_GiveCamera_005
Array.english: <size=33>Take the Camera and I'll let you know when I find \nthe right place to use it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Bawa Kamera itu dan aku akan memberitahumu saat aku menemukan \ntempat yang tepat untuk menggunakannya.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_0_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=35>We’re here! Try placing\none of the <color=#1DFEAF>Bombs</color> Cobra gave you on that rock pile!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Kita sudah sampai! Coba letakkan\nsalah satu <color=#1DFEAF>Bom</color> yang diberikan Cobra padamu di tumpukan batu itu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_1_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=32>All good?\nYou know, it's sort of hard to see through the radio.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Semuanya baik-baik saja?\nKau tahu, agak sulit melihat melalui radio.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_1_Complete_002
Array.english: We can’t have you torn into a thousand pieces\nand become FOOD for the sharks!
Array.indonesia: Kita tidak bisa membiarkanmu tercabik-cabik\ndan menjadi MAKANAN bagi hiu!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_1_Complete_003
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>That’s a scary thing to say in such a casual voice...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Itu pernyataan yang menakutkan kalau diucapkan dengan nada santai seperti itu...</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_1_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=37>Now, back away from the Bomb for a bit.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Nah, menjauhlah dulu sebentar dari Bom itu.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_2_001
Array.english: There, that should be enough.
Array.indonesia: Nah, itu seharusnya sudah cukup.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_2_002
Array.english: <size=45>Here it goes!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=45>Ayo mulai!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_2_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=35>Nice. Now the road is clear.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Bagus. Sekarang jalannya sudah bersih.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_2_Complete_002
Array.english: There’s a faint light coming from inside...\nGo on inside.
Array.indonesia: Ada cahaya samar yang berasal dari dalam...\nMasuk saja ke dalam.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_2_Complete_003
Array.english: Ugh... What if there’s a monster or something inside?
Array.indonesia: Ugh... Bagaimana kalau ada monster atau sesuatu di dalam?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_2_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=38>That would also be an amazing scientific discovery!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Itu juga akan menjadi penemuan ilmiah yang luar biasa!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_3_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=38>Wow! This place is... wow!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Wow! Tempat ini... wow!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_3_Complete_002
Array.english: <size=33>It appears to be some kind of Sea People <color=#F1DC2B>Record Chamber</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Sepertinya ini semacam <color=#F1DC2B>Ruang Arsip</color> Suku Laut!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_3_Complete_003
Array.english: <size=32>My lucky feeling was correct!\nThere definitely was a Sea People civilization in this region!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Perasaan beruntungku benar!\nPasti pernah ada peradaban Suku Laut di wilayah ini!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_3_Complete_004
Array.english: Look at that mural back there...\nNo human could have painted that so deep underwater.
Array.indonesia: Lihatlah mural di belakang sana...\nTidak mungkin manusia bisa melukis itu sedalam ini di bawah air.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_3_Complete_005
Array.english: Maybe these are from some ancient civilization\nthat sank from seismic activity?
Array.indonesia: Mungkin ini berasal dari peradaban kuno\nyang tenggelam akibat aktivitas seismik?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_3_Complete_006
Array.english: A good point! But, that style of painting and architecture can’t been seen anywhere above ground.
Array.indonesia: Benar juga! Tapi, gaya lukisan dan arsitektur seperti itu tidak bisa ditemukan di mana pun di daratan.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_3_Complete_007
Array.english: Please first <color=#F1DC2B>investigate</color> this place!\nI’m sure you’ll be able to find a variety of interesting clues.
Array.indonesia: Tolong, pertama-tama <color=#F1DC2B>selidiki</color> tempat ini!\nAku yakin kamu akan bisa menemukan berbagai petunjuk menarik.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_3_1_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=33>Good. That should be enough.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Baik. Itu seharusnya sudah cukup.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_3_1_Complete_002
Array.english: I would like to research a little more, so please take a photo\nwith the <color=#F1DC2B>Camera</color> that I gave you.
Array.indonesia: Aku ingin meneliti sedikit lebih lanjut, jadi tolong ambil foto\ndengan <color=#F1DC2B>Kamera</color> yang sudah kuberikan padamu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_4_Charm_001
Array.english: Huh? I see something on the floor there...
Array.indonesia: Hah? Aku melihat sesuatu di lantai sana...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_4_Charm_002
Array.english: <size=32>Oh! It might be another Sea People artifact.\nBring it to me!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh! Mungkin itu artefak Suku Laut lainnya.\nBawakan padaku!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_4_001
Array.english: <size=43>It’s the sound from before!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=43>Itu suara tadi!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_4_002
Array.english: Hmm... a Record Chamber filled with Sea People symbols...\nWhat could they have written?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Ruang Catatan yang dipenuhi simbol-simbol Suku Laut...\nApa yang mungkin mereka tulis?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_4_003
Array.english: <size=32>More importantly, didn’t you hear something?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Yang lebih penting, apakah kamu tidak mendengar sesuatu?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_4_004
Array.english: <size=32>What do you mean?\nI didn’t hear anything over the radio...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Maksudmu apa?\nAku tidak mendengar apa-apa dari radio...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_4_005
Array.english: <size=37>Come back up to the boat for now!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Kembalilah ke perahu dulu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=34>Hmm...<color=#F1DC2B> A Sea People artifact</color>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hmm...<color=#F1DC2B> Sebuah artefak Suku Laut</color>...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_Complete_002
Array.english: <size=45>Hmm...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=45>Hmm...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_Complete_003
Array.english: <size=44>Very interesting!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=44>Sangat menarik!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_Complete_004
Array.english: Well... I’m glad you like it.
Array.indonesia: Yah... Aku senang kamu menyukainya.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_Complete_005
Array.english: I’ll have to analyze this artifact and the mural\nfurther at my lab.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus menganalisis artefak ini dan mural\nlebih lanjut di lab-ku.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_Complete_006
Array.english: <size=38>I’ll be in touch soon!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Aku akan segera menghubungimu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_SeaBlue_001
Array.english: <size=42>Hey hey, you there!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>Hei hei, kamu di sana!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_SeaBlue_002
Array.english: <size=36>I heard an explosion in the sea.\nDo you know what’s going on?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Aku mendengar ledakan di laut.\nApakah kamu tahu apa yang sedang terjadi?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_SeaBlue_003
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, about that... um...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, soal itu... um...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_SeaBlue_004
Array.english: <size=42>We are <color=#90CDFF>Sea Blue</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>Kami adalah <color=#90CDFF>Sea Blue</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_SeaBlue_005
Array.english: <size=32>We are an organization that tracks down people \nwho pollute this beautiful sea, and reports them.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kami adalah organisasi yang memburu orang-orang \nyang mencemari laut indah ini, dan melaporkannya.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_SeaBlue_006
Array.english: <size=34>I sometimes carry out justice myself\nfor those that commit particularly evil deeds!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kadang-kadang aku sendiri yang menegakkan keadilan\nbagi mereka yang melakukan perbuatan jahat yang sangat keji!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_SeaBlue_007
Array.english: <size=33>I’ve had reports of someone who has been engaging in \nmindless destruction of the environment in these parts.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku mendapat laporan tentang seseorang yang telah melakukan \npenghancuran lingkungan yang sembrono di daerah ini.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_SeaBlue_008
Array.english: I don’t know if it was you,\nbut you better be aware of this.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak tahu apakah itu kamu,\ntapi sebaiknya kamu waspada terhadap hal ini.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_SeaBlue_009
Array.english: Whoever harms the great sea will have to \ncontend with <color=#90CDFF>Sea Blue</color>...
Array.indonesia: Siapa pun yang merusak laut yang agung akan harus \nberhadapan dengan <color=#90CDFF>Sea Blue</color>...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_SeaBlue_010
Array.english: <size=38>And me, <color=#F1DC2B>John Watson</color>!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Dan aku, <color=#F1DC2B>John Watson</color>!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_SeaBlue_011
Array.english: Now then, be ever grateful to the sea\nand never lose your love for it!
Array.indonesia: Nah, jadilah selalu bersyukur kepada laut\ndan jangan pernah kehilangan cintamu padanya!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_SeaBlue_012
Array.english: I’ll be leaving for now.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan pergi dulu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_SeaBlue_013
Array.english: <size=48>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=48>...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_SeaBlue_014
Array.english: <size=44>We’re watching you….</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=44>Kami mengawasimu….</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_SeaBlue_02_001
Array.english: What a creepy dude...\nWill we be okay?
Array.indonesia: Orang yang menyeramkan sekali...\nApakah kita akan baik-baik saja?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_SeaBlue_02_002
Array.english: <color=#90CDFF>Sea Blue</color>...\nThat group is infamous. They commit acts of violence under the pretext of environmental protection...
Array.indonesia: <color=#90CDFF>Sea Blue</color>...\nKelompok itu terkenal jahat. Mereka melakukan tindakan kekerasan dengan dalih perlindungan lingkungan...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_SeaBlue_02_003
Array.english: It’s mostly the large corporations with big fishing businesses...
Array.indonesia: Sebagian besar justru perusahaan-perusahaan besar dengan bisnis perikanan skala besar...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_SeaBlue_02_004
Array.english: ... and not the small fisheries, that harm the environment\nthe most...They say nothing to the corporations, however.
Array.indonesia: ...bukan usaha perikanan kecil, yang paling merusak lingkungan\n...Namun, mereka tidak mengatakan apa-apa kepada perusahaan-perusahaan itu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_SeaBlue_02_005
Array.english: I expect they’re taking bribes or something <color=#9E7BFF>unsavory</color> like that...
Array.indonesia: Aku menduga mereka menerima suap atau hal-hal <color=#9E7BFF>tidak terpuji</color> seperti itu...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_SeaBlue_02_006
Array.english: That guy looked like bad news.
Array.indonesia: Orang itu kelihatannya tidak bisa dipercaya.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_SeaBlue_02_007
Array.english: It won’t do you any good to be on their radar...\nBe careful.
Array.indonesia: Tidak ada gunanya bagimu jika masuk dalam radar mereka...\nHati-hati.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_RoomBlock_001
Array.english: First finish investigating this place!
Array.indonesia: Selesaikan dulu penyelidikan di tempat ini!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_001
Array.english: <size=37>Hmm! Dave!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Hmm! Dave!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_002
Array.english: <size=34>Yes, Dr. Bacon?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ya, Dr. Bacon?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_003
Array.english: <size=45>Dave!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=45>Dave!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_004
Array.english: <size=38>Yes...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Ya...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_005
Array.english: <size=32>Do you want to hear the good news,\nor the bad news?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kamu mau dengar kabar baiknya,\natau kabar buruknya?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_006
Array.english: <size=32>The good news...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kabar baiknya...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_007
Array.english: <size=36>Haha! You’re the positive type!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Haha! Kamu memang orang yang positif!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_008
Array.english: I studied the <color=#F1DC2B>bracelet</color>\nyou brought me yesterday...
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah memeriksa <color=#F1DC2B>gelang</color>\nyang kamu bawa kemarin...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_009
Array.english: <size=36>It was from the Sea People, as I expected!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Ternyata itu dari Suku Laut, seperti yang kuduga!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_010
Array.english: Wow... so it’s an ancient artifact?
Array.indonesia: Wow... jadi itu artefak kuno?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_011
Array.english: The bracelet seems to be imbued\nwith a mysterious power.
Array.indonesia: Gelang itu sepertinya dipenuhi\ndengan kekuatan misterius.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_012
Array.english: <size=38>Here, you can wear this.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Ini, kamu bisa memakainya.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_013
Array.english: What? Me?\nI mean, I’m grateful, but why?
Array.indonesia: Apa? Aku?\nMaksudku, aku berterima kasih, tapi kenapa?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_014
Array.english: Haha! Who knows, there might be some frightening\nSea People curse on it!
Array.indonesia: Haha! Siapa tahu, mungkin ada kutukan menakutkan\ndari Suku Laut di gelang itu!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_015
Array.english: <size=50>….</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>….</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_016
Array.english: Well, in any case...\ntry it on first!
Array.indonesia: Yah, bagaimanapun juga...\ncoba pakai dulu!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_AfterCharmTutorial_000
Array.english: <size=34>Wow...\nI feel some kind of new power inside me!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wah...\nAku merasakan semacam kekuatan baru di dalam diriku!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_AfterCharmTutorial_000_2
Array.english: Haha! Glad to hear nothing bad happened!
Array.indonesia: Haha! Senang mendengar tidak ada hal buruk yang terjadi!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_AfterCharmTutorial_001
Array.english: You’ll be able to check your <color=#F1DC2B>Diver Box</color>\nfor more information about the charm you’re wearing.
Array.indonesia: Kamu bisa memeriksa <color=#F1DC2B>Kotak Penyelam</color>\nmu untuk informasi lebih lanjut tentang jimat yang kamu kenakan.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_AfterCharmTutorial_002
Array.english: Oh, and I have more great news.
Array.indonesia: Oh, dan aku punya kabar baik lainnya.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_AfterCharmTutorial_003
Array.english: I’ve analyzed the artifacts and investigation data...
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah menganalisis artefak dan data investigasi...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_AfterCharmTutorial_004
Array.english: <size=37>I was able to find a very strong signal\nin these <color=#F1DC2B>ocean depths</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Aku berhasil menemukan sinyal yang sangat kuat\ndi <color=#F1DC2B>kedalaman laut</color> ini!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_AfterCharmTutorial_005
Array.english: This was the right place.\nThe objects didn’t just float over here.
Array.indonesia: Ini memang tempat yang tepat.\nBenda-benda itu tidak sekadar mengapung ke sini.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_AfterCharmTutorial_006
Array.english: I have a feeling the Giant Blue Hole that suddenly appeared\nis serving as a conduit to a Sea People site.
Array.indonesia: Aku merasa Giant Blue Hole yang tiba-tiba muncul\nberfungsi sebagai saluran menuju situs Suku Laut.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_AfterCharmTutorial_007
Array.english: <size=38>A very lucky opportunity!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Kesempatan yang sangat beruntung!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_AfterCharmTutorial_008
Array.english: That just sounds like I have to risk my life again...
Array.indonesia: Kedengarannya sepertinya aku harus mempertaruhkan nyawaku lagi...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_AfterCharmTutorial_009
Array.english: <size=34>So... what’s the bad news?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Jadi... apa kabar buruknya?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_AfterCharmTutorial_010
Array.english: Hmm... In order to venture deep,\nyou’ll need a <color=#1DFEAF>Deep Sea Headlamp</color>...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Untuk menjelajah ke kedalaman,\nkamu butuh <color=#1DFEAF>Lampu Kepala Laut Dalam</color>...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_AfterCharmTutorial_011
Array.english: Deliveries have stopped right now for some reason,\nso getting one is out of the question.
Array.indonesia: Pengiriman sedang dihentikan untuk saat ini karena suatu alasan,\njadi mustahil untuk mendapatkannya.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_AfterCharmTutorial_012
Array.english: Maybe <color=#F1DC2B>Duff</color> will have one?\nHe has all sorts of things.
Array.indonesia: Mungkin <color=#F1DC2B>Duff</color> punya?\nDia punya segala macam barang.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_AfterCharmTutorial_013
Array.english: <size=34>Hmm. You’re right.\nTry contacting <color=#F1DC2B>Duff</color> first, will you?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hmm. Kamu benar.\nCoba hubungi <color=#F1DC2B>Duff</color> dulu, ya?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_1_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=40>Arrrgh!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Arrrgh!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_1_Complete_002
Array.english: Why are you so angry, Duff?
Array.indonesia: Kenapa kamu marah banget, Duff?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_1_Complete_003
Array.english: <size=38>I ordered a limited-edition\n<color=#ff61e3>Leahs-chan</color> figurine!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Aku pesan figurine edisi terbatas\n<color=#ff61e3>Leahs-chan</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_1_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=38>But it hasn’t come for over a week, \nwould you believe it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Tapi udah lebih dari seminggu belum datang, \npercaya nggak sih!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_1_Complete_005
Array.english: <size=38>It’s got a serial number,\nand a limited-edition-only artbook!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Figurin itu punya nomor seri,\ndan buku seni edisi terbatas!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_1_Complete_006
Array.english: Whoa... Calm down a bit.\nEveryone seems upset with the deliveries having stopped.
Array.indonesia: Wah... Tenanglah sedikit.\nSemua orang sepertinya kesal karena pengiriman terhenti.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_1_Complete_007
Array.english: <size=32>I think there must have been some kind of accident.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Menurutku pasti ada semacam kecelakaan.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_1_Complete_008
Array.english: To see what's going on, I will need the <color=#1DFEAF>Deep Sea Headlamp</color>.
Array.indonesia: Untuk mengetahui apa yang terjadi, aku butuh <color=#1DFEAF>Lampu Kepala Laut Dalam</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_1_Complete_009
Array.english: <size=36>Dr. Bacon says you might have one.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Dr. Bacon bilang kamu mungkin punya satu.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_1_Complete_010
Array.english: Oho! Well, of course I have one of those in my safe storage.
Array.indonesia: Oho! Ya, tentu saja aku punya satu di tempat penyimpanan amanku.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_1_Complete_011
Array.english: <size=37>But I can’t give it to you for free.\nThere’s a condition.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Tapi aku tidak bisa memberikannya secara gratis.\nAda syaratnya.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_1_Complete_012
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(I think I know what’s coming...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Sepertinya aku tahu apa yang akan terjadi...)</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_1_Complete_013
Array.english: <size=38>Please find my <color=#ff61e3>Leahs-chan</color> figurine.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Tolong temukan patung <color=#ff61e3>Leahs-chan</color> milikku.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_1_Complete_014
Array.english: <size=33>It’s in a <color=#1DFEAF>Pink Delivery Box</color>.\nYou’ll know it when you see it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Itu ada di dalam <color=#1DFEAF>Kotak Pengiriman Merah Muda</color>.\nKamu akan langsung mengenalnya begitu melihatnya.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_1_Complete_015
Array.english: I requested special care for the package,\nso it should not have been washed away.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah meminta agar paket itu diperlakukan dengan hati-hati,\njadi seharusnya tidak hanyut terbawa arus.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_1_Complete_016
Array.english: If the ship carrying it sank...\nIt’s likely to be <color=#F1DC2B>somewhere nearby</color>.
Array.indonesia: Jika kapal yang mengangkutnya tenggelam...\nKemungkinan besar figurine itu ada di <color=#F1DC2B>suatu tempat di sekitar sini</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_1_Complete_017
Array.english: Find it for me and I’ll give you the <color=#1DFEAF>Deep Sea Headlamp</color>.
Array.indonesia: Temukan itu untukku dan aku akan memberimu <color=#1DFEAF>Lampu Kepala Laut Dalam</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_1_Complete_018
Array.english: *Sigh* I’ll have to first find the location of \nthe <color=#F1DC2B>Sunken Transport Ship</color>.
Array.indonesia: *Huff* Aku harus mencari lokasi \nkapal <color=#F1DC2B>pengangkut yang tenggelam</color> terlebih dahulu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_2_001
Array.english: <size=40>There!\nMy precious <color=#ff61e3>Leahs-chan</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Itu dia!\n<color=#ff61e3>Leahs-chan</color> kesayanganku!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_2_002
Array.english: <size=33>Bring it to me quick.\nFinish your mission.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Bawakan padaku secepatnya.\nSelesaikan misimu.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_2_AfterTimeline_001
Array.english: <size=35>Wh-what was that just now?\nM-my <color=#ff61e3>Leahs-chan</color>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>A-apa itu tadi?\n<color=#ff61e3>Leahs-chan</color>-ku... .</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_2_AfterTimeline_002
Array.english: <size=38>She disappeared into the unfathomable depths!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Dia menghilang ke kedalaman yang tak terduga!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_2_AfterTimeline_003
Array.english: It seems to have been some kind of giant life form...
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya itu adalah semacam makhluk hidup raksasa...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_2_AfterTimeline_004
Array.english: <size=38>Please go and retrieve her.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Tolong pergi dan selamatkan dia.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_2_AfterTimeline_005
Array.english: <size=37>Wait, that obviously looks dangerous.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Tunggu, itu jelas terlihat berbahaya.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_2_AfterTimeline_006
Array.english: Besides, the doors on the ship\nare all locked, so I can’t go inside.
Array.indonesia: Lagipula, pintu-pintu di kapal\nsemuanya terkunci, jadi aku tidak bisa masuk.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_2_AfterTimeline_007
Array.english: Do you really think I didn’t think of that\nbefore concocting <color=#ff61e3>Leahs-chan’s rescue plan</color>?
Array.indonesia: Apa kamu benar-benar berpikir aku tidak memikirkan hal itu\nsebelum menyusun <color=#ff61e3>rencana penyelamatan Leahs-chan</color>?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_2_AfterTimeline_008
Array.english: <size=38>I’ll provide you with my secret weapon,\nthe <color=#1DFEAF>Gas Cutter</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Aku akan memberimu senjata rahasiaku,\nyaitu <color=#1DFEAF>Gas Cutter</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_2_AfterTimeline_009
Array.english: Even at this moment Leahs-chan\nawaits her master.
Array.indonesia: Bahkan saat ini pun Leahs-chan\nmasih menanti tuannya.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_2_AfterTimeline_010
Array.english: <size=35>Come to the boat, will you?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ayo ke perahu, ya?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_2_AfterTimeline_011
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(This guy is incorrigible...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Orang ini memang tak bisa diubah...)</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_Complete_001
Array.english: I’m still having trouble calming down, just like Leahs-chan did when she first came face-to-face with Fenrir.
Array.indonesia: Aku masih kesulitan menenangkan diri, sama seperti yang dialami Leahs-chan saat pertama kali berhadapan langsung dengan Fenrir.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_Complete_002
Array.english: Since you’ve found the location, I’ll reward you for it.\nI like to do honest dealings...
Array.indonesia: Karena kamu sudah menemukan lokasinya, aku akan memberimu hadiah.\nAku suka bertransaksi secara jujur.. .

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_001
Array.english: <size=34>Now then, let’s begin the <color=#ff61e3>Leahs-chan rescue mission</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Nah, mari kita mulai <color=#ff61e3>misi penyelamatan Leahs-chan</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_002
Array.english: <size=35>Take this <color=#1DFEAF>Gas Cutter</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ambil <color=#1DFEAF>Pemotong Gas</color> ini.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_003
Array.english: You’ll see a spot that can be cut into when you reach the ship.\n<color=#C3C3C3>There will be a button prompt...</color>
Array.indonesia: Kamu akan melihat titik yang bisa dipotong saat sampai di kapal.\n<color=#C3C3C3>Akan muncul petunjuk tombol...</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_004
Array.english: Cut the weak point in the iron door\nand you’ll be able to enter the ship.
Array.indonesia: Potong titik lemah di pintu besi\ndan kamu akan bisa masuk ke kapal.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_005
Array.english: Just retrieve the <color=#1DFEAF>Pink Delivery Box</color> that has Leahs-chan, from inside the ship. Should be simpler than you’d think.
Array.indonesia: Ambil saja <color=#1DFEAF>Kotak Pengiriman Merah Muda</color> yang berisi Leahs-chan, dari dalam kapal. Seharusnya lebih mudah dari yang kamu bayangkan.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_006
Array.english: But I saw a huge <color=#F1DC2B>Tentacle</color> taking the ship...\nIt looks extremely dangerous...
Array.indonesia: Tapi aku melihat <color=#F1DC2B>Tentakel</color> raksasa yang sedang menyeret kapal itu...\nKelihatannya sangat berbahaya...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_007
Array.english: <size=32>Do you mean to say that it’s okay for <color=#ff61e3>Leahs-chan</color> to \nexpire in the darkness down there?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Maksudmu, tidak apa-apa jika <color=#ff61e3>Leahs-chan</color> \nmeninggal dalam kegelapan di bawah sana?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_008
Array.english: <size=37>This mission must not be delayed\nfor a moment longer.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Misi ini tidak boleh ditunda\nsedetik pun lagi.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_009
Array.english: Ugh, alright, I get it.\nOh well. I’ll try going down there.
Array.indonesia: Ugh, baiklah, aku mengerti.\nYa sudah. Aku akan coba turun ke sana.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_1_CutStart_001
Array.english: <size=35><color=#C3C3C3>This must be the door.\nThe <color=#1DFEAF>Gas Cutter</color> from Duff could help cut through.</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35><color=#C3C3C3>Ini pasti pintunya.\n<color=#1DFEAF>Pemotong Gas</color> dari Duff bisa membantu memotongnya.</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_1_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oho... I was in too much of a hurry to properly\ntell you how to use it, but you figured it out.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oho... Aku terlalu terburu-buru untuk\nmenjelaskan cara menggunakannya dengan benar, tapi kamu sudah mengetahuinya sendiri.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_1_Complete_002
Array.english: <size=40>Go in through the open door now.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Masuklah melalui pintu yang terbuka itu sekarang.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_1_Complete_003
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>Leahs-chan... Your master is coming...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Leahs-chan... Tuannya sedang datang...</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_2_Complete_001
Array.english: Huh? The space below seems larger than expected.\nTake a look around, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Hah? Ruang di bawah ini sepertinya lebih luas dari yang kuduga.\nLihat-lihat sekeliling, Dave.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_3_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=35>Wait…\nwere those Sea People just now?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Tunggu…\napakah itu Orang Laut tadi?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_3_Complete_002
Array.english: Huh? What do you mean?\nAll I can see is the <color=#1DFEAF>Pink Delivery Box</color>.
Array.indonesia: Hah? Maksudmu apa?\nYang kulihat hanyalah <color=#1DFEAF>Kotak Pengiriman Merah Muda</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_3_Complete_003
Array.english: <size=34>Bring it back quickly!\nIt’s awaiting rescue!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Bawa kembali secepatnya!\nKotak itu sedang menunggu diselamatkan!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_3_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=33><color=#C3C3C3>Telling him won’t do any good...\nI’ll have to go up and tell Dr. Bacon.</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33><color=#C3C3C3>Memberitahunya tidak akan ada gunanya...\nAku harus naik ke atas dan memberi tahu Dr. Bacon.</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_4_LegCutEvent_001
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>Hmm... The <color=#1DFEAF>box</color> is pinned under a squid tentacle...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Hmm... <color=#1DFEAF>Kotak</color> itu terjepit di bawah tentakel cumi-cumi...</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_4_LegCutEvent_002
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>I’ll have to cut it... I wonder if it’s edible?\nI should try taking it to <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color>.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Aku harus memotongnya... Aku penasaran, apakah ini bisa dimakan?\nSepertinya aku harus membawanya ke <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color>.</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_4_WrongWay_001
Array.english: Oh, I almost forgot to pick up Duff's <color=#1DFEAF>Pink Delivery Box</color>!
Array.indonesia: Oh, aku hampir lupa mengambil <color=#1DFEAF>Kotak Pengiriman Merah Muda</color> milik Duff!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=42>Yes! Leahs-chan! Leahs-chan!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>Ya! Leahs-chan! Leahs-chan!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_Complete_002
Array.english: <size=34>To think she hasn’t been damaged...\nOh... There’s saltwater everywhere...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ternyata dia tidak rusak...\nOh... Ada air laut di mana-mana...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_Complete_003
Array.english: <size=34>I’ll clean you up<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>\n<size=41><color=#ff61e3>Here comes Leahs!</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku akan membersihkannya<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>\n<size=41><color=#ff61e3>Leahs datang!</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=33>Whoops. I said Leahs-chan’s line by accident, \nthough I’m the master.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ups. Tanpa sengaja aku mengucapkan kalimat Leahs-chan, \npadahal aku yang jadi tuannya.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_Complete_005
Array.english: <size=50>….</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>….</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_Complete_006
Array.english: Ahem. In any case.\nA promise is a promise.
Array.indonesia: Ahem. Bagaimanapun juga.\nJanji adalah janji.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_Complete_007
Array.english: <size=33>Here you are. \nThe <color=#1DFEAF>Deep Sea Headlamp</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ini dia. \nLampu <color=#1DFEAF>Deep Sea Headlamp</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_Complete_008
Array.english: It’s a recent model\nthat turns on automatically as necessary...
Array.indonesia: Ini model terbaru\nyang menyala otomatis sesuai kebutuhan...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_Complete_009
Array.english: I must go help Leahs-chan recover.\n<color=#ff61e3>GOODBYE-TERNITY★</color>.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus pergi membantu Leahs-chan pulih.\n<color=#ff61e3>GOODBYE-TERNITY★</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission12_001
Array.english: Phew. I guess that’s over for now.
Array.indonesia: Wah. Sepertinya itu sudah selesai dulu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission12_002
Array.english: Come to think of it...\nI did bring this...
Array.indonesia: Kalau dipikir-pikir...\nAku memang membawa ini...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission12_003
Array.english: <size=36>What will I do with this <color=#F1DC2B>Giant Squid Tentacle</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Apa yang harus aku lakukan dengan <color=#F1DC2B>Tentakel Cumi Raksasa</color> ini?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission12_004
Array.english: It smells so awful...\nI’m not sure it can be used for cooking.
Array.indonesia: Baunya sangat busuk...\nAku tidak yakin ini bisa dipakai untuk memasak.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission12_005
Array.english: <size=34>I’ll have to give <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color> a call.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku harus menelepon <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission12_CallBancho_001
Array.english: <size=34>I’ll have to give <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color> a call.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku harus menelepon <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission12_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=35>What is it, Dave?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ada apa, Dave?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission12_Complete_002
Array.english: I... I was helping Duff,\nand I defeated a Giant Squid...
Array.indonesia: Aku... aku sedang membantu Duff,\ndan aku berhasil mengalahkan Cumi-cumi Raksasa...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission12_Complete_003
Array.english: <size=40>That’s... incredible.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Itu... luar biasa.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission12_Complete_004
Array.english: I couldn’t bring the whole thing, so I cut off a bit of its tentacle...\nIs this edible, perhaps?
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak bisa membawa seluruh tubuhnya, jadi aku memotong sedikit tentakelnya...\nApakah ini bisa dimakan, mungkin?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission12_Complete_005
Array.english: <size=42>Hmm. Of course.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>Hmm. Tentu saja.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission12_Complete_006
Array.english: The ammonium chloride that helps it float\ngives it an awful stench, however...
Array.indonesia: Namun, amonium klorida yang membantunya mengapung\nmenyebabkan baunya sangat busuk...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission12_Complete_007
Array.english: And because it’s very tough, it’s difficult to cook\nusing conventional methods.
Array.indonesia: Dan karena teksturnya sangat keras, sulit untuk dimasak\ndengan metode konvensional.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission12_Complete_008
Array.english: I don’t think we’ll be able to offer it to our customers anyway...
Array.indonesia: Lagipula, kurasa kita tidak akan bisa menyajikannya kepada pelanggan...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission12_Complete_009
Array.english: <size=36>Why don’t we close up shop for the day and hold\na <color=#F1DC2B>party</color> with the squid?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Kenapa kita tidak tutup toko hari ini dan mengadakan\nsebuah <color=#F1DC2B>pesta</color> bersama cumi-cumi itu?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission12_Complete_010
Array.english: I’ve been so busy since we opened that I haven’t treated you\nto any proper food, despite your hard work.
Array.indonesia: Aku sangat sibuk sejak kita buka sehingga belum sempat mentraktirmu\nmakanan yang layak, padahal kamu sudah bekerja keras.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission12_Complete_011
Array.english: <size=38>Wow! That sounds fantastic!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Wah! Kedengarannya luar biasa!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission12_Complete_012
Array.english: <size=35>Let me clean up a bit.\nCome to the <color=#F1DC2B>Sushi Bar</color> when you’re ready.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Biarkan aku membereskan sedikit.\nDatanglah ke <color=#F1DC2B>Sushi Bar</color> kalau kamu sudah siap.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission12_Complete_013
Array.english: <size=33><color=#C3C3C3>(Dr. Bacon will be there as well,\nso I can tell him about the fish people I saw.)</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33><color=#C3C3C3>(Dr. Bacon juga akan ada di sana,\njadi aku bisa menceritakan padanya tentang orang-orang ikan yang aku lihat.)</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Enter_001
Array.english: Dave, you’re a bit late!\nEveryone’s been waiting for you.
Array.indonesia: Dave, kamu agak terlambat!\nSemua orang sudah menunggumu.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Enter_002
Array.english: <size=38>Wow! You finished all the cooking already!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Wah! Kamu sudah selesai memasak semuanya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Enter_003
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>When did everyone arrive, though?</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Kapan sih semua orang datang?</color>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bacon_01_001
Array.english: Uh, Dr. Bacon?
Array.indonesia: Eh, Dr. Bacon?

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bacon_01_002
Array.english: Oh Dave! What is it?
Array.indonesia: Oh Dave! Ada apa?

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bacon_01_003
Array.english: <size=36>I saw the <color=#1DFEAF>Sea People</color> down below.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Aku melihat <color=#1DFEAF>Orang Laut</color> di bawah sana.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bacon_01_004
Array.english: <size=44>You what!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=44>Kamu apa!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bacon_01_005
Array.english: You really saw <color=#1DFEAF>Sea People</color> and not dugongs?\nWhat did they look like? Were they dressed? \nDid they resemble humans?
Array.indonesia: Kamu benar-benar melihat <color=#1DFEAF>Orang Laut</color> dan bukan dugong?\nSeperti apa penampilan mereka? Apakah mereka berpakaian? \nApakah mereka mirip manusia?

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bacon_01_006
Array.english: Um... Their torsos look like our own, but the sight of me scared them off into the <color=#F1DC2B>depths</color>. I couldn’t get a good look...
Array.indonesia: Um... Bagian tubuh atas mereka mirip dengan kita, tapi kehadiranku membuat mereka kabur ke <color=#F1DC2B>kedalaman</color>. Aku tidak bisa melihatnya dengan jelas...

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bacon_01_007
Array.english: <size=38>That’s too bad!\nIt could have been an amazing find!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Sayang sekali!\nBisa jadi itu penemuan yang luar biasa!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bacon_01_008
Array.english: That means we might encounter them in the depths!\nThat’s where the <color=#1DFEAF>signal</color> is strongest.
Array.indonesia: Itu berarti kita mungkin akan menemui mereka di kedalaman!\nDi situlah <color=#1DFEAF>sinyal</color> paling kuat.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bacon_01_009
Array.english: <size=36>Perhaps there’s even a <color=#F1DC2B>village</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Mungkin bahkan ada <color=#F1DC2B>desa</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bacon_01_010
Array.english: <size=44>A <color=#F1DC2B>village</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=44>Sebuah <color=#F1DC2B>desa</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bacon_01_011
Array.english: Yes. They have artifacts, murals, a language...\nThey are beings with a unique civilization.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Mereka memiliki artefak, lukisan dinding, bahasa...\nMereka adalah makhluk dengan peradaban yang unik.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bacon_01_012
Array.english: <size=38>It would not be surprising in the least for them to live together in a <color=#F1DC2B>village</color> of sorts.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Tidak akan mengejutkan sama sekali jika mereka hidup bersama di semacam <color=#F1DC2B>desa</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bacon_01_013
Array.english: <size=35>That would be quite the find indeed!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Itu benar-benar akan menjadi penemuan yang luar biasa!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bacon_01_014
Array.english: <size=32>An ancient civilization under the sea could be \nrevealed to us!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Sebuah peradaban kuno di bawah laut mungkin akan \nterungkap kepada kita!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bacon_01_015
Array.english: <size=36>Dave, you’re my best hope.\nKeep up the good work!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Dave, kamu adalah harapan terbesarku.\nTeruslah bekerja dengan baik!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bacon_02_001
Array.english: To think Sea People were real!
Array.indonesia: Siapa sangka Orang Laut itu benar-benar ada!

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bacon_02_002
Array.english: <size=38>Now then, let’s enjoy ourselves today, Dave!\nTo the success of our research!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Nah, mari kita nikmati hari ini, Dave!\nSemoga penelitian kita sukses!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bancho_01_001
Array.english: A <color=#F1DC2B>Giant Squid</color> tentacle...\nIt is not exactly an easy ingredient to use…
Array.indonesia: Sebuah <color=#F1DC2B>tentakel Cumi Raksasa</color>...\nIni bukanlah bahan yang mudah digunakan…

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bancho_01_002
Array.english: Suppressing the stench should allow me to reach its essence.
Array.indonesia: Dengan menekan baunya, aku seharusnya bisa mencapai esensinya.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bancho_01_003
Array.english: You’re still studying the ingredients.
Array.indonesia: Kamu masih mempelajari bahan-bahannya.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bancho_01_004
Array.english: Good work today, bringing back precious ingredients.
Array.indonesia: Kerja bagus hari ini, berhasil membawa pulang bahan-bahan berharga.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bancho_01_005
Array.english: This is a difficult sort to prepare,\nbut that’s part of the fun of cooking.
Array.indonesia: Ini jenis hidangan yang sulit disiapkan,\ntapi itulah bagian yang menyenangkan dari memasak.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bancho_01_006
Array.english: <size=38>So, how does it taste?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Jadi, bagaimana rasanya?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bancho_01_007
Array.english: The food’s always been great, but today’s is even more...
Array.indonesia: Makanannya selalu enak, tapi hari ini rasanya bahkan lebih...

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bancho_01_008
Array.english: <size=44>Spectacular!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=44>Luar biasa!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bancho_01_009
Array.english: Since there was a lot of it, I made many different dishes,\nthough we won’t be able to offer these to customers.
Array.indonesia: Karena jumlahnya banyak, aku membuat berbagai macam hidangan,\nmeski kita tidak bisa menyajikannya kepada pelanggan.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bancho_01_010
Array.english: There seems to be no end to the path of the chef.\nIt’s a fortunate thing to have a path to pursue.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya perjalanan seorang koki tidak pernah berakhir.\nMerupakan hal yang beruntung memiliki jalan yang bisa ditempuh.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bancho_01_011
Array.english: The same can be said of the study of ingredients.\nDave, please keep persevering and one day we’ll succeed.
Array.indonesia: Hal yang sama juga berlaku untuk mempelajari bahan-bahan masakan.\nDave, tolong teruslah gigih dan suatu hari nanti kita pasti akan berhasil.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bancho_01_012
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(I’m not sure what you mean, but...)</color>\n<size=33>Sure, I’ll be sure to bring back more fish!</size>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Aku tidak yakin apa maksudmu, tapi...)</color>\n<size=33>Tentu, aku pasti akan membawa lebih banyak ikan lagi!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bancho_02_001
Array.english: <size=34>Bon appetit!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Selamat menikmati!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Cobra_01_001
Array.english: <size=33>Bwahaha! Dave, congratulations! \nWord of Bancho Sushi is now getting around!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Bwahaha! Dave, selamat! \nKabar tentang Bancho Sushi kini mulai tersebar!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Cobra_01_002
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(He looks to be in a very good mood...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Dia terlihat sedang dalam suasana hati yang sangat baik...)</color>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Cobra_01_003
Array.english: Look at this <color=#F1DC2B>Squid Tentacle</color>!\nIt’s the sort of thing you dream of eating as a child!
Array.indonesia: Lihat ini <color=#F1DC2B>Tentakel Cumi</color>!\nIni adalah jenis makanan yang kamu impikan untuk dimakan saat masih kecil!

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Cobra_01_004
Array.english: <size=35>I’ll bet more people will flock here\nif such things are offered on the menu.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Aku yakin akan lebih banyak orang yang berbondong-bondong ke sini\njika hidangan seperti ini ditawarkan di menu.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Cobra_01_005
Array.english: Aren’t we eating this because\nit’s difficult to serve to customers, though?
Array.indonesia: Bukankah kita makan ini justru karena\nsulit disajikan kepada pelanggan?

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Cobra_01_006
Array.english: Kgh... You’re right!\nWhat a pity. Everyone would want to try something that looks like this, regardless of the taste.
Array.indonesia: Kgh... Kamu benar!\nSayang sekali. Semua orang pasti ingin mencoba sesuatu yang terlihat seperti ini, terlepas dari rasanya.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Cobra_01_007
Array.english: Regardless of the flavor, you say?\nThere’s no way Bancho could stomach that.
Array.indonesia: Terlepas dari rasanya, katamu?\nTidak mungkin Bancho bisa menelan itu.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Cobra_01_008
Array.english: Let’s go with something else.
Array.indonesia: Ayo pilih yang lain saja.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Cobra_01_009
Array.english: Alright. About the... <color=#F1DC2B>depths</color>.\nI have a feeling there must be things down there,
Array.indonesia: Baiklah. Tentang... <color=#F1DC2B>kedalaman</color>.\nAku merasa pasti ada sesuatu di sana,

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Cobra_01_010
Array.english: <size=36>things that’ll make people jump out of their seats.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>sesuatu yang akan membuat orang-orang terkejut.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Cobra_01_011
Array.english: If Dr. Bacon’s research is successful,\nthis place will be famous and filled with people!
Array.indonesia: Jika penelitian Dr. Bacon berhasil,\ntempat ini akan terkenal dan dipenuhi orang!

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Cobra_01_012
Array.english: Hmm. You’re right.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Kamu benar.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Cobra_01_013
Array.english: <size=38>When that happens, we’ll make <color=#F1DC2B>tons of money</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Kalau itu terjadi, kita bakal dapat <color=#F1DC2B>banyak uang</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Cobra_01_014
Array.english: <size=34>So let’s keep at it, Dave!\nLet’s get rich together. Hahaha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Jadi, ayo terus berusaha, Dave!\nAyo kita jadi kaya bareng-bareng. Hahaha!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Cobra_02_001
Array.english: <size=38>Wonderful food, good drinks, and a plan for becoming rich!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Makanan lezat, minuman enak, dan rencana untuk menjadi kaya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Yoshie_01_001
Array.english: A <color=#F1DC2B>party</color> with customers...\nThere’s been a lot of progress. Very good.
Array.indonesia: Sebuah <color=#F1DC2B>pesta</color> bersama pelanggan...\nSudah banyak kemajuan. Sangat bagus.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Yoshie_01_002
Array.english: <size=34>Has there?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Benarkah begitu?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Yoshie_01_003
Array.english: Restaurants should put their customers first.\nFood, drinks, service... and customers are the basic foundations of a restaurant.
Array.indonesia: Restoran seharusnya mengutamakan pelanggannya.\nMakanan, minuman, pelayanan... dan pelanggan adalah fondasi utama sebuah restoran.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Yoshie_01_004
Array.english: <size=33>In the past, there was only a rigorous chef\nand his cooking.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Dulu, yang ada hanyalah seorang koki yang sangat teliti\ndan masakannya.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Yoshie_01_005
Array.english: <size=36>Um... I was also here from the beginning...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Um... Aku juga sudah ada di sini sejak awal...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Yoshie_01_006
Array.english: <size=36>Yes, but you weren’t very noticeable.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Ya, tapi kamu tidak terlalu menonjol.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Yoshie_01_007
Array.english: Do you remember what I told you back then?\nAbout the reviews on <color=#ff61e3>Cooksta</color>.
Array.indonesia: Apa kamu ingat apa yang aku katakan padamu saat itu?\nTentang ulasan di <color=#ff61e3>Cooksta</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Yoshie_01_008
Array.english: <size=36>You said...</size>\nThere wasn’t any real mention of me...
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Kamu bilang...</size>\nTidak ada yang benar-benar menyebut namaku...

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Yoshie_01_009
Array.english: But now people do mention you,\nalbeit rarely.
Array.indonesia: Tapi sekarang orang-orang memang menyebut namamu,\nmeskipun jarang.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Yoshie_01_010
Array.english: They say things like “He poured me hot green tea,” \n“He was working hard preparing the wasabi,”\n“He was friendly,” “He looked busy...”
Array.indonesia: Mereka mengatakan hal-hal seperti “Dia menuangkan teh hijau panas untukku,” \n“ Dia bekerja keras menyiapkan wasabi,”\n“Dia ramah,” “Dia terlihat sibuk...”

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Yoshie_01_011
Array.english: <size=36>Oh?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Oh?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Yoshie_01_012
Array.english: <size=33>The customers are recognizing your hard work.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Para pelanggan mengakui kerja kerasmu.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Yoshie_01_013
Array.english: <size=36>Well! That makes me feel good.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Wah! Itu membuatku merasa senang.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Yoshie_01_014
Array.english: Customers are honest and intuitive, more so than you think.\nThey know if you're sincere, kind, diligent, or skilled, and they react accordingly.
Array.indonesia: Pelanggan itu jujur dan peka, lebih dari yang kamu kira.\nMereka tahu apakah kamu tulus, baik hati, rajin, atau terampil, dan mereka bereaksi sesuai dengan itu.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Yoshie_01_015
Array.english: That’s why this moment is hard to believe. To think that such an obstinate Bancho would be working with people and holding parties...
Array.indonesia: Itulah mengapa momen ini sulit dipercaya. Bayangkan, seorang Bancho yang begitu keras kepala malah bekerja sama dengan orang-orang dan mengadakan pesta...

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Yoshie_01_016
Array.english: <size=34>I think it’s thanks to you, <color=#F1DC2B>Dave</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku rasa itu berkatmu, <color=#F1DC2B>Dave</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Yoshie_01_017
Array.english: <size=33>That makes me wonder what he was like in the past...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Itu membuatku penasaran seperti apa dia di masa lalu...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Yoshie_01_018
Array.english: I can’t divulge details about someone else’s past.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak bisa membocorkan detail tentang masa lalu orang lain.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Yoshie_01_019
Array.english: But maybe someday, if the opportunity presents itself...\nI might be able to tell you.
Array.indonesia: Tapi mungkin suatu hari nanti, jika ada kesempatan...\naku mungkin bisa menceritakannya padamu.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Yoshie_02_001
Array.english: <size=36>Bancho, holding a party...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Bancho, mengadakan pesta...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Dave_01_001
Array.english: <size=36>Phew. That’s good stuff.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Wah. Itu bagus sekali.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Dave_01_002
Array.english: Bancho’s food is so nice.\nI can understand the growing popularity of the restaurant.
Array.indonesia: Makanan Bancho sangat enak.\nAku bisa mengerti mengapa restoran ini semakin populer.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Dave_01_003
Array.english: Or maybe it’s because I caught the fish?
Array.indonesia: Atau mungkin karena aku yang menangkap ikannya?

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Dave_01_004
Array.english: <size=33>In any case, there's been a lot of stuff going on.\nA Giant Squid... Sea People...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Bagaimanapun juga, banyak hal yang terjadi belakangan ini.\nCumi-cumi raksasa... Orang-orang Laut...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Dave_01_005
Array.english: <size=36>There’s no end to the mysteries of the ocean,\neven if it’s dangerous.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Misteri lautan memang tak ada habisnya,\nmeski berbahaya.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Dave_01_006
Array.english: <size=33>I suppose I’ll go even deeper tomorrow.</size>\n<size=33>I wonder what I’ll find?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Sepertinya besok aku akan menyelam lebih dalam lagi.</size>\n<size=33>Apa yang akan kutemukan ya?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Dave_01_007
Array.english: Eh, whatever.\nI’ll think about that tomorrow.
Array.indonesia: Eh, sudahlah.\nAku akan memikirkannya besok.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Dave_01_008
Array.english: <size=36>Time to toast with everyone and rest!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Saatnya bersulang bersama semua orang dan beristirahat!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_Monologue_001
Array.english: Haha! The wind is always cool and nice at night.\nI am sobering up now.
Array.indonesia: Haha! Angin selalu sejuk dan menyenangkan di malam hari.\nAku mulai sadar kembali sekarang.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_Monologue_002
Array.english: (Beep, beep, beep)
Array.indonesia: (Bip, bip, bip)

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_Monologue_003
Array.english: <size=36>Mm? The radar of the Sea People detected something.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Mm? Radar Suku Laut mendeteksi sesuatu.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_Monologue_004
Array.english: But it's not from the water.\nJust how?
Array.indonesia: Tapi itu bukan berasal dari air.\nBagaimana bisa?

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_Monologue_005
Array.english: Well, I am feeling lucky today.
Array.indonesia: Yah, aku merasa beruntung hari ini.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_Monologue_006
Array.english: <size=36>I should go check what it is.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Aku harus pergi memeriksa apa itu.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_Start_001
Array.english: <size=33>I am receiving signals from this cave!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku menerima sinyal dari gua ini!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_Start_002
Array.english: This cave doesn’t look like it was naturally formed.
Array.indonesia: Gua ini sepertinya bukan terbentuk secara alami.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_Start_003
Array.english: <size=32>Worth an investigation.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Layak untuk diselidiki.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_InCave_001
Array.english: <size=37>What a surprise. \nA <color=#1DFEAF>mural</color> in a place like this?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Sungguh mengejutkan. \nSebuah <color=#1DFEAF>lukisan dinding</color> di tempat seperti ini?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_InCave_002
Array.english: Well, it’s quite different from the murals of the Sea People \nI saw in the sea.
Array.indonesia: Yah, ini cukup berbeda dari lukisan dinding Suku Laut \nyang aku lihat di laut.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_InCave_003
Array.english: <size=35>Let me examine it closely.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Biarkan aku memeriksanya lebih dekat.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_Password_001
Array.english: There is a device of some sort here.\nAnd I think I have seen some of these <color=#F1DC2B>letters</color> on the mural.
Array.indonesia: Ada semacam alat di sini.\nDan kurasa aku pernah melihat beberapa <color=#F1DC2B>huruf</color> ini di mural tersebut.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_OpenSecretRoom_001
Array.english: <size=35>Bravo! The door is open!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Bravo! Pintunya terbuka!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_OpenSecretRoom_002
Array.english: It looks dark and creepy, but a true archaeologist will never miss this kind of opportunity.
Array.indonesia: Tempat ini terlihat gelap dan menyeramkan, tapi seorang arkeolog sejati tidak akan pernah melewatkan kesempatan seperti ini.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_OpenSecretRoom_003
Array.english: <size=35>Let’s see what’s inside!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ayo lihat apa yang ada di dalamnya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_InTortureChamber_001
Array.english: <size=35>This place...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Tempat ini...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_InTortureChamber_002
Array.english: <size=32>Look at all these bones and torture devices...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Lihatlah semua tulang dan alat penyiksaan ini...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_InTortureChamber_003
Array.english: I must first examine the <color=#1DFEAF>mural</color> in the back \nto find some clues.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus memeriksa <color=#1DFEAF>lukisan dinding</color> di belakang \nterlebih dahulu untuk mencari petunjuk.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_AfterChamberResearch_001
Array.english: <size=34>So, that’s what happened, huh?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Jadi, begitulah yang terjadi, ya?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_AfterChamberResearch_002
Array.english: Humans could live in harmony with the Sea People\nwere it not for small misunderstandings.
Array.indonesia: Manusia bisa hidup harmonis dengan Suku Laut\njika saja tidak ada kesalahpahaman kecil.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_AfterChamberResearch_003
Array.english: Let’s first bring this <color=#F1DC2B>artifact</color> for further research.
Array.indonesia: Mari kita bawa dulu <color=#F1DC2B>artefak</color> ini untuk diteliti lebih lanjut.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_PickupTreasure_001
Array.english: <size=36>Wow, this...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Wah, ini...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_PickupTreasure_002
Array.english: Looks like a sort of <color=#1DFEAF>breathing apparatus</color>.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya semacam <color=#1DFEAF>alat bantu pernapasan</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_PickupTreasure_003
Array.english: Maybe a Sea People device made for humans?
Array.indonesia: Mungkin alat buatan Suku Laut yang dibuat untuk manusia?

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_CaveNoise_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hm? What’s that noise outside?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hm? Suara apa itu di luar?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_Chasing_Start_001
Array.english: <size=34>What? Who is that?\nWhy is he here?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Apa? Siapa itu?\nKenapa dia ada di sini?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_Chasing_Start_002
Array.english: <size=34>Agh! Pirates!\nWhat are they doing here? Raiding?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Agh! Bajak laut!\nApa yang mereka lakukan di sini? Merampok?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_Chasing_Start_003
Array.english: <size=32>Back to the boat!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kembali ke perahu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_Boat_Chasing_001
Array.english: <size=34>This is our turf!\nGive us whatever you have right now!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ini wilayah kita!\nBerikan apa pun yang kalian miliki sekarang juga!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_Boat_Chasing_002
Array.english: <size=33>They won’t let us go easily if we stop now.\nLet’s get away as far as we can!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Mereka tidak akan membiarkan kita pergi begitu saja jika kita berhenti sekarang.\nAyo kita menjauh sejauh mungkin!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_Chasing_Clear_001
Array.english: <size=34>Whew, I almost fainted.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wah, aku hampir pingsan.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_Chasing_Clear_002
Array.english: <size=32>I must take this Sea People <color=#1DFEAF>breathing apparatus</color> for further study.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku harus membawa alat bantu pernapasan <color=#1DFEAF>Suku Laut ini</color> untuk diteliti lebih lanjut.</size>

Array.name: dialog_intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_NextMorning_001
Array.english: <size=38>Oy, got some sleep?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Hei, sudah tidur?</size>

Array.name: dialog_intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_NextMorning_002
Array.english: Yes. But not enough though.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Tapi belum cukup.

Array.name: dialog_intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_NextMorning_003
Array.english: I went to a cave nearby last night\nand found this by chance.
Array.indonesia: Tadi malam aku pergi ke sebuah gua di dekat sini\ndan menemukan ini secara kebetulan.

Array.name: dialog_intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_NextMorning_004
Array.english: I think it is an apparatus that allows you to breathe underwater like Sea People do.
Array.indonesia: Menurutku ini adalah alat yang memungkinkanmu bernapas di bawah air seperti yang dilakukan Suku Laut.

Array.name: dialog_intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_NextMorning_005
Array.english: I speculate that Sea People possibly made this for humans.
Array.indonesia: Aku menduga bahwa Orang Laut mungkin membuat ini untuk manusia.

Array.name: dialog_intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_NextMorning_006
Array.english: Anyway, it was lying deep in the cave,\nnever used.
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun, alat itu tergeletak di bagian dalam gua,\nbelum pernah digunakan.

Array.name: dialog_intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_NextMorning_007
Array.english: <size=34>Maybe it could prove useful somewhere.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Mungkin alat ini bisa berguna di suatu tempat.</size>

Array.name: dialog_intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_NextMorning_008
Array.english: I will keep it in the lab just in case.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan menyimpannya di laboratorium untuk berjaga-jaga.

Array.name: dialog_intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_NextMorning_009
Array.english: <size=34>Say hi to the Sea People for me!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Sampaikan salamku kepada Suku Laut!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Bacon_MorningTalk_001
Array.english: <size=38>Dave, is everything going well?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Dave, apakah semuanya berjalan lancar?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Bacon_MorningTalk_002
Array.english: Um, I opened the passage to the Glacial Area, but...
Array.indonesia: Um, aku sudah membuka jalan menuju Area Gletser, tapi...

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Bacon_MorningTalk_003
Array.english: <size=32>I can’t explore the area because it’s too cold.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku tidak bisa menjelajahi area itu karena terlalu dingin.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Bacon_MorningTalk_004
Array.english: Oh, your current suit is not warm enough, I see.
Array.indonesia: Oh, rupanya pakaianmu saat ini tidak cukup hangat.

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Bacon_MorningTalk_005
Array.english: So the Sea People gave me this <color=#1DFEAF>cloth</color>,\nbut I don’t know how to use it.
Array.indonesia: Jadi, Suku Laut memberiku <color=#1DFEAF>kain</color> ini,\ntapi aku tidak tahu cara menggunakannya.

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Bacon_MorningTalk_006
Array.english: <size=36>The cloth is warm to the touch!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Kain ini terasa hangat saat disentuh!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Bacon_MorningTalk_007
Array.english: This is the <color=#1DFEAF>breathing apparatus</color> found in the Sea People’s cave.
Array.indonesia: Ini adalah <color=#1DFEAF>alat bantu pernapasan</color> yang ditemukan di gua Suku Laut.

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Bacon_MorningTalk_008
Array.english: I could make a Cold-resistant Suit\nif I had a <color=#1DFEAF>mechanical part</color> that could patch up the items.
Array.indonesia: Aku bisa membuat Pakaian Tahan Dingin\njika aku punya <color=#1DFEAF>komponen mekanis</color> yang bisa memperbaiki barang-barang itu.

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Bacon_MorningTalk_009
Array.english: <size=35>Mechanical part...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Bagian mekanis...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Bacon_MorningTalk_010
Array.english: Don’t you have one from John Watson’s suit?
Array.indonesia: Bukankah kamu punya satu dari baju pelindung John Watson?

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Bacon_MorningTalk_011
Array.english: You’re right. \nActually, I brought some complex mechanical parts.
Array.indonesia: Kamu benar. \nSebenarnya, aku membawa beberapa bagian mekanis yang rumit.

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Bacon_MorningTalk_012
Array.english: This is a device that automatically adjusts water pressure.\nI may be able to do something with this.
Array.indonesia: Ini adalah perangkat yang secara otomatis menyesuaikan tekanan air.\nMungkin aku bisa memanfaatkan ini.

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Bacon_MorningTalk_013
Array.english: <size=36>But...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Tapi...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Bacon_MorningTalk_014
Array.english: It’s too damaged to be used without repair.\nIf only you could find one intact somewhere.
