Array.indonesia: Perangkat ini terlalu rusak untuk digunakan tanpa diperbaiki.\nAndai saja kamu bisa menemukan yang masih utuh di suatu tempat.

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Bacon_MorningTalk_015
Array.english: <size=38>Oh! I have a good idea!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Oh! Aku punya ide bagus!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Bacon_MorningTalk_016
Array.english: <size=35>What is it?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Apa itu?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Bacon_MorningTalk_017
Array.english: <size=36>I will tell you later in the <color=#1DFEAF>evening</color>. \nI need to organize my thoughts. Haha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Aku akan memberitahumu nanti di <color=#1DFEAF>malam hari</color>. \nAku perlu mengatur pikiranku dulu. Haha!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Bacon_MorningTalk_018
Array.english: I have a bad feeling about this.
Array.indonesia: Aku punya firasat buruk soal ini.

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Stealth_Evening_001
Array.english: So, what is the idea you mentioned earlier?
Array.indonesia: Jadi, ide apa yang kamu sebutkan tadi?

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Stealth_Evening_002
Array.english: Oh, that...
Array.indonesia: Oh, itu...

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Stealth_Evening_003
Array.english: <size=36>What if you infiltrate the Sea Blue base \nand retrieve the <color=#1DFEAF>mechanical part</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Bagaimana kalau kamu menyusup ke markas Sea Blue \ndan mengambil <color=#1DFEAF>bagian mekanis</color> itu?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Stealth_Evening_004
Array.english: <size=38>Me? Go to their base?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Aku? Pergi ke markas mereka?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Stealth_Evening_005
Array.english: Sea Blue folks were scouting the area\nusing underwater drones at night.
Array.indonesia: Orang-orang Sea Blue sedang mengintai daerah itu\nmenggunakan drone bawah air di malam hari.

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Stealth_Evening_006
Array.english: Follow those drones and you will find their base.
Array.indonesia: Ikuti drone-drone itu dan kamu akan menemukan markas mereka.

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Stealth_Evening_007
Array.english: <size=38>That sounds very dangerous...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Kedengarannya sangat berbahaya...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Stealth_Evening_008
Array.english: Hahaha, don’t worry.\nI will prepare an <color=#F1DC2B>infiltration suit</color> with camouflage patterns.
Array.indonesia: Hahaha, jangan khawatir.\nAku akan menyiapkan <color=#F1DC2B>pakaian penyusupan</color> dengan pola kamuflase.

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Stealth_Evening_009
Array.english: <size=35>It will hide you from plain sight at night!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Itu akan menyamarkanmu dari pandangan orang lain di malam hari!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Stealth_Evening_010
Array.english: ...no guarantees though.
Array.indonesia: ...tapi tidak ada jaminan.

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Stealth_Evening_011
Array.english: <size=38>Umm...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Umm...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Stealth_Evening_012
Array.english: Anyways, it’s not dark enough yet, so I will see you later\nwhen I close the bar. Hahaha!
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun, belum cukup gelap, jadi aku akan menemuimu nanti\nsaat aku menutup bar. Hahaha!

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Stealth_BoatTalk_001
Array.english: Whew, this should be enough.
Array.indonesia: Wah, ini seharusnya cukup.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Stealth_BoatTalk_002
Array.english: Dave, you’re here.
Array.indonesia: Dave, kamu sudah di sini.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Stealth_BoatTalk_003
Array.english: It’s so dark, are you sure there’s something there?
Array.indonesia: Gelap sekali, kamu yakin ada sesuatu di sana?

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Stealth_BoatTalk_004
Array.english: Hehehe, just put on this infiltration gear.\nIt will help you stay unnoticed.
Array.indonesia: Hehehe, pakai saja perlengkapan penyusupan ini.\nIni akan membantumu tetap tak terdeteksi.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Stealth_AfterCostumeChange_001
Array.english: <size=36>Oh, I feel like a secret agent!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Oh, aku merasa seperti agen rahasia!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Stealth_AfterCostumeChange_002
Array.english: Dressed for success!\nYou look ready to enter Dark Moses Island in that!
Array.indonesia: Berpakaian untuk sukses!\nDengan pakaian itu, kamu terlihat siap memasuki Pulau Dark Moses!

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Stealth_AfterCostumeChange_003
Array.english: Well, into the water now.\nYou will see roaming drones underwater.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah, sekarang masuk ke air.\nKamu akan melihat drone-drone yang berkeliaran di bawah air.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Stealth_AfterCostumeChange_004
Array.english: Follow them unnoticed.\nI bet they will lead you to Sea Blue’s base.
Array.indonesia: Ikuti mereka tanpa ketahuan.\nAku yakin mereka akan membawamu ke markas Sea Blue.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Stealth_AfterCostumeChange_005
Array.english: <size=37>Oh, right.\nLeave your weapons here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Oh, benar.\nTinggalkan senjatamu di sini.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Stealth_AfterCostumeChange_006
Array.english: <size=38>What? You want me to infiltrate their base unarmed?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Apa? Kamu mau aku menyusup ke markas mereka tanpa senjata?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Stealth_AfterCostumeChange_007
Array.english: Sea Blue runs a tight security system with sentry drones \nand sensors.
Array.indonesia: Sea Blue memiliki sistem keamanan yang ketat dengan drone penjaga \ndan sensor.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Stealth_AfterCostumeChange_008
Array.english: If one of the drones detects a weapon, \nthey will alert the base immediately.
Array.indonesia: Jika salah satu drone mendeteksi senjata, \nmereka akan segera memberi tahu markas.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Stealth_AfterCostumeChange_009
Array.english: <size=32>This is a covert mission. You’ll go in quietly, retrieve the mechanical part, and return undetected. Simple enough, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ini adalah misi rahasia. Kamu harus masuk diam-diam, mengambil bagian mekanis itu, dan kembali tanpa terdeteksi. Cukup sederhana, kan?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Stealth_AfterCostumeChange_010
Array.english: Why am I here losing sleep…
Array.indonesia: Kenapa aku di sini sampai susah tidur…

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Stealth_FollowDrone_001
Array.english: <size=36><color=#C3C3C3>That must be one of Sea Blue’s sentry drones.</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36><color=#C3C3C3>Itu pasti salah satu drone penjaga Sea Blue.</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Stealth_FollowDrone_002
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>I should follow it from a distance.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Aku harus mengikutinya dari kejauhan.</color>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Stealth_FindSeaBlue_001
Array.english: <size=36><color=#C3C3C3>Oh, a hidden entrance?</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36><color=#C3C3C3>Oh, pintu masuk tersembunyi?</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Stealth_FindSeaBlue_002
Array.english: <size=36><color=#C3C3C3>I should hurry before the door closes.</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36><color=#C3C3C3>Aku harus bergegas sebelum pintunya tertutup.</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Dave_Stealth_Start_001
Array.english: <size=34><color=#C3C3C3>Isn’t this too big to be a hidden base?</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34><color=#C3C3C3>Bukankah ini terlalu besar untuk sebuah markas rahasia?</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Dave_Stealth_Start_002
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>What are these facilities for?</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Untuk apa fasilitas-fasilitas ini?</color>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Dave_Stealth_Start02_001
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>Machines processing dolphin meat...?!</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Mesin-mesin yang mengolah daging lumba-lumba...?!</color>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Dave_Stealth_Start02_002
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>I am confused. Aren't Sea Blue environmentalists?\nWhat in the world are these for?</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Aku bingung. Bukankah Sea Blue adalah kelompok pecinta lingkungan?\nUntuk apa sih semua ini?</color>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Dave_Stealth_Start02_003
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>I must find some <color=#1DFEAF>mechanical parts</color> for now.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Aku harus mencari beberapa <color=#1DFEAF>suku cadang mekanik</color> dulu.</color>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Dave_Stealth_End_001
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>This looks like an office.\nIt looks like it contains some <color=#1DFEAF>mechanical parts</color> here.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Tempat ini terlihat seperti kantor.\nSepertinya ada beberapa <color=#1DFEAF>komponen mekanik</color> di sini.</color>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Dave_Stealth_End_002
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>Man, I miss my warm, clean bed at home.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Wah, aku rindu tempat tidurku yang hangat dan bersih di rumah.</color>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Dave_Find_Item_001
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3><size=38>Good! Here it is!</size></color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3><size=38>Bagus! Ini dia!</size></color>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Dave_Find_Item_002
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3><size=38>Let me take it.</size></color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3><size=38>Biar aku yang ambil.</size></color>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Dave_End_001
Array.english: <size=38>Oh, Dave!\nYou came back in one piece!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Oh, Dave!\nKamu kembali dengan selamat!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Dave_End_002
Array.english: Well... I sense a lack of trust in your voice \nregarding my survival skills...
Array.indonesia: Yah... Aku merasakan kurangnya kepercayaan dalam suaramu \nterkait kemampuan bertahan hidupku...

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Dave_End_003
Array.english: <size=34>Haha! C’mon. Take a look at this thing. \nSea Blue’s <color=#1DFEAF>mechanical part</color>! In pristine condition!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Haha! Ayolah. Lihat benda ini. \nBagian mekanis <color=#1DFEAF>Sea Blue</color>! Dalam kondisi sangat baik!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Dave_End_004
Array.english: Why didn’t you warn me of the armed pirates?
Array.indonesia: Kenapa kamu tidak memperingatkanku soal bajak laut bersenjata itu?

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Dave_End_005
Array.english: <size=35>Honestly, I didn’t know of their presence!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Jujur, aku tidak tahu mereka ada di sana!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Dave_End_006
Array.english: Anyway…
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun…

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Dave_End_007
Array.english: I found many pieces of equipment used to\nprocess and freeze fish at Sea Blue’s base.
Array.indonesia: Aku menemukan banyak peralatan yang digunakan untuk\nmengolah dan membekukan ikan di markas Sea Blue.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Dave_End_008
Array.english: And I believe they caught some dolphins as well.
Array.indonesia: Dan kurasa mereka juga menangkap beberapa lumba-lumba.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Dave_End_009
Array.english: Isn’t Sea Blue a group of environmentalists?\nDoesn’t that make them hypocrites?
Array.indonesia: Bukankah Sea Blue adalah kelompok pecinta lingkungan?\nBukankah itu membuat mereka munafik?

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Dave_End_010
Array.english: Knowing they have been exposed might make them \nmore dangerous. You better be careful.
Array.indonesia: Mengetahui bahwa mereka telah terbongkar mungkin membuat mereka \nlebih berbahaya. Sebaiknya kamu berhati-hati.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Dave_End_011
Array.english: Anyways, get some rest. It’s getting late.
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun, istirahatlah sebentar. Sudah larut malam.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Dave_End_012
Array.english: <size=37>I will talk to Dr. Bacon tomorrow!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Aku akan berbicara dengan Dr. Bacon besok!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_001
Array.english: <size=38>Good morning!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Selamat pagi!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_002
Array.english: I must have drank too much yesterday... I feel sick.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya aku minum terlalu banyak kemarin... Aku merasa mual.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_003
Array.english: You did seem a bit excited...
Array.indonesia: Kamu memang terlihat agak bersemangat...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_004
Array.english: Haha! You don’t get gatherings like that every day!\nThat sort of occasion calls for joviality...
Array.indonesia: Haha! Acara seperti itu nggak setiap hari ada!\nAcara seperti itu memang harus dirayakan dengan riang gembira...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_005
Array.english: <size=50>Hrrk...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>Hrrk...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_006
Array.english: <size=42>You can’t throw up here, Dr. Bacon!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>Kamu tidak boleh muntah di sini, Dr. Bacon!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_007
Array.english: Oof... I’m not the drinker I used to be.\nIn any case...
Array.indonesia: Uff... Aku sudah tidak sekuat dulu dalam minum.\nBagaimanapun juga...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_008
Array.english: Take the <color=#1DFEAF>Deep Sea Headlamp</color> Duff gave you\nand try venturing down into the depths.
Array.indonesia: Ambil <color=#1DFEAF>Lampu Kepala Laut Dalam</color> yang diberikan Duff kepadamu\ndan coba menjelajah ke kedalaman.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_009
Array.english: It’ll probably turn on automatically when you reach the right depth.
Array.indonesia: Lampu itu mungkin akan menyala secara otomatis saat kamu mencapai kedalaman yang tepat.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_009_2
Array.english: And don’t forget... You’ll have to enhance your <color=#F1DC2B>Diving Suit</color>\nif you want to venture into the depths!
Array.indonesia: Dan jangan lupa... Kamu harus meningkatkan <color=#F1DC2B>Pakaian Selam</color>\n jika ingin menjelajah ke kedalaman!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_010
Array.english: I’ll have to <color=#F1DC2B>enhance my equipment</color> first, then.\nBy the way, do you happen to have scuba—
Array.indonesia: Kalau begitu, aku harus <color=#F1DC2B>meningkatkan perlengkapanku</color> dulu.\nNgomong-ngomong, apakah kamu kebetulan punya peralatan selam—

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_011
Array.english: <size=50>Blaargh!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>Blaargh!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_012
Array.english: Ugh...\nHe’s asking me to enter the water after that?
Array.indonesia: Ugh...\nDia meminta aku masuk ke dalam air setelah itu?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_CobraShop_001
Array.english: <size=40>Oh! Dave, by the way...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Oh! Dave, ngomong-ngomong...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_CobraShop_002
Array.english: I’ve added some <color=#1DFEAF>new tools</color> to the Cobra Shop.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah menambahkan beberapa <color=#1DFEAF>alat baru</color> ke Cobra Shop.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_CobraShop_003
Array.english: <size=40>Talk to me when you have the time!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Hubungi aku kalau kamu punya waktu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_1_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=45>Wait!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=45>Tunggu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_1_Complete_002
Array.english: So it was you...\nThe one who’s been harming the ocean!
Array.indonesia: Jadi itu kamu...\nOrang yang selama ini merusak laut!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_1_Complete_002_01
Array.english: <size=38>You even vomited, you disgusting creature!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Kamu bahkan muntah, makhluk menjijikkan!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_1_Complete_003
Array.english: Wait... That wasn’t me, it was...
Array.indonesia: Tunggu... Itu bukan aku, itu...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_1_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=38>I have no time for your petty excuses!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Aku tidak punya waktu untuk alasan-alasan remehmu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_1_Complete_005
Array.english: Now that you’ve been caught by John Watson of <color=#90CDFF>Sea Blue</color>, \nthe Guardians of the Sea, you won’t be leaving so easily.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang setelah kamu tertangkap oleh John Watson dari <color=#90CDFF>Sea Blue</color>, \nPara Penjaga Laut, kamu tidak akan bisa kabur begitu saja.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_1_Complete_006
Array.english: <size=42>I’ll turn you into fish food!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>Aku akan mengubahmu menjadi makanan ikan!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_1_Timeline2_001
Array.english: <size=47>Oh my Poseidon!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=47>Ya ampun, Poseidon!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_1_Timeline2_002
Array.english: This is all your fault.\nYou did this to the precious sea...
Array.indonesia: Ini semua salahmu.\nKamu yang melakukan ini pada laut yang berharga...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_1_Timeline2_003
Array.english: You’re the one shooting bombs...
Array.indonesia: Kamu yang menembakkan bom-bom itu...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_1_Timeline2_004
Array.english: And all I do is catch a few fish to keep the restaurant running...
Array.indonesia: Dan yang aku lakukan hanyalah menangkap beberapa ikan agar restoran ini tetap berjalan...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_1_Timeline2_005
Array.english: Why don’t you look into the fishing vessels responsible for catching thousands of fish, not individual divers like me!
Array.indonesia: Kenapa kamu tidak menyelidiki kapal-kapal penangkap ikan yang bertanggung jawab atas penangkapan ribuan ikan, bukan penyelam individu seperti aku!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_1_Timeline2_006
Array.english: <size=55>...</size>\r<size=68>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=55>...</size>\r<size=68>...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_1_Timeline2_007
Array.english: <size=38>Enough blabbing!\nI’ll shut that yapper of yours!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Cukup omong kosongnya!\nAku akan membungkam mulutmu yang cerewet itu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_1_Timeline2_008
Array.english: <size=48>Here goes!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=48>Ini dia!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_2_Complete_001
Array.english: Kgh... How dare you fight back against me, \nJohn Watson, formerly of the Navy Seals...
Array.indonesia: Kgh... Berani-beraninya kamu melawan aku, \nJohn Watson, mantan anggota Navy Seals...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_2_Complete_002
Array.english: That should serve as an adequate warning\nso I’ll back away for now to protect the environment...
Array.indonesia: Itu seharusnya menjadi peringatan yang cukup\njadi aku akan mundur dulu untuk melindungi lingkungan...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_2_Complete_003
Array.english: <size=33>But I won’t let you go unpunished \nif you persist in damaging the ocean!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tapi aku tidak akan membiarkanmu lolos begitu saja \njika kamu terus merusak lautan!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_2_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=44>We’re watching you...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=44>Kami mengawasimu...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_2_AfterTimeline_001
Array.english: A path has opened up in the direction of John Watson’s escape.
Array.indonesia: Sebuah jalan telah terbuka ke arah pelarian John Watson.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_2_AfterTimeline_002
Array.english: Let’s go that way to reach the <color=#F1DC2B>signal</color>.
Array.indonesia: Ayo kita pergi ke sana untuk mencapai <color=#F1DC2B>sinyal</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_3_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=40>Huh? It’s the Sea People from before!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Hah? Itu Orang-Orang Laut tadi!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_3_AfterTimeline_001
Array.english: Um... They’re saying something...\nI can’t tell what they’re saying...
Array.indonesia: Um... Mereka sedang mengatakan sesuatu...\nAku tidak bisa memahami apa yang mereka katakan...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_3_AfterTimeline_002
Array.english: I’ll have to call Dr. Bacon.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus menghubungi Dr. Bacon.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_3_AfterTimeline_003
Array.english: <size=36><color=#C3C3C3>*Static*</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36><color=#C3C3C3>*Gangguan sinyal*</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_3_AfterTimeline_004
Array.english: <size=48>My goodness! Wow!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=48>Astaga! Wow!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_3_AfterTimeline_005
Array.english: To... to think the Sea People were real...\nIt’s simply incredible!
Array.indonesia: S... siapa sangka Suku Laut itu nyata...\nIni sungguh luar biasa!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_3_AfterTimeline_006
Array.english: Um... they’re saying something to me,\nbut I can’t understand them.
Array.indonesia: Um... mereka sedang mengatakan sesuatu kepadaku,\ntapi aku tidak bisa memahaminya.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_3_AfterTimeline_007
Array.english: Hmm. I think analyzing the patterns\nmight allow us to translate...
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Kurasa dengan menganalisis polanya\nmungkin kita bisa menerjemahkannya...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_3_AfterTimeline_008
Array.english: Come back up to the boat for now.\nI’ll try and think of a way to translate!
Array.indonesia: Kembalilah ke perahu dulu.\nAku akan mencoba memikirkan cara untuk menerjemahkannya!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_Complete_001
Array.english: Hmm! I did expect the Sea People civilization to be real,\nbut to think there are living Sea People...
Array.indonesia: Hmm! Aku memang menduga peradaban Suku Laut itu nyata,\ntapi tidak menyangka ada Suku Laut yang masih hidup...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_Complete_002
Array.english: This is truly the find of the century!\nThis is thanks to you, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Ini benar-benar penemuan abad ini!\nIni semua berkatmu, Dave.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission14_002
Array.english: <size=36>Hahaha!\nLet’s tell all the news outlets in the world about this!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Hahaha!\nAyo kita beritahu semua media di dunia tentang ini!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission14_003
Array.english: Wait! I think that might be risky...
Array.indonesia: Tunggu! Menurutku itu mungkin berisiko...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission14_004
Array.english: But why?\nThat’s how we’ll get people flocking to this place!
Array.indonesia: Tapi kenapa?\nDengan begitu orang-orang akan berbondong-bondong datang ke tempat ini!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission14_005
Array.english: It wouldn’t matter if we were talking about some ruins,\nbut these are living Sea People. Poachers are bound to show up.
Array.indonesia: Tidak masalah jika kita sedang membicarakan reruntuhan,\ntapi ini adalah Suku Laut yang masih hidup. Pemburu liar pasti akan muncul.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission14_006
Array.english: They’ll start hunting the Sea People,\nsince that will be a way to get a lot of attention.
Array.indonesia: Mereka akan mulai memburu Suku Laut,\nkarena itu akan menjadi cara untuk menarik banyak perhatian.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission14_007
Array.english: Y-you have a point there...
Array.indonesia: K-kamu memang benar...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission14_008
Array.english: How about we first make a <color=#F1DC2B>Translator</color> to analyze their sound waves and figure out what they’re saying?
Array.indonesia: Bagaimana kalau kita buat dulu <color=#F1DC2B>Penerjemah</color> untuk menganalisis gelombang suara mereka dan mencari tahu apa yang mereka katakan?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission14_009
Array.english: I think they have something to tell us.
Array.indonesia: Menurutku mereka punya sesuatu untuk disampaikan kepada kita.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission14_010
Array.english: We’ll first need a <color=#1DFEAF>Sea People Stone Tablet</color>\nwith their writing on it...
Array.indonesia: Pertama-tama kita butuh <color=#1DFEAF>Lempengan Batu Suku Laut</color>\nyang bertuliskan aksara mereka...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission14_011
Array.english: As well as a <color=#1DFEAF>Microphone</color> and an <color=#1DFEAF>Amethyst</color>.
Array.indonesia: Serta sebuah <color=#1DFEAF>Mikrofon</color> dan sebuah <color=#1DFEAF>Amethyst</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission14_012
Array.english: If I’m guessing right...The <color=#1DFEAF>Microphone</color> should be below the sunken ship and the <color=#1DFEAF>Stone Tablet</color> is likely to be in their Record Chamber...\rI hear you can mine <color=#1DFEAF>Amethyst</color> at 100m or deeper with a <color=#F1DC2B>Pickaxe</color>!
Array.indonesia: Kalau tebakanku benar... <color=#1DFEAF>Mikrofon</color> seharusnya ada di bawah kapal karam itu dan <color=#1DFEAF>Tablet Batu</color> kemungkinan besar ada di Ruang Arsip mereka...\rKudengar kamu bisa menambang <color=#1DFEAF>Amethyst</color> di kedalaman 100 m atau lebih dengan <color=#F1DC2B>Palu Tambang</color>!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission14_013
Array.english: Um... The Record Chamber, the ship... and...
Array.indonesia: Um... Ruang Catatan, kapal itu... dan...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission14_014
Array.english: If you can’t remember the locations, check the <color=#72ff0a>To-Do App</color>.\nI’ll add the information there!
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu lupa lokasinya, cek <color=#72ff0a>Aplikasi To-Do</color>.\nAku akan menambahkan informasinya di sana!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission14_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=34>Wow! You had to visit a lot of places,\nbut you managed to get everything!\nNow that’s what I call lucky!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wow! Kamu harus mengunjungi banyak tempat,\ntapi kamu berhasil mendapatkan semuanya!\nItulah yang aku sebut beruntung!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission14_Complete_002
Array.english: I’ll use these to try and make a <color=#F1DC2B>Translator</color> in my lab.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan menggunakan ini untuk mencoba membuat <color=#F1DC2B>Penerjemah</color> di lab-ku.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission14_Complete_003
Array.english: I’ll need some time to make it...\nYou can go about your business in the meantime!
Array.indonesia: Aku butuh waktu untuk membuatnya...\nKamu bisa melanjutkan aktivitasmu sementara itu!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission14_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=36>I’ll be in touch soon!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Aku akan segera menghubungimu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission14_PickItem_First_001
Array.english: Found one of the components of the Translator…\nNow there’s just <color=#1DFEAF>{0}</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>{1}</color> left.
Array.indonesia: Sudah menemukan salah satu komponen Penerjemah…\nSekarang tinggal <color=#1DFEAF>{0}</color> dan <color=#1DFEAF>{1}</color> lagi.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission14_PickItem_Second_001
Array.english: Now, I just need <color=#1DFEAF>{0}</color> to create the Sea People Translator!
Array.indonesia: Sekarang, aku hanya butuh <color=#1DFEAF>{0}</color> untuk membuat Penerjemah Suku Laut!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission14_PickItem_Third_001
Array.english: Good. I got all the materials.\nI should be able to make the <color=#F1DC2B>Sea People Translator</color> now, I think.
Array.indonesia: Bagus. Aku sudah mendapatkan semua bahan.\nSepertinya aku bisa membuat <color=#F1DC2B>Penerjemah Suku Laut</color> sekarang.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission14_PickItem_Third_002
Array.english: <size=35>I should deliver it to Dr. Bacon!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Aku harus menyerahkannya kepada Dr. Bacon!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_001
Array.english: Phew. I tried to do it alone, but it was too tough.\nI got a bit of help from <color=#F1DC2B>Duff</color>.
Array.indonesia: Wah. Aku mencoba melakukannya sendiri, tapi terlalu sulit.\nAku mendapat sedikit bantuan dari <color=#F1DC2B>Duff</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_002
Array.english: Thanks to his help, we can now translate\nyour words into the Sea People’s language as well.
Array.indonesia: Berkat bantuannya, kini kita juga bisa menerjemahkan\nkata-katamu ke dalam bahasa Suku Laut.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_003
Array.english: Wow!\nI’m curious to know what they have to say as well.
Array.indonesia: Wow!\nAku juga penasaran ingin tahu apa yang akan mereka katakan.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_004
Array.english: I’ll first make my way back to the <color=#F1DC2B>Sea People’s location</color>.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan kembali dulu ke <color=#F1DC2B>lokasi Suku Laut</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_1_Complete_001
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>Let’s try out the Sea People Translator\nfrom Dr. Bacon and see how it works.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Ayo kita coba Penerjemah Suku Laut\ndari Dr. Bacon dan lihat bagaimana cara kerjanya.</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=34>Ah... Ah... Can you... hear me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ah... Ah... Bisakah... kamu mendengarku?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_002
Array.english: <size=42>What!\nHow is a human speaking our language?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>Apa!\nBagaimana mungkin seorang manusia bisa berbicara dalam bahasa kami?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_003
Array.english: An interesting creature...His body looks different from\nthat of the humans we occasionally see...
Array.indonesia: Makhluk yang menarik... Tubuhnya terlihat berbeda dari\ntubuh manusia yang sesekali kami lihat...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=50>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_005
Array.english: Well, in any case!\nRight. I should introduce myself.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah, bagaimanapun juga!\nBenar. Seharusnya aku memperkenalkan diri.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_006
Array.english: <size=36>My name is <color=#F1DC2B>Suwam</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Namaku <color=#F1DC2B>Suwam</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_007
Array.english: Among us <color=#90CDFF>Low-Dwellers</color>...\nOh, you said you call us Sea People, right?
Array.indonesia: Di antara kita <color=#90CDFF>Penduduk Bawah</color>...\nOh, kamu bilang kamu menyebut kami Orang Laut, kan?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_008
Array.english: You could say I’m the bravest and coolest male\namong them. Ahem!
Array.indonesia: Bisa dibilang aku adalah pria paling berani dan paling keren\ndi antara mereka. Ahem!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_009
Array.english: Suwam... Nice to meet you.\nI’m <color=#F1DC2B>Dave</color>.
Array.indonesia: Suwam... Senang bertemu denganmu.\nAku <color=#F1DC2B>Dave</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_010
Array.english: Hehe, Dave…in our language, \nyour name sounds very similar to <color=#90CDFF>“broken toilet lid.”</color>
Array.indonesia: Hehe, Dave… dalam bahasa kami, \nnamamu terdengar sangat mirip dengan <color=#90CDFF>“tutup toilet yang rusak.”</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_011
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>What is with this creature?</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Ada apa dengan makhluk ini?</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_012
Array.english: In any case! The person lying here\nis the daughter of the Sea People village chief... <color=#F1DC2B>Ramo</color>!
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun juga! Orang yang terbaring di sini\nadalah putri kepala desa Suku Laut... <color=#F1DC2B>Ramo</color>!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_013
Array.english: Ever since being kidnapped by that stupid giant squid,\nshe has been unconscious...
Array.indonesia: Sejak diculik oleh cumi-cumi raksasa bodoh itu,\ndia terus tak sadarkan diri...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_014
Array.english: If I’d known about it a little earlier...\nI’d have shown that squid a thing or two!
Array.indonesia: Seandainya aku tahu lebih awal...\naku pasti sudah memberi pelajaran pada cumi-cumi itu!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_015
Array.english: Don’t get a big head for defeating that insignificant squid, human! I am the one that guards <color=#F1DC2B>Ramo</color>!
Array.indonesia: Jangan sombong hanya karena mengalahkan cumi-cumi tak berarti itu, manusia! Akulah yang menjaga <color=#F1DC2B>Ramo</color>!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_016
Array.english: You really are a noisy one.\nIn any case, you seem to have something to say... what is it?
Array.indonesia: Kau benar-benar orang yang berisik.\nBagaimanapun juga, sepertinya kau punya sesuatu yang ingin dikatakan... apa itu?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_017
Array.english: Oh, about that.\nIn order to allow Ramo to recover, we need some <color=#F1DC2B>Medicinal Herbs</color>.
Array.indonesia: Oh, soal itu.\nAgar Ramo bisa pulih, kita butuh beberapa <color=#F1DC2B>Ramuan Obat</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_018
Array.english: I’m unable to leave, as I must stay\nand look after her!
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak bisa pergi, karena aku harus tinggal\ndan merawatnya!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_019
Array.english: Human, you must acquire some <color=#F1DC2B>Medicinal Herbs</color>\nto help Ramo recover.
Array.indonesia: Manusia, kamu harus mendapatkan beberapa <color=#F1DC2B>Ramuan Obat</color>\nuntuk membantu Ramo pulih.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_020
Array.english: The <color=#1DFEAF>Feather Coral</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>Lily Coral</color> grow in these parts.\nPlease make them edible and bring them to me.
Array.indonesia: <color=#1DFEAF>Karang Bulu</color> dan <color=#1DFEAF>Karang Lily</color> tumbuh di daerah ini.\nTolong jadikan keduanya bisa dimakan dan bawakan kepadaku.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_021
Array.english: Make them edible?\nHow do I do that?
Array.indonesia: Jadikan bisa dimakan?\nBagaimana caranya?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_022
Array.english: That’s for you to figure out, human!\nGo find a <color=#F1DC2B>chef</color> to help you or something!
Array.indonesia: Itu tugasmu untuk mencari tahu, manusia!\nPergilah cari <color=#F1DC2B>koki</color> untuk membantumu atau semacamnya!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_023
Array.english: Hmm... She’s ill, so I can’t refuse to help her...\n<color=#1DFEAF>Feather Coral</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>Lily Coral</color>, huh? \nI guess I’ll take a look around first...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Dia sakit, jadi aku tidak bisa menolak membantunya...\n<color=#1DFEAF>Karang Bulu</color> dan <color=#1DFEAF>Karang Lily</color>, ya? \nSepertinya aku akan melihat-lihat dulu. ..

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_Complete_001
Array.english: Phew. It seems I got everything that fussy half-fish\nasked me for.
Array.indonesia: Wah. Sepertinya aku sudah mendapatkan semua yang diminta oleh setengah ikan yang rewel itu\n.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_Suwam_Normal_01
Array.english: Good, follow along.\nMake sure Ramo isn’t hurt!
Array.indonesia: Bagus, ikuti aku.\nPastikan Ramo tidak terluka!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_Suwam_Normal_02
Array.english: Hey now, human... Don’t tell me you’re tired already?\nBring her carefully!
Array.indonesia: Hei, manusia... Jangan bilang kamu sudah lelah?\nBawa dia dengan hati-hati!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_Suwam_Wait_WithOutRamo_01
Array.english: Why are you alone? Where did you leave Ramo?\nI knew it, humans aren’t to be trusted!
Array.indonesia: Kenapa kamu sendirian? Di mana kamu tinggalkan Ramo?\nSudah kuduga, manusia memang tidak bisa dipercaya!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_001
Array.english: He wanted me to make this coral edible, right?
Array.indonesia: Dia ingin aku membuat karang ini bisa dimakan, kan?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_002
Array.english: <size=37>I’ll have to ask <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color> for help.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Aku harus minta bantuan <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_1_Complete_001
Array.english: Hmm... So this coral has to be prepared so\nit’s easy to eat for Sea People...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Jadi karang ini harus diolah agar\nmudah dimakan oleh Orang Laut...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_1_Complete_002
Array.english: Well, I think we could start with a <color=#1DFEAF>porridge</color> of sorts...\nGive me a moment.
Array.indonesia: Yah, kurasa kita bisa mulai dengan semacam <color=#1DFEAF>bubur</color>...\nTunggu sebentar.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_1_Complete_003
Array.english: Here you go.\nI softened the coral to make it easy to eat, so it should be fine.
Array.indonesia: Ini dia.\nAku melunakkan karang ini agar mudah dimakan, jadi seharusnya tidak masalah.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_1_Complete_004
Array.english: Wow, thank you, Bancho.\nYou’re so quick.
Array.indonesia: Wah, terima kasih, Bancho.\nKamu cepat sekali.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_1_Complete_005
Array.english: Alright! Let’s take this to <color=#F1DC2B>Ramo</color>.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah! Ayo kita bawa ini ke <color=#F1DC2B>Ramo</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Complete_001
Array.english: Here, I brought some <color=#1DFEAF>Coral Porridge</color>.
Array.indonesia: Ini, aku bawa <color=#1DFEAF>Bubur Karang</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Complete_002
Array.english: Oho! You really brought it?\n*sniff* Seems to be right.
Array.indonesia: Oho! Kamu beneran bawa?\n*sniff* Kayaknya bener.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Complete_003
Array.english: <color=#F1DC2B>Ramo</color>! This is Coral Porridge!\nI prepared it myself!
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Ramo</color>! Ini Bubur Karang!\nAku yang bikin sendiri!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=50>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Timeline_001
Array.english: <size=40>Phew! I feel much better now!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Wah! Sekarang aku udah jauh lebih baik!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Timeline_002
Array.english: I can’t remember anything after\nseeing squid tentacles...
Array.indonesia: Aku nggak ingat apa-apa setelah\nmelihat tentakel cumi-cumi...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Timeline_003
Array.english: <size=42>Huh? A human? What is a human doing here?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>Hah? Manusia? Apa yang dilakukan manusia di sini?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Timeline_004
Array.english: Well... you could say I saved you.\nI defeated the Giant Squid and brought you the Coral Porridge...
Array.indonesia: Yah... bisa dibilang aku yang menyelamatkanmu.\nAku mengalahkan Cumi-cumi Raksasa dan membawakanmu Bubur Karang...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Timeline_005
Array.english: <size=45>Hmm? Is that so?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=45>Hmm? Benarkah begitu?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Timeline_006
Array.english: Wait, Ramo, that’s not it!\nI’m actually the one who...
Array.indonesia: Tunggu, Ramo, bukan begitu!\nSebenarnya akulah yang...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Timeline_007
Array.english: <size=37>Alright, then! Human!\nYou shall <color=#F1DC2B>escort</color> me back to my village!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Baiklah, kalau begitu! Manusia!\nKamu harus <color=#F1DC2B>mengantarku</color> kembali ke desaku!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Timeline_008
Array.english: <size=40>Me? Why should I?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Aku? Kenapa harus aku?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Timeline_009
Array.english: I’m an injured lady!\nYou need to keep anything dangerous from happening!
Array.indonesia: Aku seorang wanita yang terluka!\nKamu harus mencegah hal-hal berbahaya terjadi!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Timeline_010
Array.english: Ramo, I can escort you to...
Array.indonesia: Ramo, aku bisa mengantarmu ke...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Timeline_011
Array.english: <size=34>Suwam! You go ahead and scout our path!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Suwam! Kamu duluan saja dan telusuri jalan kita!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Timeline_012
Array.english: What? How could you let a human escort you!\nI can keep you safe and...
Array.indonesia: Apa? Bagaimana bisa kamu membiarkan manusia mengantarmu!\nAku bisa menjagamu tetap aman dan...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Timeline_013
Array.english: You haven’t even passed the village tactics exam!\nIt was tough enough coming here.
Array.indonesia: Kamu bahkan belum lulus ujian taktik desa!\nSudah cukup sulit datang ke sini.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Timeline_014
Array.english: <size=45>Argh! That’s a sore spot for me!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=45>Argh! Itu titik lemahku!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Timeline_015
Array.english: Suwam!\nStop complaining and be our lookout for the path ahead.
Array.indonesia: Suwam!\nBerhenti mengeluh dan jaga jalan di depan untuk kami.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Timeline_016
Array.english: As for you, human, you’ll have to <color=#F1DC2B>carry</color> me on your back.
Array.indonesia: Sedangkan kamu, manusia, kamu harus <color=#F1DC2B>menggendong</color> aku di punggungmu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Timeline_017
Array.english: On my... back?\nIt’s hard enough to move around as it is down here.
Array.indonesia: Di... punggungku?\nSudah cukup sulit bergerak di sini.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Timeline_018
Array.english: Ow... My injured fin is hurting again...
Array.indonesia: Aduh... Siripku yang terluka terasa sakit lagi...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Timeline_019
Array.english: You are impossible.\nI’ll take you to the village and no further... alright?
Array.indonesia: Kamu memang susah diatur.\nAku akan membawamu ke desa dan tidak lebih jauh dari itu... oke?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_MidEvent_001
Array.english: What is this vibration?
Array.indonesia: Getaran apa ini?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_MidEvent_002
Array.english: It’s rare to experience one so strong...
Array.indonesia: Jarang sekali merasakan getaran sekuat ini...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_MidEvent_003
Array.english: <size=35>Did something happen to the village?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Apakah terjadi sesuatu di desa?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_MidEvent_004
Array.english: <size=35>We must return quick.\nHurry, human!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Kita harus segera kembali.\nCepat, manusia!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=36>Ramo... This...\nOur path in is blocked with rock!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Ramo... Ini...\nJalan masuk kita terhalang batu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_Complete_002
Array.english: Oh no! What is going on?
Array.indonesia: Oh tidak! Apa yang sedang terjadi?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_Complete_003
Array.english: Um... It must have been the vibrations earlier...
Array.indonesia: Um... Pasti karena getaran tadi...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_Complete_004
Array.english: Suwam! Think of something.\nI need to get back quick before my father scolds me again!
Array.indonesia: Suwam! Pikirkan cara apa pun.\nAku harus segera kembali sebelum ayahku memarahiku lagi!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_Complete_005
Array.english: Um...\n<size=45>Hmm...</size>
Array.indonesia: Um...\n<size=45>Hmm...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_Complete_006
Array.english: <size=37>Maybe we can open up a path by dropping\nthe loose <color=#F1DC2B>rock pile</color> over there?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Mungkin kita bisa membuka jalan dengan menjatuhkan\ntumpukan <color=#F1DC2B>batu yang longgar</color> di sana?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_Stone_001
Array.english: <size=36>If we can topple it and make it fall...\nIt might just do the trick!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Kalau kita bisa menjatuhkannya...\nMungkin itu bisa berhasil!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_Stone_002
Array.english: Well... I suppose it might work.\nHow do we make the rocks fall, though?
Array.indonesia: Yah... Kurasa itu mungkin berhasil.\nTapi, bagaimana cara kita membuat batu-batu itu jatuh?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_Anchor_001
Array.english: Hmm? I see a <color=#1DFEAF>Stake</color> over there...\nMaybe if we pull it out?
Array.indonesia: Hmm? Aku melihat sebuah <color=#1DFEAF>tiang</color> di sana...\nMungkin kalau kita mencabutnya?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_Anchor_002
Array.english: Human! Can you pull out that <color=#1DFEAF>Stake</color> over there?
Array.indonesia: Manusia! Bisakah kamu mencabut <color=#1DFEAF>tiang</color> di sana?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_Anchor_003
Array.english: The Stake?\nI think I’ll hurt my hands with the <color=#F1DC2B>Gloves</color> I’m wearing...
Array.indonesia: Tiang itu?\nAku rasa tanganku akan terluka karena <color=#F1DC2B>Sarung Tangan</color> yang aku pakai...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_Anchor_004
Array.english: I could probably do it with <color=#F1DC2B>Gloves</color> that are thicker and offer a better grip.
Array.indonesia: Mungkin aku bisa melakukannya dengan <color=#F1DC2B>Sarung Tangan</color> yang lebih tebal dan lebih mudah digenggam.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_Anchor_004_02
Array.english: <size=36><color=#C3C3C3>*Static*</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36><color=#C3C3C3>*Gangguan Sinyal*</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_Anchor_005
Array.english: Dave... My apologies...\nI left the microphone on because I was dying\nto know what you were talking about.
Array.indonesia: Dave... Maaf ya...\nAku lupa mematikan mikrofon karena aku penasaran sekali\nmau tahu apa yang kamu bicarakan.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_Anchor_006
Array.english: If it’s enhanced <color=#F1DC2B>Diving Gloves</color> you need,\nI think my lab could help you out.
Array.indonesia: Kalau yang kamu butuhkan adalah <color=#F1DC2B>Sarung Tangan Selam</color> yang ditingkatkan,\nkurasa labku bisa membantumu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_Anchor_007
Array.english: Huh? New gloves?
Array.indonesia: Hah? Sarung tangan baru?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_Anchor_008
Array.english: <size=36>Haha, equipment goes hand-in-hand with exploration, does it not? Come up to the boat!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Haha, peralatan memang tak terpisahkan dari eksplorasi, bukan? Ayo naik ke kapal!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_Anchor_009
Array.english: <size=36><color=#C3C3C3>*Static*</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36><color=#C3C3C3>*Gangguan sinyal*</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_Anchor_010
Array.english: I think there must be a way...\nCould you wait here for a moment?
Array.indonesia: Kurasa pasti ada caranya...\nBisakah kamu menunggu sebentar di sini?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_Anchor_011
Array.english: Hold it, human.\nYou plan to leave Ramo in a dangerous place like this?
Array.indonesia: Tunggu dulu, manusia.\nKamu berencana meninggalkan Ramo di tempat berbahaya seperti ini?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_Anchor_012
Array.english: Luckily she has me guarding her...\nStill, be back quick!
Array.indonesia: Untungnya ada aku yang menjaganya...\nTapi, cepat kembali ya!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_Complete_001
Array.english: Hmm! The road back to the Sea People village, huh...
Array.indonesia: Hmm! Jalan kembali ke desa Suku Laut, ya...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_Complete_002
Array.english: <size=46>How fascinating!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=46>Sungguh menarik!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_Complete_003
Array.english: My lab has developed some <color=#F1DC2B>Diving Gloves</color>\nto be used for retrieving artifacts.
Array.indonesia: Laboratoriumku telah mengembangkan beberapa <color=#F1DC2B>Sarung Tangan Selam</color>\nyang digunakan untuk mengambil artefak.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_Complete_004
Array.english: I see! That should let me pull out a <color=#1DFEAF>Stake</color>\nwithout my hands slipping, right?
Array.indonesia: Begitu! Itu seharusnya memungkinkan aku menarik <color=#1DFEAF>Tiang</color>\ntanpa tanganku tergelincir, kan?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_Complete_005
Array.english: Haha! Of course. It has various safety measures built in \nthat’ll let you move <color=#1DFEAF>many other objects</color> besides stakes.
Array.indonesia: Haha! Tentu saja. Sarung tangan ini dilengkapi berbagai fitur keamanan \nyang memungkinkanmu memindahkan <color=#1DFEAF>banyak benda lain</color> selain tiang.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_Complete_006
Array.english: The long dive must have been tiring.\nGet some rest, I’ll explain the details tomorrow.
Array.indonesia: Penyelaman yang lama pasti melelahkan.\nIstirahatlah dulu, aku akan menjelaskan detailnya besok.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_Complete_007
Array.english: <size=38>I’ll come to the boat tomorrow morning!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Aku akan datang ke kapal besok pagi!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_WrongWay_001
Array.english: Not this way, human!\nLet's go follow <color=#1DFEAF>Suwam</color>.
Array.indonesia: Bukan ke sini, manusia!\nAyo kita ikuti <color=#1DFEAF>Suwam</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_001
Array.english: Looks like Dr. Bacon left abruptly again\nafter finishing his explanation.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya Dr. Bacon pergi dengan terburu-buru lagi\nsetelah menyelesaikan penjelasannya.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_002
Array.english: In any case, these <color=#F1DC2B>Diving Gloves</color> look like they could \ncome in very handy.
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun juga, <color=#F1DC2B>Sarung Tangan Selam</color> ini sepertinya akan \nsangat berguna.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_003
Array.english: I heard that the Sea People are waiting for you.\nGo down there and try pulling out the <color=#1DFEAF>Stake</color>!
Array.indonesia: Aku dengar Suku Laut sedang menunggumu.\nTurunlah ke sana dan coba cabut <color=#1DFEAF>Tongkat</color> itu!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_1_Complete_001
Array.english: Oh, you’re back, human.\nI was afraid you’d been eaten by a frilled shark on the way back.
Array.indonesia: Oh, kamu sudah kembali, manusia.\nAku takut kamu dimakan hiu berkerah dalam perjalanan pulang.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_1_Complete_002
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>She talks like someone I know...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Dia bicara seperti seseorang yang kukenal...</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_1_Complete_003
Array.english: I think I’ll be able to pull out the Stake if I use the <color=#F1DC2B>Diving Gloves</color>\nfrom Dr. Bacon, who lives on land.
Array.indonesia: Kurasa aku bisa mencabut <color=#F1DC2B>Paku</color>\n itu kalau pakai <color=#F1DC2B>Sarung Tangan Selam</color>\n dari Dr. Bacon, yang tinggal di darat.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_1_Complete_004
Array.english: Bacon... Hehe.\nIn our language, that name sounds like <color=#90CDFF>“spoiled whale meat”</color>. Hehe.
Array.indonesia: Bacon... Hehe.\nDalam bahasa kami, nama itu terdengar seperti <color=#90CDFF>“daging paus busuk”</color>. Hehe.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_1_Complete_005
Array.english: Um... okay.\nWait a moment. Let me try and pull.
Array.indonesia: Um... oke.\nTunggu sebentar. Biar aku coba tarik.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_2_Complete_001
Array.english: It was effective, but not enough... Hmm.
Array.indonesia: Berhasil, tapi belum cukup... Hmm.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_2_Complete_002
Array.english: <size=32>I think one more attempt might cut it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kurasa satu kali lagi mungkin cukup.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_2_Complete_003
Array.english: Human! There’s another rock pile over there.
Array.indonesia: Manusia! Ada tumpukan batu lain di sana.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_2_Stones_001
Array.english: Um... There’s no movable device over there.\nI’ll have to go check it out first.
Array.indonesia: Um... Di sana tidak ada alat yang bisa digerakkan.\nAku harus memeriksanya dulu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_2_Barricade_001
Array.english: Let's pull that Stake first!
Array.indonesia: Ayo tarik Pasak itu dulu!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_3_WrongSide_001
Array.english: Hmm... There’s nothing that can be done on this side...\nI’ll have to try going around back.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Tidak ada yang bisa dilakukan di sisi ini...\nAku harus mencoba memutar ke belakang.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_3_Complete_001
Array.english: There’s a <color=#1DFEAF>Stake</color> in the back!\nIf I pull that out...
Array.indonesia: Ada <color=#1DFEAF>tiang</color> di belakang!\nKalau aku mencabutnya...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_4_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=33>Wow, human!\nGood, we have a path!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wah, manusia!\nBagus, sekarang ada jalan!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_4_Complete_002
Array.english: You’re more useful than you look!
Array.indonesia: Kamu lebih berguna daripada yang terlihat!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_4_Complete_003
Array.english: The village is very close.\nCome in through the hole you just made. I’ll go ahead.
Array.indonesia: Desa itu sudah sangat dekat.\nMasuklah melalui lubang yang baru saja kamu buat. Aku akan pergi duluan.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_4_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=31>Wait, I can leave now, can’t I?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Tunggu, aku bisa pergi sekarang, kan?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_4_Complete_005
Array.english: <size=32>Would you listen to yourself! \nAren’t you worried for Ramo?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Dengar sendiri omonganmu itu! \nKamu tidak khawatir dengan Ramo?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_4_Complete_006
Array.english: Besides, I have a request for you.\nSo…I would like you to come to the village with us.
Array.indonesia: Lagipula, aku punya permintaan untukmu.\nJadi… aku ingin kamu ikut ke desa bersama kami.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_4_Complete_007
Array.english: <size=35>The Sea People village? Me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Desa Suku Laut? Aku?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_4_Complete_008
Array.english: Yes. There’s a reason I came all the way up to the human sea.\nI have a request.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Ada alasan mengapa aku datang jauh-jauh ke laut manusia.\nAku punya permintaan.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_4_Complete_009
Array.english: Oh... Okay.
Array.indonesia: Oh... Oke.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_5_Complete_001
Array.english: Ugh... I’m getting real spooky vibes.
Array.indonesia: Ugh... Aku merasakan getaran yang benar-benar menyeramkan.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_5_AfterTimeline_001
Array.english: <size=33>So-something just moved past me!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Baru saja ada sesuatu yang melintas di depanku!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_5_AfterTimeline_002
Array.english: <size=38>Human! Go on ahead and be our lookout!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Manusia! Silakan maju dan jaga pengintaian untuk kami!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_5_AfterTimeline_003
Array.english: But... it’s so dark!
Array.indonesia: Tapi... sangat gelap!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_5_AfterTimeline_004
Array.english: <size=32>I feel like there might be something dangerous there... Ugh.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku merasa mungkin ada sesuatu yang berbahaya di sana... Ugh.</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss001_enter_001
Array.english: Hmm... I went in the <color=#F1DC2B>vortex</color> and ended up here...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Aku masuk ke <color=#F1DC2B>pusaran</color> dan berakhir di sini...

Array.name: dialog_boss001_enter_002
Array.english: Maybe these are things that were brought here by the storm…
Array.indonesia: Mungkin ini adalah benda-benda yang terbawa ke sini oleh badai…

Array.name: dialog_boss001_enter02_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hm?\nI think that big truck just moved...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hm?\nSepertinya truk besar itu baru saja bergerak...</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss001_start_001
Array.english: <size=34>Ahh! A moving truck...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ahh! Truk yang bergerak...?</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss001_start_002
Array.english: <size=34>It’s not a truck, it’s a giant hermit crab!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Itu bukan truk, itu kepiting pertapa raksasa!</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss001_start_003
Array.english: I don’t think a gun will do anything...\nWhat do I do?
Array.indonesia: Aku rasa senjata api nggak bakal berguna...\nApa yang harus aku lakukan?

Array.name: dialog_boss001_end_001
Array.english: <size=35>That thing was really nothing without the shell.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Makhluk itu benar-benar tak berdaya tanpa cangkangnya.</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss001_end_002
Array.english: I hope the <color=#1DFEAF>Boss Card</color> Sato was talking about has been activated.
Array.indonesia: Kuharap <color=#1DFEAF>Kartu Bos</color> yang dibicarakan Sato sudah diaktifkan.

Array.name: dialog_boss001_end_003
Array.english: The <color=#F1DC2B>vortex</color> came back after defeating the hermit crab.
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>pusaran</color> itu kembali setelah kepiting pertapa itu dikalahkan.

Array.name: dialog_boss001_end_004
Array.english: <size=34>Let’s go back to the boat using that!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ayo kembali ke perahu menggunakan itu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss002_enter_001
Array.english: What is this?\nWhy is there debris so deep down here?
Array.indonesia: Apa ini?\nKenapa ada puing-puing sedalam ini?

Array.name: dialog_boss002_earthquake_001
Array.english: <size=38>Oh no... those vibrations again?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Oh tidak... getaran itu lagi?</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss002_earthquake_002
Array.english: Something has to be here...\nWhy did he tell me to come alone?
Array.indonesia: Pasti ada sesuatu di sini...\nKenapa dia menyuruhku datang sendirian?

Array.name: dialog_boss002_firstcontact_001
Array.english: Wh-what is that?\nThere are Wolf Eels that big?
Array.indonesia: A-apa itu?\nAda Ikan Serigala sebesar itu?

Array.name: dialog_boss002_firstcontact_002
Array.english: Ugh... I don’t think I can run...\nOh, whatever!
Array.indonesia: Ugh... sepertinya aku nggak bisa lari...\nAh, sudahlah!

Array.name: dialog_boss002_firstdash_001
Array.english: <size=36>Ugh... It looks really tough!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Ugh. .. Kelihatannya sangat tangguh!</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss002_firstdash_002
Array.english: Huh? The shining spot on its <color=#F1DC2B>tail</color>...\nIt looks weaker than the rest of its body.
Array.indonesia: Hah? Titik berkilau di <color=#F1DC2B>ekornya</color>...\nKelihatannya lebih lemah daripada bagian tubuhnya yang lain.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_7_Complete_001
Array.english: Ugh...\nHow can a Wolf Eel be so big?
Array.indonesia: Ugh...\nBagaimana bisa Ikan Serigala sebesar ini?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_7_Complete_002
Array.english: Ahem. I was just about to come and defeat it.\nI guess I came too late.
Array.indonesia: Ahem. Aku baru saja mau datang untuk mengalahkannya.\nSepertinya aku datang terlambat.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_7_Complete_002_2
Array.english: Haha! You’re stronger than I expected, human.
Array.indonesia: Haha! Kamu lebih kuat dari yang kuduga, manusia.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_7_Complete_003
Array.english: Now, you see that big gate over there?\nThat’s the entrance to the village.
Array.indonesia: Nah, lihat gerbang besar di sana?\nItu adalah pintu masuk ke desa.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_7_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=36>Take the lead, human!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Pimpinlah, manusia!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_7_AfterTimeline_001
Array.english: Hmm. Looks safe now.\nGood work, human!
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Sepertinya sudah aman sekarang.\nKerja bagus, manusia!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_8_Complete_001
Array.english: Phew. We’re finally back to the village entrance passageway.\n<color=#F1DC2B>Ramo</color>, you have a key, right?
Array.indonesia: Fiuh. Akhirnya kita kembali ke lorong pintu masuk desa.\n<color=#F1DC2B>Ramo</color>, kamu punya kuncinya, kan?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_8_Complete_002
Array.english: <size=38>Oh no! I left the key back at the...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Oh tidak! Aku meninggalkan kuncinya di...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_8_Complete_003
Array.english: Just kidding, hehe.\nI have it here in my bag!
Array.indonesia: Cuma bercanda, hehe.\nKuncinya ada di tasku!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_8_Complete_004
Array.english: Phew. I thought you would ask me to take you again...
Array.indonesia: Fiuh. Kupikir kamu akan memintaku mengantarmu lagi...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_8_Complete_005
Array.english: <size=34>Let’s insert the key...\nAnd get back to the village!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ayo masukkan kuncinya...\nDan kembali ke desa!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=44>Wow... So this is...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=44>Wah... Jadi ini...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_Complete_002
Array.english: Haha, that’s right!\nThis is the <color=#F1DC2B>Sea People Village</color> we live in!
Array.indonesia: Haha, betul!\nIni adalah <color=#F1DC2B>Desa Suku Laut</color> tempat kita tinggal!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_Complete_003
Array.english: To think there would be a place like this under the sea...
Array.indonesia: Siapa sangka ada tempat seperti ini di bawah laut...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_NawangAwang_001
Array.english: <size=40>Wait!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Tunggu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_NawangAwang_002
Array.english: How... how did a human get in here?
Array.indonesia: Bagaimana... bagaimana bisa ada manusia di sini?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_NawangAwang_003
Array.english: Huh? Ramo and Suwam?\nWere you kidnapped by this human?
Array.indonesia: Hah? Ramo dan Suwam?\nApakah kalian diculik oleh manusia ini?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_NawangAwang_004
Array.english: <color=#F1DC2B>Tenzhin</color> awaits you. \nHe’s lost sleep worrying about you.
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Tenzhin</color> sedang menunggumu. \nDia tidak bisa tidur karena mengkhawatirkan kalian.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_NawangAwang_005
Array.english: Um... It’s kind of hard to explain...
Array.indonesia: Um... Agak sulit dijelaskan...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_NawangAwang_006
Array.english: Haha! Allow me!\nI rescued Ramo after she was kidnapped by a squid...
Array.indonesia: Haha! Biar aku yang jelaskan!\nAku menyelamatkan Ramo setelah dia diculik oleh seekor cumi-cumi...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_NawangAwang_007
Array.english: Forget it. Just take me to my father.\nIt’ll be faster for me to explain things to him.
Array.indonesia: Lupakan saja. Bawa aku ke ayahku saja.\n Akan lebih cepat kalau aku yang menjelaskan semuanya kepadanya.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_01_001
Array.english: <size=45>Oh my goodness! Ramo! My daughter! <color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=45>Ya ampun! Ramo! Putriku! <color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_01_002
Array.english: <size=36>Where were you, my precious girl! Your daddy...\nYour daddy was worried out of his wits! <color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Di mana saja kamu, gadis kesayanganku! Ayahmu...\nAyahmu sangat khawatir! <color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_01_003
Array.english: <size=34>Are you hurt?\nDid the humans do something to you, my daughter?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Apakah kamu terluka?\nApakah manusia-manusia itu melakukan sesuatu padamu, putriku?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_01_004
Array.english: <size=45>Wait! Who is this next to you?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=45>Tunggu! Siapa orang di sampingmu ini?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_01_005
Array.english: <size=38>I thought you’d brought a blue manatee,\nbut this is a human!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Aku kira kamu membawa seekor manatee biru,\ntapi ini manusia!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_01_006
Array.english: <size=50>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_02_001
Array.english: What is going on here?\nI’d like an explanation.
Array.indonesia: Apa yang sedang terjadi di sini?\nAku ingin penjelasan.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_02_002
Array.english: You know that strange things have been happening\naround here recently, right?
Array.indonesia: Kamu tahu kan bahwa hal-hal aneh telah terjadi\ndi sekitar sini belakangan ini?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_02_003
Array.english: For example, the tremors...\nand the ice melting off the Divine Tree.
Array.indonesia: Misalnya, getaran-getaran...\ndan es yang mencair dari Pohon Suci.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_02_004
Array.english: Of course, Ramo.\nI’ve been looking into the causes.
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja, Ramo.\nAku sudah menyelidiki penyebabnya.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_02_005
Array.english: It’s already been two years!\nYou know our technology has its limits.
Array.indonesia: Sudah dua tahun berlalu!\nKamu tahu teknologi kita punya batasannya.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_02_006
Array.english: We-well, the ancient texts have all been lost\nand we need to figure out new methods again...
Array.indonesia: Kami—yah, semua teks kuno sudah hilang\ndan kita harus mencari metode baru lagi...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_02_007
Array.english: We can’t simply keep waiting, Father.
Array.indonesia: Kita tidak bisa terus-menerus menunggu, Ayah.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_02_008
Array.english: Humans are selfish, but they have good technology.\nWe need their help.
Array.indonesia: Manusia memang egois, tapi mereka memiliki teknologi yang canggih.\nKita membutuhkan bantuan mereka.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_02_009
Array.english: <size=40>No, not the humans!\nThey can’t be trusted!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Tidak, bukan manusia!\nMereka tidak bisa dipercaya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_02_010
Array.english: They dirtied our home and even hunted our kind to put on display...
Array.indonesia: Mereka mengotori rumah kita dan bahkan memburu jenis kita untuk dipamerkan...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_02_011
Array.english: They’re wicked creatures looking to hunt us\nand steal from us. We can’t ally with the likes of—
Array.indonesia: Mereka adalah makhluk jahat yang ingin memburu kita\ndan mencuri dari kita. Kita tidak bisa bersekutu dengan orang-orang seperti—

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_03_001
Array.english: <size=40>Another huge tremor!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Gempa besar lagi!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_03_002
Array.english: <size=33>See?\nSomething really bad will happen if we don’t do anything.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Lihat?\nSesuatu yang sangat buruk akan terjadi jika kita tidak berbuat apa-apa.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_03_003
Array.english: <size=36>Um... Hmm…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Um... Hmm…</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_03_004
Array.english: When I was taken by the Giant Squid in human waters,\n<color=#F1DC2B>Dave</color> here helped me out.
Array.indonesia: Saat aku diculik oleh Gurita Raksasa di perairan manusia,\n<color=#F1DC2B>Dave</color> di sini menolongku.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_03_005
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(Suwam said he was the one who did that earlier...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Suwam bilang dia yang melakukannya tadi...)</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_03_006
Array.english: Try asking him.\nNot all humans can be bad, can they?
Array.indonesia: Coba tanya dia.\nTidak mungkin semua manusia itu jahat, kan?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_03_007
Array.english: I mean... well...
Array.indonesia: Maksudku... yah...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_03_008
Array.english: Even... even if I wanted this,\nthe villagers would not agree.
Array.indonesia: Bahkan... bahkan jika aku menginginkannya,\npenduduk desa tidak akan setuju.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_03_009
Array.english: Help from humans?\nNo one would believe it.
Array.indonesia: Bantuan dari manusia?\nTidak ada yang akan mempercayainya.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_03_010
Array.english: <size=32>If this man can gain the <color=#1DFEAF>village’s trust</color>,\nI’ll consider your suggestion!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Jika pria ini bisa mendapatkan <color=#1DFEAF>kepercayaan desa</color>,\naku akan mempertimbangkan saranmu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_03_011
Array.english: Hmm... The <color=#1DFEAF>village’s trust</color>...\nHow does he go about winning that?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... <color=#1DFEAF>Kepercayaan desa</color>...\nBagaimana caranya dia bisa mendapatkannya?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_03_012
Array.english: How about asking around\nto see what they need?
Array.indonesia: Bagaimana kalau bertanya-tanya\nuntuk mengetahui apa yang mereka butuhkan?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_03_013
Array.english: Alright. \nSince today’s long trip must have been pretty tiring...
Array.indonesia: Baiklah. \nKarena perjalanan jauh hari ini pasti cukup melelahkan...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_03_014
Array.english: Human! Come back here tomorrow!\nYou’ll have to listen to the villager’s requests!
Array.indonesia: Manusia! Kembalilah ke sini besok!\nKamu harus mendengarkan permintaan penduduk desa!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_03_015
Array.english: Wait, I didn’t even agree yet...\nHow am I supposed to come all the way here?
Array.indonesia: Tunggu, aku bahkan belum setuju...\nBagaimana aku bisa datang jauh-jauh ke sini?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_tenzhin_give_mirror_001
Array.english: Hmm. Since you say you helped my daughter, Ramo...
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Karena kamu bilang telah membantu putriku, Ramo...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_tenzhin_give_mirror_002
Array.english: I suppose it wouldn’t be fitting for my people\nto ignore your needs, even if you’re a human.
Array.indonesia: Kurasa tidak pantas bagi rakyatku\nuntuk mengabaikan kebutuhanmu, meskipun kamu seorang manusia.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_tenzhin_give_mirror_003
Array.english: <size=38>Use this.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Gunakan ini.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_tenzhin_give_mirror_004
Array.english: What is this? It looks like an ordinary mirror.
Array.indonesia: Apa ini? Kelihatannya seperti cermin biasa.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_tenzhin_give_mirror_005
Array.english: This <color=#1DFEAF>Sea People Mirror</color>, once installed,\nwill let you instantly travel to this village.
Array.indonesia: <color=#1DFEAF>Cermin Suku Laut</color> ini, setelah dipasang,\nakan membawamu langsung ke desa ini.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_tenzhin_give_mirror_006
Array.english: <size=39>Wow! Is such a thing possible?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=39>Wah! Mungkinkah hal seperti itu?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_tenzhin_give_mirror_007
Array.english: Various disasters have caused our decline,\nbut our ancestors were a very advanced civilization once.
Array.indonesia: Berbagai bencana telah menyebabkan kemunduran kami,\ntetapi nenek moyang kami dulunya adalah peradaban yang sangat maju.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_tenzhin_give_mirror_008
Array.english: Right now all we have left is a few of their relics...\nSadly.
Array.indonesia: Saat ini yang tersisa hanyalah beberapa peninggalan mereka...\nSayangnya.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_tenzhin_give_mirror_009
Array.english: In any case, installing this in your village\nwill allow you to come to this village whenever you need.
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun juga, memasang benda ini di desa Anda\nakan memungkinkan Anda datang ke desa ini kapan pun Anda membutuhkannya.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_tenzhin_give_mirror_010
Array.english: <size=32>It will recognize your face,\nso only you’ll be able to use it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Benda ini akan mengenali wajah Anda,\njadi hanya Anda yang bisa menggunakannya.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_tenzhin_give_mirror_011
Array.english: It also operates from the light of the Divine Tree or the sun,\nso you can only use it <color=#F39321>during the day</color>.
Array.indonesia: Perangkat ini juga beroperasi menggunakan cahaya Pohon Ilahi atau matahari,\njadi kamu hanya bisa menggunakannya <color=#F39321>pada siang hari</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_tenzhin_give_mirror_011_2
Array.english: Oh, and... I’ll give you a <color=#1DFEAF>Village Map</color> to use.\nIt’ll help you find the villagers.
Array.indonesia: Oh, dan... Aku akan memberimu <color=#1DFEAF>Peta Desa</color> untuk digunakan.\nPeta ini akan membantumu menemukan para penduduk desa.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_tenzhin_give_mirror_012
Array.english: Hmm. A teleportation device...\nThat’s pretty amazing.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Alat teleportasi...\nItu sungguh menakjubkan.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_tenzhin_give_mirror_013
Array.english: <size=34>I’ll have to go back to the boat with this mirror for now.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Untuk saat ini, aku harus kembali ke perahu dengan cermin ini.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_tenzhin_receive_mirror_001
Array.english: I guess I’ll install this <color=#1DFEAF>Sea People Mirror</color> on the boat.
Array.indonesia: Kurasa aku akan memasang <color=#1DFEAF>Cermin Suku Laut</color> ini di perahu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_tenzhin_receive_mirror_002
Array.english: He said I could go to the <color=#F1DC2B>Sea People Village</color> with this during the day right?\nI should go tomorrow.
Array.indonesia: Dia bilang aku bisa pergi ke <color=#F1DC2B>Desa Orang Laut</color> dengan ini pada siang hari, kan?\nAku sebaiknya pergi besok.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_tenzhin_receive_mirror_003
Array.english: Oh no... Look at the time!\nBancho Sushi must have opened already.
Array.indonesia: Oh tidak... Lihat jamnya!\nBancho Sushi pasti sudah buka.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_tenzhin_receive_mirror_004
Array.english: I should drop by and check if anything of note happened.
Array.indonesia: Aku sebaiknya mampir dan mengecek apakah ada hal penting yang terjadi.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Lobby_001
Array.english: Oh! Dave!\nYou weren’t around yesterday, so I was a bit worried!
Array.indonesia: Oh! Dave!\nKamu nggak ada kemarin, jadi aku agak khawatir!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Lobby_002
Array.english: I couldn’t get in touch with you via radio, either...
Array.indonesia: Aku juga nggak bisa menghubungimu lewat radio...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Lobby_003
Array.english: I was... at the Sea People Village yesterday...
Array.indonesia: Aku... ada di Sea People Village kemarin...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Lobby_004
Array.english: <size=45>You... you what?\nWhat happened?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=45>Kamu... kamu apa?\nApa yang terjadi?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Lobby_005
Array.english: Well, you see...
Array.indonesia: Nah, begini...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Lobby_AfterFade_001
Array.english: I see... I envy you, I do!\nWhat a lucky experience...
Array.indonesia: Aku mengerti... Aku iri padamu, sungguh!\nPengalaman yang sangat beruntung...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Lobby_AfterFade_002
Array.english: I’m not sure how I can help,\nbut it’s clear they have problems to deal with.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak yakin bagaimana aku bisa membantu,\ntapi jelas mereka punya masalah yang harus dihadapi.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Lobby_AfterFade_003
Array.english: Why don’t you go talk with the residents first?\nI’d love to go as well, but...
Array.indonesia: Kenapa kamu tidak pergi bicara dengan para penghuni dulu?\nAku juga ingin ikut, tapi...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Lobby_AfterFade_004
Array.english: As you said, only one person can use the <color=#1DFEAF>Sea People Mirror</color>.\nWhat a pity!
Array.indonesia: Seperti yang kamu katakan, hanya satu orang yang bisa menggunakan <color=#1DFEAF>Cermin Suku Laut</color>.\nSayang sekali!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Lobby_AfterFade_005
Array.english: Hahaha! What an unexpected\nturn of events!
Array.indonesia: Hahaha! Sungguh sebuah\nkejadian yang tak terduga!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Lobby_AfterFade_006
Array.english: If you need any of my tools, don't forget to\ncheck out the <color=#F1DC2B>Cobra Shop</color>!!
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu butuh alat-alatku, jangan lupa\nmampir ke <color=#F1DC2B>Toko Cobra</color>!!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Lobby_AfterFade_007
Array.english: Yes. I’ll have to use the <color=#1DFEAF>Sea People Mirror</color> first\nto visit their village.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Aku harus pakai <color=#1DFEAF>Cermin Suku Laut</color> dulu\nuntuk mengunjungi desa mereka.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_001
Array.english: It seems the villagers seem to trust you quite a lot.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya penduduk desa itu cukup percaya padamu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_002
Array.english: I’d first like to thank you for everything you’ve done\nfor our village.
Array.indonesia: Pertama-tama, aku ingin mengucapkan terima kasih atas semua yang telah kamu lakukan\nuntuk desa kami.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_003
Array.english: It seems everyone’s friendlier than I thought.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya semua orang lebih ramah daripada yang kubayangkan.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_004
Array.english: I don’t trust you fully just yet, but...\nWe could use all the help we could get right now...
Array.indonesia: Aku belum sepenuhnya mempercayaimu, tapi...\nKami sangat membutuhkan semua bantuan yang bisa kami dapatkan saat ini...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_005
Array.english: Let me tell you a little about this village.
Array.indonesia: Izinkan saya menceritakan sedikit tentang desa ini.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_006
Array.english: <size=36>Did you see the <color=#F1DC2B>tree</color> at the center of the village?</color></size>
