Array.indonesia: <size=36>Apakah Anda melihat <color=#F1DC2B>pohon</color> di tengah desa?</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_007
Array.english: Yes... It was huge and covered in ice...
Array.indonesia: Ya... Pohon itu sangat besar dan tertutup es...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_008
Array.english: Yes. We call it the <color=#F1DC2B>Divine Tree</color>.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Kami menyebutnya <color=#F1DC2B>Pohon Suci</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_009
Array.english: We use the fruit of this tree as an energy source.
Array.indonesia: Kami menggunakan buah dari pohon ini sebagai sumber energi.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_010
Array.english: The tree's roots are far below,\nusing geothermal heat to create energy…
Array.indonesia: Akar pohon itu berada jauh di bawah tanah,\nmenggunakan panas bumi untuk menghasilkan energi…

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_011
Array.english: Because the fruits are created from this energy,\nthere is a giant glacier under this tree—that is, under our village.
Array.indonesia: Karena buah-buahnya terbentuk dari energi ini,\nada gletser raksasa di bawah pohon ini—yaitu, di bawah desa kami.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_012
Array.english: A glacier on the sea bottom…\nI’ve never heard of such a thing...
Array.indonesia: Gletser di dasar laut…\nAku belum pernah mendengar hal seperti itu...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_013
Array.english: But as of late... The heat coming from deep in the earth has grown hotter, melting the ice slowly...
Array.indonesia: Namun belakangan ini... Panas yang berasal dari dalam bumi semakin meningkat, mencairkan es secara perlahan...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_014
Array.english: As the temperature of the tree increases,\nmore and more villagers are falling ill.
Array.indonesia: Seiring meningkatnya suhu pohon tersebut,\nsemakin banyak penduduk desa yang jatuh sakit.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_015
Array.english: We keep praying to King Long, but...\nBut we know things aren’t so simple as that.
Array.indonesia: Kami terus berdoa kepada Raja Long, tapi...\nTapi kami tahu masalahnya tidak sesederhana itu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_016
Array.english: We need to check on the glacier below the surface...
Array.indonesia: Kami perlu memeriksa gletser di bawah permukaan...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_017
Array.english: Because we’ve relied on only agriculture for so long,\nwe don’t have the equipment or the technology to explore down there, embarrassing as it is.
Array.indonesia: Karena kami telah bergantung pada pertanian saja selama ini,\nkami tidak memiliki peralatan atau teknologi untuk menjelajahi ke sana, meskipun hal ini memalukan.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_018
Array.english: That’s why I told you we need the humans’ help.
Array.indonesia: Itulah mengapa aku bilang pada kamu bahwa kami membutuhkan bantuan manusia.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_019
Array.english: I must admit that is now our only option, my daughter...
Array.indonesia: Aku harus mengakui bahwa itu sekarang satu-satunya pilihan kami, putriku...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_020
Array.english: In any case, I know it’s a difficult task,\nbut will you check out the glacial area below the village for us?
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun juga, aku tahu ini tugas yang sulit,\ntapi maukah kamu memeriksa area gletser di bawah desa untuk kami?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_021
Array.english: *Sigh* That sounds very dangerous...\nBut alright.
Array.indonesia: *Huff* Kedengarannya sangat berbahaya...\nTapi baiklah.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_022
Array.english: There have been more tremors on the surface as well.\nI think all this might be connected somehow.
Array.indonesia: Getaran di permukaan juga semakin sering terjadi.\nAku rasa semua ini mungkin saling terkait.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_023
Array.english: <size=36>Thank you! \nWe’ll be sure to recompense you somehow!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Terima kasih! \nKami pasti akan membalas budimu dengan cara apa pun!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_024
Array.english: Now then, you’ll need the key down to the Glacial Passage...\nThe key...
Array.indonesia: Nah, kalian akan membutuhkan kunci untuk turun ke Jalur Gletser...\nKuncinya...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_025
Array.english: <size=50>Where is the key?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>Di mana kuncinya?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_026
Array.english: Tenzhin... When we sealed the Glacial Passsage,\nwe put the key inside the <color=#F1DC2B>Abandoned Cave</color>, remember?
Array.indonesia: Tenzhin... Saat kita menyegel Jalur Gletser,\nkita meletakkan kuncinya di dalam <color=#F1DC2B>Gua Terlantar</color>, ingat?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_027
Array.english: <size=48>Oh dear! You’re right!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=48>Astaga! Kamu benar!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_028
Array.english: I sense something is not right again...
Array.indonesia: Aku merasakan ada yang tidak beres lagi...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_029
Array.english: <size=38>Human! Please go and get the <color=#1DFEAF>key</color> to the Glacial Passage from the Abandoned Cave!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Manusia! Tolong pergi dan ambil <color=#1DFEAF>kunci</color> ke Glacial Passage dari Gua Terlantar!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_030
Array.english: Suwam will take you there.
Array.indonesia: Suwam akan mengantarmu ke sana.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_031
Array.english: It’s not dangerous, is it?
Array.indonesia: Nggak berbahaya, kan?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_032
Array.english: <size=38>Nothing has happened there for the last century!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Sudah satu abad nggak ada yang terjadi di sana!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_033
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>...No one’s ventured in there for 100 years.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>...Noada yang berani masuk ke sana selama 100 tahun.</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_034
Array.english: Anyways... We need to find out what’s going on\nin the <color=#F1DC2B>Glacial Area</color> before it’s too late.
Array.indonesia: Pokoknya... Kita harus mencari tahu apa yang sedang terjadi\ndi <color=#F1DC2B>Daerah Gletser</color> sebelum terlambat.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_035
Array.english: It’s getting late, so come back tomorrow when the sun is up.
Array.indonesia: Sudah mulai malam, jadi kembalilah besok saat matahari terbit.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_036
Array.english: <size=36><color=#F1DC2B>Suwam</color> will guide you on this path.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36><color=#F1DC2B>Suwam</color> akan memandumu di jalan ini.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_EA_Complete_029
Array.english: <size=32>Hm! Human!\nYou need to go get the key now!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hm! Manusia!\nKamu harus segera mengambil kuncinya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_EA_Complete_030
Array.english: <size=36>For now, \nwe're gonna wait until <color=#F1DC2B>Official Launch</color> for this part.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Untuk saat ini, \nkita akan menunggu hingga <color=#F1DC2B>Peluncuran Resmi</color> untuk bagian ini.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_EA_Complete_031
Array.english: <size=38><color=#F1DC2B>Official Launch?</color> Huh?\nWhat's that mean?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38><color=#F1DC2B>Peluncuran Resmi?</color> Hah?\nApa maksudnya?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_EA_Complete_032
Array.english: <size=32>Um. Kinda hard to explain here!!\nHumans use this thing called <color=#9E7BFF>Discord.</color> Try asking there!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Um. Agak sulit dijelaskan di sini!!\nManusia menggunakan sesuatu yang disebut <color=#9E7BFF>Discord.</color> Coba tanyakan di sana!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_EA_Complete_033
Array.english: I have no idea what you are talking about….\nThis <color=#9E7BFF>Discord</color> thing….
Array.indonesia: Aku nggak ngerti apa yang kamu bicarakan….\nHal <color=#9E7BFF>Discord</color> ini….

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_EA_Complete_034
Array.english: Anyway... \nFirst work on helping the land and the village.
Array.indonesia: Pokoknya... \nPertama-tama, bantu tanah dan desa ini.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_EA_Complete_035
Array.english: <size=35>Don't forget to tell <color=#1DFEAF>them</color> if you have any problems!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Jangan lupa beri tahu <color=#1DFEAF>mereka</color> kalau kamu punya masalah!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_EA_Complete_036
Array.english: <size=36>Huh? Who are <color=#1DFEAF>They</color>?…?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Hah? Siapa sih <color=#1DFEAF>mereka</color> itu…?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete02_001
Array.english: Phew. I was so busy with Sea People Village\nwork that it’s already opening time.
Array.indonesia: Wah. Aku begitu sibuk dengan pekerjaan di Desa Orang Laut\nsampai-sampai sudah waktunya buka.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete02_002
Array.english: I’m tired...\nBut I should be there.
Array.indonesia: Aku lelah...\nTapi aku harus ke sana.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete02_003
Array.english: <size=38>Let’s cheer up and raise our profits!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Ayo bersemangat dan tingkatkan keuntungan kita!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Start_001
Array.english: By the way...
Array.indonesia: Ngomong-ngomong...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Start_002
Array.english: Tenzhin asked me to bring him the <color=#F1DC2B>Glacial Passage Key</color>.
Array.indonesia: Tenzhin memintaku untuk membawakannya <color=#F1DC2B>Kunci Jalur Gletser</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Start_003
Array.english: <size=34>I must return to the elder’s place in the Sea People Village.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku harus kembali ke tempat tetua di Desa Suku Laut.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_TenzhinroomTalk_001
Array.english: <size=35>Oh, you have returned, human.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh, kau sudah kembali, manusia.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_TenzhinroomTalk_002
Array.english: The Abandoned Cave is an old, abandoned Sea People’s storage.
Array.indonesia: Gua Terlantar adalah gudang tua milik Suku Laut yang sudah ditinggalkan.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_TenzhinroomTalk_003
Array.english: The <color=#F1DC2B>Glacial Passage Key</color> is in that place.
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Kunci Jalur Es</color> ada di tempat itu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_TenzhinroomTalk_004
Array.english: Suwam will guide you.\nGodspeed.
Array.indonesia: Suwam akan memandumu.\nSemoga perjalananmu lancar.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_TenzhinroomTalk_005
Array.english: <size=36>Oh! I thought you fled, human.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Oh! Aku kira kamu sudah melarikan diri, manusia.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_TenzhinroomTalk_006
Array.english: Suwam, the best warrior of the Sea People, \nwill guide you to the place. Follow me.
Array.indonesia: Suwam, prajurit terbaik Suku Laut, \nakan memandumu ke tempat itu. Ikuti aku.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Goto_WareHouse_01
Array.english: <size=35>Here, human.\nGo bring me the <color=#F1DC2B>Glacial Passage Key</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ini, manusia.\nPergilah dan bawakan aku <color=#F1DC2B>Kunci Jalur Gletser</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Goto_WareHouse_02
Array.english: So dreary and dark.\nWhy is this place locked anyway?
Array.indonesia: Begitu suram dan gelap.\nLagi pula, kenapa tempat ini dikunci?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Goto_WareHouse_03
Array.english: Hm, I am not sure.\nI heard stories about some crazy Sea People locked up somewhere, though.
Array.indonesia: Hm, aku tidak yakin.\nTapi aku pernah mendengar cerita tentang beberapa Suku Laut gila yang dikurung di suatu tempat.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Goto_WareHouse_04
Array.english: I heard the insane ones attacked other Sea People.
Array.indonesia: Katanya, orang-orang gila itu menyerang Suku Laut lainnya.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Goto_WareHouse_05
Array.english: But that was like a thousand years ago.\nSea People only live about 300 years, so don’t worry.
Array.indonesia: Tapi itu sudah terjadi sekitar seribu tahun yang lalu.\nOrang Laut hanya hidup sekitar 300 tahun, jadi jangan khawatir.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Goto_WareHouse_06
Array.english: Hm, I am nervous.\nAre you coming with me?
Array.indonesia: Hm, aku gugup.\nKamu mau ikut denganku?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Goto_WareHouse_07
Array.english: I am the best warrior of my people.\nYou want me to do such a mundane task?
Array.indonesia: Aku adalah prajurit terbaik di antara bangsaku.\nKamu mau aku melakukan tugas sepele seperti itu?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Goto_WareHouse_08
Array.english: I will stay here and protect the area.\nHurry up and bring me the key.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan tinggal di sini dan menjaga daerah ini.\nCepatlah dan bawakan kuncinya padaku.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Goto_WareHouse_09
Array.english: I knew you wouldn't go in.
Array.indonesia: Aku tahu kamu tidak akan masuk.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Goto_WareHouse_10
Array.english: It’s hidden in one of the deepest areas.\nLook for a room with a <color=#1DFEAF>mural</color>.
Array.indonesia: Kuncinya tersembunyi di salah satu area terdalam.\nCarilah sebuah ruangan dengan <color=#1DFEAF>lukisan dinding</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Goto_WareHouse_11
Array.english: <size=35>Let me know when you are ready, human.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Beri tahu aku kalau kamu sudah siap, manusia.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Goto_Office_01
Array.english: <size=36>Ow, it’s cold.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Aduh, dingin sekali.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Goto_Office_02
Array.english: The key should be deeper inside.\nA room with a <color=#1DFEAF>mural</color>, if I remember correctly.
Array.indonesia: Kuncinya seharusnya ada lebih dalam lagi.\nSebuah ruangan dengan <color=#1DFEAF>lukisan dinding</color>, kalau aku tidak salah ingat.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Gardon_InCage01
Array.english: What a cute sea bream.\nIt must have come through that small crack.
Array.indonesia: Ikan kerapu yang lucu sekali.\nPasti masuk lewat celah kecil itu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Gardon_InCage02_001
Array.english: <size=40>Holy cow! What is that?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Astaga! Apa itu?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Gardon_InCage02_002
Array.english: The ancient Sea People Suwam talked about?
Array.indonesia: Bangsa Laut kuno yang dibicarakan Suwam?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Gardon_InCage02_003
Array.english: They are still alive?
Array.indonesia: Mereka masih hidup?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Gardon_InCage02_004
Array.english: It’s fortunate that they are still locked in the cells.\nI should not draw their attention.
Array.indonesia: Untungnya mereka masih terkunci di sel.\nAku sebaiknya tidak menarik perhatian mereka.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Find_Key_01
Array.english: This must be the mural room\nSuwam was talking about.
Array.indonesia: Ini pasti ruang mural\nyang dibicarakan Suwam.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Find_Key_02
Array.english: But... Where is the <color=#F1DC2B>key</color>?
Array.indonesia: Tapi... Di mana <color=#F1DC2B>kunci</color>-nya?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Find_Key_03
Array.english: This <color=#1DFEAF>picture</color> seems to imply something...
Array.indonesia: <color=#1DFEAF>Gambar</color> ini sepertinya menyiratkan sesuatu...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Find_Key2_00
Array.english: <size=40>Oh! The device!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Oh! Alat itu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Find_Key2_01
Array.english: <size=36>That must be the <color=#F1DC2B>Glacial Passage Key</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Itu pasti <color=#F1DC2B>Kunci Jalur Gletser</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Find_Key2_02
Array.english: What a creepy place...\nI’d better pick up the key and quickly leave.
Array.indonesia: Tempat yang menyeramkan...\nSebaiknya aku mengambil kuncinya dan segera pergi.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Barricade_01
Array.english: I should bring the  <color=#F1DC2B>Glacial Passage Key</color> to Tenzhin!
Array.indonesia: Aku harus membawa <color=#F1DC2B>Kunci Jalur Gletser</color> ke Tenzhin!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Return_Tenzhin_01
Array.english: At last, playing that \nartifact-hunting adventure game pays off!
Array.indonesia: Akhirnya, bermain game petualangan berburu \nartefak itu membuahkan hasil!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Return_Tenzhin_02
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>The movie was not that great though.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Tapi filmnya nggak terlalu bagus sih.</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Return_Tenzhin_03
Array.english: I should probably head back to the Sea People village now.
Array.indonesia: Mungkin aku harus kembali ke desa Suku Laut sekarang.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_After_Earthquake01_001
Array.english: <size=48>Oh no... Another earthquake?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=48>Oh tidak... Gempa lagi?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_After_Earthquake01_002
Array.english: I heard something crumbling.\nUh oh.
Array.indonesia: Aku mendengar sesuatu runtuh.\nUh oh.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_After_Earthquake02_001
Array.english: <size=36>No! the exit is blocked.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Tidak! Pintu keluarnya terhalang.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_After_Earthquake02_002
Array.english: <size=34>And... now the\nsea monsters have come out.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Dan... sekarang\nmonster laut sudah muncul.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_After_Earthquake02_003
Array.english: I must avoid them without getting caught.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus menghindarinya tanpa ketahuan.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_LeaveCave01
Array.english: Hm, I don’t think I can pass here.
Array.indonesia: Hm, kurasa aku tidak bisa lewat di sini.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_LeaveCave02
Array.english: What if I hide behind the <color=#F1DC2B>stone statue</color> over there? \nI will go unnoticed.
Array.indonesia: Bagaimana kalau aku bersembunyi di balik <color=#F1DC2B>patung batu</color> di sana? \nAku tidak akan ketahuan.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_CaveOut_001
Array.english: Bah, I knew Suwam was not going to wait for me.
Array.indonesia: Ah, aku tahu Suwam tidak akan menungguku.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_CaveOut_002
Array.english: Anyway, I got the key.\nNow I must return to-
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun, aku sudah mendapatkan kuncinya.\nSekarang aku harus kembali ke-

Array.name: dialog_JohnWatson2_boss_enter01_001
Array.english: <size=43>Wait!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=43>Tunggu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_JohnWatson2_boss_enter01_002
Array.english: <size=38>You’re robbing graves now? As if destroying the environment was not enough...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Kamu sekarang mencuri dari kuburan? Seolah-olah merusak lingkungan saja belum cukup...</size>

Array.name: dialog_JohnWatson2_boss_enter01_003
Array.english: Huh? That is the Sea People’s...
Array.indonesia: Hah? Itu milik Suku Laut...

Array.name: dialog_JohnWatson2_boss_enter01_004
Array.english: <size=44>Be quiet!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=44>Diam!</size>

Array.name: dialog_JohnWatson2_boss_enter01_005
Array.english: Whoever harms the great sea will have to\ncontend with <color=#90CDFF>Sea Blue</color>...
Array.indonesia: Siapa pun yang merusak laut yang agung akan harus\nberhadapan dengan <color=#90CDFF>Sea Blue</color>...

Array.name: dialog_JohnWatson2_boss_enter01_006
Array.english: <size=38>And the wrath of I, <color=#F1DC2B>John Watson</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Dan murka dariku, <color=#F1DC2B>John Watson</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_JohnWatson2_boss_enter01_007
Array.english: <size=38>Feel my eco-friendly Sea Blue Armor RX-93\nand its power!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Rasakan Sea Blue Armor RX-93 ramah lingkunganku\ndan kekuatannya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_JohnWatson2_boss_enter02_001
Array.english: <size=38>You are an environmental disaster!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Kau adalah bencana lingkungan!</size>

Array.name: dialog_JohnWatson2_boss_enter02_002
Array.english: <size=40>You're gonna pay now!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Kau akan membayarnya sekarang!</size>

Array.name: dialog_JohnWatson2_boss_start_001
Array.english: No amount of words can save that thick-skulled moron.
Array.indonesia: Tak ada kata-kata yang bisa menyelamatkan si bodoh berkepala batu itu.

Array.name: dialog_JohnWatson2_boss_start_002
Array.english: That suit looks very tough.\nNo bullets will penetrate it.
Array.indonesia: Baju besi itu terlihat sangat tangguh.\nTak ada peluru yang bisa menembusnya.

Array.name: dialog_JohnWatson2_boss_missile_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh?\nThe missiles are slowing down?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh?\nRudal-rudal itu melambat?</size>

Array.name: dialog_JohnWatson2_boss_missile_002
Array.english: If only I could direct it at him...
Array.indonesia: Andai saja aku bisa mengarahkannya ke dia...

Array.name: dialog_JohnWatson2_boss_missile_003
Array.english: Is there anything that can <color=#F1DC2B>deflect the missiles</color>?
Array.indonesia: Adakah sesuatu yang bisa <color=#F1DC2B>menangkis rudal-rudal itu</color>?

Array.name: dialog_JohnWatson2_boss_missile_hit_001
Array.english: <size=40>Ack!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Aduh!</size>

Array.name: dialog_JohnWatson2_boss_missile_hit_002
Array.english: Even my armor can’t negate\nthe firepower of my Hyper Blaster.
Array.indonesia: Bahkan baju zirahku tak bisa menangkis\ndaya tembak Hyper Blaster-ku.

Array.name: dialog_JohnWatson2_boss_missile_hit_003
Array.english: <size=37>That was a nice trick,\nbut this will end now!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Itu trik yang bagus,\ntapi ini akan berakhir sekarang!</size>

Array.name: dialog_JohnWatson2_boss_die_001
Array.english: <size=40>Grrr!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Grrr!</size>

Array.name: dialog_JohnWatson2_boss_die_002
Array.english: <size=36>My eco-friendly Sea Blue Armor RX-93 is...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Armor ramah lingkungan Sea Blue RX-93-ku...!</size>

Array.name: dialog_JohnWatson2_boss_die_003
Array.english: <size=35>I can’t forgive you destroying\nnature! *mumbles*</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Aku tidak bisa memaafkanmu karena telah menghancurkan\nalam! *bergumam*</size>

Array.name: dialog_JohnWatson2_boss_die_004
Array.english: <size=40>*Mumbles* watching you *mumbles*!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>*Bergumam* melihatmu *bergumam*!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Return_Tenzhin2_001
Array.english: You are tenacious.
Array.indonesia: Kamu memang gigih.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Return_Tenzhin2_002
Array.english: He was wearing high-tech diving gear.
Array.indonesia: Dia memakai perlengkapan selam berteknologi tinggi.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Return_Tenzhin2_003
Array.english: Should I bring it to Cobra?\nHe may find <color=#F1DC2B>useful parts</color> out of this.
Array.indonesia: Haruskah aku membawanya ke Cobra?\nDia mungkin bisa menemukan <color=#F1DC2B>bagian-bagian yang berguna</color> dari ini.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_PickUp_TechSuit_001
Array.english: I see a bunch of complex mechanical parts.\nI should pick up some samples.
Array.indonesia: Aku melihat banyak bagian mekanis yang rumit.\nAku harus mengambil beberapa sampel.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_PickUp_TechSuit_002
Array.english: <size=33>It’s time to deliver the <color=#F1DC2B>Glacial Passage Key</color> to Tenzhin.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Sudah waktunya menyerahkan <color=#F1DC2B>Kunci Jalur Gletser</color> kepada Tenzhin.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_01_001
Array.english: <size=35>Oh, you actually brought me the <color=#F1DC2B>Glacial Passage Key</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh, kamu benar-benar membawakan aku <color=#F1DC2B>Kunci Jalur Gletser</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_01_002
Array.english: Suwam told me that he cleared the area \nand the key is free to be picked up. But I guess it took you some time?
Array.indonesia: Suwam memberitahuku bahwa dia sudah membersihkan area itu \ndan kuncinya bisa diambil. Tapi sepertinya kamu butuh waktu cukup lama, ya?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_01_003
Array.english: Um...\nI almost got eaten by nasty sea monsters!
Array.indonesia: Um...\nAku hampir dimakan oleh monster laut yang mengerikan!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_01_004
Array.english: <size=40>Are you telling me you’ve seen <color=#1DFEAF>Gadons</color>? \nAre they still alive?</color>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Maksudmu kamu sudah melihat <color=#1DFEAF>Gadons</color>? \nApakah mereka masih hidup?</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_01_005
Array.english: <size=35><color=#1DFEAF>Gadons</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35><color=#1DFEAF>Gadons</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_01_006
Array.english: Hmph. This is the dark history of the Sea People.
Array.indonesia: Hmph. Ini adalah sejarah kelam Suku Laut.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_01_007
Array.english: <size=36>You want to hear it?\nI have a <color=#F1DC2B>short version</color> and a <color=#F1DC2B>long version</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Kamu mau mendengarnya?\nAku punya <color=#F1DC2B>versi singkat</color> dan <color=#F1DC2B>versi panjang</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_01_008
Array.english: <size=36>Which one would you like to hear?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Mana yang ingin kamu dengar?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_select01_001
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(Hm, which version should I pick?)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Hm, versi mana yang harus aku pilih?)</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_01_option1
Array.english: The short one.
Array.indonesia: Yang singkat.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_01_option2
Array.english: The long one.
Array.indonesia: Yang panjang.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_01_option1_linked_001
Array.english: <size=36>The Gadons are the corrupt Sea People of \nancient times.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Suku Gadon adalah Suku Laut yang korup dari \nzaman kuno.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_01_option1_linked_002
Array.english: <size=50>…….</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>…….</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_01_option1_linked_003
Array.english: <size=34>That’s it?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hanya itu?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_01_option1_linked_004
Array.english: In short, yes.
Array.indonesia: Singkatnya, ya.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_01_option1_linked_005
Array.english: You want a longer version?
Array.indonesia: Kamu mau versi yang lebih panjang?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_01_option3
Array.english: Okay.
Array.indonesia: Oke.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_01_option4
Array.english: I understand.
Array.indonesia: Aku mengerti.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_HistoryTalk_001
Array.english: Good. I am going to tell you the story of the <color=#1DFEAF>Gadons</color>.\nOkay.
Array.indonesia: Bagus. Aku akan menceritakan kisah <color=#1DFEAF>Gadons</color> kepadamu.\nOke.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_HistoryTalk_002
Array.english: About 800 years ago...\nthe Gadons were at the pinnacle of their civilization.
Array.indonesia: Sekitar 800 tahun yang lalu...\nsuku Gadons berada di puncak peradaban mereka.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_HistoryTalk_003
Array.english: Our ancestors had many devices far more technologically advanced than that of humans in the old days. \rThese advanced technologies allowed them to live in peace and prosperity.
Array.indonesia: Nenek moyang kita memiliki banyak perangkat yang secara teknologi jauh lebih canggih daripada yang dimiliki manusia pada zaman dahulu. \rTeknologi canggih ini memungkinkan mereka hidup dalam kedamaian dan kemakmuran.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_HistoryTalk_004
Array.english: It was all possible due to the <color=#F1DC2B>Divine Tree Fruits</color>.
Array.indonesia: Semua itu mungkin terjadi berkat <color=#F1DC2B>Buah Pohon Ilahi</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_HistoryTalk_005
Array.english: These fruits provided the perfect balance of temperature and energy. And they lasted so long.
Array.indonesia: Buah-buahan ini memberikan keseimbangan sempurna antara suhu dan energi. Dan buah-buahan itu bertahan sangat lama.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_HistoryTalk_006
Array.english: The fruits that could only grow in the deep sea were like a blessing to our ancestors.
Array.indonesia: Buah-buahan yang hanya dapat tumbuh di laut dalam itu bagaikan berkah bagi nenek moyang kita.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_HistoryTalk_007
Array.english: <size=36>However...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Namun...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_HistoryTalk_008
Array.english: There are always those who are blinded by greed.
Array.indonesia: Selalu ada orang-orang yang dibutakan oleh keserakahan.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_HistoryTalk_009
Array.english: <color=#F1DC2B>Dasche</color>, one of the senior technicians,\nwanted to apply the powers of the fruits beyond mundane purposes.
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Dasche</color>, salah satu teknisi senior,\ningin memanfaatkan kekuatan buah-buahan tersebut untuk tujuan di luar kebutuhan sehari-hari.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_HistoryTalk_010
Array.english: He processed the fruits secretly and\nused them to modify the anatomy of the Sea People.
Array.indonesia: Ia mengolah buah-buahan tersebut secara rahasia dan\nmenggunakannya untuk memodifikasi anatomi Suku Laut.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_HistoryTalk_011
Array.english: He modified the bodies of your ancestors?
Array.indonesia: Ia memodifikasi tubuh nenek moyangmu?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_HistoryTalk_012
Array.english: Yes, it all went well in the beginning.\nModified individuals exhibited strength far exceeding that of ordinary Sea People.
Array.indonesia: Ya, semuanya berjalan lancar pada awalnya.\nMakhluk-makhluk yang dimodifikasi itu menunjukkan kekuatan yang jauh melebihi kekuatan Orang Laut biasa.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_HistoryTalk_013
Array.english: But Dasche was not satisfied with modifying the fruits, \nand wanted to go further...\rHe wanted to extract energy directly from the Divine Tree.
Array.indonesia: Namun, Dasche tidak puas hanya dengan memodifikasi buah-buahan tersebut, \ndan ingin melangkah lebih jauh...\rDia ingin mengekstrak energi secara langsung dari Pohon Ilahi.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_HistoryTalk_014
Array.english: <size=34>To do so, he began to infuse the extracted energy into \nan ancient creature called <color=#1DFEAF>Yawie</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Untuk melakukannya, ia mulai menyuntikkan energi yang diekstraksi ke dalam \nmakhluk purba bernama <color=#1DFEAF>Yawie</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_HistoryTalk_015
Array.english: Well, I don’t understand everything but it definitely sounds dangerous. Did King Long know about this?
Array.indonesia: Yah, aku tidak mengerti semuanya, tapi kedengarannya pasti berbahaya. Apakah Raja Long tahu tentang hal ini?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_HistoryTalk_016
Array.english: At that time, King Long was busy with the task of\nbuilding the <color=#F1DC2B>Control Room</color> to ensure a steady supply of resources from the tree.
Array.indonesia: Saat itu, Raja Long sedang sibuk dengan tugas\nmembangun <color=#F1DC2B>Ruang Kontrol</color> untuk memastikan pasokan sumber daya yang stabil dari pohon tersebut.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_HistoryTalk_017
Array.english: He was puzzled at the increased performance of the workers,\nbut he had no clue what was going on.
Array.indonesia: Dia bingung melihat peningkatan kinerja para pekerja,\ntapi dia tidak tahu apa yang sedang terjadi.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_HistoryTalk_018
Array.english: <size=36>Then, one day...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Lalu, suatu hari...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_HistoryTalk_019
Array.english: The bodies of those infused with the energy of the tree began to exhibit weird changes.
Array.indonesia: Tubuh mereka yang telah disuntikkan energi pohon itu mulai menunjukkan perubahan aneh.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_HistoryTalk_020
Array.english: Their bodies turned pale and their limbs twisted...\nThey became so violent that they began to attack other Sea People.
Array.indonesia: Tubuh mereka menjadi pucat dan anggota tubuh mereka melengkung...\nMereka menjadi begitu ganas hingga mulai menyerang sesama Penduduk Laut.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_HistoryTalk_021
Array.english: So, they are the monsters I encountered earlier...
Array.indonesia: Jadi, merekalah monster-monster yang kutemui sebelumnya...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_HistoryTalk_022
Array.english: Fortunately for us, the mutated ones hate light,\nso they don’t come near the village.
Array.indonesia: Untungnya bagi kita, makhluk-makhluk yang bermutasi itu membenci cahaya,\njadi mereka tidak mendekati desa.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_HistoryTalk_023
Array.english: King Long himself went into the Control Room, captured the Gadons, and locked them up in the abandoned cave.
Array.indonesia: Raja Long sendiri masuk ke Ruang Kontrol, menangkap para Gadon, dan mengurung mereka di gua yang ditinggalkan.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_HistoryTalk_024
Array.english: In the course of suppressing them, King Long suffered fatal wounds...and later died...
Array.indonesia: Dalam proses menaklukkan mereka, Raja Long menderita luka fatal... dan kemudian meninggal...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_HistoryTalk_025
Array.english: But, it happened about 800 years ago,\nand I didn’t even know the Gadons were still alive.
Array.indonesia: Namun, kejadian itu terjadi sekitar 800 tahun yang lalu,\ndan aku bahkan tidak tahu bahwa para Gadon masih hidup.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_HistoryTalk_026
Array.english: <size=33>That means... maybe...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Itu berarti... mungkin...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_HistoryTalk_027
Array.english: <size=36>Some of them may still be roaming \nthe <color=#F1DC2B>Glacial Passage</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Beberapa di antara mereka mungkin masih berkeliaran \ndi <color=#F1DC2B>Glacial Passage</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_HistoryTalk_028
Array.english: <size=35>And you are expecting me to go there?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Dan kamu mengharapkan aku pergi ke sana?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_HistoryTalk_029
Array.english: I beg you! The Sea People have been weakened \nby our ranching lifestyle.
Array.indonesia: Aku mohon padamu! Suku Laut telah melemah \nkarena gaya hidup beternak kita.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_HistoryTalk_030
Array.english: Right now, you are the only one we know, who can help us find the cause of the earthquake and temperature rise happening in the Glacial Area.
Array.indonesia: Saat ini, kamu adalah satu-satunya yang kami kenal, yang bisa membantu kami menemukan penyebab gempa bumi dan kenaikan suhu yang terjadi di Kawasan Gletser.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_HistoryTalk_031
Array.english: <size=35>...Okay. Fine.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>...Okay. Baiklah.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_HistoryTalk_032
Array.english: <size=38>Thank you, human brother.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Terima kasih, saudara manusia.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_HistoryTalk_033
Array.english: Oh, and...\ntake this. It is my gift for you.
Array.indonesia: Oh, dan...\nambil ini. Ini hadiahku untukmu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_HistoryTalk_034
Array.english: <size=38>Here, take this <color=#1DFEAF>Sea People’s Necklace</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Ini, ambillah <color=#1DFEAF>Kalung Suku Laut</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_HistoryTalk_035
Array.english: Wear this and the Tubeworms in the deep sea will retreat.
Array.indonesia: Kenakan ini dan cacing tabung di laut dalam akan mundur.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_HistoryTalk_036
Array.english: <size=30>...you know, those strange worms that look like sticks.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=30>...you tahu, cacing-cacing aneh yang terlihat seperti tongkat itu.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_HistoryTalk_037
Array.english: That’s it for now...\nYou must be tired. Have a good rest and meet me tomorrow.
Array.indonesia: Sekian dulu... \nKamu pasti lelah. Istirahatlah dengan baik dan temui aku besok.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_HistoryTalk_038
Array.english: I will tell <color=#1DFEAF>Suwam</color> to guide you \nto the entrance of the Glacial Passage.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan meminta <color=#1DFEAF>Suwam</color> untuk membimbingmu \nke pintu masuk Glacial Passage.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_DaveSolo_001
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>Honestly…\nI am kind of overwhelmed by all the things happening.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Sejujurnya…\nAku agak kewalahan dengan semua hal yang terjadi.</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_DaveSolo_002
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>I will go up and check\nif everything is all right.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Aku akan naik ke atas dan memeriksa\napakah semuanya baik-baik saja.</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_02_01_001
Array.english: <size=35>Whoa, a strong earthquake all of a sudden?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wah, tiba-tiba terjadi gempa bumi yang kuat?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_02_01_002
Array.english: The earthquakes are becoming more frequent and intense.
Array.indonesia: Gempa bumi semakin sering dan semakin kuat.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_02_01_003
Array.english: I should go check if BANCHO SUSHI is all right.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus pergi memeriksa apakah BANCHO SUSHI baik-baik saja.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_02_02_001
Array.english: Bancho, I felt a big earthquake. Is your place okay?
Array.indonesia: Bancho, aku merasakan gempa besar. Tempatmu baik-baik saja?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_02_02_002
Array.english: I took some measures against earthquakes\nafter it crumbled last time...
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah mengambil beberapa langkah pencegahan terhadap gempa\nsetelah tempat ini runtuh terakhir kali...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_02_02_003
Array.english: But I am not sure for how long\nit will withstand a series of strong earthquakes.
Array.indonesia: Tapi aku tidak yakin seberapa lama\ntempat ini akan bertahan menghadapi serangkaian gempa kuat.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_03_01_001
Array.english: <size=42>Is everyone okay?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>Apakah semua orang baik-baik saja?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_03_01_002
Array.english: <size=39>Dr. Bacon!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=39>Dr. Bacon!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_03_01_003
Array.english: I was passing by and wanted to make sure you were all right.
Array.indonesia: Aku kebetulan lewat dan ingin memastikan kalian semua baik-baik saja.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_03_01_004
Array.english: Well, it looks like everyone is okay.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya semua orang baik-baik saja.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_03_01_005
Array.english: Dave, what about the Sea People business?\nIs there any problem?
Array.indonesia: Dave, bagaimana dengan urusan Suku Laut?\nApakah ada masalah?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_03_01_006
Array.english: Um, the heat from the ground is slowly melting the ice of \nthe Sea People Village.
Array.indonesia: Um, panas dari tanah perlahan-lahan mencairkan es di \nDesa Suku Laut.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_03_01_007
Array.english: And many Sea People got sick because of that.
Array.indonesia: Dan banyak Suku Laut yang jatuh sakit karena itu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_03_01_008
Array.english: To identify the cause, I need to go down to the Glacial Area \nthat blocks the heat and investigate but…
Array.indonesia: Untuk mengidentifikasi penyebabnya, saya harus turun ke Area Gletser \nyang menghalangi panas itu dan menyelidikinya, tapi…

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_03_01_009
Array.english: There seem to be eerie monsters down there,\nand I don’t feel safe.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya ada monster-monster menyeramkan di sana,\ndan aku merasa tidak aman.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_03_01_010
Array.english: <size=39>Aw! That sounds like trouble, Dave!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=39>Aduh! Kedengarannya merepotkan, Dave!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_03_01_011
Array.english: According to the ancient records,\nSea People are very susceptible to temperature change.
Array.indonesia: Menurut catatan kuno,\nSuku Laut sangat rentan terhadap perubahan suhu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_03_01_012
Array.english: You should go down to the Glacial Area A.S.A.P.\nand find out what’s happening there.
Array.indonesia: Kamu sebaiknya segera turun ke Area Gletser \ndan mencari tahu apa yang terjadi di sana.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_03_01_013
Array.english: It would be honorable to sacrifice yourself for the Sea People,\neven if means getting frozen!
Array.indonesia: Akan menjadi suatu kehormatan untuk mengorbankan diri demi Suku Laut,\nbahkan jika itu berarti membeku!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_03_01_014
Array.english: <size=42>...uh, excuse me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>...uh, maaf?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_03_01_015
Array.english: <size=36>Never mind! We can worry about that tomorrow!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Sudahlah! Kita bisa memikirkannya besok!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_End_03_01_016
Array.english: <size=37>Today, we feast and have a fun lucky time!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Hari ini, kita berpesta dan bersenang-senang!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Start_01
Array.english: Tenzhin told me to talk to <color=#1DFEAF>Suwam</color> at the village.
Array.indonesia: Tenzhin menyuruhku berbicara dengan <color=#1DFEAF>Suwam</color> di desa.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Start_02
Array.english: I should check if there are any tasks for me\nthen head to the Sea People Village.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus mengecek apakah ada tugas untukku\nlalu pergi ke Desa Suku Laut.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_SuwamOpenPassage_01
Array.english: <size=34>Impressive.\nYou didn’t run away, human.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Mengesankan.\nKamu tidak lari, manusia.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_SuwamOpenPassage_02
Array.english: I, Suwam, will guide you personally.\nStay close to me.
Array.indonesia: Aku, Suwam, akan memandumu sendiri.\nTetaplah dekat denganku.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_PassageDoorOpen_02_01
Array.english: Well, this is the door to the <color=#F1DC2B>Glacial Passage</color>.
Array.indonesia: Nah, ini adalah pintu menuju <color=#F1DC2B>Glacial Passage</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_PassageDoorOpen_02_02
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>It is like... right next to where I was?</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Sepertinya... tepat di sebelah tempat aku tadi?</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_PassageDoorOpen_02_03
Array.english: Let me see...\nWhere is the key we found yesterday?
Array.indonesia: Coba kulihat...\nDi mana kunci yang kita temukan kemarin?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_PassageDoorOpen_02_04
Array.english: <size=35>Good. Now if I insert this here and...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Bagus. Sekarang kalau aku memasukkan ini ke sini dan...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_PassageDoorOpen_03_01
Array.english: Heh, good to know that the key is not a fake.
Array.indonesia: Heh, bagus tahu kalau kuncinya bukan palsu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_PassageDoorOpen_03_02
Array.english: <size=36>Oh, there is one thing you should know.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Oh, ada satu hal yang harus kamu tahu.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_PassageDoorOpen_03_03
Array.english: You can go straight down using the middle path \nin the Glacial Passage...
Array.indonesia: Kamu bisa langsung turun lewat jalur tengah \ndi Glacial Passage...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_PassageDoorOpen_03_04
Array.english: ...but it must have been blocked to stop the Gadons from escaping.
Array.indonesia: ...tapi pasti sudah diblokir untuk mencegah Gadon melarikan diri.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_PassageDoorOpen_03_05
Array.english: There should be a <color=#1DFEAF>contraption that opens the door</color>\nsomewhere around there.
Array.indonesia: Seharusnya ada <color=#1DFEAF>alat yang membuka pintu</color>\ndi sekitar sana.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_PassageDoorOpen_03_06
Array.english: <size=34>So, comb through the area, human.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Jadi, telusuri area itu, manusia.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_PassageDoorOpen_03_07
Array.english: I am needed elsewhere. See you then.
Array.indonesia: Aku dibutuhkan di tempat lain. Sampai jumpa nanti.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_PassageDoorOpen_03_08
Array.english: <size=39>Just don’t die.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=39>Jangan sampai mati, ya.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_EnterGlacialPassage_01
Array.english: Mm...\nThe way is blocked just as Suwam warned me.
Array.indonesia: Mm...\nJalan ini terhalang, persis seperti yang diperingatkan Suwam.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_EnterGlacialPassage_02
Array.english: I should search the area for another route down.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus mencari rute lain untuk turun di sekitar sini.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_EnterGlacialPassage_03
Array.english: By the way, what is that huge <color=#1DFEAF>mural</color> back there?
Array.indonesia: Ngomong-ngomong, apa itu <color=#1DFEAF>mural</color> raksasa di belakang sana?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_EnterGlacialPassage_04
Array.english: It may say something about the Sea People…
Array.indonesia: Mungkin itu menceritakan sesuatu tentang Suku Laut…

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_EnterGlacialPassage_05
Array.english: I should take a <color=#1DFEAF>picture</color> of it and show it to Dr. Bacon.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus mengambil <color=#1DFEAF>foto</color>-nya dan memperlihatkannya kepada Dr. Bacon.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area01SwitchPuzzle_01
Array.english: <size=35>Wow, these contraptions are overwhelming.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wah, alat-alat ini bikin pusing.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area01SwitchPuzzle_02
Array.english: In video games, players touch this and that to find out how to operate them...Shall I try?
Array.indonesia: Di video game, pemain biasanya menyentuh ini dan itu untuk mencari tahu cara mengoperasikannya... Haruskah aku mencobanya?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area01GardonFirstMeet_01
Array.english: Aw, this place is infested with Gadons as well.
Array.indonesia: Aduh, tempat ini juga dipenuhi Gadon.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area01GardonFirstMeet_02
Array.english: I should hide behind the <color=#1DFEAF>stone statue</color> to slip past them.
Array.indonesia: Sebaiknya aku bersembunyi di balik <color=#1DFEAF>patung batu</color> untuk menyelinap melewati mereka.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area01WallPainting_01
Array.english: <size=33>There is a huge mural here as well.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ada mural besar di sini juga.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area01WallPainting_02
Array.english: I should take a <color=#1DFEAF>picture</color> of it, too.
Array.indonesia: Sebaiknya aku memotret <color=#1DFEAF>foto</color>-nya juga.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area01RotatePuzzle_01
Array.english: Mm, there are strange contraptions here, too.
Array.indonesia: Hmm, ada alat-alat aneh di sini juga.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area01RotatePuzzle_02
Array.english: I bet I can figure it out if I fiddle around a bit!
Array.indonesia: Aku yakin bisa mengetahuinya jika aku mencoba-coba sebentar!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area01LightBerry_01
Array.english: <size=35>Oh! When I hit the <color=#F1DC2B>Divine Tree Fruit</color> a strong light came out of it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh! Saat aku memukul <color=#F1DC2B>Buah Pohon Suci</color>, cahaya yang sangat terang keluar darinya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area01LightBerry_02
Array.english: <size=32>The Gadons hate light.\nMaybe I can use this fruit...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Gadons membenci cahaya.\nMungkin aku bisa menggunakan buah ini...?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area01LightBerry_03
Array.english: <size=34>I should get far away before they recover!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku harus menjauh sebelum mereka pulih!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area01EXIT_01
Array.english: Um, this seems to be the right passage,\nbut the door is frozen.
Array.indonesia: Hmm, sepertinya ini jalan yang benar,\ntapi pintunya membeku.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area01EXIT_02
Array.english: The ice is not that thick.\nMaybe I can use a <color=#F1DC2B>Divine Tree Fruit</color> to melt it?
Array.indonesia: Esnya tidak terlalu tebal.\nMungkin aku bisa menggunakan <color=#F1DC2B>Buah Pohon Ilahi</color> untuk mencairkannya?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area01EXIT_door_01
Array.english: <size=37>Good! The ice wall has melt!\nI can advance now!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Bagus! Dinding esnya sudah mencair!\nSekarang aku bisa maju!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Lobby02ShortcutFound_02
Array.english: Well, if the door remains open on this side,\nI could go straight down.
Array.indonesia: Nah, kalau pintunya tetap terbuka di sisi ini,\naku bisa langsung turun.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Lobby02ShortcutFound_03
Array.english: There must be something that opens the door around here.
Array.indonesia: Pasti ada sesuatu yang bisa membuka pintu di sekitar sini.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Lobby02ShortcutAfterFound_01
Array.english: Hm? What if I pull that <color=#1DFEAF>pulley</color> thing?
Array.indonesia: Hm? Bagaimana kalau aku menarik <color=#1DFEAF>katrol</color> itu?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Lobby02ShortcutOpen_01
Array.english: <size=34>Good!\nNow I can go down directly from the entrance.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Bagus!\nSekarang aku bisa turun langsung dari pintu masuk.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Lobby02ShortcutOpen_02
Array.english: <size=35>Let me continue down to the next level.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ayo aku lanjut turun ke tingkat berikutnya.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Lobby02ShortcutOpen_03
Array.english: Brrrr.... It’s getting colder as I go down further.
Array.indonesia: Brrrr.... Semakin ke bawah, semakin dingin.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Lobby03GlacialBlock_01
Array.english: Mm...\nIt’s frozen solid and won’t open.
Array.indonesia: Mm...\nIni membeku kaku dan tidak bisa dibuka.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Lobby03GlacialBlock_02
Array.english: <size=32>I need to find something that can be used to melt it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku harus mencari sesuatu yang bisa digunakan untuk mencairkannya.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area02Puzzle_01
Array.english: <size=35>This place is full of contraptions, too?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Tempat ini juga penuh dengan alat-alat aneh, ya?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area02Puzzle_02
Array.english: <size=33>I wonder how ancient Sea People built all of these...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku penasaran bagaimana Orang Laut kuno membangun semua ini...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area02LaserFound_WithLightBerry_01
Array.english: <size=35>What is that <color=#F1DC2B>contraption</color> over there?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Apa itu <color=#F1DC2B>alat aneh</color> di sana?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area02LaserFound_WithLightBerry_02
Array.english: It looks like it can hold something.\nShould I try a <color=#F1DC2B>Divine Tree Fruit</color>?
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya bisa menampung sesuatu.\nHaruskah aku mencoba <color=#F1DC2B>Buah Pohon Suci</color>?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area02LaserFound_NoLightBerry_01
Array.english: <size=35>What is that <color=#F1DC2B>contraption</color> in the front?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Apa itu <color=#F1DC2B>perangkat</color> di depan?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area02LaserFound_NoLightBerry_02
Array.english: It looks like I can insert something.\nShould I bring a <color=#F1DC2B>Divine Tree Fruit</color>?
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya aku bisa memasukkan sesuatu ke dalamnya.\nHaruskah aku membawa <color=#F1DC2B>Buah Pohon Ilahi</color>?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area02WallPainting_01
Array.english: <size=35>Oh, the wall was melted by the light of Divine Tree Fruit.\nI see the mural now.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh, dindingnya meleleh karena cahaya Buah Pohon Ilahi.\nSekarang aku bisa melihat lukisan dindingnya.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area02WallPainting_02
Array.english: Hm... It may mean something.
Array.indonesia: Hm... Mungkin ini punya arti.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area02WallPainting_03
Array.english: <size=33>I should take its <color=#1DFEAF>picture</color>, too.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku sebaiknya memotretnya <color=#1DFEAF>juga</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area02Clear_01_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, the light from the Divine Tree is shining right next to the ice.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, cahaya dari Pohon Ilahi bersinar tepat di samping es.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area02Clear_01_002
Array.english: Maybe I can melt the ice if I slightly change the angle of the mirror.
Array.indonesia: Mungkin aku bisa melelehkan es itu jika sedikit mengubah sudut cermin.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area02Clear_02_001
Array.english: What if I pick out the rock over there?
Array.indonesia: Bagaimana kalau aku mengambil batu di sana?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area02Clear_02_002
Array.english: But I don’t have any tool to use right now...
Array.indonesia: Tapi aku tidak punya alat apa pun yang bisa digunakan saat ini...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area02Clear_02_003
Array.english: I should return to the <color=#F1DC2B>boat</color> and ask Cobra.
Array.indonesia: Aku sebaiknya kembali ke <color=#F1DC2B>perahu</color> dan bertanya pada Cobra.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_WreckingBar_01_01
Array.english: <size=35>Hmph, so you want to take out the rock stuck in the crack?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Hmph, jadi kamu ingin mengeluarkan batu yang terjepit di celah itu?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_WreckingBar_01_02
Array.english: <size=35>Then you should use a <color=#1DFEAF>Crowbar</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Kalau begitu, kamu harus menggunakan <color=#1DFEAF>Crowbar</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_WreckingBar_01_03
Array.english: <size=36>Oh, do you have one?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Oh, apa kamu punya?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_WreckingBar_01_04
Array.english: Well, the thing is...\nI ordered one but the <color=#F1DC2B>delivery ship</color> carrying it sunk...
Array.indonesia: Nah, masalahnya...\nAku sudah memesannya, tapi <color=#F1DC2B>kapal pengiriman</color> yang membawanya tenggelam...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_WreckingBar_01_05
Array.english: You may find it on the sea floor where the <color=#F1DC2B>delivery ship</color> sank.
Array.indonesia: Kamu mungkin bisa menemukannya di dasar laut tempat <color=#F1DC2B>kapal pengiriman</color> itu tenggelam.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_WreckingBar_01_06
Array.english: Ah, where I found the giant squid.
Array.indonesia: Ah, di tempat aku menemukan cumi-cumi raksasa itu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_WreckingBar_01_07
Array.english: That will be easy, since that squid is no more. Heh.
Array.indonesia: Itu akan mudah, karena cumi-cumi itu sudah tidak ada lagi. Heh.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_WreckingBar_01_08
Array.english: <size=35>Good, what are you waiting for then?\nI ordered a <color=#1DFEAF>red Crowbar</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Bagus, lalu apa yang kamu tunggu?\nAku memesan <color=#1DFEAF>Crowbar merah</color>.</size>

Array.name: Main_Mission20_JumpCrab_01_01
Array.english: <size=34>Oh, there it is!\nCobra’s <color=#1DFEAF>Crowbar</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh, itu dia!\n<color=#1DFEAF>Crowbar</color> milik Cobra!</size>

Array.name: Main_Mission20_JumpCrab_01_02
Array.english: But it’s buried under the rocks.\nI need to remove the rocks.
Array.indonesia: Tapi itu terkubur di bawah bebatuan.\nAku harus memindahkan bebatuan itu.

Array.name: Main_Mission20_JumpCrab_02_01
Array.english: Oops!\nIt looks like I aggravated a colony of crabs!
Array.indonesia: Ups!\nSepertinya aku membuat koloni kepiting marah!

Array.name: Main_Mission20_JumpCrab_02_02
Array.english: Aw, they look ferocious...
Array.indonesia: Aduh, mereka terlihat ganas...

Array.name: Main_Mission20_JumpCrab_02_03
Array.english: I need to deal with them to pick up the <color=#1DFEAF>Crowbar</color>.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus mengatasinya dulu agar bisa mengambil <color=#1DFEAF>Crowbar</color>.

Array.name: Main_Mission20_JumpCrab_03_01
Array.english: Whew, that was a tough fight.
Array.indonesia: Wah, pertarungan yang berat.

Array.name: Main_Mission20_JumpCrab_03_02
Array.english: Let me pick up the <color=#1DFEAF>Crowbar</color> and go up.
Array.indonesia: Biarkan aku mengambil <color=#1DFEAF>Crowbar</color> dan naik ke atas.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_WreckingBar_02_01
Array.english: Good. This must be the <color=#1DFEAF>Crowbar</color> that Cobra mentioned.
Array.indonesia: Bagus. Ini pasti <color=#1DFEAF>Crowbar</color> yang disebutkan Cobra.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_WreckingBar_02_02
Array.english: Why does it look familiar?\nOh, I don’t know. Let me get to the boat.
Array.indonesia: Kenapa ini terlihat familiar?\nOh, aku nggak tahu. Aku harus ke perahu dulu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_WreckingBar_03_01
Array.english: <size=35>Oh! That’s the one I ordered. Hahahaha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh! Itu yang aku pesan. Hahahaha!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_WreckingBar_03_02
Array.english: So, you take this to the rock, insert it between the cracks \nand pull it hard like this...
Array.indonesia: Jadi, bawa ini ke batu, masukkan di antara celah-celahnya \ndan tarik dengan keras seperti ini...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_WreckingBar_03_03
Array.english: <size=34>Then you will be able to take out the rock. Haha.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Lalu kamu bisa mengeluarkan batu itu. Haha.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_WreckingBar_03_04
Array.english: <size=34>Nice.\nI will be able to move the mirror with this.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Bagus.\nAku bisa memindahkan cermin dengan ini.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_WreckingBar_03_05
Array.english: <size=36>Hahaha! That’s good!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Hahaha! Bagus sekali!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_WreckingBar_03_06
Array.english: <size=32>Since you’re here, why don’t you check your gear?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Selagi kamu di sini, kenapa tidak memeriksa perlengkapanmu?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_WreckingBar_03_07
Array.english: <size=32>And don’t forget to stop by <color=#F1DC2B>BANCHO SUSHI</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Dan jangan lupa mampir ke <color=#F1DC2B>BANCHO SUSHI</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Boss_000_Barricade_01
Array.english: I must bring a <color=#1DFEAF>Crowbar</color>.\nThere must be a way to defeat those crabs.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus membawa <color=#1DFEAF>Crowbar</color>.\nPasti ada cara untuk mengalahkan kepiting-kepiting itu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_WreckingBar_GlacialPassage_Room2NoEnter_001
Array.english: I'm not sure what to do here. \nI'll have to ask Cobra.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak yakin harus berbuat apa di sini. \nAku harus bertanya pada Cobra.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_WreckingBar_GlacialPassage_Barricade_001
Array.english: I should check the <color=#1DFEAF>Crowbar</color> with Cobra.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus memeriksa <color=#1DFEAF>Crowbar</color> bersama Cobra.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Lobby02_MirrorAgain
Array.english: <size=34>I should pick out that rock using \nthe <color=#1DFEAF>Crowbar</color> from Cobra.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku harus mencabut batu itu menggunakan \n<color=#1DFEAF>Crowbar</color> dari Cobra.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Lobby02GlacialMelt_01
Array.english: Amazing, <color=#F1DC2B>Divine Tree Fruit</color> has unbelievable energy...
Array.indonesia: Luar biasa, <color=#F1DC2B>Buah Pohon Suci</color> memiliki energi yang tak terbayangkan...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Lobby02GlacialMelt_02
Array.english: It just melt that thick ice wall.
Array.indonesia: Itu baru saja melelehkan dinding es tebal itu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Lobby02GlacialMelt_03
Array.english: Well, let me go down again.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah, biarkan aku turun lagi.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Lobby02GlacialMelt_04
Array.english: Ah, it’s too cold by the way.
Array.indonesia: Ah, ngomong-ngomong, di sini terlalu dingin.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Lobby02GlacialMelt_05
Array.english: I could kill for a hot bowl of miso soup from BANCHO SUSHI.
Array.indonesia: Aku rela melakukan apa saja demi semangkuk sup miso panas dari BANCHO SUSHI.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area02Barricade_01
Array.english: I must move the mirror to change the direction of light.\nI should get this rock out using a <color=#1DFEAF>Crowbar</color>!
Array.indonesia: Aku harus memindahkan cermin untuk mengubah arah cahaya.\nAku harus mengeluarkan batu ini menggunakan <color=#1DFEAF>Crowbar</color>!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Lobby03Block_01
Array.english: <size=35>Whew. This is a dead-end, too.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wah. Ini juga jalan buntu.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Lobby03Block_02
Array.english: I am almost there.\nI should check the surroundings first.
Array.indonesia: Aku hampir sampai.\nSebaiknya aku periksa sekelilingnya dulu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area03RotatePuzzle_01
Array.english: The ice wall is blocking the way.
Array.indonesia: Dinding es menghalangi jalan.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area03RotatePuzzle_02
Array.english: I think I can melt it using the <color=#F1DC2B>Divine Tree Fruit Device</color>.
Array.indonesia: Kurasa aku bisa mencairkannya menggunakan <color=#F1DC2B>Alat Buah Pohon Ilahi</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area03RotatePuzzle_03
Array.english: I must find a way to redirect\nthe <color=#F1DC2B>light</color> to that ice wall.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus menemukan cara untuk mengarahkan\n<color=#F1DC2B>cahaya</color> ke dinding es itu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area03IceWallMelt_01
Array.english: <size=35>Nice! The ice wall has melted!\nLet me go inside.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Bagus! Dinding esnya sudah mencair!\nAyo aku masuk.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area03WallPainting_01
Array.english: <size=34>There is a mural here as well.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ada lukisan dinding di sini juga.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area03WallPainting_02
Array.english: I should take its <color=#1DFEAF>picture</color> and show it to Dr. Bacon.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus <color=#1DFEAF>memotretnya</color> dan memperlihatkannya kepada Dr. Bacon.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area03MovePuzzle_01
Array.english: Mm, the mirrors here are not well aligned.\nIs there a way to align them?
Array.indonesia: Hmm, cermin-cermin di sini tidak sejajar dengan baik. \nApakah ada cara untuk menyejajarkannya?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area03IceWallMelt2_01
Array.english: <size=35>Good! The ice wall blocking the exit has melted away.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Bagus! Dinding es yang menghalangi pintu keluar telah mencair</size>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area03IceWallMelt2_02
Array.english: Now, if I go past it, I will find a door to the <color=#F1DC2B>Glacial Area</color>.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang, kalau aku melewatinya, aku akan menemukan pintu menuju <color=#F1DC2B>Area Gletser</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area03IceWallMelt2_03
Array.english: Whew, this place is really cold.\nI could use a hot cup of Green Tea right now.
Array.indonesia: Wah, tempat ini benar-benar dingin.\nAku butuh secangkir Teh Hijau panas sekarang.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Lobby04Enter1_01
Array.english: This place is too dark\nto see anything.
Array.indonesia: Tempat ini terlalu gelap\nuntuk melihat apa pun.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Lobby04Enter1_02
Array.english: Right, I hit this fruit and it glowed.\nI should use this.
Array.indonesia: Benar, aku memukul buah ini dan buah itu bersinar.\nAku harus menggunakan ini.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Lobby04GiantGardonWakeUp_01
Array.english: <size=35>Ack! What is that thing?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Aduh! Apa itu?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Lobby04GiantGardonWakeUp_02
Array.english: <size=33>That Gadon is humongous!\nIt’s almost unreal!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Gadon itu sangat besar!\nHampir tidak nyata!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Lobby04GiantGardonWakeUp_03
Array.english: Oh, it’s thankfully chained.
Array.indonesia: Oh, untungnya dia dirantai.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Lobby04GiantGardonWakeUp_04
Array.english: <size=36>Let me escape this place riding the current!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Ayo aku kabur dari tempat ini dengan menunggangi arus!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Lobby04Escape_01
Array.english: <size=35>Oh, no! I will be eaten by that thing!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh, tidak! Aku akan dimakan oleh makhluk itu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Lobby04Escape_02
Array.english: <size=36>Why don’t I ride the current?\nHere goes nothing!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Kenapa aku tidak menunggangi arus saja?\nAyo, coba saja!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_EscapeGlacialPassage_01
Array.english: <size=34>I managed to escape.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku berhasil melarikan diri.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_EscapeGlacialPassage_02
Array.english: <size=34>I must barricade the entrance before the Gadon \ncomes after me!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku harus membarikade pintu masuk sebelum Gadon \nmengejarku!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_EscapeGlacialPassage_03
Array.english: <size=33>Good, now if I nudge that <color=#1DFEAF>pile of stones</color>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Bagus, sekarang kalau aku mendorong <color=#1DFEAF>tumpukan batu</color> itu...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_EndLobby_AfterSaveDave_01
Array.english: <size=38>Suwam?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Suwam?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_EndLobby_AfterSaveDave_02
Array.english: Ha! Of course a human can't handle this.
Array.indonesia: Ha! Tentu saja manusia tidak bisa menangani ini.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_EndLobby_AfterSaveDave_03
Array.english: <size=36>You would have already been eaten by \nthe deep-sea fish were I not there for you.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Kamu pasti sudah dimakan oleh \nikan laut dalam jika aku tidak ada di sana untukmu.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_EndLobby_AfterSaveDave_04
Array.english: I admit it this time.\nThank you, Suwam.
Array.indonesia: Kali ini aku mengakuinya.\nTerima kasih, Suwam.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_EndLobby_AfterSaveDave_05
Array.english: Hahaha! Well, go and find out what’s happening\nin the <color=#F1DC2B>Glacial Area</color> as you promised me, human.
Array.indonesia: Hahaha! Nah, pergilah dan cari tahu apa yang sedang terjadi\ndi <color=#F1DC2B>Daerah Gletser</color> seperti yang kamu janjikan padaku, manusia.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_EndLobby_AfterSaveDave_06
Array.english: Ah, I didn’t imagine this place would be this cold.\nI will freeze to death if I go down further.
Array.indonesia: Ah, aku tidak menyangka tempat ini akan sedingin ini.\nAku akan mati kedinginan jika turun lebih jauh.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_EndLobby_AfterSaveDave_07
Array.english: Oh, you helpless human. You do not have any gear or clothes \nto protect your body from the cold then?
Array.indonesia: Oh, manusia yang tak berdaya. Kamu tidak punya perlengkapan atau pakaian \nuntuk melindungi tubuhmu dari dingin?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_EndLobby_AfterSaveDave_08
Array.english: Well, I must first return to Cobra and ask him.\nHe may have something to protect me from the cold.
Array.indonesia: Yah, aku harus kembali ke Cobra dulu dan bertanya padanya.\nMungkin dia punya sesuatu untuk melindungiku dari dingin.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_EndLobby_AfterSaveDave_09
Array.english: Well, we have no other option then.\nLet’s return to the village.
Array.indonesia: Yah, kalau begitu kita tidak punya pilihan lain.\nAyo kembali ke desa.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_EndLobby_AfterSaveDave_10
Array.english: You see that <color=#F1DC2B>Huge Mirror</color> in the back?\nActivate it again and you will be whisked away to the village.
Array.indonesia: Kamu lihat <color=#F1DC2B>Cermin Besar</color> di belakang itu?\nAktifkan lagi dan kamu akan langsung dibawa ke desa.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_EndLobby_AfterSaveDave_11
Array.english: You pull the right <color=#1DFEAF>lever</color>.\nI will pull the left one.
Array.indonesia: Kamu tarik <color=#1DFEAF>tuas</color> yang kanan.\nAku akan menarik yang kiri.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_End_MirrorPortal_01
Array.english: <size=34>All right! We pull these levers at once on my signal,\n okay?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Baiklah! Kita tarik tuas-tuas ini bersamaan sesuai isyaratku,\n oke?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_End_MirrorPortal_end_01
Array.english: What are you doing? Grab the <color=#1DFEAF>lever</color> on the right, human.
Array.indonesia: Apa yang kamu lakukan? Pegang <color=#1DFEAF>tuas</color> di sebelah kanan, manusia.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_End_ReturnMermanVillage_01
Array.english: <size=34>Good!\nNow, we can access this place straight from the village.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Bagus!\nSekarang, kita bisa mengakses tempat ini langsung dari desa.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_End_ReturnMermanVillage_02
Array.english: Go back to the village and find a way to withstand the cold, human.
Array.indonesia: Kembalilah ke desa dan cari cara untuk menahan dingin, manusia.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_End_ReturnMermanVillage_03
Array.english: Tsk, tsk. Humans are so fragile. This is something \nunthinkable for a superior warrior like me, Suwam.
Array.indonesia: Ck, ck. Manusia itu sangat rapuh. Ini adalah sesuatu yang \ntak terbayangkan bagi seorang pejuang unggul sepertiku, Suwam.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_End_ReturnMermanVillage_04
Array.english: Your tail has been shaking for some time now.\nAre you really all right?
Array.indonesia: Ekormu sudah gemetar sejak tadi.\nApakah kamu benar-benar baik-baik saja?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_End_ReturnMermanVillage_05
Array.english: <size=36>W-What are you talking about?\nYou are clearly mistaken, human!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>A-Apa yang kamu bicarakan?\nKamu jelas salah, manusia!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_End_ReturnMermanVillage_06
Array.english: <size=35>Let’s return to the village for now.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ayo kita kembali ke desa dulu.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_End_ReturnMermanVillage_07
Array.english: <size=39>Achu!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=39>Achu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_End_ReturnMermanVillage_08
Array.english: Urgh, I guess krill went up my nose.
Array.indonesia: Urgh, sepertinya ada krill yang masuk ke hidungku.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_TenzhinSuitTalk_01
Array.english: <size=38>Oh, you came.\nHow was the Glacial Area?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Oh, kamu sudah datang.\nBagaimana keadaan Area Gletser?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_TenzhinSuitTalk_02
Array.english: Um...\nThere was a huge Gadon in the passage so...
Array.indonesia: Um...\nAda Gadon raksasa di lorong itu jadi...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_TenzhinSuitTalk_03
Array.english: The <color=#F1DC2B>Glacial Area</color> is too cold for me to explore.\nI need something.
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Area Gletser</color> itu terlalu dingin buat aku jelajahi.\nAku butuh sesuatu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_TenzhinSuitTalk_04
Array.english: Ah, you’re ill-equipped to explore the area for sure\nwith your light diving suit.
Array.indonesia: Ah, kamu pasti tidak cukup siap untuk menjelajahi daerah itu\ndengan pakaian selam ringanmu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_TenzhinSuitTalk_05
Array.english: Our people wear clothes with Divine Tree Fruits\nand can withstand the cold.
Array.indonesia: Orang-orang kami memakai pakaian yang terbuat dari Buah Pohon Ilahi\ndan bisa menahan dingin.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_TenzhinSuitTalk_06
Array.english: <size=34>I am curious...\nCan your people tailor the <color=#1DFEAF>Divine Tree Fruit Cloths</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku penasaran...\nApakah orang-orangmu bisa menjahit <color=#1DFEAF>Pakaian dari Buah Pohon Ilahi</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_TenzhinSuitTalk_07
Array.english: <size=38>Tailoring?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Menjahit?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_TenzhinSuitTalk_08
Array.english: Cobra or Dr. Bacon may know how.
Array.indonesia: Cobra atau Dr. Bacon mungkin tahu caranya.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_TenzhinSuitTalk_09
Array.english: You seem to have talented friends.\nTake this <color=#1DFEAF>cloth</color> and ask your friends.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya kamu punya teman-teman yang berbakat.\nAmbil <color=#1DFEAF>kain</color> ini dan tanyakan pada teman-temanmu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_End_01
Array.english: Hm... <color=#1DFEAF>Divine Tree Fruit Cloths</color>...
Array.indonesia: Hm... <color=#1DFEAF>Kain Buah Pohon Ilahi</color>...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_End_02
Array.english: I need to tailor it into a suit.\nIt may protect me from the cold.
Array.indonesia: Aku perlu menjahitnya menjadi setelan.\nMungkin bisa melindungiku dari hawa dingin.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_End_03
Array.english: It’s already dinner time.
Array.indonesia: Sudah waktunya makan malam.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_End_04
Array.english: <size=36>I should visit <color=#F1DC2B>BANCHO SUSHI</color> first.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Aku sebaiknya mampir ke <color=#F1DC2B>BANCHO SUSHI</color> dulu.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Lobby02Barricade_01
Array.english: I need to open the door up there to quickly return to the village.\nI should find a way to open it.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus membuka pintu di atas sana agar bisa segera kembali ke desa.\nAku harus mencari cara untuk membukanya.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Lobby02ShortcutFound_01
Array.english: It looks like the <color=#1DFEAF>contraption</color> over there could open the door.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya <color=#1DFEAF>alat aneh</color> di sana bisa membuka pintu itu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area02Enter_01
Array.english: Similar contraptions here as well.
Array.indonesia: Ada alat serupa di sini juga.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area02Enter_02
Array.english: I guess it should work just like last time.
Array.indonesia: Kurasa ini akan berfungsi seperti terakhir kali.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Lobby04Barricade_01
Array.english: It’s too dark to see anything.\nI must hit a Divine Tree Fruit to illuminate the place.
Array.indonesia: Terlalu gelap untuk melihat apa pun.\nSaya harus memukul Buah Pohon Ilahi untuk menerangi tempat ini.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_EndLobbyBarricade_01
Array.english: <size=35>It’s too cold!\nI can’t go further down without proper gear.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Terlalu dingin!\nSaya tidak bisa turun lebih jauh tanpa perlengkapan yang memadai.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk01_001
Array.english: I went home late and couldn’t sleep well last night.
Array.indonesia: Saya pulang larut dan tidak bisa tidur nyenyak tadi malam.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk01_002
Array.english: Haha, you did a good job last night.\nLet’s go report to Dr. Bacon.
Array.indonesia: Haha, kamu bekerja dengan baik tadi malam.\nAyo kita lapor ke Dr. Bacon.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk02_001
Array.english: <size=36>Hey, Dave!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Hei, Dave!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk02_002
Array.english: <size=33>I heard that you acquired an intact mechanical part?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kudengar kamu berhasil mendapatkan bagian mekanis yang utuh?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk02_003
Array.english: Yes... With difficulties.
Array.indonesia: Ya... Dengan susah payah.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk02_004
Array.english: <size=35>Here, take it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ini, ambil.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk02_005
Array.english: <size=36>Yes! This is it!\nGood job, Dave!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Ya! Ini dia!\nKerja bagus, Dave!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk02_006
Array.english: Okay, now I have everything I need.\nI will go to the lab and craft a <color=#F1DC2B>Cold-resistant Suit</color>. But...
Array.indonesia: Oke, sekarang aku sudah punya semua yang kubutuhkan.\nAku akan pergi ke lab dan membuat <color=#F1DC2B>Pakaian Tahan Dingin</color>. Tapi...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk02_007
Array.english: <size=34>I am worried about the fact that the Glacial Area is unstable.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku khawatir karena Area Gletser itu tidak stabil.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk02_008
Array.english: <size=35>I suggest you get a good <color=#1DFEAF>weapon</color> as well as \na good suit.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Aku sarankan kamu juga menyiapkan <color=#1DFEAF>senjata</color> yang bagus serta \npakaian pelindung yang bagus.</size>
