Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk02_009
Array.english: Ah. There was a new material developed at the lab...
Array.indonesia: Ah. Ada bahan baru yang dikembangkan di laboratorium...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk02_010
Array.english: <size=34>The<color=#1DFEAF> Dive Knife</color> can be upgraded!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>The<color=#1DFEAF> Dive Knife</color> bisa ditingkatkan!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk02_011
Array.english: As usual, you can upgrade it through <color=#72ff0a>iDiver</color>.
Array.indonesia: Seperti biasa, kamu bisa meningkatkannya melalui <color=#72ff0a>iDiver</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk02_012
Array.english: Upgrading the <color=#1DFEAF>Dive Knife</color> not only increases its attack power…
Array.indonesia: Meningkatkan <color=#1DFEAF>Dive Knife</color> tidak hanya meningkatkan daya serangnya…

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk02_012_2
Array.english: <size=33>but you can also mine minerals that previously could \nonly be mined with a pickaxe!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>tetapi kamu juga bisa menambang mineral yang sebelumnya \nhanya bisa ditambang dengan beliung!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk02_013
Array.english: Oh…\nThen I won't have to go looking for the pickaxe!
Array.indonesia: Oh…\nKalau begitu, aku tidak perlu repot-repot mencari beliung!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk02_014
Array.english: <size=34>Haha! Give me <color=#1DFEAF>a day</color> to craft the suit.\nI will see you tomorrow!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Haha! Beri aku <color=#1DFEAF>satu hari</color> untuk membuat baju pelindung itu.\nSampai jumpa besok!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk03_001
Array.english: A Cold-resistant Suit... I wonder what that will look like.
Array.indonesia: Baju Pelindung Tahan Dingin... Aku penasaran seperti apa bentuknya.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk03_002
Array.english: Like Dr. Bacon said, \na suit won't be enough to protect yourself.
Array.indonesia: Seperti yang dikatakan Dr. Bacon, \nbaju pelindung saja tidak akan cukup untuk melindungimu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk03_003
Array.english: Don’t you think you should bring a weapon?
Array.indonesia: Menurutmu, apakah sebaiknya kita membawa senjata?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk03_004
Array.english: I think so, too.
Array.indonesia: Aku juga berpikir begitu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk03_005
Array.english: I will go ask <color=#F1DC2B>Duff</color>.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan bertanya kepada <color=#F1DC2B>Duff</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff_MermanWeapon_Call_001
Array.english: How’s it going, Dave?\nIt’s been a while, what can I do for you?
Array.indonesia: Apa kabar, Dave?\nSudah lama tidak bertemu, ada yang bisa kubantu?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff_MermanWeapon_Call_002
Array.english: Uh, I am going to explore the Glacial Area and\nI am not sure if the weapon I have will be enough.
Array.indonesia: Eh, aku mau menjelajahi Area Gletser dan\naku nggak yakin senjata yang aku punya bakal cukup.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff_MermanWeapon_Call_003
Array.english: Ah, the huge glacier in the deep sea.\nI’ve heard about your mission.
Array.indonesia: Ah, gletser raksasa di laut dalam.\nAku udah dengar soal misimu.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff_MermanWeapon_Call_004
Array.english: <size=35>I planted a tracker in the gun.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Aku pasang pelacak di senjatanya.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff_MermanWeapon_Call_005
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>You could have told me that earlier...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Kamu seharusnya memberitahuku lebih awal...</color>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff_MermanWeapon_Call_006
Array.english: But the one I can craft right now with the ingredients I have\nwill not be that different.
Array.indonesia: Tapi yang bisa aku buat sekarang dengan bahan-bahan yang aku miliki\ntidak akan jauh berbeda.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff_MermanWeapon_Call_007
Array.english: Unless I can get my hands on some new <color=#1DFEAF>minerals</color>.
Array.indonesia: Kecuali kalau aku bisa mendapatkan beberapa <color=#1DFEAF>mineral</color> baru.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff_MermanWeapon_Call_008
Array.english: Dave, I know you frequent the Sea People Village.
Array.indonesia: Dave, aku tahu kamu sering ke Desa Suku Laut.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff_MermanWeapon_Call_009
Array.english: Why don’t you look for new materials there?
Array.indonesia: Kenapa kamu tidak mencari bahan-bahan baru di sana?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff_MermanWeapon_Call_010
Array.english: Speaking of the village... I wonder how the <color=#F1DC2B>Sea People Workshop</color> is going.
Array.indonesia: Ngomong-ngomong soal desa itu... Aku penasaran bagaimana kabar <color=#F1DC2B>Bengkel Suku Laut</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff_MermanWeapon_Call_011
Array.english: I should pay it a visit.
Array.indonesia: Seharusnya aku mampir ke sana.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff_MermanWeapon_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=35>Oh, that’s a new type of mineral...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh, itu jenis mineral baru...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff_MermanWeapon_Complete_002
Array.english: How do you know when we’re talking over the phone?
Array.indonesia: Bagaimana kamu tahu kalau kita sedang berbicara lewat telepon?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff_MermanWeapon_Complete_003
Array.english: <size=35>Heh, because I installed a CCTV on your boat?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Heh, karena aku memasang CCTV di perahumu?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff_MermanWeapon_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=36>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff_MermanWeapon_Complete_005
Array.english: Anyways.\nI will work on a new weapon when the mineral arrives.
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun juga.\nAku akan mulai mengerjakan senjata baru begitu mineralnya tiba.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff_MermanWeapon_Complete_006
Array.english: I will add the ingredients I need to the <color=#F1DC2B>list</color>. \nSecure them and let me know.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan menambahkan bahan-bahan yang kubutuhkan ke <color=#F1DC2B>daftar</color>. \nSiapkan bahan-bahan itu dan beri tahu aku.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff_MermanWeapon_Complete_007
Array.english: I will eagerly wait for the\nnever-before-seen <color=#F1DC2B>minerals</color> to arrive.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan menanti dengan penuh antusias kedatangan \nmineral-mineral <color=#F1DC2B>yang belum pernah ada sebelumnya</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff_MermanWeapon_Complete_008
Array.english: <size=36><color=#ff61e3>GOODBYE-TERNITY★ ★</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36><color=#ff61e3>GOODBYE-TERNITY★ ★</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_BlacksmithOpen01_001
Array.english: *Coughs* I am still not feeling well,
Array.indonesia: *Batuk* Saya masih belum merasa sehat,

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_BlacksmithOpen01_002
Array.english: but good enough to reopen the <color=#F1DC2B>Workshop</color>.
Array.indonesia: tapi sudah cukup baik untuk membuka kembali <color=#F1DC2B>Bengkel</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_BlacksmithOpen01_003
Array.english: Oh! You’re open! What do you sell?
Array.indonesia: Oh! Kamu sudah buka! Apa yang kamu jual?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_BlacksmithOpen01_004
Array.english: Well, I’ll have a wide variety of minerals available. \nI’ll give you a good deal on them.
Array.indonesia: Nah, aku akan menyediakan berbagai macam mineral. \nAku akan memberikan harga yang bagus untuknya.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_BlacksmithOpen01_005
Array.english: If you know someone who knows what to do with minerals, \nit’d be good to bring them to them.
Array.indonesia: Jika kamu mengenal seseorang yang tahu cara memanfaatkan mineral, \nakan bagus jika kamu membawanya ke sana.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_BlacksmithOpen01_006
Array.english: <size=35>Oh, and...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh, dan...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_BlacksmithOpen01_007
Array.english: If you find something in the sea, bring it to me.\nI will buy it at a good price.
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu menemukan sesuatu di laut, bawa ke aku.\nAku akan membelinya dengan harga yang bagus.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_BlacksmithOpen01_008
Array.english: Sure, I will stop by your place before going up.
Array.indonesia: Tentu, aku akan mampir ke tempatmu sebelum naik ke atas.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_BlacksmithOpen01_009
Array.english: Anyways, it’s good to know that you’re getting better!\nI will keep in touch, Duwa!
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun, senang mendengar kamu sudah membaik!\nAku akan tetap berhubungan, Duwa!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_BlacksmithOpen02_001
Array.english: Wait. You are heading to the <color=#F1DC2B>Glacial Area</color>, aren’t you?
Array.indonesia: Tunggu. Kamu sedang menuju ke <color=#F1DC2B>Daerah Gletser</color>, kan?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_BlacksmithOpen02_002
Array.english: Yes, I need to investigate the roots of the Divine Tree\nto find what is causing the earthquakes.
Array.indonesia: Ya, aku perlu menyelidiki akar Pohon Suci\nuntuk mencari tahu apa yang menyebabkan gempa bumi.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_BlacksmithOpen02_003
Array.english: This place used to be very peaceful...\nThe ecosystem is unstable now and the creatures will become more aggressive.
Array.indonesia: Tempat ini dulunya sangat damai...\nEkosistemnya sekarang tidak stabil dan makhluk-makhluk di sana akan menjadi lebih agresif.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_BlacksmithOpen02_004
Array.english: I will set up the shop today.\nVisit me <color=#1DFEAF>tomorrow</color>.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan menyiapkan tokonya hari ini.\nKunjungi aku <color=#1DFEAF>besok</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_BlacksmithOpen02_005
Array.english: All right. Don’t spread yourself too thin.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah. Jangan terlalu memaksakan diri.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_BlacksmithNotOpen_001
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(I’d rather ask for weapon materials after Duwa is fully recovered...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Aku lebih baik meminta bahan senjata setelah Duwa pulih sepenuhnya...)</color>

Array.name: dialog_Doowa_Unlock_Glacial_NewMaterial_001
Array.english: I can now collect some more materials as we have secured a route to the Glacial Area.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang aku bisa mengumpulkan lebih banyak bahan karena kita sudah mengamankan rute ke Area Gletser.

Array.name: dialog_Doowa_Unlock_Glacial_NewMaterial_002
Array.english: They will help me craft a new weapon.
Array.indonesia: Bahan-bahan itu akan membantuku membuat senjata baru.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_Give_NewSuit_001
Array.english: Whew, it’s not easy crafting a suit in one day.
Array.indonesia: Wah, tidak mudah membuat baju zirah dalam satu hari.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_Give_NewSuit_002
Array.english: <size=36>But I am me! So I did it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Tapi aku kan aku! Jadi aku berhasil!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_Give_NewSuit_003
Array.english: Oh, that looks nice!
Array.indonesia: Wah, kelihatannya bagus!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_Give_NewSuit_004
Array.english: <size=34>Ba ha ha! Why don’t you go ahead and try it on?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ha ha ha! Kenapa kamu tidak mencobanya saja?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_After_NewSuit_001
Array.english: <size=36>Oho! That suits you well.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Oho! Itu cocok banget buatmu.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_After_NewSuit_002
Array.english: <size=34>Haha, the size is perfect as well.\nThank you, Dr. Bacon.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Haha, ukurannya juga pas banget.\nTerima kasih, Dr. Bacon.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_After_NewSuit_003
Array.english: It feels warm.\nMaybe because it’s made from the Divine Tree Fruit cloth.
Array.indonesia: Rasanya hangat.\nMungkin karena terbuat dari kain Buah Pohon Ilahi.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_After_NewSuit_004
Array.english: With that suit, you can not only roam underwater \nbut also cold places freely.
Array.indonesia: Dengan pakaian itu, kamu tidak hanya bisa menjelajah di bawah air \ntetapi juga di tempat-tempat dingin dengan bebas.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_After_NewSuit_005
Array.english: <size=36>Good.\nTime to go down to the Glacial Area!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Bagus.\nSaatnya turun ke Area Gletser!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_Enter_GlacialArea_001
Array.english: Wow, it’s really warm.\nIt’s completely different from before.
Array.indonesia: Wow, benar-benar hangat.\nSangat berbeda dari sebelumnya.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_Enter_GlacialArea_002
Array.english: Well, time to really explore the area.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah, saatnya benar-benar menjelajahi area ini.

Array.name: dialog_GlacialArea_Dungeon2_barricade_001
Array.english: Oh, the current here is too strong\nto enter.
Array.indonesia: Oh, arus di sini terlalu kuat\nuntuk masuk.

Array.name: dialog_GlacialArea_GoDown_barricade_001
Array.english: Wait! I feel some heat coming up.
Array.indonesia: Tunggu! Aku merasakan panas yang naik.

Array.name: dialog_GlacialArea_GoDown_barricade_002
Array.english: I can’t go down further now.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak bisa turun lebih jauh sekarang.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_Find_Dungeon01_001
Array.english: <size=36>Mm, a door?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Mm, sebuah pintu?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_Find_Dungeon01_002
Array.english: And there is a stone slab with text in front of the door.
Array.indonesia: Dan ada lempengan batu bertuliskan teks di depan pintu itu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_Find_Dungeon01_003
Array.english: I should take a picture of it and ask Dr. Bacon to decipher.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus memotretnya dan meminta Dr. Bacon untuk menguraikannya.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_TakePhoto_Dungeon01_001
Array.english: This picture is good enough.
Array.indonesia: Foto ini sudah cukup bagus.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_TakePhoto_Dungeon01_002
Array.english: Let me go up and show it to Dr. Bacon.
Array.indonesia: Biarkan aku naik dan memperlihatkannya kepada Dr. Bacon.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_TenzhinBeforeDecript_001
Array.english: Oh, a stone slab in front of a giant door?
Array.indonesia: Oh, sebuah lempengan batu di depan pintu raksasa?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_TenzhinBeforeDecript_002
Array.english: But the inscriptions are rather worn out and they are hard to read.
Array.indonesia: Tapi prasastinya sudah cukup aus dan sulit dibaca.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_TenzhinBeforeDecript_003
Array.english: I wish I could see the letters more clearly.
Array.indonesia: Seandainya aku bisa melihat huruf-hurufnya dengan lebih jelas.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_DecriptStoneTablet_001
Array.english: Dr. Bacon, could you take a look at this picture?
Array.indonesia: Dr. Bacon, bisakah Anda melihat foto ini sebentar?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_DecriptStoneTablet_002
Array.english: <size=34>Oh! An ancient stone slab of the Sea People?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh! Sebuah lempengan batu kuno milik Suku Laut?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_DecriptStoneTablet_003
Array.english: But it is very old and poorly weathered.
Array.indonesia: Tapi lempengan ini sangat tua dan kondisinya sudah rusak parah akibat cuaca.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_DecriptStoneTablet_004
Array.english: No matter, should be enough to run \nthe <color=#F1DC2B>Decoding Equipment</color> with.
Array.indonesia: Tak apa, seharusnya cukup untuk menjalankan \nPeralatan <color=#F1DC2B>Penerjemahan</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_DecriptStoneTablet_005
Array.english: <size=35>Can you hold that picture for a moment?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Bisakah Anda menahan gambar itu sebentar?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_AfterDecriptStoneTablet_001
Array.english: <size=35>Good! I can read them!\nHow lucky!</color>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Bagus! Saya bisa membacanya!\nBeruntung sekali!</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_AfterDecriptStoneTablet_002
Array.english: Oh, what a relief.\nWhat does it read?
Array.indonesia: Oh, lega sekali.\nApa yang tertulis di sana?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_AfterDecriptStoneTablet_003
Array.english: It seems to be some sort of... <color=#1DFEAF>spell</color>?
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya ini semacam... <color=#1DFEAF>mantra</color>?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_AfterDecriptStoneTablet_004
Array.english: <size=33>The letters are unfamiliar to me, \nso it is hard to decipher them clearly.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Huruf-hurufnya asing bagiku, \njadi sulit untuk mengartikannya dengan jelas.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_AfterDecriptStoneTablet_005
Array.english: Why don’t you ask the Sea People?
Array.indonesia: Mengapa kamu tidak bertanya kepada Suku Laut?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_AfterDecriptStoneTablet_006
Array.english: There must be someone who has knowledge of \ncryptography or spells.
Array.indonesia: Pasti ada seseorang yang mengerti \nkriptografi atau mantra.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_AfterDecriptStoneTablet_DaveSolo_001
Array.english: An ancient spell that even Dr. Bacon cannot decipher? \nHm...
Array.indonesia: Mantra kuno yang bahkan Dr. Bacon pun tidak bisa menguraikannya? \nHm...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_AfterDecriptStoneTablet_DaveSolo_002
Array.english: Ah, I remember seeing many old books \nin the <color=#F1DC2B>Sea People Temple</color>.
Array.indonesia: Ah, aku ingat pernah melihat banyak buku tua \ndi <color=#F1DC2B>Kuil Suku Laut</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_AfterDecriptStoneTablet_DaveSolo_003
Array.english: <color=#F1DC2B>Niamo</color> may be of help.
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Niamo</color> mungkin bisa membantu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_001
Array.english: <size=34>Huh? Suwam? What are you doing here?\nAre you reading a book?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hah? Suwam? Apa yang kamu lakukan di sini?\nKamu sedang membaca buku?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_002
Array.english: Heh, are you surprised?\nMy keen analytic abilities come from the books I read.
Array.indonesia: Heh, kamu terkejut?\nKemampuan analitisku yang tajam berasal dari buku-buku yang kubaca.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_003
Array.english: Oh, long time no see, human.\nI was sorting books.
Array.indonesia: Oh, lama tidak bertemu, manusia.\nAku sedang menyortir buku.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_004
Array.english: How can I help you?
Array.indonesia: Ada yang bisa kubantu?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_005
Array.english: Can you take a look at this picture?\nIt looks like an ancient spell, but I can’t understand what it means.
Array.indonesia: Bisakah kamu melihat gambar ini?\nSepertinya ini mantra kuno, tapi aku tidak mengerti artinya.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_006
Array.english: <size=36>Hm, hm...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Hm, hm...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_007
Array.english: I can roughly understand it.\nWhere was this stone slab located?
Array.indonesia: Aku bisa memahaminya secara garis besar.\nDi mana lempengan batu ini ditemukan?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_008
Array.english: In front of a large, closed door in the Glacial Area.
Array.indonesia: Di depan sebuah pintu besar yang tertutup di Area Gletser.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_009
Array.english: I see. According to the book...
Array.indonesia: Begitu. Menurut buku...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_010
Array.english: <size=35>There are three large doors in the Glacial Area.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ada tiga pintu besar di Area Gletser.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_011
Array.english: And inside those doors is a <color=#F1DC2B>switch</color> that will lead to \nthe Divine Tree Control Room.
Array.indonesia: Dan di balik pintu-pintu itu terdapat sebuah <color=#F1DC2B>saklar</color> yang akan mengarah ke \nRuang Kontrol Pohon Ilahi.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_012
Array.english: <size=35>I did an analysis and found that the earthquakes were\ncoming from the <color=#F1DC2B>Divine Tree Control Room</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Aku telah melakukan analisis dan menemukan bahwa gempa bumi tersebut\nberasal dari <color=#F1DC2B>Ruang Kontrol Pohon Suci</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_013
Array.english: Activate all the switches and you will be able to access the <color=#F1DC2B>Divine Tree Control Room</color>!
Array.indonesia: Aktifkan semua sakelar dan kamu akan bisa mengakses <color=#F1DC2B>Ruang Kontrol Pohon Suci</color>!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_014
Array.english: That’s not going to be easy. \nHow am I supposed to open the big door?
Array.indonesia: Itu tidak akan mudah. \nBagaimana cara membuka pintu besar itu?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_015
Array.english: I have materials referring to the door.\nLet me see...
Array.indonesia: Saya punya referensi mengenai pintu itu.\nCoba saya lihat...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_016
Array.english: Here it is. You need to cast a <color=#1DFEAF>spell</color> to open the door.
Array.indonesia: Ini dia. Kamu perlu melantunkan <color=#1DFEAF>mantra</color> untuk membuka pintu itu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_017
Array.english: <size=33>Um, but I don’t speak the language of the Sea People.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Um, tapi aku tidak bisa berbahasa Suku Laut.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_018
Array.english: Ah, of course not. Then...
Array.indonesia: Ah, tentu saja tidak. Kalau begitu...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_019
Array.english: <size=36>Why don’t you bring <color=#F1DC2B>Suwam</color> with you then?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Kenapa kamu tidak mengajak <color=#F1DC2B>Suwam</color> bersamamu saja?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_020
Array.english: Uh, Suwam, you say?
Array.indonesia: Eh, Suwam, katamu?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_021
Array.english: <size=35>Human! You can do nothing without me! Haha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Manusia! Kamu tidak bisa berbuat apa-apa tanpa aku! Haha!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_022
Array.english: Well, it looks like you’re in trouble.\nI will give you a hand this time.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya kamu sedang dalam masalah.\nAku akan membantumu kali ini.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_023
Array.english: Oh, I am not sure about this...
Array.indonesia: Oh, aku tidak yakin soal ini...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_024
Array.english: Best of luck to you, Suwam.\nMay King Long’s protection be with you.
Array.indonesia: Semoga beruntung, Suwam.\nSemoga perlindungan Raja Long menyertaimu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_025
Array.english: Stop worrying about me,\njust lead the way, human.
Array.indonesia: Jangan khawatirkan aku,\ncukup tunjukkan jalannya saja, manusia.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_ArrivedDungeon01Gate_001
Array.english: Hmph, this must be the door.
Array.indonesia: Hmph, ini pasti pintunya.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_ArrivedDungeon01Gate_002
Array.english: Well, I am supposed to cast the spell <color=#1DFEAF>Niamo</color> taught me.
Array.indonesia: Nah, aku harus melantunkan mantra yang diajarkan <color=#1DFEAF>Niamo</color> kepadaku.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_ArrivedDungeon01Gate_003
Array.english: <size=35>Watch and learn, human!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Perhatikan dan pelajari, manusia!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_AfterDungeon01GateOpen_001
Array.english: <size=36>Wow, the door really opened!\nI am impressed, Suwam!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Wah, pintunya benar-benar terbuka!\nAku terkesan, Suwam!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_AfterDungeon01GateOpen_002
Array.english: Haha, now you realize my greatness.
Array.indonesia: Haha, sekarang kamu menyadari kehebatanku.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_AfterDungeon01GateOpen_003
Array.english: You said it was a spell, \nand you had to dance as well to open it?
Array.indonesia: Kamu bilang itu mantra, \ndan kamu juga harus menari untuk membukanya?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_AfterDungeon01GateOpen_004
Array.english: Oh, that is...\nI needed to dance to keep with the beat.
Array.indonesia: Oh, itu...\nAku perlu menari agar selaras dengan iramanya.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_AfterDungeon01GateOpen_005
Array.english: Got it... \nShall we get inside and check out the place, Suwam?
Array.indonesia: Oke... \nAyo kita masuk dan lihat-lihat tempat ini, Suwam?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_AfterDungeon01GateOpen_006
Array.english: Uh, my back hurts from dancing.
Array.indonesia: Uh, punggungku sakit karena menari.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_AfterDungeon01GateOpen_007
Array.english: Unfortunately, you will have to go alone today, human.
Array.indonesia: Sayangnya, kamu harus pergi sendirian hari ini, manusia.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_AfterDungeon01GateOpen_008
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(Shakes head)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Menggelengkan kepala)</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_BackToNiamo_001
Array.english: There should be a <color=#F1DC2B>switch</color> on the other side of the big door.\nDo you think you can turn it on?
Array.indonesia: Seharusnya ada <color=#F1DC2B>saklar</color> di sisi lain pintu besar itu.\nMenurutmu, bisakah kamu menyalakannya?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_BackToNiamo_002
Array.english: May King Long’s protection be with you.
Array.indonesia: Semoga perlindungan Raja Long menyertaimu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_EnterDungeon01_001
Array.english: There must be a <color=#F1DC2B>switch</color> to operate the Divine Tree Control Room inside.
Array.indonesia: Pasti ada <color=#F1DC2B>saklar</color> untuk mengoperasikan Ruang Kontrol Pohon Suci di dalam sana.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_EnterDungeon01_002
Array.english: My gut feeling is this passage will cause me trouble, but I have no other choice.\nI need to be careful.
Array.indonesia: Instingku bilang lorong ini akan menimbulkan masalah bagiku, tapi aku tidak punya pilihan lain.\nAku harus berhati-hati.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_DG01_FindRotateGimmik_001
Array.english: A piece of strange rotating equipment is blocking my way.
Array.indonesia: Sebuah peralatan berputar yang aneh menghalangi jalanku.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_DG01_FindRotateGimmik_002
Array.english: I think I can start it by myself.
Array.indonesia: Kurasa aku bisa menyalakannya sendiri.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_DG01_UseRotateGimmik_001
Array.english: <size=36>Oh, the equipment is working\nand the stakes started moving.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Oh, peralatan itu berfungsi\ndan tiang-tiang itu mulai bergerak.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_DG01_UseRotateGimmik_002
Array.english: I must avoid them.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus menghindarinya.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_DG01_EnterStonePuzzleRoom_001
Array.english: The passage down there is blocked by ice.
Array.indonesia: Lorong di bawah sana terhalang oleh es.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_DG01_EnterStonePuzzleRoom_002
Array.english: I should do something with this <color=#F1DC2B>rotating equipment</color>.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus melakukan sesuatu dengan <color=#F1DC2B>peralatan berputar</color> ini.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_DG01_ClearStonePuzzle_001
Array.english: <size=35>Good! The ice is broken!\nTime to go on down!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Bagus! Esnya pecah!\nSaatnya turun!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_DG01_EnterFinalRoom_001
Array.english: Another room?
Array.indonesia: Ruangan lain?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_DG01_EnterFinalRoom_002
Array.english: This is the statue of King Long,\n but it looks somewhat strange.
Array.indonesia: Ini adalah patung Raja Long,\n tapi terlihat agak aneh.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_DG01_EnterFinalRoom_003
Array.english: His pose is slightly different from that of King Long \ndepicted in the <color=#1DFEAF>mural</color>. Maybe it means...
Array.indonesia: Posenya sedikit berbeda dari Raja Long \nyang digambarkan dalam <color=#1DFEAF>lukisan dinding</color>. Mungkin itu artinya...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_Dungeon01Clear_001
Array.english: Wow, is this really the ancient Sea People’s technology?\nImpressive.
Array.indonesia: Wow, apakah ini benar-benar teknologi Bangsa Laut kuno?\nMengesankan.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_Dungeon01Clear_002
Array.english: I hear some noise from afar.
Array.indonesia: Aku mendengar suara dari kejauhan.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_Dungeon01Clear_003
Array.english: That must be the first contraption Niamo told me about.
Array.indonesia: Itu pasti alat pertama yang diceritakan Niamo kepadaku.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_Dungeon01Clear_004
Array.english: The path up is now open.\nLet me return to the village and tell Tenzhin about this.
Array.indonesia: Jalan menuju atas kini terbuka.\nAku akan kembali ke desa dan memberi tahu Tenzhin tentang hal ini.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_Dungeon01Clear_005
Array.english: And I am hungry.
Array.indonesia: Dan aku lapar.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_ClearTalkTenzhin_001
Array.english: Hmph, Niamo told me the story. The Divine Tree Control Room is malfunctioning and is causing earthquakes, yes?
Array.indonesia: Hmph, Niamo sudah menceritakan kisahnya kepadaku. Ruang Kontrol Pohon Suci sedang mengalami gangguan dan menyebabkan gempa bumi, bukan?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_ClearTalkTenzhin_002
Array.english: Yes, I need to operate three switches to enter \nthe Control Room.
Array.indonesia: Ya, aku harus mengoperasikan tiga sakelar untuk masuk ke \nRuang Kontrol.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_ClearTalkTenzhin_003
Array.english: I already activated one of them.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah mengaktifkan salah satunya.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_ClearTalkTenzhin_004
Array.english: Well done.\nI am ashamed of our people having to \nrely on you in this matter.
Array.indonesia: Kerja bagus.\nAku malu karena orang-orang kita harus \nbergantung padamu dalam hal ini.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_ClearTalkTenzhin_005
Array.english: Please don’t be. \nThe earthquakes are a problem for us, too.
Array.indonesia: Tolong jangan merasa begitu. \nGempa bumi itu juga menjadi masalah bagi kami.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_ClearTalkTenzhin_006
Array.english: I remember something. \nIt was written in one of the ancient books.
Array.indonesia: Aku ingat sesuatu. \nHal itu tertulis dalam salah satu kitab kuno.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_ClearTalkTenzhin_007
Array.english: After some workers mutated into Gadons\ndue to Engineer Dasche's reckless use of energy,
Array.indonesia: Setelah beberapa pekerja bermutasi menjadi Gadon\nakibat penggunaan energi yang sembrono oleh Insinyur Dasche,

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_ClearTalkTenzhin_008
Array.english: My ancestors created switches to access the Control Room and scattered them in the Glacial Area.
Array.indonesia: Nenek moyangku menciptakan sakelar untuk mengakses Ruang Kontrol dan menyebarkannya di Area Gletser.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_ClearTalkTenzhin_009
Array.english: They created those switches to tighten the security,
Array.indonesia: Mereka menciptakan sakelar-sakelar itu untuk memperketat keamanan,

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_ClearTalkTenzhin_010
Array.english: but they have turned into obstacles now denying access to \nthe Control Room.
Array.indonesia: tetapi kini sakelar-sakelar itu telah berubah menjadi rintangan yang menghalangi akses ke \nRuang Kontrol.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_ClearTalkTenzhin_011
Array.english: It’s still cold, but the heat coming from the ground\nis melting the ice.
Array.indonesia: Udara masih dingin, tetapi panas yang berasal dari tanah\nsedang mencairkan es.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_ClearTalkTenzhin_012
Array.english: Maybe the Control Room is overheating, \ncausing the water temperature to rise.
Array.indonesia: Mungkin Ruang Kontrol terlalu panas, \nsehingga menyebabkan suhu air naik.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_ClearTalkTenzhin_013
Array.english: Stabilize the device and the water temperature will \nreturn to normal.
Array.indonesia: Stabilkan perangkat tersebut dan suhu air akan \nkembali normal.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_ClearTalkTenzhin_014
Array.english: I know it’s rather impolite of me, but please hurry \nbefore our ancestral home is completely destroyed.
Array.indonesia: Aku tahu ini agak tidak sopan, tapi tolong cepatlah \nsebelum rumah leluhur kita hancur total.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_ClearTalkTenzhin_015
Array.english: There are two doors remaining.\nI will try locating them.
Array.indonesia: Masih ada dua pintu yang tersisa.\nAku akan mencoba mencarinya.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_MissingBeluga_Start_001
Array.english: <size=36>You haven’t found it yet? \n Where did you search?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Kamu belum menemukannya? \n Di mana kamu mencarinya?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_MissingBeluga_Start_002
Array.english: I searched the whole village but no luck.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah mencari di seluruh desa, tapi belum berhasil.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_MissingBeluga_Start_003
Array.english: Huh? What’s going on, Ramo?
Array.indonesia: Hah? Ada apa, Ramo?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_MissingBeluga_Start_004
Array.english: Oh, Dave.\nMm... I think <color=#F1DC2B>the Beluga</color> has suddenly gone missing.
Array.indonesia: Oh, Dave.\nMm... Kurasa <color=#F1DC2B>Beluga</color> tiba-tiba menghilang.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_MissingBeluga_Start_005
Array.english: If he is not in the village, he could have gone to the other side of the Glacial Passage through the open door.
Array.indonesia: Kalau dia tidak ada di desa, mungkin dia sudah pergi ke sisi lain Jalur Gletser melalui pintu yang terbuka.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_MissingBeluga_Start_006
Array.english: <size=33>He is a very curious kind, you know.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Dia itu makhluk yang sangat penasaran, lho.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_MissingBeluga_Start_007
Array.english: <size=36>You didn't hide him did you, human?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Kamu tidak menyembunyikannya, kan, manusia?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_MissingBeluga_Start_008
Array.english: Why would I?
Array.indonesia: Kenapa aku harus begitu?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_MissingBeluga_Start_009
Array.english: All right. I will let you know if I find him.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah. Aku akan memberitahumu jika aku menemukannya.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_MissingBeluga_Start_010
Array.english: <size=36>Thanks!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Terima kasih!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_MissingBeluga_Start_011
Array.english: <size=34>Nawang! Awang!\nWhat are you doing? Go find the Beluga!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Nawang! Awang!\nApa yang kalian lakukan? Cepat cari Beluga itu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_MissingBeluga_Progress_RamoTalk_001
Array.english: Any update on the Beluga’s whereabouts?\nWhere did it go?
Array.indonesia: Ada kabar terbaru tentang keberadaan Beluga?\nKe mana dia pergi?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_MissingBeluga_Complete_RamoTalk_001
Array.english: It’s good to see the Beluga safely back again!
Array.indonesia: Senang melihat Beluga kembali dengan selamat!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_MissingBeluga_Complete_RamoTalk_002
Array.english: Doesn’t the Beluga look more imposing than before?
Array.indonesia: Bukankah Beluga itu terlihat lebih mengesankan daripada sebelumnya?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_ManateeTaxi_001
Array.english: <size=35>That’s a Manatee, not a Beluga.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Itu Manatee, bukan Beluga.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_ManateeTaxi_002
Array.english: It looks very slow...
Array.indonesia: Kelihatannya sangat lambat...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_ManateeTaxi_003
Array.english: But I have no choice. I should ride it.
Array.indonesia: Tapi aku tidak punya pilihan. Aku harus menaikinya.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_MissionBeluga_ColdAwang_001
Array.english: <size=36>Brrr... It’s cold.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Brrr... Dingin sekali.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_MissionBeluga_ColdAwang_002
Array.english: Human, your clothes look very warm...
Array.indonesia: Manusia, pakaianmu terlihat sangat hangat...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_MissionBeluga_ColdAwang_003
Array.english: Why don’t you...
Array.indonesia: Kenapa kamu tidak...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_MissionBeluga_ColdAwang_004
Array.english: Go inside and take a look? Achu!
Array.indonesia: Masuk ke dalam dan lihat-lihat? Achu!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_MissionBeluga_ColdAwang_005
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3><size=36>You are weaker than you look.</size></color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3><size=36>Kamu lebih lemah daripada yang terlihat.</size></color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_FindBeluga01_001
Array.english: <size=35>Oh! A Beluga!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh! Seekor Beluga!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_FindBeluga01_002
Array.english: Why is it here?
Array.indonesia: Kenapa dia ada di sini?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_FindAntarcticOctopus_001
Array.english: <size=35>Oh? Is this an Antarctic Octopus?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh? Apakah ini Gurita Antartika?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_FindAntarcticOctopus_002
Array.english: It’s venomous... Maybe poisoned?
Array.indonesia: Gurita ini beracun... Mungkin sudah diracuni?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_ChasingOctopus_Start_001
Array.english: <size=35>Ack! Why you little!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Aduh! Dasar makhluk kecil!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_ChasingOctopus_Start_002
Array.english: <size=34>I’m not letting you go. Stop there!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku tidak akan membiarkanmu pergi. Berhenti di situ!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_ChasingEnd_001
Array.english: <size=34>*Pants*\nI cornered this one.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>*Terengah-engah*\nAku sudah memojokkan yang satu ini.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_ChasingEnd_002
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(It looks kind of pitiful up close...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Kelihatannya agak menyedihkan kalau dilihat dari dekat...)</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_ChasingEnd_003
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(No, I can’t be weak now.\nI will show it who's boss!)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Tidak, aku tidak boleh lemah sekarang.\nAku akan tunjukkan siapa bosnya!)</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_ChasingEnd_Option01_001
Array.english: Harvest
Array.indonesia: Panen

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_ChasingEnd_Option02_001
Array.english: Rescue
Array.indonesia: Penyelamatan

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_ChasingEnd_FindAntidote_001
Array.english: Mm? What is this <color=#F1DC2B>bottle</color>? The octopus dropped it.
Array.indonesia: Mm? Apa ini <color=#F1DC2B>botol</color>? Gurita itu menjatuhkannya.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_ChasingEnd_FindAntidote_002
Array.english: Antidote perhaps?\nI should go back to the Beluga.
Array.indonesia: Mungkin obat penawar?\nAku harus kembali ke Beluga.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_CureBeluga01_001
Array.english: You don’t look well.
Array.indonesia: Kamu terlihat tidak sehat.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_CureBeluga01_002
Array.english: Do you want to try this?
Array.indonesia: Mau coba ini?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_CureBeluga02_001
Array.english: <size=35>Oh! You look better now!\nI am relieved.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh! Kamu terlihat lebih baik sekarang!\nAku lega.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_CureBeluga02_002
Array.english: Why don’t you return to the village? You can get there alone, right?
Array.indonesia: Kenapa kamu tidak kembali ke desa saja? Kamu bisa ke sana sendirian, kan?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_CureBeluga03_001
Array.english: Now that I found the Beluga, I should explore some more.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang setelah aku menemukan Beluga, aku harus menjelajah lebih jauh.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_CureBelugaBarricade_001
Array.english: We can't just leave the Beluga here!\nLet's give it an <color=#F1DC2B>antidote</color>!
Array.indonesia: Kita tidak bisa membiarkan Beluga di sini begitu saja!\nAyo kita berikan <color=#F1DC2B>penawar racun</color>!

Array.name: Main_Mission24_CureBelugaBarricade_Antidote
Array.english: <size=34>Oops, I need to get the <color=#F1DC2B>antidote</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ups, aku harus mengambil <color=#F1DC2B>penawar racun</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_Start_001
Array.english: I have to enter the <color=#F1DC2B>Cave with an Out-Flowing Current</color> to turn on the second Control Room switch...
Array.indonesia: Aku harus masuk ke <color=#F1DC2B>Gua dengan Arus Keluar</color> untuk menyalakan sakelar Ruang Kontrol kedua...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_Start_002
Array.english: <size=33>Is there any way to enter the cave?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Adakah cara untuk masuk ke gua itu?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_Start_003
Array.english: The current may be weaker today. I should go check.
Array.indonesia: Arusnya mungkin lebih lemah hari ini. Aku harus memeriksanya.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_ArrivedDungeon02Gate_001
Array.english: There must be a second switch somewhere inside.
Array.indonesia: Pasti ada sakelar kedua di suatu tempat di dalam sana.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_ArrivedDungeon02Gate_002
Array.english: But the strong current is blocking access.\nWhat should I do?
Array.indonesia: Tapi arus yang kuat menghalangi akses.\nApa yang harus aku lakukan?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_FindBeluga_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh? The Beluga!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh? Beluga!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_FindBeluga_002
Array.english: What are you doing here?\nIt’s dangerous here. Go back!
Array.indonesia: Apa yang kamu lakukan di sini?\nTempat ini berbahaya. Kembalilah!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_RideBeluga01_001
Array.english: What? You want me to ride on your back?
Array.indonesia: Apa? Kamu mau aku naik di punggungmu?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_RideBeluga01_002
Array.english: The Beluga could swim against the current.
Array.indonesia: Beluga bisa berenang melawan arus.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_RideBeluga01_003
Array.english: Oh, boy... I don't even have a harness.
Array.indonesia: Astaga... Aku bahkan tidak punya tali pengaman.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_RideBeluga02_001
Array.english: Maybe I should grab on here?
Array.indonesia: Mungkin aku harus berpegangan di sini?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_RideBeluga02_002
Array.english: <size=36>Oops, wait!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Ups, tunggu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_InsideDungeon_001
Array.english: Wow! I passed through the current.
Array.indonesia: Wow! Aku berhasil melewati arus itu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_InsideDungeon_002
Array.english: Beluga, help me find the <color=#F1DC2B>switch</color> if you’re not going back.
Array.indonesia: Beluga, tolong bantu aku menemukan <color=#F1DC2B>saklar</color> kalau kamu nggak mau balik.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_PhantomJelly_RoomEnter_001
Array.english: <size=35>Oh, is this... a mommy jellyfish?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh, apa ini... ubur-ubur betina?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_PhantomJelly_BattleStart_001
Array.english: No, we didn’t come to hunt small fish...
Array.indonesia: Nggak, kita nggak datang ke sini buat berburu ikan kecil...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_PhantomJelly_BattleStart_002
Array.english: It looks all riled up.\nI must first calm it down.
Array.indonesia: Kelihatannya sangat gelisah.\nAku harus menenangkannya dulu.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_PhantomJelly_BattleStart_003
Array.english: I can’t use a weapon in this state.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak bisa menggunakan senjata dalam keadaan seperti ini.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_PhantomJelly_BattleStart_004
Array.english: It would be good if I could hit those glowing <color=#F1DC2B>eyes</color>.
Array.indonesia: Alangkah baiknya jika aku bisa mengenai <color=#F1DC2B>mata</color> yang bersinar itu.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_PhantomJelly_die01_001
Array.english: Whew, lucky me. It went away.
Array.indonesia: Wah, untung sekali. Ia pergi.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_PhantomJelly_die02_001
Array.english: The back door is open. Let's go through that.
Array.indonesia: Pintu belakang terbuka. Ayo kita lewat dari sana.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_PhantomJelly_PickUp_001
Array.english: Let me see if there is anything to pick up.
Array.indonesia: Biar aku lihat apakah ada sesuatu yang bisa diambil.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_SwitchRoom01_001
Array.english: Oh, that must be the <color=#F1DC2B>switch</color>.
Array.indonesia: Oh, itu pasti <color=#F1DC2B>saklar</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_SwitchRoom01_002
Array.english: <size=34>Should I activate it?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Haruskah aku mengaktifkannya?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_BelugaTalk_001
Array.english: I could get here\nthanks to your help.
Array.indonesia: Aku bisa sampai di sini\nberkat bantuanmu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_SwitchRoom_Complete01_001
Array.english: I heard big machinery operating outside.
Array.indonesia: Aku mendengar suara mesin besar beroperasi di luar.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_SwitchRoom_Complete02_001
Array.english: A door is open there.\nMaybe it leads outside?
Array.indonesia: Ada pintu yang terbuka di sana.\nMungkin pintu itu mengarah ke luar?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_SwitchRoom_Complete03_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, I feel less heat than before.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, aku merasa panasnya berkurang dibanding tadi.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_SwitchRoom_Complete03_002
Array.english: <size=35>Maybe I can go down now?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Mungkin aku bisa turun sekarang?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_NoEnterControlRoom_001
Array.english: Hm… We need to activate one more device for the door to open.
Array.indonesia: Hm… Kita perlu mengaktifkan satu perangkat lagi agar pintu itu terbuka.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_NoEnterControlRoom_002
Array.english: Let's look for a cave that might have the third switch.
Array.indonesia: Ayo kita cari gua yang mungkin memiliki sakelar ketiga.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonFront_001
Array.english: <size=35>Suwam? What are you doing here?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Suwam? Apa yang kamu lakukan di sini?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonFront_002
Array.english: Well, I came all the way here as the heat under \nthe Glacial Area has been reduced.
Array.indonesia: Yah, aku datang jauh-jauh ke sini karena panas di bawah \nWilayah Gletser sudah berkurang.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonFront_003
Array.english: I can’t fully trust humans like you.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak bisa sepenuhnya mempercayai manusia sepertimu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonFront_004
Array.english: So, I, the hero of the Sea People who defeated \nthe giant Gadon, came here to activate the thing myself.
Array.indonesia: Jadi, aku, pahlawan Suku Laut yang mengalahkan \nraksasa Gadon, datang ke sini untuk mengaktifkan benda itu sendiri.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonFront_005
Array.english: <size=35>But...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Tapi...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonFront_006
Array.english: I need your help because the inside is quite a mess now.
Array.indonesia: Aku butuh bantuanmu karena bagian dalamnya sekarang cukup berantakan.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonFront_007
Array.english: Oh yeah? How messy?
Array.indonesia: Oh ya? Seberapa berantakannya?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonFront_008
Array.english: You will see for yourself.
Array.indonesia: Kamu akan melihatnya sendiri.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_EnterOption_001
Array.english: <size=35>Are you ready to enter, human?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Apakah kamu siap untuk masuk, manusia?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonEnter_001
Array.english: <size=35>Um, there is no water up here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Um, tidak ada air di sini.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonEnter_002
Array.english: This is near the roots of the Divine Tree. \nThey are sucking the ground heat.
Array.indonesia: Ini berada di dekat akar Pohon Suci. \nMereka menyerap panas dari tanah.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonEnter_003
Array.english: As the tree has mutated, it seems to have absorbed \neverything, leaving the soil around it completely dry.
Array.indonesia: Sejak pohon itu bermutasi, sepertinya ia telah menyerap \nsegala sesuatu, sehingga tanah di sekitarnya menjadi benar-benar kering.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonEnter_004
Array.english: I need to open the inner <color=#F1DC2B>waterway</color> to fill the water again.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus membuka <color=#F1DC2B>jalur air</color> bagian dalam untuk mengisi air kembali.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonEnter_005
Array.english: But I can’t reach the contraption up there as it is \nnot in the water.
Array.indonesia: Tapi aku nggak bisa menjangkau alat itu di atas sana karena \nnggak ada di dalam air.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonEnter_006
Array.english: <size=34>Human, you go up there and activate the contraption \non my signal!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Manusia, kamu naik ke sana dan aktifkan alat itu \nsesuai isyaratku!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonEnter_007
Array.english: <size=36>You want me to go up there?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Kamu mau aku naik ke sana?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonEnter_008
Array.english: Of course, you can’t go up there...\nAll right, wait a moment.
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja, kamu tidak bisa naik ke sana...\nBaiklah, tunggu sebentar.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonLever01_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh, there is a lever here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh, ada tuas di sini.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonLever01_002
Array.english: There you are.\nYes, pull that lever.
Array.indonesia: Nah, itu dia.\nYa, tarik tuas itu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonLever02_001
Array.english: There is another lever down here.\nI will pull this one myself.
Array.indonesia: Ada tuas lain di sini.\nAku akan menarik yang ini sendiri.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonLever02_002
Array.english: <size=34>Send me a signal when you’re ready, human.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kirimkan sinyal padaku saat kamu siap, manusia.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonAfterLever_001
Array.english: <size=35>Oh! The water began to flow from the top!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh! Air mulai mengalir dari atas!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonAfterLever_002
Array.english: <size=34>Good! It looked like an important device, and is filling the place with water.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Bagus! Sepertinya itu alat yang penting, dan sedang mengisi tempat ini dengan air.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonAfterLever_003
Array.english: <size=35>You pulled it without knowing what it does?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Kamu menariknya tanpa tahu fungsinya?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonAfterLever_004
Array.english: <size=32>I trust my gut feeling, you know.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku percaya instingku, tahu.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonAfterLever_005
Array.english: The water is filling up. \nI must suit up.
Array.indonesia: Airnya semakin penuh. \nAku harus memakai perlengkapan.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonAfterLever_006
Array.english: There seems to be a path inside. \nLet’s go in there!
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya ada jalan di dalam. \nAyo masuk ke sana!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonTogether_001
Array.english: Fortunately, this path is filled with water.
Array.indonesia: Untungnya, jalan ini tergenang air.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonTogether_002
Array.english: The place is packed with Divine Tree branches.
Array.indonesia: Tempat ini dipenuhi dahan-dahan Pohon Ilahi.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonTogether_003
Array.english: <size=36>Is there something stimulating the tree?\nThis level of growth is not normal.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Apakah ada sesuatu yang merangsang pertumbuhan pohon itu?\nTingkat pertumbuhan seperti ini tidak normal.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonTogether_004
Array.english: I need to enter the <color=#F1DC2B>Control Room</color> to figure out what’s what.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus masuk ke <color=#F1DC2B>Ruang Kontrol</color> untuk mencari tahu apa yang sebenarnya terjadi.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonTogether_005
Array.english: We move to the inner switch, human!
Array.indonesia: Ayo kita menuju sakelar di dalam, manusia!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonTogether_006
Array.english: <size=36>Follow me!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Ikuti aku!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonTogether_end_001
Array.english: Huh, matching my rhythm underwater.\nHumans aren't as hopeless as they seem.
Array.indonesia: Huh, ritme berenangmu selaras denganku di bawah air.\nManusia ternyata tidak seburuk yang terlihat.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonTogether_end_002
Array.english: All right, let's proceed through the door ahead and flip the switch.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah, mari kita lanjutkan melewati pintu di depan dan tekan sakelar itu.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Helicoprion_RoomEnter_001
Array.english: <size=35>Ack! What is that creature!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Aduh! Makhluk apa itu!?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Helicoprion_RoomEnter_002
Array.english: <size=35>Look at its snout! It’s scary!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Lihat moncongnya! Menakutkan!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Helicoprion_RoomEnter_003
Array.english: I have seen it before in the Ancient Creature Codex.\nIt is called a <color=#F1DC2B>Helicoprion</color> if my memory is correct.
Array.indonesia: Aku pernah melihatnya sebelumnya di Kodeks Makhluk Purba.\nNamanya <color=#F1DC2B>Helicoprion</color> jika ingatanku benar.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Helicoprion_RoomEnter_004
Array.english: But it went extinct 200 million years ago...
Array.indonesia: Tapi makhluk itu sudah punah 200 juta tahun yang lalu...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Helicoprion_RoomEnter_005
Array.english: <size=34>Maybe it’s been trapped in ice and has now been \nreleased as the ice melts in this region!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Mungkin makhluk itu terjebak dalam es dan kini telah \nterlepas seiring mencairnya es di wilayah ini!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Helicoprion_BattleStart01_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oops, we've been spotted! What should we do, Suwam?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ups, kita ketahuan! Apa yang harus kita lakukan, Suwam?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Helicoprion_BattleStart01_002
Array.english: <size=38> Suwam? Su-</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38> Suwam? Su-</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Helicoprion_BattleStart02_001
Array.english: <size=34>Human! This place looks strategically important!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Manusia! Tempat ini terlihat strategis!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Helicoprion_BattleStart02_002
Array.english: <size=32>Since that is an ancient deep-sea creature, \nit won’t sense bright light.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Karena itu adalah makhluk laut dalam purba, \nia tidak akan merasakan cahaya terang.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Helicoprion_BattleStart02_003
Array.english: <size=32>I will hit a <color=#1DFEAF>Divine Tree fruit</color> here to blind it,\nand you lure the creature!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku akan melempar <color=#1DFEAF>Buah Pohon Ilahi</color> ke sini untuk membutakannya,\ndan kamu yang mengalihkan perhatian makhluk itu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Helicoprion_BattleStart03_001
Array.english: Hm, it sounds like a reasonable tactic, but...\nall you do is just hide, it seems...
Array.indonesia: Hm, kedengarannya seperti taktik yang masuk akal, tapi...\nsepertinya yang kamu lakukan hanyalah bersembunyi...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Helicoprion_BattleStart03_002
Array.english: Anyways, that saw blade looks extremely dangerous.
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun, bilah gergaji itu terlihat sangat berbahaya.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Helicoprion_BattleStart03_003
Array.english: I should either hide somewhere or\nuse the <color=#1DFEAF>Divine Tree Fruit</color> as Suwam suggested.
Array.indonesia: Aku sebaiknya bersembunyi di suatu tempat atau\nmenggunakan <color=#1DFEAF>Buah Pohon Ilahi</color> seperti yang disarankan Suwam.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Helicoprion_Die_001
Array.english: Haha. Praise my strategical brain, it brought us victory.
Array.indonesia: Haha. Pujilah otak strategisku, itu yang membawa kita pada kemenangan.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Helicoprion_Die_002
Array.english: If you say so...
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu bilang begitu...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Helicoprion_Die_003
Array.english: Now, the monster is gone and we can access the door.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang, monster itu sudah pergi dan kita bisa masuk ke pintu.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Helicoprion_Die_004
Array.english: <size=34>Let’s go in, human.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ayo masuk, manusia.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Helicoprion_Pickup_001
Array.english: Wait. Check if you’re leaving anything behind.
Array.indonesia: Tunggu. Periksa apakah ada yang tertinggal.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_SwitchRoom01_001
Array.english: Here is the last <color=#F1DC2B>switch</color>.
Array.indonesia: Ini adalah <color=#F1DC2B>saklar</color> terakhir.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_SwitchRoom01_002
Array.english: It’s larger than the one in the second room. \nHelp me, Suwam.
Array.indonesia: Ukurannya lebih besar daripada yang ada di ruangan kedua. \nBantu aku, Suwam.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_SwitchRoom01_003
Array.english: You can’t do anything without me, human!
Array.indonesia: Kamu tidak bisa berbuat apa-apa tanpa aku, manusia!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_SwitchRoom_Complete_001
Array.english: Good, I activated the last switch.\nThe door to the <color=#F1DC2B>Control Room</color> should be open now.
Array.indonesia: Bagus, aku sudah mengaktifkan sakelar terakhir.\nPintu ke <color=#F1DC2B>Ruang Kontrol</color> seharusnya sudah terbuka sekarang.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_SwitchRoom_Complete_002
Array.english: <size=34>I must get out through the exit and see \nwhat’s going on outside.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku harus keluar melalui pintu keluar dan melihat \napa yang terjadi di luar.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_SwitchRoom_SuwamBeforeTalk_001
Array.english: Stop dallying and pull that lever, human.
Array.indonesia: Berhenti berlama-lama dan tarik tuas itu, manusia.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_SwitchRoom_SuwamAfterTalk_001
Array.english: What are you doing, human?\nGo check the situation outside.
Array.indonesia: Apa yang kamu lakukan, manusia?\nPergilah periksa situasi di luar.

Array.name: dialog_GlacialDeep_FishEncounter_001
Array.english: <size=33>Holy moly! Are these ancient creatures?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Astaga! Apakah makhluk-makhluk purba ini?</size>

Array.name: dialog_GlacialDeep_FishEncounter_002
Array.english: They must have been released from the melting glacial ice.
Array.indonesia: Mereka pasti terlepas dari es gletser yang mencair.

Array.name: dialog_GlacialDeep_FishEncounter_003
Array.english: I wonder if those are of any use to Bancho for his sushi place.\nI will bring him some samples if I catch any of them.
Array.indonesia: Aku penasaran apakah makhluk-makhluk itu berguna bagi Bancho untuk kedai sushinya.\nAku akan membawakan beberapa sampel kepadanya jika aku berhasil menangkap salah satunya.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_Start_001
Array.english: <size=36>Huh?\nThe Control Room door is still closed!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Hah?\nPintu Ruang Kontrol masih tertutup!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_Start_002
Array.english: The door is stuck by the Divine Tree roots growing \nfrom the inside.
Array.indonesia: Pintunya tersangkut oleh akar Pohon Suci yang tumbuh \ndari dalam.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_JohnWatson3_Enter_001
Array.english: <size=36>I knew you would be found here!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Aku tahu kamu pasti ada di sini!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_JohnWatson3_Enter_002
Array.english: <size=33>John Watson? How did you follow me here?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>John Watson? Bagaimana kamu bisa mengikuti aku ke sini?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_JohnWatson3_Enter_003
Array.english: Made of eco-friendly materials and titanium,\nthere is no place the <color=#1DFEAF>Dekken-9</color> cannot reach!
Array.indonesia: Terbuat dari bahan ramah lingkungan dan titanium,\ntidak ada tempat yang tidak bisa dijangkau oleh <color=#1DFEAF>Dekken-9</color>!

Array.name: dialog_Boss_JohnWatson3_Enter_004
Array.english: <size=34>I saw a passage in a strange village, \nso I just broke through it. Hahaha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku melihat sebuah lorong di desa aneh, \njadi aku langsung menerobosnya. Hahaha!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_JohnWatson3_Enter_005
Array.english: You don’t mind destroying this beautiful primordial place, \ndo you? I can’t believe this.
Array.indonesia: Kamu tidak keberatan menghancurkan tempat purba yang indah ini, \nkan? Aku tidak percaya ini.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_JohnWatson3_Enter_006
Array.english: You are a germ in this world and I am about to\nsterilize you!
Array.indonesia: Kamu adalah kuman di dunia ini dan aku akan segera\nmensterilkanmu!

Array.name: dialog_Boss_JohnWatson3_Enter_007
Array.english: <size=32>What a hypocrite!\nI know what your <color=#90CDFF>Sea Blue</color> did in secret!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Dasar munafik!\nAku tahu apa yang dilakukan <color=#90CDFF>Sea Blue</color>-mu secara diam-diam!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_JohnWatson3_Enter_008
Array.english: <size=50>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_JohnWatson3_Enter_009
Array.english: So, it was you… That is why the description of the suspect perfectly matches you.
Array.indonesia: Jadi, ternyata kamu… Itulah mengapa deskripsi tersangka sangat cocok denganmu.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_JohnWatson3_Enter_010
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(I am suddenly very curious about how I was portrayed \nin the description...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Tiba-tiba aku jadi sangat penasaran bagaimana aku digambarkan \ndalam deskripsi itu...)</color>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_JohnWatson3_Enter_011
Array.english: <size=35>More reason that I can’t let you go free!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Alasan lain mengapa aku tidak bisa membiarkanmu bebas!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_JohnWatson3_Enter_012
Array.english: <size=35>I, John Watson of <color=#90CDFF>Sea Blue</color>, the Guardians of the Sea,\nwill rid the sea of impurity!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Aku, John Watson dari <color=#90CDFF>Sea Blue</color>, Penjaga Laut,\nakan membersihkan laut dari segala kotoran!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_JohnWatson3_BattleStart_001
Array.english: How tenacious!\nTime to finish my business with this guy.
Array.indonesia: Sungguh gigih!\nSaatnya menyelesaikan urusanku dengan orang ini.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_JohnWatson3_BattleStart_002
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>Um, how am I supposed to neutralize that sturdy Submarine?</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Um, bagaimana caranya aku bisa menetralkan kapal selam yang kokoh itu?</color>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_JohnWatson3_BattleStart_003
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>Let’s find a way while evading its attacks!</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Ayo cari cara sambil menghindari serangannya!</color>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_JohnWatson3_Die_001
Array.english: <size=35>Haha, you are running like a rat!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Haha, kau lari seperti tikus!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_JohnWatson3_Die_002
Array.english: <size=35>You can't evade this one!\nThe Kirisame of Death!!!!</color>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Kamu tidak bisa menghindar dari yang ini!\nKirisame of Death!!!!</color>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_JohnWatson3_Barricade_001
Array.english: <size=34>We can’t outrun that thing. We need to find a better way to deal with it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kita tidak bisa berlari lebih cepat dari benda itu. Kita harus mencari cara yang lebih baik untuk mengatasinya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Kronosaurus_BattleStart01_001
Array.english: <size=38>W-What is that?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>A-Apa itu?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Kronosaurus_BattleStart01_002
Array.english: <size=36>An ancient creature of the Plesiosaurus family?\nMaybe a Kronosaurus?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Makhluk purba dari keluarga Plesiosaurus?\nMungkin Kronosaurus?!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Kronosaurus_BattleStart01_003
Array.english: <size=35>Unbelievable! A monster of that size\nhidden in the deep-sea glacier?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Luar biasa! Monster sebesar itu\ntersembunyi di gletser laut dalam?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Kronosaurus_BattleStart01_004
Array.english: Fighting such a monster would be ridiculous, but...
Array.indonesia: Bertarung melawan monster seperti itu tentu saja konyol, tapi...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Kronosaurus_BattleStart01_005
Array.english: if it has recently come out of the ice,\nit may still be sluggish and weak.
Array.indonesia: jika ia baru saja keluar dari es,\nmungkin ia masih lamban dan lemah.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Kronosaurus_BattleStart01_006
Array.english: Besides, there is no way we can get to\nthe <color=#F1DC2B>Control Room</color> without confronting it.
Array.indonesia: Lagipula, tidak mungkin kita bisa mencapai\nRuang <color=#F1DC2B>Kontrol</color> tanpa berhadapan dengannya.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Kronosaurus_BattleStart02_001
Array.english: <size=34>Hm? Isn’t that a <color=#1DFEAF>missile launcher</color> that came off \nof John Watson’s Submarine?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hm? Bukankah itu <color=#1DFEAF>peluncur rudal</color> yang terlepas \ndari Kapal Selam John Watson?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Kronosaurus_BattleStart02_002
Array.english: <size=38>What if I can shoot the missiles?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Bagaimana kalau aku menembakkan rudal-rudal itu?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Kronosaurus_Barricade_001
Array.english: I really want to run, but...
Array.indonesia: Aku benar-benar ingin lari, tapi...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Kronosaurus_Barricade_002
Array.english: It’s an opportunity to do something as it is hurt now!
Array.indonesia: Ini kesempatan untuk berbuat sesuatu karena monster itu sedang terluka sekarang!

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Kronosaurus_Die_001
Array.english: Whew, it will be a nightmare if one of those monsters \nreaches land.
Array.indonesia: Wah, bakal jadi mimpi buruk kalau salah satu monster itu \nsampai ke daratan.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Kronosaurus_Die_002
Array.english: I’ve got to hurry to the Divine Tree Control Room and \nrestore the device.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus buru-buru ke Ruang Kontrol Pohon Suci dan \nmemperbaiki perangkat itu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_complete01_001
Array.english: <size=36>Mm, what is this drone?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Mm, apa ini drone?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_complete01_002
Array.english: <size=35>Hey, Dave! Sorry, I am late!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Hei, Dave! Maaf, aku terlambat!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_complete01_003
Array.english: I was making an explorer drone to aid you as \nthe Glacial Area looks dangerous, and it has just been completed.
Array.indonesia: Aku sedang membuat drone penjelajah untuk membantumu karena \nDaerah Gletser terlihat berbahaya, dan baru saja selesai.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_complete01_004
Array.english: Dr. Bacon! \nI didn’t know the signal could reach this deep.
Array.indonesia: Dr. Bacon! \nAku tidak tahu sinyalnya bisa menjangkau sedalam ini.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_complete01_005
Array.english: Haha! It’s the pride and joy of my lab.
Array.indonesia: Haha! Ini kebanggaan dan kebahagiaan labku.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_complete01_006
Array.english: This drone not only communicates but also...
Array.indonesia: Drone ini tidak hanya bisa berkomunikasi, tetapi juga...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_complete01_007
Array.english: <size=35>does many activities underwater.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>melakukan banyak aktivitas di bawah air.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_complete01_008
Array.english: <size=33>All thanks to <color=#F1DC2B>Duff</color> here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Semua berkat <color=#F1DC2B>Duff</color> di sini.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_complete01_009
Array.english: <size=35>It’s good to see you, Dave.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Senang bertemu denganmu, Dave.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_complete01_010
Array.english: Such a large glacial ice in this depth.\nIt is as if it was touched by Gabriela and her cold fingers.
Array.indonesia: Es gletser sebesar ini di kedalaman ini.\nSeolah-olah disentuh oleh Gabriela dan jari-jarinya yang dingin.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_complete01_011
Array.english: Only if I could soothe her loneliness.
Array.indonesia: Andai saja aku bisa mengobati kesepiannya.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_complete01_012
Array.english: Hmph, anyways.
Array.indonesia: Hmph, sudahlah.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_complete01_013
Array.english: It looks like the roots are blocking the door.\nThe drone can cut the roots using a <color=#1DFEAF>laser cutter</color>.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya akarnya menghalangi pintu.\nDrone itu bisa memotong akarnya menggunakan <color=#1DFEAF>pemotong laser</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_complete01_014
Array.english: Oh, isn’t that handy?
Array.indonesia: Oh, bukankah itu berguna?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_complete01_015
Array.english: Haha, I foresaw your hardship and added the feature.
Array.indonesia: Haha, aku sudah menduga kesulitanmu dan menambahkan fitur itu.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_complete01_016
Array.english: <size=32>Haha. Lucky!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha. Beruntung!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_complete01_017
Array.english: Well, why don’t you activate the laser cutter?
Array.indonesia: Nah, kenapa kamu tidak mengaktifkan pemotong laser itu?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_complete02_001
Array.english: The Divine Tree is extremely hard unlike ordinary trees.
Array.indonesia: Pohon Ilahi ini sangat keras, tidak seperti pohon biasa.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_complete02_002
Array.english: <size=32>It will take <color=#1DFEAF>2 days</color> to get it done.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Butuh waktu <color=#1DFEAF>2 hari</color> untuk menyelesaikannya.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_complete02_003
Array.english: Do your thing until I am done.
Array.indonesia: Lakukan saja tugasmu sampai aku selesai.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_complete02_004
Array.english: <size=35>I will let you know when I am done.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Aku akan memberitahumu saat aku sudah selesai.</size>

Array.name: dialog_GlacialDrone_Talk01_001
Array.english: This tree is very sturdy.
Array.indonesia: Pohon ini sangat kokoh.

Array.name: dialog_GlacialDrone_Talk01_002
Array.english: This mutated state is strange as well. \nIt will take quite some time.
Array.indonesia: Keadaan mutasinya juga aneh. \nIni akan memakan waktu cukup lama.

Array.name: dialog_GlacialDrone_Talk01_003
Array.english: I will give you a call.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan meneleponmu.

Array.name: dialog_GlacialDrone_Talk02_001
Array.english: Let me explain what this drone is capable of.
Array.indonesia: Biarkan aku menjelaskan apa saja yang bisa dilakukan drone ini.

Array.name: dialog_GlacialDrone_Talk02_002
Array.english: It can apply a filter in a video call.
Array.indonesia: Drone ini bisa menerapkan filter dalam panggilan video.

Array.name: dialog_GlacialDrone_Talk02_003
Array.english: <size=38>Like this.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Seperti ini.</size>

Array.name: dialog_GlacialDrone_Talk02_004
Array.english: What do you think? Haha.
Array.indonesia: Bagaimana menurutmu? Haha.

Array.name: dialog_GlacialDrone_Talk02_005
Array.english: Hello, master!♥\nI will always be at your side!
Array.indonesia: Halo, tuan!♥\nAku akan selalu ada di sisimu!

Array.name: dialog_GlacialDrone_Talk02_006
Array.english: <size=50>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>...</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_BaconCall01_001
Array.english: Whew, I barely managed to cut it.\nIt’s very thick and tough.
Array.indonesia: Wah, aku nyaris tidak berhasil memotongnya.\nIni sangat tebal dan keras.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_BaconCall01_002
Array.english: It is large enough now for a person to go through...
Array.indonesia: Sekarang sudah cukup besar untuk dilalui seseorang...

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_BaconCall01_003
Array.english: <size=34>Come down here when you’re ready!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Turunlah ke sini kalau sudah siap!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_BaconCall02_001
Array.english: Finally, I’m in the <color=#F1DC2B>Control Room</color>.
Array.indonesia: Akhirnya, aku sudah berada di <color=#F1DC2B>Ruang Kontrol</color>.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_BaconCall02_002
Array.english: It’s common sense to clear all the missions\nbefore fighting the boss in an RPG.
Array.indonesia: Sudah menjadi hal yang wajar untuk menyelesaikan semua misi\nsebelum melawan bos dalam sebuah game RPG.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_BaconCall02_003
Array.english: This is not an RPG game,\nbut being overly prepared doesn’t hurt.
Array.indonesia: Ini bukan game RPG,\ntapi bersiap-siap secara berlebihan tidak ada salahnya.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_Glacial_Earthquake_001
Array.english: <size=37>Yikes! The ground is rumbling again!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Astaga! Tanah bergetar lagi!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_Glacial_Earthquake_002
Array.english: It’s getting more intense.\nI should quickly go down to the Control Room.
Array.indonesia: Getarannya semakin kuat.\nAku harus segera turun ke Ruang Kontrol.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_EnterControlRoom_001
Array.english: Now, you’ll be able to go in.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang, kamu bisa masuk.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_EnterControlRoom_002
Array.english: I feel hot air coming out from inside.
Array.indonesia: Aku merasakan udara panas keluar dari dalam.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_EnterControlRoom_003
Array.english: Well, that is not a good sign...\nBe careful.
Array.indonesia: Wah, itu bukan pertanda baik...\nHati-hati.

Array.name: dialog_EnterControlRoomTalk01_001
Array.english: Get yourself prepared before diving.
Array.indonesia: Persiapkan dirimu sebelum masuk.

Array.name: dialog_EnterControlRoomTalk02_001
Array.english: Even I, a man with a heart of steel, feel a bit nervous now.
Array.indonesia: Bahkan aku, seorang pria dengan hati baja, merasa sedikit gugup sekarang.

Array.name: dialog_EnterControlRoomTalk02_002
Array.english: May the Pixies guide you...
Array.indonesia: Semoga para Pixies membimbingmu...

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom01_001
Array.english: <size=35>The roots have severely mutated...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Akar-akar itu telah bermutasi parah...</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom02_001
Array.english: That door is blocked by <color=#1DFEAF>tree sap</color>...
Array.indonesia: Pintu itu terhalang oleh <color=#1DFEAF>getah pohon</color>...

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom02_002
Array.english: There should be a way to go inside.
Array.indonesia: Pasti ada cara untuk masuk ke dalam.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom03_001
Array.english: <size=33>Alright, I passed it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Baiklah, aku berhasil melewatinya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom04_001
Array.english: <size=34>No! The path is cut off...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Tidak! Jalannya terputus...!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom04_002
Array.english: Other paths are blocked by the tree sap as well.
Array.indonesia: Jalur-jalur lain juga terhalang oleh getah pohon.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom04_003
Array.english: A sea scorpion and mutated Divine Tree fruit.\nThis is terrible.
Array.indonesia: Seekor kalajengking laut dan buah Pohon Suci yang bermutasi.\nIni mengerikan.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom04_004
Array.english: I must somehow find a way.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus mencari cara.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom05_001
Array.english: Oh! I can pop the <color=#1DFEAF>sap</color> using this mutated Divine Tree fruit!
Array.indonesia: Oh! Aku bisa meletuskan <color=#1DFEAF>getah</color> itu menggunakan buah Pohon Suci yang bermutasi ini!

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom05_002
Array.english: What if I drop this mutated Divine Tree fruit onto the door \nI saw earlier?
Array.indonesia: Bagaimana kalau aku menjatuhkan buah Pohon Ilahi yang bermutasi ini ke pintu \nyang aku lihat tadi?

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom06_001
Array.english: Mm, the hydrothermal vent is blocking the door.
Array.indonesia: Mm, lubang hidrotermal menghalangi pintu.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom06_002
Array.english: <size=33>Is there any way to stop the water jet?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Adakah cara untuk menghentikan semburan air itu?</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom07_001
Array.english: <size=33>Nice! It’s been stopped!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Bagus! Semburannya sudah berhenti!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom07_002
Array.english: I’d better pass it before it moves again.
Array.indonesia: Sebaiknya aku melewatinya sebelum air itu bergerak lagi.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom08_001
Array.english: <size=34>That is a massive crater.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Itu kawah yang sangat besar.</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom09_001
Array.english: The top wall looks loose.
Array.indonesia: Dinding bagian atasnya terlihat longgar.
