Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom09_002
Array.english: It may collapse if the crater erupts a little higher.
Array.indonesia: Dinding itu mungkin akan runtuh jika kawah itu meletus sedikit lebih tinggi.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom10_001
Array.english: <size=34>The way up is now open!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Jalan ke atas sekarang terbuka!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom10_002
Array.english: <size=33>I should bring the <color=#F1DC2B>Divine Tree fruit</color> here with me.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku sebaiknya membawa <color=#F1DC2B>buah Pohon Suci</color> ke sini.</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom11_001
Array.english: <size=33>The door is open!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Pintunya terbuka!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom11_002
Array.english: It looks spooky inside.
Array.indonesia: Di dalam terlihat menyeramkan.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom11_003
Array.english: I should be careful.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus berhati-hati.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom12_001
Array.english: <size=35>Yikes! What are those gross looking eggs?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Astaga! Apa itu telur-telur yang tampak menjijikkan itu?</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom12_002
Array.english: <size=35>Why are they attached to the Divine Tree roots?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Mengapa telur-telur itu menempel pada akar Pohon Ilahi?</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom13_001
Array.english: <size=35>Strange creatures have hatched from the eggs!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Makhluk-makhluk aneh telah menetas dari telur-telur itu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom13_002
Array.english: Wait! Those creatures...\nI have seen them in one of the Sea People’s murals.
Array.indonesia: Tunggu! Makhluk-makhluk itu...\nAku pernah melihatnya di salah satu lukisan dinding Suku Laut.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom13_003
Array.english: Oh, right. Tenzhin once told me that an ancient engineer altered creatures by infusing the Divine Tree energy...
Array.indonesia: Oh, benar. Tenzhin pernah bercerita padaku bahwa seorang insinyur kuno memodifikasi makhluk-makhluk itu dengan menyuntikkan energi Pohon Ilahi...

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom13_004
Array.english: These may be the creatures. They have survived for \nsuch a long period of time, still breeding...
Array.indonesia: Mungkin inilah makhluk-makhluk itu. Mereka telah bertahan hidup selama \nwaktu yang sangat lama, dan masih terus berkembang biak...

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom13_005
Array.english: <size=34>Oh, I don’t know what’s happening.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh, aku tidak tahu apa yang sedang terjadi.</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom14_001
Array.english: <size=34>There are even more eggs here!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ada lebih banyak telur di sini!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom14_002
Array.english: They look like they’re ready to hatch, \nbut I can’t go back now.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya telur-telur itu sudah siap menetas, \ntapi aku tidak bisa kembali sekarang.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom15_001
Array.english: There is a door there...
Array.indonesia: Ada sebuah pintu di sana...

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom15_002
Array.english: If I could melt the mucus covering the door!
Array.indonesia: Andai saja aku bisa melelehkan lendir yang menutupi pintu itu!

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom16_001
Array.english: There is an intact <color=#1DFEAF>Divine Tree fruit</color>!
Array.indonesia: Ada <color=#1DFEAF>buah Pohon Ilahi</color> yang masih utuh!

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom16_002
Array.english: <size=35>Should I put it in that <color=#1DFEAF>Divine Tree fruit device</color>?
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Haruskah aku memasukkannya ke dalam <color=#1DFEAF>alat buah Pohon Ilahi</color> itu?

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom_NoActionAlert_001
Array.english: The eggs may hatch at any moment.\nI must open the door in front of me as quickly as possible.
Array.indonesia: Telur-telur itu bisa menetas kapan saja.\nAku harus membuka pintu di depanku secepat mungkin.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom_NoActionAlert_002
Array.english: I’ll try activating the contraption using the <color=#1DFEAF>Divine Tree fruit</color>!
Array.indonesia: Aku akan mencoba mengaktifkan alat itu menggunakan <color=#1DFEAF>buah Pohon Ilahi</color>!

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom17_001
Array.english: <size=35>Good, the contraption is working!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Bagus, alatnya berfungsi!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom17_002
Array.english: Maybe I can melt the mucus by projecting the light from \nthis Divine Tree fruit?
Array.indonesia: Mungkin aku bisa melelehkan lendir itu dengan memancarkan cahaya dari \nbuah Pohon Ilahi ini?

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom18_001
Array.english: Oh, no! The eggs are hatching!
Array.indonesia: Oh, tidak! Telur-telur itu menetas!

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom18_002
Array.english: I need to get rid of them before I can melt the mucus...
Array.indonesia: Aku harus menyingkirkan mereka dulu sebelum bisa melelehkan lendir...

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom19_001
Array.english: Whew, that was the last of them.
Array.indonesia: Wah, itu yang terakhir.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom19_002
Array.english: <size=34>Let me melt the mucus covering the door!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Biarkan aku melelehkan lendir yang menutupi pintu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom20_001
Array.english: <size=35>Grrr, more eggs are hatching!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Grrr, telur-telur lainnya menetas!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom20_002
Array.english: Again, I need to get rid of them before doing anything else.
Array.indonesia: Lagi-lagi, aku harus menyingkirkan mereka sebelum melakukan hal lain.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom21_001
Array.english: They are growing in number.
Array.indonesia: Jumlah mereka semakin bertambah.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom21_002
Array.english: I must open the door and escape.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus membuka pintu dan melarikan diri.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom22_001
Array.english: <size=34>God! More are hatching!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Astaga! Semakin banyak yang menetas!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom22_002
Array.english: <size=34>This time, I will eliminate them once and for all!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kali ini, aku akan menghabisi mereka sekali dan untuk selamanya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom23_001
Array.english: *Panting* That should be the last of them.
Array.indonesia: *Terengah-engah* Seharusnya itu yang terakhir.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom23_002
Array.english: I must quickly melt the mucus covering the door \nbefore anything else shows up!
Array.indonesia: Aku harus segera melelehkan lendir yang menutupi pintu \nsebelum ada yang lain muncul!

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom24_001
Array.english: <size=34>Nice, the mucus is all gone!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Bagus, lendirnya sudah hilang semua!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom24_002
Array.english: It must be the core of the Control Room over there.
Array.indonesia: Itu pasti inti dari Ruang Kontrol di sana.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom24_003
Array.english: Let’s find out what it is.
Array.indonesia: Ayo cari tahu apa itu.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_FinalRoomEnter01_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ugh… The offspring of that ancient creature is \nclinging to something!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ugh… Keturunan makhluk purba itu \nmenempel pada sesuatu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_FinalRoomEnter01_002
Array.english: <size=34>Is that...\nthe nucleus of the Divine Tree?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Apakah itu...\ninti Pohon Ilahi?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_FinalRoomEnter01_003
Array.english: Could that be why the Divine Tree is acting strange…?
Array.indonesia: Mungkinkah itu sebabnya Pohon Ilahi bertingkah aneh…?

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_FinalRoomEnter01_004
Array.english: <size=34>I'll need to get rid of these creatures first!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku harus menyingkirkan makhluk-makhluk ini dulu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_FinalRoomEnter02_001
Array.english: <size=32>Looks like the Divine Tree's nucleus has stabilized again.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Sepertinya inti Pohon Ilahi sudah stabil kembali.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_FinalRoomEnter02_002
Array.english: I guess this should do it?
Array.indonesia: Kurasa ini sudah cukup?

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_FinalRoomEnter02_003
Array.english: Phew... I hope the earthquakes will stop now.
Array.indonesia: Fiuh... Semoga gempa bumi sudah berhenti sekarang.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_FinalRoomEnter02_004
Array.english: I should start heading back to land…
Array.indonesia: Aku harus mulai kembali ke daratan…

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_BossAppear_001
Array.english: <size=35>Arghh!! What on earth is that?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Arghh!! Apa-apaan itu?!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_BossAppear_002
Array.english: <size=34>Is that... the mom of those creatures I saw earlier?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Apakah itu... induk dari makhluk-makhluk yang kulihat tadi?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_BossAppear_003
Array.english: <size=33>No wonder there were eggs everywhere...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tak heran ada telur di mana-mana...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear01_001
Array.english: <size=33>I tracked you down in case you needed help...\nWhat's going on here?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku melacakmu kalau-kalau kamu butuh bantuan...\nApa yang sedang terjadi di sini?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear01_002
Array.english: That huge monster came out from the lava...
Array.indonesia: Monster raksasa itu muncul dari lava...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear01_003
Array.english: Hmm! I know what that is... I’ve seen it a lot in the texts \nabout the ancient civilization of the Sea People...
Array.indonesia: Hmm! Aku tahu apa itu... Aku sering melihatnya dalam teks-teks \ntentang peradaban kuno Suku Laut...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear01_004
Array.english: <size=35>Looks like the creature known as <color=#1DFEAF>Yawie</color>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Sepertinya makhluk yang dikenal sebagai <color=#1DFEAF>Yawie</color>...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear01_005
Array.english: An ancient beast from legend, still alive...\nand it's massively bigger.
Array.indonesia: Seekor binatang purba dari legenda, yang masih hidup...\ndan ukurannya jauh lebih besar.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear01_006
Array.english: The Sea People elder told me about some old experiment.
Array.indonesia: Seorang tetua Suku Laut pernah bercerita padaku tentang sebuah eksperimen kuno.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear01_007
Array.english: It must have absorbed the Divine Tree and the geothermal energy to get this big!
Array.indonesia: Pasti makhluk itu telah menyerap Pohon Suci dan energi geotermal hingga menjadi sebesar ini!

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear01_008
Array.english: We have to defeat it to stabilize the Divine Tree.
Array.indonesia: Kita harus mengalahkannya untuk menstabilkan Pohon Suci.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear01_009
Array.english: <size=33>Dave, I'm counting on you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Dave, aku mengandalkanmu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear01_010
Array.english: <size=32>What?! \nHow can I possibly defeat such a huge ancient creature?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Apa?! \nBagaimana mungkin aku bisa mengalahkan makhluk purba sebesar itu?!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear01_011
Array.english: <size=34>You took down a dinosaur just a moment ago!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kamu baru saja mengalahkan seekor dinosaurus!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear01_012
Array.english: <size=35>No, that was a different situation! \nI don't even have any weapons or bullets now...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Tidak, itu situasi yang berbeda! \nAku bahkan tidak punya senjata atau peluru sekarang...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear02_001
Array.english: <i><color=#C3C3C3>Zaaap...</color><i>
Array.indonesia: <i><color=#C3C3C3>Zaaap...</color><i>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear02_002
Array.english: Dave, isn't the weapon right here?
Array.indonesia: Dave, bukankah senjatanya ada di sini?

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear02_003
Array.english: Huh? Duff, what are you talking about?
Array.indonesia: Hah? Duff, apa yang kamu bicarakan?

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear02_004
Array.english: I told you...\nthis drone has all kinds of hidden features.
Array.indonesia: Sudah kubilang...\ndrone ini punya berbagai fitur tersembunyi.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear02_005
Array.english: I knew this day would come,\nbut it was a bit sooner than expected.
Array.indonesia: Aku tahu hari ini akan tiba,\ntapi ternyata lebih cepat dari yang kuduga.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear02_006
Array.english: <size=34>I'll input the activation code for the drone's attack mode.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku akan memasukkan kode aktivasi untuk mode serangan drone ini.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear03_001
Array.english: <size=35>Wow! It can do that?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wah! Drone ini bisa melakukan itu?!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear03_002
Array.english: This drone can maintain oxygen levels, fire unlimited bullets,\nand even <color=#F1DC2B>manipulate time</color>.
Array.indonesia: Drone ini bisa menjaga kadar oksigen, menembakkan peluru tanpa batas,\ndan bahkan <color=#F1DC2B>memanipulasi waktu</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear03_003
Array.english: <size=34><color=#F1DC2B>Manipulate time</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34><color=#F1DC2B>Memanipulasi waktu</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear03_004
Array.english: Yes. \n<image=InGame.Aim, preset=ContentsGuide_KR/>If you press this, you can temporarily manipulate time.
Array.indonesia: Ya. \n<image=InGame.Aim, preset=ContentsGuide_KR/>Jika kamu menekan ini, kamu bisa memanipulasi waktu untuk sementara.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear03_005
Array.english: It should give you some time to dodge attacks.\nOf course, you need to be quick.
Array.indonesia: Seharusnya ini memberimu waktu untuk menghindar dari serangan.\nTentu saja, kamu harus cepat.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear03_006
Array.english: This is all the help I can give right now.
Array.indonesia: Ini semua bantuan yang bisa kuberikan saat ini.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear03_007
Array.english: I hope we won't be saying our final goodbyes.\n<color=#ff61e3>GOODBYE-T...</color>, no...
Array.indonesia: Kuharap kita tidak akan mengucapkan selamat tinggal untuk selamanya.\n<color=#ff61e3>SELAMAT TINGGAL-T...</color>, tidak...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear03_008
Array.english: <color=#ff61e3>SEE YOU AGAI-ETERNITY★</color>.
Array.indonesia: <color=#ff61e3>SAMPAI JUMPA LAGI-KETERABADIAN★</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_BattleStart_001
Array.english: <size=33>I can't just run away now, not after getting this far.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku tidak bisa begitu saja kabur sekarang, tidak setelah sampai sejauh ini.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_BattleStart_002
Array.english: <size=34>Alright! Let's deal with this!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Baiklah! Ayo kita hadapi ini!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_Barricade_001
Array.english: <size=35>I can't just run away now!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Aku tidak bisa kabur begitu saja sekarang!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_StellaLaser01_001
Array.english: Our current attack level might not be enough...\nThis enemy's tougher than we expected.
Array.indonesia: Tingkat serangan kita saat ini mungkin tidak cukup...\nMusuh ini lebih tangguh dari yang kita duga.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_StellaLaser01_002
Array.english: I didn't want to go this far but...\nLet's unlock the Limiter.
Array.indonesia: Aku sebenarnya tidak ingin sampai sejauh ini, tapi...\nAyo kita buka Limiter.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_StellaLaser01_003
Array.english: <size=33>Why didn't you do that from the start?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kenapa kamu tidak melakukannya sejak awal?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_StellaLaser01_004
Array.english: <size=34>Who brings out their trump card right at the beginning \nof a game?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Siapa yang mengeluarkan kartu asnya tepat di awal \npermainan?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_StellaLaser01_005
Array.english: <size=34>Just watch this.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Lihat saja ini.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_StellaLaser02_001
Array.english: <size=35>I call this, <color=#ff61e3>Stella★Laser</color>!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Aku menyebutnya, <color=#ff61e3>Stella★Laser</color>!!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_StellaLaser02_002
Array.english: A super-powered laser combining all our tech.\nNever thought we'd use it underwater… hm...
Array.indonesia: Laser super kuat yang menggabungkan semua teknologi kita.\nTidak pernah terpikir kita akan menggunakannya di bawah air… hm...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_StellaLaser02_003
Array.english: <Touch><size=32>Pay attention.\nIf you hold <image=时间图标1, preset=ContentsGuide_KR/>, you can gather Stella energy.</size></Touch><size=32>Pay attention.\nIf you hold <image=InGame.Interaction, preset=ContentsGuide_KR/>, you can gather Stella energy.</size>
Array.indonesia: <Touch><size=32>Perhatikan baik-baik.\nJika kamu menahan tombol <image=时间图标1, preset=ContentsGuide_KR/>, kamu bisa mengumpulkan energi Stella.</size></Touch><size=32>Perhatikan baik-baik.\nJika kamu menahan tombol <image=InGame.Interaction, preset=ContentsGuide_KR/>, kamu bisa mengumpulkan energi Stella.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_StellaLaser02_004
Array.english: <size=32>Let go of the button to fire.\nEasy, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Lepaskan tombol untuk menembak.\nMudah, kan?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_StellaLaser02_005
Array.english: <size=32>But keep in mind that you'll move slower while charging.\nSo be careful.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tapi ingatlah bahwa kamu akan bergerak lebih lambat saat mengisi daya.\nJadi, berhati-hatilah.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_StellaLaser02_006
Array.english: <size=35>Good luck, Dave.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Semoga berhasil, Dave.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_StellaLaser02_007
Array.english: <i><color=#C3C3C3>Zaaap...</color><i>
Array.indonesia: <i><color=#C3C3C3>Zaaap...</color><i>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_StellaLaser02_008
Array.english: A charge and fire laser, huh...
Array.indonesia: Laser yang diisi daya dan ditembakkan, ya...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_StellaLaser02_009
Array.english: <size=35>Great!\nLet's finish with this!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Hebat!\nAyo selesaikan dengan ini!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Mission29_BossRunAway_001
Array.english: <size=35>Oh…! It's trying to run away!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh…! Makhluk itu mencoba melarikan diri!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Mission29_BossRunAway_002
Array.english: <size=33>If we don't kill it now, it will continue to cause problems.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kalau kita tidak membunuhnya sekarang, makhluk itu akan terus menimbulkan masalah.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Mission29_BossRunAway_003
Array.english: <size=35>Let's put an end to this once and for all!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ayo kita akhiri ini sekali dan untuk selamanya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Mission29_BossTired_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh! It seems like it's finally tired!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh! Sepertinya dia akhirnya kelelahan!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Mission29_BossTired_002
Array.english: <size=33>Now’s our chance, Dave!\nWe need to end...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ini saatnya, Dave!\nKita harus mengakhiri...</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_DaveRunAway_001
Array.english: <size=34>Whoa!! That was close…!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wah!! Hampir saja…!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_DaveRunAway_002
Array.english: Look, it’s using its last bit of strength...!
Array.indonesia: Lihat, dia sedang mengerahkan sisa tenaganya...!

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_DaveRunAway_003
Array.english: <size=32>Dave, move to that open path for now!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Dave, pindah ke jalan terbuka itu dulu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_DaveRunAway_004
Array.english: <size=33>It won't be able to hold on much longer!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Dia tidak akan bisa bertahan lama lagi!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_DeadEnd_001
Array.english: <size=35>It's a dead end.\nWhat should I do…?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ini jalan buntu.\nApa yang harus aku lakukan…?!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_BossTrapped_001
Array.english: <size=35>Ha! It's entangled in the Divine Tree!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ha! Makhluk itu terjerat di Pohon Suci!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_BossTrapped_002
Array.english: <size=34>This is a lucky opportunity to finish it off.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ini kesempatan bagus untuk menghabisinya.</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_BossTrapped_003
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm. The drone seems to be malfunctioning.\nI can't pick up the weapon signal.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm. Drone-nya sepertinya mengalami gangguan.\nAku tidak bisa menangkap sinyal senjatanya.</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_BossTrapped_004
Array.english: Well, what should I do?\nIs there anything useful around here?
Array.indonesia: Nah, apa yang harus kulakukan?\nAdakah sesuatu yang berguna di sekitar sini?

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_LaserCannon_001
Array.english: There's a huge <color=#F1DC2B>Divine Tree fruit device</color> over there…!
Array.indonesia: Ada <color=#F1DC2B>perangkat buah Pohon Ilahi</color> yang sangat besar di sana…!

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_LaserCannon_002
Array.english: The Divine Tree fruit seems to have returned to normal.\nWhat if I put it in there and operate it?
Array.indonesia: Buah Pohon Suci sepertinya sudah kembali normal.\nBagaimana kalau aku memasukkannya ke sana dan mengoperasikannya?

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_LaserCannon_003
Array.english: No... It's too big.\nI can't possibly move and aim it all by myself.
Array.indonesia: Tidak... Terlalu besar.\nAku tidak mungkin bisa menggerakkan dan mengarahkannya sendirian.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_MVAppear_001
Array.english: <size=35>Are you alright, human?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Kamu baik-baik saja, manusia?!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_MVAppear_002
Array.english: <size=33>Oh… Sea People…!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh… Orang-orang Laut…!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_MVAppear_003
Array.english: We came down here because you didn't come up even though the Divine Tree was stabilized.
Array.indonesia: Kami turun ke sini karena kamu tidak naik ke atas meskipun Pohon Suci sudah stabil.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_MVAppear_004
Array.english: <size=34>I-Is that <color=#F1DC2B>Yawie</color>!?\nHas it grown that big over this long period of time?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>A-Apakah itu <color=#F1DC2B>Yawie</color>!?\nApakah ia sudah tumbuh sebesar itu selama periode waktu yang begitu lama?!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_MVAppear_005
Array.english: It seems like we need to defeat that creature to end this…
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya kita harus mengalahkan makhluk itu untuk mengakhiri ini…

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_MVAppear_006
Array.english: <size=34>This is our chance while it's tied up! \nLet's finish it off…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ini kesempatan kita selagi dia terikat! \nAyo habisi dia…</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_MVAppear_007
Array.english: That won't be enough. \nUnless we use the <color=#F1DC2B>Divine Tree fruit device</color> over there.
Array.indonesia: Itu tidak akan cukup. \nKecuali kita menggunakan <color=#F1DC2B>perangkat buah Pohon Ilahi</color> yang ada di sana.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_MVAppear_008
Array.english: Well, given my expertise in both physics and math, it seems like we might need to adjust the angle of the device upwards.
Array.indonesia: Nah, mengingat keahlianku dalam fisika dan matematika, sepertinya kita perlu menyesuaikan sudut perangkat itu ke atas.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_MVAppear_009
Array.english: <size=32>Well… that might work,\nbut it looks incredibly heavy.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Yah… itu mungkin berhasil,\ntapi kelihatannya sangat berat.</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_MVAppear_010
Array.english: <size=34>We'll help!! If five of us combine our strengths, \nwe can do it somehow!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kami akan membantu!! Jika kelima dari kami menggabungkan kekuatan, \nkami pasti bisa melakukannya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_MVAppear_011
Array.english: <size=35>You bring the <color=#1DFEAF>Divine Tree fruit</color> and put it in!\nThere's no time!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Kamu bawa <color=#1DFEAF>buah Pohon Ilahi</color> dan masukkan ke dalamnya!\nTidak ada waktu lagi!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_Waiting_001
Array.english: <size=35>What are you doing, human!!\nIt's so heavy, I'm dying here!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Apa yang kamu lakukan, manusia!!\nIni sangat berat, aku hampir mati di sini!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_Waiting_002
Array.english: <size=35>Hurry up and put the <color=#1DFEAF>Divine Tree fruit</color> in the device!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Cepat masukkan <color=#1DFEAF>buah Pohon Ilahi</color> ke dalam alat itu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_LaserReady_001
Array.english: <size=35>Alright! I'm ready!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Baiklah! Aku sudah siap!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_LaserReady_002
Array.english: <size=34>The device is responding!\nIt's time to end our long history!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Perangkatnya merespons!\nSaatnya mengakhiri sejarah panjang kita!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_LaserReady_003
Array.english: <size=34>You pesky nuisance! Take this!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kau benar-benar mengganggu! Terima ini!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_Room2BossDead_001
Array.english: My aim was precise.\nIt won't recover from that state.
Array.indonesia: Tembakanku tepat sasaran.\nDia tidak akan pulih dari keadaan itu.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_Room2BossDead_002
Array.english: Phew… This has really been an incredible journey.
Array.indonesia: Wah… Perjalanan ini sungguh luar biasa.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_Room2BossDead_003
Array.english: You did a great job, human.\nLet’s go back to the Sea People Village and talk.
Array.indonesia: Kamu hebat, manusia.\nAyo kembali ke Desa Suku Laut dan bicara.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_Complete_001
Array.english: The water temperature has stabilized and the Divine Tree fruit is also in good condition.
Array.indonesia: Suhu air sudah stabil dan buah Pohon Suci juga dalam kondisi baik.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_Complete_002
Array.english: The villagers who were ill seem to be slowly improving.
Array.indonesia: Penduduk desa yang sakit tampaknya perlahan-lahan membaik.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_Complete_003
Array.english: We've faced many challenges, but it's a relief that \nwe've managed to overcome them!
Array.indonesia: Kita telah menghadapi banyak tantangan, tapi lega rasanya \nkita berhasil mengatasinya!

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_Complete_004
Array.english: I think the earthquakes on the mainland will stop as well.
Array.indonesia: Kurasa gempa bumi di daratan juga akan berhenti.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_Complete_005
Array.english: <size=34>How about going up and checking the status?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Bagaimana kalau kita naik ke atas dan memeriksa kondisinya?</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_Complete_006
Array.english: Good job, human!\nCome and visit us often!
Array.indonesia: Kerja bagus, manusia!\nSering-seringlah mampir ke sini!

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Boat_001
Array.english: <size=34>It's already nighttime?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Sudah malam?</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Boat_002
Array.english: It's been a long day...
Array.indonesia: Hari ini terasa panjang...

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Boat_003
Array.english: <size=34>I think I'll drop by <color=#F1DC2B>BANCHO SUSHI</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Sepertinya aku akan mampir ke <color=#F1DC2B>BANCHO SUSHI</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_NoPhone_001
Array.english: <size=34>I think I'll drop by <color=#F1DC2B>BANCHO SUSHI</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Sepertinya aku akan mampir ke <color=#F1DC2B>BANCHO SUSHI</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Enter_001
Array.english: <size=34>Hey there, Dave!\nYou're finally back!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hai, Dave!\nKamu akhirnya kembali!</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Enter_002
Array.english: <size=34>Oh?! Everyone's gathered here?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh?! Semua orang sudah berkumpul di sini?</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Enter_003
Array.english: We heard from Dr. Bacon.\nYou've accomplished a lot.
Array.indonesia: Kami mendapat kabar dari Dr. Bacon.\nKamu sudah mencapai banyak hal.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Enter_004
Array.english: You did a good job.\nHow about we all relax today and enjoy some food together?
Array.indonesia: Kamu hebat.\nBagaimana kalau hari ini kita semua bersantai dan menikmati makanan bersama?

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Enter_005
Array.english: Whoa, awesome… \nI was worried I might have to get right back to work.
Array.indonesia: Wah, keren… \nAku sempat khawatir harus langsung kembali bekerja.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Enter_006
Array.english: <size=35>Great! We should all celebrate together!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Bagus! Kita semua harus merayakannya bersama!</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Bacon_01_001
Array.english: I still can't believe what happened.
Array.indonesia: Aku masih nggak percaya apa yang terjadi.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Bacon_01_002
Array.english: Not just the Sea People’s civilization, but the village too...
Array.indonesia: Bukan hanya peradaban Suku Laut, tapi juga desa itu...

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Bacon_01_003
Array.english: <size=35>You even solved their crisis!\nGreat job!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Kamu bahkan berhasil menyelesaikan krisis mereka!\nKerja bagus!</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Bacon_01_004
Array.english: From now on, we should keep this civilization secret.
Array.indonesia: Mulai sekarang, kita harus merahasiakan peradaban ini.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Bacon_01_005
Array.english: They need to maintain the peace they've regained.
Array.indonesia: Mereka perlu menjaga perdamaian yang baru saja mereka peroleh.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Bacon_02_001
Array.english: Ahh... Beer tastes great today.
Array.indonesia: Ahh... Bir rasanya enak banget hari ini.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Bacon_02_002
Array.english: Maybe it's 'cause I'm in a good mood and having a good time, hahaha!!
Array.indonesia: Mungkin karena aku sedang dalam suasana hati yang baik dan bersenang-senang, hahaha!!

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Bancho_01_001
Array.english: I'm sorry I couldn't be of much help, \nI was busy with the shop.
Array.indonesia: Maaf aku tidak bisa banyak membantu, \naku sibuk mengurus toko.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Bancho_01_002
Array.english: What are you talking about, Bancho!
Array.indonesia: Apa yang kamu bicarakan, Bancho!

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Bancho_01_003
Array.english: The Sea People loved your cooking!
Array.indonesia: Suku Laut sangat menyukai masakanmu!

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Bancho_01_004
Array.english: Hmm. If that's the case, I'm glad.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Kalau begitu, aku senang.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Bancho_01_005
Array.english: <size=33>Now there are no more earthquakes, \nlet's get to work!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Sekarang gempa sudah berhenti, \nayo kita mulai bekerja!</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Bancho_02_001
Array.english: I've prepared my best dishes for today.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah menyiapkan hidangan terbaikku untuk hari ini.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Bancho_02_002
Array.english: Isn't this the best I can do on a day like this?
Array.indonesia: Bukankah ini yang terbaik yang bisa aku lakukan di hari seperti ini?

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Yoshie_01_001
Array.english: Dave, you've worked really hard.
Array.indonesia: Dave, kamu sudah bekerja sangat keras.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Yoshie_01_002
Array.english: It's gratifying to see your venture prospering.
Array.indonesia: Senang rasanya melihat usaha kamu berkembang pesat.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Yoshie_01_003
Array.english: That’s largely thanks to you for providing such reliable staff.
Array.indonesia: Itu sebagian besar berkat kamu yang menyediakan staf yang dapat diandalkan.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Yoshie_01_004
Array.english: You must have had your plate full with all kinds of things.\nBut now, I hope you can support Bancho in running the restaurant effectively.
Array.indonesia: Kamu pasti sangat sibuk dengan berbagai hal.\nTapi sekarang, aku harap kamu bisa mendukung Bancho dalam mengelola restoran ini dengan efektif.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Yoshie_01_005
Array.english: Bancho's a bit stubborn and might stir up some problems if left to his own devices!
Array.indonesia: Bancho agak keras kepala dan mungkin akan menimbulkan masalah jika dibiarkan bertindak semaunya!

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Yoshie_02_001
Array.english: The sea breeze is especially refreshing today.
Array.indonesia: Angin laut hari ini terasa sangat menyegarkan.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Yoshie_02_002
Array.english: The food is truly excellent.\nBancho's cooking is surely exceptional!
Array.indonesia: Makanannya benar-benar lezat.\nMasakan Bancho memang luar biasa!

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Cobra_01_001
Array.english: <size=35>Good job, Dave!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Kerja bagus, Dave!</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Cobra_01_002
Array.english: I only opened a shop here because this place has \nplenty of fish! Who knew it had such a secret?
Array.indonesia: Aku membuka toko di sini hanya karena tempat ini \npenuh dengan ikan! Siapa sangka ada rahasia seperti itu?

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Cobra_01_003
Array.english: Well, you’ve solved the problem, \nand my business is booming now…
Array.indonesia: Nah, kamu sudah menyelesaikan masalahnya, \ndan bisnisku sekarang sedang booming…

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Cobra_01_004
Array.english: <size=35>I guess my decision was right after all, hahaha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Sepertinya keputusanku memang tepat, hahaha!</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Cobra_01_005
Array.english: ...It was a fun experience.\nComing here was a good idea.
Array.indonesia: ...Pengalaman yang seru.\nDatang ke sini adalah ide yang bagus.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Cobra_01_006
Array.english: I’m thinking about seeking out another adventure.\nWhat do you think?
Array.indonesia: Aku sedang berpikir untuk mencari petualangan lain.\nBagaimana menurutmu?

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Cobra_01_007
Array.english: Let's just rest for now, Cobra.
Array.indonesia: Ayo istirahat dulu saja, Cobra.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Cobra_02_001
Array.english: It's peaceful now without those pesky pirates!
Array.indonesia: Sekarang sudah tenang tanpa para bajak laut yang menyebalkan itu!

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Ellie_01_001
Array.english: First time seeing you in the shop, huh?
Array.indonesia: Ini pertama kalinya aku melihatmu di toko, ya?

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Ellie_01_002
Array.english: Well… I just finished submitting my paper…\nSo I'm a bit free.
Array.indonesia: Yah… aku baru saja selesai menyerahkan makalahku…\nJadi aku agak punya waktu luang.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Ellie_01_003
Array.english: Good, I'm glad for you.
Array.indonesia: Bagus, aku senang mendengarnya.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Ellie_01_004
Array.english: Eh? That <color=#1DFEAF>eco-bag</color> there? I haven't seen it before.
Array.indonesia: Eh? <color=#1DFEAF>tas ramah lingkungan</color> itu? Aku belum pernah melihatnya sebelumnya.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Ellie_01_005
Array.english: <size=33>Ahaha! You have sharp eyes!\nIt's the reward for maxing out the <color=#72ff0a>Ecowatcher</color> level!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ahaha! Matamu tajam sekali!\nItu hadiah karena sudah mencapai level maksimal <color=#72ff0a>Ecowatcher</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Ellie_01_006
Array.english: <size=33>It’s a service that prints the faces of users committed to environmental protection, on a bag!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Itu layanan yang mencetak wajah pengguna yang berkomitmen terhadap pelestarian lingkungan, di atas tas!</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Ellie_01_007
Array.english: You've really been putting a lot of work in since you got \nsome free time. I can't fall behind.
Array.indonesia: Kamu benar-benar sudah bekerja keras sejak punya \nwaktu luang. Aku nggak boleh ketinggalan.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Ellie_02_001
Array.english: Maybe I should get more into diving?\nIt seems like a lot of fun.
Array.indonesia: Mungkin aku harus lebih serius belajar menyelam?\nSepertinya seru banget.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Ellie_02_002
Array.english: That's a great idea.\nIf you need help, I can teach you.
Array.indonesia: Itu ide yang bagus.\nKalau butuh bantuan, aku bisa ngajarin kamu.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Ellie_02_003
Array.english: Nah… If I'm going to learn, I might as well learn from \na cool instructor.
Array.indonesia: Ah… Kalau mau belajar, mendingan aku belajar dari \ninstruktur yang keren.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Ellie_02_004
Array.english: <size=35>Umm...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Umm...</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Otto_01_001
Array.english: <size=35>Hahaha!! A true feast!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Hahaha!! Benar-benar pesta yang seru!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Otto_01_002
Array.english: You're always so busy, we've hardly had the time to chat…
Array.indonesia: Kamu selalu sibuk sekali, kita hampir tidak punya waktu untuk ngobrol…

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Otto_01_003
Array.english: Now that things are calmer, I'll have plenty of time to share with you some more of my stories.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang situasinya sudah lebih tenang, aku akan punya banyak waktu untuk berbagi lebih banyak cerita dengamu.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Otto_01_004
Array.english: Um, sir…
Array.indonesia: Um, Pak…

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Otto_01_005
Array.english: Back in my diving days, \nI was mostly into free diving.
Array.indonesia: Dulu saat masih menyelam, \naku lebih sering melakukan penyelaman bebas.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Otto_01_006
Array.english: And I wore the necklace my father gave me!!\nBut Barracudas have a tendency to attack anything that shines!
Array.indonesia: Dan aku memakai kalung yang diberikan ayahku!!\nTapi barakuda cenderung menyerang apa pun yang berkilau!

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Otto_01_007
Array.english: <size=33>Out of nowhere, a school of barracudas came at me!!\nEven worse, I didn't even have a harpoon that day!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tiba-tiba, segerombolan barakuda menyerangku!!\nYang lebih parah lagi, aku bahkan tidak membawa tombak pada hari itu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Otto_01_008
Array.english: I figured fleeing might be more dangerous,\nso I swam straight toward the barracudas...
Array.indonesia: Aku pikir melarikan diri mungkin lebih berbahaya,\njadi aku berenang langsung ke arah barakuda-barakuda itu...

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Otto_01_009
Array.english: <size=37>...Whoa! I think the ground just shook!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>...Whoa! Rasanya tanah baru saja bergetar!</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Otto_01_010
Array.english: <size=34>Huh?! Eh?! I didn't feel anything!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hah?! Eh?! Aku tidak merasakan apa-apa!</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Otto_02_001
Array.english: Now that the big event's over, let's have a beer sometime soon,\nand pick up where we left off, haha.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang acara besarnya sudah selesai, ayo kita minum bir bareng-bareng nanti,\ndan lanjutkan obrolan kita yang tertunda, haha.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Udo_01_001
Array.english: Hey, Dave! Your assistance has really helped elevate \nmy status at the company.
Array.indonesia: Hei, Dave! Bantuanmu benar-benar membantu meningkatkan \nstatusku di perusahaan.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Udo_01_002
Array.english: We have a new reporter now, which lightens my load a bit.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang kita punya reporter baru, yang sedikit meringankan beban kerjaku.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Udo_01_003
Array.english: So I can even afford to join in these evening gatherings.
Array.indonesia: Jadi, aku bahkan bisa ikut dalam pertemuan-pertemuan malam ini.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Udo_01_004
Array.english: <size=33>Since I cannot drink beer, I stick to non-alcoholic drinks, though. Haha.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Karena aku tidak bisa minum bir, aku tetap memilih minuman non-alkohol saja. Haha.</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Udo_01_005
Array.english: I'm happy to hear that I was helpful. So, you don't need me\nto help with the reporting anymore, right?
Array.indonesia: Senang mendengar bahwa aku bisa membantu. Jadi, kamu tidak butuh aku\nlagi untuk membantu dalam pelaporan, kan?

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Udo_01_006
Array.english: <size=34>What are you talking about?! \nI still don't know how to dive!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Apa yang kamu bicarakan?! \nAku masih belum tahu cara menyelam!</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Udo_01_007
Array.english: <size=35>Haha! If there's anything I need help with, \nI'll come looking for you.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Haha! Kalau ada yang perlu dibantu, \naku akan mencarimu.</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Udo_02_001
Array.english: Ah, the reason I can't drink beer?
Array.indonesia: Ah, alasan aku tidak bisa minum bir?

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Udo_02_002
Array.english: There was an unfortunate incident at a company dinner where I got too drunk and even spilled on the face of my chief editor...
Array.indonesia: Ada insiden yang tidak menyenangkan saat makan malam perusahaan, di mana aku mabuk berat dan bahkan menumpahkan bir ke wajah pemimpin redaksiku...

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Udo_02_003
Array.english: <size=35>Ah…! Forget what I just said!! I simply have a low tolerance for alcohol, haha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ah…! Lupakan saja yang baru saja aku katakan!! Aku hanya tidak tahan minum alkohol, haha!</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Sato_01_001
Array.english: <size=35>Hohoho!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Hohoho!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Sato_01_002
Array.english: Ah… Sato, you made it too?
Array.indonesia: Ah… Sato, kamu juga datang?

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Sato_01_003
Array.english: Haha! I heard you've been venturing into Glacial Area to \ncollect Marinca, and I thought I'd show some support.
Array.indonesia: Haha! Aku dengar kamu sudah menjelajah ke Area Gletser untuk \nmengumpulkan Marinca, jadi aku pikir aku akan memberikan dukungan.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Sato_01_004
Array.english: Well… That's not quite true but...
Array.indonesia: Yah… Itu tidak sepenuhnya benar, tapi...

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Sato_01_005
Array.english: Haha. Thanks to you, my world ranking keeps getting \nbetter and better.
Array.indonesia: Haha. Berkat kamu, peringkat dunianya terus \nmeningkat.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Sato_01_006
Array.english: Now that the big event is behind us, \nlet's see about gathering the remaining Marinca.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang acara besarnya sudah lewat, \nayo kita cari Marinca yang tersisa.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Sato_01_007
Array.english: Oops, just remembered, I forgot to turn off the lights \nafter <color=#72ff0a>GYAO!</color> went to sleep!
Array.indonesia: Ups, baru ingat, aku lupa mematikan lampu \nsetelah <color=#72ff0a>GYAO!</color> tidur!

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Sato_02_001
Array.english: I'm in a good mood today, the drinks are going down smooth.
Array.indonesia: Hari ini aku lagi senang, minuman ini terasa nikmat.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Sato_02_002
Array.english: I have to get to <color=#1DFEAF>the gym</color> the first thing tomorrow morning.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus ke <color=#1DFEAF>gym</color> besok pagi-pagi sekali.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Sato_02_003
Array.english: Uh oh… That sounds risky...
Array.indonesia: Uh oh… Kedengarannya berisiko...

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Sato_02_004
Array.english: What? I've been feeling stiff lately, so I've been going to \nthe gym for some exercise. Is there something wrong?
Array.indonesia: Apa? Aku merasa kaku belakangan ini, jadi aku sering ke \ngym untuk berolahraga. Ada yang salah?

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Sato_02_005
Array.english: Haha… got it. Just remember not to drink too much!
Array.indonesia: Haha… oke. Ingat saja jangan minum terlalu banyak!

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Vincent_01_001
Array.english: Oh, Vincent.\nAre you here alone tonight?
Array.indonesia: Oh, Vincent.\nKamu di sini sendirian malam ini?

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Vincent_01_002
Array.english: I didn't come here to rate your restaurant today, \nso don't stress.Take it easy.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak datang ke sini untuk menilai restoranmu hari ini, \njadi jangan stres.Santai saja.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Vincent_01_003
Array.english: When I dine in peace, I can savor the intricate flavors more. \nIt's delicious.
Array.indonesia: Saat aku makan dengan tenang, aku bisa lebih menikmati cita rasa yang rumit ini. \nEnak sekali.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Vincent_01_004
Array.english: I'm happy to hear that.
Array.indonesia: Senang mendengarnya.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Vincent_01_005
Array.english: Hmm… I guess my prejudices have worn off…\nbut there's no denying that there has been a slight change to the taste.
Array.indonesia: Hmm… sepertinya prasangkaku sudah hilang…\ntapi tidak bisa dipungkiri bahwa ada sedikit perubahan pada rasanya.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Vincent_01_006
Array.english: Really? The taste changed?
Array.indonesia: Benarkah? Rasanya berubah?

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Vincent_01_007
Array.english: It’s a bit...\nsmoother, you could say it’s softer.
Array.indonesia: Rasanya sedikit...\nlebih halus, bisa dibilang lebih lembut.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Vincent_01_008
Array.english: Before, the dishes were brimming with the chef's strong-willed style, but now it feels more accommodating to the consumer.
Array.indonesia: Dulu, hidangan-hidangan itu dipenuhi dengan gaya koki yang tegas, tapi sekarang terasa lebih mengakomodasi selera konsumen.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Vincent_01_009
Array.english: Interesting. So that translates into the taste as well.
Array.indonesia: Menarik. Jadi, hal itu juga tercermin dalam rasanya.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Vincent_01_010
Array.english: Well, that might just be my perception.
Array.indonesia: Yah, mungkin itu hanya persepsiku saja.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Vincent_02_001
Array.english: It's a bit difficult to truly savor the dishes when filming.
Array.indonesia: Agak sulit untuk benar-benar menikmati hidangan saat sedang syuting.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Vincent_02_002
Array.english: Before a camera, I end up scrutinizing everything to deliver \na solid critique.
Array.indonesia: Di depan kamera, aku akhirnya memeriksa semuanya dengan teliti untuk memberikan \nkritik yang tajam.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Vincent_02_003
Array.english: Heh… I’m feeling particularly relaxed today. Very relaxing.
Array.indonesia: Heh… Aku merasa sangat santai hari ini. Sangat santai.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Sammy_01_001
Array.english: It's been a while, BANCHO SUSHI.
Array.indonesia: Sudah lama tidak ke sini, BANCHO SUSHI.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Sammy_01_002
Array.english: How are you, Sammy? Are you enjoying your life here?
Array.indonesia: Apa kabar, Sammy? Apakah kamu menikmati hidupmu di sini?

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Sammy_01_003
Array.english: <size=33>You know it! There are times when I get a bit bored… \nbut it's also incredibly inspiring, YO.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kamu tahu banget! Kadang-kadang aku memang agak bosan… \ntapi ini juga sangat menginspirasi, YO.</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Sammy_01_004
Array.english: The new song that I recently released online has been getting great feedback, you know.
Array.indonesia: Lagu baru yang baru-baru ini aku rilis secara online mendapat tanggapan yang bagus, lho.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Sammy_01_005
Array.english: So, you’re still making music, huh?
Array.indonesia: Jadi, kamu masih bikin musik, ya?

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Sammy_01_006
Array.english: For sure! The sound of a hoe hitting the ground, \nthe clucking of a hen, it's all just one big BEAT to me, YO.
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja! Suara cangkul yang menghantam tanah, \nkokok ayam betina, semuanya itu hanyalah satu BEAT besar bagiku, YO.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Sammy_02_001
Array.english: These sudden earthquakes had been scaring the chickens and causing me many sleepless nights.
Array.indonesia: Gempa bumi mendadak ini telah membuat ayam-ayam ketakutan dan membuatku sering susah tidur.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Sammy_02_002
Array.english: I was thinking about writing a song about it, but I'm starting to think I should change the theme yo!
Array.indonesia: Aku sempat berpikir untuk menulis lagu tentang hal itu, tapi sekarang aku mulai berpikir sebaiknya aku ganti temanya, yo!

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Duff_01_001
Array.english: Why didn't he come in person…?
Array.indonesia: Kenapa dia nggak datang langsung…?

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Duff_01_002
Array.english: <size=35>Because I am waiting for an important parcel today.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Karena aku sedang menunggu kiriman penting hari ini.</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Duff_01_003
Array.english: I've been inspired from afar by your bravery, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Aku terinspirasi dari jauh oleh keberanianmu, Dave.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Duff_01_004
Array.english: The way you fought tirelessly to save the Sea People Village...
Array.indonesia: Cara kamu berjuang tanpa lelah untuk menyelamatkan Desa Suku Laut...

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Duff_01_005
Array.english: If you were a beautiful girl, I might've joined your fandom.
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu seorang gadis cantik, mungkin aku sudah bergabung dengan fandom-mu.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Duff_01_006
Array.english: I'll pour all my energy into weapon research to prepare for \nany upcoming crises.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan mencurahkan seluruh energiku untuk penelitian senjata guna bersiap menghadapi \nkrisis apa pun yang akan datang.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Duff_01_007
Array.english: As your “colleague,” I'm counting on your continued efforts, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Sebagai “rekan”mu, aku mengandalkan usaha terus-menerusmu, Dave.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Duff_01_008
Array.english: Hmm... All right.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Baiklah.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Duff_02_001
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>If there's an earthquake while I'm gone... \nmy toy figure display will be ruined…</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Kalau ada gempa saat aku pergi... \nkoleksi figur mainanku bakal hancur…</color>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Duff_02_002
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>That’s why I can't leave the house empty…</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Itulah mengapa aku tidak bisa meninggalkan rumah dalam keadaan kosong…</color>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Duff_02_003
Array.english: <size=33>...That's the reason?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...Thatu alasannya?</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Duff_02_004
Array.english: <size=34>What, you've been eavesdropping?\nWould you please act like a gentleman?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Apa, kamu sedang menguping?\nBisakah kamu bersikap seperti pria sejati?!</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Lois_01_001
Array.english: Although it was quite the roller coaster, I've learned so much from Bancho.
Array.indonesia: Meskipun perjalanannya cukup naik-turun, aku belajar banyak dari Bancho.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Lois_01_002
Array.english: I wonder if I was too focused on fancy food and missed out \non what true 'flavor' is...
Array.indonesia: Aku bertanya-tanya apakah aku terlalu fokus pada makanan mewah dan melewatkan \napa itu ‘rasa’ yang sesungguhnya...

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Lois_01_003
Array.english: <size=34>But, I still can't get myself to eat that grilled shark head over there.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Tapi, aku tetap tidak bisa memaksa diri untuk makan kepala hiu panggang di sana.</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Lois_01_004
Array.english: Anyhow, please keep running the branch smoothly \nand sharing more wonderful dishes with people, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun, tolong terus kelola cabang ini dengan lancar \ndan bagikan lebih banyak hidangan lezat kepada orang-orang, Dave.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Lois_02_001
Array.english: Bancho's cooking seems more fitting for this kind of open beachfront.
Array.indonesia: Masakan Bancho sepertinya lebih cocok untuk tempat terbuka di tepi pantai seperti ini.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Lois_02_002
Array.english: Maybe the sea breeze is part of the recipe. *Giggles*
Array.indonesia: Mungkin angin laut adalah bagian dari resepnya. *Tertawa kecil*

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Dave_001
Array.english: Phew…\nIt was a lot tougher than I thought, but…
Array.indonesia: Wah…\nTernyata jauh lebih sulit dari yang kubayangkan, tapi…

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Dave_002
Array.english: I met a lot of nice people in the end.
Array.indonesia: Pada akhirnya, aku bertemu banyak orang yang baik.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Dave_003
Array.english: Looking back, it was a fun adventure.
Array.indonesia: Kalau dipikir-pikir lagi, itu adalah petualangan yang seru.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Dave_004
Array.english: I never would've visited a place like the Sea People Village \nin my life, were I not given the opportunity.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak akan pernah mengunjungi tempat seperti Desa Sea People \nseumur hidupku, kalau saja aku tidak diberi kesempatan ini.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Dave_005
Array.english: Okay, let's relax and…
Array.indonesia: Oke, mari bersantai dan…

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Dave_006
Array.english: <size=37>go for another exciting dive!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>melakukan penyelaman seru lainnya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss005_enter_01_001
Array.english: <size=35>Phew...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wah...</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss005_enter_01_002
Array.english: That thing should be too big to get out.\nNow, I just have to escape with this current…
Array.indonesia: Makhluk itu pasti terlalu besar untuk bisa keluar.\nSekarang, aku hanya perlu melarikan diri mengikuti arus ini…

Array.name: dialog_boss005_enter_02_001
Array.english: <size=38>No... No way!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Tidak... Tidak mungkin!!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss005_enter_02_002
Array.english: <size=35>I'm going to die if I get caught...\nI need to run!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Aku akan mati jika tertangkap...\nAku harus lari!</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss005_Found_LightBerry_01_001
Array.english: Something doesn’t seem right...\nI think it’s preparing an attack... What do I do?
Array.indonesia: Ada yang tidak beres...\nKurasa makhluk itu sedang bersiap menyerang... Apa yang harus aku lakukan?

Array.name: dialog_boss005_Found_LightBerry_02_001
Array.english: <size=33>Wait... That’s the <color=#1DFEAF>Divine Tree fruit</color>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tunggu... Itu adalah <color=#1DFEAF>buah Pohon Suci</color>...</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss005_Found_LightBerry_02_002
Array.english: <size=33>It hates light, so if we hit that...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Makhluk itu benci cahaya, jadi kalau kita menyerang bagian itu...!</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss005_deadend_01_001
Array.english: <size=38>Ugh! It’s a dead end!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Ugh! Ini jalan buntu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss005_deadend_01_002
Array.english: <size=35>There’s no way out!\nMy goodness!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Tidak ada jalan keluar!\nAstaga!</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss005_turn_vertical_01_001
Array.english: <size=36>Phew... That was a close call.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Wah... Baru saja lolos dari bahaya.</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss005_turn_vertical_01_002
Array.english: <size=32>... I think it fainted...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>... Sepertinya makhluk itu pingsan...</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss005_turn_vertical_02_001
Array.english: A path opened up after we hit it earlier.
Array.indonesia: Sebuah jalan terbuka setelah kita memukulnya tadi.

Array.name: dialog_boss005_turn_vertical_02_002
Array.english: <size=34>I should escape before it awakes!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku harus kabur sebelum makhluk itu bangun!</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss005_Start_vertical_001
Array.english: <size=38>It’s awake already?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Dia sudah bangun?!</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss005_Start_vertical_002
Array.english: <size=35>What a disgusting creature.\nI have to get away!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Makhluk menjijikkan.\nAku harus kabur!</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss005_turn_horizontal_001
Array.english: Did I lose the creature?
Array.indonesia: Apakah aku berhasil menghilang dari makhluk itu?

Array.name: dialog_boss005_turn_horizontal_002
Array.english: <size=35>... What is this vibration...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>. .. Getaran apa ini...?</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss005_Start_horizontal_001
Array.english: I shouldn’t let my guard down...
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak boleh lengah...

Array.name: dialog_boss005_Start_horizontal_002
Array.english: The current is flowing back to the right.\nThere should be a way out nearby.
Array.indonesia: Arus mengalir kembali ke kanan.\nSeharusnya ada jalan keluar di dekat sini.

Array.name: dialog_boss005_Start_horizontal_003
Array.english: <size=35>I should run before it awakes!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Aku harus lari sebelum makhluk itu bangun!</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss005_horizontal_end_001
Array.english: <size=35>Ah! There’s light!\nI’ll be able to escape that way!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ah! Ada cahaya!\nAku bisa melarikan diri lewat sana!!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss000_enter_001
Array.english: <size=36>There it is!\nThe <color=#1DFEAF>Pink Delivery Box</color> with Leahs-chan inside!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Itu dia!\n<color=#1DFEAF>Kotak Pengiriman Merah Muda</color> dengan Leahs-chan di dalamnya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss000_enter_002
Array.english: <size=36>Wait, more importantly...\nLook at that Giant Squid!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Tunggu, yang lebih penting...\nLihat Cumi-cumi Raksasa itu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss000_enter_003
Array.english: So that’s our culprit. I guess it knows a good thing\nwhen it sees it, even though it’s just a squid.
Array.indonesia: Jadi itulah pelakunya. Sepertinya dia tahu hal yang bagus\nbegitu melihatnya, meskipun dia hanya seekor cumi-cumi.

Array.name: dialog_boss000_enter_004
Array.english: <size=34>It seems to be asleep...\nSneak up and bring it back quietly.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Sepertinya dia sedang tidur...\nPendekati diam-diam dan bawa pulang dengan tenang.</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss000_enter_005
Array.english: Ugh... I’ve come too far to go back empty-handed...
Array.indonesia: Ugh... Aku sudah terlalu jauh untuk pulang dengan tangan kosong...

Array.name: dialog_boss000_enter_006
Array.english: I guess I’ll try approaching quietly...
Array.indonesia: Kurasa aku akan mencoba mendekatinya dengan diam-diam...

Array.name: dialog_boss000_start_001
Array.english: <size=37>Ugh... It’s awake!\nI need to get out of here!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Ugh... Dia bangun!\nAku harus segera keluar dari sini!</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss000_start_002
Array.english: <size=35>Dave! \nDon’t tell me you’re going to chicken out!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Dave! \nJangan bilang kamu bakal mundur!</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss000_start_003
Array.english: <size=35>Use the <color=#F1DC2B>Gun</color> I gave you.\nThe Harpoon will be of no use.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Gunakan <color=#F1DC2B>Pistol</color> yang kuberikan padamu.\nHarpoon tidak akan berguna.</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss000_start_004
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>Leahs-chan... Here we come!</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Leahs-chan... Kita datang!</color>

Array.name: dialog_boss000_exit_001
Array.english: <size=34>Yes. That’s the one!\nCome back up to the boat!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ya. Itu dia!\nKembali ke perahu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss000_exit_002
Array.english: <size=38><color=#C3C3C3>I’m so relieved... Leahs-chan...</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38><color=#C3C3C3>Aku lega sekali... Leahs-chan...</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss_Unlock_001
Array.english: <size=46>Ho!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=46>Ho!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss_Unlock_002
Array.english: Long time no see, Sato.\nHave you been well?
Array.indonesia: Lama tidak bertemu, Sato.\nApa kabar?

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss_Unlock_003
Array.english: Of course. My passion never dies.
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja. Semangatku tak pernah padam.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss_Unlock_004
Array.english: Hey... Have you ever heard about the <color=#1DFEAF>Super Rare Boss Card</color>?
Array.indonesia: Hei... Pernahkah kamu mendengar tentang <color=#1DFEAF>Kartu Bos Super Langka</color>?

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss_Unlock_005
Array.english: Umm... I have no idea, but it does sound very rare.
Array.indonesia: Umm... Aku nggak tahu, tapi kedengarannya sangat langka.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss_Unlock_006
Array.english: Ugh! You haven’t heard of the <color=#1DFEAF>Super Rare Boss Card</color>, a Marinca collector’s greatest wish?
Array.indonesia: Ugh! Kamu belum pernah dengar tentang <color=#1DFEAF>Kartu Bos Super Langka</color>, impian terbesar para kolektor Marinca?

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss_Unlock_007
Array.english: It’s a legendary card that gets activated\nwhen catching a large creature that isn’t common in ordinary weather...
Array.indonesia: Itu adalah kartu legendaris yang aktif\nsaat menangkap makhluk besar yang nggak biasa ditemui dalam cuaca biasa...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss_Unlock_008
Array.english: <size=34>The card’s signal was detected\nagain at this Giant Blue Hole!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Sinyal kartu itu terdeteksi\nlagi di Giant Blue Hole ini!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss_Unlock_009
Array.english: My investigation has revealed that you’ll be able to catch the creature...\non <color=#1DFEAF>the night of a storm</color>...
Array.indonesia: Hasil penyelidikan saya menunjukkan bahwa kamu akan bisa menangkap makhluk itu...\npada <color=#1DFEAF>malam saat badai</color>...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss_Unlock_010
Array.english: These clouds suggest a storm could be coming in the next few days.
Array.indonesia: Awan-awan ini menandakan kemungkinan akan ada badai dalam beberapa hari ke depan.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss_Unlock_011
Array.english: I’ll keep checking the weather and get in touch.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan terus memantau cuaca dan menghubungimu.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss_Unlock_012
Array.english: I’ll collect these super rare cards and help you become\nthe Advanced Marinca Collector that you wanted to be!
Array.indonesia: Aku akan mengumpulkan kartu-kartu super langka ini dan membantumu menjadi\nKolektor Marinca Tingkat Lanjut seperti yang kamu inginkan!

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss_Unlock_013
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>I don’t think I ever said that I wanted that...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Sepertinya aku tidak pernah bilang kalau aku menginginkan itu...</color>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss_Unlock_014
Array.english: <size=34>Then... I’ll be in touch soon, so look forward to it!\nHo ho!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kalau begitu... aku akan segera menghubungimu, jadi nantikan saja!\nHo ho!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss01_Start_001
Array.english: <size=35>Ho! The storm is getting rowdy...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ho! Badai ini semakin kencang...!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss01_Start_002
Array.english: Tonight, the creature that gives the\n<color=#1DFEAF>Super Rare Boss Card</color> will most likely appear...
Array.indonesia: Malam ini, makhluk yang memberikan \n<color=#1DFEAF>Kartu Bos Super Langka</color> kemungkinan besar akan muncul...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss01_Start_003
Array.english: <size=35>Doesn’t it excite you as a Marinca collector?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Bukankah itu membuatmu bersemangat sebagai kolektor Marinca?!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss01_Start_004
Array.english: Not really...
Array.indonesia: Tidak juga...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss01_Start_005
Array.english: Ho... Ho! If you go in the evening, \nyou’ll see the <color=#F1DC2B>vortex</color> that was created by the storm.
Array.indonesia: Ho... Ho! Jika kamu pergi pada malam hari, \nkamu akan melihat <color=#F1DC2B>pusaran</color> yang terbentuk akibat badai.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss01_Start_006
Array.english: You’ll find the creature once you go inside the <color=#F1DC2B>vortex</color>.
Array.indonesia: Kamu akan menemukan makhluk itu begitu masuk ke dalam <color=#F1DC2B>pusaran</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss01_Start_007
Array.english: I would go if my diving skills were better.\nIt’s too bad...
Array.indonesia: Aku pasti akan pergi jika kemampuan menyelamku lebih baik.\nSayang sekali...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss01_Start_008
Array.english: <size=36>Then, I wish you luck!\nHo ho ho!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Kalau begitu, semoga kamu beruntung!\nHo ho ho!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss_01_PickUpItem_001
Array.english: A piece of the Hermit Crab pincer came off.
Array.indonesia: Sepotong capit Kepiting Pertapa terlepas.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss_01_PickUpItem_002
Array.english: Should I pick up a piece?
Array.indonesia: Haruskah aku mengambil potongannya?

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss01_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=33>Wha-a?! You…found the <color=#1DFEAF>Super Rare Boss Card!?</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>A-a apa?! Kamu… menemukan <color=#1DFEAF>Kartu Bos Super Langka!?</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss01_Complete_002
Array.english: Astounding…\nYou must be a natural born Marinca collector….
Array.indonesia: Luar biasa…\nKamu pasti kolektor Marinca sejati….

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss01_Complete_003
Array.english: The sea was unrelenting…with all those terrifying sea creatures…\nThat was serious stuff.
Array.indonesia: Lautnya sangat ganas… dengan semua makhluk laut yang menakutkan itu…\nItu benar-benar serius.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss01_Complete_004
Array.english: Haha! \nMeh. That's no big deal compared to this awesome <color=#1DFEAF>Super Rare Boss Card</color>!
Array.indonesia: Haha! \nAh, biasa saja. Itu bukan apa-apa dibandingkan dengan <color=#1DFEAF>Kartu Bos Super Langka</color> yang keren ini!

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss01_Complete_005
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>But, I went through all that….</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Tapi, aku sudah melalui semua itu….</color>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss01_Complete_006
Array.english: …Now, tap 'Share Card with Friends' like this…
Array.indonesia: …Sekarang, ketuk 'Bagikan Kartu ke Teman' seperti ini…

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss01_Complete_007
Array.english: <size=35>Alright. There we go!\nKeep up the good work! Ho ho!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oke. Selesai!\nTeruslah berjuang! Ho ho!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss01_Restart_001
Array.english: <size=35>Ho! The storm is getting rowdy again!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ho! Badai mulai mengamuk lagi!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss01_Restart_002
Array.english: About the Super Rare Boss Card...\nHow about we try to get it again?
Array.indonesia: Soal Kartu Bos Super Langka...\nBagaimana kalau kita coba dapatkan lagi?

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss01_Restart_003
Array.english: You’ll be able to meet the creature by going into the\n<color=#F1DC2B>vortex</color> that was created by the storm.
Array.indonesia: Kamu bisa bertemu makhluk itu dengan masuk ke dalam\n<color=#F1DC2B>pusaran</color> yang terbentuk akibat badai.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss01_Restart_004
Array.english: <size=36>Don’t lose the opportunity,\nMarinca collector!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Jangan lewatkan kesempatan ini,\nkolektor Marinca!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Start_001
Array.english: <size=37>*Pants*</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>*Huff*</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Start_002
Array.english: What’s going on? You’re riding a raft...
Array.indonesia: Ada apa ini? Kamu sedang menaiki rakit...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Start_003
Array.english: My name is <color=#F1DC2B>Clara</color>.\nI didn’t expect to see a person on the sea in this storm.
Array.indonesia: Namaku <color=#F1DC2B>Clara</color>.\nAku tidak menyangka akan melihat seseorang di laut dalam badai seperti ini.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Start_004
Array.english: Have you seen a Great White Shark around here, \nyoung one?
Array.indonesia: Apakah kamu melihat Hiu Putih Besar di sekitar sini, \nnak?

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Start_005
Array.english: Nope. I’ve seen many sharks but no Great White.
Array.indonesia: Tidak. Aku sudah melihat banyak hiu, tapi tidak ada Hiu Putih Besar.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Start_006
Array.english: <size=35>That can’t be true! <color=#F1DC2B>Klaus</color>, the enemy of my husband \nmust be around somewhere!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Itu tidak mungkin benar! <color=#F1DC2B>Klaus</color>, musuh suamiku \npasti ada di sekitar sini!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Start_007
Array.english: All traces lead to this place for sure.
Array.indonesia: Semua jejak pasti mengarah ke tempat ini.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Start_008
Array.english: Klaus is known to be sighted only on stormy nights.
Array.indonesia: Klaus dikenal hanya muncul pada malam-malam badai.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Start_009
Array.english: On a stormy night just like this, it took my husband... \nthat was 36 years ago.
Array.indonesia: Pada malam badai seperti ini, hiu itu merenggut suami saya... \nitu terjadi 36 tahun yang lalu.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Start_010
Array.english: It will appear here for sure.\nEverything leads me to this place.
Array.indonesia: Hiu itu pasti akan muncul di sini.\nSegala sesuatu mengarah ke tempat ini.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Start_011
Array.english: By the way, I’ve dived several times and I noticed \nthat the terrain changed every time.
Array.indonesia: Ngomong-ngomong, saya sudah menyelam beberapa kali dan saya perhatikan \nbahwa medan di bawah air berubah setiap kali.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Start_012
Array.english: Oh, you’re not mistaken.\nThe sea around here is very confusing for newcomers.
Array.indonesia: Oh, kamu tidak salah.\nLaut di sekitar sini sangat membingungkan bagi pendatang baru.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Start_013
Array.english: Gosh, I just don’t have enough time to get used to it...
Array.indonesia: Astaga, aku tidak punya cukup waktu untuk membiasakan diri...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Start_014
Array.english: <size=37>Young one? Can you find Klaus for me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Anak muda? Bisakah kamu mencarikan Klaus untukku?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Start_015
Array.english: <size=38>Huh? Me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Hah? Aku?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Start_016
Array.english: Yes, you. You are familiar with this place.\nI need to find it before the storm passes.
Array.indonesia: Ya, kamu. Kamu sudah familiar dengan tempat ini.\nAku harus menemukannya sebelum badai berlalu.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Start_017
Array.english: Just locate it and I will take care of the rest.\nHelp this old lady, please.
Array.indonesia: Cukup temukan saja, dan aku yang akan mengurus sisanya.\nTolong bantu nenek ini, ya.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Start_018
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(Ah, she looks desperate.\nOkay, all I have to do is just find it...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Ah, dia terlihat putus asa.\nOke, yang harus kulakukan hanyalah menemukannya...)</color>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Start_019
Array.english: All right. I will sweep the area.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah. Aku akan menyisir daerah ini.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Start_020
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, really?\nThank you, young one.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, benarkah?\nTerima kasih, Nak.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Start_021
Array.english: Just give me a holler when you find <color=#1DFEAF>Klaus’s Hideout</color>.\nAnd I will come right to you.
Array.indonesia: Beri tahu aku saja saat kamu menemukan <color=#1DFEAF>Sembunyi-sembunyi Klaus</color>.\nDan aku akan segera datang kepadamu.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_FindVortex_001
Array.english: <size=35>Whoa, a Vortex.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wah, sebuah Vortex.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_FindVortex_002
Array.english: Does this mean the Great White Shark’s <color=#1DFEAF>hideout</color> is inside?
Array.indonesia: Apakah ini berarti <color=#1DFEAF>tempat persembunyian</color> Hiu Putih Raksasa ada di dalamnya?

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_FindVortex_003
Array.english: I will just go check inside, and call the old lady.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan memeriksa ke dalam, lalu menelepon nenek itu.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_RoomEnter_001
Array.english: <size=35>Ack! I knew it was here!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Aduh! Aku tahu pasti ada di sini!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_RoomEnter_002
Array.english: I must quickly call the old lady.\nWhere is the walkie-talkie?
Array.indonesia: Aku harus segera menelepon nenek itu.\nDi mana walkie-talkie-nya?

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_RoomEnter_003
Array.english: <size=37>Oh my god, I didn’t ask her phone number!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Astaga, aku belum minta nomor teleponnya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_RoomEnter_004
Array.english: How ferocious looking.\nI should find a way out before it opens...
Array.indonesia: Kelihatannya sangat ganas.\nAku harus mencari jalan keluar sebelum mulutnya terbuka...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_BattleStart_001
Array.english: <size=38>Ack! It woke up!?!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Aduh! Dia bangun!?!?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_BattleStart_002
Array.english: <size=35>Urgh, I need to buy time until that old lady returns!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ugh, aku harus mengulur waktu sampai nenek itu kembali!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_die_001
Array.english: <size=38>Finally got you, Klaus!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Akhirnya kudapat kamu, Klaus!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_die_002
Array.english: <size=33>I am sorry, young one. I couldn’t get familiar with this area after all.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Maaf, Nak. Ternyata aku tidak bisa mengenal daerah ini dengan baik.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_die_003
Array.english: A Great White Shark making a whirlpool?...\nI didn’t see this coming!
Array.indonesia: Hiu Putih Raksasa yang menciptakan pusaran air?...\nAku tidak menyangka ini akan terjadi!

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_die_004
Array.english: How ruthless.\nThe whirlpool claimed my husband’s life... *sobs*
Array.indonesia: Betapa kejamnya.\nPusaran air itu merenggut nyawa suamiku... *menangis*

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_die_005
Array.english: Anyways, you gave it what it deserved.\nI must express my gratitude somehow...
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun, kamu sudah memberinya balasan yang pantas.\nAku harus mengucapkan terima kasih dengan cara apa pun...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_die_006
Array.english: <size=33>I will see you at the boat.\nI will be waiting for you from up there.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku akan menemuimu di perahu.\nAku akan menunggumu dari atas sana.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_PickUpItem_001
Array.english: Whew, that thing was extra ferocious.
Array.indonesia: Wah, makhluk itu benar-benar ganas sekali.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_PickUpItem_002
