Array.english: Now, let me find a trophy to write home about.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang, biar aku cari piala yang layak untuk dikirim ke rumah.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_PickUpItem_barricade_001
Array.english: There should be something worth taking with me.\nI should explore the area.
Array.indonesia: Pasti ada sesuatu yang layak kubawa pulang.\nAku harus menjelajahi daerah ini.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_PickUp_001
Array.english: The meat is very tough.
Array.indonesia: Dagingnya sangat keras.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_PickUp_002
Array.english: It is fatty though. Bancho will like it.
Array.indonesia: Tapi berlemak. Bancho pasti suka.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_ReStart_001
Array.english: Another stormy night, young one.
Array.indonesia: Malam yang penuh badai lagi, nak.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_ReStart_002
Array.english: Find the <color=#1DFEAF>hideout</color> of Klaus the Great White Shark!\nSo I can end it for good!
Array.indonesia: Temukan <color=#1DFEAF>sarang</color> Klaus, Hiu Putih Agung!\nSupaya aku bisa mengakhiri semuanya selamanya!

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Complete01_001
Array.english: I was finally able to complete my long-waited revenge, thanks to you!
Array.indonesia: Akhirnya aku bisa menyelesaikan balas dendam yang sudah lama kutunggu-tunggu, berkatmu!

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Complete01_002
Array.english: As long as it gave you peace.
Array.indonesia: Selama itu memberimu kedamaian.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Complete01_003
Array.english: This is for you. It is a <color=#F1DC2B>necklace made of the teeth</color> I broke off of it during my first encounter.
Array.indonesia: Ini untukmu. Ini adalah <color=#F1DC2B>kalung yang terbuat dari gigi</color> yang aku patahkan darinya saat pertemuan pertamaku dengannya.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Complete01_004
Array.english: Oh, a Shark Tooth Necklace.\nI can sense some power within it.
Array.indonesia: Oh, kalung gigi hiu.\nAku bisa merasakan ada kekuatan di dalamnya.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Complete01_005
Array.english: I don’t need it anymore.\nBut it will help you in your adventure.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah tidak membutuhkannya lagi.\nTapi ini akan membantumu dalam petualanganmu.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Complete01_006
Array.english: <size=34>May you live in peace.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Semoga kamu hidup dalam kedamaian.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Complete02_001
Array.english: <size=33>Huh? I received a notification and...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hah? Aku menerima notifikasi dan...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Complete02_002
Array.english: <size=35>A Super Rare Great White Shark Boss Card!!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Kartu Bos Hiu Putih Raksasa Super Langka!!?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Complete02_003
Array.english: Oh, you must be a hardcore Marinca collector.\nI bet you would risk your life to get rare Marinca.
Array.indonesia: Oh, kamu pasti kolektor Marinca yang fanatik.\nAku yakin kamu rela mempertaruhkan nyawa demi mendapatkan Marinca langka.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Complete02_004
Array.english: I, uh, didn’t do this to collect cards...
Array.indonesia: Aku, eh, tidak melakukan ini untuk mengoleksi kartu...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Complete02_005
Array.english: Am I seeing a <color=#F1DC2B>Marinca Completer</color> in the making?
Array.indonesia: Apa aku sedang melihat seorang <color=#F1DC2B>Pengumpul Marinca</color> yang sedang tumbuh?

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Complete02_006
Array.english: <size=35>Yeah,\nI guess it’s time for me to make way for the future generation.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ya,\nkurasa sudah waktunya aku memberi jalan bagi generasi mendatang.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Complete02_007
Array.english: I will keep an eye on you.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan terus mengawasimu.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Complete02_008
Array.english: <size=35>Godspeed. YIPPEEE!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Semoga sukses. YIPPEEE!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_Start_001
Array.english: <size=36>Wow, it’s a nasty storm today!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Wah, badai hari ini benar-benar dahsyat!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_Start_002
Array.english: Oh, you again. \nLooking for a <color=#1DFEAF>Super Rare Boss Card</color> as usual?
Array.indonesia: Oh, kamu lagi. \nLagi cari <color=#1DFEAF>Kartu Bos Super Langka</color> seperti biasa?

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_Start_003
Array.english: Ho ho! I felt an energy of something extremely powerful today.
Array.indonesia: Ho ho! Aku merasakan energi sesuatu yang sangat kuat hari ini.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_Start_004
Array.english: I can’t help you today.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak bisa membantumu hari ini.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_Start_005
Array.english: <size=38><color=#F1DC2B>Vortex </color>! Remember the Vortex!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38><color=#F1DC2B>Vortex </color>! Ingat Vortex!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_Start_006
Array.english: The storm is gaining strength.\nI will see you around!
Array.indonesia: Badai semakin kencang.\nSampai jumpa nanti!

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_Start_007
Array.english: <size=35>Chuchu!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Chuchu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_EnterBossRoom_001
Array.english: I ended up in a strange place again.
Array.indonesia: Aku berakhir di tempat aneh lagi.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_EnterBossRoom_002
Array.english: Well, this place looks uninhabited.
Array.indonesia: Yah, tempat ini kelihatannya tak berpenghuni.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_BeforeBattle_001
Array.english: <size=35>Huh? A crawfish wearing a pair of boxing gloves?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Hah? Seekor udang karang yang memakai sepasang sarung tinju?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_BeforeBattle_002
Array.english: I think I know what it is. It must be a <color=#F1DC2B>Mantis Shrimp</color>.
Array.indonesia: Kurasa aku tahu apa itu. Pasti itu <color=#F1DC2B>Udang Mantis</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_BeforeBattle_003
Array.english: <size=36>But its size is unreal.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Tapi ukurannya nggak masuk akal.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_BeforeBattle_004
Array.english: I guess it could crush me with one hit.
Array.indonesia: Kayaknya dia bisa menghancurkanku dengan satu pukulan saja.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_BeforeBattle_005
Array.english: It would be nice if I could find <color=#F1DC2B>something tough</color> to \nblock that thing’s punches.
Array.indonesia: Alangkah baiknya kalau aku bisa menemukan <color=#F1DC2B>sesuatu yang kuat</color> untuk \nmenangkis pukulan makhluk itu.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_PickUpItem_001
Array.english: <size=33>Whew, that was close.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wah, nyaris saja.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_PickUpItem_002
Array.english: <size=33>There must be something worth picking up.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Pasti ada sesuatu yang layak diambil.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_PickUp_001
Array.english: Um, I guess that should be enough.\nI should go up and tell Sato.
Array.indonesia: Hmm, kurasa itu sudah cukup.\nAku harus naik ke atas dan memberi tahu Sato.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_ReStart_001
Array.english: It’s stormy again.
Array.indonesia: Cuaca kembali bergejolak.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_ReStart_002
Array.english: Don’t miss this opportunity.
Array.indonesia: Jangan lewatkan kesempatan ini.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_ReStart_003
Array.english: <size=34>Chuchu.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Chuchu.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=35>Yes! This is...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ya! Ini...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_Complete_002
Array.english: A <color=#1DFEAF>Mantis Shrimp Boss Card</color>!
Array.indonesia: Sebuah <color=#1DFEAF>Kartu Bos Udang Mantis</color>!

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_Complete_003
Array.english: I haven’t seen it even at the gym.
Array.indonesia: Aku bahkan belum pernah melihatnya di gym.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_Complete_004
Array.english: Oh, I mean the gym I workout at.
Array.indonesia: Oh, maksudku gym tempat aku berolahraga.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_Complete_005
Array.english: Okay, look, if you transfer this card using Share...
Array.indonesia: Oke, dengar, kalau kamu mentransfer kartu ini menggunakan Share...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_Complete_006
Array.english: <size=36>Okay! I got it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Oke! Aku paham!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_Complete_007
Array.english: See you then. Keep in touch. \nKeep collecting cards!
Array.indonesia: Sampai jumpa nanti. Tetap berhubungan. \nTerus kumpulkan kartunya!

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_Complete_008
Array.english: <size=35>Chuchu!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Chuchu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_CompleteMarinca01_001
Array.english: *Gasp* I just received the Marinca social notification…
Array.indonesia: *Huff* Aku baru saja menerima notifikasi sosial dari Marinca…

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_CompleteMarinca01_002
Array.english: Did you really collect all the cards?
Array.indonesia: Apa kamu benar-benar sudah mengumpulkan semua kartunya?

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_CompleteMarinca01_003
Array.english: Yes, apparently.
Array.indonesia: Ya, sepertinya begitu.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_CompleteMarinca01_004
Array.english: You did it… Unbelievable….
Array.indonesia: Kamu berhasil… Luar biasa….

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_CompleteMarinca01_005
Array.english: <size=34>I'll drop by in the near future to celebrate!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku akan mampir dalam waktu dekat untuk merayakannya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_CompleteMarinca01_006
Array.english: …Chuchu.
Array.indonesia: …Chuchu.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_CompleteMarinca02_001
Array.english: Hmm, this is incredible no matter how many times I look at it…\nA completed collection.
Array.indonesia: Hmm, ini sungguh luar biasa, berapa pun kali aku melihatnya…\nKoleksi yang lengkap.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_CompleteMarinca02_002
Array.english: Even I couldn’t do it, and I've been collecting Marinca for 32 years.
Array.indonesia: Bahkan aku pun tidak bisa melakukannya, padahal aku sudah mengoleksi Marinca selama 32 tahun.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_CompleteMarinca02_003
Array.english: …Has Marinca been around for that long?
Array.indonesia: …Apakah Marinca sudah ada selama itu?

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_CompleteMarinca02_004
Array.english: Haha! It used to be a sticker that came with chocolate snacks.
Array.indonesia: Haha! Dulu itu stiker yang disertakan dalam kemasan camilan cokelat.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_CompleteMarinca02_005
Array.english: My mom once gave me an earful because I would keep the stickers and throw away the snacks.
Array.indonesia: Ibu saya pernah memarahi saya karena saya selalu menyimpan stikernya dan membuang camilannya.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_CompleteMarinca02_006
Array.english: I see. I guess these cards have a lot of stories to tell.
Array.indonesia: Begitu ya. Sepertinya kartu-kartu ini menyimpan banyak cerita.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_CompleteMarinca02_007
Array.english: <size=33>Hmm… Wait a second…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hmm… Tunggu sebentar…</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_CompleteMarinca02_008
Array.english: <size=36>This silhouette…\nIt’s <color=#F1DC2B>Lusca</color>…!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Siluet ini…\nItu <color=#F1DC2B>Lusca</color>…!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_CompleteMarinca02_009
Array.english: What do you mean?
Array.indonesia: Maksudmu apa?

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_CompleteMarinca02_010
Array.english: So it was true…\nIt's the hidden card that appears once all cards have been collected…
Array.indonesia: Jadi itu benar…\nIni adalah kartu tersembunyi yang muncul setelah semua kartu terkumpul…

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_CompleteMarinca02_011
Array.english: This silhouette must be that of the legendary monster in Blue Hole…\n<color=#F1DC2B>Lusca</color>!
Array.indonesia: Siluet ini pasti milik monster legendaris di Blue Hole…\n<color=#F1DC2B>Lusca</color>!

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_CompleteMarinca02_012
Array.english: If you wish to achieve your dream of becoming a Marinca Completer, you'll need this card.
Array.indonesia: Jika kamu ingin mewujudkan impianmu menjadi seorang Marinca Completer, kamu membutuhkan kartu ini.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_CompleteMarinca02_013
Array.english: Huh? But I…
Array.indonesia: Hah? Tapi aku…

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_CompleteMarinca02_014
Array.english: <size=33>I'll contact you the next <color=#1DFEAF>stormy night</color>.\nThis is nerve-racking… but also exciting.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku akan menghubungimu pada <color=#1DFEAF>malam badai</color> berikutnya.\nIni bikin deg-degan… tapi juga seru.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_CompleteMarinca02_015
Array.english: …Chuchu.
Array.indonesia: …Chuchu.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Start_001
Array.english: <size=35>Woah! Today’s storm feels especially strong!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wah! Badai hari ini terasa sangat kencang!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Start_002
Array.english: <color=#F1DC2B>Lusca</color> is here… I can feel it!
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Lusca</color> ada di sini… Aku bisa merasakannya!

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Start_003
Array.english: Ah, the hidden card you mentioned earlier…
Array.indonesia: Ah, kartu tersembunyi yang kamu sebutkan tadi…

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Start_004
Array.english: Good luck.\nThis is the opportunity to fulfill your dreams of becoming a <color=#F1DC2B>Marinca Completer</color>!
Array.indonesia: Semoga berhasil.\nIni adalah kesempatan untuk mewujudkan impianmu menjadi seorang <color=#F1DC2B>Marinca Completer</color>!

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Start_005
Array.english: But I really don't mind if I don't become one…
Array.indonesia: Tapi aku benar-benar tidak keberatan jika tidak menjadi salah satunya…

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Start_006
Array.english: I'll wait for the notification.\nThis is exciting.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan menunggu notifikasinya.\nIni seru sekali.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Start_007
Array.english: <size=40>Chuchu!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Chuchu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_ReStart_001
Array.english: Hmm, it wasn’t easy, I take it? Of course it wasn't…
Array.indonesia: Hmm, sepertinya tidak mudah, ya? Tentu saja tidak…

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_ReStart_002
Array.english: But there's always a next time!
Array.indonesia: Tapi selalu ada kesempatan berikutnya!

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=36>I saw the notification! *Gasp* A Lusca card…!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Aku melihat notifikasinya! *Tersentak* Kartu Lusca…!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_002
Array.english: Incredible… the Marinca collection is finally complete. It’s glorious...
Array.indonesia: Luar biasa… koleksi Marinca akhirnya lengkap. Sungguh luar biasa...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_003
Array.english: I’ve seen monsters like it only in movies. I never thought it would actually exist.
Array.indonesia: Aku hanya pernah melihat monster seperti itu di film. Aku tidak pernah menyangka monster itu benar-benar ada.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_004
Array.english: To think I'd actually see this card in my lifetime… As a Marinca collector, I'm… *sob*
Array.indonesia: Siapa sangka aku benar-benar bisa melihat kartu ini dalam hidupku… Sebagai kolektor Marinca, aku… *isak*

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_005
Array.english: Thank you, Dave.\nYou've earned the right to call yourself a Marinca Completer.
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih, Dave.\nKamu berhak menyebut dirimu sebagai Marinca Completer.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_006
Array.english: I hereby give you...
Array.indonesia: Dengan ini aku memberimu...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_007
Array.english: <size=35>This <color=#F1DC2B>hat</color>, given by my Marinca master.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Topi <color=#F1DC2B>ini</color>, yang diberikan oleh guru Marinca-ku.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_008
Array.english: Woah… But this hat means a lot to you, doesn't it?
Array.indonesia: Wah… Tapi topi ini sangat berarti bagimu, bukan?

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_009
Array.english: Haha… It's nothing compared to the joy you’ve given me.
Array.indonesia: Haha… Itu tidak seberapa dibandingkan dengan kebahagiaan yang telah kamu berikan padaku.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_010
Array.english: Thank you, Sato!
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih, Sato!

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_011
Array.english: The hat is a little big for me. I'll use it as a decoration for BANCHO SUSHI.
Array.indonesia: Topi ini agak kebesaran untukku. Aku akan menggunakannya sebagai hiasan untuk BANCHO SUSHI.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_012
Array.english: Haha. Sounds like a wonderful idea.
Array.indonesia: Haha. Kedengarannya ide yang bagus.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_013
Array.english: Ah, wait a moment.
Array.indonesia: Ah, tunggu sebentar.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_014
Array.english: <size=45>….</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=45>….</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_015
Array.english: <size=38>This should do it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Ini seharusnya cukup.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_016
Array.english: <size=36>...The same hat…?! You have multiple same hats?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>...The topi yang sama…?! Kamu punya beberapa topi yang sama?!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_017
Array.english: The same? Nonsense. The hat I gave you is the original, the one and only.
Array.indonesia: Sama? Omong kosong. Topi yang kuberikan padamu adalah yang asli, satu-satunya.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_018
Array.english: It's just that I grew fond of its design, so I bought a similar one.
Array.indonesia: Hanya saja aku jadi suka desainnya, jadi aku beli yang mirip.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_019
Array.english: Umm… Alright.
Array.indonesia: Umm… Baiklah.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_020
Array.english: Anyway, thanks, Sato.\nI’ve enjoyed Marinca as well!
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun, terima kasih, Sato.\nAku juga menikmati Marinca!

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_021
Array.english: Haha. If a new Marinca expansion comes out…\nI'll come find you then.
Array.indonesia: Haha. Kalau ada ekspansi Marinca baru yang dirilis…\nAku akan mencarimu nanti.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_022
Array.english: Chuchu.
Array.indonesia: Chuchu.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_EnterBossRoom01_001
Array.english: Hmm… This place is even bigger than the other places…
Array.indonesia: Hmm… Tempat ini bahkan lebih besar daripada tempat-tempat lainnya…

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_EnterBossRoom01_002
Array.english: Is this where the Monster of Blue Hole lives…?
Array.indonesia: Apakah di sinilah Monster Blue Hole tinggal…?

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_EnterBossRoom02_001
Array.english: <size=35>Woah… Is that… a great white shark?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wah… Apakah itu… hiu putih raksasa?!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_EnterBossRoom02_002
Array.english: Wait… It has arms like an octopus…
Array.indonesia: Tunggu… Ia punya lengan seperti gurita…

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_EnterBossRoom02_003
Array.english: Are the shark and octopus in some—
Array.indonesia: Apakah hiu dan gurita itu berada dalam suatu—

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Encounter_001
Array.english: <size=35>Arghh…! What the…?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Arghh…! Apa-apaan ini…?!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Encounter_002
Array.english: The head of a shark and the arms of an octopus…\nIt's something you'd see in a low-budget creature film!
Array.indonesia: Kepala hiu dan lengan gurita…\nIni seperti makhluk yang muncul di film monster beranggaran rendah!

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Encounter_003
Array.english: Does Sato really want me to defeat this creature…?
Array.indonesia: Apakah Sato benar-benar ingin aku mengalahkan makhluk ini…?

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Encounter_004
Array.english: …Is it because he thinks I'm up to the task? Haha.
Array.indonesia: …Apakah karena dia pikir aku mampu melakukannya? Haha.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Encounter_005
Array.english: Wait, now's not the time to get cocky…
Array.indonesia: Tunggu, sekarang bukan waktunya untuk sombong…

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Encounter_006
Array.english: <size=35>Now I have to defeat it, no matter what!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Sekarang aku harus mengalahkannya, apa pun yang terjadi!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Die_001
Array.english: *Pant*
Array.indonesia: *Terengah-engah*

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Die_002
Array.english: How could something so big be so fast?
Array.indonesia: Bagaimana mungkin sesuatu yang sebesar itu bisa secepat ini?

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Die_003
Array.english: No wonder there's so few sightings of it.
Array.indonesia: Tak heran kalau makhluk ini jarang terlihat.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Die_004
Array.english: I should return to the boat and check my <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca</color>.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus kembali ke perahu dan memeriksa <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca</color>-ku.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Die_005
Array.english: Ah! Before that, I should see if it has any edible parts.
Array.indonesia: Ah! Sebelum itu, aku harus lihat apakah ada bagian yang bisa dimakan.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_PickUp_001
Array.english: I see this as a big win, since I can get both shark and octopus meat.
Array.indonesia: Aku anggap ini kemenangan besar, karena aku bisa dapat daging hiu dan gurita sekaligus.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_PickUp_002
Array.english: Though I’m not sure it'll be tasty….
Array.indonesia: Meskipun aku tidak yakin rasanya akan enak….

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_PickUp_003
Array.english: I’m done collecting. I should head back up.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah selesai mengumpulkan. Sebaiknya aku kembali ke atas.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission00_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=37>Oh, Dave!\nYou collected <color=#F1DC2B>100 Gold</color>!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Oh, Dave!\nKamu mengumpulkan <color=#F1DC2B>100 Emas</color>!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission00_Complete_002
Array.english: Great job!\nThis should be enough to repair what's broken!
Array.indonesia: Kerja bagus!\nIni seharusnya cukup untuk memperbaiki yang rusak!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission00_Complete_003
Array.english: Then give me some time!\nThese repairs need to be done right.
Array.indonesia: Kalau begitu, beri aku waktu sebentar!\nPerbaikan ini harus dilakukan dengan benar.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission00_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=35>I really hope the customers keep coming!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Aku benar-benar berharap pelanggan terus berdatangan!</size>

Array.name: dialog_C_Area_Block_001
Array.english: It’s too dark down here...\nIt’ll be dangerous to venture down in this state.
Array.indonesia: Di sini terlalu gelap...\nAkan berbahaya untuk turun ke bawah dalam kondisi seperti ini.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_001
Array.english: <size=40>Hola... Amigo!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Hola... Amigo!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_002
Array.english: Who... are you?
Array.indonesia: Siapa... kamu?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_003
Array.english: Well... I’m <color=#F1DC2B>Jose Da Silva</color>.\nI’m a Brazilian soccer player.
Array.indonesia: Nah... aku <color=#F1DC2B>Jose Da Silva</color>.\nAku seorang pemain sepak bola Brasil.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_004
Array.english: Oh! I’ve seen you on TV!\nI haven’t heard much about you lately, though.
Array.indonesia: Oh! Aku pernah melihatmu di TV!\nTapi aku belum banyak mendengar kabar tentangmu belakangan ini.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_005
Array.english: <size=31>Actually... I haven’t been able to shoot the ball accurately of late! It’s a huge slump, I’m telling you! It’s very sad indeed.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Sebenarnya... akhir-akhir ini aku nggak bisa menendang bola dengan akurat! Ini masa-masa sulit banget, aku bilang! Sungguh menyedihkan.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_006
Array.english: That’s why I’ve come here to train by myself.\nI, <color=#F1DC2B>Jose</color>, will get back up again!
Array.indonesia: Makanya aku datang ke sini untuk berlatih sendiri.\nAku, <color=#F1DC2B>Jose</color>, pasti bisa bangkit lagi!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_007
Array.english: Alright! Good luck. I’ll be cheering for you.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah! Semoga berhasil. Aku akan mendukungmu.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_008
Array.english: But you see... I kicked my ball into the water...\nIt’s a <color=#1DFEAF>soccer ball made out of steel</color> for my training sessions...
Array.indonesia: Tapi begini... Aku menendang bolaku ke dalam air...\nItu adalah <color=#1DFEAF>bola sepak yang terbuat dari baja</color> untuk sesi latihanku...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_009
Array.english: Well, that’s terrible news...
Array.indonesia: Wah, itu berita yang mengerikan...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_010
Array.english: So! Amigo! Can you help me out?\nI, <color=#F1DC2B>Jose</color>, need that ball desperately!
Array.indonesia: Jadi! Amigo! Bisakah kamu membantuku?\nAku, <color=#F1DC2B>Jose</color>, sangat membutuhkan bola itu!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_011
Array.english: Jose is very scared of the water! Ever since I fell into the water on a beach in Copacabana...\nThe sea gives me the woozies...
Array.indonesia: Jose sangat takut air! Sejak aku terjatuh ke air di pantai Copacabana...\nLaut membuatku pusing...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_012
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(But why is he training on the beach anyway?)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Tapi kenapa dia berlatih di pantai sih?)</color>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_013
Array.english: I’ve kicked it far enough to land it about <color=#F1DC2B>30m</color> deep.\nYou’ll find it for me, I’m sure.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah menendangnya cukup jauh hingga mendarat di kedalaman sekitar <color=#F1DC2B>30m</color>.\nKamu pasti bisa menemukannya untukku.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_014
Array.english: Alright... I guess I’ll try and look for it...
Array.indonesia: Baiklah... Kurasa aku akan coba mencarinya...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_Yes_01
Array.english: Wow! Thank you!\nI’m sorry to press you, but I need it <color=#F39321>today</color>. It’s very important.
Array.indonesia: Wow! Terima kasih!\nMaaf sudah memaksamu, tapi aku membutuhkannya <color=#F39321>hari ini</color>. Ini sangat penting.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_Yes_02
Array.english: It’s somewhere at <color=#F1DC2B>30m</color>.\nJose will be waiting for you here.
Array.indonesia: Itu ada di suatu tempat di kedalaman <color=#F1DC2B>30m</color>.\nJose akan menunggumu di sini.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_No_01
Array.english: Oh, well... can’t be helped.\nI will still continue to train.
Array.indonesia: Oh, ya sudah... tidak bisa dihindari.\nAku akan tetap melanjutkan latihan.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_No_02
Array.english: I’m sure we’ll meet again.\nStay healthy. Adios!
Array.indonesia: Aku yakin kita akan bertemu lagi.\nJaga kesehatan. Adios!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_Complete_01
Array.english: <size=33>Wow! Wow! Thank you!\nThis is it! </size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wow! Wow! Terima kasih!\nInilah dia! </size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_Complete_02
Array.english: I can resume training again.\nI can be the best again.
Array.indonesia: Aku bisa melanjutkan latihan lagi.\nAku bisa menjadi yang terbaik lagi.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_Complete_03
Array.english: Thank you, Dave.\nYou are a true ami-go. Obriga-do!
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih, Dave.\nKamu adalah ami-go sejati. Obriga-do!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_Complete_04
Array.english: It’s not much, but I’ve prepared a small gift. Please take it.
Array.indonesia: Memang tidak seberapa, tapi aku sudah menyiapkan hadiah kecil. Silakan ambil.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_Complete_05
Array.english: <size=33>Hope to see you again next time!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Semoga bisa bertemu lagi lain kali!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_Fail_01
Array.english: Oh... You couldn’t find it... Oh well.
Array.indonesia: Oh... Kamu tidak bisa menemukannya. .. Yah, sudahlah.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_Fail_02
Array.english: <size=33>It’s okay! See you next time, ami-go!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tidak apa-apa! Sampai jumpa lain kali, ami-go!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Otto_001
Array.english: <size=45>What? Sea people..?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=45>Apa? Orang laut..?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Otto_002
Array.english: It's hard to believe that something I've only heard of \nin legend is real.
Array.indonesia: Sulit dipercaya bahwa sesuatu yang hanya kudengar \ndalam legenda ternyata nyata.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Otto_003
Array.english: If there is good beer in that area I wouldn't mind trying some!
Array.indonesia: Kalau ada bir enak di daerah itu, aku nggak keberatan mencobanya!

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Otto_004
Array.english: I don’t think there will be drinks underwater…
Array.indonesia: Kurasa nggak akan ada minuman di bawah air…

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_001
Array.english: Looks like this is the only place to eat...\nThis is what I don’t like about remote areas.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya ini satu-satunya tempat untuk makan...\nInilah yang nggak aku suka dari daerah terpencil.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_002
Array.english: This decrepit place can’t possibly make sushi\nthat will inspire me. I’ll just have to fill my belly\nwith what I can get.
Array.indonesia: Tempat bobrok ini pasti nggak bisa bikin sushi\nyang bikin aku terinspirasi. Aku hanya perlu mengisi perutku\ndengan apa pun yang bisa kudapat.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_003
Array.english: Um... What a rude customer.\nWhat do you want?
Array.indonesia: Um... Pelanggan yang kasar sekali.\nApa yang kamu mau?

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_004
Array.english: Allow me to introduce myself.\nI’m the movie director <color=#F1DC2B>Michael Bang</color>.
Array.indonesia: Izinkan aku memperkenalkan diri.\nAku adalah sutradara film <color=#F1DC2B>Michael Bang</color>.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_005
Array.english: <size=38>Wait... Didn’t you direct <color=#5dd3bb>Robot Samurai</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Tunggu... Bukankah kamu yang menyutradarai <color=#5dd3bb>Robot Samurai</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_006
Array.english: Ha! Looks like your eyes are functional!\nYes, I’m the great action film director, Michael Bang.
Array.indonesia: Ha! Sepertinya matamu masih berfungsi!\nYa, aku adalah sutradara film aksi hebat, Michael Bang.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_007
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>I can’t believe he’s talking like that about himself...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Aku nggak percaya dia ngomong gitu tentang dirinya sendiri...</color>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_008
Array.english: I’m filming my new movie, <color=#5dd3bb>The Stone</color>, around these parts\nand I can’t seem to get the ending scene right...
Array.indonesia: Aku sedang syuting film baruku, <color=#5dd3bb>The Stone</color>, di sekitar sini\ndan sepertinya aku belum bisa membuat adegan penutupnya dengan benar...

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_009
Array.english: I think I might find new inspiration with food\nthat’ll clear up my head!
Array.indonesia: Kurasa aku mungkin bisa menemukan inspirasi baru dari makanan\nitu akan menjernihkan pikiranku!

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_010
Array.english: It doesn’t seem likely I’ll find anything here.\nI’m leaving.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya aku tidak akan menemukan apa pun di sini.\nAku pergi.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_011
Array.english: <size=50>Wait!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>Tunggu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_012
Array.english: <color=#5dd3bb>Robot Samurai</color>... was an amazing movie.\nI watched it multiple times, and was moved every time.
Array.indonesia: <color=#5dd3bb>Robot Samurai</color>... adalah film yang luar biasa.\nAku menontonnya berkali-kali, dan selalu terharu setiap kali menontonnya.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_013
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>All I can remember is explosions...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Yang bisa aku ingat hanyalah ledakan-ledakan...</color>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_014
Array.english: If you can make another such great movie through my food,\nI’d be willing to cook for you.
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu bisa membuat film hebat seperti itu lagi lewat masakanku,\naku bersedia memasak untukmu.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_015
Array.english: Oh? So you’re a fan? I’m grateful, but...\nCan you pull it off?
Array.indonesia: Oh? Jadi kamu penggemarnya? Aku berterima kasih, tapi...\nBisakah kamu melakukannya?

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_016
Array.english: I’ve got high standards when it comes to sushi.\nThe rice they use in these parts is terrible, by the way.
Array.indonesia: Aku punya standar tinggi soal sushi.\nNgomong-ngomong, beras yang dipakai di daerah sini jelek banget.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_017
Array.english: That’s why we use the best rice we can find\nin this region.
Array.indonesia: Makanya kami pakai beras terbaik yang bisa kami temukan\ndi wilayah ini.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_018
Array.english: <size=32>Give me <color=#1DFEAF>3 days</color>. I’ll prepare food that will make your head \nall but explode with inspiration.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Beri aku waktu <color=#1DFEAF>3 hari</color>. Saya akan menyiapkan hidangan yang akan membuat kepalamu \nhampir meledak karena inspirasi.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_019
Array.english: Well, alright... I’ll be back in <color=#1DFEAF>3 days</color>.\nDon’t disappoint me, Chef.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah... Saya akan kembali dalam <color=#1DFEAF>3 hari</color>.\nJangan mengecewakan saya, Chef.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_leave_001
Array.english: Bancho, do you have a plan?
Array.indonesia: Bancho, apa kamu punya rencana?

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_leave_002
Array.english: Hmm. Cooking is an art form.\nI know well the pain of an auteur.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Memasak adalah sebuah bentuk seni.\nAku sangat memahami penderitaan seorang seniman.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_leave_003
Array.english: I’ll prepare food that will inspire him.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan menyiapkan hidangan yang akan menginspirasinya.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_leave_004
Array.english: However…\nAs he said, the rice I use is the Annam rice of this region...
Array.indonesia: Namun…\nSeperti yang dia katakan, beras yang aku gunakan adalah beras Annam dari daerah ini...

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_leave_005
Array.english: It bothers me that the ingredient has limits\nwhen it comes to creating the best possible sushi.
Array.indonesia: Aku merasa terganggu karena bahan tersebut memiliki keterbatasan\ndalam menciptakan sushi terbaik yang mungkin.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_leave_006
Array.english: <size=38>Hehe. I’ve been listening in to your conversation...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Hehe. Aku telah mendengarkan percakapan kalian...</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_leave_007
Array.english: <size=36>If its <color=#1DFEAF>rice</color>...\nI think I could come up with something.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Jika itu <color=#1DFEAF>beras</color>...\nAku rasa aku bisa memikirkan sesuatu.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_leave_008
Array.english: Hmm? Do you have an idea, Otto?
Array.indonesia: Hmm? Apa kamu punya ide, Otto?

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_leave_009
Array.english: <size=33>Hehe. Give me just a <color=#F1DC2B>day</color>.\nI’ll be in touch in the morning.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hehe. Beri aku waktu <color=#F1DC2B>satu hari</color> saja.\nAku akan menghubungimu besok pagi.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_leave_010
Array.english: Hmm. If we can get high-quality rice...
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Kalau kita bisa mendapatkan beras berkualitas tinggi...

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_leave_011
Array.english: We can make sushi with three kinds of fish...\n<color=#1DFEAF>Titan Triggerfish</color>, <color=#1DFEAF>Harlequin Hind</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>Coral Trout</color>.
Array.indonesia: Kita bisa membuat sushi dengan tiga jenis ikan...\n<color=#1DFEAF>Ikan Triggerfish Titan</color>, <color=#1DFEAF>Ikan Harlequin Hind</color>, dan <color=#1DFEAF>Ikan Trout Karang</color>.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_leave_012
Array.english: <size=33>That’s a lot of ingredients.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Itu banyak sekali bahan.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_leave_013
Array.english: He appreciates flourish...\nPlease don’t be late.
Array.indonesia: Dia suka yang mewah...\nTolong jangan terlambat.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Complete01_01
Array.english: Phew... This place is rather hot...
Array.indonesia: Wah... Tempat ini cukup panas...

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Complete01_02
Array.english: Is the food ready yet?\nBe honest now, I won’t chide you for it if it isn’t.
Array.indonesia: Apakah makanannya sudah siap?\nJujur saja, aku tidak akan memarahimu jika belum siap.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Complete01_03
Array.english: Here you are.\nThis food will make your inspiration skyrocket.
Array.indonesia: Ini dia.\nMakanan ini akan membuat inspirasimu melonjak tinggi.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Complete01_04
Array.english: Haha... Looks like an explosive dish, alright.\nIt looks nice, but will the taste justify its fanciness?
Array.indonesia: Haha... Kelihatannya hidangan yang luar biasa, ya.\nKelihatannya enak, tapi apakah rasanya sebanding dengan penampilannya yang mewah?

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Complete01_05
Array.english: Try it first.
Array.indonesia: Coba dulu.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Complete02_01
Array.english: <size=44>RRRGGGGARR! It’s coming to me! Yes!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=44>RRRGGGGARR! Aku mulai merasakannya! Ya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Complete02_02
Array.english: <size=44>Such powerful inspiration\nis filling my soul!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=44>Inspirasi yang begitu kuat\nmengisi jiwaku!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Complete02_03
Array.english: *Pant* I haven’t felt this way in a while.
Array.indonesia: *Terengah-engah* Sudah lama aku tidak merasakan hal seperti ini.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Complete02_04
Array.english: This rice... It’s not easy to find such rice in these parts...\nHow did you...
Array.indonesia: Nasi ini... Tidak mudah menemukan nasi seperti ini di daerah sini...\nBagaimana kamu bisa...

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Complete02_05
Array.english: I had some help from a friend.\nI’m glad to see you like it.
Array.indonesia: Aku dibantu oleh seorang teman.\nAku senang melihat kamu menyukainya.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Complete02_06
Array.english: If you’ll continue making your masterful movies that pluck at the heartstrings, you’re welcome to eat here whenever you like.
Array.indonesia: Jika kamu terus membuat film-film hebat yang menyentuh hati, silakan makan di sini kapan pun kamu mau.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Complete02_07
Array.english: Hmm... you’re quite the man.\nI like your style.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... kamu memang pria yang luar biasa.\nAku suka gayamu.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Complete02_08
Array.english: Perhaps my next movie should be about\na sushi bar...
Array.indonesia: Mungkin filmku berikutnya harus tentang\nsebuah bar sushi...

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Complete02_09
Array.english: It should feature a man with a missile launcher in one hand...
Array.indonesia: Film itu harus menampilkan seorang pria dengan peluncur rudal di satu tangannya...

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Complete02_10
Array.english: <size=42>What... kind of story is that?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>Cerita... macam apa itu?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Complete02_11
Array.english: Hahaha! In any case, I think I’m all set,\nthanks to you!
Array.indonesia: Hahaha! Bagaimanapun, saya rasa saya sudah siap,\nberkat Anda!

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Complete02_12
Array.english: This is a <color=#1DFEAF>Robot Samurai Poster</color> with my autograph.\nYou can have it as a gift!
Array.indonesia: Ini adalah <color=#1DFEAF>Poster Robot Samurai</color> dengan tanda tanganku.\nKamu bisa memilikinya sebagai hadiah!

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Complete02_13
Array.english: <size=40>My gosh... Robot... Samurai...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Astaga... Robot... Samurai...</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Complete02_14
Array.english: Hahaha! You can look forward to the next movie!\nIt’s sure to be an exhilarating one!
Array.indonesia: Hahaha! Kamu bisa menantikan film berikutnya!\nPasti akan sangat seru!

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Fail_01
Array.english: Tsk... I knew you wouldn’t have it ready,\nfor all your bluster.
Array.indonesia: Ck... Aku tahu kamu nggak bakal siap,\nmeski kamu banyak omong.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Fail_02
Array.english: There’s not many places to eat around here, though,\nso I’ll come back another time!
Array.indonesia: Tapi nggak banyak tempat makan di sekitar sini,\njadi aku bakal balik lain kali!

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_MichaelBang01_Phone_Fail_001
Array.english: Hmph! Closing the restaurant when I’d made a reservation!\nThat’s rude!!!
Array.indonesia: Hmph! Tutup restoran padahal aku udah reservasi!\nItu nggak sopan!!!

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_MichaelBang01_Phone_Fail_002
Array.english: Next time, you’d better show me that you’re a professional!
Array.indonesia: Lain kali, lebih baik kamu tunjukkan padaku bahwa kamu seorang profesional!

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Revisit_Reservation_001
Array.english: Since I'm in the area, I might as well stop by for something to eat.
Array.indonesia: Karena aku sedang di daerah ini, mendingan aku mampir untuk makan sesuatu.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Revisit_Reservation_002
Array.english: I'll be back <color=#1DFEAF>tomorrow</color> so prepare something that will ignite inspiration!
Array.indonesia: Aku akan kembali <color=#1DFEAF>besok</color> jadi siapkan sesuatu yang akan memicu inspirasi!

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Revisit_01
Array.english: Is the food ready today, chef?
Array.indonesia: Apakah makanannya sudah siap hari ini, chef?

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Revisit_02
Array.english: Here you are.\nThis food will make your inspiration skyrocket.
Array.indonesia: Ini dia.\nMakanan ini akan membuat inspirasimu melonjak tinggi.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Revisit_03
Array.english: Haha... Looks like an explosive dish, alright.\nIt looks nice, but will the taste justify its fanciness?
Array.indonesia: Haha... Kelihatannya memang hidangan yang luar biasa.\nTampilannya bagus, tapi apakah rasanya sebanding dengan kemewahannya?

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Revisit_04
Array.english: Try it first.
Array.indonesia: Coba dulu.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_001
Array.english: <size=36>Hello, viewers!\nThis is <color=#F1DC2B>Yui</color> from the TV show <color=#00d98f>Star★The Chef</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Halo, pemirsa!\nIni <color=#F1DC2B>Yui</color> dari acara TV <color=#00d98f>Star★The Chef</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_002
Array.english: Today We’ve come to a seaside sushi bar that’s all the rage on Cooksta, <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho Sushi</color>!
Array.indonesia: Hari ini kami datang ke bar sushi tepi pantai yang sedang hits di Cooksta, <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho Sushi</color>!

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_003
Array.english: In this sushi bar that's famous for its exotic sushi, we have with us the legendary sushi expert <color=#F1DC2B>Vincent Yamaoka</color>!
Array.indonesia: Di bar sushi yang terkenal dengan sushi eksotisnya ini, kami ditemani oleh ahli sushi legendaris <color=#F1DC2B>Vincent Yamaoka</color>!

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_004
Array.english: <size=36>Ahem!\nI am <color=#F1DC2B>Vincent Yamaoka</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Ahem!\nSaya adalah <color=#F1DC2B>Vincent Yamaoka</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_005
Array.english: Hello Vincent.\nHow would you define "Sushi"?
Array.indonesia: Halo Vincent.\nBagaimana Anda mendefinisikan "Sushi"?

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_006
Array.english: Sushi is a very simple dish.\rThere’s only rice, vinegar, wasabi, and the fish that goes on top.\nEverything hangs upon these ingredients. However...
Array.indonesia: Sushi adalah hidangan yang sangat sederhana.\rHanya ada nasi, cuka, wasabi, dan ikan yang diletakkan di atasnya.\nSemuanya bergantung pada bahan-bahan ini. Namun...

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_007
Array.english: Simple does not mean easy!\nListen!!
Array.indonesia: Sederhana bukan berarti mudah!\nDengarkan!!

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_008
Array.english: How good the ingredients are, how they were stored and aged,\nhow they were cut, how the rice was cooked,\nand how it was molded.
Array.indonesia: Seberapa baik kualitas bahan-bahannya, bagaimana cara penyimpanan dan pematangannya,\nbagaimana cara memotongnya, bagaimana cara memasak nasinya,\ndan bagaimana cara membentuknya.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_009
Array.english: All those things matter in the art of sushi!\nYes!
Array.indonesia: Semua hal itu penting dalam seni membuat sushi!\nYa!

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_010
Array.english: I see. In that case, what do you think of the exotic sushi\nthat Bancho Sushi is famous for?
Array.indonesia: Begitu ya. Kalau begitu, apa pendapatmu tentang sushi eksotis\nyang menjadi ciri khas Bancho Sushi?

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_011
Array.english: The ingredients for sushi have long been similar... \nThe king of fish, the tuna, and particularly the belly...\rBelow that the olive flounder and amberjack with white and red meat....All verified ingredients, you understand.\rTo dare to use new ingredients despite the many proven ones that existed from the Edo era...
Array.indonesia: Bahan-bahan untuk sushi sudah lama serupa... \nRaja ikan, tuna, dan khususnya bagian perutnya...\rDi bawahnya ada ikan flounder zaitun dan ikan amberjack dengan daging putih dan merah....Semua bahan yang teruji, kamu mengerti.\rBerani menggunakan bahan baru meskipun sudah ada banyak bahan teruji yang ada sejak era Edo...

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_012
Array.english: <size=36>Regardless of the taste,\nthis shows a lack of respect!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Terlepas dari rasanya,\nini menunjukkan kurangnya rasa hormat!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_013
Array.english: You have once criticized California rolls as not being real sushi.
Array.indonesia: Anda pernah mengkritik California roll sebagai bukan sushi asli.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_014
Array.english: We’re curious to see what your opinion on \nBancho Sushi will be!
Array.indonesia: Kami penasaran ingin tahu pendapat Anda tentang \nBancho Sushi!

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_015
Array.english: Now then, let’s start by introducing the star of today’s show!\nThis is the owner, <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color>!
Array.indonesia: Baiklah, mari kita mulai dengan memperkenalkan bintang acara hari ini!\nInilah pemiliknya, <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color>!

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_016
Array.english: <size=35>Um... This is a bit sudden.</size>\n<size=28><color=#C8C8C8>I’m called Ban—</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Um... Ini agak mendadak.</size>\n<size=28><color=#C8C8C8>Namaku Ban—</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_017
Array.english: <size=38>He’s quite reticent!</size>\nThat can only mean he speaks through his cooking!!
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Dia cukup pendiam!</size>\nItu berarti dia berbicara melalui masakannya!!

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_018
Array.english: This sushi bar offers a fantastic view as it’s near the Giant Blue Hole, and the chef sure gives off the vibes of a master!
Array.indonesia: Bar sushi ini menawarkan pemandangan yang fantastis karena letaknya dekat dengan Giant Blue Hole, dan koki di sini benar-benar memancarkan aura seorang ahli!

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_019
Array.english: I’m really looking forward to how the food will taste.\nVincent, which food will you be trying?
Array.indonesia: Aku benar-benar tidak sabar ingin tahu seperti apa rasanya makanan di sini.\nVincent, makanan apa yang akan kamu coba?

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_020
Array.english: I’m not really interested in the food of a place\nthat’s so focused on appearances.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak terlalu tertarik dengan makanan di tempat\nyang begitu mementingkan penampilan.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_021
Array.english: You there, Bancho, was it? Your name.
Array.indonesia: Kamu di sana, Bancho, kan? Namamu.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_022
Array.english: Let me take a look at what you can do. Let me see.\nBring me something to surprise me.
Array.indonesia: Biarkan aku lihat apa yang bisa kamu lakukan. Ayo lihat.\nBawakan sesuatu yang bisa mengejutkanku.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_023
Array.english: <size=36>Wow! Vincent offers a daring provocation!\nHe left the menu for the chef to decide!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Wow! Vincent melontarkan tantangan berani!\nDia membiarkan koki yang menentukan menunya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_024
Array.english: I can’t just sit by and listen to your prejudiced thinking.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak bisa hanya duduk diam dan mendengarkan pemikiranmu yang penuh prasangka.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_025
Array.english: <size=35>Give me <color=#1DFEAF>2 days</color>.\nI’ll be sure to shock you.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Berikan aku <color=#1DFEAF>2 hari</color>.\nAku pasti akan membuatmu terkejut.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_026
Array.english: <size=34>A standoff between a traditional gourmet and \nan exotic chef! Things are getting real interesting.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Pertarungan antara seorang pecinta kuliner tradisional dan \nseorang koki eksotis! Situasinya semakin menarik.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_027
Array.english: <size=34>We’ll come to you live on the next episode!\nDon’t forget to tune in next time to <color=#00d98f>Star★The Chef</color> <color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kami akan menyiarkannya secara langsung di episode berikutnya!\nJangan lupa menonton episode berikutnya di <color=#00d98f>Star★The Chef</color> <color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_02_001
Array.english: <size=32>What are you thinking?\nWhat are you going to do?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Apa yang kamu pikirkan?\nApa yang akan kamu lakukan?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_02_002
Array.english: A man does not run from a challenge.\nI’ve thought of something. Will you get me the ingredients?
Array.indonesia: Seorang pria tidak lari dari tantangan.\nAku sudah memikirkan sesuatu. Maukah kamu membelikanku bahan-bahannya?

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_02_003
Array.english: I need some <color=#1DFEAF>Sea Grapes</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>White Spotted Jellyfish</color>.
Array.indonesia: Aku butuh <color=#1DFEAF>Anggur Laut</color> dan <color=#1DFEAF>Ubur-ubur Bintik Putih</color>.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_02_004
Array.english: <size=32>They can both be harvested in\nthe <color=#1DFEAF>Limestone Cave</color> about 100m down in the depths.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Keduanya bisa dipanen\n di<color=#1DFEAF>Gua Batu Kapur</color> yang terletak sekitar 100 m di kedalaman.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_02_005
Array.english: By the way, you’ll need to capture the <color=#1DFEAF>White Spotted Jellyfish</color> alive! You’ll need a Tranquilizer Gun or a Net Gun.
Array.indonesia: Ngomong-ngomong, kamu harus menangkap <color=#1DFEAF>Ubur-ubur Berbintik Putih</color> dalam keadaan hidup! Kamu akan membutuhkan Senapan Bius atau Senapan Jaring.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_02_006
Array.english: Hmm. You’re going to make sushi with those? Okay...\nA <color=#1DFEAF>Limestone Cave</color>, right? I’ll go look for them.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Kamu mau bikin sushi dari itu? Oke...\nDi <color=#1DFEAF>Gua Batu Kapur</color>, kan? Aku akan pergi mencarinya.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_01_01
Array.english: <size=36>Hello, viewers!\nThis is <color=#F1DC2B>Yui</color> from <color=#00d98f>Star★The Chef</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Halo, para penonton!\nIni <color=#F1DC2B>Yui</color> dari <color=#00d98f>Star★The Chef</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_01_02
Array.english: Now, we’re back at Bancho Sushi!\nWhat kind of sushi will the chef have prepared, I wonder?
Array.indonesia: Sekarang, kita kembali ke Bancho Sushi!\nSushi apa yang sudah disiapkan oleh koki, ya?

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_01_03
Array.english: <size=34>I have prepared <color=#1DFEAF>Jellyfish Sushi</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku sudah menyiapkan <color=#1DFEAF>Sushi Ubur-ubur</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_01_04
Array.english: <size=38>Jellyfish?\nYou mean like in Chinese cold vegetables?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Ubur-ubur?\nMaksudmu seperti dalam hidangan sayuran dingin Tiongkok?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_01_05
Array.english: Did you think that you could win the acknowledgment of \nVincent Yamaoka while ignoring traditional ingredients? \nNo way!
Array.indonesia: Apa kamu pikir bisa mendapat pengakuan dari \nVincent Yamaoka sambil mengabaikan bahan-bahan tradisional? \nTidak mungkin!

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_01_06
Array.english: You call yourself a gourmet. Will you judge\nbefore you’ve even tasted it?
Array.indonesia: Kamu menyebut diri kamu seorang pecinta kuliner. Apa kamu akan menilai\nsebelum mencobanya?

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_01_07
Array.english: <size=34>Ugh... Alright.\nBring it over, then!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ugh... Baiklah.\nBawakan saja ke sini!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_01_08
Array.english: <size=35>Alright. \nI’ll bring you 1 serving of Jellyfish Sushi!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Baiklah. \nAku akan membawakanmu 1 porsi Sushi Ubur-ubur!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_02_01
Array.english: Wow! So this is jellyfish? The flesh is transparent...\nThe white dots are pretty as well!
Array.indonesia: Wow! Jadi ini ubur-ubur? Dagingnya transparan...\nTitik-titik putihnya juga cantik!

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_02_02
Array.english: What... You made it with bunched rice?\nYou should have made sure it doesn’t scatter, by making gunkan maki instead...
Array.indonesia: Apa... Kamu membuatnya dengan nasi yang digulung?\nSeharusnya kamu memastikan nasinya tidak berantakan dengan membuat gunkan maki saja...

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_02_03
Array.english: <size=34>It’ll dry up. Hurry up and eat.\nIt’s already been seasoned.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Nasi ini bakal kering. Cepat makan.\nSudah dibumbui.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_02_04
Array.english: Tsk. I know it can’t possibly taste good,\nbut since it’s for the program, I’ll try it...
Array.indonesia: Ckck. Aku tahu rasanya pasti nggak enak,\ntapi karena ini untuk acara, aku akan mencobanya...

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_03_01
Array.english: <size=40>Vincent, the look on your face...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Vincent, ekspresi wajahmu...</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_03_02
Array.english: This is amazing...I can taste the sea as soon as I\nbite into it, and the jellyfish is nice and firm!
Array.indonesia: Ini luar biasa...Aku bisa merasakan rasa laut begitu aku\nmenggigitnya, dan ubur-uburnya kenyal dan padat!

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_03_03
Array.english: <size=38>And I taste something popping inside!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Dan aku merasakan sesuatu yang meletup di dalam!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_03_04
Array.english: Could it be flying fish roe? Wait, they’re bigger than that. Caviar?\nNo, that would have killed the jellyfish flavor...Could it be...
Array.indonesia: Mungkinkah itu telur ikan terbang? Tunggu, ukurannya lebih besar dari itu. Kaviar?\nTidak, itu pasti akan menghilangkan rasa ubur-ubur...Mungkinkah itu...

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_03_05
Array.english: <size=35>Yes. \nI added some <color=#1DFEAF>SeaGrape</color> below the jellyfish.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ya. \nAku menambahkan sedikit <color=#1DFEAF>SeaGrape</color> di bawah ubur-ubur.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_03_06
Array.english: <size=38>Firm jellyfish flesh and SeaGrape, huh...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Daging ubur-ubur yang kenyal dan SeaGrape, ya...</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_03_07
Array.english: <size=38>This is... the <color=#a1edf7>sea</color>! I taste the <color=#a1edf7>sea</color>!\nThe <color=#a1edf7>sea</color>, where the sea kelp sway...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Ini adalah... <color=#a1edf7>laut</color>! Aku merasakan <color=#a1edf7>laut</color>!\n<color=#a1edf7>laut</color>, tempat rumput laut bergoyang...</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_03_08
Array.english: Hmm... I can’t help but admit it...\nThis sushi is amazing, based on a very deep understanding of the ingredients.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Aku tak bisa tidak mengakuinya...\nSushi ini luar biasa, dibuat berdasarkan pemahaman yang sangat mendalam tentang bahan-bahannya.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_03_09
Array.english: But why is it that you use such unknown ingredients\ninstead of the proven ones?
Array.indonesia: Tapi mengapa kamu menggunakan bahan-bahan yang tidak dikenal\ndaripada yang sudah teruji?

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_03_10
Array.english: <size=35>The first reason is the taste.</size>\rJellyfish has a gentle, mild taste with a strong texture,\nmaking it a perfect match for the scent and flavor of SeaGrape.
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Alasan pertama adalah rasanya.</size>\rUbur-ubur memiliki rasa yang lembut dan ringan dengan tekstur yang kuat,\nsehingga sangat cocok dengan aroma dan rasa SeaGrape.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_03_11
Array.english: The second reason is the potential.\nThere are so many kinds of ingredients out there.
Array.indonesia: Alasan kedua adalah potensinya.\nAda begitu banyak jenis bahan di luar sana.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_03_12
Array.english: Insisting on using only the verified few,\nis the same as ignoring the infinite possibilities.
Array.indonesia: Berpegang teguh hanya pada beberapa bahan yang sudah teruji,\nsama saja dengan mengabaikan kemungkinan yang tak terbatas.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_03_13
Array.english: <size=32>Thank you for those amazing words, Bancho!\nNow then, it’s time for the evaluation... Vincent?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Terima kasih atas kata-kata luar biasa itu, Bancho!\nNah, sekarang saatnya evaluasi... Vincent?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_03_14
Array.english: Alright.\nLet’s get into the evaluation.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah.\nMari kita mulai evaluasinya.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_03_15
Array.english: Now! This is the Jellyfish Sushi that made Vincent marvel!\nAnd Mr.Bancho who created this dish!\r<size=40>What will the score be?</size>
Array.indonesia: Nah! Inilah Sushi Ubur-ubur yang membuat Vincent takjub!\nDan Tuan Bancho yang menciptakan hidangan ini!\r<size=40>Berapa nilainya?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_03_16
Array.english: <size=38>I’ll give Bancho Sushi... <color=#FF6F23>80 points</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Aku akan memberi Sushi Bancho... <color=#FF6F23>80 poin</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_03_17
Array.english: Huh? Isn’t that too low?\nYou looked quite impressed while eating.
Array.indonesia: Hah? Bukankah itu terlalu rendah?\nKamu terlihat cukup terkesan saat memakannya.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_03_18
Array.english: Listen, the sushi was excellent.\nThis establishment lacks something, though!
Array.indonesia: Dengar, sushinya memang luar biasa.\nTapi tempat ini kurang sesuatu!

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_03_19
Array.english: Eating combines many enjoyments. To think you’d only offer Green Tea with this beautiful ocean in front of us...
Array.indonesia: Makan itu menggabungkan banyak kenikmatan. Siapa sangka kamu hanya menyajikan Teh Hijau padahal ada laut yang indah di depan kita...

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_03_20
Array.english: <size=32>Romance!\nThis place doesn’t have enough romance and appreciation for the arts!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Romantisme!\nTempat ini kurang romantis dan kurang menghargai seni!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_03_21
Array.english: <size=32>That’s why I’ll give this place 80 points.\nAs a side reward, however, I’ll give you a <color=#1DFEAF>Refrigerator</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Itulah mengapa aku akan memberi tempat ini 80 poin.\nNamun, sebagai hadiah tambahan, aku akan memberimu sebuah <color=#1DFEAF>kulkas</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_03_22
Array.english: Being able to drink cold beer from that fridge...\nwould make the score 100! It’ll be perfect.
Array.indonesia: Bisa minum bir dingin dari kulkas itu...\npasti akan membuat nilainya jadi 100! Itu akan sempurna.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_03_23
Array.english: <size=36>Wow! As expected of you, Vincent!\nThat was an excellent opinion.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Wow! Seperti yang kuduga dari kamu, Vincent!\nItu pendapat yang sangat bagus.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_03_24
Array.english: Now, how did you like <color=#00d98f>Star★The Chef</color> today?\nWe’ll be really looking forward to Bancho Sushi’s exotic sushi being served with beer!
Array.indonesia: Nah, bagaimana pendapatmu tentang <color=#00d98f>Star★The Chef</color> hari ini?\nKami sangat menantikan sushi eksotis dari Bancho Sushi yang disajikan bersama bir!

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_03_25
Array.english: <size=38>See you again next time <color=#ff61e3>♥</color>\nThis was reporter Yui!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Sampai jumpa lagi di lain waktu <color=#ff61e3>♥</color>\nIni reporter Yui!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_04_01
Array.english: Wow, Bancho! Amazing!\nThat picky Vincent acknowledged you!
Array.indonesia: Wow, Bancho! Luar biasa!\nVincent yang pemilih itu pun mengakui kamu!

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_04_02
Array.english: <size=33>The tongue does not lie.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Lidah tidak pernah berbohong.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_04_03
Array.english: Vincent has a point.\nShall we try selling <color=#F1DC2B>Beer</color> from now on?
Array.indonesia: Vincent memang benar.\nBagaimana kalau kita coba jual <color=#F1DC2B>Bir</color> mulai sekarang?

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Fail_01
Array.english: Hehe. I knew it.\nAfter all that bluster, you have nothing to show for it!
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Aku tahu.\nSetelah semua omong kosong itu, kamu nggak punya apa-apa untuk dibanggakan!

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Fail_02
Array.english: Hehe. I knew it.\nAfter all that bluster, you have nothing to show for it!
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Aku tahu.\nSetelah semua omong kosong itu, kamu tidak punya apa-apa untuk dibanggakan!

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Fail_03
Array.english: Ah... we won’t be able to film like this...\nWe’ll have to change the schedule again...
Array.indonesia: Ah... kita tidak bisa syuting seperti ini...\nKita harus mengubah jadwal lagi...

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Vincent_Phone_Fail_01
Array.english: You didn’t open the restaurant today. Unbelievable.
Array.indonesia: Kamu tidak membuka restoran hari ini. Nggak bisa dipercaya.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Vincent_Phone_Fail_02
Array.english: I know you're afraid…\nbut if you're a true chef, toughen up!
Array.indonesia: Aku tahu kamu takut…\ntapi kalau kamu koki sejati, bersikaplah lebih tangguh!

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Vincent_Phone_Fail_03
Array.english: <size=35>I'll be in touch!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Aku akan menghubungimu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Revisit_01
Array.english: Hmm. I’ve grown a bit curious\nabout what you want to make. Let me see.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Aku jadi sedikit penasaran\ndengan apa yang ingin kamu buat. Coba kulihat.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Revisit_02
Array.english: I’ll come back <color=#F1DC2B>tomorrow</color>,\nso try and get things ready again.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan kembali <color=#F1DC2B>besok</color>,\njadi coba siapkan semuanya lagi.

Array.name: dialog_Customer_Mission02_001
Array.english: Huh? Where are you going?
Array.indonesia: Hah? Mau ke mana?

Array.name: dialog_Customer_Mission02_Complete_01
Array.english: Try collecting crops here.\nBancho will have more types of food to prepare.
Array.indonesia: Coba panen tanaman di sini.\nBancho akan punya lebih banyak jenis makanan untuk disiapkan.

Array.name: dialog_Customer_PaddyExpansion_Start
Array.english: <size=32>Alright! I’ll slightly expand the rice paddy after the next harvest.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Baiklah! Aku akan sedikit memperluas sawah setelah panen berikutnya.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Customer_FarmExpansion_Start
Array.english: <size=32>Alright! I’ll slightly expand the Vegetable Farm by tomorrow morning.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Baiklah! Aku akan sedikit memperluas Kebun Sayur sebelum besok pagi.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Customer_FarmExpansion_Complete
Array.english: <size=32>What do you think? Neat, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Bagaimana menurutmu? Keren, kan?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Customer_FarmExpansion_Complete_002
Array.english: Now you have more room to grow your crops!
Array.indonesia: Sekarang kamu punya lebih banyak ruang untuk menanam tanamanmu!

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Start_001
Array.english: Huh?\nLittle kid, we haven’t opened yet.
Array.indonesia: Hah?\nNak, kami belum buka.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Start_002
Array.english: <size=50>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Start_003
Array.english: <size=36>Hello? Kid?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Halo? Nak?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Start_004
Array.english: <size=50>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Start_005
Array.english: Um... you look like a student... we haven’t opened yet.\nCome back a bit later.
Array.indonesia: Um... kamu terlihat seperti pelajar... kami belum buka.\nKembalilah nanti.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Start_006
Array.english: <size=40>Listen, you %$@#!\nI heard you the one time, so stop babbling!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Dengar, kamu %$@#!\nAku sudah dengar sekali, jadi berhenti mengoceh!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Start_007
Array.english: <size=42>Wh-what in the world?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>A-apa-apaan ini?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Start_008
Array.english: I-I’m sorry! It wasn’t me...
Array.indonesia: M-maaf! Bukan aku...

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Start_009
Array.english: <size=40>You rotten blowfish, you!\nGet me food, food!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Kau ikan buntal busuk, kau!\nBawakan aku makanan, makanan!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Start_010
Array.english: Um... What in the world is going on here?
Array.indonesia: Um... Apa yang sebenarnya terjadi di sini?

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Start_011
Array.english: I think I’ve read about this somewhere.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya aku pernah membaca tentang ini di suatu tempat.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Start_012
Array.english: There’s a therapy method that involves letting \ntraumatized kids speak their mind through dolls.
Array.indonesia: Ada metode terapi yang melibatkan membiarkan \nanak-anak yang mengalami trauma mengungkapkan perasaannya melalui boneka.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Start_013
Array.english: <size=40>Doll? How dare you!\nYou idiots don’t deserve to live!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Boneka? Berani-beraninya kamu!\nKalian para idiot tidak pantas hidup!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Start_014
Array.english: <size=36>I... suppose it could be something more complicated.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Aku... kira ini mungkin sesuatu yang lebih rumit.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Start_015
Array.english: Let’s ask what she wants first.
Array.indonesia: Ayo tanya dulu apa yang dia mau.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Start_016
Array.english: <size=40><color=#1DFEAF>Kombu and White Trevally Ochazuke</color>!\nI want it! I do!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40><color=#1DFEAF>Ochazuke dengan Kombu dan Ikan Trevally Putih</color>!\nAku mau itu! Aku mau!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Start_017
Array.english: Um... That sounds likes something older men would want.
Array.indonesia: Um... Kedengarannya seperti sesuatu yang diinginkan pria yang lebih tua.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Start_018
Array.english: I don’t know what’s going on, but we’ll have to give her \nwhat she wants for us to try and have a conversation...
Array.indonesia: Aku nggak tahu apa yang sedang terjadi, tapi kita harus memberinya \napa yang dia mau biar kita bisa mencoba ngobrol...

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Start_019
Array.english: <color=#1DFEAF>Kombu and White Trevally Ochazuke</color>...\nLet’s check the ingredients first.
Array.indonesia: <color=#1DFEAF>Ochazuke Kombu dan Ikan Trevally Putih</color>...\nAyo kita cek bahan-bahannya dulu.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_001
Array.english: *Sob* *Sob*
Array.indonesia: *Hiks* *Hiks*

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_002
Array.english: Huh? Why are you crying suddenly?
Array.indonesia: Hah? Kenapa tiba-tiba kamu nangis?

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_003
Array.english: <size=40>It’s too good! You $#%#$!\nThis is way too good!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Ini terlalu enak! Dasar $#%#$!\nIni terlalu enak banget!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=40>Damn it, it’s too good!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Sial, ini terlalu enak!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_005
Array.english: It... reminds me of my father... *sob*
Array.indonesia: Ini... mengingatkanku pada ayahku... *hiks*

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_006
Array.english: Wh-what’s going on, kid?
Array.indonesia: A-ada apa, Nak?

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_007
Array.english: My name is Maki... I’m looking for my father...
Array.indonesia: Namaku Maki... Aku sedang mencari ayahku...

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_008
Array.english: My father left to explore the depths...\nAnd I can’t get in touch with him anymore.
Array.indonesia: Ayahku pergi menjelajahi kedalaman...\nDan aku tidak bisa menghubunginya lagi.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_009
Array.english: His favorite food was\n<color=#1DFEAF>Kombu and White Trevally Ochazuke</color>,\nand I heard you sell it here...
Array.indonesia: Makanan favoritnya adalah\n<color=#1DFEAF>Kombu dan Ochazuke Ikan Trevally Putih</color>,\ndan aku dengar kamu menjualnya di sini...

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_009_2
Array.english: <size=37>I thought he might have come by here...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Aku pikir mungkin dia pernah mampir ke sini.. .</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_010
Array.english: That’s a pity...\nI’ll be sure to tell you if we see someone that looks like your father.
Array.indonesia: Sayang sekali...\nAku pasti akan memberitahumu jika kami melihat seseorang yang mirip dengan ayahmu.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_011
Array.english: And what is that doll?
Array.indonesia: Dan boneka apa itu?

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_012
Array.english: This is a <color=#1DFEAF>Clione</color> plushie. My father gave it to me\nbefore he left.
Array.indonesia: Ini adalah <color=#1DFEAF>Clione</color> boneka berbulu. Ayahku memberikannya kepadaku\nsebelum dia pergi.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_013
Array.english: Oh! I have a favor to ask. It’s about the Clione...
Array.indonesia: Oh! Aku mau minta tolong. Soal Clione itu...

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_014
Array.english: <size=33>I’ve never seen one in person.\nCould you catch one for me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku belum pernah melihatnya secara langsung.\nBisakah kamu menangkap satu untukku?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_015
Array.english: <size=35>Huh? A <color=#1DFEAF>Clione</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Hah? Seekor <color=#1DFEAF>Clione</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_016
Array.english: Um... We can’t catch something so small with a Harpoon...\nWhat do we do?
Array.indonesia: Um... Kita tidak bisa menangkap sesuatu yang sekecil itu dengan tombak...\nApa yang harus kita lakukan?

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_017
Array.english: <size=36>Could we use this?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Bisakah kita pakai ini?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_018
Array.english: <size=38>Oh? A <color=#F1DC2B>Bug Net</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Oh? Jaring <color=#F1DC2B>serangga</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_019
Array.english: Hmm... I think it might work.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Menurutku mungkin bisa berhasil.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_020
Array.english: <size=36>Alright. I’ll give it a shot!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Baiklah. Aku akan mencobanya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_021
Array.english: <size=40>What are you doing, you walrus!\nGet your tights on and jump in the water!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Apa yang kamu lakukan, dasar walrus!\nPakai celana ketatmu dan lompat ke air!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_022
Array.english: Oh... I’m so sorry…\nI can’t control my emotions that well yet...
Array.indonesia: Oh... Maaf banget…\nAku belum bisa mengendalikan emosiku dengan baik...

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_023
Array.english: <size=50>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_boss_4th_complete_beforeTimeline
Array.english: I just need one more.\nI should look around more.
Array.indonesia: Aku cuma butuh satu lagi.\nMungkin aku harus cari-cari lagi.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_boss_4th_complete_afterTimeline
Array.english: Just now... Did I see a huge Clione?
Array.indonesia: Tadi... Apakah aku melihat Clione raksasa?

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_boss_5th_complete
Array.english: Phew. All done.\nShould I go back up now?
Array.indonesia: Wah. Sudah selesai.\nHaruskah aku naik kembali sekarang?

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_boss_enter_001
Array.english: What! What is this place?
Array.indonesia: Apa! Tempat apa ini?

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_boss_enter_002
Array.english: Oh no...\nThat’s such a big Clione!
Array.indonesia: Oh tidak...\nItu Clione yang sangat besar!

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_boss_start_001
Array.english: Ugh... I probably won’t get away without a fight...
Array.indonesia: Ugh... Sepertinya aku nggak bakal bisa kabur tanpa bertarung...

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_boss_start_002
Array.english: Whatever. Let’s defeat it first!
Array.indonesia: Sudahlah. Ayo kita kalahkan dulu!

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_boss_end_01_001
Array.english: <size=38>Phew... What a monster...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Wah... Monster yang luar biasa...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_boss_end_01_002
Array.english: It still stings.
Array.indonesia: Masih terasa perih.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_boss_end_01_003
Array.english: Let me see if there's anything useful to pick up.
Array.indonesia: Aku coba lihat apakah ada barang berguna yang bisa diambil.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_boss_end_BossCarving_001
Array.english: <size=36>Huh? I see something shiny over there.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Hah? Aku lihat ada sesuatu yang berkilau di sana.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_boss_end_BossCarving_002
Array.english: <size=34>I should go have a look.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku harus pergi melihatnya.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_boss_end_02_001
Array.english: <size=38>Huh? A photo of <color=#F1DC2B>Maki</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Hah? Foto <color=#F1DC2B>Maki</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_boss_end_02_002
Array.english: <size=36>I’ll have to take it back up.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Aku harus mengambilnya kembali.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_Complete_01
Array.english: Here, a <color=#1DFEAF>Clione</color> like you asked.
Array.indonesia: Ini dia, <color=#1DFEAF>Clione</color> seperti yang kamu minta.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_Complete_02
Array.english: It’s so beautiful!\nThank you... Dave.
Array.indonesia: Indah sekali!\nTerima kasih... Dave.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_Complete_03
Array.english: And... I found this.
Array.indonesia: Dan... aku menemukan ini.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_Complete_04
Array.english: <size=35>Huh? Is this a photo of me?</size>
