Array.indonesia: Kurasa begitu. Aku pernah melihat satu di dekat <color=#1DFEAF>Glacial Passage</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Start_008
Array.english: Dave, I'm sorry to ask you again…\nBut could you look for Selgio?
Array.indonesia: Dave, maaf aku harus meminta tolong lagi…\nTapi bisakah kamu mencari Selgio?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Start_009
Array.english: If he's hiding somewhere, you can lure him out with some <color=#F1DC2B>feed</color>.
Array.indonesia: Kalau dia bersembunyi di suatu tempat, kamu bisa memancingnya keluar dengan <color=#F1DC2B>makanan</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Start_010
Array.english: Okay. I'll search around the <color=#1DFEAF>Glacial Passage</color>.
Array.indonesia: Oke. Aku akan mencari di sekitar <color=#1DFEAF>Glacial Passage</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_001
Array.english: <size=34>Huh? A <color=#F1DC2B>Shining Jellyfish</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hah? Seekor <color=#F1DC2B>Shining Jellyfish</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_002
Array.english: That looks like something Selgio would like.\nI should follow it!
Array.indonesia: Itu sepertinya sesuatu yang disukai Selgio.\nAku harus mengikutinya!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_Timeattack_001
Array.english: It seems like the path collapsed when the giant Gadon woke up.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya jalan itu runtuh saat Gadon raksasa itu bangun.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_Timeattack_002
Array.english: <size=33>I've come this far. I can't lose it now!\nGotta keep following it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku sudah sampai sejauh ini. Aku tidak boleh kehilangan jejaknya sekarang!\nHarus terus mengikutinya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Timeattack_Barricade_001
Array.english: <size=32>I might lose the jelly fish!\nLet's keep after it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku mungkin akan kehilangan ubur-ubur itu!\nAyo terus mengejarnya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_gone_001
Array.english: Ah… The jellyfish disappeared.
Array.indonesia: Ah… Ubur-ubur itu menghilang.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_gone_002
Array.english: Hmm… Why don't I look around the area where it disappeared?
Array.indonesia: Hmm… Kenapa aku tidak mencari-cari di sekitar tempat ia menghilang?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Barricade01_001
Array.english: Selgio's gotta be here. I should look around a bit more.
Array.indonesia: Selgio pasti ada di sini. Aku harus mencari-cari sedikit lagi.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_holefound_001
Array.english: Huh? I just heard something behind the ice.
Array.indonesia: Hah? Aku baru saja mendengar sesuatu di balik es.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_holefound_002
Array.english: I think <color=#F1DC2B>Selgio</color> is hiding behind this sheet of ice…
Array.indonesia: Kurasa <color=#F1DC2B>Selgio</color> bersembunyi di balik lembaran es ini…

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_holefound_003
Array.english: Oh, right! I have the <color=#1DFEAF>Ice Pick</color> Tsuchi gave me!
Array.indonesia: Oh, benar! Aku punya <color=#1DFEAF>Ice Pick</color> yang diberikan Tsuchi padaku!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_holefound_004
Array.english: Stay right there, you little rascal.
Array.indonesia: Tetap di sana, dasar nakal kecil.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_food_start_001
Array.english: <size=35>Alright! I broke the sheet of ice!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oke! Aku berhasil memecahkan lapisan es itu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_food_start_002
Array.english: Now I should use the <color=#F1DC2B>feed</color> Linchen gave me to lure it.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang aku harus menggunakan <color=#F1DC2B>pakan</color> yang diberikan Linchen padaku untuk memancingnya.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_capture_01_001
Array.english: Alright! Selgio came out!\nNow, time to capture it with a butterfly net!
Array.indonesia: Oke! Selgio sudah muncul!\nSekarang, saatnya menangkapnya dengan jaring kupu-kupu!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_capture_02_001
Array.english: Selgio sure is fearless, considering it came all the way here.
Array.indonesia: Selgio memang berani sekali, mengingat dia datang jauh-jauh ke sini.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_capture_02_002
Array.english: I should go see Linchen now.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus menemui Linchen sekarang.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_complete01_001
Array.english: Huh? Linchen, what brings you here?
Array.indonesia: Hah? Linchen, apa yang membawamu ke sini?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_complete01_002
Array.english: I was so worried about Selgio, I couldn't stay inside…\nYou found him!
Array.indonesia: Aku sangat khawatir dengan Selgio, jadi aku tidak bisa tinggal di dalam…\nKamu menemukannya!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_complete01_003
Array.english: Come here, Selgio.
Array.indonesia: Kemarilah, Selgio.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_complete02_001
Array.english: Dave, I owe you again.
Array.indonesia: Dave, aku berhutang budi padamu lagi.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_complete02_002
Array.english: Haha, not at all.\nI hope Selgio doesn't cause any more trouble.
Array.indonesia: Haha, tidak apa-apa.\nSemoga Selgio tidak menimbulkan masalah lagi.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_complete02_003
Array.english: *Giggles* Come visit the <color=#F1DC2B>Game Parlor</color> later. I have a small reward for you.
Array.indonesia: *Tertawa kecil* Nanti mampir ke <color=#F1DC2B>Game Parlor</color> ya. Aku punya hadiah kecil buatmu.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_complete02_004
Array.english: I'll be on my way, then.\nTake care, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Kalau begitu, aku pergi dulu.\nJaga diri baik-baik, Dave.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_reward01_001
Array.english: Dave, you're here.
Array.indonesia: Dave, kamu di sini.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_reward01_002
Array.english: Thank you for saving Selgio.
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih sudah menyelamatkan Selgio.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_reward01_003
Array.english: It seems he likes to wander around when there's no one watching him.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya dia suka berkeliling saat tidak ada yang mengawasinya.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_reward01_004
Array.english: *Giggle* This is a small gift for you.
Array.indonesia: *Tertawa kecil* Ini hadiah kecil untukmu.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_reward01_005
Array.english: Here's to our friendship, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Untuk persahabatan kita, Dave.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SushiBarEvent_GetMail_001
Array.english: <size=33>Huh? Some kind of mail is here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hah? Ada surat masuk.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SushiBarEvent_GetMail_002
Array.english: <size=33>Should I check it...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Haruskah aku memeriksanya...?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SushiBarEvent_Start_001
Array.english: <size=35>Oh! A party!\nWhat a nice looking picture, pwhahaha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh! Pesta!\nFoto yang bagus sekali, pwhahaha!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SushiBarEvent_Start_002
Array.english: I guess they’re trying to open this place for tourism.\nI just hope it doesn’t get too chaotic.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya mereka sedang berusaha membuka tempat ini untuk pariwisata.\nAku hanya berharap situasinya tidak menjadi terlalu kacau.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SushiBarEvent_Start_003
Array.english: Well, it’s a party held on a special day.\nWe just need to prepare for more customers!
Array.indonesia: Nah, ini pesta yang diadakan di hari istimewa.\nKita cuma perlu bersiap-siap menyambut lebih banyak pelanggan!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SushiBarEvent_Start_004
Array.english: The mail said the party’s theme was jellyfish.\n<color=#F1DC2B>Jellyfish</color> dishes should be popular!
Array.indonesia: Di email tertulis tema pestanya adalah ubur-ubur.\n<color=#F1DC2B>Hidangan </color>ubur-ubur</color> pasti bakal laris!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SushiBarEvent_Start_005
Array.english: <size=33>It’s <runtime_info type=next_moon_date value=HalfMoon/>... so we have <color=#1DFEAF>3 days</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ini <runtime_info type=next_moon_date value=HalfMoon/>... jadi kita punya <color=#1DFEAF>3 hari</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SushiBarEvent_Start_006
Array.english: <size=32>Haha! Make sure to prepare some <color=#F1DC2B>jellyfish</color>, \nwhatever kind it may be. Let’s hit the jackpot!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha! Pastikan untuk menyiapkan beberapa <color=#F1DC2B>ubur-ubur</color>, \napa pun jenisnya. Ayo raih kesuksesan besar!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Start_001
Array.english: <size=38>Oh my! You’re the human!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Astaga! Kamu manusia!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Start_002
Array.english: I’m <color=#F1DC2B>Yami</color>.\nI’m in charge of this Seahorse Racecourse, hehe.
Array.indonesia: Aku <color=#F1DC2B>Yami</color>.\nAku yang bertanggung jawab atas Arena Balap Kuda Laut ini, hehe.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Start_003
Array.english: *Sigh* I heard you caught all the Seahorses that ran off...\nThank you so much for that.
Array.indonesia: *Huff* Kudengar kamu sudah menangkap semua Kuda Laut yang kabur...\nTerima kasih banyak untuk itu.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Start_004
Array.english: I heard from Linchen already. \nWe’ll give you a nice, strong Sea Horse as a gift for your efforts!
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah mendengarnya dari Linchen. \nKami akan memberimu seekor Kuda Laut yang bagus dan kuat sebagai hadiah atas usahamu!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_AfterReceive_001
Array.english: Wow... I’ve seen many Seahorses like this elsewhere as well.\nCan they also race here?
Array.indonesia: Wow... Aku juga pernah melihat banyak Kuda Laut seperti ini di tempat lain.\nApakah mereka juga bisa ikut balapan di sini?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_AfterReceive_002
Array.english: <size=34>Of course!\nBring them to me and I’ll register them for the races.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Tentu saja!\nBawa saja ke sini dan aku akan mendaftarkannya untuk balapan.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_AfterReceive_003
Array.english: <size=36>Since you’re here, why don’t you try registering\nyour new Seahorse?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Selagi kamu di sini, kenapa tidak mencoba mendaftarkan\nSeahorse barumu?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_AfterReceive_004
Array.english: <size=40>Select the <color=#1DFEAF>Register</color> menu.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Pilih menu <color=#1DFEAF>Daftar</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Register_001
Array.english: Hehe! This is where you can <color=#1DFEAF>Register</color>\nSeahorses you’ve caught for the races.
Array.indonesia: Hehe! Di sinilah kamu bisa <color=#1DFEAF>mendaftarkan</color>\nSeahorse yang sudah kamu tangkap untuk balapan.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Register_002
Array.english: <size=40>Why don’t you try it out right now?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Mengapa tidak mencobanya sekarang juga?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Register_Done_001
Array.english: Good.\nNext, select the <color=#1DFEAF>Race</color> menu to get ready to race!
Array.indonesia: Bagus.\nSelanjutnya, pilih menu <color=#1DFEAF>Balapan</color> untuk bersiap-siap balapan!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Management_001
Array.english: This is where you can check on the growth of your Seahorses.
Array.indonesia: Di sini kamu bisa memeriksa pertumbuhan kuda lautmu.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Management_002
Array.english: Seahorses that have grown fully can be used as <color=#1DFEAF>Coaches</color>.\nYou don’t have any grown ones yet, so check back later. Hehe.
Array.indonesia: Kuda laut yang sudah tumbuh sepenuhnya dapat digunakan sebagai <color=#1DFEAF>Pelatih</color>.\nKamu belum punya yang sudah tumbuh, jadi periksa lagi nanti. Hehe.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Management_003
Array.english: Now then, let’s get started with a race.\nPlease go to <color=#1DFEAF>Race</color>.
Array.indonesia: Nah, mari kita mulai balapan.\nSilakan pergi ke <color=#1DFEAF>Balapan</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Play_01_001
Array.english: This is where you can select the course and begin a race.\nSince you’re new to this...
Array.indonesia: Di sini kamu bisa memilih lintasan dan memulai balapan.\nKarena kamu masih baru...

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Play_01_002
Array.english: <size=36>I suggest selecting <color=#1DFEAF>Course C</color> for starters.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Saya sarankan memilih <color=#1DFEAF>Lintasan C</color> untuk permulaan.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Play_02_001
Array.english: <size=36>We’ll select <color=#1DFEAF>General</color> now.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Kita akan memilih <color=#1DFEAF>Umum</color> sekarang.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Play_03_001
Array.english: This is where you can see the participants\nand check who you’re up against. Hehe.
Array.indonesia: Di sini kamu bisa melihat para peserta\ndan memeriksa siapa saja lawanmu. Hehe.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Play_03_002
Array.english: <size=34>Now then, shall we select a <color=#1DFEAF>Seahorse</color> for the race?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Nah, bagaimana kalau kita pilih <color=#1DFEAF>Kuda Laut</color> untuk balapan ini?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Play_04_001
Array.english: This is where you can select one of\nthe <color=#1DFEAF>Seahorses</color> you’ve registered.
Array.indonesia: Di sini kamu bisa memilih salah satu dari\n<color=#1DFEAF>Kuda Laut</color> yang sudah kamu daftarkan.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Play_04_002
Array.english: Oh, the seahorses’ <color=#1DFEAF>stamina</color> is really important!\nAlways make sure to check the arrow on the right.
Array.indonesia: Oh, <color=#1DFEAF>stamina</color> kuda laut sangat penting!\nPastikan selalu memeriksa panah di sebelah kanan.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Play_04_003
Array.english: Once seahorses race, they need to rest to recover their <color=#1DFEAF>stamina</color>.\nYou should have several seahorses ready for the race.
Array.indonesia: Setelah kuda laut berlomba, mereka perlu beristirahat untuk memulihkan <color=#1DFEAF>stamina</color> mereka.\nSebaiknya kamu menyiapkan beberapa kuda laut untuk balapan.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Play_04_004
Array.english: <size=40>Let’s go with this one for now.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Ayo kita pilih yang ini dulu.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Play_05_001
Array.english: This is where you can select their <color=#1DFEAF>Food</color>.
Array.indonesia: Di sini kamu bisa memilih <color=#1DFEAF>Makanan</color> mereka.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Play_05_002
Array.english: If you’d like to enhance the performance\nof your Seahorses, it’s crucial you provide them with good food.
Array.indonesia: Jika kamu ingin meningkatkan performa\nkuda lautmu, sangat penting untuk memberi mereka makanan yang baik.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Play_05_003
Array.english: As with anything in this world...\nThe more expensive it is, the better the quality, hehe.
Array.indonesia: Seperti halnya segala sesuatu di dunia ini...\nSemakin mahal harganya, semakin baik kualitasnya, hehe.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Play_06_001
Array.english: <size=40>Looks like you’re all set.\nLet’s get started!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Sepertinya kamu sudah siap.\nAyo kita mulai!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Result_01_001
Array.english: <size=38>Wow! That’s impressive for your first race!\nI knew you had potential!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Wow! Itu mengesankan untuk balapan pertamamu!\nAku tahu kamu punya potensi!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Result_02_001
Array.english: Oh dear... I must not have provided an adequate explanation.\nDon’t worry, everyone starts off like this.
Array.indonesia: Astaga... Sepertinya aku belum memberikan penjelasan yang memadai.\nJangan khawatir, semua orang memulai seperti ini.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Result_linked_001
Array.english: Raise your Seahorse well, since their abilities grow\nas they themselves do.
Array.indonesia: Pelihara Kuda Lautmu dengan baik, karena kemampuannya akan berkembang\nseiring pertumbuhannya.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Result_linked_002
Array.english: <size=38>Don’t forget to try out\nmore courses, either! Hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Jangan lupa untuk mencoba\nlintasan lain juga! Hehe.</size>

Array.name: dialog_SeahorseRacing_Yami_Talk_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh you're back, Human!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh, kamu sudah kembali, Manusia!</size>

Array.name: dialog_SeahorseRacing_Yami_Talk_002
Array.english: <size=33>Get ready for some exciting Seahorse racing!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Bersiaplah untuk balapan Kuda Laut yang seru!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Common_InGame_WrongWay
Array.english: This doesn’t seem to be the right way.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya ini bukan jalan yang benar.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Not_answering_01
Array.english: Hmm... not picking up.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... tidak terdeteksi.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Duff01_001
Array.english: What is it?.\nI’m kind of busy right now with research.
Array.indonesia: Ada apa?.\nAku lagi sibuk dengan penelitian.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Duff01_002
Array.english: I hear a TV in the background, though...
Array.indonesia: Tapi aku dengar suara TV di latar belakang...

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Duff01_003
Array.english: Y-you’re breaking up.\nSee you, then. <color=#ff61e3>GOODBYE-TERNITY★</color>.
Array.indonesia: S-sinyalnya putus-putus.\nSampai jumpa, ya. <color=#ff61e3>GOODBYE-TERNITY★</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Duff02_001
Array.english: <color=#ff61e3>Master. A new task has arrived.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#ff61e3>Tuan. Tugas baru sudah masuk.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Duff02_002
Array.english: What was that?
Array.indonesia: Apa itu?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Duff02_003
Array.english: Whoops. That was my phone going off...\nI-it’s nothing. I’m hanging up now.
Array.indonesia: Ups. Itu ponselku yang berbunyi...\nT-tidak apa-apa. Aku tutup telepon dulu.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Duff03_001
Array.english: Dave, have you been collecting gun materials?
Array.indonesia: Dave, apakah kamu sudah mengumpulkan bahan senjata?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Duff03_002
Array.english: Yeah, whatever I can get my hands on…
Array.indonesia: Ya, apa pun yang bisa kudapatkan…

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Duff03_003
Array.english: You can't just collect anything.\nYou can collect new materials in the Sea People Village, can't you?
Array.indonesia: Kamu nggak bisa sembarangan mengumpulkan apa saja.\nKamu bisa mengumpulkan bahan-bahan baru di Desa Suku Laut, kan?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Duff03_004
Array.english: <size=34>See if you can get anything from there.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Coba lihat apakah kamu bisa mendapatkan sesuatu dari sana.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Duff04_001
Array.english: I couldn't go to the last meeting because I had some important parcel deli—I mean, important work to do.
Array.indonesia: Aku nggak bisa datang ke pertemuan terakhir karena ada urusan pengiriman paket penting—maksudku, pekerjaan penting yang harus diselesaikan.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Duff04_002
Array.english: But I kind of regret not going.
Array.indonesia: Tapi aku agak menyesal tidak pergi.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Duff04_003
Array.english: I'll drop by if there's another get-together.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan mampir kalau ada pertemuan lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Duff04_004
Array.english: <size=33>Until then.\n<color=#ff61e3>GOODBYE-TERNITY★</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Sampai jumpa.\n<color=#ff61e3>GOODBYE-TERNITY★</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Cobra01_001
Array.english: What’s the point of calling when you’re so close! It’s a waste of phone fees!\nTalk to me in person.
Array.indonesia: Ngapain telepon kalau kamu udah deket banget! Itu buang-buang pulsa!\nBicaralah langsung denganku.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Cobra01_002
Array.english: <size=36>Oh... okay.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Oh... oke.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Cobra02_001
Array.english: Hmm? Dave, you're not on the boat. Where are you?
Array.indonesia: Hmm? Dave, kamu tidak ada di kapal. Di mana kamu?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Cobra02_002
Array.english: I'm nearby—
Array.indonesia: Aku di dekat sini—

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Cobra02_003
Array.english: <size=33>Okay. Let me know if you need me!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oke. Beri tahu aku kalau kamu butuh aku!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bacon01_001
Array.english: What is it?\nDid you discover something new?
Array.indonesia: Ada apa?\nApakah kamu menemukan sesuatu yang baru?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bacon01_002
Array.english: That’s not it...
Array.indonesia: Bukan itu...

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bacon01_003
Array.english: I see...\nTell me if you see anything peculiar, whatever it may be!
Array.indonesia: Begitu...\nBeri tahu aku kalau kamu melihat sesuatu yang aneh, apa pun itu!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bacon02_001
Array.english: There must be a reason we’re finding traces of the Sea People civilization here when they could be found nowhere else.
Array.indonesia: Pasti ada alasan mengapa kita menemukan jejak peradaban Suku Laut di sini, padahal jejak itu tidak ditemukan di tempat lain.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bacon02_002
Array.english: What reason? Do you have any ideas?
Array.indonesia: Alasan apa? Apa kamu punya ide?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bacon02_003
Array.english: I’m wondering if this Giant Blue Hole\nis somehow closely linked to their civilization.
Array.indonesia: Aku penasaran apakah Giant Blue Hole ini\nentah bagaimana terkait erat dengan peradaban mereka.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bacon02_004
Array.english: But as they’re expected to have lived very deep under the sea,\nit’s difficult to conduct a detailed investigation with what we have right now.
Array.indonesia: Tapi karena mereka diperkirakan pernah hidup sangat dalam di bawah laut,\nsulit untuk melakukan penyelidikan mendetail dengan apa yang kita miliki saat ini.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bacon02_005
Array.english: Keep up the good work, Dave!
Array.indonesia: Teruslah bekerja dengan baik, Dave!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bacon03_001
Array.english: You've actually been to the Sea People Village… Man, I'm so jealous.
Array.indonesia: Kamu benar-benar pernah ke Desa Suku Laut… Wah, aku sangat iri.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bacon03_002
Array.english: You know, I've always been afraid of diving, but seeing you, I'm tempted to learn it.
Array.indonesia: Kamu tahu, aku selalu takut menyelam, tapi melihatmu, aku jadi tergoda untuk mempelajarinya.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bacon03_003
Array.english: Give it a try! I'll teach you.
Array.indonesia: Coba saja! Aku akan mengajari kamu.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bacon03_004
Array.english: <size=40>…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>…</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bacon03_005
Array.english: …Let me think about it a bit more. Haha!
Array.indonesia: …Biar aku pikirkan dulu sebentar. Haha!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bancho01_001
Array.english: What is it?\nDo you want to learn to cook, perhaps...
Array.indonesia: Ada apa?\nMungkin kamu mau belajar memasak...

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bancho01_002
Array.english: No, I just came to see if you needed any particular ingredients.
Array.indonesia: Tidak, aku cuma datang untuk memastikan apakah kamu butuh bahan-bahan tertentu.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bancho01_003
Array.english: A master chef can cook with any ingredient.\nI’ll show you the best food possible, regardless of what you bring me.
Array.indonesia: Seorang koki handal bisa memasak dengan bahan apa pun.\nAku akan tunjukkan masakan terbaik yang bisa dibuat, apa pun yang kamu bawa.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bancho01_004
Array.english: Just bring me lots of it.
Array.indonesia: Bawakan saja banyak-banyak.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bancho02_001
Array.english: It was a unique experience to cook something as exotic as Giant Squid.
Array.indonesia: Memasak sesuatu yang eksotis seperti Cumi Raksasa adalah pengalaman yang unik.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bancho02_002
Array.english: Make sure to bring me the ingredients if you defeat another giant creature.
Array.indonesia: Pastikan kamu membawakan bahan-bahannya kepadaku jika kamu mengalahkan makhluk raksasa lainnya.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bancho02_003
Array.english: I will. I'm curious what you'll cook up with it.
Array.indonesia: Akan kulakukan. Aku penasaran apa yang akan kamu masak dengan bahan itu.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bancho03_001
Array.english: Dave, are you giving enough attention to the <color=#F1DC2B>branch</color> ?
Array.indonesia: Dave, apakah kamu cukup memperhatikan <color=#F1DC2B>cabang</color> ?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bancho03_002
Array.english: What? O-Of course!
Array.indonesia: Apa? T-Tentu saja!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bancho03_003
Array.english: Then why does my question surprise you?
Array.indonesia: Lalu mengapa pertanyaanku membuatmu terkejut?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bancho03_004
Array.english: Well, I never expected you to care enough about the branch to ask.
Array.indonesia: Yah, aku tidak pernah menyangka kamu cukup peduli pada cabang itu sampai bertanya.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bancho03_005
Array.english: The place has my name on it. Of course I care.
Array.indonesia: Tempat itu menggunakan namaku. Tentu saja aku peduli.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bancho03_006
Array.english: I can't go to each branch, so please take care of them and keep our customers satisfied.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak bisa mengunjungi setiap cabang, jadi tolong uruslah mereka dan pastikan pelanggan kita puas.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bancho03_007
Array.english: Yes. I will.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Aku akan melakukannya.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto01_001
Array.english: The farming’s going well, don’t worry.
Array.indonesia: Pertaniannya berjalan lancar, jangan khawatir.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto01_002
Array.english: You still have to drop by regularly\nand pull out the weeds!
Array.indonesia: Kamu tetap harus mampir secara rutin\ndan mencabut rumput liar!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto01_003
Array.english: Okay, okay. I’ll come by sometime.
Array.indonesia: Oke, oke. Aku akan mampir suatu saat nanti.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto02_001
Array.english: Hmm? What is it?
Array.indonesia: Hmm? Ada apa?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto02_002
Array.english: I'm just calling to see if everything is alright.
Array.indonesia: Aku hanya menelepon untuk memastikan semuanya baik-baik saja.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto02_003
Array.english: Hahaha! You were bored, I see!
Array.indonesia: Hahaha! Ternyata kamu bosan, ya!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto02_004
Array.english: Speaking of boredom…
Array.indonesia: Ngomong-ngomong soal kebosanan…

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto02_005
Array.english: When I was 12… No, 13? I was playing ball with my friends at the beach.
Array.indonesia: Saat aku berusia 12… Eh, 13? Aku sedang bermain bola dengan teman-temanku di pantai.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto02_006
Array.english: <size=34>But out of nowhere, a seagull snatched the ball and dropped it into the ocean!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Tapi tiba-tiba, seekor burung camar mencuri bola itu dan menjatuhkannya ke laut!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto02_007
Array.english: We didn't know what to do, and that was when my friend's father dove into the ocean and got the ball for us.
Array.indonesia: Kami tidak tahu harus berbuat apa, dan saat itulah ayah temanku menyelam ke laut dan mengambil bola itu untuk kami.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto02_008
Array.english: I decided to become a diver in that very moment!\nAnd I started training like there's no tomorrow!
Array.indonesia: Aku memutuskan untuk menjadi penyelam tepat pada saat itu juga!\nDan aku mulai berlatih seolah-olah tidak ada hari esok!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto02_009
Array.english: Did I mention what kind of training I did?
Array.indonesia: Apa aku sudah cerita tentang jenis latihan apa yang aku lakukan?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto02_010
Array.english: …Ah, you did. Hahaha. Of course I know about it!
Array.indonesia: …Ah, kamu sudah. Hahaha. Tentu saja aku tahu soal itu!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto02_011
Array.english: Hahaha! I see. Very well.\nCall me again whenever you're bored!
Array.indonesia: Hahaha! Oh, begitu. Baiklah.\nHubungi aku lagi kalau kamu bosan!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto03_001
Array.english: Haha. I thought I'd never see Sammy again, but here we are, running a farm together.
Array.indonesia: Haha. Aku pikir aku tidak akan pernah bertemu Sammy lagi, tapi lihatlah, kita sekarang mengelola sebuah peternakan bersama.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto03_002
Array.english: I'm glad you two could meet again.
Array.indonesia: Aku senang kalian berdua bisa bertemu lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto03_003
Array.english: I wish I could talk with Sammy about the ol' days…
Array.indonesia: Aku berharap bisa berbincang dengan Sammy tentang masa lalu…

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto03_004
Array.english: But after talking for a few days…\nHe went back to making music again and now we barely talk.
Array.indonesia: Tapi setelah ngobrol selama beberapa hari…\nDia kembali ke dunia musik lagi dan sekarang kita hampir nggak pernah ngobrol.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto03_005
Array.english: I still have so much to tell him… *sob*
Array.indonesia: Masih banyak yang ingin aku ceritakan padanya… *huhu*

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto03_006
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(Um… I think I know why.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Um… Kurasa aku tahu alasannya.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto03_007
Array.english: How about you take it one small conversation at a time…?
Array.indonesia: Bagaimana kalau kamu melakukannya sedikit demi sedikit…?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto03_008
Array.english: Hmm? But wouldn't Sammy find that frustrating?
Array.indonesia: Hmm? Tapi bukankah Sammy akan merasa frustrasi?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto03_009
Array.english: …I'm sure he won't mind. Besides, it's easier to remember things that way.
Array.indonesia: …Aku yakin dia tidak akan keberatan. Lagipula, lebih mudah mengingat hal-hal dengan cara itu.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto03_010
Array.english: You got a point. I'll give it a try.
Array.indonesia: Kamu benar juga. Aku akan mencobanya.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Jose01_001
Array.english: Oh! Dave!\nI’m currently in the middle of some fierce soccer practice!
Array.indonesia: Oh! Dave!\nAku sedang asyik latihan sepak bola yang intens nih!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Jose01_002
Array.english: My condition’s slowly improving!
Array.indonesia: Kondisiku perlahan membaik!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Jose01_003
Array.english: That’s good.\nDon’t kick your ball into the water again.
Array.indonesia: Bagus.\nJangan tendang bolamu ke air lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Jose01_004
Array.english: No worries!\nI have you, Dave, my ami-go!
Array.indonesia: Tenang aja!\nAku punya kamu, Dave, sahabatku!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Jose01_005
Array.english: Oh... Is that right...
Array.indonesia: Oh... Benarkah...

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Ellie01_001
Array.english: What is it?\nI’m at the library right now.
Array.indonesia: Ada apa?\nAku sedang di perpustakaan sekarang.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Ellie01_002
Array.english: Calling me so suddenly...\nWhere are your manners!?
Array.indonesia: Meneleponku begitu tiba-tiba...\nDi mana sopan santunmu!?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Ellie01_003
Array.english: <size=43><color=#C3C3C3>*Click*</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=43><color=#C3C3C3>*Klik*</color></size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Ellie02_001
Array.english: Haha! Ellie, I reached the maximum level in Ecowatcher, too!
Array.indonesia: Haha! Ellie, aku juga sudah mencapai level maksimum di Ecowatcher!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Ellie02_002
Array.english: Woah, you did?
Array.indonesia: Wah, beneran?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Ellie02_003
Array.english: Then did you get a tote bag with your face printed on it?
Array.indonesia: Terus, kamu dapet tas jinjing yang dicetak wajahmu?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Ellie02_004
Array.english: <size=34>Sure did! Here, look.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Tentu saja! Ini, lihat.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Ellie02_005
Array.english: <size=33>Huh… So you really did it. I have to admit, you're one of us now.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Huh… Jadi kamu benar-benar berhasil. Aku harus akui, kamu sekarang salah satu dari kita.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Ellie02_006
Array.english: But with you…
Array.indonesia: Tapi kalau kamu…

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Ellie02_007
Array.english: <size=34>I think you look better on the tote bag.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Menurutku kamu terlihat lebih bagus di tas jinjing itu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Ellie02_008
Array.english: <size=34>What's that supposed to mean?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Apa maksudnya itu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Ellie02_009
Array.english: Haha! Nothing.\nAnyway, congratulations!
Array.indonesia: Haha! Nggak apa-apa.\nPokoknya, selamat!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Ellie03_001
Array.english: Dave, do you have any plans for all of us to meet up again?
Array.indonesia: Dave, apa kamu punya rencana buat kita semua ketemu lagi?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Ellie03_002
Array.english: Hmm? No, not yet. Why?
Array.indonesia: Hmm? Belum, belum ada. Kenapa?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Ellie03_003
Array.english: Oh, because that day was a lot of fun.
Array.indonesia: Oh, soalnya hari itu seru banget.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Ellie03_004
Array.english: All I do is read and research all day… It was fun to be around people.
Array.indonesia: Yang aku lakukan hanyalah membaca dan meneliti sepanjang hari… Seru juga bisa berkumpul dengan orang-orang.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Ellie03_005
Array.english: I get it. It felt nice to hang around with people without a care in the world.
Array.indonesia: Aku ngerti. Rasanya enak bisa nongkrong bareng orang-orang tanpa beban apa pun.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Ellie03_006
Array.english: Alright, I'll set up another get-together.
Array.indonesia: Oke, aku akan atur pertemuan lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Ellie03_007
Array.english: I'm just a poor student, so…\nYou're buying, right? Thanks!
Array.indonesia: Aku cuma mahasiswa miskin, jadi…\nKamu yang traktir, kan? Terima kasih!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Ellie03_008
Array.english: Umm… Yeah.
Array.indonesia: Umm… Ya.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Yoshie01_001
Array.english: Dave! Don’t just leave work to the staff.\nYou need to lead by example.
Array.indonesia: Dave! Jangan cuma serahkan pekerjaan ke staf.\nKamu harus memberi contoh.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Yoshie01_002
Array.english: Don’t forget, a serving job means they’ll see you as the face of the restaurant.
Array.indonesia: Jangan lupa, pekerjaan sebagai pelayan berarti mereka akan melihatmu sebagai wajah restoran.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Yoshie01_003
Array.english: Okay, okay.
Array.indonesia: Oke, oke.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Yoshie02_001
Array.english: Is something the matter, Dave?
Array.indonesia: Ada apa, Dave?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Yoshie02_002
Array.english: Oh… Nothing. I just wanted to thank you for telling me about Bancho.
Array.indonesia: Oh… Nggak ada apa-apa. Aku cuma mau berterima kasih karena sudah memberitahuku tentang Bancho.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Yoshie02_003
Array.english: Heh… Sure you did.\nI've been meaning to talk to you as well.
Array.indonesia: Heh… Pasti deh.\nAku juga udah lama pengen ngobrol sama kamu.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Yoshie02_004
Array.english: Bancho has changed a lot since then.
Array.indonesia: Bancho udah banyak berubah sejak saat itu.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Yoshie02_005
Array.english: Of course, he's still a stubborn man.\nBut he learned how to get along with others.
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja, dia masih orang yang keras kepala.\nTapi dia sudah belajar cara bergaul dengan orang lain.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Yoshie02_006
Array.english: <size=34>And it's all thanks to people like you, Dave.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Dan itu semua berkat orang-orang seperti kamu, Dave.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Yoshie02_007
Array.english: Haha, you're making me blush. You know, it's a lot of fun, running a restaurant with Bancho.
Array.indonesia: Haha, kamu bikin aku malu. Kamu tahu, mengelola restoran bersama Bancho itu sangat menyenangkan.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Yoshie02_008
Array.english: Haha. It's strange how you two get along even though you're so different from each other.
Array.indonesia: Haha. Aneh juga, kalian berdua bisa akur padahal sangat berbeda satu sama lain.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Yoshie02_009
Array.english: Please keep it up, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Teruslah seperti itu, Dave.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Yoshie03_001
Array.english: Hm. I was just thinking of calling you.
Array.indonesia: Hm. Aku baru saja berpikir untuk meneleponmu.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Yoshie03_002
Array.english: Really? What did you want to talk about?
Array.indonesia: Benarkah? Mau ngobrolin apa?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Yoshie03_003
Array.english: The restaurant <color=#F1DC2B>branch</color>. I was wondering if you've been managing it well.
Array.indonesia: Restoran <color=#F1DC2B>cabang</color>. Saya ingin tahu apakah Anda sudah mengelolanya dengan baik.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Yoshie03_004
Array.english: As you already know, the <color=#F1DC2B>branch</color> is run by employees and employees only. You have to tell them exactly what to do.
Array.indonesia: Seperti yang sudah Anda ketahui, <color=#F1DC2B>cabang</color> dikelola oleh karyawan dan hanya oleh karyawan. Anda harus memberi tahu mereka dengan tepat apa yang harus dilakukan.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Yoshie03_005
Array.english: It's important to assign the right employees, but how you manage the branch will also affect your revenue.
Array.indonesia: Memang penting untuk menugaskan karyawan yang tepat, tetapi cara Anda mengelola cabang tersebut juga akan memengaruhi pendapatan Anda.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Yoshie03_006
Array.english: Right. I have to go to the <color=#F1DC2B>branch</color> myself and give instructions, right?
Array.indonesia: Benar. Saya harus pergi ke <color=#F1DC2B>cabang</color> sendiri dan memberikan instruksi, kan?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Yoshie03_007
Array.english: Yes. You're running multiple restaurants now, Dave. Always take good care of them.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Anda sekarang mengelola beberapa restoran, Dave. Selalu rawatlah mereka dengan baik.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Vincent01_001
Array.english: Hmm? What is it? What happened?
Array.indonesia: Hmm? Ada apa? Ada apa?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Vincent01_002
Array.english: I’m busy with all the filming.\nText me.
Array.indonesia: Aku sibuk dengan syuting.\nKirim pesan saja.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Vincent02_001
Array.english: What is it? We're about to film so make it quick.
Array.indonesia: Ada apa? Kita sebentar lagi syuting, jadi tolong cepat.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Vincent02_002
Array.english: Oh… I'm just calling to say hi.
Array.indonesia: Oh… Aku cuma menelepon untuk menyapa.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Vincent02_003
Array.english: Tsk… Boring. Just keep diving, will you?
Array.indonesia: Ck… Membosankan. Terus saja menyelam, ya?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Vincent02_004
Array.english: <size=33>By the way, I'm considering you as the face of a new TV show I'm thinking of.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ngomong-ngomong, aku sedang mempertimbangkanmu sebagai bintang utama acara TV baru yang sedang aku rencanakan.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Vincent02_005
Array.english: <size=36>What…!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Apa…!?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Vincent02_006
Array.english: <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆The Diver</color>… How does it sound? Doesn't it sound fun?
Array.indonesia: <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆The Diver</color>… Gimana kedengarannya? Bukankah kedengarannya seru?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Vincent02_007
Array.english: <size=35>…I-I'm not ready yet… I don't even know how to sign an autograph…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>…A-Aku belum siap… Aku bahkan nggak tahu cara menandatangani autograf…</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Vincent02_008
Array.english: Hahaha! I'm joking. Stop worrying and help Bancho, alright?
Array.indonesia: Hahaha! Aku cuma bercanda. Jangan khawatir dan bantu Bancho, oke?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Vincent02_009
Array.english: <size=36>…Umm.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>…Umm.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Vincent_BattleVIP_001
Array.english: This is Vincent speaking. Oh, it’s you. What’s up?
Array.indonesia: Ini Vincent yang bicara. Oh, kamu ya. Ada apa?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Vincent_BattleVIP_002
Array.english: You told to me to call you if I want a rematch...
Array.indonesia: Kamu bilang padaku untuk meneleponmu kalau aku mau pertandingan ulang...

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Vincent_BattleVIP_003
Array.english: Oh, of course.\nAre you ready for another match?
Array.indonesia: Oh, tentu saja.\nApakah kamu siap untuk pertandingan lagi?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Vincent_BattleVIP_004
Array.english: You know the rules. I will give you <color=#1DFEAF>three days</color> to prepare.\nI will see you at your place.
Array.indonesia: Kamu tahu aturannya. Aku akan memberimu <color=#1DFEAF>tiga hari</color> untuk bersiap.\n Sampai jumpa di tempatmu.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Vincent_BattleVIP_005
Array.english: Make sure that you are ready this time, all right?
Array.indonesia: Pastikan kamu siap kali ini, oke?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato01_001
Array.english: <size=34>Ho!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ho!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato01_002
Array.english: What is it?
Array.indonesia: Ada apa?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato01_003
Array.english: Ah, just calling. How's your Marinca collection going?
Array.indonesia: Ah, cuma nelpon aja. Bagaimana perkembangan koleksi Marinca-mu?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato01_004
Array.english: Very well! In fact, I completed my deep sea collection not too long ago. Haha!
Array.indonesia: Sangat baik! Sebenarnya, aku baru saja menyelesaikan koleksi laut dalamku belum lama ini. Haha!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato01_005
Array.english: Woah… That's amazing! I still have lots to do.
Array.indonesia: Wah… Luar biasa! Aku masih punya banyak yang harus dikerjakan.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato01_006
Array.english: The key is to always catch new fish if you come across one.
Array.indonesia: Kuncinya adalah selalu menangkap ikan baru jika kamu menemukannya.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato01_007
Array.english: By the way, how do you collect them? You don't even dive.
Array.indonesia: Ngomong-ngomong, gimana caranya kamu mengumpulkannya? Kamu kan nggak pernah menyelam.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato01_008
Array.english: <size=50>…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>…</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato01_009
Array.english: <size=34>Try harder! Chuchu!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Berusahalah lebih keras! Chuchu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato02_001
Array.english: <size=34>GGGYAO!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>GGGYAO!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato02_002
Array.english: Were you playing <color=#72ff0a>GYAO!</color> Sato?
Array.indonesia: Kamu lagi main <color=#72ff0a>GYAO!</color> Sato?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato02_003
Array.english: I was in the middle of a minigame, but you interrupted it with your call…
Array.indonesia: Aku lagi main minigame, tapi kamu mengganggu dengan panggilanmu…

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato02_004
Array.english: Oh… Sorry for interrupting.
Array.indonesia: Oh… Maaf sudah mengganggu.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato02_005
Array.english: I'm sorry, my Ribbon Eel, my Josephine…
Array.indonesia: Maaf, Ribbon Eel-ku, Josephine-ku…

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato02_006
Array.english: …You give them names?
Array.indonesia: …Kamu memberi nama pada mereka?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato02_007
Array.english: Of course! I get so attached to them once I name them, it breaks my heart whenever I have to revive them.
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja! Aku jadi sangat terikat pada mereka begitu aku memberi nama, hatiku hancur setiap kali harus menghidupkan mereka kembali.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato02_008
Array.english: I'm amazed at how you're so passionate about everything you do.
Array.indonesia: Aku kagum melihat betapa bersemangatnya kamu dalam segala hal yang kamu lakukan.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato02_009
Array.english: Heh. A true collector always plays their games with everything they've got.
Array.indonesia: Heh. Seorang kolektor sejati selalu memainkan gimnya dengan sepenuh hati.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato02_010
Array.english: Josephine calls. I have to go now.
Array.indonesia: Josephine memanggil. Aku harus pergi sekarang.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato02_011
Array.english: Chuchu.
Array.indonesia: Chuchu.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato03_001
Array.english: The legendary monster of Blue Hole…
Array.indonesia: Monster legendaris dari Blue Hole…

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato03_002
Array.english: If it appeared as a hidden card in Marinca, it means it really exists.
Array.indonesia: Jika ia muncul sebagai kartu tersembunyi di Marinca, itu berarti ia benar-benar ada.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato03_003
Array.english: Even its silhouette is frightening.
Array.indonesia: Bahkan siluetnya saja sudah menakutkan.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato03_004
Array.english: Dave, I have faith in you.
Array.indonesia: Dave, aku percaya padamu.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato03_005
Array.english: But just in case anything happens to you…
Array.indonesia: Tapi kalau-kalau terjadi sesuatu padamu…

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato03_006
Array.english: Let me know your account name and password beforehand.
Array.indonesia: Beri tahu aku nama akun dan kata sandimu terlebih dahulu.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato03_007
Array.english: <size=35>…What do you mean?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>…Maksudmu apa?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato03_008
Array.english: <size=34>Oops! My desire to complete my Marinca collection got the better of me!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ups! Keinginan aku untuk melengkapi koleksi Marinca-ku menguasai diriku!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato03_009
Array.english: Anyway, good luck. I'll be waiting for a notification.
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun, semoga berhasil. Aku akan menunggu notifikasinya.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato03_010
Array.english: Chuchu.
Array.indonesia: Chuchu.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato04_001
Array.english: Every Marinca collector I know envies me, thanks to you!
Array.indonesia: Semua kolektor Marinca yang aku kenal iri padaku, berkat kamu!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato04_002
Array.english: A Lusca card… Haha, I still can't believe it.
Array.indonesia: Kartu Lusca… Haha, aku masih nggak percaya.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato04_003
Array.english: Of course, it has your name on it, since you shared it with me.
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja, ada namamu di sana, karena kamu membagikannya kepadaku.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato04_004
Array.english: Haha! It feels good to be acknowledged!
Array.indonesia: Haha! Rasanya menyenangkan diakui!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato04_005
Array.english: By the way, will Marinca ever be updated with new entries?
Array.indonesia: Ngomong-ngomong, apakah Marinca akan diperbarui dengan entri baru?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato04_006
Array.english: Well, that would depend on the dev—\nI mean, the discovery of new organisms.
Array.indonesia: Yah, itu tergantung pada pengembang—\nmaksudku, penemuan organisme baru.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato04_007
Array.english: I'll let you know if there's any news.\nUntil then, enjoy the glory of being a <color=#F1DC2B>Marinca Completer</color>!
Array.indonesia: Aku akan memberitahumu jika ada kabar terbaru.\nSampai saat itu, nikmati kebanggaan menjadi seorang <color=#F1DC2B>Marinca Completer</color>!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Udo01_001
Array.english: Sir, have you been keeping up with your photos?
Array.indonesia: Pak, apakah kamu masih rajin mengunggah foto-fotomu?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Udo01_002
Array.english: Remember, the more unique the organism, the more valuable the article.
Array.indonesia: Ingat, semakin unik organisme tersebut, semakin berharga artikelnya.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Udo01_003
Array.english: It'll be even more valuable if you manage to capture a special moment!
Array.indonesia: Akan lebih berharga lagi jika Anda berhasil mengabadikan momen spesial!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Udo01_004
Array.english: What if I don't like my photo?
Array.indonesia: Bagaimana jika saya tidak suka foto saya?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Udo01_005
Array.english: Haha! Don't worry. You can select <color=#F1DC2B>Take Again</color> in your phone's photo app to retake the photo.
Array.indonesia: Haha! Jangan khawatir. Anda bisa memilih <color=#F1DC2B>Ambil Lagi</color> di aplikasi kamera ponsel Anda untuk mengambil foto ulang.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Udo01_006
Array.english: …Of course, it might be after the article's been distributed.
Array.indonesia: …Tentu saja, mungkin setelah artikel tersebut sudah didistribusikan.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Udo01_007
Array.english: Anyway, I'll look forward for it. Hehe.
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun, aku akan menantikannya. Hehe.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Udo02_001
Array.english: The text goes here… The photo goes to the right… Wait, no…
Array.indonesia: Teksnya di sini… Fotonya di sebelah kanan… Tunggu, bukan…

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Udo02_002
Array.english: Oh, I didn't realize the call went through.
Array.indonesia: Oh, aku tidak menyadari panggilan itu tersambung.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Udo02_003
Array.english: The <color=#F1DC2B>FishMon Project</color> has been keeping me busy.
Array.indonesia: Proyek <color=#F1DC2B>FishMon</color> membuatku sibuk.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Udo02_004
Array.english: I was trying to come up with a way to place your photos in my article to make it look cooler. Hehe.
Array.indonesia: Aku sedang mencoba mencari cara untuk memasukkan fotomu ke dalam artikelku agar terlihat lebih keren. Hehe.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Udo02_005
Array.english: So please, don't forget about FishMon and the photos.
Array.indonesia: Jadi tolong, jangan lupakan FishMon dan foto-fotonya.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Udo02_006
Array.english: Alright. I'll do my best.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah. Aku akan berusaha sebaik mungkin.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Lois01_001
Array.english: What's the matter?
Array.indonesia: Ada apa?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Lois01_002
Array.english: Ah… I had your number in my contacts.
Array.indonesia: Ah… Aku punya nomor teleponmu di kontakku.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Lois01_003
Array.english: What a boring man. I'm very busy, you know.
Array.indonesia: Dasar pria yang membosankan. Aku sangat sibuk, lho.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Lois01_004
Array.english: By the way… How is it with the branch? Is everything going well?
Array.indonesia: Ngomong-ngomong… Bagaimana kabar cabang itu? Semuanya lancar?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Lois01_005
Array.english: I guess so. But I'm still not used to it.
Array.indonesia: Kurasa begitu. Tapi aku masih belum terbiasa.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Lois01_006
Array.english: I don't expect Bancho to involve himself with all the finer matters.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak mengharapkan Bancho ikut campur dalam urusan-urusan detail.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Lois01_007
Array.english: That's where you come in, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Di situlah peranmu, Dave.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Lois01_008
Array.english: Since B&C is handling the basic management…
Array.indonesia: Karena B&C menangani manajemen dasar…

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Lois01_009
Array.english: Please make sure to assign personnel and supply ingredients.
Array.indonesia: Tolong pastikan untuk menugaskan personel dan menyediakan bahan-bahan.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Lois01_010
Array.english: Okay. I'll take good care of it!
Array.indonesia: Oke. Aku akan mengurusnya dengan baik!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Lois01_011
Array.english: Heh, I'll be watching.\nTa-ta.
Array.indonesia: Heh, aku akan mengawasinya.\nSampai jumpa.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Lois02_001
Array.english: Hmm...
Array.indonesia: Hmm...

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Lois02_002
Array.english: Is there something wrong, Lois?
Array.indonesia: Ada yang tidak beres, Lois?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Lois02_003
Array.english: Ah… I'm worried that the quality of ingredients used in our restaurants has gone down.
Array.indonesia: Ah… Aku khawatir kualitas bahan baku yang digunakan di restoran-restoran kita sudah menurun.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Lois02_004
Array.english: It's a complicated supply chain…\nAnd it's proving difficult to manage.
Array.indonesia: Rantai pasokannya rumit…\nDan ternyata sulit untuk dikelola.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Lois02_005
Array.english: We wouldn't have to worry about it if we could get ingredients directly from the source like BANCHO SUSHI does.
Array.indonesia: Kita tidak perlu khawatir soal itu kalau bisa mendapatkan bahan baku langsung dari sumbernya seperti yang dilakukan BANCHO SUSHI.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Lois02_006
Array.english: I can't imagine running a big company like that.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak bisa membayangkan mengelola perusahaan sebesar itu.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Lois02_007
Array.english: Haha! It's just a matter of size. In the end, it's just like managing a branch.
Array.indonesia: Haha! Itu hanya soal skala. Pada akhirnya, itu sama saja dengan mengelola sebuah cabang.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Lois02_008
Array.english: If you understand how to manage things on a small scale, managing things on a bigger scale will come naturally to you.
Array.indonesia: Jika Anda memahami cara mengelola sesuatu dalam skala kecil, mengelola sesuatu dalam skala yang lebih besar akan terasa alami bagi Anda.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Lois02_009
Array.english: Hmm. I guess that makes sense.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Sepertinya itu masuk akal.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_Start_001
Array.english: Hello,\nI hope you're having a great day!
Array.indonesia: Halo,\nSemoga hari Anda menyenangkan!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_Start_002
Array.english: Please note that this call is being recorded for quality assurance.
Array.indonesia: Harap diperhatikan bahwa panggilan ini direkam untuk jaminan kualitas.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_Select_001
Array.english: <size=34>What can I help you with today?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ada yang bisa saya bantu hari ini?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_option1
Array.english: Claim Reward
Array.indonesia: Klaim Hadiah

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_option2
Array.english: My Information
Array.indonesia: Informasi Saya

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_option3
Array.english: Today's Fortune
Array.indonesia: Ramalan Hari Ini

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_option4
Array.english: Exit
Array.indonesia: Keluar

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_code_Start_001
Array.english: You've chosen to claim the reward.
Array.indonesia: Anda telah memilih untuk mengklaim hadiah.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_code_Start_002
Array.english: Please enter the <color=#ff61e3>promotion code</color>.
Array.indonesia: Silakan masukkan <color=#ff61e3>kode promosi</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_code_end_001
Array.english: <size=35>You've won a prize! Congratulations!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Anda telah memenangkan hadiah! Selamat!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_code_wrong_001
Array.english: The <color=#ff61e3>promotion code</color> you entered does not exist.\nPlease try again.
Array.indonesia: <color=#ff61e3>Kode promosi</color> yang Anda masukkan tidak ada.\nSilakan coba lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_code_cancel_001
Array.english: It seems you don't have the code.\nPlease visit next time.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya Anda tidak memiliki kodenya.\nSilakan kunjungi lagi lain kali.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_fortune_Start_001
Array.english: You've chosen to hear your fortune for today.\nHere it is…
Array.indonesia: Anda telah memilih untuk mengetahui ramalan keberuntungan Anda hari ini.\nInilah ramalannya…

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_fortune_Party01_001
Array.english: "Always be prepared, then you will earn large profits."\n… Or so it says.
Array.indonesia: "Selalu bersiap, maka Anda akan memperoleh keuntungan besar."\n… Begitulah katanya.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_fortune_Party02_001
Array.english: "Don't forget and prepare the festival."\n… Or so it says.
Array.indonesia: "Jangan lupa mempersiapkan perayaan."\n… Begitulah katanya.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_fortune_VIP01_001
Array.english: "A valued guest will come soon. Be prepared."\n… Or so it says.
Array.indonesia: "Seorang tamu terhormat akan segera datang. Bersiaplah."\n… Begitulah katanya.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_fortune_VIP02_001
Array.english: "An opportunity to show your talent will come. Don't miss it and be prepared."\n… Or so it says.
Array.indonesia: "Kesempatan untuk menunjukkan bakatmu akan datang. Jangan lewatkan dan bersiaplah."\n… Begitulah katanya.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_fortune_Normal01_001
Array.english: "Happiness dwells in your mundane life. Diligence is the key."\n… Or so it says.
Array.indonesia: "Kebahagiaan ada dalam kehidupan sehari-harimu. Ketekunan adalah kuncinya."\n… Begitulah katanya.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_fortune_Normal02_001
Array.english: "Do not count on sheer luck. Work hard."\n… Or so it says.
Array.indonesia: "Jangan mengandalkan keberuntungan semata. Bekerjalah keras."\n… Begitulah katanya.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_fortune_End_001
Array.english: That's it for today's fortune telling.
Array.indonesia: Sekian ramalan hari ini.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_fortune_ReSelect_001
Array.english: <size=34>Is there anything else you need?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Apakah ada yang lain yang kamu butuhkan?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_MyInfo_Start_001
Array.english: I'll check your information…\nPlease hold.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan memeriksa informasimu…\nTunggu sebentar.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_MyInfo_Start_002
Array.english: (*Beep*)

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_MyInfo_Info01_001
Array.english: You have collected <color=#F1DC2B><myinfo=ScrapCount/></color> items in total.
Array.indonesia: Kamu telah mengumpulkan <color=#F1DC2B><myinfo=ScrapCount/></color> item secara total.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_MyInfo_Info01_01_001
Array.english: …That's not a lot.
Array.indonesia: … Itu tidak banyak.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_MyInfo_Info01_02_001
Array.english: <size=34>You've worked hard!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Anda telah bekerja keras!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_MyInfo_Info02_001
Array.english: You captured <color=#F1DC2B><myinfo=KillFish/></color> fishes in total.
Array.indonesia: Anda telah menangkap <color=#F1DC2B><myinfo=KillFish/></color> ikan secara total.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_MyInfo_Info02_01_001
Array.english: …Still getting used to your harpoon?
Array.indonesia: …Masih beradaptasi dengan tombak Anda?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_MyInfo_Info02_02_001
Array.english: <size=34>You must have fed a lot of customers!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Anda pasti sudah memberi makan banyak pelanggan!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_MyInfo_Info03_001
Array.english: It's been <color=#F1DC2B><myinfo=DayCount/></color> days since you came to Blue Hole.
Array.indonesia: Sudah <color=#F1DC2B><myinfo=DayCount/></color> hari sejak kamu datang ke Blue Hole.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_MyInfo_Info03_01_001
Array.english: …Still get lost, right?
Array.indonesia: …Masih sering tersesat, kan?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_MyInfo_Info03_02_001
Array.english: <size=34>I bet you can find your way around blind-folded!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku yakin kamu bisa menemukan jalan keluar meski mata tertutup!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_MyInfo_Info04_001
Array.english: The deepest you've dived was <color=#F1DC2B><myinfo=DeepestDepth/></color> meters.
Array.indonesia: Kedalaman menyelam terendahmu adalah <color=#F1DC2B><myinfo=DeepestDepth/></color> meter.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_MyInfo_Info04_01_001
Array.english: …You're not scared of getting wet, are you?
Array.indonesia: …Kamu tidak takut basah, kan?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_MyInfo_Info04_02_001
Array.english: <size=33>You can dive really deep. Outstanding!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kamu bisa menyelam sangat dalam. Luar biasa!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_MyInfo_End_001
Array.english: That concludes your personal information verification.
Array.indonesia: Demikianlah verifikasi informasi pribadimu.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_End_001
Array.english: Thank you for calling.\nPlease don't hesitate to call us again!
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih telah menelepon.\nJangan ragu untuk menghubungi kami lagi!

Array.name: dialogue_Suwam_Talk_10050043_After_001
Array.english: Hurry up and get ingredients to treat Ramo with!
Array.indonesia: Cepat cari bahan-bahan untuk mengobati Ramo!

Array.name: dialogue_Suwam_Talk_10050043_After_002
Array.english: Humans and their memory...\n<color=#1DFEAF>Feather Coral</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>Lily Coral</color> should be around this area!
Array.indonesia: Manusia dan ingatannya...\n<color=#1DFEAF>Karang Bulu</color> dan <color=#1DFEAF>Karang Bunga</color> seharusnya ada di sekitar area ini!

Array.name: dialogue_Suwam_Talk_10050044_AfterLooting_001
Array.english: You just brought raw coral…\nIt should be cooked into a<color=#F1DC2B> dish</color>!
Array.indonesia: Kamu baru saja membawa karang mentah…\nItu harus dimasak menjadi<color=#F1DC2B> hidangan</color>!

Array.name: dialogue_Suwam_Talk_10050044_AfterLooting_002
Array.english: <size=34>Find a human worthy of cooking this into a dish!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Temukan manusia yang layak untuk memasak ini menjadi hidangan!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Suwam_Talk_10050047_After_001
Array.english: <size=40>Get the path open already, human!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Segera buka jalannya, manusia!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Suwam_Talk_10050051_After_001
Array.english: I want to take the lead, but...\nI must protect Ramo.
Array.indonesia: Aku ingin memimpin, tapi...\nAku harus melindungi Ramo.

Array.name: dialogue_Suwam_Talk_10050051_After_002
Array.english: It’s not because I’m afraid. Of course it isn’t.
Array.indonesia: Bukan karena aku takut. Tentu saja bukan.

Array.name: dialogue_Suwam_Talk_10050125_After_001
Array.english: Are you ready to enter, human?
Array.indonesia: Apakah kamu siap masuk, manusia?

Array.name: dialogue_Suwam_Talk_10050125_After_Yes
Array.english: Yes, I'm Ready!
Array.indonesia: Ya, aku siap!

Array.name: dialogue_Suwam_Talk_10050125_After_No
Array.english: Not Yet…
Array.indonesia: Belum...

Array.name: dialogue_Ramo_Talk_10050047_After_001
Array.english: To think the path to the village is blocked...\nHurry up and do something!
Array.indonesia: Siapa sangka jalan menuju desa terhalang...\nCepatlah lakukan sesuatu!

Array.name: dialogue_Ramo_Talk_10050051_After_001
Array.english: I hope nothing has happened to the village...\nPlease hurry, human.
Array.indonesia: Kuharap tidak terjadi apa-apa di desa...\nTolong cepat, manusia.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoSushi_upgrade_boat_001
Array.english: Dave, while you were out at sea the repairs were completed.
Array.indonesia: Dave, saat kamu berada di laut, perbaikan sudah selesai.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoSushi_upgrade_boat_004
Array.english: <size=42>Let's head to the restaurant!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>Ayo kita ke restoran!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoSushi_upgrade_001
Array.english: <size=40>Wow..It's looking very nice!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Wow..It terlihat sangat bagus!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoSushi_upgrade_002
Array.english: <size=32>Haha! It doesn't matter how delicious the food is, \nthe restaurant can't be a mess!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha! Tidak peduli seberapa lezat makanannya, \nrestoran tidak boleh berantakan!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoSushi_upgrade_003
Array.english: <size=34>Ah, If you want to change the interior,\nthe <color=#F1DC2B>Interior</color> menu below is open, so please check it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ah, jika kamu ingin mengubah interiornya,\nmenu <color=#F1DC2B>Interior</color> di bawah ini sudah terbuka, jadi silakan periksa!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_UVLightFirstEvent_hasUVlight_001
Array.english: <size=35>This must be the place...\n<color=#1DFEAF>Tubeworms</color> are blocking the way, though...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ini pasti tempatnya...\n<color=#1DFEAF>Cacing tabung</color> menghalangi jalan, sih...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_UVLightFirstEvent_hasUVlight_002
Array.english: Dr. Bacon, I have <color=#1DFEAF>Tubeworms</color> blocking my path.\nIs there a solution?
Array.indonesia: Dr. Bacon, ada <color=#1DFEAF>cacing tabung</color> yang menghalangi jalanku.\nAda solusinya?

Array.name: dialogue_UVLightFirstEvent_hasUVlight_003
Array.english: Hmm... Let’s see...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Mari kita lihat...

Array.name: dialogue_UVLightFirstEvent_hasUVlight_004
Array.english: Right! Tubeworms are said to hate <color=#F1DC2B>UV light</color>\nand will shrink away from it.
Array.indonesia: Benar! Cacing tabung konon membenci <color=#F1DC2B>sinar UV</color>\ndan akan menjauh darinya.

Array.name: dialogue_UVLightFirstEvent_hasUVlight_005
Array.english: You don’t happen to have one lying around, do you?
Array.indonesia: Kebetulan kamu punya sinar UV di sekitar sini, kan?

Array.name: dialogue_UVLightFirstEvent_hasUVlight_006
Array.english: <size=36>Oh! You already have one!\nTry shining it on them!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Oh! Kamu sudah punya!\nCoba sorotkan ke mereka!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_UVLightFirstEvent_NoUVLight_001
Array.english: <size=35>Oh no... <color=#1DFEAF>Tubeworms</color> are blocking my path...\nWhat do I do?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh tidak... <color=#1DFEAF>Cacing tabung</color> menghalangi jalanku...\nApa yang harus kulakukan?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_UVLightFirstEvent_NoUVLight_002
Array.english: Dr. Bacon, I have <color=#1DFEAF>Tubeworms</color> blocking my path.\nIs there a solution?
Array.indonesia: Dr. Bacon, ada <color=#1DFEAF>cacing tabung</color> yang menghalangi jalanku.\nAdakah solusinya?

Array.name: dialogue_UVLightFirstEvent_NoUVLight_003
Array.english: Hmm... Let’s see...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Mari kita lihat...

Array.name: dialogue_UVLightFirstEvent_NoUVLight_004
Array.english: Right! Tubeworms are said to hate <color=#F1DC2B>UV light</color>\nand will shrink away from it.
Array.indonesia: Benar! Cacing tabung konon membenci <color=#F1DC2B>sinar UV</color>\ndan akan menjauh darinya.

Array.name: dialogue_UVLightFirstEvent_NoUVLight_005
Array.english: <size=35>One might be nearby, \nso try opening the <color=#F1DC2B>Chests</color> nearby!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Mungkin ada yang berada di dekat sini, \njadi coba buka <color=#F1DC2B>Peti</color> di sekitar sini!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene1_001
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(This is the <color=#1DFEAF>Dugong Hotel</color>... I worked here 12 years ago. \nIt’s a five-star hotel with both tradition and a long history.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Ini adalah <color=#1DFEAF>Hotel Dugong</color>... Saya pernah bekerja di sini 12 tahun yang lalu. \nIni adalah hotel bintang lima yang memadukan tradisi dan sejarah panjang.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene1_002
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(It looks a bit old, yes, but at the time\nthe quality of the food and service had been newly improved.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Memang terlihat agak tua, ya, tapi pada saat itu\nkualitas makanan dan layanannya baru saja ditingkatkan.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene1_003
Array.english: Yoshie, do you have a moment?
Array.indonesia: Yoshie, apakah kamu punya waktu sebentar?

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene1_004
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>What is it, Manager?</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Ada apa, Manajer?</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene1_005
Array.english: Well... A troublesome customer left a reservation.
Array.indonesia: Nah... Ada tamu yang merepotkan yang sudah melakukan pemesanan.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene1_006
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>A troublesome customer?</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Tamu yang merepotkan?</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene1_007
Array.english: Do you know the actress <color=#F1DC2B>Lois Crawford</color>?\nShe made a reservation at our hotel.
Array.indonesia: Apakah kamu mengenal aktris <color=#F1DC2B>Lois Crawford</color>?\nDia sudah memesan kamar di hotel kita.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene1_008
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(Lois Crawford...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Lois Crawford...)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene1_option1
Array.english: Hotel
Array.indonesia: Hotel

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene1_option2
Array.english: Manager
Array.indonesia: Manajer

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene1_option3
Array.english: Lois Crawford
Array.indonesia: Lois Crawford

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene1_option1_linked_001
Array.english: Our <color=#1DFEAF>Dugong Hotel</color> is a luxury hotel with many years of history and tradition.\nIn the past we had nobles staying in our accommodations, and many notable films \nwere shot here.
Array.indonesia: <color=#1DFEAF>Dugong Hotel</color> kami adalah hotel mewah dengan sejarah dan tradisi yang panjang.\nDulu, para bangsawan pernah menginap di akomodasi kami, dan banyak film terkenal \nyang diambil gambarnya di sini.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene1_option1_linked_002
Array.english: Many people seeking that sort of old-era nostalgia used our services,\nand we had very high standards for the services we provided.
Array.indonesia: Banyak orang yang mencari nuansa nostalgia zaman dulu memanfaatkan layanan kami,\ndan kami memiliki standar yang sangat tinggi untuk layanan yang kami berikan.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene1_option2_linked_001
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(The manager had spent his entire life at the hotel.\nIt was like he was a living embodiment of its history.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Manajer tersebut telah menghabiskan seluruh hidupnya di hotel itu.\nSeolah-olah dia adalah perwujudan hidup dari sejarah hotel tersebut.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene1_option2_linked_002
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(He had a lot of knowledge about the etiquette used by the upper class of each country,\nand he was very used to servicing those of high rank.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Dia memiliki pengetahuan luas tentang etiket yang digunakan oleh kalangan atas di setiap negara,\ndan dia sangat terbiasa melayani orang-orang berkedudukan tinggi.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene1_option2_linked_003
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(Many VIPs sought his services.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Banyak tokoh penting yang mencari layanannya.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene1_option3_linked_001
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(Lois Crawford...\nShe was a leading actress with a long career.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Lois Crawford...\nDia adalah aktris terkemuka dengan karier yang panjang.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene1_option3_linked_002
Array.english: (Her role as a spy in one of her most famous works, The 42nd Floor, \nwas extremely impressive. She appears to have hit a slight slump \nas her new movies haven’t been doing very well.)
Array.indonesia: (Perannya sebagai mata-mata dalam salah satu karyanya yang paling terkenal, The 42nd Floor, \nsangat mengesankan. Dia tampaknya sedang mengalami sedikit kemunduran \nkarena film-film barunya tidak terlalu sukses.)

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene2_001
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>I’ve heard that Lois Crawford can be very picky.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Saya dengar Lois Crawford bisa sangat pilih-pilih.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene2_002
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>But we are a very high-quality hotel with history and tradition on our side.\nI don’t think there will be any issue if she comes.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Tapi kami adalah hotel berkualitas tinggi dengan sejarah dan tradisi yang mapan.\nSaya rasa tidak akan ada masalah jika dia datang.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene2_003
Array.english: Haha... So, there it is.\nNobody can beat the level of services and staff at this hotel.
Array.indonesia: Haha... Jadi, begitulah.\nTidak ada yang bisa mengalahkan tingkat layanan dan staf di hotel ini.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene2_004
Array.english: We’ve won many prizes as well.\nJust one thing... you haven’t heard the rumors about her, have you?
Array.indonesia: Kami juga telah memenangkan banyak penghargaan.\nHanya satu hal... kamu belum mendengar rumor tentang dia, kan?

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene2_005
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3><size=40>The rumors?</size></color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3><size=40>Rumor?</size></color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene2_006
Array.english: <size=40>Take a look at this.</color>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Lihat ini.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene2_007
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(This is...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Ini adalah...)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene2_008
Array.english: She’s famous not only as a chef but a gourmet.\nThat’s a blurb she published in a travel magazine recently.
Array.indonesia: Dia terkenal tidak hanya sebagai koki, tetapi juga sebagai penikmat kuliner.\nItu adalah ulasan yang dia terbitkan di majalah perjalanan baru-baru ini.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene2_009
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>Hmm... It appears to be a description of her travels,\nbut it’s just her bashing on the hotel she stayed at.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Hmm... Sepertinya ini deskripsi perjalanannya,\ntapi sebenarnya dia hanya mengkritik habis-habisan hotel tempat dia menginap.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene2_010
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>Gloria Hotels are the best of the best\nand yet she wrote such a scathing review...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Gloria Hotels adalah yang terbaik di antara yang terbaik\nnamun dia menulis ulasan yang begitu pedas...</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene2_011
Array.english: Bringing out the bad does make a person look...\nmore professional.
Array.indonesia: Menonjolkan hal-hal buruk memang membuat seseorang terlihat...\nlebih profesional.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene2_012
Array.english: Her writing is mostly like this.\nWhat do you suggest we do, Yoshie?
Array.indonesia: Tulisan-tulisannya kebanyakan seperti ini.\nApa saranmu, Yoshie?

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene2_013
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3><size=35>Well...</size></color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3><size=35>Yah...</size></color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene2_option1
Array.english: Decline Reservation
Array.indonesia: Tolak Pemesanan

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene2_option2
Array.english: Accept Reservation
Array.indonesia: Terima Pemesanan

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene2_option1_linked_001
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>How about we refuse the reservation?\nWe don’t really need to take a customer that will purposefully try to hurt our reputation, do we?</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Bagaimana kalau kita tolak pemesanan itu?\nKita kan nggak perlu menerima pelanggan yang sengaja ingin merusak reputasi kita, kan?</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene2_option1_linked_002
Array.english: If we do that...\nShe’ll probably use an even more crafty way to get at us.
Array.indonesia: Kalau kita lakukan itu...\nDia mungkin akan menggunakan cara yang lebih licik lagi untuk menyerang kita.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene2_option1_linked_003
Array.english: She’ll send out messages saying that we lack confidence,\nthat we’re picky about who we accept, and so on.
Array.indonesia: Dia akan menyebarkan pesan bahwa kita kurang percaya diri,\nbahwa kita pilih-pilih dalam menerima tamu, dan sebagainya.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene2_option2_linked_001
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>I suppose we can’t refuse the reservation,\nif only for the hotel’s reputation’s sake.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Kurasa kita tidak bisa menolak pemesanan ini,\nsetidaknya demi reputasi hotel.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene2_option2_linked_002
Array.english: In that case, we’ll have to think about how we’ll serve her.
Array.indonesia: Kalau begitu, kita harus memikirkan cara melayani dia.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_001
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>We’ll take the reservation,\nbut we also need to think of ways to satisfy her.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Kita akan menerima pemesanan itu,\ntapi kita juga perlu memikirkan cara untuk memuaskan dia.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_002
Array.english: I suppose you’re right.\nDo you have any ideas, Yoshie?
Array.indonesia: Kurasa kamu benar.\nApa kamu punya ide, Yoshie?

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_003
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>Um...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Um...</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_004
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>Our hotel’s strengths are our long history and tradition\nas well as our high-quality service.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Keunggulan hotel kita adalah sejarah dan tradisi yang panjang\nserta layanan berkualitas tinggi.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_005
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>The way we can satisfy her will involve\nmaking good use of these things.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Cara untuk memuaskan beliau adalah dengan\nmemanfaatkan hal-hal tersebut dengan baik.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_006
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>Did she reserve a suite?</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Apakah dia memesan suite?</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_007
Array.english: <size=38>Yes, it’s a suite.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Ya, itu suite.</size>
