Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_008
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>We’ll need clean rooms and services that match her tastes.\nWe’ll treat her as a VIP.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Kita perlu kamar yang bersih dan layanan yang sesuai dengan seleranya.\nKita akan memperlakukannya sebagai tamu VIP.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_009
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>I’ll look into the drinks and amenities she prefers\nand place them as I also check on the state of the rooms.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Saya akan memeriksa minuman dan fasilitas yang dia sukai\nserta menyiapkannya sambil memeriksa kondisi kamar-kamar tersebut.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_010
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>And about who will receive her...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Dan mengenai siapa yang akan menyambutnya...</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_011
Array.english: <size=36>I suppose I’ll have to do that.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Sepertinya saya yang harus melakukannya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_012
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>Thank you.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Terima kasih.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_013
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>There’s no one that can handle such a tricky customer\nexcept you, with your long experience with many VIPs.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Tidak ada orang lain yang bisa menangani tamu yang begitu rumit\nkecuali Anda, dengan pengalaman panjang Anda menangani banyak tamu VIP.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_014
Array.english: I’m more tense than usual.
Array.indonesia: Saya lebih tegang dari biasanya.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_015
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>And about the meals. We can offer her the buffet for breakfast,\nbut we’ll also need to ready a dinner course.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Dan mengenai hidangan. Kita bisa menawarkan sarapan prasmanan kepadanya,\ntetapi kita juga perlu menyiapkan hidangan makan malam.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_016
Array.english: The dinners at our hotel...
Array.indonesia: Makan malam di hotel kami...

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_option1
Array.english: Italian
Array.indonesia: Italia

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_option2
Array.english: French
Array.indonesia: Prancis

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_option3
Array.english: Japanese
Array.indonesia: Jepang

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_option1_linked_001
Array.english: Our hotel provides Italian food like a bistro, and in à la carte style.\nWe serve pasta or pizza with a simple wine.
Array.indonesia: Hotel kami menyajikan masakan Italia seperti di bistro, dan dalam gaya à la carte.\nKami menyajikan pasta atau pizza dengan anggur sederhana.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_option1_linked_002
Array.english: The chef learned to cook in Naples, and his margherita pizza was good, \nbut...
Array.indonesia: Koki kami belajar memasak di Naples, dan pizza margherita buatannya enak, \ntapi...

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_option1_linked_003
Array.english: It didn’t really go well with the dinner course.
Array.indonesia: Rasanya tidak terlalu cocok dengan hidangan makan malam.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_option2_linked_001
Array.english: We have fantastic French food at our hotel.
Array.indonesia: Kami memiliki masakan Prancis yang luar biasa di hotel kami.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_option2_linked_002
Array.english: It's the pride and joy of Dugong Hotel,\nwith a Michelin-starred head chef at the helm.
Array.indonesia: Ini adalah kebanggaan dan kebahagiaan Dugong Hotel,\ndengan kepala koki berbintang Michelin yang memimpin dapur.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_option2_linked_003
Array.english: But you came at the most inconvenient time.\nOur head chef is in France on a culinary research trip.
Array.indonesia: Namun, Anda datang pada waktu yang paling tidak tepat.\nKoki kepala kami sedang berada di Prancis untuk perjalanan riset kuliner.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_option2_linked_004
Array.english: The sous-chef has taken his place for now and he cooks wonderfully as well.\nHowever, our upcoming customer is a very difficult one...
Array.indonesia: Koki pembantu telah menggantikannya untuk sementara dan dia juga memasak dengan sangat baik.\nNamun, tamu kami berikutnya adalah tamu yang sangat sulit...

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_option3_linked_001
Array.english: Dugong Hotel’s Japanese food has never been its strong suit.\nWe only served udon or simple donburi...
Array.indonesia: Masakan Jepang di Dugong Hotel memang belum pernah menjadi keunggulan kami.\nKami hanya menyajikan udon atau donburi sederhana...

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_option3_linked_002
Array.english: We’ve been making exponential progress, however, after we hired\n<color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color>, we've grown quite dramatically.
Array.indonesia: Namun, kami telah mengalami kemajuan pesat, terutama setelah kami mempekerjakan\n<color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color>, perkembangan kami pun semakin pesat.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_option3_linked_003
Array.english: <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color> is famous for his ability to reinterpret the use of ingredients,\nand his food was recently featured in an overseas magazine.
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color> terkenal karena kemampuannya dalam menafsirkan kembali penggunaan bahan-bahan masakan,\ndan hidangannya baru-baru ini ditampilkan di sebuah majalah luar negeri.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_option3_linked_004
Array.english: <size=38>He might be our dark horse.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Dia mungkin menjadi kuda hitam kita.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene4_001
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>That means Japanese is likely to be our best choice...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Itu berarti masakan Jepang kemungkinan besar akan menjadi pilihan terbaik kita...</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene4_002
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>Bancho hasn’t really proven himself yet. Do you think it’ll be alright?</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Bancho belum benar-benar membuktikan kemampuannya. Menurutmu, apakah ini akan baik-baik saja?</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene4_003
Array.english: Hmm. Bancho’s skill is indisputable.\nHowever...
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Kemampuan Bancho memang tak terbantahkan.\nNamun...

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene4_004
Array.english: One great drawback is that he doesn’t consider the preferences of his customers.\nHis sole focus is letting people try new flavors.
Array.indonesia: Salah satu kelemahan utamanya adalah dia tidak mempertimbangkan preferensi pelanggannya.\nFokus utamanya hanyalah mengajak orang mencoba rasa baru.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene4_005
Array.english: That is what drives his creativity, of course,\nbut this time it won’t really serve us.
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja, itulah yang mendorong kreativitasnya,\ntapi kali ini hal itu tidak akan benar-benar menguntungkan kita.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene4_006
Array.english: We’re dealing with the infamous Lois Crawford, after all.
Array.indonesia: Lagipula, kita sedang berurusan dengan Lois Crawford yang terkenal itu.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene4_007
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>I see. That’s a good point.\nHowever, I think the best we can do right now is try and persuade Bancho.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Aku mengerti. Itu poin yang bagus.\nNamun, menurutku yang terbaik yang bisa kita lakukan saat ini adalah mencoba meyakinkan Bancho.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene4_008
Array.english: I agree.\nBest of luck, Yoshie.
Array.indonesia: Aku setuju.\nSemoga berhasil, Yoshie.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_001
Array.english: <size=36><color=#A2F0F3>Bancho, are you here?</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36><color=#A2F0F3>Bancho, apakah kamu di sini?</color></size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_002
Array.english: Miss Yoshie? What are you doing here?
Array.indonesia: Nona Yoshie? Apa yang kamu lakukan di sini?

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_003
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>Oh, you’re here. That’s good.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Oh, kamu di sini. Bagus.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_004
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>I’ve come to check on the status of the manager’s request.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Aku datang untuk mengecek status permintaan manajer.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_005
Array.english: Look all you want.\nIt’s just an ordinary Japanese food kitchen.
Array.indonesia: Silakan lihat sesukamu.\nIni hanya dapur masakan Jepang biasa.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_006
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(Bancho was a peculiar man. He suddenly appeared one day,\nhanding us a resume and explaining he’d been learning in Japan.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Bancho adalah pria yang aneh. Suatu hari dia tiba-tiba muncul,\nmenyerahkan resume kepadamu dan menjelaskan bahwa dia pernah belajar di Jepang.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_007
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(All the sushi establishments listed in the resume were top-tier,\nbut Bancho never stayed in one place for long.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Semua tempat sushi yang tercantum dalam riwayat hidupnya adalah yang terbaik,\ntetapi Bancho tidak pernah bertahan lama di satu tempat.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_008
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(He told me that he moved on each time after learning enough. \nThe manager had a long talk with him and then left the operation of the Japanese Food Team to him.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Dia mengatakan kepadaku bahwa dia pindah setiap kali sudah cukup belajar. \nManajer berbicara panjang lebar dengannya, lalu menyerahkan pengelolaan Tim Masakan Jepang kepadanya.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_009
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(He could always be found in the kitchen busy with something, day in and day out.\nHe researched food on his own when there were no customers.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Dia selalu bisa ditemukan di dapur sibuk dengan sesuatu, hari demi hari.\nDia meneliti makanan sendiri saat tidak ada pelanggan.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_010
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(He hated to be interrupted.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Dia benci diganggu.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_011
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>Were you practicing?</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Apakah kamu sedang berlatih?</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_012
Array.english: Well... Yes.
Array.indonesia: Yah... Ya.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_013
Array.english: “Training” means thousands and tens of thousands of attempts.\nPractice without rest is the only way to produce meaningful results.
Array.indonesia: “Latihan” berarti ribuan hingga puluhan ribu kali percobaan.\nBerlatih tanpa henti adalah satu-satunya cara untuk menghasilkan hasil yang berarti.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_014
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>...I see.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>...I, aku mengerti.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_015
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>I heard that you never skip research and practice, Bancho.\nIt relieves me to see you so hard at work.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Aku dengar kamu tidak pernah melewatkan penelitian dan latihan, Bancho.\nAku lega melihatmu bekerja sekeras ini.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_016
Array.english: What do you mean, you’re relieved?
Array.indonesia: Apa maksudmu, kamu lega?

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_017
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>Bancho, would you be willing to try servicing a VIP?</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Bancho, maukah kamu mencoba melayani seorang VIP?</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_018
Array.english: <size=38>Servicing a VIP?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Melayani seorang VIP?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_option1
Array.english: VIP
Array.indonesia: VIP

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_option2
Array.english: Service
Array.indonesia: Melayani

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_option1_linked_001
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>That’s right. We have an important guest who will increase our reputation...\nor rather, who might send it plummeting to the ground.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Benar. Kami memiliki tamu penting yang akan meningkatkan reputasi kami...\natau lebih tepatnya, yang mungkin akan membuat reputasi kami hancur berantakan.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_option1_linked_002
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>Her name is <color=#F1DC2B>Lois Crawford</color>...\nShe’s an actress that’s infamously hard to please, and also a gourmet reviewer.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Namanya <color=#F1DC2B>Lois Crawford</color>...\nDia adalah seorang aktris yang terkenal sulit dipuaskan, sekaligus seorang kritikus kuliner.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_option2_linked_001
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>It’s been about a year since you joined the Dugong Hotel.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Sudah sekitar satu tahun sejak kamu bergabung dengan Hotel Dugong.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_option2_linked_002
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>Our Japanese Food Team, which was never very strong,\nreceived much attention in a short span of time...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Tim Masakan Jepang kami, yang memang tidak pernah terlalu kuat,\nmendapat banyak perhatian dalam waktu singkat...</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_option2_linked_003
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>And we can’t deny that your contribution to this was great.\nHowever, this means that we also get customers who want special treatment.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Dan kami tidak bisa menyangkal bahwa kontribusi Anda dalam hal ini sangat besar.\nNamun, ini berarti kami juga mendapat pelanggan yang menginginkan perlakuan istimewa.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene6_001
Array.english: So you mean to say that I should try and please\nthis picky woman, Lois Crawford?
Array.indonesia: Jadi, maksud Anda saya harus berusaha memuaskan\nwanita pemilih ini, Lois Crawford?

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene6_002
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>Yes. This is important, as Dugong Hotel’s reputation lies in the balance.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Ya. Ini penting, karena reputasi Hotel Dugong sedang dipertaruhkan.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene6_003
Array.english: <size=40>Hmm…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Hmm…</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene6_004
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>What do you say?</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Bagaimana menurut Anda?</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene6_005
Array.english: <size=32>For me, cooking has always been a battle with myself,\nnot with others. </size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Bagi saya, memasak selalu menjadi pertarungan dengan diri sendiri,\nbukan dengan orang lain. </size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene6_006
Array.english: <size=32>Making perfect food has always been my goal,\nand that won’t change no matter who I cook for.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Menciptakan hidangan yang sempurna selalu menjadi tujuan saya,\ndan itu tidak akan berubah, siapa pun yang saya masak untuknya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene6_007
Array.english: <size=32>I simply use the best ingredients available in the current season \nand the most suitable recipe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku hanya menggunakan bahan-bahan terbaik yang tersedia di musim ini \ndan resep yang paling cocok.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene6_008
Array.english: <size=38>Will that be okay with you?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Apakah itu tidak masalah bagimu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene6_009
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>Alright. We’ll leave the individual dishes in your hands, Bancho.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Baiklah. Kami serahkan pemilihan hidangan masing-masing kepada Anda, Bancho.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene6_010
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>However,\nI would like to offer input on the method of servicing our guest...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Namun,\nsaya ingin memberikan masukan mengenai cara menyajikan hidangan kepada tamu kita...</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene6_011
Array.english: Alright. You’re the expert, Miss Yoshie, when it comes to servicing food.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah. Anda ahlinya, Nona Yoshie, dalam hal penyajian hidangan.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene6_012
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>Very good. Now as for the type of menu to employ...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Bagus sekali. Sekarang mengenai jenis menu yang akan disajikan...</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene6_option1
Array.english: Sushi Course
Array.indonesia: Paket Sushi

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene6_option2
Array.english: Kaiseki Course
Array.indonesia: Paket Kaiseki

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene6_option1_linked_001
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>A sushi course offers various kinds of sushi in a certain order,\nwith a few side dishes interspersed in between.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Paket sushi menyajikan berbagai jenis sushi dalam urutan tertentu,\ndengan beberapa hidangan pendamping diselingi di antaranya.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene6_option1_linked_002
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>It allows us to use sushi to allow customers to try many types of fish.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Hal ini memungkinkan kita menggunakan sushi agar pelanggan dapat mencicipi berbagai jenis ikan.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene6_option1_linked_003
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>What do you think of the sushi course?\nIt’s also your specialty...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Bagaimana pendapatmu tentang menu sushi?\nItu juga spesialisasimu...</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene6_option1_linked_004
Array.english: I’m very familiar with the method.\nHowever, don’t you think it’ll be too ordinary?
Array.indonesia: Saya sangat paham dengan metodenya.\nNamun, bukankah menurutmu itu akan terlalu biasa?

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene6_option1_linked_005
Array.english: If we choose to go with this, we’ll likely use tuna sushi, pike eel sushi,\nor olive flounder sushi as the main dish—olive flounder being in season right now.
Array.indonesia: Jika kita memilih untuk melakukannya, kemungkinan besar kita akan menggunakan sushi tuna, sushi belut pike,\natau sushi ikan flounder zaitun sebagai hidangan utama—ikan flounder zaitun sedang musim saat ini.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene6_option1_linked_006
Array.english: That won’t be very impressive, however.
Array.indonesia: Namun, itu tidak akan terlalu mengesankan.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene6_option2_linked_001
Array.english:
<color=#A2F0F3>Kaiseki is a traditional Japanese dining method.
An hors d’oeuvre, small dishes, sashimi, soup, grilled food, and steamed food 
are brought out in order followed by rice.</color><color=#A2F0F3>It allows you to taste many kinds of food
and is regarded as the quintessential Japanese meal.</color>
Array.indonesia:
<color=#A2F0F3>Kaiseki adalah metode bersantap tradisional Jepang.
Hors d’oeuvre, hidangan kecil, sashimi, sup, hidangan panggang, dan hidangan kukus 
disajikan secara berurutan, diikuti dengan nasi.</color><color=#A2F0F3>Metode ini memungkinkan Anda mencicipi berbagai macam hidangan
dan dianggap sebagai hidangan khas Jepang yang sesungguhnya.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene6_option2_linked_002
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>What do you think of the kaiseki course? It’s traditional...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Bagaimana pendapat Anda tentang hidangan kaiseki? Hidangan ini tradisional...</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene6_option2_linked_003
Array.english: Kaiseki is a form of art which utilizes many dishes to express a unified theme.\nThat means using soup, grilled food, steamed food, and deep-fried food to express a theme...
Array.indonesia: Kaiseki adalah sebuah bentuk seni yang memanfaatkan banyak hidangan untuk mengekspresikan sebuah tema yang utuh.\nArtinya, menggunakan sup, hidangan panggang, hidangan kukus, dan hidangan goreng untuk mengekspresikan sebuah tema...

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene6_option2_linked_004
Array.english: Doing all that is impossible in this current kitchen.
Array.indonesia: Melakukan semua itu mustahil di dapur ini.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene7_001
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>Hmm. Alright.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Hmm. Baiklah.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene7_002
Array.english: Since it’s to be a dinner, I think a course would be better than a single dish.\nThat means it’d probably be better to employ a western course format instead...
Array.indonesia: Karena ini untuk makan malam, menurutku hidangan bertahap akan lebih baik daripada hidangan tunggal.\nArtinya, mungkin akan lebih baik menggunakan format hidangan bertahap ala Barat...

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene7_003
Array.english: Though it’ll be a bit different from the traditional method, I think I could add soup, \nan hors d’oeuvre, sashimi, side dishes, sushi, tempura, and dessert to the course. \nWhat do you think?
Array.indonesia: Meskipun akan sedikit berbeda dari cara tradisional, menurutku aku bisa menambahkan sup, \nhidangan pembuka, sashimi, lauk pendamping, sushi, tempura, dan hidangan penutup ke dalam menu bertahap tersebut. \nBagaimana menurutmu?

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene7_004
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>Not bad. So what will you make for each dish?</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Tidak buruk. Jadi, apa yang akan kamu buat untuk setiap hidangannya?</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene7_005
Array.english: There’s the soup to begin with...
Array.indonesia: Pertama-tama ada sup...

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene8_001
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>...Yes, I think that’ll be fine up to the sushi.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>...Yes, menurutku itu sudah cukup sampai ke sushi.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene8_002
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>Tempura is next.\nI suppose shrimp would be the most logical choice...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Selanjutnya tempura.\nKurasa udang adalah pilihan yang paling masuk akal...</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene8_003
Array.english: Hmm, it’s difficult to create any impact with shrimp.\nWe’ve kept everything pretty normal so far, so this is where we add a little spice.
Array.indonesia: Hmm, sulit untuk menciptakan kesan yang kuat dengan udang.\nSejauh ini semuanya masih cukup biasa, jadi di sinilah kita perlu menambahkan sedikit bumbu.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene8_004
Array.english: I’ve been researching this very topic.\nHow does something like this sound?
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah meneliti topik ini.\nBagaimana kalau begini?

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene8_005
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>You must have a good idea.\nLet’s hear it.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Pasti kamu punya ide bagus.\nCeritakan dong.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene8_006
Array.english: <size=40><color=#1DFEAF>Shark</color>!\nI’m thinking of a dish that uses a shark head.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40><color=#1DFEAF>Hiu</color>!\nAku sedang memikirkan hidangan yang menggunakan kepala hiu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene8_007
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3><size=38>What? A shark? Can sharks be eaten?</size></color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3><size=38>Apa? Hiu? Apakah hiu bisa dimakan?</size></color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene8_008
Array.english: Sharks are a very tasty fish.\nThis is the time of year when they grow fat, boosting the flavor.
Array.indonesia: Hiu adalah ikan yang sangat lezat.\nIni adalah musim di mana mereka gemuk, sehingga rasanya semakin nikmat.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene8_009
Array.english: The meat in the cheeks in particular has a lovely chewy texture\nwhich reminds you of both ordinary meat and fish.
Array.indonesia: Daging di bagian pipi khususnya memiliki tekstur kenyal yang nikmat\nyang mengingatkan pada daging biasa sekaligus ikan.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene8_010
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>But shark is too exotic of an ingredient.\nCouldn’t we use something a little more widely consumed?</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Tapi hiu adalah bahan yang terlalu eksotis.\nTidak bisakah kita menggunakan bahan yang lebih umum dikonsumsi?</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene8_011
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>Especially considering this is Lois Crawford...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Terutama mengingat ini adalah Lois Crawford...</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene8_012
Array.english: <size=36>Good food will impress anyone.\nAnyone who takes a bite will recognize the food for what it is, </size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Makanan yang enak akan membuat siapa pun terkesan.\nSiapa pun yang mencicipinya akan menyadari apa sebenarnya makanan ini, </size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene8_013
Array.english: <size=38>that it is the best possible food that can be found\naround here in the current season!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>bahwa ini adalah makanan terbaik yang bisa ditemukan\ndi sekitar sini pada musim ini!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene8_014
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>Um... I’ll give it some thought.\nI’m not sure if it’ll be okay.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Um... Aku akan memikirkannya.\nAku tidak yakin apakah itu akan baik-baik saja.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene8_015
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3><size=40>...</size></color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3><size=40>...</size></color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene8_017
Array.english: <size=40><color=#A2F0F3>I can’t help but think it’s not that great of an idea, Bancho.</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40><color=#A2F0F3>Aku tidak bisa tidak berpikir bahwa itu bukan ide yang bagus, Bancho.</color></size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene8_018
Array.english: <size=43>Hmm.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=43>Hmm.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene8_019
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>If you serve that dish and things go sideways,\nthe consequences won’t affect you alone.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Jika kamu menyajikan hidangan itu dan terjadi masalah,\nkonsekuensinya tidak hanya akan menimpa dirimu sendiri.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene8_020
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>Both the manager and I will also take part of the blame.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Baik manajer maupun aku juga akan ikut bertanggung jawab.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene8_021
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>After all, she’s coming to the Dugong Hotel, \nnot to a restaurant operated by you.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Lagipula, dia datang ke Hotel Dugong, \nbukan ke restoran yang kamu kelola.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene8_022
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>A hotel must seek to provide the most restful and enjoyable experience\nto its guests.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Sebuah hotel harus berupaya memberikan pengalaman yang paling menenangkan dan menyenangkan\nkepada para tamunya.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene8_023
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>Nothing can be allowed to mar that experience, as the hotel will stand to lose by it.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Tidak boleh ada hal apa pun yang merusak pengalaman tersebut, karena hotel akan mengalami kerugian karenanya.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene8_024
Array.english: But there’s no guarantee she’ll hate it.\nShe’ll know from taking just a bite that it’s one of the greatest foods...
Array.indonesia: Tapi tidak ada jaminan dia akan membencinya.\nDia akan tahu hanya dengan mencicipi sekali bahwa itu adalah salah satu hidangan terbaik...

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene8_025
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>There’s always an exception to the rule.\nShe’s an extremely picky person, after all.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Selalu ada pengecualian dari aturan.\nLagipula, dia orang yang sangat pemilih.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene8_026
Array.english: What a pity. I understand. I’ll go with shrimp tempura, then,\n<color=#C3C3C3><size=26>though it can’t compare to shark...</size></size>
Array.indonesia: Sayang sekali. Saya mengerti. Kalau begitu, aku akan memilih tempura udang,\n<color=#C3C3C3><size=26>meskipun rasanya tidak sebanding dengan hiu...</size></size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene9_001
Array.english: This way, <color=#F1DC2B>Miss Crawford</color>.
Array.indonesia: Silakan ke sini, <color=#F1DC2B>Nona Crawford</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene9_002
Array.english: Thank you.
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene9_003
Array.english: This is the chef who will be preparing your food today, <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color>.
Array.indonesia: Ini adalah koki yang akan menyiapkan makanan Anda hari ini, <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene9_004
Array.english: Hmm, he’s younger than I expected.\nI was hoping for a slightly more experienced chef...
Array.indonesia: Hmm, dia lebih muda dari yang saya kira.\nSaya berharap koki yang sedikit lebih berpengalaman...

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene9_005
Array.english: <size=45>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=45>...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene9_006
Array.english: Oh my... Tight-lipped, are we?\nPerhaps my looks leave you at a loss for words? Ehehe.
Array.indonesia: Astaga... Diam seribu bahasa, ya?\nMungkin penampilanku membuatmu kehabisan kata-kata? Ehehe.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene9_007
Array.english: Hahaha, he seems a little tense!\nHe’s still quite a skilled chef, I assure you.
Array.indonesia: Hahaha, dia kelihatannya agak tegang!\nDia tetap koki yang cukup terampil, aku jamin.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene9_008
Array.english: I’ll be looking forward to the food, then.\nI remember the service here being quite alright for an old hotel.
Array.indonesia: Kalau begitu, aku akan menantikan hidangannya.\nAku ingat pelayanannya di sini cukup baik untuk hotel tua.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene9_009
Array.english: I liked the carpet and the paintings on the walls as well.\nFurnishings at Gloria Hotel have a kitsch quality to them that I don’t like.
Array.indonesia: Aku juga suka karpet dan lukisan-lukisan di dindingnya.\nPerabotan di Gloria Hotel memiliki nuansa kitsch yang tidak kusukai.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene9_010
Array.english: But to think there’s no gym... That’s a bit of a shocker.\nI need to exercise daily to maintain my figure.
Array.indonesia: Tapi siapa sangka tidak ada gym... Itu agak mengejutkan.\nSaya perlu berolahraga setiap hari untuk menjaga bentuk tubuh saya.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene9_011
Array.english: It was our intention that your stay be as restful as possible...
Array.indonesia: Tujuan kami adalah agar masa menginap Anda senyaman mungkin...

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene9_012
Array.english: Everyone has their preferred way of resting.\nWell... the bathing facilities were good, so I’ll content myself with that.
Array.indonesia: Setiap orang punya cara masing-masing untuk bersantai.\nYah... fasilitas mandinya bagus, jadi saya akan puas dengan itu.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene9_013
Array.english: <size=40>So, what’s for dinner?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Jadi, apa menu makan malamnya?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene9_014
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>A Japanese course meal. \nHere’s the course menu.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Hidangan set ala Jepang. \nIni menu hidangannya.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene9_015
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>The first dishes are...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Hidangan pertama adalah...</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene9_option1
Array.english: Steamed Snapper and Yam Soup
Array.indonesia: Ikan Kakap Kukus dan Sup Ubi

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene9_option2
Array.english: Steamed Egg
Array.indonesia: Telur Kukus

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene9_option3
Array.english: Pickled Olive Flounder Fins
Array.indonesia: Sirip Ikan Flounder Asam Zaitun

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene9_option1_linked_001
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>This is a steamed dish composed of grilled snapper and roe—which was then \nsteamed—garnished with ground yam. The soup features the rich flavor of fish.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Ini adalah hidangan kukus yang terdiri dari ikan kakap panggang dan telur ikan—yang kemudian \ndikukus—dihiasi dengan ubi tumbuk. Sup ini memiliki rasa ikan yang kaya.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene9_option1_linked_002
Array.english: Hmm, is that a Japanese soup?
Array.indonesia: Hmm, apakah itu sup Jepang?

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene9_option1_linked_003
Array.english: It’s got a bland flavor coupled with... a spicy scent? Quite interesting.
Array.indonesia: Rasanya hambar, tapi dipadukan dengan... aroma pedas? Cukup menarik.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene9_option1_linked_004
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>That is the flavor of the shichimi.\nThere is a tiny bit of flavoring provided by a condiment made from seven different spices.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Itu adalah rasa dari shichimi.\nAda sedikit rasa yang berasal dari bumbu yang terbuat dari tujuh rempah berbeda.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene9_option2_linked_001
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>This is strained egg steamed with dashi and other ingredients.\nYou’ll find lily root, shrimp, ginkgo net, and mushrooms inside.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Ini adalah telur yang disaring dan dikukus dengan dashi serta bahan-bahan lainnya.\nDi dalamnya terdapat akar bunga lili, udang, daun ginkgo, dan jamur.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene9_option2_linked_002
Array.english: Steamed egg?\nI was expecting something a bit more special.
Array.indonesia: Telur kukus?\nAku mengira ini akan lebih istimewa.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene9_option2_linked_003
Array.english: Well, I suppose there are quite a few ingredients inside.
Array.indonesia: Yah, sepertinya ada cukup banyak bahan di dalamnya.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene9_option2_linked_004
Array.english: It was also made with love to bring out the best flavor for the guests, haha.
Array.indonesia: Makanan ini juga dibuat dengan penuh cinta agar rasa terbaiknya bisa dinikmati para tamu, haha.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene9_option3_linked_001
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>These are pickled olive flounder fins. The fins of the olive flounder have been pickled in a mixture of soy sauce and peppers.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Ini adalah sirip ikan flounder zaitun yang diasamkan. Sirip ikan flounder zaitun ini telah diasamkan dalam campuran kecap dan cabai.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene9_option3_linked_002
Array.english: Raw fish from the very first dish.\nIt really is... Japanese, isn’t it?
Array.indonesia: Ikan mentah dari hidangan pertama.\nIni benar-benar... khas Jepang, bukan?

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene9_option3_linked_003
Array.english: Is that salty taste supposed to disguise the fatty flavor?\nEven so, this is too salty...
Array.indonesia: Apakah rasa asin itu dimaksudkan untuk menyamarkan rasa lemaknya?\nMeski begitu, ini terlalu asin...

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene9_option3_linked_004
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>As that is a hors d’oeuvre meant to stimulate the appetite,\nI did give it a stronger flavor.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Karena ini adalah hidangan pembuka yang dimaksudkan untuk membangkitkan selera makan,\nsaya memang memberi rasa yang lebih kuat.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene10_001
Array.english: <size=34><color=#A2F0F3>And the next dish is...</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34><color=#A2F0F3>Dan hidangan berikutnya adalah...</color></size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene10_002
Array.english: ...So...the tempura and dessert are left?
Array.indonesia: ...Jadi...tinggal tempura dan hidangan penutup?

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene10_003
Array.english: What’s the tempura? Don’t tell me it’s shrimp.\nThe sort that’s commonly served with rice? *Sigh*
Array.indonesia: Apa itu tempura? Jangan bilang itu udang.\nJenis yang biasanya disajikan dengan nasi? *Huff*

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene10_004
Array.english: The dessert’s no doubt the usual fruit...\nI suppose I’ve tasted basically everything.
Array.indonesia: Makanan penutupnya pasti buah-buahan biasa...\nSepertinya aku sudah mencicipi hampir semuanya.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene10_005
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(It’s hard to decipher her reaction... Have we succeeded?)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Sulit menebak reaksinya... Apakah kita berhasil?)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene10_006
Array.english: How do you like it...\nAre you happy with our Japanese food?
Array.indonesia: Bagaimana menurutmu...\nApakah kamu puas dengan masakan Jepang kami?

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene10_007
Array.english: Well, it’s about as good as I expected it to be, I suppose.
Array.indonesia: Yah, rasanya kira-kira sesuai ekspektasiku, kurasa.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene10_008
Array.english: I suppose I could come here to eat every now and then,\nbut why bother coming to a hotel to eat food that’s quite average?
Array.indonesia: Kurasa aku bisa datang ke sini untuk makan sesekali,\ntapi buat apa repot-repot datang ke hotel hanya untuk makan makanan yang biasa-biasa saja?

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene10_009
Array.english: Hahaha. E-even so, I’m sure our food is better than that of most other restaurants...
Array.indonesia: Hahaha. B-bahkan begitu, aku yakin masakan kami lebih enak daripada kebanyakan restoran lain...

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene10_option1_linked_001
Array.english: The snapper soup or something was pretty interesting, but that’s it.\nIt was just a fishy soup with a spicy aftertaste...
Array.indonesia: Sup kakap atau semacamnya cukup menarik, tapi cuma itu saja.\nItu cuma sup ikan dengan rasa pedas di akhir...

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene10_option1_linked_002
Array.english: To think you added sticky yam on top...\nUgh... I didn’t really like the texture.
Array.indonesia: Sia-sia saja kamu menambahkan ubi lengket di atasnya... \nUgh... Aku nggak terlalu suka teksturnya.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene10_option2_linked_001
Array.english: The moment I saw the steamed egg,\nI had a feeling the food would be average. And I was right.
Array.indonesia: Begitu aku lihat telur kukus itu,\naku udah merasa makanannya bakal biasa-biasa aja. Dan ternyata bener.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene10_option3_linked_001
Array.english: The picked olive flounder fins at the start of the course were interesting, of course...
Array.indonesia: Sirip ikan flounder yang diasamkan di awal hidangan memang menarik, tentu saja...

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene10_option3_linked_002
Array.english: But serving pickled fish as an appetizer? I mean, really?\nA salad might have been better.
Array.indonesia: Tapi menyajikan ikan acar sebagai hidangan pembuka? Maksudku, beneran?\nSalad mungkin lebih baik.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene10_option3_linked_003
Array.english: Well, that’s how it is with Japanese food. They always bring out some obscure rural dish,\nfollowed by boring fish cut and arranged all nicely…
Array.indonesia: Yah, begitulah makanan Jepang. Mereka selalu menyajikan hidangan pedesaan yang aneh-aneh,\ndiikuti dengan potongan ikan yang membosankan dan ditata rapi…

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene11_001
Array.english: Oh dear... It seems Japanese food isn’t all that to your liking.
Array.indonesia: Astaga... Sepertinya makanan Jepang tidak terlalu sesuai dengan seleramu.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene11_002
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>Ignorant of that fact, we served you Japanese...\nMy mistake. Please accept my apologies.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Tanpa menyadari hal itu, kami menyajikan masakan Jepang untukmu...\nKesalahanku. Mohon maafkan aku.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene11_003
Array.english: Whatever. It wasn’t that good, but it was healthy, at least.\nThis hotel doesn’t even have a gym, so I suppose the food should be healthy \nat the very least. Heh.
Array.indonesia: Terserah. Rasanya memang tidak terlalu enak, tapi setidaknya sehat.\nHotel ini bahkan tidak punya gym, jadi kurasa makanannya haruslah sehat \nsetidaknya. Heh.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene11_004
Array.english: <size=42>Um... May I have a word?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>Um... Boleh saya bicara sebentar?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene11_005
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3><size=46>Bancho!</size></color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3><size=46>Bancho!</size></color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene11_006
Array.english: <size=38>Allow me to introduce myself again.\nI am the master chef who works here, <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color>. </size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Izinkan saya memperkenalkan diri lagi.\nSaya adalah kepala koki yang bekerja di sini, <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color>. </size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene11_007
Array.english: <size=38>I’m not much of a speaker, so I’ve been listening quietly.\nI find it impossible to maintain my silence now, however.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Saya bukan orang yang pandai bicara, jadi saya hanya mendengarkan dengan diam.\nNamun, sekarang saya merasa tidak mungkin lagi untuk tetap diam.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene11_008
Array.english: Oh my, do you have something to tell me?\nApparently you’re supposed to have better food than anywhere else, right?
Array.indonesia: Astaga, apakah ada yang ingin Anda sampaikan kepada saya?\nKatanya makanan di sini seharusnya lebih enak daripada di tempat lain, kan?

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene11_009
Array.english: Now now, Bancho, Miss Lois here is just—
Array.indonesia: Sudahlah, Bancho, Nona Lois di sini hanya—

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene11_010
Array.english: <size=38>It is most definitely my fault\nfor failing to provide food that satisfies you. </size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Ini jelas-jelas kesalahanku\nkarena gagal menyajikan makanan yang memuaskanmu. </size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene11_011
Array.english: Will you not give me a chance to make up for my mistake?
Array.indonesia: Maukah kamu memberiku kesempatan untuk menebus kesalahanku?

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene11_012
Array.english: <size=32>What? Oh... Well, gosh, I’m a very busy woman.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Apa? Oh... Wah, astaga, aku wanita yang sangat sibuk.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene11_013
Array.english: <size=38>What you witnessed today aren’t my real skills.\nI’ll serve you food that can objectively be called good.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Apa yang kamu saksikan hari ini bukanlah kemampuan asliku.\nAku akan menyajikan makanan yang secara objektif bisa disebut enak.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene11_014
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3><size=38>Bancho, you can’t be talking about...</size></color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3><size=38>Bancho, kamu tidak mungkin sedang membicarakan...</size></color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene11_015
Array.english: Hmm, so you’re saying you have something else you think will satisfy me?
Array.indonesia: Hmm, jadi kamu bilang kamu punya sesuatu lain yang menurutmu akan memuaskanku?

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene11_016
Array.english: Alright, I’ll wait. But remember, my time is valuable.\nYour food had better be amazing.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah, aku akan menunggu. Tapi ingat, waktuku berharga.\nMakananmu sebaiknya luar biasa.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene11_017
Array.english: <size=42><color=#A2F0F3>Bancho, you can’t be thinking of...</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42><color=#A2F0F3>Bancho, kamu pasti tidak sedang memikirkan...</color></size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene11_018
Array.english: What is it, Miss Yoshie?\nIs there something I’m missing?
Array.indonesia: Ada apa, Nona Yoshie?\nApakah ada yang terlewatkan?

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene11_019
Array.english: <size=42>All done.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>Sudah selesai.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene11_020
Array.english: This is <color=#1DFEAF><size=40>Whole-Roasted Shark Head</size></color>.
Array.indonesia: Ini adalah <color=#1DFEAF><size=40>Kepala Hiu Panggang Utuh</size></color>.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene11_021
Array.english: <size=49>OH MY GOD!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=49>OH MY GOD!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene11_022
Array.english: <size=49>Th-this is...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=49>I-ini...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene11_023
Array.english: <size=49>You... fried the whole head?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=49>Kamu... menggoreng kepalanya utuh?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene11_024
Array.english: <size=38>It is an amazing dish. The meat in the cheeks hasn’t been cut out.\nI chose to fry the head whole to preserve the supple texture.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Ini hidangan yang luar biasa. Daging di pipinya belum dipotong.\nSaya memilih menggoreng kepalanya utuh untuk mempertahankan teksturnya yang lembut.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene11_025
Array.english: <size=40>You’ll never taste something like this anywhere else!\nIt’s a high-quality dish made using the best possible ingredients.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Kamu tidak akan pernah mencicipi hidangan seperti ini di tempat lain!\nIni hidangan berkualitas tinggi yang dibuat menggunakan bahan-bahan terbaik.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene11_026
Array.english: <size=47>Get that out of my sight! \nHow can you call this food!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=47>Singkirkan itu dari pandanganku! \nBagaimana bisa kamu menyebut ini makanan!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene11_027
Array.english: <size=40>What are you saying?\nTake just a bite! I guarantee you’ll be transported to heaven!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Apa yang kamu katakan?\nCoba gigit sedikit saja! Aku jamin kamu akan merasa seperti di surga!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene11_028
Array.english: <size=42>I am not happy about this.\nIs this what service is like at the Dugong Hotel?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>Aku tidak senang dengan ini.\nApakah begini layanan di Hotel Dugong?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene11_029
Array.english: <size=38>I-it’s all my fault. I’ll apologize.\nNow... Bancho, Yoshie, you apologize as well.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>I-ini semua salahku. Aku akan meminta maaf.\nSekarang... Bancho, Yoshie, kalian juga minta maaf.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene11_030
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>I’m sorry, Miss Lois.\nI should have been more vigilant...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Maaf, Nona Lois.\nSeharusnya aku lebih waspada...</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene11_031
Array.english: <size=40>Looks are not all there is to food.\nWhy do you refuse to even try it, Miss Lois?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Penampilan bukan segalanya dalam makanan.\nKenapa kamu menolak untuk mencobanya, Nona Lois?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene11_032
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3><size=38>Bancho! Now isn’t the time to—</size></color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3><size=38>Bancho! Sekarang bukan waktunya untuk—</size></color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene11_033
Array.english: <size=40>I find this highly unpleasant.\nIs this some kind of hidden camera prank... or a punishment?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Aku merasa sangat tidak nyaman dengan ini.\nApakah ini semacam lelucon kamera tersembunyi... atau hukuman?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene11_034
Array.english: <size=40>You’ll pay for treating me this way.\nDon’t think I’ll just let you get away with it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Kamu akan membayar akibat memperlakukanku seperti ini.\nJangan kira aku akan membiarkanmu lolos begitu saja!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene11_035
Array.english: <size=40>I’m leaving. Cancel my suite. \nCharge me a cancellation fee if you wish, I don’t care!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Aku pergi. Batalkan pemesanan suite-ku. \nKenakan biaya pembatalan jika mau, aku tidak peduli!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_time_flow
Array.english: A few minutes later...
Array.indonesia: Beberapa menit kemudian...

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_Sushibar_open_001
Array.english: Um... Looks like I arrived too late.
Array.indonesia: Um... Sepertinya aku datang terlambat.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_Sushibar_open_002
Array.english: I should do a little cleanup.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya aku harus membereskan sedikit.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_Sushibar_Yoshie_BeforeBeer_001
Array.english: Huh? Miss Yoshie, what are you doing here?
Array.indonesia: Hah? Nona Yoshie, apa yang kamu lakukan di sini?

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_Sushibar_Yoshie_BeforeBeer_002
Array.english: Oh, my work ended just now and I was passing by.\nI saw the lights were on despite the hour.
Array.indonesia: Oh, pekerjaanku baru saja selesai dan aku kebetulan lewat.\nAku lihat lampunya masih menyala meski sudah larut malam.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_Sushibar_Yoshie_BeforeBeer_003
Array.english: Bancho seems to have gone home already.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya Bancho sudah pulang.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_Sushibar_Yoshie_BeforeBeer_004
Array.english: He looked a bit tired recently. I’m worried he might fall ill.
Array.indonesia: Dia terlihat agak lelah belakangan ini. Aku khawatir dia bisa sakit.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_Sushibar_Yoshie_BeforeBeer_005
Array.english: Hehe. Even so, I’m glad to see him working so hard \nagain like this.
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Meski begitu, aku senang melihatnya bekerja keras \nlagi seperti ini.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_Sushibar_Yoshie_BeforeBeer_006
Array.english: Oh, come to think of it, I heard he once gave up on cooking\nbecause of <color=#9E7BFF>a certain incident</color>...
Array.indonesia: Oh, kalau dipikir-pikir, aku dengar dia pernah berhenti memasak\nkarena <color=#9E7BFF>sebuah insiden tertentu</color>...

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_Sushibar_Yoshie_BeforeBeer_007
Array.english: Yes...\nBack then, I thought he was gone for good.
Array.indonesia: Ya...\nSaat itu, aku pikir dia sudah pergi selamanya.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_Sushibar_Yoshie_BeforeBeer_008
Array.english: I wonder what it was about.
Array.indonesia: Aku penasaran apa yang terjadi.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_Sushibar_Yoshie_BeforeBeer_009
Array.english: Hehe, well, it’s nothing that secretive.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, yah, itu bukan rahasia besar.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_Sushibar_Yoshie_BeforeBeer_010
Array.english: I simply avoided mentioning it with him present\njust in case it’s still a sore spot for Bancho.
Array.indonesia: Aku hanya menghindari membicarakannya di hadapannya\njaga-jaga kalau itu masih menjadi luka lama bagi Bancho.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_Sushibar_Yoshie_BeforeBeer_011
Array.english: <size=32>I’m thirsty.\nCan you first give me a glass of <color=#F1DC2B>Beer</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku haus.\nBisakah kamu memberiku segelas <color=#F1DC2B>bir</color> dulu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_Sushibar_Yoshie_AfterBeer_001
Array.english: *Sigh*\nNothing so refreshing as a glass of beer after work.
Array.indonesia: *Huff*\nTidak ada yang lebih menyegarkan daripada segelas bir setelah bekerja.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_Sushibar_Yoshie_AfterBeer_002
Array.english: It’s especially nice to have a view of the sea at night\nlike this as I drink.
Array.indonesia: Rasanya sangat menyenangkan bisa menikmati pemandangan laut di malam hari\nseperti ini sambil minum.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_Sushibar_Yoshie_AfterBeer_003
Array.english: I’ll tell you now a bit about Bancho,\nand why he quit cooking for a while.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan menceritakan sedikit tentang Bancho,\ndan mengapa dia berhenti memasak untuk sementara waktu.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_Sushibar_Yoshie_AfterBeer_004
Array.english: <size=34>It was 12 years ago...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Itu terjadi 12 tahun yang lalu...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_Sushibar_Close_001
Array.english: After that... Bancho quit his job at the hotel and left,\nsaying he needed to train.
Array.indonesia: Setelah itu... Bancho berhenti dari pekerjaannya di hotel dan pergi,\ndengan alasan dia perlu berlatih.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_Sushibar_Close_002
Array.english: It’s my belief it wasn’t so much the cooking itself as\nthe ingredients and cooking methods that he researched.
Array.indonesia: Menurutku, yang dia teliti bukanlah memasak itu sendiri, melainkan\nbahan-bahan dan metode memasaknya.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_Sushibar_Close_003
Array.english: I see...
Array.indonesia: Begitu ya...

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_Sushibar_Close_004
Array.english: Still, I admire him a little for not giving up on the belief\nthat he’s going on the right path.
Array.indonesia: Meski begitu, aku sedikit mengaguminya karena tidak menyerah pada keyakinannya\nbahwa dia berada di jalur yang benar.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_Sushibar_Close_005
Array.english: I suppose it was this stubborn side of him\nthat allowed him to attain his current level of skill.
Array.indonesia: Kurasa sisi keras kepalanya inilah\nyang membuatnya bisa mencapai tingkat keahliannya saat ini.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_Sushibar_Close_006
Array.english: Working with you now, he even started\nsocial media...
Array.indonesia: Bekerja bersamamu sekarang, dia bahkan mulai\nmenggunakan media sosial...

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_Sushibar_Close_007
Array.english: I feel something has changed about him, and I like it.
Array.indonesia: Aku merasa ada sesuatu yang berubah darinya, dan aku menyukainya.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_Sushibar_Close_008
Array.english: <size=34>I think you’re good for him. Please continue to get along.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Menurutku kamu baik untuknya. Tolong teruslah akur dengannya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_Sushibar_Close_009
Array.english: <size=32>I’ll do my best to help Bancho focus on his cooking!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku akan berusaha sebaik mungkin untuk membantu Bancho fokus pada masakannya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Interior_Waring_001
Array.english: Restore all the interior furnishings\nyou have placed so far to their original state?
Array.indonesia: Mengembalikan semua perabotan interior\nyang telah kamu letakkan sejauh ini ke keadaan semula?

Array.name: dialogue_Interior_Waring_003
Array.english: This will apply all the interior furnishings you have placed up to now.
Array.indonesia: Ini akan mengembalikan semua perabotan interior yang telah kamu letakkan hingga saat ini.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_MeetUdo_001
Array.english: <size=35>Wait! Can I have a moment with you?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Tunggu! Boleh aku bicara sebentar denganmu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_MeetUdo_002
Array.english: Yes? I’m sorry... you are?
Array.indonesia: Ya? Maaf... kamu siapa?

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_MeetUdo_003
Array.english: Teehee! I should introduce myself first.\nI’m a reporter for the magazine <color=#5dd3bb>Weekly Fish</color>. \nThe name is <color=#F1DC2B>Udo</color>.
Array.indonesia: Teehee! Seharusnya aku memperkenalkan diri dulu.\nAku seorang reporter untuk majalah <color=#5dd3bb>Weekly Fish</color>. \nNamaku <color=#F1DC2B>Udo</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_MeetUdo_004
Array.english: Oh, I’ve read that magazine, too!\nIt covers unique fish species!
Array.indonesia: Oh, aku juga pernah membaca majalah itu!\nMajalah itu membahas spesies ikan yang unik!

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_MeetUdo_005
Array.english: <size=35>Oh, you have? That’s right!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh, benar? Itu benar!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_MeetUdo_006
Array.english: I heard that the Blue Hole is home to \na variety of fish species… Is that true?
Array.indonesia: Saya dengar Blue Hole adalah rumah bagi \nberbagai spesies ikan… Benarkah itu?

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_MeetUdo_007
Array.english: You could say that.\nThere are all kinds of fish species from around the world.
Array.indonesia: Bisa dibilang begitu.\nAda berbagai macam spesies ikan dari seluruh dunia.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_MeetUdo_008
Array.english: <size=35>Oh, I knew it!\nSo I’ve come to the right place!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh, aku tahu!\nJadi, aku datang ke tempat yang tepat!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_MeetUdo_009
Array.english: I’d love to take pictures myself for the magazine, \nbut…
Array.indonesia: Aku ingin sekali mengambil foto sendiri untuk majalah itu, \ntapi…

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_MeetUdo_010
Array.english: <size=35>Unfortunately, I can’t dive.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Sayangnya, aku tidak bisa menyelam.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_MeetUdo_011
Array.english: Speaking of which…\nWould you help me take some <color=#F1DC2B>pictures</color>?
Array.indonesia: Ngomong-ngomong…\nBisakah kamu membantuku mengambil beberapa <color=#F1DC2B>foto</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_MeetUdo_012
Array.english: <size=35>Pictures...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Foto...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_MeetUdo_013
Array.english: Yes! See, you have that nice camera over there…
Array.indonesia: Ya! Lihat, kamu punya kamera bagus di sana…

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_MeetUdo_014
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>Oh… It’s the one from Dr. Bacon…</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Oh… Itu milik Dr. Bacon…</color>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_MeetUdo_015
Array.english: But I’m no expert in photography.\nI’m not sure if I’m good enough….
Array.indonesia: Tapi aku bukan ahli fotografi.\nAku nggak yakin apakah aku cukup pandai….

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_MeetUdo_016
Array.english: Don’t worry! \nI’ll tell you where and what to photograph.
Array.indonesia: Jangan khawatir! \nAku akan memberitahumu di mana dan apa yang harus difoto.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_MeetUdo_017
Array.english: And of course, I’ll reward you if you decide to \nhelp me out! Ha ha!
Array.indonesia: Dan tentu saja, aku akan memberimu hadiah jika kamu memutuskan untuk \nmembantuku! Ha ha!

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_MeetUdo_016_re
Array.english: Don’t worry! \nIf you're a reader of "Weekly Fish" you will get a feel for what kind of fish to photograph.
Array.indonesia: Jangan khawatir! \nKalau kamu pembaca “Weekly Fish”, kamu pasti tahu ikan seperti apa yang harus difoto.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_MeetUdo_017_re
Array.english: And of course, I’ll reward you if you\ntake a nice picture! Haha!
Array.indonesia: Dan tentu saja, aku akan memberi hadiah kalau kamu \nmengambil foto yang bagus! Haha!

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_MeetUdo_018
Array.english: Well, if you say so…
Array.indonesia: Ya, kalau kamu bilang begitu…

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_MeetUdo_019
Array.english: <size=31>All right.\nIt’d be nice to make a record of this amazing world.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Baiklah.\nAkan menyenangkan jika bisa mendokumentasikan dunia yang menakjubkan ini.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Reward_Start_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh! You brought a picture of something!\nCan I see?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh! Kamu membawa foto sesuatu!\nBoleh aku lihat?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Reward_End_001
Array.english: I’ll put your picture to good use.\nI’m sure the readers will love it!
Array.indonesia: Aku akan memanfaatkan fotomu dengan baik.\nAku yakin para pembaca akan menyukainya!

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Reward_End_002
Array.english: There are <color=#F1DC2B>Photo Spots</color> all over the place. \nThank you for your help and keep up the good work!
Array.indonesia: Ada <color=#F1DC2B>Tempat Foto</color> di mana-mana. \nTerima kasih atas bantuannya dan teruslah bekerja dengan baik!

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Oarfish01_Find_001
Array.english: <size=36>Wait! That’s… a <color=#1DFEAF>giant oarfish</color>?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Tunggu! Itu… seekor <color=#1DFEAF>ikan dayung raksasa</color>?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Oarfish01_Find_002
Array.english: Blue plankton and giant oarfish would be perfect together!\nYou have to do this for me!
Array.indonesia: Plankton biru dan ikan dayung raksasa pasti akan serasi!\nKamu harus melakukannya untukku!

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Oarfish01_Find_001_re
Array.english: <size=36>Whoa…\nThat's a...<color=#F1DC2B>giant oarfish </color>?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Wah…\nItu...<color=#F1DC2B>ikan dayung raksasa </color>?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Oarfish01_Find_002_re
Array.english: If I take a picture with the <color=#1DFEAF>blue plankton </color> next to it, that could make a pretty nice picture!
Array.indonesia: Kalau aku foto bareng <color=#1DFEAF>plankton biru </color> di sebelahnya, hasilnya pasti keren!

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Oarfish01_Retake_001
Array.english: <size=35>Ah, it's the <color=#F1DC2B><photozone=target/></color> again!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ah, itu <color=#F1DC2B><photozone=target/></color> lagi!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Oarfish01_Retake_002
Array.english: The photo taken last time could have been better…\nTry again?
Array.indonesia: Foto yang diambil terakhir kali seharusnya bisa lebih bagus…\nCoba lagi?

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Reward_Oarfish01_001
Array.english: <size=34>That’s a…<color=#1DFEAF>giant oarfish</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Itu adalah…<color=#1DFEAF>ikan dayung raksasa</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Reward_Oarfish01_002
Array.english: I heard the fish was referred to as a god in the ancient times…\nIt really is huge. Amazing.
Array.indonesia: Aku dengar ikan itu disebut sebagai dewa di zaman kuno…\nMemang sangat besar. Luar biasa.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Whale01_Find_001
Array.english: <size=36>Oh! This is the path where the <color=#1DFEAF>humpback whale</color> passes through!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Oh! Ini jalur yang dilalui oleh <color=#1DFEAF>paus bungkuk</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Whale01_Find_002
Array.english: Please take a picture of the humpback whale family!
Array.indonesia: Tolong foto keluarga paus bungkuk itu!

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Whale01_Find_001_re
Array.english: <size=36>That's the family of the <color=#F1DC2B>humpback whale</color> I met earlier! </size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Itu keluarga <color=#F1DC2B>paus bungkuk</color> yang kutemui tadi! </size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Whale01_Find_002_re
Array.english: <size=34>Should I take a picture…?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Haruskah aku memotret…?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Whale01_Retake_001
Array.english: <size=35>Ah, it's the <color=#F1DC2B><photozone=target/></color> again!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ah, itu <color=#F1DC2B><photozone=target/></color> lagi!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Whale01_Retake_002
Array.english: The photo taken last time could have been better…\nTry again?
Array.indonesia: Foto yang diambil tadi sepertinya bisa lebih bagus…\nCoba lagi?

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Reward_Whale01_001
Array.english: <size=34>A <color=#1DFEAF>humpback whale</color>...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Seekor <color=#1DFEAF>paus bungkuk</color>...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Reward_Whale01_002
Array.english: What a gigantic, yet amazing creature!\nIt’s famous for its love of family.
Array.indonesia: Makhluk yang sangat besar, namun menakjubkan!\nIa terkenal karena kecintaannya pada keluarga.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Fail_Whale01_001
Array.english: Oh, it just passed by...\nIt won’t come back for a while now, so let’s wait for the next turn.
Array.indonesia: Oh, ia baru saja lewat...\nIa tidak akan kembali untuk sementara waktu, jadi mari kita tunggu giliran berikutnya.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_PinkDolphin01_Find_001
Array.english: <size=34>Whoa! Is that a <color=#1DFEAF>pink dolphin</color>!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wah! Apa itu <color=#1DFEAF>lumba-lumba merah muda</color>!?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_PinkDolphin01_Find_002
Array.english: It looks like it’s your friend.\nPlease take a picture of it!
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya itu temanmu.\nTolong foto dia!

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_PinkDolphin01_Find_001_re
Array.english: <size=34>Ah, the <color=#F1DC2B>pink dolphin</color> I met before!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ah, <color=#F1DC2B>lumba-lumba merah muda</color> yang pernah kutemui sebelumnya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_PinkDolphin01_Find_002_re
Array.english: What if it gets caught by poachers again while wandering around alone...?
Array.indonesia: Bagaimana kalau dia tertangkap lagi oleh pemburu liar saat berkeliaran sendirian...?

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_PinkDolphin01_Find_003_re
Array.english: If we raise awareness about it\ncan't we maybe make it harder to poach?
Array.indonesia: Kalau kita meningkatkan kesadaran tentang hal ini\nmungkin kita bisa membuat perburuan liar jadi lebih sulit?

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_PinkDolphin01_Find_004_re
Array.english: <size=33>I should take a picture and get it it published in "Weekly Fish"!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku harus memotretnya dan mempublikasikannya di "Weekly Fish"!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_PinkDolphin01_Retake_001
Array.english: <size=35>Ah, it's the <color=#F1DC2B>pink dolphin</color> again!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ah, itu <color=#F1DC2B>lumba-lumba merah muda</color> lagi!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_PinkDolphin01_Retake_002
Array.english: The photo taken last time could have been better…\nTry again?
Array.indonesia: Foto yang diambil terakhir kali bisa lebih bagus…\nCoba lagi?

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Reward_PinkDolphin01_001
Array.english: <size=34>Wow… A <color=#1DFEAF>pink dolphin</color>...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wow… Seekor <color=#1DFEAF>lumba-lumba merah muda</color>...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Reward_PinkDolphin01_002
Array.english: It’s so adorable, I’d like to take it home!
Array.indonesia: Lucu sekali, aku ingin membawanya pulang!

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Reward_PinkDolphin01_003
Array.english: <size=34>... I’m kidding.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>... Aku bercanda.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Reward_PinkDolphin01_004
Array.english: Great. Then let's name this dolphin <color=#FFC2FB>Pinky</color>…\nand get people to notice.
Array.indonesia: Bagus. Kalau begitu, mari kita beri nama lumba-lumba ini <color=#FFC2FB>Pinky</color>…\ndan buat orang-orang menyadarinya.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Reward_PinkDolphin01_005
Array.english: <size=35>Then poachers won't be able to catch it so easily!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Kalau begitu, pemburu liar tidak akan bisa menangkapnya dengan mudah!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Loggerhead_Sea_Turtle01_Find_001
Array.english: <size=34>I… I see a <color=#1DFEAF>loggerhead turtle</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku… aku melihat seekor <color=#1DFEAF>penyu tempayan</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Loggerhead_Sea_Turtle01_Find_002
Array.english: I think turtles are the highlight of the underwater world.\nPlease take a picture of it!
Array.indonesia: Menurutku, penyu adalah daya tarik utama dunia bawah laut.\nTolong fotoin dia!

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Loggerhead_Sea_Turtle01_Find_001_re
Array.english: <size=34>Oh, a <color=#F1DC2B>loggerhead turtle</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh, seekor <color=#F1DC2B>penyu tempayan</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Loggerhead_Sea_Turtle01_Find_002_re
Array.english: <size=33>A picture of a turtle is a must-have sea picture!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Foto penyu adalah foto laut yang wajib dimiliki!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Loggerhead_Sea_Turtle01_Find_003_re
Array.english: Alright, time to take a pic!
Array.indonesia: Baiklah, saatnya mengambil foto!

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Loggerhead_Sea_Turtle01_Retake_001
Array.english: <size=35>Ah, it's the <color=#F1DC2B><photozone=target/></color> again!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ah, itu <color=#F1DC2B><photozone=target/></color> lagi!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Loggerhead_Sea_Turtle01_Retake_002
Array.english: The photo taken last time could have been better…\nTry again?
Array.indonesia: Foto yang diambil terakhir kali bisa lebih bagus…\nCoba lagi?

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Reward_Loggerhead_Sea_Turtle01_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ooh… A <color=#1DFEAF>loggerhead turtle</color>…!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ooh… Seekor <color=#1DFEAF>penyu tempayan</color>…!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Reward_Loggerhead_Sea_Turtle01_002
Array.english: As a child, I dreamed of exploring the waters \non the back of a turtle.
Array.indonesia: Saat kecil, aku bermimpi menjelajahi lautan \ndi punggung seekor penyu.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Reward_Loggerhead_Sea_Turtle01_003
Array.english: Of course, I would drown if I tried that myself.
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja, aku akan tenggelam kalau mencoba melakukannya sendiri.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Leatherback_Turtle01_Find_001
Array.english: <size=34>I-Isn’t that…!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I-Itu bukankah…!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Leatherback_Turtle01_Find_002
Array.english: <size=34>A <color=#1DFEAF>leatherback turtle</color>, the largest turtle alive!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Seekor <color=#1DFEAF>penyu belimbing</color>, penyu terbesar yang masih hidup!!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Leatherback_Turtle01_Find_003
Array.english: <size=32>I can’t miss this!\nPlease take a picture of it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aku nggak boleh melewatkan ini!\nTolong fotoin dong!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Leatherback_Turtle01_Find_001_re
Array.english: <size=34>Isn't that the seaweed collector Tsuchi and \nhis pet <color=#F1DC2B>leatherback sea turtle</color>!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Bukankah itu Tsuchi si pengumpul rumput laut dan \nhewan peliharaannya  <color=#F1DC2B>penyu belimbing</color>!?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Leatherback_Turtle01_Find_002_re
Array.english: What was the turtle's name again...?
Array.indonesia: Nama penyu itu apa ya...?

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Leatherback_Turtle01_Find_option01
Array.english: Leo
Array.indonesia: Leo

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Leatherback_Turtle01_Find_option02
Array.english: Dona
Array.indonesia: Dona

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Leatherback_Turtle01_Find_option03
Array.english: Raffie
Array.indonesia: Raffie

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Leatherback_Turtle01_Find_option04
Array.english: Mike
Array.indonesia: Mike

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Leatherback_Turtle01_Find_option01_linked
Array.english: Wasn't it...<color=#F1DC2B> Leo</color>...?
Array.indonesia: Bukankah itu...<color=#F1DC2B> Leo</color>...?

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Leatherback_Turtle01_Find_option02_linked
Array.english: That's right! It was <color=#1DFEAF>Dona</color> wasn't it!
Array.indonesia: Benar! Itu <color=#1DFEAF>Dona</color>, kan!

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Leatherback_Turtle01_Find_option03_linked
Array.english: Wasn't it...<color=#F1DC2B>Raffie</color>...?
Array.indonesia: Bukankah itu...<color=#F1DC2B>Raffie</color>...?

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Leatherback_Turtle01_Find_option04_linked
Array.english: Wasn't it...<color=#F1DC2B>Mike</color>...?
Array.indonesia: Bukankah itu...<color=#F1DC2B>Mike</color>...?

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Leatherback_Turtle01_Find01_001
Array.english: The giant leatherback turtle of the deep sea! \nWhat a wonderful sight! Let's take a picture to commemorate!
Array.indonesia: Penyu belimbing raksasa dari laut dalam! \nPemandangan yang luar biasa! Ayo kita foto untuk kenang-kenangan!

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Leatherback_Turtle01_Find01_002
Array.english: Ah, <color=#1DFEAF>Tsuchi</color> of the Sea People shouldn't be in the picture.\nI'll have to keep him out of the shot.
Array.indonesia: Ah, <color=#1DFEAF>Tsuchi</color> dari Suku Laut tidak boleh ada di foto.\nAku harus memastikan dia tidak masuk ke dalam bingkai.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Leatherback_Turtle01_Find02_001
Array.english: Hm…Something's not right…
Array.indonesia: Hm… Ada yang tidak beres…

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Leatherback_Turtle01_Find02_002
Array.english: Anyway, it's a wonderful sight to see a leatherback turtle in the deep sea!\nTime for a pic!
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun, pemandangan penyu belimbing di laut dalam sungguh menakjubkan!\nWaktunya foto!

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Leatherback_Turtle01_Find02_003
Array.english: Ah, <color=#1DFEAF>Tsuchi</color> of the sea people shouldn't be in the picture.\nI'll have to keep him out of the shot.
Array.indonesia: Ah, <color=#1DFEAF>Tsuchi</color> dari Suku Laut tidak seharusnya ada di foto ini.\nAku harus mengeluarkannya dari bingkai.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Leatherback_Turtle01_Retake_001
Array.english: <size=35>Ah, it's the <color=#F1DC2B><photozone=target/></color> again!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ah, itu <color=#F1DC2B><photozone=target/></color> lagi!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Leatherback_Turtle01_Retake_002
Array.english: What was its name again…
Array.indonesia: Apa namanya lagi ya…

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Leatherback_Turtle01_Retake_003
Array.english: The photo taken last time could have been better…\nTry again?
Array.indonesia: Foto yang diambil terakhir kali bisa lebih bagus…\nCoba lagi?

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Reward_Leatherback_Turtle01_001
Array.english: <size=34>Wow... A <color=#1DFEAF>leatherback turtle</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wah... Seekor <color=#1DFEAF>penyu belimbing</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Reward_Leatherback_Turtle01_002
Array.english: Did you know that its back is actual leather?
Array.indonesia: Tahukah kamu bahwa punggungnya benar-benar terbuat dari kulit?

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Reward_Leatherback_Turtle01_003
Array.english: That’s why it can’t hide its head inside its own shell.\nHow sad.
Array.indonesia: Itulah sebabnya ia tidak bisa menyembunyikan kepalanya di dalam cangkangnya sendiri.\nSayang sekali.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Opah_Find_001
Array.english: <size=34>Whoa! That’s… an <color=#1DFEAF>opah</color>…!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wah! Itu… seekor <color=#1DFEAF>opah</color>…!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Opah_Find_002
Array.english: I’ve never seen one in the deep water! \nPlease take its picture!
Array.indonesia: Aku belum pernah melihatnya di perairan dalam! \nTolong foto dia!

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Opah_Find_001_re
Array.english: <size=34>That's an…\n<color=#1DFEAF> Opah</color>…?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Itu…\n<color=#1DFEAF> Opah</color>…?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Opah_Find_002_re
Array.english: It looks like a sunfish….\nThis is the first time I've seen one in person.
Array.indonesia: Kelihatannya seperti ikan mola-mola….\nIni pertama kalinya aku melihatnya secara langsung.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Opah_Find_003_re
Array.english: Maybe I'll take a picture as a souvenir?
Array.indonesia: Mungkin aku akan memotretnya sebagai kenang-kenangan?

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Opah_Retake_001
Array.english: <size=35>Ah, it's the <color=#F1DC2B><photozone=target/></color> again!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ah, itu <color=#F1DC2B><photozone=target/></color> lagi!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Opah_Retake_002
Array.english: The photo taken last time could have been better…\nTry again?
Array.indonesia: Foto yang diambil terakhir kali bisa lebih bagus…\nCoba lagi?

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Reward_Opah_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh… an <color=#1DFEAF>opah</color>….</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh… seekor <color=#1DFEAF>opah</color>….</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Reward_Opah_002
Array.english: Did you know that the opah is warm-blooded?
Array.indonesia: Tahukah kamu bahwa opah itu berdarah panas?

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Reward_Opah_003
Array.english: Oh... I think I've heard that before.
Array.indonesia: Oh... sepertinya aku pernah dengar itu sebelumnya.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Reward_Opah_004
Array.english: Ha ha. It’s amazing that some fish species are warm-blooded.\nThe ocean is full of mysteries.
Array.indonesia: Ha ha. Sungguh menakjubkan bahwa ada spesies ikan yang berdarah panas.\nLautan ini penuh dengan misteri.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_RecordRoom_WallArt01_Retake_001
Array.english: The <color=#F1DC2B>Ancient Sea People Village Mural</color> that I captured at the request of Dr. Bacon….
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Mural Desa Penduduk Laut Kuno</color> yang aku abadikan atas permintaan Dr. Bacon….

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_RecordRoom_WallArt01_Retake_002
Array.english: he photo taken last time could have been better…\nTry again?
Array.indonesia: Foto yang diambil terakhir kali seharusnya bisa lebih bagus…\nCoba lagi?

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_UnderwaterLake_Retake_001
Array.english: The <color=#F1DC2B>Undersea Lake</color>!</size> is still mysterious as ever.
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Danau Bawah Laut</color>!</size> masih misterius seperti biasa.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_UnderwaterLake_Retake_002
Array.english: he photo taken last time could have been better…\nTry again?
Array.indonesia: Foto yang diambil terakhir kali bisa lebih bagus…\nCoba lagi?

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_General_Retake_001
Array.english: <size=35>Ah, it's the <color=#F1DC2B><photozone=target/></color> again!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ah, itu <color=#F1DC2B><photozone=target/></color> lagi!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_General_Retake_002
Array.english: The photo taken last time could have been better…\nTry again?
Array.indonesia: Foto yang diambil terakhir kali bisa lebih bagus…\nCoba lagi?

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Frost_Tutorial_001
Array.english: It’s cold here and the lens collected <color=#F1DC2B>frost</color>.
