Array.indonesia: Di sini dingin dan lensa tertutup <color=#F1DC2B>embun beku</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Frost_Tutorial_002
Array.english: I need to clean the lens first.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus membersihkan lensa dulu.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_SouthernRightWhaleDolphins_FirstEncounter01_001
Array.english: <size=33>A dolphin? In a place like this?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Lumba-lumba? Di tempat seperti ini?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_SouthernRightWhaleDolphins_FirstEncounter01_002
Array.english: It must be a <color=#1DFEAF>lissodelphis peronii</color>.
Array.indonesia: Pasti itu <color=#1DFEAF>lissodelphis peronii</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_SouthernRightWhaleDolphins_FirstEncounter01_003
Array.english: I heard they are pack animals, but that one is swimming alone.
Array.indonesia: Aku dengar mereka adalah hewan yang hidup berkelompok, tapi yang satu itu berenang sendirian.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_SouthernRightWhaleDolphins_FirstEncounter02_001
Array.english: <size=32>Ah, it disappeared behind the iceberg.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ah, dia menghilang di balik gunung es.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_SouthernRightWhaleDolphins_Find_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, there are more of them behind the iceberg!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, ada lebih banyak lagi di balik gunung es!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_SouthernRightWhaleDolphins_Find_002
Array.english: A school of dolphins is always a sight to see.
Array.indonesia: Kawanan lumba-lumba selalu menjadi pemandangan yang menakjubkan.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_SouthernRightWhaleDolphins_Find_003
Array.english: Maybe I should take a <color=#F1DC2B>picture</color> of them.
Array.indonesia: Mungkin aku harus <color=#F1DC2B>memotret</color> mereka.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Fail_SouthernRightWhaleDolphins_001
Array.english: Aw, they’re gone before I could take a picture.\nMaybe next time.
Array.indonesia: Aduh, mereka sudah pergi sebelum aku sempat memotret.\nMungkin lain kali.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Reward_SouthernRightWhaleDolphins_001
Array.english: <size=34>Wow! A <color=#1DFEAF>dolphin</color> found among the Glacial Area?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wow! Seekor <color=#1DFEAF>lumba-lumba</color> ditemukan di Kawasan Gletser?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Reward_SouthernRightWhaleDolphins_002
Array.english: Where have you been, Dave?\nThe Antarctic or something?
Array.indonesia: Kamu baru saja dari mana, Dave?\nAntartika atau semacamnya?

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Reward_SouthernRightWhaleDolphins_003
Array.english: I found it in the deep waters of the Blue Hole.
Array.indonesia: Aku menemukannya di perairan dalam Blue Hole.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Reward_SouthernRightWhaleDolphins_004
Array.english: That’s amazing.\nThis Blue Hole is like...
Array.indonesia: Luar biasa.\nBlue Hole ini seperti...

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Reward_SouthernRightWhaleDolphins_005
Array.english: <size=33>…a goldmine for our magazine.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>…tambang emas bagi majalah kita.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Reward_SouthernRightWhaleDolphins_006
Array.english: That was a joke.
Array.indonesia: Itu cuma bercanda.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Firefly_Squid_Find_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh! A glowing squid?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh! Cumi-cumi bercahaya?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Firefly_Squid_Find_002
Array.english: <size=32>Wow…\nI saw them in a documentary before. They look more fascinating in real life!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wah…\nAku pernah melihatnya di sebuah film dokumenter sebelumnya. Mereka terlihat lebih menakjubkan di kehidupan nyata!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Firefly_Squid_Find_003
Array.english: Maybe I should take a <color=#F1DC2B>picture</color>.
Array.indonesia: Mungkin aku harus mengambil <color=#F1DC2B>foto</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Reward_Firefly_Squid_001
Array.english: <size=34>This glowing thing is…\n<color=#1DFEAF>watasenia scintillans</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Makhluk bercahaya ini adalah…\n<color=#1DFEAF>watasenia scintillans</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Reward_Firefly_Squid_002
Array.english: It is harder to find that marvelous specimen in the sea than on land!\nYou are a lucky guy!
Array.indonesia: Lebih sulit menemukan spesimen menakjubkan itu di laut daripada di darat!\nKamu orang yang beruntung!

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Reward_Firefly_Squid_003
Array.english: I am sure that your great experience is a reward in itself,\nso may I skip the payment this week?
Array.indonesia: Aku yakin pengalaman hebatmu itu sudah menjadi hadiah tersendiri,\njadi bolehkah aku tidak membayar minggu ini?

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Reward_Firefly_Squid_004
Array.english: ...I’m joking, you know.
Array.indonesia: ...Aku bercanda, lho.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Arandaspis_Find_001
Array.english: <size=32>Huh? What are those tadpole-like creatures?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hah? Makhluk-makhluk yang mirip kecebong itu apa?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Arandaspis_Find_002
Array.english: Are they an ancient species as well?\nWhat a cute bunch!
Array.indonesia: Apakah mereka juga spesies purba?\nLucu sekali!

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Arandaspis_Find_003
Array.english: What a rare opportunity!\nI should take a <color=#F1DC2B>picture</color> of them while I can!
Array.indonesia: Kesempatan yang langka sekali!\nAku harus <color=#F1DC2B>memotret</color> mereka selagi bisa!

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Arandaspis_Reward_001
Array.english: <size=34>What are these tadpoles?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kecebong apa ini?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Arandaspis_Reward_002
Array.english: I think I have seen a picture of them in a book.\nHm...
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya aku pernah melihat fotonya di sebuah buku.\nHm...

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Arandaspis_Reward_003
Array.english: <size=33>I remember now! <color=#F1DC2B>Arandaspis</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Sekarang aku ingat! <color=#F1DC2B>Arandaspis</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Arandaspis_Reward_004
Array.english: How did you take this picture?\nWhere in the world could you take this kind of picture?...
Array.indonesia: Bagaimana kamu bisa mengambil foto ini?\nDi mana di dunia ini kamu bisa mengambil foto seperti ini?...

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Arandaspis_Reward_005
Array.english: Our readers may think that we’re using fake pictures.
Array.indonesia: Pembaca kita mungkin mengira kita menggunakan foto palsu.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Arandaspis_Reward_006
Array.english: <size=32>If so, it’s all on you, Dave!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Kalau begitu, itu semua salahmu, Dave!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Arandaspis_Reward_007
Array.english: <size=50>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Arandaspis_Reward_008
Array.english: I am just kidding, haha.
Array.indonesia: Aku cuma bercanda, haha.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Giant_Isopod_Find_001
Array.english: <size=33>Gee! That is a huge sow bug!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wah! Itu kumbang babi yang sangat besar!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Giant_Isopod_Find_002
Array.english: It must be the species called <color=#1DFEAF>bathynomus</color>.
Array.indonesia: Pasti spesies yang disebut <color=#1DFEAF>bathynomus</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Giant_Isopod_Find_003
Array.english: The scavenger of the deep sea.\nIt looks bigger than I thought.
Array.indonesia: Pemakan bangkai di laut dalam.\nTernyata lebih besar dari yang aku kira.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Giant_Isopod_Find_004
Array.english: This is a rare encounter...\nLet me take a <color=#F1DC2B>picture</color> of it.
Array.indonesia: Ini pertemuan yang langka...\nBiar aku ambil <color=#F1DC2B>foto</color>-nya.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Giant_Isopod_Reward_001
Array.english: <size=34>Yuck! It’s gross!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ih! Jijik!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Giant_Isopod_Reward_002
Array.english: A sow bug...\nI remember often seeing it in my backyard.
Array.indonesia: Kutu tanah...\nAku ingat sering melihatnya di halaman belakang rumahku.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Giant_Isopod_Reward_003
Array.english: <size=33>Did you take this picture at my place?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Apakah kamu mengambil foto ini di rumahku?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Giant_Isopod_Reward_004
Array.english: Oh, it’s underwater. I see it now.
Array.indonesia: Oh, ini di bawah air. Sekarang aku mengerti.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Giant_Isopod_Reward_005
Array.english: Yes, it is a <color=#1DFEAF>bathynomus</color>.\nI am sure of it.
Array.indonesia: Ya, itu adalah <color=#1DFEAF>bathynomus</color>.\nAku yakin itu.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Giant_Isopod_Reward_006
Array.english: It’s a fresh change from the usual pictures of fish.
Array.indonesia: Ini perubahan yang menyegarkan dari foto-foto ikan yang biasa.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Giant_Isopod_Reward_007
Array.english: Heh, I need to send it to the editor-in-chief right away.
Array.indonesia: Heh, aku harus segera mengirimkannya ke pemimpin redaksi.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_MermanWallPainting_001
Array.english: <size=34>Whoa...! These are the Sea People glacial passage murals...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wah...! Ini adalah lukisan dinding lorong glasial Suku Laut...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_MermanWallPainting_002
Array.english: Yeah. I think I captured everything there.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Kurasa aku sudah memotret semuanya di sana.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_MermanWallPainting_003
Array.english: Hmmm... This looks like the legend of when the Sea People discovered the Divine Tree.
Array.indonesia: Hmmm... Ini sepertinya legenda saat Suku Laut menemukan Pohon Suci.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_MermanWallPainting_004
Array.english: From the very beginning, the Sea People lived in colonies near the Divine Tree...
Array.indonesia: Sejak awal, Suku Laut tinggal di koloni-koloni dekat Pohon Suci...

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_MermanWallPainting_005
Array.english: <size=33>This...is...!\nThere must have been a huge earthquake and lava eruption in the deep in ancient times…!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>This...is...!\nPasti pernah terjadi gempa bumi besar dan letusan lava di kedalaman pada zaman purba…!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_MermanWallPainting_006
Array.english: Hm... It seems that this is when the Sea People suffered significant losses.
Array.indonesia: Hm... Sepertinya inilah saat Suku Laut mengalami kerugian yang sangat besar.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_MermanWallPainting_007
Array.english: The one in this mural looks like<color=#F1DC2B>King Long</color> ….\nI read that mutated Sea People were imprisoned by him.…This must be that scene.
Array.indonesia: Sosok dalam lukisan dinding ini mirip dengan <color=#F1DC2B>Raja Long</color> ….\nAku membaca bahwa Suku Laut yang bermutasi dipenjara olehnya… Ini pasti adegan tersebut.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_MermanWallPainting_008
Array.english: So there was a reason for why the Sea People were sensitive to earthquakes and rising temperatures.
Array.indonesia: Jadi, ada alasan mengapa Suku Laut sangat sensitif terhadap gempa bumi dan kenaikan suhu.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_MermanWallPainting_009
Array.english: So we can't rule out the possibility of a catastrophe happening at that time too.
Array.indonesia: Jadi, kita tidak bisa mengesampingkan kemungkinan terjadinya bencana pada saat itu juga.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_MermanWallPainting_010
Array.english: You are going to have to explore the glacial area to check on its current status.
Array.indonesia: Kamu harus menjelajahi kawasan gletser untuk memeriksa kondisinya saat ini.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_MermanWallPainting_011
Array.english: <size=34>Good Luck, Dave!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Semoga berhasil, Dave!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_LionsManeJelly_Find_001
Array.english: <size=35>Whoa…A huge jellyfish…!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wah… Ubur-ubur raksasa…!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_LionsManeJelly_Find_002
Array.english: What was its name?…Lion mane…\nor something?
Array.indonesia: Apa namanya?…Lion mane…\natau semacam itu?

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_LionsManeJelly_Find_003
Array.english: Anyway, it's a giant jellyfish in the Glacial Area.…! \nIt must make a nice photo.
Array.indonesia: Pokoknya, itu ubur-ubur raksasa di Kawasan Gletser.…! \nPasti jadi foto yang bagus.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_LionsManeJelly_Find_004
Array.english: <size=34>Let's take a pic.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ayo kita foto.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_LIons_Mane_Jellyfish_success01_001
Array.english: Nice! That was a good shot!
Array.indonesia: Keren! Itu foto yang bagus!

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_LIons_Mane_Jellyfish_success02_001
Array.english: Whooa boy….\nYou scared me!
Array.indonesia: Wah, astaga….\nKamu bikin aku kaget!

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_LIons_Mane_Jellyfish_success02_002
Array.english: Even in such a cold place, there is still something for such a big creature to eat.
Array.indonesia: Bahkan di tempat sedingin ini, masih ada makanan untuk makhluk sebesar itu.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_LIons_Mane_Jellyfish_success02_003
Array.english: The deep sea really is a mysterious place.
Array.indonesia: Laut dalam memang tempat yang misterius.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_LionsManeJelly_Reward_001
Array.english: <size=33>Wow! A giant jellyfish…!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wah! Ubur-ubur raksasa…!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_LionsManeJelly_Reward_002
Array.english: The tentacles look like a lion's mane...
Array.indonesia: Tentakelnya terlihat seperti surai singa...

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_LionsManeJelly_Reward_003
Array.english: <size=34>Did you hear something growling?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kamu dengar suara geraman?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_LionsManeJelly_Reward_004
Array.english: …Haha! Just kidding!\nYou can't hear anything underwater.
Array.indonesia: …Haha! Cuma bercanda!\nKamu nggak bisa dengar apa-apa di bawah air.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Red_Lipped_Batfish_Find_001
Array.english: Hmm? I think...I saw some kind of strange creature...
Array.indonesia: Hmm? Kayaknya... aku lihat makhluk aneh...

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Red_Lipped_Batfish_Find_002
Array.english: Should I check with the camera?
Array.indonesia: Haruskah aku memeriksanya dengan kamera?

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Red_Lipped_Batfish_Success_001
Array.english: It's a fish that has red lips...That's really unique.
Array.indonesia: Itu ikan yang bibirnya merah... Benar-benar unik.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Red_Lipped_Batfish_Success_002
Array.english: Udo is gonna like this.\nLet's go up and show it to him.
Array.indonesia: Udo pasti akan suka ini.\nAyo kita naik ke atas dan tunjukkan padanya.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Red_Lipped_Batfish_Reward_001
Array.english: <size=34>Ehh?! What kind of fish is this?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ehh?! Ikan apa ini?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Red_Lipped_Batfish_Reward_002
Array.english: Did you paint the lips on?
Array.indonesia: Apa kamu melukis bibirnya?

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Red_Lipped_Batfish_Reward_003
Array.english: <size=34>...to get more money?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>...topa mau dapat uang lebih?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Red_Lipped_Batfish_Reward_004
Array.english: ...haha. Just kidding.\nActually, I've heard of this kind of fish.
Array.indonesia: ...haha. Cuma bercanda.\nSebenarnya, aku pernah dengar tentang ikan jenis ini.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Red_Lipped_Batfish_Reward_005
Array.english: <size=50>….</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>….</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Coelacanth_Find_001
Array.english: Oh? I think the pile of rocks over there just moved...
Array.indonesia: Oh? Kayaknya tumpukan batu di sana baru saja bergerak...

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Coelacanth_Find_002
Array.english: Should I check with the camera?
Array.indonesia: Haruskah aku periksa pakai kamera?

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Coelacanth_Success_001
Array.english: Wow…\nIsn't that a <color=#1DFEAF>coelacanth</color>, what they call a living fossil?
Array.indonesia: Wow…\nBukankah itu <color=#1DFEAF>coelacanth</color>, yang disebut fosil hidup?

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Coelacanth_Success_002
Array.english: I can't believe it still exists in its ancient form like this.
Array.indonesia: Aku nggak percaya dia masih ada dalam bentuk purba seperti ini.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Coelacanth_Success_003
Array.english: Udo will really like this.
Array.indonesia: Udo pasti akan sangat menyukai ini.

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Coelacanth_Reward_001
Array.english: <size=34>A co.. coelacanth!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Seekor co… coelacanth!?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Coelacanth_Reward_002
Array.english: A living fossil, that barely changed from the paleozoic era...
Array.indonesia: Fosil hidup, yang hampir tidak berubah sejak era Paleozoikum...

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Coelacanth_Reward_003
Array.english: But, no one in the Paleozoic era actually saw it in person.\nSo how can we be sure it's the same?
Array.indonesia: Tapi, tidak ada seorang pun di era Paleozoikum yang benar-benar melihatnya secara langsung.\nJadi, bagaimana kita bisa yakin bahwa ini sama?

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Coelacanth_Reward_004
Array.english: Maybe this is what you call an Inconvenient Truth?…?
Array.indonesia: Mungkin inilah yang kamu sebut sebagai Kebenaran yang Tidak Nyaman?…?

Array.name: dialogue_PhotoZone_Coelacanth_Reward_005
Array.english: This picture is going to make waves!
Array.indonesia: Foto ini pasti akan menjadi perbincangan!

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_01_Start_001
Array.english: <size=40>Wait! Can I have a moment with you?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Tunggu! Bolehkah saya bicara sebentar dengan Anda?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_01_Start_002
Array.english: Oh…You are that reporter from before.\nDo you need help with something?
Array.indonesia: Oh… Anda adalah wartawan yang tadi.\nApakah Anda membutuhkan bantuan?

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_01_Start_003
Array.english: Thanks to your help, my boss\nentrusted me with a new project!
Array.indonesia: Berkat bantuan Anda, bos saya\nmenugaskan saya proyek baru!

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_01_Start_003_2
Array.english: <size=36>I am sure a promotion will be in order!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Aku yakin kamu akan segera dipromosikan!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_01_Start_003_3
Array.english: Well, anyways.
Array.indonesia: Yah, bagaimanapun juga.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_01_Start_004
Array.english: Tell me, sir, have you seen extremely novel fish inside \nthis <color=#90CDFF>Giant Blue Hole</color>?
Array.indonesia: Katakan padaku, Pak, apakah kamu pernah melihat ikan yang sangat unik di dalam \nGiant Blue Hole<color=#90CDFF> ini?</color>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_01_Start_005
Array.english: Um... There are fish from many different locales in there...\nWhat do you mean by novel?
Array.indonesia: Um... Di sana ada ikan dari berbagai daerah...\nApa yang Anda maksud dengan 'unik'?

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_01_Start_006
Array.english: I mean very peculiar fish,\nthe sort no one has ever discovered before!
Array.indonesia: Maksud saya ikan yang sangat aneh,\njenis yang belum pernah ditemukan oleh siapa pun sebelumnya!

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_01_Start_007
Array.english: Our magazine has a secret weapon: The Fish Radar!\nAnd it tells us that this Blue Hole is a treasure trove of undiscovered species!
Array.indonesia: Majalah kami memiliki senjata rahasia: Radar Ikan!\nDan radar itu memberitahu kami bahwa Blue Hole ini adalah gudang harta karun spesies yang belum ditemukan!

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_01_Start_008
Array.english: We <color=#5dd3bb>Weekly Fish</color> are planning a series of specials over \nthe next few months to showcase these precious new fish.
Array.indonesia: Kami di <color=#5dd3bb>Weekly Fish</color> berencana menyelenggarakan serangkaian acara spesial selama \nbeberapa bulan ke depan untuk memperkenalkan ikan-ikan baru yang langka ini.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_01_Start_009
Array.english: <size=40>It’s called the <color=#F1DC2B>Catch Them All Project</color>!</color>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Proyek ini dinamakan <color=#F1DC2B>Catch Them All Project</color>!</color>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_01_Start_010
Array.english: We can research the fish during the week\nand if you can catch specimens for us on the weekends…
Array.indonesia: Kami bisa meneliti ikan-ikan tersebut selama hari kerja\ndan jika kamu bisa menangkap spesimen untuk kami di akhir pekan…

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_01_Start_011
Array.english: They’ll be featured in the specials that we’ll be publishing \nin the <color=#5dd3bb>Weekly Fish</color> every Monday! Yes, Monday!
Array.indonesia: Spesimen-spesimen itu akan ditampilkan dalam edisi khusus yang akan kami terbitkan \ndi <color=#5dd3bb>Weekly Fish</color> setiap hari Senin! Ya, hari Senin!

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_01_Start_012
Array.english: Me... catch them?
Array.indonesia: Aku... menangkapnya?

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_01_Start_013
Array.english: Well, you are kind of the only diver in these parts, aren’t you?
Array.indonesia: Yah, kamu kan satu-satunya penyelam di daerah ini, bukan?

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_01_Start_014
Array.english: I’m not really following your logic...
Array.indonesia: Aku agak bingung dengan logikamu...

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_01_Start_015
Array.english: In any case! As we have to have the issues ready by Monday,\nyou’ll have to catch the specimens by <color=#F39321>Sunday evening</color> at the latest.
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun juga! Karena kami harus menyiapkan terbitan tersebut paling lambat hari Senin,\nkamu harus menangkap spesimen-spesimen itu paling lambat <color=#F39321>Minggu malam</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_01_Start_016
Array.english: But that’s tomorrow, isn’t it? \nThis... this is just too sudd—
Array.indonesia: Tapi itu besok, kan? \nIni... ini terlalu mendadak—

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_01_Start_017
Array.english: Now then, let’s get down to business.\nThe fish we spotted with our Radar this week was...
Array.indonesia: Baiklah, mari kita langsung ke intinya.\nIkan yang kita temukan dengan Radar kita minggu ini adalah...

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_01_Start_018
Array.english: <size=46>The <color=#F1DC2B>Humphead Parrotfish</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=46><color=#F1DC2B>Ikan Kakatua Berpunuk</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_01_Start_019
Array.english: Hmm. A horned parrotfish...\nI’ve never seen anything like it!
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Ikan kakatua bertanduk...\nAku belum pernah melihat yang seperti ini sebelumnya!

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_01_Start_020
Array.english: The location is close to the <color=#1DFEAF>Boat Wreck</color>...
Array.indonesia: Lokasinya dekat dengan <color=#1DFEAF>Bangkai Kapal</color>...

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_01_Start_021
Array.english: That’s what I can detect!\nOh, and...
Array.indonesia: Itulah yang bisa aku deteksi!\nOh, dan...

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_01_Start_022
Array.english: I’ll give you this <color=#1DFEAF>Fish Tracker</color>.\nIf there’s a FishMon you need to catch nearby, it’ll vibrate and play a sound.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan memberimu <color=#1DFEAF>Pelacak Ikan</color> ini.\nJika ada FishMon yang perlu kamu tangkap di dekat sini, alat ini akan bergetar dan mengeluarkan bunyi.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_01_Start_023
Array.english: <size=37>Oh!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Oh!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_01_Start_024
Array.english: Don’t be surprised. Guess what this device can do!
Array.indonesia: Jangan kaget. Coba tebak apa yang bisa dilakukan perangkat ini!

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_01_Start_025
Array.english: <size=36>It allows you to see all the information about fish even while diving in the water!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Perangkat ini memungkinkanmu melihat semua informasi tentang ikan bahkan saat sedang menyelam di dalam air!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_01_Start_026
Array.english: You can see your best grade fish, how many fish you have in your restaurant and fish farm, and more.
Array.indonesia: Kamu bisa melihat ikan dengan kualitas terbaikmu, berapa banyak ikan yang kamu miliki di restoran dan tambak ikanmu, dan masih banyak lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_01_Start_027
Array.english: Is that right? But how is that possible when I didn’t link my device yet?
Array.indonesia: Benarkah itu? Tapi bagaimana mungkin, padahal saya belum menghubungkan perangkat saya?

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_01_Start_027_2
Array.english: <size=42>….</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>….</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_01_Start_028
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>Oh, you are a bit clueless, aren’t you?...</color>\nBy the way…
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Oh, kamu agak ketinggalan informasi, ya?...</color>\nNgomong-ngomong…

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_01_Start_029
Array.english: <size=32>Good luck, then!\nThat’s till Sunday... or <color=#F39321>tomorrow evening</color>, to be precise!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Semoga berhasil, ya!\nItu sampai hari Minggu... atau <color=#F39321>besok malam</color>, tepatnya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_01_Start_030
Array.english: Um... This is sudden... Work for a magazine?
Array.indonesia: Um... Ini mendadak sekali... Bekerja untuk majalah?

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_01_Start_031
Array.english: Come to think of it, I think I’ve seen the <color=#1DFEAF>Boat Wreck</color> in passing...
Array.indonesia: Kalau dipikir-pikir, sepertinya aku pernah melihat <color=#1DFEAF>Boat Wreck</color> sekilas...

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_01_Restart_001
Array.english: The fish we spotted with our Radar this week is...
Array.indonesia: Ikan yang kami temukan dengan Radar kami minggu ini adalah. ..

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_01_Restart_002
Array.english: <size=36>the <color=#F1DC2B>Humphead Parrotfish</color>, the same as last week!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36><color=#F1DC2B>Ikan Kakatua Kepala Bengkak</color>, sama seperti minggu lalu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_01_Restart_003
Array.english: The analysis suggests that...\nthe thick head is almost impervious to any attacks.
Array.indonesia: Analisis menunjukkan bahwa...\nkepalanya yang tebal hampir kebal terhadap serangan apa pun.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_01_Restart_004
Array.english: <size=36>Do you want to try again?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Mau coba lagi?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Wizard_Barrel_Jellyfish_start_001
Array.english: Hmm... The <color=#F1DC2B>FishMon</color> this week, as detected by the Radar, is...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... <color=#F1DC2B>FishMon</color> minggu ini, seperti yang terdeteksi oleh Radar, adalah...

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Wizard_Barrel_Jellyfish_start_002
Array.english: What is this?\nA jellyfish with some kind of <color=#F1DC2B>wizard hat</color>?
Array.indonesia: Apa ini?\nUbur-ubur dengan semacam <color=#F1DC2B>topi penyihir</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Wizard_Barrel_Jellyfish_start_003
Array.english: That can’t be a real jellyfish!
Array.indonesia: Itu tidak mungkin ubur-ubur sungguhan!

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Wizard_Barrel_Jellyfish_start_004
Array.english: <size=38>Goodness! Do you doubt the accuracy of our <color=#1DFEAF>Fish Radar</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Astaga! Apa kamu meragukan keakuratan <color=#1DFEAF>Radar Ikan</color> kami?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Wizard_Barrel_Jellyfish_start_005
Array.english: It was a very difficult task detecting this jellyfish with our radar.\nThe reason was...
Array.indonesia: Sangat sulit mendeteksi ubur-ubur ini dengan radar kami.\nAlasannya adalah...

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Wizard_Barrel_Jellyfish_start_006
Array.english: <size=37>This jellyfish teleports around at incredible speeds!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Ubur-ubur ini berpindah-pindah dengan kecepatan luar biasa!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Wizard_Barrel_Jellyfish_start_007
Array.english: It’ll disappear as soon as you go near...\nYou probably won’t be able to catch it unless you have something like a <color=#F1DC2B>Sniper Rifle</color>.
Array.indonesia: Ia akan menghilang begitu kamu mendekat...\nKamu mungkin tidak akan bisa menangkapnya kecuali kamu memiliki sesuatu seperti <color=#F1DC2B>Senapan Penembak Jitu</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Wizard_Barrel_Jellyfish_start_008
Array.english: About <color=#1DFEAF>100 m</color> underwater...\nNear the yellow shipwreck...
Array.indonesia: Sekitar <color=#1DFEAF>100 m</color> di bawah air...\nDi dekat bangkai kapal kuning...

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Wizard_Barrel_Jellyfish_start_009
Array.english: That’s what my information says, ahem.
Array.indonesia: Itulah yang tertulis dalam informasiku, ahem.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Wizard_Barrel_Jellyfish_start_010
Array.english: <size=38>Now then! Keep up the good work this week!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Nah, sekarang! Teruslah bekerja dengan baik minggu ini!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Wizard_Barrel_Jellyfish_start_011
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>Um... A jellyfish that teleports...\nThat is kind of interesting, I suppose.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Um... Ubur-ubur yang bisa berteleportasi...\nItu cukup menarik, kurasa.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Wizard_Barrel_Jellyfish_Restart_001
Array.english: The fish we spotted with our Radar this week is...
Array.indonesia: Ikan yang kami temukan dengan Radar kami minggu ini adalah...

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Wizard_Barrel_Jellyfish_Restart_002
Array.english: <size=36>the <color=#F1DC2B>Wizard Barrel Jellyfish</color>, the same as last week!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36><color=#F1DC2B>Ubur-ubur Barrel Penyihir</color>, sama seperti minggu lalu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Wizard_Barrel_Jellyfish_Restart_003
Array.english: About <color=#1DFEAF>100 meters</color> underwater...\nNear the yellow shipwreck...
Array.indonesia: Sekitar <color=#1DFEAF>100 meter</color> di bawah air...\nDi dekat bangkai kapal kuning...

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Wizard_Barrel_Jellyfish_Restart_004
Array.english: My advice is to bring a <color=#F1DC2B>Sniper Rifle</color>\nbecause it can teleport.
Array.indonesia: Saran saya, bawalah <color=#F1DC2B>Senapan Penembak Jitu</color>\nkarena makhluk itu bisa berteleportasi.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Wizard_Barrel_Jellyfish_Restart_005
Array.english: <size=36>Do you want to try again?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Mau mencoba lagi?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Ghost_Squid_start_001
Array.english: <size=38>A lovely weekend, Dave!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Selamat menikmati akhir pekan, Dave!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Ghost_Squid_start_002
Array.english: Yes. Seems you’re always working hard, Udo.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Sepertinya kamu selalu bekerja keras, Udo.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Ghost_Squid_start_003
Array.english: Hahaha! A reporter must keep his eyes and ears\nopen at all times!
Array.indonesia: Hahaha! Seorang reporter harus selalu\nwaspada!

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Ghost_Squid_start_004
Array.english: Okay. So did you detect another fish this week?
Array.indonesia: Oke. Jadi, apakah kamu mendeteksi ikan lain minggu ini?

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Ghost_Squid_start_005
Array.english: Of course, hehe.\nThis week we detected...
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja, hehe.\nMinggu ini kami mendeteksi...

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Ghost_Squid_start_006
Array.english: Huh? It’s transparent... Hard to see.\nAlmost like a ghost.
Array.indonesia: Hah? Transparan... Sulit dilihat.\nHampir seperti hantu.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Ghost_Squid_start_007
Array.english: Um... If it’s this transparent...\nI have a feeling bullets might just pass through.
Array.indonesia: Um... Kalau se-transparan ini...\nAku merasa peluru mungkin bisa menembusnya begitu saja.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Ghost_Squid_start_008
Array.english: In the movies I watched a long ago when I was young...
Array.indonesia: Di film-film yang aku tonton dulu saat masih kecil...

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Ghost_Squid_start_009
Array.english: Ghosts stopped moving when they were exposed to <color=#1DFEAF>Special Light</color>.
Array.indonesia: Hantu-hantu berhenti bergerak saat terkena <color=#1DFEAF>Cahaya Khusus</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Ghost_Squid_start_010
Array.english: But I am not sure if it will really work, because I have seen a ghost only once…\r…that was when I went into a mountain after I got fired from my previous job at a magazine publisher.
Array.indonesia: Tapi aku tidak yakin apakah itu benar-benar akan berhasil, karena aku hanya pernah melihat hantu sekali…\r…itu terjadi saat aku pergi ke gunung setelah dipecat dari pekerjaan sebelumnya di penerbit majalah.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Ghost_Squid_start_011
Array.english: <size=38>Oh, I'm rambling again aren't I?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Oh, aku ngelantur lagi, ya?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Ghost_Squid_start_012
Array.english: Anyways…the depth seems to be around <color=#1DFEAF>220m</color>.
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun… kedalamannya sepertinya sekitar <color=#1DFEAF>220 m</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Ghost_Squid_start_013
Array.english: If you find one of those squids, try flashing <color=#1DFEAF>Special Light</color> on it.
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu menemukan salah satu cumi-cumi itu, coba sorot dengan <color=#1DFEAF>Lampu Khusus</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Ghost_Squid_start_014
Array.english: Here’s to another fruitful week, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Semoga minggu ini juga berbuah hasil, Dave.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Ghost_Squid_start_015
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>A transparent Ghost Squid that can only be seen with <color=#1DFEAF>Special Light</color>…\nKind of creepy, yet quite fascinating.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Cumi Hantu transparan yang hanya bisa dilihat dengan <color=#1DFEAF>Lampu Khusus</color>…\nAgak menyeramkan, tapi cukup menarik.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Ghost_Squid_Restart_001
Array.english: The fish we spotted with our Radar this week is...
Array.indonesia: Ikan yang kami temukan dengan Radar kami minggu ini adalah...

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Ghost_Squid_Restart_002
Array.english: <size=36>the <color=#F1DC2B>Transparent Ghost Squid</color>, the same as last week!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36><color=#F1DC2B>Cumi-cumi Hantu Transparan</color>, sama seperti minggu lalu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Ghost_Squid_Restart_003
Array.english: It’s swimming at a depth of <color=#1DFEAF>220 meters</color>.
Array.indonesia: Ia berenang pada kedalaman <color=#1DFEAF>220 meter</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Ghost_Squid_Restart_004
Array.english: Like in the movies, you need\n<color=#1DFEAF>Special Light</color> to catch one of those squids.
Array.indonesia: Seperti di film-film, kamu butuh\n<color=#1DFEAF>Cahaya Khusus</color> untuk menangkap salah satu cumi-cumi itu.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Ghost_Squid_Restart_005
Array.english: Look for anything useful around you.
Array.indonesia: Carilah benda apa pun yang berguna di sekitarmu.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Ghost_Squid_Restart_006
Array.english: <size=36>Do you want to try again then?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Mau coba lagi?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Titanium_Triggerfish_start_001
Array.english: <size=38>A refreshing Saturday it is, Dave!</color>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Hari Sabtu yang menyegarkan, Dave!</color>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Titanium_Triggerfish_start_002
Array.english: Yes. It’s already the weekend.\nAre you working on the weekend again?
Array.indonesia: Ya. Sudah akhir pekan.\nKamu kerja lagi di akhir pekan?

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Titanium_Triggerfish_start_003
Array.english: Haha! Working when others are resting\nis the only way to get ahead, don’t you agree?
Array.indonesia: Haha! Bekerja saat orang lain sedang beristirahat\nadalah satu-satunya cara untuk maju, setuju kan?

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Titanium_Triggerfish_start_004
Array.english: In any case...\nFrom what I saw on the Radar...
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun juga...\nDari yang kulihat di Radar...

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Titanium_Triggerfish_start_005
Array.english: At around <color=#1DFEAF>50m</color> deep...\nWhere the light starts to grow dim...
Array.indonesia: Di kedalaman sekitar <color=#1DFEAF>50 m</color>...\nDi tempat cahaya mulai meredup...

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Titanium_Triggerfish_start_006
Array.english: There’s another FishMon to add to our collection!\nWe nearly mistook it for a rock or some kind of mineral!
Array.indonesia: Ada FishMon lain yang bisa ditambahkan ke koleksi kita!\nKita hampir mengira itu batu atau semacam mineral!

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Titanium_Triggerfish_start_007
Array.english: <size=36>The silverly Titan Triggerfish!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Ikan Titan Triggerfish yang berkilau perak!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Titanium_Triggerfish_start_008
Array.english: <size=36>The point is, its scales are not just silvery-looking but actually made of silver!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Intinya, sisiknya tidak hanya terlihat perak, tetapi benar-benar terbuat dari perak!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Titanium_Triggerfish_start_009
Array.english: Is that even possible?\nIs it bulletproof then?
Array.indonesia: Apakah itu mungkin?\nApakah itu berarti tahan peluru?

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Titanium_Triggerfish_start_010
Array.english: I bet it is.
Array.indonesia: Aku yakin begitu.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Titanium_Triggerfish_start_011
Array.english: Use science.\nSilver is a good conductor of electricity.
Array.indonesia: Gunakan ilmu pengetahuan.\nPerak adalah konduktor listrik yang baik.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Titanium_Triggerfish_start_012
Array.english: I think one can inflict damage\nusing a <color=#1DFEAF>weapon that can discharge electricity</color>.
Array.indonesia: Menurutku, kita bisa menimbulkan kerusakan\ndengan menggunakan <color=#1DFEAF>senjata yang bisa melepaskan listrik</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Titanium_Triggerfish_start_013
Array.english: It looks quite heavy, so you’ll have to watch your weight capacity, too.
Array.indonesia: Ikan itu terlihat cukup berat, jadi kamu juga harus memperhatikan kapasitas bebanmu.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Titanium_Triggerfish_start_014
Array.english: Keep up the good work, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Teruslah bekerja dengan baik, Dave.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Titanium_Triggerfish_start_015
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>Hm, a <color=#F1DC2B>weapon that can discharge electricity</color>...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Hm, <color=#F1DC2B>senjata yang bisa melepaskan arus listrik</color>...</color>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Titanium_Triggerfish_Restart_001
Array.english: The fish we spotted with our Radar this week is...
Array.indonesia: Ikan yang kami temukan dengan Radar minggu ini adalah...

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Titanium_Triggerfish_Restart_002
Array.english: <size=36>the <color=#F1DC2B>Silver Titan Triggerfish</color>, the same as last week!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36><color=#F1DC2B>Silver Titan Triggerfish</color>, sama seperti minggu lalu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Titanium_Triggerfish_Restart_003
Array.english: This fish...\nis almost invulnerable to conventional weapons.
Array.indonesia: Ikan ini...\nhampir kebal terhadap senjata konvensional.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Titanium_Triggerfish_Restart_004
Array.english: You may want to bring a weapon that can <color=#F1DC2B>electrocute</color> it.
Array.indonesia: Sebaiknya kamu membawa senjata yang bisa <color=#F1DC2B>menyetrum</color> ikan itu.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Titanium_Triggerfish_Restart_005
Array.english: It swims at a depth of <color=#1DFEAF>50 meters</color>...\nThat’s where the sunlight starts to grow dim.
Array.indonesia: Ikan itu berenang di kedalaman <color=#1DFEAF>50 meter</color>...\nDi situlah cahaya matahari mulai meredup.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Titanium_Triggerfish_Restart_006
Array.english: <size=36>Do you want to try again?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Mau mencoba lagi?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Warrior_Green_Humphead_Parrotfish_Success_001
Array.english: <size=38>Ooh! You brought the new FishMon for our collection!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Wah! Kamu membawa FishMon baru untuk koleksi kita!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Warrior_Green_Humphead_Parrotfish_Success_002
Array.english: Hmm... A parrotfish...\nWith a helm and horns...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Ikan kakatua...\nDengan helm dan tanduk...

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Warrior_Green_Humphead_Parrotfish_Success_003
Array.english: <size=38>The readership will go crazy over this!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Para pembaca pasti akan tergila-gila dengan ini!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Warrior_Green_Humphead_Parrotfish_Success_004
Array.english: I’m excited to see how many of the upcoming issues will sell\nwhen it’s published <color=#F39321>Monday morning</color>.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak sabar ingin tahu berapa banyak edisi mendatang yang akan terjual\nsaat diterbitkan <color=#F39321>Senin pagi</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Warrior_Green_Humphead_Parrotfish_Success_005
Array.english: When the issue’s out,\nwe’ll bring you a fee for your work!
Array.indonesia: Saat edisi itu terbit,\nkami akan memberikan bayaran untuk pekerjaanmu!

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Warrior_Green_Humphead_Parrotfish_Success_006
Array.english: Please keep up the good work!
Array.indonesia: Teruslah berkarya!

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Warrior_Green_Humphead_Parrotfish_Success_007
Array.english: <size=38>Um... Well, if there’s a fee I’m getting for this...\nThis might be a serviceable weekend side hustle.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Um... Nah, kalau ada bayaran yang akan saya terima untuk ini...\nIni mungkin bisa jadi pekerjaan sampingan yang lumayan untuk akhir pekan.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Wizard_Barrel_Jellyfish_success_001
Array.english: <size=38>Ooh! You brought the new FishMon for our collection!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Wah! Kamu membawa FishMon baru untuk koleksi kita!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Wizard_Barrel_Jellyfish_success_002
Array.english: Hmm... To think a jellyfish that looks like it’s wearing a wizard hat actually exists...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Siapa sangka ubur-ubur yang terlihat seperti memakai topi penyihir benar-benar ada...

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Wizard_Barrel_Jellyfish_success_003
Array.english: <size=38>Surprise!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Kejutan!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Wizard_Barrel_Jellyfish_success_004
Array.english: Now then, we’ll send you your fee when the issue is out on <color=#F39321>Monday morning</color>. Please keep this up!
Array.indonesia: Nah, kami akan mengirimkan bayaranmu saat terbitan ini dirilis pada <color=#F39321>Senin pagi</color>. Teruslah berkarya seperti ini!

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Ghost_Squid_success_001
Array.english: Did you bring something back for the collection?\nI don’t see anything...
Array.indonesia: Apakah kamu membawa sesuatu untuk koleksi?\nAku tidak melihat apa-apa...

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Ghost_Squid_success_002
Array.english: <size=38>Oh! It’s really like some kind of ghost, this squid!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Oh! Cumi-cumi ini benar-benar seperti hantu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Ghost_Squid_success_003
Array.english: Oh! You shouldn’t touch it.\nIt’s extremely poisonous.
Array.indonesia: Oh! Jangan sentuh itu.\nItu sangat beracun.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Ghost_Squid_success_004
Array.english: Whoops! Nearly doomed this week’s article...
Array.indonesia: Ups! Hampir saja merusak artikel minggu ini. ..

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Ghost_Squid_success_005
Array.english: Anyhow, thank you!\nWe’ll send you your fee when the issue’s out on <color=#F39321>Monday morning</color>!
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun, terima kasih!\nKami akan mengirimkan bayaranmu saat terbitan ini dirilis pada <color=#F39321>Senin pagi</color>!

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Titanium_Triggerfish_success_001
Array.english: <size=36>Ehe! This FishMon looks hard as nails!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Ehe! FishMon ini kelihatannya sangat tangguh!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Titanium_Triggerfish_success_002
Array.english: <size=36>I doubt even my iron fist could do anything against this one.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Aku ragu bahkan tinju besarku pun bisa berbuat apa-apa melawan yang satu ini.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Titanium_Triggerfish_success_003
Array.english: <size=40>I’m kidding...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Aku bercanda...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Titanium_Triggerfish_success_004
Array.english: Anyhow, thank you!\nWe’ll send you your fee when the issue’s out on <color=#F39321>Monday morning</color>!
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun, terima kasih!\nKami akan mengirimkan bayaranmu saat terbitan ini dirilis pada <color=#F39321>Senin pagi</color>!

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Electric_Eel_Start_01
Array.english: <size=35>A lovely weekend, Dave!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Selamat menikmati akhir pekan, Dave!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Electric_Eel_Start_02
Array.english: You don’t look well today.
Array.indonesia: Kamu terlihat kurang sehat hari ini.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Electric_Eel_Start_03
Array.english: Well... Dave, I didn’t want to keep asking for a favor...\nBut I’m trying to get my rookie diving license...
Array.indonesia: Nah... Dave, aku nggak mau terus-terusan minta tolong...\nTapi aku lagi berusaha dapetin lisensi menyelam pemula...

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Electric_Eel_Start_04
Array.english: <size=33>I touched a <color=#F1DC2B>striped electric eel</color>, and then!\nMy body was all paralyzed….</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku menyentuh seekor <color=#F1DC2B>belut listrik bergaris</color>, dan kemudian!\nSeluruh tubuhku jadi lumpuh….</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Electric_Eel_Start_05
Array.english: <size=35>Striped electric eel...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Belut listrik bergaris...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Electric_Eel_Start_06
Array.english: Yes. The weather was nice, so I went into the ocean,\nand I saw a curious moray eel...
Array.indonesia: Ya. Cuacanya bagus, jadi aku masuk ke laut,\ndan aku melihat seekor belut moray yang penasaran...

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Electric_Eel_Start_07
Array.english: <size=33>You’re a beginner. Why did you dive in the middle of the night...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kamu masih pemula. Kenapa kamu menyelam di tengah malam...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Electric_Eel_Start_08
Array.english: Anyhow, the moray eel was really eccentric and all...\nWill you capture it for me?
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun, belut moray itu benar-benar aneh dan segala macam...\nMaukah kamu menangkapnya untukku?

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Electric_Eel_Start_09
Array.english: I think it shows up in the <color=#1DFEAF>night</color>...\nAnd I saw it around <color=#1DFEAF>30 m</color> below the surface.
Array.indonesia: Kurasa dia muncul di <color=#1DFEAF>malam</color>...\nDan aku melihatnya sekitar <color=#1DFEAF>30 m</color> di bawah permukaan.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Electric_Eel_Start_10
Array.english: <size=35>Hmm…<color=#F1DC2B>Striped electric eel,</color> is it….</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Hmm…<color=#F1DC2B>Belut listrik bergaris,</color> ya...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Electric_Eel_Success_01
Array.english: <size=35>Whoa… Yes, this is it…!\nA <color=#F1DC2B>striped moray eel</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wah… Ya, ini dia…!\nSeekor <color=#F1DC2B>belut moray bergaris</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Electric_Eel_Success_02
Array.english: It stung really bad...\nMy left arm still aches. It’s hard for me to write.
Array.indonesia: Sengatannya sangat sakit...\nLengan kiriku masih terasa nyeri. Aku sulit menulis.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Electric_Eel_Success_03
Array.english: Oh, wait, I’m right-handed. Ha ha ha!
Array.indonesia: Oh, tunggu, aku kidal. Ha ha ha!

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Electric_Eel_Success_04
Array.english: <size=50>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Electric_Eel_Success_05
Array.english: Anyhow, thank you!\nWe’ll send you your fee when the issue’s out on <color=#F39321>Monday morning</color>!
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun, terima kasih!\nKami akan mengirimkan bayaranmu saat terbitan ini dirilis pada <color=#F39321>Senin pagi</color>!

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Electric_Eel_Restart_001
Array.english: The fish we spotted with our Radar this week is...
Array.indonesia: Ikan yang kami temukan dengan Radar kami minggu ini adalah...

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Electric_Eel_Restart_002
Array.english: <size=36>the <color=#F1DC2B>Spotty Electric Moray</color>, the same as last week!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36><color=#F1DC2B>Moray Listrik Berbintik</color>, sama seperti minggu lalu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Electric_Eel_Restart_003
Array.english: I think it shows up in the <color=#1DFEAF>night</color>...\nAnd I saw it around <color=#1DFEAF>30 m</color> below the surface.
Array.indonesia: Menurutku ikan itu muncul pada <color=#1DFEAF>malam</color>...\nDan aku melihatnya sekitar <color=#1DFEAF>30 m</color> di bawah permukaan.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Electric_Eel_Restart_004
Array.english: <size=36>Do you want to try again?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Mau coba lagi?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Turtle_Magma_Start_001
Array.english: <size=35>What a great weekend, Dave!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Akhir pekan yang luar biasa, Dave!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Turtle_Magma_Start_002
Array.english: I came here for the usual stuff. Fishmon!
Array.indonesia: Aku datang ke sini untuk hal-hal biasa. Fishmon!

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Turtle_Magma_Start_003
Array.english: Do you know anything about <color=#F1DC2B>ice weapons</color> by any chance?
Array.indonesia: Apa kamu kebetulan tahu sesuatu tentang <color=#F1DC2B>senjata es</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Turtle_Magma_Start_004
Array.english: Sort of.
Array.indonesia: Agak-agak.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Turtle_Magma_Start_005
Array.english: Good. Because this week’s Fishmon\ncan only be caught using an ice weapon.
Array.indonesia: Bagus. Karena Fishmon minggu ini\nhanya bisa ditangkap menggunakan senjata es.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Turtle_Magma_Start_006
Array.english: And what’s that fish?
Array.indonesia: Dan ikan apa itu?

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Turtle_Magma_Start_007
Array.english: <size=35>It’s a turtle with a flaming shell!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Itu seekor penyu dengan cangkang yang menyala!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Turtle_Magma_Start_008
Array.english: <size=34>That sounds quite intimidating.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kedengarannya cukup menakutkan.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Turtle_Magma_Start_009
Array.english: As you know, the shell of a sea turtle is very tough.
Array.indonesia: Seperti yang kamu tahu, cangkang penyu laut sangat keras.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Turtle_Magma_Start_010
Array.english: But what if you can freeze it with an ice weapon?
Array.indonesia: Tapi bagaimana kalau kamu bisa membekukannya dengan senjata es?

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Turtle_Magma_Start_011
Array.english: This turtle lives...\nin a very deep place.
Array.indonesia: Penyu ini tinggal...\ndi tempat yang sangat dalam.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Turtle_Magma_Start_012
Array.english: It seems to live <color=#1DFEAF>deep inside a hot cave</color>.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya ia tinggal <color=#1DFEAF>jauh di dalam gua panas</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Turtle_Magma_Start_013
Array.english: But the Radar can’t pinpoint its location because it’s too deep.
Array.indonesia: Tapi Radar tidak bisa menentukan lokasinya karena terlalu dalam.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Turtle_Magma_Start_014
Array.english: Keep up the good work, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Teruslah bekerja dengan baik, Dave.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Turtle_Magma_Start_015
Array.english: A cave in a hot place?
Array.indonesia: Gua di tempat yang panas?

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Turtle_Magma_Success_001
Array.english: <size=35>Wow... This is it!\nA <color=#F1DC2B>Magma Turtle</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wah... Ini dia!\nSeekor <color=#F1DC2B>Kura-kura Magma</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Turtle_Magma_Success_002
Array.english: It was very difficult to haul this smoldering thing.
Array.indonesia: Sangat sulit sekali menyeret benda yang masih membara ini.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Turtle_Magma_Success_003
Array.english: I forgot to tell you to bring an icebox, hehe...
Array.indonesia: Aku lupa bilang padamu untuk bawa kotak es, hehe...

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Turtle_Magma_Success_004
Array.english: <size=35>Because I brought one here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Karena aku sudah bawa satu ke sini.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Turtle_Magma_Success_005
Array.english: Take a look at this turtle.\nIt doesn’t look like a sea turtle.
Array.indonesia: Lihatlah kura-kura ini.\nSepertinya bukan kura-kura laut.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Turtle_Magma_Success_006
Array.english: <size=35>Maybe a family of ancient Archelon?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Mungkin keluarga Archelon purba?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Turtle_Magma_Success_007
Array.english: Anyhow, thank you!\nWe’ll send you your fee when the issue’s out on <color=#F39321>Monday morning</color>!
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun, terima kasih!\nKami akan mengirimkan bayaranmu saat terbitan ini dirilis pada <color=#F39321>Senin pagi</color>!

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Turtle_Magma_Restart_001
Array.english: The fish we spotted with our Radar this week is...
Array.indonesia: Ikan yang kami temukan dengan Radar kami minggu ini adalah...

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Turtle_Magma_Restart_002
Array.english: <size=36>The  <color=#F1DC2B>Magma Turtle</color>, the same kind as the one from last week!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36><color=#F1DC2B>Kura-kura Magma</color>, jenis yang sama dengan yang minggu lalu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Turtle_Magma_Restart_003
Array.english: It will be found <color=#1DFEAF>deep inside a hot cave</color>.
Array.indonesia: Ikan itu akan ditemukan <color=#1DFEAF>jauh di dalam gua panas</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Turtle_Magma_Restart_004
Array.english: A hotspot in the water... It could be incredibly deep then.
Array.indonesia: Titik panas di dalam air... Bisa jadi kedalamannya sangat luar biasa.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Stingray_Ice_Start_001
Array.english: <size=35>What a great weekend, Dave!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Akhir pekan yang luar biasa, Dave!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Stingray_Ice_Start_002
Array.english: I heard that you are going to explore the deepest places of the Glacial Area.
Array.indonesia: Aku dengar kamu akan menjelajahi tempat-tempat terdalam di Kawasan Gletser.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Stingray_Ice_Start_003
Array.english: I see why you are a reporter.
Array.indonesia: Aku mengerti mengapa kamu menjadi seorang reporter.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Stingray_Ice_Start_004
Array.english: Haha, people talk about you. It’s not hard for this future editor-in-chief to hear news about you.
Array.indonesia: Haha, orang-orang membicarakanmu. Tidak sulit bagi calon pemimpin redaksi ini untuk mendengar kabar tentangmu.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Stingray_Ice_Start_005
Array.english: One of the Fishmons our Radar picked up\nseems to inhabit the Glacial Area.
Array.indonesia: Salah satu Fishmon yang terdeteksi oleh Radar kami\ntampaknya menghuni Kawasan Gletser.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Stingray_Ice_Start_006
Array.english: <size=34>I have a favor to ask, Dave.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku ingin meminta bantuanmu, Dave.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Stingray_Ice_Start_007
Array.english: It inhabits a <color=#1DFEAF>Cave with Ice</color>...\nIt looks like a common stingray.
Array.indonesia: Ia tinggal di <color=#1DFEAF>Gua Es</color>...\nKelihatannya seperti ikan pari biasa.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Stingray_Ice_Start_008
Array.english: But its color is similar to that of ice, so it won’t be easy to spot.
Array.indonesia: Tapi warnanya mirip es, jadi tidak akan mudah untuk menemukannya.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Stingray_Ice_Start_009
Array.english: An Ice Stingray living in an icy cave? How interesting.
Array.indonesia: Ikan pari es yang hidup di gua es? Menarik sekali.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Stingray_Ice_Start_010
Array.english: Isn’t it?\nI will wait till you return then!
Array.indonesia: Benar, kan?\nAku akan menunggumu sampai kamu kembali!

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Stingray_Ice_Success_001
Array.english: <size=35>Wow... This is it!\nAn <color=#F1DC2B>Ice Stingray</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wah... Ini dia!\nSeekor <color=#F1DC2B>ikan pari es</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Stingray_Ice_Success_002
Array.english: What’s that on its tail? A chunk of ice?
Array.indonesia: Apa itu yang ada di ekornya? Sepotong es?

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Stingray_Ice_Success_003
Array.english: If it weren't for that, it would just look like a frozen skate!
Array.indonesia: Kalau bukan itu, dia bakal terlihat seperti ikan skate yang membeku!

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Stingray_Ice_Success_004
Array.english: Anyhow, thank you!\nWe’ll send you your fee when the issue’s out on <color=#F39321>Monday morning</color>!
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun, terima kasih!\nKami akan mengirimkan bayaranmu saat terbitan ini dirilis pada <color=#F39321>Senin pagi</color>!

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Stingray_Ice_Restart_001
Array.english: The fish we spotted with our Radar this week is...
Array.indonesia: Ikan yang kami temukan dengan Radar kami minggu ini adalah...

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Stingray_Ice_Restart_002
Array.english: <size=36>the <color=#F1DC2B>Ice Stingray</color>, the same as last week!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36><color=#F1DC2B>Ice Stingray</color>, sama seperti minggu lalu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Stingray_Ice_Restart_003
Array.english: It is somewhere in the <color=#1DFEAF>Cave with Ice</color> in \nthe Glacial Area.
Array.indonesia: Ikan itu berada di suatu tempat di <color=#1DFEAF>Gua Es</color> di \nArea Gletser.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Prism_Mirror_Pacificfanfish_Start_001
Array.english: <size=35>How’s your weekend going, Dave?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Bagaimana akhir pekanmu, Dave?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Prism_Mirror_Pacificfanfish_Start_002
Array.english: You don’t look well today.
Array.indonesia: Kamu terlihat tidak sehat hari ini.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Prism_Mirror_Pacificfanfish_Start_003
Array.english: Hmph, it’s because I have no clue as to how to catch this week’s Fishmon.
Array.indonesia: Hmph, itu karena aku sama sekali tidak tahu cara menangkap Fishmon minggu ini.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Prism_Mirror_Pacificfanfish_Start_004
Array.english: What kind of Fishmon is it?
Array.indonesia: Fishmon jenis apa itu?

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Prism_Mirror_Pacificfanfish_Start_005
Array.english: It looks like a normal Fanfish at a glance...
Array.indonesia: Sekilas terlihat seperti Fanfish biasa...

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Prism_Mirror_Pacificfanfish_Start_006
Array.english: <size=38>But it knows how to create mirror images.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Tapi dia bisa menciptakan bayangan cermin.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Prism_Mirror_Pacificfanfish_Start_007
Array.english: <size=35>Mirror images? Are you kidding?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Bayangan cermin? Kamu bercanda?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Prism_Mirror_Pacificfanfish_Start_008
Array.english: Well, then you have only one option. Look closely at the images and notice the difference.
Array.indonesia: Nah, kalau begitu kamu hanya punya satu pilihan. Perhatikan baik-baik bayangan-bayangan itu dan temukan perbedaannya.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Prism_Mirror_Pacificfanfish_Start_009
Array.english: It’s in the <color=#1DFEAF>Underwater Lake</color>.\nA lake in the water, huh? The fish living there must be so special.
Array.indonesia: Ikan itu ada di <color=#1DFEAF>Danau Bawah Air</color>.\nDanau di dalam air, ya? Ikan yang hidup di sana pasti sangat istimewa.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Prism_Mirror_Pacificfanfish_Start_010
Array.english: Here’s to another fruitful week, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Semoga minggu ini juga berbuah hasil, Dave.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Prism_Mirror_Pacificfanfish_Success_001
Array.english: <size=35>Wow... This is it!\nA <color=#F1DC2B>Prismatic Fanfish</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wow... Ini dia!\nSeekor <color=#F1DC2B>Ikan Kipas Prismatik</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Prism_Mirror_Pacificfanfish_Success_002
Array.english: Its body clearly glows and its fins reflect light.
Array.indonesia: Tubuhnya bersinar terang dan siripnya memantulkan cahaya.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Prism_Mirror_Pacificfanfish_Success_003
Array.english: This is the secret of their ‘mirror images’ I guess.\nHaha.
Array.indonesia: Kurasa inilah rahasia ‘bayangan cermin’ mereka.\nHaha.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Prism_Mirror_Pacificfanfish_Success_004
Array.english: <size=35>What an amazing creature!\nThis week’s revenue will surely spike.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Makhluk yang luar biasa!\nPendapatan minggu ini pasti akan melonjak.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Prism_Mirror_Pacificfanfish_Success_005
Array.english: Anyhow, thank you!\nWe’ll send you your fee when the issue’s out on <color=#F39321>Monday morning</color>!
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun, terima kasih!\n Kami akan mengirimkan bayaran Anda saat terbitan ini dirilis pada <color=#F39321>Senin pagi</color>!

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Prism_Mirror_Pacificfanfish_Restart_001
Array.english: The fish we spotted with our Radar this week is...
Array.indonesia: Ikan yang kami temukan dengan Radar kami minggu ini adalah...

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Prism_Mirror_Pacificfanfish_Restart_002
Array.english: <size=36>the <color=#F1DC2B>Prismatic Fanfish</color>, the same as last week!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36><color=#F1DC2B>Prismatic Fanfish</color>, sama seperti minggu lalu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Prism_Mirror_Pacificfanfish_Restart_003
Array.english: Its location is... the <color=#1DFEAF>Underwater Lake</color>.
Array.indonesia: Lokasinya adalah... di <color=#1DFEAF>Danau Bawah Air</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Prism_Mirror_Pacificfanfish_Restart_004
Array.english: Here’s to another fruitful week, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Semoga minggu ini juga berbuah hasil, Dave.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Blackpowder_Vampire_Squid_Start_001
Array.english: <size=37>Aww...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Aww...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Blackpowder_Vampire_Squid_Start_002
Array.english: What’s wrong, Udo?
Array.indonesia: Ada apa, Udo?

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Blackpowder_Vampire_Squid_Start_003
Array.english: The Radar picked up a Fishmon and its stats are scary.\nI was taken aback.
Array.indonesia: Radar mendeteksi seekor Fishmon dan statistiknya menakutkan.\nAku kaget.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Blackpowder_Vampire_Squid_Start_004
Array.english: What kind of Fishmon was it?
Array.indonesia: Fishmon jenis apa itu?

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Blackpowder_Vampire_Squid_Start_005
Array.english: <size=36>Vampire Squid... It really sucks blood!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Cumi Vampir... Ia benar-benar menghisap darah!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Blackpowder_Vampire_Squid_Start_006
Array.english: Vampire Squids normally do not really suck blood, but this one is different.\nThis one is vampiric indeed.
Array.indonesia: Cumi Vampir biasanya tidak benar-benar menghisap darah, tapi yang ini berbeda.\nYang ini memang benar-benar vampir.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Blackpowder_Vampire_Squid_Start_007
Array.english: That’s not all! Its ink is volatile and explodes.\nIsn’t that scary?
Array.indonesia: Belum selesai! Tinta-nya mudah menguap dan bisa meledak.\nBukankah itu menakutkan?

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Blackpowder_Vampire_Squid_Start_008
Array.english: This one looks dangerous. I’d rather skip it.
Array.indonesia: Yang ini kelihatannya berbahaya. Mending aku lewatkan saja.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Blackpowder_Vampire_Squid_Start_009
Array.english: <size=34>Oh, no! Dave!\nA diver of your caliber should not be afraid of it! You can do it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh, tidak! Dave!\nSeorang penyelam sekelasmu seharusnya tidak takut padanya! Kamu pasti bisa!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Blackpowder_Vampire_Squid_Start_010
Array.english: I will pray for your safe return!\nGodspeed then!
Array.indonesia: Aku akan berdoa agar kamu kembali dengan selamat!\nSemoga sukses!

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Blackpowder_Vampire_Squid_Start_011
Array.english: <size=50>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Blackpowder_Vampire_Squid_Start_012
Array.english: Oh, I forgot to tell you the location of the Fishmon.
Array.indonesia: Oh, aku lupa memberitahumu lokasi Fishmon itu.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Blackpowder_Vampire_Squid_Start_013
Array.english: Our radar indicates that it is at the bottom most area of the <color=#1DFEAF>Passage to the Glacial Area</color>.
Array.indonesia: Radar kami menunjukkan bahwa ia berada di area paling bawah dari <color=#1DFEAF>Jalur Menuju Kawasan Gletser</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Blackpowder_Vampire_Squid_Start_014
Array.english: I will wait for you to return with good news!
Array.indonesia: Aku akan menunggumu kembali dengan kabar baik!

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Blackpowder_Vampire_Squid_Success_001
Array.english: <size=35>Whoa… Yes, this is it…!\nThe <color=#F1DC2B>Explosive Vampire Squid</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wah… Ya, ini dia…!\n<color=#F1DC2B>Cumi-cumi Vampir Peledak</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Blackpowder_Vampire_Squid_Success_002
Array.english: It even looks creepy!
Array.indonesia: Bahkan terlihat menyeramkan!

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Blackpowder_Vampire_Squid_Success_003
Array.english: <size=45>Boom!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=45>Boom!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Blackpowder_Vampire_Squid_Success_004
Array.english: It looks like it’s ready to explode at any time.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya ia siap meledak kapan saja.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Blackpowder_Vampire_Squid_Success_005
Array.english: Anyhow, thank you!\nWe’ll send you your fee when the issue’s out on <color=#F39321>Monday morning</color>!
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun, terima kasih!\nKami akan mengirimkan bayaranmu saat terbitan ini dirilis pada <color=#F39321>Senin pagi</color>!

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Blackpowder_Vampire_Squid_Restart_001
Array.english: The fish we spotted with our Radar this week is...
Array.indonesia: Ikan yang kami temukan dengan Radar kami minggu ini adalah...

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Blackpowder_Vampire_Squid_Restart_002
Array.english: <size=36>the <color=#F1DC2B>Explosive Vampire Squid</color>, the same as last week!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36><color=#F1DC2B>Cumi-cumi Vampir Peledak</color>, sama seperti minggu lalu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Blackpowder_Vampire_Squid_Restart_003
Array.english: Its location is the bottom-most area of the <color=#1DFEAF>Passage to the Glacial Area</color>.
Array.indonesia: Lokasinya berada di area paling bawah dari <color=#1DFEAF>Jalur Menuju Area Gletser</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Blackpowder_Vampire_Squid_Restart_004
Array.english: Here’s to another fruitful week, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Semoga minggu ini juga berbuah hasil, Dave.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Capture
Array.english: <size=35>Good! Captured the <color=#1DFEAF>Fishmon</color>!\nI should take it to Udo!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Bagus! Sudah menangkap <color=#1DFEAF>Fishmon</color>!\nAku harus membawanya ke Udo!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_FailFinished
Array.english: Oh, Dave... You failed to catch it.\nI guess our sales are going to flop this week...
Array.indonesia: Oh, Dave... Kamu gagal menangkapnya.\nSepertinya penjualan kita bakal sepi minggu ini...

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_01_contact
Array.english: Ooh, Dave! That’s the one!\nPlease catch it without killing it!
Array.indonesia: Ooh, Dave! Itu dia!\nTolong tangkap tanpa membunuhnya!

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_01_contact_Ghost_Squid
Array.english: It will react to <color=#1DFEAF>Special Light</color>.
Array.indonesia: Ia akan bereaksi terhadap <color=#1DFEAF>Cahaya Khusus</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeeklyFishing_die
Array.english: Oof! You killed the FIshMon...\nWe have to get them alive. Alive!
Array.indonesia: Aduh! Kamu membunuh FishMon...\nKita harus menangkapnya dalam keadaan hidup. Hidup!

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_stun
Array.english: Oh! The FishMon is unconcious!\nNow’s your chance! Capture it!
Array.indonesia: Oh! FishMon-nya pingsan!\nIni saatnya! Tangkap dia!

Array.name: dialogue_Contents_EnhancedWeapon_Duff_01
Array.english: Huh? What is it?
Array.indonesia: Hah? Ada apa?

Array.name: dialogue_Contents_EnhancedWeapon_Duff_02
Array.english: I spent some quality time with Leahs-chan\nand did some quiet thinking...
Array.indonesia: Aku menghabiskan waktu berkualitas bersama Leahs-chan\ndan merenung sejenak...

Array.name: dialogue_Contents_EnhancedWeapon_Duff_03
Array.english: I realized that paying people back for help received\nwas what a noble master would do.
Array.indonesia: Aku menyadari bahwa membalas kebaikan orang lain\nadalah hal yang akan dilakukan oleh seorang master yang mulia.

Array.name: dialogue_Contents_EnhancedWeapon_Duff_04
Array.english: Tell me, Dave. Are you satisfied with your <color=#F1DC2B>guns</color>?
Array.indonesia: Katakan padaku, Dave. Apakah kamu puas dengan <color=#F1DC2B>senjatamu</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_Contents_EnhancedWeapon_Duff_05
Array.english: Um... They’re fine...\nIt’d be nice if they were stronger, though.
Array.indonesia: Um... Senjataku baik-baik saja...\nTapi alangkah baiknya kalau senjataku lebih kuat.

Array.name: dialogue_Contents_EnhancedWeapon_Duff_06
Array.english: Heh. I guess it’s time I stepped into the spotlight, \nso to speak.
Array.indonesia: Heh. Sepertinya sudah waktunya aku tampil ke depan, \nbegitu kira-kira.

Array.name: dialogue_Contents_EnhancedWeapon_Duff_07
Array.english: <size=34>I’ll help you <color=#F1DC2B>Enhance</color> your guns.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku akan membantumu <color=#F1DC2B>meningkatkan</color> senjatamu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Contents_EnhancedWeapon_Duff_08
Array.english: <size=36><color=#F1DC2B>Enhance</color> them? How do you do that?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36><color=#F1DC2B>Meningkatkan</color> senjata itu? Bagaimana caranya?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Contents_EnhancedWeapon_Duff_09
Array.english: Heh. It’s about making them stronger...\nOr imbuing elements like poison or electricity.
Array.indonesia: Heh. Intinya adalah membuatnya lebih kuat...\nAtau menanamkan unsur-unsur seperti racun atau listrik.

Array.name: dialogue_Contents_EnhancedWeapon_Duff_10
Array.english: <size=36>There’s one thing you need to remember, though!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Tapi ada satu hal yang harus kamu ingat!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Contents_EnhancedWeapon_Duff_11
Array.english: Only guns that have been created can be enhanced.\n<color=#C8C8C8>I speak at the risk of sounding obvious...</color>
Array.indonesia: Hanya senjata yang sudah dibuat yang bisa ditingkatkan.\n<color=#C8C8C8>Aku ngomong ini meski kedengarannya klise...</color>

Array.name: dialogue_Contents_EnhancedWeapon_Duff_12
Array.english: Oh... I see! Gun enhancement...\nThat sounds pretty useful.
Array.indonesia: Oh... Aku mengerti! Peningkatan senjata...\nKedengarannya cukup berguna.

Array.name: dialogue_Contents_EnhancedWeapon_Duff_13
Array.english: Duff... \nyou’re a cooler person than I thought.
Array.indonesia: Duff... \nKamu orang yang lebih keren dari yang aku kira.

Array.name: dialogue_Contents_EnhancedWeapon_Duff_14
Array.english: Wh-what are you saying! I-I’m just trying\nto be the best master I can be for Leahs-chan...
Array.indonesia: A-apa yang kamu katakan! A-aku hanya berusaha\nmenjadi tuan terbaik yang bisa aku jadi untuk Leahs-chan...

Array.name: dialogue_Contents_EnhancedWeapon_Duff_15
Array.english: I think I’ve provided an adequate explanation. \nIt’s back to the world of the Pixies for me. \n<color=#ff61e3>GOODBYE-TERNITY★</color>.
Array.indonesia: Kurasa aku sudah memberikan penjelasan yang memadai. \nSekarang saatnya aku kembali ke dunia Pixies. \n<color=#ff61e3>SELAMAT TINGGAL-TERNITY★</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_MVSeedShop_Contents_Unlock_Gumo_001
Array.english: Oh, human.\nThe <color=#F1DC2B>Seaweed Farm</color> is ready.
Array.indonesia: Oh, manusia.\n<color=#F1DC2B>Peternakan Rumput Laut</color> sudah siap.

Array.name: dialogue_MVSeedShop_Contents_Unlock_Gumo_002
Array.english: I see you got some <color=#1DFEAF>Seaweed Seeds</color>.\nWant to try planting them?
Array.indonesia: Aku lihat kamu punya beberapa <color=#1DFEAF>Benih Rumput Laut</color>.\nMau coba menanamnya?

Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_001
Array.english: <size=46>Hopitty hop!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=46>Hopitty hop!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_002
Array.english: You...\nDo you know a lot about this <color=#90CDFF>Giant Blue Hole</color>?
Array.indonesia: Kamu...\nApakah kamu tahu banyak tentang <color=#90CDFF>Giant Blue Hole</color> ini?

Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_003
Array.english: Well... I’m not sure what to say to that...\nIt’s different in there every time...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Aku nggak yakin harus jawab apa...\nDi dalam sana selalu berbeda setiap kali...

Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_004
Array.english: Yes! That’s it!\nIt’s the best place to collect <color=#1DFEAF>MarinCa</color>!
Array.indonesia: Ya! Itu dia!\nItu tempat terbaik untuk mengumpulkan <color=#1DFEAF>MarinCa</color>!

Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_005
Array.english: I could complete my collection in this place!\nAhaha!
Array.indonesia: Aku bisa melengkapi koleksiku di tempat ini!\nAhaha!

Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_006
Array.english: <color=#1DFEAF>MarinCa</color>?
Array.indonesia: <color=#1DFEAF>MarinCa</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_007
Array.english: What!? Don’t tell me you don’t know the highly popular \nocean life trading cards, <color=#1DFEAF>MarinCa</color>!
Array.indonesia: Apa!? Jangan bilang kamu nggak tahu \nkartu koleksi makhluk laut yang sangat populer, <color=#1DFEAF>MarinCa</color>!

Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_008
Array.english: How can you not have heard of the futuristic trading cards that utilize an AI recognition system that automatically corresponds to fish in real life…
Array.indonesia: Kok bisa kamu belum pernah dengar tentang kartu koleksi futuristik yang menggunakan sistem pengenalan AI yang secara otomatis mencocokkan ikan di dunia nyata…

Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_009
Array.english: Um... Never heard of them.\nIt sounds fun, though.
Array.indonesia: Um... Belum pernah dengar.\nTapi kedengarannya seru, sih.

Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_010
Array.english: *Sigh* You seem quite behind the times.
Array.indonesia: *Huff* Kamu kayaknya ketinggalan zaman banget.

Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_011
Array.english: Let me help you install the <color=#72ff0a>app</color>.
Array.indonesia: Biar aku bantu kamu menginstal <color=#72ff0a>aplikasinya</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_012
Array.english: So you do this... Then press here...\nTouch that... add a friend...
Array.indonesia: Jadi begini caranya... Lalu tekan di sini...\nSentuh yang itu... tambahkan teman...

Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_013
Array.english: <size=43>Done!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=43>Selesai!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_014
Array.english: Um, okay. So what do I do now?
Array.indonesia: Hmm, oke. Jadi, apa yang harus aku lakukan sekarang?

Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_015
Array.english: The amazing thing about these <color=#1DFEAF>MarinCa</color> is...
Array.indonesia: Hal yang menakjubkan dari <color=#1DFEAF>MarinCa</color> ini adalah...

Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_016
Array.english: <size=38>You don’t really need to do anything special!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Kamu sebenarnya tidak perlu melakukan apa-apa yang istimewa!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_017
Array.english: Just catch a new fish, and you’ll get a card.\nCheck the cards every now and then on the app, and you’re done.
Array.indonesia: Cukup tangkap ikan baru, dan kamu akan mendapatkan kartu.\nPeriksa kartunya sesekali di aplikasi, dan selesai.

Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_018
Array.english: I see!\nI guess I’ll be able to easily see what fish I’ve caught so far.
Array.indonesia: Oh, begitu!\nSepertinya aku bisa dengan mudah melihat ikan apa saja yang sudah kutangkap sejauh ini.
