Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_019
Array.english: <size=38>That’s right! It’s almost like a...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Benar sekali! Rasanya hampir seperti...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_020
Array.english: Whoa! You don’t want to be saying the name.\nI understand. I’ll try it out.
Array.indonesia: Wah! Jangan sebut namanya.\nAku mengerti. Aku akan mencobanya.

Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_021
Array.english: <size=34>Oh, I forgot to introduce myself, didn’t I?\nI’m <color=#F1DC2B>Sato</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh, aku lupa memperkenalkan diri, ya?\nNamaku <color=#F1DC2B>Sato</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_022
Array.english: I’ll give you my contact info, so hit me up if you have questions.\nSee you, then. Chu-chu!
Array.indonesia: Aku akan memberikan info kontakku, jadi hubungi aku kalau ada pertanyaan.\nSampai jumpa. Chu-chu!

Array.name: dialogue_Bosscard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_001
Array.english: <size=46>YOWEE!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=46>YOWEE!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Bosscard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_002
Array.english: You seem... energetic today.
Array.indonesia: Kamu kelihatan... bersemangat hari ini.

Array.name: dialogue_Bosscard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_003
Array.english: I saw a <color=#1DFEAF>Boss Card</color> acquisition notification pop up on \nyour Marine Card account.
Array.indonesia: Aku melihat notifikasi perolehan <color=#1DFEAF>Kartu Bos</color> muncul di akun \nKartu Marinirmu.

Array.name: dialogue_Bosscard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_004
Array.english: <size=40>It’s this <color=#F1DC2B>Giant Squid</color> boss card!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Ini kartu bos <color=#F1DC2B>Giant Squid</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Bosscard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_005
Array.english: How did you get this?\nIt’s such a rare card...
Array.indonesia: Bagaimana kamu bisa mendapatkannya?\nKartu ini sangat langka...

Array.name: dialogue_Bosscard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_006
Array.english: Uh, well... I was just on my way to pick up a delivery, \nand as chance would have it...
Array.indonesia: Eh, begini... Aku sedang dalam perjalanan untuk mengambil kiriman, \ndan kebetulan...

Array.name: dialogue_Bosscard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_007
Array.english: Okay, I don’t have a clue what that means, \nbut in any case you’ve made amazing progress.
Array.indonesia: Oke, aku sama sekali tidak mengerti maksudnya, \ntapi bagaimanapun juga, kamu sudah membuat kemajuan yang luar biasa.

Array.name: dialogue_Bosscard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_008
Array.english: Try collecting all the rare Boss Cards.\nSomething good’s sure to happen!
Array.indonesia: Cobalah mengumpulkan semua Kartu Bos langka.\nPasti akan terjadi sesuatu yang baik!

Array.name: dialogue_Bosscard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_009
Array.english: Oh, and if you venture to new regions... \nfor example the depths, the automatic Marine Card AI system will unlock a <color=#1DFEAF>new Card Pack</color>.
Array.indonesia: Oh, dan jika kamu menjelajah ke wilayah baru... \nmisalnya di kedalaman laut, sistem AI Kartu Marine otomatis akan membuka <color=#1DFEAF>Paket Kartu baru</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_Bosscard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_010
Array.english: Don’t forget to collect fish cards in the new regions as well.
Array.indonesia: Jangan lupa mengumpulkan kartu ikan di wilayah baru itu juga.

Array.name: dialogue_Bosscard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_011
Array.english: <size=40>Goodbye, then. Chu-chu!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Sampai jumpa. Chu-chu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Gyao_Contents_Unlock_Sato_001
Array.english: <size=46>GYA-GYAO!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=46>GYA-GYAO!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Gyao_Contents_Unlock_Sato_002
Array.english: Oh? A new greeting sound?
Array.indonesia: Oh? Suara sapaan baru?

Array.name: dialogue_Gyao_Contents_Unlock_Sato_003
Array.english: Nope. It’s from the new game I am playing these days.
Array.indonesia: Nggak. Itu dari game baru yang lagi aku mainkan belakangan ini.

Array.name: dialogue_Gyao_Contents_Unlock_Sato_004
Array.english: What game are you playing?
Array.indonesia: Game apa yang kamu mainkan?

Array.name: dialogue_Gyao_Contents_Unlock_Sato_005
Array.english: It’s <color=#72ff0a>GYAO!</color>...
Array.indonesia: Namanya <color=#72ff0a>GYAO!</color>...

Array.name: dialogue_Gyao_Contents_Unlock_Sato_006
Array.english: <size=36>A game raising digital fish!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Game memelihara ikan digital!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Gyao_Contents_Unlock_Sato_007
Array.english: You feed them and keep them happy \nand they grow and mutate!
Array.indonesia: Kamu memberi makan mereka dan membuat mereka senang \nlalu mereka tumbuh dan bermutasi!

Array.name: dialogue_Gyao_Contents_Unlock_Sato_008
Array.english: <size=34>That sounds somewhat familiar!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kedengarannya agak familiar!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Gyao_Contents_Unlock_Sato_009
Array.english: Sigh.. Lately I'm feeding GYAO! as soon as I get up in the morning…
Array.indonesia: Hmm.. Akhir-akhir ini aku memberi makan GYAO! begitu bangun tidur…

Array.name: dialogue_Gyao_Contents_Unlock_Sato_010
Array.english: <size=35>Ah!! Come to think about it, I completely forgot to do that today!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ah!! Kalau dipikir-pikir, aku benar-benar lupa melakukannya hari ini!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Gyao_Contents_Unlock_Sato_011
Array.english: Wait a sec.
Array.indonesia: Tunggu sebentar.

Array.name: dialogue_Gyao_Contents_Unlock_Sato_012
Array.english: <size=46>……</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=46>……</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Gyao_Contents_Unlock_Sato_013
Array.english: ...Alright. Now I'll give it a snack.
Array.indonesia: ...Baiklah. Sekarang aku akan memberinya camilan.

Array.name: dialogue_Gyao_Contents_Unlock_Sato_014
Array.english: <size=36>Haha! Look, GYAO! is satisfied!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Haha! Lihat, GYAO! sudah puas!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Gyao_Contents_Unlock_Sato_015
Array.english: Why don’t you try it yourself? I shared the <color=#72ff0a>app</color> with you \nusing Share with Friend.
Array.indonesia: Kenapa kamu tidak mencobanya sendiri? Aku sudah membagikan <color=#72ff0a>aplikasi</color> itu kepadamu \nmelalui fitur Bagikan ke Teman.

Array.name: dialogue_Gyao_Contents_Unlock_Sato_016
Array.english: You'll be able to experience something fun besides just catching fish!
Array.indonesia: Kamu bisa merasakan pengalaman seru selain sekadar memancing!

Array.name: dialogue_Gyao_Contents_Unlock_Sato_017
Array.english: <size=36>Chuchu.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Chuchu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_ManagementApp_Contents_Unlock_Yoshie_001
Array.english: I forgot to tell you something.
Array.indonesia: Aku lupa memberitahumu sesuatu.

Array.name: dialogue_ManagementApp_Contents_Unlock_Yoshie_002
Array.english: What is it, Miss Yoshie?
Array.indonesia: Apa itu, Nona Yoshie?

Array.name: dialogue_ManagementApp_Contents_Unlock_Yoshie_003
Array.english: When you hire more employees and purchase more ingredients, you will have to take care of many things all at once.
Array.indonesia: Saat kamu mempekerjakan lebih banyak karyawan dan membeli lebih banyak bahan baku, kamu harus mengurus banyak hal sekaligus.

Array.name: dialogue_ManagementApp_Contents_Unlock_Yoshie_004
Array.english: So I decided to give you a <color=#72ff0a>Management</color> app, which works on your smartphone. You can check the current status of BANCHO SUSHI at any time with it.
Array.indonesia: Jadi, aku memutuskan untuk memberimu aplikasi <color=#72ff0a>Management</color>, yang bisa digunakan di ponsel pintarmu. Dengan aplikasi ini, kamu bisa memeriksa status terkini BANCHO SUSHI kapan saja.

Array.name: dialogue_ManagementApp_Contents_Unlock_Yoshie_005
Array.english: You can check the status of your restaurant\nwithout having to go there.
Array.indonesia: Kamu bisa memeriksa status restoranmu\ntanpa harus pergi ke sana.

Array.name: dialogue_ManagementApp_Contents_Unlock_Yoshie_006
Array.english: <size=35>That sounds handy!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Kedengarannya praktis!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_ManagementApp_Contents_Unlock_Yoshie_007
Array.english: I already linked the app. Why don’t you check it on your <color=#F1DC2B>smartphone</color>?
Array.indonesia: Saya sudah menyertakan tautan aplikasinya. Mengapa Anda tidak mencobanya di <color=#F1DC2B>smartphone</color> Anda?

Array.name: dialogue_ManagementApp_Contents_Unlock_Yoshie_008
Array.english: I am sure BANCHO SUSHI will grow bigger and prosper.
Array.indonesia: Saya yakin BANCHO SUSHI akan semakin berkembang dan sukses.

Array.name: dialogue_Dave_First_Dead_001
Array.english: Dave, this <color=#90CDFF>Giant Blue Hole</color> looks infinitely more dangerous\nthan any other place.
Array.indonesia: Dave, <color=#90CDFF>Giant Blue Hole</color> ini terlihat jauh lebih berbahaya\n daripada tempat lain mana pun.

Array.name: dialogue_Dave_First_Dead_002
Array.english: Always pay attention to your oxygen\nand use the <color=#1DFEAF>Escape Pod</color> when you’re in danger to get out quickly.
Array.indonesia: Selalu perhatikan persediaan oksigenmu\ndan gunakan <color=#1DFEAF>Escape Pod</color> saat kamu dalam bahaya agar bisa keluar dengan cepat.

Array.name: dialogue_Dave_First_Dead_003
Array.english: I can rescue you if you run out of oxygen,\nbut you’ll only be able to bring back one of the items you collected!
Array.indonesia: Aku bisa menyelamatkanmu jika oksigenmu habis,\ntapi kamu hanya bisa membawa pulang satu dari barang-barang yang kamu kumpulkan!

Array.name: dialogue_TimelineDummy_001
Array.english: (not in use)
Array.indonesia: (tidak digunakan)

Array.name: dialogue_TimelineDummy_002
Array.english: (not in use)
Array.indonesia: (tidak digunakan)

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Ramo_Ch3_Progress_001
Array.english: <size=38>Dear me... The tremors are getting worse...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Astaga... Getaran ini semakin parah...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Ramo_Ch3_Progress_002
Array.english: <size=36>Human! Hurry up and help the villagers\nto gain their trust!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Manusia! Cepat bantu penduduk desa\nagar mereka mempercayai kamu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Ramo_Ch3_Cleared_001
Array.english: Hmm? Looks like you’ve made yourself quite well-known \nin the village.
Array.indonesia: Hmm? Sepertinya kamu sudah cukup terkenal \ndi desa ini.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Ramo_Ch3_Cleared_002
Array.english: Even so, don’t go about doing your own thing.\nHelp the villagers!
Array.indonesia: Meski begitu, jangan seenaknya sendiri.\nBantu para penduduk desa!

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Suwam_Ch3_Progress_001
Array.english: Hey now, don’t go poking about in the village too much.
Array.indonesia: Hei, jangan terlalu banyak mengutak-atik di desa ini.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Suwam_Ch3_Progress_002
Array.english: You might trip on seaweed with those silly legs of yours. \nPfft.
Array.indonesia: Kamu bisa tersandung rumput laut dengan kaki konyolmu itu. \nPfft.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Suwam_Ch3_Cleared_001
Array.english: I guess the villagers don’t know how terrible\nhumans can be.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya penduduk desa tidak tahu betapa mengerikannya\nmanusia itu.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Suwam_Ch3_Cleared_002
Array.english: Remember that I’m always watching you, human.\nBest be on your best behavior.
Array.indonesia: Ingatlah bahwa aku selalu mengawasimu, manusia.\nSebaiknya kamu bersikap sebaik mungkin.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Tenzhin_Ch3_Progress_001
Array.english: Ahem. I mean, I wouldn’t mind having a bit of help from you...
Array.indonesia: Ahem. Maksudku, aku tidak keberatan jika kamu sedikit membantuku...

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Tenzhin_Ch3_Progress_002
Array.english: <size=37>You’ll need the trust of the villagers as well.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Kamu juga butuh kepercayaan dari para penduduk desa.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Tenzhin_Ch3_Progress_003
Array.english: They’ve heard a lot of bad things about humans\nand stayed out of contact for a long time.
Array.indonesia: Mereka sudah mendengar banyak hal buruk tentang manusia\ndan sudah lama tidak berhubungan.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Tenzhin_Ch3_Progress_004
Array.english: <size=36>Go and help out the villagers first!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Pergilah dan bantu para penduduk desa dulu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Tenzhin_Ch3_Cleared_001
Array.english: Hmm... \nI’d like you to venture down to the glacial region now...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... \nAku ingin kamu menjelajah ke wilayah gletser sekarang...

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Tenzhin_Ch3_Cleared_002
Array.english: It’s been closed off for a long time,\nso I’m not sure if it’ll be okay...
Array.indonesia: Wilayah itu sudah ditutup sejak lama,\njadi aku tidak yakin apakah itu akan baik-baik saja...

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Kazhin_#1_Progress_001
Array.english: Without King Long, the Sea People\nwould have died out already...
Array.indonesia: Tanpa Raja Long, Suku Laut\npasti sudah punah...

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Kazhin_#1_Progress_002
Array.english: It’s a very easy thing that we do,\noffering flowers like this.
Array.indonesia: Ini hal yang sangat mudah yang kita lakukan,\nmenawarkan bunga seperti ini.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Kazhin_#2_Progress_001
Array.english: Huh? You haven't brought the <color=#1DFEAF>book</color> yet?
Array.indonesia: Hah? Kamu belum membawa <color=#1DFEAF>buku</color> itu?

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Kazhin_#2_Progress_002
Array.english: Volume 2….
Array.indonesia: Jilid 2….

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Kazhin_#2_Progress_003
Array.english: I can't leave the shop now.\nPlease go on and borrow it from <color=#F1DC2B>Niamo</color> at the Shrine!
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak bisa meninggalkan toko sekarang.\nSilakan pinjam saja dari <color=#F1DC2B>Niamo</color> di Kuil!

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Kazhin_1Mission_Cleared_001
Array.english: There are more and more earthquakes lately…\nYour faith should be even stronger during times like these.
Array.indonesia: Akhir-akhir ini gempa bumi semakin sering terjadi…\nImanmu seharusnya semakin kuat di masa-masa seperti ini.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Kazhin_2Mission_Cleared_001
Array.english: Why don't you read some of the great works of King Long?
Array.indonesia: Kenapa kamu tidak membaca beberapa karya agung Raja Long?

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Kazhin_2Mission_Cleared_002
Array.english: But, I can't read the Sea People's language…
Array.indonesia: Tapi, aku tidak bisa membaca bahasa Suku Laut…

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Kazhin_2Mission_Cleared_003
Array.english: <size=34>Then how about I give you a <color=#1DFEAF>detailed</color> explanation?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kalau begitu, bagaimana kalau aku memberikanmu penjelasan <color=#1DFEAF>terperinci</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Kazhin_2Mission_Cleared_004
Array.english: …Nah. \nI'd rather just learn the Sea People's language.
Array.indonesia: …Ah, tidak. \nAku lebih suka belajar bahasa Suku Laut saja.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Kazhin_#3_Progress_001
Array.english: There is no way this human <color=#1DFEAF>seaweed dish</color> can be good.\nWell go ahead and bring it. I'll wait.
Array.indonesia: Tidak mungkin <color=#1DFEAF>hidangan rumput laut</color> buatan manusia ini enak.\nBaiklah, silakan bawa saja. Aku akan menunggu.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Kazhin_#3_Progress_002
Array.english: <size=33>But, he's not the most friendly guy. \nI don't know if he's really gonna help. hm!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tapi, dia bukan orang yang ramah. \nAku tidak tahu apakah dia benar-benar akan membantu. hm!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Kazhin_#1_Cleared_001
Array.english: I’m not sure if King Long’s greatness\nis something humans can understand, though...
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak yakin apakah keagungan Raja Long\nadalah sesuatu yang bisa dipahami manusia, sih...

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Kazhin_#1_Cleared_002
Array.english: Let me give you a bit of history.<size=24><color=#C3C3C3>It was in the year 1049 of our calendar... There was a sudden burst of magma, which also heated the sea. The Sea People were on the verge of destruction...</color></size>
Array.indonesia: Biarkan aku menceritakan sedikit sejarah.<size=24><color=#C3C3C3>Itu terjadi pada tahun 1049 menurut kalender kita... Tiba-tiba terjadi letusan magma, yang juga memanaskan laut. Suku Laut berada di ambang kehancuran...</color></size>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Kazhin_#1_Cleared_003
Array.english: <size=35>That’s when King Long appeared in front of everyone and claimed he would solve this problem! \nHe went into the Control Room all brave-like...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Saat itulah Raja Long muncul di hadapan semua orang dan menyatakan bahwa dia akan menyelesaikan masalah ini! \nDia masuk ke Ruang Kontrol dengan penuh keberanian...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Kazhin_#1_Cleared_004
Array.english: *Sob* He saved the whole village, but he died\nfrom his injuries... The thought of it brings tears to my eyes...
Array.indonesia: *Hiks* Ia menyelamatkan seluruh desa, tetapi ia meninggal\nakibat luka-lukanya... Memikirkannya saja sudah membuat mataku berkaca-kaca...

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Kazhin_#1_Cleared_005
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>This conversation... sounds strangely familiar...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Percakapan ini... terdengar anehnya familiar...</color>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Kazhin_#1_Cleared_006
Array.english: In any case! Keep the great King Long in your thoughts\nas you go about our village!
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun juga! Ingatlah Raja Long yang agung\nsaat kalian berkeliling desa kita!

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Doowa_Ch3_Progress_001
Array.english: <size=38>Hmm... Human...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Hmm... Manusia...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Doowa_#1_Progress_001
Array.english: <size=36>cough….</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>ehm….</size>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Doowa_#1_Progress_002
Array.english: Nothing to worry about…
Array.indonesia: Tidak ada yang perlu dikhawatirkan…

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Doowa_#1_Progress_003
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>Hm…I really need to get the <color=#1DFEAF>Coral Porridge</color> quickly….</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Hm…Aku benar-benar harus segera mendapatkan <color=#1DFEAF>Bubur Karang</color>….</color>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Doowa_#1_Cleared_001
Array.english: ….I guess I should be thankful for the porridge.
Array.indonesia: ….Kurasa aku harus bersyukur atas bubur itu.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Doowa_#2_Progress_001
Array.english: To start the Blacksmith Workshop I'll need <color=#1DFEAF>Opal</color>.\nI would appreciate it if you could get it….
Array.indonesia: Untuk memulai Bengkel Pandai Besi, aku butuh <color=#1DFEAF>Opal</color>.\nAku akan sangat berterima kasih jika kamu bisa mendapatkannya….

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Doowa_Ch3_Cleared_001
Array.english: I guess... humans aren’t as evil as I thought...
Array.indonesia: Kurasa... manusia tidak seburuk yang kukira...

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Doowa_Ch3_Cleared_002
Array.english: I’ll help you if you need something...\nI find that easier than making conversation...
Array.indonesia: Aku akan membantumu jika kamu membutuhkan sesuatu...\nBagiku itu lebih mudah daripada mengobrol...

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Linchen_#1_Progress_001
Array.english: The earthquake has allowed all the Seahorses to escape,\nand the <color=#1DFEAF>Seahorse Races</color> are on hold.
Array.indonesia: Gempa bumi telah membuat semua Kuda Laut melarikan diri,\ndan <color=#1DFEAF>Balapan Kuda Laut</color> ditunda.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Linchen_#1_Progress_002
Array.english: Please look throughout the village.\nI’ll be waiting here.
Array.indonesia: Tolong cari di seluruh desa.\nAku akan menunggu di sini.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Linchen_#1_Cleared_001
Array.english: Heh. This Game Parlor is open to anybody.
Array.indonesia: Heh. Ruang Permainan ini terbuka untuk siapa saja.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Linchen_#1_Cleared_002
Array.english: Nothing’s as fair as play.
Array.indonesia: Tidak ada yang seadil permainan.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Linchen_#1_Cleared_003
Array.english: Come anytime you want.\nBring plenty of Bei as well, heh.
Array.indonesia: Datanglah kapan pun kamu mau.\nBawalah banyak Bei juga, heh.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Linchen_#3_Progress_001
Array.english: Selgio…\nfollowed the <color=#1DFEAF>Shining Jellyfish</color> again?!...
Array.indonesia: Selgio…\nmengikuti <color=#1DFEAF>Ubur-ubur Bercahaya</color> lagi?!...

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Linchen_#3_Cleared_001
Array.english: Thank you, human.\nSelgio shouldn't run away now.
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih, manusia.\nSelgio sebaiknya tidak kabur sekarang.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Mima_#1_Progress_001
Array.english: Ugh... Nawang and Awang...\nThey’re so noisy when they’re hungry.
Array.indonesia: Ugh... Nawang dan Awang...\nMereka sangat berisik saat lapar.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Mima_#1_Progress_002
Array.english: Please hurry, human,\nbefore they come to the restaurant and raise a ruckus again.
Array.indonesia: Tolong cepat, manusia,\nsebelum mereka datang ke restoran dan membuat keributan lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Mima_#1_Cleared_001
Array.english: Oh my, human.\nI’m running into you often.
Array.indonesia: Astaga, manusia.\nAku sering bertemu denganmu.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Mima_#1_Cleared_002
Array.english: I think I might have another request for you soon...\nCome visit again, alright? Ehehe.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya aku akan punya permintaan lain untukmu sebentar lagi...\nDatanglah lagi, ya? Ehehe.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Mima_#2_Progress_001
Array.english: Oh dear... I need <color=#1DFEAF>Tube Coral</color> to cook...
Array.indonesia: Astaga... Aku butuh <color=#1DFEAF>Karang Tabung</color> untuk memasak...

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Mima_#2_Progress_002
Array.english: The coral looks like this... Please do get it for me.\nIt should be near the <color=#1DFEAF>Whale Bones</color>.
Array.indonesia: Karangnya terlihat seperti ini... Tolong ambilkan untukku.\nSeharusnya ada di dekat <color=#1DFEAF>Tulang Paus</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Mima_#2_Cleared_001
Array.english: Wow! Thanks for all your help.
Array.indonesia: Wow! Terima kasih atas semua bantuannya.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Mima_#2_Cleared_002
Array.english: I’ve been told humans are selfish...\nYou don’t seem half bad. Ehehe.
Array.indonesia: Katanya manusia itu egois...\nKamu kelihatannya lumayan, sih. Ehehe.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Mima_#3_Progress_001
Array.english: Hmm. I wonder how monstrous\nhuman food must be...
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Aku penasaran seberapa mengerikan\nmakanan manusia itu...

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Mima_#3_Progress_002
Array.english: Please do deliver it safely so I can have a look.
Array.indonesia: Tolong antarkan dengan selamat biar aku bisa lihat.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Mima_Herbman_Progress_001
Array.english: That Tsuchi…should be at home…
Array.indonesia: Tsuchi itu… seharusnya ada di rumah…

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Mima_Herbman_Progress_002
Array.english: If you see <color=#1DFEAF>Jellyfish Pieces</color> follow them!\nBecause that's the food that those leatherback turtles love!
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu melihat <color=#1DFEAF>Potongan Ubur-ubur</color>, ikuti mereka!\nKarena itulah makanan yang disukai penyu belimbing!

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Mima_#3-2_Cleared_001
Array.english: Ehehe, human.\nI’ve been hearing some good things about you...
Array.indonesia: Ehehe, manusia.\nAku sudah mendengar hal-hal baik tentangmu...

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Mima_#3-2_Cleared_002
Array.english: They’ve been saying they’re reevaluating humans, ehehe!
Array.indonesia: Mereka bilang sedang mengevaluasi ulang manusia, ehehe!

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Mima_#3-2_Cleared_003
Array.english: They may be a little stiff-backed, but the people here\nare all good-hearted.
Array.indonesia: Mereka mungkin sedikit kaku, tapi orang-orang di sini\nsemua baik hati.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Mima_#3-2_Cleared_004
Array.english: Come over often! Ehehe!
Array.indonesia: Sering-seringlah mampir! Ehehe!

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Nawang_Ch3_Progress_001
Array.english: Human... Don’t act all friendly.
Array.indonesia: Manusia... Jangan bersikap terlalu ramah.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Nawang_Ch3_Cleared_001
Array.english: Hmm. Some of the villagers have been saying good things\nabout you.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Beberapa penduduk desa mengatakan hal-hal baik\ntentangmu.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Nawang_Ch3_Cleared_002
Array.english: But humans are chronic liars...\nI’m not lowering my guard!
Array.indonesia: Tapi manusia itu pembohong kronis...\nAku tidak akan lengah!

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Nawang_Mima#1_WaitLunch_001
Array.english: What do you want, human?\nDon't get on my nerves especially when I'm hungry.
Array.indonesia: Apa yang kamu inginkan, manusia?\nJangan bikin aku kesal, apalagi saat aku lapar.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Nawang_Mima#1_AfterGive_001
Array.english: Mima’s Lunch Box...\nIt tastes fantastic, as usual...
Array.indonesia: Bekal Mima...\nRasanya luar biasa, seperti biasa...

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Nawang_Mima#1_AfterGive_002
Array.english: Human! I’ll compliment you\nfor not stealing some of the food.
Array.indonesia: Manusia! Aku akan memujimu\nkarena tidak mencuri sebagian makanannya.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Awang_Ch3_Progress_001
Array.english: Human…\nBe grateful you’re allowed to stay here at all.
Array.indonesia: Manusia…\nBersyukurlah kamu diizinkan tinggal di sini.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Awang_Ch3_Cleared_001
Array.english: Hmm. Even if Tenzhin trusts you,\nAwang is different!
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Meskipun Tenzhin mempercayaimu,\nAwang berbeda!

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Awang_Ch3_Cleared_002
Array.english: I will not miss even the slightest danger\nto this village... You’d better believe it.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak akan melewatkan bahaya sekecil apa pun\nyang mengancam desa ini... Lebih baik kamu percaya itu.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Awang_Mima#1_WaitLunch_001
Array.english: What are you doing wandering around here, human?
Array.indonesia: Apa yang kamu lakukan berkeliaran di sini, manusia?

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Awang_Mima#1_WaitLunch_002
Array.english: You've been waiting for somebody to take off for lunch...\nYou are quite the sneaky species.
Array.indonesia: Kamu sudah menunggu seseorang pergi makan siang...\nKamu memang spesies yang licik.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Awang_Mima#1_AfterGive_001
Array.english: <size=37>Yum... This... is what I’ve been craving!\nI love the taste of this food!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Wah... Ini... yang selama ini aku idam-idamkan!\nAku suka sekali rasa makanan ini!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Awang_Mima#1_AfterGive_002
Array.english: <size=43>What! Human!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=43>Apa! Manusia!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Awang_Mima#1_AfterGive_003
Array.english: How long have you been peeping,\nyou treacherous creature...
Array.indonesia: Sudah berapa lama kamu mengintip,\nmakhluk pengkhianat...

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Niamo_#1_Progress_001
Array.english: Records of the song should be in the <color=#1DFEAF>Sea People Record Chamber</color>.
Array.indonesia: Catatan lagu itu seharusnya ada di <color=#1DFEAF>Ruang Arsip Bangsa Laut</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Niamo_#1_Progress_002
Array.english: Please help us, human...\nMay King Long protect you...
Array.indonesia: Tolong bantu kami, manusia...\nSemoga Raja Long melindungimu...

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Niamo_#1_Cleared_001
Array.english: According to the records... King Long was killed in an attack\nby mutated Sea People.
Array.indonesia: Menurut catatan... Raja Long tewas dalam serangan\noleh Suku Laut yang bermutasi.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Niamo_#1_Cleared_002
Array.english: The mutants are called <color=#F1DC2B>Gadon</color>,\nand apparently very violent.
Array.indonesia: Makhluk-makhluk mutan itu disebut <color=#F1DC2B>Gadon</color>,\ndan tampaknya sangat ganas.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Niamo_#1_Cleared_003
Array.english: I still don’t have enough data on\nthe events of this period...
Array.indonesia: Aku masih belum memiliki cukup data mengenai\nperistiwa pada periode ini...

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Niamo_#2_Progress_001
Array.english: <size=40>Oh no! King Long’s statue is broken...</color>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Oh tidak! Patung Raja Long hancur...</color>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Niamo_#2_Progress_002
Array.english: This is all my fault!\nI failed to maintain it properly...
Array.indonesia: Ini semua salahku!\nAku gagal merawatnya dengan baik...

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Niamo_#2_Progress_003
Array.english: Oh human... Please find a way!
Array.indonesia: Oh manusia... Tolong temukan cara!

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Niamo_#2_Cleared_001
Array.english: Thank you so much!
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih banyak!

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Niamo_#2_Cleared_002
Array.english: I would not have liked to meet my ancestors one day\nafter I let King Long’s statue break...
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak ingin suatu hari nanti harus bertemu leluhurku\nsetelah membiarkan patung Raja Long hancur...

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Niamo_#2_Cleared_003
Array.english: Everything seems solid now, thanks to you.\nI won’t forget what you’ve done for me.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang semuanya tampak kokoh, berkat kamu.\nAku tidak akan melupakan apa yang telah kamu lakukan untukku.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Niamo_#2_Cleared_004
Array.english: May the blessing of King Long go with you.
Array.indonesia: Semoga berkah Raja Long menyertaimu.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Maro_#1_Progress_001
Array.english: Please find the ball the Megamouth Shark\nswallowed... human.
Array.indonesia: Tolong temukan bola yang ditelan Hiu Megamouth\n... manusia.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Maro_#1_Cleared_001
Array.english: Thanks to you, I can have fun with my friends again!\nThank you!
Array.indonesia: Berkat kamu, aku bisa bersenang-senang lagi bersama teman-temanku!\nTerima kasih!

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Maro_#2_Cleared_001
Array.english: Heh….I'll be doing fine in the village.\nSo don't worry about me!
Array.indonesia: Heh….Aku akan baik-baik saja di desa.\nJadi jangan khawatirkan aku!

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Beagi_Maro#2_Progress_001
Array.english: Ugh….Maro really is insufferable.
Array.indonesia: Ugh…. Maro benar-benar menyebalkan.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Beagi_Maro#2_Progress_002
Array.english: Maro must have gone to the undersea lake.\nFollow the <color=#1DFEAF>direction signs</color> to get there!
Array.indonesia: Maro pasti sudah pergi ke danau bawah laut.\nIkuti <color=#1DFEAF>rambu-rambu arah</color> untuk sampai ke sana!

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Padeuma_Ch3_Progress_001
Array.english: Oh my, I’ve never seen a human before...\nYou have legs... just like a crab...
Array.indonesia: Astaga, aku belum pernah melihat manusia sebelumnya...\nKamu punya kaki... persis seperti kepiting...

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Padeuma_Ch3_Cleared_001
Array.english: Hmm. I think I’m getting used to the sight of a human.\nIsn’t it uncomfortable to swim around when you look like that?
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Sepertinya aku mulai terbiasa melihat manusia.\nBukankah tidak nyaman berenang dengan penampilan seperti itu?

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Padeuma_FindSeahorse_001
Array.english: Seahorses?\nI think I might have seen them near the <color=#1DFEAF>gate to the square</color>.
Array.indonesia: Kuda laut?\nSepertinya aku pernah melihatnya di dekat <color=#1DFEAF>gerbang menuju alun-alun</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Yese_Ch3_Progress_001
Array.english: <size=40>Ahee!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Ahee!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Yese_Ch3_Progress_002
Array.english: Don’t pop out of nowhere like that...\nSee my gills pumping?
Array.indonesia: Jangan muncul tiba-tiba seperti itu...\nLihat insangku yang bergerak-gerak?

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Yese_Ch3_Cleared_001
Array.english: <size=40>Ahee!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Ahee!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Yese_Ch3_Cleared_002
Array.english: I guess I’m... not as surprised as before.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya aku... tidak sekejut sebelumnya.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Yese_FindSeahorse_001
Array.english: <size=40>Ahee!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Ahee!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Yese_FindSeahorse_002
Array.english: Seahorses? I think I’ve seen them enter the <color=#1DFEAF>Seed Shop</color>.
Array.indonesia: Kuda laut? Kayaknya aku pernah lihat mereka masuk ke <color=#1DFEAF>Toko Benih</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Gumo_Ch3_Progress_001
Array.english: You’re getting in the way of my farming.
Array.indonesia: Kamu menghalangi aktivitas bertani aku.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Gumo_FindSeahorse_001
Array.english: I was busy farming. I haven’t seen any Seahorse.
Array.indonesia: Aku lagi sibuk bertani. Aku belum melihat kuda laut sama sekali.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Gumo_Kazhin#3_Progress_001
Array.english: A human made <color=#1DFEAF>seaweed dish</color> can't be good.\nI'll wait for you to bring it.
Array.indonesia: <color=#1DFEAF>Masakan rumput laut</color> buatan manusia pasti nggak enak.\nAku akan menunggu sampai kamu membawanya.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Gumo_Ch3_Cleared_001
Array.english: Hmm... I heard humans farm, too.\nI guess we have more in common than I thought...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Aku dengar manusia juga bertani.\nSepertinya kita punya lebih banyak kesamaan daripada yang aku kira...

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Yami_Before_Racing_001
Array.english: This is troublesome…\nAll the Seahorses escaped.\rWe can’t hold races... \nand it’s tough putting food on the table.
Array.indonesia: Ini merepotkan…\nSemua kuda laut kabur.\rKita tidak bisa mengadakan balapan... \ndan sulit mencari nafkah.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Junak_first_talk_001
Array.english: <size=38>Heh, well look at you, human!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Heh, lihat dirimu, manusia!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Junak_first_talk_002
Array.english: I’m sure you had a lot of trouble\ncoming all the way down here.
Array.indonesia: Aku yakin kamu mengalami banyak kesulitan\ndatang sejauh ini.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Junak_first_talk_003
Array.english: Nothing like a few games to get your adrenaline going\nwhen you’re tired, eh?
Array.indonesia: Nggak ada yang lebih asyik dari main game buat bikin adrenalin naik\nkalau lagi capek, ya?

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Junak_first_talk_004
Array.english: <size=40>Play a game with me, hehe!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Main game bareng aku dong, hehe!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Tenzhin_NewSuit_001
Array.english: That is...an interesting outfit.
Array.indonesia: Itu... pakaian yang menarik.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Tenzhin_NewSuit_002
Array.english: It’s a suit made of the Divine Tree Fruit Cloth you gave me and some human contraption.
Array.indonesia: Ini adalah setelan yang terbuat dari Kain Buah Pohon Ilahi yang kamu berikan padaku dan beberapa alat buatan manusia.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Tenzhin_NewSuit_003
Array.english: I can explore the Glacial Area with this. It’s very warm.
Array.indonesia: Dengan ini, aku bisa menjelajahi Area Gletser. Setelan ini sangat hangat.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Tenzhin_NewSuit_004
Array.english: <size=35>Good for you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Bagus sekali!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Tenzhin_NewSuit_005
Array.english: Then, can I ask you\nto explore the Glacial Area again to see what happened there?
Array.indonesia: Kalau begitu, bolehkah aku memintamu\nuntuk menjelajahi Area Gletser lagi guna melihat apa yang terjadi di sana?

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Ramo_NewSuit_001
Array.english: You look different today.
Array.indonesia: Kamu terlihat berbeda hari ini.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Ramo_NewSuit_002
Array.english: That’s because I am wearing a Cold-resistant Suit to protect me from the coldness of the Glacial Area.
Array.indonesia: Itu karena aku memakai Pakaian Tahan Dingin untuk melindungiku dari hawa dingin di Kawasan Gletser.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Ramo_NewSuit_003
Array.english: You look good.\nKeep up the good work!
Array.indonesia: Kamu terlihat bagus.\nTeruslah berjuang!

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Suwam_NewSuit_001
Array.english: <size=34>What is that thing you’re wearing? A costume?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Apa itu yang kamu pakai? Kostum?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Suwam_NewSuit_002
Array.english: Ha, you need that thing to survive down there?\nHumans are so fragile.
Array.indonesia: Ha, kamu butuh benda itu untuk bertahan hidup di sana?\nManusia memang sangat rapuh.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Suwam_NewSuit_003
Array.english: Good luck down there.\nI am on patrol.
Array.indonesia: Semoga berhasil di sana.\nAku sedang berpatroli.

Array.name: dialogue_Glacial_Dungeon1_SuwamWait_001
Array.english: Ah, my waist hurts from intense training.\nI should have known...
Array.indonesia: Ah, pinggangku sakit karena latihan yang intens.\nSeharusnya aku sudah tahu...

Array.name: dialogue_Glacial_Dungeon1_SuwamWait_002
Array.english: Take a look inside carefully, human.
Array.indonesia: Perhatikan baik-baik ke dalam, manusia.

Array.name: dialogue_Duff_Concert_opening_01
Array.english: Phew.. I should call it a day.
Array.indonesia: Wah... Sepertinya sudah waktunya aku berhenti hari ini.

Array.name: dialogue_Duff_Concert_opening_02
Array.english: It’s a long road, becoming a great master…
Array.indonesia: Perjalanan untuk menjadi seorang master hebat memang panjang…

Array.name: dialogue_FGT_TestEnd_001
Array.english: Did you enjoy playing the game?
Array.indonesia: Apakah kamu menikmati permainan ini?

Array.name: dialogue_FGT_TestEnd_002
Array.english: This is the version we have prepared for testing.
Array.indonesia: Ini adalah versi yang telah kami siapkan untuk pengujian.

Array.name: dialogue_FGT_TestEnd_003
Array.english: There are no further stories ready yet,\nbut you can enjoy the game freely in your own way.
Array.indonesia: Belum ada cerita lanjutan yang siap,\ntapi kamu bisa menikmati game ini sesuka hatimu.

Array.name: dialogue_FGT_TestEnd_004
Array.english: Just play the game and give us feedback.\nYour feedback helps improving our game quality :)
Array.indonesia: Mainkan saja game ini dan berikan masukan kepada kami.\nMasukanmu membantu meningkatkan kualitas game kami :)

Array.name: dialogue_FGT_TestEnd_005
Array.english: Thank you for participating in the game testing.
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih telah berpartisipasi dalam pengujian game ini.

Array.name: dialog_Title_Warning_NewGame
Array.english: Overwrite existing data.\nStart from the beginning?
Array.indonesia: Menimpa data yang ada.\nMulai dari awal?

Array.name: dialog_Settings_Warning_GoTitle
Array.english: Cannot save right now.\nRestarting will start you from last save point.\nAre you sure you want to quit?
Array.indonesia: Tidak dapat menyimpan saat ini.\nMemulai ulang akan membawa Anda ke titik simpan terakhir.\nApakah Anda yakin ingin keluar?

Array.name: dialog_Settings_Warning_SaveLocked
Array.english: Cannot save right now.\nPlease try again after the event ends.
Array.indonesia: Tidak dapat menyimpan saat ini.\nSilakan coba lagi setelah acara berakhir.

Array.name: dialog_Settings_Warning_LoadFail
Array.english: Failed to load save file.\nPlease try another save file.
Array.indonesia: Gagal memuat file simpanan.\nSilakan coba file simpanan lainnya.

Array.name: dialog_Settings_Warning_SaveFail
Array.english: Failed to save.\nPlease try again a little later.
Array.indonesia: Gagal menyimpan.\nSilakan coba lagi nanti.

Array.name: dialog_Settings_Warning_SaveOverwrite
Array.english: Overwrite your previous existing save file?
Array.indonesia: Ingin menimpa berkas penyimpanan yang sudah ada sebelumnya?

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy01_001
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>Um...Didn’t the manager say he saw someone who looked like Otto around here?</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Um...Didn bukankah manajer mengatakan dia melihat seseorang yang mirip Otto di sekitar sini?</color>

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy01_002
Array.english: Hey, chef? May I ask you something?
Array.indonesia: Hei, koki? Bolehkah saya bertanya sesuatu?

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy01_003
Array.english: <size=40>Welcome to BANCHO SUSHI!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Selamat datang di BANCHO SUSHI!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy01_004
Array.english: You guys sell <color=#1DFEAF>Vegetable Sushi</color> here by any chance?
Array.indonesia: Apakah kalian kebetulan menjual <color=#1DFEAF>Sushi Sayuran</color> di sini?

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy01_005
Array.english: <size=40>...<color=#1DFEAF>Vegetable Sushi</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>...<color=#1DFEAF>Sushi Sayuran</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy01_006
Array.english: Um, we don’t have that on the menu.\nNorimaki Sushi is the closest thing to that though.
Array.indonesia: Um, kami tidak punya itu di menu.\nTapi Norimaki Sushi adalah yang paling mirip dengan itu.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy01_007
Array.english: Not Norimaki sushi. \nI want sushi made with fresh veggies.
Array.indonesia: Bukan Norimaki sushi. \nSaya mau sushi yang dibuat dengan sayuran segar.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy01_008
Array.english: Well, it’s okay then. I will get going.\nHave a good one!
Array.indonesia: Baiklah, kalau begitu. Saya akan pergi dulu.\nSemoga harimu menyenangkan!

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy02_001
Array.english: Wait. This music...\nIt’s Hot Pepper Tuna, the title song from my first album!
Array.indonesia: Tunggu. Lagu ini...\nIni Hot Pepper Tuna, lagu utama dari album pertamaku!

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy02_002
Array.english: This kind of music intrigues me.\nYou must be <color=#F1DC2B>MC Sammy</color>, I presume?
Array.indonesia: Musik seperti ini membuatku penasaran.\nKamu pasti <color=#F1DC2B>MC Sammy</color>, kan?

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy02_003
Array.english: <size=36>Heh! You recognize me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Heh! Kamu mengenaliku?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy02_004
Array.english: I am pleased to see one of my fans here.\nCould you perhaps make me some <color=#1DFEAF>Vegetable Sushi</color> then?
Array.indonesia: Senang melihat salah satu penggemarku di sini.\nBisakah kamu membuatkan aku <color=#1DFEAF>Sushi Sayuran</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy02_005
Array.english: We do have some vegetables,\nbut Vegetable Sushi is not that simple.
Array.indonesia: Kami memang punya sayuran,\ntapi Sushi Sayuran itu tidak semudah itu.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy02_006
Array.english: Give me three days and\nI will serve you some proper <color=#F1DC2B>Vegetable Sushi</color>.
Array.indonesia: Beri aku tiga hari dan\naku akan menyajikan <color=#F1DC2B>Sushi Sayuran</color> yang enak untukmu.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy02_007
Array.english: Nice, yo!
Array.indonesia: Keren, bro!

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy02_008
Array.english: I will come back in <color=#F1DC2B>three days</color> then!\nI can’t wait!
Array.indonesia: Aku akan kembali dalam <color=#F1DC2B>tiga hari</color> nanti!\nAku nggak sabar!

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy03_001
Array.english: Bancho, you got any good ideas?
Array.indonesia: Bancho, kamu punya ide bagus?

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy03_002
Array.english: <size=40>Nope.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Nggak.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy03_003
Array.english: <size=40>Then what is your plan?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Lalu apa rencanamu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy03_004
Array.english: Otto knows more about vegetables than I do.\nI was going to ask him.
Array.indonesia: Otto lebih tahu soal sayuran daripada aku.\nAku mau tanya dia.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy03_005
Array.english: Ah, that makes sense. I will give him a call.
Array.indonesia: Ah, masuk akal. Aku akan meneleponnya.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy04_001
Array.english: <size=37>Hello, Dave! What’s up?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Halo, Dave! Ada apa?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy04_002
Array.english: Oh, one of our customers asked us to make some <color=#1DFEAF>Vegetable Sushi</color>...And we need to secure the ingredients for it.
Array.indonesia: Oh, salah satu pelanggan kita meminta kita membuat <color=#1DFEAF>Sushi Sayuran</color>...And, jadi kita perlu menyiapkan bahan-bahannya.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy04_003
Array.english: Huh? <color=#1DFEAF>Vegetable Sushi</color>?\nThat’s one of my favorites...
Array.indonesia: Hah? <color=#1DFEAF>Sushi Sayuran</color>?\nItu salah satu favoritku...

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy04_004
Array.english: <size=38>Haha, that customer knows true taste!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Haha, pelanggan itu tahu selera yang sesungguhnya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy04_005
Array.english: Give me some time.\nI will have to work through the night.
Array.indonesia: Beri aku waktu sebentar.\nAku harus bekerja semalaman.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy04_006
Array.english: <size=38>I will call you tomorrow morning!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Aku akan meneleponmu besok pagi!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy04_007
Array.english: Nice! I will visit your place in the morning.
Array.indonesia: Bagus! Aku akan mampir ke tempatmu besok pagi.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_01_001
Array.english: <size=42>Hey, are you ready?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>Hei, kamu sudah siap?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_01_002
Array.english: Right on time.
Array.indonesia: Tepat waktu.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_01_003
Array.english: <size=40>Have a seat. It won’t take long.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Silakan duduk. Nggak akan lama.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_02_001
Array.english: <size=44>Yes! This is it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=44>Ya! Ini dia!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_02_002
Array.english: <size=42>The taste of this <color=#1DFEAF>Vegetable Sushi</color>\nreminds me of my younger days!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>Rasa <color=#1DFEAF>Sushi Sayuran</color>\nini mengingatkanku pada masa mudaku!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_02_003
Array.english: <size=36>Your Vegetable Sushi is perfect.\nWhat’s the secret?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Sushi Sayuranmu sempurna.\nApa rahasianya?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_02_004
Array.english: All I did was properly season it... Though my acquaintances have provided some assistance with the ingredients.
Array.indonesia: Yang aku lakukan hanyalah membumbui dengan benar... Meskipun teman-temanku juga membantu menyediakan bahan-bahannya.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_03_001
Array.english: <size=42>Son?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>Nak?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_03_002
Array.english: <size=42>Dad?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>Ayah?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_03_003
Array.english: <size=34>I wondered who’d eat something like <color=#1DFEAF>Vegetable Sushi</color>.\nI didn’t know it was you...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku penasaran siapa yang mau makan <color=#1DFEAF>Sushi Sayuran</color>.\nTernyata kamu...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_03_004
Array.english: I heard people talking about someone who looks like you. That's why I visited this place and ordered Vegetable Sushi.
Array.indonesia: Aku mendengar orang-orang membicarakan seseorang yang mirip denganmu. Itulah mengapa aku datang ke tempat ini dan memesan Sushi Sayuran.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_03_005
Array.english: It has been eight years since you left.\nYou never contacted us since.
Array.indonesia: Sudah delapan tahun sejak kamu pergi.\nKamu tidak pernah menghubungi kami sejak saat itu.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_03_006
Array.english: Well, it’s a long story...\nThere was a storm and I got shipwrecked on an uninhabited island...
Array.indonesia: Yah, ceritanya panjang...\nAda badai dan aku terdampar di sebuah pulau tak berpenghuni...

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_03_006_2
Array.english: It was just trees and the sea...
Array.indonesia: Di sana hanya ada pepohonan dan laut...

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_03_007
Array.english: <size=34>I worked hard to get food and water!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku bekerja keras untuk mendapatkan makanan dan air!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_03_008
Array.english: <size=34>And sometimes hunted wild animals with \na Harpoon Gun and roasted them.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Dan kadang-kadang berburu hewan liar dengan \nsenapan tombak dan memanggangnya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_03_009
Array.english: I had to spend some years on the island until I got \nrescued and settled here.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus menghabiskan beberapa tahun di pulau itu sampai akhirnya \ndiselamatkan dan menetap di sini.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_03_010
Array.english: <size=38>What a story, dad.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Kisah yang luar biasa, Ayah.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_03_011
Array.english: I wanted to visit home after securing a stable life here.
Array.indonesia: Aku ingin pulang ke rumah setelah kehidupan di sini sudah stabil.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_03_012
Array.english: But it took so long and time flew.\nI am sorry, my boy.
Array.indonesia: Tapi butuh waktu lama dan waktu berlalu begitu cepat.\nMaafkan aku, Nak.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_03_013
Array.english: The folks at the village think you abandoned us, dad.
Array.indonesia: Orang-orang di desa mengira kamu telah meninggalkan kami, Ayah.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_03_014
Array.english: My friends pitied me.\nAnd some mocked me.
Array.indonesia: Teman-temanku mengasihani aku.\nDan ada juga yang mengejekku.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_03_015
Array.english: I began writing music and singing songs\nto relieve stress and I became a rapper.
Array.indonesia: Aku mulai menulis musik dan menyanyikan lagu-lagu\nuntuk melepas stres, dan akhirnya aku menjadi seorang rapper.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_03_016
Array.english: My son has grown into such a fine young man \neven without me. I am proud of you, son.
Array.indonesia: Anakku telah tumbuh menjadi pemuda yang luar biasa \nbahkan tanpa kehadiranku. Aku bangga padamu, Nak.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_03_017
Array.english: I blamed you so much at first,\nbut the music healed me. Gave me inner peace.
Array.indonesia: Awalnya aku sangat menyalahkanmu,\ntapi musik menyembuhkanku. Memberiku kedamaian batin.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_03_018
Array.english: Oh, since you’ve come all the way here,\nwhy don’t you stay at my farm?
Array.indonesia: Oh, karena kamu sudah datang jauh-jauh ke sini,\nmengapa kamu tidak menginap di peternakanku?

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_03_019
Array.english: Of course, like old times.
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja, seperti dulu.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_03_020
Array.english: Haha, since you are all grown up,\nwe can grab some beer together!
Array.indonesia: Haha, karena kamu sudah dewasa,\nkita bisa minum bir bareng!

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_04_001
Array.english: What a plot twist.\nThat rapper was the son of Otto...
Array.indonesia: Sungguh plot twist yang mengejutkan.\nRapper itu ternyata putra Otto...

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_04_002
Array.english: They have something in common.\nBoth are quite talkative.
Array.indonesia: Mereka punya kesamaan.\nKeduanya cukup cerewet.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_04_003
Array.english: Yeah, I agree.
Array.indonesia: Ya, aku setuju.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_04_004
Array.english: This is a good thing.\nBANCHO SUSHI helped them to reunite!
Array.indonesia: Ini hal yang bagus.\nBANCHO SUSHI membantu mereka bersatu kembali!

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_04_005
Array.english: The two must have much to say.\nI hope they can resolve their misunderstandings.
Array.indonesia: Keduanya pasti punya banyak hal untuk dibicarakan.\nSemoga mereka bisa menyelesaikan kesalahpahaman mereka.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Fail_01
Array.english: Ow, <color=#1DFEAF>Vegetable Sushi</color> isn’t ready yet?
Array.indonesia: Aduh, <color=#1DFEAF>Sushi Sayuran</color> belum siap?

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Fail_02
Array.english: Yo, I will drop by later when it is available...
Array.indonesia: Yo, aku bakal mampir nanti kalau sudah tersedia...

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Fail_03
Array.english: <size=34>I am disappointed, Chef...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku kecewa, Chef...</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Phone_Fail_01
Array.english: Can you bring <color=#1DFEAF>vegetable sushi</color> when you visit next time?
Array.indonesia: Bisakah kamu bawa <color=#1DFEAF>sushi sayuran</color> saat mampir lagi nanti?

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Phone_Fail_02
Array.english: It's a food that means a lot to me yo.\nPlease, please bro!
Array.indonesia: Itu makanan yang sangat berarti bagiku, yo.\nTolong, tolong, bro!

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Revisit_01
Array.english: I couldn’t order <color=#1DFEAF>Vegetable Sushi</color> last time.\nCan I order it this time? Yo?
Array.indonesia: Aku nggak bisa pesan <color=#1DFEAF>Sushi Sayuran</color> terakhir kali.\nBolehkah aku memesannya kali ini? Yo?

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Revisit_02
Array.english: <size=37>I will come back <color=#F1DC2B>tomorrow</color>! Peace!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Aku akan kembali <color=#F1DC2B>besok</color>! Sampai jumpa!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Appear_01
Array.english: <size=34>Hello, everyone!\nThis is <color=#F1DC2B>Yui</color> from NDC station!<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Halo, semuanya!\nIni <color=#F1DC2B>Yui</color> dari stasiun NDC!<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Appear_02
Array.english: Today, I present a new program called\n<color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color> featuring Vincent Yamaoka!
Array.indonesia: Hari ini, aku mempersembahkan program baru berjudul \n<color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color> yang menampilkan Vincent Yamaoka!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Appear_03
Array.english: It’s been a long time, everyone.\nI am Vincent Yamaoka.
Array.indonesia: Sudah lama tidak bertemu, semuanya.\nSaya adalah Vincent Yamaoka.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Appear_04
Array.english: <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color> is a program set to discover\nmaster chefs of the world!
Array.indonesia: <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color> adalah program yang bertujuan untuk menemukan\nkoki-koki ulung dari seluruh dunia!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Appear_05
Array.english: The champion of the last season was <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color>, who was praised by Vincent! He will be the defending champion today...
Array.indonesia: Juara musim lalu adalah <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color>, yang dipuji oleh Vincent! Dia akan menjadi juara bertahan hari ini...

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Appear_06
Array.english: <size=36>D-defending champion?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Juara bertahan?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Appear_07
Array.english: <size=35>And this season’s first challenger\nis <color=#F1DC2B>Wang Pang</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Dan penantang pertama musim ini\nadalah <color=#F1DC2B>Wang Pang</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Appear_08
Array.english: <size=35>It’s my honor to be here. \nI am <color=#F1DC2B>Wang Pang</color> from Hong Kong.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Merupakan kehormatan bagi saya untuk berada di sini. \nSaya adalah <color=#F1DC2B>Wang Pang</color> dari Hong Kong.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Appear_09
Array.english: Nice to meet you, Wang Pang.
Array.indonesia: Senang bertemu denganmu, Wang Pang.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Appear_10
Array.english: All right! We’ve met the contestants,\nnow let us begin the show!
Array.indonesia: Baiklah! Kita sudah bertemu dengan para kontestan,\nsekarang mari kita mulai acaranya!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Appear_11
Array.english: You two will compete with dishes on the same day \nat the same place on a given theme. Vincent Yamaoka will judge your dishes.
Array.indonesia: Kalian berdua akan bersaing dengan hidangan pada hari yang sama \ndi tempat yang sama dengan tema yang telah ditentukan. Vincent Yamaoka akan menjadi juri untuk hidangan kalian.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Appear_12
Array.english: <size=33>Today’s theme for the contest is...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tema lomba hari ini adalah...</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Appear_13
Array.english: <size=38><color=#F1DC2B>Chinese cuisine</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38><color=#F1DC2B>Masakan Tiongkok</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Appear_14
Array.english: Oh well, this isn’t good.
Array.indonesia: Ah, ini tidak bagus.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Appear_15
Array.english: As you know, Chinese cuisine\ndeveloped many different cooking styles in its long history.
Array.indonesia: Seperti yang kalian ketahui, masakan Tiongkok\ntelah mengembangkan berbagai gaya memasak yang berbeda sepanjang sejarahnya yang panjang.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Appear_16
Array.english: When we talk about Chinese cuisine, many will think of \nstir-fried meat and vegetables. But that’s not all. There is more than that.
Array.indonesia: Ketika kita membicarakan masakan Tiongkok, banyak orang akan langsung memikirkan \ndaging dan sayuran yang ditumis. Namun, bukan hanya itu saja. Masih ada lagi selain itu.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Appear_17
Array.english: This time, you two will compete for the dish using fish.\nGive me a Chinese-style fish dish. May the best chef win!
Array.indonesia: Kali ini, kalian berdua akan bersaing membuat hidangan yang menggunakan ikan.\nBuatkan aku hidangan ikan ala Tiongkok. Semoga koki terbaik yang menang!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Appear_18
Array.english: I heard of you and your reputation, Bancho,\nbut I will beat you with a fabulous recipe from Hong Kong.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah mendengar tentangmu dan reputasimu, Bancho,\ntapi aku akan mengalahkanmu dengan resep luar biasa dari Hong Kong.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Appear_19
Array.english: <size=35>Ow, Wang Pang just issued an official challenge.\nThis should be interesting!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wah, Wang Pang baru saja melontarkan tantangan resmi.\nIni pasti akan menarik!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Appear_20
Array.english: <size=33>You know the rules, folks! We will come back in <color=#1DFEAF>2 days</color>\nto broadcast the intense competition between the two contestants in real time!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kalian tahu aturannya, teman-teman! Kami akan kembali dalam <color=#1DFEAF>2 hari</color>\nuntuk menyiarkan persaingan sengit antara kedua kontestan secara langsung!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Appear_21
Array.english: <size=34>Stay tuned and see what\ntranspires in today’s <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color><color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Tetap pantau dan lihat apa\nyang akan terjadi di <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color><color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size> hari ini

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Leave_01
Array.english: Will you be okay?\nYou’re not familiar with Chinese cuisine, are you?
Array.indonesia: Kamu bakal baik-baik aja?\nKamu nggak paham masakan Tiongkok, kan?

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Leave_02
Array.english: I don’t need to be Chinese to compete with him.\nI will use a Chinese culinary style,
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak perlu menjadi orang Tionghoa untuk bersaing dengannya.\nAku akan menggunakan gaya masakan Tionghoa,

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Leave_03
Array.english: <size=34>but with a type of fish they have never tasted before!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>tapi dengan jenis ikan yang belum pernah mereka cicipi sebelumnya!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Leave_04
Array.english: Let’s not go overboard, Bancho.
Array.indonesia: Jangan berlebihan, Bancho.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Leave_05
Array.english: <size=35>I can’t teach him a lesson with an ordinary dish.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Aku tidak bisa memberinya pelajaran dengan hidangan biasa.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Leave_06
Array.english: If you say so.
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu bilang begitu.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Leave_07
Array.english: Bring me the ingredients I want in <color=#1DFEAF>2 days</color>.
Array.indonesia: Bawakan aku bahan-bahan yang aku inginkan dalam <color=#1DFEAF>2 hari</color>.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Leave_08
Array.english: Chinese cuisine is no problem. I will just need <color=#4AFFDB>Stargazers</color>, <color=#4AFFDB>Wheat</color>, <color=#4AFFDB>Olive Oil</color>, and <color=#4AFFDB>Eggs</color>.
Array.indonesia: Masakan Tiongkok bukan masalah. Aku hanya butuh <color=#4AFFDB>Stargazers</color>, <color=#4AFFDB>Gandum</color>, <color=#4AFFDB>Minyak Zaitun</color>, dan <color=#4AFFDB>Telur</color>.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Complete01_01
Array.english: <size=34>Hello, everyone!\nThis is <color=#F1DC2B>Yui</color> from NDC station!<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Halo, semuanya!\nIni <color=#F1DC2B>Yui</color> dari stasiun NDC!<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Complete01_02
Array.english: <size=34>Ladies and gentlemen! As you know, today is the day of the showdown in <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hadirin sekalian! Seperti yang kalian tahu, hari ini adalah hari pertarungan di <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Complete01_03
Array.english: <size=36>Bancho, are you ready?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Bancho, apakah kamu sudah siap?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Complete01_04
Array.english: <size=38>Of course.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Tentu saja.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Complete01_05
Array.english: <size=36>And Wang Pang?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Dan Wang Pang?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Complete01_06
Array.english: <size=34>The same. I can’t wait!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Sama saja. Aku tidak sabar!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Complete01_07
Array.english: Excellent!\nThen let’s begin <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color> now!
Array.indonesia: Bagus sekali!\nKalau begitu, mari kita mulai <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color> sekarang!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Win_01
Array.english: <size=36>Oh, no!\nI lost? But I am the best chef in Hong Kong!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Oh, tidak!\nAku kalah? Padahal aku koki terbaik di Hong Kong!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Win_02
Array.english: Of course, your dish was excellent, Wang Pang.
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja, hidanganmu sangat lezat, Wang Pang.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Win_03
Array.english: You used the finest ingredients for flawless taste.\nBut it wasn’t good enough to impress me.
Array.indonesia: Kamu menggunakan bahan-bahan terbaik untuk rasa yang sempurna.\nTapi itu belum cukup untuk mengesankan aku.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Win_04
Array.english: But Bancho’s dish...
Array.indonesia: Tapi hidangan Bancho...

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Win_05
Array.english: It gave me a whole new experience with a fish called stargazer. To be honest, it was my first time tasting the fish.
Array.indonesia: Hidangan itu memberiku pengalaman baru sepenuhnya dengan ikan yang disebut stargazer. Sejujurnya, ini pertama kalinya aku mencicipi ikan itu.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Win_06
Array.english: Bancho gave me a perfect blend of the interesting and fresh taste of a stargazer, and the classic taste of the sweet and sour sauce.
Array.indonesia: Bancho berhasil memadukan rasa stargazer yang unik dan segar dengan rasa klasik saus asam manis secara sempurna.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Win_07
Array.english: If we’re talking only about the taste, yours was better, Wang Pang. But I highly admire Bancho’s attempt to present a foreign taste in a familiar way.
Array.indonesia: Jika kita hanya membicarakan soal rasa, hidanganmu lebih enak, Wang Pang. Tapi aku sangat mengagumi upaya Bancho dalam menyajikan cita rasa asing dengan cara yang akrab.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Win_08
Array.english: My final verdict is Bancho. Congratulations.
Array.indonesia: Keputusan akhirku adalah Bancho. Selamat.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Win_09
Array.english: <size=35>Oh, Vincent clearly explained the reason for his decision! Bancho wins the match!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh, Vincent menjelaskan alasan keputusannya dengan jelas! Bancho memenangkan pertandingan ini!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Win_10
Array.english: Bancho? What are your thoughts?
Array.indonesia: Bancho? Apa pendapatmu?

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Win_11
Array.english: <size=32>Ah, my thoughts...</size>\n<size=28><color=#C8C8C8>I wanted to present the…</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ah, pendapat saya...</size>\n<size=28><color=#C8C8C8>Saya ingin menyajikan…</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Win_12
Array.english: <size=44>Thank you, Bancho!</size>\n<size=32>The champion saves words for more action and we love it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=44>Terima kasih, Bancho!</size>\n<size=32>Juara ini lebih memilih bertindak daripada banyak bicara, dan kami menyukainya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Win_13
Array.english: <size=33>Today’s winner of <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color> is Bancho, the defending champion! What a competition! What a judgment!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Pemenang <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color> hari ini adalah Bancho, sang juara bertahan! Kompetisi yang luar biasa! Penilaian yang luar biasa!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Win_14
Array.english: <size=38>See you next time<color=#ff61e3>♥</color>\nThis was reporter Yui!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Sampai jumpa lagi<color=#ff61e3>♥</color>\nIni reporter Yui!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Win2_01
Array.english: Amazing, Bancho. You bested Wang Pang in his area of expertise.
Array.indonesia: Luar biasa, Bancho. Kamu berhasil mengalahkan Wang Pang di bidang keahliannya.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Win2_02
Array.english: Hmm. Who cares about nationality when it comes to food, \nflavor is fair game.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Siapa yang peduli soal kebangsaan dalam hal makanan, \nrasa adalah segalanya.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Win2_03
Array.english: Why do I have this feeling that the show will return again...
Array.indonesia: Kenapa aku merasa acara ini akan kembali lagi...

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Win2_04
Array.english: <size=34>But I have full confidence in your victory.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Tapi aku sangat yakin kamu akan menang.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Win2_05
Array.english: <size=37>Speaking of the contest...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Ngomong-ngomong soal lomba...</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Win2_06
Array.english: I got some new inspirations for <color=#1DFEAF>Chinese cuisine</color> while preparing for the competition.
Array.indonesia: Aku dapat beberapa inspirasi baru untuk <color=#1DFEAF>masakan Tiongkok</color> saat mempersiapkan diri untuk lomba.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Win2_07
Array.english: <size=34>I will write them down. Help me <color=#F1DC2B>try something new</color> when you have time.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku akan menuliskannya. Bantu aku <color=#F1DC2B>mencoba sesuatu yang baru</color> kalau kamu punya waktu.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Lose_01
Array.english: <size=34>Haha! My dish has the true Mandarin spirit!\nBetter luck next time, Bancho!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Haha! Hidanganku benar-benar mencerminkan semangat Mandarin!\nSemoga lebih beruntung lain kali, Bancho!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Lose_02
Array.english: I am not specialized in Chinese cuisine,\nbut that’s no excuse.
Array.indonesia: Aku memang tidak ahli dalam masakan Tiongkok,\ntapi itu bukan alasan.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Lose_03
Array.english: Ah, champion Bancho admits his defeat!\nCheers to both contestants, but today’s winner is Wang Pang!
Array.indonesia: Ah, sang juara Bancho mengakui kekalahannya!\nSelamat untuk kedua kontestan, tapi pemenang hari ini adalah Wang Pang!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Lose_04
Array.english: Hm, too little time was given\nto show off my culinary skills. Bad things do happen.
Array.indonesia: Hm, waktu yang diberikan terlalu sedikit\nuntuk memamerkan keahlian kulinerku. Hal-hal buruk memang bisa terjadi.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Lose_05
Array.english: Give me a call if you want a rematch!
Array.indonesia: Hubungi aku kalau mau pertandingan ulang!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Lose_06
Array.english: Wang Pang won today’s <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color> contest!\nStay tuned, folks!
Array.indonesia: Wang Pang memenangkan kontes <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color> hari ini!\nTetap ikuti perkembangannya, teman-teman!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Lose_07
Array.english: <size=38>See you next time<color=#ff61e3>♥</color>\nThis was reporter Yui!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Sampai jumpa lagi<color=#ff61e3>♥</color>\nIni reporter Yui!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Fail_01
Array.english: <size=36>Bancho, are you ready?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Bancho, kamu siap?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Fail_02
Array.english: Um, actually...
Array.indonesia: Um, sebenarnya...

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Fail_03
Array.english: <size=36>What a surprise! \nThe champion has failed to bring his ingredients!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Wah, sungguh mengejutkan! \nJuara tidak membawa bahan-bahannya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Fail_04
Array.english: It will be Wang Pang’s win by default!\nBetter luck next time, BANCHO SUSHI!
Array.indonesia: Wang Pang akan menang secara otomatis!\nSemoga lebih beruntung lain kali, BANCHO SUSHI!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Fail_05
Array.english: Hm, Bancho wasn’t prepared. He didn’t have enough time to prepare what he needed. Bad things do happen.
Array.indonesia: Hm, Bancho tidak siap. Dia tidak punya cukup waktu untuk menyiapkan apa yang dibutuhkannya. Hal-hal buruk memang bisa terjadi.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Fail_06
Array.english: Give me a call if you want a rematch!
Array.indonesia: Hubungi aku kalau mau pertandingan ulang!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Fail_07
Array.english: Wang Pang won today’s <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color> contest!\nStay tuned, folks!
Array.indonesia: Wang Pang memenangkan kontes <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color> hari ini!\nTetap ikuti perkembangannya, teman-teman!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Fail_08
Array.english: <size=38>See you next time<color=#ff61e3>♥</color>\nThis was reporter Yui!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Sampai jumpa lagi<color=#ff61e3>♥</color>\nIni reporter Yui!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Revisit_Success_01
Array.english: All right, we’re at BANCHO SUSHI again!\nIs he ready this time?
Array.indonesia: Baiklah, kita kembali ke BANCHO SUSHI!\nApakah dia sudah siap kali ini?

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Revisit_Success_02
Array.english: <size=35>Of course.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Tentu saja.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Revisit_Success_03
Array.english: <size=36>And Wang Pang?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Dan Wang Pang?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Revisit_Success_04
Array.english: <size=34>The same. I can’t wait!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Sama saja. Aku tidak sabar!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Revisit_Success_05
Array.english: Excellent!\nIt looks like both contestants are ready for today’s <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color>!
Array.indonesia: Luar biasa!\nSepertinya kedua kontestan sudah siap untuk <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color> hari ini!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Revisit_Fail_01
Array.english: All right, we’re at BANCHO SUSHI again!\nIs he ready this time?
Array.indonesia: Baiklah, kita kembali lagi di BANCHO SUSHI!\nApakah dia sudah siap kali ini?

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Revisit_Fail_02
Array.english: Um, actually...
Array.indonesia: Um, sebenarnya...

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Revisit_Fail_03
Array.english: <size=36>Oh, no! The champion had trouble getting the required ingredients!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Oh, tidak! Juara mengalami kesulitan mendapatkan bahan-bahan yang dibutuhkan!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Revisit_Fail_04
Array.english: Aren’t you too laid back to win this, Bancho?
Array.indonesia: Bukankah kamu terlalu santai untuk menang kali ini, Bancho?

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Revisit_Fail_05
Array.english: Give me a call if you want a rematch!
Array.indonesia: Hubungi aku kalau mau pertandingan ulang!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Revisit_Fail_06
Array.english: Wang Pang won today’s <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color> contest!\nStay tuned, folks!
Array.indonesia: Wang Pang memenangkan kontes <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color> hari ini!\nTetap pantau terus, teman-teman!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Revisit_Fail_07
Array.english: <size=38>See you next time<color=#ff61e3>♥</color>\nThis was reporter Yui!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Sampai jumpa lagi<color=#ff61e3>♥</color>\nIni reporter Yui!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Lose_Call_01
Array.english: Hmph. Are you up for another match?
Array.indonesia: Hmph. Kamu siap untuk pertandingan lagi?

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Lose_Call_02
Array.english: I will come back <color=#1DFEAF>tomorrow</color>!
Array.indonesia: Aku akan kembali <color=#1DFEAF>besok</color>!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Lose_Call_03
Array.english: Make sure to get fully prepared.\nStart working on it now.
Array.indonesia: Pastikan kalian sudah benar-benar siap.\nMulailah mempersiapkannya sekarang.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Appear_01
Array.english: <size=34>Hello, everyone!\nThis is <color=#F1DC2B>Yui</color> from NDC station!<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Halo, semuanya!\nIni <color=#F1DC2B>Yui</color> dari stasiun NDC!<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Appear_02
Array.english: Good to see you again. I’m Vincent Yamaoka.
Array.indonesia: Senang bertemu kalian lagi. Saya Vincent Yamaoka.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Appear_03
Array.english: Here he is, appearing out of nowhere again…
Array.indonesia: Inilah dia, muncul entah dari mana lagi…

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Appear_04
Array.english: <size=34>The previous episode of <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color> was as hot as molten lava! It was truly an interesting development.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Episode sebelumnya dari <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color> sepanas lava yang meleleh! Perkembangannya benar-benar menarik.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Appear_05
Array.english: <size=35>And in today’s episode, a new challenger appears!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Dan di episode hari ini, seorang penantang baru muncul!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Appear_06
Array.english: <size=33>Let me introduce you to Alex Cooper, COOKSTA’s Platinum-ranked chef from the United Kingdom!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Izinkan saya memperkenalkan Alex Cooper, koki peringkat Platinum COOKSTA dari Inggris Raya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Appear_07
Array.english: Ah, you must be the sushi chef who beat Wang Pang \nin the last competition, yes?
Array.indonesia: Ah, Anda pasti koki sushi yang mengalahkan Wang Pang \ndalam kompetisi terakhir, bukan?

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Appear_08
Array.english: I expected a fancier restaurant than this...\nYour establishment is humble indeed!
Array.indonesia: Saya mengira restorannya akan lebih mewah dari ini...\nRestoran Anda memang sederhana sekali!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Appear_09
Array.english: Oh, the challenger is provoking the champion!\nThis will be an exciting match!
Array.indonesia: Oh, penantang ini sedang memprovokasi sang juara!\nPertandingan ini pasti akan seru!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Appear_10
Array.english: Today’s theme is...
Array.indonesia: Tema hari ini adalah...

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Appear_11
Array.english: <size=38><color=#00d98f>Fry the Sea!</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38><color=#00d98f>Goreng Lautan!</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Appear_12
Array.english: Both Japan and the United Kingdom are popular for \ntheir fried dishes.
Array.indonesia: Baik Jepang maupun Inggris Raya terkenal dengan \nhidangan gorengnya.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Appear_13
Array.english: Their dishes may look similar, but are authentic each \nin their own way!
Array.indonesia: Hidangan mereka mungkin terlihat mirip, tetapi masing-masing \nmemiliki keasliannya sendiri!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Appear_14
Array.english: Whose dish will please the palate of Vincent, the judge?\nCan you guess the winner?
Array.indonesia: Hidangan siapa yang akan memuaskan selera Vincent, sang juri?\nBisakah kalian menebak pemenangnya?

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Appear_15
Array.english: My mouth is watering already, haha<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>
Array.indonesia: Mulutku sudah ngiler, haha<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Appear_16
Array.english: Like before, we will give you <color=#1DFEAF>2 days</color>!\nI repeat. You have <color=#1DFEAF>2 days</color> to compete!
Array.indonesia: Seperti sebelumnya, kami akan memberi kalian <color=#1DFEAF>2 hari</color>!\nSaya ulangi. Kalian punya <color=#1DFEAF>2 hari</color> untuk berkompetisi!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Appear_17
Array.english: Dear audience!\nThis match will be fire!
Array.indonesia: Para penonton yang terhormat!\nPertandingan ini pasti seru!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Appear_18
Array.english: <size=34>Stay tuned and see what\ntranspires in today’s <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color><color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>
