Array.indonesia: <size=34>Tetap ikuti perkembangannya dan lihat apa\nyang terjadi di <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color><color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size> hari ini

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Leave_01
Array.english: Whew. It is an easy one this time.
Array.indonesia: Wah. Kali ini mudah sekali.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Leave_02
Array.english: Your fried sea bream or black tiger shrimp\nwill win the day easily!
Array.indonesia: Ikan kerapu goreng atau udang black tiger kalian\npasti akan menang dengan mudah!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Leave_03
Array.english: <size=38>My choice is deep-sea fish.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Pilihan saya adalah ikan laut dalam.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Leave_04
Array.english: <size=35>But why?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Tapi kenapa?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Leave_05
Array.english: They are well-known recipes\nand I don’t want to just replicate the tastes!
Array.indonesia: Itu resep-resep yang sudah terkenal\ndan saya tidak ingin sekadar meniru rasanya!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Leave_06
Array.english: I took up the kitchen knife to explore new ingredients\nand tastes of the sea.
Array.indonesia: Aku mengambil pisau dapur untuk mengeksplorasi bahan-bahan baru\ndan cita rasa laut.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Leave_07
Array.english: The flesh of deep-sea fish is usually soft and gelatinous.\nI will fry it and harden it to add flavor and texture!
Array.indonesia: Daging ikan laut dalam biasanya lembut dan kenyal.\nAku akan menggorengnya dan membuatnya lebih padat untuk menambah rasa dan tekstur!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Leave_08
Array.english: But you’re not familiar with deep fish recipes. \nWhat if Vincent doesn’t like your dish?
Array.indonesia: Tapi kamu tidak familiar dengan resep ikan laut dalam. \nBagaimana jika Vincent tidak menyukai masakanmu?

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Leave_09
Array.english: <size=35>Don’t worry.\nI will cook the best deep sea dish!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Jangan khawatir.\nAku akan memasak hidangan laut dalam terbaik!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Leave_10
Array.english: Today’s main ingredients are...
Array.indonesia: Bahan utama hari ini adalah...

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Leave_11
Array.english: <size=36><color=#1DFEAF>Cookiecutter sharks</color>, <color=#1DFEAF>vampire squids</color>, and \n<color=#1DFEAF>binocular fish</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36><color=#1DFEAF>Hiu pemotong kue</color>, <color=#1DFEAF>cumi-cumi vampir</color>, dan \n<color=#1DFEAF>ikan teropong</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Leave_12
Array.english: <size=38>The lineup is quite ambitious.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Daftar bahan ini cukup ambisius.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Leave_13
Array.english: Well, I trust your hunch, Bancho.\nI will try to secure them.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah, aku percaya instingmu, Bancho.\nAku akan berusaha mendapatkannya.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Complete01_01
Array.english: <size=34>Hello, everyone!\nThis is <color=#F1DC2B>Yui</color> from NDC station!<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Halo, semuanya!\nIni <color=#F1DC2B>Yui</color> dari stasiun NDC!<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Complete01_02
Array.english: <size=34>Ladies and gentlemen! As you know, today is the day of the final clash in <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hadirin sekalian! Seperti yang kalian ketahui, hari ini adalah hari pertarungan final di <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Complete01_03
Array.english: <size=36>Bancho, are you ready?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Bancho, apakah kamu sudah siap?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Complete01_04
Array.english: <size=38>Yes.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Ya.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Complete01_05
Array.english: <size=36>How about you, Alex?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Bagaimana denganmu, Alex?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Complete01_06
Array.english: <size=34>Ready. My fingers are uncontrollably wiggling!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Siap. Jari-jariku tak bisa diam!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Complete01_07
Array.english: Excellent!\nThen let’s begin <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color> now!
Array.indonesia: Bagus sekali!\nKalau begitu, mari kita mulai <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color> sekarang!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_01
Array.english: <size=36>What?! Alex’s fish and chips lost?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Apa?! Fish and chips Alex kalah?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_02
Array.english: <size=35>What an upset!\nMy fries are the best in the world...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Sungguh mengejutkan!\nKentang gorengku adalah yang terbaik di dunia...</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_03
Array.english: Yes, your fish and chips indeed tasted excellent.\nIncredible, actually.
Array.indonesia: Ya, fish and chips-mu memang rasanya luar biasa.\nSungguh luar biasa, sebenarnya.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_04
Array.english: <size=35>But what is the theme of this contest?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Tapi apa tema lomba ini?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_05
Array.english: The theme? It’s fried dishes.
Array.indonesia: Temanya? Hidangan goreng.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_06
Array.english: Not quite right!\nThe theme for this contest was Fry the Sea!
Array.indonesia: Belum tepat!\nTema lomba ini adalah Fry the Sea!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_07
Array.english: Masterfully fried cod is good on its own,\nbut that alone does not represent the sea.
Array.indonesia: Ikan cod yang digoreng dengan sempurna memang enak dimakan begitu saja,\ntapi itu saja tidak mewakili laut.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_08
Array.english: <size=33>However, Bancho’s dish was...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Namun, hidangan Bancho itu...</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_09
Array.english: <size=36>What kind of soy sauce did you use?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Kecap apa yang kamu gunakan?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_10
Array.english: I added chopped green laver and added it to normal soy sauce.
Array.indonesia: Saya menambahkan rumput laut hijau cincang ke dalam kecap asin biasa.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_11
Array.english: <size=32>As I expected. I liked your shark and squid combination, \nbut the highlight was your soy sauce recipe!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Seperti yang saya duga. Saya suka kombinasi hiu dan cumi-cumi Anda, \ntetapi yang paling menonjol adalah resep kecap asin Anda!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_12
Array.english: The soy sauce enriched with the flavor of the sea\nbetter represented the taste of the sea! What an impressive flavor!
Array.indonesia: Kecap asin yang diperkaya dengan cita rasa laut\nlebih mewakili rasa laut! Rasa yang sangat mengesankan!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_13
Array.english: Your dish gave me a feeling of exploring the sea,\nfrom the coastal waters to the deep sea. That was a fabulous adventure!
Array.indonesia: Hidanganmu membuatku merasa seolah-olah sedang menjelajahi laut,\nmulai dari perairan pesisir hingga laut dalam. Itu adalah petualangan yang luar biasa!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_14
Array.english: The texture of your fried dish was good as well,\nbut the game changer was your soy sauce!
Array.indonesia: Tekstur hidangan gorengmu juga bagus,\ntapi yang benar-benar mengubah segalanya adalah kecapmu!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_15
Array.english: <size=34>Alas...\nMy perfect fries were not enough to satisfy the judge...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Sayangnya...\nKentang goreng sempurnaku tidak cukup untuk memuaskan juri...</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_16
Array.english: <size=40>It was a close match!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Pertandingannya sangat ketat!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_17
Array.english: <size=38>Let us hear what Bancho has to say!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Mari kita dengarkan apa yang dikatakan Bancho!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_18
Array.english: <size=35>You need to be careful when making the soy sauce.\nThat’s...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Kamu harus hati-hati saat membuat kecap.\nItu...</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_19
Array.english: <size=44>Thank you, Bancho!</size>\n<size=34>The champion prefers action over words and we love it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=44>Terima kasih, Bancho!</size>\n<size=34>Juara ini lebih memilih tindakan daripada kata-kata, dan kami menyukainya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_20
Array.english: <size=33>And it’s time to wrap up today’s episode of <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color>. Today, Bancho won the contest! This is-</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Dan saatnya mengakhiri episode hari ini dari <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color>. Hari ini, Bancho memenangkan kontes! Ini adalah-</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_21
Array.english: Wait a moment.
Array.indonesia: Tunggu sebentar.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_22
Array.english: I am pleased by today’s contest and\nI would like to give him a piece of advice.
Array.indonesia: Saya senang dengan kontes hari ini dan\nsaya ingin memberinya sebuah nasihat.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_23
Array.english: You, I see your menu is expanding,\nbut the drinks you offer stay the same, yes?
Array.indonesia: Kamu, saya lihat menu kamu semakin beragam,\ntapi minuman yang kamu tawarkan tetap sama, ya?

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_24
Array.english: <size=38>Because I am a chef, not a barkeep.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Karena saya seorang koki, bukan bartender.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_25
Array.english: You said the same thing before.\nDining is a comprehensive experience.
Array.indonesia: Kamu sudah pernah mengatakan hal yang sama sebelumnya.\nMakan adalah pengalaman yang menyeluruh.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_26
Array.english: What do you pair up with your pasta? A glass of wine,\na glass of cola, or just a glass of water? It will significantly change the dining experience.
Array.indonesia: Apa yang kamu padukan dengan pasta-mu? Segelas anggur,\nsegelas cola, atau sekadar segelas air? Hal itu akan sangat mengubah pengalaman bersantap.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_27
Array.english: Your place cannot satisfy the various tastes of customers \nwith a limited selection of drinks.
Array.indonesia: Tempatmu tidak bisa memuaskan selera beragam pelanggan \ndengan pilihan minuman yang terbatas.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_28
Array.english: <size=38>This is my gift for you. It’s a <color=#F1DC2B>Cocktail Dispenser</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Ini hadiahku untukmu. Ini adalah <color=#F1DC2B>Dispenser Koktail</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_29
Array.english: Mm? Cocktails?\nThey don’t go well with sushi though.
Array.indonesia: Hmm? Koktail?\nTapi koktail tidak cocok dengan sushi.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_30
Array.english: <size=38>Oh, please. Not every cocktail is sweet.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Ah, ayolah. Tidak semua koktail itu manis.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_31
Array.english: You can make interesting cocktails using sake as a base.
Array.indonesia: Kamu bisa membuat koktail yang menarik dengan menggunakan sake sebagai bahan dasarnya.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_32
Array.english: Well, of course, you are not in charge of drinks.\nThat hungry-looking guy... Hey! Yes, you!
Array.indonesia: Yah, tentu saja, kamu bukan yang bertanggung jawab atas minuman.\nPria yang terlihat lapar itu... Hei! Ya, kamu!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_33
Array.english: <size=40>Me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Aku?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_34
Array.english: I will leave this <color=#F1DC2B>Cocktail Dispenser</color> here.\nYou find out how best to use it.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan tinggalkan <color=#F1DC2B>Dispenser Koktail</color> ini di sini.\nKamu cari tahu cara terbaik menggunakannya.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_35
Array.english: <size=36>Oh, a gift from Vincent!\nA <color=#F1DC2B>Cocktail Dispenser</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Oh, hadiah dari Vincent!\nSebuah <color=#F1DC2B>Dispenser Koktail</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_36
Array.english: BANCHO SUSHI will offer more menu items soon!\nAnd we can’t wait to see what will be added to its menu!
Array.indonesia: BANCHO SUSHI akan segera menawarkan lebih banyak pilihan menu!\nDan kami tidak sabar untuk melihat apa saja yang akan ditambahkan ke menunya!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_37
Array.english: <size=38>See you next time<color=#ff61e3>♥</color>\nThis was reporter Yui!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Sampai jumpa lagi<color=#ff61e3>♥</color>\nIni reporter Yui!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win2_01
Array.english: Cocktails...
Array.indonesia: Koktail...

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win2_02
Array.english: This dispenser is designed to serve <color=#1DFEAF>three different cocktails</color> \nat the same time.
Array.indonesia: Dispenser ini dirancang untuk menyajikan <color=#1DFEAF>tiga jenis koktail yang berbeda</color> \nsecara bersamaan.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win2_03
Array.english: Well, I am not familiar with cocktails, \nbut come to think of it...
Array.indonesia: Yah, aku memang tidak terlalu paham soal koktail, \ntapi kalau dipikir-pikir...

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win2_04
Array.english: <size=36>This is like a drink version of omakase.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Ini seperti versi minuman dari omakase.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win2_05
Array.english: Yeah, that makes sense.\nIt’s our job to serve the drinks customers want.
Array.indonesia: Ya, itu masuk akal.\nTugas kita adalah menyajikan minuman yang diinginkan pelanggan.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win2_06
Array.english: <size=33>Why don’t we make more money by adding \ncocktails to the menu?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kenapa kita tidak menambah \nkoktail ke dalam menu untuk mendapatkan lebih banyak uang?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Lose_01
Array.english: <size=34>Hahaha! Your gelatinous fish\nis no match for my perfect fish and chips!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hahaha! Ikan jeli-mu\ntidak ada apa-apanya dibandingkan fish and chips-ku yang sempurna!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Lose_02
Array.english: I admit that my fried dishes are not as good as my sushi.\nCongratulations.
Array.indonesia: Aku akui hidangan gorenganku tidak sebagus sushiku.\nSelamat.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Lose_03
Array.english: Ah, champion Bancho admits his defeat!\nCheers to both contestants, but today’s winner is Alex!
Array.indonesia: Ah, juara Bancho mengakui kekalahannya!\nSelamat untuk kedua kontestan, tapi pemenang hari ini adalah Alex!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Lose_04
Array.english: Heh, my expectations were high from the previous match. All right.
Array.indonesia: Heh, ekspektasiku tinggi setelah pertandingan sebelumnya. Baiklah.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Lose_05
Array.english: Give me a call if you want a rematch!
Array.indonesia: Hubungi aku kalau mau pertandingan ulang!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Lose_06
Array.english: Today’s winner is Alex Cooper! \nStay tuned to <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color> and find out what will happen in the next episode!
Array.indonesia: Pemenang hari ini adalah Alex Cooper! \nTetap ikuti <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color> dan temukan apa yang akan terjadi di episode berikutnya!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Lose_07
Array.english: <size=38>See you next time<color=#ff61e3>♥</color>\nThis was reporter Yui!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Sampai jumpa lagi<color=#ff61e3>♥</color>\nIni reporter Yui!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Fail_01
Array.english: <size=36>Bancho, are you ready?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Bancho, sudah siap?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Fail_02
Array.english: Um, actually...
Array.indonesia: Um, sebenarnya...

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Fail_03
Array.english: <size=36>What a surprise! \nThe champion has failed to bring his ingredients!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Wah, sungguh mengejutkan! \nJuara gagal membawa bahan-bahannya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Fail_04
Array.english: It will be Alex’s win by default!\nToo bad for BANCHO SUSHI!
Array.indonesia: Alex akan menang secara otomatis!\nSayang sekali untuk BANCHO SUSHI!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Fail_05
Array.english: Hm, Bancho wasn’t ready for it.\nHe didn’t have enough time to prepare what he needed. Bad things do happen.
Array.indonesia: Hm, Bancho tidak siap menghadapi ini.\nDia tidak punya cukup waktu untuk menyiapkan apa yang dibutuhkannya. Hal-hal buruk memang bisa terjadi.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Fail_06
Array.english: Give me a call if you want a rematch!
Array.indonesia: Hubungi aku kalau kamu mau pertandingan ulang!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Fail_07
Array.english: Today’s winner is Alex Cooper! Stay tuned to <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color>\nand find out what will happen in the next episode!
Array.indonesia: Pemenang hari ini adalah Alex Cooper! Tetap ikuti <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color>\ndan temukan apa yang akan terjadi di episode berikutnya!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Fail_08
Array.english: <size=38>See you next time<color=#ff61e3>♥</color>\nThis was reporter Yui!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Sampai jumpa lagi<color=#ff61e3>♥</color>\nIni reporter Yui!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Revisit_Success_01
Array.english: All right, we’re at BANCHO SUSHI again!\nIs he ready this time?
Array.indonesia: Baiklah, kita kembali ke BANCHO SUSHI!\nApakah dia sudah siap kali ini?

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Revisit_Success_02
Array.english: <size=35>Of course.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Tentu saja.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Revisit_Success_03
Array.english: <size=36>How about you, Alex?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Bagaimana denganmu, Alex?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Revisit_Success_04
Array.english: <size=34>I am ready as always. I can’t wait!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku siap seperti biasa. Aku nggak sabar!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Revisit_Success_05
Array.english: Excellent!\nIt looks like both contestants are ready for today’s <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color>!
Array.indonesia: Bagus sekali!\nSepertinya kedua kontestan sudah siap untuk <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color> hari ini!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Revisit_Fail_01
Array.english: All right, we’re at BANCHO SUSHI again!\nIs he ready this time?
Array.indonesia: Baiklah, kita kembali lagi di BANCHO SUSHI!\nApakah dia sudah siap kali ini?

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Revisit_Fail_02
Array.english: Um, actually...
Array.indonesia: Um, sebenarnya...

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Revisit_Fail_03
Array.english: <size=36>Oh, no! The champion had trouble getting the required ingredients!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Astaga! Sang juara kesulitan mendapatkan bahan-bahan yang dibutuhkan!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Revisit_Fail_04
Array.english: Aren’t you being a bit too laid back to win this thing, Bancho?
Array.indonesia: Bukankah kamu terlalu santai untuk bisa memenangkan kompetisi ini, Bancho?

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Revisit_Fail_05
Array.english: Give me a call if you want a rematch!
Array.indonesia: Hubungi aku kalau kamu mau pertandingan ulang!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Revisit_Fail_06
Array.english: Today’s winner is Alex Cooper!\n Stay tuned to <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color> and find out what will happen in the next episode!
Array.indonesia: Pemenang hari ini adalah Alex Cooper!\n Tetap ikuti <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color> dan temukan apa yang akan terjadi di episode berikutnya!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Revisit_Fail_07
Array.english: <size=38>See you next time<color=#ff61e3>♥</color>\nThis was reporter Yui!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Sampai jumpa lagi<color=#ff61e3>♥</color>\nIni reporter Yui!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Lose_Call_01
Array.english: Hmph. Are you up for another match?
Array.indonesia: Hmph. Kamu siap untuk pertandingan lagi?

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Lose_Call_02
Array.english: I will come back <color=#1DFEAF>tomorrow</color>!
Array.indonesia: Aku akan kembali <color=#1DFEAF>besok</color>!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Lose_Call_03
Array.english: Make sure to get fully prepared.\nStart working on it now.
Array.indonesia: Pastikan kamu sudah benar-benar siap.\nMulailah mempersiapkannya sekarang.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear_01
Array.english: <size=34>Hello, everyone!\nThis is <color=#F1DC2B>Yui</color> from NDC station!<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Halo, semuanya!\nIni <color=#F1DC2B>Yui</color> dari stasiun NDC!<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear_02
Array.english: We have a very special guest today!
Array.indonesia: Hari ini kita kedatangan tamu istimewa!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear_03
Array.english: As far as we know, our guest, in an ill-fated relationship \nwith Bancho, was a has-be...
Array.indonesia: Sejauh yang kita tahu, tamu kita ini, yang pernah menjalin hubungan naas \ndengan Bancho, dulunya adalah...

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear_04
Array.english: <size=34>I mean, legendary actress!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Maksudku, aktris legendaris!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear02_01
Array.english: <size=38>Loigi!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Loigi!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear02_02
Array.english: <size=35>Excuse me. The name is <color=#F1DC2B>Lois</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Maaf. Namaku <color=#F1DC2B>Lois</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear02_03
Array.english: Long time no see, Bancho.\nThe last time I saw you, you owned a restaurant at a five-star hotel, not this kind of shabby restaurant.
Array.indonesia: Lama tidak bertemu, Bancho.\nTerakhir kali aku melihatmu, kamu memiliki restoran di hotel bintang lima, bukan restoran kumuh seperti ini.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear02_04
Array.english: <size=33>Shark dishes didn't sell well or something?\nHahaha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Mungkin hidangan hiu tidak laku atau gimana?\nHahaha!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear02_05
Array.english: She’s rude.\nIs she the restaurant critic who defamed you?
Array.indonesia: Dia kasar.\nApakah dia kritikus restoran yang mencemarkan nama baikmu?

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear02_06
Array.english: You heard stories from Miss Yoshie?\nRight. That’s she.
Array.indonesia: Kamu dengar cerita dari Nona Yoshie?\nBenar. Itulah dia.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear02_07
Array.english: What brought you to a lowly place like this?\nI thought you review only prestigious restaurants?
Array.indonesia: Apa yang membawa kamu ke tempat rendahan seperti ini?\nKupikir kamu hanya mengulas restoran-restoran bergengsi?

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear02_08
Array.english: Well, my previous review of your restaurant...\nIt became a thorn in my side.
Array.indonesia: Nah, ulasan saya sebelumnya tentang restoranmu...\nItu menjadi duri di sisi saya.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear02_09
Array.english: My reputation suffered from comments saying I was \n‘closed-minded,’ ‘disqualified as a taster,’ et cetera...
Array.indonesia: Reputasiku tercoreng oleh komentar-komentar yang menyebutku \n‘berpikiran sempit,’ ‘tidak layak jadi penilai rasa,’ dan sebagainya...

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear02_10
Array.english: And my career as a restaurant critic has declined since then.
Array.indonesia: Dan karierku sebagai kritikus restoran pun merosot sejak saat itu.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear02_11
Array.english: <size=36>All because you served me a disgusting dish…!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Semua itu karena kamu menyajikan hidangan yang menjijikkan kepadaku…!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear02_12
Array.english: She tried to make a comeback in movies, \nbut that didn't go well either. Peccato…
Array.indonesia: Dia mencoba bangkit kembali di dunia film, \ntapi itu pun tidak berjalan lancar. Sayang sekali…

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear02_13
Array.english: <size=36>No need to speak of that!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Tak perlu membicarakan hal itu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear03_01
Array.english: Let me introduce <color=#F1DC2B>Pastro Antogiovani</color>. I brought him from Italy\nto teach you what culinary elegance really means.
Array.indonesia: Izinkan saya memperkenalkan <color=#F1DC2B>Pastro Antogiovani</color>. Aku membawanya dari Italia\nuntuk mengajarkanmu apa arti sebenarnya dari keanggunan kuliner.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear03_02
Array.english: Ciao, amico. I heard a lot about you. An oddball of a chef\nwho uses strange ingredients to draw attention.
Array.indonesia: Ciao, amico. Aku sudah banyak mendengar tentangmu. Seorang koki yang aneh\nyang menggunakan bahan-bahan aneh untuk menarik perhatian.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear03_03
Array.english: You are just a showman and I will prove that today.
Array.indonesia: Kamu hanyalah seorang pencari sensasi dan aku akan membuktikannya hari ini.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear03_04
Array.english: Why do chefs and cooks stick to certain ingredients? \nBecause they are time-tested and proven!
Array.indonesia: Mengapa para koki dan juru masak tetap menggunakan bahan-bahan tertentu? \nKarena bahan-bahan itu sudah teruji oleh waktu dan terbukti!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear03_05
Array.english: Replacing time-tested ingredients arbitrarily doesn’t \nmake a good dish. Your dishes are disgusting.
Array.indonesia: Mengganti bahan-bahan yang sudah teruji secara sembarangan tidak \nakan menghasilkan hidangan yang enak. Hidanganmu menjijikkan.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear03_06
Array.english: I will show you. You will learn why Italian cuisine has led the world for centuries.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan tunjukkan padamu. Kamu akan belajar mengapa masakan Italia telah memimpin dunia selama berabad-abad.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear03_07
Array.english: <size=36>Oh! Drama from the past!\nI can’t wait to see how it will develop!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Oh! Drama dari masa lalu!\nAku tidak sabar melihat bagaimana ini akan berkembang!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear03_08
Array.english: <size=35>Well, today’s theme is...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Nah, tema hari ini adalah...</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear03_09
Array.english: <size=40>Pasta!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Pasta!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear03_10
Array.english: Why does the subject always benefit the challenger!
Array.indonesia: Kenapa topiknya selalu menguntungkan sang penantang!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear03_11
Array.english: <size=33>A clash between two maestros!\nLet’s find out whom Vincent will choose!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Pertarungan antara dua maestro!\nAyo kita lihat siapa yang akan dipilih Vincent!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear03_12
Array.english: <size=35>As always, the contest will begin in <color=#1DFEAF>2 days</color>.\nWe will meet here in 2 days!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Seperti biasa, kompetisi akan dimulai dalam <color=#1DFEAF>2 hari</color>.\nKita akan bertemu di sini dalam 2 hari!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear03_13
Array.english: <size=34>Stay tuned and see what\ntranspires in today’s <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color><color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Tetap ikuti perkembangannya dan lihat apa yang\nterjadi dalam <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color><color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size> hari ini

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Leave_01
Array.english: Pasta?! Isn’t it too one-sided? \nThat Italian chef is definitely at an advantage.
Array.indonesia: Pasta?! Bukankah ini terlalu sepihak? \nKoki Italia itu pasti lebih diuntungkan.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Leave_02
Array.english: I saw this show on TV, and found out that one of the sponsors of this show was the <color=#1DFEAF>B&C Company</color>.
Array.indonesia: Aku menonton acara ini di TV, dan ternyata salah satu sponsor acaranya adalah <color=#1DFEAF>Perusahaan B&C</color>.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Leave_03
Array.english: The <color=#1DFEAF>B&C Company</color>...\nThe famous restaurant franchise?
Array.indonesia: <color=#1DFEAF>Perusahaan B&C</color>...\nWaralaba restoran terkenal itu?

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Leave_04
Array.english: Their restaurants are all good.\nSo what is the problem?
Array.indonesia: Restoran-restoran mereka semuanya enak.\nJadi, apa masalahnya?

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Leave_05
Array.english: Of course, they serve good food.\nUse fresh ingredients as well. But...
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja, mereka menyajikan makanan yang enak.\nMereka juga menggunakan bahan-bahan segar. Tapi...

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Leave_06
Array.english: <size=35>...But?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>...But?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Leave_07
Array.english: <size=36>The letter C in B&C represents <color=#F1DC2B>Crawford</color>. \nThat’s the problem.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Huruf C dalam B&C mewakili <color=#F1DC2B>Crawford</color>. \nItulah masalahnya.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Leave_08
Array.english: <size=37>What?! It’s Lois Crawford’s company!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Apa?! Itu perusahaan milik Lois Crawford!?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Leave_09
Array.english: It’s her family business to be exact.\nAnd she will one day inherit it.
Array.indonesia: Tepatnya, itu bisnis keluarganya.\nDan suatu hari nanti dia akan mewarisinya.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Leave_10
Array.english: I see. That’s why she is quite knowledgeable \nin cooking for an actress.
Array.indonesia: Begitu. Itulah mengapa dia cukup ahli \ndalam memasak untuk ukuran seorang aktris.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Leave_11
Array.english: I bet she wanted to get back at you using the show!
Array.indonesia: Aku yakin dia ingin membalas dendam padamu lewat acara itu!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Leave_12
Array.english: Quite possible.
Array.indonesia: Sangat mungkin.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Leave_13
Array.english: Still, all she can do is select the contest theme.\nAfter all, it’s Vincent’s call that matters in the end.
Array.indonesia: Meski begitu, yang bisa dia lakukan hanyalah memilih tema lomba.\nLagipula, pada akhirnya keputusan Vincent-lah yang menentukan.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Leave_14
Array.english: His palate doesn’t lie.\nI have a chance to win if I am well prepared.
Array.indonesia: Selera makannya tidak pernah salah.\nAku punya peluang menang jika aku mempersiapkan diri dengan baik.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Leave_15
Array.english: I will cook squid and shrimp this time. \nBring me some <color=#1DFEAF>Humboldt Squids</color>, <color=#1DFEAF>White Shrimp</color>, <color=#1DFEAF>Wheat</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>Garlic</color>.
Array.indonesia: Kali ini aku akan memasak cumi-cumi dan udang. \nTolong bawakan aku <color=#1DFEAF>Cumi-cumi Humboldt</color>, <color=#1DFEAF>Udang Putih</color>, <color=#1DFEAF>Gandum</color>, dan <color=#1DFEAF>Bawang Putih</color>.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Leave_16
Array.english: <color=#1DFEAF>Humboldt squids</color> are nocturnal predators.\nYou need to dive at <color=#F1DC2B>night</color> to hunt them.
Array.indonesia: <color=#1DFEAF>Cumi-cumi Humboldt</color> adalah predator nokturnal.\nKamu harus menyelam pada <color=#F1DC2B>malam hari</color> untuk memburunya.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Leave_17
Array.english: I see.
Array.indonesia: Begitu ya.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Leave_18
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(Hm. This contest will not be easy for Bancho.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Hm. Kontes ini tidak akan mudah bagi Bancho.)</color>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Complete01_01
Array.english: <size=34>Hello, everyone!\nThis is <color=#F1DC2B>Yui</color> from NDC station!<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Halo, semuanya!\nIni <color=#F1DC2B>Yui</color> dari stasiun NDC!<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Complete01_02
Array.english: Today is the day we've all been waiting for!\nWith whose victory will this longstanding conflict end?
Array.indonesia: Hari ini adalah hari yang kita semua tunggu-tunggu!\nKemenangan siapa yang akan mengakhiri konflik berkepanjangan ini?

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Complete01_03
Array.english: <size=36>Bancho, are you ready?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Bancho, apakah kamu siap?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Complete01_04
Array.english: <size=38>Yes.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Ya.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Complete01_05
Array.english: <size=36>Pastro?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Pastro?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Complete01_06
Array.english: Sono pronto. Let’s get it started.
Array.indonesia: Sono pronto. Ayo kita mulai.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Complete01_07
Array.english: Excellent!\nThen let’s begin <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color> now!
Array.indonesia: Bagus sekali!\nKalau begitu, mari kita mulai <color=#00d98f>Tantangan◆si Koki</color> sekarang!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_AngryOut_01
Array.english: Mamma mia! I can’t believe it!\nI, Pastro Antogiovani, defeated in a pasta contest?
Array.indonesia: Mamma mia! Aku tidak percaya!\nAku, Pastro Antogiovani, kalah dalam lomba pasta?

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_AngryOut_02
Array.english: I can’t accept the judge’s call. \nThis show is lame and not worth my time. ORRIBILE.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak bisa menerima keputusan juri. \nAcara ini payah dan tidak layak untuk waktuku. ORRIBILE.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_01
Array.english: Tsk, that guy is hot-tempered.\nHis carbonara was fantastic though. It was unbelievable.
Array.indonesia: Ckck, cowok itu emang gampang marah.\nTapi carbonara buatannya luar biasa. Sungguh tak terbayangkan.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_02
Array.english: I liked the combination of salty guanciale and \nsoft yolk sauce...It was heavenly.
Array.indonesia: Aku suka perpaduan guanciale yang asin dan \nsaus kuning telur yang lembut... Rasanya surgawi.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_03
Array.english: <size=36>Then why didn’t he win, Vincent?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Lalu kenapa dia nggak menang, Vincent?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_04
Array.english: Ms. Lois. Do you know why squid ink\nis used in dishes?
Array.indonesia: Nona Lois. Tahukah Anda mengapa tinta cumi-cumi\ndigunakan dalam masakan?

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_05
Array.english: What? Isn’t that for the color?\nWhy bother making the color like that though?
Array.indonesia: Apa? Bukankah itu untuk warnanya?\nTapi, mengapa repot-repot membuat warnanya seperti itu?

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_06
Array.english: Not really, Ms. Lois.
Array.indonesia: Sebenarnya tidak, Nona Lois.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_07
Array.english: The visual is only a part of the reason.\nSquid ink is reminiscent of the taste of nature's seawater.
Array.indonesia: Aspek visual hanyalah sebagian dari alasannya.\nTinta cumi-cumi mengingatkan pada rasa air laut yang alami.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_08
Array.english: When I tasted Bancho’s pasta,\nI saw the dark and quiet sea.
Array.indonesia: Saat aku mencicipi pasta Bancho,\naku membayangkan laut yang gelap dan sunyi.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_09
Array.english: Black pasta...\nAnd nocturnal sea creatures dotting the black sea.
Array.indonesia: Pasta hitam...\nDan makhluk laut malam yang bertebaran di laut hitam itu.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_10
Array.english: <size=34>I felt like diving into\nthe dark, quiet sea naked at night!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Saya merasa ingin menyelam ke dalam\nlaut yang gelap dan sunyi itu dalam keadaan telanjang di malam hari!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_11
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(Why naked though...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Tapi kenapa harus telanjang sih...)</color>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_12
Array.english: ‘Tastiness’ is a very subjective experience after all.\nEven for a critic like myself. It’s never easy to be objective.
Array.indonesia: ‘Kelezatan’ pada dasarnya adalah pengalaman yang sangat subjektif.\nBahkan bagi seorang kritikus seperti saya. Tidak pernah mudah untuk bersikap objektif.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_13
Array.english: I liked the taste of both dishes equally.
Array.indonesia: Saya menyukai rasa kedua hidangan itu sama-sama.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_14
Array.english: However, I gave more points to Bancho for his near-perfect representation of the theme in every nook and cranny of his dish.
Array.indonesia: Namun, saya memberikan poin lebih banyak kepada Bancho karena ia berhasil menggambarkan tema dengan hampir sempurna di setiap sudut dan celah hidangannya.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_15
Array.english: Your reasoning is so absurd!
Array.indonesia: Alasanmu sungguh tidak masuk akal!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_16
Array.english: <size=34>You do know who is the biggest sponsor of your program, don’t you?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kamu tahu siapa sponsor terbesar programmu, kan?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_17
Array.english: <size=38>I do know!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Aku tahu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_18
Array.english: <size=33><color=#F1DC2B>Nolan Crawford</color>…\nThe chairman of the B&C Group, who is your father.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33><color=#F1DC2B>Nolan Crawford</color>…\nKetua B&C Group, yang merupakan ayahmu.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_19
Array.english: He is also my Sensei.
Array.indonesia: Dia juga Sensei-ku.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_20
Array.english: <size=34>Y-you know my father personally? \nHow is that possible?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>K-kamu kenal ayahku secara pribadi? \nBagaimana mungkin?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_VincentTalk_01
Array.english: When I was young,\nI worked at your father’s restaurant in New York.
Array.indonesia: Saat aku masih muda,\naku bekerja di restoran ayahmu di New York.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_VincentTalk_02
Array.english: Back then, I was nothing but an inexperienced apprentice cook. I was lucky to be hired by your father.
Array.indonesia: Saat itu, saya hanyalah seorang magang koki yang belum berpengalaman. Saya beruntung bisa dipekerjakan oleh ayahmu.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_VincentTalk_03
Array.english: My first job was cooking omelets.
Array.indonesia: Pekerjaan pertama saya adalah memasak omelet.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_VincentTalk_04
Array.english: Although egg is a pretty common ingredient,\nit is one of the hardest to master.
Array.indonesia: Meskipun telur adalah bahan yang cukup umum,\ntelur adalah salah satu bahan yang paling sulit untuk dikuasai.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_VincentTalk_05
Array.english: It’s very hard to time the perfect moment to flip the omelet in a frying pan. I was struggling to figure that out.
Array.indonesia: Sangat sulit menentukan waktu yang tepat untuk membalik omelet di wajan. Saya kesulitan memahami hal itu.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_VincentTalk_06
Array.english: And...
Array.indonesia: Dan...

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_VincentTalk_07
Array.english: Someone tapped my shoulder with a smile on his face.
Array.indonesia: Seseorang menepuk bahu saya sambil tersenyum.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_VincentTalk_08
Array.english: <size=33>It was your father, <color=#F1DC2B>Nolan Crawford</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Itu adalah ayahmu, <color=#F1DC2B>Nolan Crawford</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_VincentTalk_09
Array.english: He kindly taught me when and how to better flip the egg.
Array.indonesia: Dengan ramah, dia mengajari saya kapan dan bagaimana cara membalik telur dengan lebih baik.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_VincentTalk_10
Array.english: He, the restaurant owner, didn’t mind spending his precious time teaching a new hire.
Array.indonesia: Dia, sang pemilik restoran, tidak keberatan menghabiskan waktu berharganya untuk mengajari seorang karyawan baru.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win2_01
Array.english: His passion and creativity toward food were truly inspirational.
Array.indonesia: Semangat dan kreativitasnya terhadap makanan sungguh menginspirasi.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win2_02
Array.english: He was always looking for new tastes and experimented with new recipes. He failed more times than I can remember, but he would succeed in the end.
Array.indonesia: Dia selalu mencari cita rasa baru dan bereksperimen dengan resep-resep baru. Dia gagal berkali-kali hingga aku tak bisa mengingatnya, tapi pada akhirnya dia akan berhasil.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win2_03
Array.english: I see...
Array.indonesia: Begitu ya...

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win2_04
Array.english: He is now an entrepreneur of a large corporation,\nbut I believe his passion would never change. I can feel it.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang dia adalah pengusaha di sebuah perusahaan besar,\ntapi aku yakin semangatnya takkan pernah berubah. Aku bisa merasakannya.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win2_05
Array.english: Ms. Lois.\nWhy don’t you try Bancho’s pasta yourself?
Array.indonesia: Nona Lois.\nMengapa Anda tidak mencoba pasta Bancho sendiri?

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win2_06
Array.english: Well, if you insist.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah, kalau Anda memaksa.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_01
Array.english: <size=34>…I admit I was prejudiced.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>…Saya akui saya sempat berprasangka buruk.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_02
Array.english: <size=36>This pasta is... incredible.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Pasta ini... luar biasa.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_03
Array.english: It’s not just the visual.\nIt carries the natural flavor of each ingredient.
Array.indonesia: Bukan hanya penampilannya.\nPasta ini juga menghadirkan rasa alami dari setiap bahan.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_04
Array.english: And I criticized his dish without even trying it.
Array.indonesia: Dan aku mengkritik hidangannya tanpa mencobanya sama sekali.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_05
Array.english: I am not worthy to be a restaurant critic.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak layak menjadi kritikus restoran.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_06
Array.english: <size=34>Don’t blame yourself.\nWe just have a different philosophy about food.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Jangan menyalahkan dirimu sendiri.\nKita hanya memiliki filosofi yang berbeda tentang makanan.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_07
Array.english: <size=32>Bancho?\nI know it’s a rather abrupt offer, but...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Bancho?\nAku tahu ini tawaran yang agak mendadak, tapi...</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_08
Array.english: <size=35>Would you be interested in opening a <color=#F1DC2B>branch</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Apakah kamu tertarik untuk membuka <color=#F1DC2B>cabang</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_09
Array.english: <size=40>A branch?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Cabang?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_10
Array.english: Yes.\nAnother <color=#F1DC2B>BANCHO SUSHI</color>.
Array.indonesia: Ya.\n<color=#F1DC2B>BANCHO SUSHI</color> lainnya.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_11
Array.english: Clearly there are many people who\ndon’t understand your food philosophy.
Array.indonesia: Jelas ada banyak orang yang\ntidak memahami filosofi makanan Anda.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_12
Array.english: But if they taste your food at least once,\nthey will wake up to a new dimension of food.
Array.indonesia: Namun, jika mereka mencicipi makanan Anda setidaknya sekali,\nmereka akan menyadari dimensi baru dalam makanan.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_13
Array.english: I want them to have that mind-blowing opportunity.
Array.indonesia: Saya ingin mereka mendapatkan kesempatan yang luar biasa itu.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_14
Array.english: <size=33>But your current restaurant is too small.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Tapi restoran Anda saat ini terlalu kecil.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_15
Array.english: It’s big enough for me.
Array.indonesia: Cukup besar bagi saya.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_16
Array.english: Your restaurant is already widely known.\nPeople will visit your place in droves sooner or later.
Array.indonesia: Restoran Anda sudah terkenal luas.\nOrang-orang akan berbondong-bondong mengunjungi tempat Anda cepat atau lambat.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_17
Array.english: You need to be prepared to maintain the quality \nof the food you serve.
Array.indonesia: Anda harus siap untuk menjaga kualitas \nmakanan yang Anda sajikan.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_18
Array.english: But if he opens a branch, it will be harder for him \nto control the food quality.
Array.indonesia: Tapi kalau dia buka cabang, bakal lebih sulit baginya \nuntuk mengontrol kualitas makanannya.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_19
Array.english: He has staff members\nwho sincerely follow his philosophy, right?
Array.indonesia: Dia punya staf\nyang dengan tulus mengikuti filosofinya, kan?

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_20
Array.english: They can be the <color=#1DFEAF>manager</color> of the branch.
Array.indonesia: Mereka bisa jadi <color=#1DFEAF>manajer</color> cabang itu.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_21
Array.english: Manager you say...
Array.indonesia: Manajer, katamu...

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_22
Array.english: Don’t worry. Trust your staff. They know what to do\nto live up to the reputation you built.
Array.indonesia: Jangan khawatir. Percayalah pada staf Anda. Mereka tahu apa yang harus dilakukan\nuntuk mempertahankan reputasi yang telah Anda bangun.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_23
Array.english: Trust your staff and let more people taste your food.
Array.indonesia: Percayalah pada staf Anda dan biarkan lebih banyak orang mencicipi makanan Anda.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_24
Array.english: But I don’t have a management system and\nfunds to open a branch yet.
Array.indonesia: Tapi saya belum memiliki sistem manajemen dan\ndana untuk membuka cabang.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_25
Array.english: <size=34>That... I can help you with.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Itu... Aku bisa membantumu.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_26
Array.english: I know how to operate a franchise. I was well educated in that matter by my father. I have the skills and the money for this.
Array.indonesia: Aku tahu cara mengelola waralaba. Aku sudah diajari dengan baik oleh ayahku soal itu. Aku punya keterampilan dan uang untuk ini.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_27
Array.english: And I won’t ask anything in return.\nConsider this your reward for winning the contest.
Array.indonesia: Dan aku tidak akan meminta imbalan apa pun.\nAnggap saja ini hadiahmu karena memenangkan kontes.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_28
Array.english: Well, I am not sure if this is right... \nBANCHO SUSHI without me...
Array.indonesia: Yah, aku tidak yakin apakah ini benar... \nBANCHO SUSHI tanpa saya...

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_29
Array.english: <size=36>Bancho, I think you should give it a try.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Bancho, menurut saya kamu harus mencobanya.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_30
Array.english: This will be a good challenge for the staff to grow further.
Array.indonesia: Ini akan menjadi tantangan yang bagus bagi staf untuk berkembang lebih jauh.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_31
Array.english: Um, if that's what everyone thinks, I have no other choice.
Array.indonesia: Hmm, kalau memang semua orang berpikir begitu, saya tidak punya pilihan lain.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_32
Array.english: Okay. I will open a <color=#F1DC2B>branch</color>.
Array.indonesia: Oke. Aku akan membuka <color=#F1DC2B>cabang</color>.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_33
Array.english: What am I supposed to do though?\nOrder wooden planks or something?
Array.indonesia: Tapi apa yang harus aku lakukan?\nMemesan papan kayu atau semacamnya?

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_34
Array.english: Don’t worry about the construction.\nB&C Company will take care of it.
Array.indonesia: Jangan khawatir soal pembangunan.\nPerusahaan B&C akan mengurusnya.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_35
Array.english: You just name the <color=#1DFEAF>manager</color> and\ndecide what to serve with what ingredients, Bancho.
Array.indonesia: Kamu tinggal sebutkan nama <color=#1DFEAF>manajer</color> dan\ntentukan menu apa yang akan disajikan beserta bahan-bahannya, Bancho.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_36
Array.english: Well, it’s about time for the nightshift.\nThe construction will be completed by tomorrow morning.
Array.indonesia: Nah, sudah waktunya shift malam.\nPembangunan akan selesai besok pagi.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_37
Array.english: <size=36>She must be kidding...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Dia pasti bercanda...</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_38
Array.english: Anyway, I realized that I was closed-minded about \nnew approaches to food.
Array.indonesia: Bagaimanapun, aku menyadari bahwa aku terlalu tertutup terhadap \npendekatan baru dalam hal makanan.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_39
Array.english: <size=35>I apologize for my poor review of your dish in the past.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Aku minta maaf atas ulasan burukku tentang hidanganmu di masa lalu.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_40
Array.english: From now on, I will help you spread your food \nfar and wide.
Array.indonesia: Mulai sekarang, saya akan membantu Anda mempromosikan hidangan Anda \nke mana-mana.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_41
Array.english: I will contact you again when the <color=#F1DC2B>branch</color> is ready \nfor business.
Array.indonesia: Saya akan menghubungi Anda lagi ketika <color=#F1DC2B>cabang</color> sudah siap \nuntuk beroperasi.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Lose_01
Array.english: <size=35>Haha, quite an obvious result.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Haha, hasil yang cukup jelas.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Lose_02
Array.english: <size=34>I praise your courage going up against me though.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Namun, saya memuji keberanian Anda yang berani menantang saya.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Lose_03
Array.english: Hmph, pasta is not easy to master.
Array.indonesia: Hmph, pasta itu tidak mudah dikuasai.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Lose_04
Array.english: <size=35>Oh! The challenger Pastro wins!\nMaybe it’s time for Bancho to give up the throne!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh! Penantang Pastro menang!\nMungkin sudah waktunya Bancho menyerahkan tahtanya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Lose_05
Array.english: I expected more from you.
Array.indonesia: Aku mengharapkan lebih darimu.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Lose_06
Array.english: Give me a call if you want a rematch!
Array.indonesia: Hubungi aku jika kamu ingin pertandingan ulang!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Lose_07
Array.english: Pastro won today’s <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color> contest!\nStay tuned, folks!
Array.indonesia: Pastro memenangkan kontes <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color> hari ini!\nTetap ikuti perkembangannya, teman-teman!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Lose_08
Array.english: <size=38>See you next time<color=#ff61e3>♥</color>\nThis was reporter Yui!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Sampai jumpa lagi<color=#ff61e3>♥</color>\nIni reporter Yui!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Fail_01
Array.english: <size=36>Bancho, are you ready?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Bancho, apakah kamu siap?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Fail_02
Array.english: Um, actually...
Array.indonesia: Um, sebenarnya...

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Fail_03
Array.english: <size=36>What a surprise! \nThe champion has failed to bring his ingredients!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Sungguh mengejutkan! \nJuara tidak membawa bahan-bahannya!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Fail_04
Array.english: It will be Pastro’s win by default!\nBetter luck next time, BANCHO SUSHI!
Array.indonesia: Pastro akan menang secara otomatis!\nSemoga lebih beruntung lain kali, BANCHO SUSHI!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Fail_05
Array.english: Hmph, couldn’t find ingredients? I can’t believe this..
Array.indonesia: Hmph, tidak bisa menemukan bahan-bahannya? Aku tidak percaya ini..

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Fail_06
Array.english: Give me a call if you want a rematch!
Array.indonesia: Hubungi aku kalau kamu mau pertandingan ulang!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Fail_07
Array.english: Pastro won today’s <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color> contest!\nStay tuned, folks!
Array.indonesia: Pastro memenangkan kontes <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color> hari ini!\nTetap ikuti perkembangannya, teman-teman!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Fail_08
Array.english: <size=38>See you next time<color=#ff61e3>♥</color>\nThis was reporter Yui!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Sampai jumpa lagi<color=#ff61e3>♥</color>\nIni reporter Yui!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Revisit_Success_01
Array.english: All right, we’re at BANCHO SUSHI again!\nIs he ready this time?
Array.indonesia: Baiklah, kita kembali ke BANCHO SUSHI!\nApakah dia sudah siap kali ini?

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Revisit_Success_02
Array.english: <size=35>Of course.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Tentu saja.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Revisit_Success_03
Array.english: <size=36>Pastro?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Pastro?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Revisit_Success_04
Array.english: Ovviamente. Let us begin.
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja. Mari kita mulai.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Revisit_Success_05
Array.english: Excellent!\nIt looks like both contestants are ready for today’s <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color>!
Array.indonesia: Luar biasa!\nSepertinya kedua kontestan sudah siap untuk <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color> hari ini!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Revisit_Fail_01
Array.english: All right, we’re at BANCHO SUSHI again!\nIs he ready this time?
Array.indonesia: Baiklah, kita kembali ke BANCHO SUSHI!\nApakah dia sudah siap kali ini?

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Revisit_Fail_02
Array.english: Um, actually...
Array.indonesia: Um, sebenarnya...

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Revisit_Fail_03
Array.english: <size=36>Oh, no! The champion had trouble getting the required ingredients!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Oh, tidak! Sang juara mengalami kesulitan mendapatkan bahan-bahan yang dibutuhkan!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Revisit_Fail_04
Array.english: Aren’t you too being a bit too laid back to win this thing, Bancho?
Array.indonesia: Bukankah kamu terlalu santai untuk memenangkan kompetisi ini, Bancho?

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Revisit_Fail_05
Array.english: Give me a call if you want a rematch!
Array.indonesia: Hubungi aku kalau mau pertandingan ulang!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Revisit_Fail_06
Array.english: Pastro won today’s <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color> contest!\nStay tuned, folks!
Array.indonesia: Pastro memenangkan kontes <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color> hari ini!\nTetap pantau terus, teman-teman!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Revisit_Fail_07
Array.english: <size=38>See you next time<color=#ff61e3>♥</color>\nThis was reporter Yui!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Sampai jumpa lagi<color=#ff61e3>♥</color>\nIni reporter Yui!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Lose_Call_01
Array.english: Hmph. Are you up for another match?
Array.indonesia: Hmph. Kamu siap untuk pertandingan lagi?

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Lose_Call_02
Array.english: I will visit you <color=#1DFEAF>tomorrow</color> then.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan mengunjungimu <color=#1DFEAF>besok</color>.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Lose_Call_03
Array.english: Make sure to get fully prepared!\nStart working on it now.
Array.indonesia: Pastikan kamu sudah benar-benar siap!\nMulailah mempersiapkannya sekarang.

Array.name: dialog_PickUp_SeaUrchin_Fail_001
Array.english: <size=34>Ah! It hurts...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ah! Sakit...!</size>

Array.name: dialog_PickUp_SeaUrchin_Fail_002
Array.english: I don’t think sea urchins can be picked up with these <color=#1DFEAF>Gloves</color>...
Array.indonesia: Kurasa landak laut nggak bisa diambil pakai <color=#1DFEAF>sarung tangan</color> ini...

Array.name: dialog_PickUp_SeaUrchin_Success_001
Array.english: <size=33>Yes! These Diving Gloves should be able to pick up <color=#F1DC2B>sea urchins</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Iya! Sarung tangan selam ini pasti bisa dipakai buat mengambil <color=#F1DC2B>landak laut</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_PickUp_SeaUrchin_Success_002
Array.english: <size=32>Sea Urchin Sushi... Just the thought of it makes me drool...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Sushi Landak Laut... Hanya membayangkannya saja sudah membuatku ngiler...</size>

Array.name: dialog_BelugaTaxi_BeforeUnlock_001
Array.english: Well, look at this sign...\nDoes it mean I can ride a Beluga here?
Array.indonesia: Nah, lihat papan tanda ini...\nApakah ini berarti aku bisa menunggangi Beluga di sini?

Array.name: dialog_BabyAnomarli_Get_001
Array.english: Ugh... Is this edible...?
Array.indonesia: Ugh... Apakah ini bisa dimakan...?

Array.name: dialog_BabyAnomarli_Get_002
Array.english: I'll have to take it with me.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus membawanya pulang.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_AfterEnding_001
Array.english: <size=33>Did you sleep well, Dave?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kamu tidur nyenyak, Dave?</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_AfterEnding_002
Array.english: <size=33>Yep. I finally got some sound sleep!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Iya. Akhirnya aku bisa tidur nyenyak!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_AfterEnding_003
Array.english: <size=34>I even dreamed I was exploring space.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku bahkan bermimpi sedang menjelajahi luar angkasa.</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_AfterEnding_004
Array.english: <size=33>Haha! Things should calm down a bit now.…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Haha! Seharusnya situasinya sudah mulai tenang sekarang.…</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_AfterEnding_005
Array.english: <size=35>Well then...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Kalau begitu...</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_AfterEnding_006
Array.english: <size=33>Check on any unfinished business…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Periksa apakah ada urusan yang belum selesai…</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_AfterEnding_007
Array.english: <size=35>And let's have a blast running BANCHO SUSHI!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Dan mari kita bersenang-senang mengelola BANCHO SUSHI!</size>

Array.name: dialog_PromotionCode_seapeople_001
Array.english: There’s some hidden writing here.
Array.indonesia: Ada tulisan tersembunyi di sini.

Array.name: dialog_PromotionCode_seapeople_002
Array.english: Is this supposed to be some kind of <color=#ff61e3>code</color>…?
Array.indonesia: Apakah ini semacam <color=#ff61e3>kode</color>…?

Array.name: dialog_PromotionCode_easteregg_001
Array.english: There’s some writing behind the chicken coop…\n<color=#ff61e3>easteregg</color>...?
Array.indonesia: Ada tulisan di belakang kandang ayam…\n<color=#ff61e3>easteregg</color>...?

Array.name: dialog_PromotionCode_easteregg_002
Array.english: Did Sammy write this? Maybe it's a new idea for one of his lyrics?
Array.indonesia: Apakah Sammy yang menulis ini? Mungkin ini ide baru untuk salah satu lirik lagunya?

Array.name: dialog_PromotionCode_GreatKingLong_001
Array.english: There's a <color=#ff61e3>memo</color> wedged into this book about King Long’s achievements.
Array.indonesia: Ada <color=#ff61e3>catatan</color> yang terselip di buku ini tentang prestasi Raja Long.

Array.name: dialog_PromotionCode_GreatKingLong_002
Array.english: …What does it mean?
Array.indonesia: …Apa artinya?

Array.name: dialog_PromotionCode_SeaBlueSubmarine_001
Array.english: There’s some writing on the Submarine panel…
Array.indonesia: Ada tulisan di panel Kapal Selam…

Array.name: dialog_PromotionCode_SeaBlueSubmarine_002
Array.english: <size=35><color=#ff61e3>SEABLUEFOREVER</color>…?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35><color=#ff61e3>SEABLUEFOREVER</color>…?</size>

Array.name: dialog_PromotionCode_SeaBlueSubmarine_003
Array.english: I guess they're really proud of what they do.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya mereka benar-benar bangga dengan apa yang mereka lakukan.

Array.name: dialog_DaveStatue_001
Array.english: <size=36>Is…this...me??!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Apakah…ini...aku??!</size>

Array.name: dialog_DaveStatue_002
Array.english: Seeing a statue of me in the Sea People village feels...kinda nice to be honest! Haha.
Array.indonesia: Melihat patung diriku di desa Sea People rasanya… lumayan menyenangkan, jujur saja! Haha.

Array.name: dialog_Bowheadwhales_FirstEncounter01_001
Array.english: <size=35>Wow…Whales this deep in the glacial area?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wah… Paus di kedalaman area gletser seperti ini?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Bowheadwhales_FirstEncounter01_002
Array.english: Was that a <color=#F1DC2B>Bowhead Whale</color>…?\nLooks pretty unique!
Array.indonesia: Apakah itu <color=#F1DC2B>Paus Bowhead</color>…?\nKelihatannya cukup unik!

Array.name: dialogue_Dredge_Merchant_Appear_001
Array.english: Phew... The fog is really thick today.
Array.indonesia: Wah… Kabutnya benar-benar tebal hari ini.

Array.name: dialogue_Dredge_Merchant_Appear_002
Array.english: <size=34>Oh...who…are you?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh...who…kamu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Dredge_Merchant_Appear_003
Array.english: <size=33>I'm a traveller and a merchant, all rolled into one!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku seorang pengelana sekaligus pedagang, semuanya dalam satu orang!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Dredge_Merchant_Appear_004
Array.english: I ended up here while I was out hunting for <color=#F1DC2B>aberrated</color> fish.
Array.indonesia: Aku berakhir di sini saat sedang berburu ikan <color=#F1DC2B>aberrated</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_Dredge_Merchant_Appear_005
Array.english: <size=35><color=#F1DC2B>Aberrated</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35><color=#F1DC2B>Aberrated</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Dredge_Merchant_Appear_006
Array.english: Ah…You don't know, do you? <color=#F1DC2B>Aberrations</color> refer to sea species that have strangely mutated or changed in some bizarre way.
Array.indonesia: Ah… Kamu tidak tahu, ya? <color=#F1DC2B>Aberrations</color> merujuk pada spesies laut yang telah bermutasi secara aneh atau berubah dengan cara yang ganjil.

Array.name: dialogue_Dredge_Merchant_Appear_007
Array.english: They appear at specific locations on days when the red mist rolls in.
Array.indonesia: Mereka muncul di lokasi-lokasi tertentu pada hari-hari ketika kabut merah menyelimuti.

Array.name: dialogue_Dredge_Merchant_Appear_008
Array.english: There are creatures called <color=#F1DC2B>Hooded Figures</color> who feed on these abberated fish…
Array.indonesia: Ada makhluk yang disebut <color=#F1DC2B>Hooded Figures</color> yang memakan ikan-ikan aberrated ini…

Array.name: dialogue_Dredge_Merchant_Appear_009
Array.english: If you bring them aberrated fish, they will compensate you well!
Array.indonesia: Jika kamu membawakan mereka ikan aberrated, mereka akan memberimu imbalan yang lumayan!

Array.name: dialogue_Dredge_Merchant_Appear_010
Array.english: I have no idea what you are talking about…
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak tahu apa yang kamu bicarakan…

Array.name: dialogue_Dredge_Merchant_Appear_011
Array.english: Hooded Figures are sure to visit a nearby <color=#F1DC2B>restaurant</color> during the evening.
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Hooded Figures</color> pasti akan mengunjungi <color=#F1DC2B>restoran</color> terdekat pada malam hari.

Array.name: dialogue_Dredge_Merchant_Appear_012
Array.english: By the way, you seem like a fisher. In that case, can you help me catch some <color=#F1DC2B>Aberrant Fish</color>?
Array.indonesia: Ngomong-ngomong, kamu kelihatannya seorang nelayan. Kalau begitu, bisakah kamu membantuku menangkap beberapa <color=#F1DC2B>Ikan Aberrant</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_Dredge_Merchant_Appear_013
Array.english: <size=34>What? I can't sail in this fog!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Apa? Aku tidak bisa berlayar dalam kabut seperti ini!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Dredge_Merchant_Appear_014
Array.english: Now, don't you worry. I'll lend you a <color=#1DFEAF>special light</color> that helps you sail through fog.
Array.indonesia: Nah, jangan khawatir. Aku akan meminjamkanmu <color=#1DFEAF>lampu khusus</color> yang bisa membantumu berlayar melewati kabut.

Array.name: dialogue_Dredge_Merchant_Appear_015
Array.english: <size=34>It's called the <color=#1DFEAF>Sky Fire</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Namanya <color=#1DFEAF>Sky Fire</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Dredge_Merchant_Appear_016
Array.english: You'll be able to navigate through the red fog with this.\n<size=27><color=#C3C3C3>Though, you won't see very far.</color></size>
Array.indonesia: Dengan ini, kamu bisa menavigasi melalui kabut merah.\n<size=27><color=#C3C3C3>Tapi, jangkauannya tidak terlalu jauh.</color></size>

Array.name: dialogue_Dredge_Merchant_Appear_017
Array.english: <size=35>Haha! Aberrant fish? That sounds fun!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Haha! Ikan aneh? Kedengarannya seru!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Dredge_Merchant_Appear_018
Array.english: For now, we could use that <color=#1DFEAF>light</color> of yours.\nAs it is, we won't even be able to reach BANCHO SUSHI!
Array.indonesia: Untuk saat ini, kita bisa memanfaatkan <color=#1DFEAF>cahaya</color> milikmu itu.\nKalau begini terus, kita bahkan tidak akan bisa mencapai BANCHO SUSHI!

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Merchant_AfterLightChange_001
Array.english: <size=35>Alright! Now we should be able to navigate these waters.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Baiklah! Sekarang kita seharusnya bisa menavigasi perairan ini.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Merchant_AfterLightChange_002
Array.english: Oh, by the way, about the <color=#F1DC2B>Aberrant Fish</color>…
Array.indonesia: Oh, ngomong-ngomong, soal <color=#F1DC2B>Ikan Aneh</color>…

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Merchant_AfterLightChange_003
Array.english: Those <color=#9E7BFF>Hooded Figures</color> may eat them, but for sure the regular guests won't.
Array.indonesia: Para <color=#9E7BFF>Sosok Bertudung</color> itu mungkin akan memakannya, tapi yang pasti para tamu biasa tidak akan.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Merchant_AfterLightChange_004
Array.english: <size=34>What should we do with the leftover fish, Miss?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Apa yang harus kita lakukan dengan sisa ikan itu, Nona?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Merchant_AfterLightChange_005
Array.english: Haha. I'll come and buy whatever's left once you close up shop.
Array.indonesia: Haha. Aku akan datang dan membeli apa pun yang tersisa setelah toko ini tutup.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Merchant_AfterLightChange_006
Array.english: After all, they'll go bad the very next day if you store them like any other fish.
Array.indonesia: Lagipula, ikan-ikan itu akan busuk keesokan harinya jika disimpan seperti ikan pada umumnya.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Merchant_AfterLightChange_007
Array.english: Well, if that's the deal…
Array.indonesia: Baiklah, kalau begitu…

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Merchant_AfterLightChange_008
Array.english: <size=35>Shall we give it a try, Dave?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Mau kita coba, Dave?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Merchant_AfterLightChange_009
Array.english: <color=#F1DC2B>Aberrant Fish</color>, huh…\nShould be pretty interesting stuff for a diver like you!
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Ikan Aneh</color>, ya…\nPasti hal yang cukup menarik buat penyelam sepertimu!

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Merchant_AfterLightChange_010
Array.english: I do want to see them, but I have a feeling they won't be easy to catch.
Array.indonesia: Aku memang ingin melihatnya, tapi aku merasa mereka tidak akan mudah ditangkap.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Merchant_AfterLightChange_011
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! But you've got yourself a mighty harpoon!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Tapi kamu punya tombak yang hebat!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Merchant_AfterLightChange_012
Array.english: <size=35>For now, let's sail!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Untuk saat ini, ayo berlayar!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_BoatControl_001
Array.english: <size=34>Hmm… The fog is thick…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hmm… Kabutnya tebal…</size>

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_BoatControl_002
Array.english: Dave, days like this can be a dangerous one. I recommend brushing up on how to steer the boat.
Array.indonesia: Dave, hari-hari seperti ini bisa berbahaya. Aku sarankan kamu mengasah kembali keterampilan mengemudikan perahu.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_PointDesc_001
Array.english: <i><color=#C3C3C3>Bzz…</color><i>
Array.indonesia: <i><color=#C3C3C3>Bzz…</color><i>

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_PointDesc_002
Array.english: It seems like it's smooth sailing for you.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya perjalananmu lancar-lancar saja.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_PointDesc_003
Array.english: There's one thing I forgot to mention.
Array.indonesia: Ada satu hal yang lupa kusebutkan.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_PointDesc_004
Array.english: Where there's a <color=#F1DC2B>small vortex</color>, there's sure to be aberrant fish.
Array.indonesia: Di mana ada <color=#F1DC2B>pusaran kecil</color>, pasti ada ikan aneh.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_PointDesc_005
Array.english: Hmm… A small vortex.
Array.indonesia: Hmm… Pusaran kecil.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_PointDesc_006
Array.english: Oh, and you'll also see some <color=#F1DC2B>spots foaming with bubbles</color>.
Array.indonesia: Oh, dan kamu juga akan melihat beberapa <color=#F1DC2B>titik yang berbusa</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_PointDesc_007
Array.english: It won't be easy diving in those areas, but there's <color=#1DFEAF>valuables</color> you can dredge in those areas.
Array.indonesia: Menyelam di area-area itu tidak akan mudah, tapi ada <color=#1DFEAF>barang berharga</color> yang bisa kamu temukan di sana.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_PointDesc_008
Array.english: You might find rare materials or items that will fetch a good price, so keep an eye out for them.
Array.indonesia: Kamu mungkin menemukan bahan langka atau barang yang harganya mahal, jadi perhatikan baik-baik.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_PointDesc_009
Array.english: <size=34>Valuables? Now that's something we can't miss! Haha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Barang berharga? Itu sesuatu yang tidak boleh kita lewatkan! Haha!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_PointDesc_010
Array.english: Talk to you later.\nSee you at the restaurant.
Array.indonesia: Sampai jumpa nanti.\nSampai jumpa di restoran.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_PointDesc_011
Array.english: <i><color=#C3C3C3>Bzz…</color><i>
Array.indonesia: <i><color=#C3C3C3>Bzz…</color><i>

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_DredgingPoint_001
Array.english: <size=34>Dave! Look over there!\nThose must be the <color=#F1DC2B>bubbles</color> the merchant mentioned!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Dave! Lihat ke sana!\nItu pasti <color=#F1DC2B>gelembung-gelembung</color> yang disebutkan pedagang tadi!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_DredgingPoint_002
Array.english: <size=34>Woah… It does look like something is there.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wah… Sepertinya memang ada sesuatu di sana.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_DredgingPoint_003
Array.english: Let’s see… There should be equipment for dredging in this boat…
Array.indonesia: Coba kita lihat… Seharusnya ada peralatan pengerukan di perahu ini…

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_DredgingPoint_004
Array.english: <size=35>Let's sail to the <color=#F1DC2B>bubbles</color> for now!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ayo kita berlayar ke <color=#F1DC2B>gelembung-gelembung</color> dulu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_DivePoint_001
Array.english: <size=35>There! That looks like the <color=#F1DC2B>small vortex</color> that the merchant mentioned!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Itu dia! Sepertinya itu <color=#F1DC2B>pusaran kecil</color> yang disebutkan pedagang itu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_DivePoint_002
Array.english: It looks like it.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya memang begitu.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_DivePoint_003
Array.english: <size=34>Ready to go in, Dave?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Siap masuk, Dave?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_DivePoint_004
Array.english: Umm… It looks even more dangerous up close…
Array.indonesia: Umm… Kelihatannya malah lebih berbahaya kalau dilihat dari dekat…

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_DivePoint_005
Array.english: We can't come all the way here only to leave empty handed…
Array.indonesia: Kita nggak mungkin datang jauh-jauh ke sini cuma buat pulang dengan tangan kosong…

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_DivePoint_006
Array.english: <size=34>With your skills, there shouldn't be any problems.\nNow let's catch some <color=#F1DC2B>Aberrant Fish</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Dengan keahlianmu, seharusnya nggak ada masalah.\nAyo kita tangkap beberapa <color=#F1DC2B>Ikan Aberrant</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_Barricade01_001
Array.english: <size=34>Already leaving, Dave?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Sudah mau pergi, Dave?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_Barricade01_002
Array.english: Aren't those <color=#9E7BFF>Hooded Figures</color> going to visit BANCHO SUSHI for some aberrant fish tonight?
Array.indonesia: Bukankah <color=#9E7BFF>Sosok-Sosok Bertudung</color> itu akan mampir ke BANCHO SUSHI untuk menikmati ikan aberrant malam ini?

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_Barricade01_003
Array.english: And the money will be worth it, if I recall correctly.
Array.indonesia: Dan uangnya pasti sepadan, kalau aku tidak salah ingat.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_Barricade01_004
Array.english: <size=35>It'll be a shame to miss such an opportunity!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Sayang sekali kalau melewatkan kesempatan seperti itu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_Barricade01_005
Array.english: <size=35>Let's find the <color=#F1DC2B>small vortex</color> that the merchant mentioned!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ayo kita cari <color=#F1DC2B>pusaran kecil</color> yang disebutkan pedagang itu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_DriveMode_Barricade_001
Array.english: <size=33>The fog is too thick. I'm not sure if we can go any farther…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kabutnya terlalu tebal. Aku tidak yakin apakah kita bisa melangkah lebih jauh…</size>

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_DriveMode_Barricade_002
Array.english: <size=33>We'll be putting ourselves in danger if we keep going.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kita akan membahayakan diri sendiri jika terus melaju.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_DriveMode_Barricade_003
Array.english: <size=35>Let's try to find some in these waters for now.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Mari kita coba cari beberapa di perairan ini dulu.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_FirstFog_MorningTalk_001
Array.english: The <color=#F1DC2B>fog</color> sure is thick today…
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Kabut</color> hari ini benar-benar tebal…

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_FirstFog_MorningTalk_002
Array.english: Never thought Blue Hole would see any fog.
Array.indonesia: Tidak pernah menyangka Blue Hole akan berkabut.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_FirstFog_MorningTalk_003
Array.english: It's kind of creepy…
Array.indonesia: Rasanya agak menyeramkan…

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_FirstFog_EveningTalk_001
Array.english: <size=35>The <color=#F1DC2B>fog</color> is even redder now that it's the evening!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35><color=#F1DC2B>Kabut</color> itu malah semakin merah sekarang karena sudah malam!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_FirstFog_EveningTalk_002
Array.english: <size=34>Well… How creepy!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wah… Seram sekali!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_FirstFog_EveningTalk_003
Array.english: Huh? There's some light that's approaching us…
Array.indonesia: Hah? Ada cahaya yang mendekat ke arah kita…

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_MorningFog_001
Array.english: The fog is thick today.
Array.indonesia: Kabutnya tebal hari ini.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_MorningFog_002
Array.english: Those <color=#9E7BFF>Hooded Figures</color> might visit in the evening again.
Array.indonesia: <color=#9E7BFF>Sosok-Sosok Bertudung</color> itu mungkin akan datang lagi di malam hari.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_EveningFog_001
Array.english: Red fog is in the air, meaning there'll be <color=#F1DC2B>Aberrant Fish</color> in the waters.
Array.indonesia: Kabut merah mengambang di udara, artinya akan ada <color=#F1DC2B>Ikan Aneh</color> di perairan.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_EveningFog_002
Array.english: The <color=#9E7BFF>Hooded Figures</color> will be visiting BANCHO SUSHI soon. You gotta serve them something, right?
