Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050085
Array.english: There are more highly venomous <color=#008c6f>Jellyfish</color>.\nRemove the <color=#008c6f>Jellyfish</color> to restore environmental balance.
Array.indonesia: Ada lebih banyak <color=#008c6f>Ubur-ubur</color> yang sangat beracun.\nSingkirkan <color=#008c6f>Ubur-ubur</color> untuk memulihkan keseimbangan lingkungan.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050086
Array.english: A recent increase in the population of <color=#008c6f>Lionfish</color> is destroying the food chain.\nCull the <color=#008c6f>Red Lionfish</color> population.
Array.indonesia: Peningkatan populasi <color=#008c6f>Ikan Singa</color> belakangan ini sedang merusak rantai makanan.\nKurangi populasi <color=#008c6f>Ikan Singa Merah</color>.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050087
Array.english: There are too many <color=#008c6f>Red Lionfish</color> and <color=#008c6f>Titan Triggerfish</color>.\nHunt them to cull their number.
Array.indonesia: Ada terlalu banyak <color=#008c6f>Ikan Singa Merah</color> dan <color=#008c6f>Ikan Trigger Titan</color>.\nBuru mereka untuk mengurangi jumlahnya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050088
Array.english: The <color=#008c6f>Titan Triggerfish</color> and <color=#008c6f>Great Barracuda</color> populations have exploded.\nHunt them to cull their number.
Array.indonesia: Populasi <color=#008c6f>Ikan Trigger Titan</color> dan <color=#008c6f>Barracuda Besar</color> telah meledak.\nBuru mereka untuk mengurangi jumlahnya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050089
Array.english: The <color=#008c6f>Titan Triggerfish</color> and <color=#008c6f>Great Barracuda</color> populations have exploded.\nHunt them to cull their number.
Array.indonesia: Populasi <color=#008c6f>Ikan Trigger Titan</color> dan <color=#008c6f>Barracuda Besar</color> telah meledak.\nBuru mereka untuk mengurangi jumlahnya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050090
Array.english: The <color=#008c6f>Striped Catfish</color> and <color=#008c6f>Sheepshead</color> populations have exploded.\nHunt them to cull their number.
Array.indonesia: Populasi <color=#008c6f>Ikan Lele Bergaris</color> dan <color=#008c6f>Ikan Kepala Domba</color> telah meledak.\nBuru mereka untuk mengurangi jumlahnya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050091
Array.english: The <color=#008c6f>Fangtooth</color> and <color=#008c6f>Bluespotted Stargazer</color> populations have exploded.\nHunt them to cull their number.
Array.indonesia: Populasi <color=#008c6f>Ikan Gigi Taring</color> dan <color=#008c6f>Ikan Bintang Bintik Biru</color> telah meledak.\nBuru mereka untuk mengurangi jumlahnya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050092
Array.english: The Red Lionfish and Titan Triggerfish appear in large numbers at night. Hunt them to cull their numbers.
Array.indonesia: Ikan singa merah dan ikan pemicu raksasa muncul dalam jumlah besar pada malam hari. Buru mereka untuk mengurangi populasinya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050093
Array.english: The increased <color=#008c6f>Moray Eel</color> population has contributed to a rise in night diving accidents at night.\nHunt them to cull their number.
Array.indonesia: Meningkatnya populasi <color=#008c6f>belut moray</color> telah berkontribusi pada peningkatan kecelakaan selam malam.\nBuru mereka untuk mengurangi populasinya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050094
Array.english: <color=#008c6f>Fangtooths</color> are disrupting the deep-sea ecology.\nHunt them to cull their number.
Array.indonesia: <color=#008c6f>Ikan Gigi Taring</color> mengganggu ekologi laut dalam.\nBuru mereka untuk mengurangi jumlahnya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050095
Array.english: There are too many <color=#008c6f>Stargazers</color> and <color=#008c6f>Viperfish</color> in the depths.\nHunt them to cull their number.
Array.indonesia: Ada terlalu banyak <color=#008c6f>Ikan Stargazer</color> dan <color=#008c6f>Ikan Viper</color> di kedalaman laut.\nBuru mereka untuk mengurangi jumlahnya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050096
Array.english: We have a peculiar girl as a customer...\nI should first prepare <color=#4AFFDB>White Trevally</color>, <color=#4AFFDB>Kelp</color>, and <color=#4AFFDB>Soy Sauce</color>.
Array.indonesia: Kami memiliki seorang gadis yang unik sebagai pelanggan...\nSaya harus menyiapkan <color=#4AFFDB>White Trevally</color>, <color=#4AFFDB>Kelp</color>, dan <color=#4AFFDB>Kecap</color> terlebih dahulu.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050100
Array.english: I wish to see a <color=#4AFFDB>Clione</color> from the depths in person...\nCould you collect about five?
Array.indonesia: Saya ingin melihat <color=#4AFFDB>Clione</color> dari kedalaman secara langsung...\nBisakah Anda mengumpulkan sekitar lima ekor?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059100
Array.english: What a huge clione..!! I think I need to defeat her to get out…!
Array.indonesia: Clione yang sangat besar..!! Sepertinya aku harus mengalahkannya untuk bisa keluar…!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059101
Array.english: What is this <color=#4AFFDB>frame</color>? Let's take it up to the boat.
Array.indonesia: Apa ini <color=#4AFFDB>bingkai</color>? Ayo kita bawa ke perahu.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059102
Array.english: I need to go to the Sushi Bar and Meet Maki.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus pergi ke Sushi Bar dan menemui Maki.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059103
Array.english: Is there anything worth salvaging from the Giant Clione? Let's investigate.
Array.indonesia: Apakah ada sesuatu yang layak diselamatkan dari Clione Raksasa itu? Ayo kita selidiki.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050097
Array.english: There’s something strange about that <color=#4AFFDB>Coral</color>.\nI should try and approach it.
Array.indonesia: Ada yang aneh dengan <color=#4AFFDB>Karang</color> itu.\nAku harus mencoba mendekatinya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050098
Array.english: Ugh... That nasty octopus...\nI’m going to chase him and teach him a lesson!
Array.indonesia: Ugh... Gurita menjijikkan itu...\nAku akan mengejarnya dan memberinya pelajaran!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050099
Array.english: Bring Dish to Michael Bang
Array.indonesia: Bawa Dish ke Michael Bang

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050103
Array.english: The dolphin seems to want me to follow.\nI should try following.
Array.indonesia: Lumba-lumba itu sepertinya ingin aku mengikutinya.\nAku harus mencoba mengikutinya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050104
Array.english: A Pink Dolphin has been caught in an illegal fishing net!\nCut the <color=#4AFFDB>Rope</color> before it’s dragged up!
Array.indonesia: Seekor Lumba-lumba Merah Muda terjebak dalam jaring penangkapan ikan ilegal!\nPotong <color=#4AFFDB>Tali</color> sebelum dia ditarik ke atas!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050105
Array.english: Otto said I should visit the <color=#4AFFDB>Empty Lot</color>.\nI should go by boat.
Array.indonesia: Otto bilang aku harus mengunjungi <color=#4AFFDB>Lahan Kosong</color>.\nAku harus pergi dengan perahu.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050106
Array.english: Pirates! You keep torturing the dolphins!\nI’ll teach them a lesson today.
Array.indonesia: Bajak laut! Kalian terus menyiksa lumba-lumba!\nAku akan memberi mereka pelajaran hari ini.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050107
Array.english: Hmm! Humans can’t be trusted.\nI’ll think about it if you first build up some <color=#4AFFDB>trust</color> with the villagers.
Array.indonesia: Hmm! Manusia tidak bisa dipercaya.\nAku akan memikirkannya jika kamu terlebih dahulu membangun <color=#4AFFDB>kepercayaan</color> dengan penduduk desa.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050108
Array.english: I think I’ve grown quite close with the villagers now.\nLet’s go back to Tenzhin.
Array.indonesia: Aku rasa aku sudah cukup dekat dengan penduduk desa sekarang.\nAyo kembali ke Tenzhin.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050109
Array.english: Deliver <color=#4AFFDB>Lunch Boxes</color> to the gatekeepers Awang and Nawang!\nThey’ll be upset again if their food is late.
Array.indonesia: Antarkan <color=#4AFFDB>Kotak Makan Siang</color> kepada penjaga gerbang Awang dan Nawang!\nMereka akan marah lagi kalau makanannya terlambat.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059109
Array.english: I’ve delivered the Lunch Boxes, so I should tell Mima.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah mengantarkan Kotak Makan Siang, jadi sebaiknya aku memberi tahu Mima.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050110
Array.english: I have guests to serve, and I haven’t been able to acquire <color=#4AFFDB>Tube Corals</color>.\nCould you look for some in the depths?
Array.indonesia: Aku harus melayani tamu, dan aku belum bisa mendapatkan <color=#4AFFDB>Karang Tabung</color>.\nBisakah kamu mencarinya di kedalaman?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050111
Array.english: Mima said she wanted to try human food, right?\nI should ask Bancho.
Array.indonesia: Mima bilang dia ingin mencoba makanan manusia, kan?\nAku harus bertanya pada Bancho.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050112
Array.english: Take the salad Bancho made to Mima.
Array.indonesia: Bawakan salad buatan Bancho kepada Mima.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050113
Array.english: I can’t speak with someone who doesn’t respect King Long.\nGo offer a flower or something first!
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak bisa berbicara dengan seseorang yang tidak menghormati Raja Long.\nPergilah memberikan bunga atau sesuatu terlebih dahulu!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050114
Array.english: I’ve offered a flower, so I should speak to Kazhin at the Seed Shop.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah memberikan bunga, jadi sebaiknya aku berbicara dengan Kazhin di Toko Benih.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050115
Array.english: Get <color=#4AFFDB>Cucumbers</color> and return to Kazhin at the Seed Shop.
Array.indonesia: Dapatkan <color=#4AFFDB>Mentimun</color> dan kembalilah ke Kazhin di Toko Benih.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050116
Array.english: These special <color=#4AFFDB>Sea People Seeds</color>...\nThey could probably grow on the surface, too. Try planting them!
Array.indonesia: Benih <color=#4AFFDB>Orang Laut</color> yang istimewa ini...\nMungkin bisa tumbuh di darat juga. Coba tanam!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050117
Array.english: Try growing <color=#4AFFDB>Sea People Seeds</color> at the Farm.
Array.indonesia: Coba tanam <color=#4AFFDB>Benih Orang Laut</color> di Lahan Pertanian.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050118
Array.english: Wow! To think sea people plants grow on land as well!\nI should go and tell Kazhin.
Array.indonesia: Wow! Ternyata tanaman Orang Laut juga bisa tumbuh di darat!\nAku harus memberitahu Kazhin.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050119
Array.english: A Megamouth swallowed our <color=#4AFFDB>Ball</color>...\nCan you get it back for us?
Array.indonesia: Seekor Megamouth menelan <color=#4AFFDB>Bola</color> kita...\nBisakah kamu mengambilnya kembali untuk kami?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050120
Array.english: The Stone Slab with the wedding song is broken...\nRecords should be left in the <color=#4AFFDB>Sea People Record Chamber</color>... Please help me.
Array.indonesia: Lempengan Batu yang berisi lagu pernikahan itu pecah...\nRekaman-rekaman itu seharusnya disimpan di <color=#4AFFDB>Ruang Rekaman Suku Laut</color>... Tolong bantu aku.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050121
Array.english: This must be the Stone Slab with the wedding song...\nI should take it to Niamo at the Sea People Village.
Array.indonesia: Ini pasti Lempengan Batu yang berisi lagu pernikahan... \nAku harus membawanya ke Niamo di Desa Suku Laut.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059122
Array.english: Kinglong’s statue is... broken.\nDo you think a human might know how to repair it?
Array.indonesia: Patung Kinglong... rusak.\nMenurutmu, apakah ada manusia yang tahu cara memperbaikinya?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059123
Array.english: Alright. I should take the <color=#4AFFDB>Adhesive</color> from Cobra\nand go back to Niamo in front of the Kinglong statue.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah. Aku harus mengambil <color=#4AFFDB>Lem</color> dari Cobra\ndan kembali menemui Niamo di depan patung Kinglong.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050122
Array.english: Use your human tool to reattach\nKinglong’s arm... Please.
Array.indonesia: Gunakan alat manusia milikmu untuk memasang kembali lengan \nKinglong... Tolong.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050123
Array.english: <color=#4AFFDB>4</color> Seahorses ran away from the Seahorse Racecourse...\nCould you find them for me? They should be in various parts of the village.
Array.indonesia: <color=#4AFFDB>4</color> Kuda laut melarikan diri dari Arena Balap Kuda Laut...\nBisakah kamu mencarinya untukku? Mereka seharusnya berada di berbagai penjuru desa.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050124
Array.english: Talk to <color=#4AFFDB>Yami</color> at the Seahorse Racecourse.
Array.indonesia: Bicaralah dengan <color=#4AFFDB>Yami</color> di Arena Balap Kuda Laut.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050125
Array.english: Come to the <color=#4AFFDB>Village Elder’s Place</color> when the day breaks.\nI will tell you how to get to the Abandoned Cave.
Array.indonesia: Datanglah ke <color=#4AFFDB>Rumah Tetua Desa</color> saat fajar menyingsing.\nAku akan memberitahumu cara menuju Gua Terlantar.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050126
Array.english: So, the key to the Glacial Area is in this <color=#4AFFDB>Deep Storehouse</color>? It’s creepy...
Array.indonesia: Jadi, kunci ke Kawasan Gletser ada di <color=#4AFFDB>Gudang Bawah Tanah</color> ini? Seram sekali...

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050127
Array.english: I heard that I could find the key to the Glacial Passage in the room where the <color=#4AFFDB>mural</color> is.
Array.indonesia: Aku dengar kunci ke Jalur Gletser bisa ditemukan di ruangan tempat <color=#4AFFDB>lukisan dinding</color> itu berada.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050128
Array.english: This is where the <color=#4AFFDB>mural</color> is, but I can’t find any key here. Should I take a closer look at the symbol in the picture?
Array.indonesia: Di sinilah <color=#4AFFDB>lukisan dinding</color> itu berada, tapi aku tidak menemukan kunci apa pun di sini. Haruskah aku melihat lebih dekat simbol di gambar itu?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059128
Array.english: All right! I found the <color=#4AFFDB>Glacial Passage Key</color>! I’ll bring it to Tenzhin.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah! Aku menemukan <color=#4AFFDB>Kunci Jalur Glacial</color>! Aku akan membawanya ke Tenzhin.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050129
Array.english: Ah, the earthquake let loose all the monsters. I must escape them without being detected.
Array.indonesia: Ah, gempa bumi itu melepaskan semua monster. Aku harus melarikan diri dari mereka tanpa ketahuan.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050130
Array.english: <color=#4AFFDB>John Watson</color> again! He’s relentless. I will teach him a lesson this time!
Array.indonesia: <color=#4AFFDB>John Watson</color> lagi! Dia tak kenal lelah. Kali ini aku akan memberinya pelajaran!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059130
Array.english: John Watson’s gear looked incredible.\nMaybe I should pick up the <color=#4AFFDB>debris</color> in case there’s anything useful.
Array.indonesia: Perlengkapan John Watson terlihat luar biasa.\nMungkin aku harus mengambil <color=#4AFFDB>puing-puing</color> itu, siapa tahu ada yang berguna.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050131
Array.english: Whew, that was a close call. I found the key anyway. I should deliver this to <color=#4AFFDB>Tenzhin</color>.
Array.indonesia: Wah, itu hampir saja. Untungnya aku berhasil menemukan kuncinya. Aku harus mengantarkan ini ke <color=#4AFFDB>Tenzhin</color>.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050132
Array.english: A mother whale is crying... I think it’s trying to say something. Should I call <color=#4AFFDB>Ellie</color> and ask?
Array.indonesia: Seekor induk paus sedang menangis... Kurasa dia mencoba mengatakan sesuatu. Haruskah aku menelepon <color=#4AFFDB>Ellie</color> dan bertanya?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050133
Array.english: A baby whale got lost. I should look around to see if I can hear it <color=#4AFFDB>cry</color>.
Array.indonesia: Seekor bayi paus tersesat. Aku harus mencari-cari di sekitar sini untuk melihat apakah aku bisa mendengar <color=#4AFFDB>tangisannya</color>.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050134
Array.english: Wait! I just heard a <color=#4AFFDB>baby whale cry</color>! It should be around here somewhere.
Array.indonesia: Tunggu! Aku baru saja mendengar <color=#4AFFDB>tangisan bayi paus</color>! Seharusnya ada di sekitar sini.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050135
Array.english: The sound is coming from the inside... I can’t get through because of the <color=#4AFFDB>rocks</color>. Is there any way to get rid of them?
Array.indonesia: Suaranya berasal dari dalam... Aku tidak bisa masuk karena <color=#4AFFDB>batu-batu</color>. Adakah cara untuk menghilangkannya?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050136
Array.english: There should be a baby whale in here. I should look for the baby whale.
Array.indonesia: Seharusnya ada seekor bayi paus di sini. Aku harus mencari bayi paus itu.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050137
Array.english: The baby whale is scared. I’ll have to soothe it to bring it out of here.
Array.indonesia: Bayi paus itu ketakutan. Aku harus menenangkannya agar bisa membawanya keluar dari sini.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050138
Array.english: All right! Now I’ll bring it back to its mother. It should follow me if I go up to the <color=#4AFFDB>surface level</color>.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah! Sekarang aku akan membawanya kembali ke ibunya. Seharusnya ia akan mengikutiku jika aku naik ke <color=#4AFFDB>permukaan</color>.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050139
Array.english: Suwam told me that he’d wait in front of Tenzhin’s place.
Array.indonesia: Suwam memberitahuku bahwa ia akan menunggu di depan rumah Tenzhin.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059139
Array.english: Now that I have the key, I can open the door to Glacial Passage.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang setelah aku punya kuncinya, aku bisa membuka pintu ke Glacial Passage.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050140
Array.english: The door is open.\nLet’s get inside the Glacial Passage.
Array.indonesia: Pintunya terbuka.\nAyo masuk ke Glacial Passage.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050141
Array.english: The door leading down is blocked. I must find another way.
Array.indonesia: Pintu yang mengarah ke bawah terhalang. Aku harus mencari jalan lain.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050142
Array.english: It will be handy if the central passage is open. I should look around.
Array.indonesia: Akan sangat membantu jika lorong tengahnya terbuka. Aku harus melihat-lihat sekeliling.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050143
Array.english: A big chunk of ice is blocking the passage. I must find a way to melt it. I should look around to see if there is anything useful.
Array.indonesia: Sebongkah es besar menghalangi lorong. Aku harus mencari cara untuk mencairkannya. Sebaiknya aku melihat-lihat apakah ada sesuatu yang berguna.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059143
Array.english: I think I have to remove the rock from the mirror...\nBut I don’t have any tools right now. I’ll go back to the boat.
Array.indonesia: Kurasa aku harus menggeser batu dari cermin...\nTapi aku tidak punya alat apa pun saat ini. Aku akan kembali ke perahu.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050144
Array.english: With the right gear you should be able to get the stone unstuck from the mirror... Ask <color=#4AFFDB>Cobra</color>!
Array.indonesia: Dengan peralatan yang tepat, kamu seharusnya bisa melepaskan batu yang tersangkut di cermin... Tanyakan pada <color=#4AFFDB>Cobra</color>!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059144
Array.english: Good. I can pick out the rock stuck in the mirror using this <color=#4AFFDB>Crowbar</color>. I should go back to the Glacial Passage now.
Array.indonesia: Bagus. Aku bisa mengeluarkan batu yang tersangkut di cermin menggunakan <color=#4AFFDB>Crowbar</color> ini. Sebaiknya aku kembali ke Glacial Passage sekarang.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050145
Array.english: The door leading down is open! Should I explore more? The area down there is cold.
Array.indonesia: Pintu yang mengarah ke bawah terbuka! Haruskah aku menjelajah lebih jauh? Daerah di bawah sana sangat dingin.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050146
Array.english: This is a dead-end as well. I need to take the other way.
Array.indonesia: Ini juga jalan buntu. Aku harus mengambil jalan lain.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050147
Array.english: The way is blocked by ice. Maybe I can melt it using the <color=#4AFFDB>Divine Tree Fruit</color>?
Array.indonesia: Jalannya terhalang es. Mungkin aku bisa melelehkannya menggunakan <color=#4AFFDB>Divine Tree Fruit</color>?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050148
Array.english: I can’t see a thing in this darkness... Maybe I can use the <color=#4AFFDB>Divine Tree Fruit</color> to light the path.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak bisa melihat apa-apa dalam kegelapan ini... Mungkin aku bisa menggunakan <color=#4AFFDB>Buah Pohon Ilahi</color> untuk menerangi jalan.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050149
Array.english: What in the heck is that huge Gadon? I must escape it by riding the currents.
Array.indonesia: Apa sih Gadon raksasa itu? Aku harus melarikan diri darinya dengan mengikuti arus.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050150
Array.english: I need to block that exit as soon as possible. What if I make that <color=#4AFFDB>pile of rocks</color> collapse?
Array.indonesia: Aku harus memblokir jalan keluar itu secepat mungkin. Bagaimana kalau aku membuat <color=#4AFFDB>tumpukan batu</color> itu runtuh?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050151
Array.english: It’s too cold down there. I should activate that huge mirror and return to the village first.
Array.indonesia: Di bawah sana terlalu dingin. Aku sebaiknya mengaktifkan cermin raksasa itu dan kembali ke desa terlebih dahulu.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050152
Array.english: I must return to the village and find out how to go down to the Glacial Area.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus kembali ke desa dan mencari tahu cara turun ke Area Gletser.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050159
Array.english: The <color=#4AFFDB>Crowbar</color> that Cobra had ordered sank with the delivery ship. I must dive and look for it.
Array.indonesia: <color=#4AFFDB>Crowbar</color> yang dipesan Cobra tenggelam bersama kapal pengiriman. Aku harus menyelam dan mencarinya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059159
Array.english: Cobra’s <color=#4AFFDB>crowbar</color> should be here somewhere....
Array.indonesia: <color=#4AFFDB>Crowbar</color> milik Cobra seharusnya ada di sini di suatu tempat....

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050160
Array.english: I can pick up the <color=#4AFFDB>Crowbar</color> if I remove all the rocks.
Array.indonesia: Aku bisa mengambil <color=#4AFFDB>Crowbar</color> itu jika aku menyingkirkan semua batu.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050161
Array.english: Wow, they are very aggressive crabs. I must defeat them to pick up the <color=#4AFFDB>Crowbar</color>.
Array.indonesia: Wah, kepiting-kepiting ini sangat agresif. Aku harus mengalahkan mereka untuk mengambil <color=#4AFFDB>Crowbar</color> itu.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050162
Array.english: Whew, I managed to dispatch those crabs.\nIt’s time to claim the <color=#4AFFDB>Crowbar</color>!
Array.indonesia: Wah, aku berhasil menghabisi kepiting-kepiting itu.\nSaatnya mengambil <color=#4AFFDB>Crowbar</color>!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050164
Array.english: Ugh...! It’s the octopus again!\nI won’t let you escape this time!!!
Array.indonesia: Ugh...! Itu gurita lagi!\nAku tidak akan membiarkanmu kabur kali ini!!!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050165
Array.english: I think a <color=#4AFFDB>rock</color> could break that plank.\nYou just wait, octopus!
Array.indonesia: Kurasa <color=#4AFFDB>batu</color> bisa memecahkan papan itu.\nTunggu saja, gurita!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050166
Array.english: Good, now I can go through. I’ll chase the octopus.
Array.indonesia: Bagus, sekarang aku bisa lewat. Aku akan mengejar gurita itu.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050167
Array.english: Hmm? The octopus left something behind. I’ll have to check.
Array.indonesia: Hmm? Gurita itu meninggalkan sesuatu. Aku harus memeriksanya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050154
Array.english: I want to have the <color=#4AFFDB>Vegetable Sushi</color> that I used to have when I was young.\nThe taste of fresh vegetables, yeah!
Array.indonesia: Aku ingin makan <color=#4AFFDB>Sushi Sayuran</color> yang biasa aku makan waktu kecil.\nRasa sayuran segar, ya!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050155
Array.english: Deliver the food to MC Sammy!
Array.indonesia: Antarkan makanan ke MC Sammy!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050156
Array.english: Ugh, I need Marinca Cards, but it looks too strong...\nI’ll just defeat it, then!!
Array.indonesia: Ugh, aku butuh Kartu Marinca, tapi kelihatannya terlalu kuat...\nKalau begitu, aku akan mengalahkannya saja! !

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059156
Array.english: I need to go into the <color=#4AFFDB>whirlpool</color> on a stormy night to get the Marinca Super Rare Card? That sounds dangerous.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus masuk ke <color=#4AFFDB>pusaran air</color> di malam badai untuk mendapatkan Kartu Marinca Super Langka? Kedengarannya berbahaya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059157
Array.english: Didn’t the <color=#4AFFDB>truck</color> just move? Maybe I should go check.
Array.indonesia: Bukankah <color=#4AFFDB>truk</color> itu baru saja bergerak? Mungkin aku harus pergi memeriksanya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059158
Array.english: A piece of the Hermit Crab pincer came off. \nShould I pick up a piece?
Array.indonesia: Sepotong capit Kepiting Pertapa terlepas. \nHaruskah aku mengambil potongannya?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050157
Array.english: I know that I am not an expert on Chinese cuisine, but I must win the contest. Bring me Stargazer, Wheat, Olive Oil, and Eggs.
Array.indonesia: Aku tahu aku bukan ahli masakan Tiongkok, tapi aku harus memenangkan kontes ini. Bawakan aku Stargazer, Gandum, Minyak Zaitun, dan Telur.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050158
Array.english: Wang Pang? Fine. Let’s do it.
Array.indonesia: Wang Pang? Baiklah. Ayo kita lakukan.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10056001
Array.english: The deep-sea crabs keep destroying the edible corals!\nCould you defeat just three?
Array.indonesia: Kepiting laut dalam terus merusak karang yang bisa dimakan!\nBisakah kamu mengalahkan tiga saja?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10056002
Array.english: The deep-sea crabs keep destroying the corals...\nPlease defeat five more!
Array.indonesia: Kepiting laut dalam terus merusak karang...\nTolong kalahkan lima lagi!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10056003
Array.english: The vicious Fangtooth make me scared to leave the village.\nCould you defeat them?
Array.indonesia: Fangtooth yang ganas membuatku takut untuk meninggalkan desa.\nBisakah kamu mengalahkan mereka?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10056004
Array.english: I left the village and got bitten by a <color=#4AFFDB>Cookiecutter Shark</color>.\nPlease defeat it for me!
Array.indonesia: Aku meninggalkan desa dan digigit oleh <color=#4AFFDB>Hiu Pemotong Kue</color>.\nTolong kalahkan dia untukku!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10056005
Array.english: It’s said that the depths of human seas have a stone called the <color=#4AFFDB>Amethyst</color>, which shines a lovely purple. I’d like to see it.
Array.indonesia: Konon, di kedalaman laut manusia terdapat batu bernama <color=#4AFFDB>Amethyst</color>, yang bersinar ungu indah. Aku ingin melihatnya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10056006
Array.english: My marriage anniversary is coming up, and I don’t have a gift!\nCould you get me some <color=#4AFFDB>Opal</color>?
Array.indonesia: Ulang tahun pernikahanku sebentar lagi, dan aku belum punya hadiah!\nBisakah kamu membelikanku beberapa <color=#4AFFDB>Opal</color>?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10056007
Array.english: I’d like to keep some small and pretty <color=#5dd3bb>Nautiluses</color>.\nCould you get me just three?
Array.indonesia: Aku ingin mengoleksi beberapa <color=#5dd3bb>Nautilus</color> yang kecil dan cantik.\nBisakah kamu membelikanku tiga saja?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10056008
Array.english: My friends want <color=#5dd3bb>Nautiluses</color> too...\nPlease get me just five more.
Array.indonesia: Teman-temanku juga ingin <color=#5dd3bb>Nautilus</color>...\nTolong carikan saya lima lagi saja.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10056009
Array.english: I heard there’s a small winged creature in the depths...\nThe <color=#4AFFDB>Clione</color>, I think it’s called? I’d like to see one.
Array.indonesia: Saya dengar ada makhluk bersayap kecil di kedalaman...\n<color=#4AFFDB>Clione</color>, saya rasa begitu namanya? Saya ingin melihatnya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10056010
Array.english: I think analyzing the <color=#4AFFDB>Bones</color> of past dead creatures will help us uncover the cause of the tremors. Please find some!
Array.indonesia: Saya rasa menganalisis <color=#4AFFDB>Tulang</color> makhluk-makhluk yang sudah mati di masa lalu akan membantu kita mengungkap penyebab getaran tersebut. Tolong cari beberapa!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10056101
Array.english: Some <color=#4AFFDB>Porbeagle Sharks</color> are blocking the way to the Glacial Area. Can you get rid of them?
Array.indonesia: Beberapa <color=#4AFFDB>Hiu Porbeagle</color> menghalangi jalan menuju Area Gletser. Bisakah kamu menyingkirkannya?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10056102
Array.english: I want to have a look at the Control Room… but some <color=#4AFFDB>Dunkleosteuses</color> are blocking the way. Please help.
Array.indonesia: Aku ingin melihat Ruang Kontrol… tapi beberapa <color=#4AFFDB>Dunkleosteus</color> menghalangi jalan. Tolong bantu.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10056103
Array.english: I heard <color=#4AFFDB>Aquamarines</color> are great for preserving foods. I'd appreciate it if you got me some.
Array.indonesia: Aku dengar <color=#4AFFDB>Aquamarine</color> sangat bagus untuk mengawetkan makanan. Aku akan sangat berterima kasih jika kamu bisa membawakan beberapa untukku.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10056104
Array.english: I want to make some accessories out of flaming red <color=#4AFFDB>Rubies</color>… Could you get me some?
Array.indonesia: Aku ingin membuat beberapa aksesori dari <color=#4AFFDB>Rubi</color> berwarna merah menyala… Bisakah kamu membawakan beberapa untukku?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10056105
Array.english: I heard about <color=#4AFFDB>Torbernite</color>, a toxic, but beautiful and rare mineral. I'd like to have a look at it!
Array.indonesia: Aku mendengar tentang <color=#4AFFDB>Torbernite</color>, mineral beracun, tapi indah dan langka. Saya ingin melihatnya!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10056201
Array.english: Looks like a <color=#4AFFDB>Cookiecutter Shark</color> is making a mess again! Can you help?
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya <color=#4AFFDB>Hiu Cookiecutter</color> sedang membuat kekacauan lagi! Bisakah kamu membantu?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10056202
Array.english: The <color=#4AFFDB>Porbeagle Shark</color> is still running amok. Can you take care of it?
Array.indonesia: <color=#4AFFDB>Hiu Porbeagle</color> masih berkeliaran dengan liar. Bisakah kamu mengatasinya?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10056203
Array.english: A <color=#4AFFDB>Dunkleosteus</color> is blocking the passage. Please take care of it.
Array.indonesia: Seekor <color=#4AFFDB>Dunkleosteus</color> menghalangi jalan. Tolong tangani dia.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10056204
Array.english: Can you get me some <color=#4AFFDB>fossils</color>? I need them for my research.
Array.indonesia: Bisakah kamu membawakan aku beberapa <color=#4AFFDB>fosil</color>? Aku membutuhkannya untuk penelitianku.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10056205
Array.english: Can you get me some <color=#4AFFDB>Opals</color>?
Array.indonesia: Bisakah kamu membawakan aku beberapa <color=#4AFFDB>Opal</color>?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10056206
Array.english: Can you get me some <color=#4AFFDB>Aquamarines</color>?
Array.indonesia: Bisakah kamu membawakan aku beberapa <color=#4AFFDB>Aquamarine</color>?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10056207
Array.english: Can you get me some <color=#4AFFDB>Rubies</color>?
Array.indonesia: Bisakah kamu membawakan aku beberapa <color=#4AFFDB>Rubi</color>?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10056208
Array.english: Can you get me some <color=#4AFFDB>Torbernite</color>?
Array.indonesia: Bisakah kamu membawakan aku beberapa <color=#4AFFDB>Torbernite</color>?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10056209
Array.english: I want to see the deep sea creature <color=#4AFFDB>Clione</color>. Can you capture some for me?
Array.indonesia: Aku ingin melihat makhluk laut dalam <color=#4AFFDB>Clione</color>. Bisakah kamu menangkap beberapa untukku?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10056210
Array.english: Traces of ancient creatures… I need some <color=#4AFFDB>Nautiluses</color> for my research.
Array.indonesia: Jejak makhluk purba… Saya membutuhkan beberapa <color=#4AFFDB>Nautilus</color> untuk penelitian saya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10056011
Array.english: Analyzing the characteristics of the polar <color=#008c6f>Marine Plants</color> greatly aids in learning about the ecology.
Array.indonesia: Menganalisis karakteristik <color=#008c6f>Tumbuhan Laut</color> di kutub sangat membantu dalam mempelajari ekologi.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10056012
Array.english: Analyzing the characteristics of the polar <color=#008c6f>Marine Plants</color> greatly aids in learning about the ecology.
Array.indonesia: Menganalisis karakteristik <color=#008c6f>Tumbuhan Laut</color> di kutub sangat membantu dalam mempelajari ekologi.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10056013
Array.english: Analyzing the characteristics of the polar <color=#008c6f>Marine Plants</color> greatly aids in learning about the ecology.
Array.indonesia: Menganalisis karakteristik <color=#008c6f>Tumbuhan Laut</color> di kawasan kutub sangat membantu dalam mempelajari ekologi.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10056014
Array.english: Research <color=#008c6f>Clam Shells</color> to analyze the substances of the sea in the polar regions.
Array.indonesia: Teliti <color=#008c6f>Cangkang Kerang</color> untuk menganalisis zat-zat di laut kawasan kutub.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10056015
Array.english: Research <color=#008c6f>Clam Shells</color> to analyze the substances of the sea in the polar regions.
Array.indonesia: Teliti <color=#008c6f>Cangkang Kerang</color> untuk menganalisis zat-zat di laut kawasan kutub.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10056016
Array.english: The number of <color=#008c6f>North Pacific Seastars</color> is spiking and they are disrupting the ecosystem.\nReduce their number by collecting them.
Array.indonesia: Jumlah <color=#008c6f>Bintang Laut Pasifik Utara</color> sedang melonjak dan mengganggu ekosistem.\nKurangi jumlahnya dengan mengumpulkannya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10056017
Array.english: The number of <color=#008c6f>North Pacific Seastars</color> is spiking and they are disrupting the ecosystem.\nReduce their number by collecting them.
Array.indonesia: Jumlah <color=#008c6f>Bintang Laut Pasifik Utara</color> sedang melonjak dan mengganggu ekosistem.\nKurangi jumlahnya dengan mengumpulkannya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10056018
Array.english: The <color=#008c6f>Artifacts</color> found under the sea can show what the region was like in the past.
Array.indonesia: <color=#008c6f>Artefak</color> yang ditemukan di bawah laut dapat menunjukkan seperti apa wilayah tersebut di masa lalu.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10056019
Array.english: The <color=#008c6f>Artifacts</color> found under the sea can tell what the region was like in the past.
Array.indonesia: <color=#008c6f>Artefak</color> yang ditemukan di bawah laut dapat menceritakan seperti apa wilayah tersebut di masa lalu.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10056020
Array.english: Investigate the mysterious <color=#008c6f>Aquamarine</color> gemstones found in the Blue Hole, and its effects on the marine ecology.
Array.indonesia: Selidiki batu permata <color=#008c6f>Aquamarine</color> misterius yang ditemukan di Blue Hole, serta pengaruhnya terhadap ekologi laut.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10056021
Array.english: Investigate the mysterious <color=#008c6f>Torbernite</color> gemstones found in the Blue Hole to study marine ecology.
Array.indonesia: Selidiki batu permata <color=#008c6f>Torbernite</color> misterius yang ditemukan di Blue Hole untuk mempelajari ekologi laut.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10056022
Array.english: Investigate the mysterious <color=#008c6f>Ruby</color> gemstones found in the Blue  and its effects on the marine ecology.
Array.indonesia: Selidiki batu permata <color=#008c6f>Ruby</color> misterius yang ditemukan di Blue Hole dan pengaruhnya terhadap ekologi laut.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10056023
Array.english: Secure <color=#008c6f>a variety of fish specimens</color> from the hidden place to find a way to preserve the ecology.
Array.indonesia: Dapatkan <color=#008c6f>berbagai spesimen ikan</color> dari tempat tersembunyi untuk menemukan cara melestarikan ekologi.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10056024
Array.english: Secure <color=#008c6f>a variety of fish specimens</color> from the hidden place to find a way to preserve the ecology.
Array.indonesia: Dapatkan <color=#008c6f>berbagai spesimen ikan</color> dari tempat tersembunyi untuk menemukan cara melestarikan ekologi.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10056025
Array.english: Secure <color=#008c6f>a variety of fish specimens</color> from the hidden place to find a way to preserve the ecology.
Array.indonesia: Dapatkan <color=#008c6f>berbagai spesimen ikan</color> dari tempat tersembunyi untuk menemukan cara melestarikan ekologi.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10057001
Array.english: So, the yacht party customers want tuna dishes? I’ll find out how to capture <color=#4AFFDB>tuna</color>.
Array.indonesia: Jadi, para tamu pesta kapal pesiar ingin hidangan tuna? Aku akan mencari tahu cara menangkap <color=#4AFFDB>tuna</color>.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10057002
Array.english: All right! I captured the tuna! I’ll use Cobra’s <color=#4AFFDB>salvage drone</color> to take it back to the boat.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah! Aku sudah menangkap tuna itu! Aku akan menggunakan <color=#4AFFDB>drone penyelamat</color> milik Cobra untuk membawanya kembali ke kapal.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10057004
Array.english: The hideout of the Great White... She said I should look for <color=#4AFFDB>Vortexes</color> on a stormy night.
Array.indonesia: Sarang Hiu Putih Besar... Dia bilang aku harus mencari <color=#4AFFDB>Vortexes</color> pada malam yang berangin kencang.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10057005
Array.english: Oops, that shark is bigger than I thought! What should I do now?
Array.indonesia: Ups, hiu itu lebih besar dari yang kuduga! Apa yang harus kulakukan sekarang?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10057006
Array.english: Whew, I barely managed to defeat it. Let me look for something of value.
Array.indonesia: Wah, aku nyaris saja berhasil mengalahkannya. Biarkan aku mencari sesuatu yang berharga.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10057007
Array.english: Ms. Clara is waiting for me on her boat. I’d better go up now.
Array.indonesia: Nona Clara sedang menungguku di perahunya. Sebaiknya aku naik sekarang.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10057008
Array.english: The <color=#4AFFDB>Cucumber Party</color>? I should ask Otto about cucumber seeds.
Array.indonesia: <color=#4AFFDB>Pesta Mentimun</color>? Aku harus bertanya pada Otto tentang benih mentimun.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10057009
Array.english: I should ask Bancho if he knows any cucumber recipes.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus bertanya pada Bancho apakah dia tahu resep mentimun.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10057015
Array.english: Another storm. I was instructed to enter a <color=#4AFFDB>Vortex</color> at night.
Array.indonesia: Badai lagi. Aku diperintahkan untuk memasuki <color=#4AFFDB>Vortex</color> di malam hari.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10057016
Array.english: Uh, what is this place? Let me take a sneak peek.
Array.indonesia: Eh, tempat apa ini? Biarkan aku mengintip sebentar.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10057017
Array.english: Wow, a creature with huge fists. I have no place to hide!
Array.indonesia: Wow, makhluk dengan tinju raksasa. Aku tidak punya tempat untuk bersembunyi!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10057018
Array.english: Whew, I barely managed to defeat it. Let me look for something of value.
Array.indonesia: Whew, aku nyaris saja berhasil mengalahkannya. Biarkan aku mencari sesuatu yang berharga.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10057021
Array.english: The hidden final Marinca card… I have to enter the <color=#4AFFDB>Vortex</color> if I want to get it.
Array.indonesia: Kartu Marinca terakhir yang tersembunyi… Aku harus masuk ke <color=#4AFFDB>Vortex</color> kalau mau mendapatkannya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10057022
Array.english: This place is big… It must be here somewhere. I should look around.
Array.indonesia: Tempat ini luas… Pasti ada di sini di suatu tempat. Sebaiknya aku cari-cari dulu.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10057023
Array.english: A shark head with octopus arms?! This creature makes zero sense…!
Array.indonesia: Kepala hiu dengan lengan gurita?! Makhluk ini benar-benar nggak masuk akal…!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10057024
Array.english: Whew… I barely managed to defeat it. I should check if there's anything worth taking.
Array.indonesia: Wah… Aku nyaris saja kalah. Sebaiknya aku periksa apakah ada barang yang layak diambil.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10057501
Array.english: Hmm. He just gave me some <color=#4AFFDB>Pepper Seed</color> and left. I should ask Otto if I can plant it.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Dia baru saja memberiku beberapa <color=#4AFFDB>Biji Lada</color> lalu pergi. Sebaiknya aku tanya Otto apakah aku bisa menanamnya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10057502
Array.english: Hmm. You learned how to harvest peppers. Then can you cook me some Hot Pepper Tuna?
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Kamu sudah belajar cara memanen lada. Kalau begitu, bisakah kamu memasakkan Hot Pepper Tuna untukku?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10057503
Array.english: Something seems to be troubling Sammy. I should go to the farm and talk to him.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya ada sesuatu yang mengganggu Sammy. Aku harus pergi ke kebun dan berbicara dengannya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10057504
Array.english: It looks like Sammy's got some news to share with me. I should go to the farm and talk to him.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya Sammy punya kabar yang ingin dibagikan padaku. Aku harus pergi ke kebun dan berbicara dengannya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050168
Array.english: There is a cave from which the Sea People’s signal originates.\nThat cave needs to be investigated.
Array.indonesia: Ada sebuah gua yang menjadi sumber sinyal Suku Laut.\nGua itu perlu diselidiki.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050169
Array.english: A mural depicting an old story.\nThis warrants an investigation.
Array.indonesia: Sebuah lukisan dinding yang menggambarkan sebuah kisah kuno.\nIni perlu diselidiki.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050170
Array.english: There must be something on the other side of this door.\nHow am I supposed to open it?
Array.indonesia: Pasti ada sesuatu di balik pintu ini.\nBagaimana cara membukanya?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059170
Array.english: T-There are sea people bones...!\nWhat on earth happened...?!
Array.indonesia: T-Ada tulang-tulang Suku Laut...!\nApa yang sebenarnya terjadi...?!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050171
Array.english: I must bring the artifact for further study.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus membawa artefak ini untuk diteliti lebih lanjut.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050172
Array.english: Pirates! Are they here to raid?\nWe should run for our lives!
Array.indonesia: Bajak laut! Apakah mereka datang untuk menyerang?\nKita harus lari menyelamatkan diri!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050173
Array.english: Sea Blue deploys scouting drones at night.\nFollow one of them and I might find the base.
Array.indonesia: Sea Blue mengerahkan drone pengintai di malam hari.\nIkuti salah satunya dan mungkin aku bisa menemukan markasnya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050174
Array.english: That must be one of those drones.\nI should follow it without being noticed.
Array.indonesia: Itu pasti salah satu drone itu.\nAku harus mengikutinya tanpa ketahuan.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050175
Array.english: This is the base of Sea Blue?\nThey’re processing dolphins!
Array.indonesia: Inikah markas Sea Blue?\nMereka sedang mengolah lumba-lumba!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050176
Array.english: There must be a part somewhere here.\nI should hurry before I am noticed.
Array.indonesia: Pasti ada bagiannya di suatu tempat di sini.\nAku harus bergegas sebelum ketahuan.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050178
Array.english: Will you go to Tsuchi’s house? He’s a seaweed collector. There should be <color=#4AFFDB>traces of jellyfish</color> his turtle had been eating.
Array.indonesia: Maukah kamu pergi ke rumah Tsuchi? Dia seorang pengumpul rumput laut. Seharusnya ada <color=#4AFFDB>jejak ubur-ubur</color> yang dimakan penyu miliknya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050179
Array.english: Are these the traces of jellyfish that Tsuchi’s turtle had been eating? I’ll have to follow them.
Array.indonesia: Apakah ini jejak ubur-ubur yang dimakan penyu milik Tsuchi? Aku harus mengikuti jejaknya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050180
Array.english: Argh...! The giant leatherback turtle is going crazy! I’ll have to hold it and calm it down.
Array.indonesia: Argh...! Penyu belimbing raksasa itu jadi gila! Aku harus menahannya dan menenangkannya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050181
Array.english: So it was because of the plastic bag... People shouldn’t be throwing this into the ocean. Now I’ll go back to <color=#4AFFDB>Mima</color>!
Array.indonesia: Jadi ternyata karena kantong plastik... Orang-orang tidak boleh membuang ini ke laut. Sekarang aku akan kembali ke <color=#4AFFDB>Mima</color>!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050182
Array.english: Will you please find my pet squid Selgio? It once got lost trying to follow a <color=#4AFFDB>shining jellyfish</color>.
Array.indonesia: Bisakah kamu tolong cari cumi-cumi peliharaan saya, Selgio? Dia pernah tersesat saat mencoba mengikuti <color=#4AFFDB>ubur-ubur bercahaya</color>.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050183
Array.english: Hmm, I think it should be here somewhere. Maybe inside that hole...?
Array.indonesia: Hmm, sepertinya dia ada di sekitar sini. Mungkin di dalam lubang itu...?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050184
Array.english: Okay, it looks good now... I’ll use Linchen’s <color=#4AFFDB>food</color> to lure it out!
Array.indonesia: Oke, sepertinya sudah aman sekarang... Aku akan menggunakan <color=#4AFFDB>makanan</color> milik Linchen untuk memancingnya keluar!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050185
Array.english: Now! I’ll capture Selgio!
Array.indonesia: Sekarang! Aku akan menangkap Selgio!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059185
Array.english: So Selgio was hiding here...I need to take him to Linchen.
Array.indonesia: Jadi Selgio bersembunyi di sini... Aku harus membawanya ke Linchen.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050186
Array.english: Maro went out to see the Underwater Lake but hasn’t come back... You’ll find Maro if you follow the <color=#4AFFDB>signs</color> in the deep waters!
Array.indonesia: Maro pergi untuk melihat Danau Bawah Air tapi belum kembali... Kamu akan menemukan Maro jika mengikuti <color=#4AFFDB>tanda-tanda</color> di perairan dalam!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059186
Array.english: I can’t get in because the rocks collapsed... I think a <color=#4AFFDB>pickaxe</color> might get me through.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak bisa masuk karena bebatuan runtuh... Kurasa <color=#4AFFDB>kapak</color> mungkin bisa membantuku melewatinya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050187
Array.english: The sea child should be inside. Look around carefully!
Array.indonesia: Anak laut itu seharusnya ada di dalam. Perhatikan sekeliling dengan saksama!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059187
Array.english: Underwater Lake... Fascinating. Maybe I should take a <color=#4AFFDB>picture</color> of it.
Array.indonesia: Danau Bawah Air... Menarik sekali. Mungkin aku harus mengambil <color=#4AFFDB>foto</color> tempat ini.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059188
Array.english: I think I heard some screams from inside. That's kinda scary...but I guess I should go in.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya aku mendengar teriakan dari dalam. Agak menakutkan... tapi kurasa aku harus masuk.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050188
Array.english: Argh...! I’ll have to defeat the <color=#4AFFDB>Goblin Shark</color> to save the child!
Array.indonesia: Argh...! Aku harus mengalahkan <color=#4AFFDB>Hiu Goblin</color> untuk menyelamatkan anak itu!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059190
Array.english: Is there anything worth salvaging from the <color=#4AFFDB>Goblin Shark</color>? Let's investigate.
Array.indonesia: Apa ada yang layak diselamatkan dari <color=#4AFFDB>Hiu Goblin</color>? Ayo kita selidiki.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050189
Array.english: Borrow me a book from the <color=#4AFFDB>temple</color>!\nAsk Niamo about the details.
Array.indonesia: Pinjamkan aku buku dari <color=#4AFFDB>kuil</color>!\nTanyakan detailnya pada Niamo.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050190
Array.english: I hope this is the right book. I’ll go back to the Seed Shop.
Array.indonesia: Semoga ini buku yang tepat. Aku akan kembali ke Toko Benih.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050191
Array.english: I won’t farm seaweed for humans. Unless there’s a <color=#4AFFDB>cook</color> who makes a decent seaweed dish.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak akan menanam rumput laut untuk manusia. Kecuali ada <color=#4AFFDB>koki</color> yang bisa membuat hidangan rumput laut yang enak.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050192
Array.english: A seaweed dish... I can do that. Bring me <color=#4AFFDB>seaweed</color>, <color=#4AFFDB>white rice</color>, and <color=#4AFFDB>sea urchin</color>.
Array.indonesia: Hidangan rumput laut... Aku bisa membuatnya. Bawakan aku <color=#4AFFDB>rumput laut</color>, <color=#4AFFDB>nasi putih</color>, dan <color=#4AFFDB>landak laut</color>.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050193
Array.english: All right! I’ll deliver this sea urchin and seaweed bibimbap to <color=#4AFFDB>Gumo</color>.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah! Aku akan mengantarkan bibimbap landak laut dan rumput laut ini ke <color=#4AFFDB>Gumo</color>.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050194
Array.english: You need <color=#4AFFDB>feather coral</color> and <color=#4AFFDB>lily coral</color> to make Coral Porridge... But can a human make it? *Coughs*
Array.indonesia: Kamu butuh <color=#4AFFDB>karang bulu</color> dan <color=#4AFFDB>karang lili</color> untuk membuat Bubur Karang... Tapi, apakah manusia bisa membuatnya? *Batuk*

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050195
Array.english: Ask Bancho to cook <color=#4AFFDB>Coral Porridge</color>.
Array.indonesia: Minta Bancho untuk memasak <color=#4AFFDB>Bubur Karang</color>.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050196
Array.english: All right! I’ll deliver <color=#4AFFDB>Coral Porridge</color> to the sick sea person at the Workshop.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah! Aku akan mengantarkan <color=#4AFFDB>Bubur Karang</color> ke makhluk laut yang sakit di Bengkel.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050197
Array.english: I need 5 <color=#4AFFDB>opals</color> to reopen the workshop... Will you bring them to me, human?
Array.indonesia: Aku butuh 5 <color=#4AFFDB>opal</color> untuk membuka kembali bengkel... Maukah kamu membawakannya kepadaku, manusia?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050198
Array.english: I need <color=#4AFFDB>Divine Tree fruit</color> for smelting... Will you come with me? *Coughs*
Array.indonesia: Aku butuh <color=#4AFFDB>buah Pohon Ilahi</color> untuk peleburan... Maukah kamu ikut denganku? *Batuk*

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050199
Array.english: Pick Divine Tree fruit and drop it in Duwa’s basket. I need 5 of them!
Array.indonesia: Petik buah Pohon Ilahi dan masukkan ke keranjang Duwa. Aku butuh 5 buah!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050200
Array.english: Junak took my Beluga Whistle! Retrieve it for me, human!
Array.indonesia: Junak mengambil Peluit Beluga-ku! Ambilkan kembali untukku, manusia!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050201
Array.english: Hm, win a game of cards and I can have the whistle back? All right, nothing to lose here.
Array.indonesia: Hm, menang dalam permainan kartu dan aku bisa dapat peluitnya kembali? Baiklah, tidak ada ruginya di sini.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050202
Array.english: I am unbeatable when it comes to fried food. Bring me <color=#4AFFDB>Cookiecutter Shark</color>, <color=#4AFFDB>Vampire Squid</color>, <color=#4AFFDB>Barreleye</color>, and <color=#4AFFDB>kelps</color>.
Array.indonesia: Aku tak terkalahkan dalam hal makanan goreng. Bawakan aku <color=#4AFFDB>Hiu Pemotong Kue</color>, <color=#4AFFDB>Cumi Vampir</color>, <color=#4AFFDB>Ikan Mata Tong</color>, dan <color=#4AFFDB>rumput laut</color>.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050203
Array.english: It’s time to decide who’s the real maestro of fried food, <color=#4AFFDB>Alex</color>.
Array.indonesia: Saatnya menentukan siapa maestro sejati makanan goreng, <color=#4AFFDB>Alex</color>.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050204
Array.english: Pasta... It’s not something I am familiar with. Bring me <color=#4AFFDB>Humboldt Squid</color>, <color=#4AFFDB>White Shrimp</color>, <color=#4AFFDB>Wheat</color>, and <color=#4AFFDB>Garlic</color>.
Array.indonesia: Pasta... Itu bukan sesuatu yang aku kenal. Bawakan aku <color=#4AFFDB>Humboldt Squid</color>, <color=#4AFFDB>White Shrimp</color>, <color=#4AFFDB>Wheat</color>, dan <color=#4AFFDB>Garlic</color>.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050205
Array.english: It’s time to decide the winner, <color=#4AFFDB>Pastro</color>!
Array.indonesia: Saatnya menentukan pemenangnya, <color=#4AFFDB>Pastro</color>!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050206
Array.english: Whew, it was a close call. I should deliver this <color=#4AFFDB>mechanical part</color> to Dr. Bacon.
Array.indonesia: Wah, hampir saja. Aku harus mengantarkan <color=#4AFFDB>komponen mekanis</color> ini ke Dr. Bacon.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050207
Array.english: Good. Now, to put on the suit Dr. Bacon made and visit the <color=#4AFFDB>Glacial Area</color> again.
Array.indonesia: Bagus. Sekarang, saatnya mengenakan pakaian yang dibuat Dr. Bacon dan mengunjungi <color=#4AFFDB>Kawasan Gletser</color> lagi.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050208
Array.english: Wow, I never imagined that there could be such a large frozen area in the deep sea. I should explore the area.
Array.indonesia: Wah, aku tidak pernah membayangkan ada kawasan beku seluas ini di laut dalam. Aku harus menjelajahi kawasan ini.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050209
Array.english: The content of this <color=#4AFFDB>Stone Slab</color> needs to be deciphered. I must take a picture of it.
Array.indonesia: Isi <color=#4AFFDB>Lempengan Batu</color> ini perlu diuraikan. Aku harus memotretnya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050210
Array.english: An ancient stone slab found in the Glacial Area. I wonder if Dr. Bacon can decipher the texts?
Array.indonesia: Sebuah lempengan batu kuno yang ditemukan di Area Glacial. Aku penasaran apakah Dr. Bacon bisa menguraikan teks-teksnya?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050211
Array.english: I should ask Niamo about the text on the stone slab.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus bertanya kepada Niamo tentang teks di lempengan batu itu.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050212
Array.english: This door opens only by casting an ancient spell. Suwam will help you.
Array.indonesia: Pintu ini hanya bisa dibuka dengan melantunkan mantra kuno. Suwam akan membantumu.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050213
Array.english: I am exhausted from casting the spell. You go alone, human.
Array.indonesia: Aku kelelahan setelah melantunkan mantra itu. Pergilah sendiri, manusia.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050214
Array.english: Hm. I heard that I must activate the contraption inside to cool down the water temperature.
Array.indonesia: Hm. Aku dengar aku harus mengaktifkan alat di dalamnya untuk menurunkan suhu air.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050215
Array.english: I must report back to Tenzhin.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus melapor kembali ke Tenzhin.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050216
Array.english: The Beluga went missing. I hope it didn’t wander all the way to the <color=#4AFFDB>Glacial Area</color>.
Array.indonesia: Beluga itu hilang. Kuharap ia tidak sampai berkeliaran ke <color=#4AFFDB>Kawasan Gletser</color>.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050217
Array.english: That <color=#4AFFDB>Antarctic Octopus</color>’s venom immobilized the Beluga. Let’s punish that octopus.
Array.indonesia: Racun <color=#4AFFDB>Gurita Antartika</color> itu membuat Beluga lumpuh. Ayo kita hukum gurita itu.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050218
Array.english: This looks like an antidote. I should give it to the Beluga.
Array.indonesia: Ini sepertinya penawar racun. Aku harus memberikannya kepada Beluga.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050219
Array.english: The second cave looks inaccessible because of the strong current. Should I check the place again?
Array.indonesia: Gua kedua tampak tidak bisa dijangkau karena arus yang kuat. Haruskah aku memeriksa tempat itu lagi?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050220
Array.english: Wow, the Beluga can swim against the current! Let me activate the contraption.
Array.indonesia: Wah, Beluga bisa berenang melawan arus! Biarkan aku mengaktifkan alat itu.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050221
Array.english: Yikes! A giant jellyfish! That squishy part is impervious to attack.
Array.indonesia: Astaga! Ubur-ubur raksasa! Bagian lunaknya kebal terhadap serangan.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050222
Array.english: Good. Let’s activate the second contraption.
Array.indonesia: Bagus. Ayo kita aktifkan alat kedua.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050223
Array.english: The water temperature has stabilized a lot. I can go down further now.
Array.indonesia: Suhu air sudah jauh lebih stabil. Sekarang aku bisa turun lebih dalam.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050224
Array.english: The cave is a mess. You should come with me, human.
Array.indonesia: Gua ini berantakan. Kamu sebaiknya ikut denganku, manusia.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050225
Array.english: Something is wrong with the Divine Tree. It absorbed all the water around it. We must reopen the waterway.
Array.indonesia: Ada yang tidak beres dengan Pohon Suci. Pohon itu menyerap semua air di sekitarnya. Kita harus membuka kembali saluran airnya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050226
Array.english: Wow, that shark has a sawblade in its mouth. You go fight it. I will support you with the <color=#4AFFDB>Divine Tree Fruit</color> from behind you!
Array.indonesia: Wow, hiu itu punya bilah gergaji di mulutnya. Kamu yang melawan dia. Aku akan mendukungmu dengan <color=#4AFFDB>Buah Pohon Suci</color> dari belakangmu!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059224
Array.english: *Sighs* A shark with a saw blade?\nLet's see if there's anything worth keeping.
Array.indonesia: *Menghela napas* Hiu dengan bilah gergaji?\nAyo lihat apakah ada yang layak disimpan.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059225
Array.english: Enter the door that the Helicoprion broke. There should be a third switch there!
Array.indonesia: Masuklah ke pintu yang dihancurkan oleh Helicoprion. Seharusnya ada sakelar ketiga di sana!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059226
Array.english: Okay. let's activate the third switch.
Array.indonesia: Oke. Ayo aktifkan sakelar ketiga.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050227
Array.english: I am not sure if my weapon will be still effective in the Glacial Area. I should give Duff a call.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak yakin apakah senjataku masih efektif di Area Glacial. Sebaiknya aku menelepon Duff.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050228
Array.english: Oh, I remember seeing a <color=#4AFFDB>Workshop</color> at the Sea People Village. I should drop by the place.
Array.indonesia: Oh, aku ingat pernah melihat <color=#4AFFDB>Bengkel</color> di Desa Suku Laut. Sebaiknya aku mampir ke sana.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050229
Array.english: A way to lure a Manta Ray... Hm, I think <color=#4AFFDB>Ellie</color> should have a better idea.
Array.indonesia: Cara untuk memancing Ikan Manta... Hm, kurasa <color=#4AFFDB>Ellie</color> pasti punya ide yang lebih bagus.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050230
Array.english: I need to collect 5 kelp. But what does that have to do with Manta Rays?
Array.indonesia: Aku perlu mengumpulkan 5 rumput laut. Tapi apa hubungannya dengan Ikan Manta?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050231
Array.english: Good. I got a <color=#4AFFDB>Lure Capsule</color> now. I should give Woodo a call.
Array.indonesia: Bagus. Sekarang aku sudah punya <color=#4AFFDB>Kapsul Umpan</color>. Sebaiknya aku menelepon Woodo.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050232
Array.english: I installed lighting fixtures to help you take better pictures. At a depth of about <color=#4AFFDB>20 meters</color>.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah memasang lampu untuk membantumu mengambil foto yang lebih bagus. Di kedalaman sekitar <color=#4AFFDB>20 meter</color>.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050233
Array.english: The lighting fixtures are scattered all over the ground. I can’t take pictures as they are. I need to stand them up.
Array.indonesia: Lampu-lampu itu berserakan di mana-mana. Aku tidak bisa mengambil foto dalam kondisi seperti ini. Aku harus menegakkannya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050234
Array.english: So, I am supposed to use the <color=#4AFFDB>Lure Capsule</color> here?
Array.indonesia: Jadi, aku harus menggunakan <color=#4AFFDB>Lure Capsule</color> di sini?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050235
Array.english: As long as I am exposed like this, <color=#4AFFDB>Manta Rays</color> won’t come. I need to find a place to hide.
Array.indonesia: Selama saya terpapar seperti ini, <color=#4AFFDB>Ikan Manta</color> tidak akan datang. Saya perlu mencari tempat untuk bersembunyi.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050236
Array.english: Wow, it’s so big! It’s my chance to take pictures of the <color=#4AFFDB>Manta Ray</color>!
Array.indonesia: Wow, besar sekali! Ini kesempatan saya untuk memotret <color=#4AFFDB>Ikan Manta</color>!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059237
Array.english: I activated all three switches, so the door must have opened. Should I head to the control room entrance?
Array.indonesia: Saya telah mengaktifkan ketiga sakelar, jadi pintunya pasti sudah terbuka. Haruskah aku menuju pintu masuk ruang kontrol?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050237
Array.english: <color=#4AFFDB>John Watson</color>... You brought a submarine? You will pay for your foolishness now!
Array.indonesia: <color=#4AFFDB>John Watson</color>... Kamu membawa kapal selam? Sekarang kamu akan menanggung akibat kebodohanmu!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050238
Array.english: A dinosaur? It can't be easily defeated. I should use John Watson’s <color=#4AFFDB>Missile Launcher</color> against it.
Array.indonesia: Seekor dinosaurus? Dia tidak bisa dikalahkan dengan mudah. Aku harus menggunakan <color=#4AFFDB>Peluncur Rudal</color> milik John Watson untuk menghadapinya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059238
Array.english: *Sighs* I almost got burned. I should check if there's anything useful on the body.
Array.indonesia: *Menghela napas* Aku hampir terbakar. Aku harus memeriksa apakah ada barang berguna di tubuhnya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050239
Array.english: This branch was so thick that I barely managed to cut it. Come back to the <color=#4AFFDB>Entrance to the Control Room</color>!
Array.indonesia: Cabang ini sangat tebal sehingga aku hampir tidak bisa memotongnya. Kembalilah ke <color=#4AFFDB>Pintu Masuk Ruang Kontrol</color>!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050240
Array.english: The door to the <color=#4AFFDB>Control Room</color> is now open. I should explore inside.
Array.indonesia: Pintu ke <color=#4AFFDB>Ruang Kontrol</color> sekarang sudah terbuka. Aku harus menjelajahi bagian dalamnya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050241
Array.english: The Divine Tree turned into something totally new! I should find another way to go through the door.
Array.indonesia: Pohon Ilahi berubah menjadi sesuatu yang benar-benar baru! Aku harus mencari cara lain untuk melewati pintu itu.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050242
Array.english: Good! The door is now open. It’s creepy, but I should explore the area.
Array.indonesia: Bagus! Pintunya sekarang terbuka. Rasanya menyeramkan, tapi aku harus menjelajahi area ini.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050243
Array.english: OMG...Weird eggs are hatching!! I'll have to figure out how to clear the way!
Array.indonesia: Astaga... Telur-telur aneh sedang menetas!! Aku harus mencari cara untuk membersihkan jalan!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050244
Array.english: Whew, they’re gone now. Let me go inside!
Array.indonesia: Wah, mereka sudah hilang sekarang. Ayo aku masuk!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059244
Array.english: There's a bunch of ancient creature offspring attached to the core of the Divine Tree. Better get rid of them first...!
Array.indonesia: Ada sekelompok keturunan makhluk purba yang menempel di inti Pohon Ilahi. Sebaiknya aku singkirkan mereka dulu...!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050245
Array.english: The creature modified by the ancient Sea People grew so huge! The creature was the reason for the earthquakes! Please, take care of that thing, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Makhluk yang dimodifikasi oleh Suku Laut purba itu tumbuh sangat besar! Makhluk itulah penyebab gempa bumi! Tolong, tangani makhluk itu, Dave.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050246
Array.english: Yawie... That creature is the cause of the earthquake...! This is our only chance! Let's chase it!
Array.indonesia: Yawie... Makhluk itu adalah penyebab gempa bumi...! Ini satu-satunya kesempatan kita! Ayo kejar dia!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050247
Array.english: It's amazing to see the Sea People come to our aid... Let's utilize the <color=#4AFFDB>firing device</color> to finally take down Yawie.
Array.indonesia: Luar biasa melihat Suku Laut datang membantu kita... Ayo manfaatkan <color=#4AFFDB>alat penembak</color> untuk akhirnya mengalahkan Yawie.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050248
Array.english: Go to Bancho’s Sushi Bar.
Array.indonesia: Pergilah ke Bancho’s Sushi Bar.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050249
Array.english: Phew. What a hectic few days. I haven’t had this much free time in a while.\nI should talk with some people.
Array.indonesia: Wah. Beberapa hari terakhir ini sungguh sibuk. Sudah lama aku tidak punya waktu luang sebanyak ini.\nAku harus ngobrol dengan beberapa orang.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050250
Array.english: There’s my Beer mug.\nI should pick it up for a toast!
Array.indonesia: Itu gelas birku.\nAku harus mengambilnya untuk bersulang!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050251
Array.english: Gumo said the baby manatee was gone, right? \nMaybe it's at the <color=#4AFFDB> Glacial Area</color>...?
Array.indonesia: Gumo bilang bayi manatee itu hilang, kan? \nMungkin dia ada di <color=#4AFFDB> Area Gletser</color>...?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050264
Array.english: Duwa's coughing won't stop… Maybe Mima has some advice?
Array.indonesia: Batuk Duwa tak kunjung berhenti… Mungkin Mima punya saran?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050265
Array.english: Otto used to be a diver. He should know how to catch Horsehair Crabs.
Array.indonesia: Otto dulunya seorang penyelam. Dia pasti tahu cara menangkap Kepiting Rambut Kuda.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050266
Array.english: Haha. Crafting a <color=#4AFFDB>Crab Trap</color> isn't hard at all. Just get me the materials!
Array.indonesia: Haha. Membuat <color=#4AFFDB>Perangkap Kepiting</color> itu sama sekali tidak sulit. Cukup berikan saja bahan-bahannya padaku!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050267
Array.english: Alright! I gathered all the materials for the <color=#4AFFDB>Crab Trap</color>. I should go back to Otto.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah! Aku sudah mengumpulkan semua bahan untuk <color=#4AFFDB>Perangkap Kepiting</color>. Sebaiknya aku kembali menemui Otto.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050268
Array.english: Let's catch a <color=#4AFFDB>Horsehair Crab</color> at the Glacial Area with the Crab Trap made by Otto.
Array.indonesia: Ayo kita tangkap <color=#4AFFDB>Kepiting Rambut Kuda</color> di Area Gletser dengan Perangkap Kepiting buatan Otto.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050269
Array.english: Alright! I caught a <color=#4AFFDB>Horsehair Crab</color>! I should give this to Mima.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah! Aku berhasil menangkap <color=#4AFFDB>Kepiting Bulu Kuda</color>! Aku harus memberikan ini kepada Mima.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050270
Array.english: So, <color=#4AFFDB>Steamed Horsehair Crab</color> is good for coughs. I should give this to Duwa.
Array.indonesia: Jadi, <color=#4AFFDB>Kepiting Bulu Kuda Kukus</color> bagus untuk meredakan batuk. Aku harus memberikan ini kepada Duwa.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050271
Array.english: Someone seems to be trapped inside the Ice Cave. I should lure the <color=#4AFFDB>narwhal</color> to break the ice wall.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya ada seseorang yang terjebak di dalam Gua Es. Aku harus memancing <color=#4AFFDB>narwhal</color> untuk menghancurkan dinding es.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050272
Array.english: Alright! I broke the ice wall. I should go inside.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah! Aku sudah menghancurkan dinding es. Aku harus masuk ke dalam.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050273
Array.english: The current is stronger than I thought. I should avoid any sharp icicles.
Array.indonesia: Arusnya lebih kuat dari yang kuduga. Aku harus menghindari es yang runcing.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050274
Array.english: Another ice wall. I'm sure Dona can break through it.
Array.indonesia: Dinding es lagi. Aku yakin Dona bisa menembusnya.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050275
Array.english: The ice wall is down! I should exit through the open passage.
Array.indonesia: Dinding esnya sudah hancur! Aku harus keluar melalui lorong yang terbuka ini.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050276
Array.english: I'm sorry to ask again, but...could you please find Selgio for me? I saw a shining jellyfish near the\n<color=#4AFFDB>glacial passage</color> and I wonder if he may have followed it…
Array.indonesia: Maaf harus bertanya lagi, tapi... bisakah kamu tolong cari Selgio untukku? Aku melihat ubur-ubur bercahaya di dekat\n<color=#4AFFDB>lorong gletser</color> dan aku penasaran apakah dia mungkin mengikutinya…

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050277
Array.english: Alright! This must be the jellyfish. I should follow it!
Array.indonesia: Baiklah! Ini pasti ubur-uburnya. Aku harus mengikutinya!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050278
Array.english: Oh… This looks pretty complicated. Still, I have to follow it!
Array.indonesia: Oh… Ini kelihatannya cukup rumit. Tapi, aku harus mengikutinya!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050279
Array.english: Selgio must be nearby. I should search every nook and cranny.
Array.indonesia: Selgio pasti ada di dekat sini. Aku harus mencari di setiap sudut dan celah.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050280
Array.english: Selgio is hiding behind the ice. How do I get him out?
Array.indonesia: Selgio bersembunyi di balik es. Bagaimana cara mengeluarkannya?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050281
Array.english: Alright! I got Selgio. I should take him to Linchen.
Array.indonesia: Baiklah! Aku sudah menemukan Selgio. Aku harus membawanya ke Linchen.

Array.name: Mission_Condition_100
Array.english: Return to Boat
Array.indonesia: Kembali ke Perahu

Array.name: Mission_Condition_101
Array.english: Find Rope
Array.indonesia: Temukan Tali

Array.name: Mission_Condition_102
Array.english: Find Scrap Iron
Array.indonesia: Temukan Besi Rongsokan

Array.name: Mission_Condition_10030004
Array.english: Catch Fish
Array.indonesia: Tangkap Ikan

Array.name: Mission_Condition_10001
Array.english: Find Sea People Artifact (70m)
Array.indonesia: Temukan Artefak Suku Laut (70m)

Array.name: Mission_Condition_10002
Array.english: Go to Sushi Bar
Array.indonesia: Pergi ke Sushi Bar

Array.name: Mission_Condition_10003
Array.english: Get 10 Followers
Array.indonesia: Dapatkan 10 Pengikut

Array.name: Mission_Condition_10004
Array.english: Upgrade Diving Suit to Lv. 2
Array.indonesia: Tingkatkan Pakaian Selam ke Lv. 2

Array.name: Mission_Condition_1001
Array.english: Find Iron Soccer Ball (30m)
Array.indonesia: Temukan Bola Sepak Besi (30m)

Array.name: Mission_Condition_1002
Array.english: Find the Striped Snapper
Array.indonesia: Temukan Ikan Kakap Garis-garis

Array.name: Mission_Condition_30001
Array.english: Create Peter’s Order within the Time Limit!
Array.indonesia: Selesaikan Pesanan Peter dalam Batas Waktu!

Array.name: Mission_Condition_30002
Array.english: Serve the Special Sushi Set to Michael Bang!
Array.indonesia: Sajikan Paket Sushi Spesial kepada Michael Bang!

Array.name: Mission_Condition_40001
Array.english: Talk to Noisy Customer
Array.indonesia: Bicaralah dengan Pelanggan yang Ribut

Array.name: Mission_Condition_40002
Array.english: Serve Moray Curry!
Array.indonesia: Sajikan Kari Moray!

Array.name: Mission_Condition_40003
Array.english: Go to the Empty Lot behind the Sushi Bar!
Array.indonesia: Pergi ke Lahan Kosong di belakang Bar Sushi!

Array.name: Mission_Condition_40004
Array.english: Go to the Farm!
