Array.name: NPC_Name_Mxmtoon
Array.english: mxmtoon
Array.indonesia: mxmtoon

Array.name: Sushi_ZoneE_Stage_mxmtoon_Name
Array.english: Small stage
Array.indonesia: Panggung kecil

Array.name: Sushi_ZoneE_Stage_mxmtoon_Desc
Array.english: This is a stage for mxmtoon. On days she is not around, it will play the instrumental version of her songs.
Array.indonesia: Ini adalah panggung untuk mxmtoon. Pada hari-hari ketika dia tidak ada, panggung ini akan memutar versi instrumental dari lagu-lagunya.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_001
Array.english: Hello. Is this a sushi restaurant?
Array.indonesia: Halo. Apakah ini restoran sushi?

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_002
Array.english: Yes, it is. Sorry, but I have to mention…
Array.indonesia: Ya, benar. Maaf, tapi saya harus bilang…

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_003
Array.english: I feel like I have seen you before.
Array.indonesia: Rasanya saya pernah melihat Anda sebelumnya.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_004
Array.english: That's good to hear! My name is mxmtoon. \nI am a singer-songwriter.
Array.indonesia: Senang mendengarnya! Nama saya mxmtoon. \nSaya seorang penyanyi-penulis lagu.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_005
Array.english: Oh, so that's how I know you! \nIsn't one of your songs?
Array.indonesia: Oh, jadi itu sebabnya saya mengenal Anda! \nBukankah adalah salah satu lagu Anda?

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_006
Array.english: <size=33>Aww! I am so happy you know my song!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aww! Saya sangat senang Anda mengenal lagu saya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_007
Array.english: Actually... my album is coming out soon and I am so nervous...
Array.indonesia: Sebenarnya… album saya akan segera dirilis dan saya sangat gugup…

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_008
Array.english: I think eating my favorite food would help to ease my heart a bit.
Array.indonesia: Aku rasa makan makanan favoritku akan sedikit menenangkan hatiku.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_009
Array.english: What kind of food is it...?
Array.indonesia: Makanan apa itu...?

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_010
Array.english: It's a dish called <color=#F1DC2B>Chirashi Sushi</color>…\nCould you make some for me?
Array.indonesia: Itu adalah hidangan bernama <color=#F1DC2B>Chirashi Sushi</color>…\nBisakah kamu membuatkannya untukku?

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_011
Array.english: <color=#F1DC2B>Chirashi Sushi</color> is not a difficult dish at all.
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Chirashi Sushi</color> sama sekali bukan hidangan yang sulit.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_012
Array.english: But... this isn't just any Chirashi Sushi, I am looking for one made with a special ingredient.
Array.indonesia: Tapi... ini bukan Chirashi Sushi biasa, aku mencari yang dibuat dengan bahan khusus.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_013
Array.english: <size=33>Do you know what a <color=#1DFEAF>Green Sea Urchin</color> is?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Apakah kamu tahu apa itu <color=#1DFEAF>Landak Laut Hijau</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_014
Array.english: Yes, of course. The finest of all sea urchins.
Array.indonesia: Ya, tentu saja. Landak laut terbaik di antara semuanya.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_015
Array.english: But...
Array.indonesia: Tapi...

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_016
Array.english: This sea urchin is very hard to find, as it hides in the crevices of rocks. That makes it even more valuable.
Array.indonesia: Landak laut ini sangat sulit ditemukan, karena bersembunyi di celah-celah batu. Hal itu membuatnya semakin berharga.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_017
Array.english: Between rocks…\nI'd just have to dig around a bit.
Array.indonesia: Di antara batu-batu…\nAku hanya perlu menggali sedikit.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_018
Array.english: Ah...! What if...</size>
Array.indonesia: Ah...! Bagaimana kalau...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_019
Array.english: Yes? What is it?
Array.indonesia: Ya? Ada apa?

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_020
Array.english: <size=33>Can I go into the sea and look for them myself?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Bolehkah aku masuk ke laut dan mencarinya sendiri?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_021
Array.english: <size=35>What…?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Apa…?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_022
Array.english: You see... I've learned a bit of diving too, hehe.
Array.indonesia: Begini... Aku juga sudah belajar menyelam sedikit, hehe.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_023
Array.english: If you could help me a little, I think I might be able to catch them myself...\nIs there any way you could?
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu bisa bantu aku sedikit, kurasa aku bisa menangkapnya sendiri...\nApakah ada cara kamu bisa membantuku?

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_024
Array.english: But... the Blue Hole is a dangerous place.
Array.indonesia: Tapi... Blue Hole itu tempat yang berbahaya.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_025
Array.english: If you do me this favor, I will come and perform here! For free!
Array.indonesia: Kalau kamu mau membantuku, aku akan datang dan tampil di sini! Gratis!

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_026
Array.english: Dave, perhaps you should agree.
Array.indonesia: Dave, mungkin kamu sebaiknya setuju.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_027
Array.english: There's something special about eating a dish made with ingredients you caught yourself.
Array.indonesia: Ada sesuatu yang istimewa saat menyantap hidangan yang dibuat dari bahan-bahan yang kamu tangkap sendiri.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_028
Array.english: And I am sure that eating a dish made from <color=#1DFEAF>Green Sea Urchin</color> she caught herself will boost her confidence.
Array.indonesia: Dan aku yakin, menyantap hidangan yang terbuat dari <color=#1DFEAF>landak laut hijau</color> yang dia tangkap sendiri akan meningkatkan kepercayaan dirinya.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_029
Array.english: Well, if even Bancho agrees, I guess I can't refuse.
Array.indonesia: Yah, kalau Bancho pun setuju, kurasa aku tidak bisa menolak.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_030
Array.english: Woah! So that means you will go into the sea with me?\nThank you!!
Array.indonesia: Wah! Jadi itu berarti kamu akan ikut ke laut bersamaku?\nTerima kasih!!

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_031
Array.english: I'll have the diving gear ready, so please give me a <color=#F1DC2B>call</color>!
Array.indonesia: Aku akan menyiapkan perlengkapan selamnya, jadi tolong <color=#F1DC2B>hubungi aku</color>!

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionCall01_001
Array.english: Mr. Dave! Can we go catch <color=#1DFEAF>Green Sea Urchins</color> now?
Array.indonesia: Pak Dave! Bisakah kita pergi menangkap <color=#1DFEAF>landak laut hijau</color> sekarang?

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionCall01_002
Array.english: Yes, I am still anxious, but a promise is a promise.
Array.indonesia: Ya, aku masih cemas, tapi janji adalah janji.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionCall01_003
Array.english: <size=34>Haha! Thank you! I will be right there!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Haha! Terima kasih! Aku akan segera ke sana!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionCall02_001
Array.english: Hehe, don't worry. I recently went on a diving trip with my friends.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, jangan khawatir. Baru-baru ini aku pergi menyelam bersama teman-temanku.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionCall02_002
Array.english: This is not a tourist attraction. There are aggressive fish, so you must be very careful.
Array.indonesia: Ini bukan tempat wisata. Ada ikan-ikan yang agresif, jadi kamu harus sangat berhati-hati.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionCall02_003
Array.english: Well, if they show up, I am sure you'll protect me! Hehe.
Array.indonesia: Yah, kalau mereka muncul, aku yakin kamu akan melindungiku! Hehe.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_Call_NotReady_001
Array.english: Hm? Are you really going to go catch <color=#1DFEAF>Green Sea Urchins</color> this late?
Array.indonesia: Hm? Kamu benar-benar mau pergi menangkap <color=#1DFEAF>Landak Laut Hijau</color> selarut ini?

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_Call_NotReady_002
Array.english: Ah... now that you mention it, it is pretty late.\nI will call you again soon!
Array.indonesia: Ah... sekarang kamu sebutkan, memang sudah cukup larut.\nAku akan meneleponmu lagi sebentar lagi!

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_Call_WrongPlace_001
Array.english: Are you ready to go catch some <color=#1DFEAF>Green Sea Urchins</color>?
Array.indonesia: Kamu sudah siap untuk menangkap <color=#1DFEAF>landak laut hijau</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_Call_WrongPlace_002
Array.english: I should probably get ready, too.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya aku juga harus bersiap-siap.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_Call_WrongPlace_003
Array.english: I will give you a call later from the boat!
Array.indonesia: Nanti aku akan meneleponmu dari kapal!

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_Call_WatingFood_001
Array.english: Oh! Is <color=#F1DC2B>Chirashi Sushi</color> ready?!
Array.indonesia: Oh! Apakah <color=#F1DC2B>Chirashi Sushi</color> sudah siap?!

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_Call_WatingFood_002
Array.english: Not yet. I also need ingredients other than green sea urchins, so...
Array.indonesia: Belum. Aku juga butuh bahan-bahan lain selain landak laut hijau, jadi...

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_Call_WatingFood_003
Array.english: It should be ready soon! I just need a little more time...
Array.indonesia: Seharusnya sebentar lagi siap! Aku hanya butuh sedikit waktu lagi...

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_Call_WatingFood_004
Array.english: Haha, I don't want to rush you.\nI will see you at the sushi restaurant!
Array.indonesia: Haha, aku tidak mau terburu-buru.\nSampai jumpa di restoran sushi!

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_Call_AfterMission_001
Array.english: Mr. Dave. You can play the instrumental version of my songs if you install the <color=#1DFEAF>Mini Stage</color> I gave you in the restaurant.
Array.indonesia: Pak Dave. Kamu bisa memutar versi instrumental lagu-laguku jika memasang <color=#1DFEAF>Mini Stage</color> yang kuberikan padamu di restoran.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_Call_AfterMission_002
Array.english: I have some free time on the weekends, so... I'll come sing for you in person!
Array.indonesia: Aku punya waktu luang di akhir pekan, jadi... Aku akan datang menyanyi untukmu secara langsung!

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_BoatTalk_001
Array.english: I have to admit, it's a bit nerve-wracking now that I'm about to go in.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus akui, rasanya agak deg-degan sekarang karena aku akan masuk.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_Diving01_001
Array.english: <size=33>Wow! So this is the Blue Hole! It's beautiful!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wow! Jadi ini dia Blue Hole! Indah sekali!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_Diving01_002
Array.english: Don't get too distracted by the scenery. Always be on the lookout for…
Array.indonesia: Jangan terlalu teralihkan oleh pemandangannya. Selalu waspada terhadap…

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_Diving01_003
Array.english: <size=34>I have a feeling we might find them over there!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku punya firasat kita mungkin akan menemukannya di sana!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_Diving02_001
Array.english: <size=34>You can't just go off like that...!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kamu tidak bisa begitu saja pergi...!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FindStone01_001
Array.english: <size=33>I think we'll find <color=#1DFEAF>Green Sea Urchins</color> under that pile of rocks.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aku rasa kita akan menemukan <color=#1DFEAF>Landak Laut Hijau</color> di bawah tumpukan batu itu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FindStone01_002
Array.english: <size=32>How do you know?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Bagaimana kamu tahu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FindStone01_003
Array.english: <size=33>It's just…a hunch!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ini cuma… firasat!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FindStone01_004
Array.english: <size=34>I will go search, hehe!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku akan pergi mencari, hehe!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FindStone01_005
Array.english: Um... I don't think it's safe…
Array.indonesia: Um... Menurutku itu tidak aman…

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FindStone02_001
Array.english: Oh no, dangerous fish are heading that way!
Array.indonesia: Oh tidak, ikan-ikan berbahaya sedang menuju ke sana!

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FindStone02_002
Array.english: I knew it...\nI must go help her.
Array.indonesia: Aku tahu...\nAku harus pergi membantunya.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FindUni01_001
Array.english: <size=34>Yeah! I found them, <color=#1DFEAF>Green Sea Urchins</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ya! Aku menemukannya, <color=#1DFEAF>Landak Laut Hijau</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FindUni01_002
Array.english: <size=35>Woah, they're actually there?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wah, mereka benar-benar ada di sana?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FindUni01_003
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(Maybe she has a hidden talent for diving?)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Mungkin dia punya bakat tersembunyi dalam menyelam?)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FindUni01_004
Array.english: <size=34>Ah, don't use your bare hands!\nLet me help you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ah, jangan pakai tangan kosong!\nBiarkan aku membantumu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_GoSecondPoint_001
Array.english: Hm? Why do you look so tired?
Array.indonesia: Hm? Kenapa kamu terlihat lelah sekali?

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_GoSecondPoint_002
Array.english: …Because I was protecting you from dangerous fish…
Array.indonesia: …Karena aku melindungimu dari ikan-ikan berbahaya…

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_GoSecondPoint_003
Array.english: Oh, did you? Hehe. I didn't know because I was so focused on finding sea urchins!
Array.indonesia: Oh, begitu ya? Hehe. Aku nggak tahu karena aku terlalu fokus mencari landak laut!

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_GoSecondPoint_004
Array.english: <size=34>Shall we go that way this time?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Bagaimana kalau kali ini kita lewat sana?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FindSecondStone01_001
Array.english: <size=34>How about that pile of rocks?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Bagaimana dengan tumpukan batu itu?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FindSecondStone01_002
Array.english: She knows the fish will attack her again...\nThere's no stopping her, is there?
Array.indonesia: Dia tahu ikan-ikan itu akan menyerangnya lagi...\nTidak ada yang bisa menghentikannya, kan?

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FindSecondUni01_001
Array.english: <size=34>See? Found more here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Lihat? Aku menemukan lebih banyak di sini.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FindSecondUni01_002
Array.english: Huh, she really has a talent for finding things…
Array.indonesia: Huh, dia memang jago banget nemuin barang…

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FindSecondUni01_003
Array.english: <size=34>Alright. Let me pick them up!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oke. Biar aku yang ngambil!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_GoLastPoint_001
Array.english: One more and we'll have enough.
Array.indonesia: Satu lagi dan kita udah cukup.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_GoLastPoint_002
Array.english: Already? I was having so much fun...\nbut alright.
Array.indonesia: Udah? Aku lagi asyik-asyiknya...\ntapi ya udah.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FindLastStone01_001
Array.english: <size=34>Look, there's another pile of rocks!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Lihat, ada tumpukan batu lagi!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FindLastStone01_002
Array.english: <size=33>My intuition tells me that's the place. I will search there!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Intuisiku bilang itu tempatnya. Aku akan mencari di sana!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FindLastUni01_001
Array.english: <size=34>Woohoo! I found another one!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Woohoo! Aku menemukan satu lagi!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_GoToBoat_001
Array.english: Whew, I think this will be enough.
Array.indonesia: Wah, kurasa ini sudah cukup.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_GoToBoat_002
Array.english: Hehe, thank you, mister.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, terima kasih, Pak.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_GoToBoat_003
Array.english: <size=34>I can finally have my <color=#F1DC2B>Chirashi Sushi</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Akhirnya aku bisa menikmati <color=#F1DC2B>Chirashi Sushi</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_GoToBoat_004
Array.english: I need to get some additional ingredients besides sea urchins.
Array.indonesia: Aku perlu membeli beberapa bahan tambahan selain landak laut.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_GoToBoat_005
Array.english: <size=33>You return to the boat first.\nI will give you a call later!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kamu pulang dulu ke perahu.\nNanti aku akan meneleponmu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_GoToBoat_After_001
Array.english: Well, it's a relief we found the Green Sea Urchins without too much trouble.
Array.indonesia: Wah, lega juga kita bisa menemukan Landak Laut Hijau tanpa terlalu banyak kesulitan.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_GoToBoat_After_002
Array.english: Let's see... I need some <color=#1DFEAF>Bluefin Tuna Ootoro</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>Cuttlefish</color> as well to make Chirashi Sushi.
Array.indonesia: Coba kita lihat... Aku butuh <color=#1DFEAF>Ootoro Tuna Sirip Biru</color> dan <color=#1DFEAF>Cumi-cumi</color> juga untuk membuat Chirashi Sushi.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_GoToBoat_After_003
Array.english: Do I have them in the inventory? \nIf not, I should get some more.
Array.indonesia: Apakah aku punya bahan-bahan itu di inventaris? \nKalau tidak, aku harus membeli lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionComplete01_001
Array.english: <size=34>Wow...<color=#F1DC2B>Chirashi Sushi</color>! You really prepared it for me!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wah...<color=#F1DC2B>Chirashi Sushi</color>! Kamu benar-benar menyiapkannya untukku!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionComplete01_002
Array.english: <size=34>Let me give it a try…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Biar aku coba dulu…</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionComplete02_001
Array.english: <size=35>Wow! It's super delicious!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wah! Enak banget!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionComplete02_002
Array.english: <size=34>This has the flavor I was searching for—the best taste in the world!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ini rasanya persis yang aku cari—rasa terbaik di dunia!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionComplete02_003
Array.english: I feel energized! I even feel like I can perform right now!
Array.indonesia: Aku jadi bersemangat! Aku bahkan merasa bisa tampil sekarang juga!

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionComplete02_004
Array.english: Oh, is there any open space around here?
Array.indonesia: Oh, ada tempat terbuka di sekitar sini?

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionComplete02_005
Array.english: I would like to have a small performance, if you don't mind. To relax a bit.
Array.indonesia: Aku ingin mengadakan pertunjukan kecil-kecilan, kalau kalian tidak keberatan. Untuk bersantai sejenak.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionComplete02_006
Array.english: Oh, can we go watch?
Array.indonesia: Oh, bolehkah kita menonton?

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionComplete02_007
Array.english: Of course! I would more than love to invite you all.
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja! Aku sangat senang bisa mengundang kalian semua.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionComplete02_008
Array.english: Awesome. I think the farm behind this building would be nice for that.
Array.indonesia: Keren. Menurutku, ladang di belakang gedung ini cocok untuk itu.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionComplete02_009
Array.english: Hehe. Alright, I’ll get ready for the performance! See you at the farm after the restaurant closes for the day!
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Baiklah, aku akan bersiap-siap untuk pertunjukan! Sampai jumpa di ladang setelah restoran tutup hari ini!

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert01_001
Array.english: <size=34>Wow! You really came! Thank you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wah! Kamu benar-benar datang! Terima kasih!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert01_002
Array.english: Though I seldom listen to this style of music, I find the songs to my liking. I would like to hear them in person.
Array.indonesia: Meskipun aku jarang mendengarkan genre musik ini, aku suka lagu-lagunya. Aku ingin mendengarnya secara langsung.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert01_003
Array.english: A ukulele song? It's perfect for the farm here!
Array.indonesia: Lagu ukulele? Cocok banget buat ladang di sini!

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert01_004
Array.english: Hehe, thank you! Well then…
Array.indonesia: Hehe, terima kasih! Baiklah kalau begitu…

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert01_005
Array.english: This one is called , one of my songs.
Array.indonesia: Lagu ini judulnya , salah satu lagu ciptaanku.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert01_006
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! I am excited!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Aku nggak sabar!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert_Encore_001
Array.english: Wow! So touching...!\nI feel part of my heart warming.
Array.indonesia: Wow! Sungguh menyentuh...!\nAku merasa sebagian hatiku menjadi hangat.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert_Encore_002
Array.english: Hehe, thank you.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, terima kasih.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert_Encore_003
Array.english: <size=34>I can sing one more if you want.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku bisa menyanyikan satu lagu lagi kalau kamu mau.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert_Encore_Select1
Array.english: Ask for encore
Array.indonesia: Minta encore

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert_Encore_Select2
Array.english: Call it a day
Array.indonesia: Selesai untuk hari ini

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert_Sing02_001
Array.english: Of course! We'd love to hear more.
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja! Kami ingin mendengarnya lagi.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert_Sing02_002
Array.english: My pleasure.
Array.indonesia: Dengan senang hati.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert_Sing02_003
Array.english: Now, this is my most recent song.
Array.indonesia: Nah, ini lagu terbaruku.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert_Sing02_004
Array.english: It's called . This is a lighthearted one, so enjoy!
Array.indonesia: Judulnya . Lagu ini ceria, jadi nikmatilah!

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert_End_001
Array.english: So that's it for today's performance!
Array.indonesia: Nah, itu saja penampilan hari ini!

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert_End_002
Array.english: It was excellent. Easy to listen to, yet full of rich emotion... It would be great to put on in the restaurant.
Array.indonesia: Luar biasa. Mudah didengarkan, namun penuh dengan emosi yang kaya... Akan sangat bagus jika diputar di restoran.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert_End_003
Array.english: Hooray! It would make me so happy to hear my music being played at BANCHO SUSHI!
Array.indonesia: Hore! Saya akan sangat senang mendengar musik saya diputar di BANCHO SUSHI!

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert_End_004
Array.english: This <color=#F1DC2B>Mini Stage</color> is my gift for you.
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Mini Stage</color> ini adalah hadiah saya untuk Anda.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert_End_005
Array.english: If you install this at BANCHO SUSHI, you'll be able to play the instrumental accompaniment of my songs anytime…
Array.indonesia: Jika kalian memasang ini di BANCHO SUSHI, kalian bisa memutar iringan instrumental lagu-laguku kapan saja…

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert_End_006
Array.english: ...and I can even perform at your place on the weekends!
Array.indonesia: ...dan aku bahkan bisa tampil di tempat kalian pada akhir pekan!

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert_End_007
Array.english: <size=35>Whoa! Live performance?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wah! Pertunjukan langsung?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert_End_008
Array.english: <size=35>Hahaha! My customers would love it! Thank you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Hahaha! Pelangganku pasti akan menyukainya! Terima kasih!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert_End_009
Array.english: I got my confidence back thanks to you. I really appreciate it!
Array.indonesia: Aku mendapatkan kembali kepercayaan diriku berkat kamu. Aku sangat menghargainya!

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_SelectMusic_001
Array.english: How about a different song?
Array.indonesia: Bagaimana kalau lagu yang lain?

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_SelectMusic_End_001
Array.english: Good! I will sing you this one!
Array.indonesia: Bagus! Aku akan menyanyikan lagu ini untukmu!

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_Interior_BgmOption01
Array.english: prom dress
Array.indonesia: gaun prom

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_Interior_BgmOption02
Array.english: feelings are fatal
Array.indonesia: perasaan itu mematikan

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_Interior_BgmOption03
Array.english: i hate texas
Array.indonesia: aku benci Texas

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_Interior_BgmOption04
Array.english: rain
Array.indonesia: hujan

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_Interior_Bgm_End
Array.english: I will play this piece!
Array.indonesia: Aku akan memainkan lagu ini!

Array.name: NPC_Sushi_order_desc_Mxmtoon_001
Array.english: A dish made of ingredients one has gathered themselves is indeed, special.
Array.indonesia: Hidangan yang terbuat dari bahan-bahan yang dikumpulkan sendiri memang istimewa.

Array.name: Special_Mxmtoon_Talk_Lv1
Array.english: Chirashi Sushi made of green sea urchins I found myself! I can't wait.
Array.indonesia: Chirashi Sushi dari landak laut hijau yang kutemukan sendiri! Aku tidak sabar.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Name_10012036
Array.english: Inspirational Chirashi Sushi
Array.indonesia: Chirashi Sushi yang menginspirasi

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10057506
Array.english: Give me a call when you go out to catch green sea urchins! Remember you promised to take me along?
Array.indonesia: Telepon aku saat kamu pergi menangkap landak laut hijau! Ingat, kamu janji akan mengajakku, kan?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10057507
Array.english: Dive into the sea with mxmtoon
Array.indonesia: Menyelam ke laut bersama mxmtoon

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10057508
Array.english: She really shouldn’t be wandering off like that... I’d better go after her!
Array.indonesia: Dia benar-benar tidak seharusnya berkeliaran seperti itu... Sebaiknya aku mengejarnya!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10057509
Array.english: My new album is coming out soon... I think Chirashi Sushi will help me relax!
Array.indonesia: Album baruku akan segera dirilis... Kurasa Chirashi Sushi akan membantuku rileks!

Array.name: Mission_Condition_10032106

Array.name: Menu_Chirashizushi_Desc
Array.english: A premium rice bowl topped with green sea urchin roe, cuttlefish, and bluefin tuna akami.\nIt is known to be singer-songwriter mxmtoon's favorite dish.
Array.indonesia: Semangkuk nasi premium yang dihiasi telur landak laut hijau, sotong, dan akami tuna sirip biru.\nHidangan ini dikenal sebagai hidangan favorit penyanyi-penulis lagu mxmtoon.

Array.name: Menu_Urchin_Jellyfish_Salad_Desc
Array.english: A dish featuring shredded jellyfish topped with green sea urchin roe and sea grapes.\nBe careful not to eat the bowl.
Array.indonesia: Hidangan yang menampilkan potongan-potongan ubur-ubur yang dihiasi telur landak laut hijau dan anggur laut.\nHati-hati jangan sampai memakan mangkuknya.

Array.name: Menu_Urchin_Tempura_Set_Desc
Array.english: A dish featuring green sea urchin roe wrapped in seaweed and purple sea urchin wrapped in kajime, fried until crisp.
Array.indonesia: Hidangan yang menampilkan telur landak laut hijau yang dibungkus rumput laut dan landak laut ungu yang dibungkus kajime, digoreng hingga renyah.

Array.name: Menu_Urchin_Cucumber_Salad_Desc
Array.english: A cucumber salad generously topped with green sea urchin and buckbean.\nThe cucumber cut into a long, single, continuous slice is the main feature of this dish.
Array.indonesia: Salad mentimun yang ditaburi telur landak laut hijau dan buckbean secara melimpah.\nMentimun yang dipotong menjadi irisan panjang, utuh, dan menyambung adalah ciri khas utama hidangan ini.

Array.name: Cooksta_Content_Chirashizushi
Array.english: This is it! The harmony of these ingredients... it's like listening to a beautiful piece of music!\n<color=#3a8ed6>#mxmtoon #seaurchin #bancho_sushi #chirashizushi</color>
Array.indonesia: Inilah dia! Harmoni bahan-bahan ini... rasanya seperti mendengarkan sebuah karya musik yang indah!\n<color=#3a8ed6>#mxmtoon #seaurchin #bancho_sushi #chirashizushi</color>

Array.name: Cooksta_Content_Urchin_Jellyfish_Salad
Array.english: Used the sea urchin shell as the bowl! What a beauty.\n<color=#3a8ed6>#bancho_sushi #greenseaurchin</color>
Array.indonesia: Menggunakan cangkang landak laut sebagai mangkuknya! Sungguh indah.\n<color=#3a8ed6>#bancho_sushi #greenseaurchin</color>

Array.name: Cooksta_Content_Urchin_Tempura_Set
Array.english: To try the green sea urchin, or to try the purple sea urchin. That is the question!\n<color=#3a8ed6>#tempura #urchin #bancho_sushi</color>
Array.indonesia: Mencoba landak laut hijau, atau mencoba landak laut ungu. Itulah pertanyaannya!\n<color=#3a8ed6>#tempura #urchin #bancho_sushi</color>

Array.name: Cooksta_Content_Urchin_Cucumber_Salad
Array.english: How can one cucumber slice be this long?\n<color=#3a8ed6>#bancho_sushi #urchin #cucumber</color>
Array.indonesia: Bagaimana mungkin satu irisan mentimun bisa sepanjang ini?\n<color=#3a8ed6>#bancho_sushi #urchin #cucumber</color>

Array.name: Sushi_ZoneE_MxmtoonStage_Desc
Array.english: A small stage gifted by mxmtoon.\nIt can play 4 of mxmtoon's songs.\nOn weekends, mxmtoon will visit the restaurant to perform live.
Array.indonesia: Panggung kecil hadiah dari mxmtoon.\nPanggung ini bisa memutar 4 lagu karya mxmtoon.\nSetiap akhir pekan, mxmtoon akan mengunjungi restoran tersebut untuk tampil secara langsung.

Array.name: Keyring_Mxmtoon_Desc
Array.english: A phone charm that reminds you of the refreshing winds of Hawaii.
Array.indonesia: Gantungan ponsel yang mengingatkanmu pada angin segar Hawaii.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_Call_OnTheBoat_001
Array.english: Hm? I’m standing right next to you—why did you call me?
Array.indonesia: Hm? Aku berdiri tepat di sampingmu—kenapa kamu meneleponku?

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_Call_OnTheBoat_002
Array.english: Haha, it seems you are more nervous than I am!
Array.indonesia: Haha, sepertinya kamu lebih gugup daripada aku!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_001
Array.english: Are the ingredient preparations going well?\nGet the menus ready before the <color=#F1DC2B>operating hours</color>.
Array.indonesia: Apakah persiapan bahan-bahannya berjalan lancar?\nSiapkan menu-menunya sebelum <color=#F1DC2B>jam operasional</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_002
Array.english: I know things are busy during the day... But if the ingredients aren’t ready, we’ll only be able to sell Norimaki. \r<size=34>Be sure to get things ready.</size>
Array.indonesia: Aku tahu hari ini sangat sibuk... Tapi kalau bahan-bahannya belum siap, kita hanya bisa menjual Norimaki. \r<size=34>Pastikan semuanya sudah siap.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_003
Array.english: Food with a high <color=#1DFEAF>Taste Score</color> will increase customer satisfaction. Never stop learning.
Array.indonesia: Makanan dengan <color=#1DFEAF>Skor Rasa</color> yang tinggi akan meningkatkan kepuasan pelanggan. Jangan pernah berhenti belajar.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_004
Array.english: No matter how busy you are you need to do <color=#F1DC2B>cooking research</color>.\nThere will be customers looking for new menu items.
Array.indonesia: Seberapa pun sibuknya kamu, kamu harus melakukan <color=#F1DC2B>penelitian memasak</color>.\nAkan ada pelanggan yang mencari menu baru.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_005
Array.english: Operation costs increase the more employees there are.\nYou may end up running at a loss if you only sell cheap dishes.
Array.indonesia: Biaya operasional akan meningkat seiring bertambahnya jumlah karyawan.\nKamu bisa mengalami kerugian jika hanya menjual hidangan murah.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_006
Array.english: If you are low on seasoning, you can send staff to get it.\nIt may take a while, so prepare ahead of time.
Array.indonesia: Jika persediaan bumbu menipis, Anda bisa mengirim staf untuk membelinya.\nProsesnya mungkin memakan waktu, jadi persiapkanlah terlebih dahulu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_007_001
Array.english: I don't like farmed fish, but…
Array.indonesia: Saya tidak suka ikan budidaya, tapi…

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_007_002
Array.english: Otto's farmed fish are said to be of high quality.\nWhen it's not convenient to fish, stop by the <color=#F1DC2B>Fish Farm</color>.
Array.indonesia: Ikan budidaya Otto konon berkualitas tinggi.\nJika tidak praktis untuk memancing, mampirlah ke <color=#F1DC2B>Peternakan Ikan</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_008_001
Array.english: You can manage your restaurant on your phone?\nThat’s neat.
Array.indonesia: Kamu bisa mengelola restoranmu lewat ponsel?\nKeren sekali.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_008_002
Array.english: I am not familiar with new technologies. Why don’t you utilize the <color=#F1DC2B>Management</color> app?
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak terbiasa dengan teknologi baru. Mengapa kamu tidak memanfaatkan aplikasi <color=#F1DC2B>Manajemen</color>?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_009_001
Array.english: It was difficult to secure fresh vegetables, so it is nice to have a <color=#F1DC2B>Field</color> to grow them.
Array.indonesia: Dulu sulit mendapatkan sayuran segar, jadi senang rasanya punya <color=#F1DC2B>Ladang</color> untuk menanamnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_009_002
Array.english: <size=34>Don’t forget to visit the farm and sow some seeds.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Jangan lupa mengunjungi ladang dan menabur benih.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_010_001
Array.english: Hm... A <color=#F1DC2B>branch</color>?\nI have never thought about it.
Array.indonesia: Hm... <color=#F1DC2B>cabang</color>?\nSaya belum pernah memikirkannya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_010_002
Array.english: You should not be distracted from cooking, so it’s important to assign someone who can be trusted as a <color=#F1DC2B>manager</color>.
Array.indonesia: Kamu tidak boleh teralihkan dari memasak, jadi penting untuk menunjuk seseorang yang dapat dipercaya sebagai <color=#F1DC2B>manajer</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_010_003
Array.english: Oh, and you should carefully determine your <color=#F1DC2B>Operation Policy</color>.
Array.indonesia: Oh, dan kamu harus menentukan <color=#F1DC2B>Kebijakan Operasional</color> dengan cermat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_010_004
Array.english: Hm, it doesn’t sound easy at all.\nDave, please take care of the branch for me.
Array.indonesia: Hm, kedengarannya sama sekali tidak mudah.\nDave, tolong urus cabang itu untukku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_011_001
Array.english: Bancho? You know that you need to manage the <color=#F1DC2B>ingredients at the branch</color> as well?
Array.indonesia: Bancho? Kamu tahu kan bahwa kamu juga harus mengelola <color=#F1DC2B>bahan-bahan di cabang</color>?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_011_002
Array.english: Yes, that’s what I’ve heard.
Array.indonesia: Ya, begitu yang kudengar.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_011_003
Array.english: Well, once you get immersed in cooking you don’t care about anything else, so...
Array.indonesia: Yah, begitu kamu sudah asyik memasak, kamu nggak akan peduli hal lain, jadi...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_011_004
Array.english: I will keep monitoring the <color=#F1DC2B>ingredients at the branch</color> for you!
Array.indonesia: Aku akan terus memantau <color=#F1DC2B>bahan-bahan di cabang</color> untukmu!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_BranchTutorial_001
Array.english: Hm... A <color=#F1DC2B>branch</color>?\nI have never thought about it.
Array.indonesia: Hm... Sebuah <color=#F1DC2B>cabang</color>?\nAku belum pernah memikirkannya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_BranchTutorial_002
Array.english: You should not be distracted from cooking, so it’s important to assign someone who can be trusted as a <color=#F1DC2B>manager</color>.
Array.indonesia: Kamu tidak boleh teralihkan dari memasak, jadi penting untuk menunjuk seseorang yang bisa dipercaya sebagai <color=#F1DC2B>manajer</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_BranchTutorial_003
Array.english: Oh, and you should carefully determine your <color=#F1DC2B>Operation Policy</color>.
Array.indonesia: Oh, dan kamu harus menentukan <color=#F1DC2B>Kebijakan Operasional</color>-mu dengan cermat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_BranchTutorial_004
Array.english: Hm, it doesn’t sound easy at all.\nDave, please take care of the branch for me.
Array.indonesia: Hm, kedengarannya sama sekali tidak mudah. \nDave, tolong urus cabang itu untukku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_Ending01_001
Array.english: No more earthquakes ruining my shop. \nI can finally focus on my cooking!
Array.indonesia: Tidak ada lagi gempa bumi yang merusak tokonya. \nAkhirnya aku bisa fokus memasak!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_01_001
Array.english: Come to think of it, it’s already been...\naround eight years that we’ve known each other!
Array.indonesia: Kalau dipikir-pikir, sudah...\nsekitar delapan tahun kita saling kenal!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_01_002
Array.english: I was having fun diving back then near Richelieu Rock.
Array.indonesia: Saat itu aku sedang asyik menyelam di dekat Richelieu Rock.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_01_003
Array.english: You suddenly wanted to get your suitcase that fell off the boat…
Array.indonesia: Tiba-tiba kamu ingin mengambil kopermu yang jatuh dari perahu…

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_01_004
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha!\nI thought I was in real trouble back then!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha!\nSaat itu aku pikir aku benar-benar dalam masalah!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_01_005
Array.english: I was working as a weapon dealer,\nand there were important blueprints in the suitcase...
Array.indonesia: Aku bekerja sebagai pedagang senjata,\ndan ada gambar teknis penting di dalam koper itu...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_01_006
Array.english: Luckily, you saved them before they could be ruined!
Array.indonesia: Untungnya, kamu menyelamatkannya sebelum rusak!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_01_007
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>I have no idea how I would have fought Hans Lindemann\nwithout the blueprints...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Aku tidak tahu bagaimana caranya aku bisa melawan Hans Lindemann\ntanpa gambar teknis itu...</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_01_008
Array.english: <size=37>Hans Lindemann?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Hans Lindemann?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_01_009
Array.english: <size=34>Oh, I was talking to myself.\nDon’t mind me!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh, aku sedang bicara sendiri.\nJangan hiraukan aku!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_02_001
Array.english: By the way, Dave,\nhave you been making good use of your <color=#F1DC2B>Gun</color>?
Array.indonesia: Ngomong-ngomong, Dave,\napakah kamu sudah memanfaatkan <color=#F1DC2B>Pistol</color>-mu dengan baik?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_02_002
Array.english: Yes, but...\nI get less meat if I kill with a gun…
Array.indonesia: Ya, tapi...\nAku mendapat lebih sedikit daging jika membunuh dengan pistol…

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_02_003
Array.english: That’s often the case with smaller fish.
Array.indonesia: Itu sering terjadi pada ikan yang lebih kecil.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_02_004
Array.english: But with stronger, bigger fish,\nit’ll be easier to weaken them a bit first.
Array.indonesia: Tapi untuk ikan yang lebih kuat dan besar,\nakan lebih mudah untuk melemahkan mereka sedikit terlebih dahulu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_02_005
Array.english: If they’re weakened, they’ll show changes like bleeding or swaying. Observe them carefully.
Array.indonesia: Jika mereka sudah melemah, mereka akan menunjukkan tanda-tanda seperti berdarah atau goyah. Perhatikan mereka dengan saksama.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_02_006
Array.english: I see.\nI’ll have to consider the timing carefully.
Array.indonesia: Begitu ya.\nAku harus mempertimbangkan waktunya dengan cermat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_02_007
Array.english: If you need good guns, you can craft them at \n<color=#F1DC2B>Duff’s Weapon Shop</color> on your phone. Don’t forget it!
Array.indonesia: Jika kamu membutuhkan senjata yang bagus, kamu bisa membuatnya di \n<color=#F1DC2B>Toko Senjata Duff</color> di ponselmu. Jangan lupa!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_03_001
Array.english: My package hasn't arrived, and its been a while.
Array.indonesia: Paketku belum sampai, dan sudah cukup lama.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_03_002
Array.english: I wonder what's wrong?
Array.indonesia: Apa ya yang salah?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_03_003
Array.english: Recently picked it up from the floating remnants of \na wrecked boat…
Array.indonesia: Baru-baru ini aku mengambilnya dari puing-puing \nperahu yang karam…

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_03_004
Array.english: There must have been some kind of accident.\nA sudden accident in this isolated blue hole.
Array.indonesia: Pasti terjadi kecelakaan.\nKecelakaan mendadak di Blue Hole terpencil ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_03_005
Array.english: I think I saw a huge squid a while ago.\nIt's not because of that is it?
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya aku melihat cumi-cumi raksasa beberapa waktu lalu.\nBukan karena itu, kan?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_03_006
Array.english: <size=34>A <color=#F1DC2B>Giant Squid</color>…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>A <color=#F1DC2B>Cumi-cumi Raksasa</color>…</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_03_007
Array.english: Just about anything can happen here.\nAlways stay on your toes!!
Array.indonesia: Hampir semua hal bisa terjadi di sini.\nSelalu waspada!!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_04_001
Array.english: Dave, \nalways have your gear ready before diving.
Array.indonesia: Dave, \nselalu siapkan perlengkapanmu sebelum menyelam.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_04_002
Array.english: Can't I just use what's already in the sea?
Array.indonesia: Tidak bisakah aku hanya menggunakan apa yang sudah ada di laut?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_04_003
Array.english: Sigh. Do I have to tell you again?
Array.indonesia: Huh. Apa aku harus mengatakannya lagi?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_04_004
Array.english: Weapons are destroyed as soon as you come out of the sea.
Array.indonesia: Senjata akan hancur begitu kamu keluar dari laut.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_04_005
Array.english: You can only keep weapons that have been crafted by Duff.
Array.indonesia: Kamu hanya bisa menyimpan senjata yang dibuat oleh Duff.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_04_006
Array.english: Yeah.\nIt's tough because you never know what's out there.
Array.indonesia: Ya.\nIni sulit karena kamu tidak pernah tahu apa yang ada di luar sana.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_04_007
Array.english: <size=34>Hahaha! So why wouldn't I open the <color=#F1DC2B>Cobra Shop</color>!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hahaha! Jadi, kenapa aku tidak membuka <color=#F1DC2B>Toko Cobra</color>!!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_04_008
Array.english: <size=32>As you know…\nI give you the best prices, so come often!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Seperti yang kamu tahu…\nAku memberikan harga terbaik, jadi sering-seringlah datang!!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_04_009
Array.english: …Just get some good stuff to sell….
Array.indonesia: …Cari saja barang bagus untuk dijual….

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_05_001
Array.english: <size=32>A sudden attack by John Watson!?....</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Serangan mendadak dari John Watson!?....</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_05_002
Array.english: Sea Blue is a group that utilizes strange methods to protect the sea.\nBut weapons…?
Array.indonesia: Sea Blue adalah kelompok yang menggunakan metode aneh untuk melindungi laut.\nTapi senjata…?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_05_003
Array.english: And particularly powerful weapons at that….
Array.indonesia: Dan senjata yang sangat kuat pula….

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_05_004
Array.english: Hm. They are famous for using particularly aggressive methods.\nBut using weapons in the sea is something I couldn't forsee.
Array.indonesia: Hm. Mereka terkenal karena menggunakan metode yang sangat agresif.\nTapi penggunaan senjata di laut adalah sesuatu yang tidak pernah kubayangkan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_05_005
Array.english: I guess you might be pretty concerned hanging around this place.
Array.indonesia: Kurasa kamu mungkin cukup khawatir kalau sering berkeliaran di tempat ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_05_006
Array.english: <size=35>Something smells fishy….</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ada yang mencurigakan….</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_05_007
Array.english: Anyway, be careful! \nEspecially with that John Watson guy around. That guy is dangerous!
Array.indonesia: Pokoknya, hati-hati! \nTerutama dengan adanya si John Watson itu. Orang itu berbahaya!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_06_001
Array.english: <size=34>Sea People…!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Orang-orang Laut…!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_06_002
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! Dr. Bacon was right!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Dr. Bacon benar!!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_06_003
Array.english: You have to promote this to attract customers.
Array.indonesia: Kamu harus mempromosikan ini untuk menarik pelanggan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_06_004
Array.english: But Dr. Bacon said that poachers would come.
Array.indonesia: Tapi Dr. Bacon bilang pemburu liar akan datang.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_06_005
Array.english: Well, yeah that's true…
Array.indonesia: Ya, memang benar…

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_06_006
Array.english: <size=33>Well let's keep an eye out!\nAnyway, the number of customers is increasing at Bancho Sushi!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ya, mari kita waspada!\nBagaimanapun, jumlah pelanggan di Bancho Sushi semakin bertambah!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_07_001
Array.english: You went to the Sea People village right?
Array.indonesia: Kamu pergi ke desa Orang Laut, kan?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_07_002
Array.english: Yeah. It's wild that such a place exists in the sea.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Sungguh luar biasa bahwa tempat seperti itu ada di laut.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_07_003
Array.english: It seems like something dangerous was going on.
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya ada sesuatu yang berbahaya sedang terjadi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_07_004
Array.english: Hm. It's probably related to all the recent earthquakes.
Array.indonesia: Hm. Mungkin itu terkait dengan semua gempa bumi yang terjadi belakangan ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_07_005
Array.english: Hm. Yeah. There sure have been a lot of earthquakes \naround here lately.
Array.indonesia: Hm. Ya. Memang banyak sekali gempa bumi \ndi sekitar sini belakangan ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_07_006
Array.english: If there is an earthquake as big as the one that happened \nwhen Bancho Sushi opened…business is done for!
Array.indonesia: Kalau ada gempa sebesar yang terjadi \nsaat Bancho Sushi dibuka… bisnis ini pasti tamat!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_07_007
Array.english: There are some favors the Sea People asked for…\nSo I'll get some info from them as I help.
Array.indonesia: Ada beberapa permintaan yang diajukan oleh Suku Laut…\nJadi, aku akan mencari informasi dari mereka sambil membantu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_08_001
Array.english: <size=33>John Watson attacked you again?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>John Watson menyerangmu lagi?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_08_002
Array.english: Yes, he was wearing some thick, improvised suit.
Array.indonesia: Ya, dia memakai baju pelindung tebal yang dibuat seadanya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_08_003
Array.english: I don’t know where Sea Blue earns all their money,\nbut I heard that they got some high-tech stuff.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak tahu dari mana Sea Blue mendapatkan semua uangnya,\ntapi kudengar mereka punya peralatan berteknologi tinggi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_08_004
Array.english: I also don’t understand why they'd be targeting you.
Array.indonesia: Aku juga tidak mengerti mengapa mereka menargetkanmu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_08_005
Array.english: As if you’re sniffing out some Blue Hole <color=#F1DC2B>secrets</color> they don’t want you to know about.
Array.indonesia: Seolah-olah kamu sedang mengendus <color=#F1DC2B>rahasia</color> Blue Hole yang tidak ingin mereka kamu ketahui.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_08_006
Array.english: It’s all good since you’re safe.\nBe careful, though!
Array.indonesia: Tidak apa-apa selama kamu aman.\nTapi tetap berhati-hatilah!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_09_001
Array.english: I always thought there was something fishy about Sea Blue.
Array.indonesia: Aku selalu merasa ada yang mencurigakan tentang Sea Blue.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_09_002
Array.english: They claim that they protect nature, \nbut they’re too heavily armed to be environmentalists.
Array.indonesia: Mereka mengklaim melindungi alam, \ntapi mereka terlalu bersenjata lengkap untuk disebut sebagai aktivis lingkungan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_09_003
Array.english: Especially that guy named John Watson...\nHe is probably more of a warmonger than a peacemaker.
Array.indonesia: Terutama pria bernama John Watson itu...\nDia mungkin lebih seperti penghasut perang daripada pembawa damai.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_09_004
Array.english: I infiltrated and messed up their base. They must be so mad at me right now.
Array.indonesia: Aku menyusup dan mengacaukan markas mereka. Mereka pasti sangat marah padaku sekarang.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_09_005
Array.english: Still, they will want to keep a low profile for some time.\nAnd they need time to recuperate.
Array.indonesia: Meski begitu, mereka pasti akan bersikap low profile untuk sementara waktu.\nDan mereka butuh waktu untuk memulihkan diri.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_09_006
Array.english: I will keep an eye on them, too!
Array.indonesia: Aku juga akan terus mengawasi mereka!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_10_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! What a suit!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Pakaian apa ini!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_10_002
Array.english: It feels warm to the touch.\nMaybe it’s because the suit is made of the Divine Tree Fruit Cloth?
Array.indonesia: Terasa hangat saat disentuh.\nMungkin karena pakaian ini terbuat dari Kain Buah Pohon Ilahi?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_10_003
Array.english: It’s just warm, not hot. I can wear this in a hot place like this.
Array.indonesia: Hanya hangat, bukan panas. Aku bisa memakai ini di tempat panas seperti ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_10_004
Array.english: It feels like the suit itself is regulating temperature.
Array.indonesia: Rasanya seperti baju renang itu sendiri yang mengatur suhunya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_10_005
Array.english: That’s why the Sea People can withstand the cold.
Array.indonesia: Itulah sebabnya Orang Laut bisa tahan terhadap dingin.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_10_006
Array.english: The water temperature became unstable these days and many Sea People got sick.
Array.indonesia: Suhu air jadi tidak stabil akhir-akhir ini dan banyak Orang Laut yang sakit.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_10_007
Array.english: And also the earthquakes...\nSomething is happening for sure.
Array.indonesia: Ditambah lagi gempa bumi...\nPasti ada sesuatu yang sedang terjadi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_11_001
Array.english: There is a huge iceberg in the deep sea?\nWho could have guessed?
Array.indonesia: Ada gunung es raksasa di laut dalam?\nSiapa yang bisa menduganya?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_11_002
Array.english: That was a sight to see.
Array.indonesia: Itu pemandangan yang luar biasa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_11_003
Array.english: Heh, \nI once traveled to the Antarctic for a mission.
Array.indonesia: Heh, \nAku pernah bepergian ke Antartika untuk sebuah misi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_11_004
Array.english: It was fascinating to find such humongous icebergs and snow in the southernmost region of the world.
Array.indonesia: Sungguh menakjubkan menemukan gunung es sebesar itu dan salju di wilayah paling selatan dunia.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_11_005
Array.english: There are still wild places to explore in the world.
Array.indonesia: Masih ada tempat-tempat liar yang bisa dieksplorasi di dunia ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_11_006
Array.english: You know, humans know less about the sea than space.\nKeep up the good work!
Array.indonesia: Tahukah kamu, manusia lebih sedikit mengetahui tentang laut daripada tentang luar angkasa.\nTeruslah bekerja dengan baik!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_12_001
Array.english: I see...\nWhen you enter the <color=#F1DC2B>Control Room</color>, activate three switches...
Array.indonesia: Begitu ya...\nSaat kamu memasuki <color=#F1DC2B>Ruang Kontrol</color>, aktifkan tiga sakelar...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_12_002
Array.english: I wonder if the contraption built by the ancient Sea People is still working.
Array.indonesia: Aku penasaran apakah alat yang dibuat oleh Suku Laut kuno itu masih berfungsi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_12_003
Array.english: The Glacial Area is cold, but heat is coming from beneath.
Array.indonesia: Kawasan Gletser memang dingin, tapi ada panas yang berasal dari bawah.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_12_004
Array.english: I think the <color=#F1DC2B>Control Room</color> also has a function that regulates the temperature of the surrounding area.
Array.indonesia: Menurutku, <color=#F1DC2B>Ruang Kontrol</color> juga memiliki fungsi yang mengatur suhu di sekitarnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_12_005
Array.english: Don’t forget to visit the <color=#F1DC2B>Cobra Shop</color> before embarking on a dangerous mission!\nHahaha!
Array.indonesia: Jangan lupa mampir ke <color=#F1DC2B>Toko Cobra</color> sebelum memulai misi berbahaya!\nHahaha!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_BranchTutorial_001
Array.english: <size=34>Hahaha! A <color=#F1DC2B>branch</color>, eh? \nI can smell the money already!!\n</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hahaha! Sebuah <color=#F1DC2B>cabang</color>, ya? \nAku sudah bisa mencium aroma uangnya!!\n</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_InteriorUnlock_001
Array.english: <size=32>Aha! Things are looking good!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aha! Segalanya terlihat menjanjikan!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_InteriorUnlock_002
Array.english: If you want to change to a different style, try changing it in the <color=#F1DC2B>Interior</color> Menu!
Array.indonesia: Jika ingin mengganti gaya, coba ubah di Menu <color=#F1DC2B>Interior</color>!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_Ending01_001
Array.english: The shaking may have stopped, but we're still reeling in a variety from the Blue Hole.
Array.indonesia: Guncangan mungkin sudah berhenti, tapi kita masih memancing berbagai jenis ikan dari Blue Hole.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_Ending01_002
Array.english: <size=35>Let's get back to business without a care in the world, hahaha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ayo kembali ke urusan kita tanpa beban apa pun, hahaha!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Sushi_order_desc_Yoshie_001
Array.english: I’ll be offering the true flavor of Whole-Roasted Shark Head.\nDon’t forget to procure the ingredients as well as completing the <color=#F1DC2B>Cooking Research</color> in advance.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan menyajikan cita rasa asli Kepala Hiu Panggang Utuh.\nJangan lupa untuk menyiapkan bahan-bahannya serta menyelesaikan <color=#F1DC2B>Penelitian Memasak</color> terlebih dahulu.

Array.name: NPC_Sushi_order_desc_Otto_001
Array.english: Hmm. Morray Curry... That’s a difficult dish to make.\nMoray Eels are nocturnal and only come out at night.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Kari Moray... Itu hidangan yang sulit dibuat.\nIkan moray adalah hewan nokturnal dan hanya keluar pada malam hari.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Otto_CrabTrapMaking_001
Array.english: Did you collect all the materials for the Crab Trap?
Array.indonesia: Apakah kamu sudah mengumpulkan semua bahan untuk Perangkap Kepiting?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Otto_CrabTrapMaking_002
Array.english: To make it properly you will need wood, scrap iron, rope…oh, and you will need <color=#1DFEAF>Tiger Shark Teeth</color>.
Array.indonesia: Untuk membuatnya dengan benar, kamu membutuhkan kayu, besi tua, tali… oh, dan kamu juga membutuhkan <color=#1DFEAF>Gigi Hiu Macan</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Otto_CrabTrapMaking_003
Array.english: Come to think of it...
Array.indonesia: Kalau dipikir-pikir...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Otto_CrabTrapMaking_004
Array.english: When I was around 22 years old...I had set a trap to catch a tropical rock lobster when suddenly, a storm hit!
Array.indonesia: Saat aku berusia sekitar 22 tahun... aku memasang perangkap untuk menangkap lobster batu tropis ketika tiba-tiba, badai melanda!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Otto_CrabTrapMaking_005
Array.english: I didn't want the trap to be swept away, so I jumped right into the storm!
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak ingin perangkap itu hanyut, jadi aku langsung melompat ke tengah badai!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Otto_CrabTrapMaking_006
Array.english: While in the whirlpool...I saw a giant creature approaching me...and I swiftly grabbed the trap and escaped!
Array.indonesia: Saat berada di pusaran air… aku melihat makhluk raksasa mendekatiku… dan aku segera meraih perangkap itu lalu melarikan diri!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Otto_CrabTrapMaking_007
Array.english: At the time, both of my legs were perfectly fine!! Hahaha!
Array.indonesia: Saat itu, kedua kakiku masih baik-baik saja!! Hahaha!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Otto_CrabTrapMaking_008
Array.english: ...I'll hurry and go find the materials.
Array.indonesia: …Aku akan segera pergi mencari bahan-bahannya.

Array.name: NPC_FarmTalk_Otto_01_001
Array.english: I’ll grow the rice. Just kill off the insects every now and then.
Array.indonesia: Aku yang akan menanam padi. Kamu cukup membasmi serangga sesekali saja.

Array.name: NPC_FarmTalk_Otto_01_002
Array.english: That’s when I took a Harpoon in the knee!
Array.indonesia: Saat itulah aku terkena tombak di lutut!

Array.name: NPC_FarmTalk_Otto_02_001
Array.english: Use <color=#F1DC2B>White Rice</color> from the farm to make better-quality sushi.
Array.indonesia: Gunakan <color=#F1DC2B>Beras Putih</color> dari kebun untuk membuat sushi berkualitas lebih baik.

Array.name: NPC_FarmTalk_Otto_02_002
Array.english: Sushi made with Annam rice isn’t really original sushi! \nHaha!
Array.indonesia: Sushi yang dibuat dengan beras Annam bukanlah sushi asli! \nHaha!

Array.name: NPC_FishFarmTalk_Otto_01_001
Array.english: You can collect <color=#F1DC2B>Fish Eggs</color> as you catch fish.
Array.indonesia: Kamu bisa mengumpulkan <color=#F1DC2B>Telur Ikan</color> saat menangkap ikan.

Array.name: NPC_FishFarmTalk_Otto_01_002
Array.english: If there’s a fish you’d like to keep, it’ll help to catch many of that fish.
Array.indonesia: Jika ada ikan yang ingin kamu simpan, akan lebih baik jika kamu menangkap banyak ikan jenis itu.

Array.name: NPC_FishFarmTalk_Otto_02_001
Array.english: I’ll tell you when fish hatch, so drop by then.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan memberitahumu saat telur ikan menetas, jadi mampirlah saat itu.

Array.name: NPC_FishFarmTalk_Otto_02_002
Array.english: I’ll take good care of them,\nso no worries.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan merawatnya dengan baik,\njadi jangan khawatir.

Array.name: NPC_FishFarmTalk_Otto_03_001
Array.english: I told you about <color=#F1DC2B>Density</color> before, right?
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah memberitahumu tentang <color=#F1DC2B>Kepadatan</color> sebelumnya, kan?

Array.name: NPC_FishFarmTalk_Otto_03_002
Array.english: You can’t put in any more fish if the Density\nreaches 100%, so keep that in mind.
Array.indonesia: Kamu tidak bisa memasukkan ikan lagi jika Kepadatan\nmencapai 100%, jadi ingatlah itu.

Array.name: NPC_FishFarmTalk_Otto_Cucumber_001
Array.english: You’re talking about the farm. Why don’t we go to the farm and continue?
Array.indonesia: Kamu sedang membicarakan peternakan. Kenapa kita tidak pergi ke peternakan dan melanjutkan pembicaraan di sana?

Array.name: NPC_FarmTalk_Sammy_01_001
Array.english: The sound of water and insects here\nfeels like a beat sometimes, yo.
Array.indonesia: Suara air dan serangga di sini\nterkadang terasa seperti irama, lho.

Array.name: NPC_FarmTalk_Sammy_01_002
Array.english: I should make this into a song one of these days.\nHip-hop is not just about glamorous city life.
Array.indonesia: Suatu hari nanti aku harus membuat lagu dari ini.\nHip-hop bukan hanya tentang kehidupan kota yang glamor.

Array.name: NPC_FarmTalk_Sammy_02_001
Array.english: Dad has never scolded me.
Array.indonesia: Ayah tidak pernah memarahiku.

Array.name: NPC_FarmTalk_Sammy_02_002
Array.english: He told me to do whatever I want.
Array.indonesia: Dia bilang aku boleh melakukan apa pun yang aku mau.

Array.name: NPC_FarmTalk_Sammy_02_003
Array.english: The only problem is that he goes on and on.
Array.indonesia: Satu-satunya masalahnya adalah dia terus-terusan bicara.

Array.name: NPC_FarmTalk_Sammy_Night_Hiring_001
Array.english: It's too late.\nGotta work on my music at night.
Array.indonesia: Sudah terlambat.\nAku harus mengerjakan musikku di malam hari.

Array.name: NPC_FarmTalk_Sammy_Night_Hiring_002
Array.english: <size=35>Come back tomorrow!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Kembalilah besok!</size>

Array.name: NPC_FarmTalk_Sammy_Check_Seed
Array.english: Wait! I can't help you sow seeds if you don't give me any.
Array.indonesia: Tunggu! Aku tidak bisa membantumu menabur benih kalau kamu tidak memberikannya padaku.

Array.name: NPC_Sushi_order_desc_Jango_001
Array.english: Hmm. Anything with Habanero in it will be really spicy. I'm not sure if he'll be able to handle it.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Apa pun yang mengandung Habanero pasti akan sangat pedas. Aku nggak yakin dia bakal bisa menahannya.

Array.name: Special_Jango_Talk_Lv1
Array.english: Ugh… It's freezing… How's the cooking going?
Array.indonesia: Ugh… Dingin banget… Gimana masakannya?

Array.name: NPC_MerchantTalk_Jango_01_001
Array.english: It's too cold during the evening…
Array.indonesia: Malam-malam ini terlalu dingin…

Array.name: NPC_MerchantTalk_Jango_01_002
Array.english: I've been to some rough places….
Array.indonesia: Aku pernah ke beberapa tempat yang berat….

Array.name: NPC_MerchantTalk_Jango_01_003
Array.english: This is the best price I can offer.
Array.indonesia: Ini harga terbaik yang bisa aku tawarkan.

Array.name: NPC_MerchantTalk_Jango_01_004
Array.english: I do love me some warm green tea.
Array.indonesia: Aku memang suka teh hijau hangat.

Array.name: NPC_MerchantTalk_Jango_01_005
Array.english: Why is there no heater?
Array.indonesia: Kenapa tidak ada pemanas?

Array.name: NPC_MerchantTalk_Jango_01_006
Array.english: Aren't you cold in that outfit?
Array.indonesia: Apa kamu tidak kedinginan dengan pakaian seperti itu?

Array.name: NPC_MerchantTalk_Jango_01_007
Array.english: This place has a nice view.
Array.indonesia: Tempat ini punya pemandangan yang bagus.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Suwam_default_002
Array.english: I can’t understand what it’s saying...\nI should go to Dr. Bacon first.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak mengerti apa yang dikatakan...\nSepertinya aku harus menemui Dr. Bacon dulu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Staff_01_Kyoko_bored
Array.english: Opening only for the evening...\nBut I’m too exhausted at such a late hour.
Array.indonesia: Hanya buka pada malam hari...\nTapi aku terlalu lelah di jam segini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Staff_02_Liu_nice
Array.english: Hahaha! Don’t worry about running the restaurant \nas long as I’m here!
Array.indonesia: Hahaha! Jangan khawatir soal mengelola restoran \nselama aku masih di sini!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Staff_03_Calorina_nice
Array.english: Customers have been flooding in lately.\nAre they fascinated by my beauty?
Array.indonesia: Pelanggan membludak belakangan ini.\nApakah mereka terpesona oleh kecantikanku?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Staff_04_Mitchell_worry
Array.english: I’ve never worked at a sushi place.\nPlease, I need your support.
Array.indonesia: Aku belum pernah bekerja di restoran sushi.\nTolong, aku butuh dukunganmu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Staff_04_Mitchell_nice
Array.english: I just love working here!\nI’ll do my best!
Array.indonesia: Aku sangat suka bekerja di sini!\nAku akan berusaha sebaik mungkin!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Staff_05_Yusuke_nice
Array.english: Hahaha! I’ve got faster hands than anyone else! \nI’m so talented.
Array.indonesia: Hahaha! Tanganku lebih cepat daripada siapa pun! \nAku sangat berbakat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Staff_06_James_normal
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>...Hoo... ha... hoo... ha...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>...Hoo... ha... hoo... ha...</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Staff_07_Billy_nice
Array.english: Do you feel the heat of this beach!?\nRock ’n roll!
Array.indonesia: Apa kalian merasakan panasnya pantai ini!?\nRock ’n roll!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Staff_08_Tohoku_smile
Array.english: Whatever it is, do it every day, 100 times a day!
Array.indonesia: Apa pun itu, lakukan setiap hari, 100 kali sehari!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Staff_09_Yone_nice
Array.english: All right, let’s roll!
Array.indonesia: Baiklah, ayo mulai!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Staff_1NPC_Talk_Elnino_nice
Array.english: Hahahaha! I’ll satisfy the customers \nwith my signature movements!
Array.indonesia: Hahahaha! Aku akan memuaskan para pelanggan \ndengan gerakan andalan ku!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Staff_11_Jandi_worry
Array.english: Hmm, I’m not used to wearing a uniform...\nI hope I’ll get used to it.
Array.indonesia: Hmm, aku belum terbiasa memakai seragam...\nSemoga aku bisa terbiasa.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Staff_12_Pai_nice
Array.english: If you keep on practicing, you can become a master.
Array.indonesia: Kalau terus berlatih, kamu bisa jadi ahli.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Staff_13_Charlie_thinking
Array.english: This place is 890 square meters, so the optimal seating capacity is...\nN-Never mind.
Array.indonesia: Tempat ini seluas 890 meter persegi, jadi kapasitas tempat duduk optimalnya adalah...\nN-Sudahlah.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Staff_14_Maki_nice
Array.english: I’ll become a great cook and make my father proud!
Array.indonesia: Aku akan jadi koki hebat dan membuat ayahku bangga!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Staff_14_Maki_worry
Array.english: Phew... Working isn’t easy...
Array.indonesia: Wah... Bekerja itu tidak mudah...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Staff_15_CohhCarnage
Array.english: This is amazing! Thank you. \nI won't let you down.
Array.indonesia: Ini luar biasa! Terima kasih. \nAku tidak akan mengecewakanmu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Staff_16_Raptor
Array.english: Barely believe you hired me! \nThe sushi is so good here, you'd think I'd eat all your profits!
Array.indonesia: Hampir tidak percaya kamu mempekerjakanku! \nSushi di sini sangat enak, seolah-olah aku akan memakan seluruh keuntunganmu!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Staff_17_Drae_001
Array.english: Gonna be honest with you, I lied on my résumé.
Array.indonesia: Jujur saja, aku berbohong di CV-ku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Staff_17_Drae_002
Array.english: I have no idea what I'm doing!
Array.indonesia: Aku sama sekali tidak tahu apa yang sedang kulakukan!

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_18_Raul
Array.english: Hmm...Are you exercising?\nAll energy comes from the muscles.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Apa kamu berolahraga?\nSemua energi berasal dari otot.

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_19_Davina
Array.english: Don't worry. Haha!\nI'll save this shop!
Array.indonesia: Jangan khawatir. Haha!\nAku akan menyelamatkan toko ini!

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_20_Itsuki_001
Array.english: I trained as a ninja for several years…\nBut it wasn't easy making a living as a ninja.
Array.indonesia: Aku berlatih menjadi ninja selama beberapa tahun…\nTapi tidak mudah mencari nafkah sebagai ninja.

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_20_Itsuki_002
Array.english: Leave it all to me, my lord.
Array.indonesia: Serahkan semuanya padaku, Tuanku.

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_21_Masayoshi_001
Array.english: Oh yeah. These sharp knives are more like it!
Array.indonesia: Oh ya. Pisau tajam ini jauh lebih cocok!

Array.name: NPC_Staff_Talk_21_Masayoshi_002
Array.english: I can do a lot with these…
Array.indonesia: Aku bisa melakukan banyak hal dengan ini…

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_Delivering
Array.english: I’ll take the ingredient for the contest!\nGood bye!
Array.indonesia: Aku akan mengambil bahan untuk lomba!\nSampai jumpa!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman01_dislike_001
Array.english: Whoa... My first time seeing a human…
Array.indonesia: Wah... Ini pertama kalinya aku melihat manusia…

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman01_dislike_002
Array.english: <size=35>Weird!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Aneh!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman01_AfterGlacial_001
Array.english: Ugh, I'm not feeling well…
Array.indonesia: Ugh, aku merasa tidak enak badan…

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman01_AfterGlacial_002
Array.english: It's cold and then it's hot… What’s wrong with the weather?
Array.indonesia: Kadang dingin, kadang panas… Ada apa dengan cuacanya?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman01_Ending_001
Array.english: Life has never been better in this village. \nThanks for your help, human.
Array.indonesia: Hidup di desa ini belum pernah sebaik ini. \nTerima kasih atas bantuannya, manusia.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman01_like_001
Array.english: Well, I guess I'm kinda getting used to it.
Array.indonesia: Yah, kurasa aku mulai terbiasa dengan ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman02_dislike_001
Array.english: What do you do with that mouth?\nYou can't even breathe underwater.
Array.indonesia: Apa yang kamu lakukan dengan mulut itu?\nKamu bahkan tidak bisa bernapas di bawah air.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman02_like_001
Array.english: Human, help me find the reason for the earthquakes.
Array.indonesia: Manusia, tolong bantu aku mencari penyebab gempa bumi ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman02_AfterGlacial_001
Array.english: So you're saying the cause of the earthquake is in the Glacial Area?
Array.indonesia: Jadi, maksudmu penyebab gempa bumi itu ada di Kawasan Gletser?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman02_Ending_001
Array.english: We, the Sea People, have always lived in harmony with the Divine Tree.
Array.indonesia: Kami, Suku Laut, selalu hidup selaras dengan Pohon Suci.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman02_Ending_002
Array.english: When something happens to the Divine Tree, we're the first to feel the impact.
Array.indonesia: Ketika terjadi sesuatu pada Pohon Suci, kami adalah yang pertama merasakan dampaknya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman03_dislike_001
Array.english: <size=34>How…How did you get here?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Bagaimana…Bagaimana kamu bisa sampai di sini?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman03_like_001
Array.english: We can't even go on land...\nHuman technology is quite something!
Array.indonesia: Kami bahkan tidak bisa pergi ke daratan...\nTeknologi manusia sungguh luar biasa!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman03_AfterGlacial_001
Array.english: Our ancestors were known to travel in cold areas.
Array.indonesia: Nenek moyang kami dikenal sering bepergian ke daerah-daerah dingin.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman03_AfterGlacial_002
Array.english: I'm not sure if we're up to it these days.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak yakin apakah kami masih sanggup melakukannya saat ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman03_Ending_001
Array.english: The Glacial Area seems manageable?\nMaybe we should give it a try.
Array.indonesia: Daerah Gletser sepertinya bisa ditaklukkan?\nMungkin kita harus mencobanya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman04_dislike_001
Array.english: Tenzhin said you could stay here right?\nWell, don't wander around too much.
Array.indonesia: Tenzhin bilang kalian boleh tinggal di sini, kan?\nNah, jangan berkeliaran terlalu jauh.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman04_like_001
Array.english: Don't tell the Humans about our village.\nWe really dont trust them!
Array.indonesia: Jangan beri tahu Manusia tentang desa kita.\nKita benar-benar tidak percaya pada mereka!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman04_AfterGlacial_001
Array.english: Gadon's still alive…\nThe things you get to see as you age.
Array.indonesia: Gadon masih hidup…\nHal-hal yang bisa kamu lihat seiring bertambahnya usia.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman04_Ending_001
Array.english: I've been feeling a bit under the weather lately, but now I'm back in full swing!
Array.indonesia: Aku merasa sedikit kurang sehat belakangan ini, tapi sekarang aku sudah kembali bugar!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman05_dislike_001
Array.english: I've lived 200 years and this is the first time I've seen a human.\nWhat are you doing here?
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah hidup selama 200 tahun dan ini pertama kalinya aku melihat manusia.\nApa yang kamu lakukan di sini?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman05_like_001
Array.english: Hm. Don't go about touching stuff just because it looks mysterious…!
Array.indonesia: Hm. Jangan sembarangan menyentuh benda-benda hanya karena kelihatannya misterius…!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman05_AfterGlacial_001
Array.english: In the Glacial Area, there's a device our ancestors built to control the power of the Divine Tree.
Array.indonesia: Di Kawasan Gletser, ada sebuah perangkat yang dibangun oleh nenek moyang kita untuk mengendalikan kekuatan Pohon Suci.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman05_AfterGlacial_002
Array.english: I'm not sure if it's still operational…
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak yakin apakah alat itu masih berfungsi…

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman05_Ending_001
Array.english: You've actually been to the Control Room?\nEven among humans, there’s truly a brave one like you.
Array.indonesia: Kamu benar-benar pernah ke Ruang Kontrol?\nBahkan di antara manusia, ada yang seberani kamu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman06_dislike_001
Array.english: I haven't won any money since humans came here!\nThis can't be a coincidence!
Array.indonesia: Aku belum pernah menang uang sejak manusia datang ke sini!\nIni pasti bukan kebetulan!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman06_like_001
Array.english: Yep. Catching a high quality <color=#F1DC2B> seahorse </color> is the key.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Menangkap kuda laut <color=#F1DC2B> berkualitas tinggi </color> adalah kuncinya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman06_AfterGlacial_001
Array.english: Glacier? Why should we care about that now?!
Array.indonesia: Gletser? Kenapa kita harus peduli soal itu sekarang?!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman06_AfterGlacial_002
Array.english: There must be some trickery at play…!\nThere has to be!
Array.indonesia: Pasti ada tipu muslihat di balik ini…!\nPasti ada!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman06_Ending_001
Array.english: Nawang and Awang say they've seen Yawie with their own eyes.
Array.indonesia: Nawang dan Awang bilang mereka sudah melihat Yawie dengan mata kepala sendiri.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman06_Ending_002
Array.english: It must've been an illusion due to the heat in the Control Room!
Array.indonesia: Pasti itu ilusi akibat panas di Ruang Kontrol!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman07_dislike_001
Array.english: How can hermit crabs be so fast?
Array.indonesia: Kok kepiting pertapa bisa secepat itu?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman07_like_001
Array.english: Haha! Junak! Your fingers must hurt!
Array.indonesia: Haha! Junak! Jari-jarimu pasti sakit!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman07_AfterGlacial_001
Array.english: Ugh… Just when we were about to win, an earthquake hit…
Array.indonesia: Ugh… Tepat saat kita hampir menang, gempa bumi terjadi…

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman07_Ending_001
Array.english: The threat of earthquakes kept me from focusing, but now, it's time to get serious!
Array.indonesia: Ancaman gempa bumi membuatku sulit berkonsentrasi, tapi sekarang, saatnya serius!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman08_dislike_001
Array.english: I heard that this was the door previously used to go to the <color=#F1DC2B>Glacial Area</color>…?
Array.indonesia: Kudengar ini adalah pintu yang sebelumnya digunakan untuk pergi ke <color=#F1DC2B>Area Gletser</color>…?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman08_dislike_002
Array.english: But this <color=#F1DC2B>passage</color> has been blocked for a while…\nNobody knows what state it's been in during that time.
Array.indonesia: Tapi <color=#F1DC2B>jalur</color> ini sudah tertutup cukup lama…\nTidak ada yang tahu kondisi seperti apa selama ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman08_like_001
Array.english: Um…Human, you say you are going to go to the Glacial Area down there?
Array.indonesia: Um… Manusia, kau bilang mau pergi ke Area Gletser di bawah sana?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman08_like_002
Array.english: It's gonna be freezing down there…\nYou can't go in clothes like that.
Array.indonesia: Di sana pasti sangat dingin…\nKau tidak bisa masuk dengan pakaian seperti itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman08_AfterGlacial_001
Array.english: Our village stays pleasantly warm all year round thanks to the Divine Tree.
Array.indonesia: Desa kami tetap hangat sepanjang tahun berkat Pohon Suci.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman08_AfterGlacial_002
Array.english: But recently, the temperature has been fluctuating wildly.\nIt's strange.
Array.indonesia: Namun belakangan ini, suhunya berfluktuasi dengan sangat ekstrem.\nAneh sekali.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman08_AfterGlacial_003
Array.english: These earthquakes keep occurring…\nSomething must have happened to the Divine Tree.
Array.indonesia: Gempa bumi terus terjadi…\nPasti ada sesuatu yang terjadi pada Pohon Suci.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman08_Ending_001
Array.english: I thought I was just getting old and achy, but now that the water temperature has stabilized, I feel invigorated!
Array.indonesia: Awalnya aku kira aku hanya semakin tua dan tubuhku mulai terasa pegal-pegal, tapi sekarang setelah suhu air stabil, aku merasa segar kembali!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman08_Ending_002
Array.english: Exactly! I feel like I have enough vitality to live another 200 years at least!
Array.indonesia: Benar sekali! Aku merasa punya cukup vitalitas untuk hidup setidaknya 200 tahun lagi!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman09_dislike_001
Array.english: Even though we pray, earthquakes keep coming…\nIs faith really enough to solve this problem?
Array.indonesia: Meskipun kita berdoa, gempa bumi terus terjadi…\nApakah iman saja cukup untuk menyelesaikan masalah ini?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman09_dislike_002
Array.english: <size=32>Don't say such things!\nThe reason we are all still okay is all thanks to King Long!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Jangan katakan hal seperti itu!\nAlasan kita semua masih baik-baik saja adalah berkat Raja Long!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman09_like_001
Array.english: If you want to stop the earthquakes, you need human technology!\nI know this.
Array.indonesia: Jika ingin menghentikan gempa bumi, kita membutuhkan teknologi manusia!\nAku tahu itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman09_like_002
Array.english: Technology is just an aid. You can't lose faith!
Array.indonesia: Teknologi hanyalah alat bantu. Jangan sampai kehilangan iman!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman09_AfterGlacial_001
