Array.english: I heard tales that we Sea People used to wander the Glacial Area freely back in the day.
Array.indonesia: Aku mendengar cerita bahwa kita, Suku Laut, dulu bisa berkelana dengan bebas di Kawasan Gletser.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman09_AfterGlacial_002
Array.english: Legends tell us our technology was more advanced at that time.
Array.indonesia: Legenda mengatakan bahwa teknologi kita lebih maju pada masa itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman09_AfterGlacial_003
Array.english: Personally, I'm content now! Back then, they wouldn’t have had anything like Mima’s Dumplings!
Array.indonesia: Secara pribadi, aku puas dengan keadaan sekarang! Dulu, mereka pasti tidak punya makanan seperti Pangsit Mima!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman09_Ending_001
Array.english: See? We offered our prayers to King Long and peace has returned.
Array.indonesia: Lihat? Kita telah mendoakan Raja Long dan kedamaian pun kembali.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman09_Ending_002
Array.english: Who would’ve known if the two events were related?\nThis time, humans also stepped in to help.
Array.indonesia: Siapa yang tahu apakah kedua peristiwa itu saling terkait?\nKali ini, manusia juga ikut turun tangan membantu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman09_Ending_003
Array.english: Don't lose faith! King Long wouldn't be pleased!
Array.indonesia: Jangan kehilangan keyakinan! Raja Long tidak akan senang!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman10_dislike_001
Array.english: The ice of the Divine Tree is melting little by little...\nThere are more and more getting sick….
Array.indonesia: Es Pohon Suci mencair sedikit demi sedikit.. .\nSemakin banyak yang jatuh sakit….

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman10_like_001
Array.english: I have a bad feeling.\nHelp us, human!
Array.indonesia: Aku punya firasat buruk.\nTolong kami, manusia!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman10_AfterGlacial_001
Array.english: It feels like the water temperature has dropped recently... It's a bit chilly.
Array.indonesia: Rasanya suhu air turun belakangan ini... Agak dingin.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman10_AfterGlacial_002
Array.english: Or was it warmer before?\nHmm, something feels off!
Array.indonesia: Atau apakah sebelumnya lebih hangat?\nHmm, ada yang terasa aneh!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman10_Ending_001
Array.english: I felt a bit unwell, but I'm feeling better now.
Array.indonesia: Aku sempat merasa sedikit tidak enak badan, tapi sekarang sudah lebih baik.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman11_restaurant_001
Array.english: Yep. The food at Mimame's is so good!
Array.indonesia: Iya. Makanan di Mimame's enak banget!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman11_restaurant_002
Array.english: It's really different than the food at home.\nWhere do you get your ingredients?
Array.indonesia: Rasanya benar-benar beda dari makanan di rumah.\nDari mana kamu dapat bahan-bahannya?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman11_restaurant_AfterGlacial_001
Array.english: How in the world do you make these dumplings so tasty!
Array.indonesia: Gimana sih caranya kamu bikin pangsit ini jadi seenak ini!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman11_restaurant_Ending_001
Array.english: Now that the water temperature in the Glacial Area has stabilized...\nMaybe I should try making some dumplings myself?
Array.indonesia: Sekarang suhu air di Kawasan Gletser sudah stabil...\nMungkin aku harus coba bikin pangsit sendiri?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman11_restaurant_Ending_002
Array.english: No, there's no way I could make them taste this good!
Array.indonesia: Nggak, nggak mungkin aku bisa bikin yang rasanya seenak ini!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman12_restaurant_001
Array.english: I've been coughing a lot lately.\nHot soup is just right for this.
Array.indonesia: Aku sering batuk-batuk belakangan ini.\nSup panas pas banget buat ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman12_restaurant_002
Array.english: How do you eat soup in water?\nHumans ask such strange things….cough*
Array.indonesia: Bagaimana cara makan sup di dalam air?\nManusia memang suka bertanya hal-hal aneh….batuk*

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman12_restaurant_AfterGlacial_001
Array.english: <size=35>Ouch! Don't talk to me when I’m eating! I burned my mouth!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Aduh! Jangan bicara padaku saat aku sedang makan! Mulutku terbakar!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman12_restaurant_Ending_001
Array.english: Even when I get mad at my husband, eating dumplings here cheers me right up…
Array.indonesia: Bahkan saat aku marah pada suamiku, makan pangsit di sini langsung membuatku ceria kembali…

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman13_Wooten01_001
Array.english: Would you like a little live music?
Array.indonesia: Mau dengar musik live sebentar?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman13_Wooten02_001
Array.english: Hehe, I hope you enjoyed it.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, semoga kamu menikmatinya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman13_Wooten_AfterGlacial_001
Array.english: With the ground being so unstable, it's hard to get inspired to compose.
Array.indonesia: Dengan tanah yang begitu tidak stabil, sulit untuk mendapatkan inspirasi dalam berkarya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman13_Wooten_Ending01_001
Array.english: But now that the Divine Tree's power is returning, I feel my inspiration coming back.
Array.indonesia: Tapi sekarang setelah kekuatan Pohon Ilahi kembali, aku merasa inspirasiku pun kembali.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman13_Wooten_Ending01_002
Array.english: Let me give you a sneak peek of the piece I'm working on.\nIt's a song dedicated to the Divine Tree.
Array.indonesia: Biar aku kasih sedikit cuplikan lagu yang sedang aku kerjakan.\nIni lagu yang didedikasikan untuk Pohon Suci.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman13_Wooten_Ending02_001
Array.english: Hehe, I hope you enjoyed it.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, semoga kamu menikmatinya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Daphne01_001
Array.english: I've been gambling a lot to blow off steam.\nI should skip a few meals.
Array.indonesia: Aku sering berjudi untuk melepas penat.\nSepertinya aku harus melewatkan beberapa kali makan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Daphne_AfterGlacial_001
Array.english: You're hunting down the cause of the earthquakes, huh?
Array.indonesia: Kamu sedang memburu penyebab gempa bumi, ya?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Daphne_AfterGlacial_002
Array.english: I was about to demand my Beluga Whistle from you...\nbut you can keep it.
Array.indonesia: Aku hampir saja menuntut Beluga Whistle-ku darimu...\ntapi kamu boleh menyimpannya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Daphne_AfterGlacial_003
Array.english: With the temperature swings, there's not much to do outside and I have no use for it.
Array.indonesia: Dengan fluktuasi suhu seperti ini, tidak banyak yang bisa dilakukan di luar dan aku tidak membutuhkannya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Daphne_Ending_001
Array.english: Now that the temperature's steady, roaming around is kind of fun.
Array.indonesia: Sekarang suhunya sudah stabil, berkeliling-keliling jadi cukup menyenangkan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Daphne_Ending_002
Array.english: You can keep the Beluga Whistle.
Array.indonesia: Kamu boleh menyimpan Beluga Whistle itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Linchen_AfterGlacial_001
Array.english: If an earthquake happens while patrons are enjoying the entertainment, it can nullify their progress, inevitably leading to their discontent.
Array.indonesia: Jika gempa terjadi saat para pengunjung sedang menikmati hiburan, hal itu bisa menggagalkan kemajuan mereka, yang pada akhirnya akan menimbulkan ketidakpuasan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Linchen_AfterGlacial_002
Array.english: For the happiness of the Sea People residents, I hope these earthquakes cease soon.
Array.indonesia: Demi kebahagiaan penduduk Sea People, aku berharap gempa-gempa ini segera berhenti.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Linchen_Ending_001
Array.english: Whenever you're feeling down and need some comfort,\nor when you're in high spirits and want to share your joy,
Array.indonesia: Kapan pun kamu merasa sedih dan butuh penghiburan,\natau saat kamu sedang bersemangat dan ingin berbagi kebahagiaan,

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Linchen_Ending_002
Array.english: our Game Parlor is always here for you, tee-hee.
Array.indonesia: Game Parlor kami selalu ada untukmu, hehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Maro_FirstMeet_001
Array.english: <size=34>Wow…! Are you a human?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wah…! Apa kamu manusia?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Maro_FirstMeet_002
Array.english: Yes. That's correct.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Benar sekali.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Maro_FirstMeet_003
Array.english: <size=33>Whoa! I guess you need to have a round shape like that to survive on land!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wah! Sepertinya kamu harus punya bentuk bulat seperti itu untuk bisa bertahan hidup di darat!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Maro_FirstMeet_004
Array.english: I told you, it's a scary place.
Array.indonesia: Sudah kubilang, itu tempat yang menakutkan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Maro_FirstMeet_005
Array.english: No...Guys...
Array.indonesia: Tidak... Teman-teman...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Maro_AfterGlacial_001
Array.english: Did you hear that the path to the Glacial Area is open?
Array.indonesia: Apa kalian dengar kalau jalan menuju Kawasan Gletser sudah dibuka?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Maro_AfterGlacial_002
Array.english: Wow, it seems like fun!
Array.indonesia: Wow, kayaknya seru!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Maro_AfterGlacial_003
Array.english: You! You must not go down there, okay?\nIt was very dangerous down there.
Array.indonesia: Kamu! Kamu jangan turun ke sana, ya?\nDi sana sangat berbahaya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Maro_AfterGlacial_004
Array.english: Hehe… I know. Just trying it out.
Array.indonesia: Hehe… Aku tahu. Cuma coba-coba aja.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Maro_Ending_001
Array.english: Did you hear about the Control Room?
Array.indonesia: Kalian dengar soal Ruang Kontrol?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Maro_Ending_002
Array.english: Suwam told me! It sounded really fun!
Array.indonesia: Suwam udah cerita ke aku! Kedengarannya seru banget!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Maro_Ending_003
Array.english: <size=34>What're you guys chattering about now?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Kalian lagi ngobrolin apa sih sekarang?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Maro_Ending_004
Array.english: Oh, haha! Nothing at all!!
Array.indonesia: Oh, haha! Nggak ada apa-apa!!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Padeuma_AfterGlacial_001
Array.english: Recently, it feels like more villagers are falling sick.
Array.indonesia: Belakangan ini, rasanya makin banyak penduduk desa yang sakit.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Padeuma_AfterGlacial_002
Array.english: The inconsistent water temperature is quite disconcerting.
Array.indonesia: Suhu air yang nggak stabil itu cukup mengkhawatirkan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Padeuma_Ending_001
Array.english: I feel like my pain has been washed away!
Array.indonesia: Rasanya rasa sakitku sudah hilang!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Padeuma_Ending_002
Array.english: This village has never really had a good clinic.
Array.indonesia: Desa ini memang belum pernah punya klinik yang bagus.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Yese_AfterGlacial_001
Array.english: Huh? You, a human, are planning on venturing into the glacial area?
Array.indonesia: Hah? Kamu, seorang manusia, berencana menjelajah ke daerah gletser?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Yese_AfterGlacial_002
Array.english: It'll be extremely cold… Are you sure you're up for it?
Array.indonesia: Di sana akan sangat dingin… Kamu yakin sanggup melakukannya?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Yese_Ending_001
Array.english: There's a heated region underneath the cold area?
Array.indonesia: Ada wilayah yang hangat di bawah daerah dingin itu?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Yese_Ending_002
Array.english: It's truly astonishing that\nall of this is controlled by the Divine Tree.
Array.indonesia: Sungguh menakjubkan bahwa\nsemua ini dikendalikan oleh Pohon Suci.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Niamo_FirstMeet_001
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>Oh…Nobody is here.\nI guess I'll have to come back later.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Oh… Tidak ada siapa-siapa di sini.\nSepertinya aku harus kembali nanti.</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Niamo_AfterGlacial_001
Array.english: Our ancestors used to traverse the Glacial Area with ease.
Array.indonesia: Nenek moyang kita dulu bisa melintasi Kawasan Gletser dengan mudah.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Niamo_AfterGlacial_002
Array.english: But ever since we settled in this place, we became weaker and the Glacial Area has become a dangerous place.
Array.indonesia: Namun, sejak kita menetap di tempat ini, kita menjadi lebih lemah dan Kawasan Gletser pun berubah menjadi tempat yang berbahaya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Niamo_AfterGlacial_003
Array.english: We need your help, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Kami membutuhkan bantuanmu, Dave.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Niamo_AfterDungeon01_001
Array.english: The contraption built by our ancestors is difficult to operate.
Array.indonesia: Alat yang dibuat oleh leluhur kami sulit dioperasikan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Niamo_AfterDungeon01_002
Array.english: And it seems that something caused the contraption to malfunction.
Array.indonesia: Dan sepertinya ada sesuatu yang menyebabkan alat itu mengalami gangguan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Niamo_AfterDungeon01_003
Array.english: I know it’s not right to get you involved in matters of ours,\nbut please do help us.
Array.indonesia: Aku tahu tidak pantas melibatkanmu dalam urusan kami,\ntapi tolong bantu kami.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Niamo_AfterDungeon01_004
Array.english: The earthquakes are not only your problem. Humans are suffering from them, too.
Array.indonesia: Gempa bumi bukan hanya masalahmu. Manusia juga menderita karenanya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Niamo_AfterDungeon01_005
Array.english: I will find out the cause.
Array.indonesia: Aku akan mencari tahu penyebabnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Niamo_AfterDungeon01_006
Array.english: Thank you.\nMay the blessings of King Long be with you.
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih.\nSemoga berkat Raja Long menyertaimu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Niamo_7ChapterProgress_001
Array.english: Fortunately, the water temperature has stabilized a bit.
Array.indonesia: Untungnya, suhu air sudah sedikit stabil.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Niamo_7ChapterProgress_002
Array.english: But we need to find the main cause to prevent it from recurring.
Array.indonesia: Namun, kami perlu menemukan penyebab utamanya agar hal ini tidak terulang lagi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Niamo_Ending_001
Array.english: Dave... You did a great job.
Array.indonesia: Dave... Kamu telah melakukan pekerjaan yang hebat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Niamo_Ending_002
Array.english: I heard about the situation in the Control Room from Tenzhin...\nThe moment I heard it, I...
Array.indonesia: Aku mendengar tentang situasi di Ruang Kontrol dari Tenzhin...\nBegitu aku mendengarnya, aku...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Niamo_Ending_003
Array.english: <size=50>!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>!!!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Niamo_Ending_004
Array.english: I made this face.
Array.indonesia: Aku membuat ekspresi seperti ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Niamo_Ending_005
Array.english: Phew, it was quite a scene.\nBut thanks to the help of the Sea People, we managed to handle it.
Array.indonesia: Wah, itu benar-benar kejadian yang heboh.\nTapi berkat bantuan Suku Laut, kami berhasil mengatasinya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Niamo_Ending_006
Array.english: The collaboration between humans and the Sea People in this incident will surely go down in history.
Array.indonesia: Kerja sama antara manusia dan Suku Laut dalam insiden ini pasti akan tercatat dalam sejarah.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Niamo_Ending_007
Array.english: Thank you once again...\nMay King Long's blessings always be with you.
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih sekali lagi...\nSemoga berkat Raja Long selalu menyertai kalian.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Ramo_AfterGlacial_001
Array.english: So the giant mirror that goes to the <color=#F1DC2B>Glacial Area</color> is working?
Array.indonesia: Jadi, cermin raksasa yang menuju ke <color=#F1DC2B>Wilayah Gletser</color> itu berfungsi?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Ramo_AfterGlacial_002
Array.english: Suwam, that guy...\nI think he went around town saying he did it all by himself.
Array.indonesia: Suwam, orang itu...\nSepertinya dia berkeliling kota sambil bilang kalau dia melakukannya sendirian.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Ramo_AfterGlacial_003
Array.english: He's incorrigible...
Array.indonesia: Dia memang tak bisa diubah...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Ramo_7ChapterProgress_001
Array.english: The Divine Tree in the Control Room mutated, you say?
Array.indonesia: Pohon Suci di Ruang Kontrol mengalami mutasi, katamu?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Ramo_7ChapterProgress_002
Array.english: What is happening?
Array.indonesia: Apa yang sedang terjadi?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Ramo_Ending_001
Array.english: If you had declined my initial request to visit our Sea People Village,
Array.indonesia: Jika kamu menolak permintaan awalku untuk mengunjungi Desa Suku Laut kami,

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Ramo_Ending_002
Array.english: our village might still be stuck in the same situation, right?
Array.indonesia: desa kami mungkin masih terjebak dalam situasi yang sama, bukan?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Ramo_Ending_003
Array.english: Honestly, even thinking about it now gives me chills.
Array.indonesia: Jujur saja, bahkan memikirkannya sekarang saja sudah membuatku merinding.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Ramo_Ending_004
Array.english: But on a positive note, everything is fine now, haha!
Array.indonesia: Tapi sisi baiknya, semuanya baik-baik saja sekarang, haha!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_AwangNawang_AfterGlacial_001
Array.english: I heard that you found a way inside the Glacial Area, human.
Array.indonesia: Kudengar kau menemukan jalan masuk ke Area Gletser, manusia.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_AwangNawang_AfterGlacial_002
Array.english: But don't put on airs!
Array.indonesia: Tapi jangan sok hebat!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_AwangNawang_AfterGlacial_003
Array.english: For us, who keep the town safe,\nit's one more thing to worry about.
Array.indonesia: Bagi kami, yang menjaga keamanan kota,\nini satu hal lagi yang perlu dikhawatirkan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_AwangNawang_AfterGlacial_004
Array.english: I think that no sane person would enter such a cold place, though.
Array.indonesia: Menurutku, tidak ada orang waras yang akan masuk ke tempat sedingin itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_AwangNawang_AfterBeluga_001
Array.english: You resist the cold quite well, human.
Array.indonesia: Kamu cukup tahan terhadap dingin, manusia.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_AwangNawang_AfterBeluga_002
Array.english: Oh, that is because of the Divine Tree fruit we gave you, heh.
Array.indonesia: Oh, itu karena buah Pohon Suci yang kami berikan padamu, heh.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_AwangNawang_7ChapterProgress_001
Array.english: A Control Room below the glacial area, huh…
Array.indonesia: Ruang Kontrol di bawah Area Gletser, ya…

Array.name: NPC_Talk_AwangNawang_7ChapterProgress_002
Array.english: It feels like I've seen it in an old document. So it really did exist.
Array.indonesia: Rasanya aku pernah melihatnya di dokumen kuno. Jadi, tempat itu memang benar-benar ada.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_AwangNawang_7ChapterProgress_003
Array.english: Don’t touch anything. It could be dangerous, human.
Array.indonesia: Jangan sentuh apa pun. Itu bisa berbahaya, manusia.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_AwangNawang_Ending_001
Array.english: You know, I think I might actually be able to trust you, but...
Array.indonesia: Kau tahu, kurasa aku mungkin benar-benar bisa mempercayaimu, tapi...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_AwangNawang_Ending_002
Array.english: A while back, a human caused a ruckus in the village with some round contraption.
Array.indonesia: Beberapa waktu lalu, seorang manusia membuat keributan di desa dengan alat bulat aneh.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_AwangNawang_Ending_003
Array.english: Humans are always unpredictable.\nWe have to stay on guard.
Array.indonesia: Manusia selalu tidak bisa diprediksi.\nKita harus tetap waspada.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Suwam_BeforeGlacialPassage_001
Array.english: <size=34>Tips on fighting the Gadons?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ada tips untuk melawan Gadon?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Suwam_BeforeGlacialPassage_002
Array.english: *Laughing* Of course, it’s only natural for you to seek a piece of advice from a great warrior and strategist like myself.
Array.indonesia: *Tertawa* Tentu saja, wajar saja kalau kamu meminta nasihat dari seorang pejuang dan ahli strategi hebat sepertiku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Suwam_BeforeGlacialPassage_003
Array.english: Now, listen carefully. The most important thing is...
Array.indonesia: Sekarang, dengarkan baik-baik. Hal terpenting adalah...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Suwam_BeforeGlacialPassage_004
Array.english: <size=34>not to encounter them in the first place.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>jangan sampai bertemu mereka sejak awal.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Suwam_BeforeGlacialPassage_005
Array.english: That doesn’t help...
Array.indonesia: Itu tidak membantu...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Suwam_BeforeGlacialPassage_006
Array.english: Minimizing the risk is the best tactic.\nYou didn’t know that?!
Array.indonesia: Meminimalkan risiko adalah taktik terbaik.\nKamu tidak tahu itu?!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Suwam_BeforeNewSuit_001
Array.english: My choice is to protect the village from all threats.
Array.indonesia: Pilihanku adalah melindungi desa dari segala ancaman.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Suwam_BeforeNewSuit_002
Array.english: Go find a way into the Glacial Area.
Array.indonesia: Pergilah cari jalan masuk ke Kawasan Gletser.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Suwam_AfterDungeon01_001
Array.english: You took so long, human.
Array.indonesia: Kamu lama sekali, manusia.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Suwam_AfterDungeon01_002
Array.english: I would have done it myself if my back was not injured.
Array.indonesia: Aku pasti sudah melakukannya sendiri kalau punggungku tidak cedera.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Suwam_AfterDungeon01_003
Array.english: I feel sorry for everyone in the village, haha.
Array.indonesia: Aku kasihan pada semua orang di desa, haha.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Suwam_7ChapterProgress_001
Array.english: Don’t forget that thanks to me, you could activate the last switch.
Array.indonesia: Jangan lupa bahwa berkat aku, kamu bisa mengaktifkan sakelar terakhir.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Suwam_7ChapterProgress_002
Array.english: Argh...\nThe scars I received from that thresher shark still hurt.
Array.indonesia: Argh...\nBekas luka yang kudapat dari hiu thresher itu masih terasa sakit.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Suwam_7ChapterProgress_003
Array.english: I am counting on you, human.
Array.indonesia: Aku mengandalkanmu, manusia.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Suwam_7ChapterProgress_004
Array.english: <size=52>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=52>...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Suwam_Ending_001
Array.english: Hehehe…\nGiven such a heroic performance, I'm sure my name will be etched in the annals of history.
Array.indonesia: Hehehe…\nDengan penampilan heroik seperti itu, aku yakin namaku akan terukir dalam lembaran sejarah.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Suwam_Ending_002
Array.english: Suwam and his comrades, under Suwam's leadership, conquered the mutated monster Yawie and saved the world!
Array.indonesia: Suwam dan kawan-kawannya, di bawah kepemimpinan Suwam, berhasil mengalahkan monster mutan Yawie dan menyelamatkan dunia!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Suwam_Ending_003
Array.english: Cool! I can practically envision another statue standing tall beside the statue of King Long!
Array.indonesia: Keren! Aku hampir bisa membayangkan patung lain yang menjulang tinggi di samping patung Raja Long!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Suwam_Ending_004
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(...Well, let him bask in his glory for now.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(...Yah, biarkan dia menikmati kemuliaannya untuk saat ini.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_4ChapterProgress_001
Array.english: I need the key to the passage leading to the Glacial Area.
Array.indonesia: Aku butuh kunci untuk lorong yang mengarah ke Area Gletser.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_4ChapterProgress_002
Array.english: Can you bring it to me? It’s in the <color=#F1DC2B>Abandoned Cave</color>. Suwam will go with you.
Array.indonesia: Bisakah kamu membawakannya untukku? Kuncinya ada di <color=#F1DC2B>Gua Terlantar</color>. Suwam akan menemanimu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_4ChapterCleared_001
Array.english: Get some rest on land and come back tomorrow.
Array.indonesia: Istirahatlah sebentar di darat dan kembali besok.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_5ChapterBeforeGlacialPassage_001
Array.english: The key has been handed over to Suwam. You should meet him.
Array.indonesia: Kunci itu sudah diserahkan kepada Suwam. Kamu sebaiknya menemuinya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_5ChapterProgress_001
Array.english: The Glacial Passage has long been sealed.
Array.indonesia: Terowongan Gletser sudah lama tertutup.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_5ChapterProgress_002
Array.english: It’s a pity that we don’t have enough strength or weapons to explore the area.
Array.indonesia: Sayang sekali kita tidak memiliki kekuatan atau senjata yang cukup untuk menjelajahi daerah itu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_5ChapterProgress_003
Array.english: Suwam claims that he’s the best warrior among you, is that true?
Array.indonesia: Suwam mengklaim bahwa dia adalah prajurit terbaik di antara kalian, benarkah itu?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_5ChapterProgress_004
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! Hm...\nWell, I admire his confidence!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Hm...\nYah, aku kagum dengan kepercayaan dirinya!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_5ChapterCleared_001
Array.english: Use the <color=#F1DC2B>Divine Tree Fruit Cloth</color> to craft a suit and you can enter the Glacial Area as well.
Array.indonesia: Gunakan <color=#F1DC2B>Kain Buah Pohon Ilahi</color> untuk membuat setelan, dan kalian pun bisa memasuki Area Gletser.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_5ChapterCleared_002
Array.english: Of course, you will need to find a human tailor or something for the task since our attire is different from yours.
Array.indonesia: Tentu saja, kalian perlu mencari penjahit manusia atau semacamnya untuk tugas ini karena pakaian kami berbeda dengan kalian.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_6ChapterAfterDecript_001
Array.english: Hm, a stone slab found in the Glacial Area?\nI can roughly translate the text, but...
Array.indonesia: Hm, sebuah lempengan batu yang ditemukan di Area Gletser?\nAku bisa menerjemahkan teksnya secara kasar, tapi...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_6ChapterAfterDecript_002
Array.english: If you want to know the details, ask <color=#F1DC2B>Niamo</color>.
Array.indonesia: Jika kamu ingin tahu detailnya, tanyakan pada <color=#F1DC2B>Niamo</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_6ChapterProgress_001
Array.english: You need to activate three switches and enter the <color=#F1DC2B>Control Room</color> to find out what is causing the earthquakes.
Array.indonesia: Kamu perlu mengaktifkan tiga sakelar dan masuk ke <color=#F1DC2B>Ruang Kontrol</color> untuk mencari tahu apa yang menyebabkan gempa bumi tersebut.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_6ChapterProgress_002
Array.english: The water temperature is unstable and making \nour health deteriorate.
Array.indonesia: Suhu air tidak stabil dan membuat \nkesehatan kita memburuk.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_6ChapterProgress_003
Array.english: I am sorry to pester you, but we don’t have much time.
Array.indonesia: Maaf telah mengganggu Anda, tapi kita tidak punya banyak waktu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_7ChapterProgress_001
Array.english: As I feared, the Divine Tree is not in good condition.
Array.indonesia: Seperti yang kutakutkan, Pohon Suci tidak dalam kondisi baik.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_7ChapterProgress_002
Array.english: I hope we can somehow help you with this.
Array.indonesia: Semoga kami bisa membantu Anda dalam hal ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_Ending_001
Array.english: You have put in significant effort in assisting our Sea People.
Array.indonesia: Kamu telah berupaya keras dalam membantu Suku Laut kami.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_Ending_002
Array.english: It's nothing really. It was a problem affecting the land as well.
Array.indonesia: Sebenarnya tidak apa-apa. Itu adalah masalah yang juga memengaruhi daratan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_Ending_003
Array.english: I've been biased, having seen the darker side of humans for so long.
Array.indonesia: Aku telah bersikap bias, karena telah melihat sisi gelap manusia selama ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_Ending_004
Array.english: There are still so many humans with greedy intentions,\nbut there are also plenty of good ones.
Array.indonesia: Masih banyak manusia dengan niat serakah,\ntetapi ada juga banyak yang baik.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_Ending_005
Array.english: For the time being, I'll ensure the Sea People's territory remains a secret!\nHowever, I will be dropping by occasionally!
Array.indonesia: Untuk saat ini, aku akan memastikan wilayah Suku Laut tetap menjadi rahasia!\nNamun, aku akan mampir sesekali!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_Ending_006
Array.english: <size=34>Thank you. Feel free to visit anytime.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Terima kasih. Silakan mampir kapan saja.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_FirstMeet_001
Array.english: Why is a human here...
Array.indonesia: Kenapa ada manusia di sini...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_FirstMeet_002
Array.english: I need to have some peace and quiet. Please leave.
Array.indonesia: Aku butuh ketenangan dan kedamaian. Tolong pergi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_FirstMeet_003
Array.english: <size=34>…cough.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>…uhuk.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_AfterGlacial_001
Array.english: Cough... Cough…
Array.indonesia: Uhuk... Uhuk…

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_AfterGlacial_002
Array.english: Are you okay?
Array.indonesia: Apa kamu baik-baik saja?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_AfterGlacial_003
Array.english: The water temperature keeps changing so rapidly. \nI am not feeling well.
Array.indonesia: Suhu air terus berubah dengan sangat cepat. \nAku merasa tidak enak badan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_AfterGlacial_004
Array.english: It’s not just me. Many of us got sick.
Array.indonesia: Bukan hanya aku. Banyak dari kami yang sakit.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_AfterGlacial_005
Array.english: We must find what caused this and quickly resolve the issue.
Array.indonesia: Kita harus mencari tahu apa penyebabnya dan segera menyelesaikan masalah ini.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_Ending_001
Array.english: *Coughing*
Array.indonesia: *Batuk*

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_Ending_002
Array.english: Duwa, you still not feeling well?
Array.indonesia: Duwa, kamu masih tidak enak badan?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_Ending_003
Array.english: Don't sweat it... I'm a lot better than before.
Array.indonesia: Jangan khawatir... Aku sudah jauh lebih baik daripada sebelumnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_Ending_004
Array.english: I've got a longstanding illness.\nJust flared up recently.
Array.indonesia: Aku punya penyakit kronis.\nBaru-baru ini kambuh.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_Ending_005
Array.english: I see...\nIf you ever need help, just let me know, okay?
Array.indonesia: Begitu...\nKalau kamu butuh bantuan, bilang saja padaku, ya?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_ShopNormal_001
Array.english: Our people do not wield weapons except the guards.
Array.indonesia: Orang-orang kita tidak menggunakan senjata kecuali para penjaga.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_ShopNormal_002
Array.english: So, this Workshop mostly crafts production tools.
Array.indonesia: Jadi, bengkel ini kebanyakan membuat alat produksi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_ShopNormal_003
Array.english: You should bring the materials to land to create a weapon. *Cough*
Array.indonesia: Kamu harus membawa bahan-bahannya ke daratan untuk membuat senjata. *Batuk*

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_Wating_Shop_001
Array.english: Today, I'll do my best to prepare the blacksmith shop, so come by <color=#1DFEAF>tomorrow</color>.
Array.indonesia: Hari ini, aku akan berusaha sebaik mungkin menyiapkan bengkel pandai besi, jadi mampirlah <color=#1DFEAF>besok</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_CrabPotComplete_001
Array.english: *Coughing*
Array.indonesia: *Batuk*

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_CrabPotComplete_002
Array.english: Your coughing hasn't stopped yet.
Array.indonesia: Batukmu belum berhenti juga.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_CrabPotComplete_003
Array.english: It hasn't…\nBut the Steamed Horsehair Crab made me feel a lot better.
Array.indonesia: Belum…\nTapi Kepiting Bulu Kuda Kukus itu membuatku merasa jauh lebih baik.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_CrabPotComplete_004
Array.english: Still, I may have overdone it, heh. Must've been the crab working its magic on me.
Array.indonesia: Meski begitu, mungkin aku makan terlalu banyak, heh. Pasti kepiting itu yang memberi efek ajaib padaku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_CrabPotComplete_005
Array.english: You haven't completely recovered yet. You need to take care of yourself.
Array.indonesia: Kamu belum sepenuhnya pulih. Kamu harus menjaga kesehatanmu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_CrabPotComplete_006
Array.english: Thank you. I will.
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih. Aku akan melakukannya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mima_AfterGlacial_001
Array.english: I am sure that I will be able to find new ingredients for my dumplings in the Glacial Area.
Array.indonesia: Aku yakin bisa menemukan bahan-bahan baru untuk pangsitku di Kawasan Gletser.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mima_AfterGlacial_002
Array.english: I will prepare some energizing dumplings for you. Godspeed!
Array.indonesia: Aku akan menyiapkan pangsit yang memberi energi untukmu. Semoga sukses!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mima_Ending_001
Array.english: I heard you visited a really scorching place…!
Array.indonesia: Kudengar kamu mengunjungi tempat yang sangat panas…!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mima_Ending_002
Array.english: You're probably not in the mood for hot dumplings right now, eh?
Array.indonesia: Kamu mungkin nggak lagi pengen makan pangsit panas sekarang, ya?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mima_Ending_003
Array.english: Not at all!\nMima's dumplings are always delicious, no matter when I eat them.
Array.indonesia: Nggak sama sekali!\nPangsit buatan Mima selalu enak, kapan pun aku memakannya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mima_ShopNormal_001
Array.english: Hoho! I modified them for humans to enjoy.\nBon appetit!
Array.indonesia: Hoho! Aku sudah memodifikasinya agar bisa dinikmati manusia.\nSelamat menikmati!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mima_CrabPotMaking_001
Array.english: Steamed Horsehair Crab is good for coughs.
Array.indonesia: Kepiting Bulu Kuda Kukus bagus untuk meredakan batuk.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mima_CrabPotMaking_002
Array.english: I have a steamer at my place. Just get me a <color=#F1DC2B>Horsehair Crab</color>!
Array.indonesia: Aku punya pengukus di rumah. Cukup bawakan aku <color=#F1DC2B>Kepiting Bulu Kuda</color>!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mima_CrabPotMaking_003
Array.english: How do I catch it?
Array.indonesia: Bagaimana cara menangkapnya?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mima_CrabPotMaking_004
Array.english: You have to use a <color=#F1DC2B>Crab Trap</color>, haha!\nA Horsehair Crab can be lured with some bait!
Array.indonesia: Kamu harus menggunakan <color=#F1DC2B>Perangkap Kepiting</color>, haha!\nKepiting Rambut Kuda bisa dipancing dengan umpan!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mima_CrabPotDeliver_001
Array.english: Wait, you still haven't delivered the <color=#F1DC2B>Steamed Horsehair Crab</color> to Duwa?
Array.indonesia: Tunggu, kamu belum mengantarkan <color=#F1DC2B>Kepiting Rambut Kuda Kukus</color> ke Duwa?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mima_CrabPotDeliver_002
Array.english: He should be waiting for you.
Array.indonesia: Dia pasti sedang menunggumu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Gumo_AfterGlacial_001
Array.english: Corals and seaweeds can be found even in the coldest Glacial areas.
Array.indonesia: Karang dan rumput laut bisa ditemukan bahkan di daerah Gletser yang paling dingin sekalipun.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Gumo_AfterGlacial_002
Array.english: Bring me their seeds and I will cultivate them with care.
Array.indonesia: Bawakan aku benihnya dan aku akan menanamnya dengan penuh perhatian.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Gumo_Ending_001
Array.english: Did you perhaps notice any seaweed sprouting in that Control Room?
Array.indonesia: Apa kamu mungkin melihat rumput laut tumbuh di Ruang Kontrol itu?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Gumo_Ending_002
Array.english: Mm... it didn't seem like anything could grow there.
Array.indonesia: Mm... sepertinya tidak ada yang bisa tumbuh di sana.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Gumo_Ending_003
Array.english: That’s a shame. There's always a thrill in nurturing new seaweed.
Array.indonesia: Sayang sekali. Selalu ada sensasi tersendiri dalam merawat rumput laut baru.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Gumo_ShopNormal_001
Array.english: I still can’t believe that humans also eat seaweed.
Array.indonesia: Aku masih tidak percaya bahwa manusia juga makan rumput laut.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Gumo_ShopNormal_002
Array.english: I remember the food on land was quite tasty too...\nYou humans have such diverse cooking ingredients.
Array.indonesia: Aku ingat makanan di darat juga cukup lezat...\nKalian manusia memiliki bahan masakan yang begitu beragam.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Kazhin_AfterGlacial01_001
Array.english: I pray every morning but the earthquakes still continue.
Array.indonesia: Aku berdoa setiap pagi, tetapi gempa bumi masih terus terjadi.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Kazhin_AfterGlacial01_002
Array.english: Human, why don’t you join me in reading the morning prayer?
Array.indonesia: Manusia, mengapa kamu tidak ikut bersamaku membaca doa pagi?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Kazhin_AfterGlacial01_003
Array.english: <size=34>What? But I don’t read your language.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Apa? Tapi aku nggak bisa baca bahasa kamu.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Kazhin_AfterGlacial01_004
Array.english: Ah, right...\nI have no use for you then.
Array.indonesia: Ah, benar juga...\nKalau begitu, kamu nggak berguna buatku.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Kazhin_AfterGlacial02_001
Array.english: There are plants inhabiting the Glacial Area.
Array.indonesia: Ada tumbuhan yang tumbuh di Kawasan Gletser.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Kazhin_AfterGlacial02_002
Array.english: I procured some of their seeds. You may purchase some of them from Gumo and try cultivating them.
Array.indonesia: Aku sudah mendapatkan beberapa bijinya. Kamu bisa membelinya dari Gumo dan mencoba menanamnya.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Kazhin_ShopNormal_001
Array.english: Reading a book amidst plants gives me inner peace.
Array.indonesia: Membaca buku di tengah-tengah tumbuhan memberiku ketenangan batin.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Kazhin_ShopNormal_002
Array.english: The stories about the great feats of King Long never get boring.
Array.indonesia: Kisah-kisah tentang prestasi hebat Raja Long tidak pernah membosankan.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Kazhin_ShopNormal_003
Array.english: My favorite is...\n<size=26>the story about him when our people were wandering in search of a new home.</size>
Array.indonesia: Favoritku adalah...\n<size=26>kisah tentang dirinya saat kaum kita mengembara mencari rumah baru.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Kazhin_ShopNormal_004
Array.english: Oh? The Sea People Translator is not working!\nMaybe next time, haha!
Array.indonesia: Oh? Penerjemah Kaum Laut tidak berfungsi!\nMungkin lain kali, haha!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Kazhin_Ending_001
Array.english: I heard about your exploits, human!\nSome unbelievable stuff, eh?
Array.indonesia: Aku mendengar tentang prestasi-prestasi mu, manusia!\nHal-hal yang sulit dipercaya, ya?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Kazhin_Ending_002
Array.english: Yeah, it's a lot to put into words.
Array.indonesia: Ya, sulit dijelaskan dengan kata-kata.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Kazhin_Ending_003
Array.english: Bahaha! We should swap stories over a cup of seaweed wine sometime.
Array.indonesia: Bahaha! Kita harus bertukar cerita sambil menikmati segelas anggur rumput laut suatu saat nanti.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Kazhin_Ending_004
Array.english: I can fill you in on King Long, too!
Array.indonesia: Aku juga bisa menceritakan tentang Raja Long padamu!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Kazhin_Ending_005
Array.english: Sure. Let's do that someday.
Array.indonesia: Tentu. Ayo kita lakukan itu suatu hari nanti.

Array.name: Staff_Talk_Manager_Kyoko_001
Array.english: Ah…<color=#F1DC2B>Manager</color> huh? Well I'm good at what I do but…
Array.indonesia: Ah…<color=#F1DC2B>Manajer</color> ya? Yah, aku memang ahli dalam pekerjaanku, tapi…

Array.name: Staff_Talk_Manager_Kyoko_002
Array.english: <size=34>Kind of...a pain...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Agak… merepotkan…</size>

Array.name: Staff_Talk_Manager_Liu_001
Array.english: An excellent choice!
Array.indonesia: Pilihan yang sangat tepat!

Array.name: Staff_Talk_Manager_Liu_002
Array.english: Looks like 'm the right person for the job of <color=#F1DC2B>manager</color>!
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya aku orang yang tepat untuk posisi <color=#F1DC2B>manajer</color>!

Array.name: Staff_Talk_Manager_Calorina_001
Array.english: The <color=#F1DC2B>manager</color> is the face of a restaurant!
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Manajer</color> adalah wajah dari sebuah restoran!

Array.name: Staff_Talk_Manager_Calorina_002
Array.english: I'd say the restaurant is already a success!
Array.indonesia: Menurutku, restoran ini sudah sukses!

Array.name: Staff_Talk_Manager_Mitchell_001
Array.english: Oh...a <color=#F1DC2B>manager</color> huh...You think I can handle it?
Array.indonesia: Oh... <color=#F1DC2B>manajer</color> ya... Menurutmu aku bisa mengatasinya?

Array.name: Staff_Talk_Manager_Mitchell_002
Array.english: Don't worry! I will guide you!
Array.indonesia: Jangan khawatir! Aku akan membimbingmu!

Array.name: Staff_Talk_Manager_Mitchell_003
Array.english: Well it sounds like I can count on you, Dave! I'll do my best!
Array.indonesia: Sepertinya aku bisa mengandalkanmu, Dave! Aku akan berusaha sebaik mungkin!

Array.name: Staff_Talk_Manager_Yusuke_001
Array.english: Heh heh. I am the ruler of this place!
Array.indonesia: Heh heh. Aku adalah penguasa tempat ini!

Array.name: Staff_Talk_Manager_James_001
Array.english: ma..muh...ma...manager...
Array.indonesia: ma..muh...ma...manajer...

Array.name: Staff_Talk_Manager_Billy_001
Array.english: Yesss! Let's get this place pumpin' with hot music!
Array.indonesia: Ya! Ayo kita buat tempat ini semarak dengan musik yang asyik!

Array.name: Staff_Talk_Manager_Tohoku_001
Array.english: Entrusting me to be <color=#F1DC2B>manager</color>!?\nI'll work my behind off!
Array.indonesia: Mempercayakan aku jadi <color=#F1DC2B>manajer</color>!?\nAku akan bekerja sekeras-kerasnya!

Array.name: Staff_Talk_Manager_Tohoku_002
Array.english: ...Well, maybe not THAT hard.
Array.indonesia: ...Yah, mungkin nggak SEKERAS itu.

Array.name: Staff_Talk_Manager_Yone_001
Array.english: Wow! Me...a <color=#F1DC2B>Manager</color>?! I'll do my best!
Array.indonesia: Wow! Aku...seorang <color=#F1DC2B>Manajer</color>?! Aku akan berusaha sebaik mungkin!

Array.name: Staff_Talk_Manager_ElNino_001
Array.english: I am El Niño! I'll be the fastest manager you've ever seen!
Array.indonesia: Aku adalah El Niño! Aku akan jadi manajer tercepat yang pernah kalian lihat!

Array.name: Staff_Talk_Manager_Jandi_001
Array.english: Will I be able to handle it?
Array.indonesia: Apakah aku bisa mengatasinya?

Array.name: Staff_Talk_Manager_Jandi_002
Array.english: Please help me out, Dave!
Array.indonesia: Tolong bantu aku, Dave!

Array.name: Staff_Talk_Manager_Pai_001
Array.english: I'm new at this so it won't be easy...
Array.indonesia: Aku masih baru di bidang ini, jadi ini tidak akan mudah...

Array.name: Staff_Talk_Manager_Pai_002
Array.english: But my training will shine through!
Array.indonesia: Tapi hasil latihanku pasti akan terlihat!

Array.name: Staff_Talk_Manager_Charlie_001
Array.english: The role of a <color=#F1DC2B>manager</color> is to streamline the customers dining experience.
Array.indonesia: Peran seorang <color=#F1DC2B>manajer</color> adalah untuk memperlancar pengalaman bersantap para pelanggan.

Array.name: Staff_Talk_Manager_Charlie_002
Array.english: Heh heh. Seems like the perfect job for me. I got this.
Array.indonesia: Heh heh. Sepertinya ini pekerjaan yang sempurna untukku. Aku pasti bisa.

Array.name: Staff_Talk_Manager_Maki_001
Array.english: Me, as a branch <color=#F1DC2B>manager</color>…wow.
Array.indonesia: Aku, sebagai <color=#F1DC2B>manajer</color> cabang… wow.

Array.name: Staff_Talk_Manager_Maki_002
Array.english: You worked hard for it, Maki. You earned it!
Array.indonesia: Kamu telah bekerja keras untuk ini, Maki. Kamu pantas mendapatkannya!

Array.name: Staff_Talk_Manager_Maki_003
Array.english: I'm sure my father would be so happy to see this...
Array.indonesia: Aku yakin ayahku pasti sangat senang melihat ini...

Array.name: Staff_Talk_Manager_CohhCarnage_001
Array.english: Wow!...To think I get to work so closely with someone I admire so much, Dave!
Array.indonesia: Wow!...Siapa sangka aku bisa bekerja begitu dekat dengan seseorang yang sangat aku kagumi, Dave!

Array.name: Staff_Talk_Manager_CohhCarnage_002
Array.english: <size=34>It's just like a game!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ini seperti permainan!!</size>

Array.name: Staff_Talk_Manager_Raptor_001
Array.english: Alright!. I'm the branch <color=#F1DC2B>manager</color> of Bancho Sushi now!
Array.indonesia: Baiklah!. Sekarang aku jadi <color=#F1DC2B>manajer</color> cabang Bancho Sushi!

Array.name: Staff_Talk_Manager_Raptor_002
Array.english: It's an honor.
Array.indonesia: Ini suatu kehormatan.

Array.name: Staff_Talk_Manager_Drae_001
Array.english: Heh heh. So... I can still be a <color=#F1DC2B> manager</color> without knowing much about cooking right?
Array.indonesia: Heh heh. Jadi... aku tetap bisa jadi <color=#F1DC2B>manajer</color> meski nggak tahu banyak soal masak, kan?

Array.name: Staff_Talk_Manager_Raul_001
Array.english: I'm going to make this place into a muscle filled powerhouse of a restaurant!
Array.indonesia: Aku bakal bikin tempat ini jadi restoran yang penuh tenaga dan otot!

Array.name: Staff_Talk_Manager_Raul_002
Array.english: <size=34>Please keep an eye on me!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Tolong awasi aku!</size>

Array.name: Staff_Talk_Manager_Davina_001
Array.english: Hahah! I'll make this place dangerously, thrillingly, awesome!
Array.indonesia: Hahah! Aku akan membuat tempat ini menjadi tempat yang berbahaya, mendebarkan, dan luar biasa!

Array.name: Staff_Talk_Manager_Davina_002
Array.english: Um...Well don't get ahead of yourself.
Array.indonesia: Um... Yah, jangan terlalu terburu-buru.

Array.name: Staff_Talk_Manager_Itsuki_001
Array.english: Like a ninja...how to be somewhere and not be seen...
Array.indonesia: Seperti ninja... cara berada di suatu tempat tanpa terlihat...

Array.name: Staff_Talk_Manager_Itsuki_002
Array.english: Being a <color=#F1DC2B>manager</color> is more than I deserve.
Array.indonesia: Menjadi <color=#F1DC2B>manajer</color> adalah lebih dari yang pantas aku dapatkan.

Array.name: Staff_Talk_Manager_Itsuki_003
Array.english: But if its something new for me to conquer, I can do it!
Array.indonesia: Tapi kalau ini sesuatu yang baru buatku untuk ditaklukkan, aku bisa melakukannya!

Array.name: Staff_Talk_Manager_Masayoshi_001
Array.english: Haha. So that makes me leader of this place!?
Array.indonesia: Haha. Jadi itu berarti aku pemimpin tempat ini!?

Array.name: Staff_Talk_Manager_Masayoshi_002
Array.english: So, this place is my territory now...
Array.indonesia: Jadi, tempat ini sekarang wilayahku...

Array.name: Photozone_Desc_Oarfish_001
Array.english: The giant oarfish sure was huge.\nNo wonder it’s called the lion of the ocean.
Array.indonesia: Ikan dayung raksasa itu memang sangat besar.\nTak heran ia dijuluki singa laut.

Array.name: Photozone_Desc_14160004
Array.english: It’s the baby humpback whale that had gone missing.\nStay close to your mother, now.
Array.indonesia: Itu adalah bayi paus bungkuk yang sempat hilang.\nTetaplah dekat dengan ibumu, ya.

Array.name: Photozone_Desc_14160005
Array.english: It’s the pink dolphin I helped out last time.\nI wonder how it’s going with the boyfriend dolphin.
Array.indonesia: Itu adalah lumba-lumba merah muda yang kubantu terakhir kali.\nAku penasaran bagaimana kabarnya dengan lumba-lumba pacarnya.

Array.name: Photozone_Desc_14160006
Array.english: A turtle is the highlight of an underwater photo!\nI was lucky enough to see the loggerhead sea turtle.
Array.indonesia: Penyu adalah daya tarik utama foto bawah air!\nAku cukup beruntung bisa melihat penyu tempayan.

Array.name: Photozone_Desc_UnderwaterLake
Array.english: A lake located underwater... It was fascinating! \nBut I ran into a scary shark...
Array.indonesia: Sebuah danau yang terletak di bawah air... Sungguh menakjubkan! \nTapi aku bertemu hiu yang menakutkan...

Array.name: Photozone_Desc_RecordRoom_WallArt01
Array.english: The Record Chamber, with the murals and writings of the Sea People.\nFascinating…
Array.indonesia: Ruang Catatan, dengan lukisan dinding dan tulisan-tulisan dari Suku Laut.\nMenarik sekali…

Array.name: Photozone_Desc_14160007
Array.english: The leatherback turtle that seaweed collector Tsuchi had with him…\nWhat was her name…?
Array.indonesia: Penyu tempayan yang dibawa oleh Tsuchi, pengumpul rumput laut…\nSiapa namanya…?

Array.name: Photozone_Desc_14160008
Array.english: It's astounding that this fish could be so flat…\nEvery time I look at the Sunfish I'm still amazed.
Array.indonesia: Sungguh menakjubkan bahwa ikan ini bisa begitu pipih…\nSetiap kali melihat Ikan Matahari, saya masih takjub.

Array.name: Photozone_Desc_GA_Dungeon01_Gate
Array.english: The stone slab in front of the Glacial Area. Its text could be important.
Array.indonesia: Lempengan batu di depan Area Gletser. Teks di atasnya mungkin penting.

Array.name: Photozone_Desc_MantaRay
Array.english: The picture of a Manta Ray at night that took me a lot of effort. I saw this several times, but it still looks awesome.
Array.indonesia: Foto ikan pari manta di malam hari yang butuh usaha keras untuk diambil. Aku sudah melihatnya beberapa kali, tapi tetap terlihat keren.

Array.name: Photozone_Desc_Southern_RightWhale_Dolphins
Array.english: Dolphins in the Glacial Area? Nice to see a school of dolphins here.
Array.indonesia: Lumba-lumba di Area Gletser? Senang melihat sekelompok lumba-lumba di sini.

Array.name: Photozone_Desc_Arandaspis
Array.english: A school of Arandaspis. They look like tadpoles.
Array.indonesia: Sekelompok Arandaspis. Mereka terlihat seperti kecebong.

Array.name: Photozone_Desc_Firefly_Squid
Array.english: It was a really pretty glowing squid. They have an organ that makes them luminous. Amazing!
Array.indonesia: Itu adalah cumi-cumi bercahaya yang sangat indah. Mereka memiliki organ yang membuat tubuhnya bersinar. Luar biasa!

Array.name: Photozone_Desc_Giant_Isopod
Array.english: That thing looks like a giant sow bug. But is it munching on a carcass? Ooh... that’s gross!
Array.indonesia: Makhluk itu terlihat seperti kutu babi raksasa. Tapi apakah ia sedang mengunyah bangkai? Ugh... menjijikkan!

Array.name: Photozone_Desc_Red_Lipped_Batfish
Array.english: Its lips are red, and its face looks like a person...It's incredible that there is a fish like this.
Array.indonesia: Bibirnya merah, dan wajahnya mirip manusia... Sungguh luar biasa ada ikan seperti ini.

Array.name: Photozone_Desc_Coelacanth
Array.english: Is this a living fossil? How did it survive for so long without evolving?
Array.indonesia: Apakah ini fosil hidup? Bagaimana ia bisa bertahan hidup begitu lama tanpa berevolusi?

Array.name: Photozone_Desc_LIons_Mane_Jellyfish
Array.english: To think that such a large jellyfish could exist in the glacial area. Does it have enough to eat?
Array.indonesia: Sungguh tak terbayangkan bahwa ubur-ubur sebesar itu bisa hidup di daerah gletser. Apakah ia punya cukup makanan?

Array.indonesia: Lukisan dinding Suku Laut Kuno!\nAku penasaran apa yang digambarkannya.

Array.name: UI_Merchant_Mushroomer_Talk_003

Array.name: UI_Merchant_Mushroomer_Shop_Talk_001

Array.name: Menu_RainbowCap_Triggerfish_Fishroll_Name
Array.english: Rainbow Cap Triggerfish Fishcake
Array.indonesia: Kue Ikan Triggerfish Topi Pelangi

Array.name: Menu_RainbowCap_Pacificfanfish_Ochazuke_Name
Array.english: Rainbow Cap Pacific Fanfish Ochazuke
Array.indonesia: Ochazuke Ikan Kipas Pasifik dengan Rainbow Cap

Array.name: Menu_RainbowCap_SnubNosedSpiny_Eel_Skewer_Name
Array.english: Rainbow Cap Eel Skewers
Array.indonesia: Tusuk Sate Belut dengan Rainbow Cap

Array.name: Menu_RainbowCap_Triggerfish_Fishroll_Desc
Array.english: A dish made with finely minced Triggerfish meat wrapped around Rainbow Cap and steamed with seaweed. Dip the fishcake in Rainbow Sauce and you can feel the galaxy in your mouth.
Array.indonesia: Hidangan yang terbuat dari daging Ikan Triggerfish yang dicincang halus, dibungkus dengan Rainbow Cap, dan dikukus bersama rumput laut. Celupkan kue ikan ini ke dalam Saus Rainbow, dan kamu akan merasakan sensasi galaksi di mulutmu.

Array.name: Menu_RainbowCap_Pacificfanfish_Ochazuke_Desc
Array.english: An Ochazuke adorned with carefully grilled Pacific Fanfish and colorful Rainbow Cap. The salty, crispy fish fillet and the fluffy, flavorful Rainbow Cap go together as if they were meant to be.
Array.indonesia: Ochazuke yang dihiasi dengan Ikan Kipas Pasifik yang dipanggang dengan hati-hati dan Rainbow Cap yang berwarna-warni. Fillet ikan yang asin dan renyah serta Rainbow Cap yang lembut dan beraroma lezat berpadu seolah-olah memang ditakdirkan untuk bersatu.

Array.name: Menu_RainbowCap_SnubNosedSpiny_Eel_Skewer_Desc
Array.english: Grilled Rainbow Cap and Snub-nosed Spiny Eel skewers. A single dish that captures a multitude of flavors.
Array.indonesia: Tusuk sate Rainbow Cap panggang dan Belut Berduri Hidung Pendek. Satu hidangan yang memadukan beragam rasa.

Array.name: Cooksta_Content_Menu_RainbowCap_Triggerfish_Fishroll
Array.english: Count one star in the night sky, eat one fishcake... That's the life! \n<color=#3a8ed6> #ILove #RainbowCap #Fishcake #bancho_sushi</color>
Array.indonesia: Hitung satu bintang di langit malam, makan satu kue ikan.. . Inilah hidup! \n<color=#3a8ed6> #ILove #RainbowCap #Fishcake #bancho_sushi</color>

Array.name: Cooksta_Content_Menu_RainbowCap_Pacificfanfish_Ochazuke
Array.english: It feels like firecrackers popping on the tip of my tongue! Very thrilling! But... there's no way it's poisonous, right...? .\n<color=#3a8ed6>#bancho_sushi #RainbowCap #Ochazuke</color>
Array.indonesia: Rasanya seperti petasan meledak di ujung lidahku! Sangat mendebarkan! Tapi... tidak mungkin ini beracun, kan...? .\n<color=#3a8ed6>#bancho_sushi #RainbowCap #Ochazuke</color>

Array.name: Cooksta_Content_Menu_RainbowCap_SnubNosedSpiny_Eel_skewer
Array.english: Yesterday I dreamt of a Snub-nosed Spiny Eel in a fancy tuxedo, feeding me Rainbow Caps. What kind of a dream is that?! \n<color=#3a8ed6>#skewers #bancho_sushi #rainbowCap </color>
Array.indonesia: Kemarin aku bermimpi tentang Belut Berduri Hidung Pesek yang mengenakan tuksedo mewah, memberiku Rainbow Cap. Mimpi macam apa itu?! \n<color=#3a8ed6>#skewers #bancho_sushi #rainbowCap </color>

Array.name: RainbowCap_Name
Array.english: Rainbow Cap
Array.indonesia: Rainbow Cap

Array.name: RainbowCap_desc
Array.english: Rainbow Cap is one of the most versatile ingredients. All you have to know is how to properly exploit the properties of this ingredient.
Array.indonesia: Rainbow Cap adalah salah satu bahan yang paling serbaguna. Yang perlu kamu ketahui hanyalah cara memanfaatkan sifat-sifat bahan ini dengan benar.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_Mission_Complete01_001
Array.english: *Winks*
Array.indonesia: *Mengedipkan mata*

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_Mission_Complete01_002
Array.english: Um... Who...are you?
Array.indonesia: Um... Siapa... kamu?

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_Mission_Complete01_003
Array.english: They call me the <color=#F1DC2B>Mushroomer</color>.
Array.indonesia: Mereka memanggilku <color=#F1DC2B>Mushroomer</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_Mission_Complete01_004
Array.english: The Fellow Alchemist told me you guys helped him. *Winking*
Array.indonesia: Rekan Alkemis itu memberitahuku bahwa kalian membantunya. *Mengedipkan mata*

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_Mission_Complete01_005
Array.english: Mushroomer... so does that mean you sell mushrooms?
Array.indonesia: Mushroomer... jadi apakah itu berarti kamu menjual jamur?

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_Mission_Complete01_006
Array.english: Yes! And I have some very fine mushrooms.\n*Winks with the other eye*
Array.indonesia: Ya! Dan aku punya beberapa jamur yang sangat bagus.\n*Mengedipkan mata dengan mata yang lain*

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_Mission_Complete01_007
Array.english: Have you ever heard of <color=#1DFEAF>Rainbow Cap</color>?
Array.indonesia: Pernahkah kamu mendengar tentang <color=#1DFEAF>Rainbow Cap</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_Mission_Complete01_008
Array.english: I cannot say that I have.
Array.indonesia: Aku tidak bisa mengatakan bahwa aku pernah mendengarnya.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_Mission_Complete01_009
Array.english: So indeed, I figured it would be quite difficult to find them in this world…
Array.indonesia: Jadi memang, aku kira akan cukup sulit menemukannya di dunia ini…

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_Mission_Complete01_010
Array.english: To thank you for helping my friend, the Fellow Alchemist, I will give you some <color=#1DFEAF>Rainbow Cap</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>recipes</color>.
Array.indonesia: Sebagai ucapan terima kasih karena telah membantu temanku, sesama Alkemis, aku akan memberimu beberapa <color=#1DFEAF>Rainbow Cap</color> dan <color=#1DFEAF>resep</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_Mission_Complete02_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh…! That's a very mysterious color…!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh…! Warnanya sangat misterius…!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_Mission_Complete02_002
Array.english: But, they say colorful mushrooms are poisonous and shouldn't be eaten...
Array.indonesia: Tapi, katanya jamur berwarna-warni itu beracun dan tidak boleh dimakan...

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_Mission_Complete02_003
Array.english: Haha, do not worry. *Winking*
Array.indonesia: Haha, jangan khawatir. *Mengedipkan mata*

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_Mission_Complete02_004
Array.english: These are safe mushrooms that taste delicious no matter how you cook them.
Array.indonesia: Ini adalah jamur yang aman dan rasanya lezat, apa pun cara memasaknya.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_Mission_Complete02_005
Array.english: <size=33>Try preparing some of the recipes I've given you.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Cobalah memasak beberapa resep yang sudah kuberikan padamu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_Mission_Complete02_006
Array.english: I will also teach Jango how to find this <color=#1DFEAF>Rainbow Cap</color>.
Array.indonesia: Aku juga akan mengajari Jango cara menemukan <color=#1DFEAF>Rainbow Cap</color> ini.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_Mission_Complete02_008
Array.english: <size=35>*Winking*</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>*Mengedipkan mata*</size>

Array.english: A phone charm that resembles a colorful mushroom.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Name_10013036
Array.english: Fellow Alchemist and Magic Cauldron
Array.indonesia: Rekan Alkemis dan Kuali Ajaib

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10057510
Array.english: Find the Magic Cauldron that glows only at night. It was seen near a broken wooden boat.
Array.indonesia: Temukan Kuali Ajaib yang hanya bersinar di malam hari. Kuali itu terlihat di dekat perahu kayu yang rusak.

Array.name: Mission_Condition_10032110
Array.english: Dive at night and find the Magic Cauldron
Array.indonesia: Selami laut di malam hari dan temukan Kuali Ajaib itu

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Mission_01_001
Array.english: Hello, my friend. How do you do?
Array.indonesia: Halo, temanku. Apa kabar?

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Mission_01_002
Array.english: Excuse me? Do I know you?
Array.indonesia: Maaf? Apakah saya mengenal Anda?

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Mission_01_003
Array.english: Haha, I am but a fellow alchemist. It's nice to know you.
Array.indonesia: Haha, saya hanyalah sesama alkemis. Senang bertemu dengan Anda.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Mission_01_004
Array.english: The restaurant is not open yet... how may I help you?
Array.indonesia: Restoran ini belum buka... ada yang bisa saya bantu?

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Mission_01_005
Array.english: Well… While passing through this area... I accidentally dropped my <color=#1DFEAF>Magic Cauldron</color> into the sea.
Array.indonesia: Nah… Saat melewati daerah ini... saya tidak sengaja menjatuhkan <color=#1DFEAF>Kuali Ajaib</color> saya ke laut.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Mission_01_006
Array.english: <size=34>A <color=#1DFEAF>Magic Cauldron</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Sebuah <color=#1DFEAF>Kuali Ajaib</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Mission_01_007
Array.english: Yes, it's a cauldron needed to craft magic potions…but a big wave struck.
Array.indonesia: Ya, itu kuali yang dibutuhkan untuk membuat ramuan sihir… tapi ada gelombang besar yang menghantam.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Mission_01_008
Array.english: Do you know anyone who can swim and help me?
Array.indonesia: Apakah Anda kenal seseorang yang bisa berenang dan membantu saya?

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Mission_01_009
Array.english: Well, I do know how to swim, but…
Array.indonesia: Hmm, saya memang bisa berenang, tapi…

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Mission_01_010
Array.english: Haha! Excellent! Then please help me.
Array.indonesia: Haha! Bagus sekali! Kalau begitu, tolong bantu aku.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Mission_01_011
Array.english: Okay then, tomorrow morning I will…
Array.indonesia: Baiklah, besok pagi aku akan…

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Mission_01_012
Array.english: <size=35>Oh…! My <color=#1DFEAF>Magic Cauldron</color> cannot be found during the day...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh…! <color=#1DFEAF>Kuali Ajaib</color>-ku tidak bisa ditemukan di siang hari...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Mission_01_013
Array.english: <size=35>It glows only at night.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Kuali itu hanya bersinar di malam hari.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Mission_01_014
Array.english: My friend, can you find my precious <color=#1DFEAF>Magic Cauldron</color> for me?
Array.indonesia: Sahabatku, bisakah kamu menemukan <color=#1DFEAF>Kuali Ajaib</color> kesayanganku untukku?

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Mission_01_015
Array.english: Mm, diving at night is dangerous... but alright.
Array.indonesia: Mm, menyelam di malam hari itu berbahaya... tapi baiklah.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Mission_01_016
Array.english: Thank you!\nI think I saw something glowing <color=#F1DC2B>near a broken wooden boat</color>.
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih!\nSepertinya aku melihat sesuatu yang bersinar <color=#F1DC2B>di dekat perahu kayu yang rusak</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Mission_01_017
Array.english: <size=35>Thank you, my friend.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Terima kasih, temanku.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Complete01_001
Array.english: Oh... I see something glowing in your restaurant.
Array.indonesia: Oh... aku melihat sesuatu yang bersinar di restoranimu.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Complete01_002
Array.english: You found it for me, my friend?
Array.indonesia: Kamu menemukannya untukku, temanku?

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Complete01_003
Array.english: Yes. It was quite heavy, and bringing it back wasn't easy.
Array.indonesia: Ya. Itu cukup berat, dan membawanya kembali tidaklah mudah.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Complete01_004
Array.english: Oh, I can't thank you enough. And it's in such pristine condition...
Array.indonesia: Oh, aku tak bisa cukup berterima kasih. Dan kondisinya masih sangat bagus...

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Complete01_005
Array.english: It was for one of my clients. You saved me from a lot of trouble, haha.
Array.indonesia: Itu untuk salah satu klienku. Kamu menyelamatkanku dari banyak masalah, haha.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Complete01_006
Array.english: I would like to give you something as a token of my gratitude.
Array.indonesia: Aku ingin memberimu sesuatu sebagai tanda terima kasihku.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Complete01_007
Array.english: <size=35>It's a <color=#1DFEAF>Magic Mortar</color>.
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ini adalah <color=#1DFEAF>Magic Mortar</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Complete01_008
Array.english: <size=35>A <color=#1DFEAF>Magic Mortar</color>…?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Sebuah <color=#1DFEAF>Magic Mortar</color>…?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Complete01_009
Array.english: Hmm. A mortar, it is a tool to pound or grind ingredients.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Mortar, itu alat untuk menumbuk atau menggiling bahan-bahan.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Complete01_010
Array.english: Correct. But this one is used to craft <color=#F1DC2B>Potions</color> rather than cooking.
Array.indonesia: Benar. Tapi yang ini digunakan untuk membuat <color=#F1DC2B>Ramuan</color>, bukan untuk memasak.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Complete01_011
Array.english: Potions, you say... What are they for?
Array.indonesia: Ramuan, katamu... Untuk apa itu?

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Complete01_012
Array.english: They can temporarily boost the imbiber's stats.
Array.indonesia: Ramuan itu bisa meningkatkan statistik peminumnya untuk sementara waktu.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Complete01_013
Array.english: Especially the ones made with <color=#F1DC2B>Seaweed</color> can boost stats underwater.
Array.indonesia: Terutama yang dibuat dengan <color=#F1DC2B>Rumput Laut</color> bisa meningkatkan statistik saat berada di bawah air.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Complete01_014
Array.english: Oh...! That would be helpful!
Array.indonesia: Oh...! Itu pasti berguna!

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Complete01_015
Array.english: Hm. Can I craft potions with fish as well?
Array.indonesia: Hm. Bisakah aku membuat ramuan dengan ikan juga?

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Complete01_016
Array.english: Meat isn't exactly the right ingredient for potions, given its nature...
Array.indonesia: Daging bukanlah bahan yang tepat untuk ramuan, mengingat sifatnya...

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Complete01_017
Array.english: <size=33>However, you can pound fish to make <color=#F1DC2B>Paste Baits</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Namun, kamu bisa menumbuk ikan untuk membuat <color=#F1DC2B>Umpan Pasta</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Complete01_018
Array.english: Hm. <color=#F1DC2B>Paste Baits</color>... They could be useful for Crab Traps.
Array.indonesia: Hm. <color=#F1DC2B>Umpan Pasta</color>... Itu mungkin berguna untuk Perangkap Kepiting.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Complete01_019
Array.english: Haha, I’m sure it’ll be useful somewhere.
Array.indonesia: Haha, aku yakin itu akan berguna di suatu tempat.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Complete01_020
Array.english: Thank you again. Now, if you will excuse me...
Array.indonesia: Terima kasih sekali lagi. Sekarang, jika kamu mengizinkan...

Array.name: ContentsDesc_MortarPestle_01
Array.english: <size=24>You can craft <color=#F1DC2B>Potions</color> and <color=#F1DC2B>Paste Baits</color> using the Magic Mortar at BANCHO SUSHI!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Anda dapat membuat <color=#F1DC2B>Ramuan</color> dan <color=#F1DC2B>Umpan Pasta</color> menggunakan Lesung Ajaib di BANCHO SUSHI!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_MortarPestle_02
Array.english: <size=24>You can use the <color=#F1DC2B>Potion</color> right after it is crafted,\nor you can store it in the Diver Box to use later.\nTry using <color=#F1DC2B>Bait</color> in the Crab Trap!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_Mission_FindCauldron_001

Array.indonesia: <size=34>Itu pasti <color=#F1DC2B>Kuali Ajaib</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_Mission_FindCauldron_002
Array.english: <size=34>I should carry it to the surface.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aku harus membawanya ke permukaan.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_Mission_CauldronClear_001

Array.indonesia: Wah… Benda ini berat sekali.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_Mission_CauldronClear_002
Array.english: I should bring it to BANCHO SUSHI.
Array.indonesia: Aku harus membawanya ke BANCHO SUSHI.
